job.title: ABC News This Week Production Intern, Spring 2027
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs ABC News This Week Production Intern, Spring 2027 Job ID 10158532 Location Washington, DC, United States Business ABC News Date posted Oct. 29, 2026 ABC News This Week Production Intern, Spring 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

About the Role

& Program: “This Week with George Stephanopoulos” is ABC News flagship public affairs program featuring newsmaker interviews, political analysis, and debates on a wide range of issues! Each week's show includes interviews with top newsmakers (including some of the nation's top political leaders) as well as a roundtable discussion, usually featuring journalists from ABC and other news organizations, of the week's happenings. This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the Washington D.C area from January 2027 - June 2027. Student must be fully available from Thursday through Sunday, 40 hours each week . Thursday through Saturday generally begins at 9:30 a.m. and ends approximately at 6:00 p.m. Sunday requires an in-person 5:00 a.m. start and generally ends by 12 pm. What You Will Do: As an intern with "This Week," you play a vital role within the editorial team! Your

responsibilities

may encompass: Generating and communicating ideas in editorial pitch meetings Conducting background research for headline interviews and roundtable segments Transcribing prerecorded interviews Assisting in the production of the live show on Sunday mornings, including guest greeting Publishing digital stories summarizing headline interviews post-show

Required Qualifications

& Skills: Demonstrated knowledge of politics, current events, and public affairs through coursework, campus media, or related experience. Demonstrated ability to research, evaluate, and synthesize information from multiple sources Demonstrated writing and editing

experience

for news, journalism, or digital media audiences.

Experience

managing multiple projects, prioritizing deadlines, and maintaining attention to detail. Ability to communicate professionally and collaborate effectively in an editorial or production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous internship

experience

in a professional newsroom or editorial environment.

Experience

editing written content for print, digital, or student publications.

Education

Major or coursework in Journalism, Political Science, Communications, Media Studies, Film/Television, or a related field. Undergraduate students in their Junior or Senior year preferred Eligibility Requirements & Program Information: Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Additional Information: Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship Fully available from January 2027 through June 2027 Fully available from Thursday through Sunday, 40 hours each week . Thursday through Saturday generally begins at 9:30 a.m. and ends approximately at 6:00 p.m. Sunday requires an in-person 5:00 a.m. start and generally ends by 12 pm. Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the Washington D.C. area Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work in the Washington D.C. area Materials Requested: A portfolio review is required for this position. For full consideration, please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Applications without a portfolio link on the résumé will not be considered a completed application packet and may not be fully considered for the position. Please visit our support site or additional information. The pay rate for this role in Washington D.C. is $23.00 per hour. Select

benefits

may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our

benefits

visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. Apply Now Save Job About ABC News: The Disney Entertainment Television group creates original entertainment and news content for the Company’s streaming platforms and its cable and broadcast networks. About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call ABC News. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. job.title: Podcast Audience Development Specialist, ABC News Podcasts
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Podcast Audience Development Specialist, ABC News Podcasts Job ID 10163680 Location New York, New York, United States / Bristol, Connecticut, United States / Washington, DC, United States Business ABC News Date posted Oct. 27, 2026 Podcast Audience Development Specialist, ABC News Podcasts Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements ABC News is seeking an enthusiastic and results-driven Podcast Audience Development Specialist to support audience growth, marketing and engagement efforts across the growing ABC News podcast portfolio. This role will work within the Podcast Programming team and collaborate with cross-functional internal and external partners to help audiences discover, engage with, and return to ABC News podcasts across audio, video, social, and digital platforms. The ideal candidate is highly organized, digitally savvy, and passionate about podcasts, news, and audience behavior. They should be comfortable coordinating a multi-platform marketing campaign, analyzing performance data, working with creative assets, and identifying emerging trends and opportunities in the podcast marketplace. This role will support both established ABC News podcast franchises and new launches, helping execute strategies that grow listenership, viewership, engagement, and awareness.

Responsibilities

Support the development and execution of audience growth strategies across the ABC News podcast portfolio, including publicity, paid marketing, social content, and more Create, revise, and deliver creative assets, including audio promos, social posts, video clips and trailers, copy, and other promotional materials for new podcasts Route assets through the appropriate internal and external channels for review and approval, and incorporate feedback into later revisions Work with internal teams and external partners at other podcast networks to identify and execute cross-promotion opportunities Review promotional assets in support of our content that are created by external teams and provide feedback with a critical eye to ensure content aligns with approved brand messaging Track podcast, video, and campaign performance, translating data into actionable insights to inform future strategy recommendations Maintain timetables to communicate deadlines to stakeholders on cross-functional teams and communicate regularly to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule Support platform merchandising and editorial-feature requests around priority programming and launches Coordinate cross-promotion across the ABC News podcast network and identify opportunities to introduce listeners of existing shows to new programming Assist with audience-facing initiatives, including live events, partnerships, subscriptions, and other fan engagement opportunities Manage entries to various awards and maintain a system to keep track of upcoming deadlines and pending submissions Provide additional coordination and administrative support for matters like invoicing, timekeeping, project management, and other podcast initiatives as needed Basic

Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of

experience

in marketing, audience development, digital media, social media, podcasting, entertainment, journalism, or a related field

Experience

supporting social media, YouTube, or other digital audience-development initiatives Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook Strong organizational and project-management skills with demonstrated attention to detail

Experience

editing video in Avid and proficiency in project creation and organization, with a creative knack for developing compelling content Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Strong interest in podcasts, digital media, and emerging audience platforms Familiarity with major podcast, video and social platforms Demonstrated initiative, curiosity and willingness to take on increasing levels of responsibility Ability to respond to changing priorities as news and business needs dictate Strong interest in news, storytelling, and the evolving audio and video landscape

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

working in podcasting strongly preferred.

Experience

working in digital media, streaming, entertainment, or news will also be considered if the candidate has a strong familiarity with the podcast industry outside of work experience. Familiarity with podcast analytics, audience measurement, and digital marketing tools

Experience

with Airtable Knowledge of podcast distribution platforms and the broader podcast marketplace Comfort working on true crime and news content, bearing in mind that the subject matter may be sensitive Required

Education

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent professional experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York is $63,300 to $84,800 per year, and in Washington, D.C., it is $60,400 to $80,900 per year, and in Philadelphia is $57,500 to $77,100, and in Bristol is $60,400 to $80,900. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. The role includes responding to time-sensitive technical issues in a live broadcast environment and providing support outside regular business hours as part of the department’s assigned coverage schedule.

 

  ABOUT ACCUWEATHER   AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.   Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.   AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 225 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Samsung, Vizio, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.   AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.   Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “themost accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history. Myers received the American Meteorological Society’s 2018 Award for Outstanding Contributions to the Advancement of Applied Meteorology and the National Weather Association’s 2017 Lifetime Achievement Award, in addition to numerous other accolades.   COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION   AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.   AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Data Architect I
job.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.

· Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.

· Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.

· Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.

· Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.

· Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.

· Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.

· Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.

· Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.

· Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.

· Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.

· Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

o Demonstrated experience planning or supporting large-scale modernization initiatives for production, customer-facing platforms.

o Experience designing production data platforms for performance, scalability, resiliency, and recoverability.

o Experience analyzing complex system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and scheduling requirements to inform architecture and modernization decisions.

o Demonstrated experience working with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, schema design, and query development.

o Advanced proficiency in Python or Go, with experience developing production-quality code for data platforms or backend systems.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience designing backend data platforms that support data delivery to external or enterprise clients.

o Experience evaluating technology and architecture options, including build-versus-buy decisions and alternative modernization approaches.

o Experience evaluating infrastructure requirements and costs to inform cloud architecture decisions and design trade-offs.

o Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and data governance requirements, including SOC 2 and data residency considerations.

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design architectures that engineering teams can implement and maintain effectively.

o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

o Sound technical judgment, with the ability to translate business and platform requirements into pragmatic architecture without overengineering or underspecifying solutions.

o Ability to move effectively between architecture and hands-on implementation, translating designs into working solutions in collaboration with engineering teams.

o Ability to mentor team members and help develop the architectural judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to independently lead complex, large-scale architecture initiatives and drive technical decisions through ambiguity.

 

About AccuWeather 

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. 

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones. 

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee. 

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally. 

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.  

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a highly creative, curious, and deeply collaborative Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications, to work directly with AccuWeather forecasters and the Writing Committee to further elevate the detail, clarity, precision, and distinctiveness of the language used to describe forecasts for our users. This role is designed for a graduate student or an individual with equivalent writing experience who brings fresh thinking about how complex weather information can be expressed in ways that are more detailed, precise, clear, engaging, and scientifically sound.

Embedded closely with Forecast Operations, this position will learn from meteorologists, participate in the forecast-writing process, and help develop new approaches, terminology, and descriptive frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more informative and better than what is available from any other source. The emphasis is on improving the consumer forecast experience - not traditional public relations - by helping forecasters communicate what the weather will be, what the impact will be, how it will evolve, what it may look like, and what details matter most to people making decisions. This includes a laser focus on developing stronger displays, greater artistry, and more effective visual communications that amplify the advantages of AccuWeather forecasts and content.

The Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications will serve as a bridge between meteorological expertise and exceptional consumer-facing writing, helping AccuWeather deliver forecast descriptions with greater depth, nuance, consistency, and usefulness while preserving the scientific accuracy and authority at the core of the AccuWeather brand.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Language, Detail & Description:

  • Work side-by-side with forecasters to craft and refine accurate, detailed, consumer-focused descriptions of daily weather, changing conditions, major storms, seasonal patterns, and forecast developments.
    • Elevate forecast language beyond basic conditions by identifying the most useful details, nuances, timing, impacts, transitions, and sensory descriptions that help users better understand what to expect. Use bold, catchy and descriptive language.
    • Translate complex meteorological concepts into clearer, more detailed, consumer-friendly language without sacrificing scientific meaning, accuracy, or appropriate expressions of forecast confidence.
    • Develop new descriptive approaches, vocabulary, sentence structures, and frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more distinctive, informative, and useful than competing forecast experiences.
    • Help establish consistent terminology for recurring weather patterns while preserving enough flexibility for forecasters to communicate the unique character and details of each forecast.

 

Forecaster & Writing Committee Collaboration:

  • Embed with AccuWeather forecasters to understand how forecasts are created, where language choices can add value, and how writing can better communicate meteorological insight to users.
    • Work closely with the AccuWeather Writing Committee to test, evaluate, and introduce new approaches to forecast writing and description.
    • Bring an outside writing perspective to established forecast workflows, asking thoughtful questions and proposing new ways of thinking, writing, and working.
  • Challenge conventional approaches to forecast description and explore new ways to communicate weather that provide users with greater detail, context, understanding, and value.
    • Gather feedback from meteorologists and other stakeholders, iterate on language, and help turn successful approaches into practical writing guidance and repeatable standards.
    • Support a collaborative environment in which meteorological expertise and strong writing work together to create a richer forecast experience.

 

Consumer Forecast Experience & Innovation:

  • Review forecast descriptions across AccuWeather consumer experiences and identify opportunities to add specificity, context, clarity, and useful detail.
    • Develop and test language that helps users better understand the timing, intensity, duration, variability, uncertainty, and real-world impacts of weather events.
  • Explore new ways to make routine forecasts more useful, engaging, descriptive, and impactful, bringing the same level of creativity and attention to detail to both high-impact weather coverage and everyday conditions such as temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, humidity, visibility, and changing conditions.
    • Help ensure forecast descriptions are clear and effective across digital platforms while retaining the depth and detail that distinguish AccuWeather.
    • Contribute ideas that reinforce AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™ through the quality, precision, and usefulness of the forecast language itself.

 

Writing Standards & Continuous Improvement:

  • Help evolve AccuWeather’s authoritative, trustworthy, detailed, and forward-looking forecast voice.
    • Identify new ways to describe weather phenomena that are vivid, memorable, consumer-relevant, and scientifically sound.
    • Contribute to forecast-writing standards, terminology guidelines, examples, and best practices used by forecasters and content teams.
    • Study how forecast language performs in practice and recommend improvements based on clarity, usefulness, consistency, and differentiation.
    • Encourage experimentation and fresh thinking while respecting operational requirements, meteorological accuracy, and established review processes.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Writing, or a closely related writing-intensive field is required.

job.title: General Counsel
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a dynamic General Counsel to join its leadership team. The General Counsel leads AccuWeather's Legal Services team and serves as chief legal advisor to the CEO and business leaders across a global B2C digital media business, and enterprise B2B weather-data and insights business, and a linear broadcast/OTT network. This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.
  • Build and own the company's internal AI governance framework and advise the business on legal and regulatory risk arising from its own use and development of AI.
  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

Commercial & Corporate Transactions

  • Negotiate and draft high-value commercial agreements, including content and technology licensing, strategic partnerships and alliances, and ad-tech platform arrangements.
  • Serve as lead legal advisor on M&A, divestitures, joint ventures, and corporate investment transactions.
  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

Data Privacy, Cybersecurity & Regulatory

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

Corporate Governance & Board Support

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • JD and 15+ years of relevant experience, including service as General Counsel or senior in-house counsel in a corporate environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI legal tools and a demonstrated record of using AI to drive legal-department efficiency (not just familiarity, but hands-on experience selecting, implementing, or championing AI tools in a legal setting).
  • Broad intellectual property experience, including patent law, IP licensing, and IP due diligence.
  • Working familiarity with employment law and compliance investigations (DOL/OFCCP).
  • Proven ability to negotiate and draft complex, high-value contracts and to quickly analyze agreements from varied origins.
  • Strong executive presence; able to advise and present to senior management, the Board, and international clients and partners.
  • Experience managing a team of attorneys and legal support staff and managing outside counsel cost-effectively.
  • Experience with corporate governance matters involving a Board of Directors.
  • General knowledge of tax laws and standards as they relate to corporate transactions.
  • Must reside in State College, PA, or be willing to relocate to the State College area.

Preferred

  • Experience in digital media, broadcast/OTT, or a comparable data- or platform-driven industry.
  • Exposure to board governance, M&A processes, or strategic planning cycles.
  • Experience directing strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Experience managing or coordinating cross-functional teams without direct authority.

job.description:
AccuWeather is expanding its Marketing team and looking a Go-to-Market & Industry Marketing Manager to join its growing team. The Go-to-Market & Industry Marketing Manager supports the execution of AccuWeather's go-to-market strategy across priority industries and strategic growth initiatives. This role partners closely with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to develop industry-specific messaging, customer stories, sales enablement materials, campaigns, webinars, and market-facing programs that accelerate enterprise growth. 

The ideal candidate is an execution-oriented marketer who enjoys translating customer insights and business strategy into repeatable go-to-market programs. This individual will help operationalize industry marketing initiatives, support multiple strategic growth priorities, and continuously improve how AccuWeather brings solutions to market.

Industry Go-to-Market Execution

  • Create and maintain industry landing pages, webinars, campaigns, nurture programs, and supporting marketing assets.  
  • Support industry-specific product launches and commercialization initiatives.

  • Conduct customer interviews, market research, and competitive analysis to support go-to-market planning.  
  • Monitor industry trends, emerging customer needs, buying center evolution, and competitive positioning.  
  • Translate market insights into messaging, campaign recommendations, and customer-facing content.  
  • Maintain industry personas, use cases, and supporting documentation.

  • Partner with Sales and Business Development to support strategic account planning and executive meetings.  
  • Ensure customer-facing messaging remains consistent across campaigns, presentations, and outbound programs.  
  • Support development of case studies, testimonials, and industry-specific success stories.

  • Execute industry webinars, customer panels, conference follow-up campaigns, and thought leadership initiatives.  
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Creative Services, and Digital Marketing to deliver integrated campaigns.  
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities supporting strategic growth initiatives.  
  • Support AI-assisted marketing workflows and identify opportunities to improve campaign execution through automation.  

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Creative Services.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of AccuWeather's go-to-market processes and marketing effectiveness.

  • Excellent written communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.

  • Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS, APIs, data, AI, or technology solutions.

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with national, regional, and trade media; providing strategic guidance to secure high-impact coverage of AccuWeather's news and content; shaping compelling narratives around AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™, products, innovation, leadership, and enterprise solutions; and supporting executive visibility. Manager, Public Relations Strategy will serve as a key strategic advisor, ensuring consistent, timely, and accurate messaging across earned media channels in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment.

  • Draft, edit, and oversee the distribution of press releases, media advisories, statements, talking points, FAQs, and executive messaging
  • Lead proactive media outreach strategy to secure coverage highlighting AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™, innovation, thought leadership, AccuWeather For Business solutions, and the AccuWeather Network

  • Manage communications during significant weather events and time-sensitive situations

  • Support executive visibility initiatives and thought leadership opportunities
  • Maintain organized media lists, press materials, messaging documents, and coverage archives

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field
  • 2-4+ years of progressive experience in media relations, public relations, or corporate communications
  • Proven track record of securing national and top-tier media coverage
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills

  • Strong understanding of AP Style and media best practices

job.title: Storm Warning Meteorologist
job.description:
We are seeking a full-time meteorologist with outstanding forecasting and communication skills to join our family of Storm Warning Meteorologists at the AccuWeather Severe Weather Center in Wichita, Kansas. We are looking for someone who is energetic, driven, team oriented and has a proactive work ethic. This is a fast-paced environment where the goal is to save lives, protect property and help clients maximize weather-related opportunities while minimizing weather-related risks. If you would like to contribute to a highly professional team that also knows how to have fun along the way, then this opening is for you! 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

As a Storm Warning Meteorologist, you will have opportunities to handle all types of hazardous weather forecasting and issue weather warnings for major business, transportation, education, media, and government organizations. These include:  

  • Utilize internal warning software to create your own customized, site-specific hazardous weather warnings (tornado, wind, flash flood, hurricane, etc.) independent of government agencies. 
  • Create hazardous weather forecast graphics and customized text discussions for transportation and other specialized clients across North America. 
  • Daily interaction with clients that need to make immediate operational weather-related decisions. 
  • Use internal computer applications. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

  

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Bachelor’s in Meteorology or Atmospheric Sciences. 
  • Refined customer service skills. 
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines. 
  • Great attention to detail. 
  • Ability to process meteorological data and make swift, accurate warning decisions. 
  • Ability to interact with and collaborate professionally with other members of the forecasting team.

job.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Accounts Payable Specialist may specialize in a variety of different accounting areas related to company invoicing and payment processing. The AP Specialist will focus on the processing of invoices and the payment of company expenses. Responsibilities may include month end close duties and reporting, and other administrative or ad hoc projects as assigned.

Essential Functions

  • Review invoices, road checks, purchase card transactions, and other expenditures for accuracy, and enter and appropriate code into JD Edwards.
  • Contact vendors to request missing invoices and/or request changes to where invoices are being submitted.
  • Review T&E reports in Concur to ensure expenses are valid and employees are submitting proper receipts and support for all expenditures
  • Assist the accounting department as needed in filling out required forms for Wire Payments, Road Checks and Withholding Tax forms
  • Assist the accounting department with filling out and submitting new or change vendor forms
  • Contact vendors as needed to verbally verify payment information

job.title: Database Engineer II
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

 

AXS actively seeking a Database Engineer to provide quality, scalable data solutions for AXS products. The candidate will be expected to collaborate to design and then develop, implement, and optimize critical databases, processes and reports to achieve business goals and support the development and data platform teams.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain relational and NoSQL databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Aurora, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Integrate database deployments into CI/CD pipelines to enable automated schema migrations, rollback, and testing.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) for database provisioning (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible).
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure database performance, health, and security.
  • Optimize database queries, indexes, and execution plans to improve performance and reduce costs.
  • Manage high availability, replication, backup, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Collaborate with developers, SREs, and DevOps engineers to ensure smooth and secure application-to-database integration.
  • Enforce security best practices, including encryption, key management (AWS KMS/CMK), access control, and compliance with data regulations.
  • Automate routine operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis.
 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience as a Database Engineer / DBA with at least 3+ years in a DevOps/Cloud environment.
  • Proficiency with PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server,  Aurora (at least one deeply, others working knowledge).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Liqbase,  GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Expertise in cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure/GCP a plus).
  • Solid understanding of database security, encryption, and auditing.
  • Solid understand on Kafka cluster. 
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills

 

 

Pay Scale: $100,000-$120,000

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. 

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

*There will be an in-person onsite component as part of our interview process.

 

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

 

More about AXS

 

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

 

 

More about AEG

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

The AEG owned and operated arena continues to distinguish itself as the host of major, high-profile events of national and international distinction including the 2004, 2011 & 2018 NBA All-Star Games, 2002 & 2017 NHL All-Star Games, 2000 Democratic National Convention, 2009 World Figure Skating Championships and 21 GRAMMY Awards shows. 
 
For a quarter of a century, Crypto.com Arena has been marked with performances and special events that brought international stature to the downtown Los Angeles venue including concerts headlined by Taylor Swift, Drake, Beyoncé, Prince, U2, Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, Usher, Jay-Z, Keith Urban, Roger Waters, Britney Spears, Katy Perry, Ed Sheeran, Kendrick Lamar, Michael Bublé, Carrie Underwood and Justin Timberlake, as well as world championship boxing, family shows and other live events. 
 
Crypto.com Arena is not only a great venue for sports and entertainment, but it also holds a special place in the hearts of the local community. The arena has witnessed many historic moments, unforgettable performances, and become an iconic landmark in the region for the most popular and important events.

Job Summary:

The Event Crew Lead is responsible for carrying out tasks set by the Operations Management team for arena setups and events. The incumbent coordinates with the Operations Manager and Event Crew supervisor the daily objectives for the Event Crew staff.

Essential Functions:

  • Complete set-ups, breakdowns, and repairs including: meeting rooms, seat repairs and removals, glass repair, ice maintenance, etc. Entrance set-ups and occasional loading dock tasks.
  • Act as lead in the absence of the supervisor and ensure team receives instructions for the day’s objectives.
  • Communicate completion or pass down of event set-up, breakdowns or repairs to management.
  • Inform management of any maintenance, damage, or equipment that needs repairs that staff comes across while completing regular duties.
  • Attend mandatory training to ensure safety compliance such as, proper lifting technique, use of tools, etc.
  •  Communicate to management team during emergency situations, ensuring timely and effective coordination of response efforts.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management to support operational and organizational objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency.
  • A minimum of 2-4 years of related work experience.
  • A general knowledge of event related setups and breakdowns.
  • Basic knowledge of hand tools.
  • Basic computer skills with the ability to learn required business systems.
  • The ability to understand verbal and written instructions in English to perform tasks.
  • Must be able to climb stairs and ladders.
  • Must be able to stand/walk for long periods of time and have the ability to regularly lift or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift or move up to 100 pounds.
  • Strong organizational skills and proven experience.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize multiple projects.
  • Ability to perform work in a safe and efficient manner.

  • Ability to work long irregular hours for an extended period of time as dictated by events and schedule (including nights, weekends and holidays).

job.title: LA Galaxy, Producer- Video & Content
job.description:
LA Galaxy is where soccer, culture, and community come together. As one of Major League Soccer’s most storied clubs, the Galaxy deliver unforgettable matchdays and moments that connect fans across Los Angeles and beyond.

Owned by AEG, the LA Galaxy are powered by teams who bring energy, creativity, and commitment to everything they do, from matchday operations and fan engagement to the work that happens behind the scenes. Every role plays a part in shaping the experience on and off the pitch and building a club that reflects the city it represents.   If you want to be part of a team where your work shows up live, in real time, and in front of passionate fans, there’s a place for you here. Because on matchday, it happens here.

Job Summary

The Apple TV Video and Content Producer for the LA Galaxy will plan, produce, and elevate all video content created for our recurring Apple TV programming. This includes both short‑form and long‑form storytelling that will also be repurposed across the club's owned and operated channels.

The incumbent will lead the end‑to‑end production of original content, oversee post‑production workflows, manage video platforms, and support broadcast and external partners with footage requests. This role requires regular domestic and international travel to capture content for scheduled events and club initiatives.

Additionally, this position will help conceptualize and execute creative motion graphics for visual communications including in‑stadium videoboards and LED displays along with digital content for websites, social media, and video‑based advertising for the LA Galaxy and Dignity Health Sports Park.

Essential Functions

  • Plans, oversees, and produces a wide range of video content (documentary‑style features, comedy segments, news pieces, sizzle reels, highlight packages, commercial spots, PSAs, etc.) for the LA Galaxy, Marketing, Digital, Ticket Sales, Partnerships, and Dignity Health Sports Park.
  • Conceptualizes and provides creative guidance for Corporate Partnerships and Marketing on commercial spots, branded content series, and partner‑driven storytelling.
  • Captures video content on the field, at training sessions, in studio environments, and on production sets across scheduled events at DHSP and other locations (special events, PR appearances, away games). Responsibilities include filming, lighting design, audio recording, and conducting interviews for video productions.
  • Maintains the LA Galaxy Digital Asset Management platform by uploading and organizing new content for cross‑departmental use.
  • Collaborates with Design, Digital, Video Production, Photo (Creative Services), and Game Presentation teams to develop motion graphics for LA Galaxy and DHSP videoboards and LED boards, including matchup assets, player animations, goal and win animations, and other in‑stadium visuals.
  • Oversees the design, creation, and implementation of graphics, animations, and subtitling to ensure alignment with LA Galaxy brand standards established by Creative Services and Brand Marketing.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In Video Production, Media Production or a related area
  • 2-4 years In a videographer or content editing role
  • 2-4 years Industry specific experience is preferred
  • Experience with a professional sports team is a plus
  • Must have an excellent proficiency of non-linear software (i.e. Final Cut Pro, Premier) as well as a mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Proactive, highly organized, and resourceful with great attention to details
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize workload efficiently and quickly
  • Proactive and have the ability to work independently without the need for supervision.
  • Ability to multi-task, meet tight timelines, and work effectively in a high pressure and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to professionally handle highly sensitive and confidential information
  • Must be creative, idea-oriented, and thrive in a collaborative team-based environment
  • Must be technically proficient with MS Office.
  • Efficient and skilled in Adobe After Effects, ensuring smooth, timely, and accurate execution of motion‑based deliverables.
  • Outstanding written and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to professionally communicate and interact with all levels of management, staff, etc.
  • Ability to carry and maneuverer equipment efficiently of 40 lbs. or more
  • Proficiency in Spanish preferred

job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Marketing Manager- Festivals is responsible for all marketing assets for festivals on calendar.  This position will work in conjunction with artist management, Radio/TV, and marketing team to create and develop an effective marketing plan that will reach the correct demographic and target customers appropriate for each show.  The Marketing Manager will develop graphic content used to inform the general public of shows for the purpose of gaining ticket sales.  This position will also be responsible for maintaining and tracking budgets to make sure funds are allocated correctly.  The Marketing Manager will oversee social media accounts and ensure they are up to date with engaging material.

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for development and execution of marketing and promotional plans. Collaborates with festival directors, talent buyers, and marketing director to plan and oversee the marketing spend.
  • Generate and adhere to marketing budget. Book and account for all advertising and media ensuring funds are allocated to correct partners. Prepare advertising settlements for each show
  • Oversee Social Media accounts for each show.  Develop ad copy; implement ad schedules to appeal to a specific demographic and target customer.
  • Oversee and evaluate show performance, making adjustments to meet marketing strategy in changing market or competitive conditions
  • Supervise publicity, advance press interviews, secure and coordinate artist availability for promotions with management, label and public relations agencies.
  • Develop and pitch promotions to media outlets.  Contact radio and schedule radio time and set up giveaways.  Negotiate rates and contracts with various media outlets
  • Develop additional marketing opportunities to increase ticket sales when needed.   Keep up with current marketing and social media trends to brainstorm new ideas and concepts for assets and promotions to market events.
  • Work with marketing team and artist management to strategize new ways to market shows and reach the correct audience.   Request graphics for ecards, banners, posters, social media post, radio station needs and e-mails
  • May be responsible for overseeing interns and assistants.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4 years) in Marketing/ Business Communications, PR Preferred
  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • 4-6 years Experience with media buying
  • May be responsible for overseeing interns and assistants.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Knowledge of social media and online marketing initiatives and strategies
  • Must be internet savvy
  • Proficient in Photoshop and MS Office
  • Creative, detail-oriented person who can juggle multiple tasks

job.description:

Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

Job Summary

The Manager Operations will oversee operations and perform management functions at venues and events throughout the region. The Manager Operations will be responsible for day-to-day operations; marketing shows, working with the General Manager to ensure all event needs are met, and working with the production team to advance the shows at their assigned venue ensuring the artist contract is properly fulfilled within the show budget. This position will work closely with staff to provide a high-level customer service to ensure a friendly, safe environment at all events, and work with operations team on developing policies and procedures, assist with planning and cost estimates. Additionally, the Manager Operations will handle daily administration, oversee equipment and supplies inventory, and provide input on venue improvements.

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for project managing shows. In constant contact with client or tour managers to make sure all needs of the show are met, addressed and resolved; review artist contracts related to production, merchandise, ticketing, and rider requirements.
  • Work closely with operations team on developing policies and procedures, assisting in operations planning and cost estimates, and overseeing staff for assigned venues and projects.
  • Ensure a high level of customer service, oversee day of show operations at venue. Manage backstage area of venue ensuring artist hospitality needs are met, this includes preparing greenrooms and being a resource to artists and their crew to answer any questions they may have.
  • Responsible for the day-to-day office administrative work including staff schedules, timekeeping, hiring, supervising and monitoring of staff performance. Work with staff to create a friendly, safe environment at all events through proper training.
  • Ensure all events have adequate equipment and supplies to function properly. Work with members of the operations team to procure these items at the most competitive price. Negotiate vendor contracts and maintain good working relationship with vendors.
  • Engage in venue improvements and capital projects by providing recommendations for improvements and working with management team to obtain bids, develop ROI (Return on Investment) analyses, and oversee projects to completion. Ensure venue is ready for opening and reporting any maintenance/supply needs to GM.
  • Responsible for day of show settlement, prepare invoices and handle payroll discrepancies.

Required Qualifications

  • 4-6 years Of related work experience

  • Ability to create practical, audience-specific content, including articles, playbooks, checklists, job aids, tutorials, and learning resources.
  • Knowledge of information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, search optimization, content governance, and content lifecycle management.
  • Ability to structure accurate, current, searchable, reusable content for users and future AI-enabled search or chatbot experiences.
  • Proficiency using generative AI tools to support content analysis, drafting, summarization, tagging, search-gap analysis, and workflow improvement.

job.description:

Job Summary

The Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Administrator & Solutions Engineer owns the health of AEG Presents' marketing automation platform while designing and building the technical solutions that power it. This role blends the day-to-day discipline of a platform administrator — governance, data hygiene, and deliverability — with the build-it mindset of a solutions engineer, using AMPscript, SQL, and APIs to turn business requirements from the Personalization, CRM, and Analytics teams into scalable, well-documented technical solutions inside SFMC. The SFMC Administrator & Solutions Engineer will act as a trusted advisor, shaping how Salesforce Marketing Cloud is leveraged within the broader Martech ecosystem to drive fan engagement, unlock revenue opportunities, and deliver personalized

Essential Functions

  • Administer the Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) platform, including user access, business unit configuration, and security settings.

  • Deep understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, etc.)
