job.title: Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

 

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

 

  • Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
  • Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
  • Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
  • Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
  • Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

 

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
  • 4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
  • Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
  • Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
  • Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
  • Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
  • Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
  • Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Bonus:  This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Job Summary

The Sr. Accountant is responsible for financial reporting, including the reconciliation of the balance sheet and the monthly reforecasting. The Sr. Accountant enters, codes, and approves invoices, road checks and expenses and will also be responsible for preparing the monthly closing, journal entries, balance sheet analysis, expense coding, maintaining show files, settling shows and miscellaneous accounting projects as assigned. The Sr. Accountant is accountable for monthly accounting entries in the general ledger including invoices, petty cash, T&E, corporate credit cards, royalties and insurance. This position works in conjunction with Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting and is a contributing member of the finance team that oversees all financials for venue/region.

Essential Functions

  • Review and reconciliation of balance sheet, general ledger, accounts receivables and accounts payables.
  • Review and coding of invoices, road checks, cash receipts, p-card transactions and expenses. Create and code invoices for outstanding receivables. Obtain proper approval and code to specific events. Audits show file for tour and co-promotion settlements.
  • Responsible for monthly accounting entries in general ledger including invoicing rental clients, 3rd party processing, petty cash, T&E, corporate credit cards, royalties, and insurance.
  • Enter cash receipts and road checks for region into JDE and code to appropriate department. Review event settlements for accuracy and process road checks and cash receipts through AP.
  • Works in conjunction with Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting for department/venue to prepare annual budgeting and reforecasting based on monthly and annual projected sales. Complete the month end close and show and tour reconciliation.
  • Management of audits, including compilation of data for appropriate inquiries. Organize payroll audits for regional venues and offices.
  • Liaison with CAPs and part-time employees. Ensuring that staff needs are met and payroll conflicts are resolved in a timely manner to reduce compliance liability - check requests, rate discrepancies, and payroll audits.
  • Analyzes cost data to determine return on investment on partnership deals and renewals.
  • Annual management of building permits and renewals.
  • May assist in show settlement as necessary for unassigned shows or tours.

  • Experience with JDE, ImageNow, and Concur
  • Knowledge of basic accounting principles

job.title: Sr. Director, Business Development - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Senior Director of Business Development will drive AXS’s growth across the sports industry by identifying, developing, and closing new partnerships with teams, leagues, venues, and other rights holders. Reporting to the Vice President of Business Development, this role will manage the full business development lifecycle, from market development and prospecting through solution design, financial modeling, negotiation, contracting and transition to implementation.

The Senior Director will build trusted relationships with senior decision makers, develop customized partnership strategies, and clearly communicate AXS’s ticketing capabilities. This individual will work closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to create compelling proposals, structure commercially sound agreements, and ensure organizational alignment through the sales process.

The ideal candidate combines deep sports industry knowledge, strong commercial judgement, and a proven ability to navigate complex, long-term sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

What Will You Do?

  • Financial Proposals and Negotiations: Manage financial proposals and lead contract negotiations for new partnerships and renewals, ensuring terms that support long-term objectives.

  • Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy and advocate for best practices in data management, facilitating smooth handoffs to Customer Success.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with potential partners and lead efforts to secure and coordinate meetings that drive business opportunities.
  • Sales Tools and Resources: Evolve sales tools, presentations, and contracts to meet marketplace needs and communicate AXS's value proposition.
  • Messaging and Content: Develop messaging and content that clearly articulate AXS's unique value across products, services, and verticals.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field
  • 6+ years' experience in Business Development and ticketing or live entertainment
  • Strong experience with identifying opportunities, developing strategies, and negotiating creative solutions
  • Experience negotiating and executing contracts.
  • Experience in evolving sales tools, presentations, and messaging to align with market trends.
  • Experience representing a company at industry events and tradeshows, with the ability to network and generate leads.
  • Strong understanding of the sports and live entertainment ecosystem, including teams, leagues, venues, promoters, and other rights holders.
  • Knowledge of ticketing technology, primary and secondary distribution, pricing, inventory management, data, marketing, sponsorship, and venue operations.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, develop revenue models, and structure mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Consultative selling skills and the ability to translate a prospective partner’s business objectives into a customized solution
  • Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to communicate complex technology and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for client meetings, industry conferences, events, and internal collaboration

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary

The primary responsibilities of the Touring Project Manager are to support the successful execution of tours and live events by coordinating logistics, operational planning, and cross-functional communication. This role serves as a key operational partner to Touring Managers, exercising independent judgment and discretion in managing project timelines, prioritizing tasks, coordinating resources, and resolving routine operational challenges. The Touring Project Manager supports advancing activities, event settlements, documentation management, and stakeholder communications to ensure tours are delivered efficiently and in accordance with company standards. Additionally, this role maintains strong relationships with venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments while proactively identifying operational risks and escalating significant issues when necessary.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day operational execution of tours, events, and live entertainment engagements.
  • Coordinate tour logistics, schedules, timelines, travel arrangements, and operational deliverables.
  • Manage project timelines and ensure key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Support show advancing activities, including venue coordination, artist requirements, production needs, and operational planning.
  • Assist with day-of-show settlements, event reconciliation, and operational documentation.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments regarding assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with artists, managers, promoters, venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
  • Monitor project progress and identify potential operational risks, delays, or challenges.
  • Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing competing operational demands and recommending solutions to support successful event execution.
  • Coordinate internal follow-up activities across Booking, Touring, Production, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, schedules, budgets, reports, settlement materials, and operational records.
  • Support expense tracking, budget monitoring, and financial reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, artist riders, venue requirements, and company operational standards.
  • Escalate significant operational issues, financial concerns, or project risks to Touring Managers and leadership when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, operational efficiencies, and enhanced event execution.
  • Represent the company professionally during events, site visits, meetings, and business travel.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Entertainment Management, Event Management, Communications, Music Business, or a related field; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in project management, event operations, concert promotion, venue operations, artist relations, or related live entertainment roles.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, events, tours, or operational initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of live event operations, touring logistics, event production, and artist relations.
  • Experience supporting show advancing, event execution, settlements, and operational planning.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating projects, prioritizing resources, and resolving operational issues.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience collaborating across multiple departments and managing external stakeholder relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, event management software, and project management tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Knowledge of current trends and best practices within the live entertainment and touring industries.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

Payscale: $55,000-$65,000

Bonus:This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship.  AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

job.title: Utility Operator (Crypto.com Arena)
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Utility Operator controls and shades cameras during events for Crypto.com Arena.

Essential Functions:

  • Work with the camera operators to prepare the proper connection and operation at the Camera Control Unit (CCU). This includes properly connecting the camera with the camera cable to the assigned port at one of the media panels. This includes running the cable from the panel to the camera location and making sure any points along the run are taped to the ground with non-stick gaffer’s tape at any point that is considered a trip hazard.
  • During the game, will provide support as the handheld camera is requested to move around to get shots. This includes making sure the extra cable staged by the camera is kept organized and fed out and wrapped up neatly as the camera operator moves from their original position.
  • Act as a guide to the camera operator ensuring their safety from their blind side and behind them. May also need to make supply runs back to the control room such as fresh batteries or tape or a replacement headset.
  • Lift and/or carry a handheld camera which can weigh up to 30 lbs.
  • Must be able to spend time on their feet or be seated throughout the shift, including moving from a seated position to standing and moving quickly such as an unexpected time out that requires quick action.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency.
  • A minimum of two years of related work experience.
  • Ability to lift heavy objects, walk, sit and move quickly.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment.
  • Must be able to focus on their job in front of very large crowd.
  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds either sitting or standing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to perform a proper “over/under” cable wrap a plus.

Pay scale: $70.00

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification).

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for an experienced Mobile Marketing Manager to help drive worldwide customer acquisition through our mobile advertising channels. This person will build and manage the execution of highly impactful acquisition campaigns, and test into white space opportunities. An entrepreneurial spirit, a creative mindset for pushing boundaries, and the ability to work effectively with a large number of partners and international stakeholders are some of the key skills we are looking for.


We Are Looking For Candidates With
• A hands-on growth mindset and the ability to develop, launch, and scale mobile app acquisition programs that drive measurable customer and business growth.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate campaign, customer, and market data into clear investment and optimization decisions.
• The ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and independently drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution.
• A strong test-and-learn orientation, with the ability to identify new growth opportunities across channels, partners, audiences, creative, and emerging marketing capabilities.
• The ability to work across marketing, product, analytics, technology, finance, and creative teams to solve complex acquisition and measurement challenges.



Key job responsibilities
• Own and scale Amazon Music’s worldwide mobile app acquisition strategy across major paid media channels, identifying where and how we invest to efficiently acquire high-value customers.
• Own campaign strategy, investment allocation, experimentation, and performance optimization across channels including Google App Campaigns, paid social, Apple Search Ads, programmatic/DSPs, and emerging mobile acquisition partners.
• Oversee and continuously improve mobile measurement, attribution, tracking, and data access to evaluate campaign and customer performance, including ROI and downstream business outcomes. Establish scalable reporting and optimization processes.
• Translate campaign and customer performance into actionable investment decisions, identifying opportunities to scale, optimize, test, or redirect spend.
• Develop and execute a rigorous test-and-learn roadmap across existing and emerging channels, partners, targeting approaches, creative strategies, and mobile acquisition capabilities.
• Build and manage strategic relationships with key advertising platforms, mobile ecosystem partners, and technology providers, identifying opportunities to improve performance and unlock new capabilities.
• Collaborate closely with product, technical, finance, business intelligence, creative, and business teams to execute complex, time-sensitive growth initiatives and improve the end-to-end mobile acquisition experience.
• Partner with mobile marketing teams across Amazon to establish best practices, leverage shared capabilities and partner relationships, and advance a unified approach to mobile acquisition.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience with mobile DSPs, Google App Campaigns, and/or familiarity with ad-fraud prevention mechanisms/tools
- Experience partnering cross-functionally with analytics, product, engineering, and/or creative teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust and a strong understanding of mobile attribution.
- Experience optimizing acquisition against downstream outcomes such as subscription, retention, LTV, or ROAS—not solely installs.
- Experience with mobile DSPs, third-party app networks, and/or fraud-prevention solutions.
- Experience with SKAN and privacy-preserving mobile measurement.
- Experience managing large-scale or multi-country acquisition programs.
- Subscription, consumer technology, media, or entertainment experience.

As a Senior UX Designer focused on the visual experience for millions of fans worldwide, you'll own large, complex design projects end to end, from customer research and early concept through evaluation and delivery, creating immersive experiences that delight customers across our suite of surfaces. This role sits at the intersection of elevating craft and driving coherence: you'll dive deep into your own work while partnering closely with other designers to develop and refine the visual design, IA, interaction patterns, and motion design that raise the bar for the team. Through those partnerships, you'll help ensure each surface and our full product suite feel unified, leveraging customer research, frameworks like Jobs to Be Done, and shared IA patterns. Success in this role requires strong craft, critical and inventive thinking, clear design chops, motion skills, deep customer obsession, and the ability to communicate your ideas effectively to senior leaders. Being a big music fan is a big plus.

Design Disciplines: graphic design, interaction design, UI designer, system design, animation / motion

Key job responsibilities
· Own complex visual design projects end to end, from customer research and early concept through evaluation and delivery, effectively communicating design strategies and interaction behaviors throughout the process.

·       Develop high-level customer experience strategy for both the near and long term, navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity to design decision-making through your work.

·       Partner closely with other designers across Amazon Music to elevate the craft and raise the quality bar for what we ship.

·       Develop and refine visual design, IA, and interaction patterns that drive coherence within each surface and across our full suite of experiences, leveraging customer research and frameworks like Jobs to Be Done.

·       Contribute to and evolve a central design system and its application across touch, mouse & keyboard, and remote-specific features.

·       Work with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, research, data analysis, and conversation design, to define requirements, assess features, and optimize experiences.

·       Present design work to the UX team, product team, engineering team, leaders, and partner organizations for review and feedback.

·       Proactively manage your own work queue, time, and expectations, communicating needs and tradeoffs when priorities shift.

A day in the life
As a Senior UX Designer focused on the visual experience for millions of fans worldwide, you'll own large, complex design projects end to end, from customer research and early concept through evaluation and delivery, creating immersive experiences that delight customers across our suite of surfaces. This role sits at the intersection of elevating craft and driving coherence: you'll dive deep into your own work while partnering closely with other designers to develop and refine the visual design, IA, interaction patterns, and motion design that raise the bar for the team. Through those partnerships, you'll help ensure each surface and our full product suite feel unified, leveraging customer research, frameworks like Jobs to Be Done, and shared IA patterns. Success in this role requires strong craft, critical and inventive thinking, clear design chops, motion skills, deep customer obsession, and the ability to communicate your ideas effectively to senior leaders. Being a big music fan is a big plus.

About the team
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- 5+ years of UX designer or interaction designer experience
- Experience with UX design of complex workflows
- Degree in UX Design, Animation, Fine Arts, Cognitive Psychology, HCI, or related field
- Background across multi-platform experiences (mobile, Web, Desktop, Auto, TV, Wearables/Hearables)
- Some Motion experience (Figma and/or After Effects, AI)

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep passion for defining the future of audio entertainment experiences across Large Screens, Mobile, Web, automotive, and smaller surfaces such as wearables and hearables
- Relentless desire for innovation, balanced with business needs and customer expectations
- Proficiency in industry-standard design tools (e.g., Figma) and AI-assisted prototyping methods
- Proven ability to present strategic design rationale clearly and persuasively to senior stakeholders across product, engineering, and business teams
- Experience navigating fast-paced, ambiguous environments while managing your own work, timelines, and tradeoffs independently
- Experience leading complex, multi-platform design projects (mobile, desktop, TV) that span multiple disciplines and departments.
- Experience designing for LLM-enabled, AI-driven, or multimodal customer experiences
- Experience directly contributing to design system frameworks and defining visual, IA, and interaction patterns that scale across a product suite
- Experience integrating qualitative and quantitative data into design decisions and iterations, including conducting usability studies, user research, and journey mapping

job.title: Producer I, Social (FinLit)
job.description:
Position Summary:

Marketplace is looking for a creative social media producer who can create those scroll-stopping moments for our portfolio of financial literacy programs and help bring our economic journalism to new audiences.

We are the most widely heard suite of business shows in the country, reaching more than 10 million people on air, online, and on demand. Our financial literacy portfolio includes award-winning kids podcast “Million Bazillion” and award-winning money and relationships podcast “This Is Uncomfortable,” among others.

The ideal candidate is someone who can produce and execute innovative social content. You must have sharp social copywriting, video editing, graphic design, and fact-checking skills. You’ll optimize Marketplace content in a dynamic way across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, and emerging social platforms. You have strong instincts for short-form video and visual design. And you have demonstrated success in creating campaigns and content that resonate with diverse audiences.

*This is a grant-funded, two-year role.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between Marketplace and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Expected Compensation Range: $41.62 - $49.94 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity. 

Location: Remote

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Write and produce highly shareable social-first content on tight deadlines, including short-form videos and graphics, for all social platforms.
  • Identify stories, moments and ideas from Marketplace’s financial literacy programs that can translate into compelling social content.
  • Help develop original social videos, including researching ideas, writing scripts, shaping hooks and selecting clips.
  • Write and edit social copy, headlines, captions, scripts and other audience-facing language.
  • Strategically schedule and publish content across all social platforms.
  • Analyze social performance and produce regular campaign and content reports.
  • Work collaboratively with reporters, producers and hosts.
  • Use data to inform how and what we post.
  • Stay up-to-date and ahead of the curve on social media best practices.
  • Ensure consistent voice and branding across our social platforms.
  • Help cultivate and develop conversations between our audience, hosts and reporters.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Journalism or related field required.
  • 5+ years experience producing content for social platforms on behalf of a brand or media outlet.
  • Familiarity with financial literacy content and social media trends in the FinLit space, with an understanding of how creators and organizations are engaging audiences around economic topics.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Self-starter with excellent editorial judgment and an understanding of journalistic standards.
  • Deep interest in how economic news intersects with people’s lives.
  • Demonstrated success producing engaging social content for a newsroom, media organization, publication or other editorial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of social media trends and best practices, including video-first platforms such as YouTube and TikTok
  • Superb social copywriting and fact-checking skills.
  • Proficient in Photoshop, Premiere, CapCut, Davinci Resolve or similar editing software
  • A team player who is accountable, proactive, and solution-oriented
  • Have strong instincts for content that social audiences find engaging.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to successfully meet deadlines and handle multiple responsibilities on a consistent basis.
  • Superior communication, organizational and collaborative skills.
  • Experience using social analytics and audience insights.
  • Responsible for developing and owning the social strategy for the fin-lit porftolio.
  • Ability to appear on camera or directing/editing on-camera video as needed.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience using Sprout Social or similar social media programs (Hootsuite, Buffer, Later, etc.)
  • Familiarity with public media and Marketplace’s approach to economic journalism.

Reporting to this Position:

  • None

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands:
    • Required to move about in an office environment and sit at extensive periods of time
    • Reach with hands and arms
    • Balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch
    • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping
  • Working Conditions:
    • Moderate noise level

job.title: Associate Director, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Creative Membership leverages deep music industry knowledge to cultivate and maintain strong relationships within the Atlanta creative community and its surrounding areas. In this role, you will serve as a vital bridge to songwriters, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and talent agents. A primary emphasis is placed on enhancing ASCAP's local presence through active on-the-ground engagement, which includes attending live shows, hosting industry mixers, and conducting in-person meetings with ASCAP members and local executives.

This position is based in our Atlanta office and will report to the VP, Creative Membership located in New York. This position currently is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Discovery and development of talent, including songwriters, composers and producers, in the Atlanta and surrounding area.
  • Perform market research and partner closely with the Senior Director to identify, attract, recruit and successfully transition local up-and-coming creators to ASCAP, in order to grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Support and maintain relationships within the Atlanta and surrounding creative community, including songwriters and publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, an agents.
  • Develop an understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership and distribution related inquiries.
  • Stay informed of, escalating and making viable recommendations to the relevant internal subject matter experts on effectively addressing member needs.
  • Partner with the Marketing & Communications team to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Act as a brand ambassador of ASCAP by attending industry panels, conferences and events.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in the Music Industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with ASCAP leadership..
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills with the ability to represent ASCAP with poise and professionalism across diverse creator and executive groups.
  • Exceptional judgment.
  • Knowledge of and enthusiasm for the Atlanta music industry.
  • Ability to juggle priorities and be a team player.
  • Market research skills.
  • Will be required to travel and attend events, including ASCAP’s membership events, outside of office hours and/or overnight.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be in the office 3 days per week.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option, including a company match for pre-tax and Roth contributions
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

Please be aware that ASCAP is not a nut-free or other allergen-free workplace.

ASCAP is an equal opportunity employer. All ASCAP employment decisions are made on the basis of individual qualifications and performance and not on the basis of race, national origin, ethnicity, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, genetic information, disability, handicap, color, creed, religion, veteran status, or any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. Job Overview:

The TV Analyst is responsible for assisting both the TV Team Leader and other TV Distribution team members with the processing of audio and visual programming, sharing in the overall responsibility of ensuring that ASCAP members are properly credited for the performance of their works in audio/visual media.

Successful completion of these efforts requires the careful analysis of television performance, promo, and cue sheet data. TV Analysts will associate programs and promos with performances, verify the accuracy of any data provided, procure and upload any missing data, identify and reconcile discrepancies, and participate in quality assurance procedures to ensure that ASCAP members are accurately paid. The TV Analyst position reports to the TV Team Leader, is situated within the TV Distribution department, and is based out of ASCAP’s New York City office.   • Verify cue sheet content.
  • Assign and create work records for cues.
  • Control check work records and performances that have been matched by 3rd party vendors.
  • Integrate music video programming into distribution.
  • Assist with the timely resolution of member-initiated inquiries.

job.title: Director, Security Engineering
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

About AP Cybersecurity 

Trust is AP's most important asset. Every day, AP journalists, systems and customers depend on technology that must be secure, resilient and available — in newsrooms, in the field and across a global content distribution network that serves media organizations and businesses around the world. 

AP's Cybersecurity team, part of the Technology organization under the Chief Technology Officer, protects AP's people, journalism, platforms and data. We build the security capabilities that let AP report from anywhere, deliver content in real time and adopt new technologies with confidence.  

 

Why this role matters:  

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Director of Cyber Engineering to lead security engineering across product security, infrastructure and cloud security, cloud governance and network security. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity, this is a senior leadership role within AP's security organization. 

You will inherit and lead a team of established engineers, set technical direction for security engineering and turn security strategy into platforms, controls and practices that scale. You will stay close enough to the technology to review architecture, challenge designs and help solve hard problems. 

Building strong partnerships across Technology and the wider AP organization will be central to this role. Security at AP succeeds through collaboration and this leader will help foster a culture where security is clearly understood, valued and built in from the start. 

 

What you will do:  

Lead Security Engineering Strategy & Architecture 

  • Define and execute a security engineering roadmap across products, infrastructure, cloud and network security, aligned with AP's technology and business priorities. 

  • Own security architecture standards and reference designs for AP's cloud, on-premises and network environments. 

  • Advance modern security models such as zero trust, least-privilege access and secure-by-default infrastructure. 

  • Evaluate emerging threats and technologies, including risks introduced by AI, and translate them into practical engineering priorities. 

Product Security 

  • Embed security into the software development lifecycle through threat modeling, secure design reviews, code and dependency scanning, and security testing. 

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines without slowing delivery. 

  • Establish clear, practical secure development standards and guidance for engineering teams. 

Infrastructure, Cloud Security & Governance 

  • Lead the security architecture and hardening of AP's cloud and infrastructure environments. 

  • Establish and maintain cloud governance, including policies, guardrails, configuration standards and posture management across cloud accounts and services. 

  • Drive security automation and infrastructure-as-code to improve consistency, reduce manual effort and scale controls. 

Network Security 

  • Own the strategy and engineering of AP's network security controls across offices, data centers, cloud and remote workforce. 

  • Modernize network security architecture, including segmentation, secure remote access and perimeter controls. 

Lead People & Build a Security Culture 

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of established security engineers, and build a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous learning. 

  • Develop trusted relationships with stakeholders across Technology, product, newsroom, legal, commercial and business teams. 

  • Work with those partners to build and grow a security culture across AP, making secure choices the easy choices. 

  • Act as a senior technical leader during security incidents and turn lessons learned into lasting engineering improvements. 

  • Manage vendor relationships and budget for security engineering tools and services. 

  • Communicate risk, tradeoffs and progress clearly to technical teams, senior leadership and nontechnical audiences. 

 

Who you are: 

We expect strong candidates to bring many, but not necessarily all, of the following: 

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in security engineering, security architecture or infrastructure engineering, including minimum 4+ years leading engineering teams. 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  

  • Deep hands-on experience in at least two of AP's focus areas (product security, cloud and infrastructure security, cloud governance or network security) and working knowledge of the others. 

  • Experience in major public cloud environments and hybrid infrastructure. 

  • Strong grounding in application security and DevSecOps practices in modern software environments. 

  • Experience designing and operating enterprise network security architectures. 

  • Experience with security automation, scripting or coding and infrastructure-as-code. 

  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence without authority across engineering, business and nontechnical teams. 

  • Experience leading security awareness, champions programs or other efforts to shift security culture. 

  • Sound risk judgment: the ability to prioritize what matters most and make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to senior leadership. 

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP or cloud security certifications are a plus. 

  • Experience in media, journalism or other high-visibility environments; supporting a global or distributed workforce; securing AI/ML systems; or growing a small team into a larger function is especially relevant but not required. 

 

 

Why This Role 

AP's journalism is only as trusted as the systems behind it. AP operates at a scale and risk profile few organizations share: a global newsroom, real-time distribution to customers worldwide, and a mission that depends on accuracy and trust. 

For a security engineering leader who wants to build, influence and protect something that matters, this is an opportunity to shape how one of the world's most trusted news organizations secures its people, platforms and journalism. 

 

Location:

This role is based in New York, NY. 

 

Why Join Us? 

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions

 

Salary & Benefits: 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000 - $180,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:   

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage   
  • Retirement benefits   
  • Company paid life insurance   
  • Paid vacation and sick days   
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent   
  • Mental well-being resources   

 



 

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Research Product Manager AP Intelligence
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

About AP Intelligence 

The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual, accurate and nonpartisan reporting. 

 

AP Intelligence is building a new intelligence layer on top of AP’s global reporting—transforming verified journalism into structured facts, events, entities, relationships and signals that machines and people can use in real time. 

 

By combining AP’s firsthand reporting, editorial standards, historical depth and global reach with modern data and AI infrastructure, AP Intelligence creates machine-readable intelligence that can be integrated into models, applications and decision systems. 

 

We are expanding the product team responsible for determining what intelligence can be derived from AP reporting, how we know it is useful and reliable, and which capabilities should become scalable products. 

 

The Role 

We are seeking an intellectually curious, highly analytical Research Product Manager to lead research and product definition for emerging AP Intelligence capabilities. This is a 0→1 individual contributor role. Much of the work begins before there is a roadmap—and sometimes before the precise product problem is fully understood. 

 

You will turn broad questions into structured hypotheses, research plans and experiments; investigate them using data, customer conversations and lightweight prototypes; and translate what you learn into clear product decisions and requirements. 

 

Here, “research” means structured product investigation: framing unanswered questions, working directly with data and product outputs, testing hypotheses, evaluating results and learning from customers. 

 

This is not a traditional feature-delivery PM role. You will help discover the problems, define the products and establish the frameworks that allow engineering teams to build them. 

 

The role does not have direct reports at the outset, but offers significant ownership and visibility. As AP Intelligence grows, its scope may expand based on business needs and the individual’s strengths and interests, including deeper product leadership, domain ownership or people leadership. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Research, Prototype & Evaluate 

  • Lead research into ambiguous product questions across event intelligence, structured news data, knowledge graphs, real-time information and AI systems. 

  • Turn questions such as “What makes an event important?” or “How should we measure whether a signal is reliable and useful?” into hypotheses, experiments and evaluation frameworks. 

  • Work hands-on with AP datasets and product outputs, using tools such as SQL, Python, notebooks, LLMs and lightweight prototypes to test ideas. 

  • Design benchmarks and evaluation methods for dimensions such as accuracy, timeliness, confidence, relevance and usefulness. 

  • Identify patterns that can become scalable schemas, taxonomies, scoring systems and product capabilities. 

Define Products & Influence the Roadmap 

  • Translate research into clear product concepts, requirements and recommendations engineering teams can build. 

  • Define how concepts such as event importance, impact, velocity, provenance and confidence become useful AP Intelligence capabilities. 

  • Partner with engineering and applied AI teams to identify failure modes, improve product quality and move promising ideas from prototype to production. 

  • Use evidence to recommend which ideas should advance, change or stop and to inform AP Intelligence priorities. 

Learn With Customers & Lead Across Disciplines 

  • Work directly with prospective customers and design partners to understand workflows, test emerging concepts and determine where AP Intelligence creates meaningful value. 

  • Assess not only whether a capability is technically possible, but whether customers will integrate it, rely on it and pay for it. 

  • Partner closely with journalists, engineers, AI teams, commercial teams and senior leaders. 

  • Synthesize editorial, technical, customer and commercial perspectives into clear decisions and communicate complex ideas to technical and nontechnical audiences. 

 

Who You Are 

We expect strong candidates to bring many, but not necessarily all, of the following: 

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in product management, data products, AI/ML products, applied research, search/information systems or another highly analytical product environment. We care more about demonstrated 0→1 product ownership and judgment than a conventional career path. 

  • A strong track record of taking ambiguous problems and independently turning them into structured questions, experiments and product recommendations. 

  • Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking, with an ability to find patterns in complex information and develop clear points of view from incomplete evidence. 

  • Strong technical and data fluency. You do not need to be a production engineer, but should be comfortable exploring datasets, interrogating outputs and building lightweight analyses or prototypes. 

  • Familiarity with structured or semi-structured data and areas such as APIs, taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs, search, retrieval or related information systems. 

  • Working knowledge of modern AI systems and concepts, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, information retrieval, structured outputs and model evaluation. 

  • Strong product and customer judgment, including the ability to distinguish an interesting research problem from a capability customers will use and value. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and comfort working across engineering, AI, journalism, commercial teams and senior leadership. 

 

Experience with AI/ML products, knowledge graphs, search/retrieval, real-time or event-driven data, intelligence platforms, AI evaluation, financial/risk/geopolitical information products, or early-stage 0→1 environments is especially relevant, but not required. 

 

What Success Looks Like 

In your first year, you will have: 

  • Turned important unanswered AP Intelligence questions into rigorous product investigations and clear recommendations. 

  • Established benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for emerging capabilities. 

  • Helped define and validate new event, signal and intelligence capabilities from research through product definition. 

  • Influenced the AP Intelligence roadmap through evidence from data, customers and experimentation. 

 

Why This Role 

AP Intelligence sits at an unusual intersection of journalism, data infrastructure, artificial intelligence and real-world decision-making. 

 

AP has spent nearly two centuries building a global system for determining what happened, verifying it and communicating it accurately. AP Intelligence is exploring what becomes possible when that same reporting is structured for machines. 

 

For someone who enjoys ambiguous problems, data, emerging technology and building new products, this is an opportunity to help define a new category of product for AP. 

 

Location, Salary & Benefits 

This role may be based in New York, NY or remotely within the United States. 

 

The anticipated salary range is $140,000–$185,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. 

The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage; retirement benefits; company-paid life insurance; paid vacation and sick days; paid parental leave; and mental well-being resources. 

 

 

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

Overview

Job Title: Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: General Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop new business through consistent prospecting, networking, referrals, email, phone calls and face-to-face meetings - minimum of 100 outreach per week
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, marketing leaders and decision-makers
  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand a client's business, challenges, goals and target audience
  • Create customized, multi-platform marketing solutions based on each client's needs
  • Sell across Audacy's portfolio, including broadcast, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and other marketing solutions
  • Manage the entire sales process from prospecting and presentation through closing and campaign execution and retainment 
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual sales goals
  • Maintain a strong pipeline and actively look for opportunities to grow existing accounts
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and become a trusted marketing partner to your clients
  • Stay current on industry trends, consumer behavior and new advertising opportunities
  • Work collaboratively with sales management, marketing, programming, digital and other internal teams to deliver successful campaigns
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings and events

Qualifications

Required:

We’re looking for someone who is driven to win and motivated/disciplined to build something of their own.

 

You may be a media salesperson already, or you may come from another sales environment. What matters most is your ability to prospect, build relationships, understand business needs, present solutions and close.

 

Our ideal candidate is:

 

  • A proven hunter who enjoys developing new business
  • Self-disciplined and comfortable creating their own opportunities
  • Confident communicating and presenting to business owners and decision-makers
  • Curious and willing to ask questions to uncover client needs
  • Creative and able to think beyond a traditional advertising solution
  • Persistent and resilient when faced with rejection or obstacles
  • Organized and able to manage multiple clients and opportunities
  • Competitive and motivated by achieving and exceeding goals
  • Comfortable working independently while being a strong team player
  • Someone who takes ownership of their business and their results
  • Experienced in media, advertising, sponsorship, digital or another consultative sales environment preferred

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven track record of success in sales, preferably new-business development
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage the full sales process from prospecting through close
  • Comfortable using CRM and standard Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

Job Title: Account Manager

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Senior Account Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): New York, NY | Los Angeles, CA

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 to 4 days on-site, remaining remote)

Overview:

Audacy’s Enterprise Team is looking to add to our Account Manager team. The Account Manager role is responsible for quarterbacking the post-sale process once a campaign has been sold, as well as helping strategize what we’re going to market with from a pre-sale perspective. The Account Manager oversees the entire Sales process, from the point of RFP to the final wrap report and must be familiar with each part in the process to ensure we’re going to market with the best service possible. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional client-facing skills, have a thorough understanding of marketing and integrated media channels, and be able to lead large-scale campaigns from start to finish while being the main point of contact for Audacy. You will have a knack for communicating efficiently and effectively under pressure to both internally & externally, and the detail orientation skills to ensure that the client’s needs are met.

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Quarterback internal strategy calls to ensure we’re providing our best recommendations.
  • Lead conversations with internal creative and execution teams to ensure client expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Provide “white glove” client service to advertisers through great communication and properly setting expectations.
  • Quarterback Internal & External pre-sale/post-sale Kickoff Calls
  • Work with Marketing to create in-depth detailed wrap reports, calling out prominent metrics to keep the client satisfied
  • Work closely with the Campaign Management team to ensure that we’re delivering well, or optimizing with the goal of delivering in full.
  • Manage all post-sale correspondence with the client and creative stakeholders.
  • Monitor and convey recording timelines and manage expectations for closed campaigns.
  • Present campaign performance reports including delivery, optimizations, insights, and program recommendations including mid-campaign and wrap reports
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on your client, and track anything that could result in risk
  • Work with planning on re-allocations while being cognizant of what the client is and is not interested in.
  • Communicate effectively with Podcast Partner Management to manage custom facets of campaigns and ensure we’re keeping to timeline.
  • Vet & monitor the podcast vetting portal to ensure we have approvals to run in shows at the point of sale

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2 years working with a media company, digital agency, or integrated media sales position, preferably in a client-facing capacity.
  • Basic understanding of digital advertising strategy and measurement is preferred.
  • Problem solver and solution-oriented thinker with great organizational skills.
  • Public speaking skills and ability to lead a room
  • Skilled at interpreting data to properly position sellback metrics.
  • A background working with and leading communication with internal teams
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented work environment
  • Exceptional communication and writing skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Are you a proven hunter who lives for winning new business? Do you have a track record of opening doors, building relationships, and closing deals in a competitive marketplace?

Audacy is looking for a driven Digital Account Executive to accelerate growth and make an immediate impact. This is more than a sales job—it's an opportunity to build your own book of business, sell industry-leading digital marketing solutions, and earn without limits.

At Audacy, you'll have the opportunity to sell one of the most comprehensive digital marketing portfolios in the industry. Backed by strategic partnerships with Google Premier Partner, Meta Premier Partner, Amazon Advanced Partner, and other leading technology platforms, you'll help businesses accelerate growth through data-driven marketing solutions that deliver measurable results.

As a Digital Account Executive, you'll work with a powerful suite of products that spans the entire customer journey—from building brand awareness to driving conversions and customer acquisition. You'll collaborate with local businesses, regional brands, and national advertisers to create customized marketing strategies using cutting-edge digital solutions.

  • Own the Close: Take control of the entire sales process, from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Compete to Win: Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where results are recognized and rewarded.
  • Sell Industry-Leading Solutions: Help businesses grow with best-in-class digital marketing solutions.
  • Become a Trusted Advisor: Understand client goals, uncover challenges, and deliver strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Outwork the Competition: Stay ahead of market trends, identify emerging opportunities, and bring fresh ideas to every client conversation.

This is more than a sales role—it's an opportunity to become a trusted marketing consultant, helping businesses navigate today's evolving digital landscape while building a rewarding career with an industry leader.

 

If you're energized by prospecting, passionate about digital marketing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, Audacy provides the tools, training, partnerships, and support to help you succeed.

Qualifications

More About You:

  • Proven Sales Success: 4+ years of digital media or advertising sales experience with a track record of winning new business and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Hunter Mentality: You thrive on prospecting, opening doors, and building a pipeline from the ground up.
  • Digital Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of digital advertising solutions, including programmatic, search, social, video, and audience targeting.
  • Strategic & Consultative Approach: You uncover client challenges, develop customized solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Executive Presence: Confident presenting to business owners, marketing leaders, and C-suite decision-makers while simplifying complex digital strategies.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable using campaign metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROI, ROAS, and conversion rates to guide recommendations and prove performance.
  • Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills that drive long-term partnerships.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in Salesforce, Google Workspace, and digital marketing platforms, with the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies.
  • Self-Starter: Highly motivated, accountable, and driven to succeed in a fast-paced, performance-focused environment.

Job Description:

 

1010 WINS is looking for a digital journalist with strong news judgment, sharp social instincts and a passion for visual storytelling. This role will focus on turning breaking news, reporter content and broadcast material into engaging digital content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Threads and X. The ideal candidate understands how people consume news on social media, can quickly identify the strongest angle in a story, and knows how to make content feel native to each platform while maintaining high journalistic standards.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $20.00/Hr.-$25.00/Hr.
