Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

Job responsibilities:

 

  • Board Operators are responsible for running the control board, following station format, arranging and playing commercials and IDs according to the program and commercial logs, following applicable laws and FCC regulations
  • In addition, you may help administer contests, answer listener phone calls, screen listener calls for live shows, operate satellite receivers, conduct EAS tests, etc.
  • You will also be involved in producing WFAN Content such as booking guests and posting to social media as well as host show prep and ideas for content.
  • This is a critical role in the on-air execution of the station. Must be a detail-oriented person available to work evenings, overnights, weekends, vacation fill-in and holidays.
  • Other duties as required by management as well as following training modules

 

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

 

  • Previous experience running a studio board, editing play-by-play highlights and interviews using a digital editing program such as Adobe Audition, NewsBoss, or Pro Tools is required.
  • The ideal candidate will have previous radio experience running a soundboard, booking guests, writing and editing audio.
  • Previous experience as a radio board operator, preferably at a sports talk radio station/network.
  • Must have experience with digital operating system (Media Touch, Audio Vault, Enco or Profit).
  • Must be a team player, computer savvy and have the flexibility to work different shifts, including weekends, overnights and holidays.
  • Minimum Education Level: HS diploma or equivalent.

 

 

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

Audacy is a leading audio content and entertainment company. As champions of audio, we connect with people in the moments that matter — delivering trusted local news, passionate sports and your favorite music across 220+ radio stations, premium podcasts, live events and digital experiences that reach more than 200 million listeners every month.We create compelling content, foster deeply engaged audiences and deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. job.title: Associate Director, Event Production
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios Live transforms award-winning journalism into dynamic live events—offering editorial experiences that spark smart conversations across politics, business, technology, health, and more. We are hiring an Associate Director of Production to manage the technical execution, budget management, and vendor oversight for in-person and virtual events, helping scale Axios Live into its next phase of editorial and experiential growth.

Why It Matters: This isn’t just about running events—it’s about making them work flawlessly. You will serve as the technical lead for some of Axios’s most visible moments, from live-streamed policy interviews to international stage productions. As a strategic and hands-on executor, you'll ensure each event reflects Axios's high standards for editorial integrity, production value, and audience experience.

The details:

Technical Execution & Production Oversight

  • Manage the technical production of Axios Live events, including A/V systems, staging, lighting, livestreaming, video playback, and on-site recording for our large-scale event productions.
  • Serve as stage manager and show-caller, managing real-time production cues, backstage operations, and talent movement
  • Oversee A/V production vendors, including sourcing, scoping, budgeting, contracting, and on-site management
  • Coordinate site-specific tech builds, rehearsals, and contingency plans for both in-person and virtual platforms (e.g. Zoom, Vimeo, custom integrations)

Manage post-production editing workflows, including rapid content clipping in Adobe Premiere Pro and video asset delivery to marketing/editorial teams

Production & Budget Management

  • Own end-to-end production timelines, task tracking, and staffing schedules for simultaneous events
  • Manage event production budgets at the line-item level—tracking vendor estimates, spend actuals, and reconciliations with minimal supervision
  • Negotiate cost-effective solutions with vendors while ensuring Axios’s production standards are met or exceeded

Maintain internal tools and documentation for production planning, budget tracking, vendor database and show files (e.g. run-of-show, call sheets, tech specs)

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Collaborate with editorial, creative, and design teams to bring branded experiences to life across Axios IP and custom event formats
  • Act as a technical advisor to internal stakeholders on what’s possible (or not), offering solutions grounded in experience and vendor capabilities
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to associates and freelance contractors, helping build a strong, technically savvy team culture

Support new production innovation by identifying technical opportunities to improve quality, reduce risk, or scale event offerings

What You’ll Bring: You are a technical producer with creative instincts, leadership skills, and a command of live event dynamics. You have:

  • 5–7 years of experience in high-volume event production, including technical design, A/V execution, and budget management
  • Deep understanding of A/V production workflows, including livestreaming, broadcast systems, LED, comms, rigging, and event safety
  • Demonstrated success managing production budgets line by line, including vendor estimates, POs, and invoice reconciliation
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with A/V and production vendors, including onsite teams
  • High proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects and Photoshop is a plus. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior executives and high-profile participants
  • Ability to manage fast paced, quick communication work flows with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience managing open-press or public-facing events under tight timelines
  • Calm, adaptable, and solution-oriented under pressure
  • Familiarity with project management software (e.g. Wrike, Airtable) is a plus

job.title: IT Security Specialist
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy news and information with efficiency, clarity, and Smart Brevity. We are hiring an IT Security Specialist on our IT team to help protect the systems, devices, identities, applications, and workflows that power the company.

Why it matters: Security at Axios is not simply a matter of deploying tools or responding to vulnerabilities. It means understanding how systems are used, assessing whether they are fit for purpose, and identifying risk created by workflows, permissions, configurations, vendors, and user behavior.

This role will help de-risk current and future solutions by embedding security into technology decisions from evaluation and procurement through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Go deeper: This role will own key areas of our corporate security environment, including endpoint security, identity and access management, Google Workspace, SaaS security, security monitoring, security awareness, and AI security. We’re looking for an experienced practitioner who understands that, in a modern company, the browser is often the operating system through which people access data, applications, and business workflows. In this role, you will:

  • Own security for Axios’ Mac fleet, including Jamf, compliance, monitoring, alert investigation, malware response, and device remediation.
  • Own Okta-based identity and access management, including adaptive MFA, authentication, SSO, application assignments, access scopes, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.
  • Partner with People, Legal and Infrastructure to improve provisioning, offboarding, access removal, archival, legal holds, and lifecycle automation.
  • Establish and maintain security configurations and risk controls for core services and SaaS applications, including authentication, access, collaboration, email security, data protection, alerting, activity monitoring, vendor and procurement reviews, security questionnaires, evidence gathering, and recommended safeguards.
  • Treat the browser and SaaS layer as critical security boundaries, evaluating how users access data and applications and where browser-based workflows create risk.
  • Use logs and activity monitoring across endpoints, browsers, identity systems, Google Workspace, and SaaS applications to investigate suspicious activity and support incident response.
  • Assess systems, tools, permissions, and workflows for security, operational fit, and long-term supportability.
  • Help protect high-risk users, including journalists and executives, through appropriate privacy, account-security, and personal-data protections.

Security awareness and AI security

  • Own security awareness programs, including human risk, phishing simulations, reporting workflows, completion tracking, and targeted training for higher-risk users.
  • Design and deliver customized training for different parts of the company, including the newsroom, journalists, business teams, and technical teams, based on their workflows and threat models.
  • Develop practical AI security policies and guidance, and review AI tools, automations, agents, and internally built solutions for data handling, permissions, authentication, authorization, secrets management, logging, monitoring, human oversight, and operational readiness.

Worthy of your time: This is an opportunity to shape security inside an AI-enabled media company. You’ll have meaningful ownership and the chance to improve security across our technology environment and the workflows built on top of it.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has substantial experience in IT security, endpoint security, identity and access management, systems administration, or a related field.
  • Has hands-on experience with macOS, Jamf or comparable endpoint platforms, CrowdStrike Falcon, Okta or a similar identity provider, and Google Workspace security.
  • Understands modern security boundaries across browsers, SaaS applications, identity providers, endpoints, APIs, data flows, and AI-enabled systems.
  • Has experience with security logging, monitoring, incident investigation, vendor assessments, and SaaS risk management.
  • Has operated or improved security awareness, phishing, or role-specific training programs.
  • Can evaluate risk in the context of real-world workflows, users, business requirements, and operational constraints.

Why it matters: You will turn advertiser needs and commercial opportunities into buyable products. Working with revenue, engineering, design, and editorial partners, you will take initiatives from discovery through delivery, using data and user research to guide priorities and measure results.

job.description:

Why it matters: The Production Manager will drive the day-to-day execution of Axios Creative House’s custom video and visual content, serving as the primary production partner to Client Success and guiding complex programs from kickoff through launch with clear ownership, timelines, and communication.

Go Deeper: In this role, you will coordinate stakeholders, deliverables, approvals and production requirements while developing deep expertise in Airtable, ACH’s production operating system, to strengthen workflows, visibility and team adoption. This includes the following responsibilities and opportunities for impact:

  • Video + custom visual content production: Manage assigned video and custom web destination programs from kickoff through delivery.
    • Coordinate timelines, deliverables, approvals and handoffs across internal creative teams, external partners and client-facing teams.
    • Keep projects moving by proactively identifying dependencies, following up on outstanding needs and escalating risks when necessary.
  •  Client Success partnership: Serve as the primary Production point of contact for Client Success on assigned programs.
    • Provide clear guidance on production requirements, timelines, deliverables and next steps.
    • Maintain consistent visibility into project status so client-facing teams can communicate confidently with advertisers.
    • Help translate client needs and feedback into clear, actionable direction for production partners.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Connect the people and inputs required to successfully execute custom programs.
    • Partner closely with video, design and written leadership.
    • Coordinate internal and external production resources and ensure teams have the information, assets and approvals needed to deliver.
  • Launch readiness + quality control: Help ensure programs meet agreed-upon requirements and are ready to launch.
    • Track key milestones, approvals and dependencies throughout production.
    • Coordinate QA and final delivery checks across video and custom web experiences.

    • Maintain accurate project documentation, timelines and status updates across ACH production workflows.
    • Develop deep expertise in Airtable as ACH’s production operating system, serving as a go-to resource for troubleshooting, dashboard updates and day-to-day system questions.
    • Identify opportunities to improve Airtable workflows, dashboards and reporting to increase visibility, usability and team adoption.

    • Share best practices and help reinforce consistent processes and system usage across the team.

  • Experience in production, project management, creative operations, branded content, digital media or a related field.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can work effectively across creative and client-facing teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, proactively solve problems and know when to escalate.
  • Familiarity with video production, design workflows and custom digital content experiences is a plus.
  • Experience with Airtable or similar workflow and project-management systems is a plus.

Markers of success

  • Client Success and creative teams have a reliable Production partner who brings clarity and accountability to complex programs.
  • Projects move from kickoff through launch efficiently, with risks identified early and fewer last-minute execution issues.
  • Airtable provides accurate, useful visibility into production activity and is consistently adopted across the team.

job.title: Reporter, News
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media organization dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We're hiring for a writer-editor to lead the afternoons and evenings on our newsdesk. 

Why it matters: Reporting to our Executive Editor, the news writer-editor will play a critical role as part of the 24/7 nerve center for the newsroom.

  • We are after people with a “see it, write it” mentality who have a personal passion for news and a fast-twitch set of journalistic reflexes.
  • This is a job for the news junkies who “monitor the situation” for fun and want to do it for a living. 
  • We operate at one cadence - do it right now - and are after people who marry a love of news with the thrill of being busy.  
  • This is the ultimate “safe pair of hands” job — someone we can trust to both edit the work of others and write their own, too. 

Go deeper: The role comes with a range of responsibilities, including:

  • Real-time news surveillance
  • Quick-turn writing of spot news stories

job.title: Senior Manager, Experience Optimization
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Senior Manager of Experience Optimization to own the conversion layer of the Axios funnel: the subscription, registration, and paywall experiences where readers become subscribers and subscribers become members.

Why it matters: By continuously improving conversion rates, you'll increase the impact of every growth initiative while helping Axios maximize the value of its investment in subscriptions, paywalls, and audience growth.

Go deeper: In this role, you'll own the registration, subscription, and paywall ecosystem, lead landing page and first-party data capture testing, drive SEO/GEO conversion strategies, and orchestrate personalized onsite experiences to create a seamless journey across web and email. Reporting to the SVP of Audience & Growth, you'll partner across subscriptions, membership, and event marketing to optimize every step of the conversion experience. 

Responsibilities:

Subscription, Registration & Paywall Optimization

  • Own the performance and optimization of Axios's subscription, registration, and paywall experiences across national and local products.
  • Lead ongoing experimentation across offers, messaging, templates, and access rules to improve conversion.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for the Piano platform, driving platform capabilities and performance.
  • Establish conversion benchmarks, reporting, and scalable optimization processes across the business.

Conversion Optimization & First-Party Data

  • Design and execute experiments across landing pages, lead generation, and first-party data capture to improve acquisition and conversion.
  • Partner with Audience Insights and Lifecycle Marketing to strengthen first-party data collection and personalization.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized experimentation roadmap, using data and testing to drive continuous improvement.

Search, AI & Onsite Experiences

  • Optimize conversion experiences for SEO, GEO, and AI-driven traffic, partnering with Analytics to measure performance and identify new opportunities.
  • Own onsite audience segmentation and personalization in Segment, ensuring a seamless customer journey across web and email.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Editorial, Revenue, Analytics, Design, and Marketing to deliver high-impact growth initiatives.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders while driving a shared roadmap for onsite experience optimization.
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by documenting learnings, sharing insights, and scaling best practices across the Growth organization.

Skills

  • 6+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization (CRO), growth marketing, growth product, or digital experience optimization.
  • Proven success improving conversion through A/B testing and experimentation.
  • Experience with subscription, membership, or digital media businesses.
  • Hands-on experience with paywall or subscription platforms (Piano preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills, including funnel analysis, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Experience with marketing technology platforms such as Segment, Braze, Sailthru, or similar tools.

In your first year, you will:

  • Increase subscription and registration conversion rates through continuous experimentation.
  • Establish a scalable testing program with measurable improvements across the conversion funnel.

  • Create seamless onsite experiences that work in concert with lifecycle marketing.
  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Editorial, Analytics, Revenue, and Growth to drive measurable business impact.

This hands-on, end-to-end producer will take ideas from concept through production, post-production, publishing, and audience growth.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.
  • Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.
  • Shape, maintain, and execute the company’s long-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero-trust architecture standards.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time.
  • Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices.
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Skills:

  • Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3).
  • Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement.
  • Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
  • Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling).
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility.

What success looks like:

  • Security & Compliance: Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long-term security roadmap.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least-privilege access standards.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity.
  • Security Tooling Adoption: Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk.
  • Threat Detection & Response: Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Security Leadership: Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation.
  • AI Defense & Security: Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI-driven threats and emerging attack vectors.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who pairs strong product-engineering fundamentals with modern AI-native development practices to build and scale the systems and experiences that power Axios’ core products.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver clear, trustworthy, and informative news to millions of readers every day. As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll build the interfaces, services, APIs, and data flows behind our audience-facing products and publishing tools. 

AI has become a core part of how we build software. You’ll use coding agents and other AI tools throughout the development lifecycle—from understanding problems and exploring solutions through implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operation. You’ll remain accountable for the architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes of everything you ship.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll deliver high-quality, reliable product features across Axios’ frontend and backend systems, using modern agentic development practices to accelerate delivery and ensuring performance and stability across our publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • End-to-end feature development: Own features across the frontend, APIs, business logic, data layer, testing, and production systems. Turn product problems into clear technical plans and reviewable units of work, using AI agents thoughtfully across research, prototyping, implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Frontend development: Create accessible, responsive, and maintainable interfaces using JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks such as Next.js.
  • Backend and API development: Build production services and APIs that support Axios’ products and publishing workflows, and create clear contracts that can be understood and used reliably by people, applications, and AI-powered tools.
  • AI-enabled product development: Identify opportunities where models, agents, retrieval, or intelligent automation can create meaningful value for readers or internal teams. Build those capabilities with clear user controls, measurable behavior, appropriate guardrails, and an understanding of when conventional software is the better solution.
  • Quality and reliability: Write automated tests, improve performance, and contribute to logging, metrics, tracing, security, and operational reliability.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product, design, quality engineering, and other developers to clarify requirements, explain tradeoffs, and deliver effectively. Participate in code reviews, pairing, onboarding, and mentorship.
  • Product and technical improvement: Understand how technical work supports readers, editorial workflows, and business goals.Improve existing systems through thoughtful refactoring, sound technical decisions, and practical experimentation with emerging engineering approaches.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a thoughtful engineer who cares about user experience, reliability, scalability, and maintainable code—and who has moved beyond occasional AI assistance to using agents as a substantive part of their engineering practice. You should have:

  • Experience: 2-5+ years of professional software development experience, with production experience in frontend, backend, or full-stack development and the ability to contribute across the stack.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear specifications and acceptance criteria, provide relevant context, break work into appropriately scoped tasks, decide what to delegate, and guide an agent when its initial approach is incomplete or incorrect.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions against the actual system, identify security and maintainability risks, and recognize when an agent-produced solution is plausible but wrong. You understand that AI increases the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js or a comparable modern framework.
  • Backend development: Experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems primarily use Go and Python, and you should be comfortable working in or learning either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with unit and integration testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and common web security practices.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to own scoped work, make sound tradeoffs, navigate ambiguity, and connect technical decisions to product and business goals. You can evaluate when an AI-assisted or AI-enabled approach creates real leverage and when a straightforward deterministic solution is more appropriate.
  • Communication: Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about rapidly changing models, tools, and development practices, paired with an evidence-based approach to evaluating them. You share what works, identify what does not, and help the team improve its practices over time.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Production experience with Go or Python.
  • Experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, generated clients, or service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, orchestration, or CI/CD.
  • Experience with caching, background jobs, queues, or asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Experience operating production systems with observability, performance optimization or benchmarking, or accessibility testing.

What success looks like:

  • Valuable, accelerated delivery: You ship useful features from concept through production and use AI to shorten research, implementation, and feedback cycles without creating avoidable rework.
  • Sound AI leverage: You delegate meaningful work to agents, give them the context and constraints needed to succeed, and verify their output before it reaches users. You know when AI adds value and when it introduces unnecessary complexity.
  • Quality and reliability: Your work is maintainable, well-tested, secure, accessible, observable, and dependable.
  • Product impact: You make technical decisions that support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals.
  • Team and system improvement: You contribute to a stronger team through collaboration, code reviews, pairing, mentorship, and thoughtful improvements to existing systems. You leave behind better documentation, tests, context, tools, and development patterns that make future work easier for both people and agents.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer—a senior, hands-on individual contributor—to lead architecture and delivery for Axios’ core products across multiple teams using strong product-engineering and AI-native practices.

Why it matters: Axios delivers clear, trustworthy news to millions of readers. You’ll be anchored to a product area while shaping full-stack systems and technical direction across multiple teams and connected systems. This is not a people-management role.

AI is core to how we build. You’ll use coding agents throughout implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operations while remaining accountable for architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes. Staff impact comes from sustained scope, judgment, and results—not tool use alone.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, engineers, and leaders to shape plans, align dependencies, resolve ambiguity, build resilient systems, and help others make better technical decisions.

Responsibilities:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll lead reliable product and platform work across Axios’ frontend and backend systems. You’ll remain hands-on while driving multi-quarter initiatives, improving technical coherence, and using agentic practices to accelerate delivery. Key responsibilities include:

  • Cross-team technical leadership: Lead mission-critical or high-risk initiatives spanning teams and connected systems. Frame problems, align ownership and dependencies, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive production adoption.
  • Architecture and design: Own architecture for a product area and scalable boundaries across frontend, APIs, data, and production systems. Lead design reviews and establish standards within your sphere of influence.
  • Hands-on system ownership: Own the technical direction and long-term evolution of key systems while writing and reviewing code, prototyping, debugging, leading migrations, and operating services in production.
  • AI-enabled product and engineering: Identify where models, agents, retrieval, or automation create value. Build reusable capabilities with measurable behavior, guardrails, and judgment about when conventional software is better.
  • Quality, reliability, and incident leadership: Improve testing, performance, observability, security, and operational readiness. Anticipate systemic risks, address technical debt, and help lead resolution and learning during critical production issues.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers across teams, spread systems thinking and design patterns, and build alignment through proposals, reviews, and influence without authority.
  • Product and technical strategy: Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to shape the product-area roadmap, align dependencies, and connect technical investment to reader, editorial, and business outcomes.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a staff-level engineer with sustained multi-team impact, deep expertise in a relevant domain, broad systems thinking, and a commitment to user experience, reliability, scalability, maintainable code, and effective AI-enabled practice. You should have:

  • Experience: Typically 7+ years in professional software development, or equivalent sustained Staff-level impact, including leading complex initiatives across multiple teams or systems.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear strategies, specifications, and acceptance criteria; provide context; scope complex work; decide what to delegate; and redirect incomplete or incorrect approaches.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions, identify security, scalability, and maintainability risks, and catch plausible but wrong solutions. You understand that AI raises the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Hands-on experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js, plus judgment to guide frontend architecture across teams.
  • Backend development: Hands-on experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems use Go and Python, and you should be able to shape reliable service boundaries and work effectively in or learn either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and web security practices, plus the ability to raise standards across teams.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, identify high-leverage problems, align teams, make sound tradeoffs, and connect decisions to product and business goals—including when AI is not the right tool.
  • Communication: Ability to build alignment through clear proposals and reasoning, communicate risks and tradeoffs across functions, and drive clarity during disagreement.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about changing models, tools, and practices, paired with an evidence-based approach. You share useful patterns, identify what fails, and make others more effective.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Led a multi-team architecture, platform, migration, or modernization initiative from problem framing through production adoption.
  • Owned critical systems through incidents, scaling challenges, and long-term architectural evolution.
  • Drove adoption of technical standards, reusable tools, or platform capabilities across multiple teams.
  • Mentored experienced engineers and helped improve technical judgment beyond your immediate team.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Production experience with Go or Python and distributed systems using gRPC, cloud infrastructure, containers, queues, CI/CD, or similar technologies.

What success looks like:

  • Cross-team delivery: You drive multi-quarter initiatives from problem framing through production adoption, aligning dependencies and ownership to produce durable outcomes.
  • Engineering leverage: Teams deliver more effectively because of the standards, tools, architecture, documentation, and context you create. You establish safe, repeatable AI patterns where they add value.
  • System health: Key systems become more reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and easier to change. You reduce systemic risk and improve incident prevention and response.
  • Product-area impact: Your decisions support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals within the teams and systems you influence.
  • Organizational technical leadership: Engineers across teams make better decisions through your mentorship, proposals, reviews, and example. You remain a hands-on IC who multiplies others’ effectiveness.

 

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $165,000 - $215,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend

  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios Employee Support Fund, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers

job.title: Producer / On-Air Talent for X107.9 (KVGS)
job.description:
Position Overview 

Beasley Media Group Las Vegas is seeking a creative, energetic, and versatile Producer / On-Air Talent for X107.9 (KVGS), our alternative music station and the English-language radio home of the Vegas Golden Knights. 

We're looking for a talented broadcaster who can bring personality, creativity, and technical expertise to both sides of the microphone. The ideal candidate is passionate about alternative music, pop culture, sports, and the Las Vegas community, with the ability to produce compelling content, execute flawless broadcasts, and connect with listeners on-air and across digital platforms. 

This is a hands-on position that combines on-air hosting, audio production, live broadcast execution, and digital content creation. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, collaborating with programming and sales teams, and thriving in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 

Key Responsibilities 

On-Air Talent & Content Creation 

  • Host assigned on-air shifts with an engaging, authentic personality that reflects the X107.9 brand. 

  • Deliver compelling, entertaining content focused on alternative music, pop culture, local events, sports, and the Las Vegas lifestyle. 

  • Prepare and execute entertaining on-air breaks, interviews, promotions, and station features. 

  • Maintain strong listener engagement through on-air interaction, social media, and station events. 

  • Execute commercial endorsements, promotional announcements, and sponsored features as assigned. 

  • Represent X107.9 professionally at concerts, community events, promotional appearances, and station activities. 

Production & Broadcast Operations 

  • Produce high-quality audio content, including commercials, station imaging, promotional announcements, interviews, and specialty programming. 

  • Record, edit, mix, and deliver audio using industry-standard production software. 

  • Operate studio equipment, automation systems, and broadcast technology to ensure smooth daily programming. 

  • Coordinate with programming, traffic, sales, and engineering to ensure accurate and timely execution of broadcast content. 

  • Manage production deadlines, maintain organized audio libraries, and ensure consistent quality across all produced materials. 

  • Troubleshoot routine broadcast and production issues in a live environment. 

Vegas Golden Knights & Sports Programming 

  • Support the production and execution of Vegas Golden Knights game broadcasts and related programming on X107.9. 

  • Coordinate with play-by-play talent, producers, board operators, and station management to ensure seamless live broadcasts. 

  • Assist with pregame and postgame programming, sports features, interviews, and special broadcasts. 

  • Execute commercial breaks, sponsorship elements, and in-game features accurately. 

  • Produce and edit hockey-related audio, promotional content, and digital features. 

  • Assist with live remote broadcasts and special events as needed. 

Digital & Social Media 

  • Create engaging content for station social media platforms, streaming channels, and digital properties. 

  • Develop short-form video, audio clips, interviews, and behind-the-scenes content to extend the station's reach. 

  • Collaborate with the programming and promotions teams on digital campaigns, contests, and audience engagement initiatives. 

  • Stay current on alternative music trends, emerging artists, pop culture, and digital content opportunities. 

Programming & Team Collaboration 

  • Work closely with the Program Director to execute the station's programming strategy and brand vision. 

  • Collaborate with sales and promotions on creative client campaigns, sponsored content, and station events. 

  • Maintain accurate programming logs and ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company policies. 

  • Provide support for additional programming, production, and live broadcast needs across the Las Vegas cluster as assigned. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in radio broadcasting, audio production, on-air hosting, or a related media position preferred. 

  • Strong on-air communication skills, creativity, and the ability to connect authentically with listeners. 

  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software, such as Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, or similar platforms. 

  • Experience with radio automation systems, studio operations, and live broadcast production. 

  • Knowledge of alternative music, emerging artists, pop culture, and current music trends. 

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, digital content creation, and video editing. 

  • Experience with live sports broadcasting or production is a plus. 

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events, including Vegas Golden Knights broadcasts, as needed. 

  • Valid driver's license and ability to participate in off-site promotional events as required. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for someone who loves radio, lives for great content, and isn't afraid to jump in wherever needed. You should be equally comfortable behind a microphone, producing a compelling piece of audio, running a live broadcast, or creating content that gets people talking online. 

X107.9 is a station with personality, energy, and a strong connection to the Las Vegas community. As the English-language radio home of the Vegas Golden Knights, we offer a unique opportunity to combine music, sports, entertainment, and live broadcasting in one exciting role. 

If you're creative, technically skilled, passionate about alternative music, and ready to make an impact both on-air and behind the scenes, we want to hear from you. 

About Beasley Media Group 

Beasley Media Group is a leading multiplatform media company delivering engaging content and innovative advertising solutions through its radio stations, digital platforms, and community partnerships. 

Location: Las Vegas, Nevada 
Position: Full-Time 
Department: Programming 
Company: Beasley Media Group 

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

job.title: Program Director – KOAS Máxima 105.7
job.description:
Position Overview 

Beasley Media Group Las Vegas is seeking a dynamic, creative, and results-driven Program Director for KOAS Máxima 105.7, our Spanish-language radio station serving the vibrant and growing Hispanic community in Southern Nevada. 

The ideal candidate is a passionate radio programmer who understands Hispanic culture, music, and audience engagement, with the ability to build compelling on-air and digital content that connects with listeners and drives ratings and revenue. 

This position will oversee all aspects of KOAS programming, talent development, music strategy, promotions, and community engagement. Additionally, the Program Director will play a key leadership role in managing Máxima's Spanish-language broadcasts of the Vegas Golden Knights (VGK), helping expand the team's connection with Hispanic fans throughout Las Vegas. 

Key Responsibilities 

Programming & Content Strategy 

  • Lead the overall programming strategy, sound, and brand identity of KOAS Máxima. 

  • Manage daily programming operations, music scheduling, imaging, production, and on-air execution. 

  • Develop engaging content that reflects the interests, culture, and lifestyle of Las Vegas's Hispanic audience. 

  • Monitor ratings, audience trends, competitive stations, and listener research to identify opportunities for growth. 

  • Ensure consistency in station branding, positioning, and programming quality across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. 

  • Collaborate with the promotions, digital, and sales departments to develop creative programming initiatives and revenue opportunities. 

Talent Management & Development 

  • Recruit, coach, schedule, and develop on-air personalities and programming staff. 

  • Provide regular feedback and direction to improve talent performance and audience engagement. 

  • Oversee airchecks, show preparation, content development, and talent accountability. 

  • Foster a collaborative, creative, and high-performance programming environment. 

Vegas Golden Knights – Spanish Broadcast Management 

  • Oversee the programming and operational execution of the Vegas Golden Knights' Spanish-language radio broadcasts on KOAS Máxima. 

  • Coordinate with the VGK organization, Spanish-language play-by-play talent, producers, board operators, and station operations to ensure seamless execution of game broadcasts. 

  • Manage broadcast schedules, pregame and postgame programming, game-day logistics, and technical coordination. 

  • Work closely with the Spanish broadcast talent to develop compelling hockey-related content that connects with Hispanic listeners and builds the VGK fan base. 

  • Collaborate with the sales team to ensure proper execution of sponsorship commitments, in-game features, commercial inventory, and branded content. 

  • Identify opportunities to expand VGK programming through interviews, promotional appearances, social media, community events, and special features. 

  • Maintain strong communication with the VGK organization and internal departments to ensure broadcast quality and partnership success. 

Promotions, Digital & Community Engagement 

  • Work with the promotions team to develop station events, contests, and community initiatives that strengthen Máxima's connection with Hispanic audiences. 

  • Oversee the station's digital content strategy in collaboration with the digital team, including streaming, social media, video, and audience engagement. 

  • Build relationships with local Hispanic organizations, businesses, entertainers, and community leaders. 

  • Identify opportunities for station visibility at concerts, cultural celebrations, sporting events, and community activities. 

  • Partner with the sales department to develop creative, integrated sponsorship opportunities that deliver value to advertisers while maintaining programming integrity. 

Operations & Compliance 

  • Ensure station programming complies with FCC regulations and company policies. 

  • Oversee programming schedules, commercial execution, and coordination with traffic and engineering. 

  • Manage programming resources, staffing schedules, and departmental budgets. 

  • Maintain high standards for broadcast quality, operational efficiency, and brand consistency. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 3–5 years of radio programming experience, preferably in Spanish-language or Hispanic-targeted formats. 

  • Previous experience as a Program Director, Assistant Program Director, Music Director, or comparable programming leadership role preferred. 

  • Fluency in Spanish and English required, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages. 

  • Deep understanding of Hispanic music, culture, audience preferences, and the Las Vegas marketplace. 

  • Experience with music scheduling, automation, audio production, and broadcast programming systems. 

  • Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and talent development skills. 

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, promotions, digital, engineering, and corporate leadership. 

  • Experience with sports broadcasting, live events, or play-by-play production is a plus. 

  • Strong understanding of social media, streaming, and digital audience engagement. 

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and special events, including Vegas Golden Knights game broadcasts, as needed. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for more than a traditional Program Director. We want a creative leader who understands the power of local radio, embraces the energy and diversity of Las Vegas, and knows how to connect with Hispanic audiences through great music, engaging personalities, community involvement, and compelling content. 

With Máxima's Spanish-language Vegas Golden Knights broadcasts, this role offers a unique opportunity to help grow the station's audience, strengthen its community presence, and build one of the market's most exciting Spanish-language media brands. 

About Beasley Media Group 

Beasley Media Group is a leading multiplatform media company delivering engaging content and innovative advertising solutions through its radio stations, digital platforms, and community partnerships.

Department: Programming 
Company: Beasley Media Group

job.title: VP, Digital Sales and Operations
job.description:
Position Overview

Beasley Media Group is seeking a dynamic and growth-oriented Vice President, Digital Sales & Operations to lead and scale the Company's digital commercial business. This is a remote leadership position responsible for driving digital revenue growth, sales performance, and operational excellence across all markets.

This executive will lead initiatives focused on accelerating digital revenue growth, optimizing advertising operations, enhancing customer acquisition and retention, and ensuring operational excellence across Beasley's portfolio of digital marketing solutions.

As the senior leader accountable for the performance of Beasley's digital business, the Vice President will oversee digital sales strategy, revenue generation, advertising operations, fulfillment, client success, and key business initiatives. This leader will own digital revenue performance and profitability while partnering closely with executive leadership to expand market share, strengthen competitive positioning, and accelerate the Company's transformation into a leading multi-platform media and digital marketing organization.

The Vice President will play a critical role in shaping strategy, driving execution, and building a high-performance culture focused on growth, accountability, innovation, and measurable results.

Location: Remote (U.S.-based). Candidates may reside anywhere in the United States. Periodic travel to corporate offices, market visits, client meetings, industry events, and leadership meetings is required.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & Business Leadership

  • Own and lead the digital business revenue plan, operating budget, and P&L performance.
  • Develop and execute strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth, profitability, and long-term enterprise value.
  • Establish sales and operating performance targets aligned with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Partner with market leadership teams to increase digital revenue penetration and expand adoption of digital products and services.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities, partnerships, and go-to-market strategies that support business expansion.
  • Deliver accurate forecasting, pipeline visibility, and performance reporting to executive leadership.

Sales Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed team of digital sales and operations leaders.
  • Foster a high-performance culture centered on accountability, execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Recruit, retain, and develop top talent while building leadership bench strength and succession plans.
  • Establish clear goals, compensation alignment, and performance management processes that drive results.
  • Lead organizational transformation efforts that improve sales productivity and overall business performance.

Advertising Operations & Client Delivery

  • Oversee all digital advertising operations, campaign fulfillment, and client delivery functions.
  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level standards focused on quality, efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive process optimization initiatives that improve speed-to-market, campaign execution, and operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure excellence in campaign performance, reporting, billing accuracy, and client support.
  • Champion automation, technology adoption, and workflow improvements that increase productivity and profitability.

Customer Success & Retention

  • Develop strategies that improve customer retention, increase customer lifetime value, and reduce client churn.
  • Partner with sales leadership to strengthen client relationships and maximize revenue growth within existing accounts.
  • Ensure client success teams deliver exceptional experiences and measurable business outcomes for customers.
  • Analyze customer performance data, identify trends, and implement initiatives that improve retention and expansion opportunities.

Strategic Partnerships & Innovation

  • Collaborate with the Chief Digital Officer to evaluate technology platforms, vendor relationships, and strategic partnerships.
  • Support the development, commercialization, and market positioning of new digital products and services.
  • Drive innovation initiatives that improve competitive differentiation and business performance.
  • Partner with product, technology, finance, and market leadership teams to align resources and execution against strategic priorities.
  • Support the growth of Beasley's B2B platform initiatives, customer acquisition strategies, and long-term digital business expansion plans.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital media, advertising, ad-tech, marketing services, agency leadership, SaaS, or related industries.
  • Proven track record of leading high-growth digital businesses with direct responsibility for revenue, profitability, and operating performance.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling digital sales organizations and advertising operations teams.
  • Experience managing multi-million-dollar revenue businesses and complex organizational structures.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems, programmatic media, performance marketing, audience solutions, CRM platforms, analytics, and campaign fulfillment processes.
  • Proven ability to drive organizational change, improve operational performance, and execute transformational initiatives.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
  • Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical, financial, and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Experience within digital agencies, media organizations, marketing technology companies, publishers, or ad-tech platforms strongly preferred.
  • Radio broadcasting experience is not required.



Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Director, Distribution (Music Nation)
job.description:
Great music deserves accurate, trusted distribution.

As Director, Distribution - Music Nation, you’ll lead the royalty distribution operations supporting Music Nation, overseeing matching and identification, funds management, quarterly distributions, quality assurance, payment methodologies and market share calculations. You’ll play a key role in helping BMI deliver Rights Administration and Distribution services for an international collective management organization across both mechanical and performing rights.

This role sits at the intersection of royalty operations, repertoire integrity, data quality, technology and stakeholder partnership. You’ll ensure distribution processes are accurate, scalable and aligned with Music Nation’s licensing strategy while working across BMI to strengthen controls, improve data quality, manage operational risk and enhance the systems and processes that support distribution.

You’ll also help build BMI’s broader multi-right and multi-territory administration capabilities, bringing together operational leadership, analytical thinking, industry expertise and continuous improvement to support both today’s distribution cycles and future growth.

Position Summary

Direct, plan, and oversee all royalty distribution activities supporting Music Nation, including matching and identification, funds management, quarterly distributions, and quality assurance. Responsible for establishing and maintaining royalty payment methodologies, market share calculations, and royalty distributions.

This position serves as a key operational leader supporting BMI's delivery of Rights Administration and Distribution services to Music Nation and helps establish the organization's capability to manage mechanical and performing rights on behalf of an international collective management organization. The role ensures repertoire integrity across publisher, writer, society, and Music Nation data sources and supports the successful execution of Music Nation's licensing and distribution strategy.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

• Lead all royalty distribution activities supporting Music Nation, including matching and identification, funds management, methodology and market share management, and quarterly distribution processing.

• Serve as Music Nation’s subject matter expert for royalty distribution standards and industry data exchange initiatives, representing the organization in industry forums and discussions with societies and other stakeholders to help support evolving rights administration and distribution needs.

• Own and oversee quality assurance strategies that support Music Nation’s quarterly distribution cycles, with particular focus on radio, live concert, and general licensing markets.

• Ensure distribution data integrity through production cycle monitoring, reconciliation testing, variance analysis, and issue resolution across internal systems and third-party data sources.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risk related to distribution processes, vendor inputs, and reporting outputs.

• Monitor changes to Music Nation License Agreements and ensure that distribution practices are appropriately aligned with any license agreement change. Work across the distribution supply chain to ensure the appropriate on-boarding of new licenses from inception through to distribution.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for operational, leadership, and external audiences.

• Partner with SoundExchange team supporting the neighboring rights management and distribution for Music Nation

• Support prioritization, workload planning, and process improvement efforts to ensure timely and accurate distribution outcomes.

• Develop operational procedures, workflows, controls, and service standards supporting Music Nation royalty distribution management.

• Monitor and improve data quality, operational performance, and processing accuracy through reporting, audits, and quality assurance reviews.

• Own market share assessments used for license fee allocations and ongoing rate settings.

• Collaborate with Licensing, Rights Administration, Customer Service, International Relations, Technology, and Product teams to support Music Nation business objectives.

• Participate in business requirements definition, testing, implementation, and enhancement of Music Nation distribution platforms and supporting technologies.

• Maintain compliance with BMI policies, industry standards, copyright requirements, and Music Nation service commitments.

• Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and operational scalability.

• Prepare and deliver operational metrics, readiness reporting, and executive updates to leadership.

• Support Music Nation service readiness initiatives and the ongoing development of BMI's multi-right and multi-territory administration and distribution capabilities.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• Directly supervises managers, team leads, analysts, and/or operational specialists supporting Music Nation royalty distribution functions.

• Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with BMI policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, workload prioritization, and employee development.

• Provides leadership across all locations for operational resources supporting distribution activities.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Concentration in Music Business, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field preferred.

• Extensive knowledge of music publishing, copyright administration, and collective rights management.

Experience

• Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in music publishing, repertoire administration, copyright operations, collective management, or related rights distribution disciplines.

• Experience managing teams and operational processes.

• Experience with industry standards such as CWR, CAF, CISAC, and related music rights management frameworks preferred.

• Experience working with international repertoire administration and distribution preferred.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

• Expert knowledge of music publishing operations, repertoire administration, and royalty distribution methods.

• Strong understanding of mechanical and performing rights distribution.

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong project and process management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.

• Ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying data integrity issues.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and enterprise business systems.

• Commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

• You lead accurate, timely and well-controlled royalty distributions for Music Nation across matching, identification, funds management, market share and quarterly processing.

• You establish clear distribution methodologies, procedures, controls and service standards that support both operational consistency and Music Nation’s evolving business needs.

• You use data, reconciliation, variance analysis and quality assurance to identify issues early, protect distribution integrity and drive continuous improvement.

• You balance strategic priorities with day-to-day execution, keeping quarterly distribution cycles on track while improving scalability and operational efficiency.

• You build strong partnerships across Licensing, Rights Administration, Customer Service, International Relations, Technology, Product and external stakeholders to resolve complex issues and improve end-to-end outcomes.

• You translate complex royalty, repertoire and market-share data into clear insights and recommendations for operational teams, leadership and external audiences.

• You identify opportunities for automation and technology enhancement that improve accuracy, reduce risk and strengthen BMI’s ability to support multi-right and multi-territory administration.

• You develop a high-performing team with strong technical knowledge, clear priorities and a consistent focus on quality, accountability and service.

Why Join Us?

Distribution is where rights, data and value come together.

At BMI, accurate royalty distribution is central to delivering value to the creators, publishers and partners we serve. As Director, Distribution (Music Nation), you’ll have the opportunity to lead a highly visible operation supporting an international collective management organization while helping expand BMI’s capabilities across mechanical and performing rights.

You’ll work across teams, markets and technologies to strengthen distribution processes, improve data integrity, manage operational risk and help build scalable solutions for a growing multi-right, multi-territory service model.

If you’re energized by complex royalty operations, international rights management, data-driven decision making and building teams and processes that deliver accurate outcomes, we’d love to meet you!

job.title: Account Director, Defence
job.description:
Opportunity

Account Directors produce high quality advisory documents demonstrating a deep understanding of clients and issues. You will be regularly providing advice and analysis to clients, and developing an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events. You will manage some key workstreams as well as guiding executives and assistants on the account.

As an Account Director, you will also begin to develop a network and build relationships with clients, media, advisers, Brunswick colleagues and other stakeholders. You will work to develop your media-handling skills and have a good understanding of Brunswick’s different sectors and specialist offers and how to connect them with clients as part of our one firm offering.

About the Role

This role is working within Brunswick’s expanding Defence Sector Group, focussing on Investor Relations and capital market communications. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver media, political, regulatory and market analysis to clients, with intelligent insight and recommendations informed by data, analysis and experience.
  • Manage the development of high-quality client documents, playing a key role in drafting, proofing, editing and version control, along with seamless project management of client workstreams.
  • Guide executives and assistants in effectively supporting accounts.
  • Work to develop a solid understanding of different sectors and specialist offers.
  • Ensure all logistics for client meetings and events are executed smoothly and manage upwards to ensure Brunswick delivers on time and above expectation.
  • Begin to develop an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events.
  • Nurture a network amongst peers inside and outside the firm, providing valuable insight for the firm and for clients.

What We’re Looking For

  • Highly knowledgeable on business issues and current affairs; up to date on key trends, issues, commentators and debates, particularly as it relates to the investor community.
  • 2-5 years’ experience ideally working in the German aerospace and defence sectors as well as in relevant policy areas – with the potential to further expand it.
  • Experience in report writing (English/German), presentation preparation, stakeholder analysis and social media.
  • Able to demonstrate excellent written research and analysis for business audiences; must be able to synthesize large amounts of intelligence across numerous sources in a timely but thoughtful manner.
  • Proven project and/or program management experience, with the ability to oversee multiple fast-moving workstreams at any one time.
  • A dynamic self-starter with a strong work ethic.
  • High level of attention to detail and an intellectually rigorous, client-service attitude.
  • An experienced team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.

We offer you the opportunity to work on exciting projects in an international team of bright minds. We allow individuals to thrive by empowering you with a great deal of freedom and creativity in your work, while operating in a dynamic and international environment.
