job.title: AI Enablement Consultant
job.description:
AI Enablement Consultant

Opportunity

Brunswick is recruiting for an AI Enablement Consultant to join our pioneering AI Lab.

Brunswick’s AI Lab serves as the firm’s central hub for AI innovation. The Lab researches, builds and maintains cutting-edge AI solutions, while partnering with client teams to provide advanced technical expertise on complex mandates.

As AI adoption accelerates across the firm, the Lab plays a critical role in ensuring Brunswick remains at the forefront of AI-enabled advisory work and equipping our teams with the tools, skills and confidence to deliver differentiated value to clients.

This role is focused on enabling people across the firm to use AI tools confidently, effectively and responsibly. It combines training delivery, content creation, tool evaluation, hands-on support, and close engagement with teams to embed AI into day-to-day workflows. 

The successful candidate will work closely with Partners, Directors and teams globally to drive adoption and ensure AI tools deliver tangible business value.

About the Role 

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Leading adoption, embedding and providing user support 

  • Embed within teams for defined periods to help them integrate AI tools into live client work.
  • Identify barriers to adoption and work with the AI Lab to address them.
  • Track recurring issues and feedback themes to inform training, documentation and product improvements.
  • Give input into the overall AI adoption plan.
  • Act as first-line support for AI tools, answering user queries and troubleshooting common issues.
  • Provide practical guidance on effective prompting and workflow integration.

Adoption and training 

  • Design and deliver structured AI training programmes, including: 
    • In-person workshops and office sessions 
    • Virtual training sessions 
    • Written guidance and internal communications 
    • Recorded training videos 
  • Create clear, practical materials that translate technical capabilities into relevant business use cases, presented in language that will resonate with different audiences. 
  • Drive internal adoption campaigns to increase awareness, confidence and usage of approved AI tools. 
  • Travel to Brunswick offices to deliver training and support local AI embedding efforts. 

Tool Evaluation and Selection 

  • Support the evaluation of emerging AI tools, including hands-on testing and business relevance assessment.
  • Gather structured feedback from users to inform tool selection, prioritization, and business needs.
  • Provide input into decisions on tool rollout, retirement, and optimization.
  • Stay current with developments across the generative AI landscape (e.g. ChatGPT, GPTs, Claude and related tools) and assess their relevance to the firm.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will combine strong communication skills, curiosity about both business and technology, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments. They will be comfortable moving between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on practical support with end users. Standout candidates demonstrate:

  • Practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GPTs, Claude) in a professional setting with a strong understanding of where they add value and where they don’t.
  • Exceptional written communication skills and able to translate complex ideas into clear, concise, actionable guidance that people can immediately apply.
  • Strong presentation skills, including developing high-quality PowerPoint materials and delivering engaging sessions to senior audiences.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders, with the ability to flex your style and messaging depending on the audience.
  • Experience evaluating digital tools or technology solutions, with sound judgement about business impact, risks, and practical implementation.
  • A natural ability to bring structure to ambiguity and turning broad business challenges into practical workflows, tools, and guidance.
  • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and rolling up your sleeves to get things done in fast-moving environments.
  • High emotional intelligence and genuine curiosity about how people and teams work, and how to help them work better.
  • Willingness to travel internationally to deliver training and embed within teams when needed.
  • Previous experience in learning and development is highly desirable.
  • Experience in professional services or advisory environments would be advantageous.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

The successful applicant will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits package: 

Base Pay: The annual base compensation range for this role is $140,000 - $170,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors including experience, skills, training, office location, certifications, and education.

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual and firm-wide performance.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Commuter Benefits. Generous Paid Time Off: 25 vacation days and 10 days sick leave, as well as 11 paid company holidays. Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts.

Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.

job.description:
Associate, Financial Practice, Investor Relations Specialist  

Brunswick Group is seeking an Associate to join our Financial practice. This individual will be an integrated member of the team who specializes in Investor Relations.

Brunswick was founded in 1987 as a financial communications firm, expertise that continues to differentiate us. For nearly four decades, Brunswick has consistently ranked at the top of our industry’s league tables on a country, regional, and global basis.

Our global Financial practice has unparalleled experience developing and implementing campaigns to advise clients on both long-term positioning to enhance valuation and navigating complex capital markets transactions. Members of our Financial practice are deeply experienced and focus their client work on strategic investor relations and financial communications, mergers & acquisitions, shareholder activism, IPOs, and restructuring. These specialists partner with global colleagues to bring a powerful and complementary combination of perspectives across stakeholders to help clients manage their reputations during critical financial events.

We are seeking an Associate to join the Financial practice who will specialize in advising Brunswick's leading corporate clients in integrating deep knowledge of investors into their strategic communications and decision making.

About the Role 

Client Contribution & Handling
  • Developing investor relations and financial communications engagement programs
  • Advising clients across industries on effectively communicating to investors at critical moments such as financial transactions and leadership transitions
  • Support management teams on financial calendar milestones such as earnings, conferences, and investor days
  • Analyzing complex financial information and developing strategic messaging to support valuation and help manage volatility
  • Develop plans to disseminate messaging across traditional and emerging communications channels to target members of the investor community
Team Management
  • Managing and mentoring team members; working with Partners and Directors on the day-to-day management of staff and client deliverables
  • Actively and effectively managing account teams and driving day-to-day activities for multiple clients at a time
  • Managing the development of key client documents, supporting drafting, editing and integrating feedback from across internal and client stakeholders.
  • Overseeing research assignments on fast-moving situations with tight deadlines; distilling a large amount of information into impactful insight and recommendations.
Networking
  • Playing an entrepreneurial role in supporting Brunswick’s Financial practice and strategic investor relations capability including thought leadership and new business development
  • Actively cultivating relationships with clients and potential clients
  • Developing relationships with the analyst and investor community 

What We're Looking For

  • 7-10+ years of relevant work experience in one or more of the following areas: investment banking, sell-side equity research, buy-side active asset management, in-house public company investor relations, investor relations advisory
  • Deep knowledge of the corporate finance, capital markets and U.S. public company investment landscape
  • Ability to anticipate and analyze market expectations, translate the investor perspective into effective communications to multiple stakeholders (shareholders, analysts, ratings agencies and financial media)
  • Ability to rapidly learn new sectors and companies, and operate with imperfect information

job.title: Director, Foundations
job.description:
Opportunity  

As a Director, you will lead on the development and delivery of strategic communications plans and provide senior-level advice to a broad range of clients in the foundations and non-profit sector. You will develop and land regular and proactive ideas for clients, advising on critical issues impacting some of the world’s most influential businesses and playing a leading role as day-to-day point of contact for your clients.

You will also develop strategies to approach and cultivate new business targets using a strong internal network that includes talent from across Brunswick’s entire offering, as well as your own external network.

You will ensure the smooth running of teams by establishing clear roles, managing performance, and ensuring that all key stakeholders and client needs are being covered by the team. You will work closely with Partners on all aspects of client management, including account finances, fee negotiation, and adviser meetings.

About the Role

  • Significantly contribute to the development and enhancement of Brunswick’s Foundations and Non-Profits practice in the UK, Europe, Africa, and globally; by deepening our expertise and building a world-class practice that will deliver outstanding work.
  • Understand and articulate the issues and challenges facing philanthropy; working with clients and colleagues to translate these issues into meaningful programmes which align with and ultimately enhance the respective client’s wider business strategy.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients; partnering with them and helping them define and articulate their position across a range of audiences and stakeholder groups.
  • Drive at least one major global client account
  • Foster ‘big idea’ generation, innovation and activation across the sector, driving colleagues and teams to bring ideas to life.
  • Drive new business and prospecting; work closely with Brunswick colleagues to define and deliver a business strategy which makes use of internal networks and marketing opportunities to deliver “more for more”.
  • Maintain clear sight of the operational effectiveness of client accounts and teams, staying close on quality assurance and open to being “hands-on” with client work.
  • Lead by example to move the business forward and to support the ongoing development of colleagues and mentees. Inspire, develop, and actively mentor colleagues.
  • Proactively represent Brunswick’s Foundations and Non-Profits practice externally, and alongside other key colleagues within the Partnership.

 

What We're Looking For

  • A strong track record either working in an advisory role within a global corporate or charitable foundation, multilateral organisation, NGO, or government or consulting experience advising philanthropic clients. Agency experience is preferred and advantageous.
  • 10+ years’ relevant professional experience.
  • Deep understanding of the philanthropic and international development landscape, with first-hand experience of handling highly topical issues, and an extensive network from which to draw intelligence.
  • An understanding of the interplay between business, politics, and society, particularly as it relates to this sector.
  • A strong understanding of corporate positioning, and how to develop strategies and advocacy campaigns that can translate into programs with real sustained impact.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a commercial, self-starting, and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience advising senior leaders with efficacy and diplomacy.
  • Ability to connect with and leverage the skills and expertise of colleagues, to deliver the best possible advice, campaigns and programs to clients.
  • A strong verbal and written communicator with high EQ levels and an engaging presentation style.
  • A global perspective and experience working with international teams or organisations.
  • A balance of creative and analytical thinking, bringing rigor, accuracy, and attention to detail.
  • A natural team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.

 

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

job.title: FP&A Analyst
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick seeks to appoint an FP&A Analyst, UK/Europe. The principal objective of this role is to provide timely, accurate and relevant analysis/insights to help track performance, enable great decision making and strategic interventions to ultimately help shape and drive growth for the business globally.

 

This role, based in London but working across both UK and Continental Europe, sits within the global Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team, a business partnering team, with members in London, Hong Kong and the USA that advises on key financial information to client-facing colleagues and senior leadership.

 

The successful candidate will have a background in consulting and/or an in-house analytical role, with extensive experience of working with financial data to analyse business performance and the underlying drivers to generate insightful analytics and reporting. Candidates should be able to point to examples of where their analysis has delivered impactful outcomes.

 

The successful candidate will play a central role in developing, coordinating and delivering impactful value-adding analysis and reporting for the business globally. Liaising with a range of business stakeholders, including the leadership team, the Growth & Performance team, our Partners and Core Services functions.

 

Our work in FP&A

 

The FP&A team is responsible for analysing and presenting data in a way that is impactful for stakeholders to inform business decisions and guiding conversations with business leaders to facilitate a greater understanding of the revenue and recovery data that is relevant to themselves, their sector or practice group. The team will also listen to the needs of users and working with the Power BI infrastructure team to design and improve reporting dashboards, report to the business globally on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.

About the Role

  • Creation and development of insightful and impactful reporting, including regular packs for the leadership team
  • Work with the FP&A team globally to ensure reporting is aligned with the strategy of the firm and leadership’s objectives
  • Ensure FP&A reporting is designed and evolves to surface opportunities to improve performance and drive growth
  • Advocate and demonstrate the value of analysing internal data
  • Carry out detailed analysis that drills down into the underlying drivers of business performance and be able to explain this to non-financial stakeholders
  • As appropriate, work with stakeholders to interpret analysis/findings and devise strategies to address issues and opportunities
  • Support the technical implementation and roll-out of new reporting dashboards on Power BI
  • Ad-hoc data requests from across the business to aid the business-as-usual processes for different functions

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 3+ years’ professional experience in a strategic analysis focussed role
  • Analytical experience/capabilities
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen
  • Highly proficient and self-sufficient in data analysis and financial modelling
  • Experience running analysis across multiple business functions (e.g. finance, marketing, HR)
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and multitask in high-pressure situations
  • Shows a keen passion and sense of urgency regarding reaching objectives and a successful outcome
  • Strong problem-solving skills, and ability to think creatively
  • A strong verbal and written communicator
  • Advanced Excel skills with experience of working with large volumes of data
  • Good familiarity with reporting tools, specifically Power BI is beneficial
  • Experience of working within a professional services organisation would be advantageous
  • Resilient and enthusiastic team player with strong self-motivation and a hands-on, collaborative nature
  • Can work autonomously
  • Ability to pay close attention to detail and review own work to ensure a quality product is delivered

 

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

job.title: Technical Support Analyst
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Support Analyst to provide onsite support for our Hong Kong office and remote support across APAC (Tokyo, Beijing, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Sydney). You will work with colleagues, global ICT teams and approved suppliers to resolve issues, support workplace technology and deliver a reliable user experience.

This role suits someone who is service-focused, organised and comfortable supporting senior stakeholders, live meetings and colleagues across different locations and time zones.

About the Role

  • Manage ICT activities for joiners, movers and leavers, including device preparation, access checks, induction and equipment recovery.
  • Providing onsite and remote technical support.
  • Deliver proactive and discreet support to Partners, Directors and other priority users.
  • Prepare and support office meetings, client events and video-conferencing sessions.
  • Coordinate local suppliers, support visits, quotations and service escalations.
  • Purchase and manage ICT equipment, stock and asset records throughout the device lifecycle.
  • Support APAC offices without dedicated onsite ICT resources, coordinating with local contacts and suppliers when required.
  • Log and manage incidents and service requests, maintain clear user communication and escalate risks appropriately.
  • Contribute to office moves, technology refreshes, service improvements and regional ICT projects.
  • Follow information security, data protection and company technology policies at all times

What We’re Looking For

  • At least two years of experience in service desk, desktop support or end-user computing.
  • Practical experience supporting Windows 11, macOS, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive and SharePoint.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Intune and endpoint management; Jamf experience is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting laptops, iPhones, printers, meeting-room technology and audio/video conferencing.
  • Good understanding of basic networking, Wi-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP.
  • Experience with ITSM ticketing, asset management and technical documentation.
  • Awareness of information security, phishing, MFA and secure handling of company equipment.
  • ITIL, Microsoft, CompTIA, Apple or Jamf certification is desirable but not essential.
  • Outstanding communication skills in English and, ideally, a regional language.

job.title: 3D Designer - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Burson Studio:

In Studio, we create ideas and bring them to life. We’re a multi-disciplined team, creating content for integrated marketing campaigns, brand experiences and brand identity. We currently have a team of around 40; a mix of Creatives, Brand and Digital Designers, Editors and Content Producers and Creative Project Managers, supplemented by freelancers when specialist skills are needed or workload dictates.

Everyone that succeeds here enjoys the diversity of clients and projects and is driven to do great work that will have a positive effect on our clients’ businesses.

More about the role:

As an Experiential Designer you will be instrumental in working alongside the team executing creative design solutions across a broad range of projects, ensuring we deliver exceptional and immersive brand experiences and design for events. You will bring broad experience across spatial, experiential and interior design. You will be adept at taking productions through all stages from concept and brief, through the pitch process.

You will have an eye for detail, high-end design experience and understanding of brand and consumer experience. Being equally confident developing ideas and creative concepts as you are in 3D we are looking for a creative designer and not just a visualiser, so we are keen to meet people who bring big ideas as well as technical skills.

You can present your ideas clearly and with confidence. You need to be able to give and listen to feedback and act on it for the good of the project. Asking questions is important. You will have curiosity and a desire to soak up ideas and feedback from wherever you can. We want to see your passion for design and creativity, and see you explore the creative world around you, looking out for what’s hot and what’s not. Being part of the experiential team, you will regularly communicate key trends in design and technology to the wider team.

The devil is in the detail and you’ll be expected to be thorough, articulate and well organised in your work. Attention matters and we want you to obsess over it.

We’ll look to you to have good organisational skills and manage your time and requested project
deadlines well. At your level, you will be able to handle multiple projects at once, calmly and
with confidence.

What you'll do:

  • Work as an integral member of the Studio, collaborating with the Experiential team to support the delivery of spatial projects and events of varying scales and complexity  
  • Work closely with cross functional teams and directly with clients on projects, building their trust and confidence at every stage
  • Communicate ideas through mood imagery and description, honing creative concepts and inspiring others
  • Build out ideas into 3D designs and visuals
  • Work closely with cross functional teams across 2D and graphics, strategy and account management teams to deliver excellence
  • Recommend and research suppliers that share your creative vision and will partner with us to deliver first class events
  • Collaborate with production and technical teams to make sure we are in line with timelines and budgets, and that your incredible design vision is honoured through to implementation

Experience that contributes to success:

  • You will have a minimum of 4 years’ experience working in a similar role
  • You will have an understanding of brand experiences, consumer journey and design at the highest level
  • You will have experience taking design projects from start to finish, from initial concept right through to final design and implementation
  • You will have a high cultural radar with a finger on the pulse across all areas of art, design and culture
  • You will have a desire to drive innovation within the business, creating beautiful and impactful work that strives to make a difference (environmentally and socially)
  • You will be experienced working in collaborative and multi-facetted teams
  • You will be energetic and collaborative, we are big fans of teamwork
  • You will be Proficient in Sketchup and Creative Suite
  • CAD and visualisation software capability – ideally Vector Works / Cinema 4D or equivalents
  • You will be motivated to always push creative ideas as far as possible
  • However, you will also be pragmatic, realistic and diligent never to over promise or under deliver - managing client expectations brilliantly while looking for alternative solutions
  • You will have a good understanding of build and production and the technical aspects of the design process
  • You will be calm and organised with meticulous attention to detail
  • Strong organisational and communication skills
  • Be kind, supportive and fun

Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!

#LI-CY1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

  • Act as a day-to-day client leader and maintain a clear and consistent communication channel between the client and the account team.

  • Stay updated on social media trends and build relationships with key influencers and community contacts to optimize channels.
  • You must possess a strong familiarity with how Generative AI tools are used across communications programmes, especially in planning, research, ideation, content creation, and daily operations to drive relevance and efficiency.

  • Support the Directors and other senior leaders to identify new business opportunities within existing and potential clients.
  • Be proactive during new business brainstorms and take ownership of portions of new business proposals under the guidance of Directors and senior leaders

  • Minimum 7+ years of work experience in public relations or the communications industry, with at least 3 years leading a team. 
  • Experience of handling Enterprise Technology clients in a PR agency and has a significant network of connections with media outlets, reporters, etc
  • Graduation in Public Relations or Communication.

job.title: Account Director, Earned Media - Health & Wellness
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are seeking an Account Director, Earned Media to join our growing Health & Wellness practice and help lead earned media strategy and execution across pharmaceutical, biotech and wellness clients. This role is ideal for an experienced media relations professional who is passionate about finding compelling stories within complex healthcare topics, building strong relationships with journalists and helping clients earn meaningful attention in an increasingly fragmented media landscape.

You will play a hands-on role in developing and executing earned media strategies, identifying newsworthy opportunities and proactively engaging traditional, trade, consumer and emerging media. From complex science and clinical data to product milestones, disease awareness, thought leadership and consumer-facing campaigns, you will help translate healthcare stories into timely, relevant narratives that resonate with reporters and their audiences.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare communications experience, established media relationships, a track record of securing impactful coverage and the ability to confidently counsel clients and guide teams through execution. You will work closely with account, digital, social, creative and strategy colleagues to ensure earned media is integrated into broader communications programs.

The Team

The Health & Wellness team at Burson is one of the largest and most innovative groups in the space. We have pushed the limits of traditional healthcare communications with a complete 360-degree integrated offer for our clients: social, digital, data, brands, celebrity, science, corporate, consumer and more.

We are a group of people who work hard as a team to continue building our reputation as visionaries in the industry. We are looking for individuals who want to challenge both themselves and the status quo.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and execute earned media strategies for healthcare clients that align with client objectives, communications priorities and the evolving media landscape.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare, business, consumer and trade reporters, editors and other influential media contacts.
  • Proactively identify and pitch compelling stories ranging from complex science, clinical trial results, regulatory milestones and product approvals/launches to disease awareness campaigns, executive thought leadership and consumer-facing partnerships.
  • Translate complex scientific and healthcare information into clear, relevant and newsworthy narratives for different media audiences.
  • Serve as a trusted earned media counselor to clients, providing recommendations around story positioning, messaging, media targets, spokesperson preparation and outreach strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to insert clients and subject-matter experts into timely healthcare, cultural and industry conversations.
  • Work closely with account, digital, social, creative and strategy colleagues to integrate earned media into broader communications campaigns and ensure consistency across channels.
  • Manage day-to-day earned media programs from strategy through execution, keeping workstreams moving and ensuring teams deliver high-quality work.
  • Provide strategic counsel and support around issues management and sensitive media situations, working with senior team members as appropriate.
  • Help develop earned media plans, measurement frameworks and KPIs, and use performance insights to continually strengthen media strategies.
  • Oversee media monitoring and reporting across traditional, digital and trade outlets, identifying trends, opportunities and implications for clients.
  • Analyze earned media performance and translate results into actionable insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Manage and mentor junior team members, providing clear direction, feedback and opportunities to strengthen their media relations and healthcare communications expertise.
  • Review and provide thoughtful feedback on media materials including pitches, press releases, talking points, briefing materials, Q&As and media strategies.
  • Stay current on the evolving healthcare and media landscapes, bringing new reporters, platforms, trends and storytelling approaches to clients and internal teams.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 7+ years of experience in public relations and communications, with meaningful experience in earned media and healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech or wellness communications.
  • Demonstrated success securing media coverage for healthcare clients across areas such as product launches, clinical data, regulatory milestones, disease awareness, executive thought leadership and consumer-facing campaigns.
  • Strong relationships with healthcare, business, consumer and/or trade journalists, along with an understanding of how reporters and outlets approach healthcare stories.
  • Experience developing media strategies and translating those strategies into proactive, results-oriented media relations programs.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking an Account Supervisor to join our Consumer Brand practice. This is an exciting opportunity for a communications professional with strong earned media experience, excellent storytelling skills, and a passion for building brand visibility through integrated communications programs.

The ideal candidate understands how compelling stories, audience insights, cultural trends, and strong execution come together to generate meaningful earned media results. You will play a key role in developing and executing media relations programs for leading consumer brands spanning consumer lifestyle, retail, consumer health and wellness, food and beverage, travel, and other consumer-facing categories.

In this client-facing role, you will help drive earned media strategies, manage day-to-day client relationships, contribute to integrated communications programs, and deliver high-quality work across multiple accounts. You will collaborate closely with senior leaders while helping to mentor junior team members and support new business initiatives as needed.

What you'll do:

Earned Media Strategy & Execution

  • Support the development and execution of strategic earned media programs informed by audience insights, research, analytics, and strong storytelling.
  • Identify story angles, media opportunities, and cultural moments that help advance client objectives.
  • Contribute to integrated communications programs that connect earned media with social, influencer, digital, content, paid, and experiential efforts.
  • Apply consumer, category, and marketplace insights to inform communications recommendations and media strategies.

Client Management

  • Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for clients, ensuring responsive communication and strong account management.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive counsel, problem-solving, and consistent execution.
  • Manage project timelines, deliverables, and account activities across multiple workstreams.
  • Participate in client meetings and presentations, helping to develop recommendations and reporting.

Media Relations & Storytelling

  • Develop media strategies tailored to client objectives, target audiences, and the unique news value of each story.
  • Draft pitches, press releases, fact sheets, media alerts, executive talking points, briefing documents, and other communications materials.
  • Build and maintain relationships with reporters, editors, producers, content creators, and influencers.
  • Secure meaningful media coverage, interviews, speaking opportunities, and brand storytelling placements.
  • Monitor media activity and respond efficiently to media inquiries and emerging opportunities.

Integrated Communications

  • Collaborate with specialists across digital, social, influencer, paid media, creative, research, and analytics teams to execute integrated campaigns.
  • Utilize media monitoring, social listening, and analytics tools to track performance and uncover opportunities.
  • Leverage emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools to support research, media audits, competitive analysis, and planning while exercising sound professional judgment.

Team & Business Contribution

  • Help coach and support junior team members, providing guidance on account activities and professional development.
  • Contribute to new business efforts through research, media strategy development, and presentation support.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to share ideas that enhance client programs and agency capabilities.

 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Approximately 6 years of experience in public relations, earned media, strategic communications, or integrated marketing communications.
  • Experience developing and executing earned media programs for consumer brands.
  • Strong understanding of today's media landscape, including traditional, digital, social, influencer, and creator channels.
  • Ability to translate business objectives, consumer insights, and cultural trends into effective communications strategies and media opportunities.
  • Demonstrated success securing earned media coverage and building productive relationships with media and other external stakeholders.
  • Strong client service skills and experience managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience developing media materials, messaging frameworks, executive talking points, and communications plans.
  • Excellent writing, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Experience utilizing media intelligence and monitoring platforms such as Cision, Muck Rack, Brandwatch, Newswhip, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
  • Experience collaborating with influencer, paid, social, analytics, and creative teams.
  • Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a passion for storytelling.
  • Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative workplace culture.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Agency experience supporting national or global consumer brands.
  • Experience across consumer sectors such as retail, consumer products, food and beverage, travel, hospitality, wellness, technology, automotive, and lifestyle brands.
  • Experience supporting integrated campaigns that combine earned, social, influencer, and paid media strategies.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled research, media intelligence, and communications planning tools.

More about the role:

As a Consultant (Account Manager or Senior Account Manager) in Burson’s Corporate & Public Affairs practice, you will help lead integrated communications programmes for recognised organisations operating across the Technology and Aviation sectors in the Netherlands.

Media relations will be at the heart of the role. You will develop strong media strategies, identify compelling stories and build trusted relationships with journalists, while also supporting clients across public affairs and issues & crisis communications.

We are looking for someone who combines excellent day-to-day account management with a sharp understanding of the Dutch media, political and regulatory landscape. You will be comfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment, collaborating with specialists and helping clients navigate complex reputational and stakeholder challenges.

This is an Account Manager-level opportunity, although we are also open to considering more senior profiles who bring the right blend of sector knowledge, media expertise and integrated corporate and public affairs experience.

What you'll do:

  • Client partnership and account management: Act as a trusted day-to-day client contact, developing a strong understanding of client objectives, stakeholders and sector dynamics, while coordinating activity and maintaining consistently high standards of service. 
  • Media relations: Develop and deliver proactive and reactive media relations strategies, identify strong news angles, prepare high-quality media materials and build productive relationships with relevant Dutch media. 
  • Corporate and public affairs: Support integrated programmes that connect corporate communications, stakeholder engagement and public affairs, helping clients engage effectively with media, policymakers and wider audiences.
  • Issues and crisis communications: Support clients in anticipating and responding to reputational issues and live situations through monitoring, scenario planning, messaging and coordinated response activity.
  • Technology and aviation expertise: Build a strong understanding of the trends, policy developments and reputational considerations shaping the Technology and Aviation sectors, translating these into relevant communications opportunities and advice.
  • Planning and storytelling: Turn complex business, policy and technical topics into clear, compelling narratives and creative content that earn attention and strengthen reputation.
  • Quality control and delivery: Manage multiple workstreams, timelines and deliverables, ensuring accurate, polished work and smooth collaboration across integrated teams.
  • Team contribution: Support and guide junior colleagues, contribute positively to client teams and broader Burson initiatives, and demonstrate effective time management and a collaborative agency mindset.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Corporate communications experience at Account Manager level or above, ideally gained within a communications or public relations agency. 
  • Fluency in Dutch, with excellent written and verbal communication skills; strong professional English is also required for an international client and team environment.
  • Proven media relations experience in the Netherlands, including the ability to develop relevant stories, pitch confidently and build strong journalist relationships.
  • Experience working with, or a clear interest in, Technology, Aviation or Financial Services clients and the issues shaping these sectors is preferred.
  • An interest in public affairs and issues & crisis communications, with experience in either area considered an advantage.
  • Strong account management skills, including the ability to manage priorities, coordinate teams and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good knowledge of the Dutch media, political, regulatory and stakeholder landscape.
  • A proactive, collaborative and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to contribute ideas and build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues.

For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Influence Strategist (AD) will provide strategic delivery across influencer and creator communications for a portfolio of clients and sectors.

This role is responsible for defining the strategic role of influencers within integrated communications programmes. You will translate client and audience challenges into clear influencer strategies, audience frameworks, creator ecosystems, channel recommendations and measurement approaches.

Working closely with clients, you will act as a trusted strategic advisor, helping them understand how influencers can support their business and communications objectives. You will work alongside account teams ensuring strategic thinking is applied consistently across briefs, creative development, activation and evaluation.

The role requires a strong understanding of the evolving influencer landscape, including creator communities, platform behaviours, cultural trends, audience motivations and the changing relationship between brands and talent. You will bring sound judgement, creativity and strategic rigour to help clients make better decisions about influence.

What you'll do:

  • Develop insight-led influencer strategies that align creator activity with broader communications and business objectives.
  • Build audience frameworks and creator ecosystems, identifying the right mix of influencers, experts, advocates and community voices.
  • Shape cross-platform influencer strategies across social, video, podcast, live and emerging channels.
  • Lead influencer planning, creator selection, partnership frameworks and content strategies that drive effective creative work.
  • Provide senior counsel on creator partnerships, governance, compliance, brand safety and influencer risk management.
  • Build trusted client relationships, leading workshops, presentations and strategic discussions.
  • Drive organic growth and new business opportunities, including pitch and proposal development.
  • Partner with PR, creative, paid, corporate affairs and analytics teams to deliver integrated campaigns and measurable business impact.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Senior Experience: A proven track record leading influencer marketing, social media within an agency or client-side environment.
  • Set Strategic Standards: Contribute to best practice across influencer planning, creator selection, audience strategy, cultural insight, governance and measurement..
  • Influencer Tech Stack & Analytics: Hands-on familiarity with influencer discovery, social listening, and analytics platforms (e.g., CreatorIQ, Brandwatch, Traackr, or equivalent).
  • Communications & Presentation Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and articulate creative strategies with clarity and authority.
  • DEI & Inclusive Culture: A commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, championing diversity in creator representation and team talent.

As a PowerPoint Designer, you will be the creative force behind some of Burson’s most important presentations – designing and building best-in-class templates and pitch decks that help win new business.   • Design, build and maintain a suite of on-brand PowerPoint templates, master slides and reusable assets for use across the agency

  • Safeguard brand consistency across all presentations, ensuring every deck reflects Burson’s identity and quality standards
  • Advise teams on presentation best practice, layout and visual storytelling to raise the bar across the business
  • Manage multiple briefs simultaneously, prioritizing effectively and remaining calm under pressure

 

Experience that contributes to success:

 

  • Advanced, expert-level proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, including master slides, templates, animations and transitions
  • Strong working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) for asset creation
  • A standout portfolio demonstrating template design and high-stakes pitch or new business presentations
  • Excellent layout, typography and data-visualisation skills, with a sharp attention to detail
  • Experience designing within brand guidelines and building scalable, easy-to-use templates for non-designers
  • Ability to interpret and challenge briefs, translating complex information into clear visual narratives
  • Strong time management, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deliver at pace
  • A collaborative team player, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-disciplinary teams

The role involves taking on a trusted, consultative position for key client contacts, leading the execution of integrated communication strategies, and driving daily account operations across consumer technology launches, product storytelling, media and influencer engagement, reviews programmes, events, and always-on reputation-building activity.

What you'll do:

  • Client Relationship Management: Serving as the primary day-to-day contact for mid-level clients, leading regular status touchpoints, ensuring proactive upward communication, and anticipating client needs. 
  • Technology Storytelling: Distilling complex technologies, products, platforms, propositions, and launches into sharp narratives tailored for business, trade, vertical, national, consumer technology, lifestyle, creator, and influencer audiences.

Supporting product reviews and seeding programmes, analyst and stakeholder activity, launch moments, press events, and the development of high-impact materials including press releases, pitches, briefing notes, messaging, Q&As, blog content, and executive thought leadership.

More about the role:

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded UK Marketing Lead to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.

Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further  Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.

You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.

We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.

What you'll do:

 

  • Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.
  • Strengthen Burson’s profile among priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.
  • Build a distinctive thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.
  • Identify key moments across the business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.
  • Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.
  • Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.

Experience that contributes to success:

We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of a marketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.

You'll bring:

  • A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.
  • Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.
  • Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.
  • Excellent editorial judgement. You know what makes an interesting point of view, what will engage an external audience and what won't.
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives.
  • Commercial instinct and an understanding of the relationship between reputation, relationships, marketing and new business.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders, including the ability to advise, influence and challenge constructively.
  • A strong understanding of AI-enabled marketing, together with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve insight, creativity, personalisation, productivity and measurement.
  • Strong knowledge of the communications, marketing and wider business landscape, with a natural curiosity about what's happening in the world.
  • A proactive approach to building external relationships with industry influencers, partners, media stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
  • A bias for action. You spot opportunities, bring ideas and make them happen.
  • High standards and exceptional attention to detail, without allowing perfection to get in the way of momentum.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to bring people together across Growth, practices, capabilities, creative teams and regional marketing colleagues.

What success looks like

You will help create a Burson UK that feels impossible to ignore: sharper in the market, faster into important conversations and better at turning our expertise into reputation, relationships and growth.

Success will mean:

  • greater visibility and distinctiveness for Burson amongst priority audiences;
  • stronger engagement with the clients and prospects we most want to reach;
  • a recognisable and consistent flow of distinctive Burson attitude, thinking and expertise into the market;
  • greater visibility for our senior experts and our best client work;
  • marketing programmes, content and experiences that create meaningful conversations and support growth; and
  • a faster, smarter and more measurable marketing operation.

This is an opportunity to help shape not simply how Burson markets itself in the UK, but how the market sees Burson and what we are capable of.

#LI-CY1

job.title: Vice President, Consumer Brand, Sports Portfolio - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Consumer Brand team partners with some of the world's most recognized sports brands, properties, leagues, and organizations to create culturally relevant communications programs that drive conversation, engagement, and business impact. We operate at the intersection of sports, earned media, entertainment, influencer engagement, athlete partnerships, and brand storytelling to help clients connect with consumers through compelling narratives, strategic partnerships, and integrated communications campaigns.

We are seeking a Vice President, Consumer Brand Sports to serve as a senior communications leader responsible for developing and executing integrated earned media and brand communications programs for a diverse portfolio of sports clients. This role will lead strategic communications initiatives that generate meaningful earned media results, elevate brand reputation, and connect clients with consumers through sports, culture, talent, and experiences across diverse consumer audiences.

The ideal candidate brings established relationships with key media outlets, publishers, journalists, producers, influencers, and industry stakeholders, along with expertise in athlete marketing, sponsorship activation, sports business trends, and culturally relevant storytelling that helps brands authentically engage consumers.

This individual will lead in the development and execution of campaigns, athlete and brand partnership programs, experiential events, press trips, and other integrated communications initiatives. They will serve as a trusted counselor to senior clients, delivering strategic recommendations, executive communications support, and compelling presentations while building long-term relationships and driving client growth.

The Vice President will manage and mentor team members, collaborate across agency disciplines, and contribute to agency growth through business development, client expansion, innovative communications strategies, and thought leadership.

The preferred locations for this role are Los Angeles (Hybrid), Southern California (Remote), or San Francisco (Hybrid).

What you'll do:

Lead Client Communications Programs

  • Develop and execute integrated earned media and communications programs for leading brands, sports properties, and entertainment clients.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to clients, providing senior-level counsel on media strategy, reputation management, athlete partnerships, sponsorship activations, and brand storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders while proactively identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships and grow business.

Drive Earned Media Excellence

  • Leverage deep knowledge of key sports, consumer, lifestyle, entertainment, and business media outlets, publishers, journalists, podcasts, newsletters, broadcast partners, and emerging media platforms.
  • Develop media strategies that generate earned coverage, cultural relevance, and audience engagement across traditional, digital, social, and emerging channels.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with sports, consumer, lifestyle, entertainment, and business media.

Lead Athlete Activations and Experiential Programming

  • Develop and execute athlete activation programs that align with client business objectives and brand narratives.
  • Identify and manage athlete, ambassador, influencer, and talent partnerships that drive visibility and engagement.
  • Lead the planning and execution of press trips, media tours, product launches, experiential activations, sporting event programs, and marquee consumer experiences.
  • Partner closely with talent agencies, athlete representatives, leagues, teams, and industry partners to maximize program impact.

Provide Team Leadership

  • Manage, mentor, and develop account teams while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and career development support to junior and mid-level team members.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across strategy, creative, social, influencer, analytics, and production disciplines to deliver integrated client solutions.

Contribute to Agency Growth

  • Play an active role in business development, including prospecting, pitch strategy, proposal development, and presentation delivery.
  • Contribute to new business opportunities by developing communications strategies and presenting recommendations to prospective clients.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through strategic counsel and innovative programming.
  • Partner with account leadership to identify organic growth opportunities, support account planning and resource management efforts, and contribute to the overall financial success of the business.
  • Represent Burson as a subject matter expert in sports communications, athlete partnerships, consumer brand marketing, and integrated communications.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 10+ years of experience in sports communications, consumer brand marketing, earned media, public relations, or integrated communications, preferably within an agency environment.
  • Deep understanding of the consumer sports landscape, including major leagues, teams, athletes, media ecosystems, sponsorship trends, fan engagement strategies, and cultural moments that drive conversation.
  • Proven relationships with leading sports, consumer, lifestyle, business, and entertainment media outlets, publishers, and journalists.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated earned media campaigns that generate impactful coverage and measurable results.
  • Significant experience planning and executing press trips, media events, product launches, experiential activations, and large-scale event communications programs.
  • Proven success leading athlete activations, sponsorship campaigns, endorsement programs, and talent-driven consumer marketing initiatives.
  • Strong client-facing presence with exceptional presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience counseling senior executives and marketing leaders on communications strategy, media engagement, and reputation management.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead integrated teams and collaborate effectively across disciplines to deliver business results.
  • Experience attracting, managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of agency business operations, including account management, staffing, financial oversight, and resource planning.
  • Proven success supporting and winning new business opportunities, including developing pitch strategies, presenting recommendations, and building relationships with prospective clients.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and sound judgment in high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a strategic mindset and delivering exceptional client service.
  • A passion for sports, culture, communications, and storytelling, with a pulse on emerging trends and opportunities shaping the industry.

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

job.title: Baseball Operations Trainee
job.description:
Overview:

The Baseball Operations Trainee is a seasonal, part-time position designed to provide hands-on stadium operations and event management experience for individuals interested in a career in professional sports. The trainee supports Durham Bulls games and other events across guest services, hospitality, parking, facility management, and event operations. The position generally runs between February and September for approximately four to seven months, depending on the candidate's availability and organizational needs. Hours vary based on the event schedule and include evenings, weekends, and holidays.


Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Supports the setup, operation, and breakdown of Durham Bulls games and other stadium events.

Assists with guest services by answering questions, providing directions, and helping resolve concerns in a professional manner.

Supports hospitality operations, including preparing event spaces and assisting with guest and group needs.

Assists with parking operations and helps maintain safe, organized pedestrian and vehicle flow.

Completes facility preparation, inspections, light cleaning, and event reset tasks as assigned.

Monitors assigned areas during events and promptly communicates safety, facility, or guest-service concerns to a supervisor.

Works with full-time staff, seasonal employees, vendors, and other departments to support efficient event execution.

Follows established safety procedures, stadium policies, and emergency protocols.

Maintains a flexible, team-oriented approach while rotating among operational assignments.

Performs other duties as required or assigned, provided they are reasonably related to the responsibilities outlined in this job description.


Required Qualifications: 

High school diploma or equivalent.

Strong customer-service and verbal communication skills.

Ability to follow instructions, exercise sound judgment, and work effectively with limited supervision.

Strong organizational skills, dependability, and attention to detail.

Ability to adapt to changing assignments and work collaboratively in a fast-paced event environment.

Availability to work a variable schedule that includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and most scheduled events during the assignment.

Ability to use basic communication tools, including email, mobile applications, and two-way radios, after training.

Ability to comply with Durham Bulls and Capitol Broadcasting Company safety and workplace policies.

No specific professional sports experience is required.


Preferred Qualifications:

Current enrollment in or recent completion of a sport management, hospitality, event management, business, or related program.

Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, athletics, live events, facilities, or venue operations.

Experience working collaboratively in a team-based environment.

Interest in pursuing a career in professional sports or event operations.

Familiarity with event-day operations or guest-service standards.


Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. 

Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during events.

Ability to move throughout the ballpark, including stairs, ramps, concourses, seating areas, and service spaces.

Ability to bend, crouch, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive event setup and breakdown tasks.

Ability to lift and carry equipment, supplies, or materials weighing up to 50 pounds, with assistance when appropriate.

Clear vision and hearing sufficient to communicate with guests and coworkers and respond to activity in a live-event environment.


Work Conditions: The work conditions and characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. 

Work is performed throughout the ballpark in indoor and outdoor areas and may involve heat, cold, rain, humidity, and changing weather conditions.

The event environment may include crowds, elevated noise levels, bright lights, and frequent interaction with the public.


Schedules vary based on games and events and may include long shifts, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Pre-Employment Information:

A pre-employment drug screening is required. 

Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify. 

Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.

All Capitol Broadcasting Company properties are tobacco-free.


EEO Statement:

Capitol Broadcasting Company is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Capitol Broadcasting Company, Inc. is a diversified communications company which owns and/or operates WRAL-TV, WRAZ-TV, WRAL-FM, WRAL-HD2, WNGT-CD, WCMC-FM, WCMC-HD1, WDNC-AM, WCMC-HD2, WCMC-HD3, WCLY-AM, WCMC-HD4, Microspace, and WRAL Digital in Raleigh, NC; WILM-TV, WILT-LD and Sunrise Broadcasting in Wilmington, NC; The Durham Bulls Baseball Club, Bull City Hospitality, and Coastal Plain League in Durham, NC; The Holly Springs Salamanders in Holly Springs, NC; the American Underground startup hub in Durham, NC; and real estate interests including the American Tobacco Historic District in Durham, NC; Rocky Mount Mills in Rocky Mount, NC; MoJud Lofts in Greensboro, NC; and The Thread in Rock Hill, SC.

job.title: Board Operator
job.description:
Overview:

Microspace Communications is seeking a detail-oriented Part-Time Board Operator to support a variety of broadcast operations. This role is responsible for managing religious programming, live event broadcasts, network feeds, and play-by-play content, ensuring high-quality, reliable on-air delivery.

This position may also include part-time shifts within our 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC), providing monitoring and support for satellite and IP-based broadcast systems. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, monitoring broadcast systems, and responding quickly to technical or programming issues to maintain seamless operations.

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions: 

  • Operate the broadcast console during live talk shows, ensuring smooth andaccurateon-air execution 
  • Manage audio levels in real time by adjusting faders andmonitoringoverall sound quality 
  • Log key events, highlights, and timing markers during broadcasts, andassistwith seamless transitions between segments or games 
  • Coordinate with customers and theMicrospaceNetwork Operations Center (NOC) toestablishand maintain reliable broadcast connections
  • Troubleshoot and support audio codec systems, includingComrex,Tieline, and Telos Z/IP, to ensure consistent signal quality and performance

Required Qualifications: 

Core Qualifications

  • Demonstrated reliability with a strong work ethic 
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to work independently 
  • Prior radio board operation experiencerequired
  • Experience working with studio and broadcast equipment 
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record 

Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of audio signal flow and broadcast chain (studio to IP delivery) 
  • Familiarity with audio codecs and IP-based audio transport (e.g.,Comrex,Tieline, Telos, RTP/streaming)
  • Working knowledge of broadcast automation systems and scheduling software 
  • Basic understanding of IP networking concepts (IP addressing, connectivity, latency) 
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, particularly in live environments

Operations & Performance

  • Proven ability to perform effectively in high-pressure, live broadcast environments 
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize during simultaneous live events or incidents 
  • Strong planning, preparation, and attention to detail 
  • Ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and escalation protocols 
  • Experience working in or willingness to learn a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment 

Communication & Teamwork

  • Clear and professional communication skills, both verbal and written 
  • Strong attention to detail in logging, documentation, and incident reporting 
  • Team-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate across engineering, operations, and customers 

Availability & Flexibility

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays 
  • Willingness toparticipatein on-call rotations or emergency response situations as needed

Physical Demands: 

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods (up to 4–6 hours per shift) at a broadcast console or workstation
  • Manual dexterity tooperatefaders, buttons, rotary knobs, and touchscreen interfaces with precision
  • Near visual acuity tomonitoraudio meters, waveforms, logs, and network status displays
  • Hearing ability sufficient to detect subtle audio anomalies, level imbalances, and signal quality issues
  • Ability to speak clearly and listen actively via headsets, studio monitors, and intercom systems
  • Occasional reaching, twisting, or bending to access equipment or cabling behind racks or consoles
  • Ability tolift upto 25–30 pounds (e.g., codecs, cables, small broadcast gear) whenassistingwith equipment setup or troubleshooting

Work Conditions: 

  • Work is performed in a broadcast studio and Network Operations Center (NOC) environment
  • Part-time schedule:approximately 20–24 hours per week, with shifts that may include nights, weekends, and holidays
  • May berequiredto work during live events, breaking broadcasts, or emergency response situations
  • On-call rotation participation may berequiredas needed
  • Fast-paced, high-pressure environment requiring quick decision-making and multitasking
  • Collaboration with remote customers, NOC personnel, and engineering teams via phone, radio, and digital communication tools
  • Some shift flexibilityrequiredbased on broadcast schedules and operational needs

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employmentdrug screening isrequired. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Companyparticipatesin E-Verify. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Companyparticipatesin the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.
