job.title: Traffic Coordinator (Bay Area)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is seeking a highly organized, detail-driven Traffic Continuity Coordinator to play a vital role in the success of our broadcast and digital advertising operations. This position will be in the office located in the Bay Area of California. This position sits at the intersection of programming, sales, and revenue, ensuring that premium advertising inventory is managed with precision, accuracy, and care across multiple radio stations. As a key member of our operations team, the Traffic Continuity Coordinator helps keep everything running smoothly—meeting tight deadlines, maintaining flawless logs, and supporting both internal teams and clients with reliable, timely information. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, stays calm under pressure, and takes pride in getting the details right the first time. You’ll collaborate closely with programming and management, use industry-leading tools to manage commercial activity, and contribute directly to the financial performance of the stations. If you enjoy a role where accuracy matters, teamwork is valued, and your behind-the-scenes expertise makes a visible impact every day, you’ll feel right at home at Connoisseur Media. What you need to do to be successful in this position: Prepare and Manage Program Logs: Accurately prepare daily program logs for one or more of our five radio stations, ensuring precision and adherence to strict deadlines. Schedule and Process Commercials: Efficiently schedule radio commercials and process commercial contracts on a daily basis. Provide Inventory Insights: Supply station management with accurate and up-to-date advertising inventory information. Collaborate on Programming: Work closely with station programmers to ensure hourly clocks are accurate and current on all program logs. Reconcile Daily Logs: Reconcile daily program logs for assigned radio stations, verifying all scheduled content aired correctly. Generate Reports: Prepare various reports for station management as needed, providing valuable insights into our traffic operations. Manage Commercial Copy as needed: Process and schedule commercial copy, ensuring all ad materials are ready for air. Utilize Industry Tools: Work with third-party service, programming, and spot providers such as Wide Orbit, Mr. Master, vCreative, or other industry networks. Support Team Operations: Perform other duties consistent with the position to ensure smooth and efficient traffic operations. What you need to bring:

Experience

At least three years Eagle Eye: Legendary attention to detail is legendary. Nothing gets past you! Withstand Pressure? What Pressure? Deadlines? No sweat! You stay cool, calm, and collected, even when things are hectic. Be a Solo Star: You can totally crush tasks on your own without needing constant hand-holding. Problem Solver Pro: You're quick to spot a snag and even quicker to flag it so we can fix it. Keyboard Ninja: You're a data entry whiz – fast and accurate. Tech Savvy: Picking up new software is a breeze for you. Preference may be given to candidates who meet the above requirements plus have the following:

Experience

working with WideOrbit and/or vCreative traffic software. Working knowledge of spreadsheet and word processing applications.

job.title: Automated Control Room Operator - Global News Toronto
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Global News Toronto

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Toronto, Ontario - Don Mills (On-site)

About the Role:

Global News Toronto is looking for a Full-Time Automated Control Room Operator to join their team.

Reporting to the Manager of Broadcast Operations, the successful candidate will be responsible for directing various live and pre-taped programming for on-air and online broadcasts.

You will contribute by:

• Direct various live and pre-taped programming for on air and online broadcasts in an automated control room environment.

• Perform facilities checks and assist with technical initialization for robotic cameras, audio boards, graphics systems, and teleprompter.

• Collaborate closely with producers, anchors and reporters in blocking and building show rundowns.

• Be a leader in the control room and provide guidance and direction for technical teams.

• Creatively lead the graphics and production staff in the look of various shows

• Maintain the highest production standards for all programming.

• Remote coordinate live events when required.

• Ability to work late nights, early morning and weekends as needed.

• Other duties as assigned.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Diploma or degree in Broadcast Technology, Journalism, Radio & TV Production, or related field.

• Minimum 2 years of network control room experience in the role of Director, Assistant Director or Technical Director

• Automated control room directing experience using Mosart or Overdrive is a plus.

• Ability to work in a team environment as a collaborator and leader to meet tight deadlines.

• Excellent communication skills

• Ability to calmly manage the demands and pressures of meeting multiple daily broadcast deadlines in a high-tech environment.

• Knowledge of lighting principles, virtual sets and audio systems would be beneficial.

• Knowledge around any of the following newsroom management systems including Open Media, Grass Valley, Xpression is beneficial.

• Excellent multitasking skills and adaptability in an evolving media landscape

• A positive, can-do attitude.

Application Deadline: October 30, 2026

job.title: Coordonnateur(-trice) des médias sociaux – Marketing général
job.description:
Corus est une force motrice de l'industrie des médias, avec un portefeuille diversifié de marques reconnues qui divertissent et informent les auditoires par le biais de récits exceptionnels et de contenu captivant, touchant chaque jour des millions de personnes à travers le monde entier.

Notre culture et notre équipe sont ce qui fait de nous, noUS.

Nous sommes passionnés par le désir de tisser des liens avec le monde qui nous entoure : nous voulons exprimer, échanger et faire partie de la vie des gens. Notre culture primée est l'expression de qui nous sommes, ce que nous faisons et comment nous prospérons. Nos valeurs représentent notre culture en action. Elles décrivent notre manière d'atteindre nos objectifs, de travailler ensemble, de nous engager avec nos partenaires et d'interagir avec nos collectivités. Chez Corus, nous Gagnons ensemble, Pensons différemment, Faisons avancer les choses, Apprenons chaque jour, et Démontrons notre bienveillance.

Prêt à vous joindre à noUS?

Envie de découvrir les coulisses de la télé? Tu cherches une équipe chaleureuse et un nouveau défi? Corus Média recherche une personne créative et organisée pour propulser la présence numérique de nos chaînes spécialisées francophones : Vivéo, Historia, Séries Plus et Télétoon la nuit.

Tu orchestreras le calendrier éditorial, tu créeras des contenus visuels et vidéo accrocheurs, tu déploieras des campagnes payantes et tu géreras nos chaînes YouTube, en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes et nos partenaires de production.

Ta mission : faire briller nos marques en ligne, engager nos communautés et mettre en valeur nos productions grâce à des contenus créatifs et performants.

Pour accomplir cette mission, il te faudra faire preuve de créativité, d’organisation, de proactivité et avoir un vif intérêt pour la télé québécoise et les tendances numériques. Nous cherchons une personne passionnée et capable de jongler plusieurs projets à la fois sur qui l’équipe peut compter!

Tes responsabilités

Stratégie et planification

• Contribuer à l’élaboration de la stratégie numérique et sociale de nos marques, puis la déployer.

• Concevoir le calendrier éditorial et en assurer le suivi, de la production à la diffusion.

• Repérer les tendances émergentes et proposer des concepts novateurs pour maximiser notre portée.

• Collaborer avec l’équipe des communications pour les trousses de presse numériques, les partenariats, les concours et tous les autres projets spéciaux.

• Travailler en synergie avec la responsable du service à l’auditoire pour la gestion de communauté.

• Conseiller les équipes internes sur les meilleures pratiques et les outils numériques.

Création et gestion de contenu

• Piloter tout le cycle de production en collaboration avec l'équipe créative : idéation, création visuelle, montage vidéo (publications, Reels, Stories, etc.) et diffusion.

• Gérer et optimiser les chaînes YouTube de nos marques, y compris leur référencement (SEO).

• Collaborer avec les équipes de production pour repérer les occasions de captation de contenu et coordonner le crosspostage.

• Appliquer les meilleures pratiques d’accessibilité numérique (sous-titres, formats adaptés, lisibilité).

Publicité numérique et analyse de performance

• Paramétrer, programmer et optimiser des campagnes payantes sur Meta Ads et Google Ads.

• Mesurer la performance (organique et payant), puis présenter résultats et recommandations.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Études en communications, marketing numérique, médias sociaux ou domaine connexe.

• Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en gestion de médias sociaux, création de contenu et placement publicitaire numérique.

• Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles en français.

• Maîtrise de ensemble des outils de Meta et de Google Ads (paramétrage, ciblage, suivi).

• Bonne connaissance de YouTube et de ses outils d’optimisation (SEO vidéo, listes de lecture).

• Maîtrise d’outils de création et de montage (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, CapCut, Canva ou équivalents)

• Anglais fonctionnel, requis pour communiquer efficacement avec les partenaires

• Vif intérêt pour la télé québécoise, la culture et les contenus d’ici.

• Curiosité marquée pour les tendances du web.

Comment postuler

Envoie ta candidature d’ici le 30 octobre 2026. Nous communiquerons uniquement avec les personnes retenues pour une entrevue.

Candidat(e)s internes

Chaque jour, nous travaillons forts pour devenir un lieu de travail encore plus diversifié, équitable et inclusif, qui favorise le bien-être de nos employés et apporte une contribution positive à nos communautés. Vous souhaitez en savoir plus ? Consultez notre plan d'action pour la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion ainsi que notre rapport sur le développement durable pour obtenir plus d'informations sur notre approche en matière de personnes, de planète et de responsabilité.

Nous voulons que notre main-d'œuvre reflète toute la diversité des communautés à travers le Canada.

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience accessible à tous les candidats, quelles que soient leurs capacités. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers au cours du processus de recrutement, veuillez en informer votre recruteur ou le responsable du recrutement, ou envoyez-nous un courriel confidentiel à accessibility@corusent.com.

Comment postuler :

Si cette offre vous intéresse, cliquez sur le bouton « Postuler maintenant » en haut de cette page pour soumettre votre candidature.

Employés Interne de Corus:

Vous devez vous connecter à votre compte Dayforce sous « Rechercher des emplois » pour postuler en interne.

Nous apprécions l'intérêt de tous les candidats, mais seuls ceux sélectionnés pour un entretien seront contactés. Veuillez ne pas téléphoner.

• Ability to effectively communicate with reporters, the public, and the newsroom;

Globalnews.ca is looking for a full-time Online Supervisor based in Toronto to join its team.

Reporting to the Managing Editor for Local Coverage, the successful candidate will both report stories and help oversee a dynamic group while creating top-quality content daily.

They will require a strong communication and organizational skills and must be able to move efficiently and responsibly through a sizeable volume of stories coming from markets across the country.

They will also show a track record for reporting news hits.

A demonstrable enthusiasm and curiosity for local stories is a must, as is a passion for mentoring younger reporters.

• Communicating, teaching, tracking and model Global News’ best practices in digital journalism.

• Writing, posting and promoting online content.

• Report on top-performing content to help inform editorial decisions for all publishing platforms.

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law. 

 

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Account Manager - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

Our Cox Media Group team in Orlando, FL is looking for an Account Manager (AM). Our AMs get to provide administrative support to the entire sales department. For example, our AMs work on special projects, set appointments, write correspondence, create presentations, compile data and research, and work directly with our clients and sales staff. Some of which could be of a sensitive or confidential nature.

 

Our ideal candidate will have worked in a support position in a sales environment, having an aptitude towards working with the digital sales process and open to learning new software programs.

 

As this position is in sales, the ideal candidate must enjoy working in a team-oriented environment and playing an integral role in achieving the goals of the department. This role may qualify for future promotion to a senior professional assistant or media consultant. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides high level internal and external customer service 
  • Works with Sales to provide customer-facing support including any billing errors or issues, inputting sales orders/revisions for traditional and digital sales, pulls various sales reports as required by sales management and MCs from Google Analytics, AdWords, DFP, and others. 
  • Serves as our Special Event coordinator. 
  • Creates proposals, presentations and various sales collateral. 
  • Become an expert with all internal systems: Wide Orbit, Miller Kaplan, Nielsen, DOT, XSM, to name a few. 
  • Provides general administrative support. 
  • Maintains keen attention to detail in organizing meetings and anticipating needs. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2 years' college or equivalent high-level administrative experience required. 
  • Excellent communication skills with attention to detail accuracy and follow-up required. 
  • Excellent written correspondence, document presentation, proposal creation (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Photoshop/Illustrator, or other similar tools) skills required. 
  • Experience communicating directly and confidently with clients required. 
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality required 
  • Must be fluent, or have the talent to become fluent, in sales technology assets (to include but not limited to Scarborough, Tapscan, Nielsen, Topline) 
  • Ability to prioritize and complete tasks, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

job.title: Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Miami Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Miami

Job Title:  Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Miami Radio

 

Position Overview

The Activation Specialist for Miami Radio reports directly to the Promotions & Activations Manager and represents the radio stations as a Brand Ambassador at events and on social media, as well as assisting the promotions team in the office by preparing for events, fulfilling contests and prizing, and utilizing other skills to create content across departments.

 

This role is an entry-level, part-time position, with the opportunity to potentially shadow current CMG employees and assist in videography, graphic design, social media, marketing, promotions, event planning, and sales and programming.

 

Exceptional communication skills and an energetic personality are a requirement. This role will require working nights, weekends and holidays regularly, as well as the ability to lift 50 pounds.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Engaging with the public at events ranging from client locations to major festivals and concerts, which may require high levels of energy for several hours
  • Show up professionally on-site at events, in the office and on social media
  • Represent each radio station in the cluster through knowledge of, and passion for, the brands
  • Set up and break down of station sound and promotional equipment (tents, banners, speakers, audio PA system) at station events
  • Create and post engaging content, photos and video on station social media
  • Assist with organization and maintenance of station vehicles and promotional equipment
  • Compose accurate and detailed event recaps for management
  • Effectively communicate with listeners via email, phone and in-person
  • Assist in various departments throughout the station as needed, including but not limited to digital content, programming, sales, and engineering

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be a professional team player with customer focus and ability to take initiative and direction
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Highly adaptable and professional
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Able to multi-task in a high-speed environment
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills including grammar, spelling and the ability to tailor copywriting to each stations’ brand voice
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and holidays throughout the year
  • Possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Preferred Qualifications

  • College coursework in marketing, public relations, digital media, preferred
  • Videography, event coordination, customer service and/or social media skills preferred

job.description:
Location: NC-Charlotte

Job Title:  Anchor/Reporter - Telemundo WSOC TV

 

Position Overview

Telemundo Charlotte, part of the WSOC newsroom, is seeking an enterprising and energetic Anchor/Reporter to help grow the market’s only Spanish-language TV newscast. This position requires a newsroom leader who can confidently anchor newscasts, react to breaking news, and produce impactful stories for Noticias Charlotte. This journalist will also produce and share content for Noticias Charlotte on digital and social media.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Bilingual, with excellent Spanish-writing skills.
  • Assist in writing, pre-production and broadcast preparation; ensuring stories are clear/accurate and represent the station’s benchmark goals
  • Deliver news copy on camera with confidence
  • Use creativity and imagination, and exercise independent professional judgment in investigating, reporting, interviewing, writing, editing and delivering news stories and assigned events

Position Overview

The Digital Media Manager will be responsible for driving digital revenue growth by working with local sellers and developing new direct digital advertising clients in the local market. In this role, you will identify, implement, and accelerate strategic digital sales initiatives to meet and exceed goals. This will be accomplished by working with our local sales team, sales management, market management, and the CMG Local Solutions team. Are you a digitally savvy, client-focused media strategist who enjoys helping businesses grow? CMG is looking for a Digital Media Strategist – Radio Sales to partner with our Atlanta Radio Sales team and develop smart, integrated advertising solutions for local and regional clients.

 

In this role, you’ll work side by side with Radio Sellers and market leaders to uncover advertiser needs, shape compelling media strategies, and connect clients with the right mix of CMG radio brands, digital audio, streaming, targeted display, video, paid search, SEO/CRO, paid social, lead generation, sponsorships, and premium digital advertising products.

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Dir, Traffic - TV

 

Position Overview

Do you have a proven record of creating best practices, leading, and developing a traffic team? Do you have a passion for helping local and national businesses reach their target customers right where they are? If so, this is the job for you!

 

Cox Media Group “CMG” has an exciting opportunity for a best-in-class Director of Television Traffic. We are looking for a dynamic leader to standardize Sales and Traffic operations across markets.  

 

Reporting to the SVP, Chief Sales Officer, this role will focus on increasing revenue and minimizing errors by defining standard processes and setting up and maintaining database configurations, including Inventory Codes, property settings, sales codes, and security settings, to ensure optimal performance  and use.  

 

Location: Other CMG TV Markets locations will be considered 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Process Improvements:

  • Defines workflow communication processes for order errors, oversell, inventory management, late orders, material changes, preempts, makegoods, etc.  
  • Liaises between stations and the corporate office to build relationships and resolve issues.  
  • Works with the corporate sales operations team on divisional initiatives and workflow.  
  • Monitors changes and resolves traffic discrepancies.  
  • Partners with the Sales department to ensure current and updated inventory availability, sellout  information, and placement of bonus spots.  
  • Assists sales management with internal pricing and with communication of inventory to both local and national sales offices.  
  • Works with programming, account executives, and sales management to ensure a seamless flow of schedules and revisions. Assists the sales team with inquiries about AR and the traffic system
  • Works closely with Finance on cash-in-advance and credit-restricted accounts.
  • Standardizes formats, inventory codes, advertiser and agency profiles, sales codes, format codes, priority use, etc., so that these items are uniform across all stations and logs to maximize operational efficiency and minimize errors.  
  • Customizes the database and system properties for optimal performance and efficiency.  
  • Standardizes the day-to-day business processes for exchanging information between traffic and each station. This includes processing orders, managing spots, setting deadlines, logging changes, finalizing and reconciling logs, etc.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Training for Staff:

  • Trains log editors and creates a comprehensive checklist for daily duties and the best way to use the Software to be efficient and effective in doing that task, including WO Traffic tools.
  • Works with staff to identify the best workflows and processes for spot placement, log massaging, and barter.
  • Maintains daily staff schedules and vacation grids, and ensures backup coverage is available for sick leave, vacation, etc.  
  • Key Performance Indicators related to Traffic should be monitored, and workflows should be updated to reduce the most common errors.  
  • Creates Monthly Inventory Management Performance and reviews it with log editors and sales managers to increase revenue by reviewing spot placements.  
  • Assists staff with solving problems and troubleshooting issues with WO Support.  
  • Be available after hours and on weekends in case of on-air emergencies.
  • Resolves problems among Traffic Staff, Sales, Continuity, Programming, and Accounting.  

 

WideOrbit Traffic and Station Information: 

  • Maintains a complete understanding of the WideOrbit software system, including reviewing release notes and implementing new features.  
  • Interacts with engineering and broadcast operations regarding any "On-Air" malfunctions that may arise.  
  • Works closely with station programmers to ensure hourly clocks are accurate and up to date in the program logs.  
  • Maintains inventory and sales codes, selling elements, placer, and property settings related to traffic and sales.
  • Assists with the analysis of implementing or purchasing new features, implementing new workflows, and bridging the gap in understanding between the user and the executive team.  
  • Establishes a cross-functional, multi-station advisory team to test and review new features and ideas.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of Traffic Management experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of broadcast traffic to effectively manage the scheduling, placement, and delivery of advertisements across various media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills to ensure accurate and timely implementation of traffic schedules, while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities to resolve any issues related to ad placements, discrepancies, or conflicts, ensuring smooth operations and client satisfaction.
  • Effective communication and people skills to collaborate with internal teams, clients, and media vendors, providing clear instructions and resolving any conflicts or discrepancies in a professional manner.
  • Project Management, planning, and/or Buying capacity.
  • Advanced experience working with Microsoft Outlook (creating and organizing folders, answering, and/or managing 500+ emails per day), Microsoft SharePoint, and WideOrbit Traffic. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, management, communications, or related field.
  • Advertising/ Media Agency Experience
  • Supervise Regional Traffic Managers at multiple locations, including training, scheduling, and performance evaluations.
  • Proven experience participating in or leading inventory optimization discussions and committees.

job.title: Director of Engineering - WFTV/WRDQ Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Director of Engineering - WFTV/WRDQ Orlando

 

Position Overview

WFTV/WRDQ Orlando TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
  • Partner with station leadership to align engineering priorities with operational goals, audience needs, local news production, company initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Plan, execute, and track annual operating and capital budgets, including forecasting, business case development, bid solicitation, vendor selection, documentation, and project delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during outages, planned maintenance, project work, and operational incidents, including impact, status, timelines, and follow-up actions.
  • Lead after-action reviews for significant technical incidents, document root causes and corrective actions, and implement improvements to reduce repeat issues.
  • Prepare timely status reports, budget updates, project documentation, technical records, and leadership briefings as required.
  • Serve as an essential leader during emergencies, severe weather, breaking news, major technical failures, or other events requiring immediate technical response.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, media technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5–10 years of progressively responsible broadcast, media technology, or engineering experience, including leadership or management responsibility.
  • Strong understanding of television broadcast operations, RF transmission, studio production, newsroom systems, master control, automation, signal flow, media workflows, and FCC compliance.
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networks, firewalls, switches, servers, operating systems, endpoint management, cybersecurity fundamentals, and business continuity practices.
  • Experience managing operating budgets, capital budgets, technical projects, vendor relationships, documentation, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, prioritize, and develop technical staff in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, 24/7 operational environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess operational risk and respond effectively during urgent situations.
  • Customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with internal departments, corporate partners, vendors, contractors, clients, and the public.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and provide leadership during nights, weekends, holidays, emergencies, or outages as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a mid- or major-market television station, multi-site broadcast environment, or highly complex live production operation.
  • Experience with IP video/audio, cloud playout, broadcast automation, newsroom systems, remote production, bonded cellular, streaming, virtualization, and disaster recovery workflows.
  • Familiarity with ATSC 3.0, HDR, SMPTE standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and emerging broadcast technology trends.
  • SBE certification, PMP certification, cybersecurity certification, or other relevant technical credentials.

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.

  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.

  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with business AI leaders, champions, and stakeholders to support department-specific AI initiatives, share best practices, and accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to accelerate AI adoption and value realization.

  • Support evaluation and implementation planning for new AI solutions and capabilities.

Position Overview

The Director, Financial Data Reporting leads the strategy, architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise ﬁnancial data and business intelligence solutions. This role combines deep expertise in data engineering, warehousing, analytics, ﬁnancial systems, and technical leadership to improve business processes, expand access to trusted information, and enable timely, informed decision-making.

 

The Director owns the full systems development life cycle for complex reporting and data initiatives—from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, production support, and continuous optimization. The role also directs the conﬁguration of interactive dashboards, including global and local ﬁlters, to meet a broad range of ﬁnance and business requirements.

 

Serving as a trusted partner to executive leadership, Corporate Finance, IT, Security, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director translates business needs into scalable technical solutions, strengthens data governance and controls, resolves performance challenges, and advances the organization’s ﬁnancial reporting capabilities.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic leadership: Connects data and technology priorities to business strategy and long-term enterprise needs.
  • Business partnership: Builds credibility across Finance, IT, Security, operations, vendors, and executive leadership.
  • Execution and accountability: Converts complex requirements into reliable solutions and delivers measurable results across competing priorities.
  • Continuous improvement: Uses data, technology, and disciplined problem-solving to simplify processes and improve performance.
  • Communication and inﬂuence: Presents complex information clearly and drives alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy, design, development, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehouse, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Manage the full systems development life cycle across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring solutions align with stakeholder requirements, technical standards, delivery commitments, and business priorities.
  • Own the AWS (RDS MySQL, S3) and SQL Server reporting databases, including moving the remaining legacy reporting to AWS.
  • Own month-end close data processing: WideOrbit, programmatic, digital and MAI revenue loads and the journal entry/invoice ﬁles into SAP, including reconciliations and controls.
  • Own the Power BI estate: reports, data models, scheduled refreshes and subscriptions, including daily revenue pacing and the daily liquidity summary.
  • Lead digital analytics data engineering on Google Cloud (BigQuery) and the Tableau-to-Power BI migration.
  • Direct the contractors and vendors supporting data and reporting.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks and backup coverage so no critical process depends on one person.
  • Evaluate and recommend system architecture that improves scalability, reliability, availability, performance, and access to critical ﬁnancial data.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Build and optimize data processes that integrate multiple disparate data sets into a trusted reporting environment, reducing executive reporting cycle times.
  • Partner with Corporate Finance and cross-functional teams to identify reporting needs, resolve data and warehouse performance issues, and deliver timely, actionable insights.
  • Oversee the integration of WideOrbit, WideOrbit Programs, MAI, Concur, Costar, Darwin, Operative, ADP, Blackline, Magnit, and related vendor systems with SAP and the broader reporting environment.
  • Design and conﬁgure interactive dashboards using global and local ﬁlters to support a diverse matrix of ﬁnancial and operational requirements.
  • Establish data governance, validation, reconciliation, documentation, and quality-control practices that support accurate, consistent, secure, and audit-ready ﬁnancial reporting.
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and Security to maintain appropriate data access, privacy, retention, and information-security standards.
  • Provide production support and operational oversight, including monitoring, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, change management, and business continuity for critical reporting solutions.
  • Deﬁne and monitor success measures for data availability, reporting accuracy, system performance, user adoption, project delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Provide technical leadership, communicate complex data concepts clearly, manage key vendor relationships, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders, business partners, and technical teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related ﬁeld; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, or ﬁnancial systems, including at least ﬁve years leading enterprise initiatives, technical teams, or cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated success delivering executive reporting solutions and leading complex systems integrations, cloud or data warehouse migrations, and ERP transformations.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL-based environments, cloud data platforms, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, dashboard design, data quality practices, and ﬁnancial reporting architecture.
  • Experience with project management, SDLC governance, quality assurance, production support, and vendor management in a complex operating environment.
  • Proven ability to inﬂuence senior leaders, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and support multiple business units.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and executive-presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to ﬁnancial, operational, and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a related ﬁeld.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, AWS MySQL, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and enterprise ﬁnancial or media-industry systems.
  • Relevant certiﬁcation such as CPA, CMA, CBIP, Microsoft Power BI, AWS, GCP, SAP, PMP, or CSM.

WSB-TV is the leading television station in the South, built on a winning culture of collaboration, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to serving our community. WSBTV leaders believe in empowering our employees to grow, lead, and deliver exceptional results for our audiences and advertisers.

 

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence.

 

By anticipating needs, identifying risks and bottlenecks, and proactively driving follow-through, the Executive Business Partner helps maximize organizational effectiveness and the impact of executive leader(s) and their teams.

Competencies for Success

Executive Presence

  • Communicates professionally and effectively with leaders, employees, and external stakeholders.

Operational Excellence

  • Creates structure, manages details, and consistently delivers high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Business Judgment

  • Understands priorities, exercises sound judgment, and appropriately escalates issues when needed.

Initiative

  • Anticipates needs, takes action, and looks ahead to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Accountability

  • Demonstrates ownership, follows through on commitments, and ensures details are completed accurately and on time.

Relationship Building

  • Builds strong partnerships through collaboration, responsiveness, and trust.

Adaptability

  • Effectively manages changing priorities, ambiguity, and competing demands while maintaining a positive attitude.

Strategic Acumen

  • Understands organizational objectives, business priorities, and leadership goals; connects daily activities to broader business outcomes and helps drive strategic execution.

Influencing Without Authority

  • Builds alignment, gains commitment, and drives follow-through across stakeholders through credibility, relationships, communication, and accountability. 

Continuous Improvement

  • Seeks opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, and enhance overall productivity.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Support & Coordination

  • Provides comprehensive support to executive and senior leaders, including complex calendar management, scheduling prioritization, meeting coordination, travel planning, expense reporting, and administrative support.
  • Proactively manages the executive’s time, energy and strategic priorities by identifying conflicts, anticipating emerging issues, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared for meetings and positioned for effective decision making and execution.
  • Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Maintains awareness of key business priorities, organizational developments, and leadership initiatives to help proactively coordinate activities; identify scheduling considerations, dependencies, risks, and opportunities; and items requiring executive attention.

 

Meeting & Communication Management

  • Develops meeting agendas, presentation materials, executive briefings, summaries, reports, and communications that support productive discussions and informed leadership conversations.
  • Coordinates follow-up communications, tracks action items, and maintains documentation of meeting outcomes and commitments to ensure accountability for critical deliverables.
  • Serves as a liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, and discretion.

 

Project & Process Support

  • Supports special projects and business initiatives through organization, coordination, information gathering, documentation, and progress tracking.
  • Tracks key deliverables, deadlines, and commitments and follows up with stakeholders to support timely completion and clear accountability.
  • Creates and maintains project trackers, dashboards, templates, and other tools that support efficient execution and visibility.
  • Assists with coordination across departments, project teams, and executive support partners to promote alignment and effective communication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Operational Excellence

  • Leverages technology and productivity tools, including AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline administrative and operational tasks.
  • Establishes and maintains effective processes, workflows, and organizational systems that improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Establishes and manages executive operating rhythms, including leadership meetings, business reviews, action-item tracking, communication cadence, and executive follow-up processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvements and recommends practical enhancements to increase effectiveness.

Relationship Management

  • Builds positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Supports a collaborative and service-oriented environment while maintaining flexibility in response to changing business needs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience providing executive support, executive operations, business operations, chief of staff, project coordination, or related support to senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate executive needs, exercise independent judgment, and operate with a high degree of autonomy while managing competing priorities. 
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience supporting C-suite, executive-level, or senior business leaders within a complex, fast-paced organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage highly complex calendars, competing priorities, time-sensitive meetings, travel, expense reporting, and executive communications.
  • Strong business judgment, discretion, professionalism, and ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare polished executive materials, presentations, summaries, and correspondence.
  • Expert proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and related productivity tools.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships, collaborate across functions, and interact effectively with senior executives, external partners, and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, organizational leadership, project management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience supporting executives with distributed teams or managing scheduling across multiple time zones.
  • Experience in media, technology, professional services, or another dynamic, matrixed environment.
  • Experience supporting governance-related activities, executive off-sites, or confidential leadership forums.
  • Experience using AI and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to streamline workflows, improve reporting, and enhance executive productivity.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards, project trackers, templates, and operating cadence tools.

Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.
  • Manages breaking news. Ensures that we are on the air quickly. Monitors the execution in the control room. Facilitates drills to ensure talent is up to speed.
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes.
  • Executes live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms.
  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations. 

 

Physical Demands:

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.
  • Document review and computer use, including ability to manipulate fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines (including self-imposed deadlines). 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required 
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment 
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms 
  • Must be a good teacher and leader 
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects. 
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings. 
  • Ability to work well with others and deal with employee issues appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other field of study preferred 
  • Large market experience preferred

job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV, a Cox Media Group (CMG) station in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced, highly motivated I.T. Manager. Operating in the nation’s 26th largest television market, this hands-on leadership role manages the station's entire computing environment, localized server architecture, high-security network perimeters, and integrated broadcast-I.T. ecosystems.

 

The I.T. Manager ensures 24/7/365 operational continuity for our live news, production, and multi-platform digital channels. The ideal candidate will blend advanced systems administration with deep technical knowledge of specialized, automated broadcast television environments. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering and works in tandem with the station's local engineering team and CMG corporate technology group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Enforcement: Serve as the local gatekeeper for network security. Manage, patch, and monitor the station's Fortinet infrastructure (firewalls, switches, and secure access points), ensuring strict adherence to CMG corporate cybersecurity mandates.
  • Systems & Automation Administration: Direct the optimization of Microsoft enterprise environments, Active Directory, endpoint systems, and localized automated script pipelines to minimize operational overhead and drive reliability.
  • User Support Leadership: Manage the local help desk workflow, ensuring high-priority, zero-downtime technical support for live control rooms, field news crews, digital production teams, sales, and administrative staff.
  • Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Formulate, test, and manage strict local business continuity blueprints, ensuring off-site cloud backups and local hardware redundancies preserve the on-air and digital stream integrity during critical weather or emergency events.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.
  •  5+ years of experience in systems administration, network engineering, or I.T. infrastructure management, with a proven track record working inside a high-pressure, live broadcast television or multi-platform media environment.
  • Technical Proficiencies:
    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).
    • Profound understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, and QoS settings for media over IP).
  • Must be willing to participate in an on-call emergency rotation encompassing nights, weekends, and holiday coverage to support a continuous news cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security & Networking Certifications: Active certifications in corporate networking and perimeter protection (e.g., Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert).
  • Industry Accreditations: Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) certifications—specifically the Certified Broadcast Networking Engineer (CBNE) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT)—are highly valued.

Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Meteorologist - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB-TV in Atlanta is seeking a Meteorologist to join Severe Weather Team 2. The Atlanta area experiences all four seasons, making forecasting a central part of our coverage. Severe weather is a major focus, and we’re seeking a candidate with strong on-air delivery who can provide breaking weather coverage with a clear, authoritative presence.

 

The ideal candidate is creative and clear in their presentation and graphic support, has a digital-first mindset and connects authentically with viewers both on-air and online. This Meteorologist will also contribute to daily editorial meetings and turn stories.

 

Please submit your resume, link to demo reel (including breaking weather coverage), and examples of digital/social content in your application.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver clear, accurate, and engaging forecasts across multiple newscasts
  • Provide confident, in-depth coverage during severe and breaking weather events
  • Contribute to storm tracking and team coverage during high-impact weather
  • Create and publish timely, compelling content for digital, app, streaming, and social platforms
  • Produce weather explainers and enterprise content that enhances viewer understanding
  • Utilize The Weather Company and Baron Lynx weather systems to build visually compelling graphics and presentations
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to integrate weather coverage across all platforms
  • Represent the station at community events and public appearances

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
  • Minimum 3–5 years of on-air broadcast meteorology experience (major or competitive mid-major market preferred)
  • Proven experience covering severe weather and extended storm events
  • Strong working knowledge of The Weather Company system
  • Excellent live presentation, ad-libbing, and storytelling skills
  • Demonstrated digital-first approach, including social media and app engagement
  • Flexible scheduling, including weekends and holidays, is required, along with participation in an on-call rotation
  • This is an on-site, in-station role in the WSB-TV Newsroom
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active AMS Seal of Approval (CBM or CDM preferred)

Position Overview

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. This role is one of the primary on-air voices of the morning show and helps build audience loyalty, grow ratings and digital engagement, create compelling multiplatform content, and represent WNGC in the community.

 

We are looking for a great storyteller with a strong point of view, quick wit, and passion for Country music, local culture, and audience engagement. job.description:
Location: MA-Boston

Job Title:  Multi-Platform Editor/Videographer - WFXT TV

 

Position Overview

WFXT TV is seeking a Multi-Platform Editor/Videographer to join the Boston 25 News team.

 

We’re looking for a skilled video editor and/or videographer with strong visual composition and sound judgment. In this role, you’ll work with producers and reporters to shoot and edit video for 14.5 hours of daily on-air news coverage, while also creating content for streaming channels, the website, news and weather apps, and social media platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, self-motivated, deadline-focused, and brings strong people skills, a solid work ethic, and a positive attitude. This role requires availability to work nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Shoot and edit clear, compelling local news stories.
  • Work well under pressure and make quick decisions in the field.
  • Operate and maintain professional video cameras and news gathering equipment, including laptops, iPhones, LiveU units, and drones.
  • Use non-linear editing techniques to meet deadlines and produce high-impact stories.
  • Respond effectively during crises and breaking news and handle last-minute changes professionally.
  • Create digital content, edit social videos, and post to social media.
  • Come prepared for editorial and other meetings, contribute daily story ideas, and bring creative energy to the team.

job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  News Technology Coordinator - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV Pittsburgh has an exciting opportunity for a News Technical Coordinator. The role is responsible for resolving time-sensitive technical requests, maintaining the gear used to present and preserve media, maintaining tech supply inventory, and working alongside journalists to capture aerial video of news assignments.

WSB TV Channel 2, the #1 television station in Atlanta, Georgia is seeking a dedicated and creative video editor and motion designer to join its marketing & creative services team. You'll edit news promotions, image campaigns, and social content while creating motion graphics and branded assets for marketing campaigns across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms. Your work will help shape how one of the country's leading local television brands connects with its audience.

 

The Promotions Editor works primarily in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Avid Media Composer to turn news stories and station initiatives into polished promotions and marketing content. The ideal candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can manage multiple projects and collaborate with marketing producers and other stakeholders in a fast-paced local news environment.

Promotional Editing & Storytelling

  • Edit compelling promotional content for daily news, severe weather, investigations, special programming, station branding, and community initiatives.
  • Edit image campaigns for broadcast, streaming, social media, digital platforms, and paid marketing in formats suited to each channel.
  • Use music, pacing, sound design, and visual storytelling to maximize audience engagement.

Motion Design & Visual Branding

  • Develop branded graphics, typography, transitions, and promotional assets for television, streaming, web, and social platforms.
  • Maintain a consistent and polished WSB-TV look across marketing channels.

Content Creation & Digital Media

  • Edit and adapt platform-specific content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and emerging platforms.
  • Repurpose broadcast campaigns into social-first content designed to reach and engage more viewers.
  • Stay current on creative trends, editing techniques, storytelling styles, and social media best practices.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Creative Development & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with marketing producers, news leadership, digital teams, on-air talent, photographers, and other stakeholders to develop campaigns that connect with viewers.
  • Contribute fresh ideas for station initiatives, ratings periods, major news events, and community campaigns.
  • Help bring campaign concepts to life through editing, motion design, and content tailored to each platform.

  • Ensure deliverables meet technical specifications, brand standards, and platform requirements.

Position Overview

Cox Media Group Atlanta Radio is looking for a Senior Client Performance Manager to help our largest and most strategic advertisers get the most from their media investments.

 

In this senior, client-facing role, you will be a trusted performance partner, turning campaign data, market insights, and advertiser goals into clear recommendations that strengthen relationships, improve outcomes, and support long-term account growth.

 

You will work directly with clients and collaborate closely with Account Executives, sales leaders, digital sales teams, and operations partners to align strategy, execution, reporting, and optimization across radio, digital, and cross-channel campaigns.

 

The right candidate is consultative, analytical, and confident leading performance conversations with senior client stakeholders. You know how to connect campaign results to business priorities, identify meaningful opportunities, and communicate value in a way that builds trust.

 

This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys using data to tell a compelling performance story, guide optimization decisions, and help clients see the full value of their partnership with CMG Atlanta Radio.

 

Cox Media Group is an integrated company spanning broadcast, publishing, direct marketing, and digital media. We are digital experts – leveraging the best of television, radio, and digital marketing services to create innovative marketing solutions for businesses across the country.

 

At CMG Atlanta Radio, you will have the opportunity to work with well-known brands, influential local advertisers, and high-impact media campaigns in one of the country’s most dynamic markets. This role offers visibility, variety, and the chance to shape how strategic clients understand performance, value, and growth.

  • Ability to manage complex advertising campaigns or account portfolios with multiple stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, and performance expectations
  • Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms, reporting tools, and campaign workflows, including performance monitoring, trafficking, optimization, and results communication
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and develop insights that support client retention, revenue growth, and stronger campaign outcomes
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create polished, client-ready reports, presentations, and performance narratives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting insights to clients, senior stakeholders, sales leaders, and cross-functional partners
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative media environment
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong commitment to client service, accountability, and measurable business results

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in radio, audio, broadcast, digital media, or integrated local advertising solutions

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

About Cox Media Group 
CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 14 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com
