job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

1-3 Years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $3,000.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
    Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

 

For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

CUMULUS | Los Angeles 790 KABC-AM radio is LA's first premiere talk station and home of Armstrong & Getty, John Phillips, The Vince Show, and Mottek on Money. 


Position Overview

AM 790 KABC is seeking a part-time board operator in Culver City, California. The part-time board operator will report directly to KABC’s Program Director and be responsible for running the broadcast console during live talk programs, live sports broadcasts and other live programming needs. Plus, be responsible for recording, mixing and editing full length programs, podcasts, segments and other production elements as needed.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record operating a broadcast console for (a) major market radio station(s), have excellent communication skills, be detail oriented, organized, and possess the ability to work solo or with a team. Knowledge of Adobe Audition and OPX automation preferred but not required. Must be available to work weekends and holidays.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Responsibilities:

  • Operate broadcast console during live talk programs.
  • Run live remote broadcast (both talk and sports)
  • Knowledge of COMREX, SAS, OPX, Cleanfeed and Zoom a plus.
  • Ensure all commercials run as indicated on the commercial log.
  • Monitor on-air content and dump any unfavorable language as directed by KABC’s Program Director.
  • Forwarding EAS test as instructed by Chief Engineer and mandated by FCC rule.
  • Record, edit and mix full length programs, podcasts, segments, etc.
  • Commercial spot dubbing.
  • Posting content to KABC’s podcast page.
  • Troubleshoot technical problems in a timely manner.

 


Desired Skills, Knowledge and Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of board operator experience (or other audio engineering role).
  • Experience working with OP-X Automation (or similar systems).
  • Ability to record, edit and mix using Adobe Audition.
  • Strong track record and dependability.
  • Must be organized, detail oriented and possess excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Available to work weekends and holidays.

job.description:
Company Overview

CUMULUS | Modesto/Stockton, CA currently features 8 stations in the Modesto/Stockton area and surrounding counties.  Our stations include:  KATM-FM, KHKK-FM/KDJK-FM, KWIN-FM/KWNN-FM, KHOP-FM, KJOY-FM, and KESP-AM.  The cluster of 8 stations reaches thousands of listeners on a daily basis.     

 

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

Cumulus Media | Modesto is looking for a Director of Sales with a proven track record of winning, successfully supporting their teams and creating a positive environment where everyone can succeed. Our Director of Sales are exceptional problem solvers, true collaborators, creative, efficient and lead their teams to exceed our local sales revenue goals utilizing our on-air, digital and experiential assets. Developing new business is key to our success so our sales leaders cultivate plans to assist our sales teams to strategically prospect, develop and maintain opportunities both locally and beyond our home markets.


The right Director of Sales candidate will be someone who lives by our FORCE Cumulus values; WE are Focused, Responsible, Collaborative and Empowered!  If you are looking for a great culture and professional environment, then Cumulus could be the home for you.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement a strategic sales plan that will exceed the market’s revenue goals. The emphasis will be on selling integrated solution campaigns consisting of but not limited to: Radio, Audio, Digital, Live Events, Sweet Deals, and NTR
  • Be a visible and available leader to your team and community
  • Identify, recruit, train, coach, manage and develop high-performance Sales talent and build a successful team to ensure continued top-line growth
  • Maintain an ongoing recruitment effort to ensure top quality team, always having a bench of 3 or more candidates
  • Attend all high-profile account presentations; provide coaching and leadership to sales team
  • Conduct weekly one-on-one meetings with Sales Team members to evaluate pending business for conversion and note in CRM accordingly
  • Maximize and monitor CRM to verify your team has a blueprint to succeed
  • Participate and lead Sales staff meetings and training sessions
  • Manage inventory and reporting in Stratus/Wide Orbit
  • Manage administrative functions connected with forecasting revenue, rate, pricing and order approvals
  • Actively participate in business & community associations with the intention of developing extensive relationships with local influencers and decision makers
  • Develop and build relationships with clients by providing quality customer service
  • Lead communication with other departments to assure quality service when placing orders and coordinating promotions
  • Oversee special event sales
  • Provide managerial assistance in local and national rate negotiations, sales plans and budgeting
  • Develop creative, solution oriented, customer-focused revenue programs and ancillary sales projects
  • Oversee and manage expenses of the Sales organization
  • Generate revenue from personal account list
  • Work in collaboration between all departments

 

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast or digital sales, sales management and mentoring experience preferred with a proven track record of success in the radio and/or digital industry required.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, communications, marketing or related field is preferred.
  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including traveling to client meetings and attending business-related events.
  • Proficient in all aspects of radio and digital sales, including use of quantitative/qualitative research, event development, and multi-platform/integrated sales expertise.
  • Familiar with the management of CRM systems, budget procedures, daily sales accountability and recognition programs, inventory management and collections procedures.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms.
  • Highly developed training and coaching skills including; skills in organization, delegating, interviewing and motivating sales people.
  • Demonstrate high energy level and achievement-oriented attitude toward sales, sales training and education, and client relations with exceptional negotiation skills.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Flexible and creative.
  • Digitally savvy.
  • Ability to stay ahead of the curve in the constantly evolving advertising landscape.

Pay Range

USD $120,000.00 - USD $150,000.00 /Yr.
What We Offer

  • Competitive Pay
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
  • Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

job.title: Multimedia Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Lafayette currently features 4 stations and a digital agency in the Lafayette area.  The stations are KSMB 94.5, KRRQ 95.5, KNEK Magic 104.7 and KXKC 99.1 that reach thousands of listeners on a daily basis.  At Cumulus Lafayette we strive to hire passionate, driven, resourceful, problem solvers who have the ability to drive the evolving, diverse culture of the Power of Radio and Digital to success. 

 

 

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

Cumulus Media- LAFAYETTE, LA is seeking a dynamic Multimedia Account Executive to join our team!  We are looking for passionate, motivated, goal-oriented individuals with high business acumen and the desire to WIN in a fast-paced highly competitive sales environment.  Someone who is digitally savvy and desire to create integrated marketing campaigns for their clients.  In return, we offer a unique opportunity: a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, inspired leadership and the chance to realize your full potential as a professional.
 
The Multimedia Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • 2 years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $3,000.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.

What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment

job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

CUMULUS MEDIA | Syracuse is in search of a hard-working Part-Time Promotions Assistant. If you are looking to get a foot in the door to the radio industry, have an outgoing personality and have a passion for radio, this is a great opportunity for you! This job will consist of general office duties as well as going out into the community to interact with listeners and promote our stations.

 

The Promotions Assistant travels around the area and represents the Cumulus stations at specified events, acting as Brand Ambassadors. This includes set-up and breakdown of pop-up tents and tables, hanging banners, interacting with listeners and executing on-site activations. To join the team, you must be able to lift 50 pounds and be on your feet for extended periods of time.


In the office, the Promotions Assistant handles prize fulfillment, event preparation, contest building, attending weekly promotions meetings, posting on radio station social media platforms, brainstorming new ideas, and other promotion-oriented tasks. The position also includes running errands and helping with vehicle maintenance.


Would you describe yourself as an extrovert? Are you social media savvy? We’re looking for charismatic applicants, with smiling faces and outgoing personalities. If you love talking to people and listening to great radio, this could be the perfect job for you. If you desire a job where no day is the same as the last, this could be for you! This position is a great foot in the door to an exciting career in media!


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in planning, organizing & execution of promotional events and digital campaigns
  • Execute proper technical and physical set-up and breakdown of remote broadcasts and station events; ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues on the fly
  • Represent stations at events in an upbeat, outgoing and friendly manner
  • Data Entry of Promotional events and contesting
  • Create e-blasts, social media posts & website posts; review promotional information and graphics
  • Inventory and maintenance of prize closet, calendars, events for current and upcoming promotions
  • Assisting the Promotions and Marketing Department with projects as needed in the office
  • Assist with vehicle inspections, fuel and coordinating maintenance
  • Ability to drive station vehicles with attached trailer
  • Maintain and storage of station equipment


Qualifications:

  • No experience necessary, however Customer Service experience helpful
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Reliable; have a flexible schedule and be available to work at least 20 hours per week, including days, nights, weekends and holidays
  • May require lifting or moving up to 50 pounds
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time
  • Outgoing, energetic, detail-oriented and responsible
  • Proficient using computers and Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Multi-tasking abilities
  • Event experience a plus
  • Works well with a variety of personalities
  • Passion and desire to perform at a high level in a competitive environment
  • Positive attitude, even in stressful situations, is a must
  • Desire and bravado to share innovative ideas with team
  • Ability to ask for clarification, when needed
  • Strong Social Media skills

Pay Range

USD $16.00 - USD $16.00 /Hr.
What We Offer

  • Competitive Pay
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • 401K with company match


For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

job.title: Director of Sales
job.description:
Description

  

Dick Broadcasting Company | Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
Full-Time | Exempt

Dick Broadcasting Company is looking for a driven, entrepreneurial sales leader to lead our Myrtle Beach sales team and accelerate revenue growth across our broadcast and digital platforms.

This is not a position for someone who wants to simply maintain the status quo.

We are looking for someone who wants to build — a great sales team, strong client relationships, new business opportunities, and a culture where people are continually challenged to improve and succeed.

You will lead the sales efforts for our four-station Myrtle Beach operation and its growing digital advertising business, with significant responsibility for developing people, executing sales strategies, and delivering results.

For more than 72 years, Dick Broadcasting Company has built successful local media brands by remaining committed to the communities we serve. As a family-owned company, we believe local leadership matters. We encourage our leaders to identify opportunities, try new things, develop people, solve problems, and find creative ways to grow our business.

This position is based in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, one of the Southeast’s most dynamic and rapidly growing markets. Beyond being a world-class tourism destination, Myrtle Beach offers a strong local business community, tremendous population growth, beaches, golf, entertainment, and an outstanding quality of life.

If you are a successful Local Sales Manager, General Sales Manager, Digital Sales Manager, or proven media sales leader looking for an opportunity to build and lead a high-performing sales organization, we would like to hear from you.


  

What You’ll Do

Build and lead a great sales team.

Recruit, develop, coach, and retain talented sales professionals. Create an environment where people enjoy coming to work, know what is expected of them, celebrate wins together, and are continually challenged to grow and improve.

Drive revenue growth.

Develop and execute sales strategies that grow revenue across broadcast, digital, and other advertising platforms. Place a strong emphasis on local-direct new business development, growing existing client relationships, and identifying new revenue opportunities.

Develop people, not just manage numbers.

Spend time in the field with your sellers. Participate in client meetings, provide meaningful coaching, help improve their prospecting and presentation skills, and develop their ability to uncover client needs and recommend effective advertising solutions.

Create a culture of consistent sales activity.

Establish clear expectations for prospecting, discovery meetings, presentations, follow-up, and closing business. Help sellers build strong pipelines and develop the habits necessary for sustained success.

Be part of the sales effort.

Lead by example. Participate in key client meetings, help develop creative advertising strategies, and assist sellers in overcoming challenges and closing opportunities. Be a resource for the sales team without becoming the sales team.

Know the numbers and use them to drive results.

Take ownership of sales budgets, revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and sales performance. Utilize CRM data, sales activity, ratings, digital performance, and other key metrics to recognize opportunities, identify challenges, and hold the team accountable for results.

Help our clients succeed.

Build a sales organization focused on understanding client needs and delivering results rather than simply selling advertising schedules. Encourage creative thinking and the development of integrated solutions that help local businesses grow.

Collaborate across departments.

Work closely with programming, promotions, digital, and other departments to develop compelling advertising opportunities, maximize the value of our brands, and ensure successful execution of client campaigns.

Be part of the Myrtle Beach community.

Build relationships with advertisers, agencies, community organizations, and business leaders. Be visible in the market, develop new relationships, and help ensure our stations remain valuable partners to local businesses.

Requirements

  

What We’re Looking For

We are less interested in a particular title than we are in finding the right sales leader. The successful candidate will bring:

· A demonstrated track record of growing revenue, developing new business, and consistently delivering sales results.

· Proven experience leading, coaching, motivating, and developing sales professionals.

· A strong understanding of the sales process, from prospecting and discovery through presenting, negotiating, following up, and closing.

· The ability to establish clear expectations, measure performance, and hold people accountable while building a positive team culture.

· Experience managing sales budgets, forecasting revenue, and evaluating sales pipelines.

· An understanding of digital advertising and how broadcast and digital solutions can work together to solve client problems.

· A willingness to get into the field, work alongside sellers, and actively participate in the sales process.

· Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

· Curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to try new things.

· The confidence to make decisions and the humility to listen to other ideas.

· An entrepreneurial mindset and a desire to create opportunities rather than wait for them to appear.

· A college degree or equivalent professional experience.

· A valid driver’s license.

Who Will Thrive Here

This opportunity is best suited for someone who genuinely enjoys building a successful sales team and helping people reach their potential.

We want a leader who gets energy from coaching sellers, developing creative ideas, meeting with clients, winning new business, and celebrating the team’s successes.

You should be comfortable setting high expectations, having difficult conversations when necessary, and holding yourself and others accountable for delivering results.

We believe great sales leadership requires both encouragement and accountability. The right person will know how to motivate a team, recognize progress, address underperformance, and create an environment where everyone understands their role in the organization’s success.

At DBC, we value leaders who take initiative, think creatively, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who measures their success not just by the revenue they personally generate, but by the success of the salespeople they lead and the business they help build.

If you are looking for an opportunity to develop a great team, grow revenue, have some fun along the way, and make a meaningful impact in one of DBC’s key markets, we would like to hear from you.

Benefits

Dick Broadcasting Company offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

· Paid Time Off (Vacation, Personal and Sick)

· Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance

· Flexible Spending Account

· 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs ABC Network Maintenance Engineer (daily hire) Job ID 10163853 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 26, 2026 ABC Network Maintenance Engineer (daily hire) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements ABC Network (Los Angeles) provides professional targeted engineering and support to production, postproduction and broadcast departments in the Los Angeles area. This role supports a wide variety of broadcast systems that provide television production, transmission, communications, monitoring and various technical support for the ABC Network. It is a great opportunity for someone who wants to be an important part of a cutting-edge network level broadcast operation. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. This team is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The Maintenance Engineer supports the operation, maintenance, repair, and technical advancement of broadcast, studio, production, and media systems. The ideal candidate has

experience

working in a fast-paced television production environment and can respond to immediate, time-critical technical issues with calm urgency. This individual must be a proactive self-starter who can work independently, troubleshoot complex problems, perform preventative maintenance, and support live productions without unnecessary delays. This role will be covered by the National Association of Broadcast Employees and Technicians – Communication Workers of America – ABC collective bargaining agreement. the daily hire pay rate for this role is $65.18 per hour.

Responsibilities

Maintain and support broadcast, production, transmission, and content distribution systems, restoring service and resolving technical issues across media technology environments. Perform installation, configuration, maintenance, repair, and upgrades of broadcast, audio, video, networking, RF, automation, and electromechanical systems, including both hardware and software components. Analyze, diagnose, and resolve complex signal flow and infrastructure issues across traditional SDI and IP-based environments, including audio, video, control, timing, and network connectivity systems. Execute preventive maintenance programs and system health monitoring to maximize reliability, identify developing issues, and minimize operational disruptions. Support engineering projects, technology refreshes, equipment deployments, remote productions, live broadcasts, and infrastructure enhancements under the direction of senior engineering staff. Assist with the evaluation, specification, procurement, inventory, deployment, and lifecycle management of technical equipment, systems, and related resources. Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, operating procedures, system diagrams, and workflow standards while supporting training and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, contractors, and service providers to deliver operational support, resolve technical challenges, and ensure media technology systems align with business and production objectives. Basic

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent years of work experience. 5+ years supporting, maintaining, designing, or deploying broadcast, studio, live-production, media-production, or content-distribution environments, including

experience

leading technical efforts or supporting critical production systems. Strong troubleshooting skills across broadcast, audio, video, hardware, software, networking, and media technology systems, including component-level electronic repair and time-critical production support. Working knowledge of SDI and IP-based broadcast infrastructures, SMPTE standards (including ST 2110, ST 2059, ST 2022-7, ST 292M, and ST 424M), audio/video signal transport, synchronization, compression technologies, and modern broadcast cabling systems.

Experience

with TCP/IP networking, fiber-optic infrastructure, signal-flow analysis, technical documentation, AutoCAD or similar drawing tools, and the installation and troubleshooting of broadcast and data cabling.

Experience

integrating, maintaining, or upgrading production control rooms, media workflows, storage and compute platforms, asset management systems, transcoding and distribution systems, and related broadcast technologies. Knowledge of broadcast equipment and platforms from industry vendors such as Evertz, Grass Valley, Ross, Lawo, Calrec, Riedel, Imagine Communications, and similar media technology providers. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals, system documentation, and workflow diagrams;

experience

creating technical documentation is a plus. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced production environment, effectively prioritize multiple tasks, and communicate clearly under pressure. Valid driver's license Additional Requirements: Must be available to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, holidays, overtime, extended shifts, on-call support, and emergency response assignments. Must be willing to travel for remote productions, equipment deployments, and other technical assignments, and work in a variety of technical environments including studios, control rooms, equipment rooms, rooftops, and remote production sites. Must be able to safely perform physical tasks such as climbing ladders, working from aerial lifts, maneuvering in confined spaces, and lifting/moving equipment up to 50 lbs., while following all established safety procedures around electrical, mechanical, RF, networking, and fiber-optic systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

with electronic modification, circuit design, system integration, and the deployment or support of enterprise and standalone broadcast, production, and media networks.

Experience

with advanced media workflow technologies, including encoding/transcoding platforms, media asset management (MAM), file-based workflows, NAS, SAN, and cloud-based storage and compute environments. Familiarity with AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud platforms; foundational cloud certification preferred.

Experience

developing automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Node.js, or similar technologies. Hands-on

experience

with broadcast fiber infrastructure, including SMPTE 311M hybrid fiber systems and single-mode SC, ST, and FC fiber-optic connectors.

Experience

with professional broadcast video and signal-management systems, including Evertz frame synchronizers, distribution amplifiers, VIP Multiviewers, Magnum controllers, Xenon routers, master clocks, character generators, For-A color-correction systems, Leader and Tektronix waveform monitors, Grass Valley Kayak switchers, CP300 routers, SDI video infrastructure, synchronization systems, encoders, transmission equipment, and tally-routing systems.

Experience

with professional production equipment and camera systems, including Sony HDC4300 cameras, HDCU camera-control units, BPU baseband processors, MSU master setup units, RCP remote-control panels, Sony viewfinders, Fujinon lenses, Vinten Quattro and Fulmar pedestals, Vinten Merlin crane arms, and Stanton Jimmy Jib systems.

Experience

with broadcast audio, communications, and infrastructure technologies, including Studer Vista V audio consoles, Wohler monitoring systems, Shure wireless systems and Wireless Workbench, Riedel wireless intercom systems, RTS ADAM and ADAM-M intercom frames, RTS KP-96 keypanels, TCP/IP network infrastructure, RF and CATV systems, spectrum analyzers, system-monitoring platforms, and industry-standard broadcast and data cabling using BNC, XLR, RJ45, Elco, F-type, TRS, SMPTE 311M, SC, ST, and FC connectors. Ability to operate forklift and aerial lift equipment. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY This role will be covered by the National Association of Broadcast Employees and Technicians – Communication Workers of America – ABC collective bargaining agreement. the daily hire pay rate for this role is $65.18 per hour. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Lead Full Stack Product Software Engineer - ESPN
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Lead Full Stack Product Software Engineer - ESPN Job ID 10162149 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States / New York, New York, United States / Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 20, 2026 Lead Full Stack Product Software Engineer - ESPN Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. The Product & Data Engineering team is responsible for end to end development for Disney's world-class consumer-facing products, including streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+, and digital products & experiences across ESPN, Marvel, Disney Studios, NatGeo, and ABC News. The team drives innovation at scale for millions of consumers around the world across Apple, Android, Smart TVs, game consoles, and the web, with our platforms powering core experiences like personalization, search, messaging and data. Core Web Platform The Core Web Platform team builds the foundational web technologies, frameworks, and shared components that power Disney's portfolio of world-class digital properties—including ESPN.com, ABCNews.com, National Geographic, Marvel.com, and more. As a platform team, we enable product engineering teams across brands to ship faster and more consistently by providing reusable solutions for rendering, performance, design systems, developer tooling, and core web architecture. A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology ● Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. ● Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more. ● Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences

experience

sports, entertainment & news.

Job Summary

As a Lead Software Engineer on the Core Web Platform team, you will architect and deliver foundational frontend solutions that power Disney's portfolio of consumer-facing web properties, including ESPN, ABC News, National Geographic, and Marvel. You will drive technical direction for shared web frameworks, components, and tooling used across multiple brands and engineering teams, balancing platform consistency with brand-specific needs. You will mentor engineers, influence cross-team technical decisions, and ensure our platform delivers exceptional performance, accessibility, and developer

experience

at scale. If you: Demonstrate determination in finding solutions to complex, cross-cutting technical challenges Have the curiosity to research and evaluate new web technologies and platform patterns Employ positive thinking and work constructively in a diverse, distributed team setting Are passionate about building platforms that multiply the impact of other engineers Value learning and being exposed to new experiences across brands and product domains then working at Disney is unlike anything else. We have the latest technology, game-changing ideas, and world-class talent. Come help us build the core web foundation that powers how audiences connect with our brands across the digital landscape.

Responsibilities

and Duties of the Role: Design, build, and maintain shared frontend platform capabilities—including reusable components, frameworks, build tooling, and design system integrations—consumed by engineering teams across ESPN, ABC News, NatGeo, Marvel, and other Disney web properties. Define technical architecture, engineering standards, and best practices for multi-brand web development; lead design reviews, RFCs, and technical decision-making for platform initiatives. Research and evaluate emerging web technologies; prototype and drive adoption of improvements to performance, accessibility, SEO, and developer experience. Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers through code review, pairing, and knowledge sharing; help raise the bar for frontend engineering quality across the organization. Partner with product engineering teams across brands to understand requirements, prioritize platform roadmap investments, and deliver scalable solutions that balance shared needs with brand-specific customization. Basic

Qualifications

Proven mastery of frontend web development technologies and principles Minimum 7+ years of relevant industry

experience

with demonstrated technical leadership Comprehensive expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React strongly preferred)

Experience

building reusable platform libraries, design systems, or shared frontend infrastructure at scale Strong understanding of web performance, accessibility (WCAG), SEO, and responsive design

Experience

Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Technical Program Mgr (PH) Job ID 10161088 Location Santa Monica, California, United States / Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Oct. 29, 2026 Sr Technical Program Mgr (PH) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research, and is responsible for driving the day-to-day operation of the Product & Technology organization, including: project and portfolio management and tracking; organization-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace

experience

support team.

Job Summary

This is a position within the DE&E Product + Technology: Business Operations - Global Program Management organization, supporting our Ad Platforms technology group. The Technical Program Manager will focus on the planning and execution of complex programs that may span several areas of Ad Platforms, or may cut across the department and other DEE Technology groups. This position requires proven

experience

in program management. Ideal candidates must be highly proactive, detail-oriented, and able to autonomously work on multiple assignments. They must be capable of attaining a strong understanding of technical details and clearly communicating schedules, risks, status, and processes to a variety of business and technical audiences. They must be able to partner with closely with project managers and technical leads to coordinate schedules, deliverables, and dependencies.

Responsibilities

and Duties of the Role: Drive activities for large, strategic, technically complex, priority programs Develop plans and timelines, accounting for all dependencies Ensure transparency of progress and issues/risks. Proactively drive risk mitigation and contingency planning, along with issue resolution Communicate status, updates, and program summaries via presentations, email, and direct communication with key stakeholders and executive leadership Ensure that all involved parties understand and accept their roles and

responsibilities

and are held accountable to their deliverables Facilitate all build activities (including QA), as per plan Proactively drive, track, and report on budgets Perform capacity planning for teams Collaborate with other program management colleagues to coordinate activities across multiple technology teams Strong understanding of most program domain technical components, including architecture, tools and deployment practices that development team is employing, including cross-system interactions and dependencies Track and report key program metrics, informing stakeholders as appropriate Independently manage activities and resolve conflict within associated teams, with minimal influence from management Effortlessly sift through “noise” and facilitate discussions and activities with a laser focus towards results Navigate the TWDC to effectively drive progress, even when the scope of

responsibilities

may be unclear Exemplify leadership characteristics through collaboration, work ethic, and creative thinking. Strive to inspire others and deliver the best possible outputs Coordinate with external vendors, where applicable May manage Agile ceremonies and processes at the team-of-teams level Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Basic

Qualifications

BA/BS or equivalent

experience

required 5+ years of

experience

managing large-scale, strategic, software development programs in a well-established global technology organization Proven ability to facilitate effective communication across disparate teams Expertise in Agile or Waterfall program management methods that may include Scrum, Kanban, and/or Scaled Agile Evidence of strong planning, delivery, and problem-solving skills Superb written and verbal communications, presentation skills, and meeting facilitation skills (especially when working with senior leadership)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

working in a media technology environment Ad tech domain knowledge, or demonstrated aptitude for learning a technology-based engineering domain Formal project management certifications Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in California is $131,200.00 to $176,000.00 per year. experience

job.title: ABC News Audience Engagement Intern, Spring 2027
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs ABC News Audience Engagement Intern, Spring 2027 Job ID 10163290 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment Television Date posted Oct. 21, 2026 ABC News Audience Engagement Intern, Spring 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

About the Role

& Program The ABC News Audience Development team is responsible for creating, distributing, curating, and optimizing ABC News content across digital platforms, including ABCNews.com, mobile apps, major social media platforms, search, video, and other distribution channels. The team plays a critical role in connecting audiences with breaking news and original journalism while identifying opportunities to grow engagement across existing and emerging platforms. As an Audience Development Intern, you will gain hands-on

experience

at the intersection of journalism, audience strategy, analytics, and digital storytelling. Working alongside experienced audience development professionals, you will learn how editorial judgment, data insights, and experimentation help drive audience growth and engagement. The ideal candidate is passionate about news and current events, follows digital media trends, and is interested in understanding how audiences discover and consume content across platforms. This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the New York, New York area from January 2027 - June 2027 What You Will Do On any given day, you will support audience development initiatives across ABC News digital platforms, including ABCNews.com, mobile apps, search, social media, video, and other distribution channels. You will help curate content experiences across owned platforms, support audience growth strategies, and assist in distributing content to external partners to help maximize visibility during major news events. You will contribute to headline testing efforts, monitor news, search, and social trends, and help identify emerging platforms, formats, and audience behaviors. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen editorial judgment, analytical thinking, collaboration, and digital storytelling skills while gaining exposure to how data and audience insights inform content strategy.

Required Qualifications

& Skills

Experience

with journalism, news reporting, news production, digital media, or content creation through coursework, internships, campus media, or related projects. Understanding of the 24/7 news cycle, current events, and breaking news coverage. Demonstrated writing and editing skills through coursework, internships, campus media, or published content samples.

Experience

using social media platforms, digital publishing tools, or content distribution channels through academic, extracurricular, internship, or personal projects. Familiarity with audience metrics, analytics, or data-informed decision-making through coursework, projects, or prior experience. Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

& Skills

Experience

conducting research or analyzing audience, engagement, or content performance data. Familiarity with social media management, content publishing, or audience analytics tools.

Experience

creating content for digital, social, or campus media platforms.

Experience

working in a newsroom, media organization, student publication, or related environment. Familiarity with SEO, headline writing, or audience engagement strategies. Interest in emerging digital platforms and evolving audience consumption behaviors.

Education

Junior or Senior year preferred. Major or coursework in Journalism, Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, Media Studies, Marketing, or a related field preferred. Eligibility Requirements & Program Information Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Additional Information Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship Fully available from January 2027 through June 2027 Fully available from Monday through Friday, 40 hours each week Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the New York, New York area Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work in the New York, New York area Materials Requested: A portfolio review is required for this position. For full consideration, please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Applications without a portfolio link on the résumé will not be considered a completed application packet and may not be fully considered for the position. Please visit our support site or additional information. The pay rate for this role in New York is $23.00 per hour. Select

benefits

may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our

benefits

visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. Apply Now Save Job About Disney Entertainment Television: Disney Entertainment Television is a collection of renowned content brands at The Walt Disney Company creating original entertainment and news programming for the company’s streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu and Star, and its broadcast and cable networks. Its extensive portfolio is comprised of ABC Entertainment, ABC News, ABC Owned Television Stations, Disney Branded Television, Freeform, FX, Hulu Originals, National Geographic Content and Onyx Collective, in addition to Disney Television Studios, which include 20th Television, 20th Television Animation, ABC Signature and Walt Disney Television Alternative. Responsible for over 4,500 hours of programming a year across more than 300 programs of all genres, Disney Entertainment Television’s creative brands are at the forefront of groundbreaking storytelling, captivating audiences and generating critical acclaim. In 2023, Disney Entertainment Television’s programming excellence earned 163 Emmy® nominations across daytime, primetime, news & documentary, and children’s & family categories. About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. This position is with Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & Intl, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment Television. Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & Intl is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military or veteran status, medical condition, genetic information or disability, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. To learn more about Disney's policies on the use of AI for candidates, click here. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs. We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. job.title: ABC News Publicity Intern, Spring 2027
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs ABC News Publicity Intern, Spring 2027 Job ID 10160865 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment Television Date posted Oct. 23, 2026 ABC News Publicity Intern, Spring 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

About the Role

& Program: Are you passionate about news and media? Do you want to learn and grow with America’s most trusted news source? Are you a reliable, curious, go-getter excited about storytelling? An internship with the ABC News Publicity department offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on

experience

supporting high-profile programs and connecting with audiences across multiple platforms. You’ll join a team of professionals in a fast-paced environment where interns play a vital role and are relied on every day. With curiosity, dedication, and a willingness to jump in, you’ll learn on the job, build valuable connections, and develop skills that can shape your future career in news and media. The ABC News Publicity department manages all media relations and internal and external communications for ABC News and its programs and platforms, including World News Tonight with David Muir , Good Morning America , Nightline , 20/20 , This Week with George Stephanopoulos , The View , Tamron Hall , GMA3 , ABC News Live, ABC News Studios, ABC News Digital, ABC News Audio, and ABC NewsOne. We handle press outreach, social media, and publicity campaigns to ensure our content reaches audiences effectively across all platforms. What You Will Do: Compile and edit daily press clips, reporter media lists, and correspondent, anchor, and executive bios; support and lead coverage reports for ABC News Studios projects, including gathering press clips for documentary releases. Support and lead extensive clip tracking during breaking news or PR crisis situations. Maintain social media accounts, creatively disseminate program information, and design graphics using Canva. Assist with awards submissions by coordinating invitations, tracking RSVPs, and managing follow-up communications. Assist during virtual and in-person events, including occasional evenings and weekends. Participate in brainstorming and publicity strategy meetings, write press releases and loglines, and manage weekly status reports and highlights documents

Required Qualifications

& Skills : Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced environments, especially within a news organization. Hands-on, proactive mentality, and willingness to take on any task to support the team. Dependable, responsive, and accountable, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proficient in MS Office Suite and Canva; familiar with Muck Rack and social listening tools (Sprout, Sprinklr, or similar). Previous media or PR experience; flexible to support evening/weekend coverage and handle sensitive information with discretion Excellent writing, verbal, and interpersonal skills, collaborating effectively across departments and levels.

Preferred Qualifications

& Skills: Basic knowledge of Adobe/MailChimp Existing knowledge of media and news Proficient in using and navigating ChatGPT and other AI tools

Education

Junior or Senior year. Senior preferred Major or previous coursework in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, or related major preferred Eligibility Requirements & Program Information Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Additional Information Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship The approximate dates of this internship are January 2027 until June 2027 Fully available from Monday through Friday for the duration of the internship, 40 hours each week Able to provide own housing for the duration internship program The pay rate for this role in New York is $23.00 per hour. Select

benefits

may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our

benefits

visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. Apply Now Save Job About Disney Entertainment Television: Disney Entertainment Television is a collection of renowned content brands at The Walt Disney Company creating original entertainment and news programming for the company’s streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu and Star, and its broadcast and cable networks. Its extensive portfolio is comprised of ABC Entertainment, ABC News, ABC Owned Television Stations, Disney Branded Television, Freeform, FX, Hulu Originals, National Geographic Content and Onyx Collective, in addition to Disney Television Studios, which include 20th Television, 20th Television Animation, ABC Signature and Walt Disney Television Alternative. Responsible for over 4,500 hours of programming a year across more than 300 programs of all genres, Disney Entertainment Television’s creative brands are at the forefront of groundbreaking storytelling, captivating audiences and generating critical acclaim. In 2023, Disney Entertainment Television’s programming excellence earned 163 Emmy® nominations across daytime, primetime, news & documentary, and children’s & family categories. About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment Television. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military or veteran status, medical condition, genetic information or disability, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. job.title: Fitness Instructor - Tenaya Stone Spa - Part Time
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Fitness Instructor - Tenaya Stone Spa - Part Time Job ID 1371989BR Location Anaheim, California, United States Business Disneyland Resort Date posted Oct. 29, 2026 Fitness Instructor - Tenaya Stone Spa - Part Time Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

As a Certified Fitness Instructor at Disney’s Grand Californian Hotel & Spa, you can make fitness fun in our state-of-the-art health club, Eureka Fitness Center, practice yoga on a paddle board or inside the theme parks before they open and throughout The Disneyland ® Resort. Guests can enjoy independent workouts or join our Fitness program offered by one of our skilled Certified Fitness Instructors.

Responsibilities

Provide consistent professional fitness class and personal training sessions in accordance with spa protocols and accepted certification practices Properly care for equipment and maintain fitness equipment Have complete knowledge and understanding of all fitness offerings while educating and training guests in these areas Perform administrative duties in a complete, organized and accurate manner Actively promote spa, treatments, services, sessions and retail as well as programs and promotions Maintain a clean, safe, fully stocked and well organized fitness area Handle Guests questions and concerns professionally and courteously Provide accurate and immediate responses to all requests by guests ensuring complete Guest satisfaction Attend mandatory training to maintain knowledge of current spa policies, procedures and trends Basic

Qualifications

You must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for this role Yoga Instructor certification Extensive

experience

in the fitness field National Certification (i.e.; ACE, NASM, NSCA, ACSM) for fitness instruction/personal training and/or Associates degree or higher in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or related field Excellent communication and listening skills Ability to complete tasks independently Spiel memorization and delivery Knowledgeable about The Disneyland Resort and surrounding area Swimming

experience

Preferred Qualifications

Previous

experience

job.title: Associate Director, Enterprise Marketing
job.description:
Job Title

Associate Director, Enterprise Marketing

Job Description

About The Role

People Inc. is seeking an Associate Director, Enterprise Marketing to help shape how our company and portfolio of essential brands show up in the advertising marketplace. Serving as the lead marketing partner to the Enterprise Sales team, this role will help build influence and drive growth with our agency holding company partners. This is a hands-on opportunity for a visually-driven, design-minded strategic storyteller who can translate business priorities into clear, compelling narratives grounded in the People Inc. brand.


Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead Enterprise Agency Marketing: ​Own the strategy and day-to-day execution of Enterprise Agency Marketing in close partnership with Enterprise Sales, serving as the team’s  primary marketing partner across our agency holding company partnerships

  • Agency-Specific Marketing Materials: Lead the creation of targeted presentations, narratives, and supporting materials that deliver against each agency partner’s priorities

  • Enterprise Narratives: Develop scalable, enterprise-level People Inc. narratives that translate our value into clear, visually compelling presentations, one-sheets, and related sales materials

  • Brand Stewardship: Help define and communicate the People Inc. brand across every enterprise and agency-facing touchpoint, ensuring its strengths, voice, and visual identity are clear and consistent

  • Enterprise Marketing Resources: Own and evolve the central enterprise resource for People Inc.’s strongest stories, proof points, and premium opportunities

  • Agency Activations: Plan and execute light agency activations, presentations, lunch-and-learns, roadshows, and related experiences, as needed

  • Partner Across People Inc.: Build strong relationships across People Inc.’s brands, teams, and functions to develop a deep understanding of the business and bring the full value of People Inc. to the marketplace


Education:
Minimum Bachelor’s Degree 


Experience:
6–8 years of relevant experience in brand strategy, creative strategy, enterprise marketing, or sales marketing, with a track record of translating complex ideas into compelling visual stories. Experience at a branding or creative agency is a plus.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications, and Abilities:

  • Excellent storytelling skills with an ability to execute visually impactful presentations (fluent in Google Slides, Keynote and PowerPoint)

  • Strong understanding of branding, design principles, and visual hierarchy

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted partner to Sales and tailor messages for different audiences, 

  • Strong understanding of the advertising and media landscape, with the ability to quickly learn the priorities, structures, and ways of working of agency holding company partners

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and remain poised under pressure

% Travel Required (Approximate): N/A
 

It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Pay Range

Salary: New York: $95,000.00 - $115,000.00

The pay range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position and may change in the future. Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. We also offer voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, accident, critical and hospital indemnity health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance.
