Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

job.title: Senior II Engineer - Commercial Technology
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

About you

You are an experienced senior engineer and technical leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of providing technical direction across business-critical products and platforms.

You combine deep technical expertise with pragmatic engineering judgement. You are comfortable navigating complex systems, shaping architecture, making and facilitating significant technical decisions, and helping engineering teams turn business requirements into secure, resilient and sustainable solutions.

You think beyond individual features and solutions to the long-term health of the technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, operability, developer experience, technical debt and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working with engineers, Product, Programme and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical considerations clearly and making thoughtful trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and longer-term technical investment.

You are also motivated by developing engineering capability. While this is not a people-management role, you will mentor engineers, encourage technical ownership, create opportunities for others to develop their expertise and help build a strong engineering culture based on learning, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.

 

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating several Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership for one of the engineering capabilities within Commercial Technology, working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product, engineers, other Technical Leads and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

 

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

 

What you’ll work on

As Technical Lead within Commercial Technology, you will provide technical leadership for the engineering capability responsible for the delivery, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology.

You will be accountable for the technical direction and engineering integrity of the capability, ensuring our technology is secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and aligned with wider Commercial Technology and FT engineering standards. You will lead architectural thinking, guide significant technical decisions and ensure technical risks, dependencies and opportunities are understood and actively managed.

You will help lead the technical transformation of the FT’s commercial technology landscape, shaping the transition from our established marketing platforms towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360 and the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem while ensuring our existing technology remains sustainable throughout that transition.

You will work in close partnership with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data. Together, you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve the capability successfully. The Engineering Manager is primarily accountable for people leadership, delivery, capacity and operational coordination, while you will be primarily accountable for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and technical sustainability.

You will remain close to engineering delivery, working directly with engineers to solve complex technical problems, review and challenge approaches, improve engineering practices and create opportunities for engineers to develop greater technical ownership and expertise.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your capability, ensuring local technical decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

 

Your responsibilities will include

Technical Direction & Architecture

  • Own the technical direction for the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring technology decisions align with the wider Commercial Technology strategy and FT engineering standards.
  • Lead architectural thinking and significant technical decisions across the capability, balancing immediate delivery needs with security, resilience, scalability, maintainability and long-term sustainability.
  • Establish and champion appropriate engineering standards, patterns and practices across the team.
  • Maintain visibility of architecture, technical debt, lifecycle risks, dependencies and emerging technology opportunities.
  • Work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other Technical Leads on decisions that span multiple capabilities, platforms or technology domains.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve the technology landscape while avoiding unnecessary complexity and duplication.

Engineering Quality & Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and guidance to engineers while creating appropriate autonomy for individuals to make decisions and take ownership of the technology they work with.
  • Mentor engineers and technical specialists, helping them develop their technical expertise, engineering judgement and confidence in making technical decisions.
  • Support engineers through complex technical challenges without becoming the decision-maker or implementation owner for every issue.
  • Promote strong engineering practices including testing, automation, observability, security, documentation and sustainable software development.
  • Encourage constructive technical challenge, knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to identify technical skills and capability gaps and help develop the engineering capabilities required for our future platform.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data to ensure technical strategy, people, delivery and operational priorities remain aligned.
  • Provide technical input into roadmaps, planning and prioritisation, ensuring delivery plans are technically achievable and account for complexity, dependencies, technical risk and longer-term investment.
  • Work with Product, Programme and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into appropriate technical approaches and clearly communicate technical considerations, trade-offs and opportunities.
  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early and work with the Engineering Manager and wider Commercial Technology leadership to ensure they are understood and appropriately managed.
  • Work closely with Technical Leads, Engineering Managers and engineers across Commercial Technology to coordinate technical decisions and shared dependencies.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors, providing technical direction and ensuring solutions align with FT architecture, engineering standards and practices.

Operational Excellence & Technical Health

  • Be accountable for the technical health and sustainability of the Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure solutions are designed and engineered with appropriate consideration for security, resilience, scalability, observability, maintainability and supportability.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager and Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities are operationally ready and can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Provide technical leadership during incidents affecting Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities, supporting diagnosis, technical decision-making and sustainable resolution.
  • Ensure technical debt, lifecycle risks and engineering improvements are visible, understood and appropriately considered alongside product and programme priorities.
  • Ensure learning from incidents and operational issues informs architecture, engineering standards and future technical decisions.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Provide technical leadership for the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Shape the technical transition from established marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Define and evolve the architecture, engineering patterns and technical practices required to support the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to ensure the team develops the technical skills and knowledge required to own and evolve the future platform sustainably.
  • Work with Commercial Platform, other Technical Leads, the Principal Architect and the Principal Engineer to ensure platform changes integrate coherently with the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem and maintain operational continuity.

 

Technical and Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing, leading or designing a Customer Data Platform, ideally utilising Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360.
  • Significant software engineering experience working with complex production systems, platforms or enterprise technology.
  • Experience providing technical leadership across engineering teams or significant technology capabilities.
  • Strong architectural and engineering judgement, with experience making and guiding significant technical decisions.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and the design of secure, resilient, scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Experience identifying and managing technical debt, architectural risk, technology lifecycle concerns and cross-system dependencies.
  • Experience working closely with engineers to solve complex technical problems while enabling others to take ownership and develop their expertise.
  • Experience balancing immediate delivery needs with longer-term architecture, engineering quality and technical investment.
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence, observability, reliability and production engineering.
  • Experience working effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across teams and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate area.
  • Experience leading technical change across significant platform or technology transformations would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms, enterprise SaaS ecosystems or complex integration architectures would be beneficial, but is not essential

 

Characteristics we value

  • Strong technical judgement and curiosity.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes.
  • Pragmatism when balancing technical quality, delivery needs and operational risk.
  • An ability to make complex technical concepts understandable.
  • Confidence challenging technical approaches constructively.
  • An instinct for enabling and mentoring engineers rather than becoming the person through whom every technical decision must pass.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, reliability and long-term technical sustainability.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Data and business teams.
  • Calm and clear technical leadership during incidents and periods of change.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, please contact the FT Talent team via email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

job.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
job.description:
About the FT

The Financial Times is one of the world's leading business news organisations, recognised internationally for its authority, integrity and accuracy.

Trust sits at the heart of the FT. That means not only producing journalism our readers can rely on, but also being thoughtful, transparent and responsible in how we design our products and use customer data.

Our Product & Technology organisation plays a central role in helping the FT deliver on this ambition, building products and experiences that serve our customers while supporting the long-term growth of the business.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Privacy to lead this important product area on a fixed-term basis, covering maternity leave until the end December, 2027.

The role

Privacy is an increasingly important part of the customer experience.

Customers should be able to understand how their information is used, make meaningful choices and feel confident that the FT acts responsibly with their data. Our ambition is to make privacy a reason for customers to trust the FT.

As Senior Product Manager for the Privacy team, you will lead the product strategy and roadmap for this area.

You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data, Legal, Compliance, Marketing and commercial teams to turn complex customer, regulatory, technical and business needs into simple, trustworthy product experiences.

It is a product leadership role focused on how the FT can create clearer, simpler and more transparent experiences, while ensuring that privacy and responsible data use are embedded into the way we build products. 

You will help us work towards an ambition of being one of the most trusted digital organisations in how we handle customer data and privacy choices.

What you'll work on

You will lead the evolution of the FT's privacy and consent experience, including areas such as:

  • Customer trust: Identifying opportunities to strengthen trust through clear, transparent and respectful privacy experiences.
  • Customer choice: Making it easier for customers to understand and manage how their data is used.
  • Privacy experience: Creating simpler and more consistent experiences across customer journeys.
  • Responsible data use: Helping ensure that product teams use customer data in ways that are responsible, understandable and aligned with customer expectations.
  • Privacy by design: Working with teams across the FT to embed privacy thinking earlier in product and technology development.
  • Measurement and insight: Developing a better understanding of how customers interact with privacy choices and how those experiences affect trust and engagement.
  • Experimentation: Using customer research and responsible experimentation to improve how privacy choices are communicated and experienced.
  • Regulatory change: Working with Legal, Compliance and Data Governance colleagues to ensure that evolving requirements are translated into scalable and customer-friendly product solutions.
  • Product foundations: Helping improve the systems, processes and ownership models that support privacy experiences across the FT, powering more personalised journeys.

What you'll do

Set the product direction

Define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for the Privacy team

Identify the most important customer and business problems to solve and translate them into measurable outcomes.

Balance customer trust, regulatory responsibilities, product experience, technical sustainability and business needs when setting priorities.

Look beyond individual requirements or projects to build capabilities that can support the FT over the long term.

Champion the customer

Make the customer perspective central to privacy product decisions.

Work with Research, Design and Data teams to understand how customers perceive privacy, data use and consent.

Identify areas where experiences may be confusing, inconsistent or unnecessarily difficult.

Advocate for simple language, meaningful choices and experiences that help customers feel informed and in control.

Lead complex cross-functional work

Lead initiatives involving multiple product and technology teams and a wide range of business stakeholders.

Work closely with Engineering and Architecture colleagues to understand technical opportunities, constraints and dependencies.

Partner with Legal, Compliance and Data Governance teams to translate specialist requirements into effective customer and product solutions.

Build strong relationships across the FT and create alignment where different teams have competing needs or priorities.

Use evidence to make decisions

Define meaningful measures of success and use data and customer research to understand product performance.

Develop hypotheses and experiments that help improve customer understanding and trust.

Use external trends, industry developments and emerging best practice to inform product direction.

Ensure decisions are based on evidence while recognising the importance of judgement in areas involving trust and customer expectations.

Deliver outcomes

Take opportunities from problem definition and discovery through delivery, measurement and iteration.

Give cross-functional teams clear objectives and priorities.

Identify risks, dependencies and trade-offs early and help teams make good decisions.

Communicate strategy, progress, outcomes and decisions clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

Provide senior product leadership

Bring clarity and structure to complex and ambiguous problems.

Influence teams and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Contribute to the wider Product community and help raise the quality of product thinking and practice.

Support and mentor other Product Managers where appropriate.

What you'll bring

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is comfortable working in complex, technically challenging and highly cross-functional environments.

You are likely to have:

  • Significant experience managing digital products or platforms.
  • A strong track record of defining product strategy and turning it into measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
  • A strong customer focus and an ability to identify the underlying customer problem rather than simply respond to requirements.
  • Excellent judgement when balancing customer, business, technical and regulatory considerations.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data, customer research and experimentation to inform decisions.
  • The ability to turn complex or ambiguous problems into clear priorities and actions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working closely with engineers, designers, researchers, analysts and other specialist disciplines.
  • An understanding of how product decisions contribute to both customer value and sustainable business outcomes.
  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Experience that would be useful

You do not need to be a privacy lawyer or regulatory expert.

We are interested in experienced Product Managers who can learn a complex domain quickly and work effectively with specialist colleagues.

Experience in one or more of the following would be helpful:

  • Privacy, consent or customer preferences.
  • Customer identity or first-party data.
  • Personalisation or data-driven customer experiences.
  • Data governance.
  • Trust and safety.
  • Regulatory or highly regulated product environments.
  • Large-scale digital platforms or shared product capabilities.

Most importantly, you will care deeply about creating products that customers can trust.

What success looks like

Success in this role means helping the FT make privacy and responsible data use a stronger part of our customer proposition.

You will help us:

  • Create simpler and more understandable privacy experiences.
  • Give customers greater clarity and control over their choices.
  • Build stronger understanding of how privacy experiences affect customer trust.
  • Establish clearer product principles for the responsible use of customer data.
  • Embed privacy thinking more consistently into product development.
  • Improve the foundations that allow teams to deliver trustworthy experiences efficiently.
  • Build stronger alignment between customer needs, regulatory responsibilities and business priorities.
  • Develop a clear long-term product direction for Privacy & Trust.

Ultimately, we want customers to feel that the FT respects their choices, is transparent about how their data is used and consistently earns their trust.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

job.title: Senior Reporter, Health Payer Specialist
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to a fair and inclusive workplace

At the FT, we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone has equal opportunity to succeed. We welcome and value different perspectives and strive to ensure all employees are heard and supported. We believe people do their best work when they can be themselves and have the flexibility they need to balance their work and personal lives. We are an equal opportunity employer and align with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination.

The role / Position overview

Health Payer Specialist, a Financial Times Specialist publication, is looking for a Senior Reporter to cover one of America’s most dynamic markets: health insurance.

Published three times a week, Health Payer Specialist provides insurance companies with news, insights and intelligence covering corporate strategy, government policy and workforce issues.

We are looking for an experienced reporter who can break news, stay ahead of industry trends and develop a strong network of sources. You may already have experience reporting on the healthcare or payer ecosystem, or have developed deep expertise covering another industry. You will be equally comfortable turning around scoops quickly and developing analytical, insight-led trend stories.

The successful candidate will enjoy digging into SEC filings, earnings reports and other disclosures to uncover important information others may have missed. You’ll be able to identify the details that matter and turn sophisticated information into sharp, tightly focused articles that help our readers make better-informed decisions.

As part of a small team, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to broaden your responsibilities and develop your career. The position reports to the publication’s Managing Editor.

Key responsibilities

  • Report and write several articles each week, varying in length, format and depth of reporting.
  • Develop deep subject-matter expertise and use it to produce journalism with clarity, insight and authority.
  • Break news and stay ahead of industry developments by building and maintaining a strong network of sources.
  • Monitor company and government filing deadlines, earnings disclosures and relevant data releases to identify news and reporting opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with insurance executives, companies and other relevant industry sources.
  • Develop scoops, enterprise stories and analytical coverage that distinguish Health Payer Specialist and provide value to subscribers.
  • Travel to industry events and meet with sources to stay close to the market and identify emerging trends.
  • Collaborate with other teams to produce videos, graphics and other formats that support editorial coverage, including occasionally creating videos based on interviews with sources.
  • Occasionally moderate webcasts or panels at events run by FT Specialist or the Financial Times’ events group.

Required skills / experience

  • At least three years of business reporting experience, including experience working for a daily or wire publication and some editing experience.
  • A consistent record of producing high-quality journalism, with a focus on breaking news and delivering valuable information to subscribers ahead of competitors.
  • Experience reporting on the healthcare or payer ecosystem, or demonstrated experience covering another industry in depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to write or produce content for a specialist or niche audience.
  • Experience leading a beat and generating scoops, enterprise story ideas and other distinctive content.
  • Strong source-building skills and the ability to establish trusted relationships with senior industry contacts.
  • Confidence working with SEC filings, earnings reports, company disclosures and other detailed source material to identify newsworthy information.
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to recognize and respond to readers’ information needs.
  • Excellent writing and analytical skills, with the ability to communicate complex subjects clearly and concisely.
  • The ability to work accurately at pace while balancing breaking news with longer-term reporting.
  • Intellectual curiosity, creativity, persistence and resilience.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skills; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs. Company & Department Context

The Financial Times (FT) is one of the world’s leading business news and information organizations. We are recognized globally for our authority, integrity and accuracy. We provide a broad range of essential services, including news, comment, data and analysis, to the growing audience of internationally minded business people.

We have offices in more than 35 cities, including London, New York, Hong Kong, Beijing, Manila, Sofia, San Francisco and Tokyo. Join us and find an inclusive and fast-paced environment with unique opportunities to support every step of your career.

Learn more about the FT, including announcements and career opportunities, at aboutus.ft.com and FT Specialist 

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer to join the FT Specialist group as part of the Product & Technology organisation within FT.

A key part of the business, providing significant revenue and contribution to the FT, is Specialist Titles. This is an exciting time for Specialist Titles as we are creating a large new cross functional product & technology team in Sofia to support the needs of this part of the business. job.title: The FT World Desk Fellowship
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

The Financial Times has an exciting opportunity for aspiring Black foreign correspondents.

Are you keen to report on the world at this time of tumult? Are you excited by international news and do you want a hand in interpreting and explaining it to a global audience? Are you tempted by the idea of a wide-ranging career in journalism reporting on dramatic events from across the globe? If so, then our new six-month World Desk fellowship would suit you well.   

The FT’s global, award-winning editorial team represents the gold standard in journalism, seeking depth, originality and balance that differentiates the FT from the pack and engages subscribers.

The Fellowship is a six-month, paid fellowship in the heart of the FT’s London newsroom. You will join the World News Desk, where a dozen-strong team of accomplished journalists commission and edit our global coverage.   

You will work with the editors to help deliver ground-breaking coverage. You will also work closely with our London-based regional editors, the Africa Editor, Europe Editor, Latin America Editor and Middle East Editor, helping them with their coverage.

You will support the global network of correspondents with research and ideas for how to complement their stories with the right data and visual elements. You will be encouraged to write your own stories and will have mentoring from senior FT editors, in particular the foreign editor, in how to conceive and craft an “FT story”.

 

What You Will Learn 

You will be part of a team of experienced journalists covering the world, and there may also be opportunities for short-term stints on other editorial desks. You will learn the timeless arts of writing clear crisp copy and reporting on complex and sensitive stories. 

You will also gain insight into the essential skills of cutting-edge digital journalism and story-telling. The overarching ambition of the fellowship is to help to equip you one day to be a foreign correspondent, hopefully for the FT.

 

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will:

  • Display a keen interest in international affairs
  • Want to pursue a career in journalism covering global news
  • Be capable of keeping a cool head under deadline pressure
  • Care deeply about writing accurately and objectively

Some experience in journalism is preferable but not essential. Career change applications are also welcome.

This opportunity is designed for Black candidates to help to address historical under-representation in the media, and to support greater diversity.

 

How to apply

All applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom.

Please upload three documents:

  • CV
  • A Cover Letter detailing what you will bring to the role and why you think you are suitable
  • An unpublished article on an international story (600 words max)

 

The deadline for applications is 8pm on Sunday 15th November 2026.

 

Further information

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and to take a short writing test. The successful applicant will join the World News Desk and report to the FT’s Foreign Editor, Alec Russell.  

This 6-month fellowship is for 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, starting in Spring 2027.

The fellow will receive a monthly bursary of £2,500.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism.  Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

job.title: US Data Journalist
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

The role

The FT’s visual and data journalism team is looking for an experienced data journalist to cover US politics, economics and financial news. This is a full-time staff position.

The successful applicant will collaborate with US-based news editors and correspondents across North America as well as colleagues in London, Hong Kong and beyond. You’ll help us deliver compelling journalism on our core coverage areas of trade, economics and financial markets, as well as US electoral politics and campaign finance. 

You will have a record of working self-sufficiently, from story pitch to final product, and an interest in providing a global perspective for both US and overseas readers. You will also collaborate with the wider Visual & Data Journalism team, and reporters and editors from across the FT’s network who need support applying data-driven methods to their work. 

We are happy to consider candidates wishing to be based in Washington DC or New York City. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Occasional weekend/flexible working may be required as part of covering fast-moving news.

 

Essential skills

You will have a strong portfolio of work in data journalism, ideally focused on business, finance, economics or politics in North America. In addition, we are looking for:

  • Experience using data journalism or data science techniques to find and tell news stories
  • Confidence using R or Python for data sourcing (including web scraping, APIs and large databases), cleaning and analysis
  • Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to explain your quantitative analysis work simply to non-specialist audiences
  • A passion for continuously learning in order to keep your skills at the forefront of current practice
  • The ability to pitch, write and deliver original data driven stories

 

Desirable Skills

While this is not a graphics-production role, experience of using data visualisation effectively in reporting would be a distinct advantage. 

In addition, while we don’t expect you to have all of these skills, any of the following would be beneficial, so please mention them in your cover letter and résumé:

  • Training in statistics, data science or quantitative social science methods
  • Experience building, maintaining or working with pipelines for continuously acquiring and processing data
  • Experience applying data analysis in financial or business journalism
  • Knowledge of working collaboratively with others on coding projects using version control systems such as Git
  • Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator 

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Friday 6th November 2026. 

 

Salary range

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $85,000 to $115,000. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skill set; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs. This position is represented by the News Guild.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion 

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

job.title: US Summer Newsroom Intern
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading business news organisations, recognised internationally for its authority, integrity, and accuracy.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing. 

The FT has a record paying readership of 1.6 million, more than 1.4 million of which are digital subscriptions. It is part of Nikkei Inc., which provides a broad range of information, news, and services for the global business community. We have offices in more than 35 countries, including London, New York, Hong Kong, Beijing, Manila, Sofia, San Francisco, and Tokyo.

Our Internships

We are looking for passionate and motivated students who are interested in pursuing a career in media to join our team! We expect our interns to be in the office a minimum of three days a week. 

This program offers the opportunity to connect and collaborate across the FT — in the US and globally. You’ll develop ideas that help drive our growth, present your work to US leadership, and gain valuable insights from across the business. Plus, you’ll be paired with a dedicated Buddy to provide mentorship and support throughout your experience.

This internship pays $22 per hour for 40 hours per week and runs from June 7, 2027 - Aug 13, 2027. Before applying, please ensure you will be available on these dates.

Applicants must be authorised to work in the US.

Role Overview

The FT’s US newsroom internship offers aspiring journalists a front-row seat to the fast-paced world of global news. This is your chance to learn from and contribute to a dynamic multimedia newsroom that values curiosity, creativity, and sharp storytelling.

No two days are the same. From breaking stories and in-depth research to innovative digital projects, you’ll work alongside editors and reporters to bring ambitious journalism to life. We’re looking for versatile, driven interns who are eager to dig into stories that matter and help shape how the world understands the news.

Key responsibilities

  • Pitching, reporting, and writing original news stories
  • Conducting interviews and developing sources
  • Assisting senior correspondents with research, document analysis and reporting
  • Curating newsletters and contributing to digital projects
  • Collaborating with staffers on special projects

Required skills / experience

  • Proven interest in journalism
  • Some experience or knowledge of financial journalism, business, economics, or related areas
  • Curiosity about global markets, companies, and economies
  • Initiative to pitch and complete story ideas
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Excellent research and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and writing skills across platforms
  • Sound news judgment and high ethical standards

Please submit your application by November 2nd by 5pm Eastern Time and be sure to include the following documents in your application:

  • Resume
  • A cover letter explaining why you would be a good fit, and explaining your interest in joining our team
  • Three writing samples or published clips

Any application submitted after the deadline will not be considered.

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. For this reason, FT editorial staff do not use AI tools to write articles or create reader-facing content.

AI may be used in specific, pre-approved cases to assist with research, such as in data investigations. We expect internship applicants to refrain from using AI in writing tests or written materials submitted during the application process. All submissions must reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences.

Candidates may use AI to assist with research and interview preparation. However, the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure fairness and transparency for all applicants.

Our commitment to a fair and inclusive workplace

At the FT, we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone has equal opportunity to succeed. We welcome and value different perspectives and strive to ensure all employees are heard and supported. We believe people do their best work when they can be themselves and have the flexibility they need to balance their work and personal lives. We are an equal opportunity employer and align with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

job.title: Account Executive (Regular Full-Time)
job.description:
Account Executive (Regular Full-Time)

FOX Television Stations—FOX10/FOX10Xtra | Phoenix, AZ

Are you a driven, results-oriented sales professional and a skillful relationship-builder who thrives in a collaborative environment? If so, we are looking for a proactive business development professional ready to make an immediate impact within a fast-paced, innovative culture. Join a team where critical input and new ideas are essential, all while enjoying the career stability that comes with working for a highly successful, well-known industry leader.

Leveraging the scale and resources of Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, we lead the Phoenix television market by broadcasting the highest volume of local news and complimented with the most watched live sports (NFL, MLB, NCAA, NASCAR, INDY, and more). Beyond our broadcast footprint, we provide sophisticated, best-in-class Digital and OTT/CTV offerings. We are looking for a strategist who can weave these assets into comprehensive, omnichannel marketing solutions, enabling clients to achieve measurable results throughout the marketing plan.

The FOX10 Phoenix Sales Team has an excellent opportunity for an experienced Account Executive focused on driving revenue through an omnichannel approach, with a primary emphasis on bringing brand-new video advertisers to Phoenix’s leading local television station.

Why Join Us?

  •  Work in a fast-paced environment where teamwork is paramount. We brainstorm together, support one another's strategies, and celebrate our collective successes.
  • Collaborate with accomplished media professionals to drive revenue and elevate your omnichannel sales approach.
  • You will have the opportunity to work alongside top talent in the market, utilizing advanced technology and advertising platforms.

Job Summary

  • Assume primary responsibility for actively prospecting, developing, and maintaining a robust sales pipeline focused heavily on converting brand-new video advertisers who have not traditionally utilized TV or premium streaming.
  • Design and present omnichannel campaigns, seamlessly integrating traditional linear broadcast, Fox Local Extension (FLX) OTT, Fox Local News (FLN), and our digital/mobile platforms to address client challenges.
  • Source new sales opportunities through a combination of researching potential accounts, initiating outbound communication, and following up on inbound leads.
  • Maintain a consistent presence in the field to develop relationships, conduct needs-analysis meetings, and present the benefits of our complete video portfolio.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (sales management, FLX, marketing, and creative services) to develop custom presentations that highlight the utility of our solutions.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the competitive media landscape, OTT platforms, and a clear understanding of the characteristics that give FOX10 a competitive advantage.
  • Manage client advertising initiatives and create impactful post-campaign recaps, providing actionable recommendations to further optimize client ROI.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proactive Business Development: Experience managing high-volume sales activity in a B2B environment. You excel at identifying untapped opportunities and consulting with new clients to demonstrate how video can achieve their business objectives.
  • Digital Video Advertising, Broadcast Sales, and/or Agency experience is preferred.
  • Team-Oriented Approach: You naturally build rapport with both clients and colleagues. You recognize that collaboration drives success and actively contribute to a positive workplace environment.
  • Omnichannel Expertise: You manage your time efficiently to meet deadlines, and you have a strong grasp of how traditional broadcast and digital/OTT video work together to create an effective marketing funnel.
  • Proven Track Record: You thrive in a metrics and results-driven sales culture. You are skilled at conveying technical information, addressing objections, and preparing professional presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and account management skills are required. Proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is essential.
  • Varied hours, weekends, holidays, and local travel are required. Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • College degree (or equivalent work experience) and a minimum of 1 to 3 years of sales experience is required.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Package: Excellent health benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. 401k with company match.

Additional Details

  • The on-target earnings for this position are $100,000-$110,000 annually.
  • Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and have a valid, local driver’s license.
  • Local travel and entertainment are required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours and overtime as needed.
  • FOX 10/Fox 10 Xtra Phoenix is a 24/7 operation.

If you have proven success in digital and ad sales and have the skills and experience to excel in this role, we encourage you to apply.

#LI-MB2

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Administrative Coordinator
job.description:
Administrative Coordinator

FOX Television Stations – FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 PLUS

The Opportunity

FOX 5 DC is seeking an organized, energetic, and service-minded Administrative Coordinator to help keep a fast-moving, multiplatform media operation connected and running smoothly. Reporting to the Office Manager, this role supports department heads and station teams across linear television, digital, streaming, and social media.

As a central coordination point for employees, viewers, visitors, community and business partners, vendors, and guests, you’ll bring a dependable, proactive, and approachable style; work effectively with varied personalities; and manage shifting priorities with sound judgment, discretion, and a positive, solutions-oriented approach.

What You’ll Do

• Support station operations. Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Office Manager, department heads, and station teams, including office operations, schedules, travel, expenses, supplies, mail, deliveries, and special projects.

• Coordinate meetings and calendars. Manage calendars, conference calls, agendas, meeting materials, rooms, technology, and follow-up items; anticipate conflicts and communicate changes promptly.

• Keep communications current. Draft, proofread, format, and distribute station memos, presentations, reports, correspondence, and other communications; maintain the internal Stay Ahead channel so information remains timely, useful, and current.

• Manage vendors and workplace needs. Coordinate vendor setup, invoicing, purchasing, and related activity in Coupa and Graphite Connect; work with vendors, contractors, building contacts, and internal teams on workplace and equipment needs.

• Deliver outstanding service. Support employees, viewers, visitors, guests, community and business partners, and vendors by coordinating access, hospitality, station tours, schedules, and on-site logistics.

• Track and report. Prepare tracking and data-driven reports for station leadership, monitor relevant social media trends and platform activity, organize key information, and provide timely, accurate updates.

• Support community and multiplatform initiatives. Partner with multiple departments to coordinate station events, community partnerships, employee activities, and other promotional or community initiatives across linear, digital, streaming, and social platforms.

• Protect information, strengthen processes, and stay ready to pivot. Maintain organized records and resources, safeguard confidential information, support administrative needs and provide administrative backup as needed, and help strengthen team processes and communication.

What You Bring

• Education and experience. High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, administration, or a related field preferred. Two or more years of progressively responsible administrative support, office coordination, or comparable professional experience.

• Service and communication. Excellent customer service, written and verbal communication, organizational, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with a positive, approachable, and professional demeanor.

• Judgment and follow-through. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently with limited supervision, anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment, follow through on details, maintain strict confidentiality, and compile, organize, and communicate tracking information accurately and clearly.

• Technology. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn and regularly use station and Company systems such as Workday, WideOrbit, Coupa, Graphite Connect, collaboration tools, virtual meeting technology, and other evolving business platforms.

• Multiplatform adaptability. Comfortable learning digital, social, and streaming-related tools and adapting to evolving technology and workflows across linear broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media.

Benefits

• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.

• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

Work Location & Schedule

This position is fully onsite, with an initial schedule of 11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. As a member of the FOX 5 DC Admin team, hours and priorities may shift based on station operations, events, special projects, breaking news, and last-minute needs, including early mornings, late evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Ready to help people, stay one step ahead, and contribute to a fast-moving, multiplatform media operation? Apply today, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast-turnaround content creation/editing environments.

This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.

The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi-path transmission.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Project Delivery and Governance

  • Lead the full project lifecycle, including discovery, scoping, technical design coordination, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering work breakdown structures, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, hardware/software lead times, risks, issues, and capital/operating budgets.
  • Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change-control decision forums.
  • Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post-production, IT infrastructure, and third-party vendors/systems integrators.
  • Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational-readiness criteria.
  • Maintain rigorous project documentation, including functional specs, system schematics coordination, rack elevations, acceptance test plans (ATP), cutover runbooks, and handover documentation.

Broadcast & Media Technology Delivery

  • Lead initiatives involving production switchers, audio consoles, studio cameras, robotics, multi-viewers, tally/intercom systems (e.g., Riedel, RTS), broadcast graphics (e.g., Vizrt), and virtual/augmented reality studio tech.
  • Oversee deployments for field acquisition, bonded cellular (e.g., LiveU, Dejero), satellite/fiber contribution, IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, Zixi), and baseband/IP ingest pipelines.
  • Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
  • Drive technical delivery for non-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
  • Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
  • Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
  • Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.
  • Support infrastructure modernization and technology refreshes, such as SDI-to-ST 2110 IP transitions, cloud-assisted production, and hybrid on-prem/cloud workflows.
  • Coordinate technical design reviews alongside Principal Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads.

Live Operations, Commissioning & Deployment Readiness

  • Plan and direct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), end-to-end rehearsal workflows, operational shadow periods, cutovers, and rollback strategies.
  • Schedule and oversee maintenance windows and deployment sequencing to ensure zero disruption to on-air linear feeds and 24/7 live studio operations.
  • Partner with Broadcast Operations and Engineering teams to establish support escalation models, monitoring/telemetry dashboards, signal path redundancies, runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on-air cutover.

Technology Modernization & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with engineering leads to evaluate emerging broadcast standards (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, NDI) and cloud/virtualized production platforms.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks in the content creation and turnaround pipeline, introducing automation for ingest, transcode, QC, and archiving.
  • Promote standard operating procedures and best-practice deployment frameworks across all broadcast and studio facilities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Media Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Technology project management experience, with experience directly managing broadcast engineering, studio facility, transmission, or media production technology projects.
  • Proven track record leading projects through technical scoping, RFP/vendor evaluation, rack/facility buildout, systems integration, commissioning, and on-air cutover.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge across core broadcast domains, including:
    • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
    • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
    • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
    • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
    • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.
  • Solid grasp of broadcast video/audio signals and protocols (Baseband SDI, SMPTE ST 2110, AES67, Dante, PTP timing, MPEG-TS).
  • Experience coordinating structured acceptance testing (FAT/SAT) and high-stakes, off-hours facility cutovers with tight change-window constraints.
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Visio/Lucidchart).
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to bridge conversations between on-air talent/editorial teams and deep technical engineering specialists.
  • Experience leading facility buildouts, studio relocations, or control room overhauls.
  • Practical knowledge of IP media network architecture (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6/7, NMOS IS-04/IS-05).
  • Experience with broadcast equipment vendors and platforms (e.g., Grass Valley, Evertz, Ross Video, Sony, Avid, Imagine Communications, Vizrt, Harmonic, Telestream).
  • Familiarity with hybrid/cloud-based media workflows in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience managing external Systems Integrators (SIs) and broadcast equipment hardware vendors.
  • Relevant industry certifications: PMP, CAPM, or technical broadcast certifications (e.g., SBE - Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications).
  • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
  • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
  • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
  • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
  • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM) to lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy and paid media investment across Latin America. The team upholds Enterprise Technology's standards for shared infrastructure while owning the creative media pipelines that are unique to Entertainment. It's a dual role - the strategic partner for long-term technology plans and facility-operations growth, and the hands-on operational owner accountable for keeping it running every day. The ideal candidate is a high-judgment, highly hands-on operator who is equally comfortable setting strategy and building executive-level narratives as getting deep into execution and cross-functional alignment. You manage and prioritize a team of specialized engineers, drive outcomes through influence as much as authority, and use AI and agentic workflows to modernize the work and extend what a lean team can deliver.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

Lead the Team & Design the Organization

job.title: Director, Technology Business Operations
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service. Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise. Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms. At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX's direct-to-consumer product and technology organization powers FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and FOX News digital experiences across mobile, connected TV, and web platforms. We are seeking a Director, Technology Business Operations to lead the strategy, systems, and processes that connect technology investments, resource planning, and software capitalization. 


Reporting to the VP of Product Operations, you will establish a reliable, scalable source of truth that enables leadership to understand where engineering resources are invested, measure associated costs, and make informed decisions about future investments. In this highly cross-functional role, you will partner with Program, Engineering, Finance, Controllership, Internal Audit, and People Systems to modernize how labor and investment data is captured, classified, analyzed, and reported. You will also drive the development of AI-assisted workflows and automation that improve accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, and reduce administrative effort. The ideal candidate combines financial and operational expertise with strong technical fluency, a systems-oriented mindset, and the ability to translate complex data into simple and actionable business insights. You will play a critical role in building an operating model that is accurate enough to withstand external audit, insightful enough to guide strategic investment decisions, and streamlined enough to integrate naturally into how teams work.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive technology business operations strategy spanning software capitalization, investment planning, resource analytics, and operational governance.
  • Own and continuously improve software labor capitalization methodologies, ensuring clear distinctions between capitalizable development and non-capitalizable activities, including maintenance, research, operations, and support.
  • Partner with Controllership, Internal Audit, and external auditors to establish capitalization policies, internal controls, evidence standards, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Drive audit readiness and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce findings, shorten audit cycles, and minimize manual evidence collection.
  • Develop investment and resource planning models that connect labor costs to technology initiatives, products, platforms, and business outcomes.
  • Deliver financial and operational analyses that inform annual planning, quarterly business reviews, capitalization forecasts, and strategic investment decisions.
  • Evaluate resource allocation scenarios, including employee versus contingent labor, build-versus-buy decisions, platform versus product investments, and capacity planning.
  • Own the multi-year roadmap for systems, data models, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities that support labor tracking, classification, financial reporting, and investment analytics.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and People Systems to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and implement scalable solutions across Workday, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, and related platforms.
  • Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for classification recommendations, anomaly detection, audit evidence assembly, and planning analytics, with appropriate human oversight, traceability, and controls.
  • Partner with the VP of Product Operations to streamline information flow across teams, systems, identify opportunities to eliminate redundant reporting, simplify workflows, and reduce administrative burden for engineering teams and leadership.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 10+ years’ experience in technology business operations, software capitalization, technical accounting operations, engineering finance, or technology investment planning within a complex, multi-product technology organization.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling cross-functional systems, processes, and operating models across Finance, HR, and Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of software development capitalization practices, financial controls, audit requirements, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience developing financial and operational models that connect technology investments, labor costs, resource allocation, and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and technical capabilities, including hands-on experience with SQL, business intelligence and analytics tools such as Tableau or Amplitude, and advanced spreadsheet modeling. 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You proactively seek out the information, context, and relationships you need to move work forward rather than waiting for them to come to you.
  • Experience working with enterprise HRIS, financial, and software development systems, including Workday, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, or comparable platforms. 
  • Ability to generate artifacts and products from insights that are simple to use and enable executive decision making, yet solid enough to withstand audits and internal reviews. 
  • Practical experience designing or implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation, with an understanding of data integrity, human oversight, and audit risk.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, establish appropriate controls, and determine where automation can improve operational accuracy and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of how software engineering organizations plan, prioritize, develop, and deliver products across multiple platforms.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, demonstrated ability to influence decisions, build alignment, and drive organizational change without direct reporting authority.
  • A user-centered, continuous improvement mindset. 
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience supporting software capitalization processes through external financial audits.
  • Experience developing technology investment frameworks or resource optimization models across multiple digital products and platforms.
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer streaming, digital media, or subscription-based technology businesses.
  • Experience implementing AI agents or intelligent automation within financial operations, technology governance, or enterprise planning workflows.
  • Experience integrating data across HRIS, financial planning, engineering work management, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience building operational capabilities or governance frameworks from the ground up in a rapidly evolving technology environment.

The Field Producer will be responsible for working with reporters to obtain information, write scripts, build graphics and deliver compelling live shots and packages on tight deadlines.   • Being a self-starter who can work independently, as well as a team player
