job.title: Freelance Host/Producer, LiveNOW (Orlando or Phoenix)
job.description:
LiveNOW from FOX is looking for Freelance Host/Producers to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As a Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.
  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.
  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.
  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.
  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.
  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.
  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.
  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.
  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.title: Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting
job.description:
The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision. Additionally, this role collaborates with the FP&A team during budget and forecast cycles to support planning activities and ensure alignment between actual results and forward-looking projections. This position reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting.
 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Month-End Close/General Accounting 

  • Manage monthly and quarterly close processes for the Operating Division, including oversight of third-party goods and services, proper expense codification, and accurate general ledger recording

  • Analyze actual spending results and review accrual journal entries to ensure completeness and accuracy of third-party costs across both the P&L and Balance Sheet

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on monthly financial results, clearly articulating drivers of spend, key variances, and accounting treatments to finance and operational stakeholders

  • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

You will help ensure that language, regulatory, cultural, and market-specific requirements are appropriately reflected across systems, workflows, and customer experiences.

You are a strategic and analytical thinker who uses data, performance metrics, and a clear understanding of operational dependencies to inform recommendations. You are comfortable navigating complex, cross-functional environments and digging into the details through testing, monitoring, documentation, and issue resolution. You bring a proactive, solutions-oriented approach, communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are passionate about improving the customer experience.

job.title: News Photographer
job.description:
At FOX 7 Austin, we don’t wait for the clock to tell us when to deliver the news. Our mission is 24/7 content delivery — meeting our audience where they are, whenever they need us.

During your shift, you’ll help us create and distribute content in real time — whether that’s live in the field, collaborating through Slack, or publishing directly to our digital platforms. Some days you’ll team up with a reporter who shares this same fast-moving, audience-first mindset. Other days, you’ll take the lead independently. You may even lend your voice to a live on-air moment or step in front of the camera to help us tell the story.

We’re looking for someone who’s excited to experiment with format, embrace non-traditional storytelling techniques, and create content that’s relevant, memorable, and impactful.

Most importantly, this is a fun, collaborative newsroom in one of the most vibrant cities in the country. Austin moves fast, thinks creatively, and values authenticity — and so do we. If you’re energized by innovation and want to help shape the future of local news in Austin, this is a cool opportunity to do just that.

job.description:
KCPQ Fox 13 is seeking a per-diem Transmitter Engineer to support our primary broadcast transmitter facilities at Capitol Hill in Seattle, and Gold Mountain near Bremerton.

This role requires extensive experience in television transmitter site operations and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

Transmitter Operations (Capitol and Gold Mtn sites)

· Primary Sites Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/air and liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

· Transmitter testing, failover testing, transport signal path monitoring, local MPEG encoder operation and baseband signal flow testing. Ability to work during high-profile events such as Sunday football games, The World Series, and other events.

· Infrastructure & Power: Monitor critical site support systems, including site-located IT systems, microwave and terrestrial signal transport systems, satellite downlinks, UPS and generator systems, and other site-located equipment.

· Emergency Restoration: Respond to transmitter outages, which includes driving up to the Gold Mountain site in various weather conditions to keep the station on the air.

· Compliance: Ensure the transmitter site complies with FCC standards.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

· Experience: 2–3 years of experience in electronics repair, studio AV setup, IT/networking, or military technical roles. (A technical degree or equivalent training is highly valued).

· Technical Aptitude: A solid grasp of signal flow, electrical safety, and how to use basic tools (such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and hand tools).

· IT Knowledge: Basic IT/networking skills (IP addresses, subnets, switches, PC’s ).

· Driving & Logistics: Must have a valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and the confidence to drive mountain roads in rain, fog, or light winter conditions.

· Physical Demands: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders, and work comfortably behind equipment racks.

· Availability: Ability to work a flexible schedule, including being on-call for emergency transmitter or critical studio outages during off-hours.

· Cable Management: Experience with soldering, custom cable fabrication, and reading schematics.

We turn emerging technology into practical tools and workflows across scripted, unscripted, animation, and marketing. We test in real productions, learn what works, and make those lessons useful across the business. We also develop talent and help our creative and production teams build the skills to use these tools confidently.

Our approach starts with people and craft. We work with creative partners to solve real production problems, protect creative intent, and use AI responsibly, with respect for rights, the creative community, and the resources production consumes.

The Project Manager turns priorities into coordinated action. You will manage intake, establish clear plans and ownership, track delivery, and make sure the right decisions happen at the right time. We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, direct, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You ask good questions, follow through, and raise problems early with a recommendation. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring others in. You build enough structure to help talented people do their best work as the business grows.

job.title: Senior Payroll Tax Analyst
job.description:
As a Senior Payroll Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for payroll tax reporting, compliance, liabilities, and the filing of associated employment tax returns for multiple FEINS in multiple states.  You will also ensure the integrity of employee wage and tax data reported on employees’ Form W-2.

You will drive efficiencies through creative problem-solving and analysis as you work with large volumes of complex data to draw conclusions that identify process improvements and automations, improving accurate and timely tax payments and filings.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings, amendments, and reporting including employee W-2s and W-2c’s
  • Reconcile all tax and wage amounts for multiple legal entities monthly, quarterly, and annually between the payroll system and third-party tax service including reconciliation of W-2s to payroll tax reports and the quarterly 941 returns to W-2 totals. Research and correct any discrepancies
  • Analyze payroll tax issues and provide recommendations for solutions relating, but not limited to employee mobility, reciprocal taxation, stock taxation and reporting, inpats and expats, employer-provided fringe benefits and local taxation
  • Review and reconcile all daily tax and wage amounts submitted to third-party tax services and research any discrepancies and handle accordingly
  • Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual reconciliations of gross earnings to taxable wages to validate accuracy of taxable wages
  • Submit tax notices and facilitate resolutions in coordination with third-party tax vendors timely to avoid penalties and interest; research and determine the root cause, and work with the appropriate parties to take action to prevent future issues
  • Provide excellent customer service in researching and responding to payroll tax-related inquiries from employees, agencies, and other internal/external parties
  • Research all W-2 correction inquiries, complete and submit all W-2c’s for review and approval, and distribute W-2c through appropriate channel
  • Review all Workday tax updates and test accordingly, and communicate key changes to the Payroll team and HR as necessary
  • Partner with the Payroll team to ensure state and local taxes are set up correctly for employees, particularly for employees who live and work in different states
  • Maintain unemployment tax rates and communicate changes to third-party tax services
  • Apply and register for new state SUI and withholding tax accounts for new locations, FEINS, as needed
  • Prepare various tax returns and reporting not filed by third-party tax services, including other required government reporting
  • Review third-party sick pay and ensure appropriate reporting
  • Collaborate with the Manager to enhance, streamline, and document payroll tax processes
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations, including taxation of fringe benefits, by studying existing and new legislation and ensure compliance and advise management on needed actions


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of experience and education
  • FPC or CPP certification strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience servicing a large volume of employees (including a remote workforce) in a multi-state, multi-entity organization
  • Comprehensive knowledge of federal, multi-state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations
  • Strong working knowledge of taxation of fringe benefits and long-term equity incentive instruments (RSUs, NQ Stock Options, etc.)
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail with high service orientation, integrity, discretion, and ownership of work with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, be self-motivated, and piece together facts and data necessary to identify issues, propose resolutions, make decisions, and operationalize necessary changes to improve taxes and service delivery
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Intermediate to advanced analytical skillset, including the use of Excel V-Lookup and Pivot Tables and/or other tools
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Able to handle confidential information and issues effectively and without breach of confidentiality


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday and ADP systems
  • Experience with inpats and expats
  • Experience with international payroll (UK, EU, Israel)

job.title: Software Development Engineer, Backend ( Golang )
job.description:
Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform.


Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

As a Software Engineer in the Backend/API team, you will be responsible for building and operating scalable, resilient backend systems that power multiple consumer-facing platforms. You will work on high-throughput, low-latency services and APIs that are critical to core product experiences.

This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production. We are looking for strong backend engineers who can work independently, make sound technical decisions, and deliver reliable systems without the need for constant hand-holding.

  • Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that run at high scale with strict reliability and performance requirements.
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from requirements understanding and system design to production rollout and ongoing operations.
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code across backend components.
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production.
  • Optimize existing systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost.
  • Apply strong problem-solving skills and data structures knowledge to design efficient, real-world solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver backend capabilities that support evolving product needs.
  • Participate actively in code and design reviews, maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Continuously improve system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering best practices within the team.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 4-8 years of experience building backend software systems in production environments.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang.
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability.
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud-based systems (e.g., AWS or equivalent).
  • Experience working with databases and data stores (relational and/or NoSQL) and an understanding of data modeling and performance trade-offs.
  • Practical understanding of modern AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), and how to integrate AI capabilities into backend software.
  • Familiarity with using AI to build, enhance, or operate software systems (e.g., LLM-based APIs, prompt-driven workflows, automation, developer productivity).
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance.

job.title: Streaming Host/Producer
job.description:
FOX 10 is searching for a versatile, personable, high-energy Streaming Host/Producer to drive coverage across all FOX 10 live stream platforms.

In this dynamic, nights-and-weekends role, you will host unscripted live coverage of breaking news events in real time, engage with digital audiences through chat and produce VOD content to inform our audience about topics that matter most. We are looking for a journalist who thrives in the fast pace of breaking news, doesn't need to rely on a teleprompter, and knows exactly how to connect with digital viewers on a personal, human level through a conversational approach. If you love unscripted reporting and are ready to redefine how local news is shared, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do

  • Own the Stream: Serve as the face and voice of our night and weekend stream. You will balance real-time coverage of events as they unfold with updates and insights on the day’s biggest topics.

  • Keep It Conversational: Ditch the script! Talk with our audience, not at them. You will drive digital engagement during both daily news blocks and breaking, unscripted events.

  • Master the Tech: We will train you to operate a Tricaster, empowering you to independently produce, direct, and anchor your very own streaming broadcasts.

  • Be a Team Player: Seamlessly transition between hosting your own live coverage and jumping in to support your talented teammates behind the camera in a producing role, when needs arise.

Own the Stream: Serve as the face and voice of our night and weekend stream. You will balance real-time coverage of events as they unfold with updates and insights on the day’s biggest topics.

Keep It Conversational: Ditch the script! Talk with our audience, not at them. You will drive digital engagement during both daily news blocks and breaking, unscripted events.

Master the Tech: We will train you to operate a Tricaster, empowering you to independently produce, direct, and anchor your very own streaming broadcasts.

Be a Team Player: Seamlessly transition between hosting your own live coverage and jumping in to support your talented teammates behind the camera in a producing role, when needs arise.

What You'll Need

  • News Junkie Mentality: A strong knowledge of current events, topics making headlines and stories that matter to our audience.

  • Confidence: Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently, on camera and off, in a fast-paced breaking news environment.

  • Sharp Instincts: Excellent editorial judgment, strong research skills, and a meticulous attention to detail.

  • Digital Fluency: Basic experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies. Familiarity with a Tricaster is a huge plus, but a willingness and ability to learn new technology quickly is a must.

  • Strategic Mindset: Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and always think several steps ahead.

  • Agility: The ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops in real time.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.

The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

job.title: VP, Media Technology Architecture
job.description:
About You

FOX is seeking a senior, strategic, and technical Vice President with a strong foundation in Information, Security, Network, and Broadcast Media Technologies. This leader will be part of a team responsible for setting business-wide technical strategy that supports media technology across multiple business units.  This role requires a versatile problem-solver with a proactive approach to leading teams, a strategic mindset, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions and architecture with FOX’s broader business goals.  

Reporting to the SVP, Media Technology & Engineering, we are looking for a Vice President, Media Technology Architecture to coordinate and implement strategic technology initiatives associated with both broadcast and digital platforms to align with the company standardizations (cloud first), AI and technical goals.

The major areas of responsibility include all new initiatives for AI, IP and Cloud based Broadcast Operations for news, programming, station automation, virtualization & cloud projects, station delivery platforms for OTT, Streaming, and OTA, Media Technology and Transmission.

This mission critical role will be responsible for collaboration with all departments on new technologies, media architecture and workflow development to enable high quality, fast-paced content creation and will lead the technical side of the creative vision for digital experiences, disaster recovery and resiliency on all platforms.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Technology Implementation: Coordinate and implement strategic technology initiatives associated with both broadcast television and digital platforms to align with station goals and projects
  • Media Implementation: Supervise and manage all aspects of the Media architecture, implementations, projects and the multi-platform content distribution across FOX
  • Team Leadership: Supervise a team of Media Solution Engineers to architect, implement and manage modern broadcast technologies that support our business
  • Technology Collaboration & Workflow Development: Collaborate with all departments on architecture and workflow development to enable high quality, fast-paced content creation and distribution.

  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with key vendors to ensure service levels meet expectations, validate technical requirements, and drive procurement strategies aligned with organizational goals.
  • Project Management: Collaborate with the Critical Response team and PMO to manage projects, including technology upgrades, expansions, and new integrations, ensuring on-time and within-budget delivery. 
  • Capital Budget Management: Prepare and manage the fiscal operating budget for the technical department, including capital budget
  • Documentation & Compliance:  Develop and maintain processes for up-to-date documentation of network, security, information, and broadcast infrastructures, ensuring alignment with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Driving Adoption: Promote the adoption of new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to improve team efficiency and standardize deployment procedures.
  • Mentorship: Mentor and support cross-functional teams, fostering skill development, collaboration, and innovation. Guide teams to define requirements, manage expectations, and deliver high-quality solutions, cultivating a motivated and engaged engineering environment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with tech leaders to align with the broader Media strategy and ensure adherence to security policies.
  • Innovation: Stay informed on emerging technologies and industry trends, driving continuous improvement and ensuring the team remains at the forefront of innovation while maintaining backward compatibility.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree (computing or engineering program preferred) and/or formal training in Technology or a related field
  • Minimum 10+ years in a broadcasting operations and engineering management role
  • Proven experience as a team builder and leader that provides clear structure and managerial oversight of the Technology Department
  • Significant experience evaluating, selecting, installing, servicing, and maintaining broadcasting industry equipment and information technology systems
  • Experience establishing long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them
  • Executive-level communication and presentation abilities, with a proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders.
  • Experience in administration of broadcast file workflows and play-out systems
  • Broadcast IP Routing deployments
  • Knowledge in AWS cloud solutions
  • Knowledgeable in control room automation systems (ELC, Ignite or Ross)
  • Thorough understanding of FCC rules and regulations
  • Familiarity with all applicable FCC, OSHA rules & regulations
  • In-depth understanding of a broadcast station including news production, live event production, studio operation, file-based content creation and editing/transport/transmission
  • Ability to integrate new technologies into media operation on multiple delivery platforms such as broadcast, streaming and OTT
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex ideas strategically, influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, and anticipate diverse perspectives and responses.
  • Excellent verbal and writing skills will be expected as well as strong interpersonal skills
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule including, travel with night, weekend, holiday and on-call work in support of a 24/7/365 operation
  • Excellent stress and crisis management skills, with the ability to multi-task and make informed and appropriate decisions under pressure

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

job.title: Weekend Senior Producer, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
We're hiring a Weekend Senior Producer to join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. 

As a Weekend Senior Producer, you will serve as an editorial leader for our team and take an active role in boosting the quality of our product while championing the LiveNOW mission. If you describe yourself as a tech-savvy multitasker obsessed with news and producing it differently, this is your opportunity to create compelling content in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

With your guidance, you will help take LiveNOW’s content to the next level!

This position is based in LiveNOW’s West Coast newsroom located in Phoenix, Arizona.

SCHEDULE: Thursday - Monday

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take a hands-on role in producing relevant, timely, live coverage of breaking news and major news events for all digital platforms.
  • Lead editorial decisions and ensure content meets editorial standards while staying on top of current news, events, and industry news.
  • Monitor video feeds, social media, and other newsgathering tools for fresh, live content and the latest information. 
  • Contribute to coverage plans of major stories and live events to drive viewer engagement.
  • Support the development of other producers as you ensure a positive work environment and mentor them. 
  • Actively participate in training news staff on all technical, editorial, and presentation aspects of LiveNOW.
  • Work closely with LiveNOW leadership to develop and adjust producer workflows as needed. 
  • Support LiveNOW’s efforts to cultivate relationships with key players at FTS O&O stations and other internal or external partners.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3-5 years of experience leading the planning and producing of live news content, including breaking news on digital, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or a related field. 
  • Strong knowledge of technical aspects of digital news production, including live streaming and video publishing
  • Prior experience leading and developing, with a track record of taking ownership to successfully deliver key projects or initiatives. 
  • Superior news judgment, strong attention to detail, and impeccable organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment under deadline pressures.
  • Proficient in social media, SEO, and various tools used for web-based newsgathering, content creation, and digital analytics.
  • Varied hours including regular weekend and evening shifts, and holidays as required.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.title: Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.


Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.


Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.


At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM) to lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy and paid media investment across Latin America. As FOX One expands its international footprint, this leader will play a critical role in developing and scaling regional growth strategies, driving efficient subscriber acquisition, and establishing a strong market presence across LATAM.


Reporting to the Senior Director, Acquisition Marketing, this role will serve as the primary strategic lead for LATAM acquisition marketing, overseeing multi-million-dollar media investments, agency partnerships, and regional campaign performance. The Director will collaborate closely with U.S.-based leadership and international marketing teams while providing dotted-line leadership to LATAM-based team members.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in performance marketing, international media strategy, and incrementality-based measurement, along with the ability to balance short-term subscriber growth objectives with long-term brand development. This individual will be instrumental in shaping FOX One's regional acquisition roadmap, identifying opportunities to scale investment, and building a sustainable, data-driven growth engine across Latin America.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy across LATAM, developing regional growth plans that align with global business objectives, subscriber targets, and market expansion priorities.
  • Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar paid media budgets across LATAM markets, driving investment decisions, resource allocation, and acquisition efficiency to maximize subscriber growth and return on marketing investment.
  • Provide strategic oversight of integrated paid media campaigns across paid social, paid search, Youtube, display, and connected TV (CTV), ensuring effective planning, execution, and optimization across markets.
  • Serve as the acquisition lead for LATAM, partnering with the U.S.-based leadership and regional stakeholders to translate global growth strategies into locally relevant marketing initiatives.
  • Establish and advance incrementality-based measurement frameworks, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and holdout/control testing, to evaluate media effectiveness and inform investment decisions.
  • Lead and develop strategic relationships with media, creative, and measurement agency partners, establishing performance expectations, accountability, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Provide dotted-line leadership and strategic direction to LATAM-based team members, fostering collaboration, accountability, and alignment across regional and global teams.
  • Own regional acquisition performance reporting, including CPA/CPS, subscriber growth, campaign pacing, and marketing efficiency, delivering actionable insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Partner with measurement, analytics, creative, product, and international marketing teams to develop integrated go-to-market strategies that support FOX One's regional launches and ongoing growth.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, evolving consumer behaviors, and competitive dynamics to inform regional acquisition strategies and long-term investment planning.

job.title: Director, Media Systems Engineering & Support
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment is hiring a Director, Media Systems Engineering & Support to lead the engineering and technical support teams - an SRE-oriented group focused on reliability, automation, and workflow tooling - that keeps Entertainment’s systems running and modern. The team upholds Enterprise Technology's standards for shared infrastructure while owning the creative media pipelines that are unique to Entertainment. It's a dual role - the strategic partner for long-term technology plans and facility-operations growth, and the hands-on operational owner accountable for keeping it running every day. The ideal candidate is a high-judgment, highly hands-on operator who is equally comfortable setting strategy and building executive-level narratives as getting deep into execution and cross-functional alignment. You manage and prioritize a team of specialized engineers, drive outcomes through influence as much as authority, and use AI and agentic workflows to modernize the work and extend what a lean team can deliver.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the Team & Design the Organization

  • Lead, develop, and prioritize the engineering support teams behind Entertainment’s owned post-production environments
  • Set clear roles, ownership, and remit so the team operates independently and escalates at the right moments - defining where it executes to direction and where ownership can grow
  • Direct a specialized, highly skilled labor force to the work where it adds the most value.

Set the Technology Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the long-term architecture and roadmap for owned systems and platforms, and build the executive-level narratives that align leadership behind decisions and trade-offs
  • Collaborate actively with leaders across the group to align the plans with FOX Entertainment's broader technology vision
  • Plan facility moves and the steady-state technology operations that follow

Keep Systems Reliable (SRE)

  • Own the day-to-day reliability and maintenance of on-prem infrastructure and post systems - storage, render and virtualization, editorial/finishing/graphics systems, and facility technology
    • For shared enterprise tooling - network, virtual systems, storage, and applications - adhere to, maintain, and update against the standards Enterprise Technology sets; transition ownership where possible to eliminate running parallel infrastructure
    • For the systems unique to Entertainment - the creative media pipelines and bespoke post-production workflows - own their reliability and evolution end to end, building on the enterprise foundations to serve the specific needs of our creative users
    • Apply a site-reliability approach across both - monitoring, automation, and continuous improvement - with hands-on depth focused where it adds the most value
  • Ensure a consistent, well-run support and issue-resolution experience in partnership with the support desk teams
  • Keep media transfer platforms healthy and clear roadblocks, supporting the day-to-day operational teams

Deliver Projects & Establish Standards

  • Deliver capital and infrastructure projects against plan, with risks defined, clear RACI ownership, and blockers or delays surfaced early
  • Evaluate - and where necessary, establish - the workflows, documentation, and standards that make delivery repeatable and resilient to turnover, measured against clear, outcome-driven goals

Modernize & Partner Across the Org

  • Use AI and agentic workflows to automate and modernize the work, extending what a lean team can deliver and directing effort to where it counts most
  • Partner with TechOps leadership, Enterprise Technology, and other teams across the org - reducing duplicated infrastructure and keeping clear lines of ownership

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • People-leadership instinct - you develop talent, delegate with intent, prioritize ruthlessly, and manage performance directly
  • Judgment to move fluidly between strategy and the weeds, and to make good calls on where to invest limited, specialized capacity
  • Judgment about where to adhere to enterprise standards versus where Entertainment-specific systems warrant bespoke ownership - reducing duplication rather than standing up parallel IT
  • Enough hands-on technical depth to know what needs to get done, to recognize when an approach doesn't hold up, and to ask the questions that keep the team operating at the leanest, most efficient footprint while managing necessity. This isn't a build-it-yourself role, but you must be credible enough to direct the people who do
  • Deep working knowledge of network and media systems, media transfer pipelines, and post-production & vfx infrastructure - storage, render and virtualization, editorial/finishing/graphics systems, and facility technology
  • Fluency with post-production editing and graphics systems
  • Ability to drive outcomes through influence - aligning senior stakeholders and framing trade-offs across teams you don't directly control
  • Builder's instinct for modernization - using AI and agentic workflows to automate and extend what a team can deliver
  • Skill in defining roles and ownership so a specialized, highly skilled labor force is used where it adds the most value
  • Clear, calm communication; you bring problems and decisions forward, not just status, and you surface issues before they become crises
  • 8+ years leading post-production engineering and/or technical support teams, including technical program leadership
  • Experience owning technology roadmaps and delivering capital or infrastructure projects on plan
  • Hands-on experience developing AI/agentic workflows
  • Demonstrated experience managing and prioritizing a team of specialized technical staff
  • Strong, hands-on experience with the modern post-production stack — high-performance shared storage, MAM and render-farm management, pipeline tooling, and remote-workstation/virtualization
  • Working knowledge of finishing, mastering, and high-speed media transfers (e.g. Aspera, Signiant)
  • Knowledge of emerging media technologies and standards - HDR, audio & color (Dolby Vision/Atmos, HDR10+, ACES), IMF mastering, broadcast standards, virtualization, accessibility, cloud workflows — and industry bodies such as SMPTE, FCC, MovieLabs, TPN, ATSC

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar), including relevant certifications
  • Experience working with union or collectively-bargained labor
  • Experience planning or executing a facility move or major build
  • Structured program leadership at scale (PMP or equivalent)
  • Facility infrastructure experience in a vendor, studio or network broadcast environment

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Executive Director, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Fox Entertainment is seeking an Executive Director, Business & Legal Affairs to lead and support a broad range of strategic dealmaking and legal matters across creator partnerships, production, and emerging technology initiatives. This role will serve as a senior legal and business advisor, partnering closely with business and legal affairs leadership and key stakeholders to structure, negotiate, and execute complex agreements in a rapidly evolving media landscape.

The department sits at the intersection of traditional entertainment, the creator economy, and technology-driven production. The ideal candidate is a highly versatile, business-minded executive who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment within a large media company. This individual combines strong strategic judgment with the ability to independently manage a high volume of complex, day-to-day matters; build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders; and develop practical solutions that advance business objectives while appropriately managing risk.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the negotiation, drafting, and execution of a broad range of complex agreements, including creator, production, talent, licensing, content, and technology-related deals

  • Serve as a legal and business advisor to internal stakeholders, providing practical counsel on deal structure, business strategy, contractual terms, and legal and commercial risk

  • Partner cross-functionally with production, ad sales, technology, finance, business development, and other teams to structure and execute partnerships and strategic initiatives

  • Advise on legal, business, and policy considerations arising from emerging technologies, including AI-related initiatives, content creation tools, workflow solutions, and evolving rights issues

  • Help shape and implement scalable legal processes, contract templates, playbooks, and best practices that support the department’s evolving business needs

  • Contribute to the development of technology-related policy, guidelines, and governance frameworks as the business models in this space take shape

  • Navigate a high degree of ambiguity, applying sound judgment to novel legal and business questions where clear precedent doesn't yet exist

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, producers, agents, attorneys, technology partners, and other external stakeholders

  • Manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously while exercising sound judgment in a fast-paced and evolving environment

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • JD degree and active membership in the California Bar; candidates eligible for Registered In-House Counsel status under Rule 9.46 will also be considered.

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible legal experience, including substantial in-house entertainment, media, technology, or related transactional experience; top-tier law firm experience

  • Significant experience independently negotiating and drafting complex production, talent, creator, licensing, content, and/or technology agreements

  • Demonstrated ability to advise senior business leaders and influence strategic decisions through practical, commercially minded legal counsel

  • Strong understanding of entertainment rights, production, talent, and evolving digital media business models

  • Excellent legal judgment, negotiation, drafting, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • Proven ability to build credibility and work effectively with senior executives, creative teams, business partners, and external representatives

  • Ability to lead complex matters from strategy through execution, manage competing priorities, and remain composed under pressure

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience advising on AI-related legal, business, rights, and policy issues in media, content, or technology

  • Experience supporting creator economy, digital media, platform, or technology-enabled production initiatives

  • Prior experience mentoring or managing attorneys, paralegals, or other legal professionals

job.title: Field Producer, Fox News EDGE
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Fox News owns and operates affiliates in the largest and most dynamic markets in America. We’re looking for a creative, organized, motivated, curious individual with strong editorial, logistical, and leadership skills to fill a Field Producer in our Washington D.C. Bureau to provide content for those stations and other Fox affiliates. The Field Producer will be responsible for working with reporters to obtain information, write scripts, build graphics and deliver compelling live shots and packages on tight deadlines. Aggressively seeking out additional information and pitching stories is critical to success in this position. A natural curiosity of news is a must. You must be willing to travel on short notice to breaking news locations. While working in the field, you will be responsible for leading the team, balancing management requests, crew needs, and station requests. 


Must be flexible with your schedule and willing to travel and work both weekdays and weekends. 


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Find elements, log events, identify news developments, and write scripts 
  • Work closely with Fox-owned affiliates to facilitate requests and answer questions on daily news stories 
  • Is read-in and familiar with daily developments on stories from politics and breaking news to entertainment 
  • Work with reporters to set up interviews, ask questions and obtain information to craft and produce live shots and packages 
  • Monitor wires, social media, and other broadcast networks for news developments 
  • Build graphics, chyrons, and lower thirds for story delivery 
  • Pitch story ideas 
  • Work with editors to make sure we deliver visually compelling stories 
  • Travel, field produce, and coordinate crew movement on breaking news stories 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED 

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field of study is preferred, or equivalent experience 
  • 5 years of experience in a local or national newsroom  
  • Experience with producing news live shots and packages both in-house and in the field 
  • Strong logistical and editorial skills with knowledge of national and international politics 
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills with a focus on accuracy and proper grammar 
  • Keen understanding of how to gather and disseminate news 
  • Being a self-starter who can work independently, as well as a team player 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, and prioritize on a daily basis, especially in breaking news situations 
  • Familiarity with iNews, Outlook

job.title: Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision. Additionally, this role collaborates with the FP&A team during budget and forecast cycles to support planning activities and ensure alignment between actual results and forward-looking projections. This position reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting.
 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Month-End Close/General Accounting 

  • Manage monthly and quarterly close processes for the Operating Division, including oversight of third-party goods and services, proper expense codification, and accurate general ledger recording

  • Analyze actual spending results and review accrual journal entries to ensure completeness and accuracy of third-party costs across both the P&L and Balance Sheet

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on monthly financial results, clearly articulating drivers of spend, key variances, and accounting treatments to finance and operational stakeholders

  • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

Principal Partner and Procure-to-Pay Process

  • Manage the Procure-to-Pay Process including day-to-day vendor management and invoicing, including answering vendor inquiries, overseeing invoice processing, working closely with cross-functional teams to secure appropriate approvals, and resolving payment issues.

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to Accounts Payable, operational stakeholders, and external vendors, facilitating vendor onboarding, issue resolution, and adherence to internal policies

  • Ensure compliance with Purchase Order policies and approval workflows to support accurate accruals and timely expense recognition

  • Partner cross-functionally to review and interpret contractual terms, supporting appropriate financial treatment and alignment between purchase orders and invoice processing

  • Proactively identify and implement process improvements, including automation and system enhancements, to drive efficiency and scalability

Other Activities

  • Partner with the FP&A team during month-end and budget/forecast cycles to support financial planning and performance analysis

  • Ensure timely completion of close deliverables in coordination with the General Accounting team, maintaining accountability for assigned reporting deadlines

  • Prepare and contribute to management presentations and supporting materials related to financial results and operational performance

  • Assist in supporting Internal and External Audit requests including ensuring proper compliance with identified “Key SOX Controls” and proper documentation of transactions and tracking status of requests

  • Reconcile and validate embedded cost reports from cross-divisional partners, collaborating with stakeholders to investigate material variances and ensure accurate financial reporting

  • Respond to ad hoc financial inquiries and support quarterly reporting requirements from Corporate Accounting, ensuring timely and accurate deliverables

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field

  • 3–5+ years of accounting or finance experience, preferably within public accounting or a large corporate environment

  • Strong understanding of accrual accounting and working knowledge of GAAP

  • Strong analytical thinking

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial data and identify variances

  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy and accountability

  • Demonstrated experience supporting month-end close processes, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables and the ability to analyze large data sets; working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate financial concepts to stakeholders at all levels

  • Ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday Financials and Coupa

  • Experience supporting Engineering, Technology Infrastructure, or SaaS-driven operating environments

  • Familiarity with data analytics tools and emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools)

job.title: News Photographer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At FOX 7 Austin, we don’t wait for the clock to tell us when to deliver the news. Our mission is 24/7 content delivery — meeting our audience where they are, whenever they need us.

 

During your shift, you’ll help us create and distribute content in real time — whether that’s live in the field, collaborating through Slack, or publishing directly to our digital platforms. Some days you’ll team up with a reporter who shares this same fast-moving, audience-first mindset. Other days, you’ll take the lead independently. You may even lend your voice to a live on-air moment or step in front of the camera to help us tell the story.

 

We’re evolving beyond traditional linear TV workflows. That means fewer standard “TV news packages” and more dynamic, creative storytelling designed for digital audiences. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to experiment with format, embrace non-traditional storytelling techniques, and create content that’s relevant, memorable, and impactful.

 

Most importantly, this is a fun, collaborative newsroom in one of the most vibrant cities in the country. Austin moves fast, thinks creatively, and values authenticity — and so do we. If you’re energized by innovation and want to help shape the future of local news in Austin, this is a cool opportunity to do just that.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

Job Requirements

JOB DESCRIPTION

FoxNXT is FOX Entertainment’s next-generation technology studio, built to expand what our creative teams can achieve and put more of every production dollar on screen. Our work spans four pillars: R&D, Production, Talent, and Education.

We turn emerging technology into practical tools and workflows across scripted, unscripted, animation, and marketing. We test in real productions, learn what works, and make those lessons useful across the business. We also develop talent and help our creative and production teams build the skills to use these tools confidently.


Our approach starts with people and craft. We work with creative partners to solve real production problems, protect creative intent, and use AI responsibly, with respect for rights, the creative community, and the resources production consumes.

The Project Manager turns priorities into coordinated action. You will manage intake, establish clear plans and ownership, track delivery, and make sure the right decisions happen at the right time. Working across creative, production, technical, and business teams, you will keep an accurate picture of what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, direct, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You ask good questions, follow through, and raise problems early with a recommendation. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring others in. You build enough structure to help talented people do their best work as the business grows.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own project intake and help translate requests into clear objectives, scope, deliverables, owners, and timelines
  • Maintain a reliable, current view of active projects, priorities, dependencies, and team capacity
  • Coordinate across R&D, production, talent, education, and business teams to align resources and move work forward
  • Identify risks, conflicting priorities, and resource constraints early. Recommend solutions and escalate decisions with clear options and trade-offs
  • Drive follow-through on commitments, approvals, and next steps, with clear accountability for each
  • Give leadership and project teams concise, useful updates on progress, blockers, decisions needed, and outcomes
  • Track schedules, agreed budgets, and scope changes. Make the impact of changes visible before commitments are made
  • Capture requirements, decisions, workflows, and lessons learned so each project makes the next one stronger
  • Track meaningful measures of success, including delivery time, cost, adoption, and production impact
  • Improve how the team works, using practical processes and AI tools to reduce administrative work and keep information accurate

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of project management experience in media, entertainment, technology, or a closely related field
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise
  • Working understanding of television and film production, with the ability to connect creative requirements to technical and operational execution
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, including checking outputs and applying judgment to their use
  • Strong organizational skills and sound judgment about priorities, dependencies, risks, and when to escalate
  • Clear, concise communication. You can explain what matters, what needs to happen, and who owns the next step
  • Ability to build trust and hold people accountable across functions and levels of seniority
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Notion, and Google Workspace
  • Comfort working in a growing team where priorities evolve and some processes still need to be built
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience moving emerging technology from experimentation into production use
  • Experience working directly with creative teams, production crews, or technical artists
  • PMP or equivalent certification

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Fox Entertainment Studios is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Client Operations. This role leads the team responsible for all third-party client servicing of Fox Entertainment Global (FEG Sales), ensuring that clients across the world receive their contracted content and materials accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: a great communicator with a genuine commitment to best-in-class client service.

 

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
