  • Partner with the Mastering and Legal Documentation teams to ensure timely receipt of high-quality materials
  • Onboard new clients for technical delivery, using internal systems and external vendors as needed
  • Maintain accurate, auditable records of delivery status, client specifications, and completed deliverables
  • Trigger and perform revenue recognition upon verified delivery, in coordination with Finance and in accordance with contract terms and company policy
  • Ensure client satisfaction through on-time delivery, proactive communication, and prompt issue resolution
  • Lead, coach, and develop one US-based and one UK-based team member, while directly managing a portfolio of global clients
  • Collaborate with Business Affairs, Legal, Finance, and Rights Management

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of related experience in high-volume entertainment studio servicing
  • 2+ years of people management or team leadership experience
  • Experience supporting clients and colleagues across multiple time zones, including the UK
  • Familiarity with media assets, including audio and visual materials, marketing and advertising materials, and legal documentation
  • Working knowledge of frame rates, codecs, resolutions, and delivery specifications
  • Strong prioritization and resource-allocation skills
  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent deliveries or projects at various stages in an extremely fast-paced environment
  • Ability to learn new systems, processes, and client requirements quickly and thoroughly
  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior executives
  • Discretion in handling confidential information
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Telecommuting permitted from any location in the U.S.

job.title: Software Development Engineer, Backend ( Golang )
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY:

Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform.


Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.


Job Description


As a Software Engineer in the Backend/API team, you will be responsible for building and operating scalable, resilient backend systems that power multiple consumer-facing platforms. You will work on high-throughput, low-latency services and APIs that are critical to core product experiences.

This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production. We are looking for strong backend engineers who can work independently, make sound technical decisions, and deliver reliable systems without the need for constant hand-holding.


A Snapshot of Your Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that run at high scale with strict reliability and performance requirements.
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from requirements understanding and system design to production rollout and ongoing operations.
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code across backend components.
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production.
  • Optimize existing systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost.
  • Apply strong problem-solving skills and data structures knowledge to design efficient, real-world solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver backend capabilities that support evolving product needs.
  • Participate actively in code and design reviews, maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Continuously improve system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering best practices within the team.

What Will You Need


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 4-8 years of experience building backend software systems in production environments.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang.
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability.
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud-based systems (e.g., AWS or equivalent).
  • Experience working with databases and data stores (relational and/or NoSQL) and an understanding of data modeling and performance trade-offs.
  • Practical understanding of modern AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), and how to integrate AI capabilities into backend software.
  • Familiarity with using AI to build, enhance, or operate software systems (e.g., LLM-based APIs, prompt-driven workflows, automation, developer productivity).
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for a writer to help us keep our commerce content library up to date.


You’re a shopping-obsessed self-starter with strong news judgment who thrives under pressure and keeps a laser-sharp focus on metrics. You’re a seasoned and savvy shopper always on the lookout for a deal, and aware of every new product launch.


This role will be responsible for revising, updating and optimizing our commerce content to ensure it is timely, accurate and relevant. This content will include product reviews, buying guides, and deal roundups.


The role will report to the production editor, and work closely with the commerce content, partnerships and growth teams to ensure content is updated in a timely manner, and is always accurate.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Write and produce 6-10 pieces of shoppable content roundups and breakout articles a week.
  • Ensuring our content library is up to date with correct pricing and product information
  • Research and write supplemental commerce content including  buyers guide and pros and cons. This may involve conducting interviews to improve content
  • Research new products and trends, as well as competitor content picks, to make sure we always make the best recommendations to our readers.
  • Keeping on top of new product launches to ensure our content always has the most up to date products. This may involve helping test and review new products.
  • Pitching new content ideas
  • Analyze market trends to discover the best products we should be recommending
  • Thoroughly price-check each article prior to initial publish and before any scheduled republishes 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • An obsessive interest in products and shopping – you should be that one friend that people always come to for shopping advice
  • At least 2 years’ worth of digital experience (preferably in journalism or content-related affiliate commerce/marketing), including SEO expertise
  • Ability to work in deadline-driven conditions and work under pressure in a fast-paced newsroom environment 
  • Daily experience working within a CMS (familiarity with WordPress preferred)
  • Proven track record of executing revenue-driving articles (both deals-centric and evergreen)
  • Passionate about service journalism and delivering high quality content
  • Well-versed in using data and reporting tools to inform editorial ideas
  • Familiarity with digital publishing tools and trends; experience with generative AI tools is a must-have.
  • Ability to be extremely flexible, work on holidays as needed, and always “on-call” mentality and be prepared to work under emergency or breaking news conditions 
  • Experience in closely monitoring and driving audience growth
  • Obsessive attention to detail, with the ability to see the bigger picture and prioritize across multiple platforms
  • Capable of writing engaging headlines and copy all while maintaining the team’s editorial voice and standards
  • Ability to accurately price-check pieces at a fast pace, especially while adhering to deadlines 
  • Self-starter, entrepreneurial spirit 
  • Strong and collaborative work ethic
  • Critical thinker and creative problem solver

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Familiarity with AP Style
  • Strong understanding of the digital lifestyle and commerce spaces in all verticals ranging from tech to beauty

job.title: Video News Photojournalist & Editor
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are in search of a talented Video News Photojournalist & Editor to join our team and as we strive deliver the highest standards in news production in the number one market, providing content for our marquee morning news and variety show "Good Day New York", "The Noon", 5 & 6 PM newscasts, "The 10 O'clock News" and a host of special programming, plus our various digital streaming platforms.

As a Video News Photojournalist and Editor, you will play a key role in capturing and producing visually compelling news stories that resonate with our audience. You will work closely with reporters, producers, and other team members to ensure that our content is both informative and visually engaging. This position requires a creative eye, technical expertise, and a passion for storytelling.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Capture high-quality video footage for breaking news stories, live events, and special features.
  • Edit video content under tight deadlines to create accurate, engaging news segments that meet our editorial standards.
  • Work side-by-side with reporters and producers to develop visual storytelling strategies.
  • Operate and maintain video equipment, ensuring all gear is in excellent working condition.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies to continually enhance our content.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment, meeting tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Ensure all video content adheres to legal and ethical standards.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Expertise operating ENG cameras (we shoot w Sony PXW-X400 and PXW-Z300), DJI Osmos, GoPros, and other portable "action cameras".
  • 5+ years as a videographer and editor, preferably in a top 10 market.
  • Familiarity with the Tri-State area, as you will be operating station owned vehicles in NY, NJ,CT and beyond.
  • Experience with cellular bonding transmitters (LiveU/Dejero) and Starlink.
  • Strong understanding of video production techniques, including lighting, sound, and composition.
  • Proficiency with Windows OS and Adobe Premiere Pro, FTP applications is a must.
  • Excellent storytelling skills with a keen eye for detail and the moving image.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple projects all at once.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
  • A degree in journalism, film production, or a related field is preferred but not required.
  • Ability to lift heavy equipment and climb stairs; driver’s license required.

REQUIREMENTS

Flexibility to work irregular hours, including evenings, early mornings, overnights and weekends as news coverage dictates, in a 24/7/365 breaking news environment; must be able to work overtime, holidays and varied hours. job.title: Weekend Senior Producer, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're hiring a Weekend Senior Producer to join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. 


As a Weekend Senior Producer, you will serve as an editorial leader for our team and take an active role in boosting the quality of our product while championing the LiveNOW mission. If you describe yourself as a tech-savvy multitasker obsessed with news and producing it differently, this is your opportunity to create compelling content in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


With your guidance, you will help take LiveNOW’s content to the next level!


This position is based in LiveNOW’s West Coast newsroom located in Phoenix, Arizona.


SCHEDULE: Thursday - Monday


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take a hands-on role in producing relevant, timely, live coverage of breaking news and major news events for all digital platforms.
  • Lead editorial decisions and ensure content meets editorial standards while staying on top of current news, events, and industry news.
  • Monitor video feeds, social media, and other newsgathering tools for fresh, live content and the latest information. 
  • Contribute to coverage plans of major stories and live events to drive viewer engagement.
  • Support the development of other producers as you ensure a positive work environment and mentor them. 
  • Actively participate in training news staff on all technical, editorial, and presentation aspects of LiveNOW.
  • Work closely with LiveNOW leadership to develop and adjust producer workflows as needed. 
  • Support LiveNOW’s efforts to cultivate relationships with key players at FTS O&O stations and other internal or external partners.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3-5 years of experience leading the planning and producing of live news content, including breaking news on digital, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or a related field. 
  • Strong knowledge of technical aspects of digital news production, including live streaming and video publishing
  • Prior experience leading and developing, with a track record of taking ownership to successfully deliver key projects or initiatives. 
  • Superior news judgment, strong attention to detail, and impeccable organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment under deadline pressures.
  • Proficient in social media, SEO, and various tools used for web-based newsgathering, content creation, and digital analytics.
  • Varied hours including regular weekend and evening shifts, and holidays as required.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $85,000.00-95,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive– Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location:  This is a hybrid, outside sales role supporting a designated geographic territory (Langhorne, PA and surrounding region).  Success in this position requires regular in-market client and prospect in-person engagement. While much of the work is performed remotely and in the field, periodic attendance at a company office for meetings, training, collaboration, and business activities may be required.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs

Consultative, full-cycle sales

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a book of clients balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles.

Experience in media, digital marketing, advertising sales preferred.

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

Employee Referral Bonus Eligible

Someone who can independently dig in on a single topic, or lend a hand to a fellow reporter in a pinch. Strong video production skills are required for this position and familiarity with reporting on social platforms is desired.

As our audience develops and evolves we seek to meet them where they are at and where they consume their news, and a qualified candidate is someone who understands this and can demonstrate a track record of publishing news to a variety of platforms in a variety of formats. The Coloradoan values innovation and collaboration, and a good candidate will bring both to this role. When applying, please provide examples of your writing, photography, videography and any other applicable materials that demonstrate your ability to meet the demands of modern journalism.

This reporter will be a swift breaking news reporter and in tune with what’s trending each day, sometimes writing multiple times per day. This person will be expected to be among the newsroom’s top pageview producers. They will create quick videos for almost every story; sometimes producing video-only stories. This reporter will need to have the basic skills of a reporter, knowing how to access public records (such as police records and body cam and surveillance video), build sources, conduct interviews and find and read data.

Knowing and embracing Artificial Intelligence as a tool to improve their reporting duties is a must. They will be asked to localize national and state stories for our audience. They will be asked to work with other reporters and editors to create alternate URLS from existing stories. They will occasionally report in the field and will be a part of the newsroom’s coverage of big, breaking stories, such as wildfires, and tent-pole events. They will sometimes be asked to work weekends.

Responsibilities:

Write quickly and clearly, with voice.

Deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram or any other methods available to reach our audience.

Use metrics to inform story choices and shape beat strategies. This includes being adept at SEO.

Identify top stories of the day based on analytics and audience potential.

Work with editors to experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and alternate story forms. This includes experimenting with long-tail (evergreen) content.

A self-starter who is eager to take the lead on new coverage areas, as well as ambitious projects to grow our brand.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum of 2-3 years’ digital journalism experience, preferred.

Able to file quickly across platforms: mobile, desktop and social media.

Strong command of AP grammar and style.

Ability to produce content that is clean, accurate and "publication ready."

Passionate and enthusiastic about news and content that will work well with audiences on social platforms.

Comfortable in fluid, fast-breaking, stressful situations. Also comfortable using social media to enhance reporting and promote stories.

Understand reporting ethics and sourcing.

Excel in a fast-paced news environment and understands the digital first mission.

Collaborate well with others and can work with a team – including teammates and colleagues who are remote.

Open to off-typical schedules, including the possibility of early mornings, late nights and/or weekend work. Able to be flexible as needed.

Application InstructionsWe are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Digital Advertising Campaign Manager – Automotive
job.description:
Optimizer I / Account Manager – Automotive

Digital Advertising | Campaign Optimization | Fully Remote

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY NetworkBase Salary: $60,000 annuallyWork Arrangement: 100% Remote

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses grow through powerful marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn marketing into measurable results.

We combine innovative advertising solutions, actionable insights, and a customer-first approach to help businesses reach the right audiences and achieve their goals. Our teams bring together marketing expertise, technology, and collaboration to deliver solutions that make a meaningful difference for our clients.

In this role, you’ll support automotive dealerships by helping them get more from their digital advertising investments. You’ll use campaign performance data, industry knowledge, and a solution-oriented mindset to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and help customers make informed decisions about their marketing.

About the Role

Our Digital Marketing Account Manager – Automotive role is an opportunity for someone who enjoys analyzing performance, building relationships, and turning challenges into solutions.

You’ll manage a portfolio of automotive dealer accounts, serving as a trusted day-to-day partner to customers and our internal Sales team. You’ll monitor digital advertising campaigns, evaluate performance trends, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend actions that align with each dealer’s business goals.

This role combines analytical thinking, digital marketing expertise, and customer relationship management. You won’t simply report numbers or pass along problems. You’ll dig into the details, ask thoughtful questions, investigate what’s happening, and collaborate with the right people to determine the best path forward.

Working closely with Sales, campaign operations, analytics, creative, product, and other internal partners, you’ll help deliver a strong customer experience while supporting account health, retention, and long-term growth.

With a $60,000 annual base salary and the flexibility of a fully remote work environment, this is an opportunity to grow your digital marketing expertise, take ownership of meaningful customer relationships, and make a direct impact on business results.

Why This Role Stands Out

$60,000 annual base salary

100% remote work with the flexibility to work from home

Opportunity to work at the intersection of digital marketing, campaign strategy, and account management

Manage a portfolio of automotive dealership accounts and build meaningful client relationships

Use data and performance insights to identify opportunities and make a measurable impact

Develop expertise across digital advertising platforms, analytics tools, and emerging marketing technologies

Collaborate with Sales and specialized internal teams to solve customer challenges and improve campaign performance

Build knowledge of the automotive retail industry and the digital automotive shopping journey

Strengthen your analytical, strategic, communication, and customer-management skills

Work within an established organization backed by the marketing expertise, resources, and reach of LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

Access professional development opportunities and continued learning as advertising technology evolves

Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and additional employee benefits

What You Will Do

Manage day-to-day relationships across a portfolio of automotive dealership accounts, developing an understanding of each customer's goals, inventory priorities, market conditions, and business challenges

Monitor digital advertising campaigns, evaluating performance, budget pacing, traffic, conversions, leads, and other key performance indicators

Identify trends, investigate performance changes, and uncover the why behind the numbers

Make appropriate campaign optimizations and recommend strategies that align with dealer objectives and business priorities

Translate campaign data into clear, actionable insights that help customers understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement

Proactively communicate with customers, manage requests from intake through resolution, and provide updates to ensure consistent follow-through

Identify potential issues involving campaigns, tracking, websites, creative, targeting, or operations and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams to resolve them

Partner with Sales to support customer satisfaction, account health, retention, and growth opportunities

Collaborate with campaign operations, creative, analytics, product, support, and other internal partners to deliver effective solutions

Manage competing priorities, customer requests, deadlines, and campaign responsibilities while maintaining accurate documentation

Build expertise across digital advertising channels and platforms, including Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, and reporting tools

Stay curious about changes in advertising technology, AI-driven marketing, consumer behavior, and the automotive marketplace

Identify recurring challenges and share ideas that improve processes, team collaboration, and the overall customer experience

Qualifications

2–4 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, campaign optimization, automotive advertising, agency services, or account management

Experience supporting automotive dealerships or working in automotive advertising is strongly preferred

Working knowledge of digital advertising concepts and performance metrics, including impressions, clicks, CPC, CTR, conversions, conversion rate, leads, budget pacing, and return on advertising investment

Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, or comparable advertising and analytics tools is preferred

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate performance trends and turn data into actionable recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain campaign performance and recommendations in a clear, customer-friendly way

Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with customers, Sales, and cross-functional partners

A proactive, solution-oriented approach to challenges, with the ability to investigate issues, evaluate options, and determine when additional expertise is needed

Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities

Comfort working in an evolving environment where customer needs, advertising platforms, products, and priorities can change

Strong working knowledge of Excel and the ability to learn new advertising, analytics, CRM, and reporting systems

Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are curious, analytical, collaborative, and driven to find solutions. They enjoy understanding how things work, asking questions, and looking beyond the surface to uncover opportunities.

You’ll thrive if you enjoy working with data but also understand the importance of the people behind it. You can identify a performance issue, investigate the possible causes, and communicate a practical recommendation without losing sight of the customer's goals.

You’re also someone who takes ownership. You follow through on commitments, keep others informed, and work through challenges rather than simply passing them along. You know when to take initiative independently and when to bring in the right partners to reach the best outcome.

Above all, you’re eager to learn. Whether you’re building your automotive expertise, exploring new advertising technology, or finding a better way to support a customer, you approach each opportunity with a growth mindset and a willingness to improve.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:Build foundational knowledge of LocaliQ's advertising products, campaign-management processes, internal tools, and automotive customers. Develop relationships with Sales and internal partners while learning to evaluate campaign performance, manage customer requests, and navigate available resources.

6 Months:Independently manage day-to-day account responsibilities, monitor campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate meaningful recommendations. Build confidence troubleshooting common issues and coordinating solutions across internal teams.

12 Months:Confidently manage your portfolio of dealer accounts, proactively identify performance opportunities, and serve as a reliable partner to customers and Sales. Demonstrate strong ownership of account needs, effective cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to turn campaign insights into actionable solutions that support customer satisfaction and business results.

Benefits & Growth

We believe great work starts with competitive compensation, flexibility, opportunities to learn, and the ability to build a rewarding career.

$60,000 annual base salary

100% remote work environment

Medical, dental, and vision coverage

401(k)

Paid time off and floating holidays

8 paid holidays

Professional development and ongoing learning opportunities

Opportunities to expand your digital marketing, analytics, and automotive industry expertise

Collaboration with experienced Sales, marketing, and campaign-management professionals

Career development opportunities within LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

Turn Marketing Insights Into Meaningful Results

Great marketing is about more than numbers. It’s about understanding a customer's goals, recognizing opportunities, and finding the right solutions to help their business grow.

As a Digital Marketing Account Manager – Automotive, you’ll bring together analytical thinking, digital marketing, and customer partnership to help automotive dealerships get more from their advertising investments.

With a $60,000 base salary and the flexibility of working remotely, you’ll have the opportunity to build your expertise, take ownership of your work, and contribute to meaningful customer outcomes.

If you’re ready to solve problems, build strong relationships, and make an impact in digital marketing, we encourage you to apply.

The salary for this role will range between $55,000 and $60,000. Base compensation is reflective of multiple factors, including market location, education level, skills, certifications, and experience. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and may apply based on the role.

job.title: Director, Product Development - Product Management
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

job.title: Electrician II
job.description:
Electrician II

Gannett Publishing Services / USA TODAY CO

Des Moines, IA

WE ARE OFFERING A STARTING ANNUAL SALARY UP TO $83,200 (PLUS ADDITIONAL OVERTIME PAY) BASED ON BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE

WE ARE ALSO OFFERING A SIGN ON BONUS OF UP TO $2,250 PAID OUT IN 3 INCREMENTS

Position Details:

Performs advance level electrical maintenance (including preventive), diagnostics and repairs on production equipment and systems in an industrial environment to support efficient production operations as needed.

Serve in a lead role as part of a team to achieve and maintain on-time production performance, product quality and accuracy standards as well as operational safety including OSHA and EPA compliance.

Provide direction on electrical repairs of production equipment and perform electrical maintenance, diagnostics and repairs on specified equipment which may include, but are not limited to:  CTP Imagers, processors, benders; press controls, printing units, reels, dampening & inking systems; inserting equipment, stackers, strappers, labelers, applicators, bindery equipment, conveyors, motors, pumps, dryers and other ancillary equipment.  Potential involvement with the building department infrastructure equipment (HVAC and plumbing).

Monitor all production reporting for maintenance/repair issues. Record entries in repair log (failed equipment) and preventive maintenance log books while looking for trends in machine performance.   Communicate repair/maintenance issues and provide updates of ongoing projects and preventative maintenance programs to supervisor.

Safety:

Always work in a safe manner and consistently utilize required safety equipment to promote top-of-mind safety awareness:

Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Assist in leading safety compliance within the department including accident investigations and follow up.

Complete required annual OSHA safety training programs.

Ensure all machine safety-guards are installed, functioning properly, and in use.

Immediately report any potential safety hazards, operational concerns and all accidents/injuries and near misses to production management.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Requirements:

High school diploma or GED equivalent

Certified electrical training required (Vocational school, military, trade)

Journeyman level electrical certification required

Experience Required or Preferred

Minimum five years’ experience in electrical maintenance, diagnostics and repair required

Specialized Knowledge Required or Preferred:

Ability to read blueprints and sufficient computer skills required for diagnostic applications.

Ability to use precision instruments and measuring tools.

Ability to read pneumatic and electrical schematics/wiring diagrams. Ability to use testing equipment. Experience with PLC controllers. Experience uploading programs to a CPU and downloading to a laptop.   Experience with synchronous and asynchronous motors.  Understanding of AC frequency drive controllers, instrumentation and measurements.

Proficient verbal and written communication skills

Proven excellent time management skills working in a fast-paced deadline driven environment with a sense of urgency

Strong mechanical aptitude.

May be required to work flexible shifts; including weekend, nighttime and holiday shifts around loud production equipment.  May be on call for emergency services.

Want a Monday–Friday Job That Gets You Out of Retail or Restaurants?

If you're ready for a change from working nights, weekends, or unpredictable shifts, this could be your opportunity to step into a professional office environment — without needing previous office experience.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay Press-Gazette team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, working on a computer, and keeping things organized. Maybe you've worked in retail, restaurants, hospitality, customer service, or another busy environment. You've already developed many of the skills you'll use here.

We'll teach you the rest.

You'll receive hands-on training, learn our systems, and help process important public notices while supporting customers and coworkers. It's a chance to build office experience, develop new skills, and settle into a consistent weekday routine.

What Your Day Could Look Like

Entering information into computer systems and processing public notices

Helping resolve questions and working with other teams when needed

Learning our systems and processes with support and hands-on training

Enjoy helping customers and working with people

Communicate clearly and professionally

Show up, follow through, and can be counted on

You'll also have access to:

Health, Dental & Vision coverage

Paid Time Off

Company holidays

Training and development opportunities

A supportive team environment

If you're looking for a dependable weekday job, want to gain office experience, or are ready to try something new, we'd love to hear from you.

No previous office experience? That's okay. If you're dependable, willing to learn, and ready for a change, apply today.

job.title: Local Government Watchdog/Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
Local Government Watchdog/Breaking News Reporter

The Desert Sun/desertsun.com in Palm Desert, California, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is looking for a reporter to join our team covering nine Coachella Valley cities – from Palm Springs to Coachella in the California desert — and Riverside County government.

This fast-growing area of Southern California is bursting with amazing stories to chase or conceive. We are looking for a journalist who is comfortable with quick-hit breaking news and ambitious enterprise in an exciting and complex area widely known for its Hollywood history as it grapples with modern-day realities. This dynamic position offers the chance to cover city hall; social justice issues; new restaurants and businesses and buzzy pop-ups; in addition to weather, traffic and public safety issues. The right candidate understands how to deliver this information both through traditional story formats and videos.

We are looking for a watchdog reporter who will hold public officials accountable and help our audience make informed decisions about their communities — from the spending of tax dollars, to the quality of their schools and the safety of their neighborhoods. Although your first task is to serve the local community, we want someone who will strive to use this local beat as a launching pad for stories with statewide or national impact. You must build trust with sources and have an eye for important details buried in local government agendas, budgets and public records. You should have work samples that demonstrate an aptitude for data-driven stories and familiarity with FOIA requests, and a track record of producing compelling, timely, well-sourced stories and videos. We expect that you can recognize compelling, socially shareable stories and that you will be quick to jump on them.

This job is well suited for a reporter who can think critically and creatively and communicate with clarity and impact on complex issues in a fast-paced and competitive environment. You must be willing to ask tough questions that are in the moment, but also with an eye toward the future.  We will expect you to break important news and develop stories that engage our audiences on multiple platforms using text, video, graphics, social media and more. The best candidate can act independently, drawing on audience interest to identify stories our readers and viewers need and want to know about.

Responsibilities:

Report quickly, clearly and accurately to deliver news, via stories, video, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram or any other methods available to reach our audiences.

Jump on breaking news. Research, write, report, photograph and/or video a variety of stories.

Demonstrate fast news judgement on an ongoing basis.

Source development is key to cultivating contacts among city officials, community leaders, residents, first responders and police. Have a genuine interest in people and ability to build trust and engage on social media with sources and audiences.

Experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and alternate story forms.

Monitor real-time news and sniff out the most important and fascinating stories important to our audiences in addition to pursuing enterprise/investigative work to uncover stories that no one else is reporting.

Use metrics to inform story choices and identify top news stories of the day, based on analytics and audience potential.

Write and/or produce multimedia content that appeals to key audience targets and maximizes user experience on digital and social platforms to reach readers where they spend their time and attention.

job.title: Marketing Automation & Lifecycle Specialist
job.description:
Purpose

Serve as a hands-on technical and solutions partner across marketing activation, connecting platforms, data, audiences and workflows to make our marketing programs more automated, reliable, measurable and effective.

About the role

We're looking for a technically curious, solutions-oriented marketing automation specialist who likes figuring out how things work, why they aren't working and how they could work better. This role sits at the intersection of marketing operations, marketing technology, audiences, data and activation. You'll work across email, onsite experiences, audience targeting, campaign production and other marketing technologies to help connect the dots across our Consumer ecosystem. You'll be comfortable getting hands-on in platforms and troubleshooting technical issues, but this is not simply an execution or ticket-taking role. You'll proactively identify opportunities to improve targeting, workflows, QA, reporting and automation, and help turn business problems into practical technical solutions.

What you'll do

Partner across Marketing Operations, MarTech, Audience Strategy, Analytics, Product and Performance Marketing to design and improve scalable marketing activation solutions.

Work hands-on across email, onsite experiences, audiences, campaign production and marketing automation, helping teams connect data, technology and execution.

Build, launch and optimize automated and lifecycle programs supporting acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, pricing and customer communications.

Support email campaign and journey execution, including segmentation, personalization, automation, audience logic, deployment and troubleshooting.

Partner on audience strategy and activation, helping teams evaluate who we target, how frequently we reach them and how audience and campaign strategies could be improved.

Identify and troubleshoot campaign, audience, data, platform and deployment issues, helping determine root causes and recommending solutions.

Develop stronger QA, monitoring and validation processes to identify issues before and after campaigns and experiences are deployed.

Identify repetitive or manual processes and build or recommend automation that improves speed, scalability and accuracy.

Use AI and automation to accelerate campaign production, QA, analysis, documentation, troubleshooting and other marketing operations workflows.

Proactively recommend new capabilities, platform improvements and better ways of working rather than waiting for requirements or tickets.

How we'll measure success

Reduction in manual work through automation and improved workflows

Accuracy and reliability of campaign and experience deployments

Ability to proactively identify, troubleshoot and resolve technical and operational issues

Improvements in QA, monitoring and visibility into campaign health

Quality of audience segmentation, personalization and activation

Speed-to-market for campaigns and customer experiences

Adoption and successful implementation of new marketing capabilities

Ability to turn data and technical findings into actionable recommendations

Contribution to acquisition, engagement, retention and revenue goals

What you'll bring

3+ years of experience in marketing automation, marketing technology, lifecycle marketing, CRM, marketing operations or a related technical marketing discipline.

Hands-on experience working with one or more enterprise email, CRM, marketing automation or customer engagement platforms.

Experience building or supporting automated campaigns, customer journeys, audience segmentation, personalization or triggered communications.

Strong understanding of customer data, audience logic, segmentation and how data flows between marketing systems.

Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical and data-related problems, identify root causes and recommend practical solutions.

Experience improving workflows or using automation to reduce manual execution.

Strong QA instincts and attention to detail, with experience developing or improving processes that increase execution reliability.

Comfort working with both technical and nontechnical partners and translating business needs into technical solutions.

Curiosity and initiative. You look for problems and opportunities proactively rather than waiting for someone to tell you what to fix.

Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and platforms quickly.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio or Contact Builder

SQL, AMPscript, HTML/CSS, JavaScript or similar technical skills

Experience with Looker, Tableau or similar reporting and visualization tools

Experience creating dashboards or conducting analysis specifically to identify anomalies, uncover issues or recommend optimization opportunities

Experience with onsite messaging, personalization or digital experience platforms

Experience applying AI to marketing operations, automation, QA, analysis or technical workflows

Lifecycle marketing experience in subscription, media or ecommerce

job.title: National News Boats Reporter
job.description:
USATODAY Network is seeking a consumer-focused Boats Reporter to lead coverage for our new national Boats hub. This journalist will create compelling, useful and audience-driven content for people who are considering a boat purchase, enjoy life on the water or are deeply engaged with boats and boating culture.

We’re looking for a boating enthusiast with strong reporting instincts, multimedia storytelling skills and a deep understanding of how to serve three key audience segments:

Boat shoppers and buyers researching models, features, prices and purchasing decisions

Recreationists looking for accessible, practical and inspiring ways to enjoy boating and life on the water

Boating enthusiasts who closely follow new products, innovations, destinations, events and boating culture

This role supports USAT Networks' strategic goal of growing engaged audiences through high-quality, platform-optimized consumer coverage. The reporter will become a leading voice of the Boats hub, producing authoritative journalism while helping establish its identity, audience and programming across multiple platforms.

The reporter will work closely with editors, visual journalists and reporters across the USA TODAY Network to deliver timely, relevant and distinctive coverage. Video will be central to the role. The successful candidate must be comfortable appearing on camera, developing original video concepts and producing content from idea through publication.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position. The role is remote, though candidates may also be based in a USAT local market.

Responsibilities:

Report and write useful, engaging stories for boat shoppers, recreationists and enthusiasts

Develop authoritative buying guidance, product comparisons, explainers and other service journalism that helps consumers make informed decisions

Cover boating news, trends, innovations, destinations, events and culture

Generate original video concepts that complement the hub’s journalism and expand its reach

Report, shoot and produce platform-appropriate video, including on-camera segments, demonstrations, interviews and field reporting

Translate reporting into compelling visual stories for YouTube, social platforms and other video destinations

Pitch timely ideas based on news, seasonal interest, consumer demand, search behavior and audience data

Balance quick-turn coverage with enterprise reporting, distinctive features and recurring franchises

Create content optimized for search, social media, newsletters, video and other audience channels

Build and maintain relationships with boat manufacturers, dealers, industry experts, recreational organizations, boat owners and other relevant sources

Collaborate with journalists across the USA TODAY Network to identify local expertise, expand coverage and maximize reach

Help establish the hub’s editorial voice, coverage priorities and publishing rhythm

Monitor performance metrics and use the results to refine topics, formats, packaging and distribution

What you’ll need to thrive

A genuine passion for boats, boating and life on the water

Strong reporting, writing and news judgment

The ability to make boating approachable to newcomers without losing credibility with experienced enthusiasts

Confidence developing stories around consumer questions and real-world audience needs

Strong video instincts and comfort working both behind and in front of the camera

The ability to identify which ideas are best told through articles, videos, social content or a combination of formats

Familiarity with SEO, social media best practices and audience analytics

Clear, concise writing that avoids unnecessary jargon

An energetic and creative approach to building a new editorial product

The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across a distributed newsroom

Sound judgment when reporting in marinas, on boats and around the water

Requirements

Proven experience in journalism, digital media, video production or a related content field

Excellent reporting, writing, communication and organizational skills

Demonstrated experience creating original video content

Experience shooting and producing video in field environments

Comfort appearing on camera and conducting on-camera interviews

Ability to manage multiple stories and formats in a fast-paced environment

Understanding of audience strategy and digital publishing

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer, pre-employment background check

Preferred qualifications

Experience covering boats, outdoor recreation, travel, consumer products or a related subject

Demonstrated knowledge of boats and boating culture

Experience with video editing and YouTube programming

Experience producing product reviews, demonstrations or comparison content

Familiarity with consumer buying journeys, affiliate-supported content or commerce journalism

Knowledge of newsletter strategy and performance metrics

Experience using audience data to identify and develop coverage opportunities

How success will be measured

Growth in engaged audience across shoppers, recreationists and enthusiasts

Development of a consistent and recognizable voice for the Boats hub

Performance of original video across relevant platforms

Search, social and direct audience growth

Growth in repeat visitation and audience loyalty

Timeliness, usefulness and distinctiveness of coverage

Development of successful recurring topics, formats and franchises

Effective collaboration with journalists across the USA TODAY Network

Use of performance insights to improve coverage and distribution

Application instructions

We’re eager to learn more about you and how you would build an ambitious, consumer-focused Boats hub. When applying, please upload a single PDF document that includes:

Your resume

A cover letter explaining your approach to serving boat shoppers, recreationists and enthusiasts

Links to three to six examples of your reporting, video or other digital work

A brief description of one story or video franchise you would launch for the Boats hub

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.description:
Videographer/Photographer

The Des Moines Register/desmoinesregister.com, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seeks a videographer/photographer to join our talented staff in Iowa’s capital city.

This journalist should have an interest in telling stories with video, from spot news to mini-documentaries and social media clips. They should also be versed in making still photos that tell stories from sports fields, Iowans’ homes and political rallies. They will also play a key role in training members of our newsroom on video and will track and adopt evolving best practices.

The successful candidate must have a passion for telling stories visually, quickly when needed, in-depth when called for, and always with accuracy.

We expect anyone who works with us to constantly improve their skills. We offer internal and company-wide training programs and study metrics, audience, social and search trends to deliver essential news and information.

The position requires flexibility to cover the news and is generally a Tuesday to Saturday workweek.

Des Moines is one of the Midwest’s fastest growing cities and has become a magnet for young professionals, attracted by an expanding job base and an increasingly diverse cultural and arts scene.

The Des Moines Register is a 17-time Pulitzer Prize winner. The Register offers an opportunity to build a career path in Iowa or to gain the foundation to move on to top metros across the country.

Three years of experience in professional photojournalism.

Solid news judgment.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

New Castle, Delaware

The Wilmington GPS group is looking for a full-time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our Goss HO presses. The work includes working with a team to prepare the presses for production, operates the presses or any of their components, cleans the presses and the pressroom, maintains the mechanical readiness of the presses, and other duties as assigned.Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success:

job.title: Sales Associate
job.description:
Sales Associate, Marketing Solutions

Position Summary

LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network are seeking a motivated, career-driven Sales Associate to join our Marketing Solutions team. This entry-level sales role serves as the foundation for future growth into Media Specialist and Account Executive positions.

The Sales Associate is responsible for generating new business opportunities, building prospect pipelines, supporting open territories, and securing qualified meetings for the sales organization. Working closely with sales leaders and account teams, this role plays a critical part in driving future revenue growth through proactive prospecting, lead generation, and customer engagement.

What You'll Do

Prospecting & Business Development

Conduct outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other lead-generation channels.

Research local businesses and identify potential advertising and marketing opportunities.

Build and maintain prospect lists utilizing Salesforce, market intelligence tools, and industry resources.

Schedule qualified discovery meetings for Media Specialists and Account Executives.

Support open territories and transitional account assignments through business development activities.

Create and develop new sales opportunities that contribute to territory growth.

Sales Activity & Pipeline Management

Execute daily activity plans designed to achieve prospecting, meeting, and opportunity goals.

Maintain accurate prospect, activity, and pipeline data within Salesforce.

Follow established sales processes for lead qualification and opportunity management.

Monitor and update prospecting campaigns and outreach efforts.

Research industries, customer needs, and competitive insights to support sales strategy.

Collaboration & Sales Support

Partner with Sales Managers, Media Specialists, Account Executives, and Account Coordinators to support business growth.

Ensure qualified opportunities are documented and transitioned effectively.

Participate in ongoing coaching, training, and professional development programs.

Collaborate cross-functionally to support exceptional customer experiences.

Customer Engagement

Serve as an initial point of contact for prospective customers.

Conduct basic needs assessments and qualification conversations.

Build professional relationships with local business decision makers.

Represent LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network with professionalism and integrity.

Qualifications

Required

Associate's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Strong customer service mindset.

Ability to learn new sales tools, platforms, and processes quickly.

Self-motivated with a desire to build a sales career.

Preferred

1-3 years of experience in sales, customer service, account support, business development, or related fields.

Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms.

Experience working in a deadline-driven environment.

Familiarity with digital marketing, advertising, media, or customer acquisition strategies.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

This position offers a structured pathway into a full-cycle sales career. You'll receive hands-on experience in prospecting, pipeline management, customer engagement, and sales strategy while working alongside experienced media sales professionals. Successful Sales Associates will develop the foundational skills needed to advance into Media Specialist and Account Executive opportunities.

Technology & Tools

Salesforce CRM

Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)

Sales engagement and prospecting tools

Market research and business intelligence platforms

Work Environment

Hybrid or remote work environment

Regular business hours

Occasional travel for meetings, training, and team events

Collaborative, growth-oriented sales culture

Why LocaliQ?

LocaliQ combines the strength of the USA TODAY Network with leading digital marketing technology, helping businesses attract, convert, and retain customers through innovative marketing solutions. As a Sales Associate, you'll gain exposure to digital advertising, search marketing, social media, programmatic advertising, SEO, AI-powered marketing technology, and more while building a rewarding career in media sales.

This role is ideal for competitive, curious, and coachable individuals looking to launch a career in consultative sales and digital marketing.

job.title: Sr Director, Creative Operations and Activation

Lead the execution engine behind Consumer growth, overseeing creative production, channel activation, lifecycle deployment, workflow optimization and automation across all consumer marketing channels.

Our Consumer team grows digital subscriptions and reader engagement across USA TODAY and the USA TODAY Network. This role runs the engine that makes it happen.
