job.title: ESPN Cleveland Account Executive
job.description:
ESPN Cleveland Marketing Consultant (Account Executive)

(Cleveland, OH)  

ESPN Cleveland is looking for our next high-performing Marketing Consultant to join one of Cleveland’s leading sports media brands. You’ll help local, regional and national brands connect with passionate Cleveland sports fans through customized marketing partnerships across ESPN Cleveland audio, digital content, social media and live events. 
 
As a Marketing Consultant, you’ll build relationships with advertising partners, understand their business goals and develop creative solutions that leverage the power of ESPN Cleveland. You’ll bring together the right ideas and assets to create meaningful partnerships that help our partners grow their businesses.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with local, regional and national brands and decision-makers.
  • Build, grow and maintain strong partner relationships focused on achieving their business and marketing objectives.
  • Understand each partner’s goals and challenges and develop customized marketing solutions across ESPN Cleveland audio, digital content, social media and live events.
  • Collaborate with ESPN Cleveland’s Digital Marketing Consultants to develop integrated solutions that help partners achieve their business goals.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to uncover additional partnership opportunities across Good Karma Sports and connect partners with the right teammates and solutions.
  • Communicate and collaborate with sales support teammates to effectively manage partner relationships, campaign execution and follow-through.
  • Develop a strong understanding of ESPN Cleveland’s audiences, content and marketing assets and connect those opportunities to partner needs.
  • Proactively manage new business activity, leads, opportunities and partner follow-through through our internal CRM.
  • Stay current on sports marketing, media and emerging industry trends.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve new business outreach, partner research, campaign development, communication and sales effectiveness while maintaining a high level of personalization and partner interaction.
  • Other assigned tasks.
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the company core values: Listen, Be Honest, Follow Through, Teamwork, Work Hard and Over Deliver.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications 

  • Previous sales, business development or marketing experience and a passion for sales and service.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage decision-makers at all levels.
  • Goal-oriented and creative self-starter with a strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Strong network and relationships within the Cleveland business community, or the ability to develop them.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently.
  • Willingness to accept and provide feedback and continuously learn and grow.
  • With this career, you are required to hold a valid driver’s license

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is an exempt role with a competitive base salary plus commission. This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for salary growth based on increased skills and responsibilities and meeting targeted goals. The position will be required to work some evenings and weekends based on station events, promotions, and community activities.


Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 5, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: ESPN Cleveland Spring 2027 Internship
job.description:
ESPN Cleveland Spring 2027 Internship 

(Cleveland, OH) 

Good Karma Sports & ESPN Cleveland are currently recruiting college students for the Spring 2027 Semester. This is a part-time paid internship that will provide an excellent opportunity for students to learn more about sport marketing and media.

The ideal candidate will be an organized self-starter who is interested in hands-on experience in the areas of new business development, promotional event marketing, and sports content creation.

Daily Responsibilities of an Intern: 

  • Take initiative to learn all aspects of the business, ideally becoming competent in marketing execution, the Good Karma Sports partner acquisition process and Good Karma’s content creation strategies and best practices 
  • Assist with event planning, set-up and execution and event breakdown 
  • Engage and interact with local partners and fans during events 
  • Other assigned tasks 
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the Good Karma core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork and Follow Through. 

Hours and Pay 

This internship is approximately 20-30 hours/week from late January to April/May 2027. Interns are paid $11.00 an hour and will gain experience in marketing, sales, and content. 

Opportunity for Growth 

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company. 

How to Apply 

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 29, 2026. All are encouraged to apply. 

About Good Karma Sports 

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all. We foster integrity and respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought. We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Accounts Payable Specialist (Part Time)
job.description:
Graham Media Group October 19, 2026 Accounts Payable Specialist (Part Time) Graham Media Group October 19, 2026

Reports to: VP/Chief Financial Officer

Location: Remote in one of GMG’s markets Detroit, MI; Houston or San Antonio TX; Jacksonville or Orlando, FL.

Description

Graham Media Group is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Payable Specialist to join our centralized team. This role is responsible for managing accounts payable processes for multiple properties, including seven TV stations, Social News Desk, and corporate offices. Reporting directly to the VP/CFO, the ideal candidate will ensure timely and accurate payables processing while identifying opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.

Responsibilities

  • Vendor Management: Create and maintain vendor files, including foreign vendors.

  • Invoice Processing: Assemble, review, verify, code, and submit invoices for approval. Resolve discrepancies and issues promptly.

  • Purchase Card Management: Ensure charges are properly approved, coded, and supported by receipts.

  • Credit Card Assistance: Support credit card processing and reconciliation.

  • Communication: Address payables discrepancies with Finance Directors and Department Heads.

  • General Ledger Transactions: Post transactions and assist with month-end close accruals.

  • Expense Analysis: Analyze expenses to identify cost-saving opportunities across the group.

  • Audit Support: Prepare supporting documentation for audits and maintain accurate historical records.

  • Process Improvements: Review and enhance standard operating procedures, integrations, and workflows for greater efficiency.

  • Special Projects: Contribute to key initiatives as assigned by leadership.

  • Year-End Procedures: Prepare and issue 1099s.

  • Back up Accounts Receivable functions as needed.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in accounts payable or a similar role.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word.

  • Familiarity with Oracle is highly desirable.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Exceptional organizational and problem-solving abilities.

  • High attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

  • Capacity to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Business, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in media or related industries is a plus.

Contact: Kim Parker, VP/Chief Financial Officer

kparker@grahammedia.com

Additional Information

Graham Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition to complying with the requirements of federal law, GMG will comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination. Any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening, investigative background check, employment/education verifications and reference checks.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

Job Summary/Description:

WSAZ, a media organization, is searching for an Accounting Clerk to perform administrative, clerical, and accounting duties for executive management. The Accounting Clerk will work with the executive team and corporate accounting to ensure proper communication and timely workflow.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Perform light accounting, support office financial activities, and provide clerical/administrative support
- Responsible for administering station accounting duties as prescribed by Shared Services, including accounts receivable/credit and collections, daily traffic log reconciliations, and processing vendor invoices through the company’s accounts payable system
- Responsible for coordinating all station programming schedules and formats with Corporate Programming, HUB Traffic, Nielsen, Comscore, and the station Sales, News, and Master Control operations
- Manage station reporting records on the FCC website and complete annual FCC filings
- Ensure compliance with FCC regulations and applicable governmental agencies
- Assist with planning and execution of station events
- Work closely with corporate Accounting Manager and Program Manager
- Serve as backup to the Office Manager

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Minimum 3+ years of accounting or administrative experience.
- Basic knowledge of accounting concepts and principles
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including strong Excel skills
- A college degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field and broadcast experience are a plus.
- Dependable and able to meet deadlines
- Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills
- Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities
- Proven ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and confidentiality

About KBTX:

KBTX Media operates the CBS and CW affiliates in Bryan-College Station, Texas, serving an 18-county area known as the Brazos Valley. For nearly 70 years, we’ve been the dominant choice for local news and entertainment. Our team produces nearly 40 hours of broadcast content each week, along with a constant presence online at KBTX.com.
KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA, and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. The station has won four consecutive Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service awards, and in 2023 won a National Edward R. Murrow Award for Digital content. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year.

The station has launched the careers of many well-known journalists, meteorologists, and network executives, and takes pride in helping talent grow quickly into the nation’s largest television markets. The work family of KBTX is made up of a group of dedicated, professional, and passionate individuals who are the backbone of our daily mission.

Bryan-College Station, Texas, is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small-town feeling, but offer big-city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system, and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as leaders in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.

College Station is home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.
Learn more about KBTX at www.kbtx.com.

Job Summary/Description:

This role involves working closely with our sales team and department heads, as well as serving as the primary point of contact for viewers and clients visiting or calling the television station.

• Answering incoming calls and warmly greeting station guests
• Collaborating effectively with managers, coworkers, and clients to deliver exceptional service

• Providing administrative support to managers and account executives
• Assisting with accounting tasks and supporting the office manager as needed
• Creating quarterly station newsletters
• Performing other support duties as required

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Previous clerical experience in an office setting
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Strong data entry skills
• Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and adapt to new tasks
• Customer service experience with excellent interpersonal communication skills
• Exceptional attention to detail, time management, and organizational abilities
• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
• Capable of working independently while also contributing to a team
• Dependable, punctual, and maintains a professional appearance

job.title: ASSISTANT NEWS DIRECTOR - WBKO
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WBKO:

WBKO is home to award-winning journalism in the heart of south-central Kentucky between Louisville and Nashville. WBKO is the dominant source for local news and entertainment in the Bowling Green area and operates the ABC, FOX, Telemundo, Heroes & Icons, and CW affiliates. We are proud to serve our community and nurture our employees to grow professionally in an encouraging environment. Bowling Green is the third largest and fastest-growing city in Kentucky and is “geared for fun” as the home of the Corvette, the Bowling Green Hot Rods baseball team, an active arts scene, countless caves, and hiking trails ready to be explored!

Job Summary/Description:

WBKO News, South Central Kentucky’s #1 news station, is seeking an experienced, innovative Assistant News Director to help lead daily newsroom operations and drive a winning multi-platform news strategy. This leadership role manages reporter assignments, coordinates breaking news coverage, fills in where needed, coaches and provides feedback to journalists, supports digital publishing, and partners with the News Director on special projects. Ideal candidates are organized, detail-oriented newsroom leaders with experience in broadcast journalism, editorial planning, producing, digital coverage, reporting, and team development.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

* Help lead daily editorial coverage across broadcast, streaming, web, mobile, and social platforms.
* Coach, mentor, and develop producers, anchors, reporters, and newsroom staff.
* Partner with producers to improve rundowns, writing, showcasing, and overall newscast quality.
* Review scripts, rundowns, and digital content for accuracy, fairness, clarity, tone, and audience impact.
* Coordinate breaking news, severe weather, and major-event coverage across all platforms.
* Support the First Alert brand through timely, trusted weather and safety coverage.
* Collaborate with the Digital Content Manager to deliver urgent news quickly and effectively.
* Promote platform-specific storytelling for TV, streaming, digital, mobile, and social audiences.
* Work with newsroom leadership on future planning, audience growth, station priorities, and coverage strategy.
* Maintain high editorial standards while fostering a supportive, accountable, creative newsroom culture.
* Communicate clearly and calmly in fast-paced, high-pressure situations.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Mass Communications, or a related field required.
* At least 3 years of newsroom leadership experience, such as Executive Producer, Managing Editor, or Assistant News Director.
* Strong news judgment, writing, storytelling, journalism ethics, and editorial decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop a diverse team of journalists.
* Knowledge of digital-first content strategy, current social platforms, and multi-platform distribution.
* Familiarity with ENPS or other rundown systems, digital CMS platforms, live production, field workflows, and modern video formats.
* Strong organizational, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to pass an MVR check required

Job Summary/Description:

K8 News is searching for a commanding, trusted, and engaging Chief Meteorologist to lead the K8 Weather Team and serve as the trusted face and voice of our severe weather coverage. As the Chief Meteorologist, you will oversee daily forecasting operations, command prime-time broadcasts, drive digital and social media weather engagement, and lead a team of broadcast meteorologists. The ideal candidate brings at least 5 years of professional broadcast meteorology experience, exceptional severe weather tracking abilities, strong on-air storytelling skills, and proven leadership capability.

- Weather anchor weekday evening and prime-time newscasts with clear, engaging on-air presentations.

- Lead, schedule, and mentor the weather team to maintain consistent editorial and forecasting standards.
- Design dynamic, high-impact weather graphics using The Weather Company's Max system.
- Coordinate with news producers and management to integrate weather coverage into daily broadcasts.
- Execute digital weather strategy across mobile apps, OTT streaming, web, and social platforms.
- Represent the station at community events.
- Maintain active liaison with the National Weather Service and local emergency management agencies.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or a related field.
- Minimum of four years of on-air broadcast meteorology and severe weather forecasting experience.
- AMS Certified Broadcast Meteorologist (CBM) designation or NWA Seal of Approval preferred.
- Proficiency with weather graphics platforms and newsroom systems.
- Advanced competency in Doppler radar, dual-polarization products, and numerical weather prediction models.
- Proven ability to ad-lib and deliver calm, decisive live coverage during breaking severe weather.
- Strong scientific communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into accessible public information.

Located in the state’s largest TV market and capital city, our area features top-tier museums, multiple universities, and the state’s leading medical facilities, including the renowned University of Mississippi Medical Center. - Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator)

  • Comprehensive Medical(Rx), Dental and Vision Coverage
  • Health Savings Account with Company contributions
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Employer-paid life and disability benefits
  • Paid parental leave benefits
  • Adoption and Surrogacy Benefits
  • 401(k) Plan, including matching and profit-sharing contributions
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary benefits, including Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, Accident Insurance, and supplemental life insurance coverage

  • Focus on Caring

Salary/Wage:

$18.00 - $18.50/hr.

Shift and Schedule:

Mon. - Fri. (3:30 am - 1:30 pm) - *or as dictated by news and staffing needs*

Job Type:

Full-Time

_______________________

Career-defining opportunities: From anchoring your own stream to being part of an elite news operation, this is where you grow your brand.
Award-winning culture: Join a team that is consistently recognized for excellence by the Virginia Associated Press Broadcasters.
The Shenandoah Valley: Live and work in one of the most beautiful regions in the country, with a community that truly values local news.
Innovation at the core: At Gray Media, we’re not just keeping up with the future of media—we’re building it.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who actually loves mornings? (Or at least knows how to fake it really well with a strong cup of coffee?) WHSV-TV in the beautiful Shenandoah Valley is looking for a high-energy, digital-first storyteller to join our award-winning "Daybreak" team. As our "New This Morning" Reporter, you won't just be reading the news; you'll be the first voice our viewers hear, setting the tone for their day across TV, social media, and our growing streaming platforms.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Own the morning: Produce and anchor our "New This Morning" segment in our Daybreak newscasts, which air live from 5 a.m. - 7 a.m., delivering the most critical overnight updates with urgency and personality. You should have the ability to break down longer-form national stories into "snackable" segments on "Daybreak."
- Lead the stream: Take the center seat by anchoring your own dedicated streaming morning show, Daybreak+, reaching our audience wherever they are watching.
- Drive digital engagement: Don’t just wait for the 5:00 a.m. hit—engage our followers on social and digital platforms as news breaks overnight.
- Craft compelling stories: Shoot, write, edit, and present content that is conversational, informative, and visually engaging for a multi-platform world. You'll put a story together during the second half of your day that will air the following day for "Daybreak."
- Collaborate with the best: Work side-by-side with our "Daybreak" producer/anchor and meteorologist to ensure our morning coverage is seamless and superior.

job.title: DIGITAL CONTENT CREATOR - WSAW/WEAU
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WSAW/WEAU):

WEAU and WSAW are Gray Media stations committed to connecting with the communities we serve. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the digital future of two established newsrooms simultaneously. You'll have the platform, the resources, and the creative latitude to build something meaningful — and the support of two experienced news teams behind you.

The in-person position will be headquartered at WSAW in Wausau, Wisconsin, which is centrally located. Wausau is 1.5 hours from Eau Claire and Green Bay, a two-hour drive to Madison, three hours from the Twin Cities, and four hours from Chicago.

WSAW/WZAW is the CBS and FOX affiliate for north central Wisconsin. WEAU is the NBC affiliate for western Wisconsin. Both newsrooms are award-winning and community-focused.

Job Summary/Description:

WSAW and WEAU are looking for a driven, digitally savvy journalist and content creator to help us innovate and expand the digital reach of both newsrooms. This is a shared, digital-first position serving the audiences of two of Wisconsin's most trusted local news stations — and it's built for someone who is passionate about creating content that engages audiences on all platforms.

You will function as both a producer and a multimedia journalist, creating content that informs, engages, and grows our audiences. You will produce original content for our digital platforms and social media first, then adapt it for our TV newscasts.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Create original content: Conceptualize, shoot, write, and edit compelling short-form, vertical videos and graphic content specifically designed for WSAW and WEAU’s digital platforms, prioritizing our websites, news and weather apps, and streaming channels.
- Dominate social media: Develop and execute daily content strategies for platforms like YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram, turning local news into shareable, high-impact (and dare we say, viral) stories. Engage authentically and respectfully with those audiences.
- Produce live streams: Identify opportunities with news managers, then plan and execute engaging live streaming events, from breaking news coverage to community spotlights, interacting with our audience in real-time.
- Spot trends: Stay relentlessly curious about emerging digital trends and platform features, being the first to experiment and innovate with new ways to connect.
- Analyze and adapt: Dive into analytics to understand what resonates, using data to inform daily editorial decisions and your next big content idea. Regularly review performance metrics and work with news managers to adjust content strategies accordingly.
- Tell Central & Western Wisconsin's story: Discover and highlight unique local stories, voices, and events that truly matter to our communities, giving them a vibrant digital life.
- Develop a beat system and cultivate sources within the community to generate unique "Only On" stories — timely, impactful reporting that goes beyond the press release.
- Confirm and pursue incoming news tips via email, phone, and social media with strong critical thinking and research skills.
- Write AP-style news stories daily for digital platforms, including weau.com and wsaw.com; publish and update stories as new information develops throughout your shift.
- Plan and build special website sections and features that highlight coverage, link platforms, and encourage user engagement.
- Reformat and optimize news content produced by other team members for maximum reach and engagement across digital platforms.
- Coach and collaborate with reporting staff to maximize the digital presentation of their stories.
- Communicate effectively with producers to incorporate digital elements into newscasts.
- Present content on-camera for delivery in newscasts, live streams, podcasts, and social media videos.
- Work with a sense of immediacy — both independently and as part of a team. That is our culture.
- Ensure factual, grammatical, and legal accuracy across all platforms, upholding the station's established journalistic standards and avoiding editorial bias.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- College degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.
- Previous experience in a professional newsroom environment is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.
- Availability for weekend hours; willingness to work flexible shifts for breaking news, specialized coverage, or covering a colleague's PTO. This position includes Saturday and Sunday hours, and three weekdays.
- A genuine desire to win, the ability to reflect on your work, and a willingness to apply feedback.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with solid knowledge of AP Style *and writing conversationally for Broadcast.
- Ability to edit video in digital formats.
- Proficiency with Photoshop or Canva or comparable software to create and edit graphics.
- Ability to work well under pressure and collaborate effectively with a diverse team.
- Strong understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
- Ability to balance long- and short-term projects while consistently meeting daily deadlines.
- Proven record of digital and social media success; must maintain a responsible and professional social media presence.
- Strong research skills and the ability to employ critical thinking to dig beyond the press release and verify incoming tips.
- Ability to carry 35+ pounds of equipment.
- Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (Motor Vehicle Records check required).

job.title: DIGITAL CONTENT MANAGER - KSFY/KDLT
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 47 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls is one of the fastest growing cities in the Upper Midwest and is home to more than 200,000 people. Healthcare and finance make up much of the workforce in Sioux Falls. There is never a shortage of things to do here. Summers are packed with outdoor festivals and concert events. Many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails; be sure to stop by the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! And winter doesn't mean people hibernate; there are plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. In 2014, the city built a 12,000 seat area that has hosted everything from PBR events, hockey and indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Carrie Underwood and Ed Sheeran. The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, indoor ice skating facility, basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. There is no shortage of places to eat either. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it's also known for many great locally-owned restaurants. And if you want to get away for the weekend, you can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four and the Black Hills in five.

KSFY/KDLT is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a new studio in downtown Sioux Falls as one rebranded organization called Dakota News Now. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 38 hours of news each week. Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It's a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news. People here enjoy the work they do, and everyone steps up to the plate during major news events like breaking news and severe weather.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

Job Summary/Description:

Dakota News Now is seeking a forward-thinking, dynamic Digital Content Manager to lead and oversee our growing digital efforts, managing the production and publication of content across all multimedia platforms. This role is responsible for overseeing audience engagement and CTV growth while ensuring the station remains at the forefront of emerging digital trends, including SEO and social media strategy. As part of our leadership team, the Digital Content Manager will play a key role in ensuring high-quality, timely, and engaging content is delivered to our diverse audience. The ideal candidate will have exceptional writing skills, strong communication abilities, and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Must be able to write and publish news, weather, and sports coverage on all digital platforms
- Strong skills in gathering user-generated content and the creation of enterprise material
- Develop strategies for live and on-demand digital content to expand CTV and streaming efforts
- Oversee a team of digital content producers and ensure they are trained, supported, and meeting production goals
- Work closely with reporters, producers, and other newsroom members to identify breaking news stories, trends, and features that can be developed for digital distribution
- Collaborate with the digital team and other newsroom managers to strategize and implement engaging content plans, including illustrating weekly successes and failures using digital analytics tools
- Monitor analytics to track engagement, optimize video and story placement, and increase overall digital consumption
- Drive CTV adoption and engagement by collaborating with news and marketing teams to create and promote exclusive CTV content on platforms like Roku, Amazon Fire TV, and Apple TV
- Lead efforts to increase social referrals by developing engaging, shareable content that drives users back to Dakota News Now’s owned platforms
- Monitor algorithm changes on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok to adjust posting strategies accordingly
- Monitor and integrate AI-driven tools for content creation, audience engagement, and newsroom automation
- Stay ahead of AI trends in digital media to explore innovative ways to improve content delivery
- HTML, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite experience are preferred, as well as knowledge of ENPS

- Manage content flow, prioritize stories, and monitor all digital channels to ensure timely publication and coverage
- Collaborate with marketing and promotions teams to align digital strategies with station-wide initiatives
- Maintain schedule for digital team

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Experience developing, creating, and executing content for broadcast, digital, and social is required
- Knowledge of SEO best practices and social media strategies.
- Familiarity with digital publishing tools and content management systems (CMS).
- BS/BA in Journalism/Communications or equivalent background preferred
- Ability to identify, evaluate, and integrate emerging AI technologies
- Knowledge of AI’s role in SEO optimization

KSLA is looking for a forward-thinking, high-energy Digital Content Manager to lead our growing digital operation and oversee the creation and publishing of content across all KSLA multimedia platforms. This role will drive audience engagement and expand CTV/streaming performance, while ensuring the station stays ahead of digital best practices and emerging trends—including SEO and social strategy.

Job Summary/Description:

WFSB is seeking a Social & Streaming Producer who will help WFSB break news, own the social conversation, and create content people actually want to watch. From turning breaking news into scroll-stopping vertical videos to producing YouTube livestreams and streaming shows, this role is built for someone who can move fast, think creatively, and deliver across platforms.

You’ll be part digital content producer, part social video creator, and part streaming show producer. If you’re passionate about YouTube, love breaking news, and want to push local journalism beyond the traditional newscast, we want to hear from you.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You’ll Do:
• Break news everywhere. Write and publish web stories, breaking news updates, push alerts, and social posts. Move fast and be first.
• Own the video. Help produce and post multiple vertical videos daily, more when breaking news demands it. Edit content built for TikTok, Instagram and beyond.
• Think social first. Spot the moments, interviews and stories people need to see now, not hours later.
• Make YouTube a destination. Produce livestreams, create compelling thumbnails and headlines, and find new ways to grow views, watch time and revenue.
• Make shows happen. Book guests, develop topics, build rundowns, and produce live and recorded streaming shows from start to finish.
• Create what’s next. Pitch original social franchises, streaming series and documentary-style projects that go beyond the daily newscast.
• Own the details. Cut video for the web, create graphics and carousels, track performance, and keep content moving across platforms.
• Be a newsroom player. Work with reporters, anchors, producers and managers to turn good journalism into great digital storytelling.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• Strong vertical video editing and news judgment.
• Adobe Premiere skills and the ability to edit quickly under deadline.
• A working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and digital publishing.
• The ability to juggle breaking news, video production and show logistics without losing sight of the story.
• Creativity, initiative and a genuine obsession with what makes people click, watch and share.
• A passion for reinventing how local news reaches its audience.

The bottom line: We’re not looking for someone who just posts the news. We want someone who helps make the news impossible to miss — on social, on YouTube, on WFSB+ and everywhere our audience is watching.

Our mission is to keep our viewers safe and informed while guiding them through the ever-evolving digital world. The Quad Cities area itself is a vibrant hub on the Mississippi River, offering a fantastic quality of life with a lively arts scene, beautiful parks, diverse dining, and a welcoming community spirit. It's a place where you can truly connect, both professionally and personally.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you obsessed with being first? Do you live to break news, connect with communities, and own every screen—from broadcast to livestream to social? We're looking for a dynamic Digital Anchor/Producer who's ready to redefine morning news in the Quad Cities, delivering essential updates with urgency and authenticity wherever our audience is watching. If you're a digital journalist who thrives on innovation and has a passion for local impact, this is your moment to shine.

Digital-first DNA: You naturally think multi-platform and understand how to deliver news across web, streaming, and social.
Thirst for feedback: You actively seek coaching and embrace opportunities to grow, evolve, and sharpen your skills.
Competitive spirit: You want to be first, you push boundaries, and you're driven to beat the competition to deliver updates.
Exceptional on-air presence: You're engaging, authentic, and connect effortlessly with viewers on broadcast and livestream.
Strong news judgment: You know what matters to our audience and can prioritize information effectively, especially during fast-breaking events.

About GDM (Gray Media Group):

Gray’s Digital Technology group builds and operates the products that bring local news, sports, and live programming to audiences across 100+ television stations – on the web, on mobile, and on connected TV platforms. Quality is critical to ensure viewers are focused on journalism, not the technology that delivers it. You will help make sure that what we ship is reliable, accessible, and ready when it counts – election night, severe weather, breaking news.

Job Summary/Description:

The Digital QA Analyst validates the quality, functionality, accessibility, and reliability of digital products across web, mobile, connected TV, APIs, data feeds, and internal systems. You’ll partner closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders to confirm that what we build meets requirements, holds up under real-world use, and is genuinely ready for release. The right person combines strong testing fundamentals, critical thinking, technical curiosity, and a sharp eye for detail to catch problems early and promote quality at every stage of the development lifecycle, not just at the end.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Design, plan, and execute testing activities across web, mobile, connected TV (CTV), APIs, data feeds, and internal platforms to ensure products meet quality and business expectations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to clarify requirements, identify risks, and improve overall product quality.
• Create and maintain test strategies, test cases, regression suites, and documentation while prioritizing testing efforts based on risk, complexity, user impact, and release timelines.
• Identify, document, and validate defects through resolution, providing clear communication on testing status, release readiness, and potential risks.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality trends, supporting efficient QA processes, and helping expand test automation coverage where it provides the greatest value.

Test design and planning:
• Build test strategies, cases, and validation approaches from requirements, Jira tickets, stakeholder input, and product knowledge.
• Partner with Product Owners and developers early in the software lifecycle to surface risks, clarify requirements, and improve testability before development starts.
• Prioritize coverage by risk, complexity, business, and user impact, and release timelines.

Test execution across platforms:
• Run functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing across web, mobile, CTV, and internal platforms.
• Execute cross-browser, cross-device, and mobile testing.
• Test connected-TV apps (Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Android TV) for playback, captions, ad behavior, and live-versus-VOD scenarios.
• Validate APIs, data feeds, AI-generated outputs, JSON/XML payloads, and downstream integrations.

Defect lifecycle:
• Identify defects, usability issues, edge cases, and unexpected behavior.
• Write clear defect reports with reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, and supporting evidence.
• Re-test fixes and confirm resolution before release.

Collaboration and process:
• Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives.
• Work alongside developers to isolate issues and support root-cause analysis.
• Maintain regression suites, test documentation, and repeatable QA processes.
• Validate release readiness and communicate status, risks, and recommendations clearly.

Continuous improvement:
• Track quality trends, recurring defects, and areas of technical debt that affect product
stability.
• Help identify where automated testing would add the most value, and partner with
engineering to grow coverage and efficiency.
• Contribute to initiatives that raise product quality and team effectiveness.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in software quality assurance, digital product testing, or a related field, with hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing, with the ability to identify issues and validate solutions across multiple platforms.
• 3+ years of experience in software QA, digital product testing, or a closely related field.
• Hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong grasp of functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and acceptance testing.
• Ability to turn requirements and user workflows into effective test cases and scenarios.
• Experience validating APIs, structured data, and system integrations.
• Strong defect documentation and the collaboration skills to work across the full SDLC.
• Working understanding of accessibility principles, and willingness to build accessibility checks into everyday testing.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving instincts.
• Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience testing media, broadcast, publishing, CMS, or other content-driven platforms.
• Experience testing connected-TV/OTT apps and validating video playback, closed captions, and ad insertion (SSAI/DAI).
• Experience validating JSON/XML/API responses and integration workflows.
• Basic SQL for validation and troubleshooting.
• Experience testing iOS and Android applications.
• Familiarity with browser developer tools and network inspection.
• Exposure to test automation and an interest in growing automated coverage.
• Accessibility testing against WCAG guidelines.
• Experience supporting release validation and production readiness.

What Success Looks Like:
• Requirements are validated thoroughly before release.
• Critical workflows perform reliably across every supported platform – including playback and ad delivery.
• Defects are identified early and communicated clearly enough to influence product and development decisions.
• Releases ship with predictable quality and few production-impacting issues, which means less rework afterward.
• Test coverage and regression confidence improve over time.
• Stakeholders have clear visibility into QA status, risks, and release readiness.
• Engineering trusts the quality bar on every release.

About GDM (Shreveport):

GDM Shreveport stands as the dominant media force in the local market, delivering unmatched reach, trusted content, and powerful audience engagement across broadcast, digital, streaming, and CTV platforms. Built on a foundation of innovative, award-winning journalism, GDM Shreveport provides access to the most trusted source for breaking news, weather, sports, and community storytelling that connects deeply with viewers and drives meaningful impact.

Through GDM Shreveport, market-leading content is paired with second-to-none advertising solutions designed to help businesses grow. From high-visibility broadcast opportunities and live event sponsorships to advanced digital targeting, extended reach, streaming video, streaming audio, gaming, digital out-of-home, and measurable cross-platform campaigns, we give advertisers the tools to win locally while competing for attention and advertising dollars on a global stage. GDM Shreveport offers the leadership, scale, innovation, and results-driven strategy needed to dominate markets locally, regionally, and globally.

Job Summary/Description:

Digital advertising is the fastest-growing ad segment in Shreveport — and we want you to dominate it. We're looking for a seasoned sales pro or digital agency executive ready to sell the full digital suite (OTT/CTV, display/video, SEM, paid social, SEO, and more) backed by best-in-class, brand-safe, globally capable ad tech — and the market's largest, most dominant local audience platforms.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Own the Fastest-Growing Advertising Segment in Shreveport
• Digital advertising is where the growth is — and we're looking for a driven, consultative sales professional ready to lead the charge. This is your chance to sell best-in-class, brand-safe, globally capable ad tech, backed by the market's largest, most dominant local audience platforms.
• If you're a seasoned seller or digital agency executive who thrives on winning new business, building real client partnerships, and getting paid for performance — this is the seat you've been looking for.
________________________________________
The Opportunity:

• We're hiring a seasoned digital advertising seller who thrives in a primarily outbound environment and can consistently deliver against a $600k annual quota. This role is based in Shreveport, Louisiana, with the capability to target and sell globally.
• You will own the full sales cycle — prospecting, discovery, solution design (with internal specialists), proposal, negotiation, and long-term account growth. No limits on your ambition. Just a full digital product suite, expert internal support, and a market ready for you to dominate.
________________________________________
What You'll Do:

• Build and execute a prospecting plan to generate net-new revenue and pipeline (outbound-first)
• Run high-quality discovery to understand business goals, funnel performance, competitive context, and success metrics
• Sell integrated digital advertising solutions, including:
   o OTT / CTV, display/video, YouTube, paid social, retargeting, SEO / local search, paid search / SEM
   o Website/landing page strategy, analytics/measurement, conversion optimization
   o Audience strategy, creative approach, and performance reporting
• Develop multi-product proposals tied to real business outcomes — leads, sales, ROAS, CAC/LTV, foot traffic, brand lift, and more
• Partner with internal teams (digital strategists, ad ops, creative, analytics) to scope, launch, optimize, and retain accounts
• Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, pipeline coverage, and forecast calls
• Expand accounts through performance reviews, upsells, cross-sells, and renewals
________________________________________
What Success Looks Like

In the First 30–60 Days:
• Master Gray Digital Media's offerings, pricing/packaging, and process
• Establish weekly outbound habits and a target account list
• Build a qualified pipeline plan aligned to quota pacing

By 90 Days:
• Consistent meeting creation from outbound efforts + referrals
• Active opportunities with clear next steps, stakeholders, and timelines
• Strong internal collaboration and clean CRM execution
• Closing business, building toward the annual $600k goal

Within 6–12 Months:
• Sustained performance against a $600k annual quota
• High client retention and measurable campaign outcomes
• Predictable pipeline generation and forecast accuracy
________________________________________
Why This Role, Why Now:
• Uncapped earning potential — $100K+ at plan, with a base salary plus commission structure that rewards real performance
• Sell the full suite — no piecemeal products; you'll bring true, integrated digital solutions to the table
• Best-in-class technology — brand-safe, globally capable platforms trusted by the top advertisers and agencies in the world
• Dominant local audience reach — paired with the scale and content authority that only a market leader can offer
• Room to build — a genuine ground-floor opportunity to shape Shreveport's fastest-growing ad category
________________________________________

Qualifications/Requirements:

Who We're Looking For:

• A consultative, quota-carrying seller with a track record of new business development — digital advertising or agency sales background strongly preferred; other outbound sales backgrounds (B2B, SaaS, tech, or solutions sales) also welcome
• Comfortable in an outbound-first environment, with the discipline to prospect relentlessly and the polish to close
• Experience selling or managing SEM, paid social, programmatic/OTT/CTV, display/video, or SEO solutions
• A strong communicator who can translate marketing performance data into a compelling business case
• Highly organized, CRM-disciplined, and forecast-accurate
• Digital agency executives looking to move client-side are encouraged to apply
________________________________________
Ready to Set the Course?
If you're ready to lead in a category built for growth — with the tools, technology, and audience to back you up — we want to hear from you.
Apply today and help us define what digital success looks like in Shreveport.

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. KALB-TV is the No. 1 television station in the region of Central Louisiana. Our market comprises four primary parishes (counties), including Rapides, Avoyelles, Vernon, and Grant. KALB-TV includes the traditional NBC (News Channel 5) that has dominated the market for nearly 60 years, CBS-2, and the CW Cenla - Cenla, by the way, is short for Central Louisiana. Our team is comprised of several veterans who have worked in this market for many years, as well as those first entering the business. We are proud of our track record of talent that has gone on to larger markets, especially those who have stayed in Gray Media.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KPHO/KTVK:

Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you a sports visionary who knows that being "first" is only half the battle? Arizona’s Family is looking for a high-energy, contemporary Sports Executive Producer who understands that in today’s world, relevance is everything. We aren't looking for a traditional "TV person" — we need an audience-first, screen-agnostic leader who treats a smartphone screen with the same urgency as a 65-inch 4K TV. You’ll be the architect of a sports brand that Arizonans can’t live without, leveraging powerhouse pro partnerships while hosting your own daily streaming show. If you’re ready to lead the conversation—and be the face of it—on every platform that matters, let’s get to work.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):

What You'll Do:
• Lead the sports narrative: Oversee the creation, planning, and daily delivery of live and multi-platform sports content that feels urgent, essential, and tailored for wherever the audience is watching.
• Host your own show: Step in front of the camera as the host of our daily sports streaming show, driving high-energy segments that bridge the gap between traditional broadcast and digital-first fans.
• Own the digital space: Collaborate daily with our digital team to ensure our sports coverage isn't just "on" social media, but actively driving the conversation and engagement there.
• Leverage pro partnerships: Maximize our exclusive access and partnerships with professional teams to deliver content and "inside-the-huddle" access our competitors simply can’t match.
• Champion youth athletes: Develop a strategy to highlight local high school and youth sports, making Arizona’s Family the undisputed home for the stories that matter to local families.
• Inspire and coach: Lead a team of producers, reporters, and anchors with a focus on "buy-in," providing consistent feedback and monthly reviews to keep the storytelling bar high.
• Evolve the content: Analyze the totality of our news blocks to ensure stories evolve across platforms and repetition is eliminated—keeping our audience engaged from the first whistle to the final buzzer.
• Drive breaking news: Be the aggressive voice in the room when sports news breaks, ensuring we are the most accurate and fastest source across all digital and broadcast platforms.

What You Bring:
• Screen-agnostic leadership: You don't care which screen the audience uses, as long as they are watching us. You understand how to pivot content seamlessly between social, streaming, and broadcast.
• On-air charisma: You’re a natural communicator who is comfortable hosting a daily show, bringing personality and expertise to a digital-first audience.
• Visionary mindset: You don’t just manage a schedule; you inspire a team to pursue impactful, balanced, and highly promotable stories that cut through the noise.
• Killer news judgment: You know what’s a "must-see" and what’s just filler, and you have the script-approval chops to ensure every word counts.
• Strategic thinking: You’re focused on improving the product and raising ratings while smartly managing resources and overtime.
• Creative spark: You’re constantly mining social media and viewer submissions for the next great story idea or viral moment.
• Relentless energy: You thrive in the fast-paced world of sports and are ready to jump into the weekend on-call rotation to own the big moments.
• Collaborative spirit: You work seamlessly with the News Director, Digital Director, and Managing Editor to implement winning, multi-platform strategies.

Why You'll Love It Here:
• Unrivaled access: You’ll be working with some of the biggest names and teams in professional sports in a top-tier market.
• A platform of your own: Not many EP roles come with a daily hosting gig—this is your chance to build your personal brand alongside a powerhouse media company.
• Community connection: You’ll have the platform to celebrate local kids and athletes, making a real impact on Arizona families every single day.
• Innovation-first culture: We aren't afraid to try new things—if you have a bold idea for a digital sports show or a social campaign, this is the place to launch it.
• A winning team: Join a group of passionate journalists who are as competitive about great storytelling as the athletes they cover.

Ready to lead the best sports team in the Valley and host the show everyone is talking about? Let’s create something extraordinary together.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor's in Journalism
• Experience: 5 years of experience as an Executive Producer or Senior Producer in television news

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WSAW:

WSAW is Wausau's first TV station, debuting 71 years ago in 1954. Together, WSAW/WZAW produce more than 30 hours of news each week. We work hard and celebrate our wins. In 2026, the news team was recognized as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association “News Operation of the Year” and also small market “Station of the Year” (for coverage airing in 2025). Also in 2026, WSAW’s podcast— Forgotten: Wisconsin Cold Cases—was honored with a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award for the second-straight year.

The Training Program:     

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job; you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award-winning team from day one. The intern rate of pay can range from your state's minimum wage to $15.00/hr.          

General Responsibilities:

Duties include editing video for newscasts and writing for our TV newscasts and digital platforms, including wsaw.com and our social media platforms. Successful interns have also learned how to produce newscasts and report as an MMJ.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online).
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen- think social media, streaming apps, and web stories because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook. 
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies.
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 117 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand. 
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift. 
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule. 
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.

Our viewers and customers are extremely friendly and down-to-earth. Although we're not a major metropolitan region, the WSAZ market enjoys relatively close proximity to many large eastern cities and is easily accessible by interstate, rail, river, and air.

We enjoy all four seasons and the activities that come with each. Nature is always a short distance away, with many surrounding state parks and lakes for recreation. Within the larger towns and cities, there is a vibrant nightlife with many outstanding restaurants and local festivals throughout the year.

Since 1949, WSAZ has been the overwhelming number-one choice for Breaking News, Severe Weather coverage, and information in western West Virginia, eastern Kentucky, and southern Ohio. Generations of residents have grown up counting on WSAZ to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. Our people, on-air and behind the scenes, are trusted friends and neighbors in the community. There is a culture within our walls that recognizes the responsibility we carry, to continue what was started more than sixty years ago. We take pride
in our ratings, our content, our status, and the need to maintain the work ethic that got us to where we are.

Arizona’s Family is looking for an aggressive, experienced Investigative Reporter who doesn't just wait for stories to break — you break them. If you’re ready to own the big story and make a real impact in the Valley, let’s talk.

• Solid work ethic: You’re the first one in and the last one out when a story is breaking—you thrive on the grind.
• Relatability: You have a knack for taking complex investigations and making them matter to the person sitting in traffic on the I-10.

• A team of pros: Work alongside some of the best journalists in the business who are just as passionate about the truth as you are.
• The Gray Media advantage: Be part of a company that values local news and invests in the future of multi-platform storytelling.

Ready to uncover the next big story in Arizona? Let’s create something amazing together.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Proven investigative skills, including developing sources and accessing open records

Job Summary/Description:

The IT/Broadcast Engineer supports the reliability, security, and performance of both broadcast/production systems and core IT infrastructure. This role partners with other teams to keep on-air, streaming, and facility technology running smoothly, including studio control rooms, RF/transport, NRCS/automation, editing systems, and networked IT services.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but not limited to):

- Maintain and troubleshoot broadcast plant systems, including master control, studio/control room, routing/switching, intercom, audio, and monitoring.
- Support news and production workflows (NRCS, newsroom editing, media asset management, ingest/playout, automation).
- Administer and troubleshoot IP networks supporting broadcast systems (switching, VLANs, QoS, multicast, PTP, where applicable).
- Provide support for IT systems: Windows endpoints, basic server services, authentication, backups, patching, and endpoint security.
- Manage vendor relationships, service tickets, preventative maintenance, and documentation (rack diagrams, signal flows, IP schemas).
- Participate in engineering projects: equipment installs, upgrades, cutovers, and testing; develop operating and recovery procedures.
- Maintain facility and work with 3rd parties to keep building systems operational.
- Ensure compliance with engineering, security, and safety standards; support after-hours as required.
- Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- 3+ years (or equivalent) supporting broadcast engineering, production technology, or IT/network environments (station, live events, or media facility).
- Hands-on troubleshooting skills with both baseband and IP-based systems.
- Working knowledge of Windows administration and endpoint support.
- Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing concepts).
- Ability to work calmly under deadline pressure and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams.
- Ability to understand GPIO interfaces, both physical and digital.
- Valid driver’s license; ability to lift/handle equipment as required.

Job Description/Summary:

Hawaii News Now is looking for a highly organized, creative, and experienced Lifestyle Producer to join our Emmy Award-winning team. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves video storytelling, and is exceptionally good at keeping a lot of moving pieces moving in the right direction. The Lifestyle Producer will help produce some of Hawaii News Now’s most dynamic lifestyle programming, including HI Now Daily, Kitchen Scraps, station specials, and special projects.

The salary range for this position is $26.00- $36.00/hr. (depending on experience)

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but are not limited to) the following:

Core Responsibilities:
• Produce daily lifestyle show, segments, and station specials from concept through execution
• Manage multiple stories, shoots, guests, deadlines, and production details simultaneously
• Write, edit, and build compelling multiplatform content
• Coordinate guests, hosts, videographers, editors and other production team members
• Create and maintain rundowns, production schedules and show materials
• Anticipate production needs and solve problems before they impact the show
• Communicate clearly with the Executive Producer, production team and other departments
• Help keep projects organized, on schedule, and moving forward
• Work collaboratively with Sales and other departments when producing sponsored and client-driven content
• Maintain high editorial and production standards across every project
• Step into changing situations quickly and remain composed when plans shift
• Be willing to jump into whatever role the production needs, including floor directing, assisting with studio and field production, coordinating talent and guests,
troubleshooting or supporting teammates
• Contribute ideas and look for creative ways to make our shows and specials better

Qualifications/Requirements:

Our ideal candidate is a strong producer and natural organizer who works well with a team, communicates clearly, stays calm under pressure, and takes ownership from planning through execution. Just as important, we are looking for a true team player who is willing to jump in and play whatever role is needed to get the show on the air and make the product great.

What We Are Looking For:
• Previous television or video producing experience
• Exceptional organizational and time management skills
• Strong writing, storytelling, and production skills
• Ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines without losing attention to detail
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Someone who takes initiative, follows through, and can be counted on
• Excellent judgment and problem-solving skills
• Ability to perform well under pressure in a deadline-driven environment
• A positive, team-focused approach and a willingness to pitch in wherever needed
• Experience with ENPS preferred
• Experience producing studio, field, or lifestyle programming is a plus

Success in This Role:

• Success means being someone the team can rely on.
• You are organized and prepared. You know what needs to happen next and help make sure it happens. You communicate early, keep track of details and stay calm when the day changes unexpectedly.
• You are equally comfortable developing a great segment, building a rundown, coordinating a complicated shoot, floor directing a show, or jumping in to solve a last-minute production challenge.
• You understand that great television is a team effort and that sometimes the most important thing you can do is simply recognize what needs to be done and do it.
