About TECH:

If you've ever wanted to work at the heart of one of the most exciting media markets in the country — welcome to Atlanta.

Gray Media's Centralcast Hub is located in the energy-filled core of Midtown Atlanta, one of the most dynamic and fast-growing urban centers in the United States. From our hub, we operate approximately 30 broadcast streams, making this one of the most active and impactful centralized broadcast operations in the nation. Every day, the work done here reaches communities across the country — and you'll feel that purpose in everything we do.

Atlanta isn't just a great place to work — it's a world-class city to call home. Known as a global hub for media, entertainment, and technology, Atlanta is home to some of the biggest names in the broadcast news, cable, and film production industries. A booming film and television production scene has earned the city the well-deserved nickname "Hollywood of the South." If media is your passion, there is truly no better city to grow your career.

Beyond the industry, Atlanta offers a lifestyle that is hard to beat:

* A vibrant, walkable Midtown packed with urban parks, world-class restaurants, live music venues, and cultural attractions
* A thriving university community, with several major research universities calling Atlanta home — keeping the city young, innovative, and forward-thinking
* A booming economy where creatives, entrepreneurs, and the world's biggest brands intersect and inspire one another every single day
* A mild Southern climate with four seasons — and summers made for rooftop patios and baseball games

At Gray Media, we believe in building teams that are as passionate about their craft as they are about each other. This is a place where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your contributions make a real and measurable difference — not just within our walls, but in the communities we serve every day.

Job Summary/Description:

The Master Control Live Pivot Operator is responsible for the technical execution and quality control of live sporting events and local programming broadcasts. This role ensures the seamless delivery of high-profile, live events—including football, baseball, basketball, and more.

This position requires a high degree of scheduling flexibility to match the dynamic nature of live sports broadcasting. The operator will adjust their weekly schedule (including early mornings and late nights) to support peak live event days and will provide critical vacation and shift coverage across first, second, and third shifts.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Live Event & Master Control Operations - Monitor transmitter signals, audio/video levels, and program feeds to ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company quality standards.
* Execute flawless switching, insertion of commercial spots, promos, and emergency alert systems (EAS). Maintain a detailed and accurate master control log of all on-air activities, discrepancies, and live timing adjustments.
* Scheduling Flexibility & Shift Coverage: Adapt weekly schedules to accommodate heavy sports broadcast days (varying from early morning setups to late-night sign-offs). Act as primary vacation relief for staff members, stepping in to cover staff shortages across various shifts. Must be comfortable working non-traditional hours, primarily second shift, with occasional first or third shift coverage.
* Content Ingesting & Media Management: Receive training in and execute the ingestion of digital content into the automation system. Manage promos, program segmentation, and live records. Verify the quality and metadata accuracy of all ingested video files and programming elements before broadcast.
* Additional Duties — Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned, adapting to the evolving operational needs of the Centralcast Hub.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* At least 2- 3 years of experience in a high-volume Live Master Control setting/environment is required.
* Knowledge of Morpheus and Crispin automation systems is a strong plus.
* Scheduling: Ability and absolute willingness to work a highly flexible weekly schedule including various shifts (first, second, or third, holidays, weekends, early mornings, and late nights) is a must.
* Adaptability & Drive: Quick Learner with the ability to acquire new technical skills (including promos, program, and live record segmentation).

• Own the Twin Cities market: Prospect and win new business across the metro area, turning cold leads into long-term digital partners.

• Real impact: You’re helping local Twin Cities businesses grow and thrive in a digital-first world.

Ready to own the Twin Cities and take your career to the next level? Let’s build something big together.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• Relentless energy: You’re a self-motivated pro who gets a rush from closing a deal and building something from scratch.
• Digital fluency: You understand the difference between OTT and SEO and can explain it to a business owner in a way that makes sense (no jargon allowed).
• Autonomous mindset: You love the freedom of a remote role and have the discipline to manage your own calendar and crush your goals without someone looking over your shoulder.
• Killer communication skills: You’re as comfortable pitching in a boardroom as you are consulting over coffee.

WSAZ covers a wide, diverse area comprised of three states. Many small towns sit along the Ohio River and smaller rivers and streams that run through rolling hills. Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who sees a storm on the horizon and immediately starts thinking about how to explain the "why" and "when" to your neighbors? WHSV is looking for a high-energy Meteorologist to join our award-winning First Alert Weather Team in the beautiful Shenandoah Valley. This isn't just about reading the models; it’s about owning the weather narrative across every platform—from our weekend evening newscasts to the palm of our viewers' hands.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Live the "First Alert" brand: Embody our commitment to being the most trusted, local weather source in the Valley and our West Virginia viewing area with urgency and accuracy. We keep our viewers updated every step of the way, giving them the information they need to plan days in advance.
- Own the weekend evenings: Create and deliver compelling, conversational on-air forecasts for our 6:00 p.m. and 11:00 p.m. newscasts that keep viewers informed and safe.
- Drive digital weather: Don't just wait for the linear hit; engage our audience on social media, our weather app, and streaming platforms throughout the week.
- Tell the weather story: Spend your weekdays digging into weather-related content, whether that’s field reporting on local climate impacts or creating innovative graphics that make complex science simple.
- Collaborate and innovate: Work closely with our news and digital teams to ensure our weather coverage is seamless, multi-platform, and always ahead of the curve.
- Learn from the best: You'll get the chance to receive feedback from our award-winning weather team, which has 20 years of combined experience in the industry.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- A degree in meteorology and a background in broadcast communications/journalism preferred
- Unstoppable motivation: You have a genuine passion for meteorology and a relentless drive to communicate the forecast wherever the audience is.
- A digital-first mindset: You’re as comfortable going live or posting on social media as you are in front of the studio camera.
- Creative storytelling: You don't just show maps; you tell a story that connects the data to people's lives (and you’ve got the ideas to prove it!).
- Independence and teamwork: You can crush a solo shift but also thrive in a collaborative "weather center" environment. You bring a positive attitude to our team's strong work culture.
- Technical chops: You know your way around weather graphics systems and are ready to push the limits of what they can do.
- Urgency and calm: You handle severe weather with the perfect mix of "get-to-the-basement" urgency and "I’ve got this" authority while being able to make decisions quickly.
- Ability to work all shifts (we have newscasts beginning at 5:00 a.m. and going until 11:30 p.m.; must be able to work all those hours/shifts when needed), including during snow and severe weather events.

Ready to join the First Alert Weather Team and make your mark in the Valley? Let’s talk.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina State House.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

 Job Summary/Description:  

WIS News 10 is seeking an energetic, digitally savvy Weekend Meteorologist to join our First Alert Weather team in Columbia, South Carolina. We want a dynamic communicator who pairs strong scientific expertise with a digital-first instinct—someone who commands the screen on linear broadcast and thrives in the fast-paced world of digital, streaming, and social storytelling. If you know how to build loyalty on social, turn complex radar data into compelling video, and step up with calm, decisive authority when severe weather strikes, this role is for you.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Lead Multiplatform Storytelling: Produce and deliver compelling weather content across linear broadcast, OTT/streaming platforms, mobile apps, and social channels—tailoring presentations to engage audiences wherever they consume news.
• Drive Digital Engagement: Create dynamic, native digital weather content (quick-turn social videos, live digital updates, and interactive radar breakdowns) throughout the day to grow audience loyalty and engagement.
• Own the Midlands Forecast: Analyze meteorological data and model guidance to build accurate, actionable forecasts for Columbia and our viewing area across the South Carolina Midlands.
• Command Severe Weather: Track severe events with urgency and calm authority, delivering immediate, life-saving coverage across on-air and digital streams during breaking weather.
• Deliver Digital-Only Shows and Discussions: Weather doesn't stop when the show is over; you will have the opportunity to talk science, do science-related stories, and conduct in-depth interviews on our stream and podcasts.
• Maximize Visual Impact: Design clear, visually arresting graphics using the WSI MAX ecosystem to turn complex meteorological concepts into easy-to-digest visual stories.
• Collaborate Across Newsrooms: Partner closely with the Chief Meteorologist, digital content producers, and newsroom leadership to ensure seamless, multi-platform weather coverage.
• Report from the Field: Deliver live, immersive field reporting that brings the impact of significant weather events directly to our viewers.
• This is a weekend evening position.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Experience: Minimum 2 years of on-air and digital broadcast meteorology experience.
• Digital Fluency: Demonstrated track record of creating engaging video content for digital, OTT, and social platforms (YouTube, TikTok/Reels, Facebook Live, etc.).
• Technical Skills: Hands-on proficiency with WSI MAX
• Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science.
• AMS or CBM/NWA seal preferred.
• High-Pressure Execution: Proven ability to handle live, wall-to-wall severe weather coverage with composure and precision.
• Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work weekends, holidays, and breaking/severe weather shifts as needed.
• Safety: Valid driver’s license with an insurable, clean driving record.

WIS is the #1 local media organization in the capital city market of Columbia, South Carolina. It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. WIS is also the hub for Palmetto Sports & Entertainment, a statewide broadcast sports network, and an affiliate of Telemundo SC.

Serving South Carolina's Midlands since 1953, WIS offers the opportunity to join an award-winning culture for a popular brand built upon decades of market leadership. Named the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year a record 17 times, WIS has earned the Edward R. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina State House.

Our community combines affordable quality of life with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

Job Summary/Description:

Multimedia Journalists (MMJs) are the front line of news gathering at WIS. You will be first on scene for breaking news, pursue stories that reveal the human impact behind the headlines, and build strong relationships across our viewing area. This is a fast-paced, deadline-driven position that requires curiosity, initiative, and the ability to produce compelling journalism across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Respond quickly and professionally to breaking and spot news across the coverage area.
• Produce strong, reporter-driven journalism for television, streaming, web, and social media on a daily basis.
• Shoot high-quality video, write tight scripts, edit (VO, VOSOT, PKG), and deliver broadcast-ready packages under deadline.
• Report live from the field and present stories on-air and for digital livestreams as required.
• Develop and maintain a broad, diverse network of local sources; cultivate relationships that lead to exclusive reporting and community trust.
• Seek out and include diverse perspectives, ensuring coverage reflects the communities we serve.
• Work collaboratively with producers, digital editors, photographers, and managers to plan coverage and maximize story reach across platforms.
• Optimize content for social and digital distribution — craft clipable moments, write engaging social captions, and push timely updates.
• Adhere to newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, and ethical reporting at all times.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 2+ years of professional television reporting/MMJ experience, or equivalent newsroom experience.
• Demonstrated ability to shoot and edit broadcast-quality video and produce polished packages under deadline.
• Proficient with industry-standard cameras, editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, Avid), and live-streaming equipment.
• Strong on-air presence and clear, confident delivery in live situations.
• Excellent writing, storytelling, and interview skills with a reporter’s instinct for the human element.
• Valid driver’s license, dependable transportation, and willingness to work nights, weekends, and holidays as news dictates.

Think local news is still just a 6:00 and 10:00 broadcast? Think again. We are building the future of local storytelling at KSNB Local4, and we need an agile, digital-first journalist ready to command both the field and the screen. You won't just report packages; you will be part of our multi-platform newsroom, stepping directly onto our OTT streaming desk to assist in live coverage, break news in real time, and connect with audiences wherever they watch. job.title: MULTIMEDIA JOURNALIST (W/END) - WTAP
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WTAP:

WTAP is THE main voice in the Mid-Ohio Valley. We may be among the smallest TV stations in America, but we are also one of the most dynamic. With state-of-the-art technology, a terrific on-air look, and a dynamic digital presence. You'll be proud of the work you'll do here. And you'll grow quickly because there is so much opportunity! You'll get to explore whatever you want to do in the communications field, whether it's on-camera, behind-the-scenes, or in sales. WTAP is involved in the communities we cover. From covering high school sports, to participating in local events, to helping small businesses grow and thrive through commercials and mobile products, WTAP does it all. And we do it all - together. The Mid-Ohio Valley includes the communities of Parkersburg, WV, and Marietta, OH, and the 50-mile area surrounding them. It's the kind of place where you can walk down the street and say "hi" to people, and they'll say "hi" right back at you! It's the kind of place where local news-people become like family to the viewers and online readers they serve and communicate with. There are wonderful parks, great hiking and biking areas, high-quality restaurants, and shopping - whether you like a mall or the uniqueness of small stores on Main Street. Our area is big on heritage, and the many fairs and festivals reflect that passion. Marietta College gives its hometown a New England feel. Ohio University and the community of Athens, Ohio, are nearby. The Ohio River is the common thread that runs through everything, and the Blennerhassett State Park, located on an island of the same name very close to Parkersburg, is a historic and beautiful place to get away to on a summer day. There's much to see and do within a couple of hours' drive from our location in Western West Virginia and Southeastern Ohio. Whitewater rafting, snow skiing, and so much more are available in the mountains of West Virginia. The locally situated Mid-Ohio Valley regional airport and airports in Charleston, West Virginia, and Akron, Columbus, and Cleveland, Ohio, give you access to anywhere you want to go. Wherever you may travel, though, our area is proud of its history and heritage with roots in oil and industry, which have helped shape our region into what it is today. WTAP’s commitment to serve the Mid-Ohio Valley, the place that we call home, shows that it doesn’t matter what the market size is… we are here doing what really matters.

Successful candidates will cover news in Parkersburg, WV, Marietta, OH, and the Mid-Ohio Valley. Successful candidates will also have the ability to deliver compelling stories. Must be a self-motivator, able to meet deadlines, have strong verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrate good news judgment and decision-making. We're looking for someone who maintains a positive work environment.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Generating story ideas and building local contacts
- Contribute story ideas in our daily story meetings
- Demonstrate sound news judgment

- Work evenings, weekends and holidays as needed
- Gather information about news through research, interviews, experience, and/or attendance at local event functions
- Follow up on tips that lead to stories
- Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Strong professional social media skills.
- Maintain a professional appearance

job.title: MULTIMEDIA JOURNALIST - KMOV
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, as well as studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KMOV:

We operate a CBS + ABC duopoly in one of America's great news towns. That means more platforms for your work — First Alert 4 newscasts, new ABC 32 newscasts, and all-day streaming.

KMOV is the most watched television/digital news operation in Missouri and Southern Illinois with nationally-recognized and award-winning news, weather, and investigative content found both on-air and online. KMOV won the prestigious national Edward R. Murrow Award for Best Newscast in 2023. Based in suburban St. Louis County, KMOV’s home is a new multi-million-dollar state-of-the-art broadcasting and digital facility. Ranked as the #1 city in the nation in 2022 for new college graduates, St. Louis is now recognized for its low cost of living, convenient transportation, and robust arts and entertainment scene. Home to the world-famous Arch, St. Louis Cardinals baseball, City STL soccer, and Blues hockey, St. Louis is quickly becoming THE place to be.

Job Summary/Description:

We are hiring an MMJ to find the best moments in the St. Louis region.’ This MMJ will identify moments as they are happening and deliver them to the audience first.   If your instinct is to capture the moment that everyone will be talking about — the video, the sound, the development that makes our coverage the original source even when everyone in St. Louis is on the same story — keep reading.  

What Winning Looks Like Here:

In St. Louis, First Alert means something. It's a promise: when it matters, we alert first, we stay out front, and we don't wait for the 5 p.m. show to tell people what happened at 2 p.m.

As our Audience-First MMJ, you will:

• Hunt moments, not soundbites. Lead every story with the most memorable moment from the field — off the top, not buried at :45.
• Be the original source. On the day's biggest story, make our video, our detail, our reporting the one everyone else has to credit. How do you separate when it's 4 cameras on the same scene? Show us.
• Put audience over linear. Yes, your stories will air in our traditional newscasts on First Alert 4 and ABC 32. But first, you think audience: you shoot, you send, you collaborate live with our Digital Content Center to post with urgency — stream it, push it, publish it now.
• Live in the field. You hate sitting around in meetings. So do we — for this role. Your desk is your car. Your assignment is to be out, building, finding, breaking.

What You Do Every Day:

• Enterprise, break, and own hard news and breaking news in the St. Louis market
• Build and work sources aggressively — not just for today, but for the next big one
• Shoot, write, edit compelling, tight, moment-driven stories for broadcast, streaming, and digital
• Go live with confidence and clarity, especially when news is breaking and unscripted
• Communicate constantly with producers and the Digital Content Center: what's happening, what you have, what you need, what's next

You'll be coached, you'll be pushed, and you'll be given room to run if you earn it.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Who Thrives In This Role:

• 3+ years working in a TV newsroom as an MMJ/reporter — and you can prove you're different
• A reel that opens with moments, not standups. We should feel like we were there.
• Aggressive on breaking news, calm under chaos, relentless on follow-ups
• Strong photographer instincts: framing, natural sound, sequencing that tells the story without narration
• Digital-first habits: cut a vertical moment, write an urgent web alert and update it
• Source-builder: cops, courts, community, scanners, social — you have a system
• Team player who collaborates fast with photographers, producers, anchors, and digital producers

What We're Not Looking For:

• Someone who wants to anchor. This is not an anchor track.
• Someone who wants to wait for a 6 p.m. package to show their work.
• Someone who needs a meeting to decide to go after news.

How To Apply – Show Us You're Different

Don't send a generic cover letter. Send us:

1. Resume + link to reel (lead with your 3 best moments, not your 3 best packages)
2. In 150 words or less: Tell us about a time every station had the same story, and yours was different. What was the moment, how did you get it, and how fast did the audience see it?

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls is one of the fastest-growing cities in the Upper Midwest and is home to more than 200,000 people. Healthcare and finance make up much of the workforce in Sioux Falls. There is never a shortage of things to do here. Summers are packed with outdoor festivals and concert events. Many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails; be sure to stop by the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! And winter doesn't mean people hibernate; there are plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. In 2014, the city built a 12,000-seat arena that has hosted everything from PBR events, hockey, and indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Carrie Underwood, and Ed Sheeran. The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, an indoor ice skating facility, a basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. There is no shortage of places to eat, either. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it's also known for many great locally-owned restaurants. And if you want to get away for the weekend, you can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five.

KSFY/KDLT is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a new studio in downtown Sioux Falls as one rebranded organization called Dakota News Now. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 38 hours of news each week. Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It's a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news. People here enjoy the work they do, and everyone steps up to the plate during major news events like breaking news and severe weather.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

• Excellent live reporting skills required, ability to ad-lib during breaking news
• Must be willing to work day shifts and evening shifts, longer hours, and different days as needed
• Travel will also be required

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in journalism or related field
• Experience in on-air television reporting is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate
• Basic experience with newsroom computer systems is preferred (ENPS)
• Understanding of and adherence to AP Style (for digital platforms) and broadcast writing (for television).

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WBBJ:

WBBJ-TV is the local ABC, CBS, and ME TV station for West Tennessee. The Station is the number one source for news, weather, and sports within our coverage area. The Station is an ideal place for journalists to begin their careers, with several of our former employees now working in large markets across the Country.

Job Summary/Description:

7 Eyewitness News is hiring an entry-level Multimedia Journalist and welcomes applications from recent graduates and early career journalists. We are looking for motivated self-starters who are eager to learn, develop strong storytelling skills, and contribute to daily story ideas.

MMJs will shoot, write, edit, and report stories while gaining hands-on experience in breaking news and severe weather coverage.

Please note - primary job duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the information listed above

- A degree in journalism, communications, or a related field is preferred, but we are open to talking with all candidates with a background in Media.

We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. About WCTV:

WCTV is the dominant #1 CBS Affiliate in Tallahassee, with a coverage area of about 19 counties in North Florida and South Georgia. We are a well-established newsroom, where rising talent has an opportunity to learn from and grow with experienced anchors and reporters. The expectations are high in our newsroom. As the leader in the market, our work has never been more important. The right candidate can expect to cover everything from breaking news to severe weather, major political headlines, and heartfelt features.

Job Summary/Description:

WCTV is searching for a Multimedia Journalist to lead coverage of vital city and county government issues for Tallahassee and Leon County. Florida's capital city has so much to offer, including a chance to tell meaningful and impactful stories through the lens of local politics. This role is perfect for someone who works best with beat-based assignments and is a champion for community-focused and solutions journalism. If combing through agendas and public records and finding "real people" stories beyond government excites you, this could be a perfect fit.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Generating story ideas and building local contacts, with a focus on city and county government leaders, community advocates, experts at our local universities, and "real people" impacted by our stories
- Monitoring public meetings, including city commission, county commission, and school board
- Maintaining and organizing spreadsheets to keep track of meetings and follow-up story opportunities
- Earning the respect of sources and peers through professional, informative, and balanced storytelling
- Committing to a high level of integrity and fair reporting on complex and multi-faceted issues
- Shooting, writing, and editing daily content for multiple newscasts and livestreams through our apps, website, and other platforms.
- Compelling live reporting, including breaking news, elections, severe weather, and features
- Ability to shift into breaking news, severe weather, and feature reporting as assigned
- Operating a portable live unit and conducting live shots from the field
- Completing other duties as assigned

Qualifications/Requirements:

- 1+ years as an MMJ in a television newsroom
- Experience accessing, analyzing, and simplifying public records
- BS/BA in journalism or communications
- A valid driver's license and good driving record

Established in 1953, WLFI (News 18) is the premier television station serving the Lafayette-West Lafayette area - DMA Market 189. As a CBS affiliate, it provides comprehensive local news, weather, and sports coverage across West-Central Indiana. The Lafayette-West Lafayette area is a dynamic blend of small-town charm and high-tech innovation. Lafayette serves as the scenic county seat, featuring a vibrant, walkable downtown filled with quaint local shops & eclectic dining. Across the river, West Lafayette is the proud home of Purdue University, part of the BIG 10 Athletic Conference, and nationally ranked in multiple areas. Purdue is also an international hub for research. Overall, the area offers a rich quality of life with over 50 parks, the Columbian Park Zoo, and the Celery Bog Nature Area. With its proximity to Indianapolis and Chicago, it provides a perfect balance of Midwestern hospitality and global influence.

- Must attend and represent the station at community events regularly
- Other job-related duties as required

WTVG is located in Northwestern Ohio. Our viewers and customers are extremely friendly and down-to-earth. We are a region of proud automotive workers home to Stellantis and GM plants. We are extremely passionate about our collegiate sports teams, including The Ohio State University Buckeyes, the University of Michigan Wolverines, the University of Toledo Rockets, and the Bowling Green University Falcons.
We enjoy all four seasons and the activities that come with each. Nature is always a short distance away, with many surrounding parks and Lake Erie for recreation. The roller coaster capital of the world, Cedar Point, is just a short drive from the television station. We have two minor league sports teams. The Toledo Mud Hens have a rich baseball history and loyal following. Not to be outdone are the fans of our hockey team, the Toledo Walleye. We also love our food. There are many outstanding restaurants and local festivals throughout the year.

Since 1948, generations of families have grown up counting on WTVG to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. Our people, on-air and behind the scenes, are trusted friends and neighbors in the community. There is a culture within our walls that recognizes the responsibility we carry to continue what was started seventy years ago. We take pride in our ratings, our content, our status, and the need to maintain the work ethic that got us to where we are.

About KTUU

Alaska's News Source has a reputation of excellence as the state's most-watched news source, producing 32 hours of broadcast news, weather, and sports content each week on KTUU-TV/Channel 2 and KYES/Channel 5 in Anchorage as well as KATH and KYEX in Southeast Alaska and KTVF and KXDF in Fairbanks. Strong reach and brand loyalty are augmented by added broadcast distribution to more than 200 rural communities throughout the state via ARCS-TV, Alaska's rural communications service. A leader in digital content, AlaskasNewSource.com offers breaking news and statewide community coverage. Our News and Weather Apps, podcasts, and streamed content offered through Connected TV platforms reach audiences far beyond broadcast. Our mission is "To Tell Alaska's Story," and we strive to consistently distinguish ourselves as Alaska's preferred source for news, information, and community service.

Job Summary/Description:

Alaska's News Source is looking for a versatile, news-driven journalist who is equally at home in the field, stacking/writing/creating newscasts and producing breaking news in the control room. As an MMJ/ Producer, you'll spend two days a week leading our newscasts as a producer and three days each week reporting in the field — gathering, shooting, and reporting/delivering stories that matter to and impact Alaskans. This is not a role for someone who wants to do one thing. It's a role for someone who loves all of it! The MMJ/Producer schedule is 2:30 p.m.-10:30 p.m. Wed-Sun.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but not be limited to):

Producing (Two Days A Week):
- Produce 2 newscasts per day with strong story selection, compelling teases, and clean show flow
- Make real-time editorial decisions during breaking news situations with minimal supervision
- Collaborate with anchors, meteorologists, and directors to deliver a polished, audience-first broadcast
- Write and edit copy, teases, and anchor reads under deadline pressure
- Write and post copy daily on all digital platforms as new information is learned and throughout your assigned shift. This includes copy for web, social media, our news app, our digital desk/CTV, and within our television newscasts on broadcast.

MMJ/Reporting (Three Days a Week):
- Research, pitch, shoot, write, edit, and present original news packages and live reports
- Gather content with a multi-platform mindset — thinking about what works on social and digital, not just on air
- File social content including vertical videos from the field in real time when news warrants it
- Develop and maintain sources across the state of Alaska
- Contribute story ideas that serve our broadcast and digital audiences

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Experience in both broadcast producing and MMJ reporting
- Strong editorial judgment, especially in breaking news situations
- Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines simultaneously
- A digital-aware mindset: you think about your audience on every platform, not just the one watching at 6:00 pm
- Excellent writing skills, tight, active, conversational broadcast copy
- Self-motivated and dependable; weekends require someone who leads without being managed
- Must have a desire to win, a positive attitude, and the ability to reflect on your work and apply feedback
- Ability to work a combination of dayside and nightside shifts, as well as overtime when warranted for breaking news or special coverage
- Valid driver's license and ability to drive a company vehicle
- A journalism-related degree (or similar) is preferred
- Must be able to carry 35+ pounds of gear and be experienced in shooting and editing unique content. We have photographers and editors to partner with on select assignments.

This role is built for a journalist who thinks in multiple platforms, someone who can deliver a broadcast package, produce a 60-second vertical explainer, and anchor a streaming update all in the same shift. If you believe local news should meet audiences where they are on broadcast, on streaming, and on social, this role is for you.

• Anchor weekend evening newscasts with a focus on local impact, utility, and community connection, delivering content that earns trust with audiences across all age groups.

Are you a natural storyteller who lights up when the “On Air” sign glows? KALB, the dominant news leader in Alexandria, Louisiana, is looking for an Evening Anchor/MMJ who’s passionate about storytelling and thrives in a digital-first newsroom. We aren’t just looking for a “reader” — we want a journalist who can lead, innovate, and connect with our audience across Central Louisiana on every platform.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You’ll Do:
- Anchor live newscasts, breaking news, and special coverage with clear, accurate delivery

- The experience: At least two years of professional newsroom and on-air experience.

- Digital fluency: You embrace the modern newsroom toolkit to connect with audiences across all platforms.
- Technical chops: Knowledge of ENPS and Edius is a major plus.
- Communication skills: You’re effective with sources, viewers, and teammates in the newsroom.
- Leadership mindset: You’re a team player who can lead a broadcast and elevate those around you.
- The essentials: Valid driver’s license and a good driving record.

Why You’ll Love It Here:
- Market dominance: Work at the #1 station in the market, with the resources and reach to make a real impact.
- Creative freedom: Your voice and ideas matter—you’ll have a seat at the table in shaping coverage.
- Digital innovation: We’re a digital-first newsroom that encourages you to experiment and grow your personal brand across platforms.
- Community connection: Central Louisiana is a place where local news truly matters, and you’ll be at the heart of it every day.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- College degree in journalism, communications, or a related field
- Must thrive as part of a team and collaborate effectively with others
- Strong anchoring, communication, and writing skills with the ability to craft engaging content across platforms
- Must meet daily news deadlines and work well under pressure during breaking news and severe weather events
- Understanding of and adherence to journalism ethics and using AP Style
- Knowledge of ENPS and Edius is a plus

WYMT is the CBS Affiliate and dominates as the number-one station in the scenic Appalachian Mountains of Southeastern Kentucky. This regional station is located in the small town of Hazard and has three bureaus and serves more than 25 counties. WYMT provides award-winning local news, weather, and sports coverage. WYMT.com is the region's most powerful digital platform. WYMT is involved and dedicated to the local communities we serve, participating in numerous charities and causes. A second channel, Heroes & Icons (H&I), allows WYMT to offer even more local programming, including dozens of live high school and college football and basketball games each year.

Job Summary/Description:

KGMB (CBS), KHNL (NBC), and K5 are seeking a Producer. Hawaii News Now is the state's dominant multimedia news organization. This person must be able to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment. The successful candidate must be a self-starter with good organizational skills and must be able to deliver energetic newscasts and engaging stories on all platforms under tight, pressure-packed deadlines. This includes a leading presence on Facebook, Twitter, hawaiinewsnow.com, as well as Instagram.

Duties/Responsibilities (but not limited to) the following:

- The successful candidate will also produce a variety of newscasts.
- We are looking for candidates with experience as a line producer in a competitive news market, including working with anchors, LIVE reporters, and directors.
- Candidates must be a great writer and communicator and should have natural leadership skills.
- Candidates must be able to sift through complicated issues and provide clarity to viewers and web users.
- Newscasts are fast-paced, “Happening Now” newscasts, filled with LIVE reports and breaking news from anywhere.
- Adjusting to situations is key, and thinking uniquely about breaking events will continue to move this newscast forward.
- Multitasking is key as you will be juggling many things at once. The successful candidate will be required to post stories to the station website and all social media platforms.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Experience with ENPS and Edius editing is a plus.
- Experience producing special reports and breaking news will put a candidate ahead of others.
- College degree in journalism or related experience is required.
- Must be able to work extra hours, holidays, etc.
- Must have a valid driver's license.

We are committed to the highest standards of excellence in our local news, entertainment, information, and public service programming.

We have the top-rated news station plus broadcast website. We are a Midsize market with opportunity to grow. We are a self-starting team driven for success with unique selling opportunities for a creative seller. Essential to that effort is a foundation of honesty and integrity — qualities which help us earn and build trust with our viewers, co-workers, and business partners.

Job Description/Summary:

WNEM, a Gray Local Media I station, is recruiting for a Producer. This person creates, coordinates, and writes content on a variety of platforms, including broadcast, web, digital, and social media. The Producer displays creativity, aggressiveness, attention to detail, resourcefulness, and team spirit in the pursuit of excellent content for newscasts, online, and social platforms. The Producer assists with the daily flow of news to the newsroom for appropriate coverage both on-air and on the station’s
digital platforms. This person gathers meaningful news information from various sources, generates story ideas, and checks out credible news tips. Successful candidates will have solid news judgment, a sound grasp of broadcast and online journalism, and a sense of urgency for breaking news.

- Previews news material before airing and/or posting to the web.
- Prepares possible interview segments.
- Coordinates breaking news and executes newscast in the control room.
- Contributes content to web and multimedia efforts.
- Monitors news sources and social media to ensure news is being appropriately covered.
- Discerning news tips, gathering information, distributing that information to the newsroom, setting up interviews, and answering phones.
- Conceptualizes innovative graphic and pre-production elements.
- Monitors and works to improve the look and execution of newscasts constantly.

NO PHONE CALLS, PLEASE

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent training and/or experience.
- At least two years working in broadcast media and Social Media.
- Experience using a content management system (CMS) is a plus.
- Strong editorial skills and working knowledge of AP and Broadcast Style also preferred.

Leadership is about more than being the most popular. Come see how we're embracing our responsibilities to promote prosperity in the Wiregrass for all. Experience the energy of Dothan's impressive economic growth, while still enjoying a very comfortable cost of living.

Job Summary/Description:

WTVY is looking for a Newscast/Digital Producer to join our news team.  You’ll be responsible for creating, writing, and producing one or more of our daily broadcasts and digital content. The ideal candidate will be passionate about storytelling, demonstrate a grasp of local, regional, national, and international news, and be a professional who thrives under deadline pressure. Salary is based on experience.

- Producing one or more daily news broadcasts and digital content, including writing, editing, and making editorial decisions about the content in each broadcast.
- Collaborating with anchors, multimedia journalists (MMJ’s), technical media producers (TMP’s), digital producers, and newsroom leadership to create compelling broadcasts and digital content.

- Understanding station and corporate-provided research to contribute to daily story assignments, live elements and digital content in each broadcast.
- Monitoring newswires, social media and email for story ideas and updates.
- Assist in copy editing with special attention to journalistic standards, ethical decision-making and legal guidelines.
- Working flexible shifts.
- Perform other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, or a related field is preferred, but we will consider and fast-learner with strong writing skills without formal training for our industry.
- Demonstrate visual storytelling experience. (Can include traditional broadcast and/or digital and/or social media examples.)
- Demonstrate knowledge of local, regional, national, and international current events.
- Current driver’s license with a clean driving record is a must.
- Knowledge and experience with standard workplace software including Microsoft applications for email and word processing; previous experience with ENPS, EDIUS, VizRT, Flowics and BitCentral newsroom systems is preferred.
- Please include a portfolio link or video link if you have previous producing experience.

The Paid Search Specialist manages and optimizes high-volume paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Facebook/Meta, YouTube, and key SaaS/managed-service platforms. KMOV is the most watched television/digital news operation in Missouri and Southern Illinois, with nationally-recognized and award-winning news, weather, and investigative content found both on-air and online. KMOV won the prestigious national Edward R. Murrow Award for Best Newscast in 2023. Based in suburban St. Louis County, KMOV's home is a new multi-million-dollar state-of-the-art broadcasting and digital facility. Ranked as the #1 city in the nation in 2022 for new college graduates, St. Louis is now recognized for its low cost of living, convenient transportation, and robust arts and entertainment scene. Home to the world-famous Arch, St. Louis Cardinals baseball, St. Louis CITY SC, and St. Louis Blues hockey — St. Louis is quickly becoming THE place to be.

Job Summary/Description:

First Alert 4 / ABC 32 in St. Louis is looking for a senior reporter who leads the market. This is not a job for beginners — the ideal candidate has 10+ years of reporting experience, preferably in a medium or large market.

This is the station to work at in the St. Louis market if you want to grow and be part of a growing team that recently added ABC programming to the lineup. Growth is encouraged, and impactful reporting is front and center of everything we do.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What you will bring:
- Lead the market with high-impact reporting that has other stations following up the next day
- Adapt quickly to breaking news; own the big story on linear TV, streaming, and digital
- Develop high-caliber sources that consistently break major stories
- Come ready as a self-starter with bulletproof story pitches every day
- Strong digital execution across web, social, and streaming — digital is a must
- Understand the St. Louis audience; tap into real people for real stories
- Master the follow-up: turn one story into ten over days and weeks
- Anchor shows as needed; work with experienced journalists
- Contribute enterprise reporting across all platforms
- Great attitude; contribute to a positive culture of teamwork

Details: Starts as Monday–Friday; work across First Alert 4, ABC 32, streaming and digital; flexible schedule required; engage on social; comfortable in active breaking news on-air and streaming; based in St. Louis.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- At least 10 years of reporting experience, preferably in a medium or large market
- Understands the complexity of covering news in a constantly changing market like St. Louis
- Proven high-impact/enterprise reporting with strong source network

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KTVK/KPHO:

Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you obsessed with the creator economy? Do you understand why some videos explode to millions of views while others disappear into the void? Can you take a 45-minute podcast episode and turn it into five pieces of content that each hit differently on five different platforms? Then we need to talk.

Arizona's Family is looking for a Social Media Video Producer who is laser-focused on growing our content and talent through bold, creative, platform-native video content. This isn't a traditional TV job — this is a digital-first, audience-obsessed, growth-driven role for someone who thinks like a content creator, executes like a producer, and analyzes like a strategist.

You'll be the engine behind turning our long-form streaming content and podcast episodes into short-form social gold — building loyal audiences, driving subscriptions, and putting Arizona's Family at the forefront of the next era of local media.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Transform long-form into short-form magic: Watch, listen to, and deeply understand our streaming shows and podcast episodes — then identify and clip the moments that will hook audiences on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and X.
• Produce original social video content: Concept, shoot, and edit original short-form video content — teasers, trailers, behind-the-scenes, host spotlights, audiograms, and promotional clips — that drive tune-in and subscriptions.
• Grow our streaming and podcast audiences: Develop and execute platform-specific social strategies designed to convert casual scrollers into loyal subscribers and regular listeners/viewers.
• Be a storytelling architect: Identify the most compelling hooks, soundbites, and moments from each episode and package them into irresistible, binge-worthy content that leaves audiences wanting more.
• Manage content calendars: Plan, schedule, and publish content across all platforms with consistency and strategic timing — building anticipation before episodes drop and sustaining momentum after.
• Optimize for each platform: You don't post the same video everywhere. You understand aspect ratios, caption strategies, hashtag culture, trending audio, and algorithm behavior on every major platform — and you create accordingly.
• Engage and grow communities: Foster authentic engagement around our shows and podcasts — responding to comments, collaborating with hosts on their personal channels, and identifying opportunities to tap into trending conversations.
• Track, analyze, and iterate: Monitor performance metrics, including views, watch time, follower growth, click-throughs, and conversion rates, and use data to continuously refine your content strategy.
• Collaborate with field crews and talent: Work closely with our team and coach them to create authentic, engaging content, ensuring their personal brands amplify azfamily.
• Stay ahead of trends: You're always watching what's working in the creator space, new formats, emerging platforms, and viral trends that you're quick to test and adapt.
• Self-starter energy: You don't wait to be told what to create. You bring ideas, pitch concepts, and take full ownership of your content pipeline.
• Collaborative spirit: You work well with hosts, talent, and cross-functional teams — making everyone around you look and sound better.
• Bonus: Experience with audiogram tools (Headliner, Descript), podcast distribution platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, iHeart), or streaming platform management (Roku, Amazon Fire, YouTube TV).
• College degree preferred.

What You'll Be Growing:

• You'll play a direct role in expanding the reach and audience of Arizona's Family's growing portfolio, which may include:
• Original podcasts covering Arizona news, politics, sports, lifestyle, and culture
• Streaming shows distributed across platforms like Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, and YouTube
• Long-form interview and documentary-style content
• Arizona-focused lifestyle and community programming

Why You'll Love It Here:

• Be a pioneer: This is a ground-floor opportunity to shape how Arizona's Family grows in the streaming and podcast space — your fingerprints will be on everything.
• Creative freedom: Bring your boldest ideas. We want someone who pushes boundaries, experiments fearlessly, and isn't afraid to try something new.
• See your impact in real time: Watch follower counts climb, episode downloads grow, and audiences engage with content you created.
• Work with great talent: Collaborate with experienced journalists, charismatic hosts, and a passionate digital team who are all rowing in the same direction.
• Arizona's biggest media stage: Help build the future of local media in one of the fastest-growing markets in the country.
• Room to grow: Gray Media is investing heavily in streaming and digital — and so are we. This role has serious upward trajectory.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 2–4+ years of experience in social media video production, digital content creation, or a related field — ideally with experience growing a podcast, streaming show, YouTube channel, or creator brand.
• Expert short-form video skills: You live and breathe Reels, TikToks, and Shorts. You know how to hook an audience in the first 2 seconds and keep them watching.
• Strong video editing proficiency: Fluency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools. Motion graphics experience (After Effects) is a major plus.
• Platform-native thinking: You don't just repurpose content — you reimagine it for each platform's unique culture, format, and audience behavior.
• Podcast and streaming fluency: You're a regular podcast listener and streaming viewer. You understand the medium, the audience expectations, and what makes people subscribe and come back.
• Copywriting chops: You can write scroll-stopping captions, compelling CTAs, and engaging on-screen text that enhances your video content.
• Growth mindset: You're not satisfied with vanity metrics. You care about real audience growth, retention, and conversion — and you know how to move those numbers.
• Self-starter energy: You don't wait to be told what to create. You bring ideas, pitch concepts, and take full ownership of your content pipeline.
• Collaborative spirit: You work well with hosts, talent, and cross-functional teams — making everyone around you look and sound better.
• Bonus: Experience with audiogram tools (Headliner, Descript), podcast distribution platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, iHeart), or streaming platform management (Roku, Amazon Fire, YouTube TV).
• College degree preferred.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WIS-TV:

WIS is the #1 local media organization in the capital city market of Columbia, South Carolina. It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. WIS is also the hub for Palmetto Sports & Entertainment, a statewide broadcast sports network, and an affiliate of Telemundo SC.

Serving South Carolina's Midlands since 1953, WIS offers the opportunity to join an award-winning culture for a popular brand built upon decades of market leadership. Named the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year a record 17 times, WIS has earned the Edward R. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina State House.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

Job Summary/Description:

A Solutions Journalist at WIS joins a market-leading, award-winning newsroom to research, develop, and produce enterprise reporting that doesn’t stop at identifying what’s broken. This role is for an investigative-minded storyteller who understands evolving audience demand for journalism that holds power accountable while also rigorously examining responses—what’s being tried, what’s working (or not), for whom, and why.

Solutions journalism is not “good news.” It is tough, evidence-based reporting about responses to problems, grounded in:

• Evidence of effectiveness (data, results, credible evaluation)
• Insight (what can be learned and why it matters here)
• Limitations (tradeoffs, gaps, risks, what hasn’t worked, who’s left out)

The ideal candidate is an aggressive self-starter with strong public records skills, understands how to research, has a deep commitment to fairness and verification, and has the ability to produce compelling, high-impact stories across broadcast and digital platforms.

 Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Pitch, report, and produce enterprise/solutions stories that examine both the problem and credible responses, with clear evidence and limitations
• Shoot, write, edit, and publish multiplatform video (broadcast + digital) with high standards of verification and transparency
• Plan and execute short- and long-term projects on a shared enterprise calendar with newsroom stakeholders
• Use public records (FOIA), databases, documents, and data to uncover accountability and measure outcomes
• Develop sources and leads that reveal exclusive information and deepen reporting over time
• Interrogate claims made by institutions and organizations promoting “solutions,” testing what’s true and what’s overstated
• Center the audience with clear “why it matters” framing and practical context, without advocacy or cheerleading
• Present information fairly and accurately, including right-of-reply and strong attribution
• Collaborate closely with News leadership, digital, and producers to maximize reach, clarity, and follow-through reporting
• Build and maintain reporting systems (trackers, databases, timelines) to ensure stories evolve beyond a single hit
• Create strong digital components (explainers, FAQs, document viewers, short-form video, follow-ups) that extend impact and engagement

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 3-5 years’ experience in investigative, enterprise, or accountability reporting (solutions journalism experience is a plus)
• Refined ability to write for both broadcast & digital presentation
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field
• Understanding of and adherence to AP Style for digital platforms and broadcasting writing for TV
• Ability to operate a field camera, editing, and lighting equipment
• Ability to lift/carry equipment ranging from 35-50 lbs
• Must have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record
• Represent WIS professionally/responsibly in the community and newsroom, online and in person
• Must have the desire to win, reflect critically on your work, and apply feedback
• Demonstrated ability to report with rigor on evidence, impact, and limitations (data literacy and document reporting preferred)

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WKTB/Telemundo Atlanta:

Telemundo Atlanta is a premier Spanish-language television station providing award-winning local news and programming. Telemundo Atlanta is available to the Atlanta DMA on a million-watt full-power over-the-air signal on channel 47.1. Telemundo Atlanta has received 61 Emmy® Awards since 2012, including the top honor of Station Excellence in 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017, and News Excellence in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Telemundo Atlanta was nominated for Best Newscast and News Excellence in 2020. Telemundo Atlanta is the first Spanish-language television station to receive the coveted Overall Station Excellence recognition in Georgia. Telemundo Atlanta produces essential daily local news, which can also be accessed over our website www.telemundoatlanta.com, and mobile application.

Job Summary/Description:  

The Technical Director will function as one of the technical leads for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment. This is a "freelance" position.

The Technical Director will be a technical lead for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment. This position is a part-time/freelance position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Live/Taped Productions:

• Set up and operate production switchers and all associated technical equipment in a Production Control Room and/or Live Location environment during live game and/or studio broadcast productions. Orchestrate control room setup while simultaneously evaluating and assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels
• Collaborates with the Producer to execute the technical and artistic vision for each live newscast and/or studio production
• Lead the technical portion of the production team during the production setup and coordinate the faxing of their equipment and show elements since their equipment and work passes through the production switcher
• Collaborate with traffic and HUB entities needed to verify that all video and audio signals are routed correctly and making it to their final destinations
• During a live and/or studio broadcast production, recall video sources, transitions, and effects, and route studio monitors as instructed by Producers. Continuously monitoring all sources used during production to ensure all video levels look correct and stay in timing, which includes external feeds
• Must be able to handle the pressures of live programming and limited time constraints

Collaboration & Communication:

• Work closely with the Technical Operations and Production Engineering to identify, troubleshoot, and solve technical problems for Live Locations, PCRs, and Studio productions. Making sure each problem is resolved to completion
• Collaborates with Production Engineering, Technical Operations, and Production Management to identify and special order any equipment needed for live or taped studio broadcast productions

Planning Responsibilities:

• Creates documentation on switcher builds, effects build, and setup of the switcher for each broadcast production

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Minimum of 2 years of broadcast experience operating as a Technical Director, live remote and/or live studio productions, with hands-on experience in control room areas such as switching, audio, graphics, character generator, robotics, and automated rundown software
• Knowledge of current industry standards
• Knowledge of video signal flow and video router operations
• Knowledge of IP router operations and the software used to edit panels
• Must be able to technically operate various models of video switchers, digital effects devices, and other associated ancillary equipment
• Experience using ENPS or similar news production systems
• Experience using Ross Overdrive automation
• Knowledge of current broadcast technologies appropriate to the position's job responsibilities
• Knowledge of FCC regulations
• Must take ownership and accountability for assigned projects
• Experience using Edius, Adobe Creative Suite editing software preferred
• Computer skills, using MS Office
• Able to work flexible, non-traditional hours, including weekends and holidays
• Must be bilingual (English/Spanish)

Core Duties & Responsibilities:

• Operate the Video Switcher for live and pre-taped programming
• Where needed, act as Director for certain shows
• Communicate with producers, studio, and control room crew to execute live and pre-taped programming
• Lead the control room and studio crew to produce regular, special, and live show programming
• Work in conjunction with the feeds team for remote guests and live hits
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Work with remote crews on location, reporters in the field, and remote hosts throughout the day
• Communicate with talent in the studio when necessary
• Highly motivated and confident in executing difficult and complex tasks
• Ability to consistently function in a high-pressure role and environment

job.description:

Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WKTB (Telemundo Atlanta):

Telemundo Atlanta is a premier Spanish-language television station providing award-winning local news and programming. Telemundo Atlanta is available to the Atlanta DMA on a million-watt full-power over-the-air signal on channel 47.1. Telemundo Atlanta has received 61 Emmy® Awards since 2012, including the top honor of Station Excellence in 2013, 2014, 2016, 2017, 2022, and 2023, and News Excellence in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Telemundo Atlanta was nominated for Best Newscast and News Excellence in 2020. Telemundo Atlanta is the first Spanish-language television station to receive the coveted Overall Station Excellence recognition in Georgia.

Job Summary/Description:  

The Technical Director will be a technical lead for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Live/Taped Productions:

• Set up and operate production switchers and all associated technical equipment in a Production Control Room and/or Live Location environment during live game and/or studio broadcast productions. Orchestrate control room setup while simultaneously evaluating and assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels
• Collaborates with the Producer to execute the technical and artistic vision for each live newscast and/or studio production
• Lead the technical portion of the production team during the production setup and coordinate the faxing of their equipment and show elements, since their equipment and work passes through the production switcher
• Collaborate with traffic and HUB entities needed to verify that all video and audio signals are routed correctly and are making it to their final destinations
• During a live and/or studio broadcast production, recall video sources, transitions, and effects, and route studio monitors as instructed by Producers. Continuously monitoring all sources used during production to ensure all video levels look correct and stay in timing, which includes external feeds
• Must be able to handle the pressures of live programming and limited time constraints

Core Duties & Responsibilities:

• Operate the Video Switcher for live and pre-taped programming
• Where needed, act as Director for certain shows
• Communicate with producers, studio, and control room crew to execute live and pre-taped programming
• Lead the control room and studio crew to produce regular, special, and live show programming
• Work in conjunction with the feeds team for remote guests and live hits
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Work with remote crews on location, reporters in the field, and remote hosts throughout the day
• Communicate with talent in the studio when necessary
• Highly motivated and confident in executing difficult and complex tasks
• Ability to consistently function in a high-pressure role and environment
• Ability to quickly react to changing priorities and needs
• Must be able to troubleshoot difficult problems and develop solutions to address root causes.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Minimum of 2 years of broadcast experience operating as a Technical Director, live remote and/or live studio productions, with hands-on experience in control room areas such as switching, audio, graphics, character generator, robotics, and automated rundown software
• Knowledge of current industry standards
• Knowledge of video signal flow and video router operations
• Knowledge of IP router operations and the software used to edit panels
• Must be able to technically operate various models of video switchers, digital effects devices, and other associated ancillary equipment
• Experience using ENPS or similar news production systems
• Experience using Ross Overdrive automation
• Knowledge of current broadcast technologies appropriate to the position's job responsibilities
• Knowledge of FCC regulations
• Must take ownership and accountability for assigned projects
• Experience using Edius, Adobe Creative Suite editing software preferred
• Computer skills, using MS Office
• Able to work flexible, non-traditional hours, including weekends and holidays
• Must be bilingual (English/Spanish)
