job.title: 2027 Summer Internship- Creative (eGreetings)
job.description:
ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAM  

We're looking for curious, creative, and consumer-focused interns who are passionate about storytelling, trends, culture, creativity, and human connection. 

 

 eGreetings Creative Intern 

This internship focuses on the future of digital connection through animated, interactive, and video-based greeting experiences. Interns will research consumer trends, explore emerging digital behaviors, and develop concepts that help Hallmark engage younger and new consumers through innovative digital greetings experiences. Interns will partner with creative, digital, and media teams to develop concepts, storyboards, and recommendations that could influence future product development 

What you'll do: 

  • Research consumer behaviors, creative trends, and digital connection experiences.  
  • Explore opportunities for animated, video-based, and interactive greetings.  
  • Partner with Digital Greetings, Media Studio, and Creative teams to understand current capabilities and future opportunities.  
  • Develop innovative concepts focused on personalization, interactivity, and social sharing.  
  • Create storyboards, visual concepts, and creative recommendations.  
  • Gather feedback from cross-functional partners and refine concepts based on insights.  
  • Present digital greeting concepts and recommendations to business and creative leaders. 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Digital Media, Graphic Design, Animation, Motion Design, User Experience (UX), Interactive Media, Creative Technology, Film/Video Production, or a related field
  • A graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

Your resume and application will stand out if you are: 

  • Demonstrated interest in digital content, creative storytelling, emerging media, interactive experiences, or consumer engagement
  • Passionate about how people connect and communicate through digital platforms, social media, video, gaming, or emerging technologies
  • Familiarity with social, cultural, and consumer trends relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences
  • Skilled at generating creative ideas and translating them into visual concepts, storyboards, mockups, presentations, or prototypes
  • Familiar with content creation tools, design software, video editing, animation, or other digital creative platforms
  • Comfortable collaborating across creative and business disciplines and incorporating feedback into evolving concepts
  • Experience through coursework, publications, student organizations, freelance work, or personal creative projects is a plus

  

ADDITIONAL DETAILS 

  • A portfolio is required for this position. Your portfolio should be compiled into one PDF document that is no larger than 5 MB. If your portfolio file size is above the 5MB limit, you can submit a one-page overview of your work (see example). You can also submit a link to a personal portfolio website to supplement your uploaded portfolio. Applicants who do not upload a portfolio or one-page overview will not be considered.
  • Our internship program is 12 weeks long, starting in late May and ending in early August. 
  • This summer internship is a hybrid position, with the flexibility to work from both our recently renovated headquarters building in Kansas City, MO, and from your summer residence within the KC metro area. 
  • Some relocation and housing assistance is provided for interns whose permanent address is outside of the KC metro area. Relocation is required for this role. 

       

      Interested? Follow the application instructions below to apply. 

       

      APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS  

      You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  

       In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

       

      ABOUT HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important  

       

      For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!  

      When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.  

      Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the ings we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Maintenance Mechanic - 2nd Shift
job.description:
HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

Hallmark is a company rooted in connecting people. We care for our employees, our communities, and our world. A career at Hallmark means you get to make a big impact and create something that can make a genuine difference. We’re looking for people who want to continue to carry our vision forward. 

 

Maintenance Specialist

We are seeking a skilled Maintenance Specialist with a broad range of mechanical and troubleshooting abilities. This position will be responsible for installing, repairing, and maintaining machinery and equipment used in Hallmark’s Leavenworth Production Facility. Hallmark offers an exceptional work-life balance, a comfortable climate-controlled environment, a comprehensive benefits package, paid holidays, and great company culture.

The Maintenance Specialist will:

  • Repair and maintain machinery in accordance with blueprints, manuals, and craft codes.
  • Install machinery and equipment. This includes assembling, leveling, and mounting equipment, making necessary electric, compressed air, gas, and water connections.
  • Dismantle and reassemble machinery, making new connections as needed.
  • Modify existing equipment or design and build new machines to improve capacity, quality, safety, and cost.
  • Instruct operators and supervisors in the operation of new or modified equipment.
  • Demonstrate flexibility by moving to different work areas as needed.
  • Perform duties in accordance with sound safety practices. Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.

The hours for this position are Monday - Friday 3:30p - 12:00p. 

The ideal candidates will have:

  • Ability to repair and maintain machinery, including replacing belts, repairing or installing electrical wiring and hydraulic lines.
  • Proficiency in electronics, reading electronic schematics, and wiring Ladder logic.
  • Ability to weld using arc, heli-arc, and gas welding equipment.
  • Experience with lathe and milling machines for complex jobs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work as a team member.
  • Basic computer skills and willingness to continually improve skills.
  • Ability to travel for training locally and/or out of town.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years related experience that successfully demonstrates mechanical and electrical ability.
  • Must be able to read and interpret blueprints; be proficient in using gas, wire, spot and arc welding equipment; knowledge with working on boilers, chillers, and air compressors; able to install plumbing and industrial electrical systems with the proper code requirements; knowledgeable of industrial electronics and programmable logic controls, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
  • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.
  • Ability to prioritize jobs by assigned work areas according to key processes.  Ability to re-organize when needed and to work under pressure.
  • Ability to push, pull, grasp, lift and carry items weighing up to 50-100 lbs frequently and 100+ lbs occasionally.
  • Ability to constantly stand and walk. Ability to frequently bend, twist, kneel, squat, climb, and reach at/above shoulder level.
  • Ability to frequently work in awkward positions and occasionally work from ladders.
  • Good math, written, oral communication skills and ability to learn and retain knowledge. 
  • Demonstrates initiative and creative problem-solving skills. 
  • Must have basic computer skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment. 
  • Ability to work overtime as necessary

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Work overtime as required during peak seasons
  • This is a maintenance environment that requires wearing appropriate PPE and following operating procedures when working with hazardous chemicals, hazardous energies, and in harsh operating environments without climate controls
  • Must wear PPE for Arc Flash protection, as well as other PPE such as safety glasses and safety shoes
  • Required to operate hand powered tools and industrial shop machinery
  • There is some noise and hearing protection is required by Hallmark

 

This position is located in Leavenworth, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

  • Your performance will be reviewed 6 months back from the date the job posting comes down.  You must have been satisfactory in all areas and have no disqualifying CR’s for that full 6-month period in order to be considered. 
  • You must have been in your current job for at least 6 months

Please note, this is a merit-based selection process.  All selections will be based on skills, competencies and performance.  The most qualified candidate will be selected without consideration of seniority.

job.title: Materials Movement Specialist (37) - 2nd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Material Movement Specialist position in Lawrence is on 2nd Shift (3:30pm - 12:00am midnight).

The Materials Movement Specialist reports through the Warehouse Department in the Lawrence Production Center.  Individuals in this department transport stock and recycled material to and from the warehouse to the production areas.   

 

The Materials Movement Specialist in Lawrence transports stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks.  Loads and unloads incoming and outgoing trucks.  Locates stock in the warehouse and fills orders for manufacturing using a variety of powered equipment.  Responsible for loading and unloading skids onto the vertical lift and using the elevator as necessary.  Responsible for sorting paper or other materials into proper recycling categories to ensure maximum revenue generation.  Acts as a technical resource to support departments on paper grading.  Operates paper, chip and poly balers to compress recyclable materials into bales.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.  Transports hazardous waste material in accordance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.   Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.  Incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

 

The Materials Movement Specialist position may be in several departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Be certified to operate fork lifts and other power equipment as required. 
  • Transport stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks and load onto trucks.
  • Prepare materials and supplies for shipment using banding equipment, power saws, power drills, film wrapper and string tie as required.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.
  • Coordinate with paper recycling contractor, metal, or other contractors regarding the pick-up and delivery of storage containers and trailers to support manufacturing workloads.  Performs preventive and scheduled maintenance services on balers and power equipment. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished with shorter periods of time. 
  • Communicate effectively with outside vendors and other departments.
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

Requirements:

To be considered an applicant for this position you must show how you meet the basic qualifications of the job in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  Individual file size attachment limit is 10 MB.

 

If additional openings become available within 30 days of the posting coming down and the vacancy is still in an open status, applicants will be selected from the original posting. If interested in this job, please apply now.

 

If you are offered and accept this position, you understand that you will be held within this position for 6 months.  If you are offered a new position once you accept, but have been in your position for less than 6 months you will not be able to move to a new role. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.
 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Ability to frequently move materials weighing 35 pounds and occasionally lift materials weighing up to 50 pounds from the floor
  • Ability to stand and walk approximately 95% of the time
  • Ability to frequently push, pull, twist, bend and reach above shoulder level

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Good math, written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to understand the computer and ordering systems and successfully operate both systems
  • Ability to work as a member of a team and to work under pressure to meet deadlines and changing needs. Ability to reorganize and change directions when necessary
  • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures for wearing PPE, and handling hazardous chemicals
  • Good planning and organizational skills to set up work area and manage work flow
  • Ability to learn and retain knowledge
  • Understanding and practice of good customer service

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Work overtime as required during peak seasons
  • Must pass certification to operate lift trucks and power lift equipment
  • The warehouse and docks do not maintain direct climate control.
  • This is a warehouse environment that requires wearing appropriate PPE and following operating procedures when working with hazards from equipment, tools, and chemicals.
  • Required to operate hand powered tools, such as power saws, power drills, etc.

job.description:
The Account Executive is responsible for selling advertising to local businesses and ad agencies and negotiating ratings and rates with ad agencies. This position will also bring in new businesses to advertise on the TV and web. The ideal candidate is coachable, thrives in a goal-oriented team environment and has strong interpersonal skills. If you are motivated by an excellent product, great compensation, and working with a talented team of professionals, look no further.  We will provide the tools for powerful multi-platform marketing solutions that will create partnerships to retain and grow our existing and new client base – you provide sales ability, positive attitude, client focus, and desire to WIN!  If you want to work for the best, we want to hear from you today! 

Responsibilities:                                           

  • Generate revenue across all available platforms
  • Prospect, contact and present to new businesses to generate new advertising revenue
  • Manage inventory and protect station rate structure.
  • Develop new revenue through local business development
  • Form strategic business and market partnerships
  • Manage an active account and client list
  • Regularly meet with local and digital sales managers to ensure progression and success with stated goals
  • Act as negotiator for assigned accounts; ensure sales proposals are consistent with station strategies

  • Experience in TV/Radio sales
  • Solid negotiation skills

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
WCVB-TV is building a team of journalists dedicated to growing and diversifying the station's digital storytelling — original video and multiplatform content that lives across WCVB's digital platforms (web, app, YouTube, social, streaming) and within Chronicle and News broadcasts. We are seeking candidates for two off-camera positions. 

One position is based in the News department and is focused on fast-turn digital publishing, breaking news video, and enterprise/investigative reporting that extends NewsCenter 5's original journalism. The second position is based in Chronicle and is focused on field-produced, Chronicle-style long-form storytelling built for digital-first release in addition to broadcast use. 

What You'll Do

Field Production & Storytelling

  • Produce original video stories from pitch to final edit, largely working independently in the field
  • Conduct interviews, gather b-roll, and craft narratives with strong visual and storytelling quality
  • Bring either a Chronicle-style sensibility (tone, pacing, visual craft) or a news-enterprise sensibility (depth, context, follow-up reporting) to assigned stories, depending on the context
  • Ability to travel throughout New England — occasionally outside the region — is required
  • In-person attendance is required

Digital-First Publishing

  • Produce and edit short-form and long-form video optimized for digital platforms, including web, app, YouTube, and social
  • Turn content on a fast timeline — including breaking news — without sacrificing production quality
  • Package stories with strong titling, structure, and visual hooks suited to each platform
  • Adapt Chronicle and newsroom material for streaming, social, and other digital-first formats

Enterprise & Long-Form Storytelling

  • Develop digital-first stories that go beyond the day's headlines — true crime, investigative, lifestyle, archival, and multi-part features
  • Identify opportunities to advance a story or archival footage beyond its initial reporting
  • Identify opportunities to expand a single story into a series, or structure stories with future broadcast compilation in mind

Audience & Growth

  • Track platform trends and audience behavior, and identify stories with strong shareability
  • Experiment with emerging formats and growth strategies, evaluate results, and share what works with the team
  • Contribute to analytics-informed content planning, including for weekends and streaming events
  • Collaborate closely with digital, newsroom, and Chronicle teams to maximize reach

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in video production, TV news, digital media, and/or documentary-style storytelling
  • Strong mastery of the Adobe editing suite
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in the field, from pitch through final edit
  • Comfort balancing speed with production quality in a high-volume environment
  • Working knowledge of platform algorithms, digital video trends, and audience behavior
  • Strong writing skills and command of AP style

Preferred / Bonus Skills

  • Experience producing serialized, episodic, or multi-part digital content
  • Experience with YouTube and social platform optimization
  • Familiarity with leveraging archival content to build context or reimagine past stories in new formats
  • Experience developing or supporting strategy for streaming events with on-air talent

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased video views, watch time, and engagement across digital platforms
  • Growth in YouTube subscribers and overall channel performance
  • Consistent production of high-quality, platform-optimized video
  • Effective repurposing and extension of newsroom and Chronicle material
  • Energetic, inspirational collaboration across editorial, digital, and production teams

Salary

The estimated base salary range for this role is between $76,000 and $90,000. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

  • Medical | Dental | Vision
  • 401(k) matching
  • Emotional Wellness Support
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • LGBTQ+ Health Services
  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.title: Intern
job.description:
The WESH 2/ CW18 News Internship Program is a paid, rigorous and highly competitive hands-on experience that provides individuals the opportunity to learn about the operations of a broadcast television station. You will develop news writing, producing, reporting, and digital media skills while learning from award-winning staff at WESH 2 News. Additional opportunities are available in the behind-the-scenes areas of production/studio operations, weather and marketing/promotions. Your internship will prepare you for work in a real newsroom, giving you opportunities in nearly every aspect of news production.
 

Spring 2027 Session
Application Window: Nov. 14th, 2026– Dec. 15th, 2026
Session: Jan. 25th, 2027 – April 16th, 2027
*Dates are subject to change
 

WESH 2/CW18 offers paid internships in the departments below. In order to apply for an internship at WESH 2/CW18, please provide a cover letter with your application. The cover letter should include:
•    Semester i.e. Spring, Summer, or Fall (if applicable)
•    Department preference
•    Available start and end dates
•    Days and hours available to intern
 

Available Internships

Newsroom

Interns will work alongside reporters, producers, and news managers to learn skills in nearly all aspects of television news production. Examples include on-scene reporting, producing, video editing, research, and working at the assignment desk.

Production/Studio Operations

Interns will learn the technical aspects of live news broadcasts. Behind-the-scenes training will include learning robotic cameras, floor directing, lighting and show set-ups. Interns are required to be comfortable with height, able to lift light equipment, and work non-traditional hours.

Digital

Interns will learn how newsrooms publish content to digital platforms, analyze real-time online metrics and more. Interns will get the opportunity to research, write, and publish stories for WESH.com.

Weather

Interns must have working knowledge of a meteorology curriculum or closely related program of study. You will work with our team of meteorologists to learn the skills necessary in creating and delivering forecast information for a television and online audience.

Marketing/Promotions

Interns with an interest in marketing, advertising, promotion, or production will be given hands-on experience in these areas.

Orientation

Once you are accepted as an intern at WESH-TV, you will receive an instruction packet. Your first day at the station is set aside for orientation and you Must attend this. You will work three days a week, eight hours each shift with varying schedules. During the internship you should always check in with your assigned adviser upon entering the building.

Securing housing and transportation during the internship are the responsibility of the student. WESH-TV cannot offer support in this area.

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

job.title: Morning Meteorologist
job.description:
KOCO-TV, the Hearst Television ABC affiliate in Oklahoma City, has an opportunity for a high energy, highly skilled meteorologist to join our First Alert Weather Team. We are looking for a meteorologist who knows the science but can tell a relatable weather story, in one of the biggest weather markets in the world. Our next meteorologist will be an accurate forecaster, convey an appropriate tone of urgency and authority in severe weather coverage, summarize complicated information, and stay cool under pressure. This role reports to the News Director.

Responsibilities:

  • Give our viewers the First Alert with accurate, compelling, and understandable weather forecasts.
  • Will provide urgent, immediate weather information before and during severe weather events
  • Will be able to simultaneously provide content on TV, for our radio partners, and on our digital platforms.
  • Will be required to produce science-based news content during the week.
  • Will use all the technology and tools available to us, to tell an intriguing weather story
  • Could be deployed in the field during weather events
  • Gather information
  • Summarize fact and clearly communicate content for broadcast

job.title: Part-Time Storm Chaser
job.description:
Part-Time Storm Chaser (Field Weather Coverage)

KOCO-TV is looking for a part-time Storm Chaser to join one of our many two-person severe weather chase teams. This is high-pressure, real-time work supporting on-air meteorologists during rapidly changing conditions. One team member drives. The other monitors radar, data, and communications. Precision, calm judgment, and ethical decision-making are non-negotiable. This role reports to the News Director. Applicants must reside in Oklahoma.

Role Overview
Storm Chasers provide critical, ground-level reports during severe weather events. This position may serve as either the driver or the radar/data operator, depending on assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate a vehicle or monitor radar, weather data, and communications from the passenger seat during severe weather.
  • Capture live and recorded video using station-authorized equipment for on-air and digital platforms.
  • Report live on-air observations when directed.
  • Relay accurate, timely storm details to station meteorologists, including severity, movement, and real-time conditions from the field.
  • Monitor weather conditions before and during deployments to anticipate storm development.
  • Adhere strictly to journalistic ethics, safety protocols, and station policies at all times.

Work Schedule

  • No fixed schedule. Hours are dictated by weather conditions.
  • Availability required on short notice when severe weather is forecast.
  • Assignments are made at the direction of station meteorologists or news management.
  • In-person attendance is required.

Important Note
This is not a casual field position. Severe weather coverage is intense, unpredictable, and safety critical. Teamwork, judgment, and professionalism are essential.

Required Qualifications

  • Clean driving record (required for all team members).
  • Strong situational awareness and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Understanding of and commitment to journalistic ethics and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow direction precisely and communicate clearly in fast-moving situations.
  • Willingness to work in all weather conditions.

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join The Alton Telegraph to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview:  Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at The Alton Telegraph. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Alton area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within the Alton Telegraph, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

The Alton Telegraph?

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!

  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieve success as an Account Executive. 

  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.

  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.

  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.

  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.

  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.

  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.

  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.

  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.

  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.

  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.

  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.

  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.

  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.

  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.

  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.

  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.

  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.

  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.

  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

Compensation: In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Connecticut. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Connecticut, is $35,000 - $40,000 base plus commissions based on individual performance, commissions are uncapped for unlimited earning potential. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

Benefits: Eligible employees enjoy Health, dental, vision coverage, Health savings and/or flexible spending accounts, short & long-term disability insurance, 401k with company match, paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays and floating holidays. 

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories–growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms–to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. 

Be a part of something bigger–Your Headline Awaits

job.title: Director, Marketing Operations – Email & Digital Subscriptions
job.description:
Director, Marketing Operations at Hearst Newspapers

About the Role

Hearst Newspapers is looking for a strategic and hands-on Director of Marketing Operations to lead the technology, processes, and team supporting our digital subscription marketing business.

Reporting to the VP of Digital Subscriptions, this role leads a team of four and serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.

A major focus of the role is email and newsletter optimization- ensuring our customer communications, lifecycle programs, audience segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation are effective, scalable, and continuously improving.

This person will also help manage and evolve the MarTech ecosystem supporting our digital subscriber journey, from audience and customer data through website experiences, offers, checkout, and ongoing subscriber communications.

This is not primarily a campaign execution, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, or project management role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technology behind modern marketing and can translate business needs into scalable solutions.

What You’ll Do

* Lead and develop a team of four Marketing Operations professionals.
* Own and continuously improve the technology and operational processes supporting email, newsletters, lifecycle marketing, CRM/CDP, and marketing automation.
* Partner with Marketing and Editorial to improve the performance, personalization, segmentation, and effectiveness of email and newsletter programs.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into technical requirements and deliver new capabilities.
* Help oversee the technology supporting the digital customer journey, including websites, audience data, personalization, subscription offers, and customer communications.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot issues across platforms, data flows, integrations, campaigns, and customer experiences.
* Establish effective intake, prioritization, QA, governance, and release processes across multiple Hearst newspaper markets.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and enable Marketing teams to do more.
* Evaluate vendors and technology solutions and help ensure the MarTech ecosystem is scalable and well integrated.
* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Engineering, BI, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.
* Create processes and capabilities that can scale consistently across Hearst Newspapers’ markets while still supporting local needs.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

* Significant experience in Marketing Operations, preferably leading a Marketing Operations function or team.
* Deep, hands-on experience with email and/or newsletter operations, including segmentation, lifecycle communications, personalization, QA, testing, and optimization.
* Strong knowledge of MarTech platforms, marketing automation, CRM/CDP, and customer data.
* Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build or improve marketing capabilities.
* Strong understanding of how data moves across marketing systems and the ability to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes.
* Experience managing and prioritizing competing requests across multiple stakeholders or business units.
* Proven people leadership experience.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions.
* Experience using AI and automation to improve marketing processes and team efficiency.

Preferred:

* Experience in media, publishing, subscriptions, or consumer marketing.
* Experience supporting multiple brands, markets, or decentralized organizations.
* Experience with website/digital customer experiences, personalization, subscription offers, or checkout.
* Experience with platforms such as BlueConic, Sailthru, Salesforce, or comparable MarTech solutions.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integrations, or data activation.
* Experience evaluating vendors and implementing new marketing capabilities.

The Person We’re Looking For

You’re someone who enjoys figuring out how things work and how to make them work better.

You don’t simply take a request and pass it along to Engineering. You ask questions, understand the underlying business and technical problem, identify the right solution, and bring the right teams together to make it happen.

You’re comfortable moving between marketing strategy, technology, data, and operations, and you know when to get into the details and when to step back and lead.

You’re curious about AI, constantly looking for ways to eliminate manual work, and comfortable operating in a complex, multi-market organization where priorities don’t always align.

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

job.title: Senior Audience Producer
job.description:
Senior Audience Producer

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is looking for an innovative, collaborative Senior Audience Producer to help guide ambitious journalism through audience insights, thoughtful optimization and responsible use of AI. Working alongside editors and reporters, this role will help drive engagement, subscriptions and return visits across CT Insider’s digital platforms, newsletters, social media, audio and print.

This is a digital newsroom audience role - not a television or live-news producing position. We are looking for a journalist who understands digital audiences, analytics, content optimization and audience strategy, and who can work closely with reporters and editors to help journalism reach and resonate with more readers.

Senior Audience Producers will embed with key newsroom topic teams, which may include data, state politics, investigations, education, business, real estate, high school sports and UConn sports. This is an opportunity to innovate, experiment and help strengthen the reach and impact of journalism that matters to Connecticut communities.

 

About the Team

Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) is a collection of the state’s most important news properties, providing local, watchdog and investigative reporting that impacts communities across Connecticut.

HCMG includes close to 170 journalists working at 10 daily newspapers – Connecticut Post, Greenwich Time, Journal Inquirer, The Middletown Press, The New Haven Register, The News-Times, The Norwalk Hour, Record-Journal, Republican-American and Stamford Advocate – 13 weekly newspapers, Connecticut Magazine and multiple websites.

HCMG expanded further in 2021 with the launch of Connecticut’s No. 1 statewide news source, CTInsider.com, covering everything from sports and politics to breaking news stories and compelling features about Connecticut residents and businesses.

 

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with editors, reporters, photographers and audience team members to ensure journalism engages, retains and converts local readers into subscribers.

* Analyze and interpret audience metrics, translating insights into clear recommendations that inform short- and long-term coverage decisions.

* Optimize journalism across websites, social media, newsletters and search to expand reach and deepen audience engagement.

* Use topic-area knowledge and audience insights to identify story opportunities and develop recurring content series and annual special projects.

* Guide responsible and relevant use of AI and other emerging tools to improve newsroom workflows and audience outcomes.

* Communicate across departments during breaking and planned news events to alert audiences to key developments across platforms.

* Support topic teams in planning and executing audience strategies that encourage return visits and subscriber growth.

* Lead or contribute to livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain audiences, where applicable.

 

Qualifications

* Strong editorial judgment and experience working in a deadline-driven digital news or journalism environment.

* Demonstrated understanding of digital audience development, engagement and content optimization.

* Ability to optimize stories for websites, social media, newsletters and search.

* Strong comfort with analyzing and interpreting metrics and communicating what the data means.

* Experience editing short- and mid-form video, photos and audio using tools such as Canva, Photoshop or Premiere.

* Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.

* A quick, organized and technically capable problem solver who consistently meets deadlines.

* Strong organizational and detail-oriented skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities.

* Flexibility to work nights and weekends for breaking news and special content opportunities.

* Collaborative approach and curiosity about audience behavior, journalism and emerging technology.

 

Preferred qualifications

* Knowledge of topic area in sports

* Experience planning and running livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain viewers.

* Experience using analytics to shape editorial strategy and coverage decisions.

* Experience developing strategic plans or audience-focused digital initiatives.

 

Please note: This role is not a television producer, live-news producer or broadcast production position. Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on producing television newscasts, live broadcasts or broadcast control-room operations are not the target profile for this position.

 

Compensation & Benefits

The reasonable estimate for this role, if hired in Connecticut, is $56,000 - $66,000 base. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications and education.

We are proud to offer generous health and wellness benefits, competitive paid time off, financial programs like 401k matching and tuition assistance, and additional perks like company matching for charitable donations.

This hybrid position (3 days / week) based in Norwalk, Connecticut, and is not eligible for remote candidates. 

Hearst is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Legal Affairs Fellow
job.description:
About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with — enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed — it’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

This is not your typical entry-level legal role. As Legal Affairs Fellow at Hook, you will work directly alongside the General Counsel with hands-on responsibility for virtually every facet of an in-house legal practice. From day-to-day operational documents to complex content licensing and IP transactions, you will be doing the real legal affairs work of a fast-moving early-stage music and consumer tech startup. This role is designed for a 3L or recent law school graduate who already has a foundation in music, IP, or technology law and wants to understand what it truly means to serve as General Counsel within a dynamic music technology startup —not just in theory, but in practice. You will work cross-functionally within the company, learning from and collaborating with immensely talented professionals within Hook’s content, engineering, marketing, operations, and business development teams. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the company and to see your ideas and work come to fruition. This role demands excellent drafting and communication skills, an eye for detail, sound judgment about when to escalate, a passion for technology and the law, a self-driven ability to learn quickly and, most importantly: an insatiable curiosity. For the right candidate, this fellowship is designed as a path to a permanent role on Hook’s legal team as the company grows. Conversion to a permanent position is at Hook’s discretion and is not guaranteed.

What You’ll Do

Day-to-Day Legal Operations Draft, redline, and manage non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and confidentiality agreements, taking first-pass ownership of the negotiation Prepare and process offer letters, contractor agreements, and other employment-related documents Support corporate governance and organizational housekeeping, including board and stockholder consents and corporate records Transactional & Commercial Work Draft and redline service agreements, vendor contracts, and partnership deals, and support their negotiation through signature Assist with content licensing agreements with labels, publishers, and other rightsholders, as well as sync licenses and content distribution deals Conduct due diligence and support deal execution across a range of commercial transactions Intellectual Property & Entertainment Research and advise on copyright, trademark, and other IP matters relevant to the music, entertainment, and digital media industries Review and redline complex IP licensing and rights agreements Support Hook’s trademark and patent portfolio, working with outside counsel Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging legal issues in entertainment and digital media, including AI, UGC, and platform liability General Counsel Exposure Participate in cross-functional projects with business, creative, and product teams Gain exposure to risk assessment, compliance, and corporate strategy at the executive level Build and improve internal legal templates, playbooks, policies, and legal operations processes.

&

Required 3L at an ABA-accredited law school or a recent law school graduate, with strong academic credentials. Demonstrated

experience

in music, intellectual property, and/or technology law—through prior internships, clinics, journal work, coursework, or professional

experience

before or during law school. Hands-on drafting and redlining

experience

you have marked up real agreements (NDAs, services agreements, licenses, or similar) in an internship, clinic, or prior role and are comfortable working in tracked changes. A strong understanding of music copyright law and the corresponding licenses (sound recording and musical composition rights; mechanical, performance, and sync licensing). Excellent legal research, writing, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and is comfortable taking ownership of matters with General Counsel oversight. Comfort with social media consumption patterns and creator / UGC platforms. Strong interpersonal and communication skills—comfortable collaborating across teams. Preferred Prior in-house, law firm, label, publisher, or DSP

experience

in music, entertainment, or technology. An understanding of the current commercial and legal landscape within the entertainment industries, music, social media, UGC, music consumption, and creator marketplaces. Familiarity with emerging issues at the intersection of AI and copyright, including training data and AI-generated content.

working at an early-stage startup (Seed–Series B). For recent graduates: admitted to, or sitting for, the New York bar. Passion for music and technology.

About Us

Job Overview

The Account Executive is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update Sales Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

Ability to understand the features and benefits of advertising and competitive media.

Familiarity with Microsoft Word for Windows; sales software knowledge helpful.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Establish and maintain customer relationships; communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in a professional manner.

High level of initiative and ability to work independently required.

Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license and a safe driving history as determined by the Company for the purpose of meeting clients and attending events. (Driving record will be checked.)

Demonstrate effective negotiation and closing techniques.

Strong analytical skills, good judgment, and a "positive can do attitude" are required.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to work evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements: Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.). Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job function.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

job.title: Board Operator
job.description:
Board Operator

#26-1332

St. Louis, Missouri, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WXOS

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Saint Louis is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater St. Louis community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

This position is responsible for operating the board for live, satellite delivered content and syndicated programming. The Board Operator ensures that all preplanned components of a broadcast are carried out as designed, including, set-up, operation and maintenance of electronic equipment used to transmit programs.

Job Responsibilities

Run the board, play the appropriate music, features, billboards, commercials, etc. during live or recorded news and/or brokered radio programs.

Operate and troubleshoot switcher and any other radio equipment used in the course of the production of a live or recorded broadcast.

Technical perfection and flawless execution of control board and equipment to regulate the volume and sound quality during radio broadcasts.

Observe monitors and manage outgoing audio and sounds levels.

Follow program log.

Monitor all systems and make sure they are all running on schedule. Note any issues or concerns on log.

Monitor and update severe weather forecasts.

When required, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Record, edit or play back any sound requested from broadcasts.

Voice and produce news stories/features as requested/needed.

Answer phone calls during shift and screen calls.

Monitor automation, transmitter controls, which includes pattern/tower changes and record required readings.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call for additional support.

Knowledgeable of, and applies as needed, all current FCC rules and regulations.

Report to work on time and work established schedule/hours. Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules as needed, as assigned or requested by Program Director with little or no notice. Such alternate/additional work can include weekdays, evenings and weekends.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

High School diploma, GED or equivalent required, with a minimum one (1) year experience running a radio board preferred; or a combination of education and work experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis and handle last minute and unexpected changes during work shift.

Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to co-workers and others as needed.

Ability to hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically and quickly and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to learn automation systems.

Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the board.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Able to make decisions and judgments quickly.

Follow directions well, especially over the phone.

Work well under pressure.

Available to work with short notice including early mornings, late evenings and weekends.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Physical Requirements: Ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space during the course of work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Average pushing, pulling, bending, stooping and reaching over head. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

Studio

Operate with proficiency handheld television camera for in studio and live remote productions.

Program and operate robotic cameras and Smart Shell program.

Operate VOICE teleprompter,

Understand audio equipment in the studio at a satisfactory level and with confidence during live and taped shows.

Ready at the audio position during assigned shift to handle any audio needs, especially during times of breaking news.

Help with coverage of special events and with the coverage of audio during vacations and other times when no audio operator is available.

Insure that all paperwork properly submitted. Accurately complete the logging of all musical elements to insure proper credits under the music license rules. Complete any logs, scripts or other paperwork that is required.

Code and Direct an automated newscast using Overdrive.

Technical direct a creative and technically clean productions within format guidelines.

Protect the integrity of the format.

Make suggestions for improvement.

Be responsible for all elements of a show. Set a positive attitude and example. Solve problems at the source. Respond appropriately to others.

Other

Work as a team player. Set a positive attitude and example. Foster a spirit of cooperation and helpfulness with news and other departments. Develop professional relationships with employees of other departments.

Have a high knowledge of operation of current equipment. Advise Director of Operations and Operations Coordinator on equipment needs or problems.

Seek out ways to become more knowledgeable about new technologies in our business.

Maintain current equipment. Communicate with the maintenance staff any technical problems with the equipment. Actively seek solutions to problems with station personnel, equipment and procedures.

Reports to work on time and works established schedule/hours.

Other duties as assigned.

Complete other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Basic knowledge and experience with broadcast production equipment, techniques and language; can demonstrate proficiency in use of equipment, techniques and language.

Familiarity with television control rooms, audio rooms, studios and news and non-news productions. Previous experience preferred.

Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected changes calmly.

Follows directions well.

Ability to work alternate hours and schedules including early mornings, evenings and weekends.

Physical requirements

Ability to communicate information and ideas in English both verbally and in writing so that others will understand.

Ability to listen and understand information and ideas presented in English through spoken and written words.

Must be able to work in areas and conditions that can be noisy, has many distractions, and on occasion in extreme weather conditions (heat and cold).

Must also be able to work quietly during live broadcasts and tapings.

Must have manual dexterity to operate camera and studio equipment.

Must be able to move quickly at times throughout the building and on location.

Stands and sits for long periods of time.

Pushes and pulls equipment on a regular basis.

Work under tight deadlines and in pressure situations.

Must be able to lift, carry, climb a ladder, and move with up to 20 lbs.

job.description:
Federal Drive Anchor

#26-1325

Washington, District Of Columbia, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WFED-AM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard DC, which includes WTOP, Federal News Network and 2060 Digital, is committed to reporting relevant news for our region. Through continuously evolving brands, we connect consumers with advertisers across a growing number of distribution platforms including radio, podcasts, social media, and websites. We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Federal Drive anchor must have experience in developing ideas, conducting and managing audio and video interviews is strongly preferred, but will consider the right person with the right background in federal issues. This position holds the primary responsibility for the show’s content and adherence to Federal News Network editorial standards and focus areas. Also responsible for ensuring show is prepared and ready for broadcast each work day, five days per week. Audio and video show segments are posted online and published as podcast segments on major distribution networks, the Federal News Network website and multiple social media platforms. Therefore, anchor must treat Federal Drive as a primary contributor to Federal News Network’s website and as a means of attracting audience via multiple listening and watching formats and digital distribution channels.

Job Responsibilities

PLANNING:

Leading the team to determine which guests and topics should be on the show, with a strong preference for federal executives

Working with news staff for suggestions and referrals

BOOKING:

Working with producers to contact potential guests and their public affairs teams to schedule show appearances. Supervising scheduling; frequently supplying interview questions ahead of the interview

CREATING INTERVIEWS:

Reading, understanding background material

Writing teases, leads, tag

Conducting audio and video interviews, typically 2-to-5 per day

CREATING A SHOW:

Deciding which interviews will run on a given day’s show

With the assistance of producers, editing audio and video

Turning interviews into finished show segments, including the voicing of tags and tracking segment length

Creating show scripts

Creating reporter segments. These consist of voicing lead and tag provided by reporter for his or her taped or pre-produced segment. Also engineering and conducting audio and video interviews with staff reporters as daily show segments.

PROMO:

30-second daily element written, voiced and mixed by anchor, to promote subsequent day’s show.

WRITING:

Write newscast items and other news stories, as appropriate

Write occasional columns

TOOLS:

Familiarity with audio editing tools and newsroom content management systems is preferred, but willing to train the ideal candidate.

Qualifications

Experience in the public/federal government sector is strongly preferred.

Experience in journalism is preferred.

Working knowledge of social media platforms

Ability to multitask and work under pressure

Ability to work both alone and as part of a team

Strong leadership and communication skills

Project an appropriate and professional appearance and demeanor

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures

Ability to function well in a diverse team environment

Report to work on time

Ability to work weekdays. Must be able to work mornings and middays

Physical Requirements

Average sitting, standing and office-type movements. Light lifting, moving and pulling abilities. Ability to communicate in English both verbally and in writing. Ability to hear and see clearly. Dexterity to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as other office equipment. Requires the ability to think critically and tactically and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others verbally and in writing. Must be able to think quickly and work under tight deadlines and in high pressure situations. Ability to work in a variety of settings including outdoors. The successful candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job. The Company will make reasonable accommodations to facilitate a person's ability to perform those essential job functions.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

job.description:
Marketing, Community & Creative Services Director

#26-1354

Rochester (MN), Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KAAL-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

As an ABC6 News (KAAL-TV) employee, you are surrounded by opportunity while experiencing a forward-thinking philosophy. You will work among passionate, engaged professionals who work together to create content on Television and Digital platforms for our audience. Whether you are searching for a career On-Air, Behind-the-Scenes, or Marketing & Promotion, there is an opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive within ABC6 News and Hubbard Broadcasting.

Job Overview

KAAL ABC 6 News is seeking a highly organized, creative, and community-focused professional to serve as our Marketing, Community & Creative Services Director. This leadership position is responsible for leading the station's marketing, community outreach, event planning, brand management, and creative services efforts.

The ideal candidate is both a relationship-builder and a creative storyteller who can strengthen KAAL's connection with the communities we serve while developing impactful promotional campaigns across television, digital, social, and community platforms. This individual will serve as the station's primary coordinator for community engagement, marketing initiatives, station promotions, and creative services projects.

Job Responsibilities

Community Outreach & Engagement

Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of station community outreach initiatives, partnerships, and events.

Serve as the primary liaison between KAAL and local nonprofits, civic organizations, schools, businesses, and community groups.

Develop and maintain strategic partnerships that enhance KAAL's visibility and community impact.

Identify and secure opportunities for station participation in local events, public service initiatives, and fundraising campaigns.

Coordinate signature station initiatives including food drives, toy drives, school supply drives, awareness campaigns, and community service projects.

Represent KAAL at community events and ensure a professional and positive station presence.

Collaborate with News leadership to identify and promote community-focused stories and initiatives.

Creative Services & Brand Management

Manage the station's Creative Services function, ensuring consistent execution of KAAL's brand across all platforms.

Develop, write, produce, and coordinate on-air promotional campaigns for news, weather, special programming, community initiatives, and station events.

Maintain brand standards and ensure consistent messaging throughout all station communications.

Manage creative project workflows, production calendars, deadlines, and promotional priorities.

Coordinate photography, video production, talent appearances, and promotional shoots.

About Us

WNYT NewsChannel 13 is the award-winning NBC affiliate for New York State's Capital Region. We're a longtime market leader and we're committed to excellence in all we do. Whether it's live coverage of breaking news, investigative stories focused on finding solutions, or -- now more than ever -- top-notch digital content, we reach our viewers and followers across all platforms with the information they need to be informed, stay safe and plan their day.

New York's Capital Region is diverse and unique, offering a range of activities and experiences within reach all year long. Enjoy craft breweries and fine dining, water sports, winter sports, the hustle and bustle of city life -- or the calm, beautiful quiet of the Catskills. Albany sits just three hours from New York City or Boston, making experiences outside of the region just a drive, bus ride or train ride away. Whether you're an avid skier, a fan of farmers markets, enjoy theater, live music, professional sports, history, nature -- or all of the above -- the Capital Region has something for you.

When you work for Hubbard Broadcasting and WNYT, you're part of a team of dedicated and passionate professionals, pushing every day to serve our community. Here, collaboration is at the forefront, good ideas can come from anywhere and our community comes first. We're committed to the health and growth of our station culture and believe in a work environment that includes diverse backgrounds, cultures, and experiences. We strive to tell the stories of our community through the diverse eyes of our staff and provide an unbiased platform for all viewpoints. We push to advance our station culture through training, employee engagement and our everyday investment in each other.

Job Overview
