job.description:
Job Summary:

Brooklyn Bowl Nashville is hiring part-time barbacks. The starting rate is $15 per hour plus tip pool.


The Role:

Barback is responsible for bar service equipment/supply maintenance and set up.  This position will maintain the cleanliness of the bar and service area during the shift and perform functions under supervision as business requires.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain cleanliness of all bars and appearance of work area to meet departmental standards

  • Obtain bar stock, ice and service items from storage areas

  • Clean the bar area continuously during the shift
  • Remove used service items from the bar area as required
  • Assist Bartender with bar set-up and break-down as required
  • Cut (prepare) fruits and vegetables for cocktail garnishes
  • Clean, stock and replenish all items located at the bar and in the beverage storage areas
  • Possess an in- depth knowledge of beer, wine, spirits and cocktails

Required:

  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays
  • Ability to work later hours
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to work closely and efficiently with others
  • Performing reaching and stooping motions repeatedly
  • Move throughout the bar and venue areas during the entire shift
  • Work in an environment with loud music, smoke and crowds for extended periods of time
  • Stand or in a stationary position for entire shift

Preferred:

job.title: Call Center Agent (Part-time)
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – CALL CENTER AGENT

Location: Athens, Greece

Division: International Ticketing

Line Manager: Call Center Supervisor

Contract Terms: Permanent, Part-time Hours

 

 

THE JOB

 

The call centre agent answers incoming calls from customers to complete orders/selling tickets, answer inquiries and questions, handle complaints, troubleshoot problems and provide information. Satisfying the customers' needs and at the same time maintaining the good reputation of the company are the major call center agent’s responsibilities.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  •  Managing large amounts of inbound calls in a timely manner
  • Following call center “scripts” when handling different topics
  • Handling customer inquiries both by telephone and email
  • Researching required information using available resources (websites, manuals etc)
  • Managing and resolving customer complaints
  • Providing customers with information
  • Entering new customer data into system
  • Updating existing customer data in order to maintain call centre database
  • Processing orders
  • Identifying and promoting priority issues
  • Routing calls to appropriate resource
  • Following up customer calls where necessary
  • Documenting all call information according to standard operating procedures
  • Other tasks as may be directed by the Line Manager or Supervisor

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  •  Deep knowledge of Ticketmaster (Tickethour) technology to enable support customers.
  • Proficient in MS Office products and call centre equipment/software programs.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Flexibility and adaptability as you will be dealing every day with different personalities.
  • Customer Focus, Customer Service, Data Entry Skills, Listening, Phone Skills, Problem Solving.

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Outstanding verbal communication skills along with active listening
  • Ability to multi-task, set priorities and manage time effectively

 

 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

 

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. 

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

 

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

 

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

 

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

 We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

 

  • Anticipate and respond to guests’ needs
  • Suggestively sell beverages and menu items; take orders
  • Answer guest questions, make recommendations, up-sell liquors
  • Communicate drink orders to bar through Point of Sales system
  • Deliver drinks, maneuvering trays quietly while Comedian is on stage
  • Maintain line of sight/atmosphere control by circulating through your work area throughout shift
  • Remove dirty glasses and dishes from tables including the lifting/moving of bus tubs up to 25lbs.
  • Keep tables clean/wiped
  • Clean spills, remove food, trash or other obstacles from floor using proper lifting techniques
  • Maintain Company safety and sanitation standards

  • Assist other servers and staff as needed

  • Flexible schedule

  • 3 years’ work experience interacting with people in a positive environment
  • Tolerance of all cultures and art forms
  • Responsible Alcohol Awareness Training Certification or Equivalent
  • Ability to deal with intoxicated guests in a positive and safety minded manner

 

Preferred:

  • Cash handling experience
  • Experience recognizing valid ID’s
  • Experience in a live music environment

job.title: Corporate Controller
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Corporate Controller leads the day-to-day operations of the corporate accounting function, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial reporting across the organization. This role owns the monthly and quarterly close process and maintains a strong internal control environment in compliance with SOX. The Controller also manages and develops a team of accounting professionals, driving process improvement and operational efficiency.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Financial Reporting & Controls

  • Prepare and review monthly and quarterly Corporate Reporting packages, ensuring accuracy and responding to follow-up queries within tight turnaround times.
  • Prepare and review complex journal entries, ensuring compliance with GAAP and internal accounting policies.
  • Reconciliation of all balance sheet accounts and lead sheets, ensuring timely identification and resolution of variances.
  • Oversight over Banking, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable.

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Lead the annual SOX audit, including control walkthroughs.
  • Manage periodic internal and external audit requests.
  • Maintain and enforce a documented system of accounting policies and procedures to ensure SOX and internal control compliance.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and manage day-to-day operations of the corporate accounting team, ensuring deliverables are met within deadlines.
  • Coach, monitor, and evaluate direct reports' performance, driving improvements in process efficiency and effectiveness.

Intercompany & Tax Compliance

  • Oversee reconciliation and settlement of intercompany transactions, including transfer pricing impacts, across cross-border LN groups.
  • Oversee tax remittances (GST/HST, PST, QST, NRW, SOCAN) and year-end filings for NRW.

Administrative & Support

  • Oversee digital storage and organization of financial reports to support audit readiness.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA designation required.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including prior experience in a supervisory or managerial role.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, SOX compliance, and internal control frameworks.
  • Experience with multi-entity, cross-border, and intercompany accounting.
  • Familiarity with Canadian indirect tax requirements (GST/HST, PST, QST).
  • Strong analytical and account reconciliation skills.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems; Oracle Fusion experience preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve accounting processes an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

 


BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, Dental and Vision benefits for you and your family, along with Employee Assistant Programs through Modern Health and ComPsych 
  • YOURSELF:  Generous paid time off policy including holiday closures, and sick time for you and dependents, along with free concert tickets 
  • WEALTH: RRSP program with company match, Stock Program Reimbursement 
  • FAMILY: New parent programs & support including caregiver leave and baby bonus, and infertility support  
  • CAREER: Tuition reimbursement, student loan repayment internal growth and development programs & trainings  
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding network, gender reassignment support  

We thank all candidates for their interest, only those who will be selected for an interview will be contacted.

Sits for extended periods of time at a computer station or work desk; stands and walks throughout the day; occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.; uses hands and fingers to operate computers and office equipment for up to 8 hours each day; lifts up to 10 pounds regularly; exposed to typical office environment conditions and noise levels.

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE ROLE

The Recruiter will own full-cycle searches across Live Nation’s Corporate functions, from intake and calibration through sourcing, assessment, offer and close. Reporting to the Corporate Recruiting Manager, this role requires strong recruiting judgment, deep sourcing capability, and the ability to operate independently and with urgency. We are looking for someone who can build the search strategy, identify the right talent, advise hiring managers, and drive searches forward without waiting for a prescribed playbook.


The right candidate is polished, credible, and highly professional, with the presence to engage senior leaders and executive-level candidates. You should represent Live Nation exceptionally well in the market and be able to build trust quickly with both candidates and internal stakeholders. This role is based in our Beverly Hills or NYC office and requires in-office presence at least 2-3x per week, with additional in-office days as business needs require.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own full-cycle recruiting from intake through offer acceptance across multiple corporate functions and levels.
  • Operate with speed and precision while serving as a thoughtful, consultative partner to hiring managers
  • Raise the talent bar and build rigorous search strategies using competitive research, target-company identification, and direct sourcing
  • Proactively identify and engage passive, hard-to-reach and senior-level talent
  • Assess candidates critically and present well-calibrated slates based on capability, motivation and fit
  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and provide clear, informed guidance on talent, market conditions and search strategy
  • Recruit across Finance & Accounting, Technology, Marketing, Strategy and other corporate functions
  • Manage multiple searches simultaneously with strong organization, pace and follow-through
  • Negotiate and close candidate offers effectively, including senior roles
  • Maintain accurate recruiting data and adjust search strategy based on results
  • Contribute to recruitment events, projects, and stretch assignments as needed

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 5+ years of progressive full-cycle recruiting experience
  • Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, Psychology or a related field preferred
  • A polished, credible, and confident presence with candidates, hiring managers, and senior leaders
  • Demonstrated ability to independently have urgency, and run complex searches from intake through close
  • Strong hands-on sourcing expertise, including passive-candidate research, talent mapping and competitive analysis
  • Experience recruiting across multiple corporate functions and at senior and executive levels
  • Strong talent judgment and the ability to distinguish strong credentials from true role fit
  • Proven ability to influence hiring managers without authority and push for clarity and maintain high hiring standards
  • Experience working in a complex, high-performance organization and/or respected search firm
  • Strong closing and offer-negotiation skills
  • Expertise with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools; working knowledge of Workday and Gem or comparable platforms
  • Exceptional organization, discretion, attention to detail, and follow-through
  • Resourcefulness, intellectual curiosity and persistence in finding talent beyond obvious channels

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • You’re confident in your recruiting skills and have a track record of recruiting success
  • You have a demonstrated track record of delivering strong recruiting outcomes in demanding environments
  • You combine strong talent judgment with evidence, market knowledge, and disciplined assessment
  • You want meaningful ownership and are comfortable being accountable for results
  • You are resourceful and persistent, and do not stop at the obvious candidate pool

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

job.title: Cyber Security Architect
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE ROLE

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cyber Security Architecture, you will join a global, dedicated, multidisciplinary team of passionate cyber security professionals. 


This role collaborates closely with IT teams, Security Engineering, Security Operations, GRC, and other business units to ensure security configurations are aligned with our security standards, governance requirements, and industry best practices.


This role secures globally distributed cloud and on-premises environments supporting high-volume consumer platforms, live event infrastructure, and enterprise systems across multiple regions and business units.  


This highly technical role requires deep expertise across IT infrastructure, application, cloud, and security domains to ensure the organization’s applications and platforms are securely designed and configured. 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


  • Collaborate with the Third‑Party Risk Management team and the business to evaluate new applications and services, assess security controls, and ensure alignment with enterprise security requirements. 
  • Collaborate with IT teams to enforce security standards that enable secure technology solutions. 
  • Review AI platforms and Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, providing guidance on security, integration, and governance considerations.
  • Provide security guidance with a holistic view of how security configuration changes impact Security Operations, GRC compliance requirements, and Security Engineering workflows and tooling. 
  • Evaluate proposed application and platform configuration changes from business and Security Engineering teams, analyze their impact on the security posture and architectural standards, and make recommendations. 
  • Support cross-functional adoption of security controls for IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, including reference architectures and guardrails. 
  • Deliver security guidance related to creating and deploying network security controls such as firewall access control lists (ACLs). 
  • Assess changes in the external threat landscape using threat intelligence and collaborate with technology teams to guide the implementation of appropriate defensive controls. 
  • Assist in developing enterprise security standards aligned to industry frameworks (e.g. CIS Critical Security Controls), and partner with the business to ensure controls are clearly understood and effectively applied across technologies and use cases. 
  • Assist with evaluating security tools to ensure they meet business needs, security requirements, and architectural standards.  
  • Familiarity with applying security control frameworks, such as CIS Critical Security Controls or NIST SP 800-53, to architecture reviews and standards. 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING - REQUIRED


  • 6+ years of combined hands-on experience in at least 2 of the following areas: 
  • Windows, Linux/Unix server engineering 
  • Cloud engineering, preferably AWS 
  • Configuration of security tooling such as EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, SIEM, PAM, CSPM, DLP 
  • Experience in security architecture, security engineering or similar discipline 
  • Technical knowledge of networking concepts such as DNS, DHCP, VLANs, CIDR Ranges, Proxies, firewalls, and load balancers 
  • Ability to work in large global environments spanning multiple time zones 
  • Must be available for infrequent international and domestic travel 
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical professionals 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING - DESIRED


  • Experience with virtualization and containerization technologies (e.g. VMware, Docker) 
  • Experience developing scripts to automate manual tasks (Python preferred) 
  • Working knowledge of software development standards and SDLC concepts 
  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, Security+ or similar

job.description:

Who are we?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment and eCommerce company, comprised of four market leaders: Ticketmaster.com, Live Nation Concerts, Artist Nation and Live Nation Network.  Ticketmaster.com is the global event ticketing leader and one of the world’s top five eCommerce sites, with over 27 million monthly unique visitors.  Live Nation Concerts produces over 22,000 shows annually for more than 2,300 artists globally.  Artist Nation is the world’s top artist management company, representing over 250 artists.  These businesses power Live Nation Network, the leading provider of entertainment marketing solutions, enabling over 800 advertisers to tap into the 200 million consumers Live Nation delivers annually through its live event and digital platforms. HOB Entertainment, a division of Live Nation Entertainment, offers exceptional club venues nationwide. House of Blues Venues provide several genres of live music, from Rock, Hip Hop, Country, Rock en Español, Blues, Jazz, Reggae and Pop. House of Blues venues are also known for their southern-style cuisine, juke-joint inspired atmosphere and the World Famous Gospel Brunch.

House of Blues opened its doors on Thanksgiving Day in 1992, serving its first meal to the local shelters. Since opening, House of Blues has been committed to giving back to the community through the International House of Blues Foundation.

job.title: Housekeeping- Louisville Palace
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 



WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Keep floor neat, clean and free of food, trash and other obstacles throughout shift
  • Clean all spills immediately, use floor signs to caution guests and staff
  • Put all trash and recyclable products in proper receptacles
  • Clean and stock line to par throughout shift
  • Follow housekeeping standards per policy
  • Operate trash compactor per procedures policy
  • Ensure that trash cans/slim jims are clean, free of odor and lined
  • Keep all dust pans clean and free of stuck on debris/odor
  • Separate glass, cardboard and plastics per local codes
  • Pre-roll and store table paper, per venue specifications
  • Keep current on all standard operating procedures
  • Turn all lost and found items into MOD
  • Attend pre-shift meeting conducted by MOD prior to start of each shift
  • Assist Other Employees as needed
  • Clean and dust all areas of venue
  • Sweep and mop floors
  • Clean and maintains restrooms
  • Refill toilet paper, paper towel, sanitary napkin and soap dispense
  • Clean and polish hardware such as doors, woodwork, door handles, push plates, kick plates, metal handrails, cigarette urns and drinking fountains
  • Vacuum and spot clean rugs
  • Replace burned out light bulbs or report same to supervisor
  • Maintain service rooms and storage areas in a clean orderly manner
  • Maintain adequate supply of cleaning equipment, materials and supplies
  • Use cleaning tools such as mops, brooms, squeegees, cleaning cloths, sponges, pails, brushes, vacuum cleaners, etc.
  • Remove wastepaper baskets and containers, and empties same into trash containers and cleans area after trash has been picked up
  • Report all repairs required and safety and fire hazards to supervisor
  • Observe safety standards and practices
  • Additional general cleaning of venue
  • Perform related duties as required or assigned within job classification

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING


Required:

  • Three or more years in cleaning services or related type work
  • Ability to read, write and follow written instruction
  • Must have availability from 5:30p.m. to 4a.m.
  • Reliable Transportation
  • Reliable Access to internet via phone or computer
  • Detail-oriented and team player with a positive “can-do” attitude 
  • Early Morning & Day time availability
  • Sense of Urgency
  • Time Management
  • Kitchen sanitation standards
  • Critical thinking and decision making
  • High School diploma
  • Tolerance of all cultures, music and art forms

Preferred:

  • High volume kitchen operations
  • Food Service as either an Expeditor or Server in a high-volume environment
  • Exceptional communication skills

Physical Demands/Working Environment:

  • Work environment is fast-paced
  • Position requires extended periods of prolonged standing, bending, stooping, reaching, and working on your feet
  • Must be able to lift or move up to 50 lbs using proper lifting techniques
  • Tolerance of loud noises

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion.  You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work.  We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife.  As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.  It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

job.title: Insomniac - Director, Apparel & Accessories Design - Consumer Products - Motorsports
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Are you passionate about consumer products and motorsports? Do you thrive in apparel and accessories design? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a seasoned, creative, and collaborative design leader who can flex across apparel design, product strategy, trend direction, and cross-functional execution. Is this you? Read on… 


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction.  The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.


Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.


Insomniac is expanding its presence into motorsports apparel and merchandise, working with leading global brands and partners to create products that bring together the worlds of music, motorsport, and culture. 


THE ROLE

Insomniac is looking for a Director, Apparel & Accessories Design- Consumer Products - Motorsports to lead the creative direction, design organization and execution of apparel and accessories across the Consumer Products - Motorsports portfolio. This role establishes the functional design strategy and operating direction for multiple product categories, seasonal collections and consumer opportunities, translating brand direction, consumer insights, and market trends into compelling global products with locally relevant narratives.


The Director leads design management and apparel, accessories and graphic designers. The role is accountable for team performance, creative quality, talent development, resource allocation, design-process effectiveness, and cross-functional delivery. Partnering closely with Product Line Management, Product Development, Merchandising, Marketing, and external partners, the Director ensures collections are commercially relevant, technically feasible, on brand, and delivered on time. 


The position reports to the SVP, Consumer Products - Motorsports. This is a full time, on site position with work at events and approximately 30% domestic and international travel.



RESPONSIBILITIES 

Creative and Functional Leadership

  • Establish and execute the near-and medium-term creative direction, design strategy, and operating plan for Consumer Products - Motorsports decision apparel and accessories portfolio
  • Lead design direction across multiple product categories, ensuring collections reflect brand strategy, target-consumer needs, key seasonal concepts, geographic assortment needs, and commercial objectives
  • Translate consumer insights, cultural trends, market intelligence, and brand direction into clear seasonal creative frameworks, category strategies, and design priorities
  • Set and uphold standards for premium craft, product storytelling, material and color direction, it, silhouette, technical innovation and execution quality
  • Champion authentic product narratives and clearly communicate the strategic and consumer rationale behind design decisions to senior leadership, cross-functional partners, and external stakeholders
  • Maintain awareness of relevant cultural, sport, fashion and lifestyle trends; apply insights to create differentiated and consumer-relevant product

People Leadership and Talent Development

  • Directly manage the design management and a team of designers; establish clear goals, performance expectations, development plans, and accountability for creative and operational outcomes
  • Lead the design management to set team priorities, allocate work, monitor capacity, and ensure consistent delivery across design workstreams
  • Recruit, onboard, coach, develop and retain design talent; build succession plans and future capacity for the function
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high performing creative culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, constructive feedback and accountability
  • Provide senior creative guidance, coaching and decision support on complex product, trend, aesthetic, fit, material and execution challenges
  • Establish scalable design processes, team rituals, documentation, and quality standards that enable consistent execution as the function grows

Seasonal Design and Product Execution

  • Lead the creation and execution of seasonal apparel and accessories collections from concept through prototype review, final sample approval, and go to market readiness
  • Partner with product line management to establish seasonal design toolboxes, product briefs, design slots, category direction, and product creation priorities
  • Guide development of color, material, functionality, fit, proportion, silhouette, graphic and styling direction across the assortment
  • Ensure designs balance consumer appeal, brand expression, quality, technical feasibility, margin requirements, and production realities
  • Oversee prototype development, fittings, sample reviews, and design revisions; partner with product development to finalize production details and resolve quality or feasibility issues
  • Lead design reviews and creative decision points, ensuring timely approvals and alignment across collections and categories
  • Create and manage design calendar, deliverables and dependencies; resolve execution risks and keep multiple seasonal workstreams on track

Cross-Functional, Vendor, and Business Partnership

  • Partner with product line management, product development, merchandising, marketing, supply chain, and finance to align creative direction with product strategy, consumer needs, margin targets and go to market plans
  • Collaborate with external vendors and manufacturing partners on pre-development, material exploration, technical innovation, and product-execution requirements
  • Provide senior design presentation in product, assortment, commercialization, and executive planning discussions
  • Communicate design vision, collection, direction, risks, and recommendations effectively to internal teams, senior leadership, and external partners
  • Develop functional resources and capacity plans, including staffing, freelance, external creative, and vendor needs, in partnership with leadership
  • Identify and implement improvements to design workflows, tools, systems, and cross-functional ways of working to improve speed, quality, and creative consistency
  • Lead additional strategic design, product, and organizational initiatives as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in fashion design, apparel design, product design, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible apparel and accessories design experience design experience within the apparel, sportswear, lifestyle, or consumer-products industry
  • 5+ years of direct people-leadership experience, including managing and developing design professionals and at least one people manager or senior design direct report
  • Demonstrated experience establishing creative direction and leading multiple apparel or accessories categories through seasonal concept, design, development and commercialization
  • Extensive expertise in apparel materials, garment construction, outerwear functionality, fit, technical design, tech packs, schematic development, and sample execution across lifestyle and performance products
  • Strong collection-building and assortment-design capability, including the ability to translate consumer and market insights into cohesive product narratives across color, silhouette, material, graphics and key looks
  • Demonstrated ability to lead design teams through complex, multi-category calendars while balancing creative ambition, consumer relevance, financial goals, quality, and execution requirements
  • Experience partnering effectively with product line management, product development, merchandising, marketing, and domestic and international vendors or manufacturers
  • Proven ability to develop talent, build high-performing teams, manage performance, and create effective design processes and operating rhythms
  • Strong strategic thinking, decision-making, presentation, communication, relationship building, and problem solving skills
  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, 3D design, and AI-powered rendering software
  • Experience thriving in high-growth, evolving environments, with the ability to build structure, manage ambiguity, and lead multiple complex creative priorities
  • Knowledge of motorsport, sport, or lifestyle consumer segments is preferred
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel approximately 30%, including international travel

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be willing to travel to work during holidays, evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines.
  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels and drastic temperature climates while working on site at various event locations. 
  • Must be able to work in open concept office space.

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Insomniac for a visa.

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you enjoy dance music? Do you excel at marketing within the EDM space? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who embodies both a passion for music & culture and a love of marketing. Is this you? Read on… 


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.


THE ROLE

Insomniac Events is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Marketing Campaign Specialist to play an integral role in the daily operations and marketing of branded shows and festivals. This position will report to the Marketing Manager and will work in-office at the Calabasas, CA location and various on site event locations. This is not a remote position.      


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Specialize in creating and executing 360 marketing campaigns for shows and festivals; leading teams across digital advertising, social media, integrated technology, street marketing etc. 
  • Partner closely with the executive producer, marketing vertical leads, artists & managers and regularly communicates key marketing information and targets to internal and external partners
  • Execute cultural campaigns: Tailor marketing messaging, asset selection, and promotional strategies to reflect the distinct subcultures, visual aesthetics, and sound profiles of Day Trip and Factory 93
  • Leverage music and artist dynamics: Drive campaign narratives around key lineup structures, special b2b sets, record label crossovers, and exclusive stage takeovers. Have a deep working knowledge, and stay current with house and techno artists.
  • Curate high-engagement short-form content: Identify high impact track IDS, live set clips, and stage production moments to develop authentic short-form video content (reels / tiktok) that resonates with niche house and techno communities
  • Target endemic media & communities: Partner with genre-specific media outlets (Resident Advisor, Dice, other house and techno blogs and pages) and monitor niche digital hubs to amplify show announcements and community engagement.
  • Manage marketing budgets across all assigned projects and ensure that resources are allocated effectively, efficiently, and accurately
  • Lead internal & external meetings as the main speaker conveying objectives & solutions
  • Analyze week-to-week ticketing, site traffic, social media engagement, and digital advertising data; Adapt marketing plans based on insights from this data 
  • Be on top of new trends and techniques to execute the best and most forward-thinking campaigns for your assigned brands and projects, sharing actionable insights with the team 
  • Ensure fluid and accurate communication across all relevant project stakeholders
  • Manage third party marketing campaigns for your assigned projects
  • Recommend process improvement initiatives pertaining to the overall marketing workflow
  • Report on key statistics around audience growth and engagement 
  • Work closely with in-house design and new media (video and moving image) teams to develop marketing campaign assets; Ensuring creative requests are being submitted accurately, strategically, thoroughly, and timely
  • Hire and manage independent video, design, and other specialized contractors to develop necessary marketing assets for your assigned projects
  • Manage execution of on-site marketing efforts across media, social, street teams, etc for relevant events within your assigned brands’ portfolios
  • Obtain relevant approvals for marketing and social media assets 

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Deep house and techno fluency: In depth knowledge of electronic sub genres, history, artist hierarchies, and subcultural nuances within house, tech house, deep tech, industrial techno, underground dance music.
  • Understanding of dance music aesthetics: Familiarity with the distinct and visual tone of voice differences required for day time / open air house events versus underground warehouse experiences.
  • Active pulse on electronic music trends: Up to date awareness of trending tracks, unreleased IDs, label imprints, and emerging sounds across the global and SoCal nightlife ecosystems.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years relevant working experience in marketing, and/or music
  • Exceptionally high attention to detail working in a fast paced environment
  • Deep knowledge of electronic music, artists, genres, culture, and Insomniac brands
  • Articulate speaker who is affable & solution-oriented that is comfortable leading meetings
  • Proven ability to lead and execute complex and high volume marketing campaigns
  • Excel at branded writing (marketing in the voice/tone of a distinct brand, character, etc.)
  • Ability to multitask on fast-paced timelines, adapt quickly to change, and field requests from different teams simultaneously
  • Ability to systematically execute on tight deadlines
  • Experience with marketing, Photoshop, HTML, Google Analytics preferred
  • Adaptability to execute tasks off-hours at short notice if needed

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments
  • May work in drastic temperature climates on site at our events
  • Must be willing to frequently work and travel to events during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines and work events

job.title: Insomniac - Sr. Manager Marketing, Consumer Products - Motorsports
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Are you passionate about consumer products and motorsports? Do you thrive in retail marketing? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a driven, creative, and culturally fluent marketer who understands the world of Formula 1 and experiential retail marketing and can flex across both traditional and digital marketing. Is this you? Read on…


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.


Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.


Insomniac is expanding its presence into motorsports apparel and merchandise, working with leading global brands and partners to create products that bring together the worlds of music, motorsport, and culture.


THE ROLE

Insomniac is looking for a Senior Manager of Marketing, Consumer Products to lead the strategy, planning and execution of integrated retail and consumer-products marketing initiatives across the portfolio. This senior level individual contributor role develops compelling marketing programs and fan experiences that build brand connection, support commercial objectives and drive awareness, traffic, and product demand. This position will partner with intellectual property partners directly to manage retail, ecommerce, wholesale, brand marketing, creative, digital, public relations, sales and Insomniac teams, to translate brand and business priorities into actionable marketing plans. The role leads through marketing expertise, project ownership, budget accountability, and cross-functional influence. This full time, on site position reports to the SVP, Consumer Products - Motorsports and requires work at sporting events and approximately 30% domestic and international travel.


RESPONSIBILITIES
Marketing Strategy and Planning

  • Develop and execute integrated retail and consumer-products marketing plans that support fan engagement, retail experiences, e-commerce, wholesale, and broader commercial objectives
  • Partner with intellectual property brand marketing partners and Insomniac stakeholders to translate overarching brand direction into consumer-products marketing strategies, campaign priorities, and execution plans
  • Lead campaign planning across the full marketing mix, including social media, digital advertising, email, public relations, influencer, partnership retail, and on-site activation channels
  • Use consumer insights, market trends, retail performance, campaign results, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and recommend marketing strategies
  • Develop campaign briefs, strategic recommendations, timelines, success measures, and integrated launch plans for priority initiatives
  • Lead ideation for distinctive retail, product, content, and fan engagement moments that reinforce brand storytelling and create memorable consumer experiences

Campaign Execution and Channel Management

  • Independently lead end to end execution of assigned marketing campaigns, ensuring work is delivered on time, on brand, within budget, and in alignment with approved strategy
  • Partner with intellectual property digital marketing stakeholders to develop coordinated content and social media plans that support campaign objectives and long term brand positioning
  • Lead integrated campaign execution across digital, social, email, influencer, public relations, partnership, retail and on site channels
  • Manage relationships with external agencies, vendors, and marketing partners, including campaign briefs, scope of work, timelines, deliverables, quality standards and performance
  • Initiate and manage development of campaign assets, partnering with intellectual property creative stakeholders and internal teams to ensure assets meet approved creative, brand and channel requirements
  • Coordinate marketing deliverables, dependencies, and approvals across partner teams; maintain clear project plans and proactively resolve risks or delays
  • Support product photography, retail marketing, promotional packages, and race-event marketing activations as assigned

Budget, Performance and Operational Management

  • Manage assigned marketing budgets, including campaign, media, vendor, agency, production and activation expenditures
  • Track spend, forecast budget needs, manage purchase and invoice processes, and partner with Finance and Accounting to maintain accurate reporting
  • Analyst campaign performance, return on investment, cost efficiency, audience engagement, and commercial results; provide actionable recommendations to improve future initiatives
  • Develop regular reporting and presentations for the SVP, Consumer Products and other key stakeholders, communicating campaign status, results, risks and opportunities
  • Establish and improve marketing processes, tools, reporting and project management practices that strengthen planning, visibility, and execution across campaigns
  • Provide functional guidance and support to junior contributors and cross-functional partners on marketing tools, processes, assets and campaign requirements

Public Relations and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with intellectual property press and public relations teams to support press releases, publicity opportunities, media outreach, and campaign communications
  • Serve as a key liaison between Insomniac, intellectual properties, external agencies, vendors, and marketing partners to ensure coordinated, consistent, and effective consumer-facing campaigns
  • Build trusted relationships across retail, ecommerce, wholesale, creative, digital, sales, finance, legal and operations teams
  • Communicate campaign priorities, status, decisions, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Lead additional strategic marketing, consumer-products, retail and operational initiatives as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS


  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Fashion Marketing, Retail Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
  • 8+ years of progressively complex experience in retail marketing, fashion marketing, consumer products marketing, brand marketing, ecommerce marketing, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience independently developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, retail, activation, public relations, influencer and partnership channels
  • Experience managing campaign, agency, media, production, or activation budget and analyzing marketing performance, return on interment and cost efficiency
  • Experience managing campaign, agency, media, production, or activation budgets and analyzing marketing performance, return on investment and cost efficiency
  • Experience partnering with creative teams, external agencies, vendors, retail partners, and cross functional business stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of retail and consumer marketing, fan or customer engagement, ecommerce, product marketing and consumer trends
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex campaigns and workstreams simultaneously, establish priorities, and deliver against deadlines with limited oversight
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, budget management, critical thinking and problem solving
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Google Sheets and GOogle Docs;experience with project management, digital marketing, reporting rolls
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and communicate complex marketing plans clearly
  • Experience thriving in high growth, evolving environments, with the ability to create structure, manage ambiguity, and advance multiple priorities as business needs change
  • Collaborative, resourceful and proactive approach, with strong ownership and sound judgment
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel approximately 30% including international travel

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be willing to travel to work during holidays, evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines.
  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels and drastic temperature climates while working on site at various event location.

job.title: Intermediate Frontend Developer (Cape Town, South Africa)
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Intermediate Frontend Developer

Location: Cape Town, South Africa

Division: Quicket

Contract Terms: Full-time

 

THE TEAM

 

You will join Quicket’s Engineering team, responsible for building and evolving the technology that powers seamless ticketing experiences for event organisers and fans. The team works closely with Product, UX/UI, Operations and wider Ticketmaster colleagues to deliver secure, reliable and scalable solutions across web and mobile platforms.

 

As part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment, the team focuses on creating intuitive customer journeys, supporting high-demand live events and continuously improving the performance, accessibility and resilience of our products.

 

THE JOB

 

As an Intermediate Frontend Developer at Quicket, a Ticketmaster company, you will help build and enhance fast, scalable and intuitive digital experiences for fans and event organisers around the world. Quicket combines local market expertise with the scale, technology and global reach of Ticketmaster and Live Nation Entertainment.


Working primarily with Angular, you will develop high-quality web applications that are reliable, accessible and performant, particularly during high-demand event periods. You will work closely with senior engineers, Product and UX/UI teams to turn ideas and designs into secure, user-friendly solutions.


While this is a front-end-focused role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to backend development in .NET / .NET Core where needed. AI is an integral part of how we build software, and you will use AI-powered development tools in your everyday workflow to support design, coding, testing, code review and documentation. You will apply sound engineering judgement, validate AI-generated output and stay informed about emerging tools and practices that improve the quality and efficiency of our work.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 

  • Develop and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using Angular.
  • Use AI tools (e.g. coding assistants, agents and LLM-based tooling) as a core part of your daily workflow to design, build, test, review and document code faster and to a higher standard.
  • Contribute to AI-powered product features where relevant, such as integrating LLM APIs into user-facing experiences.
  • Work closely with UX/UI/product teams to translate designs into accessible, user-friendly interfaces.
  • Integrate with backend services and RESTful APIs, and contribute to backend development (.NET / .NET Core) when required.
  • Implement secure coding practices and ensure compliance with PCI DSS and GDPR.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow front-end best practices, including the responsible use of AI-generated code.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly, and ensure vulnerabilities are managed in a timely manner.

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Demonstrated equivalent experience will be considered in place of formal qualifications.
  • 4 – 6 years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on front-end development using Angular.
  • Demonstrable experience using AI tools as an integral part of your development workflow.
  • Experience working on large-scale consumer-facing applications.
  • Knowledge of global compliance standards (PCI DSS, GDPR) is a plus.

 

KPIs & Performance Metrics

  • Code Quality: Maintain high standards with minimal defects.
  • Feature Delivery: Complete assigned tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Performance Optimisation: Ensure front-end responsiveness under load.
  • Security Compliance: Zero major compliance breaches.
  • Collaboration: Positive feedback from team and stakeholders.
  • Continuous Learning: Adoption of new technologies, AI tools and best practices.

 

Core Technical Skills (Required)

  • Angular – Strong, proven experience building complex, dynamic and responsive web applications (TypeScript, RxJS, component architecture, state management).
  • AI-assisted development – Deep, hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) as a core part of your workflow, not an occasional add-on.
  • Strong understanding of how to work effectively with AI: prompting, providing context, reviewing and validating AI output, and knowing its limitations.
  • HTML, CSS/SCSS and modern front-end tooling, with a focus on performance and accessibility.
  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (Git).
  • Willingness to pick up and contribute to backend work as needed.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • .NET / .NET Core (C#) – Backend development experience.
  • React Native – Experience building or contributing to mobile applications.
  • AWS – Familiarity with cloud services and deployments.
  • MSSQL – Knowledge of database design and query optimisation.

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Adaptability and willingness to step outside the front end when the team needs it.
  • Ability to work under pressure during peak event periods.



LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

 

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. 

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

 

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

 

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

 

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

job.title: Lead CX Platform Engineer(Manchester, United Kingdom)
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Lead CX Platform Engineer

Location: Manchester, United Kingdom (hybrid)

Division: Fan Support Technology

Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-time


THE TEAM


Live Nation Entertainment is the largest live entertainment company in the world, consisting of five businesses: concert promotion and venue operations, sponsorship, ticketing solutions, ecommerce, and artist management. Live Nation seeks to innovate and enhance the live entertainment experience for artists and fans: before, during and after the show.
 

At Ticketmaster Fans come first. We care passionately about our fans’ interaction with our service channels and as the world’s leading ticketing company, we are committed to setting the standard for a great fan experience. Our technology and services help make it easier for fans to connect with their favorite events and performers.


THE JOB


As a Lead Systems Engineer within the Global Fan Experience team, you will be the technical leader within your team for the design, configuration, and maintenance of contact center technology platforms serving 100+ different Ticketmaster & Live Nation brands around the world. You will lead cross-functional problem-solving, mentor and guide junior engineers, and coordinate resources across multiple teams to deliver complex, multi-team initiatives. Balancing competing priorities, you will drive alignment on system-level decisions, shape medium-term technical planning, and ensure our agent workspace platforms are scalable, secure, resilient, and well integrated with the wider ecosystem — while ensuring customer data is properly managed and protected.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Providing technical leadership within the team and owning the architecture, global configuration framework, reusable workflow patterns, and complex engineering changes for SaaS contact center platforms such as Zendesk and Five9. Establishing standards and guardrails for business administrators, while routine administration and local macros, views, and workflow configuration remain business-owned.
  • Leading the design of scalable, performant, secure, and resilient systems and integrations — defining clear system boundaries and ensuring alignment with both business and technical requirements.
  • Leading cross-functional problem-solving, coordinating resources across teams, and driving alignment on system-level decisions and trade-offs.
  • Mentoring and coaching junior engineers, sharing knowledge, and raising the technical bar across the team.
  • Leading improvements in system performance, incident resolution processes, and cost optimization, balancing operational efficiency with stability and proactively identifying risks.
  • Owning deployment automation and modular development practices, and building and maintaining custom integrations with other systems and applications using APIs.
  • Monitoring performance, ensuring availability, and leading troubleshooting and root-cause resolution of complex incidents as they arise.
  • Supporting, implementing, and optimizing contact center channels and workflows across markets.
  • Establishing and maintaining operating procedures, documentation, code review, and QA standards for the administration of the platforms in line with company policies and processes.
  • Applying AI tools appropriately to explore data, code, and processes that accelerate delivery and decision-making, validating outputs carefully for accuracy and bias.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Proven years of experience managing and configuring CX/CRM and contact center platforms, including a track record of acting as a technical leader within a team.
  • Proven experience leading the design of scalable, resilient, and secure systems and architectures, including defining system boundaries and planning for long-term scalability.
  • Strong operational excellence background: deployment automation, monitoring, incident resolution, and cost optimization.
  • Experience with multi-channel environments, including voice, email, social, chat/chatbots, and automations.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and coordinating work across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and data analysis skills, with the ability to balance competing objectives and drive alignment on system-level decisions.
  • Ability to lead projects and manage workload and multi-team initiatives within predefined time windows.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Working familiarity with AI tools and their appropriate application, including validating outputs for accuracy and bias.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Microsoft 365, Google Analytics, RESTful APIs, JIRA, Confluence, Zendesk, Five9, Decagon AI or equivalent contact center technologies preferred.
  • Experience with large contact centers is a plus.
  • Zendesk Certification Preferred.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Working Professionally: You set and role-model high standards, consistently meeting quality standards even with competing priorities, and proactively communicate progress.
  • Working to Achieve Results: You take ownership and deliver results with appropriate independence, handle setbacks constructively by focusing on solutions and learning, and weigh both the short- and long-term impact of your work.
  • Working with Others: You proactively seek collaboration opportunities, share knowledge and resources to strengthen working relationships, and adjust your communication to ensure clarity and respect across different audiences and contexts.
  • Working Innovatively: You help solve cross-functional challenges by sharing ideas and seeking input from other perspectives, and you identify opportunities to add value through improved processes, solutions, and collaboration.


 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER


We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.


Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. 


We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

job.title: LN Concerts, Social Insights Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

THE JOB

The Social Insights Analyst will play a key role in Live Nation Entertainment’s Concert division, living and breathing in social listening, reporting and analytics from start to finish, including query building, dashboard development and delivering reports. This role will uncover insights and trends for actionable storytelling opportunities, guide marketing strategy, and inform cross-functional partners on social, cultural, and influencer trends. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Analytics & Strategy, this position is ideal for someone who thrives in building scalable analytics systems while staying deeply connected to cultural and platform trends and developments. 

We're looking for a data-minded storyteller who lives at the intersection of social media and analytics. You'll own reporting and measurement for earned conversation tied to tours, on-sales, and artist activations. This is a great fit for someone who's equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and a comment section.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own measurement and analysis of earned social conversation: mentions, share of voice, sentiment, engagement on non-owned posts, organic reach, and virality across Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Run social listening across tour cycles (from announcements, on-sales to live moments), tracking fan sentiment, conversation volume, and flagging shifts in real time.
  • Measure fan- and creator-generated content (UGC): what's made, how it spreads, which moments drive organic amplification, and how artists, media, and fan accounts pick it up.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports (daily, weekly, campaign-level, ad-hoc, and post-mortem), using Boolean logic to sharpen queries and insights delivery.
  • Run competitive and benchmark analysis to contextualize our performance.
  • Build alert systems for emerging artist topics, trends, and brand risks, supporting Community Management, Marketing, and PR/Comms in shaping response messaging.
  • Partner with social listening-tool vendors and cross-functional teams to improve benchmarks, KPIs, alerts, and depth of insight.
  • Uncover fan insights through audience demographics to help guide campaign planning

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 2–4 years in social media analytics, social listening, and/or digital insights with a focus on earned measurement (agency or in-house social team preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with social listening and publishing tools (Meltwater, Brandwatch, Sprout, Quid, etc.) plus platform-native analytics.
  • Comfortable with audience demographic tools such as Audiense as well as platform follower demographics through CreatorIQ.
  • Fluency in earned-social metrics (share of voice, sentiment, mention volume) and a clear sense of which ones actually matter.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and a solid grasp of Boolean logic for query development.
  • Proven ability to own analytics end-to-end (query design, reporting, dashboard development and maintenance), with a track record of spotting and fixing gaps in reporting infrastructure.
  • Deep understanding of social platforms as both a fan and an analyst: how conversation forms, why things spread, what fans respond to, plus genuine curiosity about cultural trends, emerging formats, and creator marketing.
  • Strong communication skills: you can turn a spike in conversation into a one-slide "so what" for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines under pressure.
  • A proactive, collaborative team player who flags insights before they're asked for and adapts to evolving leadership needs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, or a related field.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Passion for live music, touring, and artist marketing.
  • Experience with sentiment analysis, text/topic classification, or unstructured conversation data.
  • Familiarity with creator/influencer earned-coverage measurement.
  • Experience connecting earned social signals to broader marketing or fan-growth outcomes.

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

Live Nation is looking for a highly organized Legal Assistant to join our legal team in Houston, TX. You will be the front door for the team's workload, keeping attorneys running smoothly by managing the contract pipeline from assignment through execution for a high volume of sponsorship, vendor, artist, and influencer agreements.

 

This role is built for someone who thinks in systems. You bring structure to busy workloads, catch details others miss, and look for smarter ways to work, including building and refining AI prompts and agents that help the team draft, negotiate, and analyze contracts. Paralegal certification is preferred.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Serve as the front door for managing the contract pipeline in Asana and routing work to the right attorneys, understanding their individual workloads and the demands of Divisional stakeholders.
  • Maintain the legal team's ‘playbook’ and contract database, making daily updates so attorneys always work from the most current templates, contract language, and resources.
  • Manage contract execution in DocuSign, confirming that every document sent for signature is the final version approved by the attorneys
  • Organize and maintain electronic files according to team and records policies
  • Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders and vendors, keep requests moving, Communicating pipeline issues and subject matter concerns to the Division’s operations team.
  • Assist with legal research, fact gathering, and summarizing documents for attorneys
  • Help create, test, and refine AI prompts and agents that support how the team drafts, negotiates, and analyzes contracts
  • Use AI tools responsibly to summarize long documents, organize information, update files, and streamline repetitive tasks, always verifying output for accuracy and protecting confidential information
  • Identify process improvements and help build templates, checklists, and workflows that make the team more efficient
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion at all times

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 2+ years of experience as a paralegal, legal assistant, legal secretary, or in a similar administrative role in a law firm, legal department, or professional services setting
  • Bachelor's or Associate's degree is required
  • Paralegal certification is preferred

job.description:
