Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

This position will manage the day-to-day operations of the Box Office department within the scope of generally accepted practices and procedures for all Live Nation owned & operated and third-party venues, as necessary. 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

 

Managerial Duties

  • Serve as the main Ticketing contact for all events at the venue(s) or locations assigned
  • Develop strong working relationships with Live Nation promoters, ticketing staff, guests, and affiliated partners
  • Manage the hiring, training, scheduling, and day-to-day supervision of all Box Office personnel
  • Ensure all Box Office staff adheres to the company’s ticket operations policies and procedures
  • Collaborate with internal departments and external event personnel to ensure all ticketing needs are addressed
  • Organize and oversee nightly Box Office operations during events (Ticket Sales, Will Call, Ticketing Scanning, etc.)
  • Create a positive & collaborative working environment and maintain staff morale
  • Ensure Ticketing department delivers exceptional customer service to all guests and works proactively to resolve any issues that arise

 

Event Management

  • Build and maintain all events for venue(s) or locations assigned within the appropriate ticketing software
  • Assist talent buyers, tour personnel and internal staff, as necessary, with event programming, reporting, ticket holds and other ticketing details
  • Work with the Marketing, Production and Talent departments, artist management and label representatives to set-up events, place holds, process orders, and release tickets in a timely fashion
  • Assist with the monitoring of all ticket inventory
  • Collaborate with Pricing team to monitor and dynamically price tickets to maximize revenue
  • Partner with Ancillary Product team and Venue General Manager to create and optimize ancillary products to drive incremental revenue
  • Ensure ADA Compliant Ticketing Practices

 

Accounting/Financial Duties

  • Maintain accurate Box Office accounting records and archives
  • Ensure venue Box Office staff adheres to company’s cash handling policies and procedures
  • Perform daily Box Office safe reconciliation, prepare deposits, and run all daily financial reporting
  • Responsible for the preparation of all Box Office settlement reports on event nights
  • Actively participate in event settlements, as needed

 

Other Duties

  • Monitor all ticketing software and hardware and report any issues immediately
  • Embrace all new ticketing technology provided by Ticketmaster including TM1 Entry, TM1 Sales, TM1 Events etc.
  • Keep current with all key ticketing trends in entertainment industry
  • Attend all relevant meetings, discussions, and conferences as the venue’s ticketing lead
  • Any additional duties as assigned by leadership

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

 

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or comparable work experience
  • 2-3 years’ experience as a Box Office manager or representative, including management level work experience
  •  Strong knowledge of customer service, computer operations, and accounting/cash management procedures
  • Understanding of Ticketing systems including, but not limited to Ticketmaster Host, Archtics, AccountManager and the TM1 product suite
  • Previous experience managing season ticket business and ancillary products such as VIP Parking, Club and other premium hospitality offerings
  • Ability to provide leadership, engage in positive interaction with staff and guests, prioritize, organize, motivate staff, problem solve, delegate, follow-up, communicate and diffuse possibly volatile situations with tact
  • Ability to communicate respectfully with diplomacy across all levels of business is essential
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.)
  • Ability to work evening and weekend hours, based on the needs of daily business operations
  • Detail-oriented with a strong ability to work under pressure to meet strict and fluid deadlines

This role partners with business unit leaders, Human Resources, hiring managers, and other stakeholders across LNE to create and implement sustainable recruiting programs that address both immediate and long-term staffing needs.

 

This remote role leads full-time hiring for entry-level, mid-level, and senior-level positions across Live Nation Venues, including roles supporting shared services, clubs, theaters, amphitheaters, large indoor venues, and comedy clubs. The Recruiter sources, screens, interviews, recommends candidates, and manages the offer process.

 

The ideal candidate is highly organized, relationship-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with high-volume and event-based staffing needs.

  • Lead intake meetings with hiring managers to define role requirements, candidate profiles, interview processes, and hiring timelines.
  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 10–15 active requisitions at a time, prioritizing work effectively to meet business needs.

  • Extend, negotiate, and close employment offers; prepare offer letters and ensure all pre-employment documentation is accurate and completed on time.
  • Maintain accurate, timely candidate and requisition data in Workday, while leveraging Gem AI and other recruiting technologies to improve sourcing efficiency, candidate outreach, talent-pipeline management, and overall recruiting operations.

  • Experience managing multiple requisitions simultaneously and executing all stages of the recruiting process, from intake and sourcing through interview coordination, offer creation, negotiation, and close.
  • Knowledge of sourcing strategies and recruitment channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, job boards, referrals, networking, and community-based outreach.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate-assessment skills and excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating with the recruitment team on shared talent pipelines and projects.
  • Commitment to building inclusive candidate pipelines and delivering a positive, professional candidate and hiring-manager experience.

job.title: Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation
job.description:
Job Summary:

Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation 
Location: US- Remote 
Division: Global Product Analytics and Experimentation 
Line Manager: Sr. Director, Global Product Analytics and Insights 
Contract Terms: ****6 months**** 


THE TEAM 
The Global Product Analytics and Experimentation team at Ticketmaster is a highly skilled, collaborative group that finds opportunities to improve the product and grow revenue through rigorous analysis, experimentation, and new ways of looking at data. The team partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Finance. Our work covers fan insights, ticket sales, shopping behavior, site and app analytics, incremental revenue streams, venue and client analysis, and customer lifetime value. 


THE JOB 
We are seeking an experienced experimentation and product analytics leader to join Global Product Analytics and Experimentation. As Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation, you will lead the development of a scalable experimentation practice that drives product decisions and improves the fan experience. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution: setting experimentation standards, onboarding and enabling teams, configuring and managing tests in Optimizely, analyzing results with rigor, and turning learnings into clear product recommendations. You will partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to make experimentation part of every stage of product development. 


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING 

  • Lead and scale the product experimentation program, including processes, governance, measurement standards, and team onboarding. 
  • Serve as the hands-on subject-matter expert for Optimizely, including experiment setup, audience targeting, QA, instrumentation validation, and test monitoring. 
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify testing opportunities and design statistically sound A/B, multivariate, and other experiments. 
  • Interpret experiment results, explain what they mean and where they fall short, and turn findings into recommendations that shape product strategy and roadmap decisions. 
  • Work with stakeholders to define and measure key digital metrics tied to fan and business goals. 
  • Use data analysis to find trends, patterns, and opportunities that improve the end-to-end fan experience. 
  • Build analytics tools, methods, and self-service resources that help teams make better data-informed decisions. 
  • Translate business questions into analytical and experimentation solutions. 
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and counterparts across the North America Insights and Analytics organization. 
  • Partner with the Research team to combine behavioral, experimental, and qualitative insights into a deeper understanding of fan needs. 

 

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (OR TECHNICAL SKILLS) 

  • Demonstrated experience leading and executing a product experimentation program, from hypothesis development and test design through implementation, analysis, and recommendations. 
  • Hands-on experience with Optimizely or a comparable experimentation platform, including configuring, QA-ing, launching, and monitoring experiments. 
  • Advanced statistical knowledge, including hypothesis testing, power analysis and sample-size planning, confidence intervals, sequential testing, multiple-comparison correction, and variance reduction techniques. 
  • Proven ability to spot and address common experimentation pitfalls, such as sample ratio mismatch, peeking, novelty effects, and interaction effects between concurrent tests. 
  • Ability to design and run complex product experiments, including A/B and multivariate tests. 
  • Advanced proficiency with AI tools and LLMs to speed up and scale analytics work, such as writing and debugging queries, automating recurring analysis and reporting, generating test hypotheses, and summarizing results. Strong judgment to check AI output for accuracy. 
  • Experience with digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Contentsquare. 
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, with hands-on experience in Databricks and Google BigQuery. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex analytical and experimental findings into clear, compelling stories for non-technical audiences. 

YOU (BEHAVIORAL SKILLS) 

  • Partners with stakeholders to understand their needs, build analytical frameworks, and deliver data-driven strategic insights. 
  • Coaches and enables others, helping teams build confidence and skill in experimentation. 
  • Builds rapport and trust with diverse team members. 
  • Brings curiosity and intellectual honesty, and is willing to let the data challenge assumptions, including their own. 
  • Is open to diverse perspectives and ideas. 
  • Focuses on the highest-impact work. 
  • Manages time well to meet deadlines and commitments. 
  • Adapts to changing priorities and environments. 
  • Stays resilient through setbacks and obstacles. 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. job.title: Operations Accountant (12-month contract)
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a full-time, fixed-term position. Working in close collaboration with the promoter and production teams, the Operations Accountant ensures accurate and timely night-of-show settlements. The role covers full-cycle accounting for each show: recording the income statement and balance sheet entries that capture the settlement, reviewing and approving transactions, and reconciling payables and receivables through to month-end close.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

This position owns the accounting for each show, from pre-settlement through month-end reporting, including:

  • Assist with pre-settlement and night-of-show artist settlements, working directly with promoters, artist representatives and production staff.
  • Act as the primary accounting point of contact for the talent department, artist representatives and production staff.
  • Enter show settlements into the accounting systems and distribute settlement reports to stakeholders.
  • Review all show settlements to confirm proper documentation and backup are on file for audit purposes.
  • Prepare and code artist final settlement wires per contract ensuring withholding taxes, charity and album bundles are correctly recognized.
  • Settle venue expenses, shared ancillary revenues and co-promotion deals.
  • Finalize the profit and loss statement for each show.
  • Code, approve and distribute show invoices and cheques for Accounts Payable input.
  • Prepare and upload show entries, along with accounts receivable and accounts payable settlements.
  • Reconcile revenues, project costs and accruals, resolving variances promptly.
  • Reconcile accounts receivable, review balances for accuracy and follow up to ensure timely collection.
  • Complete the month-end close and report per-show contribution margin.
  • Maintain and adhere to internal controls
  • Travel and provide on-site support for large shows and festival properties as required.
  • Take on ad hoc projects as assigned by management.

 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent; progress toward or completion of a CPA designation
  • 3–5 years of accounting experience, with demonstrated strength in reconciliation (accounts payable, accounts receivable, accruals and cash).
  • Strong Oracle and/or Salesforce capability; advanced Excel
  • Practical use of Claude, AI platforms, BI and automation tooling to reduce manual work
  • Experience in live entertainment, events or another high-volume, deadline-driven transactional environment is an asset.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to complete multiple time-sensitive settlements and close activities on schedule.
  • Highly detail-oriented, with a strong ability to multi-task and maintain accuracy under tight night-of-show timelines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with promoters, artist representatives, production staff and colleagues across the organization.
  • Proficiency applications, especially Microsoft Excel.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends around show schedules, and to travel for large shows and festivals.

 

We thank all candidates for their interest, only those who will be selected for an interview will be contacted.


--


The expected compensation in Ontario is $70,000-85,000

Sits for extended periods of time at a computer station or work desk; stands and walks throughout the day; occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.; uses hands and fingers to operate computers and office equipment for up to 8 hours each day; lifts up to 10 pounds regularly; exposed to typical office environment conditions and noise levels.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE TEAM

The Core Data Services (CDS) team is the backbone of our enterprise data and analytics initiatives. We are building a scalable, modern data platform that powers business intelligence, analytics, and AI across the organization. Our mission is to make trusted data accessible and actionable—enabling data-driven decision-making across all business functions.


You will be part of the Delivery Engineering and Architecture group within CDS, working alongside platform engineers, data engineers, and solution architects to design and deliver high-impact data solutions for the enterprise.


THE ROLE

As a Senior Solution Architect within the Core Data Services (CDS) team, you will be an individual contributor responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing end-to-end data warehouse and analytics solutions. You will work closely with data engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical designs that support real-time, high-volume, and low-latency use cases.


This role sits at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and execution—you will define standards, build solutions, and guide teams on best practices in data platform design, ETL development, performance tuning, and cost optimization.


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You are a hands-on, technically strong Solution Architect who thrives on designing and delivering large-scale, high-performance data solutions. You have deep experience across the modern data stack — from ETL development and data modeling to cloud-scale architecture and API-based integrations. You are not just a strategist; you build, optimize, and get things done.


You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and take pride in delivering reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient data platforms. If you enjoy solving complex data challenges and driving architecture decisions that shape enterprise-scale systems, this role is for you.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Design & Architecture: Define and implement modern data warehouse architecture and frameworks, covering data modeling, ETL pipelines, orchestration, storage, and access patterns.
  • Build & Deliver: Develop scalable data solutions leveraging Databricks, AWS, and other modern tools to handle large-scale, high-frequency data workloads.
  • Integration & APIs: Design and build APIs and data integration layers to enable interoperability across systems and real-time data access.
  • Optimization & Reliability: Continuously improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency across ETL processes, compute environments, and data delivery systems.
  • Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams—including Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Analytics—to align technical solutions with business outcomes.
  • Data Governance & Standards: Champion best practices for data quality, lineage, metadata management, and compliance.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and design templates to support reuse and consistency across the organization.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or architecture roles, with strong expertise in data warehousing and distributed data systems.
  • Proven experience building large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, S3, and related technologies.
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT design, data modeling, and data integration patterns (batch and streaming).
  • Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, and familiarity with API development and orchestration tools.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and tools such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Knowledge of data governance, lineage, and security best practices.
  • Certifications in AWS, Databricks, or related technologies are a plus.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a team that is building the next-generation enterprise data platform from the ground up.
  • Work on high-volume, low-latency data challenges that directly impact business performance.
  • Collaborate with talented peers across engineering, architecture, and product teams.
  • Have the autonomy to design, innovate, and implement best-in-class data solutions.



BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

job.description:

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment and eCommerce company, comprised of four market leaders: Ticketmaster.com, Live Nation Concerts, Artist Nation and Live Nation Network.  Ticketmaster.com is the global event ticketing leader and one of the world’s top five eCommerce sites, with over 27 million monthly unique visitors.  Live Nation Concerts produces over 22,000 shows annually for more than 2,300 artists globally.  Artist Nation is the world’s top artist management company, representing over 250 artists.  These businesses power Live Nation Network, the leading provider of entertainment marketing solutions, enabling over 800 advertisers to tap into the 200 million consumers Live Nation delivers annually through its live event and digital platforms. For additional information, visit www.livenation.com/investors.

House of Blues venues are also known for their southern-style cuisine, juke-joint inspired atmosphere and the World Famous Gospel Brunch.

House of Blues opened its doors on Thanksgiving Day in 1992, serving its first meal to the local shelters. Since opening, House of Blues has been committed to giving back to the community through the International House of Blues Foundation.

Who are you?

Passionate and motivated.  Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

  • Carrying plates of food on trays and serving guests
  • Keep glasses filled; remove each round of plates and replenish utensils

  • Working environment is fast-paced, often loud and stressful

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

Venue Nation is seeking an Employee & Guest Experience Supervisor for the Hollywood Palladium. The Experience Supervisor will be responsible for administering various corporate and venue designed initiatives that support employee engagement and recognition programs, and guest service-related initiatives.   

  

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT: Plan, coordinate, and implement processes and activities, including newsletters, day-of-show information sheets, and other communication tools associated with employee engagement and guest service.  
  • EMPLOYEE CARE/EXPERIENCE: Manage the upkeep and vibe of the employee break area, incorporating show-day elements of care that elevate the work experience and remove hassles. Plan and facilitate ongoing employee appreciation efforts and events.  
  • EMPLOYEE RECOGNITION: Administrator of the employee recognition program, facilitating creative approaches to individual and group recognition. Will be the venue’s culture leader by looking for ways to recognize small and big service wins by your staff and create a “ONE-CREW” mentality.  
  • TRAINING & COACHING: Venue leader for the service-focused, employee training system(s). Help facilitate, in collaboration with other venue leaders, large-scale on-site venue staff training. Work with Department Managers and Supervisors to ensure the venue’s service standards of Safety, Care, Encore, and Efficiency are being communicated at pre-event meetings, demonstrated throughout the show, and incorporated at the end of each night.    
  • FAN EXPERIENCE: Develop creative and fan-focused initiatives for service recovery, surprise and delights, and guest milestones.   
  • REPORTING: Responsible for completing/managing assigned day of show/post-show reports, helping manage the guest service experience platform, and analyzing other venue service reports to create action plans for service improvements and/or opportunities in partnership with the General Manager and your regional lead.  
  • PROCESS IMPROVEMENT: Work in coordination with venue leadership to discuss budget, needs, and ongoing support. Identify and seek opportunities to remove event day hassles for both fans and employees.  
  • SPECIAL PROJECTS: May be asked to manage implementation and maintenance of other guest-facing or employee based on-site programs.

  • Proficient computer skills required including the ability to use Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and CANVA.

job.title: Election Reporter (Temporary)
job.description:
The Los Angeles Times has an opening for a temporary reporter to work on 2026 election coverage, with a focus on local races and the aftermath of results across the region.

The successful candidate should have a strong interest in local politics and digging deeply into Los Angeles and the county's massive bureaucracies. They should be able to report breaking news on deadline and write longer-term stories on a variety of topics, including post-fire recovery, homelessness and elections.

The reporter will regularly collaborate with others, including writers covering Los Angeles County, Sacramento and breaking news. Experience covering L.A. city and county government is a plus.

Responsibilities:

• Report and write stories about local politics, including breaking news, enterprise stories and voter guides

• Cultivate sources and contacts to aid in the execution of a range of stories

• Identify unique angles that will advance a news story beyond what other outlets have already reported

• Write engaging headlines and SEO components that are lively and conversational in tone (when appropriate) with a digital, diverse audience in mind

• Work with fellow writers, editors, audience engagement staff and other reporters to achieve department and organizational goals

Requirements:

• A minimum of five years of journalism experience

• Excellent skills in news writing and reporting, combining strong news judgment, fluency in style and deep knowledge of taste and legal considerations

• Ability to foster excellent communication with peers, supervisors and the newsroom

• Proven ability to juggle multiple tasks in a deadline-driven environment

• Ability to navigate digital platforms and stay on top of current events

• Understanding of the importance of accuracy and precision

• An ethical and inclusive approach in the workplace that promotes collaboration

• Comfortable appearing on TV, radio and podcasts on behalf of the L.A. Times

This temporary position will be based in El Segundo, Calif., and downtown Los Angeles. It is expected to last 60 days, with occasional night and weekend work. Reporters must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle in good working condition, with suitable auto insurance coverage.

Qualified candidates should send a resume, cover letter and applicable clips to News Coverage Editor John Corrigan.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
The Executive Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative support to legal and HR leaders. This role is responsible for managing legal invoicing and finances, providing administrative support for our litigation efforts, and working to aid HR and legal professionals with correspondence and executive scheduling, contracts, travel arrangements and other key administrative tasks.

Responsibilities:

• Support the chief human resources officer, general counsel, assistant general counsel, and other HR leaders in administrative tasks

• Work with the legal department to administer invoices from outside counsel and track and account for outside counsel spend

• Conduct initial intake of calls and correspondence to the legal and HR teams, including complaints, threats of litigation and service of process

• Complete a wide range of administrative tasks (e.g., submitting expense reports, processing invoices, completing company forms, coordinating meeting logistics, assisting guests with building access, etc.)

• Prioritize conflicting needs, handle matters expeditiously, proactively, and confidentially while following through on a variety of special requests to completion, often with deadline pressures.

• Manage and organize the executive files, documents, and records in both physical and electronic formats. The ability to create and maintain an organized filing system with highly confidential and sensitive material is essential for efficient and secure information management.

• Organize, execute, and/or assist with internal and external meetings and events (i.e., off-site, team gatherings, and other events), including helping to prepare presentations for such meetings

• Provide discovery support services to inside and outside counsel who are responding to litigations

• Prepare initial draft documents, compile requested information, and assist with formatting and editing

• Manage complex calendar scheduling across multiple locations and time zones, juggling competing priorities and shifting goals

• Prepare Executives for meetings by conducting pre-meeting briefings, developing draft meeting agendas, taking and disseminating notes and action items

• Provide support to the executives on various projects and initiatives. Conduct research, gather data and prepare reports and presentations as needed. Monitor project timelines and ensure that deliverables are met.

• Responsible for coordinating executive travel arrangements

• Other duties and projects as assigned.

Requirements:

• Minimum of 3+ years’ progressive experience as an assistant supporting multiple executives within a fast-paced environment, preferably supporting attorneys and human resources professionals.

• Demonstrated excellence in independently prioritizing and organizing projects and tasks, meeting all deadlines, while successfully balancing a high-volume workload

• Tech-savvy, competent in Microsoft as well as Google Suite programs

• Problem solver with strong decision-making skills

• Ability to quickly master new processes, systems, and tools

• Polished communication skills, both oral and written, to obtain and convey information accurately and clearly

• High level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion in handling confidential information

• Ability to develop and maintain relationships with individuals at all levels enterprise-wide and externally

• Demonstrated proactive approach to problem-solving with strong decision-making capability

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree

job.title: Camp & Country Content Specialist, McClatchy Content Innovation Lab
job.description:
Inspire Adventure: Become a Camp & Country Content Specialist – McClatchy Content Innovation Lab

Are you passionate about the outdoors and eager to help others discover where to go, what to do and what to know before their next adventure? Join McClatchy’s Content Innovation Lab as specialist for Camp & Country — a new digital destination for outdoor enthusiasts, weekend adventurers and anyone looking to spend more time in nature.

At McClatchy, we’re blending our tradition of trusted journalism with a digital-first, data-driven approach. As a Camp & Country specialist, you’ll write engaging, high-quality content that covers everything from trail conditions and seasonal guides to backcountry tips, gear reviews and stories that shape the outdoor scene. You’ll use audience insights and AI-enabled tools to surface trends and produce national content that resonates with outdoor enthusiasts across the Pacific Northwest, Heartland, California, Gulf Coast and beyond.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and produce compelling stories, guides and features that empower readers to explore, adventure and connect with the outdoors.
  • Collaborate with a dynamic team to experiment with new formats and distribution strategies, maximizing reach and engagement.
  • Use audience analytics and emerging technologies to inform your storytelling and connect with passionate outdoor communities.
  • Embrace a fast-paced, collaborative environment where curiosity, adaptability and results are celebrated.
  • Help shape Camp & Country into a trusted daily destination for readers seeking inspiration, local intel and authentic outdoor experiences.

Who you are:

  • A creative storyteller with a passion for outdoor recreation, adventure and lifestyle and the demonstrated knowledge to pitch, research, report, write, edit and fact-check content.
  • Experienced in digital content creation at a high volume, with strong writing, editing and organizational skills.
  • Comfortable using data and AI-powered tools to guide your work and amplify your impact.
  • Collaborative, curious, and excited to experiment with new ways to engage audiences.

What you’ll bring:

  • The position requires a combination of subject matter expertise and experience equivalent to a bachelor’s degree, including education, experience, skills and knowledge necessary to perform the job.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in content creation, writing or journalism.
  • Strong writing, editing and organizational skills with the ability to produce high-quality content on deadline.
  • Inquisitive mindset with a constant flow of ideas and creative approaches to content creation.
  • Adaptability and flexibility to experiment relentlessly and pivot quickly based on results.
  • Collaborative spirit with a proven track record of working effectively in team environments.

job.title: Climate Fellow
job.description:
South Florida is ground zero for climate change, where rising seas, record heat and extreme storms are reshaping daily life. The Miami Herald is offering a six-month reporting fellowship focused on the region’s most urgent climate challenges — and the people, ideas and solutions shaping its future.

As our multimedia climate reporter, you’ll drive daily coverage, break news and deliver exclusive enterprise stories that connect the science and policy of climate change to the lived experience of South Floridians. You’ll use digital tools and audience data to spot trends, test new formats and engage readers where they are — from social platforms to newsletters and beyond. AI and automation will help you spend less time on routine tasks and more time on reporting, sources and storytelling that matters.

You’ll work closely with editors and fellow reporters, pitching and producing original stories, recaps and multiformat versions that meet newsroom goals for audience growth and retention. Your reporting will focus on solutions and actionable information, helping readers understand not just the threat but what they can do about it.

What you’ll do:

  • Own daily and enterprise coverage of climate issues in South Florida, with a focus on solutions and impact
  • Use digital tools, analytics and social media to inform, distribute and measure your work
  • Collaborate across the newsroom to develop ideas, test new formats and reach new audiences
  • Build and maintain a diverse network of sources
  • Uphold the highest standards of accuracy, ethics and public service journalism
  • Embrace new technology, including AI, to work smarter and deliver more value to our readers

This is a six-month, grant-funded position.

We welcome candidates with at least 1-3 years of newsroom experience, a strong grounding in journalism ethics and a passion for digital-first, audience-focused reporting. Fluency in video, photo and social media storytelling is a plus.

To apply, submit a cover letter, resume and 4-6 samples of their work.

The Miami Herald and McClatchy are committed to building a newsroom that reflects and serves all of South Florida. Join us at the forefront of digital journalism, where every audience matters and every signal counts.

job.description:
Political Advertising Sales Manager (California) – Political & Public Affairs Vertical

McClatchy | West Coast Division

Location: California / Sacramento or Los Angeles Area (Field-based / Remote)

Position Type: Full-Time

McClatchy, a leader in local and regional media, seeks a strategic, results-oriented Account Executive to lead revenue development across California and the West Coast. With a powerful portfolio of iconic West Coast publications—including The Sacramento Bee, The Fresno Bee, and The Modesto Bee—McClatchy pairs a legacy of trusted regional journalism with a sophisticated, data-driven digital marketing suite that allows our clients to reach key decision-makers and voters with precision and impact.

Our mission has never been more vital. As a successful candidate, you will be the bridge between our first-class digital portfolio and the fast-paced political arena, leveraging data, innovation, and unmatched regional reach to drive measurable revenue growth and shape the conversations driving Western policy.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Vertical Mastery: Act as a subject matter expert in the political, government, and advocacy space, deeply understanding California policy initiatives, ballot measures, and legislative calendars.
  • Strategic Business Development: Adopt a "Hunter" mentality to identify, qualify, and secure new revenue streams from political campaigns, PACs, trade associations, and public affairs firms across the West Coast.
  • Consultative Selling: Conduct deep-dive campaign assessments to understand complex legislative or electoral objectives and design highly targeted multi-platform issue-advocacy solutions.
  • Solution Engineering: Develop and deliver compelling marketing strategies utilizing McClatchy’s full suite of products, including high-impact display, programmatic geotargeting, social media amplification, CTV/OTT, and custom branded content.
  • Relationship Management: Build long-term, trust-based partnerships with leading political consultants, media buying agencies, and corporate advocacy directors.
  • Operational Excellence: Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate records of sales activities, compliance tracking, and revenue forecasts within rapid-fire political windows using CRM tools.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • Industry Knowledge: Proven experience working directly with political campaigns, issue-advocacy groups, or within the California public affairs ecosystem.
  • Digital Fluency: A strong background in digital marketing and advertising, with a proven track record of selling custom digital solutions (Programmatic, Social, First-Party Data targeting, etc.).
  • Sales Excellence: Demonstrated ability in strategic prospecting, high-stakes negotiation, and closing business under tight deadlines through a persuasive, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Agility & Collaboration: The ability to pivot instantly in a high-pressure, rapidly evolving political environment without losing quality, while collaborating constructively with cross-functional media teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and writing skills with the ability to earn the trust of high-profile political operatives and translate policy goals into media strategies.

Requirements

  • Education: A combination of knowledge and experience equivalent to a B.A. or B.S. Degree in Political Science, Public Policy, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent CRM tools; daily CRM utilization for pipeline tracking is required.
  • Logistics: Must be located in California (Sacramento or Los Angeles regions preferred). A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and valid vehicle insurance are required for frequent regional travel.

Professional Offerings

  • Compensation: Base salary plus commission with uncapped earning potential. 
    • The anticipated base pay range for this position is between $80,000 and $95,000 annually.  Individual base pay may vary within that range depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant education, department equity, training, geography, and local wage and hours laws.
  • Advancement: Clear opportunities for professional growth within a nationally recognized media organization.
  • Benefits: Full suite of benefits including a 401(k) with company match. 
    • For a full overview of our benefits:  www.mcclatchylivewell.com
  • Culture: A fast-paced, professional, and mission-driven work environment aligned with major news cycles.

job.description:
Title: Accounts Payable Specialist

Reports to: AP Manager

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

The Accounts Payable Specialist plays a vital role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of vendor and subcontractor invoices while supporting daily financial operations within Spectrum. In this position, you will help maintain strong financial controls, resolve invoice discrepancies, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Your work directly supports smooth project execution and fosters strong, reliable relationships with our vendors and subcontractors.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Perform day-to-day financial transactions, including verifying, classifying, computing, posting and recording accounts payable data.

²  Verifies validity and resolves issues of account discrepancies by obtaining and investigating information from Purchasing and other departments.

²  Compares vendor/subcontractor invoices to purchases orders of contracts to verify quantities, prices, payment terms, freight charges, extensions, etc. Computes discounts, makes sales/tax determinations and places invoices in line for payment

²  Performs data-entry of vendor/subcontractors invoices and expense reports

²  Maintains records on equipment rental, assists with invoice preparation, invoice distribution etc.

²  Follows all requirements of the company safety program. Takes personal responsibility for the safety of the working environment. Promotes safety to peers

²  Performs additional assignments per supervisors direction

²  Process daily AP transactions in Spectrum, including verifying, coding, posting, and recording vendor and subcontractor invoices.

²  Match invoices to purchase orders, contracts, and receiving documents to confirm quantities, pricing, terms, and tax/discount accuracy.

²  Enter approved invoices and expense reports with correct GL codes, cost codes, job allocations, and retainage.

²  Research and resolve invoice discrepancies by working with Purchasing, Project Management, Field Operations, and other teams.

²  Communicate with vendors and subcontractors to obtain missing documents and resolve billing issues promptly.

²  Maintain accurate equipment rental records, including rental periods, rates, and job‑cost allocation.

²  Assist with preparing and distributing invoices, statements, and related documentation.

²  Follow company safety policies and promote a safe working environment.

²  Maintain organized digital and physical AP files in line with audit and retention requirements.

²  Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

 

 

Qualifications:

²  Requires high school diploma or GED equivalent

²  2+ years of Accounts Payable experience; construction industry experience preferred.

²  Strong attention to detail and accuracy in a fast‑paced environment.

²  Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross‑functional teams while providing friendly, courteous, and tactful customer service to both internal and external partners.

²  Ability to learn and apply company policies, accounting procedures, cash‑protection practices, and required regulatory reporting.

²  Strong communication, organizational, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to clearly support vendors, subcontractors, and cross‑functional teams.

²  Preferred experience with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), including strong skills in spreadsheet creation, data entry, and document formatting.

²  Manual dexterity and hand–eye coordination to perform tasks with accuracy and efficiency.

²  Maintains a high level of mental alertness to ensure precise, thorough, and timely completion of all work responsibilities.

²  Requires the ability to sit for extended periods and operate standard office equipment, including computers, calculators, copiers, fax machines, and related technology.

 

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Advertising Sales Executive
job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description

 

Advertising Sales Executive

We don’t just broadcast messages. Radio has the power to make people listen- and, more importantly, act. 


Strong local businesses help create strong communities. At Midwest Communications, we help Kalamazoo businesses reach new customers, strengthen their brands, and turn great ideas into results. As an Advertising Sales Executive, you’ll become a trusted marketing partner for businesses in your community. You’ll learn what a client is trying to accomplish, identify opportunities, and build marketing strategies using radio, digital, social media, promotions, and more.


What You’ll Do:

  • Help local businesses become stronger and more successful - understand what they’re trying to accomplish and find ways to help them by using marketing strategies across radio, digital, social media, and promotions.
  • Create new opportunities for growth- conduct needs assessments and build relationships with businesses that could benefit from what Midwest Communications has to offer.
  • Build a presence by attending client meetings, networking events, and community functions. 
  • Turn marketing strategies into results- help clients connect with customers, increase awareness, drive traffic, generate leads, and grow their business.
  • Create your own success story- develop new business, grow existing partnerships, and build a book of clients you’re proud to represent.
  • Stay ahead of the market by tracking the latest trends, competitor offerings, and best industry practices. 

What We Offer:

  • A full-time position with an established and successful business.
  • Competitive pay with commission and benefits ($45,000-$60,000 based on experience). Start with a guaranteed draw pay while you build your business and client relationships, with additional earning potential through commission. 
    • Paid time off/holidays, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, life insurance, and disability coverage. 
  • Professional development and sales training.
  • Performance based incentives/bonuses.
  • Opportunities to grow within Midwest Communications, Inc.

We’re Looking for Someone Who...

  • Has a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
  • Has previous sales experience; advertising or media experience is a plus.
  • Understands sales activity, forecasting, and CRM software.
  • Is a strong communicator, negotiator, presenter, and problem-solver. 
  • Has a valid Michigan driver’s license, reliable transportation, and can pass a background check and motor vehicle check. 
  • Is self-motivated, goal-oriented, and capable of working independently.

The Midwest Communications, Inc Culture

At Midwest Communications, we’re invested in the longevity and success of our sales teams. You’ll join an established team of professional sales consultants who know how to build relationships, uncover opportunities, and create solutions that make an impact. You will also work alongside talented programming, promotions, digital, and production teams to create campaigns. 

As a privately owned, family-founded business, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also maintaining a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere. You’ll have the tools, resources, and support of an established media company but the autonomy to build relationships, develop your business, and make your mark in the local market.


Are you ready to make your mark in the radio industry? We’d love to hear from you. 

Apply here!


Midwest Communications, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer by choice.

job.description:

Digital Sales Specialist 


Digital marketing is changing. Help local businesses keep up.


At Midwest Communications, Inc we don’t just help businesses get noticed. We are the home to local leading radio stations in the northeast Minnesota region. Our mission is to help local businesses connect with the right people, solve marketing challenges, and turn great ideas into results. 


We’re looking for a Digital Sales Specialist to support our sales teams in Duluth and Hibbing, Minnesota, working out of our Duluth office. You will collaborate with an established sales team while also having the opportunity to develop your own client relationships and your own book of business within the communities you serve. 


Your Responsibilities

  • Meet clients face-to-face, run needs analyses, and present customized proposals.

  • Build digital marketing packages that include search engine marketing (SEM/SEO), display ads, social media, email marketing, OTT/CTV, and streaming audio.
  • Pair digital campaigns with on-air schedules for full multi-platform reach.  
  • Track campaign performance metrics, review consumer trends, and adjust active campaigns to improve return on investment (ROI) for clients.
  • Grow accounts through renewals and upsells. 
  • Present campaign reports to clients in plain-language results and next steps.

  • Stay current on digital advertising platforms and best practices.
  • Manage pipeline in CRM and meet or exceed monthly revenue goals.

  • Are a true “people” person who enjoys interacting and helping others solve problems.
  • Have excellent communication and relationship building skills.
  • Have a valid Minnesota driver’s license, ability to pass a motor vehicle check, and satisfactory background check.

job.title: Main Street & The Farm On-Air Host
job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description

 

Main Street & The Farm On-Air Host


KELO - 1320-AM | Where South Dakota businesses and agriculture meet. 


From our small businesses to the farmers and ranchers feeding our communities, South Dakota’s economy is built by people with stories worth tuning in for. Main Street & The Farm is a brand-new two-hour program on KELO Radio dedicated to sharing those stories, exploring local economic issues, and connecting listeners with the people shaping our state. We are looking for someone who can help shape this show’s future in Sioux Falls!


What You’ll Love Doing:

  • Host a live, two-hour morning program in Sioux Falls featuring in-depth conversations with local business owners, farmers, ranchers, and community leaders.
  • Lead engaging interviews that help listeners understand local businesses, agriculture, markets, policy, and the economic issues affecting their communities.
  • Connect with Chambers of Commerce, South Dakota Farm Bureau representatives, agricultural organizations, and other local and state industry leaders to develop a strong network of guests.
  • Prepare interview questions, talking points, and background information for upcoming programs. 
  • Coordinate occasional field interviews and remote broadcasts that bring listeners closer to the people and businesses making a difference.
  • Monitor listener feedback, community interests, and emerging topics to help guide future programming. 
  • Identify and develop new advertising opportunities that connect businesses with KELO Radio’s audience.
  • Work with the Director of Sales to develop advertiser campaigns, grow revenue, and help expand Main Street & The Farm over time.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A confident, natural communicator with a genuine interest in South Dakota’s local economy and agriculture.
  • Someone who has experience (or strong demonstrated interest) in hosting live radio and is comfortable drawing out compelling stories from a variety of guests. Interviewing and interpersonal skills are essential for this role. 
  • Prior sales experience and comfort with developing advertising opportunities is a plus.
  • A valid South Dakota driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the ability to pass background and motor vehicle checks. 
  • Reliability, professionalism, and a collaborative approach to representing the station. 
  • The ideal candidate would have an interest in telling local businesses’ stories while also wanting to grow revenue for the show to aid in its expansion in the future.

Culture at Midwest Communications

At Midwest Communications, Inc., we’re invested in the longevity and satisfaction of our employees. As a privately owned, family-founded company, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also enjoying a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere where growth and creativity are encouraged. You’ll have the tools and support of an established media company, along with the autonomy to get your work done and make the role your own.


Schedule: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday

Hours: Full-time, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Live On-Air: 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM

Salary: Based on experience

On-Air Morning Show Co-Host - WIFC


WIFC - 95.5 FM | Full-Time | Wausau, WI


Make some noise, bring the energy, and own the morning in Central Wisconsin!


WIFC, 95.5 FM is Central Wisconsin’s home for contemporary hits, and we’re looking for our next on-air personality to bring the music, humor, and personality to the morning show.


At Midwest Communications, we believe great radio is live, local, and built around people who know how to connect. We want someone who can keep up with what’s trending, turn everyday moments into entertaining content, and bring the brand to life on the air, online, and out in the community.   • Attend station and promotional events to strengthen the brand’s name in the Fargo community.
  • Assistance in the coordination of giveaways, contests, event-set-up, campaigns, live music, and more.
  • Learn the behind-the-scenes of what makes a radio station run, including but not limited to: audio editing, show preparation, broadcast operations, and other day-to-day responsibilities to keep things running smoothly. 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Have a drive to create great radio content, grow an audience, strengthen the brand, and be part of a team that takes pride in their work. Prior media experience is a plus.
  • Have a valid North Dakota’s driver’s license, the ability to pass a motor vehicle check, and satisfactory background check.

Culture at Midwest Communications

At Midwest Communications, Inc., we’re invested in the longevity and satisfaction of our employees. As a privately owned, family-founded company, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also enjoying a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere where growth and creativity are encouraged. You’ll have the tools and support of an established media company, along with the autonomy to get your work done and make the role your own.


If this sounds like the position for you, we want to hear from you! 


Any additional documentation such as airchecks, audio/video samples, or cover letters can be sent to Talent and HR Coordinator, Lauryn Calkins, at lauryn.calkins@mwcradio.com. 


Midwest Communications, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer by choice.

job.title: Marketing Coordinator Apple Valley News Now | Phase 3 Digital | Kennewick, WA
job.description:
Want to help bring local campaigns to life—and make sure every detail lands? Apple Valley News Now is looking for a Marketing Coordinator who enjoys creative collaboration, keeps projects moving and takes pride in getting the details right.

We’re the local ABC affiliate serving the Yakima and Tri-Cities market and part of Morgan Murphy Media, a family-owned company rooted in the communities it serves. In this role, you’ll work with our sales team on promotions and campaigns across broadcast, digital and social media. You’ll help turn ideas into presentations, coordinate assets and deadlines, and show clients the results of their campaigns.

What you’ll do

• Coordinate station and client promotions, including contests, from planning through execution.

• Work across departments to keep campaign assets, communications and deadlines on track.

• Partner with account executives to create polished, original client presentations and compelling campaign recaps using airchecks, screenshots and video.

• Support the sales team with order entry for broadcast and digital campaigns, inventory updates in WideOrbit Media Sales, and other essential sales tasks.

• Keep spreadsheets, calendars and reports accurate and up to date; assist with avails, HubSpot and digital order and creative submissions.

• Communicate with clients and teammates professionally and help resolve day-to-day needs.

• Provide administrative support to sales leadership, including backup assistance with political file duties and executive assistance as needed.

What you’ll bring

• Strong organization, attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple requests.

• Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative, solutions-focused approach.

• Confidence using Excel, Word, PowerPoint and other Microsoft applications.

• The ability to gather information, prepare reports and work independently when needed.

• Photoshop or Adobe Illustrator proficiency is a plus.

If you’re energized by both creative projects and the behind-the-scenes coordination that makes them successful, we’d like to hear from you.

Benefits

Apple Valley News Now offers medical, dental, vision, prescription and life insurance; an Employee Assistance Program; long-term disability insurance; a flexible spending account; a 401(k); a health savings account; and an employee referral program. Paid time off includes vacation, sick time accrued at one hour for every 40 hours worked, two personal days and nine paid holidays.

Pay: $19–$23 per hour

What’s next?

Apple Valley News Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Account Executive, Telemundo T51 Fresno
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Driven and results-oriented multiplatform sales professional to join our team.   The successful candidate will sell our linear and non-linear product portfolio which provides Spanish and English language marketing solutions for businesses to reach Hispanic and non-Hispanic audiences in the Fresno DMA, California and throughout the United States through KNSO Telemundo and NBCU OTT & Peacock Platforms.  The Account Executive will be responsible for partnering with local agencies and clients to create innovative, targeted, and unique multi-platform marketing and advertising solutions that deliver results. 

Essential Responsibilities

The Account Executive will be responsible for growing revenue for Telemundo Fresno and across NBCUniversal Local OTT and digital platforms, including Peacock and NBC / Telemundo Full Episode Player through the development and sale of creative advertising solutions

  • The AE will develop an understanding of our ad products, leverage tentpole events like the World Cup, Super Bowl, and the Olympics, and have solid consultative selling skills to best develop solutions to meet client needs
  • New business, revenue closure, account relationship building, customer satisfaction, and product implementation success are key responsibilities
  • Aggressively meet and develop strong business relationships with all buyers, media planners and brand managers throughout Utah
  • Ensure optimal market coverage, professional client engagements, increasing awareness of products, services, and capabilities
  • Identify and develop strategies for penetrating key accounts and prospects
  • Provide continual input and assessments to sales management to drive ongoing improvements in sales strategy and approach
  • Achieve Quarterly revenue targets as assigned by Sales Management
  • Manage the opportunity pipeline and revenue forecasting
  • Participate in weekly pipeline, and proposal review meetings
  • Identify, coordinate, and attend all appropriate local marketing and advertising association events
  • Collaborate with NBCU Local's sales teams utilizing expertise to drive results

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in business development and media sales
  • Minimum 2 years digital media sales experience.
  • A solid record of attaining or exceeding sales quotas by developing creative solutions that meet customers’ needs across traditional and non-traditional advertising categories
  • Minimum 1 year of working knowledge with Word, PowerPoint and Excel
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing to work at the location in Fresno, CA.
  • Must have excellent driving record and active driver’s license.

Desired Qualifications

  • Degree in marketing, business, or communications
  • Bilingual: Spanish/English (a plus)
  • Experience selling OTT/CTV ad solutions
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to successfully apply sales techniques; creative and analytic ability to use information such as behavioral, demo and geo targeting data plus industry research to make effective and persuasive verbal, written or electronic sales presentations.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.
  • Experience working with Salesforce platform
  • Ability to concentrate on priorities under deadline pressure

Additional Requirements

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. 

Salary range: $60,000 -$95,000 base salary + SIC bonus (All in potential $92,307.69 - $138,461.53)

job.description:

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Position Overview

The Associate CRM Marketing Manager manages the end-to-end execution and optimization of email marketing campaigns that drive audience engagement, retention, and subscriber growth. This role owns priority campaigns from planning through deployment and reporting, while developing expertise in segmentation, personalization, automation, and lifecycle marketing.

The Associate Manager also serves as a key day-to-day partner to cross-functional teams and provides tactical guidance to Email Marketing Coordinator on campaign execution, content selection and prioritization, email best practices, quality assurance, and optimization opportunities to improve campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Execution

  • Own end-to-end execution of priority email campaigns, including intake, planning, build, QA, deployment, and reporting on campaign priorities, objectives, and overall CRM strategy.
  • Independently manage the planning, development, and execution of campaign landing pages, including coordinating creative assets, content, functionality, and QA to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and a seamless user experience.
  • Independently manage campaign calendars, timelines, deliverables, and cross-functional approvals, proactively identifying and resolving potential delays.
  • Build and deploy segmented, triggered, personalized, and dynamic-content campaigns within the ESP.
  • Conduct campaign QA across devices and email clients and troubleshoot rendering, tracking, audience, or deployment issues.
  • Collaborate with Creative and Sports Marketing teams on email creative planning, including content strategy, messaging, layout, and calls to action, providing recommendations informed by campaign performance and email best practices.

Optimization & Testing

  • Develop and execute A/B and multivariate tests across subject lines, creative, CTAs, content, and audience segmentation, aligned with the testing strategy and priorities established by the Senior CRM Manager.
  • Independently analyze campaign and newsletter performance to identify trends, optimization opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Proactively recommend and implement data-informed adjustments to content, targeting, segmentation, and automation to improve campaign performance.
  • Manage the execution and tracking of the email testing roadmap, translating results into actionable insights and best practices that inform broader CRM strategy.

Audience, Personalization & Growth

  • Independently manage campaign-level segmentation using behavioral, preference, demographic, and engagement data, with strategic guidance from the Senior CRM Manager on audience targeting approaches and priorities.
  • Support the development and execution of automated email journeys and lifecycle campaigns, with the Senior CRM Manager providing direction on lifecycle strategy, audience objectives, and journey priorities.
  • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to ensure accurate audience targeting, suppressions, and data hygiene.
  • Execute subscriber acquisition initiatives, including signup forms, CTA optimization, and campaigns designed to drive list growth, aligned with broader audience growth objectives.
  • Demonstrate expertise in personalization, dynamic content, audience targeting, and lifecycle marketing, proactively identifying opportunities to apply these capabilities to campaigns.

Reporting & Insights

  • Independently monitor campaign performance against benchmarks and historical results, identifying trends and opportunities for optimization.
  • Develop campaign recaps highlighting performance, key learnings, and recommended next steps.
  • Present results and insights during CRM team meetings, proactively recommending opportunities to improve performance.
  • Translate campaign and testing results into actionable recommendations that improve key email KPIs and inform future campaign planning.

Team & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide day-to-day tactical guidance to the Email Marketing Coordinator on campaign execution, content selection, QA, and email best practices, with overall team priorities established by the Senior CRM Manager.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned email initiatives across Creative, Editorial, Product, and other teams, independently managing routine communications and escalating strategic decisions or significant risks as needed.
  • Independently facilitate campaign kickoffs, feedback loops, and stakeholder communication to ensure alignment and timely execution.
  • Help establish and reinforce email marketing processes and best practices across the team, proactively recommending workflow and efficiency improvements.

Basic Requirements:

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, CRM or lifecycle marketing
  • Hands-on experience building, QA'ing, deploying, and optimizing campaigns within an enterprise ESP or customer engagement platform; Braze experience preferred.
  • Experience with segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, dynamic content, and marketing automation.
  • Comfort analyzing customer and audience data to inform segmentation, targeting, personalization, and testing results into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of email creative best practices, including content hierarchy, messaging, CTA strategy, and mobile-first design.
  • Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to manage campaigns from planning through deployment.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Experience with additional owned CRM channels, such as push notifications and landing pages, is a plus.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for marketing, content development, and workflow efficiency, as well as Adobe Photoshop for basic creative editing and asset optimization, is preferred.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge is a plus.

Desired Characteristics:

• Has high standards for work, excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills, attention to detail

• Ability to effectively take direction and apply learnings to everyday responsibilities

• Highly resourceful. Creative problem solver, with strong oral and written communication skills

• Strong presentation skills; comfortable presenting results to team and leadership

• Works well in a team, fast-paced, and deadline-driven environment. Excellent interpersonal skills and grace under pressure

• Possesses a strong work ethic with a desire to excel and willingness to learn

  • Strong knowledge of sports media landscape and passion for sports

• Proven ability to partner effectively with internal partners and external agencies

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.
  • Salary range: $65,000- $90,000

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service.
