NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des plus importantes entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de marques de cinéma, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et auquel nous donnons vie grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques à l’échelle mondiale, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’entremise de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics vivent et travaillent. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir à notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES 

  • As an Associate Design Director, you will support the Design Director in driving the execution, alignment, and day-to-day coordination of the project’s design vision across pillars and disciplines. You will act as a key operational and creative partner, helping ensure design decisions, priorities, and follow-through remain consistent across the project. 
  • Partner closely with the Design Director to support the execution and communication of the overall gameplay and player experience vision. 
  • Maintain visibility across multiple pillars, strike teams, and cross-disciplinary initiatives to help ensure alignment and consistency. 
  • Help drive follow-up, coordination, and resolution of cross-team design topics and dependencies. 
  • Support design decision-making on gameplay systems, player experience, workflows, and feature implementation. 
  • Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Art, UX, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines to ensure alignment between creative goals and execution realities. 
  • Help identify risks, blockers, communication gaps, and production challenges, and proactively work toward solutions. 
  • Mentor and support designers across the team by providing feedback, guidance, and design oversight. 
  • Ensure documentation, communication, and design intentions remain clear and actionable across teams. 
  • Contribute to reviews, playtests, iteration, and feature evaluations to help maintain quality and consistency across the experience. 
  • Help maintain consistency between long-term vision, short-term priorities, and day-to-day execution. 

RESPONSIBILTÉS 

  • En tant qu’Associate Design Director, vous soutiendrez le Design Director dans l’exécution, l’alignement et la coordination quotidienne de la vision design du projet à travers les différents piliers et disciplines. Vous agirez comme un partenaire créatif et opérationnel clé afin d’assurer la cohérence des décisions, priorités et suivis design à l’échelle du projet. 
  • Collaborer étroitement avec le Design Director afin de soutenir l’exécution et la communication de la vision globale du gameplay et de l’expérience joueur. 
  • Maintenir une visibilité sur plusieurs piliers, strike teams et initiatives transversales afin d’assurer l’alignement et la cohérence entre les équipes. 
  • Aider à assurer le suivi, la coordination et la résolution des sujets et dépendances design entre les équipes. 
  • Soutenir la prise de décision design concernant les systèmes de gameplay, l’expérience joueur, les workflows et l’implémentation des fonctionnalités. 
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de Production, Ingénierie, Art, UX, Animation, Audio et les autres disciplines afin d’assurer l’alignement entre les objectifs créatifs et les réalités de production. 
  • Identifier les risques, blocages, problèmes de communication et défis de production, puis contribuer activement à leur résolution. 
  • Encadrer et soutenir les designers de l’équipe en fournissant du feedback, du mentorat et de la supervision design. 
  • Veiller à ce que la documentation, la communication et les intentions design demeurent claires et exploitables pour les équipes. 
  • Participer aux revues, playtests, itérations et évaluations de fonctionnalités afin de maintenir la qualité et la cohérence de l’expérience. 
  • Contribuer à maintenir l’alignement entre la vision long terme, les priorités court terme et l’exécution quotidienne. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

 

Basic Requirements:  

  • Strong experience in game design on AAA or high-quality indie productions. 
  • Experience leading or coordinating multidisciplinary teams or large gameplay initiatives. 
  • Strong understanding of gameplay systems, player experience, progression, systemic design, and production realities. 
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to align multiple teams and stakeholders. 
  • Ability to balance creative vision with practical production constraints and technical feasibility. 
  • Strong knowledge of Unreal Engine 5 and Blueprint scripting workflows. 
  • Comfortable operating across multiple gameplay domains, features, and team structures. 
  • Experience collaborating closely with Design, Production, Engineering, Art, and UX leadership. 
  • Ability to make informed moment-to-moment decisions while maintaining alignment with broader project goals. 

Exigences de base :  

  • Solide expérience en game design sur des productions AAA ou des projets indie de haute qualité. 
  • Expérience en leadership ou en coordination d’équipes multidisciplinaires ou de grandes initiatives gameplay. 
  • Excellente compréhension des systèmes de gameplay, de l’expérience joueur, de la progression, du design systémique et des réalités de production. 
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et communicationnelles, avec la capacité d’aligner plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes. 
  • Capacité à équilibrer vision créative, contraintes de production et faisabilité technique. 
  • Solide maîtrise d’Unreal Engine 5 et des workflows de scripting Blueprint. 
  • Aisance à travailler sur plusieurs domaines de gameplay, fonctionnalités et structures d’équipe. 
  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les directions Design, Production, Ingénierie, Art et UX. 
  • Capacité à prendre des décisions éclairées au quotidien tout en restant aligné avec les objectifs globaux du projet. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with UGC systems, sandbox gameplay, live services, or player-driven experiences. 
  • Strong systems design sensibilities and understanding of emergent gameplay. 
  • Experience supporting feature teams, strike teams, or horizontal cross-project initiatives. 
  • Technical sensibility and ability to communicate effectively with engineers and technical designers. 
  • Experience reviewing implementation quality and ensuring consistency across multiple gameplay features. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate ambiguity in fast-moving production environments. 
  • Interest in iterative development, rapid prototyping, and collaborative creative workflows. 

Atouts recherchés :  

  • Expérience avec des systèmes UGC, du gameplay sandbox, des services live ou des expériences orientées joueur. 
  • Forte sensibilité en design systémique et bonne compréhension du gameplay émergent. 
  • Expérience de soutien à des feature teams, strike teams ou initiatives transversales à grande échelle. 
  • Bonne sensibilité technique et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec des ingénieurs et des technical designers. 
  • Expérience dans la révision de la qualité d’implémentation et le maintien de la cohérence entre plusieurs fonctionnalités gameplay. 
  • Solides capacités de résolution de problèmes et aisance à évoluer dans des environnements de production rapides et ambigus. 
  • Intérêt pour le développement itératif, le prototypage rapide et les workflows créatifs collaboratifs. 

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature pour être prises en considération.
  • La personne candidate doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.
  • La personne candidate doit être disposée à faire des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • La personne candidate doit être légalement autorisée à travailler au Canada.
  • La personne candidate doit être disposée à effectuer des déplacements professionnels, au besoin.

NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Business Solutions Team builds products and digital capabilities that support organizations across NBCUniversal. The team partners closely with engineering and business stakeholders to create cohesive, scalable, end-to-end solutions that improve how employees access information, communicate, and engage across the enterprise.

As part of the Enterprise Business Solutions Workplace team, the Business Systems Analysis Manager serves as a key Digital Workplace Solutions resource, partnering with Corporate Communications, Workplace stakeholders, Engineering, and enterprise technology teams to shape and optimize employee-facing digital experiences. The role provides expertise across digital workplace and communications technologies, including CMS and intranet platforms, web experiences, email and campaign technologies, event management solutions, employee engagement platforms, integrations, data, search, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities. Serving as a subject matter expert and strategic technology partner, the Business Systems Analysis Manager translates business and employee needs into scalable digital solutions, guides product and solution decisions, and helps ensure workplace platforms operate as an integrated ecosystem rather than standalone technologies.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Digital Workplace and Corporate Communications technology, including intranet and internet solutions, content management systems (CMS), email and campaign platforms, event technologies, employee engagement tools, analytics, search, integrations, and emerging AI-enabled workplace capabilities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of employee journeys, business processes, content needs, platform capabilities, data, and integrations to identify opportunities to improve the digital employee experience.
  • Analyze complex and sometimes ambiguous business needs and translate them into clear solution requirements, experience recommendations, and technology capabilities.
  • Help define product vision, strategy, roadmaps, capabilities, and success measures for key Digital Workplace products and services.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications, Engineering and other technology teams to translate strategic needs into scalable, connected digital workplace solutions.
  • Evaluate platform capabilities, integrations, data sources, technical dependencies, and solution alternatives to inform product and platform decisions.
  • Translate business and employee needs into actionable artifacts, including business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, data requirements, and integration requirements.
  • Own and prioritize product requirements and backlogs based on employee and business value, platform strategy, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities.
  • Facilitate solution design and working sessions across Corporate Communications, Engineering, operations, and business teams to establish requirements, resolve complex issues, and drive decisions.
  • Partner with technology vendors and internal Engineering teams to evaluate platform capabilities, solution options, integrations, and enhancements against business and employee experience needs.
  • Define and monitor platform and experience success measures, using analytics, employee feedback, operational insights, and business outcomes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Establish reusable standards, requirements frameworks, and solution practices that improve consistency and scalability across the Digital Workplace portfolio.
  • Mentor junior team members and help strengthen Digital Workplace, business systems analysis, and product practices across the team.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, communications technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting Digital Workplace, Corporate Communications, Internal Communications, Employee Experience, or related enterprise technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience with digital workplace and communications platforms, including technologies such as intranet and web platforms, content management systems (CMS), email and campaign platforms, event management technologies, employee engagement tools, or digital asset management solutions.
  • Experience translating business and employee needs into scalable technology solutions, including business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and solution recommendations.
  • Experience contributing to digital product strategy, roadmaps, platform enhancements, and capability planning, with the ability to balance business value, user experience, technical feasibility, and dependencies.
  • Strong experience partnering with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and technology vendors to evaluate solutions and guide products from discovery and design through implementation and ongoing optimization.
  • Experience working in Agile product development environments, including requirements definition, backlog refinement, feature scoping, iteration planning, testing, and release readiness.
  • Experience with Jira or similar product development tools used to manage requirements, user stories, features, backlogs, and development activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate complex business and technology challenges, identify dependencies and trade-offs, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience leveraging platform analytics, employee insights, and other data to evaluate digital experiences, identify opportunities, and inform product and solution decisions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear analysis, recommendations, and executive-level communications.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem solving and critical thinking skills
  • Effective communicator, skilled in storytelling and verbal reasoning

Telemundo Station Group, part of the NBCUniversal Owned Television Stations division of NBCUniversal, is comprised of 26 local television stations in the U.S. and Puerto Rico.   • Work closely with News Director, Executive Producer and Assignment manager on story/sweeps planning and coordination.
  • Understand newscast mission, station priorities and be familiar with all the platforms.
  • Leadership: take responsibility for own actions and take risks for the team and be a team player.
  • Be detail oriented, organized, and able to handle intense deadline pressure.

Media Monitoring and Industry Intelligence

We are looking for a high-performing finance professional to help shape the finance experience at NBCU for years to come. The person in the role will be a part of the team leading change in financial processes, systems, and presentation across the finance organization. For this reason, this person needs to be a high performer in the finance space with solid business acumen, while also system and data savvy, and have a talent for visual and process design. This role is part of our Corporate HQ team, supporting total company consolidation with visibility to senior leadership (including NBCUniversal CFO and EVP of FP&A), and will also work with finance teams across the company – a great opportunity to learn about a variety of businesses (TV/Streaming, Studios, Parks) as well as a variety of areas of finance (operational vs FP&A, revenue vs cost, business unit vs consolidation).

NBCU finance is going through a multi-year transformation to new systems, and in doing so we are also redesigning many of our processes. One of our initiatives is to transition FP&A and operational planning onto SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC). SAC combines the capabilities of modern data analytics (think Power BI or Tableau) with driver-based planning and consolidation. The person in this role will collaborate with finance teams and IT to design and develop new SAC planning and analytic solutions. In addition to SAC projects, more broadly, this role will help to enhance the finance organization through other means (for example: process design, report/dashboard creation, developing AI use cases, system/solution training & admin, etc.).

Note: a candidate’s experience level will determine the seniority and compensation of this role (Manager vs Senior Manager) and therefore also performance expectations.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with various teams to design and build SAC planning & analytics solutions
  • Design & build SAC models & dashboards for Corporate FP&A and other teams across the company
  • Lead SAC trainings and dashboard building workshops (this will come later after sufficient time to become familiar with the tool)
  • Own continuous FP&A and operational finance process improvement, including seeking and adopting new features/technologies as they become available
  • Potential to manage Corporate FP&A system instance as business user administrator
  • Other responsibilities and projects as needed – we are change leaders in a changing organization and company, so we maintain flexibility as priorities shift

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or other relevant area and a minimum of 3 years of experience in FP&A, operational finance, or related roles
  • Experience in the media industry is a plus but not required
  • Strong business acumen, with understanding of finance/FP&A methodologies, processes, and systems
  • Exceptional ability to visually represent financial insights in a clear and informative way
  • Experience using data analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, SAC, Anaplan, or similar)
  • Skills that will enable success in this role:
    • Strong business acumen
    • Problem solving/process design
    • Visual design (reports & dashboards)
    • Data & finance/analytics systems savviness
    • Collaboration & project management

job.title: Data Architect (Microsoft Fabric)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As a Data Architect, you will play a foundational role in the design and implementation of Unified Data, a net-new, greenfield enterprise data ecosystem for NBCUniversal Operations & Technology. Built primarily on Microsoft Fabric, Unified Data will establish a centralized, governed data foundation that brings together real-time operational events and historical data across enterprise technology domains to support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and reusable data products.

You will define the target-state architecture, data organization and modeling standards, integration patterns, security and governance framework, and engineering practices for the platform. Operating within a complex and evolving technical environment, you will exercise independent judgment to evaluate multiple architectural approaches, assess interdependencies and technical tradeoffs, and determine solutions where established patterns or precedent may be limited. The data landscape spans areas including IT service management, employee and workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity and access, infrastructure and network services, collaboration platforms, operational telemetry, and enterprise master and reference data.

In addition to serving as the lead architect, you will act as a technical leader for the delivery team, providing guidance and translating architecture and business requirements into actionable engineering work, helping create and refine epics, stories, and tasks, identifying dependencies and sequencing, and ensuring work is aligned to the appropriate resources and teams while providing technical guidance throughout implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Microsoft Fabric Architecture & Strategy: Independently define the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, notebooks, and semantic models to support cross-domain Operations & Technology use cases.
  • Greenfield Platform Architecture: Develop and establish the foundational architecture, standards, environment strategy, workspace organization, security boundaries, deployment patterns, and operating principles for a net-new enterprise data platform.
  • Technical Leadership & Delivery Enablement: Serve as the technical leader for the delivery team by translating architecture and program objectives into epics, stories, tasks, dependencies, and implementation sequencing while helping route work to the appropriate resources and teams.
  • Enterprise Data Centralization: Drive the consolidation of fragmented operational data into a centralized and discoverable ecosystem using domain-aligned data products, authoritative data sources, reusable shared datasets, and common data contracts.
  • Operational Data Architecture: Design solutions spanning IT service management, workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity, infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, telemetry, events, logs, and enterprise reference data. Evaluate cross-domain dependencies and technical tradeoffs to determine architectural approaches that address complex and evolving requirements.
  • Real-Time & Historical Data Design: Architect solutions that combine streaming and event-driven operational data with historical, transactional, master, and reference data to support operational visibility, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Lakehouse & Warehouse Patterns: Establish scalable patterns for raw, enriched, and curated data layers, Delta-based lakehouse designs, warehouse workloads, OneLake shortcuts, virtualization, partitioning, optimization, retention, and performance management.
  • Data Modeling & Semantic Standards: Define enterprise modeling principles, canonical entities, conformed dimensions, shared business definitions, and semantic standards using dimensional, normalized, domain-oriented, or hybrid approaches as appropriate.
  • Integration & Pipeline Architecture: Define resilient and reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, files, CDC, batch processing, and event streams.
  • Data Governance, Security & Quality: Partner with security, privacy, and governance teams to establish access controls, metadata, lineage, classification, data ownership, data contracts, quality standards, retention policies, and lifecycle controls.
  • Architecture Standards & Documentation: Independently develop and maintain target-state architectures, reference architectures, architecture decision records, data flow diagrams, technical standards, reusable patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
  • DevOps & Engineering Standards: Establish expectations for source control, CI/CD, environment promotion, infrastructure and configuration automation, testing, monitoring, deployment controls, and release management.
  • Architecture Review & Technical Governance: Lead reviews and advise teams on solution designs and major technical decisions to ensure implementations remain aligned with Unified Data architecture, security requirements, performance expectations, and engineering standards.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, solution architecture, or related roles, including responsibility for designing, establishing, or materially evolving enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience translating architecture and technical strategy into executable roadmaps, epics, stories, tasks, and implementation plans.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead across multidisciplinary engineering teams or complex technical programs.
  • Strong experience designing lakehouse and/or warehouse architectures, including layered data patterns from raw ingestion through curated and consumable datasets.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency with Python and/or PySpark for data engineering, automation, prototyping, and technical validation.
  • Experience architecting data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Azure, or comparable enterprise cloud data platforms.
  • Experience designing both batch and real-time/event-driven data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data integration, distributed data processing, and enterprise integration patterns.

The Director, Content Analytics & Insights, will sit on the NBC/Bravo Cross-Platform Analytics team within NBCU Media Group Decision Sciences and serve as a key leader overseeing content performance and forecasting for entertainment series across NBC and Bravo, including linear and Peacock performance. This role acts as a strategic authority on content and audience intelligence, managing a high-performing team responsible for delivering actionable insights, scalable analytical frameworks, and self-service data solutions for a wide range of NBCU stakeholders and clients.

This leader will partner closely with Content Programming, Scheduling, Marketing, Ad Sales/Finance, Communications, and Strategy while integrating with other groups across Decision Sciences to translate first- and third-party Nielsen data into clear recommendations that inform business decision-making. The role will have a direct and measurable impact on the success of NBC and Bravo entertainment series in the linear and streaming landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop deep expertise for NBC Entertainment and Bravo content performance and audiences across linear and Peacock, serving as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders across Programming, Scheduling, Comms/PR, Strategy, Marketing, and Finance
  • Leverage Nielsen data and first-party data to create impactful cross-platform insights with the ability to translate different methodologies, a variety of linear/streaming KPIs and complex analyses into clear, compelling written/verbal narratives and internal presentations tailored to diverse audiences, including senior creative executives and external partners
  • Develop and oversee linear ratings forecasts and audience projections, leveraging historical performance, marketplace trends, and viewing behaviors to deliver actionable guidance for Ad Sales, Finance, and Scheduling stakeholders
  • Partner closely with Consumer Insights to shape research agendas and deliver integrated, holistic perspectives on content performance and audience engagement via comprehensive End of Season reports
  • Translate audience data to provide strategic consultation and research support to Programming, Marketing, Finance, and Strategy stakeholders (often thru ad-hoc and urgent requests), helping inform decisions related to content development, scheduling, promotion, audience growth, and franchise expansion
  • Identify emerging audience trends and changes in viewing behavior across the broader linear and streaming landscape, proactively surfacing competitive intel, implications and strategic opportunities for NBCUniversal's entertainment portfolio
  • Collaborate with Operations & Technology teams to oversee the data requirements, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of data products that enable scalable, self-service access to insights across NBCU
  • Own projects end-to-end, from framing and planning through execution and delivery, ensuring outputs are timely, accurate and aligned with business objectives
  • Champion data democratization, performance storytelling, and data-driven decision-making across the organization
  • Harness AI solution to accelerate analysis, surface patterns and trends, and deepen actionable insight
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing, high-output analytics team while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and equitable culture within NBCUniversal

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in the media and entertainment industry, with a strong track record of working with large, complex datasets (Nielsen and first-party) and advanced analytical tools
  • Expertise in Nielsen measurement methodology, data and reporting systems (NPower, NNTV) with experience running complex segmentation analyses for both linear/traditional and streaming content/platforms
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively, confidently, and persuasively with stakeholders at all levels, especially executive leadership, and comfort presenting and speaking extemporaneously in senior forums
  • Strong working knowledge of the streaming/media landscape and a love and appreciation for great unscripted and scripted content
  • Strategic, outcome-oriented thinker with the ability to derive insights, conclusions, and recommendations from ambiguous or unstructured data from disparate sources
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance workflows, including automating repetitive work, synthesizing large and disparate datasets to surface themes, and identifying patterns and trends more quickly
  • Highly collaborative leader with strong intellectual curiosity, accountability, detail-oriented mindset, and the ability to drive projects of varying scope with clarity and purpose
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative or analytical field required
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, SQL and Tableau

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supervising entry-level and mid-career employees

Additional Requirements

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

We are looking for a Director of Product to lead Audience Decisioning & Marketing Effectiveness within NBCUniversal Enterprise Product. This role leads products that help marketers identify and engage the right audiences, measure the impact of those decisions, and continuously improve marketing effectiveness. The portfolio spans audience exploration and creation, predictive decisioning, experimentation, measurement, and optimization.

As Director, you will own portfolio strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities and lead a product team responsible for turning consumer intelligence into scalable marketing capabilities. You will build, lead, and grow a high-performing product team establishing clear ownership, strong product practices, and the capabilities needed as the portfolio evolves. You will partner closely with Marketing, Marketing Strategy & Success, Consumer Data, Consumer Identity, Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, and activation teams to build reusable products that serve brands and businesses across NBCUniversal.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop product team members, establish clear ownership, and use marketer feedback, product usage, experimental results, and business outcomes to guide prioritization, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Define and communicate the product vision, portfolio strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for audience decisioning and marketing effectiveness products.
  • Lead products across the marketing decision-and-learning lifecycle, including audience exploration and creation, predictive recommendations, measurement, learning, and optimization.
  • Develop audience and decisioning capabilities that help marketers understand consumers, identify relevant behavioral signals, compare and prioritize audiences, and determine appropriate marketing actions, including capabilities such as affinity, propensity, response prediction, and next-best-action.
  • Lead marketing effectiveness capabilities including experimentation, incrementality, promotional effectiveness, audience treatment effects, creative effectiveness, channel effectiveness, and cross-channel learning.

NBCUniversal is looking for a Director of Revenue Growth Platforms to lead product strategy for capabilities that support growing and emerging areas of our advertising business. Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales Revenue and Platforms, this role will focus on improving how sellers identify opportunities, engage prospects, manage leads, and move business through the sales lifecycle. 

The role will support key growth areas including Programmatic, Universal Ads, Local, and SMBG, with a particular focus on lead generation and prospecting, sales workflows, and the platforms that enable them. 

This person will bring a strong understanding of sales technology and the lead-to-revenue lifecycle, including how prospecting and lead intelligence platforms connect with CRM and downstream sales workflows. They will partner across Sales, Product, Operations, Data, and Technology to define product strategy, identify opportunities, and develop scalable capabilities that improve seller productivity, speed, and revenue growth.  

The Platform Solutions team provides support and builds business solutions for Sales, Planning, Marketing, Research, Account Management, and Finance departments across a national and global ad sales landscape. The Director of Revenue Growth Platforms will support NBCUniversal’s National Ad Sales team in the development and execution of all Ad Sales processes in Salesforce.  

Responsibilities 

  • Define and drive product strategy and roadmap for Revenue Growth products supporting newer and growing areas of NBCUniversal's advertising business 
  • Develop a deep understanding of the needs and workflows of Programmatic, Universal Ads, Local, and SMB sales teams and translate those needs into product opportunities
  • Own product strategy across the lead and prospecting lifecycle, including prospect identification, enrichment, qualification, assignment, engagement, and conversion 
  • Evaluate how lead generation, prospecting, sales intelligence, and CRM capabilities should work together to create a connected seller experience 
  • Assess external platforms and emerging technologies to determine where NBCUniversal should buy, integrate, enhance, or build capabilities 
  • Partner with Sales leadership and users to identify friction within existing workflows and determine where better tools, data, integrations, or processes can improve seller productivity and revenue outcomes 
  • Translate business opportunities into clear product strategies, requirements, priorities, and success measures

  • Understand upstream and downstream system dependencies and ensure new capabilities fit within the broader sales and advertising workflow 
  • Partner with Programmatic Sales and Operations teams to understand evolving business needs and identify opportunities for product and workflow improvements 
  • Identify common capabilities that can scale across sales teams while recognizing where different business models require differentiated workflows 
  • Use seller feedback, adoption, workflow performance, and business outcomes to evaluate product effectiveness and inform future investments 
  • Develop business cases and recommendations for new platforms, integrations, capabilities, and product investments 
  • Build alignment across a highly matrixed organization, connecting business strategy with Product, Technology, Data, and Operations execution 
  • Stay current on sales technology, lead intelligence, prospecting, CRM, programmatic, and advertising industry trends to inform product strategy 
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners responsible for Revenue Growth capabilities. 
  • Drive product management best practices, including roadmap planning, requirements management, stakeholder engagement, and value measurement. 
  • Act as an escalation point for complex business, process, and technology decisions impacting Revenue Growth platforms. 

Required Qualifications/Skills 

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Sales Technology, Revenue Technology, or a related role supporting complex sales organizations. 
  • Strong understanding of the lead-to-revenue lifecycle, including prospecting, lead generation, enrichment, qualification, lead management, and conversion. 
  • Experience with sales prospecting, lead intelligence, or data platforms and an understanding of how these capabilities integrate with CRM platforms such as Salesforce. 
  • Strong understanding of sales technology ecosystems and the role technology and data play in enabling different sales motions. 
  • Experience developing product strategy and roadmaps based on business needs, user workflows, market capabilities, and technology considerations. 
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate technology solutions and make thoughtful build, buy, and integrate recommendations. 
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology teams to deliver cross-functional capabilities. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities. 
  • Experience leading and developing Product Managers, Business Analysts, or cross-functional product teams.  
  • Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product organizations. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across a highly matrixed organization. 
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences and clearly present product recommendations. 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience working within advertising, media, streaming, ad tech, or a large enterprise sales organization. 
  • Experience supporting SMB, emerging business, Local, or other high-volume sales organizations. 
  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising sales and operational workflows. 
  • Experience with lead generation, prospecting, enrichment, and sales intelligence technologies 
  • Understanding of Salesforce lead, account, contact, and opportunity workflows and how external sales platforms integrate with CRM.

The Director, Sales Planning & Administration is responsible for leading title lifecycle management, deal administration, rights governance, and operational execution across assigned international territories. This role serves as a strategic operational partner to Commercial Sales, Account Management, Legal, Finance, Distribution, and Strategy, ensuring contractual compliance, inventory accuracy, and executional readiness throughout the licensing lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate is a seasoned distribution operations leader with deep expertise in rights management, window management, title availability, and enterprise system governance. This individual will possess a comprehensive understanding of the international television distribution business, including output and volume licensing structures, first-run title commitments, product qualification processes, and the end-to-end workflow from deal negotiation through operational execution. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong people leadership, operational rigor, strategic thinking, and cross-functional influence while ensuring accountability, data integrity, and executional excellence across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities:

Contract Governance & Rights Compliance 

  • Oversee all licensing activities in strict accordance with executed agreements, approved deal terms, distribution policy, and corporate SLAs. 
  • Conduct regular contract and rights audits to validate that system data matches active executed legal terms and mitigate operational exposure. 
  • Partner with Legal and Commercial Sales to evaluate amendments, waivers, title substitutions, and contract revisions prior to execution. 
  • Maintain official territory rules governing window structures, holdbacks, and commercial restrictions across transactional, output volume, and linear business models. 

Database Integrity, Pre-Submission QA & System Controls 

  • Oversee system setups in enterprise databases (SAFE) to ensure accurate configuration of rate cards, pricing, rights, and territory parameters prior to downstream release. 
  • Execute rigorous quality control over all outgoing tracking grids, budget files, and system setups to prevent fulfillment errors, data gaps, or feed disruptions. 
  • Manage database title blocking, pending order statuses, and configuration rules to ensure smooth supply chain feeds and eliminate artificial product availability blocks. 

  • Implement workflow improvements, automation initiatives, and reporting controls to enhance operational scalability and data accuracy. 

Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Governance 

  • Manage day-to-day operational support and title volume commitments across assigned international territories, ensuring full launch readiness and customer fulfillment. 
  • Drive end-to-end visibility into active deal pipelines, rights availability constraints, and market-specific operational risks. 
  • Act as the primary Sales Administration lead to Commercial Sales, Legal, Account Management, and Distribution Strategy on deal execution, windowing strategy, and title prioritization. 
  • Partner with Finance to audit revenue recognition assumptions, billing readiness, and forecasting impacts prior to deal finalization. 
  • Foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and operational rigor across all internal stakeholder groups. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Management 

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Managers and Assistant Managers, including second-line management responsibilities where applicable. 
  • Establish clear expectations around ownership, accountability, prioritization, and service delivery standards. 
  • Coach people leaders on issue resolution, workload management, stakeholder engagement, and employee development. 
  • Conduct performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building. 
  • Lead onboarding, training, knowledge transfer, and territory transition activities to ensure business continuity and operational consistency. 

Basic Requirements: 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Content Distribution, Sales Administration, Rights Management, Contract Administration, Account Management Operations, Distribution Operations, or related media entertainment functions. 
  • Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing Managers and/or second-line teams within a major studio, broadcaster, streamer, or content distributor. 
  • Demonstrated experience supporting international television and film licensing businesses across multiple territories and distribution platforms. 
  • Experience supporting output, volume, package, and library licensing agreements across international markets. 
  • Comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end distribution workflow and stakeholder functions

job.title: DreamWorks Technology - Principal Engineer, AI
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world's leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together. 

DreamWorks is seeking a highly collaborative AI Architect who will be a hands-on technical leader assistive across multiple teams aimed to provide results to both technical and creative departments. This role involves identifying, designing, and delivering AI-powered agentic architecture that eliminates the repetitive, manual, low-creativity tasks that pull artists and production management away from their craft, while maintaining high operational availability to ensure production systems run reliably. An ideal candidate should be an adventurous, growth-minded problem solver who thrives in collaborative environments, values transparency and trust, and possesses a deep passion for leveraging technology to empower artists and storytellers. 

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

“What would you say you do here?”

  • Collaborate and advise on next-generation AI-assisted agentic workflows strategy alongside product owners, developers and creatives. 
  • Design and own the architecture for AI-powered frameworks and automation across the entire Studio pipeline and platforms.
  • Define the end-to-end architecture for ingestion, processing, and routing of operational telemetry (metrics, logs, traces).
  • Integrate solutions with popular industry DCC tools.
  • Prototype solutions for high-friction tasks: asset tagging, scene prep, render queue management, shot setup, and versioning.
  • Define technical standards and integration patterns for AI tooling across departments and shows.
  • Evaluate and select AI frameworks, foundation models, and automation technologies for creative production and operational stability.
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable AI components and automation patterns.
  • Partner with platform, systems and security teams to monitor model drift, system latency, and system security.
  • Write, test, and deploy production-ready tools that run reliably inside active show pipelines.
  • Develop reference implementations that set the canonical pattern for future pipeline AI work.
  • Partner with engineers and TDs to fold automation into existing artist-facing toolsets.
  • Maintain and iterate on deployed tools based on artist feedback and production data.
  • Drive adoption across both technical and creative departments so tools are understood, trusted, and used.
  • Create lightweight training and documentation for artists and engineers.
  • Establish metrics for automation impact and report results to studio leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and surface new automation opportunities as workflows evolve.

“What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years building production systems, with 2+ years building AI/ML systems for real workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying enterprise software in AI, data, or integration environments.
  • Expertise with containerization, orchestration, Python, TypeScript, React, and AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Spring AI and MCP.
  • Deep understanding of LLM model integration and tuning.
  • Experience with designing automation that reduces manual work in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven ability to influence senior engineers without authority and to be the person others learn from.
  • History of building and supporting durable artifacts: frameworks, templates, training, open source that extend to other projects.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate fluently between artists, production management, and engineers.
  • Genuine passion for animation, storytelling, or creative production.

“What can I offer?”

  • 2+ years in a Principal, Staff, or Lead role responsible for AI or pipeline automation, ideally in a creative studio.
  • Strong understanding of the animation production pipeline, departmental workflows, and industry-standard digital content creation (DCC) software.
  • Familiarity with animation frameworks and standards such as USD, Autodesk Flow Production Tracking and Jira.
  • Experience measuring and reporting the productivity impact of engineering tooling investments.
  • Stays current with AI trends and emerging technologies.

We are a leading animation studio known for pushing the boundaries of storytelling and visual artistry. Our teams of artists, technologists, and storytellers collaborate to create unforgettable animated experiences. We are looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about the user experience to be a technical Product Owner who sets the vision and strategy for tools that empower our creative teams.

With a focus on product ownership, you will be conducting user research that reflects the voice of our internal users such as animators, designers, and production staff, ensuring their needs are deeply understood and reflected in the tools and workflows we build. You will work closely with cross-functional technical teams to deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions that enhance creative productivity and collaboration.

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

    • Champion a culture of user-centered design and iterative improvement.
  • Software Design & Development
    • Partner with technical leadership to validate feasibility of requirements.
    • Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate concepts.

  • You will manage resource allocation and facilitate timely feature delivery.
  • You will coordinate with peers on adjacent teams to refine product priorities, track progress, align delivery schedules, and weigh trade-offs.
  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience in a fast paced, high growth tech environment.
  • Strong people management experience with highly technical teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, with a track record of implementing and refining processes that drive team efficiency and effectiveness. 
  • Ability to work backwards from the big picture to deliver incremental milestones without getting bogged down in bureaucracy.
  • Experience coordinating across multiple teams, including aligning teams’ goals with a collaborative, team-oriented approach.
  • A demonstrated aptitude, enthusiasm, and willingness to learn new methods, tools, practices and skills.

  • Strong background in Software Engineering, with experience in managing technical teams and delivering complex projects.
  • Organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide a diverse team
  • High emotional quotient, with a proven ability to communicate and align with technical and nontechnical stakeholders with a variety of skillsets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively across teams and present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • An intuition and enthusiasm for launching groundbreaking, deep-tech products.
  • Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus/Nice-to-Have Characteristics:

  • Experience with modern C++ and Python will give you deeper insights into the technology you are managing.
  • Experience in the fields of computer graphics, computer vision, or visual computing, with a strong understanding of core concepts, algorithms, and tools used to create, analyze, and manipulate visual data.
  • Experience with procedural modeling techniques to create scalable, dynamic 3D assets and environments, utilizing tools such as Houdini, Blender, or custom scripting for automated content generation.

Position Overview:

As part of the Peacock Data Science team, the Senior Lead Data Scientist will be responsible for creating recommendation and personalization solutions for one or more verticals of Peacock Video Streaming Service. 

You’ll collaborate with an international, cross-functional team of engineers, architects, product managers and analysts to identify and prioritize enhancements to Peacock’s personalization models. Your responsibilities will touch everything from feature creation to model evaluation and deployment, and you’ll have opportunities to work on cutting edge machine learning like foundation models and reinforcement learning.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.

  • Experience with commercial recommender systems or a lead role in an advanced research recommender system project.
  • Strong working experience with deep learning.
  • Proficient in Python.  
  • Experience in data processing using SQL and PySpark.
  • Experience working with foundation models and other GenAI technologies.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience in media analytics and application of data science to the content streaming and TV industry.
  • Good understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and graph methodologies.
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, and Databricks (or equivalent).
  • Experience with large-scale video assets.
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des plus importantes entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous distribuons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de marques dans les domaines du cinéma, de la télévision et de la diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre par l’intermédiaire de nos destinations de parcs thématiques, de nos produits de consommation et de nos expériences à l’échelle mondiale. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’intermédiaire d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de contribuer à leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Lead Environment Artist, is responsible for support the visual direction, quality standards, and production workflows for all in-game environments. You’ll guide a team of environment artists, collaborate closely with art direction and design, and ensure that every location in the game is visually compelling, performant, and aligned with the project’s creative vision.

  • Establish and maintain the artistic vision for environments in partnership with the Associate Art Director (World) & Art Director.
  • Lead, mentor, and support a team of environment artists, providing feedback, coaching, and career development.
  • Review environment assets and scenes to ensure consistency, quality, and adherence to technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with level design to ensure environments support gameplay flow, readability, and player experience.
  • Work closely with other art leads and technical art leads to enhanced atmosphere, performance, and visual cohesion.
  • Drive improvements to pipelines, tools, and workflows to increase efficiency and maintain high production quality.
  • Partner with Associate Producer & Content Producer to plan tasks, estimate timelines, and manage team workload.
  • Troubleshoot complex environment‑related issues and propose scalable solutions.
  • Contribute to documentation, style guides, and best practices for environment creation.

RESPONSABILITÉS

En tant que Chef.fe Artiste d'environnement, la personne titulaire du poste est responsable de soutenir la direction visuelle, les normes de qualité et les processus de production pour tous les environnements en jeu. Vous guiderez une équipe d’artistes d’environnement, collaborerez étroitement avec la direction artistique et le design, et veillerez à ce que chaque lieu du jeu soit visuellement captivant, performant et conforme à la vision créative du projet.

  • Établir et maintenir la vision artistique des environnements en partenariat avec la direction artistique associée (monde) et la direction artistique.
  • Diriger, encadrer et soutenir une équipe d’artistes d’environnement en fournissant de la rétroaction, du coaching et du soutien au développement de carrière.
  • Réviser les assets et les scènes d’environnement afin d’assurer leur cohérence, leur qualité et leur conformité aux contraintes techniques.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe de level design afin que les environnements favorisent la fluidité du gameplay, la lisibilité et l’expérience de jeu.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les autres leads artistiques et les leads en art technique afin d’améliorer l’atmosphère, la performance et la cohésion visuelle.
  • Piloter l’amélioration des pipelines, des outils et des processus de travail afin d’accroître l’efficacité et de maintenir une grande qualité de production.
  • Collaborer avec l’Associate Producer et le Content Producer pour planifier les tâches, estimer les échéanciers et gérer la charge de travail de l’équipe.
  • Résoudre des problèmes complexes liés aux environnements et proposer des solutions évolutives.
  • Contribuer à la documentation, aux guides de style et aux meilleures pratiques de création d’environnements.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 2–4 years creating 3D environments for shipped games.
  • Experience with 3D packages such as Maya, Max, Blender, or Modo.
  • Experience with world-building or level-editing tools.

job.title: Lead IT GRC Analyst (Policy Management)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Lead IT GRC Analyst will lead the operational execution, integration, and continuous improvement of the Cyber Governance & Controls function. This role will support turning a broad portfolio of governance work including policies, standards, configuration baselines, Cybersecurity Risk Acceptance Memoranda, long-term governance models, control libraries, and governance advisory engagements into a coordinated, measurable enterprise service.

The successful candidate will serve as the operational leader connecting Governance strategy to day-to-day execution. The role will partner across Cybersecurity, Operations & Technology, Legal, Privacy, Audit, Procurement, and various business stakeholders to establish clear ownership, decision rights, evidence, review cadences, exception paths, and sustainable control outcomes.

This role enables delivery across eight connected service lines: policy and standards lifecycle management; security baselines and control governance; vendor security management; continuous third-party monitoring; GRC tooling and workflow automation; data protection governance; program governance advisory; and regulatory, audit, and standards interpretation. The position is differentiated from traditional project management by its accountability for the operating health, maturity, adoption, traceability, and effectiveness of Governance itself.

Responsibilities

Governance Operations

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Governance operating procedures, playbooks, lifecycle schedules, decision records, and recurring operating rhythms.
  • Coordinate policy forums, standards review, governance working sessions, steering decisions, escalations, action-item closure, and quarterly operating reviews.
  • Serve as coordinator for the Global Cybersecurity Governance Steering Committee, including agenda planning, materials, stakeholder alignment, decision tracking, action-item follow-through, and governance reporting.
  • Chair the Global Cybersecurity Governance Working Group, facilitating cross-functional discussion, driving alignment on governance priorities, escalating decisions as needed, and ensuring actions are assigned, documented, and completed.
  • Define and maintain roles, decision rights, RACIs, reviewers, approvers, accountable service owners, evidence expectations, and exception paths across Governance services.
  • Establish a consistent definition of done for governance outcomes spanning ownership, documented requirements, operational process, automation, monitoring, metrics, exceptions, and recurring review.
  • Separate administrative, technical, and operational governance so that requirements are not only approved, but implemented, monitored, evidenced, and sustained.

Policy, Standards, Baselines & Risk Acceptance Governance

  • Operate the end-to-end lifecycle for cyber policies, standards, configuration baselines, procedures, and supporting guidance, including intake, drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, communication, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Maintain the Cyber Policy Library, authoritative document hierarchy, review calendar, approval evidence, version history, control mappings, glossary, and publication quality controls.
  • Coordinate development and renewal of Cybersecurity Risk Acceptance Memoranda, including validated current-state data, residual-risk statements, accountable owners, corrective-action plans, milestones, approval records, audit dependencies, reporting, and retirement criteria.
  • Help transition broad, recurring risk acceptances toward targeted, risk-based exception and monitoring processes where sustainable ownership and evidence can be established.
  • Support requirement-centric governance by mapping policies, standards, baselines, and controls to authoritative frameworks and identifying opportunities to automate governance workflows, document reviews, approval processes, and evidence collection.

Service Management & Enablement

  • Maintain the Cyber Governance & Controls service catalog, definitions, owners, RACIs, inputs, outputs, dependencies, intake paths, service levels, and records of authority.
  • Coordinate operational visibility across policy and standards, control baselines, vendor security, continuous third-party monitoring, GRC tooling, data protection, governance advisory, and audit and standards interpretation.
  • Develop and administer common intake, triage, prioritization, status, decision, escalation, evidence, and closure practices while preserving accountability with service owners.
  • Measure demand, throughput, aging, adoption, quality, stakeholder experience, control effectiveness, and operational health across the Governance portfolio.
  • Identify work already delivered through remediation and transformation programs and make it visible through consistent governance tagging, ownership, reporting, and sustainment criteria.
  • Improve self-service through clear guidance, reusable patterns, decision trees, communications, training, and content structured for both people and AI-enabled assistants.

Metrics, Reporting & Executive Communications

  • Develop and maintain Governance metrics, key performance indicators, scorecards, and dashboards.
  • Produce executive updates, quarterly operating reviews, and portfolio health reporting.
  • Track strategic initiatives, risks, dependencies, decisions, maturity objectives, and service performance.
  • Translate complex Governance information into clear, business-oriented insights and leadership materials.

Governance Strategy & Transformation Support

  • Support execution of the Cyber Governance & Controls maturation strategy across near-term stabilization, multi-year integration and automation, and continuous, intelligence-led governance.
  • Convert time-bound remediation and transformation initiatives into sustainable business-as-usual governance with named owners, documented processes, preventive and detective controls, metrics, evidence, exception handling, and recurring review.
  • Coordinate governance design for major programs such as Frontier AI, Attack Surface Management, identity and service-account governance, secure management-plane initiatives, high-risk travel, data protection, and third-party risk.
  • Advance GRC modernization by defining authoritative systems of record and practical integration across ServiceNow IRM, LogicGate RiskCloud, Jira, risk hubs, policy repositories, dashboards, and evidence sources.
  • Facilitate maturity assessments, current-state inventories, gap analysis, target operating models, governance gates, leadership decisions, roadmap milestones, and continuous-improvement plans.
  • Partner with established program management teams while retaining ownership of Governance-specific operating models, service practices, metrics, decision rights, and enablement.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build productive partnerships across Cybersecurity, Operations & Technology, Legal, Privacy, Audit, Procurement, and various business stakeholders.
  • Facilitate stakeholder alignment, decision-making, communications, and socialization for Governance initiatives.
  • Support organizational change and adoption activities associated with new or revised Governance services and processes.
  • Act as a central point of coordination for Governance operating information without replacing accountable service owners or enterprise program managers.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in governance, risk management, compliance, cybersecurity operations, business operations, service operations, or a related discipline.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Experience establishing and managing operating processes, governance frameworks, service management practices, or control environments.
  • Experience developing executive reporting, scorecards, dashboards, and performance measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple stakeholders and functions in a complex organization.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex governance and cybersecurity topics into clear, audience-appropriate messages.
  • Strong written, verbal, facilitation, analytical, and organizational skills.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supporting Governance, Risk and Compliance, cybersecurity, audit, third-party risk, or enterprise risk functions.
  • Knowledge of governance frameworks, controls management, policy management, and enterprise operating models.
  • Experience with ServiceNow IRM, LogicGate, Archer, Jira, or comparable governance and workflow platforms.
  • Familiarity with frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or CIS.
  • Demonstrated success driving operational excellence, process improvement, stakeholder adoption, and organizational change.
  • Ability to translate complex governance requirements into practical, sustainable business processes.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Understanding of AI governance principles, emerging AI risks, responsible AI practices, and the integration of AI requirements into enterprise governance and control frameworks.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, completeness, and high-quality deliverables.
  • Self-directed, collaborative, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a highly matrixed environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Cybersecurity governance and controls operating models
  • Policy, standard, configuration baseline, procedure, and guidance lifecycle management
  • Cybersecurity Risk Acceptance Memorandum, policy exception, corrective-action, and retirement governance
  • Service catalog, service ownership, intake, workflow, portfolio reporting, and operating health
  • Control libraries, framework mapping, evidence expectations, requirement-centric governance, and policy-as-code readiness
  • Third-party and vendor security governance, continuous monitoring, and incident-response integration
  • Data protection, AI, identity, attack surface, resilience, and infrastructure governance
  • GRC platforms, records of authority, workflow automation, dashboarding, and cross-system integration
  • Regulatory and audit interpretation, executive communications, and leadership decision support
  • Organizational change, stakeholder socialization, self-service enablement, and sustainable adoption

Additional Requirements

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service.
