NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, event monitoring, incident response, and threat hunting across the enterprise in a highly collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment. Cyber Response Operations serves as NBCUniversal’s 24x7 first line of defense against cyber threats. Event Analysts and Incident Responders follow the Incident Response Plan to identify, assess, contain, remediate, and document cyber events and incidents.

The Manager of Cyber Incident Response leads the Incident Response team while guiding and supporting the Event Analyst function. The role oversees escalations involving containment, remediation, forensic analysis, and coordination with impacted businesses and partner teams. This leader establishes the operating rigor needed for consistent performance while enabling responders to exercise sound judgment, creativity, and ownership.

The Manager is accountable for team readiness, workflow prioritization, escalation quality, process maturity, and employee development. The role requires regular engagement with business stakeholders, Information Security Officers, technical teams, vendors, and senior leadership during both routine operations and active incidents.

 

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage Incident Response operations, including prioritization, resource allocation, shift coverage, tooling requirements, workflow management, and escalation processes.
  • Ensure the NBCUniversal Incident Response Plan and supporting procedures are implemented and followed in day-to-day operations.
  • Oversee and manage cyber incidents across the NBCUniversal enterprise, from escalation and validation through containment, remediation, recovery support, and closure.
  • Serve as an Incident Handler or Incident Commander for significant incidents, coordinating response activities with impacted businesses, technical owners, and partner teams.
  • Act as the managerial escalation point for potential cyber incidents, responder support needs, and decisions requiring leadership awareness or approval.
  • Participate in the manager on-call rotation for cyber incident escalation and handling in a 24x7x365 global environment.
  • Supervise operational performance across shifts, ensuring consistent prioritization, ticket ownership, escalation discipline, and adherence to company standards.
  • Review shift handovers, queue health, and open incidents to ensure continuity, clear accountability, and timely follow-through across operating periods.
  • Maintain and enforce event and incident documentation standards, case-management requirements, key performance indicators, and process adherence.
  • Monitor operational metrics and trends, identify gaps, and implement improvements that strengthen effectiveness, risk reduction, and business impact.
  • Lead the review and governance of response processes, playbooks, tuning requests, automation opportunities, and technical procedures.
  • Drive the maturity, enhancement, and strategy of the Incident Response program in alignment with business and enterprise priorities.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Information Security Officers, business stakeholders, and other security and technology teams.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, including clear ownership, review cycles, approval requirements, and change management.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Incident Response personnel, providing regular feedback and supporting technical, professional, and career growth.
  • Create and deliver monthly metrics and executive reporting that communicate operational effectiveness, risk reduction, material trends, and business impact.
  • Communicate incident status, operational concerns, decisions, and risk clearly to business VIPs and senior leadership.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in an information technology-related field and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Seven or more years of cybersecurity or investigations experience, including at least four years in Incident Response, a Security Operations Center, threat intelligence, or a similar function.
  • Previous experience leading incident response operations, cybersecurity personnel, or complex incident coordination.
  • In-depth understanding of cyber threats, adversary techniques, response procedures, network and enterprise architecture, and threat detection.
  • Demonstrated ability to make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and coordinate response activities across multiple teams.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-demand role that may require nonstandard working hours.
  • Availability to support employee development and accept escalations arising in a 24x7x365 global environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams, incidents, and escalation paths.
  • Working knowledge of core enterprise technology concepts, including web application architecture, networking, identity, endpoint, email, and cloud services.
  • Experience with host-based and network-based forensic tools and analysis.
  • Knowledge of recognized security and analysis frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, the Cyber Kill Chain, the Diamond Model, and NIST incident response guidance.
  • Experience applying security concepts in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform environments.
  • Knowledge of incident response technologies and capabilities such as EDR, XDR, SOAR, case management, and response automation.
  • Experience developing or improving incident-management processes, playbooks, metrics, or automation.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief technical professionals, business stakeholders, and senior executives.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt to changing and fast-paced environments.

Desired Characteristics

  • Prior experience managing a Cyber Incident Response, Security Operations Center, or related cyber defense function.
  • Experience supporting incident response or SOC operations for a large, complex, or global enterprise.
  • Hands-on familiarity with endpoint detection and response, forensic, network-analysis, email-security, and cloud-security technologies.
  • Relevant security certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCIA, CISSP, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated success improving operational discipline, employee development, cross-team coordination, and executive communication.

Additional Requirements: 

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range $110k - $170k (bonus eligible)

You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

Universal Products & Experiences Overview:

At Universal Products & Experiences (UP&E), we don’t just create products—we create a universe that fans can hold in their hands, wear, play, read, and experience every day. From Jurassic World’s roaring adventures to the playful charm of Minions and the timeless wonder of Back to the Future, we transform stories into unforgettable moments that spark joy across the globe.

UP&E has grown rapidly while keeping the energy, agility, and inventive spirit of a start‑up. Our mission is bold: to take imagination beyond the screen and into the real world through innovative products, immersive retail moments, and extraordinary theme park destinations. We bring both Universal-owned and third‑party worlds to life across expansive theme park destinations, e‑commerce platforms, live entertainment venues, and global retail partnerships—fueling fandom everywhere it lives. Whether it's iconic toys, fashion collaborations, books, collectibles, lifestyle products, or cutting‑edge video games, we work with world‑class licensees and creators to make our universe tangible.

Here, creativity meets technology, and strategy meets storytelling. We connect design, commercial excellence, and fan passion to deliver experiences that millions cherish—inside the parks and far beyond them. As part of Universal Destinations & Experiences, you’ll join a global team that thrives on collaboration, imagination, and the power of culture‑shaping ideas. Your work will inspire fans, uplift communities, and leave a lasting mark on entertainment history.

We believe in a workplace where every voice matters, every perspective is valued, and every colleague can shine. That’s how we strive to be an employer of choice for talent and a partner of choice for retailers, licensees, and creators who share our passion for world‑class storytelling. If you’re ready to bring imagination to life and create moments that resonate worldwide—your next adventure starts here.

Join us and help create moments that matter.

Universal Products & Experiences is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce of the highest caliber. We are committed to fostering equitable and inclusive environments that honor the experiences, perspectives, and uniqueness of each colleague.

As a Manager, Design & Development, you will lead the design, development, and execution of lifestyle accessory categories, including bags, backpacks, footwear, jewelry, socks, hair accessories, and related accessories, across multiple licensed and vertically integrated brands. You will partner with cross-functional teams, licensees, vendors, and manufacturers to bring innovative, high-quality products to market that align with brand standards, consumer expectations, and business objectives.

In this role, you will leverage your product design expertise, technical product development knowledge, and proficiency in 3D design, tech pack creation, AI-powered design tools, and draw-over techniques to bring concepts to life from ideation through production. You will serve as a key creative and product development partner, ensuring products are visually compelling, technically sound, commercially viable, and executed with excellence across assigned categories.

Design & Product Development

  • Design and oversee lifestyle accessory categories, including bags, backpacks, footwear, jewelry, socks, hair accessories, and related accessories.
  • Responsible for product execution, quality, innovation, and elevation across assigned categories.
  • Lead the design and development of accessory products across multiple licensed and vertically integrated brands.
  • Serve as the product development expert for assigned categories, leveraging a strong understanding of materials, fabrications, color palettes, construction methods, embellishments, and manufacturing techniques to deliver brand-right products across various price points.
  • Manage projects from initial concept through production, including trend research, sketches, Draw-overs, 3D renderings, tech packs, prototypes, and final design approvals.
  • Utilize AI-powered design tools and emerging technologies to enhance concept development, accelerate creative workflows, and drive innovation.
  • Create detailed tech packs and supporting development documentation to ensure successful product execution.
  • Develop and provide clear draw-overs, creative notes, graphic direction, typography guidance, and visual feedback for licensees and manufacturing partners.
  • Recommend and visually communicate commercially viable product ideas that elevate consumer products and Parks experiences.
  • Understand seasonal and emerging trends across fashion, graphics, color, materials, packaging, and product design, and translate them into compelling product opportunities.
  • Focus on delivering innovative, high-quality products across all assigned categories.

Creative Direction & Product Approval

  • Manage all 2D and 3D product approvals for assigned lifestyle accessory categories.
  • Be the creative asset expert for assigned categories and provide accurate, actionable design feedback.
  • Collaborate with licensees and external vendors to ensure product execution aligns with brand standards, design intent, quality expectations, and business objectives.
  • Research market trends, consumer insights, competitive activity, and emerging opportunities to inform innovative product concepts.
  • Develop creative tools including trend reports, style guides, product concepts, color direction, and visual assets to support IP priorities and product strategies.
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders to align product vision, business goals, and workload priorities, while collaborating with designers, freelancers, agencies, and external partners to ensure the successful execution of projects and initiatives.
  • Engage internal and external stakeholders to meet timelines, project milestones, and launch objectives.
  • Manage product approval workflows, including routing approvals through Legal, Compliance, Product Safety, and third-party IP stakeholders.
  • Utilize MediaBox, Adobe Launchpad, and related approval platforms to manage product review and approval processes.

Cross-Functional Collabration & Partner Management

  • Lead product approval meetings, ensuring all required feedback, approvals, and decisions are captured and communicated in a timely manner.
  • Understand licensee and vendor design and manufacturing capabilities to guide efficient product development and resolve execution challenges.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with licensees, vendors, manufacturers, and creative partners, including onboarding new partners when needed.
  • Lead kickoff meetings and product development discussions with licensees, vendors, and manufacturers.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior team members as appropriate.
  • Attend trade shows, retail visits, and licensee meetings as needed to stay current on industry trends and support business initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting recaps and communicate key decisions, action items, and next steps to stakeholders.
  • Actively contribute to product development and design perspectives during creative reviews and cross-functional discussions.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned to meet the evolving needs of the team and business.

The Media Group’s Growth Strategy team is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and championing key growth initiatives for the Media Group with a particular focus on Peacock. Our work focuses on strategic questions sourced directly from Chief Growth Officer Will Gonzalez and Media Group Growth leaders. Prioritized initiatives are key contributors to the broader organization’s financial goals and receive substantial leadership attention throughout their development, deployment, and optimization. By nature, Growth Strategy is a highly collaborative organization – partnering cross-functionally to analyze the latest data, align the organization to winning business strategies, and bring prioritized initiatives to market. 

About the Role

Growth Strategy’s Monetization & Innovation team is hiring a Manager to drive key workstreams around pricing, packaging, and offers strategy. The Manager will report into the VP, Monetization & Innovation and collaborate other team members to evaluate new monetization opportunities, support prioritized initiatives through deployment, and optimize operational initiatives. Through their contributions to the organization’s core DTC monetization strategy, this role will have outsized impact on Media Group growth and financial performance. 

The role is ideal for an analytically rigorous, intellectually curious professional with a strong grasp of the streaming landscape and a desire to contribute to high-impact strategy work in a fast-moving environment. Because our recommendations touch day-to-day operations across the organization, the role demands both analytical depth and cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Decision Sciences, Product, Marketing, and Growth.  The role will require the individual to: 

  • Drive growth and monetization opportunity assessments through data analysis and financial modeling, translating inputs into clear, actionable outputs 

  • Manage research and analysis to support the ongoing optimization of Peacock's pricing architecture, product offering, and offers strategy 

  • Ideate new opportunities based on evolving AI-enabled commerce activity, regulatory environment, and competitive landscape 

  • Synthesize and report on competitive activity across the streaming landscape, tracking pricing and packaging changes, offer positioning and capabilities, and go-to-market shifts 

  • Partner with Decision Sciences and Finance teams to size greenlit initiatives, track progress towards their targets, and enable a strategic feedback loop to business teams to improve go-forward decision-making 

  • Collaborate with Decision Sciences, Product, Marketing, and Growth colleagues to continually improve the offer capabilities and underlying strategy for Peacock 

  • Help lead the deployment of AI-enabled research and analytical tools to improve team velocity and efficiency 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, STEM, or related fields with 5+ years of experience in Strategy or Finance, ideally with exposure to media, streaming, or a related consumer industry 
  • Familiarity with the evolving streaming landscape, including key players, business models, and commercial tactics 
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, prioritizing effectively and deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight 
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy across both quantitative and qualitative deliverables 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings into clear summaries for senior stakeholders 
  • Experience with or interest in AI-enabled research and productivity tools is a plus 

Desired Characteristics

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a proactive, self-directed work style  
  • An excellent grasp of media economics and industry trends  
  • Exceptional Excel & PowerPoint skills  
  • Strong public speaking skills  
  • Strong project management skills

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Corporate HR team at NBCUniversal is looking for an HR Manager to support our Corporate Finance organization, while also serving as an on the ground HR resource for other Corporate Functions with employees in the Philadelphia office.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to the business, building strong relationships, and helping leaders and employees work through both the everyday and more complex people challenges that come up.

In this role, you’ll be a trusted HR partner to leaders and employees across Corporate Finance. Your work will cover employee relations, performance management, talent development, organizational and workforce planning, compensation, succession planning, and recruitment. Some days that may mean coaching a manager through a difficult employee situation; others may involve thinking through the structure of a team, identifying development opportunities, or helping plan for future talent needs.

We’re looking for someone who is practical, curious, and comfortable figuring things out. You’ll have room to take ownership, use your judgment, and bring ideas forward, while also having a strong HR team around you to collaborate with. You’ll work closely with partners across Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Total Rewards, HR Operations, Employment Law, and other HR teams depending on what the business needs.

Here you can:

  • Serve as a trusted HR partner to Corporate Finance leaders and employees.
  • Serve as an on-the-ground HR resource for employees and leaders across Corporate Functions in the Philadelphia office, helping address local needs and connect them with the appropriate HR partners and resources
  • Coach and advise managers on employee relations, performance, development, and other people-related matters.
  • Manage employee relations issues and workplace investigations, partnering with Employment Law when needed.
  • Support key talent processes including performance management, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee development.
  • Work with leaders to think through organizational needs, team structure, workforce planning, and talent priorities.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring leaders to support recruitment and hiring needs.
  • Help leaders and employees understand and navigate HR policies, practices, and programs.
  • Use workforce data and employee feedback to spot trends, identify opportunities, and help inform decisions.
  • Work closely with HR partners and subject matter experts to find solutions and get things done.
  • Lead and contribute to HR projects and initiatives that improve how we support, develop, and engage employees.

Here you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Labor Relations or related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience 
  • At least 5 years of progressive professional HR experience
  • Experience supporting leaders and employees across a range of HR matters.
  • Employee relations experience, including handling sensitive issues and workplace investigations.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills.

What we'll look for:

  • Good judgment and the confidence to work through challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Comfortable being a visible HR presence in the workplace and building relationships across different teams and functions.
  • Curious about AI and emerging technology, with good judgment about where these tools can make work simpler and more effective.
  • A practical problem solver who can get to the heart of an issue and find a path forward.
  • A self-starter who takes ownership and keeps things moving without needing a lot of direction.
  • Resourceful and comfortable finding answers, bringing in the right people, and figuring things out along the way.
  • Able to manage competing priorities and adapt as business needs change.
  • Builds trust easily and can be both supportive and candid with employees and leaders.
  • Curious about the business and interested in understanding how HR can help it succeed.

job.title: ML Solutions Architect - Architecte de solutions ML
job.description:
NBCUniversal est l’un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons des contenus d’exception, que nous diffusons à travers notre portefeuille de films, de programmes télévisés et de services de streaming, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos parcs à thème internationaux, nos produits grand public et nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, les chaînes locales NBC, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de streaming premium financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des programmes de divertissement de premier ordre grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde via Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment l’Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite l’Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Rendez-vous sur www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’informations.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles vivent et travaillent nos employés, nos clients et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de former une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer un large éventail de contenus reflétant notre monde.

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking an ML Solutions Architect who brings broad software engineering expertise along with strong machine learning-adjacent experience. In this role, you will lead the high-level design of systems that integrate ML models into our broader product suite. You will act as a technical consultant, evaluating customer requirements and determining whether they can be addressed with off-the-shelf solutions or should be escalated as specialized research initiatives for our Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning teams. 

This role is ideal for a systems-minded engineer who can translate product vision into scalable architecture, while balancing technical feasibility, performance, and maintainability. 

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) architecte de solutions ML possédant une solide expertise générale en ingénierie logicielle ainsi qu’une bonne expérience connexe à l’apprentissage automatique. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la conception de haut niveau des systèmes qui intègrent les modèles ML à notre offre de produits. Vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) technique en évaluant les besoins des clients afin de déterminer s’ils peuvent être satisfaits à l’aide de solutions prêtes à l’emploi ou s’ils doivent être confiés à nos équipes spécialisées en apprentissage profond et en apprentissage par renforcement. 

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne ayant une vision systémique, capable de traduire une vision produit en une architecture évolutive, tout en conciliant faisabilité technique, performance et maintenabilité. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • System Integration & Coprocessing: Design and implement the software layers that allow ML models to interact with a real-time rendering engine. This includes managing data pre-processing and post-processing (coprocessing) to ensure high-performance execution. 

  • Technical Consulting: Evaluate incoming customer requirements to determine the optimal path forward. You will decide if a task can be solved using off-the-shelf tools or if it requires a deep-dive research project to be handed off to our Deep Learning or Reinforcement Learning engineers. 

  • Language-Agnostic Engineering: Build and maintain wrappers, APIs, and microservices that allow our ML stack to remain flexible and language-agnostic across different production environments. 

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary technical liaison between technical leadership, customers, and the core engineering team to spec out data and integration requirements. 

  • Modular Execution: Break down complex product visions into manageable architectural components, ensuring that ML components ship as part of a stable, scalable software product. 

Responsabilités principales 

  • Intégration de systèmes et coprocessing : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les couches logicielles permettant aux modèles ML d’interagir avec un moteur de rendu en temps réel, y compris les composants de prétraitement et de post-traitement nécessaires à une exécution performante.  

  • Conseil technique : Évaluer les demandes clients et déterminer la meilleure approche à adopter, qu’il s’agisse d’outils disponibles sur le marché ou de projets de recherche spécialisés à confier aux équipes d’apprentissage profond ou d’apprentissage par renforcement.  

  • Ingénierie agnostique aux langages : Développer et maintenir des wrappers, API et microservices afin de garantir la flexibilité et l’interopérabilité de la pile ML dans différents environnements de production et langages de programmation.  

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Agir comme principal point de contact technique entre la direction, les clients et les équipes d’ingénierie afin de définir les exigences d’intégration, de système et de données.  

  • Exécution modulaire : Décomposer des visions produit complexes en composantes architecturales claires afin de livrer des fonctionnalités ML au sein d’un produit logiciel stable et évolutif. 

Qualifications 

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as a Software Architect or Systems Engineer in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Industry Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, smart grids, precision agriculture, game development, or aerospace. 

  • Technical Proficiency: 

  • Generalist Tooling: Fluency with Git, and the Unix shell, with a strong ability to work across multiple programming languages as needed (ideally including one or more of Python, C++, C#). 

  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of how to integrate ML models into production software (e.g., API design, message brokers, and containerization, compute and memory budgeting). 

  • Fluency with 3D geometry, linear algebra, and/or computer graphics

  • ML Literacy: While you may not be training models daily, you must have enough ML-adjacent experience to understand model constraints, data requirements, and the "state of the art." 

  • Experience with fine-tuning and deploying models is a plus. 

  • Attributes: 

  • Strategic Decision-Making: Ability to perform "Build vs. Buy" analyses for ML components. 

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate high-level product vision into concrete engineering specs for both technical leadership and specialized engineers. 

  • Conscientiousness: High attention to detail regarding system stability and interoperability 

Qualifications 

  • Diplôme en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe.  

  • Expérience démontrée en tant qu’architecte logiciel, architecte de solutions ou ingénieur(e) système dans un environnement dynamique.  

  • Une expérience dans des secteurs multidisciplinaires tels que la robotique, les réseaux intelligents, l’agriculture de précision, le développement de jeux vidéo ou l’aérospatiale est fortement valorisée. 

  • Compétences techniques

Telemundo62 is seeking a dynamic, creative, and digitally focused Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) / Reporter to deliver original, impactful journalism across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller with excellent editorial judgment, a passion for enterprise reporting, and the ability to independently develop, shoot, write, edit, and deliver compelling stories. We are looking for a proactive journalist who goes beyond the headlines, develops trusted sources, and produces meaningful reporting that informs and empowers our diverse communities.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, pitch, develop, and execute original, relevant, and impactful stories across Philadelphia, South Jersey, and Delaware.
  • Independently research, shoot, write, edit, and deliver compelling news content for all platforms.
  • Pursue enterprise reporting, exclusive stories, investigative opportunities, and meaningful follow-ups.
  • Deliver accurate, engaging live reports, including breaking news coverage.
  • Produce clear, visually compelling stories that explain why they matter, who is affected, and what viewers need to know.
  • Develop and maintain strong community relationships and a diverse network of sources.
  • Embrace a digital-first approach, creating timely, platform-specific content and engaging with audiences.
  • Proactively communicate story developments, challenges, and opportunities with producers, the assignment desk, and newsroom leadership.
  • Collaborate effectively, meet deadlines, and take ownership of assignments from pitch through publication.
  • Uphold the highest standards of journalistic integrity, accuracy, fairness, and production quality.
  • Participate in approved community events, station initiatives, and special projects as assigned.
  • Minimum two years of professional reporting or multimedia journalism experience, preferably in television news.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong Spanish-language storytelling, on-air presentation, and live reporting abilities.
  • Proficiency in videography, nonlinear editing, and digital content production.
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to work independently under tight deadlines.
  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Submit a resume/CV and demo reel through nbcunicareers.com.
  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States and be at least 18 years old.
  • Must be willing to work in Philadelphia and travel throughout the tri-state viewing area.
  • Must be available for flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and breaking news coverage.
  • Must be willing to join SAG AFTRA Union

Desired Characteristics

  • Self-motivated, curious, resourceful, and passionate about impactful journalism.
  • Strong enterprise reporting instincts and ability to uncover original stories.
  • Creative visual storyteller with excellent writing and ad-libbing skills.
  • Digital-first mindset with an understanding of audience engagement.
  • Collaborative team player who communicates proactively, welcomes feedback, and takes accountability for results.
  • Ability to adapt, solve problems, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced newsroom.

NBCUniversal’s Network Engineering group within the Operations & Technology organization has an opening for a Network Engineer based at our NBC Sports facility in Stamford, CT.

The Network Engineer will work within a dedicated team of network engineers responsible for building reliable, scalable network infrastructure for NBCUniversal’s broadcast and media production facilities. The selected candidate will have experience configuring, deploying, and supporting Cisco, Arista, and Palo Alto firewalls using vendor and internal automation and monitoring systems. The selected candidate will provide subject matter expertise on IP-based networking and support critical escalated issues at their location. As a member of a larger team, they will be required to support all locations, including but not limited to Denver, Los Angeles, NYC, and Miami.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience with installation and configuration of network technology from multiple vendors including Cisco (IOS, NX-OS, XR), Juniper, Palo Alto, and F5.
  • Hands-on experience implementing firewall policy on Palo Alto (Panorama), F5 via CLI and GUI.
  • Participate in operational on-call rotation for support of 24x7 production on-air network infrastructure.
  • Ability to develop and maintain technical documentation and diagrams.
  • Occasional travel for project and remote event support.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Good understanding of both Enterprise and Service Provider networking:
    • OSPF, IS-IS, vPC, port-channeling, 10/40/100G optics, IPSEC, QoS, VLAN, Multicast
    • MP-BGP, route-reflection, MPLS (IP and Segment Routing), Traffic Engineering, L3VPN, VRF
  • Ability to analyze network logging and other data sets to troubleshoot and isolate production and design problems.
  • Understanding of major broadcast vendors and how their technology is deployed in IP networks to support graphics, transcoding, playout, and master control.
  • Experience deploying and supporting hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure) with emphasis on network interconnect and security.
  • Experience with network automation and version control tools such as Ansible and Git to deploy networks at scale.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Join Telemundo’s Marketing team as a Paid Media Manager supporting integrated campaigns across entertainment, news, and sports. Reporting to the Paid Media Director, you will help turn approved media strategies into effective campaign execution across television, streaming, digital video, paid social, audio, and out-of-home channels. You will work closely with our media agency and internal partners to review media recommendations, coordinate campaign delivery, monitor performance, and identify opportunities to optimize results. You will also supervise a Paid Media Specialist. This is a temporary assignment covering a leave of absence.

This is a project/limited term position, unless otherwise amended or terminated as deliverables within this project are completed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review agency media recommendations and provide actionable feedback in partnership with the Paid Media Director and Audience Strategy team, as applicable.
  • Work closely with the media agency to coordinate campaign implementation, track milestones, and support timely delivery across media channels.
  • Partner with the Paid Media Director and Audience Strategy team, as applicable, to review key agency deliverables, including tactical plans, flowcharts, media authorizations, launch trackers, and campaign reports.
  • Track campaign spending, pacing, flighting, and delivery against approved plans; identify discrepancies and escalate budget decisions or material risks to the Paid Media Director.
  • Lead ongoing campaign performance analysis, assessing channel and creative results against relevant KPIs and benchmarks; recommend and coordinate optimizations subject to appropriate approvals.
  • Review agency reporting, campaign wrap-ups, and measurement studies; synthesize actionable insights and learnings to inform future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy, Creative, Social, and Operations on creative mapping, asset readiness, launch priorities, and integrated campaign updates.
  • Oversee preparation and accuracy of paid media inputs for internal campaign decks, recaps, and cross-functional updates.
  • Supervise and coach the Paid Media Specialist, setting priorities and overseeing quality, deadlines, and adherence to paid media procedures.

Basic Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in paid media planning, activation, campaign management, or related roles at an agency or advertiser.

  • Spanish-language proficiency is a must - Written and verbal
  • Experience coordinating integrated paid media campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience interpreting campaign reports, media KPIs, and optimization opportunities.
  • Experience monitoring media budgets, pacing, campaign timelines, and execution deliverables.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with external agencies and cross-functional stakeholders while managing competing deadlines.
  • Experience supervising or providing day-to-day direction to junior team members.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in entertainment, television, streaming, sports, or multicultural marketing.
  • Familiarity with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, connected TV, and other digital advertising environments.
  • Experience reviewing brand lift, attribution, or tune-in measurement studies.
  • Ability to turn complex performance data into concise recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational judgment, attention to detail, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Requirements

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que les membres de notre personnel aient l’occasion de s’investir dans leur communauté. Nous valorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

ROLE SUMMARY

NBCUniversal is seeking a Product Director, Mobile to lead the vision, strategy, and direction of our mobile product experience. This role will work across product, design, technology, production, and business teams to build engaging mobile experiences and help shape the future of our mobile product offering.

Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for mobile products.
  • Partner with design, technology, production, and business teams to align priorities and establish overall product direction.
  • Champion the mobile experience throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring it is represented in planning, development, and delivery decisions.
  • Translate product objectives into clear requirements, priorities, milestones, and success metrics.
  • Drive product decisions through user research, data analysis, testing, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve user onboarding, engagement, retention, monetization, and the long-term health of the product.
  • Lead and contribute to launch planning, go-to-market readiness, and the ongoing evolution of the product after launch.
  • Clearly communicate product priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations across the organization.
  • Help build, develop, and structure the mobile product function as the team grows.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste de directeur ou directrice de produit, Mobile, afin de définir la vision, la stratégie et l’orientation de notre expérience produit mobile. La personne titulaire du poste collaborera avec les équipes de produit, de design, de technologie, de production et d’affaires afin de créer des expériences mobiles attrayantes et de contribuer à façonner l’avenir de notre offre de produits mobiles.

Description du poste

  • Définir et diriger la vision, la stratégie et la feuille de route des produits mobiles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de design, de technologie, de production et d’affaires afin d’harmoniser les priorités et d’établir l’orientation globale du produit.
  • Promouvoir l’expérience mobile tout au long du cycle de développement afin de veiller à ce qu’elle soit prise en compte dans les décisions de planification, de développement et de livraison.
  • Traduire les objectifs du produit en exigences, priorités, jalons et indicateurs de réussite clairs.
  • Orienter les décisions relatives au produit en s’appuyant sur la recherche auprès des personnes utilisatrices, l’analyse de données, les tests et l’amélioration continue.
  • Cerner les possibilités d’améliorer l’intégration des personnes utilisatrices, l’engagement, la rétention, la monétisation et la santé à long terme du produit.
  • Diriger la planification des lancements et y contribuer, assurer la préparation à la mise en marché et participer à l’évolution continue du produit après son lancement.
  • Communiquer clairement les priorités, les risques, les compromis et les recommandations liés au produit dans l’ensemble de l’organisation.
  • Contribuer à bâtir, à développer et à structurer la fonction de produit mobile à mesure que l’équipe prend de l’expansion.

Basic Requirements

  • 9+ years of experience in product management, product leadership, or a related field, including recent experience working on successful mobile or cross-platform entertainment products.
  • Experience defining product strategy, developing roadmaps, prioritizing features, and driving business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of mobile product fundamentals, including engagement, retention, monetization, analytics, and experimentation.
  • Experience partnering closely with design, engineering, UX, analytics, and production teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to turn ambiguity into clear product direction and actionable plans.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience contributing to highly engaged gaming, social, creator-focused, or user-generated content (UGC) products.
  • Experience with free-to-play mobile products, live operations, progression systems, monetization systems, or virtual economies.
  • Experience launching cross-platform experiences across mobile, PC, and/or console.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to balance player value, business value, and technical constraints.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments where all the answers may not be known upfront.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to build alignment and influence without direct authority.
  • Passion for interactive entertainment and building player-centered products.
  • Experience mentoring product managers or helping build and develop a product organization.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Exigences de base

  • 9 ans ou plus d’expérience en gestion de produit, en leadership de produit ou dans un domaine connexe, y compris une expérience récente de travail sur des produits de divertissement mobiles ou multiplateformes couronnés de succès.
  • Expérience dans la définition d’une stratégie produit, l’élaboration de feuilles de route, la priorisation des fonctionnalités et l’atteinte de résultats d’affaires.
  • Solide compréhension des principes fondamentaux des produits mobiles, notamment l’engagement, la rétention, la monétisation, l’analytique et l’expérimentation.
  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes de design, d’ingénierie, d’UX, d’analytique et de production tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en gestion des parties prenantes et en influence.
  • Capacité à transformer l’ambiguïté en une orientation produit claire et en plans concrets.

Caractéristiques souhaitées

  • Expérience de contribution à des produits de jeux, sociaux, axés sur les créateurs ou fondés sur du contenu généré par les personnes utilisatrices (UGC), suscitant un fort engagement.
  • Expérience avec des produits mobiles free-to-play, les opérations live, les systèmes de progression, les systèmes de monétisation ou les économies virtuelles.
  • Expérience du lancement d’expériences multiplateformes sur mobile, PC et/ou console.
  • Excellent jugement en matière de produit et capacité à trouver un juste équilibre entre la valeur pour les joueurs, la valeur pour l’entreprise et les contraintes techniques.
  • Aisance à évoluer dans des environnements en mouvement rapide où toutes les réponses ne sont pas nécessairement connues dès le départ.
  • Solides aptitudes en collaboration et capacité à créer un consensus et à exercer une influence sans autorité directe.
  • Passion pour le divertissement interactif et la création de produits centrés sur les joueurs.
  • Expérience en mentorat auprès de responsables de produit ou dans la contribution à la mise sur pied et au développement d’une organisation de produit.

Exigences D’admissibilité:

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être considérées.

  • Doit être disposé·e à se déplacer pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

About UDX FRANCHISE, PRODUCTS & PARTNERSHIPS:

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connect audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.

UDX Franchise, Products & Partnerships

The Retail Commercial Specialist (Retail Merchandiser) independently owns assortment recommendations by location and the store merchandising financial strategy to ensure the right merchandise assortments are placed in each location. This includes executing merchandise placement in accordance with merchandiser-developed SKU-to-fixture plans, determining allocation quantities, allocating appropriate floor space for programs, and establishing product adjacencies. The Retail Commercial Specialist partners directly with Universal Studios Hollywood (USH) Retail Operations, UDX Franchise, Products & Partnerships (FPP) Global Merchandise Product Development/Buying, and Planning teams, the merchandise warehouse, and the Visual Merchandising team to develop location-specific retail strategies supported by analytics and business insights that inform and justify the overall retail master plan. The role is also responsible for managing inventory flow, monitoring out-of-stock conditions, and coordinating and directing floor sets, resets, and merchandise refreshes.

Here you can:

  • Own and manage the product assortment assignment within the Universal Studios Hollywood & CityWalk retail locations to define the short- and long-term strategic direction per location.
  • Work in tandem with the UDX Global Merchandise Product Development and Planning teams on location-based strategy planning to encompass line review attendance, mobilization milestone engagement, category, department, and program call-out via a grid implementation tool while providing location item display minimum quantity results.
  • Develop all store plans consistent with targeted guest mix, seasonal requirements, special event placement, attraction profile, and store concept profiles.
  • Regulate the balance of programs and inventory, direct the allocation strategy, re-evaluate program status, and negotiate changes as needed.
  • Manage the development of the multi-unit floor and SKU-to-fixture plans, the implementation of location plans while targeting post-mortem evaluation checks, and location financial results orientation, completed in accordance with Retail Creative (Visual Merchandise) and Retail Commercial Strategy (Merchandising), Universal Creative, UDX, and Intellectual Property (IP) brand standards and guidelines.
  • Conduct independent financial analysis to ensure program placement is meeting financial expectations and make decisions to re-assort or adjust tactics to address business trends. 
  • Communicate needs, suggestions, stock level concerns, and provide direction to the store operators and buyers/developers/planners on assortment issues, merchandise exit strategies, product replacement, expiration, and quality issues.
  • Directly monitor, track, and ensure the proper flow of goods, including new products, reorders, and delivery schedules.
  • Independently control updates to the auto replenishment schedules, parameter display minimums, replenishment adjustments, manual inventory orders, and support the store teams on caseline/confection concerns, inventory control, and RTV processes.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX/NBCU policy, procedures, training, and Team Member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility:

  • Individual Contributor.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

Here you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university in a related field required, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of the degree requirement.
  • 3+ years of retail experience required.
  • 1+ year of operational retail management or merchandising/visual display experience required.
  • Understanding of, or experience with, Adobe Creative Suite applications, including PowerPoint, InDesign, and Illustrator, required.
  • Requires strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, SharePoint, and Outlook.

  • Implement RBAC, identity controls, and policy enforcement across AI platforms.

  • 5+ years of experience in Data / Cloud Platform Engineering
  • Coding Python , Advanced SQL(Snowflake) , AWS, Semantic modelling, Git
  • Experience with AI and Database : Snowflake(Cortex) or Databricks (Genie/Agent Bricks)
  • Ability to understand how AI Frameworks work: LangGraph, MCP, RAG
  • Terraform/IaC : infrastructure as code for cloud AI environments
  • Security & Identity: RBAC, IAM policies, Azure AD
  • AI Finops: Cloud cost allocation, Tagging, and Optimization
  • Docker / Kubernetes: containerization model serving and orchestration
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

  • 5+ years of experience in Databricks or Apache Spark
  • 3+ years of experience in MLOps / AIOps pipeline ownership
  • 3+ years of experience in CI/CD tooling: GitHub Actions, Terraform, dbt

NBCUniversal is seeking a Sr. Business Analyst, Revenue Growth Platforms to support the development and execution of products that enable revenue growth across our advertising business. Reporting to the Director, Revenue Growth Platforms, this role will help deliver capabilities that improve prospecting, lead management, seller workflows, and revenue generation across Programmatic, Universal Ads, Local, and SMB businesses. 

The Sr. Business Analyst will partner closely with Sales, Operations, Data, Technology, and Product teams to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and deliver scalable solutions that improve seller productivity and business outcomes.  

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives, seller workflows, and process improvement opportunities. 
  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate business requirements for revenue growth initiatives. 
  • Translate business needs into user stories, functional requirements, process flows, and acceptance criteria. 
  • Support initiatives across lead generation, prospecting, qualification, routing, engagement, and conversion processes. 
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Product and Technology teams to implement solutions within the broader sales technology ecosystem.

Universal Products & Experiences Overview:

At Universal Products & Experiences (UP&E), we don’t just create products—we create a universe that fans can hold in their hands, wear, play, read, and experience every day. From Jurassic World’s roaring adventures to the playful charm of Minions and the timeless wonder of Back to the Future, we transform stories into unforgettable moments that spark joy across the globe.

UP&E has grown rapidly while keeping the energy, agility, and inventive spirit of a start‑up. Our mission is bold: to take imagination beyond the screen and into the real world through innovative products, immersive retail moments, and extraordinary theme park destinations. We bring both Universal-owned and third‑party worlds to life across expansive theme park destinations, e‑commerce platforms, live entertainment venues, and global retail partnerships—fueling fandom everywhere it lives. Whether it's iconic toys, fashion collaborations, books, collectibles, lifestyle products, or cutting‑edge video games, we work with world‑class licensees and creators to make our universe tangible.

Here, creativity meets technology, and strategy meets storytelling. We connect design, commercial excellence, and fan passion to deliver experiences that millions cherish—inside the parks and far beyond them. As part of Universal Destinations & Experiences, you’ll join a global team that thrives on collaboration, imagination, and the power of culture‑shaping ideas. Your work will inspire fans, uplift communities, and leave a lasting mark on entertainment history.

We believe in a workplace where every voice matters, every perspective is valued, and every colleague can shine. That’s how we strive to be an employer of choice for talent and a partner of choice for retailers, licensees, and creators who share our passion for world‑class storytelling. If you’re ready to bring imagination to life and create moments that resonate worldwide—your next adventure starts here.

Join us and help create moments that matter.

https://www.universalproductsexperiences.com/

 

Universal Products & Experiences is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce of the highest caliber. We are committed to fostering equitable and inclusive environments that honor the experiences, perspectives, and uniqueness of each colleague.

It is the policy of NBCUniversal and NBCUniversal's affiliated businesses to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy) sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 

Role Summary:

The Universal Brand Development Group is looking for a Senior Designer of Product Design Development for the UNIVERSAL PRODUCTS & EXPERIENCES Consumer Products division. As a Senior Designer, you will lead the creative development of apparel and fashion accessories, including bags, headwear, and footwear. Bringing over 4+ years of industry experience, you will enhance world-class IPs such as Jurassic World, Minions, and Shrek into trend-setting products. This role is a key creative position on the team, providing vital support to the Supervisor with technical expertise and ensuring smooth collaboration with licensees and internal stakeholders.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000

Key Responsibilities

  • Fashion-Forward Concepting: Analyze and synthesize current market trends (streetwear, luxury, etc.) to develop innovative product concepts that merge character aesthetics with modern fashion. Pitch these creative directions to the Manager for alignment.
  • Trend Forecasting & Concept Development: Lead the translation of macro and micro fashion trends into cohesive, trend-led storytelling. Provide the technical and aesthetic foundation for apparel and accessory lines, ensuring every collection is anchored in seasonal relevance.
  • Design Direction: Provide detailed feedback to licensees based on fashion expertise—covering textiles, specialty construction, and graphic placement—to strongly support the Manager’s final approvals.
  • Style Guide: Flexibly adapt and expand Universal’s style guides for complex garment and accessory constructions to ensure they serve as high-utility design assets.
  • Licensee Communication & Submission Review: Manage daily creative workflows by reviewing licensee submissions via Lunchpad. Provide clear, actionable design feedback from concept to final sample, ensuring every product achieves a high-level balance between fashion-forward sensibility and IP brand consistency.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Support: Under the Manager’s direction, partner closely with Category Management, Legal, and Franchise teams. Act as the design-side coordinator to help deliver competitive products to the retail market.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support the needs of the team.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • PORTFOLIO SUBMISSION GUIDLINES: Please submit a professional portfolio demonstrating a proven track record of translating fashion trends into compelling, character-driven licensed products with a sophisticated and commercially relevant aesthetic. Portfolios must showcase the full product development lifecycle, from concept to shelf, and include examples of sketches, trend research, graphics/logos, pattern and print development, overlays/redlines, technical design packages (tech packs), sampling iterations, and final produced products. All submitted work must be the candidate's original work, with clear examples of their individual design contributions.
  • Experience: 4+ years of senior-level design experience within the fashion industry (apparel, bags, footwear, etc.).
  • Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Deep understanding of Fashion Tech Packs and a sharp eye for translating 2D graphics into 3D garment constructions.
  • Fashion Expertise: In-depth knowledge of fabric properties, washes, and embellishment techniques (embroidery, patches, screen printing). Exceptional color sense and material sourcing skills.
  • Communication: Ability to articulate design intent logically and professionally to support the Manager and facilitate consensus with external partners.
  • Proactive mindset to drive results.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confident in advocating design decisions and collaborating toward shared goals.
  • Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and working knowledge of InDesign, Keynote, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.

Additional Requirements:

  • Travel may be required
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support the needs of the team
  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Senior Designer, Platform Design
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

About the Role

Our Platform Design team creates the imagery that defines how our services look and feel — the visual merchandising graphics that represent every title, tentpole, and live event across Entertainment, Sports, Live Events, Editorial, and Partner Channels. Peacock is the center of gravity, but the work spans the NBCUniversal portfolio: NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, Telemundo, and the Olympics. We're looking for a Senior Designer with exceptional taste and deep production fluency to join us at a pivotal moment, as we scale our output across one of the busiest content slates in streaming.

This is high-volume production design held to a bespoke standard of craft. Most days you're delivering high-quality work at scale against real deadlines; when a tentpole launch calls for hero imagery, you deliver that too. The work ships to millions of screens, and your taste, judgment, and creative confidence matter as much as the pixels.

This is a deeply hands-on design role for one of the best designers in the room. You'll spend the majority of your time creating, refining, adapting, and shipping work yourself — bringing a refined point of view to every asset, and leading through the work itself.

What You'll Do

  • Design and produce best-in-class visual merchandising imagery across the portfolio — from bespoke key art adaptation for tentpoles and originals to high-volume production design that supports thousands of assets across our platforms.
  • Bring exceptional typography, composition, layout, and image-making to everything you touch. You retouch, adapt, and extend art with precision, and your work tells the story of a title in a single frame.
  • Exercise sharp merchandising instincts: you understand what makes imagery emotionally resonant and commercially effective — what creates desire, engagement, and clarity — and you identify the strongest visual direction quickly, without needing excessive oversight or endless rounds.
  • Make confident creative decisions under pressure — you're trusted with the difficult calls, your judgment shows in the first pass, not just the final one, and you can articulate the "why" behind every choice.
  • Adapt and extend templates, toolkits, and design systems to deliver at scale without letting quality or consistency slip. You treat the system as a craft surface, not a constraint.
  • Own your work end to end, from briefing through delivery: concept development, review cycles, approvals, stakeholder communication, and publishing readiness. You own outcomes, not files.
  • Thrive in fast-moving sports and live-event environments — compressed timelines, changing requirements, athlete swaps, playoff scenarios, and last-minute updates are the job, not the exception.
  • Execute with precision within established design systems and brand guidelines. When direction is ambiguous or quality is at risk, you speak up: you ask sharp questions, flag risks early, and push for clarity rather than guessing.
  • Partner directly with Studios, Integrated Marketing, Sports Marketing, and Editorial — managing feedback, navigating approvals, and earning stakeholder trust through the strength and reliability of your work.
  • Work confidently with rights-sensitive imagery: you understand that talent, league, and partner requirements shape what ships, and you build approval realities into how you work rather than treating them as surprises.
  • Partner closely with Platform Operations, the editorial team that programs and publishes our work, so your imagery is delivered, scheduled, and shipped seamlessly.
  • Be a reference point for quality: your craft, judgment, and consistency become examples others look to when calibrating excellence.
  • Own your workflow and contribute to scalable production pipelines — including automation and AI-assisted production — exploring directions rapidly, iterating with intention, and spending your judgment on the craft decisions that matter.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of graphic design experience in entertainment, streaming, or a high-volume brand/production environment.
  • Exceptional taste, strong visual instincts, and a refined point of view — the kind of eye that consistently finds the strongest direction in the room, and the confidence to stand behind it.
  • Exceptional visual craft: typography, composition, color, layout, and image-making, with a portfolio that shows range across bespoke creative and production work.
  • Strong retouching and art adaptation skills — you can take finished key art and extend it beautifully into new formats, crops, and contexts.
  • Proven production excellence at scale — you're fast, precise, and reliable delivering large asset volumes against real deadlines, including live sports timelines.
  • Composure and decisiveness under pressure: you make quick, confident creative calls when requirements shift late.
  • Demonstrated experience working within established design systems and brand guidelines, with the judgment to know when to ask and when to decide.
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder skills — you're as strong in a briefing as you are in the file.
  • Fluency with modern design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma) and hands-on experience with AI-assisted design and production — you actively use these tools to scale output without sacrificing quality, and you're eager to push how far they can take our workload.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with sports, live events, or entertainment key art.
  • Familiarity with content management, publishing, or asset pipeline workflows.
  • Experience working with licensed or rights-managed imagery and partner approval processes.
  • Motion or video capabilities.

Additional Requirements

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.
  • Salary range: $110,000 - $130,000 + bonus & long-term incentive eligible

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.
