job.title: Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales One Platform Ad Products team builds and operates the systems that power NBCUniversal’s $10B+ advertising business, including core ad serving, programmatic, and activation capabilities across CTV and digital.

Within AP&S, the Programmatic Demand team is responsible for product strategy and development of demand-side capabilities across NBCU’s programmatic ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand to drive the evolution of how programmatic demand is optimized, scaled, and productized across NBCU’s streaming footprint.

Role Overview

This role focuses on developing scalable products, systems, and workflows that improve programmatic demand performance across NBCU’s ad tech stack.

You will identify inefficiencies in auction dynamics, platform behavior, and partner integrations—and translate those insights into durable product solutions rather than one-off optimizations.

A key focus area will be live event monetization, where concurrency, DSP behavior, and system constraints introduce complex demand-side challenges that require structured, product-led solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Auction Performance & Optimization Systems

  • Design and build scalable solutions (tools, workflows, automation) to analyze and optimize auction performance across bid rate, win rate, fill, pacing, and timeouts
  • Translate performance insights into productized capabilities (e.g., automated optimization frameworks, configuration layers, or decisioning logic)
  • Partner with Engineering to implement systems that continuously improve demand efficiency and revenue outcomes

Live Event Monetization (CTV Focus)

  • Identify performance gaps and system constraints in live event auctions (e.g., scaling limits, DSP throttling, timeout behavior)
  • Drive development of product solutions to increase stability, scalability, and performance in high-concurrency environments
  • Partner cross-functionally and externally to ensure platform and partner readiness for tentpole events

Platform Configuration & Deal Strategy

  • Define product-driven approaches to deal structure, configuration standards, and optimization across PG and PMP
  • Improve how platform settings (e.g., in FreeWheel and partner DSPs) translate into predictable demand performance
  • Productize best practices to reduce inefficiencies and variability in deal execution

Partner Integrations & Performance

  • Identify systemic partner performance issues and drive long-term solutions (vs. one-off fixes)
  • Inform product strategy based on partner capabilities, limitations, and evolving DSP behavior

Additional Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Testing: Own requirements and validation for demand optimization features and experiments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Align Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, and Strategy on priorities and outcomes
  • Issue Resolution: Lead root cause analysis and improve systems/processes to prevent recurring issues
  • Documentation & Enablement: Translate product functionality into clear internal guidance and GTM alignment
  • Market Insights: Monitor industry trends and inform product direction

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystems, including digital ad serving, measurement frameworks, identity signals, and privacy controls—and how these components work together to enable scalable, addressable advertising across CTV and digital environments
  • Experience implementing and validating measurement and data pipelines, with a focus on ensuring consistency and accuracy across platforms (e.g., bid requests, attribution, viewability, IVT, and delivery metrics)
  • Solid working knowledge of privacy regulations and industry signals (e.g., CCPA, GDPR, GPP, ATT, COPPA), and their implications for data usage, identity resolution, targeting, and measurement in a programmatic context
  • Experience understanding identity and user signals (e.g., device IDs, platform identifiers, consent signals) to enable privacy-compliant audience targeting and optimization
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable, productized solutions - particularly within programmatic demand, auction dynamics, or partner integrations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience diagnosing performance gaps, data discrepancies, and system inefficiencies, and driving root-cause resolution in production environments
  • Experience developing or leveraging automation and/or AI-driven approaches to monitor, validate, and improve the stability, quality, and performance of demand systems and measurement capabilities

In this role, you’ll use C++ to build important software that powers machine learning, computer vision, and 3D modeling applications. This software will rely on mathematical concepts to analyze images and create realistic 3D models based on real-world data. 

You’ll get to work with the latest research in fields like artificial intelligence, computer vision, and computer graphics.

To keep track of your code and changes, you’ll use Git. You’ll also test and run your code on a cloud platform, working with large-scale geospatial data (like maps and geographic information) to create 3D content that users will eventually use. 

Responsibilities include, but not limited to: 

  • You will implement, in C++, core machine-learning/computer vision and (inverse-) procedural modeling algorithms, with varying levels of oversight. These algorithms rely on mathematical techniques from linear algebra, probability, and geometry.   
  • Apply cutting-edge research in machine learning, computer vision, and computer graphics. 
  • Work closely with leadership to understand high-level product vision and customer requirements. 
  • Utilize Git for effective source code management. 
  • Deploy and test your code on large scale geospatial datasets (and ultimately generate 3D content that will be available to users) This requires you to interact with remote machines via a Unix shell. 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field 
  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience in a fast paced, high growth tech environment. 
  • Team-oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude, enthusiasm and willingness to learn new methods, tools, practices and skills 
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Experience in designing and building high-performance, efficient systems using C++, with a strong focus on optimizing code for speed, scalability, and resource management. 

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Familiarity with modern C++ will allow you to better interface with other portions of our data ingestion and product pipeline. 
  • A mathematical background covering some subset of linear algebra, probability, and geometry will also be helpful.   
  • Experience with Git is preferred, but a background with Mercurial or other DVCs is an acceptable substitute. 
  • Our development and production environments are Linux and macOS based. Confidence in a Unix shell environment (e.g. bash) is essential for working in our setup. 
  • Problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience in game technology, with expertise in areas such as Unreal Engine, C++, computational geometry, and computer graphics, driving the development of cutting-edge, high-performance gaming systems. 
  • We use CMake for project management. However, for something other than vim/make or Xcode, we need a convincing demonstration that you will be able to self-support in the environment of your preference.

This role combines people leadership, strategic project and program delivery, financial management, PMO governance, and executive stakeholder engagement to drive successful outcomes across Enterprise Technology. The successful candidate will partner with engineering and business leaders to deliver strategic initiatives across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, workplace, facilities, and physical security technology engineering.

  • Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, and executive communications.
  • Partner with engineering leaders to drive delivery of infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, workplace, facilities, and physical security technology engineering initiatives.

job.title: Sr. Product Manager, Enterprise AI Solutions
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We're looking for a product manager who embeds directly with engineering, product, and business teams to build and ship AI products that directly serve our NBCUniversal businesses. You'll work side-by-side with Enterprise Business Solutions Product and Program teams to identify high-value problems, rapidly prototype and deploy production agentic solutions to drive business impact.  

As a Senior Product Manager in the Enterprise Business Solutions AI Product team, you will own the full lifecycle of agent products — from discovery through deployment and ongoing iteration. You'll build intelligent workflows that automate program operations, surface insights from complex data, and enable teams across NBCUniversal to work with agentic solutions.  

Your work will have a direct, measurable business impact on our employees’ experience and effectiveness in their work outputs. This role is a blend of technical, design, education, and product thinking. You will understand business needs deeply, identify where AI creates leverage, write code, and ship solutions that will drive real business impact. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Work directly with Enterprise Business Solutions program and product teams to identify highest-value use cases for agentic solutions, deployment, tool adoption, and infrastructure architecture 
  • Partner with client-facing teams to understand customer use cases, ensuring conversational agents meet the needs of both end users and stakeholders. 
  • Assist in the building of end-to-end agentic products and solutions (including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, and structured reasoning), from concept and design through implementation, ensuring scalability, adaptability, and alignment with business objectives. 
  • Co-develop agentic solutions with business teams — enabling them to customize, maintain, and operate agents after initial deployment. 
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped agentic product and solution requirements with clear success metrics. 
  • Leverage data insights to continuously optimize AI products and business outcomes — measuring adoption, output quality, user journeys, time-to-insight, and other KPIs. 
  • Own agent quality by implementing evaluation frameworks, monitoring production accuracy, and driving prompt iteration cycles based on eval results. 
  • Create and present documentation to business partners, execute product demos and walk-throughs, and deliver AI-driven analytics capabilities that enable real-time, data-informed decision-making across the enterprise. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, computer science, or related field. 
  • 8+ years of experience in digital product development or a closely related field 
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. 
  • Proven expertise in developing and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture (prompt engineering, tool use, agent orchestration), NLP, machine learning algorithms, and big data analytics. 
  • Analytical skills for identifying user patterns, insights, and performance metrics. 
  • Ability to gather and comprehend complex requirements and challenges across all business levels. 
  • Ability to convey complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences, with ability to define requirements and iterate on solutions 
  • Hands-on experience with understanding and building products on large data sets and enterprise data architectures requiring systems integration, data governance, and security compliance. 
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms, cloud services, and analytics tools (e.g., Python, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) 
  • Expertise in SDLC process, scoping, iteration planning, user story writing, rollout management. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience building multi-agent systems or complex LLM orchestration pipelines 
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (accuracy, hallucination detection, quality scoring) 
  • Technical skills — ability to build end-to-end prototypes from data pipelines through user-facing interfaces 
  • Background in ERP systems, media, commerce, enablement, or enterprise operations domains 
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-use frameworks 
  • Experience embedded with business teams to build solutions (solutions engineering, field engineering, or similar) 

Additional Requirements:

· Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $130,000 - $170,000 (bonus eligible)

job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together.

In the DreamWorks Internship Program, interns work in an engaging and exciting environment alongside creative leaders and artists who are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative culture. Interns are immersed into TV and Feature animated productions while gaining hands-on experience at our studio. Open to students and recent grads, we love those who are driven and hungry to learn, are curious and resourceful, and most importantly, are passionate about animation. 

The Internship Program also showcases best-in-class opportunities by offering executive speaker series, professional/career development workshops, artistic classes, community outreach opportunities, movie screenings, and much more!

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

Spring 2027 Technology Communications & Events Internship: 

  • Applications close: November 2, 2026 at 11:59pm PT

  • Program Dates: January 25 - April 1, 2027

  • Time Commitment: Part-Time (24 hours per week required)

  • Format: In Person (Tuesday - Thursday)

Responsibilities: “What would you say you do here?”

  • Assist with a wide range of projects for the Technology Department ranging from assisting with communication to Technology, Production, and the Studio; event planning and execution; other special projects

  • Work closely with the team and support development on departmental wikis and websites, video production projects, and graphic design assignments

  • Gain exposure to daily activities of the Technology department, event management, and an understanding of Production workflows and strategies.

Basic Qualifications: “What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Pursuing an Associate, Bachelor or Graduate degree at a College/University (or equivalent), or be a recent graduate (within six months of graduation date)

  • Self-motivated and detailed approach to problem solving

  • Ability to manage and track a variety of tasks

  • Very strong organizational skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.

  • Must be willing to work in Glendale, California.

  • Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

Desired Qualifications: “What can I offer?”

  • The ideal candidate will have a multi-faceted skill set with experience in event planning/project management, graphic design, and public communications while being self-motivated, organized, and detail oriented.

  • Proficiency in software like Adobe Creative Cloud especially Photoshop, Google Apps (Docs, Sheets)

  • Experience with Jira (or similar), Word Press (or similar CMS), Microsoft Office

Hourly Rate: $18.47

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Beginning January 5, 2026, hybrid employees will be required to work from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.title: Video Producer, NBC News
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The NBC News Video and Verification unit is looking for our next great video producer. This is a wonderful opportunity to work at the core of NBC News’s newsgathering operation in a highly collaborative environment, producing video content for NBCNews.com and mobile and social platforms.

Job Duties:

  • Monitor and review incoming feeds, NBC off-air and digital streaming channels, publishing relevant clips to be embedded on articles and blogs, as well as delivery to external partners and platforms.
  • Identify compelling video and newsworthy moments across incoming feeds, agencies, NBC News platforms and other editorial sources.
  • Edit user-generated videos and raw feeds, adding graphics to enhance context and reporting.
  • Produce and edit video for wide and vertical formats across NBC News digital and social platforms.
  • Prepare onscreen graphics (banner, locator, identifier) for supplemental live streams.
  • Route feeds for simulcasts, live streams and/or recording purposes.
  • Write text to be used for headlines and captions as well as on-screen graphics.
  • Tag video content with editorially relevant metadata.
  • Select, edit and publish images to promote video clips.
  • Resurface relevant past interviews and footage from the archives.
  • Use analytics tools to help make data-informed decisions, helping to maximize ROI.
  • Help teams identify and address problems quickly when they arise.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends as news dictates.
  • Minimum three years of experience producing and editing video for digital, social and/or mobile platforms.
  • Proficiency in nonlinear editing systems (Avid/Premiere).
  • Strong journalistic writing skills and editorial judgment.
  • Familiarity with AP Style and SEO best practices.
  • Experience with content management/online publishing systems.
  • Strong knowledge of and interest in current events and a superior eye for spotting compelling video.
  • Experience crafting fair and accurate headlines and informative captions.
  • Basic photo editing skills.
  • Speedy decision-making and quick reactions to newsworthy topics.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and work ethic.
  • Ability to take direction well and provide self-direction.
  • Ability to work calmly in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize assignments well under extreme deadlines.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communication or other discipline emphasizing storytelling and multimedia creation or equivalent level relevant experience.
  • Further background in broadcast news production.
  • Experience with Avid video editing is a plus.
  • Knowledge of NBC News policies, guidelines and practices.

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • Must be able to provide examples of work.
  • Applicants may be asked to complete a writing test.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $90,000 - $125,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.title: VP, Benefits - Financial Security Products
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Vice President, Financial Security Products is the enterprise owner for retirement and financial-well-being products and for benefits-related funding and balance-sheet exposures. This leader connects employee financial security with disciplined oversight of defined-contribution and defined-benefit plans, multiemployer obligations, trusts, actuarial governance and financial reporting.

Here you can:

Product strategy

  • Set the multi-year strategy for retirement savings, retirement readiness, emergency savings, financial coaching and other financial-resilience programs.
  • Design healthcare solutions for one of the most diverse workforces in the world, supporting employees across studios, theme parks, productions, news, sports, corporate functions, and international businesses.
  • Own defined-contribution plan design, employer contributions, investments, recordkeeping, participant communications and outcome measurement.
  • Design targeted approaches for workforce populations with different earnings patterns, tenure, access and financial literacy.

Liability, funding and financial oversight

  • Oversee Taft-Hartley and multiemployer-plan exposure, including contribution obligations, funding developments and potential withdrawal liability.
  • Coordinate international defined-benefit and post-employment obligations with Global Benefits Products, Finance, Treasury, Accounting and local leadership.
  • Lead actuarial valuations, assumption and funding analysis, trust governance and consolidated benefits balance-sheet reporting.

Vendors, governance and outcomes

  • Manage recordkeepers, trustees, investment consultants, actuaries, auditors and financial-well-being vendors through scorecards and QBRs.
  • Track retirement readiness, participation, deferral rates, match utilization, financial resilience, service and investment outcomes.
  • Partner with Governance, Compliance & Fiduciary Affairs, Legal and Labor Relations on fiduciary governance, plan documentation and collectively bargained obligations.

Key Areas of Impact:

  • Advance retirement readiness and financial well-being outcomes for employees.
  • Ensure effective oversight of plan funding, liabilities, and long-term financial sustainability.
  • Maintain strong actuarial, accounting, fiduciary, and trust governance practices.
  • Drive high-quality vendor performance and participant service experiences through strategic management and continuous improvement.

Here you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in the healthcare space, with deep expertise in employer-sponsored healthcare programs. 
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, with demonstrated success leading teams, strategic initiatives and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Deep knowledge of defined-contribution plans and working knowledge of defined-benefit, multiemployer, trust, funding and financial-reporting matters.
  • Demonstrated experience translating actuarial and financial analysis into executive recommendations.
  • Experience managing recordkeepers, actuaries, trustees, investment advisors and other material vendors.
  • Exceptional financial acumen, risk judgment, governance discipline and executive communication skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, actuarial science, business, human resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience and Credentials:

  • Experience with multinational benefit liabilities and collectively bargained populations.
  • Experience with U.S. GAAP benefit accounting, asset-liability analysis or trust governance.
  • MBA, master's degree, actuarial credential, CFA, CEBS or comparable credential.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. 

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: VP, Benefits - Healthcare Products
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Vice President, Healthcare Products is the enterprise owner for the U.S. healthcare portfolio, including medical, pharmacy, behavioral health, clinical navigation and ERISA-covered clinic programs. This leader sets product strategy, manages financial and clinical performance, oversees vendors and delivers an accessible, affordable and effective employee experience across a diverse workforce.

Here you can:

Portfolio strategy and design

  • Set the multi-year healthcare strategy and product roadmap for union and non-union employee populations.
  • Design healthcare solutions for one of the most diverse workforces in the world, supporting employees across studios, theme parks, productions, news, sports, corporate functions, and international businesses.
  • Evaluate plan design, networks, funding, contributions and point solutions against affordability, access, quality, clinical outcomes and total cost.
  • Recommend programs to retain, redesign, consolidate, replace or discontinue.

Financial and clinical performance

  • Own portfolio budgeting, claims-trend targets, administrative expense and cost-management recommendations in partnership with Finance and actuarial resources.
  • Monitor high-cost claims, specialty pharmacy, chronic conditions, behavioral health, provider quality and site-of-care patterns; translate findings into action.
  • Maintain a scorecard covering financial, clinical, employee-experience and vendor outcomes.

Vendor and employee experience

  • Lead strategy, contracting recommendations, performance management and QBRs for carriers, PBMs, behavioral-health, navigation, clinical and clinic partners.
  • Define employee journeys for enrollment, care navigation, prescriptions, complex conditions, claims and behavioral-health support.
  • Partner with Benefits Platform & Experience on administration, service, data, technology and communications execution.

Governance and enterprise partnership

  • Partner with Governance, Compliance & Fiduciary Affairs on ERISA, HIPAA, mental-health parity, privacy, plan documents and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with Medical Risk & Event Health when clinics or health programs intersect with occupational health, productions, travel or event operations.
  • Present strategy, investment and performance recommendations to senior HR, Finance and business leaders.

Key Areas of Impact:

  • Healthcare cost and trend management.
  • Employee healthcare access, affordability, and experience.
  • Clinical outcomes and value realization from vendor partnerships.
  • Regulatory compliance, governance, and audit readiness.

Here you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in the healthcare space, with deep expertise in employer-sponsored healthcare programs. 
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, with demonstrated success leading teams, strategic initiatives and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Demonstrated ownership of medical, pharmacy/PBM and behavioral-health strategy, plan design, financial forecasting and vendor performance.
  • Exceptional command of healthcare economics, claims analytics, clinical-quality measures, ERISA and HIPAA requirements.
  • Experience leading major procurements, implementations, contract negotiations and vendor remediation.
  • Executive-level financial, analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience and Credentials:

  • Experience supporting hourly, seasonal, union-represented, production or geographically dispersed workforces.
  • Experience with onsite or near-site clinics, navigation platforms, alternative financing or value-based care.
  • Graduate degree or relevant professional credential in benefits, healthcare, finance or a related field.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.title: VP, Production Finance - DreamWorks
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world's leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together. 

The position of Vice President, Production Finance will play an important role in the organization dedicated to the Feature & TV Animation business with an emphasis on administration, partnership, analysis and strategy.  The VP, Production Finance reports directly into the CFO DreamWorks Animation based on the DreamWorks campus in Glendale, CA.

At DreamWorks Animation we believe that the animation we put out into the marketplace is only as good as the talent within the company that creates it. We are committed to fostering a culture that embraces innovation, creativity, collaboration, and a solid dose of fun.

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

“What would you say you do here?”

  • Close partnership with Senior Production & Studio Leadership to strategize & provide production finance/budget guidance & problem-solving.
  • Partner with other departments/divisions such as Corp. (FP&A) Finance, Business Affairs, Human Resources, Development, Post, Casting, Music, IT and NBCU.
  • Participate in Production Update meetings & provide review/approval for all the project financial updates.
  • Maintain monthly financial flash reports & responsible for final review of all Estimated Final Cost (EFC) & related monthly reports.
  • Maintain, provide and present monthly Dashboard updates to Senior Studio & NBCU Leadership.
  • Final review of all Production estimates, budgets, scenarios & related documents.
  • Provide 3rd party production service (such as, Entertainment Partners) support and guidance.
  • Advise & partner with HR & Labor Counsel regarding Union guidelines and contract negotiations.
  • Delegate ad hoc analysis & estimates requested by Studio & Production Leadership.
  • Provide guidance, feedback & final review.
  • Support or present to Studio Leadership
  • Production Tax Credit guidance, reporting & oversight.
  • Management of Production Finance Dept. to ensure timeliness, accuracy, opportunity and morale. Director & Manager level direct reports.

“What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • 10+ years professional experience in relevant roles
  • Discretion and the ability to deal with confidential information
  • Ability to work well in a fast paced, deadline driven environment
  • Solid business acumen, exceptional analytical and presentation skills with executive presence. Analytical skills combined with a clear and direct communication style
  • Ability to work well with others and work across a matrixed organization to achieve goals
  • Project and process management skills, demonstrated track record of delivering results
  • Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must have ability to execute both strategic and tactical priorities
     

“What can I offer?”

  • Production Tax Credit knowledge
  • Prior media/television/content industry experience preferred

job.title: Inside Sales Account Executive, Growth
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


We are looking for a dynamic Inside Sales Account Executive, Growth to join our team! This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and driving revenue in a fast-paced digital media environment.


The ideal candidate must have a strong understanding of the digital landscape and the ability to identify revenue opportunities, build and maintain an active sales pipeline and close business at volume. Reporting into the Senior Director of Commerce Partnerships, this role will center around prospecting new opportunities, executing effective campaigns, and managing client relations for the development of long-term partnerships.


Our team thrives in being analytical, detail-oriented, and able to coordinate and deliver projects with timely turnaround for the success of our clients and the business revenue initiatives of the company.


Responsibilities:


  • Identify, research, and prospect new business opportunities through proactive outreach
  • Respond quickly and effectively to inbound leads and sales inquiries.
  • Build and maintain a book of business focusing on mid-market and localized outreach.  
  • Conduct sales calls and lead presentations that clearly communicate the value of our products, capabilities, and offerings.
  • Manage the full sales cycle for assigned accounts, from initial outreach and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Track industry trends, competitive activity, and prospective client needs to uncover new sales opportunities.
  • Share client feedback, market insights, and emerging opportunities with internal stakeholders to help inform sales strategy and product development.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects and clients to move opportunities through the sales pipeline and build long-term relationships.
  • Effectively forecast, track and report revenue contribution and performance.
  • Coordinate internally with cross-functional teams in the planning and execution of client campaigns.
  • Meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue goals.
  • Be an active participant in strategic planning and brainstorming of sales initiatives.



Requirements:


  • 3-5 years of experience in digital media, advertising, marketing, or sales.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, build a sales pipeline, and close new business.
  • Experience selling digital advertising products, ideally including social, email/newsletters, forums, podcasts, branded content, or custom programs.
  • Highly motivated, organized, and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and priorities.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality results and exceeding client expectations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a passion for client success.

This role is ideal for a post-sale champion who excels at client communication, project management, and operational execution within the performance marketing space.

In this role, you will be the strategic bridge between our brand partners, and internal sales and social teams. You will take the reins once a partnership is secured, ensuring successful partner onboarding and fast-turnaround campaign launches. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love turning complex client campaigns into seamless successes, this role is for you.

Our team is a competitive and agile group that is first to react to market trends and opportunities. We use data-driven insights to guide decisions, combining sharp instincts and thorough analysis to drive success for both the business and our brand partners.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Client Communication & Onboarding: Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for brand and agency partners, onboarding them and managing ongoing communications.

  • Billing Support: Take ownership of the post-campaign financial lifecycle by assisting with monthly invoicing, spend tracking, and revenue reconciliation.

  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: A master of execution who can track multiple client timelines, creative deadlines, and financial sheets without missing a beat.

  • Problem-Solver: Proactive in identifying potential campaign bottlenecks (e.g., ad rejections, tracking issues) and quick to implement solutions.

job.title: Photo Editor, California Post
job.description:
Job Description:


We are looking for a Photo Editor to join the California Post team. The California Post’s Photo Department is integral to our fast-paced newsroom, working across platforms to enhance storytelling with compelling and timely imagery. Our editors are visual journalists with sharp editorial instincts and a keen sense for what resonates with readers. 


Reporting into the Photo Director, this role will be a key part of the visuals team, helping shape how stories are told across our digital platforms. The Photo Editor will react quickly to breaking news, source compelling imagery, and collaborate closely with editors and reporters to ensure our coverage is visually engaging, accurate, and timely.


Responsibilities:

  • Produce fast visual coverage on live breaking news and trending stories.
  • Fulfill photo requests to produce high quality assets for digital and print needs.
  • Researching live news, sports & political events.
  • Create visually impactful composites for the homepage.
  • Pitching photo driven stories.
  • Negotiating rates with agencies and freelance photographers.
  • Skillfully caption, add metadata, and archive imagery.
  • Multitask across different projects.
  • Collaborate with both reporters and editors.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years experience at a multi-platform digital media brand.
  • Keen newsroom experience to thrive in a fast-paced environment under pressure.
  • Good photo agency knowledge of mainstream wire services and agents.
  • Proven photo research and social verification skills.
  • Excellent news judgment with knowledge of news, sports and entertainment.
  • Digital-first mindset with experience adapting photos across platforms.
  • Proficient Adobe Photoshop skills.
  • Possess a keen eye for engaging content and understanding the global photo marketplace.

Note: This position requires on-site attendance five days per week at either our Los Angeles or New York office. The schedule is Sunday–Thursday, 1:00 p.m.–9:00 p.m. Pacific Time for Los Angeles-based employees and 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Pacific Time for New York-based employees.

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.

The New York Post is seeking a full-time Reporter (Tuesday-Saturday) who can thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

NOTE: The shift for this position is Tuesday-Friday 5:30am-1:30pm EST, Saturday 7am-3pm EST.

 

The Reporter will take the lead on major news stories, no matter the topic, and ensure The Post has the crucial elements covered while working to break our own lines. They will be at the forefront of delivering timely and accurate information to our audience. This role is pivotal in keeping our readers informed, engaged, and up-to-date on unfolding events.

Responsibilities:

● Write and report multiple stories per day in a fast-paced breaking news environment

● Pitch viral and trending news stories to be written in The Post’s signature snappy style

● Move swiftly in breaking news situations, filing real-time updates while closely monitoring the competition to keep our story fresh

● Edit news stories and collaborate with reporters to refine and strengthen story angles

● Collaborate with colleagues on originally reported news stories across all areas of coverage, including but not limited to local crime, local politics, court cases, human interest, national stories

● Vet story assignments and facts before publishing

The ideal candidate will have/be:

● At least 3 years of experience working in a competitive newsroom, preferably at a digital publication

● Excellent writing skills and strong reporting chops

● Strong news gathering skills and experience with social media platforms in order to quickly confirm information during live news events

● A voracious appetite for news and current events

● An understanding of how to navigate court documents and the criminal justice system a major plus

● The ability to spot a potentially viral story from any corner of the globe and quickly turn it into a great read

● The ability to pick out a compelling angle to a story not necessarily covered by other publications

● Strong news gathering skills and experience with social media platforms in order to quickly confirm information during live news events; think digital first

Note: This role will be expected to report on-site 5 days per week.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Producer, Radiolab 

Radiolab, pioneer of narrative nonfiction podcasting, is seeking a full-time Producer to join the team. Radiolab producers take ideas from pitch to broadcast, participating in all parts of the production process. We’re seeking an ambitious, deep-thinking, deep-feeling journalist who is obsessed with great stories, eager to help our team tackle the big questions facing our world today. The Producer will spend much of their time deep in tape, sorting through vast amounts of audio, crafting the arc of the episode in ProTools, and building out the story. They will work closely with the editorial team, making new drafts of episodes. Sometimes the Producer will work on ideas they’ve pitched; oftentimes they’ll produce other team member’s work. The Producer will help craft the soundscape of the show.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Regularly produce episodes from pitch to broadcast with minimal support

  • Find, pitch more ambitious, nuanced, and successful story ideas

  • Develop the arc of an episodes and craft narratives, with minimal editorial support

  • Executing notes from editors on new drafts of episodes

  • Cut interview selects and tracking tape

  • Source archival tape

  • Research for story ideas, booking guests, arranging logistics (ie ISDN, travel)

  • Pre-interview, book potential guests, engineer in-studio interviews and tracking

  • Perform field reporting and/or recording

  • Conceive of storyboards with the team 

  • Write narration and craft the sound design/soundscape of episodes.

  • Create new drafts of episodes in ProTools, experimenting relentlessly with story construction

  • Liaise with fact checker for episodes

  • Write and produce content for web, newsletter, and other platforms as needed


Key Qualifications:

 

  • At least five years experience producing, reporting and/or editing in long-form narrative audio, and/or comparable experience in a related field

  • Preferably has experience creating stories similar to the ones heard on Radiolab

  • Has a clear grasp of what makes a surprising, impactful and complicated story that could be heard on Radiolab

  • Has a proven ability to develop story arc and narrative

  • Has solid journalism skills including: interviewing, database research and fact checking

  • Has experience with linear editing software (ProTools, Logic, et cetera), and an advanced understanding of sound design

  • Sense of humor and musicality are a plus

 

It's important on the Radiolab team for everyone to work hard, be willing to pitch in on whatever is needed to get the job done, have an open mind, demonstrate integrity in their journalism, be wildly curious, and not be afraid to be a little bit weird.


Additional Information


This is a full-time non-exempt position with a salary range of $87,771-$95,000 and includes eligibility for medical, dental and vision insurance through SAG-AFTRA.

  

This role is based in New York City and is expected to work at our NYC Headquarters  two days per week.

 

This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement between New York Public Radio and SAG-AFTRA.


Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion


New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard.

Equal Opportunity


New York Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer committed to achieving the goal of equal employment opportunity for all. Applicants and employees are considered and evaluated for positions without regard to mental or physical disability, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, citizenship status, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, employment status or any protected federal, state or local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved. 


About Radiolab:


Created in 2002 by host Jad Abumrad, and now co-hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser, Radiolab began as an exploration of science, philosophy, and ethics using innovative composition and sound design. Radiolab has expanded and evolved to become a platform for long-form journalism and storytelling. The show challenges its listeners’ preconceived notions about how the world works. Radiolab provokes, it moves, it delights, and it asks its audience to see the world around them anew. 

 

In the past year, the show released a series on a Guantanamo Bay detainee named Latif Nasser; covered the pandemic (by looking at the present and the past); composed an experimental non-narrative meditation on the end of the world; reported out topical stories on the power of protest (here and here, too), the risk of Donald Trump trying to steal the election, the responsibilities of the police (and lack thereof); and escaped to the bottom of the sea to spend time with an octomom.

 

Since its founding nearly two decades ago, Radiolab has won some of the most prestigious awards in journalism, including two George Foster Peabody Awards, Third Coast awards, The Silver Gavel, as well as other accolades. In 2011 Abumrad received the MacArthur Genius grant. The show has spawned successful spinoff series, like More Perfect, Gonads, The Other Latif, G, Border Trilogy, and Radiolab for Kids.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About Us:

FOX 5 and KUSI are leading television stations in the San Diego market, providing news, entertainment, and impactful advertising solutions to businesses throughout the region. We offer a dynamic and collaborative work environment where talented individuals can thrive and grow. We are committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients and providing our viewers with the highest quality programming.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated, growth-minded Account Executive who takes ownership of their business and is driven to win. This role is responsible for generating new business, developing and managing client relationships, and growing revenue by strategically selling and upselling our full suite of television and digital advertising solutions.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who does not wait for opportunities to come to them. They consistently prospect, build a healthy sales pipeline, identify opportunities within existing accounts, and develop customized solutions that address clients' business and marketing objectives. Success in this role requires a strong sense of accountability, persistence, competitive drive, and the ability to consistently achieve or exceed established revenue and activity goals.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate new and incremental revenue, with a strong focus on new business and digital revenue growth, and achieve monthly sales goals through proactive prospecting, business development, and outside sales. Identify prospective advertisers, build relationships with key decision makers, and maintain a qualified pipeline by consistently developing and closing new business through cold calling, networking, referrals, targeted outreach, and other lead-generation strategies.
  • Manage client accounts, ensuring client satisfaction and maximizing revenue potential through strategic account growth, upselling, and cross-selling of broadcast, digital, streaming, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Conduct needs assessments to understand clients' business objectives, challenges, target audiences, and marketing goals, and develop customized broadcast and digital advertising solutions that address those objectives.
  • Present compelling proposals and negotiate advertising contracts with a focus on converting opportunities into new and incremental revenue.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including sales management, creative services, and others, to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Monitor campaign performance and provide clients with regular updates and reports, using performance insights to identify optimization, renewal, and additional revenue opportunities.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, digital advertising capabilities, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to effectively position the station's comprehensive marketing solutions.
  • Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets, including established expectations for new business and digital revenue growth.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of prospecting activity, sales opportunities, pipeline development, client interactions, and account activity in the CRM system.
  • Attend client meetings and industry events to develop relationships, generate leads, uncover new business opportunities, and expand the station's advertiser base.
  • Demonstrate a consistent sense of urgency, self-motivation, and accountability in prospecting and business development, with success measured by the ability to generate new business, grow digital revenue, expand existing accounts, and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and building strong client relationships.
  • Strong understanding of the media landscape and digital marketing strategies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software.  
  • Experience with Nielsen or other media measurement tools a plus.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Compensation - $70K Guarantee or Draw plus commission.
  • #LI-Onsite

 

Benefits:

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

  • Competitive compensation structure
  • Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth
  • SCAM ALERT:
  • Please be aware candidates may be at risk of being targeted by scammers seeking personal data or money. Recruiters with Nexstar Media Group and its local stations will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with Nexstar.tv domain or official station email addresses (example:@wreg.com).  Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nexstar or its recruiters via any other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. We will not contact you using a @gmail email address. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a job inquiry or offer, email us at corporaterecruiters@nexstar.tv.

job.description:
NEWS 2 (WKRN-TV) in Nashville, Tennessee is seeking a full-time Broadcast Engineer with strong IT skills to join our engineering team. You’ll provide daily maintenance and technical operational support for a large, complex broadcast facility, ensuring all broadcast systems, technology, and live day-of-air programs maintain on-air reliability across traditional and digital platforms. This position requires a combination of maintenance, IT and project management/system engineering skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and troubleshoot broadcast and IT systems, including studio/control room automation, master control, ENPS newsroom, cameras, audio gear, and streaming encoders.
  • Configure and troubleshoot IP networking for servers and broadcast equipment.
  • Diagnose signal flow and data flow issues; interpret schematics and system drawings.
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving skills with broadcast-related equipment and systems.
  • Support remote feed technologies and streaming workflows.
  • Support and assist studio operations within a live production environment.
  • Collaborate with engineering team to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborate with production and operations team to execute technical solutions that meet production needs in a timely fashion.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Strong knowledge of IP networking (LAN/VLAN/WAN/VPN), Active Directory, Windows/Linux platforms.
  • Proficiency with broadcast production systems and software, including audio consoles, intercom systems, video switchers, wireless audio, and test and measurement equipment.
  • Familiarity with broadcast systems: Ross Xpression, LED videowalls, Dante audio, satellite transmission.
  • Ability to use network tools (ping, traceroute) and common test equipment (signal generators, scopes).
  • Understanding of video compression, resolutions and bandwidth requirements.
  • Ability to read and understand technical system signal flow diagrams for studio facilities.
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving skills with broadcast-related equipment and systems.
  • Excellent written and communication skills, with the ability to diplomatically engage with colleagues across various departments.
  • Proficiency in newsroom and production environments, especially software driven.
  • Manage projects, design systems, and assist with system integration and commissioning.

Requirements:

  • Five (5) years' experience as an IT technician or maintenance engineer in a media facility is desired.

  • Ability to lift, set-up and operate equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, and be able to handle, control or feel objects, or tools.  Repetitive movements are required.

job.title: Director of Content & Innovation
job.description:
KIAH-TV/CW39 is a hyperlocal television station in Houston, TX and we are looking for a Director of Content & Innovation (previously known as News Director).


What You’ll Do


Lead all aspects of the Content Department across newsroom operations, digital content, streaming/CTV, social media, weather, sports, and content production.


Develop and execute a comprehensive multiplatform content strategy focused on total audience growth, engagement, and community impact.


Build a “Content First” culture that prioritizes storytelling, audience needs, and platform optimization over traditional show-based production.


Establish and manage rolling editorial workflows that allow content to move seamlessly across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms.


Drive growth of live streaming, CTV programming, digital video, vertical video, and other audience-focused content initiatives.


Lead recruitment, coaching, training, and performance management for all content staff to prepare current and future content creators and newsroom leaders to excel in our modernized, “Content First” newsroom.


Use audience insights, analytics, and performance data to inform content decisions and improve results across all platforms.


Encourage experimentation, innovation, and the development of new content formats that differentiate the station in the market.


Partner with station leadership to identify opportunities for growth, operational efficiency, and long-term total audience development.


Ensure content consistently reflects journalistic excellence, community impact, creativity, and audience value.


Oversee content budgets, resource allocation, and strategic investments in technology, training, and workflow.


Perform other duties as assigned.


What We’re Looking For (Requirements & Qualifications)


Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Minimum five years newsroom experience, including at least two years in content leadership, news leadership, or data-driven decision making.


Demonstrated success leading content teams across multiple platforms, including digital, social, streaming, and broadcast.


Strong understanding of total audience development, content strategy, streaming, CTV, social video, and digital publishing.


Experience building high-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, and professional development.


Proven ability to lead organizational change and implement new workflows, technologies, and content strategies.


Strong editorial judgment and a commitment to journalistic excellence.


Experience using analytics and audience data to guide content decisions and measure success.


Ability to establish long-term goals, develop strategic plans, and execute performance objectives.


Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, decision-making and problem-solving skills.


Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.


Experience with newsroom, digital publishing, streaming, and content production technologies preferred.


Passion for innovation, community storytelling, and the future of local journalism.


Success in This Role

The ideal candidate understands that great journalism is no longer created for a single platform. The Director of Content and Innovation is a builder, a coach, an innovator, and a content strategist who can inspire teams to create compelling local content that connects with audiences across every screen and platform while preparing the station for the future of local media.


OUR VALUES

We respect our audience, customers, team members and owners. We encourage every individual’s contribution and personal growth. We honor diversity. We foster work environments that provide personal pride through job satisfaction and a balanced life. We embrace the communities in which we operate. We promote open communication, innovation, and creativity. We strive for excellence in all our endeavors. We are in the local content business, providing multiple platforms for news, entertainment, and successful marketing solutions, enriching each community we serve. Each of our television stations are local service businesses.


OPPORTUNITY

With markets ranging from small to major, Nexstar has a place for every experience level. Whether you’re just starting your broadcasting career or ready to make the leap into a larger market, Nexstar offers a broad range of opportunities. And that same market diversity allows Nexstar to give employees room to grow and progress in their careers. As your experience, ability, talent, and ambition grows, so too will your options within Nexstar Nation.

job.title: IT Specialist, Part-time - NewsNation & WGN-TV
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group is seeking a skilled and motivated Part-time IT Specialist to join our Engineering organization in Chicago supporting both NewsNation and WGN-TV. If you're ready for a challenging and dynamic opportunity to work with leading-edge technology in a live news environment, we want to hear from you.


This position reports to the Manager of Information Technology for NewsNation and WGN-TV Chicago and provides support for newsrooms, production control rooms, sales, creative services, producers and talent.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows, macOS, and Linux systems across News, Creative Services, and other departments.

  • Provide expert support for Microsoft Office 365 applications and related plug-ins.

  • Manage and maintain critical infrastructure, including national news production servers, content storage systems, playout servers, graphics, and editing systems.

  • Install, configure, and resolve issues with Adobe Creative Cloud applications and plug-ins.

  • Diagnose and repair desktop and laptop hardware, including drives, memory, and peripherals.

  • Perform regular system backups and restorations, particularly for high-performance RAID-based broadcast systems.

  • Configure and troubleshoot IP networks, including 10Gbps+ high-speed links and geographically distributed systems.

  • Support both local and remote users in a mission-critical, 24/7 news environment.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Degree in Information Technology or related field preferred; equivalent work experience will be considered.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work effectively under pressure in a live broadcast setting.

  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, in support of live news operations.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to troubleshoot critical systems with urgency and precision.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds for distances up to 100 feet.

  • Manual dexterity is necessary to operate keyboards, tools, and technical equipment.

  • A valid driver’s license is required; must be able to safely operate company vehicles.

Why Join Us?

This is your chance to be part of a growing national news brand while also contributing to the success of a respected local television institution. We offer competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading professionals.

#LI-Onsite

$30 to $38 per hour - commensurate with applicant's experience and skill level

job.title: NewsNation Live Weekends Segment Producer
job.description:
Segment Producer, NewsNation Live Weekend (Chicago)


NewsNation is looking for a Segment Producer to join the team of the weekend edition of NewsNation Live based in Chicago. This role involves contributing story ideas, compiling elements, and building engaging live segments and packages based on a wide range of topics ranging from political news to domestic news to international news. The position is based at the network's offices in Chicago.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Pitch story ideas
  • Produce live guest segments and correspondent hits
  • Collaborate closely with NewsNation correspondents to produce compelling and accurate live hits and update with new details throughout the show
  • Locate and create strongest possible elements to be used in guest segments and live correspondent hits - including video, graphics, lower thirds - and load them into the rundown quickly and accurately
  • Write, organize, and produce scripts, including but not limited to anchors intros, guest segments, teases, reporter hits
  • Keep Executive Producer and Senior Producer apprised of developments of stories
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by show leaders or news management

 

Requirements & Skills:

  • 2-10 years of experience in national or major-market television news preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Knowledge and experience editing video and creating graphics
  • Knowledge of ENPS or INews preferred
  • Excellent verbal, written, grammar and analytical skills
  • Excellent knowledge of current events and politics
  • Commitment to being a self-starter who proactively seeks out tasks and opportunities for growth
  • Exhibit strong news judgment
  • Must have the ability to handle multiple projects or assignments with attention to detail
  • Must thrive in a collaborative work environment
  • Handle stress, including short deadlines
  • Work at a computer for extended periods of time
  • Must be able to work flexible assigned shifts and be on call during overnights, mornings and weekends/holidays

Salary Range: $70,000-80,000 (commensurate with experience)


Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more. Part time employees are eligible for 401(k) and any local/state leave plans. Union positions are subject to the benefits outlined in their Collective Bargaining Agreement.

job.title: Photographer/Editor
job.description:
What you’ll do:

KSWB/FOX 5 and KUSI are looking for a News ENG Photographer to help tell the stories that matter to San Diego. You’ll work closely with reporters and producers to shoot and edit daily stories, set up live shots, and deliver video for our broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. You’ll also communicate developments from the field to the assignment desk and newsroom.

We’re looking for someone who brings creativity to every assignment and takes pride in finding a compelling way to tell each story. The ideal candidate thrives on breaking news, works well with a team, and is always looking to make the next story better.

Duties & Responsibilities:

·         Shoot high-quality video and capture natural sound for daily news stories, breaking news, live coverage, and special projects.

·         Work with reporters and producers to plan visual coverage, develop story ideas, and gather the footage and sound needed to tell complete, accurate, and unbiased stories.

·         Edit video for newscasts and digital platforms using Premiere. Match video to scripts, meet deadlines, and follow station editorial and style standards.

·         Set up and operate field equipment for live shots and video feeds, including microwave, satellite, and bonded cellular systems. Troubleshoot technical issues and communicate with the control room during broadcasts.

·         Organize and archive raw footage and completed stories for future use.

·         Maintain assigned cameras, field equipment, and vehicles in good working condition, and complete required logs and paperwork.

·         Respond to breaking news and changing schedules while following station safety procedures, particularly in hazardous conditions.

·         Work professionally with colleagues and people in the field and stay current with news production tools and practices.

REQUIREMENTS:

·         At least three years of professional news camera experience is required, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

·         Professional proficiency with ENG field cameras, live trucks, field editing systems, and related equipment. Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro is required.

·         A valid driver’s license and an excellent driving record. Driving a news vehicle to and from assignments is a regular part of the job.

·         Strong attention to detail, the ability to follow direction, and sound judgment when making independent decisions under pressure.

·         Availability for early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, overnight assignments, and travel outside the San Diego market as newsroom needs require.

·         FAA Part 107 Drone License is a plus.

·         Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. of equipment.

·         Ability to perform other duties as assigned.

·         Compensation - $22+ hr commensurate with experience and skill level

The PT Seasonal - JIB & Handheld Camera Operator is responsible for getting shots using either a JIB or Handheld camera. This person will be responsible for setting up, operating and maintaining both types of cameras and equipment to create visually compelling footage for both News and other productions.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Follow directions from the director to get shots that help enhance the presentation of our news and other productions
  • Actively contribute to SOP, workflow, and show report documentation.
  • Adapt to last-minute changes and breaking news, making quick decisions under pressure.
