job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
The Strategic Account Manager is the digital marketing services sales lead and digital advertising expert.

Combining consultative selling, digital marketing expertise, and data-driven insights, this individual drives business development, client acquisition, revenue growth, and advertiser retention. Working collaboratively with Account Executives and other station departments, the Strategic Account Manager leads digital sales opportunities from prospecting and client discovery through solution development, sales presentations, campaign performance evaluation, renewal, and account expansion.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
WJZY / Queen City News is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to help lead the growth of our digital and cross-platform advertising business in the Charlotte market. This is a sales-focused, consultative leadership role for someone who understands that successful digital selling is about more than presenting products. The Strategic Account Manager will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Managers, and clients to uncover business challenges, develop compelling marketing strategies, and build solutions that drive measurable results. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, strong communicator, curious problem solver, and confident sales partner who can help transform complex digital marketing opportunities into simple, compelling solutions for local businesses. You will serve as a digital and cross-platform subject matter expert, helping the sales team identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, win new business, and grow existing accounts.

  • Key ResponsibilitiesDrive Digital Revenue Growth
  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Managers to identify, develop, and close digital and cross-platform revenue opportunities.
  • Develop strategies to grow both new and existing digital business.
  • Identify high-potential accounts and verticals and create targeted sales strategies to penetrate those opportunities.
  • Participate in client meetings and presentations as a strategic marketing and digital subject matter expert.
  • Help sales teams increase the value of client relationships by expanding marketing solutions beyond traditional television.
  • Become a Strategic Sales Partner
  • Work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales process—from prospecting and discovery through presentation, closing, and campaign strategy.
  • Help sellers prepare for meetings through research, business intelligence, and development of a clear client-focused point of view.
  • Coach and collaborate with sellers on digital strategy, positioning, objection handling, and solution development.
  • Bring creativity and a challenger-style, consultative approach to client conversations.
  • Help simplify complex digital marketing concepts and translate them into clear business outcomes.
  • Develop Client-Centric Marketing Solutions
  • Conduct research to understand a client's business, competitive environment, target audience, and marketing objectives.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to uncover client needs and opportunities rather than relying on a product-first sales approach.
  • Develop customized marketing strategies designed to increase awareness, generate leads, drive conversions, and grow market share.
  • Present recommendations with a focus on business outcomes, audience strategy, measurement, and return on investment.
  • Build trusted relationships with local businesses and advertising agencies by serving as a marketing resource and strategic advisor.
  • Lead Digital Sales Enablement
  • Keep the sales organization informed about new products, capabilities, industry trends, best practices, and emerging opportunities.
  • What We're Looking ForThe ideal candidate will have:
  • Proven experience in digital advertising, media sales, marketing, advertising technology, or a related field.
  • Strong consultative and solution-based sales skills.
  • A demonstrated ability to develop relationships with clients and uncover business needs.
  • Experience presenting marketing strategies and recommendations to business owners, executives, and/or advertising agencies.
  • A strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and current marketing trends.
  • The ability to translate complex marketing concepts, data, and technology into simple business solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • A proactive, competitive, and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to understand how marketing impacts revenue and growth.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with salespeople while also taking ownership of revenue opportunities.
  • A willingness to continually learn and adapt in a rapidly changing media and advertising landscape.
  • What Success Looks LikeSuccess in this role goes beyond selling digital products.The successful Strategic Account Manager will:
  • Grow digital revenue.
  • Help Account Executives win more business and larger opportunities.
  • Create stronger, more strategic client relationships.
  • Turn client business challenges into compelling marketing solutions.
  • Increase adoption of cross-platform solutions.
  • Elevate the digital expertise of the entire sales organization.
  • Become a trusted strategic resource for both clients and sellers.
  • This is an opportunity for a sales-minded marketing strategist who wants to have a direct impact on revenue, client success, and the evolution of a modern local media organization.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
WIVT News Channel 34 in Binghamton, NY and WETM TV 18 in Elmira, NY has an immediate opening for a Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to join our sales team in a dual market role.  As the station’s digital thought leader and strategic revenue partner, the SAM works with Account Executives to develop innovative marketing solutions, strengthen client relationships, and drive measurable results.  Combining consultative sales, digital expertise, and data-driven insights, this role helps clients achieve their business goals while fueling station growth.


Working alongside Account Executives throughout the customer lifecycle, the SAM supports research, account planning, client discovery, solution development, sales presentations, performance analysis, and growth recommendations. As the station’s digital subject matter expert, the SAM translates marketing strategies, audience insights, and performance data into digital revenue growth and advertiser retention.


This is a customer success and growth role - not tactical fulfillment or support position. The SAM owns client outcomes, retention, and revenue expansion.

Revenue Growth & Customer Success


  • Develop consultative strategies aligned with advertiser objectives, audiences, and success measures.
  • Identify renewal, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that increase recurring revenue and client value.
  • Support station digital revenue and budget attainment.

Digital Thought Leadership


  • Serve as the station’s expert on digital advertising, audience solutions, analytics, attribution, and emerging technologies.
  • Translate complex capabilities and performance data into clear business recommendations.
  • Educate clients and sales teams on trends, best practices, and growth opportunities.

Sales Partnership & Client Engagement


  • Partner with Account Executives from prospecting through renewal while maintaining clear account ownership.
  • Conduct research and account planning to develop client-specific strategies.
  • Participate in discovery meetings, presentations, and business reviews as the digital strategy expert.
  • Support proposals, audience recommendations, and integrated marketing solutions.

Performance & Retention


  • Analyze campaign results and convert findings into actionable insights.
  • Lead performance reviews that demonstrate ROI and recommend next steps.
  • Identify performance risks and opportunities that improve retention and account growth.

Collaboration & Sales Enablement


  • Collaborate with sales, research, ad operations, and digital services to provide a consistent client experience.
  • Coach sales teams on digital solutions, consultative selling, and effective use of insights.
  • Share market intelligence and success stories that strengthen digital selling.

Qualifications


  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, media sales, strategic account management, advertising strategy, or consultative selling.
  • Strong knowledge of digital advertising, audience targeting, analytics, attribution, and performance marketing.
  • Proven ability to develop and present strategies that drive revenue and business results.
  • Strong analytical, sales, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience with research, analytics, CRM, and reporting platforms.
  • Media, broadcast, agency, or digital advertising experience preferred.

Success Measures


  • Digital revenue growth and budget attainment.
  • Advertiser retention, renewal, and account expansion.
  • Client satisfaction and measurable business outcomes.
  • Increased sales conversion and Account Executive effectiveness.

Compensation: $40,000 - $60,000 annual base salary, plus commission and bonus potential.

job.title: Strategic Accounts Manager

This is a sales-focused, consultative leadership role for someone who understands that successful digital selling is about more than presenting products.

OUR VALUES

job.title: Studio Technician
job.description:
The Studio Technician operates various equipment (camera, audio, visual, graphics, lighting, or digital) used for production and/or transmission.

KRON 4, the Bay Area’s Local News Station and brand-new CW network affiliate in San Francisco, California is seeking a Studio Technician.


This is a regular, full-time, union position.


Responsibilities:

  • Operation of broadcast equipment, not limited to but including Tricaster, Ross Overdrive, Studio managing, teleprompting, audio operation, robotic cameras, transmission and other duties as assigned to execute KRON4 productions & KRON streaming services.
  • Applicant must have demonstratable skills in LIVE broadcast production, automation, and execution of LIVE breaking news.
  • Be able to communicate and document effectively and concisely with crew, news producers and assignment team.
  • Coordinates with all technical operators during newscasts and other live and recorded productions.
  • Must possess working knowledge of ENPS, MOS commands, video servers, and general broadcast production equipment.
  • Work as a liaison daily between news, engineering, and production departments.
  • Tests equipment daily to ensure proper operation.

Qualifications & Expectations:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications or related field preferred.
  • Three plus (3+) years’ experience in professional live television broadcast operations preferred.
  • Candidate should be a problem solver and quick thinker to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live news, be self-sufficient and have a “press-on-regardless” attitude.
  • Must demonstrate proficiency operating broadcast and production equipment.
  • Must be detail-oriented and be able to multitask in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
  • Applicant should have the drive to learn and advance skills.
  • Working knowledge of common business software applications, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Availability to work all day parts, including weekends and holidays. 
  • Recognize that overtime hours may occur as situations arise.
  • Physical requirements: Standing and/or sitting for extended periods of time and performing physical production duties, including moving set pieces, equipment, and studio materials.
  • Management reserves the discretion to add or modify job duties as required.

Compensation – Minimum of $33.00/hr. commensurate with experience and job skill

job.description:

  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Proficiency with broadcast control equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

job.title: Unpaid Intern
job.description:
WSYR-TV Newschannel 9, the Nexstar ABC television affiliate in Syracuse, NY has internships available for qualified students studying broadcast journalism, video production, and other communication degrees. job.title: Weekend Morning Meteorologist
job.description:
PIX11 News (WPIX-TV and PIX11+) is seeking a full-time Meteorologist to serve as our primary weekend morning meteorologist and a key contributor to weather coverage across television, streaming, digital, and social platforms.


The successful candidate will deliver accurate, timely, and engaging forecasts; create compelling multiplatform weather content; and play an important role in PIX11+'s expanding live streaming operation. This position requires a skilled forecaster, strong communicator, and innovative content creator who can translate complex meteorological data into clear, useful, and impactful storytelling for audiences wherever they consume news.


The Meteorologist will be responsible for preparing and presenting forecasts, collaborating closely with the weather team to maintain consistency and continuity across all public-facing weather coverage, and delivering energetic and easy-to-understand weather presentations. The role includes supporting weekend morning newscasts and weekday shifts focused on broadcast, streaming, digital, and social content.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working in the studio, in the field during significant weather events, and producing digital and social-first content that enhances audience engagement and understanding. The successful candidate should also be comfortable creating content on news and community topics beyond the immediate weather forecast when needed.


Forecasting & On-Air Presentation

  • Produce and deliver accurate weather forecasts for scheduled newscasts, streaming programs, and weather cut-ins.
  • Take primary ownership of weekend morning weather forecasting across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.
  • Communicate weather information clearly, confidently, and conversationally, with an emphasis on viewer utility and understanding.
  • Serve as primary meteorologist during severe weather coverage, providing extended on-air, streaming, and digital reporting as needed during significant weather events.
  • Monitor forecast models, radar, alerts, and real-time data to adjust forecasts throughout the day.
  • Build strong on-air chemistry and collaborate effectively with anchors, reporters, and other meteorologists.
  • Translate complex meteorological information into clear, engaging, audience-focused storytelling across multiple platforms.

Graphics & Content Production

  • Build and update daily weather graphics using WSI and other forecasting tools.
  • Create visual content tailored for broadcast, streaming, web, social, and mobile audiences.
  • Maintain consistency in forecast accuracy, visual presentation, and messaging across all platforms.
  • Collaborate with producers on segment development, weather storytelling, breaking coverage plans, and data integration.
  • Develop explainers, special projects, and weather-related franchise content that support audience growth and engagement.

Streaming, Digital & Social Media

  • Serve as a meteorologist for PIX11+ live streaming, including breaking weather events, severe weather coverage, special programming, and regularly scheduled live streams.
  • Develop and present weather content specifically designed for streaming audiences, including extended forecasts, explainers, live discussions, and special coverage.
  • Create platform-specific weather content, including short-form videos, forecasts, explainers, storm updates, and audience engagement features.
  • Create engaging vertical video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and emerging platforms using platform-specific storytelling techniques.
  • Produce weather content optimized for mobile-first audiences and social distribution.
  • Publish weather forecasts, alerts, articles, videos, and related content across station-owned digital platforms.
  • Track audience engagement and use platform insights to help inform content strategy and improve performance across digital and social channels.
  • Engage with viewers across digital and social platforms when appropriate.
  • Contribute to digital and streaming coverage of news, community, and special-event topics beyond weather as assigned.

Team Collaboration

  • Coordinate with news leadership and newsroom personnel on daily weather coverage priorities and severe weather planning.
  • Participate in editorial meetings to identify weather impacts, major forecast storylines, and coverage opportunities.
  • Work closely with digital, streaming, and social teams to maximize audience reach and engagement.
  • Support community outreach efforts, including school visits, public appearances, preparedness initiatives, and station events.
  • Assist in long-term planning for seasonal weather coverage, major weather events, and special projects.

Operational Duties

  • Maintain proficiency with weather equipment, forecasting tools, graphics systems, and related software.
  • Assist in identifying and troubleshooting issues related to weather systems and workflows.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company policies, and journalistic standards.
  • Remain available for coverage of significant weather events, breaking news situations, and other special assignments as needed.

Requirements & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or a related field.
  • AMS Certified Broadcast Meteorologist (CBM), AMS Seal, NWA Seal, or progress toward certification preferred.
  • Minimum five years of on-air forecasting experience in a professional newsroom environment. Major-market experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of forecast models, radar interpretation, severe weather analysis, and climate trends.
  • Advanced proficiency with weather graphics and forecasting systems, including WSI or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated success creating engaging social media, streaming, and vertical video content.
  • Strong understanding of platform-specific storytelling techniques for streaming, social media, and mobile audiences.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Sound editorial judgment and the ability to communicate complex information clearly and accurately.
  • Ability to perform effectively during severe weather, breaking news, and high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across broadcast, digital, streaming, and social teams.
  • Availability to work weekends, early mornings, holidays, severe weather events, and other special coverage assignments.
  • Proficiency in WordPress or similar digital publishing platforms.
  • Strong understanding of content publishing best practices across major social media platforms.
  • Proficiency with digital video editing systems, including Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or similar platforms.
  • Experience hosting or contributing to live-streamed content.
  • Ability to operate a live streaming studio using vMix or a similar production platform.
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.

Salary

This position has an annual base salary of $150,000. Compensation is commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Nexstar Media Group, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Associate Counsel
job.description:
The Associate Counsel will report to the Senior Vice President, Labor Relations and be responsible for development, negotiation and administration of the NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), including representing the league and clubs in litigation under the CBA.  The holder of this position will represent the league in grievance hearings and arbitrations brought by or against the NFL and supervise outside counsel in the litigation of such matters.  This critical role will require strong investigative and advocacy skills, and the ability to spot and solve issues related to league policies. 

Responsibilities

  • Acquire and demonstrate substantive mastery of the CBA and league policies regulating the conduct of clubs and players.   
  • Litigate grievances on behalf of the league and member clubs under the collective bargaining agreement with the NFL Players Association.  
  • Provide counsel to the league and clubs regarding rights and obligations under the CBA, the Salary Cap system, Player Personnel rules, and other collectively bargained league rules. 
  • Assist in the investigation and enforcement of potential violations of the CBA and related policies regulating player and club conduct.  
  • Draft and review policy directives for NFL players and Clubs. 
  • Interact with outside law firms, consultants and others involved in the administration of the CBA, policies and/or litigation. 
  • Assist in negotiations with the NFL Players Association. 
  • Prepare legal memoranda for clubs regarding policy obligations. 
  • Independently develop and maintain working relationships with club counsel and NFLPA representatives. 

Required Qualifications

  • Law Degree (J.D.); 4 to 6+ years of litigation experience at a top law firm or federal government agency.   
  • Experience conducting and maintaining a docket of litigation matters and internal investigations.   
  • Experience appearing in court or similar settings, interviewing senior executives and drafting investigatory findings.   
  • Experience deposing and cross-examining witnesses.    
  • Experience making presentations to large groups of senior executives. 
  • Familiarity with NFL and other sports’ labor relations. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours in-office per week. 

 

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

 

Salary $210,000—$245,000 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

  • Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.
  • Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.
  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.
  • Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

NFL Leadership Attributes:

  • Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.
  • Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.
  • Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.
  • Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.
  • Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.
  • Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

WHO YOU ARE:

Talent Attributes:   What we expect for our employees:

  • Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can-do attitude 
  • Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement
  • Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence
  • Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition
  • Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset

job.title: Associate, Live Content Correspondents Program Manager (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The Live Content Correspondents (LCC) Manager will support the continued growth and evolution of the NFL’s Live Content Correspondent program by helping execute key league priorities. The role will provide year-round operational support across LCC recruitment, development, and program initiatives while helping ensure the team can effectively scale and respond to emerging opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategic development and day-to-day operation of the League’s Live Content Correspondents (LCC) program, establishing standards, workflows, training programs and performance expectations across a distributed network of contributors.
  • Own overall LCC program effectiveness, including talent identification, onboarding, contributor development, engagement, retention and measurement of program success.
  • Influence and coordinate the work of contributors, market leads, agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent execution and quality standards across all LCC initiatives.
  • Drive the growth and expansion of the LCC network, identifying emerging creators and new opportunities across the U.S. and priority international markets while partnering with local teams to strengthen live content capabilities and program efficiency.
  • Partner across the League to maximize the value of LCC talent and content, identifying opportunities to support strategic initiatives, enhance partner integrations and create new business value.
  • Represent and advocate for the LCC program across the League, maintaining a visible presence in the League office to build relationships, identify opportunities and foster collaboration across Marketing and other departments.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital media, social content, creator programs, sports, entertainment or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects, programs or operational workflows across multiple stakeholders.

job.title: Associate, Post-Production Audio Mixer (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
NFL Films is seeking an experienced Associate, Post-Production Audio Mixer to play a critical role in bringing our stories to life through sound. This position is responsible for crafting immersive, broadcast-quality audio experiences across a wide range of NFL Films productions, including documentaries, feature programming, branded content, commercial projects, and digital media.

Working at the intersection of storytelling and technology, the Associate, Post-Production Audio Mixer will lead all aspects of audio post-production, including dialogue editing, sound design, restoration, re-recording mixing, and final delivery. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong creative instincts, understanding how sound enhances emotion, reinforces narrative, and elevates the viewer experience.

Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, the ability to thrive in a collaborative and deadline-driven environment, and a passion for producing world-class content that reflects the quality and legacy of NFL Films.

This role compensates at $53 to $63 per hour for this long term, benefited contract engagement.  

Essential Functions

  • Perform dialogue editing, sound effects editing, restoration, and cleanup for a variety of NFL Films productions.
  • Create original sound designs that support and enhance storytelling objectives.
  • Execute re-recording mixes for documentary, long-form, short-form, commercial, and digital content.
  • Deliver final mixes and mix stems in accordance with production, broadcast, and distribution specifications.
  • Mix and deliver content in stereo, surround sound, and Dolby Atmos formats.
  • Utilize DaVinci Resolve Fairlight and other industry-standard tools to manage audio post-production workflows.
  • Apply advanced audio restoration and repair techniques utilizing tools such as iZotope RX.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, editors, composers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure audio elements align with the creative vision.
  • Troubleshoot technical and workflow challenges while maintaining project schedules and quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting demanding production deadlines.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Audio Engineering, Recording Arts, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of professional experience as a Sound Designer and/or Re-Recording Mixer in a post-production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience across documentary, sports, commercial, and long-form content production.
  • Advanced knowledge of mix stem creation and delivery workflows.
  • Extensive experience mixing in stereo, surround, and Dolby Atmos environments.
  • Strong understanding of digital audio workstations, audio signal flow, and contemporary post-production techniques.
  • Proficiency with audio restoration, repair, and cleanup tools, including iZotope RX.
  • Proven ability to maintain high-quality output while working under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in sports, entertainment, or broadcast media environments.
  • Advanced proficiency with DaVinci Resolve Fairlight.
  • Familiarity with evolving audio standards and emerging post-production technologies.

Other Key Attributes

  • Strong creative instincts and a passion for storytelling through sound.
  • Collaborative team player with the ability to build effective working relationships across production teams.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to remain composed and productive in fast-paced production environments.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • In-office position.
  • Standard schedule averages 40 hours per week.
  • Must be available to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, extended hours, and other non-standard schedules as required by production demands and delivery deadlines.

job.title: Associate, Social & Influencer Marketing (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL’s social media team is seeking a Social Content Programmer to help manage the day-to-day creation, production and execution of social content across the NFL’s primary social channels. This person in this role will be joining the NFL’s social programming team and will be helping directly manage the league’s social presence across several platforms and verticals. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for the game along with an extensive understanding of all social media platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan, create, and publish content of all types directly on primary NFL social media platforms.
  • Use strong news and social judgment to decide what's relevant to social audiences and what isn't.
  • Constantly evaluate how the NFL can enhance content and evolve distribution across various social media platforms.
  • Ability to identify stories and make editorial and packaging decisions that result in ideal social performance.
  • Evaluate and interpret performance analytics to understand what’s working, what’s not, while being prepared to pivot at any time.
  • Work alongside social managers on ideation and execution of editorial and marketing calendars.
  • Collaborate with various internal stakeholders to coordinate social content initiatives and creative.
  • Live/real-time coverage and support of NFL games and tentpole events.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Minimum 2 years of social/editorial experience.
  • Basic video + photo editing experience, preferable in Adobe products Photoshop and Premiere Pro.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the NFL, all 32 teams, and players across the league.
  • Ability to work well under tight deadlines and thrive in the "always-on", 24/7 NFL news cycle.
  • Strong eye for social-friendly content, with ability to understand what will perform well.

job.title: Associate, Transmission (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Media group is looking for a TOC Operator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and demonstrates strong technical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills while supporting live broadcast and transmission operations. The TOC Operator performs a broad range of technical and operational duties, including monitoring systems, coordinating broadcast workflows, and ensuring all technical facility requests are resolved in a timely and effective manner. The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge in operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes and familiarity with other broadcast transmission systems. This role requires a strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows, as well as the ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a fast-paced broadcast environment. As the first point of escalation for broadcast and transmission issues, the TOC Operator is responsible for communicating with Operations and Production Management in a timely and effective manner.  

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the NFL Media Production team, Streaming Video Group, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. 
  • Partner with the Remote Operations team to support the transmission and receipts of feeds for live remote productions, including NFL Network games, the Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and other NFL Network remote projects.  
  • Collaborate with the Streaming Video Group (SVG) to ensure content is captioned across NFL.com, NFL Fast Channel, NFL+ streaming platforms.  
  • Partner closely with the Engineering team to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with a feed or broadcast.  
  • Communicate with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. 
  • Perform test bar setups as needed 
  • Conduct extensive transmission, sync, and fax checks prior to live shows and remote events.  
  • Manage booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen, AT&T Fiber, and Satellite orders. 
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required. 

 Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a broadcast operations environment, including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals, with the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows. 
  • Ability to read audio meters, digital and analog waveform monitors, and set up test bars. 
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them (ex. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, and video issues).  
  • Ability to perform sync and fax checks prior to live broadcasts and events.  
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.  
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple feeds to ensure high broadcast quality.  
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document on-air issues and have maintain excellent telephone etiquette.  
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends and holidays.  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Possess a strong work ethic, positive attitude and leadership qualities.   
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities at the same time.  
  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Minimum 40 hours/week or less as business needs permit 
  • This is an in-office position.  
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Coordinator, Communications
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Coordinator, Communications to support storytelling and communications efforts tied to the league’s community impact work and strategic initiatives. Reporting to the Manager, Communications, the Coordinator will work closely with the Director of Communications to help develop and amplify compelling stories that highlight the NFL’s impact in communities nationwide, including social impact programs, community initiatives and Flag Football. Overall responsibilities include proactive storytelling, media relations support, stakeholder communications, event support, and coordination across priority communications initiatives.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and communicator with excellent organizational skills, sound news judgment, and a passion for purpose-driven work. Candidates should have an understanding of the evolving media landscape and experience helping organizations, nonprofits, philanthropic initiatives, advocacy groups, brands, or sports properties tell impactful stories across traditional and non-traditional platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Support communications and public affairs efforts related to the NFL’s community impact, engagement, and strategic initiatives, including select work connected to Flag Football.
  • Draft and edit communications materials, including press releases, media advisories, briefing documents, talking points, messaging, and executive materials.
  • Help identify, develop, and place stories that showcase the NFL’s impact across communities, youth engagement efforts, and league initiatives.
  • Support communications planning and execution for key league events and initiatives, including the Super Bowl, NFL Draft, and other major NFL moments.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, NFL clubs, league partners, community organizations, and key stakeholders to ensure aligned messaging.
  • Build and maintain relationships with traditional and non-traditional media across sports, business, culture, philanthropy, and community-focused outlets.
  • Assist with media monitoring, reporting, recaps, and analysis to measure communications impact.
  • Support press opportunities, media availabilities, stakeholder briefings, and executive engagements.
  • Monitor emerging conversations and cultural trends relevant to sports, communities, philanthropy, advocacy, and media.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field and at least 2 years of experience in communications, public relations, public affairs, journalism, nonprofit or advocacy communications, philanthropy, agency work, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, compelling, audience-specific materials.
  • Understanding of media relations, storytelling, proactive story placement, media monitoring, and news analysis.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of and interest in the NFL, current events, sports, culture, and media trends.
  • Experience supporting mission-driven, nonprofit, advocacy, philanthropic, or community-focused initiatives preferred.
  • Media relationships across sports, culture, business, nonprofit, or community impact spaces a plus.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and committed to quality.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to identify meaningful storytelling opportunities.
  • Collaborative and comfortable working across teams and stakeholders.
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Sound judgment, integrity, and professionalism when representing the league.
  • Passion for storytelling that drives meaningful engagement and impact.

Travel:

This position will require travel to key NFL meetings and events, including occasional nights and weekends.

Terms /Expected Hours of Work:

NFL employees are required to work minimum of 40 hours per week in the office.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. job.title: Coordinator, Quality Control
job.description:
The Quality Control team’s role is to ensure all officially licensed products meet brand standards of the NFL and its 32 member clubs. Through a thorough review of every product design the QC team evaluates the accuracy of marks, logos, colors and design parameters. The QC team does not creatively direct licensees on the concept, direction or design of their product, but may offer recommendations for how to resolve a design that is in conflict with the guidelines.

Responsibilities:

  • Learn and protect the NFL all 32 Club brands.
  • Review both apparel and hard goods to ensure that they align with both NFL
    and all Club brand guidelines.
  • Learn the Quality Control review system.
  • Manage his/her own schedule to accommodate the volume of products reviewed.
  • Clearly communicate and changes needed on products.
  • Communicate consistently and effectively with the rest of the Quality Control team
    to ensure consistency among all product.
  • Be well versed in trademark compliance.
  • Establish and foster external relationships with licensees and each of the 32 clubs.
  • Manage internal relationships with other departments including Consumer Products,
    Sponsorship and Legal.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field
  • A minimum of 2 years of professional work experience in quality control 
  • An understanding of sports apparel and product
  • Experience participating in line reviews
  • Experience in product approval and quality control review

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • An understanding of the NFL brand
  • Exhibits the ability to distinguish color
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Understanding of AI & emerging technology
  • Must be well organized and punctual

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Reviewing physical product, which includes handling large boxes.
  • Travel required 5-10% of the time.

job.title: Director, Assistant Special Counsel for Investigation
job.description:
The NFL is seeking an experienced investigations professional to conduct and oversee sensitive, complex investigations involving potential violations of League policies. This role will lead investigations involving players, Game Officials, and other League and club employees, including matters arising under the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy and allegations involving domestic violence, sexual assault, and child abuse.  

Responsible for all aspects of investigation including witness interviews, gathering other relevant evidence, case file organization, and preparation of detailed investigative reports. Also liaise with Management Council lawyers regarding disciplinary process and testify at disciplinary appeal hearings.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct complex investigations involving players, Game Officials, and other League and club employees in connection with alleged violations of the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy and other applicable League policies.
  • Lead investigations involving allegations of domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, and other serious misconduct.Manage all aspects of the investigative process, including planning investigations, conducting witness interviews, gathering and reviewing relevant evidence, organizing case files, and documenting investigative findings.
  • Prepare thorough, accurate, and well-supported investigative reports for stakeholders.
  • Liaise with Management Council attorneys regarding matters arising from investigations and the related disciplinary process.
  • Provide testimony at disciplinary appeal hearings, as required.
  • Conduct annual Personal Conduct Policy training for rookie players.
  • Deliver or support other League and club training programs as requested.
  • Supervise and coordinate investigative personnel and resources across multiple disciplines, including Directors, Security Representatives, gaming integrity, insider threat, digital forensics, and external contractors.
  • Travel as necessary to conduct investigations, interviews, hearings, training, and other League business.

Required Qualifications:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Minimum seven years of relevant legal investigative experience, including prior employment at a federal or state prosecutorial office or government agency, or in a role with comparable investigative experience. 
  • Experience and training in domestic violence, child abuse and sexual assault investigations required.

Travel

  • Approximately 30% domestic and international travel is required, including travel that may arise with limited advance notice.
  • This position requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on investigative, disciplinary, and operational needs.

job.title: Manager, Global Sponsorship
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship is part of the Global partnerships team that manages and executes League sponsorship deals and relationships. The specific duties essential for this role are to manage the day to day relationships of League partners including all activations, strategy, planning, creative and work across the League to support initiatives with our partners. job.title: Manager, Sponsorship New Business
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship New Business, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Given the new business focus of this position, we are seeking candidates with a demonstrated track record of independently sourcing, negotiating, and closing sponsorship or partnership deals, and who can quickly contribute to revenue growth.

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for developing a global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals 
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource  
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world) 
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution 
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives 
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects 
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed 
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director 

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's Degree 
  • 5+ years of direct sponsorship sales experience at league, team, agency and/or company 
  • Hands-on experience leading the full new-business sales cycle, from prospecting through deal execution, required

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator; ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels both internally and externally 
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint 

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics: 

  • Energetic, self-starter with a passion for uncovering synergies between Fortune 500 brands and the NFL 
  • Strong knowledge of sports marketing and/or sponsorship landscape 
  • Proficient in conducting industry research, prospecting, outreach, pitch ideation, and proposal development 
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator 
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels, both internally and externally 
  • Experienced in leveraging your network to initiate and develop relationships with senior-level marketing executives

  • N/A 

Travel:

job.title: Part-Time Digital Video Editor
job.description:
The NFL Media Group is seeking a versatile digital video editor with advanced skills in Adobe Premiere and After Effects. The Digital Video Editor is responsible for executing weekly deliverables for all NFL Media platforms. The editor can work autonomously or with a story producer on feature stories or elements. This position is responsible for editing, post producing and finishing features while working with post Supervisors and researchers for support.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the story telling behind each creative output to ensure it is clear, concise, and tailored to our digital audience.
  • Exhibit knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud Suite, including advanced skills in using Premiere and After Effects.
  • Design various graphics and elements for NFL digital platforms.
  • Involved in all aspects of daily and weekly post-production delivery of Original Content for Digital and Social platforms.
  • Works closely with Original Content Group directors and decision-makers on a daily basis in terms of concepts/ideas, storylines, and post-production.
  • Post-Produces feature stories from start to finish; Including research, edit and delivery.
  • Formulates and develops storylines during post-production in collaboration with producers, writers and other departments.
  • Post-production of high-end features, YouTube shorts, and cross-platform elements.
  • Communicates with all parties involved in post-production process from researchers to producers to ensure quality storytelling and timely delivery of features.
  • Adheres to established post-production workflows, and schedules in order to meet deadlines and follow best practices as set forth by the department.
  • A creative team attitude is mandatory in all tasks requested from the smallest to largest project assigned.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, broadcast media, web production or related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in production environment working with digital/ social media platforms.
  • Experience editing high-end content for social/ digital platforms.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must have strong knowledge of NFL history, including notable teams, players and games.
  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League associated events and current storylines.
  • Must be able to take complex stories and concisely tell them to our fans.
  • Experience editing content for YouTube.
  • Must be adaptable and able to work quickly under short deadlines.
  • High level of attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of CMS platforms.
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication skills.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time position working fewer than 29 hours per week.

job.title: Seasonal Designer, Global Creative Marketing
job.description:
The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a seasonal designer adept in the Adobe Creative Suite for the NFL's official social platforms, as well as other NFL-affiliated channels, teams, and players. The right candidate has a passion for football, social media and storytelling, and has a drive to create new and innovative original content. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of, and experience with, social design.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and animate various graphics and other creative needs for the NFL's official social platforms and other NFL-affiliated social platforms, teams, and players.
  • Work with large creative team made up of designers, illustrators, editors, and copywriters to conceive and executive multiple daily projects.
  • Pitch and conceptualize original content ideas and franchises for NFL social media platforms.
  • Manage the story telling behind each creative output to ensure it is clear, concise, snackable and true to the content
  • Identify important storylines from around the NFL and know how to best tell them to our audience

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 2-5+ years of relevant experience in graphic design and animation
  • Must have prior experience building and animating assets on social and/or digital platforms
  • Must have a Design portfolio containing various examples of relevant work
  • Strong ability with Photoshop, After Effects, and Illustrator are must-have’s.
  • Video Editing experience is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must be willing to work early mornings, nights, and weekends due to the nature of the NFL schedule
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • Knowledge of football and the NFL audience is a major plus
  • Must be adaptable and able to work quickly under short deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to take creative direction and incorporate feedback into revised work
  • Must be able to handle concept changes and accept creative feedback

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organization skills

 

Physical Demands:

N/A

Travel:

N/A

Terms/Expected Hours of Work:

Nights and Weekends, especially during the NFL season.

Opportunities for overtime.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Utility
job.description:
As a member of the stage crew the Utility position performs a wide range of tasks in support of the overall program production process. Under supervision of the Stage Manager, Director, and Operations team, Utilities work with technical staff to satisfy production needs for live, taped, and automated programming.

Responsibilities

  • Moving large set pieces and monitors during stage resets
  • Moving and arranging furniture pieces and props (set dressing)
  • Set talent marks on floor at the direction of Stage Manager and Director
  • Work with Stage Manager to support on-camera talent needs (i.e., bottled water, equipment, etc.)
  • Work with Stage Manager and other studio personnel to keep studio, set pieces and equipment clean and organized
  • Possess in-depth knowledge of all studio equipment
  • Support Camera Operators in the setup of studio cameras and over-under cable pulls
  • Familiarity with breakdown/setup of cameras and equipment
  • Ability to troubleshoot cameras on stage (tally, prompter etc.)
  • Ability to change camera lenses
  • Maintain continuity of all related camera equipment, including studio fax out and strike at end of day
  • Assist production crew (i.e., Lighting, Director, etc.) as talent stand-ins on set
  • Understanding of signal path, routers, patch bays and bulkhead connectivity
  • Work with video engineer to determine correct camera routing
  • Pro-actively keep the studio floor safe for all tech traffic
  • Loading and off-loading of equipment trucks
  • Support studio and technical teams with routine maintenance and upkeep of studio spaces, technical rooms, and related equipment
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years' experience working on a sound stage 
  • Excellent interpersonal & communications skills required
  • Strong work ethic, positive workplace demeanor and strong leadership skills along with demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities required
  • Ability to work in fast paced, high pressure production environment
  • Ability to lift 60lbs and set/strike studio gear
  • Ability to over-under cables

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Positive attitude
  • Team player

Physical Demands

  • Ability to stand for prolonged time
  • Ability to carry 50+ lbs.
  • Ability to climb a ladder and stairs

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Full-time, non-exempt position requiring 40 hours per week.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on production needs.
  • Seasonal position up to 7 months

job.title: Senior Manager, Finance - League Operations
job.description:
The Senior Manager, League Corporate Functions Finance, leads forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning activities for League Corporate departments, partnering closely with business teams to deliver insights and support strategic decisions. This role will provide oversight and support to various league departments including Information Technology, Data & Analytics, Diversity & Inclusion, Human Resources, and Corporate Social Responsibility.

This role oversees financial deliverables across assigned functions, provides direction to staff, and ensures accuracy, consistency, and compliance with all planning and reporting outputs. The position plays a critical role in aligning financial strategies with departmental and enterprise-wide objectives to drive informed decision-making and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

job.title: VP, Treasury & Risk
job.description:
The Vice President, Treasury & Risk will be a key leader within the NFL Finance organization, responsible for leading enterprise risk management, treasury, insurance, and internal audit functions. This role will strengthen the League’s governance, risk management, and control environment while providing strategic oversight of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking administration, and financial risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Internal Audit and Treasury professionals and manage external/co-sourced service providers as needed
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on risk, controls, governance, liquidity, insurance, and financial stewardship
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the League’s enterprise risk management framework, including enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk monitoring, mitigation planning, and reporting
  • Prepare clear and timely enterprise risk and emerging risk reporting for senior leadership and the Audit Committee
  • Oversee daily cash positioning activities, including liquidity management and cash position optimization
  • Develop short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to support liquidity planning, strategic business decisions, and investments
  • Develop a structure to work cross functionally to optimize working capital
  • Oversee banking administration, banking relationships, investments, and other treasury operations
  • Invest excess cash within approved cash investment guidelines to optimize interest income while preserving liquidity and principal
  • Design, analyze, monitor, and hedge exposures to foreign exchange and interest rate risk
  • Oversee and evaluate insurance programs to help ensure appropriate coverage, administration, and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience across treasury, enterprise risk management, accounting, or finance, including significant leadership responsibility
  • Management experience and proven success leading and developing teams
  • Proven success building functions and creating or improving processes, policies, controls, and reporting
  • Strong executive presence, judgment, communication skills, and ability to influence across a complex organization

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • CPA, CIA, CTP, CRMA, CISA, or other relevant professional certification
  • Experience using data analytics, automation, and continuous monitoring within treasury, risk, or internal audit
  • Experience managing co-sourced internal audit or other third-party professional service relationships

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in the office.

job.title: Manager, Inclusive Programs & Operations
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

The Manager, Inclusive Programs & Operations is a hands-on program leader responsible for turning NPR’s diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility (DEIA) priorities into well-designed, successfully executed programs, learning experiences and strategic initiatives.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Vice President of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, helping move high-level concepts into measurable delivery. Operating as an individual contributor, the Manager will develop project plans, establish timelines and milestones, coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, manage logistics and dependencies, track budgets and deliverables, identify risks, and ensure programs are successfully launched, implemented and evaluated.

The ideal candidate does not simply generate ideas; they build the systems, frameworks and operational discipline needed to turn ideas into sustainable programs. Whether standing up a new initiative from scratch, operationalizing a multi-day convening for Member Station leaders, or designing and facilitating an inclusive leadership workshop, this role balances strong program execution with thoughtful interpersonal judgment.

Responsibilities

  • Program Design& Operational Execution: Own the planning and implementation of DEIA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through completion. Translate strategic priorities into detailed project plans with defined milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resource allocations and measures of success.
  • Strategic Initiative Management: Partner closely with the Vice President of DEI to stand up new programs and initiatives, including cross-functional and externally facing projects. Develop the operational infrastructure necessary to move initiatives from initial concept through launch, implementation and evaluation.
  • Cross-Functional Departmental Coordination: Coordinate work across key departments such as the People Team, Newsroom, Audience Insights, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Procurement, Finance, Member Partnership and other teams. Establish clear roles and responsibilities and maintain communication throughout the lifecycle of an initiative.
  • External Partnership & Program Management: Support programs involving external organizations, universities, speakers, consultants, vendors and NPR Network partners. Coordinate partner communications, schedules, deliverables, agreements, logistics and follow-up necessary for successful execution. Serve as the central point of contact and operational advisor for Employee Resource Group (ERG) leaders, guiding them through charter development, strategic goal-setting, and budget reconciliation.
  • DEI Learning & Facilitation: Design, develop and facilitate DEI-specific learning experiences for employees, supervisors, executives and Network partners. Topics may include inclusive leadership, equitable feedback, navigating difference, psychological safety, accessibility, bias, organizational culture and other emerging workplace needs.
  • Convenings & Program Logistics: Operationalize large-scale programs, convenings and learning experiences by coordinating participant communications, agendas, speakers, facilities, technology, vendors, transportation, materials, registration and other logistical components.
  • Resource & Curriculum Development: Create practical resources, facilitator guides, trainings, toolkits, templates, and frameworks that translate DEIA principles into practices staff and leaders can apply.
  • Measurement & Continuous Improvement: Develop quantitative and qualitative measures of success for programs. Gather participant feedback, analyze outcomes, document lessons learned and recommend improvements for future iterations.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • DEIA Program Experience: At least 5+ years of demonstrated experience designing or implementing diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, organizational culture or employee-engagement initiatives.
  • Program and Project Management Experience: At least 5 years of experience developing, managing and executing complex programs, projects or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, timelines and deliverables.
  • Building Programs From the Ground Up: Demonstrated ability to take a new idea or strategic objective and build the operational structure required to launch it, including workplans, timelines, stakeholder roles, communications, logistics and evaluation.
  • Training Development and Facilitation: Demonstrated experience designing learning content and facilitating workshops, trainings or discussions for employees, managers or organizational leaders.
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Leadership: Experience coordinating projects across multiple departments or functions, driving progress when participants do not directly report to the project lead, and managing relationships with senior leaders, employees, external partners, vendors, and community stakeholders.
  • Complex Event or Convening Management: Experience planning and executing large-scale convenings, programs, events or multi-session initiatives involving internal and/or external stakeholders.
  • Operational Problem-Solving: Strong record of identifying potential barriers, dependencies and risks and developing practical solutions before they disrupt project delivery.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Operational Translation: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, strategic priorities into clear, sequenced operational steps and detailed project management plans. 
  • Inclusive Coaching: Strong skill in providing constructive coaching and guiding managers on how to cultivate psychological safety within their teams.
  • Empathy & Candor: Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven capacity to build strong, trusted relationships across diverse groups while ensuring accountability.
  • Data Literacy: Comfort collecting, synthesizing, and interpreting qualitative feedback (surveys, focus groups) and quantitative metrics to continually iterate and improve programs.
  • Organizational Navigation: Strong capability to manage administrative processes, budget tracking, and governance guidelines within structured systems.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Organizational Development, Social Sciences, Communications, or a related field, OR equivalent work experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location weekly. 

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $142,500 - $158,500 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.
