job.title: Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, Morning Edition & Up First
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour
  • Manage the editorial operation of the control room during the live broadcast
  • Coordinate with teams for live updates for later news feeds
  • Work directly with show hosts, guests and reporters to prep, record and edit live and taped interviews for the show and podcast on a tight deadline
  • Line edit various scripts for the live show while maintaining NPR’s editorial standards for all parts of the final product
  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated awareness of intersectional identities and ability to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Other duties as assigned

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3  years of experience managing direct reports in a newsroom or operation
  • At least 5  years of experience writing and editing broadcast journalism content
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily news journalism content for a national or international news organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with audio production and mixing techniques
  • Experience working in a live control room
  • Experience being the lead producer or editor for a radio or podcast show 
  • Experience editing news content for various platforms
  • Familiarity in another written language other than English, such as Spanish or Mandarin

EDUCATION REQUIREMENT

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, DC .

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Mastery in project management such as managing deadlines and time management
  • Expert knowledge and demonstrated skill in news-writing techniques for varied formats such as guest interviews, breaking news,  feature stories
  • Mastery in AP style writing and editing skill for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and experience in writing and editing news copy for varied platforms including broadcast, podcast, social, mobile, newsletters and other digital platforms, especially during breaking news situations
  • Proficiency in people management skills such as delivering constructive feedback, clear communication and conflict resolution.
  • Proficiency in independent, problem solving. 
  • Ability to adapt and accommodate differing styles of editorial workflows and communication.
  • Ability to negotiate and compromise.
  • Professional communication skills when representing the NPR organization.

job.title: Senior IT Security Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As our Senior Security Engineer, you will bridge the gap between traditional infrastructure security and modern DevSecOps. We are looking for a proactive security engineer to define secure-by-design frameworks, implement high-impact DevSecOps pipelines across multi-cloud environments (AWS and GCP), and lead critical security reviews for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.

Beyond technical mastery, you will act as a collaborative partner to our internal teams, fostering a culture of proactive security, cyber vigilance, and continuous improvement. If you thrive in rapidly evolving environments and have a passion for building secure, resilient ecosystems, this is your next challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Secure-by-Design Architecture: Implement, own, and champion secure-by-design frameworks across cloud, infrastructure, and application ecosystems, ensuring all system architectures address robust cybersecurity requirements.
  • Design & Integration Reviews: Review and approve security architecture designs for new internal systems, cloud platforms, and third-party integrations.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD Pipelines: Design, enable, and maintain automated security pipelines to proactively scan Git repositories, catching vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle.
  • Cloud Security Management: Manage security lifecycles within multi-cloud environments (primarily AWS and GCP) to ensure continuous compliance and threat mitigation.
  • Vulnerability Management: Own and run the end-to-end vulnerability management program, prioritizing remediation efforts across enterprise systems.
  • AI & Emerging Tech Security: Assess and secure emerging technologies, evaluating security-focused Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI workflows to keep NPR aligned with industry progressions.
  • Security Monitoring & SIEM: Leverage SIEM platforms (specifically Splunk) to develop advanced dashboards, write queries, and build automated reporting mechanisms for real-time threat intelligence.
  • Network & Endpoint Defense: Deploy, recommend, and test advanced security controls, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), enterprise-level antivirus, and perimeter security for Cisco networking devices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal NPR technology and business teams to address security gaps, resolve concerns, and provide subject matter expertise in ongoing cybersecurity meetings.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience in an information security, security engineering, or infrastructure security role.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in DevSecOps, secure software development, or automated CI/CD security pipeline integration.
  • Strong hands-on technical experience administering enterprise security tools, including SIEM (Splunk), EDR/anti-malware, and vulnerability management systems.
  • Proven experience securing multi-cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP) and a solid understanding of cloud security posture management.
  • Practical knowledge of core networking concepts and principles, including securing perimeter devices (such as Cisco hardware).
  • Demonstrated track record of cross-functional technical communication, documentation, and assisting development teams with security remediation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, or specialized cloud/DevSecOps credentials (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and network automation tools.
  • Practical experience implementing secure workflows for generative AI tools or LLMs.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Threat & Vulnerability Analysis: Analytical capability to interpret automated scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities, and formulate remediation plans.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Foundational competence in designing and securing cloud-native services and environments.
  • Automation & Scripting: Ability to write utility scripts (Python, Bash, etc.) to automate security checks or integrate tools.
  • SIEM Querying: Proficiency in building custom queries and alerts within SIEM platforms like Splunk.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Exceptional interpersonal and technical communication skills to bridge security policies with developer workflows.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Audience Development & Content Distribution
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and mission-aligned executive to serve as Senior Vice President (SVP), Audience Development & Content Distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), this executive will bridge enterprise editorial vision with multi-platform publishing, network syndication, and station distribution strategy. While our newsroom leadership focuses on the stories we tell, you will lead how, when, where, and to whom public media journalism is delivered and experienced across our nationwide network.

The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of executive media leadership, digital strategy, and network operations—scaling quality, editorial integrity, and audience reach by building a collaborative publishing framework that aligns, empowers, and coordinates NPR, Member stations, and affiliate partners. You will oversee enterprise content roadmaps and channel distribution strategies to maximize audience acquisition, reader/listener retention, and civic impact across owned properties, third-party platforms, and member newsrooms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Multi-Platform Distribution & Ecosystem Growth

  • Drive Enterprise Content Planning: Build and manage the enterprise-wide content roadmap, aligning daily news flow, major investigative series, podcasts, newsletters, and special projects across all publishing platforms to optimize newsroom capacity and audience engagement.
  • Execute Channel & Syndication Strategy: Oversee multi-platform distribution across owned digital properties (apps, web, newsletters) and third-party networks (search, social platforms, news aggregators, streaming platforms) while adapting to media consumption trends and algorithm shifts.
  • Lead Ecosystem Relationships: Build, maintain, and expand long-term executive relationships with publishers, digital-native media outlets, radio/TV syndicators, and non-profit journalism networks.
  • Optimize Audience Growth & Impact: Direct cross-functional initiatives with SEO, social media, and newsletter teams to boost discovery, retention, and measurable civic and journalistic impact.

Member Network Strategy

  • Architect Station Network Publishing: Design, govern, and scale the operational framework for network syndication, content sharing, joint reporting initiatives, and affiliate publishing across Member stations and affiliate newsrooms.
  • Cultivate Member Relationships: Serve as the central executive partner to station managers, news directors, and affiliate leaders, establishing partner advisory cadences and service standards that deliver maximum strategic value to Member stations.
  • Establish Impact & Performance Metrics: Partner with data and analytics teams to define network operational KPIs, content adoption metrics, and ROI frameworks, translating audience data into actionable strategic recommendations for editorial leadership.

Enterprise Infrastructure & Strategic Leadership

  • Modernize Publishing Workflows: Architect technology-enabled distribution workflows, enterprise CMS stacks, asset management repositories (DAM/MAM), and ethical AI tools designed for distributed network environments.
  • Manage Budget & Executive Alignment: Oversee the content operations and distribution budget, manage strategic resource allocation, and collaborate with Legal, Product, Tech, and Revenue leadership to preserve brand safety and organizational alignment.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media strategy, content operations, audience development, or network distribution—ideally within a major newsroom, public broadcasting network, or federated media alliance.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing complex editorial calendars, media partner relationships, and multi-channel digital distribution mechanics (SEO, news aggregators, newsletters, social platforms, and streaming syndication).
  • Proven experience designing, scaling, and managing complex affiliate syndication systems, content-sharing networks, or federated member-station alliances.
  • Executive-level familiarity with enterprise publishing architecture, distributed CMS stacks, media asset management systems (MAM/DAM), and workflow automation.
  • Exceptional executive presence with a track record of building consensus, inspiring collaboration, and aligning independent station partners and cross-functional leaders around shared strategic goals.
  • Strong operational budget management experience with familiarity with network economics, membership models, or syndication structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep operational understanding of public radio, member-station governance, and federated media fundraising/licensing models.
  • Direct experience evaluating and implementing ethical AI, automated distribution tools, or next-generation media delivery frameworks within distributed media environments.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strategic Publishing Vision: Ability to bridge high-level editorial vision with operational execution, aligning enterprise storytelling with multi-platform delivery mechanics.
  • Federated Stakeholder Diplomacy: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills to build trust, navigate federated governance structures, and align independent partners.
  • Data-Informed Editorial Judgment: Strong competency in translating quantitative audience analytics and qualitative metrics into strategic publishing decisions.
  • Executive Change Leadership: Proven capacity to guide teams through digital transformation, process modernization, and evolving media landscapes.
  • Mission-Driven Commitment: Passion for public-interest journalism, editorial integrity, and the vital role of news in a healthy democracy.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

Work Location & Requirements

NPR and SAG-AFTRA Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the Washington, D.C. office at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia.

Intro to Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), the Vice President of Talent Strategy serves as the principal architect, relationship builder, and strategic scout for creative, journalistic, and host talent across NPR. In this role, you will work side-by-side with the CCO and editorial leadership to align talent acquisition, career stewardship, and creator partnerships directly with NPR’s long-term multimedia vision.

You will nurture trusted relationships with our established roster of award-winning journalists, hosts, and commentators while proactively identifying, evaluating, and attracting emerging voices from independent media, podcasts, newsletters, and digital platforms. Serving as an executive bridge across Content, People, Legal, and Member station network, you will champion a collaborative environment where exceptional storytellers can thrive and expand public media's reach across platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Talent Scouting & Pipeline Development: Design and lead a comprehensive discovery strategy across traditional broadcast, podcasting, newsletter platforms, social ecosystems, and independent journalism to build an ongoing, diverse pipeline of on-air and digital talent.
  • Cross-Functional Mediation & Advocacy: Act as the central connective tissue between creative talent, talent representatives (agents, managers, attorneys), and internal executive teams (People Team, Legal, Marketing, and Operations) to align individual goals with organizational priorities.
  • Complex Contract Structuring & Negotiations: In close coordination with the CCO, Legal, and People teams, oversee talent agreement frameworks, leading contract renewals, compensation structures, and rights agreements with precision and diplomatic finesse.
  • Editorial Standards & Mission Alignment: Ensure all talent recruitment, onboarding, and partner strategies rigorously reflect NPR’s core mission, journalistic ethics, and commitment to public service.
  • Audience Forecasting & Metric Analysis: Partner with Content Insights and divisional leadership to evaluate audience consumption trends and identify future talent requirements across evolving media such as video, episodic audio, and experiential storytelling.
  • DEI Talent Initiatives: Systematically embed diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into every phase of talent identification, pipeline cultivation, and retention.

job.title: Helpdesk Support
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The IT Helpdesk role provides Level 1/2 end-user on-site and remote support to agency end users in a predominantly Mac OS environment in the country. This includes end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site. This role provides audio-visual support as needed for high-visibility meetings on-site, as well as advanced smart-hands support as needed to support other Omnicom IT centralized services. The role requires flexibility and adaptability to supporting multiple agencies in the region and supporting “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom support as needed.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device , and audio-visual support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides executive and VVIP support and audio visual (AV) support.
  • Provide quality assurance over any 3rd party IT services provided on-site.
  • Facilitate and coordinate site-specific activities (e.g., office moves, weekend power downs) as needed.
  • Support “ad-hoc” agency IT support as needed and directed by the IT Support Manager.
  • Works directly with internal and external 3rd party resources to ensure that end-user issues are resolved efficiently.
  • Manage the end-user experience delivered to agency end-users on-site and remote in the region.
  • Provide Level 1/2 end-user on-site support to agency end users, including troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting issues with desktop, laptop, mobile device, printer, and peripheral hardware and software.
  • Maintain rapport with agency end-users and be a go-to resource for IT troubleshooting.
  • Provide end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site, including setting up, configuring, and testing devices, applications, and network connectivity.
  • Engage IT Support Manager(s) as needed to identify systemic issues with end-user support.
  • Maintain asset inventory and track IT hardware in the region.
  • Follow Omnicom IT policies, procedures, and standards for end-user support and service delivery. And report any violations of Omnicom security policies to management.
  • Provide attended meeting support for high-visibility internal and external meetings.
  • Provide “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom IT support to agencies, while also documenting the support requirements for review as a consolidation opportunity for Omnicom IT centralized services.
  • Provide advanced smart-hands support on-site, supporting other Omnicom IT centralized services that may not have an on-site presence.
  • Support cross-functional IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, incident resolution and request fulfillment.
  • Use ServiceNow ITSM platform to receive and manage incident and request tickets, maintaining proper ticket management protocols such as detailed comments and close notes.
  • Manage assigned tickets to complete within service level criteria.
  • Participate / provide after-hours support and flexibility to travel as needed.

Individual must also maintain an extreme level of confidentiality in dealing with all information that flows through the office.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device, and audio-visual support.
  • Strong technical knowledge and skills in Mac OS

job.title: HR Shared Service Specialist Tier 1
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Reporting to the HR Shared Services Supervisors and/or Managers, HR Specialist I is responsible for processing routine transactions and responding to standard employee inquiries.

The HR Specialist I serves as the first point of contact for employees seeking HR support and plays a crucial role in maintaining the integrity of HR data and processes to address and triage inquiries.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Respond to employee inquiries promptly and accurately via the Service Now system, providing clear and concise information.
  • Escalate complex or specialized inquiries to the appropriate centralized specialist team for further resolution.
  • Process transactions related to employee personal data with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Manage the end-to-end process for contingent worker creation, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of HR policies and procedures to provide accurate guidance to employees.
  • Collaborate with HR team members to continuously improve the service delivery model and enhance the employee experience.
  • Document all inquiries and transactions accurately in the HR system to ensure reliable data for reporting and analysis.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Essential:

  • Up to 2 years of experience using HR systems for administration, HR Operations, case management, or similar responsibilities.
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to handle inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Proficiency in using HR Information Systems and case management tools.
  • Excellent data entry skills with a focus on accuracy and speed.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with HR processes and best practices, particularly within a shared services context.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills, including English language skills.

Desirable:

  • Experience in a shared service center or customer support role, preferably within an HR function.
  • Effective problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Good communication skills, capable of explaining HR processes and policies clearly to employees.
  • A team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues.
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and processes within the HR field.

job.title: L&D Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Learning & Development (L&D) Coordinator supports the planning and day-to-day delivery of learning programs. Working under the guidance of the ONWARD Connected Lead and program managers, this role helps keep timelines, participant communications, enrollment details, logistics, records, and follow-up activities organized and on track.

The L&D Coordinator partners with subject matter experts (SMEs), facilitators, Learning Operations, Learning Communications, Learning Impact, Connected Capabilities Leads, Learning & Performance Business Partners (LPBPs), HR Business Partners (HRBPs), and external vendors. The role is suited to an early-career professional who is organized, service-minded, eager to learn, and ready to build program coordination skills while contributing to a positive participant experience.

This is for UK Shift. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Help maintain program calendars, workplans, schedules, task trackers, and key deadlines; update them as plans change.
  • Gather planning information from program leads, SMEs, facilitators, Learning Operations, and other partners, and keep shared materials current.
  • Coordinate routine details across program activities such as marketing, nominations, preparation, delivery, evaluation, and follow-up.

Nominations & Participant Administration

  • Support nomination and enrollment activities using established criteria, processes, forms, and timelines, in partnership with Learning Business Partners.
  • Maintain participant lists, registration status, waitlists, and alumni records, checking information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare participant rosters and provide enrollment details to Learning Operations and other partners as requested.
  • Track participation changes or gaps and bring them to the program lead's attention for review and follow-up.

Participant Communications & Support

  • Prepare and send routine participant communications using approved templates and guidance, including invitations, welcome information, reminders, logistics, and follow-up resources.
  • Help keep communication plans, templates, FAQs, and send dates organized and up to date.
  • Monitor program inboxes or communication channels; respond to routine questions using approved information and route complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate partner.
  • Provide timely, courteous support and help participants understand where to find program information and materials.

Digital & On-Demand Program Support

  • Responsible for LMS setup and enrollment following established processes.
  • Check that program information such as descriptions, dates, links, prerequisites, and instructions matches the approved source materials.
  • Use available reports to track enrollment, progress, and completion; send reminders according to the program plan and share potential concerns with the program lead.
  • Record access or technical issues and route them to Learning Operations or the appropriate support contact.

Program Logistics & Delivery

  • Use program checklists to help prepare virtual sessions, including meeting links, platform settings, breakout rooms, recordings, and technology checks.
  • Coordinate in-person logistics such as room arrangements, audiovisual needs, materials, and onsite details with the relevant partners.
  • Organize and distribute agendas, participant materials, facilitator resources, and other approved program content.
  • Support session-day operations, maintain attendance records, and share required information with Learning Operations for tracking and reporting.
  • Help identify logistical gaps early and bring them to the program lead's attention.

Evaluation, Reporting & Follow-Up

  • Help prepare and distribute program evaluations, surveys, and pulse checks; monitor responses and send planned reminders.
  • Compile attendance, enrollment, completion, and evaluation information in established trackers or templates.
  • Prepare basic status updates and summaries for review by the program lead; flag notable feedback, recurring questions, or participation issues.
  • Keep follow-up tasks and resource distribution organized after program sessions.

Documentation & Process Support

  • Maintain shared program files, calendars, participant records, and materials so information is current, easy to find, and appropriately organized.
  • Follow established version-control, privacy, data-handling, and governance practices when working with program materials and participant information.
  • Update FAQs, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other program documentation as directed.
  • Share practical ideas with the team for making recurring coordination tasks clearer, more consistent, or more efficient

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Learning & Development.
  • Organization & attention to detail: Keeps information accurate and follows through on assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Clear communication: Writes and speaks courteously, shares updates, and asks questions when expectations are unclear.
  • Service mindset: Responds helpfully to participant and stakeholder needs and knows when to seek support.
  • Teamwork & learning agility: Collaborates well, accepts feedback, and builds knowledge of learning program operations over time.
  • Coordination & prioritization: Tracks multiple tasks, adapts to changing details, and raises capacity or timing concerns early.
  • Problem solving & judgment: Notices issues, gathers relevant details, and escalates appropriately rather than making unsupported decisions.
  • Comfort with digital tools: Willingness to learn collaboration, scheduling, learning-management, and survey tools used by the team.

job.title: 403(g) Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

In This Role You'll:


Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Maintenance Technician responsible for maintenance and support of production and broadcast systems for the CBS Network and affiliated production units, providing critical 24x7 support for on-air and production infrastructure. This role covers hands-on troubleshooting and repair of routing systems, audio/video transport and IP media infrastructure (SDI and SMPTE 2110), production switchers, audio consoles, media file transfer and storage systems, video acquisition and playback servers, non-linear postproduction systems, production intercom, cameras, prompters, and other studio production systems, working to mitigate impact to production and on-air deadlines. This is a shift-based role covering rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays, with on-call/callback responsibilities per the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

 

•    3+ years' experience working with professional television broadcast equipment, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot to the component/system level under time pressure, in a live production environment.
•    Hands-on experience with broadcast test equipment (waveform monitors, vector-scopes, audio analyzers, cable/fiber test sets) and cable/fiber termination and testing.
•    In-depth knowledge in of the following: Video, Audio, Cameras, Control/Data Systems, RF, Fiber-Optics, and IP media distribution (SMPTE 2110/2059).
•    Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals — VLANs, subnetting, multicast, and basic switch/router configuration — sufficient to troubleshoot IP-based media infrastructure.
•    Strong understanding of broadcast media systems design and signal flow; ability to read and work from schematics and as-built documentation.
•    Experience with Windows, Linux, and macOS workstation/server environments as used in broadcast and postproduction facilities.
•    Ability to communicate technical root-cause and status updates clearly to non-technical production staff (directors, TDs, producers) during live troubleshooting.
•    Ability to perform physical work associated with rack and machine room environments, including lifting equipment and working in confined or elevated spaces.

 

Bonus Skills:

 

•    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Engineering, or IT preferred.
•    Direct experience with SMPTE ST 2110 (2110-20/30/40) and ST 2059 PTP timing in a production environment.
•    Scripting/automation experience (Python, JSON) for diagnostics, monitoring, or system integration.
•    Experience with virtualized and cloud-based media systems, including container management.
•    Familiarity with NMOS control/discovery frameworks in an IP media environment.
•    Familiarity with Evertz, Grass Valley routing systems; RTS intercom, Sony switchers and cameras, EVS, Grass Valley AMPP video playout/record servers a plus.

 

 

#LI-TG1

This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
WUPA is the CBS owned-and-operated station in Atlanta, Georgia, together with Paramount+ and the full CBS Stations portfolio, we give advertisers something rare: reach that spans every screen, every daypart, and every device.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who is capable of doing it all – someone who has spent time in local TV, knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.

 

As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint – with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.

 

You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will be held to results. When you sell CBS, you sell trust. When you sell Paramount, you sell reach. Together, that's a competitive advantage that belongs to you.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.•    Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Go multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build, don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Think like a strategist. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business objectives, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. 
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, to deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent WUPA-TV at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable track record of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger — you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid Drivers License

 

Preferred:

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with WideOrbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.

 

This position is eligible to participate in the sales incentive bonus plan.

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV and Simon & Schuster, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

Role Details
The Convergent Account Executive owns the full advertising relationship across both linear and streaming for their assigned clients — spanning Broadcast dayparts (Prime, News, Late Night and Daytime), Cable Networks, and the full Streaming/CTV portfolio, including programmatic and direct IO (DIO) channels. This includes regular scheduled programming as well as specials (e.g., The VMAs, Golden Globes, AMAs) and sponsorship/integration opportunities. The Convergent AE is the single point of accountability for delivering unified, cross-platform (“360”) solutions, working in tandem with specialty, programmatic, and AM partners to maximize revenue across the entire Paramount portfolio. This position sets its own sales agenda and is responsible for growing and maintaining a book of business across both linear and streaming properties. 

 

Your Day-to-Day
Account & Revenue Management:

  • Manage a robust account list spanning multiple industries across both linear and streaming platforms
  • Develop and execute account strategies for long-term development and revenue growth across the full portfolio
  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
  • Generate new sales leads and proactively uncover new linear and streaming sales opportunities
  • Manage a programmatic and direct sales pipeline — including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, and reporting

 

Client Strategy & Consultative Selling:

  • Act as a business specialist and trusted advisor on behalf of clients — strategically developing broadcast, streaming, and mixed-media solutions to suit their objectives
  • Establish and cultivate client relationships through a high volume of face-to-face calls
  • Bring proactive, consultative solutions to clients by leveraging Paramount's full sales product suite and delivering strategic insights through QBRs
  • Serve as the key point of contact internally and externally, prioritizing and leading accurate account management across teams

 

Cross-Platform Collaboration:

  • Collaborate across cable, broadcast, sports, and streaming/programmatic teams to generate revenue and deliver holistic client solutions
  • Collaborate with centers of excellence to develop strategic roadmaps and drive revenue across the full portfolio
  • Work in tandem with digital, programmatic, and specialty counterparts to ensure a seamless 360 client experience

 

Programmatic & Marketplace Expertise:

  • Confidently lead conversations about the programmatic landscape (SSP/DSP marketplaces) and direct 1:1 advertiser/agency strategies
  • Sell CTV, sponsorships, and tentpoles across the full streaming ecosystem, leveraging both DIO and programmatic channels
  • Stay ahead of the curve on marketplace trends relating to clients as well as the broader linear and digital advertising industry, actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications
  • Establish oneself as a thought leader across the broadcast and streaming community, evangelizing Paramount's unique cross-platform positioning

 

Leadership & Team Development:

  • Partner with AM Management to mentor AM sales partners, ensuring best-in-class client servicing pre- and post-sale, including deal set-up, deal management, and post-campaign QBRs
  • Collaborate with AM Management to provide assigned AMs with clear day-to-day direction, real-time feedback, and development support to foster team growth, motivation, and performance

 

Qualifications
What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales experience spanning linear and/or streaming/programmatic, with direct experience in programmatic roles at publishers, ad tech firms, or platform companies preferred
  • Sales professional with an entrepreneurial spirit who thrives in a team, goal-oriented environment
  • Strong desire to win and grow as a cross-platform (linear and streaming) ad sales professional
  • Proven capability to sell across the full advertising ecosystem — broadcast, cable, CTV, sponsorships, and tentpoles
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and organizational skills
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate command of the business, offerings, and client needs
  • Ability to manage stress and balance multiple account priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • High initiative, problem-solving ability, agility, and a growth mindset
  • Must be extremely detail oriented
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite, G Suite, and Salesforce; ability to learn proprietary systems for revenue / inventory management.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience

 

About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Hiring Salary Range: $88,500.00 - 165,600.00. 

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation, or a range thereof, for roles where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.
This position is eligible to earn sales incentive compensation.

  • Generous paid time off.

  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 


Paramount Advertising is seeking a highly motivated, consultative sales professional to drive growth across Paramount’s vast portfolio through the integration of streaming, programmatic, advanced advertising, data, and convergent media solutions. The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of today’s evolving media landscape and excels at translating Paramount’s full range of capabilities into integrated solutions that deliver against advertisers’ business objectives—moving beyond traditional demo guarantees and delivery metrics.


As an Account Executive on the Advanced Advertising Team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to agencies and advertisers, helping them navigate and capitalize on the convergence of linear TV, streaming, digital video, programmatic, and data-driven advertising. You will leverage Paramount’s suite of audience, identity, optimization, attribution, measurement, programmatic, and advanced advertising solutions to develop holistic, outcome-oriented media strategies.


The ideal candidate understands how programmatic buying and activation intersect with premium streaming and traditional television, and can articulate the value of bringing these channels together through a unified approach. You will be expected to identify opportunities to expand relationships, drive incremental revenue, and position Paramount as a leading partner for clients seeking greater scale, precision, flexibility, and measurable business outcomes across the entire video ecosystem.


Success in this role requires a balance of revenue generation, executive presence, convergent selling expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with agency investment and strategy teams, programmatic and digital leads, data and analytics partners, and Paramount’s broader sales organization to develop integrated solutions and unlock new sources of growth.


You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, are comfortable selling complex technology and data-enabled solutions, and can move fluidly between high-level business strategy and the details of media activation. You are equally effective influencing senior clients, educating agencies on emerging capabilities, partnering across internal teams, and turning sophisticated media solutions into measurable business results.

 

Results Driven 

  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis.
  • Proven capability to sell data-driven and optimized executions across linear and streaming.
  • Manage a Hold Co aligned Advanced Advertising sales pipeline—including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, reporting and long-term revenue growth.
  •  Identify and cultivate new Advanced Advertising opportunities across existing and prospective clients.
  • Leverage campaign performance, audience insights, and measurement outputs to uncover incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with internal stakeholders and clients by conducting a high volume of face-to-face calls.

 

A Consultative Sales Executive

  • Collaborate across platforms within your Hold Co (including linear, streaming, and sports) to generate revenue across the Paramount portfolio product suite to deliver holistic client solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for both clients and internal counterparts.
  • Develop and present data-driven recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and return on advertising investment.

 

Multi-platform Proficient

  • Understand the complementary value and nuance of representing all platforms and buy types, including programmatic, across a portfolio to execute a unified advertising strategy. 
  • Stay ahead of industry trends by actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications.
  • Confidently articulate the role of audience-first planning, cross-platform activation, and performance measurement in today's fragmented media landscape.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the Advanced Advertising ecosystem and competitive marketplace.

 

A Leader by Example

  • In partnership with AA Management, work closely with and mentor your Account Manager(s) to develop into future sales leaders
  • Create meaningful opportunities for Account Managers to participate in client-facing sales efforts and strategic conversations.
  • Deliver best-in-class client service throughout the campaign lifecycle, including onboarding, stewardship, optimization recommendations, and post-campaign reporting.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Planning, Data Solutions, Measurement, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to deliver seamless client experiences.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales or agency experience, with a demonstrated understanding of how data flows throughout the ecosystem, and is applied in planning, execution, and measurement

 

Additional Qualifications: 

  • Strong relationship building skills and a collaborative nature.
  • High initiative, problem solving, adaptability and a growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex technical and data concepts into compelling client narratives.
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate a command of our business, offerings and client needs.
  •  Ability to manage stress well, and balance multiple priorities at once.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience.

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Overview

The Account Manager (AM) is a developmental sales-focused role tasked with supporting day-to-day revenue efforts while developing the skills and experience needed to become a future Account Executive. This role touches all facets of the sales process—from proposal development and client support to campaign execution and stewardship—while partnering closely with Account Executives and internal teams. This is a position designed for high-potential candidates who want to learn the business, build selling skills, and grow into a full-cycle seller with direct ownership of accounts and revenue.

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to support active accounts, proposals, and revenue opportunities
  • Assist in selling streaming campaigns, with the opportunity to include linear inventory for cross-platform packages
  • Participate in sales calls (virtual and in-person) to gain exposure to client conversations, needs discovery, and selling strategies
  • Support, develop, and cultivate new business and smaller account opportunities as part of the broader AE pipeline
  • Coordinate campaign execution from pre-sale through post-sale, ensuring flawless delivery and stewardship
  • Prepare and update stewardship reports for guaranteed and non-guaranteed campaigns
  • Serve as a client support resource for inbound questions and requests
  • Work with Marketing, Research, Pricing & Inventory (Yield), and Operations teams to develop tailored sales presentations and solutions
  • Project-manage all elements needed for campaign launch, including creative assets, tags, approvals, and timelines

  • Build foundational selling skills, including proposal development, account support, pricing concepts, and inventory management
  • Learn media planning fundamentals and the end-to-end advertising sales lifecycle
  • Gain exposure to the systems, processes, and tools critical to future Account Executive success

 

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in digital advertising, media, or sales support (Digital Ad Sales, planning, buying, or agency experience preferred)

Additional Qualifications

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, team-oriented sales environment

job.title: Analyst, Strategy and Insights
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Come join the Strategy and Insights team at Paramount Pictures and be part of a dynamic group who work across the entire lifecycle of the theatrical movie experience! Unlike traditional marketing, our insights team is involved from concept to release, ensuring the consumer’s voice is at the heart of every decision from brand development to fan engagement, to the actual movie in its final editorial stage, to identifying messaging for creative marketing materials that truly resonate. The Insights team drives impactful, data-driven decisions through audience surveys, focus groups, ethnographies, and screenings. Our global insights inform production and tailor marketing campaigns that excite moviegoers worldwide. This is an onsite hourly based full-time role requiring (5) days in office based out of the Paramount Pictures Studio Lot. 


This role works collaboratively to support the entire department. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver tangible value to a wide range of creative stakeholders and collaborators across the studio.


Responsibilities Overview
We're looking for a curious, driven individual with a love of movies and an aptitude for business strategy, psychology, sociology, and/or storytelling to join our team. If you're a natural problem-solver who thrives on understanding people and uncovering the ''why'' behind their behaviors, we want you. The ideal candidate is not only analytical and skilled at working with large datasets, but also a good communicator who loves translating insights into actionable strategies creative people can understand. If you’re excited by the idea of diving deep into consumer behavior, market trends, and how movie content connects with worldwide audiences –this is the role for you!
The Analyst, Strategy and Insights will support the wider team in the design, execution, analysis and presentation of research projects to provide insights and recommendations to the Theatrical Marketing and Development teams.

 


Responsibilities Include:
- Support the team at all stages of research projects 
- Analyze large amounts of quantitative and qualitative data and turn data into actionable, story-driven insights
- Create visual documents which communicate research findings and data dynamically and succinctly
- Evaluating each motion picture’s target audience and potential opportunities and challenges
- Provide back-up support to the administrative roles within the department as needed, which may include:  
- Assisting in scheduling and coordinating meetings for the team’s global calendar 
- Performing administrative duties and creating, maintaining and organizing documents 
- Maintain reporting databases critical to the department 
- Desk research
- Be a vocal and active contributor to brainstorming sessions / meetings
- Be excited by movies and in tune with current releases

 

Basic Qualifications and Skills
• BA or BS with a track record of high achievement
• High comfort level with analyzing and synthesizing quantitative information
• 3-5 years of professional work experience in insights/research or strategy 
• Strong proficiency in Excel, including expertise in data manipulation using formulas, filters, formatting, and advanced functions
• Knowledge of movies and passion for entertainment
• Excellent visual communication skills (high PowerPoint proficiency required)
• Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy
• Highly organized with the ability to work under pressure and handle multiple projects
• Strong professional writing ability
• Team player

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

You’ll own global DTC subscriber forecasts, using models built by the data science team to inform important business decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand the business, build data pipelines upstream and downstream of models, and diagnose variance against forecasts. Success requires close attention to detail, clear and influential communication, and ownership in a fast moving environment.     Responsibilities
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand their needs and the DTC business.
  • Collaborate with data science to understand forecasting models and with data engineering to understand the data underlying models and forecasts.
  • Create global DTC subscriber forecasts for regular business processes and strategic requests as they arise.
  • Build data pipelines upstream and downstream of forecasting models, including forecast reporting pipelines.
  • Diagnose variance against forecasts and communicate findings clearly, concisely, and convincingly to stakeholders.
  • Partner with dashboard engineers to build and improve the forecast dashboarding environment for stakeholders and practitioners.
  • Estimate the effects of important business decisions through subscriber forecasting.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, data science, or analytics.
  • Ability to break complex problems into simple, coherent solutions.
  • Extensive experience writing robust Python and SQL as part of a team.
  • Robust attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate concisely and persuasively with nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Successful completion of a background check.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Experience integrating AI solutions into existing business processes.
  • Experience with media or subscription businesses.
  • Experience using Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, ML Engine, and APIs.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms.


Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.
We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.
•    Multi-Platform Content Generation: Actively write, produce, and adapt sports content tailored specifically for linear TV, CBS News Chicago Streaming, CBSChicago.com, and key social platforms (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube).
•    Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
•    Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
•    Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
•    Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
•    Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Experience: Proven experience as a Sports Anchor/Reporter in a major market (Top 10 preferred), with a demonstrated track record of success across linear and digital platforms.
•    Modern Journalism Mindset: Strong understanding of how sports consumption habits are shifting and a passion for experimenting with new digital, streaming, and social storytelling formats.
•    On-Air & On-Screen Presence: Commanding, authentic, and versatile presentation style suited for linear studio anchoring, streaming coverage, and digital video content.
•    Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of Chicago and national sports—including professional leagues, regional college athletics, and high school sports culture.
•    Writing Excellence: Superior writing skills with the ability to adjust tone and format effectively for linear television, digital articles, streaming scripts, and social copy.
•    Collaboration & Adaptability: Ability to thrive under live pressure, multi-task, and collaborate seamlessly with newsroom producers, digital team members, photojournalists, and editors.
•    Schedule Flexibility: Willingness and availability to work a flexible schedule that regularly includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and travel for major sports coverage.
•    This is a SAG/AFTRA position

This role will have a special emphasis around the CBS News Atlanta streaming platform.

 

 

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

· Collaborate closely with all members of the team, including station attorneys and CBS Standards, to develop ethical and balanced reporting.

· Protect the culture by seeking out and including perspectives from all corners of the newsroom.

· Conduct regular check-ins with members of the team and offer feedback and mentoring.

 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

· 6+ years in local news management and 2+ years in a major market required

· Bachelor’s degree in journalism required

· Knowledge of Atlanta DMA is strongly preferred

 

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

· Must be willing to work on weekends, holidays and overnight hours as needed

· Must have deep knowledge of all functions of the news operation in order to effectively “pull the levers” to ensure content/shows are crafted to the highest standards and efficiency

· Must embrace an “always on” mentality, willing to take calls, answer emails and troubleshoot newsroom issues 24/7

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021.
