As part of our broader Consumer Products legal team, this attorney role provides strategic legal counsel and services to support Paramount Global Publishing’s mission to deliver diverse, high-quality storytelling across print, digital, and audio platforms. The position focuses on enabling content that spans multiple genres and engages audiences of all ages—from children and families to adult readers.

 

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a strategic legal business partner to the Paramount Publishing team, supporting the launch and ongoing operations of a new publishing imprint developing franchise‑based and original literary IP.
  • Negotiate, draft, and review a broad range of publishing agreements, including rights acquisitions, author and illustrator agreements, collaborations and co‑author agreements, adaptations, inbound and outbound licensing agreements, distribution agreements, and vendor/production services agreements.
  • Advise on intellectual property matters related to publishing, including copyright ownership, rights, chain‑of‑title, derivative works, and exploitation across formats and platforms.
  • Initiate and support complex rights negotiations to unlock frozen and/or restricted rights.
  • Support publishing initiatives inspired by Paramount’s iconic brands and franchises, ensuring alignment with franchise management, brand protection and long‑term IP strategy.
  • Provide legal guidance on royalty structures, profit participation, accounting provisions, audit rights, advances and recoupment models customary in the book and digital publishing industries.
  • Collaborate closely with Consumer Products, Franchise, Marketing, Labor Relations and Business Affairs teams to enable timely development, launch and commercialization of publishing projects.
  • Identify and manage legal risks associated with publishing, manufacturing and distributing content, including defamation, privacy, publicity rights, trademark usage and fair use issues.
  • Oversee and coordinate with outside counsel as needed on specialized publishing or IP matters while maintaining internal ownership of core legal strategy.
  • Support the development and maintenance of legal templates, deal forms and best practices to enable efficient growth of the publishing business.

 

 Basic Qualifications:

job.title: Data Engineering Lead
job.description:
Is this role for you?

You’ll build and lead the data engineering capability for 5 Streaming in-house. You’ll own the pipelines, data models and quality controls that join streaming, advertising, marketing and registration data into a single trusted view of content and audience performance.

 

What you will be doing?

 

  • Own the design, build and operation of the data pipelines and data models that power all streaming reporting, dashboards and analysis.
  • Establish a single joined view of content and audience performance, by creating a common identity and content spine across behavioural, advertising, marketing and registration data.
  • Own the definition and reconciliation of core streaming metrics and codify the business logic across business systems.
  • Own analytics implementation and tagging governance across all streaming platforms. You’ll cover technical specification creation, naming standards and defect prioritisation, working closely with product, technology and QA teams.
  • Establish data quality monitoring, alerting and scorecards across all streaming data sources, with defined thresholds, clear ownership and escalation routes.
  • Establish an experimentation capability, providing templated test setup, instrumentation standards and analysis patterns so that product and marketing teams can run and interpret tests autonomously.
  • Build in-house data modelling capacity for churn prediction, reactivation, ad targeting, segmentation and personalisation.
  • Own the technical data roadmap, identifying AI and automation opportunities to improve the accuracy, timeliness and cost of the data stack.
  • Work alongside Skydance data teams as their technical data counterpart, and provide technical direction to the analytics team.
  • Own data governance for streaming datasets, working closely with the privacy and information security teams so that compliance is built into every data workflow.


What are we looking for?

 

Essential

  • Senior level experience in data engineering, including time as the sole or lead technical owner of a data platform, with hands-on delivery alongside roadmap ownership, vendor management and the ability to translate technical constraints for commercial, marketing and editorial stakeholders.
  • Expert SQL and Python, with production experience designing, building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines at scale.
  • Deep hands-on experience of a modern cloud data warehouse and its associated transformation and orchestration tooling.
  • Strong working knowledge of digital and product analytics platforms, including event tracking implementation across web, mobile and connected TV.
  • Demonstrable experience joining behavioural, advertising and CRM datasets, and resolving identity and metric definitions across sources that count users differently.
  • Track record of establishing data quality monitoring, governance and trusted metric definitions in an environment where none previously existed.
  • Practical knowledge of A/B testing methodology and statistical analysis, with experience building experimentation capability for non-technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Background in streaming, broadcast or media, with a working understanding of streaming and commercial performance metrics.
  • Experience of advertising, attribution and quality-of-experience platforms.
  • Experience applying machine learning to churn, propensity, segmentation or recommendation problems.
  • Experience applying AI tooling to data engineering, reporting or forecasting workflows.
  • Experience of in-housing previously outsourced capability, and of working alongside central data functions within a large group organisation.

#LI-RE1

 

Channel 5 is an award-winning public service broadcaster and the UK's third latest commercial TV station,  reaching 3 in 4 of the UK viewing public each month. The channel has a diverse schedule of original programmes across genres including issue-led documentaries,  popular factual,  accessible history,  stunning natural history,  inclusive entertainment and reality,  top level sport,  high quality scripted programming,  headline-grabbing current affairs and critically acclaimed children's and news programming. Sr. Data Engineering Manager


The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, delivery, and operational excellence of large-scale batch and real-time data platforms. This role will oversee high-performance data engineering teams that power analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization. You will guide the design and execution of distributed data systems. This includes ETL and ELT pipelines. It also includes streaming platforms, warehouse ecosystems, and cloud-native infrastructure. As a manager, you will shape technical direction, develop engineering talent, and ensure production-grade reliability, scalability, and operational rigor across data platforms.

This role requires expertise in modern data architectures and distributed systems. You should also have knowledge of cloud-native engineering. It is essential to have proven experience in leading high-performing engineering teams. 


Key Responsibilities


Lead & Scale Data Engineering Teams
● Manage and develop a team of data engineers responsible for batch and streaming data systems.
● Drive technical execution across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and serving layers.
● Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and architectural review processes.
● Mentor engineers in distributed systems design, performance optimization, and production reliability.


Architect Scalable Data Platforms
● Ensure scalable data modeling standards and efficient query performance across analytical workloads.
● Guide decisions about architecture. This includes orchestration and schema evolution. It also covers partitioning strategies and storage optimization. 
● Partner with streaming engineers to align batch and real-time data patterns into cohesive platform designs. 


Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner closely with Data Product Management to align roadmap priorities, SLAs, and platform KPIs.
● Collaborate with software engineers to integrate streaming systems, APIs, and microservices into the broader data ecosystem.
● Clearly communicate architectural tradeoffs to stakeholders. Share delivery risks and operational constraints as well. 


Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural reviews and drive long-term platform strategy.
● Foster a culture of ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.

 


Required Skills & Experience


Modern Data Architecture
● Strong expertise in data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
● Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, orchestration platforms, and distributed data processing systems.
● Solid understanding of Kafka-based architectures and event-driven data patterns.

 

Team Development & Coaching
● Proven experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining high-performing engineers across varying seniority levels.
● Commitment to building an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team culture.

 

Execution & Delivery Leadership
● Strong sprint planning, capacity modeling, and roadmap sequencing skills.
● Ability to manage competing priorities across reliability, feature delivery, and technical debt reduction.
● Experience establishing engineering KPIs such as reliability, latency, throughput, and deployment frequency.

 


Qualifications


● Proven experience leading engineering teams delivering large-scale production data platforms.
● Strong foundation in distributed systems engineering and cloud-native architecture.
● You should have great communication skills. You also need to collaborate with different teams. 
● You should be self-motivated. Focus on quality. A commitment to engineering excellence and operational discipline is essential.

The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Organizations that wish to receive job vacancy notices from this posting’s television station should contact sf_recruitingsupport@paramount.com.

This role is responsible for overseeing local digital breaking news coverage, writing and editing stories across a wide range of topics, clipping and optimizing video on CBSNews.com and on YouTube, and executing on growth initiatives across platforms.

We are looking for someone with strong news judgment who can write and edit clear, accurate, fact-driven copy and craft compelling headlines on deadline in a fast-paced environment. Scrupulous attention to detail, a cool head under pressure, and excellent communication skills are essential.

 

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage the WJZ homepage to present the best of the journalism we produce
  • Work with reporters and producers to publish the best of WJZ to our website
  • Proactively plan content around key news events and tentpoles
  • Track content performance and share content insights across WJZ to help inform story selection across platforms
  • Send push alerts on breaking news, weather and other high-interest stories

  • You are a skilled writer who can produce quality copy on deadline

job.description:

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

CBS News 24/7, the digital streaming operation from CBS News is looking for a San Francisco based freelance AR/VR ELC Director.

The ideal candidate is a great communicator, has current experience directing in active breaking news environments, has strong organizational skills and can break out of the mold of a coded newscast and pivot to breaking news when the moment happens. 

 

As an ELC director you’ll be working with show producers creating dynamic visual newscasts in a virtual space You’ll be verbally calling the shots as the anchor works the virtual studio environment with the jib camera following along as you trigger augmented reality objects to help enhance the storytelling. 

 

The Gear:

Zero Density Virtual Production 

Sony ELC Automation

Sony XVS Switchers

Chyron Prime / ISQ 

Calrec Audio

Studio Jibs

 

Job Function:

The main responsibility is to provide leadership in and out of the control room fulfilling production needs as assigned. You’ll works with the 24/7 editorial and production teams to execute an error-free production in an ELC automated control room environment. Director’s code their assigned newscast and run through portions of the show with crew and talent before going to air to help ensure a crisp production is delivered.  A successful candidate must have sound technical skills, collaborate before each show with producer and jib operator to ensure smart, effective use of virtual studio space and bring a “can-do” approach to problem solving in a fast-paced, high-energy environment. 

 

Candidate must be willing to work a flexible work schedule that may include early mornings and holidays. You must be open to implementing new technologies and/or methods to accomplish future assignments. 

  

Required:

  • Demonstrated experience in live news production is required.
  • Previous Control Room Automation use is desired, Sony ELC experience is preferred.
  • Knowledge of iNews preferred.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Must be a self-starter with excellent organizational skills.
  • Strong work ethic, positive attitude & leadership qualities with the ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities a must. 
  • Excellent people and communication skills needed.
  • Good conflict resolution and problem-solving skills are a must.

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Director, Acquisitions (Paramount Pics)
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

If you thrive at the intersection of dealmaking, financial analysis, and creative judgment, this role is for you. We’re hiring a Director, Acquisitions to help shape Paramount Picture’s film slate. This role sits at the center of the studio’s acquisitions strategy, structuring and negotiating deals while partnering closely with finance and legal to evaluate opportunities across the global marketplace. You’ll build deep familiarity with the studio’s output and licensing deals, and use that knowledge to identify commercial opportunities that align with our broader strategy.   You will be the studio’s presence at major festivals and markets, including Sundance, Cannes, TIFF, and AFM, leading internal prep, briefing the EVP, and representing Paramount directly in conversations with filmmakers, producers, and sales agents. Beyond the deal, you’ll stay involved through post-production, offering creative feedback on cuts, and you’ll drive cross-departmental coordination through mastering, marketing, distribution, and publicity to ensure a successful launch.   This role requires someone who can move fluidly between financial rigor and creative instinct, with the relationships and market fluency to spot opportunities.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Structure, negotiate, and execute acquisitions deals, utilizing financial analysis and strategic insight in partnership with finance and legal teams
  • Lead financial evaluation of acquisition opportunities, partnering with finance to build and analyze P&L models to inform valuation and overall deal strategy
  • Maintain deep familiarity with the studio’s global output and licensing deals and leveraging them effectively in the evaluation of acquisition opportunities worldwide
  • Lead sourcing, tracking, and evaluation of packages across the global marketplace, identifying commercial opportunities aligned with the overall acquisition strategy
  • Maintain and cultivate strong relationships across agencies, financiers, filmmakers, producers, and international sales companies to gain access to high-level acquisition opportunities
  • Lead internal preparation for major film festivals and markets (e.g., Sundance, Cannes, TIFF, AFM), including identifying priority titles, coordinating team coverage, and preparing the EVP with relevant materials and market intelligence to align internal stakeholders around acquisition targets
  • Represent the studio in market-facing conversations at festivals and markets, attending screenings and meetings with filmmakers, producers, and sales agents to evaluate opportunities and communicate the studio’s acquisition priorities
  • Provide strategic guidance and creative feedback to filmmakers and producers on acquired projects, including reviewing cuts during post-production and collaborating with creative stakeholders to help shape the final film
  • Maintain deep familiarity with the domestic and international sales landscape, sourcing market intelligence on upcoming projects and monitoring buyer sentiment
  • Oversee the lifecycle of acquired titles from acquisition through release, driving cross-departmental coordination across mastering, marketing, distribution, publicity, and legal to ensure timely delivery, optimal windowing strategy, and successful launch
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in film, Business, Media, or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience in film acquisitions, distribution, or sales, preferably with a major studio or agency

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling literacy, with the ability to interpret P&L projections and apply financial insights to acquisition decision-making
  • Established industry relationships across the creative and sales communities
  • Strong understanding of the global film marketplace and distribution landscape
  • Proven ability to evaluate material, talent packages, and market dynamics through both a creative and commercial lens
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with senior leadership as well as external partners

 


Founded in 1912, Paramount Pictures works with talented filmmakers to produce and distribute entertainment around the world. The film studio’s iconic logo has opened some of the most successful and beloved films in cinematic history, including timeless classics such as The Godfather, Chinatown, Forrest Gump and Titanic; and blockbuster franchises such as Star Trek, Transformers, Mission: Impossible and Sonic the Hedgehog. Recent, innovative, break-out films such as The Wolf of Wall Street, Arrival, Rocketman, and A Quiet Place have added to Paramount’s film legacy. With a beautiful 65-acre lot in the heart of Hollywood, a worldwide network of offices and a culture of engagement, Paramount Pictures’ passionate employees ensure the studio continues to deliver creativity and innovation to a dynamic industry. Paramount Pictures controls a collection of some of the most powerful brands in filmed entertainment, including Paramount Pictures, Paramount Animation, and Paramount Players. PPC operations also include Paramount Home Entertainment, Paramount Pictures International, Paramount Licensing Inc., and Paramount Studio Group. Paramount Pictures is a subsidiary of Paramount, which connects with billions of people worldwide through its global brands including MTV, CBS, Paramount Network, Nickelodeon, Comedy Central, BET and streaming service Paramount+.

The Director of Creative Music, Paramount Pictures serves as a key creative partner across Paramount Pictures’ theatrical slate, supporting filmmakers and creative leadership in the development and execution of music for feature films. Operating as an in-house music supervisor, this role oversees all creative music elements from early development through final delivery, ensuring that each film’s musical vision enhances storytelling and supports the filmmaker’s intent.   This position works closely with directors, producers, composers, artists, and internal studio partners to deliver high-quality, filmmaker-driven music for Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases. This position is based at the historic Paramount Lot in Los Angeles.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with directors, producers, and Paramount Pictures creative executives to shape and execute the musical vision for assigned theatrical films.
  • Engage in projects early in development to provide creative guidance on score, source music, and overall music strategy.
  • Serve as a trusted creative collaborator to filmmakers and talent throughout pre-production, production, and post-production.
  • Advocate for the filmmaker’s creative vision while ensuring alignment with Paramount Pictures’ production goals and creative standards.
  • Act as the in-house music supervisor for assigned Paramount Pictures theatrical films.
  • Oversee all creative music elements including score, source music, needle drops, themes, and temp music.
  • Supervise spotting sessions, music reviews, and creative discussions with filmmakers and post-production teams.
  • Ensure music choices support narrative, tone, and emotional impact.
  • Identify, recommend, and help secure composers and music collaborators in partnership with filmmakers.
  • Guide composers creatively throughout the scoring process, maintaining clear communication between creative and post-production teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with composers, artists, music editors, and scoring partners.
  • Oversee music workflows through production and post-production, including scoring schedules, recording sessions, and final mixes.
  • Attend scoring sessions, dubbing sessions, and final mixes as appropriate.
  • Ensure all music is creatively approved, delivered on time, and ready for theatrical release.
  • Collaborate with internal Paramount Pictures teams including Production, Post-Production, Creative Affairs, Legal, Business Affairs, Finance, and Marketing.
  • Partner with music clearance and licensing teams to balance creative ambition with budgetary and legal requirements.
  • Support soundtrack, marketing, publicity, and awards initiatives tied to Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in music supervision, film or series music, or creative music roles within theatrical film or television in a studio/network environment.
  • Proven experience supervising music for feature films or series from development through post-production.
  • Prior in-house experience at a major theatrical/TV studio or network
  • Experience working directly with high-profile filmmakers, creative executives and talent.
  • Established relationships with composers, filmmakers, artists, and music industry partners.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong creative instincts with deep knowledge of film scoring and source music.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple films simultaneously across a theatrical slate.
  • Working knowledge of music licensing, clearance, and music budgeting.
  • Filmmaker-first mindset
  • Collaborative and solution-oriented
  • Strong creative judgment and taste
  • Passion for theatrical storytelling and music

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Program Director to design, launch, and lead the program from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to build a flagship talent program at a major Media, Entertainment, and Tech company — shaping its curriculum, rotation structure, participant experience, and long-term success metrics. The ideal candidate combines finance acumen, program/project management rigor, a forward-looking view on how AI and technology are reshaping finance work, and a genuine passion for developing early-career talent. The Program Director will serve as the primary point of contact for participants, rotation managers, university recruiting partners, and finance leadership, ensuring the program delivers a cohesive, high-impact experience from recruitment through graduation and placement.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Program Design & Strategy
  • Build out the end-to-end structure of the program, including rotation sequencing, learning objectives, and success criteria for each of the three rotations.
  • Partner with finance leadership to identify and secure rotation placements (e.g., FP&A, Accounting & Controllership, Treasury, Investor Relations, Business Unit Finance, etc.) that provide breadth and depth of experience.
  • Design and continuously refine the technical finance capability curriculum (financial modeling, accounting, valuation, corporate finance fundamentals) in partnership with internal SMEs or external training providers.
  • Partner with the SVP of Innovation to design and integrate an AI-forward training track — covering AI/ML fundamentals for finance, generative AI tools for modeling and analysis, automation of routine finance workflows, and how emerging technology is changing the finance function — ensuring participants graduate as both strong technical financiers and confident, tech-savvy operators.
  • Continuously scan for new AI tools, platforms, and use cases relevant to finance and embed them into the curriculum as the technology landscape evolves.
  • Design and oversee the leadership development curriculum (communication, executive presence, project management, business acumen) in partnership with L&D/HR.

 

Participant Management & Experience
  • Own the day-to-day participant experience: onboarding, rotation transitions, performance check-ins, and end-of-program evaluation.
  • Serve as a primary mentor, coach, and advocate for program participants throughout their journey.
  • Facilitate regular touchpoints (1:1s, cohort sessions, exec speaker series) to build community and reinforce leadership development themes.
  • Track individual and cohort performance, proactively addressing performance or engagement concerns with rotation managers.

 

Stakeholder & Business Partnership
  • Act as the liaison between rotational participants and rotation managers, ensuring clear expectations, feedback loops, and successful integration into each business unit.
  • Partner with finance leadership to identify end-of-program placement recommendations based on participant strengths and business needs.
  • Build relationships with senior finance leaders to secure executive sponsorship, speaker engagement, and mentorship participation.
  • Serve as the primary finance-side partner to the SVP of Innovation, aligning on AI training content, piloting new tools with the cohort, and channeling participant feedback into the broader innovation roadmap.

 

Recruiting & Program Growth
  • Partner with University Recruiting to define target schools, candidate profile, and selection criteria for each incoming cohort — including evaluating candidates' comfort and curiosity with AI and data tools as part of the selection criteria.
  • Participate in candidate interviews and final selection decisions.
  • Represent the program at campus recruiting events, info sessions, and case competitions as needed.
  • Own program metrics and reporting (retention, performance, promotion/placement rates, participant satisfaction) and use data to continuously improve the program.

 

Program Operations
  • Manage program budget, vendor relationships (training providers, assessment tools, AI/tech platform vendors), and logistics.
  • Establish program governance, policies, and processes (rotation timing, performance review cadence, escalation paths).
  • Build the program's employer brand internally and externally as a flagship talent pipeline known for producing tech-fluent finance leaders.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or related field
  • 10+ years of professional experience, with a mix of finance/business experience and program management, talent development, or HR business partnering
  • Demonstrated experience building or running a rotational program, leadership development program, or similar early-career talent initiative
  • Strong knowledge of core finance functions (FP&A, accounting, corporate finance) sufficient to design meaningful rotational and technical training content
  • A tech-forward mindset — genuine curiosity about AI and how it's transforming finance, and comfort partnering with technical/innovation stakeholders to translate that into training content
  • Exemplary relationship-management skills, with credibility to engage confidently with senior finance executives and new graduates alike
  • Strong program/project management skills — able to manage multiple moving parts (curriculum, people, stakeholders, logistics) concurrently
  • Remarkable communication, coaching, and facilitation skills

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or a large, complex corporate environment.
  • Prior experience with university recruiting or campus talent pipelines.
  • Familiarity with designing learning in the flow of work.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools in a finance or business context (e.g., generative AI for modeling/analysis, automation platforms).
  • Experience with HRIS/LMS platforms and program analytics/reporting tools
  • MBA a plus

job.title: Director, Global Title Marketing, Kids and Family
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

The Director of Global Title Marketing, Kids & Family is tasked with leading the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global marketing campaigns for select Paramount+ Kids & Family titles.   This role serves as a key cross-functional leader and steward of both individual titles and broader franchises. Developing campaigns that connect with kids across different age groups while also motivating parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.   The ideal candidate has solid marketing strategy skills and deep knowledge of kids entertainment, family viewing habits, and franchise building. They also understand how young audiences discover and engage with content as those habits keep changing. The Director must be a great leader, compelling storyteller, collaborative partner, and forward-thinking problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.   This is an onsite position at our New York or Burbank office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global go-to-market strategies
  • Translate series, film, character, and franchise attributes into differentiated campaign strategies that resonate with kids, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.
  • Develop audience strategies that account for distinct developmental stages, interests, viewing behaviors, and levels of parental influence across preschool, kids, tweens, teens, and family audiences.
  • Identify clear campaign objectives, audience priorities, strategic opportunities, and measures of success. Holding team members and partners accountable throughout campaign development and execution.
  • Apply a global perspective while recognizing regional differences in family dynamics, cultural relevance, content discovery, and children’s media consumption.
  • Ensure campaign strategies and executions are age-appropriate, inclusive, brand-safe, and aligned with applicable privacy, advertising, and platform guidelines.
  • Proactively identify key milestones, connect workstreams, resolve challenges, and ensure that creative and tactical executions ladder up to the overall strategy.
  • Brief cross-functional teams on campaign strategy so each discipline can develop a cohesive, audience-led plan.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and enthusiastic steward of assigned titles, characters, and franchises.
  • Build marketing strategies that support both the immediate title launch and long-term health, relevance, and growth
  • Partner with franchise, consumer products, licensing, retail, games, publishing, experiences, and other teams, where applicable. Creating related opportunities across the broader Paramount ecosystem.
  • Foster productive and trusting relationships with key stakeholders to ensure plans are developed and executed in a timely, collaborative, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain and build the team’s knowledge of the Kids & Family landscape, including audience behaviors, platform trends, franchise development, and responsible marketing practices.
  • Drive alignment among senior leadership and external partners. This includes: creators, executive producers, filmmakers, talent, studios, and co-production partners.
  • Clearly articulate the audience opportunity, campaign positioning, and strategic choices, behind recommendations.
  • Drive innovative thinking to develop 360-degree global stunts, partnerships, activations, and breakthrough campaign ideas that can generate excitement among kids and families.
  • Identify opportunities to bring titles and characters into the real world through family experiences, fan events, cultural moments, educational initiatives, and strategic brand partnerships.
  • Brief and lead “big idea” initiatives, managing internal teams and agency partners through execution.
  • Evaluate ideas through the distinct lenses of child appeal, parent or caregiver relevance, family participation, brand safety, and earned-media potential.
  • Partner with Media and Campaign Management teams to lead the development and execution of media campaigns across platforms that reach kids, parents, caregivers, and family audiences.
  • Understand the challenges of reaching young audiences. This includes streaming, digital video, social platforms, gaming environments, connected television, family programming, and media focused on parents.
  • Identify opportunities to reach parents and caregivers as content decision-makers while also building organic excitement and cultural relevance among young audiences.
  • Analyze audience research, campaign performance, competitive intelligence, and cultural trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy. Lead cross-functional reviews of awareness, consideration, engagement, viewing, acquisition, retention, co-viewing, repeat viewing, and franchise affinity. Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Combine quantitative data with qualitative audience knowledge. Recognizing that parents, caregivers, and children may each play different roles in content discovery and viewing decisions.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of entertainment marketing experience. With demonstrated experience developing campaigns for kids & family content, family entertainment, animation, or youth-focused brands.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience leading multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution and performance analysis.
  • Solid awareness of the distinct needs and behaviors of kids, tweens, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewing audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to market to young audiences responsibly and navigate relevant brand-safety, privacy, advertising, and platform considerations.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and a proven ability to manage relationships with senior internal stakeholders, creators, talent, filmmakers, studios, agencies, and external partners.
  • Robust strategic judgment and the ability to translate audience, cultural, creative, and business insights into actionable campaign strategies.
  • Data-driven marketer with experience analyzing campaign performance and applying learnings to optimize results.
  • Ability to manage multiple titles, priorities, and stakeholders within a dynamic and highly collaborative environment.
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and presentation skills, with solid attention to detail.
  • Experience marketing original series, films, animation, preschool content, or established Kids & Family franchises for a streaming service, studio, network, or entertainment brand.
  • Experience developing campaigns that speak to both young audiences and parents or caregivers.
  • Insight with emerging Kids & Family creators, platforms, fandoms, and digital content-discovery behaviors.
  • Experience developing global campaigns and adapting strategies for different markets and cultures.
  • Genuine affinity for Kids & Family entertainment, characters, storytelling, and fandom.
  • A collaborative spirit, creative instincts, and a great sense of humor.

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

job.title: Director, Product Management
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Director, Product Management – Reporting & Measurement, Ad Ops and Business Intelligence

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

In This Role You’ll:

This Director will own product strategy for Reporting and Measurement supporting the Ad Ops and Business Intelligence organization, operating as part of the broader Measurement, Reporting, and Payments leadership team within Paramount’s Ad Tech ecosystem (linear, streaming, and Vantage). This role is responsible for defining how reporting and measurement investments serve Ad Ops and BI’s operational and business goals, translating those priorities into a roadmap, and leading a team of Product Managers to execute against it. This Director will partner directly with VP and SVP-level stakeholders across Ad Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance to align product investment decisions with broader business objectives, while collaborating closely with the Lead Product Manager on overall portfolio strategy across Measurement, Reporting, and Payments. This role operates under limited supervision, exercising significant autonomy in setting strategy and resourcing decisions for their area. This is a remote position.

  • Own product strategy for Reporting and Measurement across Ad Ops and Business Intelligence: Define the long-term vision and roadmap for how reporting and measurement products serve Ad Ops and BI’s operational and strategic needs, aligning investment decisions with broader business goals.
  • Lead and develop a team of Product Managers: Manage, mentor, and grow Product Managers supporting this area, setting priorities, removing blockers, and building organizational capability over time.
  • Partner with VP and SVP-level stakeholders to align on priorities and resourcing: Serve as the primary product leader engaging with VPs and SVPs across Ad Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance, influencing decisions on investment, resourcing, and long-term direction.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, design, and data science leadership: Partner with functional leaders to ensure team structure, resourcing, and execution plans support the strategic roadmap.
  • Balance competing priorities across the Reporting, Measurement, and Payments portfolio: Collaborate with the Lead Product Manager to make trade-off decisions across products, ensuring resources are allocated to the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Identify and evaluate long-term product and market opportunities: Proactively surface new opportunities to improve reporting and measurement capabilities, bringing a point of view on where to invest next.
  • Represent the product organization in executive-level discussions: Communicate strategy, trade-offs, and progress to senior leadership, building confidence and alignment on direction.
  • Perform ad hoc strategic projects as needed to support the broader Ad Tech Measurement, Reporting, and Payments organization.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

  • 12+ years of Ad Tech experience, including 6+ years in a people-management capacity leading Product Managers.
  • Demonstrated experience setting product strategy and owning a roadmap for a product area, platform, or portfolio – not just executing against one.
  • Extensive knowledge of ad tech ecosystems, with deep expertise across linear and streaming advertising measurement and reporting.
  • Proven track record influencing VP and SVP-level and executive stakeholders, aligning cross-functional teams around a shared strategic direction.
  • Strong experience balancing competing priorities and resourcing decisions across multiple products or teams.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence, with experience presenting strategy and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree required, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel occasionally (less than 10%) for team or company meetings, as needed.

 

Bonus Skills:

  • Experience with advertising payment systems or reconciliation workflows.
  • Familiarity with Vantage or comparable ad measurement/attribution platforms.
  • Prior experience building or scaling a product organization, including hiring and developing Product Managers.
  • Experience in media, entertainment, or streaming industries.

 

About Our Brands:

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is home to the company’s direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

If you're excited by the idea of influencing how some of the world's biggest movies are created and launched, then look no further. We're hiring a Director of Strategy and Insights to join us at Paramount Pictures!

 

At Paramount, our Strategy and Insights team sits at the intersection of consumer insights and creative strategy, shaping how upcoming releases are made, marketed, and distributed. This role offers rare exposure to the entire film slate, from original titles to iconic franchises like Mission: Impossible, Transformers, Sonic the Hedgehog, and A Quiet Place.

 

Within the studio, this team serves as the voice of the audience, understanding how moviegoers feel about our films and brands and translating those perspectives into strategies that help us tell stories that connect authentically. This role requires someone who can balance analytical rigor with creative intuition, and who can build genuine trust and influence with creative and marketing leaders — not just deliver findings to them.

 

As Director, you'll help drive how insights guide strategy for all Paramount Motion Picture releases and play a key role in designing and implementing the research that shapes creative direction. You'll report to the Senior Vice President of Global Strategy and Insights and work closely with teams across the studio.

 

Apply now and join us!


Responsibilities:

  • Drive research findings into actionable strategies that guide Paramount’s full slate of releases

Contract Type: 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract (FTC) (Strong possibility for extension)

Location: Budapest

Team: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Company: Skydance (formerly Paramount)

Shape the Future of Entertainment Finance

Join Skydance—formerly Paramount—and take full ownership of cash flow across our International Markets for the TV Media segment. We are offering an exciting 12-month Fixed-Term Contract (FTC) with a strong possibility for extension for the right candidate.

As FP&A Cashflow Finance Manager, you won't just report numbers—you will optimize resources, drive forecast innovation, and influence strategic decisions across a global media powerhouse. If you are a proactive finance leader looking for high visibility, end-to-end ownership, and direct exposure to senior executives, this is your next career move.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Treasury & Disbursement Ownership: Drive weekly treasury reporting on disbursements, updating forecasts, reconciling actuals, and translating variances into strategic insights for Treasury and senior leadership.

  • Forecast Innovation: Elevate forecast accuracy through continuous optimization. Experiment with creative approaches—such as analyzing payment-run timing, vendor behaviors, and historical trends—to build and adopt the most accurate models.

  • Cash Flow & Liquidity Strategy: Deliver timely, insight-rich analysis, variance breakdowns, and strategic recommendations for cash flow and short-term liquidity.

  • End-to-End Payment Funnel Optimization: Partner with Controllership, Accounts Payable, Procurement, and regional teams to clean underlying data (open POs, invoices, payment terms) and ensure forecasts reflect actual cash movements.

  • Financial Close & System Transformation: Support monthly cash flow reporting, month-end close for Cash Operations, and critical multi-year initiatives—including our strategic migration from SAP to Oracle Fusion in 2027.

  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Build strong partnerships with regional finance teams to map cash flow drivers, mitigate risks, and streamline global processes.

  • Agile Financial Operations: Coordinate inputs for centralized cash forecasting and provide high-level backup across monthly, annual budget, and Long-Range Plan (LRP) cycles.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Proven Expertise: 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Controllership, Treasury, or Cashflow Management within a multinational environment.

  • Analytical Mastery: Advanced Excel skills (complex modeling, pivot tables, forecast back-testing) with a track record of transforming standard reporting into actionable insight.

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Demonstrated success in measuring, back-testing, and upgrading legacy forecasting processes.

  • Strong Ownership & Persistence: Proactive approach with the tenacity to follow up across global teams until open items are fully resolved.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Excellent communication and collaboration skills in English, with the ability to build trust and convey financial narratives to cross-functional partners.

  • Technical Agility: Independence in managing priorities; experience with Alteryx, Oracle Fusion, or similar financial platforms is a strong plus.

Why You’ll Love Working at Skydance

We foster a supportive, vibrant culture that rewards your efforts and keeps you connected:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Private health insurance, including access to top clinics and an annual screening package.

  • Flexible Cafeteria Benefits: Customizable monthly perks including SZÉP card, nursery support, and home loan assistance.

  • Pet-Friendly Workplace: Bring your dog to work and enjoy a pet-friendly office environment.

  • Exclusive Entertainment Perks: Get VIP access to private, pre-premiere movie screenings before official public releases.

  • Growth & Wellness: Post-probation language courses, vision/eyewear support, and weekly fresh fruit days in the office.

Ready to lead the narrative behind Skydance's financial success?

Apply today and take the next step in your financial career!

job.title: Lead Data Scientist
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG)! DIG is a key connector across the Paramount Streaming verticals. Our group is made up of subject matter experts who prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products. We also assess, aggregate, and analyze data, and we shape both qualitative and quantitative stories and insights. In short, we give our stakeholders decision support, clear performance views, and recommendations that help the business grow!

 

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Lead Data Scientist reports to the Senior Director of Data Science. You'll support a wide range of projects, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives, and Finance. This role calls for a solid analytical foundation, real curiosity about subscriber behavior, and the skill to run careful analysis that feeds straight into strategy!

 

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly, and has hands-on experience (or eagerness to grow) in causal inference and experimentation.

 

This role supports two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to grow it?
  2. How do our optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey affect the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Run causal inference analyses (e.g., diff-in-diff, matching, uplift modeling) under the Sr. Director's guidance. You'll find which subscriber behaviors truly drive retention and long-term value, while correcting for known biases in streaming data.
  • Help map the subscriber journey to pinpoint where lifecycle, product, pricing, and promo levers have the most impact.
  • Help design, set up, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, win-back), including power analysis, monitoring, and read-outs.
  • Build and maintain reporting and models that turn journey optimization into ARPU, survival, and LTV metrics for stakeholders.
  • Own the SQL/Python data pulls, cleaning, and analysis pipelines behind the team's causal and LTV modeling.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized presentations and summaries of your findings for stakeholders.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Product Analytics to check data quality and fix issues in our experimentation and behavioral data pipelines.
  • Stay current on causal inference and experimentation best practices and help promote sound methods across the team.
  • Mentor junior analysts on SQL, statistical methods, and analytical best practices as the team grows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related).
  • 5+ years in data science/analytics, with hands-on use of causal inference or experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing, diff-in-diff, propensity score matching) — not just predictive modeling.
  • Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests, including an understanding of common pitfalls (novelty effects, selection bias, sample ratio mismatch).
  • Solid SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with or building LTV, survival, or churn-related metrics.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to turn analytical results into clear takeaways for non-technical stakeholders.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience in subscription/DTC streaming, media, or another subscription business (e.g., SaaS, telecom).
  • Familiarity with subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Exposure to advanced causal techniques (e.g., instrumental variables, double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

job.title: Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer
Personalization & Recommendation Systems


Overview
We’re hiring a Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational excellence, observability, reliability, and governance layer around our personalization and recommendation ML systems. 

Our recommendation models retrain and deploy frequently. You will define how we detect model behavior changes, diagnose issues quickly, and prevent bad deployments from reaching customers.


This is a lead-level IC role: you’ll set technical direction and drive adoption across ML Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, and Product.


Sitting within ML Platform and Infrastructure, you’ll partner closely with ML engineers who own model development. You’re not expected to build infrastructure from scratch, but you’ll define what good looks like, evaluate tooling, and own the day-to-day operational layer.


What You’ll Do

Own ML production reliability strategy

  • Define and lead the operational strategy for production ML systems, including monitoring, traceability, deployment safety, incident response, and post-deployment validation.

  • Set the standards ML teams use to assess model health, performance, and trustworthiness in production.

Own model traceability and governance

  • Ensure every production model has clear lineage (data, features, code, artifacts, validation, deployment history) and drive adoption of model registry and metadata tooling across ML teams.

Build end-to-end ML observability

  • Design and implement monitoring across the full ML signal path: data arrival, feature freshness, distribution stability, candidate generation, ranking behavior, model metrics, serving latency, and SLA performance.

Define production health metrics

  • Partner with ML, data, product, and business stakeholders to define post-deployment metrics covering model quality, system reliability, business guardrails, and degradation indicators.

Detect drift and degradation proactively

  • Detect data drift, feature drift, model behavior changes, and silent failures before they impact customers via thresholding, alerting, anomaly detection, and release-over-release monitoring.

Lead diagnostic tooling and root-cause analysis

  • Build dashboards, logs, and diagnostic workflows that progress quickly from “recommendations look off” to root cause, with context captured across candidates, features, scores, ranking decisions, and downstream outcomes.

Own ML deployment safety

  • Define and operate automated gates that prevent bad models or bad data from being promoted to production. Partner with MLEs to establish validation checks, rollback criteria, canary strategies, shadow testing, and release health reviews.

Lead ML incident response

  • Own incident response practices for ML systems, including rollback playbooks, hotfix strategies, severity definitions, tradeoff frameworks, communications, and post-mortems. Drive closure of systemic gaps after incidents rather than only resolving the immediate issue.

Partner across ML Platform, Data, and ML

  • Partner with DevOps/Platform on infrastructure and observability needs; with Data Engineering on data quality, drift, and freshness; and with ML Engineering to embed operational requirements into development and deployment workflows.

Set standards and mentor others

  • Act as the technical lead for ML operations: establish reusable patterns, playbooks, and standards, and mentor engineers on reliability, observability, and operational rigor.


Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, ML platform, applied ML, MLOps, data platform, reliability engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Demonstrated experience operating production ML systems, including monitoring, deployment, incident response, model validation, data quality, or reliability ownership.

  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams, especially where success required influencing architecture, tooling, standards, or adoption.

  • Hands-on experience with model registries, feature stores, ML metadata systems, production monitoring, model deployment pipelines, or ML observability platforms.

  • Solid knowledge of end-to-end ML systems, including training data, features, model artifacts, offline validation, online serving, post-deployment metrics, and business outcome measurement.

  • Ability to reason about ML operational failure modes: stale features, distribution shift, training-serving skew, delayed labels, and offline-online metric gaps.

  • Solid SQL skills and comfort investigating data quality, feature distributions, model outputs, pipeline behavior, and production anomalies.

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration with Platform, Data, and ML Engineering to deliver production-grade operational capabilities.

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain ML system health, risks, incidents, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation, personalization, ranking, search, ads, content discovery, or marketplace ML systems at scale.

  • Experience with real-time or near-real-time model serving systems.

  • Experience with feature stores, model registries, metadata stores, experiment tracking, data quality tools, lineage systems, or observability platforms.

  • Experience designing automated validation gates, canary deployments, rollback strategies, shadow deployments, or progressive delivery workflows for ML systems.

  • Experience with A/B testing, experiment guardrails, counterfactual evaluation, or offline-to-online metric alignment.

  • Experience with cloud-native production environments, distributed data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, or streaming systems.

  • Experience leading incident reviews, post-mortems, reliability programs, or operational excellence initiatives.

  • Experience defining standards, playbooks, or governance frameworks for production ML systems.


What Success Looks Like

  • Within the first 90 days, you will have assessed the current production ML operational landscape, identified the highest-risk gaps, and established a prioritized roadmap for observability, traceability, deployment safety, and incident response.

  • Within six months, our production recommendation systems will have clearer model lineage, stronger monitoring coverage, better diagnostic workflows, and more reliable deployment gates.

  • Within one year, ML operations will be a repeatable, trusted function: teams will know what is running, why it was promoted, how it is performing, when something is wrong, and how to recover quickly.

 

Leveling Signal
The right candidate defines strategy, leads cross-functional execution, and sets engineering standards while staying hands-on enough to investigate production issues directly.

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

Lead Network Engineer

Job Summary

The Lead Network Engineer is a seasoned professional who provides advanced expertise for planning, implementing, maintaining, and supporting network infrastructure in a global enterprise environment. The primary focus of this position is to implement and support network technology and solutions; the candidate will also be part of the larger global team, providing 24x7 network support including project management, operations, expansion, and maintenance of all equipment within the global enterprise domain.

  • Implement and manage enterprise networking solutions with high reliability and availability
  • Introduce new networking technologies or enhance existing technologies to transform capabilities and services

  • Provide 3rd-line support of all Paramount network infrastructure

  • Minimum 5–7 years of experience in a large corporate IP network communications environment

  • Knowledge of IP security implementation and multi-vendor IPS and URL filtering
  • Knowledge of Dark Fiber and CWDM/DWDM
  • Knowledge of MPLS, BGP, and Internet Exchange Peering
  • Knowledge of QoS and Multicast
  • Knowledge of Network Management and SNMP-based monitoring solutions

  Job Title: Lead Software Engineer in Test Team: Global Quality Engineering Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Staff Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This senior technical role combines deep Java engineering expertise, advanced test automation, media/streaming domain knowledge, and modern CI/CD practices to accelerate quality, reduce risk, and ensure world-class customer experiences across CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web. You will be a senior technical leader within the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization. You will use and enhance our existing departmental automation framework, define quality strategies, and mentor engineers across GQE to elevate testing maturity and engineering excellence. You will also drive AI-augmented development and testing practices using GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Automation Framework Architecture • Enhance and extend our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Establish scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. Quality Engineering Technical Leadership • Define technical strategy for automated testing across services, microservices, UIs, mobile apps, and OTT/CTV applications leveraging the departmental framework. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns. • Lead the evaluation and adoption of modern automation technologies and quality platforms.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 7+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with robust Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional automation initiatives. • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Technical leadership – ability to guide teams and evolve automation coverage. • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – knowledge of distributed systems and complex media pipelines. • Ownership – ability to drive initiatives end-to-end with autonomy.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams

The role will be end-to-end from understanding the goals and roadmaps of the product and engineering teams, through design and architecture of any solution and the delivery and maintenance of those platforms once in place.   This role involves engineering for the Android platform and developing AI.
