You will also be involved in platform architectural discussions and initiatives paving the way for optimizations and performance alongside.   You will also be working with a team of engineers through the development process, including implementing standards around code, tooling, metrics, progress reporting and interactions with the QE team to ensure a quality first approach to any work.     Responsibilities   Technical Leadership:
  • Drive the architectural direction and design of Android applications
  • Establish best practices for coding, testing, and deployment
  • Evangelize new tools, frameworks, and processes for continued innovation and development efficiency
  • Prepare architectural diagrams and technical specifications for the engineering team to deliver high quality, maintainable software
  • Lead architectural discussions around feature development and software development best practice
  • Involvement in performance and playback optimizations, overall app stability and profiling
  Application Development:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new solutions as well as maintaining, integrating and improving existing solutions using modern technologies and industry best practices
  • Ensure robust performance, responsiveness, and quality of applications, troubleshooting and debugging as needed
  AI-Integrated Development:
  • Leverage AI-driven coding assistants like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude as a core component of the daily engineering lifecycle, including architectural design, implementation, and refactoring
  • Partner with technical leadership to establish and optimize safe, high-impact practices for utilizing AI tools within the development team
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to integrate LLM and ML capabilities into product features, such as advanced search, discovery, and personalized content understanding
  Mentorship:
  • Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers, sharing technical expertise and guiding professional growth
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and consistency across the team
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements
  • Coordinate with backend services and APIs to ensure seamless integration and feature delivery
  Process Improvement:
  • Enhance software development processes and policies, driving continuous improvement in code quality, development speed, and overall team productivity
  • Stay current with emerging Android technologies, libraries, and trends, recommending their adoption where beneficial
  Ownership and Accountability:
  • Partner closely with the Android Engineering Manager on development strategies
  • Ensure the application is highly responsive and performant
  • Safeguard against production incidents
  • Enable engineers to deliver mission-critical features and enhancements
  • Identify technical risks and potential bottlenecks, proposing solutions to mitigate them
    Skills Expertise in Android Development:
  • Proficient in Kotlin and Java, with a solid understanding of the Android SDK and different Android versions
  • Deep knowledge of Architecture Patterns and Material Design (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Compose UI)
  • Experience using Gradle and Android Studio
  • Experience following and implementing software design patterns
  System Design & Architecture:
  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications
  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries
  Testing and Quality Assurance:
  • Solid experience in writing unit tests, UI tests, and automated tests using frameworks like JUnit, Espresso, and others
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  Performance Optimization:
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, slow rendering, and network inefficiencies
  • Skilled in using performance profiling and optimizations (e.g., Android Profiler, Leak Canary)
  Leadership and Communication:
  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executives
  • Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of developing and inspiring high-performing teams
    Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 6 years focused on Android development
  • Demonstrated history of leading and delivering multiple large-scale Android projects in a production environment with multiple scrum teams in an agile process
  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and driving technical decisions
  • You should have strong interpersonal skills. You will need to facilitate conversations with business partners. This includes discussions during project definition, business requirements definition, and functional design sessions.
  • Eye for quality and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into software requirements
    Desired Qualifications
  • Hands on software development on the Android/Android TV/Amazon/Amazon Fire TV platform
  • Have shipped one or more apps to the Google Play and/or Amazon app store
  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and multiple interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience working on Android projects with multi-module architecture
  • Experience with assistive technologies such as JAWS/VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only input methods
  • Experience evaluating front-end code against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Experience in creating accessible front-end designs. This includes using TalkBack properties in XML, like labelFor and contentDescription. It also involves making TalkBack announcements, scaling text dynamically, and ensuring responsive design.
  AI Literacy
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with a clear sense of what these tools are good and bad at
  • Comfort writing effective prompts, structuring context, and evaluating AI-generated diffs critically before they land in the codebase
  • Working understanding of LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, and prompt engineering, enough to design client integrations and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes
  • You should have useful experience in shipping or prototyping at least one product feature that uses machine learning (ML) or large language models (LLM). This could include features such as search, ranking, personalization, content understanding, or in-app assistants.
  • Judgment about responsible AI use: privacy, IP, attribution, and when a human review gate is required
  Bonus Skills (Nice To Have)
  • Experience with Video Streaming (HLS / MPEG-DASH)
  • Experience working with ExoPlayer
  • Widevine DRM knowledge

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Location: San Francisco – Onsite

 

About This Role

Welcome to Paramount Streaming — the team behind Paramount+, home to a mountain of entertainment for audiences around the globe. We bring together iconic brands, compelling content, and technology to deliver streaming experiences to millions of viewers.

We’re hiring a Lead Software Engineer on the AI Engagement Engine team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll build native Apple experiences that support content discovery and personalization within the Paramount+ and Pluto TV applications, integrating real-time personalization signals across key touchpoints.

You’ll partner with backend, ML, data, product, and platform teams to deliver reliable, scalable experiences across iOS and tvOS. You’ll own complex technical problems, contribute to client architecture, and work with existing technical leadership to strengthen engineering standards.

AI fluency is a core requirement for this role. We’re looking for someone who uses AI coding assistants and agents daily and understands how to work effectively with context, tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent harnesses. You should be comfortable explaining your workflows, evaluating AI-generated output, and recognizing when human review is needed.

 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Contribute to decisions on architecture, frameworks, and tooling for iOS and tvOS applications in partnership with team leads and senior peers.

  • Evaluate new technologies and adopt approaches that improve engineering quality and productivity.

  • Translate product goals into technical requirements and manageable, shippable work.

  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Application Development

  • Design, build, debug, and ship native iOS and tvOS features.

  • Improve performance, reliability, and accessibility across the app experience.

  • Build client experiences for personalization and recommendations in partnership with ML and backend teams.

  • Integrate APIs and personalization signals into responsive, data-driven interfaces.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI coding assistants and agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent tools daily to design, write, review, test, and refactor code.

  • Use MCP integrations to connect AI tools with relevant engineering tools and data sources, with appropriate access controls.

  • Work with agent harnesses to manage context, instructions, tool execution, and human review.

  • Validate AI-generated code through review and testing, investigate failures, and recognize when a different approach is needed.

  • Share useful workflows, skills, plugins, and lessons learned with teammates.

Mentorship and Collaboration

  • Help improve code quality through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing.

  • Mentor and unblock engineers through technical guidance and collaboration.

  • Partner with product, design, data, backend, and other client teams to define and deliver features.

  • Build constructive working relationships and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ownership and Delivery

  • Own features and technical problems from requirements through delivery and follow-up.

  • Manage concurrent priorities, surface risks early, and help the team deliver predictably.

  • Contribute to improvements in engineering practices, documentation, and shared standards.

 

Skills

Apple Platform Expertise

  • Strong programming skills in Swift.

  • In-depth knowledge of iOS and tvOS, and proficiency in Xcode.

  • Strong fundamentals in memory management, concurrency, animations, and performance profiling.

  • Experience designing interfaces across size classes and device families.

  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with backend services.

AI Fluency, MCP, and Agent Harnesses

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agents in day-to-day engineering work.

  • Working understanding of inference, context windows, tool use, and the capabilities and limitations of AI coding tools.

  • Familiarity with MCP, including connecting AI tools to external tools and data sources, configuring integrations, and managing permissions.

  • Understanding of agent harnesses, including how they manage context, instructions, tool execution, and human review.

  • Ability to explain practical workflows using MCP integrations and agent harnesses, including how you troubleshoot failures and validate results.

  • Working familiarity with skills and plugins, how they extend AI coding tools, and when to use an existing one.

  • Ability to write and refine prompts and context, critically evaluate AI-generated output, and validate generated code.

  • Familiarity with how LLM- or ML-powered product features are built.

  • Sound judgment around privacy, intellectual property, attribution, and responsible AI use.

Architecture and Experimentation

  • Strong problem-solving and architectural skills at the app and module level.

  • Experience with A/B testing, feature flagging, and client-side experimentation, including experiment assignment, holdout groups, and measuring impact.

  • Experience integrating ad-serving products into Apple applications, including ad surfaces, impression tracking, and collaboration with ad tech teams.

  • Working familiarity with ML-driven product features, including API contracts, client-side signals, and distinguishing between data, model, and rendering issues.

Leadership and Communication

  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Ability to mentor and support others without requiring a reporting relationship.

  • A collaborative approach to technical decisions, feedback, and problem-solving.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Apple platform development experience, or equivalent senior-level depth.

  • Hands-on experience using Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and agent harnesses in engineering workflows, including validating outputs and troubleshooting failures.

  • Experience as a key contributor to at least one publicly released native iPhone application.

  • Experience working with Agile development processes.

  • Demonstrable, current use of AI coding tools and agents in your day-to-day engineering workflow, and the ability to explain how they work to others.

Desired Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • Background supporting the integration of rich media assets, including video, into mobile applications.

  • Experience building data-driven or server-driven UI, including personalized feeds, ranked content surfaces, and dynamic layouts, with pagination, prefetching, and cache invalidation strategies that keep content fast and fresh.

  • Experience working with entertainment, games, news, or sports-related properties.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience creating reusable skills, plugins, or custom agents for AI coding tools.

  • Experience building or extending MCP integrations or agent harnesses.

  • Continuous build and test automation experience.

  • Understanding of streaming video and DRM concepts.

  • Knowledge of localization practices and tooling in Xcode.

  • Experience with Swift Package Manager.

job.title: Lead Software Test Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.


Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

For our Milan office (Corso Europa) we are currently recruiting for a full-time:

 

Lead Software Test Engineer

 

Is this the role for you?

POSITION SUMMARY:

Skydance is looking for a passionate, self-motivated lead software test engineer to handle all aspects of testing (functional, performance, load, security, etc) across a large multiplatform environment.  This individual will be partnering with various teams (product, engineering, and quality) by assisting with the development of processes and tools that allow the organization to excel in its continuous software development initiatives.  As code is being delivered multiple times per day, test coverage and automation is crucial in allowing products to deliver quickly to market while maintaining the high level of quality our consumers deserve across our many diverse platforms. 

 

What will you be doing?
PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical quality leadership and guidance to the projects and resources that are assigned by implementing testing best practices 

  • Work on product/project teams developing test plans, test cases and test execution 

  • Partner with software engineering to design and develop tools and to assist in continuous development initiatives 

  • Conduct technical assessment of process and teams 

  • Perform load / performance testing where applicable 

  • Work alongside and mentor other test engineers to continuously improve process and provide input into our internal training bootcamps 

  • Contribute to and help maintain the testing framework for various types of testing (functional, load/performance, security) on multiple platforms (web, iOS/Android, emerging platforms) 

  • Operate in an agile software delivery methodology focused on testing new features within an iteration and providing near immediate feedback to engineers through test automation 

  • Perform exploratory testing where necessary in addition to regression testing 

  • Effectively communicate complex and/or difficult information to both technical and non-technical audiences 

  • Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment supporting many products on varied release cycles 

  • Oversee activities of other QE Engineers contractors

  • Design and architect end-to-end test frameworks and strategy from the ground up for large-scale, multiplatform streaming applications, applying appropriate design patterns without over-engineering 

  • Lead the adoption of AI-augmented quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted test generation and review, evaluation of AI/LLM feature outputs, and establishing safeguards and data-governance practices (e.g. anonymization) for AI tool usage 

  • Perform hands-on code and test-design review (spotting logic bugs, flaky-prone patterns and bad practices), and hold the line on quality standards across the team 

  • Own test-suite health: prioritize test maintenance, identify and resolve flaky tests in CI, and drive risk-based and requirements-based coverage decisions 

  • Document processes and testing knowledge continuously to reduce key-person risk and support knowledge transfer across the team.

 

What are we looking for?

JOB SKILLS:

  • Deep understanding of software quality best practices, with a passion for learning and adopting emerging technologies and methodologies
  • Solid software development expertise and technical architecture capabilities
  • Strong object-oriented programming background, with a focus on building scalable, reliable, and reusable solutions
  • Hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience in one or more of C#, PHP, or Java
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git, SVN, and Stash
  • Experience with automation and testing tools, including Selenium, WebDriver, JUnit, TestNG, Appium, and Cypress
  • Proficiency with CI/CD and build automation tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo
  • Experience using performance testing tools, including JMeter and LoadRunner
  • Experience working within Agile development and testing environments
  • Understanding of web video playback, encoding, live streaming, and related technologies
  • Knowledge of network analysis and proxy tools such as Charles, Fiddler, and HttpWatch
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, content delivery networks (CDNs), database fundamentals, and caching strategies
  • Experience with TDD and BDD methodologies is a plus
  • Strong coding and analytical problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience writing and debugging unit tests
  • Good understanding of test design patterns and the ability to apply them pragmatically when appropriate
  • Practical experience leveraging AI within quality engineering, including AI-assisted test generation, prompt engineering, and evaluation of AI/LLM outputs, combined with an awareness of data governance and safety considerations
  • Experience designing and building test automation frameworks and architectures from the ground up
  • A proactive, self-motivated professional who thrives both independently and as part of a collaborative team

 

EXPERIENCE:

The ideal candidate should have a background in software engineering and is seasoned in software quality best practices.  Additionally, the candidate should have: 

  • 5+ years of designing and working with test automation frameworks and developing automated test scripts (web, mobile & OTT) specifically object-oriented frameworks 

  • 5+ years working and testing with various online research and analytics tools 

  • 3+ years working with and leading offshore resources 

  • Demonstrated experience designing (not only maintaining) a test automation framework from scratch, including architecture and technology choices 

  • Experience with online streaming video experiences (web, mobile & emerging technologies) a plus 

 

 

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related discipline. The combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered.

 

Does it sound like you? Apply now and become part of our team!

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

The hiring salary range for this position applies to Italy. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. The benefits available for this position include lunch vouchers; Cancer Prevention Centres ("Centri Prevenzioni LILT");  Parents Package ("Pacchetto Genitori"); Employee Discount Program; Tax Assistance; Business Travel Accident Insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); Well-being programmes, and applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement benefits. 

 

What we offer:

  • Comprehensive compensation and benefits packages.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Skydance's most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace. 

 

About Skydance


Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Lead Product Designer, CBS Sports App

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

  • Contributions to a design system.

The CBS Stations' Local Ad Sales team is responsible for driving all local revenue growth across all Paramount Global streaming & digital assets, as well as the 27 owned & operated CBS Television Stations. This team collaborates across Paramount Global and CBS Stations divisions, providing thought leadership that drives the local sales GTM strategy, innovation opportunities, training & development, and revenue generation.


Position Overview:


We are looking for exceptional candidates for the Manager, Account Management role, who will train and develop Account Managers to drive client and campaign excellence across our portfolio of digital & streaming assets, inclusive of Paramount+, CBS, Pluto TV, and more. The candidate will also work closely and collaborate with sales teams, clients, and internal Paramount teams.


Role Details:

 

The Manager, Account Management sits between individual-contributor account management and regional sales leadership, providing the day-to-day client and campaign management, coaching, and quality control that the Account Manager team needs to deliver sales performance. While the Account Managers roll up into their Directors, the Manager, Account Management works in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) and Local Sales Management to translate revenue goals and priorities into clear direction for the team.

 

The Manager, Account Management, will work directly with Account Managers on account sales strategy, campaign specifics, and client escalations. This role is also the primary point of contact for the internal teams that power local sales delivery -- including Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, and Ad Systems -- building and maintaining the workflows the Local team relies on to execute successfully. The ideal candidate is a proactive, organized communicator who is energized by developing people, driving excellence, and building a strong culture.

  • Directly develop the Account Manager team, including workload distribution, coaching, and sales performance feedback
  • Work in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) to lead the Account Manager team through the full sales cycle for all clients
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, Ad Systems, and other internal teams to deliver the best-in-class client experience
  • Partner with Directors and Sales Leadership to ensure Account Managers have the tools, training, and support needed to execute digital & streaming campaigns and become a future account executive
  • Identify workflow gaps between Local Sales and internal partner teams, and drive process improvements that drive revenue growth
  • Report team & client performance, and development progress to the Regional Digital Sales Director

  • 3+ years of experience in advertising/media account management, sales or sales support, with digital, streaming and/or linear experience preferred
  • Prior experience mentoring, training, or informally leading other account management or sales staff
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams (e.g. Ad Operations, Yield, Data, Marketing, Research) to solve workflow and process challenges on behalf of the sales team
  • Excels in communication, organizational and time management

  • Dedicated and driven work ethic

In this role, you will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for application security and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance across our enterprise systems. You will be in charge of ensuring strict Segregation of Duties (SoD), managing user access governance, and mitigating risk across Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, and HCM), Oracle EPM, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). job.description:

Brand/Division Overview:
We are the PMO at Paramount Streaming, that boasts unparalleled insight into transforming Agile Teams at Scale. Our program managers, release managers, project managers and scrum masters bring passion to iterative delivery and process while keeping our eyes on the goal and motivating one another to do the same! Our team blends program management, technical architecture, and engineering leadership to keep our platforms stable while continuously evolving them.


Role Details:
We're seeking a Manager, Technical Program Management who can operate as the subject matter expert on our technical architecture, working directly with engineers on implementation, risk, and scope, while coordinating across engineering, product, and business requests. This isn't a role that runs on status updates and timelines; it requires enough technical fluency to catch flawed scoping and surface dependencies before they become rework. This role also leads a team of Project Managers, responsible for their day-to-day workload, growth, and development, and ensuring the team's work stays aligned to architectural priorities.


Your Day-to-Day:
●    Serve as the subject matter expert on core technical architecture, working directly with engineers on how architectural changes get implemented, what they touch, and where they introduce risk.
●    Manage and develop a team of Project Managers, overseeing workload distribution, prioritization across their portfolios, and their growth as program/project managers.
●    Guide requirements-gathering on large architectural initiatives toward an agreed MVP, managing scope creep as multiple teams propose competing approaches.
●    Stand up and lead focused working groups (tiger teams) to execute isolated architectural changes without disrupting the broader platform.
●    Run and facilitate Architecture Intake, a standing forum with engineering leads across architecture and feature teams, reviewing new RFCs before they're committed to the roadmap.
●    Triage daily requests and escalations from feature teams across Paramount Streaming's platforms that depend on shared architecture systems, distinguishing routine asks from signals of deeper dependency issues.
●    Communicate program health, risk, and architectural roadmap status to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.


Basic Qualifications:
●    7+ years of technical program management experience in a complex, matrixed engineering organization, ideally supporting platform or architecture teams rather than feature delivery teams.
●    Prior experience managing or mentoring other program/project managers, with direct people-management responsibility (performance, growth, workload balancing).
●    Demonstrated ability to understand and reason about system architecture deeply enough to evaluate engineering estimates, scoping, and technical tradeoffs directly with engineers, not just track them.
●    Experience running structured technical review processes (e.g., architecture review boards, RFC processes) to drive cross-team alignment on technical direction.
●    Experience managing platform or infrastructure work with dependencies across multiple engineering teams and SRE.
●    Strong judgment on when to escalate, when to push back, and when to let engineering teams self-direct.
●    High proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and technical documentation; strong written and verbal communication with both engineers and leadership.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
●    Familiarity with Next.js, Module Federation, micro-frontend architectures, or similar web platform technologies.
●    Experience in direct-to-consumer streaming, media, or high-traffic web platforms.
●    Background as a software engineer or technical lead prior to moving into program management.

Location: New York, NY (1515 Broadway)

Supports: U.S. and global production workflows

Overview
Paramount: A Skydance Corporation is seeking a Media Coordinator to join the Editorial Post Production Operations (EPPO) Media Management & Archives team within Production Technology and Operations. This role is responsible for executing media management workflows supporting high-volume, multi-brand production environments across Paramount's global ecosystem. Based in New York, this position partners closely with production, editorial, and technology teams to ensure media is proficiently ingested, organized, transferred, prepared, and archived across both on-premises and cloud-based environments as well as live streaming production systems.


Responsibilities
•    Coordinate with teams across multiple productions and facilities
•    Enforce standards for media ingest, organization, directory structures, and workflows
•    Oversee media preparation for editorial, including syncing, grouping, and proxy/mezzanine creation
•    Manage media transfers across internal and external environments using approved enterprise tools
•    Partner with production teams to plan workflows, storage strategies, and delivery requirements
•    Drive adoption of AI-powered metadata workflows to improve search, discoverability, and automation
•    Support live and near-live production workflows including streaming ingest and rapid-turn deliverables
•    Oversee review and approval workflows and ensure efficient collaboration across teams
•    Provide guidance and escalation support for technical issues impacting media workflows
•    Collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize performance and scalability
•    Support on-site productions and events, including setup of DIT environments, live stream implementation, and field workflows


Qualifications
•    2-5 years of experience in media management, post-production operations, live stream tech, or related roles
•    Strong communication skills in dynamic production environments
•    Expertise in editorial workflows and media formats/codecs
•    Experience with Avid, Adobe Premiere, and/or other professional editing platforms
•    Familiarity with cloud storage platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI) and file transfer systems (Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera)
•    Experience with MAM/DAM systems and digital archive workflows
•    Working knowledge of AI-driven metadata tools and workflow automation
•    Ability to manage multiple productions and priorities simultaneously
•    Willingness to travel and support on-site production workflows as needed and to cover off-hours needs

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. LET’S GO!

 

CBS O&O in Dallas (KTVT) is looking for a dynamic Multi Skilled Journalist. This position is unique in that it’s focused on content beyond linear television. This position will create content for all platforms but have a YouTube specific focus, creating content longer in length. This candidate should understand YouTube strategies and be able to create their own content from start to finish.

job.title: Newswriter/Producer - PT
job.description:
KCAL News has immediate openings for freelance Associate Producers at the Los Angeles Duopoly. You will be a key member of the news team, that’s critical to the overall news image and growth of the station. We are seeking a dedicated, efficient, accurate and creative writer for this position. You’ll write scripts, edit video, create graphics, and assist in the overall production of stories for the Newscasts, as well as assisting in news cut-in production when necessary. This is a Writers Guild of America position and membership in WGA is required.

 

JOB FUNCTION:

  • Assist Producer and fill-in, when needed, on Newscasts & Cut-Ins.
  • Must be an excellent storyteller and have the ability to craft a news story using words, pictures, sound, and graphics.
  • Excellent writing skills and copy-editing ability needed.
  • Must have proven control room experience and be able to smoothly handle live breaking news.
  • You need to be able to build a compelling newscast with high production value in a competitive environment.

 

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Newswriting, line producing, editing
  • Collaborate effectively with a wide range of personnel to create compelling content.
  • Maintain a steadfast commitment to accuracy and fairness
  • Strong Tease/Promo writing
  • Generate story ideas and participate in editorial meetings
  • Understand & use digital tools such as social media & our OTT platforms to reach viewers and deliver news.
  • At least five years’ experience, preferably in a top 20 market
  • Strong people skills.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Experience with Avid iNEWS, and Grass Valley Edius System a plus.

job.title: Photographer - PT
job.description:
PURPOSE OF POSITION

CBS News Detroit, home of CBS 62 (WWJ-TV) and CW50 (WKBD-TV) is looking for a creative, dependable visual storyteller to provide coverage for our newsroom. The photographer will cover news events and stories for CBS Detroit newscasts, CBS News Streaming, and local programming, and will support our multi-platform and social media efforts. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of NPPA and cinematic style principles, a keen eye and ear for detail, and a demonstrated body of work. Field duties include, but are not limited to, professional operation of broadcast cameras, drones, live bonded cellular transmit units, digital microwave and satellite ENG vehicles, non-linear editing systems, and IP-based broadcast applications.

 

This is a temporary position used to cover daily assignments, breaking news, and other field needs. Days and hours are scheduled as needed and are not guaranteed.

 

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Shoot and edit news stories for air and digital platforms with strong visual storytelling, working under urgent deadlines while maintaining editorial integrity.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and experience with all aspects of ENG news coverage, including Sony HD cameras, Edius non-linear editing, ENG lighting, file-based video transfer, microwave and satellite transmission, live bonded cellular units, drones, and GoPro-style cameras.

  • Assist reporters and Multi-Skilled Journalists during live shots and on assignments as needed.

  • Safely operate company vehicles, including microwave-equipped vans and trucks, on potentially long drives in all weather conditions.

  • Maintain assigned equipment, including vehicles, cameras, lights, laptop editors, and peripheral gear, and report or initiate repairs when necessary.

  • Take extreme care to protect news equipment from theft and damage.

  • Ensure that all show production deadlines are met.

  • Contribute story ideas and production strategy in a team environment, and bring creativity and imagination to broadcast storytelling.

  • Incorporate social media and new technology into news coverage.

  • Other duties, as assigned.

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • The unpredictable nature of news often requires extending scheduled shifts on short notice.

  • Flexibility with the assigned schedule, including shifts that involve weekends, overnights, and mornings.

  • Physical ability to carry and operate a broadcast ENG camera and support gear (tripod, lights, microphones), and to carry and manipulate at least 75 lbs. of gear, set up and break down broadcast production equipment, usually alone and on tight deadlines.

  • Ability to drive company vehicles safely in all conditions, including potentially hours-long drives to and from assignments. Valid Michigan driver's license and a good driving record required.

  • Ability to communicate clearly the editorial details of stories and the logistics tied to production deadlines.

  • Ability to gather important information at news locations, with sound judgment about situational safety.

  • Must join the IBEW union if not a current member, where applicable to this position.

 

PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATION

  • Five years of experience as a news photographer and editor, preferably in a top 25 market, or at minimum a medium to large television market.

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, broadcast journalism, communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent related experience.

  • Strong non-linear editing background, including Edius, and knowledge of file-based video transfer.

  • Experience operating live bonded cellular transmit units.

  • Familiarity with the Detroit area.

  • Strong news judgment, breaking news skills, and knowledge of current events.

  • Strong computer and troubleshooting skills.

  • Drone ENG experience with FAA Part 107 certification is a plus.

  • Jib and Technical Operations Center experience is a plus.

job.description:

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

CBS LA is looking for a creative and dedicated Camera technician with great multitasking and storytelling abilities! The primary duty of this camera technician will be working with News Reporters and Producers and involves shooting quality, compelling and creative visual content. This video photographer will travel light and work quickly, and the ideal candidate should be adaptable and nimble enough to capture fleeting moments. We are seeking someone proficient in shooting, lighting, and editing who can bring compelling stories to life. 

They must possess excellent people skills, a strong work ethic, and a great outlook. A passion for storytelling is essential. The camera technician is also to respond to breaking news stories when the situation warrants. This position must be able to contribute to original reporting, enterprise stories, and have the ability to work well under pressure to make deadlines.

 

General Responsibilities:

  • Candidates must demonstrate an ability to direct lighting, set overall visual look and related technical specifications for projects, and sound as a one-person crew or as part of a team.
  • Ensure that all pictures and sounds are of the highest quality and properly recorded.
  • Work closely with Talent and Producers by providing support logistics and shot requirements.
  • Operate ENG vehicles.
  • Maintain all gear including crew vehicles, working with appropriate departments to keep all gear up to date and in working order.
  • Able to trouble-shoot quickly and effectively in a variety of circumstances.
  • Work under deadline pressure.  

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years' experience working as an ENG photographer in a large market.
  • Interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to listen and provide constructive criticism.
  • In-depth knowledge of existing and evolving newsgathering technologies.
  • Must be self-motivated, proactive, collaborative and possess a high level of creativity to tell stories with sound and images.
  • Experience in logistics, special event planning and execution.  

Requirements:

  • Must have a valid US driver's license with unrestricted ability to drive. 
  •  Must have valid US passport and the unrestricted ability to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to lift 50 plus lbs. of newsgathering equipment. 
  • Must be available to work weekends, long hours or varying shifts when necessary to meet production and broadcast deadlines in all kinds of possible weather conditions.
  • Travel for production (hostile environments are possible. Training provided). Proficient with streaming technologies Dejero and LiveU.
  • Able to travel for assignments that could last days or weeks and abroad. Applicants must provide a link to examples of their recent work.

job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering (45445) 

 

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead our ShortForm & Video Intelligence pod. This team is in charge of a critical mission: the automated transformation of our massive long-form content library into "ShortForm" assets—high-impact clips, "gists," and social-ready highlights. You will lead the development of the models that "watch" our content to identify narrative hooks, emotional climaxes, and key characters to create compelling bite-sized experiences.

 

This is a deeply technical leadership role requiring mastery of multi-modal machine learning. You will oversee the creation of intelligence layers that perform video safety analysis (nudity/profanity detection), spoiler detection, and sophisticated narrative comprehension. Your work ensures that our ShortForm content is not only engaging but also safe, contextually precise, and optimized for discovery across the Paramount ecosystem.

 

The ShortForm pod unlocks the value of our entire catalog. In this role, you will directly shape:

 

  • The "Gist" Ecosystem: Building the engine that generates short-form previews, allowing users to "snack" on content before committing to a full watch.
  • Platform Safety & Integrity: Owning the "Video Intelligence" filters that protect our brand and users through automated detection of sensitive or restricted content.
  • Narrative AI: Transitioning beyond simple metadata to a world where AI understands story arcs, character importance, and "viral" moments within a film or episode. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Lead the ShortForm Pod: Define the technical roadmap for automated clip generation and video insight, managing a high-performing pod of ML engineers.
  • Architect Multi-Modal Models: Design and deploy models that synthesize signals across video (pixels), audio (speech/music), and text (transcripts/scripts) to understand content context.
  • Own Video Intelligence: Develop and scale robust computer vision and audio classifiers for nudity, profanity, and sensitive content detection.
  • Advance Narrative Understanding: Build models that can identify "hooks," "climax points," and "narrative summaries" to automate the creation of trailers and highlights.
  • Spoiler & Context Detection: Create intelligence layers that identify plot-critical "spoilers" to ensure ShortForm assets don't ruin the viewing experience for new users.
  • Scalable Content Pipelines: Partner with Content Engineering to integrate these models into petabyte-scale video processing workflows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 6-8+ years of experience in machine learning, with a heavy focus on Computer Vision (CV) and Multi-Modal architectures.
  • Deep Learning Expertise: Mastery of PyTorch or TensorFlow, specifically for video-based tasks (e.g., Video Transformers, 3D CNNs). Video Intelligence: Proven experience building safety/moderation models (Nudity, Profanity, Hate Speech) or content-tagging systems.
  • Leadership: Experience leading senior technical teams and translating complex "creative" goals into engineering requirements.
  • Video Tech Stack: Knowledge of video processing frameworks (FFmpeg) and handling various codecs/resolutions at scale.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience with Generative AI for Video (automated editing or style transfer).
  • Background in NLP/Speech for sync-ing transcripts with video frames.
  • Knowledge of Narrative Theory or experience in the media/entertainment industry.
  • Experience deploying large-scale models in Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) with high GPU utilization efficiency.

job.description:

  Entertainment Tonight is looking for a sharp, pop-culture-obsessed Production Assistant to join our news desk. This is an entry-level role built for someone who's ready to work hard, learn fast, and grow inside the #1 entertainment news brand in the world.  

Overview:

The core of this role is news desk support. Most days, that means building folders — ingesting footage, pulling assets, and organizing everything a producer needs to write a piece. But the best PAs bring editorial instincts to that work. If you're deep in a folder on a breaking story and you spot a vault clip that just became gold, we need you to recognize it and flag it. That awareness is what separates a good PA from a great one.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You'll be assigned to the ET news desk, where you'll be the link between raw footage and finished stories.
  • Media management — ingest shoot footage, log and label assets, and build organized folders that segment producers can write directly from
  • Transcription — turn celebrity interviews and field shoots into accurate, usable transcripts on deadline
  • Asset coordination — pull b-roll, photos, social clips, and archival material; track rights and credits
  • Producer support — research, fact checks, and content prep across broadcast, digital, and social
  • Rundown meeting prep — pull and assemble daily photo docs with pap and social images to support editorial planning
  • Field and studio assistance — crew support, errands, and on-the-ground help when shoots need an extra set of hands
  • Cross-department coverage — pitch in where the show needs you

 

Qualifications:

  • You live and breathe pop culture — you can name every famous face in a crowded shot
  • You're fast, accurate, and organized under pressure
  • You communicate clearly and work well with a team
  • You have sharp editorial instincts — you know the difference between a great sound bite and a throwaway line
  • Degree or internship in TV, film, or a related field is a plus, not a requirement
  • Must pass a short celebrity knowledge quiz

 

 

CBS Media Ventures is the preeminent company in television syndication. CMV produces or distributes popular, critically acclaimed hits including “Dr. Phil,” “Judge Judy,” “Entertainment Tonight,” “Wheel of Fortune,” “Jeopardy!,” “Inside Edition,” “Rachael Ray” and “The Drew Barrymore Show.”

The division also handles national barter advertising sales for Debmar-Mercury's and Fox's first-run syndicated programming, and operates Dabl, a multiplatform, advertiser-supported lifestyle network (www.dabl.com). CMV is part of CBS Entertainment Group and a division of Paramount Global.

job.title: SAMMA Digitizer
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS Evening News, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Project Overview

The CBS News & Stations archive is one of the world’s largest and most valuable collections of its kind. Housing millions of original assets dating back to before the 1950s, it represents an extraordinary record of American history, journalism, culture, and broadcast media.

 

CBS News & Stations has launched a major initiative to digitize, catalog, and enrich more than 3 million film reels, videotapes, and audio reels. This initiative includes one of the largest robotic tape digitization operations in existence, paired with cloud-based systems and AI-supported metadata workflows operating at significant scale.

 

SAMMA is CBS News Archives’ robotic tape digitization system. It is used to migrate legacy videotape formats into digital files as part of the broader preservation and access initiative.

 

Position Summary

CBS News Archives is seeking SAMMA Digitization Operators to support this large-scale archive digitization initiative. These roles are part of the end-to-end digitization workflow, with an initial emphasis on preparing archival videotape media for migration through SAMMA digitization systems.

 

Primary responsibilities will initially include tape preparation, barcode application, tape identification, metadata entry, sorting, staging, workflow tracking, and ensuring a steady supply of prepared tapes for digitization. As operational needs evolve and training progresses, SAMMA Digitization Operators may also be assigned to operate SAMMA digitization systems, monitor ingest workflows, troubleshoot routine workflow issues, perform quality-control checks, and support related archive digitization activities, including film preparation and film digitization workflows.

 

The ideal candidates are detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable following specific workflows, and able to work carefully with physical media and metadata entry. Prior experience with broadcast archives, videotape formats, film handling, digitization, media asset management systems, or production operations is helpful, but not required if candidates are organized, trainable, and consistent.

 

Location, Hours, and Compensation

  • These positions are based onsite at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ.
  • Expected schedule is 40 hours per week. Hours may include nights and weekends depending on operational needs.
  • Hourly rate: $26.44 per hour, equivalent to $54,995.20 annually based on a 40-hour workweek.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end archive digitization workflow, with an initial focus on SAMMA tape preparation and staging.
  • Prepare, barcode, label, sort, organize, and stage videotape media for digitization.
  • Enter and verify identifying metadata, including tape IDs, station IDs, dates, and other available information.
  • Follow established workflows for preparing Beta, U-matic, DVCPro, XDCAM, and other legacy videotape formats.
  • Identify and escalate unclear labels, missing metadata, damaged media, equipment concerns, or workflow questions.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of prep, staging, digitization, and workflow status.
  • Support daily production goals by ensuring media is prepared and available for digitization.
  • As trained and assigned, operate SAMMA robotic tape digitization systems and monitor digitization workflows.
  • Perform basic workflow checks and quality-control steps to confirm successful completion of assigned tasks.
  • As trained and assigned, support film preparation and film digitization workflows, including inspection, labeling, documentation, staging, and scanner support.
  • Handle videotape, film, and related archival media carefully to prevent damage or misplacement.
  • Follow all safety, handling, and operational procedures in the archive workspace.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions carefully.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive but detail-sensitive work.
  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and use of web-based tools or spreadsheets.
  • Ability to read handwritten and printed labels and transcribe information accurately.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work independently once trained, while escalating questions when needed.
  • Comfortable handling physical media, boxes, labels, barcode scanners, and digitization-related equipment.
  • Ability to stand, sit, bend, and move throughout the workday as needed.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes of videotapes or film materials, typically up to approximately 25–35 lbs.
  • Availability to work onsite in Metropark/Iselin, NJ, including nights and weekends as operational needs require.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in archives, broadcast, libraries, records management, digitization, post-production, or a related media environment.
  • Familiarity with legacy media formats, including videotape and/or motion picture film.
  • Experience with barcode workflows, inventory systems, asset management systems, or media tracking tools.
  • Experience operating or supporting digitization, ingest, playback, scanning, or media migration systems.
  • Comfort working in a production-focused environment with daily throughput goals.
  • Interest in archive preservation, legacy media, and digitization workflows.

 

Skills and Attributes

  • Highly organized and methodical.
  • Patient and careful with legacy media.
  • Comfortable asking questions when instructions or media labels are unclear.
  • Able to maintain focus and accuracy over long periods of repetitive work.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Team-oriented, but capable of working independently.
  • Flexible and willing to adapt as workflows evolve.
  • Willing to be trained across multiple parts of the tape and film digitization workflows.

 

Work Environment

  • These positions are based onsite in an archive/digitization operations environment at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ. The work involves handling physical videotape, film, and related archival media; applying or scanning barcodes; entering metadata; staging media for digitization; operating or supporting SAMMA digitization workflows; supporting film prep and digitization workflows; and coordinating with Archives staff and digitization operators.
  • The roles support a high-volume digitization operation, so consistency, accuracy, dependability, and careful handling of archival media are critical.

 

Training

  • Training will be provided on CBS News Archives’ specific SAMMA workflows, barcode procedures, tape identification rules, prep and staging processes, digitization procedures, film preparation workflows, film handling procedures, and escalation processes for unclear, unknown, damaged, or problematic media.
  • Initial training and assignments may focus primarily on SAMMA tape preparation and staging. As employees demonstrate proficiency and as operational needs require, additional training may be provided for SAMMA digitization operation, workflow monitoring, basic troubleshooting, quality-control procedures, film preparation, and film digitization support.
  • Additional training and/or certification opportunities may be available as related workflows and partnerships continue to develop.

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist who is excited to build ML products that shape business strategy, optimize content, inform marketing investment decisions, and enhance the user experience. You will leverage rich datasets such as video and ads consumption, clickstream activity, subscription history, and 2nd/3rd party data to build user- and session-level causal and predictive models. Key applications include identifying the drivers of retention, quantifying the impact of high-value user actions, forecasting content viewership, developing user segmentations for cohort-based targeting, and surfacing opportunities to enhance the user experience. Success in this role requires a solid foundation in Python and SQL, comfort writing production-quality code in a collaborative environment, effective communication skills, and a willingness to continuously learn new tools and techniques.  
Your Day-to-Day:  
  • Translate complex business problems into coherent, actionable quantitative solutions.
  • Implement, automate, and maintain reliable, performant, and end-to-end ML systems using software engineering and MLOps best practices.
  • Deliver clear, impactful insights to stakeholders through effective communication.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the Product org to operationalize data science solutions that inform strategy and optimize the user experience.
  • Promote best practices across the data science and product analytics team.
  • Key Projects:
    • Leverage 1st / 2nd / 3rd party data to build global models that predict user behavior throughout their subscription journey (e.g., sign-up, churn)
    • Build models to identify and measure high-value user actions and drivers of habit formation.
    • Develop session-level predictions to uncover user intent at the start of a session.
    • Build models to predict content viewership and identify content traits that resonate most with each subscriber.
    • Create user segmentations that enable meaningful cohort-based targeting and support near- personalized experiences.
    • Perform diagnostic analyses such as evaluation of failed searches to surface opportunities for product improvement. 
  Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience in Data Science and ML Engineering.
  • MS or Ph.D in Statistics/Data Science/Computer Science or related disciplines with specialization in machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with both supervised and unsupervised learning methodologies.
  • Full stack experience in data collection, aggregation, analysis, visualization, productionalization, and monitoring of data science products.
  • Familiarity with well-known  statistical and ML models and methods.
  • Ability to innovate without over-engineering.
  • Communicate concisely and assertively with a wide variety of stakeholders.
  • Strong detail orientation with a penchant for data accuracy.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience using Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, ML Engine, and APIs).
  • Experience with integrating AI solutions into existing business processes.

job.description:

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group consists of subject matter experts that prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products; assess, aggregate, and analyze data; and shape qualitative and quantitative based narratives and insights, providing stakeholders with decision support, performance clarity and business driving recommendations.

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Senior Director will report into the VP of User Lifecycle Analytics, and will support a wide range of initiatives, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives and Finance. This role requires the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, an inquisitive nature, attention to detail, and a passion for media, ideally with experience in analyzing user journeys and advanced causal inference frameworks.

This role owns two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to encourage it? 
  2. How are optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey impacting the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and lead causal inference frameworks (quasi-experimental methods, uplift modeling, instrumental variables, matching, diff-in-diff). Find what truly drives retention and value.
  • Work with Lifecycle Marketing and Product to turn causal findings into clear levers. These span content, onboarding, pricing, and promos to improve subscriber health.
  • Own how we link content and journey optimization to outcomes like ARPU, survival, and LTV.
  • Design, launch, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, involvement, win-back). Use sound design. Deliver clear results.
  • Build and keep LTV and survival models with the causal drivers above. Finance and DTC teams can then use them.
  • Lead subscriber journey mapping. Find where levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promos) drive the most causal impact on retention and monetization.
  • Run pricing and promo analyses to shape pricing and promo design. Weigh short-term conversion against long-term value.
  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical teams, like DTC leaders and Finance.
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of data scientists and analysts. Set technical standards and review methods.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Product Analytics. Keep the data systems for causal analysis (experiment platforms, behavioral and billing data) reliable.
  • Share findings with senior leaders to shape the roadmap. Guide where we invest across Marketing, Product, and Finance.

 

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Computer Science).
  • 10+ years in data science/analytics. This covers hands-on and team-leading work. It spans causal inference methods (diff-in-diff, propensity matching, instrumental variables, uplift modeling, synthetic control).
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments at scale, handling common pitfalls (novelty and network effects, selection bias).
  • Built or run LTV, survival, or churn models. Turned them into financial metrics (ARPU, retention curves).
  • Strong SQL skills and a stats language (Python or R) for causal modeling.
  • A proven track record leading and growing a team of data scientists or analysts.
  • A clear communicator who can present complex work to senior leaders and shape decisions.
  • Experience working across Marketing, Product, and Finance teams.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Know pricing awareness/elasticity work. Design smart promos.
  • Skilled in subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Skilled in Bayesian or ML-based causal techniques (e.g., double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

As the Senior Director, Paid Media Performance, you will develop strategic recommendations and own performance for paid user acquisition of paid media across search, social and programmatic channels, as well as programmatic/DSP investment for the full Paramount+ title portfolio. You will help shape the vision, in partnership with senior leadership, for how paid media drives efficient, scalable subscriber and engagement growth. Directing multiple large campaigns across genres and translating business goals into channel strategy, audience approach, and measurable performance targets.   You will lead and develop a team of paid media specialists across search, social and programmatic disciplines, while also managing media partner relationships and multi-million dollar media budgets across channels.   This is a senior leadership role accountable for results across multiple campaigns, channels, and disciplines. Requiring solid people leadership, sound judgment on decisions that carry real business risk, and the ability to drive priorities and influence direction across the organization.   This is an on-site position, based at our New York City office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Develop and execute the paid media acquisition strategy across paid search, social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic/DSP channels (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, Samsung DSP), aligning channel and audience approach to the business goals across all genres.
  • Own CPA and efficiency targets across the portfolio and across channels (e.g., sports, drama, reality, and service titles), continually optimizing tactics, media mix, and audience targeting to scale acquisition cost-effectively.
  • Lead development of audience targeting and consolidation strategy across search, social and programmatic, including genre-level segmentation and cross-platform/cross-channel audience consolidation, to improve scale and efficiency.
  • Lead activation of incrementality and platform/channel performance testing in partnership with internal testing teams.
  • Provide feasibility guidance on the testing roadmap across social and programmatic, turning learnings into action.
  • Own media recommendations and launch support for key title releases and seasonal tentpoles across channels, ensuring the full paid media mix is positioned to deliver against goals.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the paid media team across social and programmatic disciplines, setting priorities, standards, and clear expectations to build a robust, high-performing function.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal marketing teams and senior leadership on budget, reporting, and strategic decisions, and represent paid search, social and programmatic in broader team planning.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in paid media/digital performance marketing across paid search, social and programmatic channels, with 5+ years of people management experience leading teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and drive priorities for multiple large paid media programs across paid search, social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic DSPs (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, TTD), with deep, hands-on channel expertise.
  • Hands-on experience planning, executing, and optimizing programmatic campaigns within at least one major DSP. Experience with audience and inventory targeting, bid strategy, and PMPs/private marketplace deals.
  • Deep track record owning CPA and efficiency targets and managing large media budgets across channels and formats to performance goals.
  • Experience developing audience strategy, testing for incrementality, and platform/channel testing, and using measurement to inform decisions.
  • Exemplary cross-functional leadership and communication skills. With experience partnering with marketing, strategy, and senior stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment on decisions that carry business risk, and the ability to recommend resourcing and staffing to meet objectives.
  • Solid data and analytics fluency, including comfort with platform/DSP reporting, BI tools, and experimentation or measurement frameworks to turn performance data into decisions.
  • Hands-on platform experience across social and/or programmatic and a working command of the day-to-day execution the team performs, while now leading strategy rather than executing in-platform.
  • Experience in entertainment, streaming, or media/subscription businesses.
  • Experience with social ad management/ad-serving platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Smartly, CM360) and/or programmatic DSPs beyond DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, and Samsung DSP (e.g., The Trade Desk, StackAdapt).
  • Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana).
  • Relevant platform or DSP certifications (e.g., Meta Blueprint, DV360 Certification) or equivalent.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Exemplary writing, copy-editing and communication skills
  • Experience supervising or providing editorial direction to writers
  • Experience with ENPS or a comparable newsroom computer system
  • This is a fully in-person position based in the control room

  • Ability to work accurately and effectively under tight deadlines
