job.title: Senior Internal Auditor, Risk and Analytics
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!


Overview and Responsibilities   The Senior Staff, Risk & Analytics, Internal Audit supports the delivery of data‑driven insights, risk‑based audits, and advisory work across the company. This role involves advanced analytics and operational audits. It also includes investigations, risk assessments, and special projects. These activities help the business operate successfully in a fast-changing media and entertainment environment. The Senior collaborates with the Internal Audit executive team, business stakeholders, and cross‑functional teams to evaluate processes, governance, and internal controls. The role requires comfort working with complex and imperfect data, applying sound judgment, and designing analytics that address real business questions. Engagements may include operational reviews, T&E audits, production audits, management‑requested reviews, and other advisory initiatives.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Support planning and execution of risk‑based analytics for audits, advisory engagements, and special projects
  • Develop project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments focused on key business priorities
  • Design approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring professional judgment
  • Evaluate process efficiency, controls, and governance; identify opportunities to reduce friction and improve accountability
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in a high‑growth or transformational area
  • Perform advanced data analysis to support audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze large datasets (e.g., production costs, T&E spend, payroll, vendor payments, advertising revenue) to identify trends and emerging risks
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics
  • Use dashboards and visuals to share insights. Prepare presentations for audience members who are not technical
  • Support management‑requested projects through data collection, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Collect, validate, and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources
  • Present insights through PowerPoint, dashboards, and other visualization tools
  • Build robust working relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners (SOX, Compliance, Finance, Legal)
  • Communicate results clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact
  • Provide useful, business‑aligned recommendations and involve remediation plans when needed
  • Maintain self-reliance and objectivity while serving as a trusted advisor
  • Contribute to the annual risk assessment and audit plan
  • Support continuous improvement of audit methodologies and analytics capabilities
  • Act as a thought partner on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends
  • Informally mentor less‑experienced team members

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related field
  • Robust knowledge of operational risk, internal controls, audit methodologies, and risk management
  • Experience executing analytics‑driven operational reviews (e.g., T&E, production, vendor payments, revenue processes)
  • Demonstrated ability to examine large, complex, and unstructured datasets and derive meaningful insights
  • Proficiency with analytics and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, ACL, or similar)
  • Expert‑level skills in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Solid organizational and project‑management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and critical‑thinking abilities
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field

 

Additional Qualifications
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred
  • Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA (active or in progress) preferred
  • Knowledge with ERM frameworks and regulatory compliance considerations
  • Ability to build trust, influence others, and work skillfully across teams and levels
  • Self‑starter with well-developed effort and the ability to learn quickly
  • Enlightened curiosity and excitement for solving complex, ambiguous problems
  • Solid interpersonal skills, including the ability to manage up, down, and across teams
  • Experience mentoring team members and reviewing work in a high‑expectation environment
  • Well-developed research skills with the ability to synthesize and present findings succinctly
  • Comfort using AI‑enabled tools and advanced analytics to support research and professional judgment.

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview   We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our multimodal embedding and retrieval systems that power content discovery across Paramount's video library. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of multi-modal embedding systems, optimized for text and video understanding, from generation, ingestion and indexing, to retrieval — directly impacting how millions of users discover and engage with short-form clips.   You will partner with product leadership, Content and Personalization engineering teams, mentor engineers and serve as a senior technical voice shaping how the platform "sees" and retrieves video clip content at scale.   The ideal candidate will be:
  • A hands-on systems builder who takes full ownership of pipelines that enable storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings
  • Skilled at designing hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity, lexical search, and reranking
  • Invested in multimodal video understanding as the foundation for meaningful content representations
  • Skilled at translating embedding system tradeoffs — latency, recall, cost — into product-relevant context that drives cross-functional decisions
  • Committed to mentoring and knowledge sharing with engineering resources
  • Effective at operating in a dynamic environment and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes end-to-end


Responsibilities

Video Understanding & Multimodal Embedding

  • Design and build embedding pipelines for video content metadata and clip-level representation
  • Design collection and vector schemas to shape data structure, indexing behavior, and retrieval performance under scale and modality complexity
  • Lead the transition from traditional feature engineering to a vector-centric "context-first" architecture, through compositional queries and by designing high-dimensional hyper-vector representations that unify visual, textual, and behavioral signals
  • Design offline/online evaluation frameworks (e.g., nDCG, MRR, Recall@K) specifically for multimodal alignment, ensuring content embeddings match search intent
  Vector Search & Retrieval Infrastructure
  • Build hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity search with lexical search and reranking layers to deliver fast, accurate, and scalable performance at production scale
  • Engineer the retrieval layer to capture nuanced user-content relationships that model training alone cannot surface, combining multimodal embeddings to improve recommendation depth at scale
  • Implement query-time optimizations including caching, filtering, and index sharding strategies
  • Tune vector quantization strategies (PQ, SQ, Binary Quantization) to reduce memory footprint and improve search throughput without compromising retrieval precision
  • Own performance SLAs and monitor retrieval systems for latency, throughput, recall, and cost efficiency
  Production Systems, Pipeline Engineering & APIs
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines, with logging, metrics, and alerting to surface anomalies and maintain observability
  • Process content at scale using distributed frameworks such as Spark or Ray
  • Architect and build scalable integration layers on top of vector databases, exposing robust APIs and services for similarity search, hybrid retrieval, and metadata filtering
  • Own model versioning and embedding migration strategies, building compatibility tooling that prevents embedding drift from degrading retrieval quality across model upgrades
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure interoperability with upstream data pipelines and integration with downstream personalization and discovery surfaces
  Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Communicate technical system behavior, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor direct reports, providing technical guidance in multimodal ML, vector retrieval, and production systems design
  • Take ownership of project outcomes from scoping through delivery in a dynamic environment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across video processing, metadata, and indexing workflows


Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on production ML systems
  • Expertise in multimodal ML, including experience with video, image, and/or audio embedding models
  • Deep knowledge of vector embedding generation, storage and retrieval, with preference for hands-on Qdrant experience (FAISS, Pinecone, Pgvector, AlloyDB or similar also considered)
  • Strong Python proficiency; Java is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines at scale, including batch and streaming ingestion workflows
  • Solid understanding of hybrid retrieval systems: vector search, lexical search, and reranking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and partner effectively with product and engineering teams
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions in a team setting


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Knowledge of Diversity & Relevance algorithms such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) within the re-ranking phase
  • Background in video codecs, FFmpeg, or low-level video processing pipelines
  • Awareness with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

job.description:

Overview

 We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational layer around our personalization and recommendation Machine Learning (ML) systems. Our models retrain and deploy daily on automated pipelines. Your job is to make sure we can trust what's running, know when something is off, and fix it fast. You'll sit within DevOps and work closely with ML engineers, who own the models end-to-end. You won't be building infrastructure from scratch, you'll partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to get the tooling you need, then own it day-to-day.

What You'll Do
  • Own model traceability: Every model in production should have clear lineage: what data trained it, what code produced it, what validation it passed, and how it's performing. Evaluate and recommend tooling for versioning, metadata, and model registry, and work with MLEs to drive adoption.
  • Build end-to-end monitoring: Monitor the full signal path: data arrival, feature distribution stability, model metrics, and serving latency against SLA. Own this individually, don't rely solely on upstream teams to catch their own issues.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality: Collaborate to surface data quality issues, detect drift in upstream sources, and ensure features stay fresh and reliable.
  • Detect issues proactively: Track drift over weeks, flag slow degradation before it crosses a threshold, surface feature freshness problems before they cascade.
  • Build diagnostic tooling: When something goes wrong, get from "recommendations look off" to root cause in minutes. That means ensuring the right context is logged at each stage, candidates, features, serving context, and building the dashboards to tie it collectively.
  • Own incident response for ML systems: Maintain rollback playbooks and pre-defined hotfix strategies with quantified tradeoffs. Own automated gates that block bad deployments. Run post-mortems and close the gaps.
  • Coordinate on post-deployment metrics: Work with ML engineers, data engineers, and stakeholders to define what metrics to collect after deployment and why they matter.


Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years in ML engineering, applied ML, or a related ML role, with demonstrated experience on the operational side of monitoring, reliability, deployment, or incident response
  • Has built or operated model registries, ML monitoring systems, or production ML pipelines
  • Understands ML systems end-to-end — not just the infra layer, but why a stale feature or a shifted distribution matters
  • Robust SQL skills and comfort digging into data distributions, feature health, and model behavior
  • Comfortable partnering with DevOps and Platform teams to define infrastructure needs without needing to own the infra yourself


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation or personalization systems at scale

job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview
We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer (IC3) to join the Platform Engineering pod. Your mission is to build the Agentic Systems Platform—the runtime environment where autonomous agents live, reason, and collaborate. You will lead the development of the MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway, routing logic, and the orchestration support required for multi-agent personalization systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional ML serving and autonomous agency. You will lead the design of agentic runtimes using GKE and Apigee, utilizing the ADK (Agent Development Kit) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocols to enable complex workflows. Your challenge is to manage the "thinking time" and cognitive overhead of agentic systems, ensuring they remain responsive and cost-effective in a production environment.

Why This Role Matters

  • Architecting Agency: You are building the foundation for our shift from passive models to active, reasoning agents.
  • Governance & Routing: Your work on the MCP Gateway ensures that agents can safely access the tools and context they need to perform their tasks.
  • Collaborative Intelligence: By mastering A2A orchestration, you enable a new class of multi-agent applications that solve problems individual models cannot.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Platform Design: Architect the production runtime for agentic systems, focusing on low-latency tool-use and state management.
  • Own the MCP Gateway: Design and implement the routing and security layer for agentic tool-use via Apigee.
  • Standardize Agentic Workflows: Develop orchestration patterns using ADK and A2A that are adopted by pods across the AMLG.
  • Performance Management: Monitor and optimize agentic "thinking" cycles to balance reasoning depth with production latency constraints.
  • Mitigate System Risks: Proactively identify and fix failure modes unique to agentic systems (e.g., tool-use loops or context window overflows).

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–8+ years in MLOps or Platform Engineering
  • Experience with API Gateways (Apigee) and K8s (GKE)
  • Background in Agentic Orchestration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with A2A protocols
  • Experience managing long-running stateful workflows

Summary

The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Sr. Data Engineering Manager to lead the strategy, design, delivery, and operational excellence of large-scale batch and real-time data platforms. This role will oversee multiple data engineering teams that power analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization.
You will guide the design and implementation of distributed data systems. This includes ETL and ELT pipelines. You will also work with streaming platforms, warehouse ecosystems, and cloud-native infrastructure.

As a manager, you will shape technical direction, develop engineering talent, and ensure production-grade reliability, scalability, and operational rigor across data platforms.This role requires deep expertise in modern data architectures, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering, plus proven experience leading multiple teams and managing managers or senior ICs.

Key Responsibilities


Lead & Scale Data Engineering Teams
•    Manage and develop a team of data engineers in charge of batch and streaming data systems.
•    Drive technical execution across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and serving layers.
•    Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and architectural review processes.
•    Mentor engineers in distributed systems design, performance optimization, and production reliability.
•    Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

Architect Scalable Data Platforms
•    Ensure scalable data modeling standards and efficient query performance across analytical workloads.
•    Help with important architectural choices. This includes orchestration. It also covers schema evolution. Additionally, it involves partitioning strategies and storage optimization.
•    Partner with streaming engineers to align batch and real-time data patterns into cohesive platform designs.
•    Ensure the platform is reliable by focusing on solid operational practices. This involves managing SLAs, monitoring performance, responding to incidents, and planning for capacity.


Cross-Functional Collaboration
•    Partner closely with Data Product Management to align roadmap priorities, SLAs, and platform KPIs.
•    Collaborate with software engineers to integrate streaming systems, APIs, and microservices into the broader data ecosystem.
•    Clearly explain architectural tradeoffs to stakeholders. Also, discuss delivery risks and operational constraints..


Technical Leadership
•    Lead architectural reviews and drive long-term platform strategy.
•    Foster a culture of ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
•    Stay current with evolving technologies and industry trends in cloud data platforms, distributed systems, and AI data infrastructure.



Required Skills & Experience


Modern Data Architecture
•    Strong expertise in data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
•    Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks, orchestration platforms, and distributed data processing systems.
•    Solid knowledge of Kafka-based architectures and event-driven data patterns.
•    You should be skilled in orchestration frameworks. You should have experience with workflow automation. Additionally, you should know how to manage production-grade pipelines.
•    Experience building and operating cloud-native data platforms in AWS, GCP, or OCI environments.


Distributed Systems & Scalability
•    Strong foundation in distributed systems engineering, scalability patterns, resiliency design, and high-availability architectures.
•    Experience optimizing performance, throughput, latency, and cost efficiency across large-scale data workloads.
•    Proficient in containerized infrastructure and Kubernetes with knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code and modern deployment practices.

Team Development & Coaching
•    Proven experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining high-performing engineers across varying seniority levels.
•    Strong coaching, mentoring, and able to manage performance effectively
•    Committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture that is also accountable.

Execution & Delivery Leadership
•    Strong sprint planning, capacity modeling, and roadmap sequencing skills.
•    Ability to manage competing priorities across reliability, feature delivery, and technical debt reduction.
•    Experience establishing engineering KPIs such as reliability, latency, throughput, and deployment frequency.

 

Qualifications
•    7 - 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or platform engineering roles, with at least 5+ years of direct engineering management experience.
•    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
•    Proven experience leading engineering teams delivering large-scale production data platforms.
•    Strong foundation in distributed systems engineering and cloud-native architecture.
•   You must have well-developed communication skills. You should be good at working with different teams.
•    You should be self-motivated and focused on quality. You must also dedicate yourself to engineering excellence and maintain solid operational discipline.

  Senior Software Engineer, CMS Platform Paramount Streaming • Technology & Engineering   Location: Burbank, CA / New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA • Full-Time (onsite)  

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, CMS to build and own the web experiences at the heart of our content management platform - shipping high-quality code across a polyglot stack that powers Paramount+, Pluto TV, and CBS.com. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: you'll spend most of your time crafting fast, resilient, server-rendered React applications, and you'll own features end to end - from the component layer down through the APIs and data model that back them; along with event driven messaging for external integrations.

 

Motivational Fit

 

·You'll become the person the team turns to on frontend architecture and web performance, lead small-to-medium projects from design through production, and mentor other engineers.

·You care about how things feel for users and how maintainable they are for the engineers who come after you.

·You are driven to improve code quality, developer experience and team processes

 

Responsibilities

 

•     Build and evolve server-rendered React applications: design high-quality, accessible, performant UIs with Next.js and modern React, with server-side rendering (SSR) at the core of how we deliver fast first-load experiences at streaming scale.

•     Own component architecture: establish and champion clean, reusable component patterns and shared design conventions that scale across the codebase and keep the team moving quickly.

•     Drive web performance: measure and improve Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, bundle size, caching, and load performance — and set the standards other engineers follow.

•     Deliver features end to end: design complete solutions that span the frontend and the services behind it — building and evolving REST APIs in Java/Spring Boot and modeling the data with PostgreSQL (entities, schema, migrations) that power those experiences.

•     Develop the API and data layer: build the Node.js and Spring Boot service layers that connect the frontend to the platform, with an eye to clean contracts and clear boundaries that also supports external clients through messaging.

•     Improve developer experience and quality: raise the bar on testing, observability, tooling, and team processes — making the whole team faster, the codebase healthier and reduce technical debt

•     Ownership: take ownership of small to medium projects from design through production, coach colleagues, and help codify expertise — including clear, agent-readable docs and conventions — so both people and AI agents can ramp quickly.

•     Mentorship: mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing including effective AI-augmented workflows

•     Collaboration: collaborate with stakeholders and partner teams to ensure seamless integrations and cohesive experiences

•     Participate in on-call rotations, incident resolution and RCAs

•     Help grow the team through interviewing and onboarding new members


Required Qualifications

 

 

•     BS in Comp Science or related field, or equivalent applicable experience

•     5+ years of professional software engineering experience

•     Strong React expertise, with production experience building server-rendered applications (SSR) using Next.js or a similar framework.

•     Deep frontend fundamentals: component architecture, TypeScript, state management, and a genuine command of web performance and accessibility.

•     Full-stack range: comfort building the services behind the UI — Node.js and/or Java/Spring Boot REST APIs — and modeling data in a relational database such as PostgreSQL (entities, schema design, migrations).

•     End-to-end ownership: a track record of taking features from design through production, and the judgment to make sound architectural tradeoffs across the stack.

•     Senior-level collaboration: strong communication, a habit of mentoring, and the ability to set patterns others adopt.

•     Technical writing: comfort producing clear design documentation and conventions.

 

Preferred

 

•     Strong exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, AWS etc.)

•     Good experience with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and DevOps/CICD practices & tools

•     Experience with message brokers (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub) / event driven messaging systems

•     Experience with search tools like Solr and Elasticsearch

 

Nice-to-Have

 

     Familiarity with content management domains, media/streaming, or other high-traffic consumer platforms.

 

How We Work

 

AI is part of how we build every day, and we expect our engineers to be fluent with it. This is core to the role, not a bonus.

 

Required:

 

•     Daily fluency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot — we provide licenses). Agents draft, you direct and review. You know how to prompt effectively, when to trust the output, and how to catch what it gets wrong.

•     Judgment over autopilot: you review agent-generated code critically, hold the quality bar, and can explain your reasoning. As a senior engineer, you'll help shape how the team uses these tools well — encoding conventions, setting review patterns for agent-generated code, and mentoring juniors on           judgment.

•     Exposure to building agentic workflows developing systems where AI agents take on multi-step tasks with the right guardrails.

•     Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar approaches for connecting AI agents to tools, data, and services.

•     Exposure to multi-agent orchestration and emerging agentic patterns.

 

Why Join

 

You'll work on web experiences seen by millions, on a team that pairs a strong frontend craft culture with real full-stack ownership and an AI-native way of building. We provide the tools, the licenses, and the room to shape how modern web engineering is done at one of the industry's most recognizable brands.

Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This role requires robust Java engineering skills and knowledge of advanced test automation. It also needs experience in the media and streaming domain. The goal is to improve quality, reduce risk, and provide top-notch customer experiences on CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web platforms.


As a member of the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization, you will utilize our existing departmental automation framework to create and maintain automated tests across a variety of front-end clients and back-end services. You will also leverage AI-augmented development and testing practices using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.


Key Responsibilities


Create Robust & Reliable Automation Coverage across front-end and back-end
• Create and maintain automated tests using our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. 
• Utilize scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. 
• Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.


AI-Augmented Quality Engineering
• Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. 
• Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. 
• Evaluate and integrate useful AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.


Media & Multi-Platform Quality
• Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. 
• Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. 
• Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. 
• Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns.


Technical Execution
• Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. 
• Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. 
• Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.

Required Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with robust Java development expertise. 
• Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework (not building entirely new frameworks). 
• Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor or similar. 
• Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.


Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc).

• Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. 

• Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.


Key Competencies
• Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. 
• AI fluency – practical judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing.


Success Metrics
• Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs.

This individual will be based in the Chicago office and report to the Senior Director of Midwest Sales.

  • Governance & Audit Partnership: Maintain robust internal controls (SOX compliance) and serve as a primary contact for external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits.

  • Process Ownership: Take full ownership of key end-to-end accounting workflows within the Compensation scope, serving as a subject matter expert (SME).

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Experience: 2+ years of progressive post-qualification experience in general accounting, RTR, or financial controlling (Shared Services / GBS experience is a strong plus).

  • Language Skills: Business-fluent English (B2/C1 or above) with excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

  • Mindset & Ownership: A proactive problem-solver who takes initiative, manages deadlines effectively, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-evolving international setting.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to articulate financial insights clearly, build strong working relationships, and influence partners across different regions.

Why Join Skydance Budapest?

We offer a culture that values innovation, flexibility, and personal well-being. Here’s what awaits you:

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive private healthcare insurance, including annual health screening packages.

  • Flexible Benefits: Generous monthly Cafeteria plan (SZÉP Card, nursery support, housing loan support options).

  • Work-Life Harmony: Hybrid working model providing the perfect balance between home and office life.

  • Entertainment Perks: Exclusive pre-premiere movie and content screenings before public release!

  • Office Culture: A modern, dog-friendly office—bring your four-legged friend to work!

  • Perks & Continuous Learning: Weekly fresh fruit days, eyewear financial support, and company-sponsored language courses after probation.

Ready to shape the future of entertainment finance? Apply today and join our team in Budapest!

Sr. Manager Analytics Engineer, Content Data 

 

Req - 46420

 

Overview and Responsibilities

 

Paramount Streaming is a division of Paramount that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team.

DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group includes experts who create and improve data systems and products. They evaluate, combine, and analyze data. They develop insights and stories from both qualitative and quantitative data. Their work helps stakeholders make decisions. It also helps them understand performance and receive business recommendations.

 

Role Details

 

In this important role, you will develop and maintain scalable data pipelines. You will build reliable core business reasoning. You will ensure high data quality standards for content metadata. This includes titles, rights, taxonomy, and catalog data that support Paramount's streaming business.

You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, content operations, programming, licensing, and product teams. Your goal is to convert basic metadata feeds and content data into reliable datasets, dashboards, and insights. These will support decision-making for Paramount+, Pluto TV, and other Paramount streaming services.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics and wants to drive data excellence at scale. This role has people management responsibilities.

 

Responsibilities

 

Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines. These pipelines will manage content metadata like titles, rights and licensing windows, genres, talent, franchise or series hierarchies, and availability. You will work with data engineering and analytics teams. Content Metadata Modeling: Develop and improve reliable data models. These models will unify content metadata from different sources. This includes ingest, catalog management, licensing, and rights management systems. They will support detailed reporting. This reporting will be at the title, franchise, and window levels.

Data Quality: Collaborate with software and data engineering teams. Make sure the metadata is complete, precise, and consistent. This involves identifying issues such as duplicate titles, missing or conflicting rights windows, incorrect genre or talent tagging, and misclassified territories.

Performance Monitoring: Contribute to anomaly detection systems and operational dashboards that track content catalog health, metadata completeness, and data quality KPIs. Collaboration across functions is important. You will work closely with analysts. Collaborate with content operations, programming teams, licensing, and product managers. You will translate business needs into technical data solutions. Tooling & Enablement: Build scalable, performant datasets in platforms such as Databricks, Looker, and Snowflake to enable self-service analytics for content stakeholders. Documentation & Standards: Lead the creation and maintenance of clear technical documents. Set coding standards and practices for data governance. Focus on metadata taxonomy standards and ensure compliance with content rights.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, Data Engineering, or related field. 7+ years of experience in analytical engineering, data engineering, or data analytics with solid SQL and data modeling expertise.

Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT principles, data architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience building scalable data products and pipelines using tools such as Databricks, Airflow, Spark, or similar platforms. You should have direct experience with modeling and maintaining content metadata pipelines. This includes working with title catalogs, rights and windowing data. You should also be acquainted with genre and talent taxonomies, or similar structured data in entertainment or media. Proficient ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact data solutions.

Fluency in building and maintaining production-grade datasets in cloud-based data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery). Proficiency with BI tools such as Looker and Tableau, including building curated data layers and performance tuning. Solid data hygiene practices, including version control, code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Exemplary problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when reconciling metadata inconsistencies across systems.

 

Additional Qualifications

 

Experience working with content rights and licensing data, including availability windows, territory restrictions, and content lifecycle management. Knowledge with content taxonomy and classification systems used in entertainment or media. Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for data transformation or orchestration.

Knowledge with streaming media or direct-to-consumer digital products.

Experience implementing anomaly detection systems or contributing to root cause investigations for metadata issues. Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices as they relate to licensed content.

Overview
Paramount: A Skydance Corporation is seeking a Media Operations Senior Manager to join the Editorial Post Production Operations (EPPO) Media Management & Archives team within Production Technology and Operations. This role carries end-to-end ownership of media infrastructure, access, and workflow decisions supporting high-volume, multi-brand production across Paramount's global ecosystem. •    Responsible for storage and archive strategy for on-premises storage and cloud environments, including capacity planning and coordination of data migrations

•    Set up and support live and near-live production and streaming workflows (e.g., WildMoka ingest, movie recorder routing) and troubleshoot encoding and routing issues in partnership with engineering
•    Coordinate media transfer, transit, and delivery workflows across internal teams and external vendors/post houses using enterprise tools (e.g., Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera)
•    Manage relationships with media technology vendors, including feature evaluation and usage guidance for shared services and tools
•    Serve as the first point of contact for cross-brand client groups for media needs, archive/retrieval, and workflow troubleshooting

•    5+ years of experience in media management, post-production operations, or media infrastructure/IT roles supporting production, with prior coordinator-level experience preferred
•    Demonstrated experience managing storage systems, Active Directory security groups, and access provisioning in a production or enterprise media environment
•    Strong working knowledge of editorial workflows, media formats/codecs, and professional editing platforms (Avid, Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve)
•    Experience with cloud storage platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI), enterprise file transfer systems (Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera), and MAM/DAM or archive systems
•    Basic understanding of live and near-live production and streaming ingest workflows
•    Ability to make and own operational decisions for the betterment of clients, balancing the team's ability to support those decisions
•    Strong cross-functional communication skills, with experience supporting multiple brands, productions, and stakeholder groups simultaneously
•    Willingness to travel and support on-site production workflows as needed, including off-hours coverage
•    Experience managing a team

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Background in high-scale, real-time production data environments.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

  Overview Paramount Global is seeking a Technical Automation Engineer / Architect to join the Technology Operations team, focused on automation, scripting, and broadcast systems integration. You will integrate broadcast infrastructure with Skyline DataMiner and other key applications. You will also create intelligent automation using AI. This will help reduce manual operational tasks. You will use your broadcast engineering knowledge along with your experience in software automation and systems architecture. Your job will include supporting the design and operation of broadcast systems.     Responsibilities
  • Develop automation frameworks and remediation workflows. These will enhance operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability in broadcast and technology environments. The automation will enable systems to recover on their own, reducing the need for manual intervention.
  • Develop scripts and services using tools such as Python, PowerShell, and Bash to support system deployments, configuration management, monitoring, and operational processes.
  • Integrate playout systems, signal distribution, encoding, and media processing platforms with monitoring and automation platforms such as Skyline DataMiner.
  • Design and deploy monitoring, observability, and alerting dashboards that provide operational visibility across broadcast workflows in real time.
  • Implement monitoring solutions driven by system events to detect faults across video transport, playout, and distribution systems.
  • Configure and maintain alerting policies, thresholds, escalation workflows, and alarm correlation to improve root cause analysis and reduce operational noise.
  • Develop integrations using REST APIs, SNMP, webhooks, and telemetry feeds to ingest operational data into monitoring and automation platforms.
  • Build middleware, connectors, and data pipelines that normalize broadcast system telemetry for monitoring dashboards and operational tools.
  • Configure and extend Skyline DataMiner connectors and elements, including custom monitoring and data models.
  • Build dashboards, visualizations, and alarms within DataMiner based on complex engineering architectures.
  • Optimize monitoring capabilities to improve fault detection, incident response, and system observability.
  • Review the current technology architecture. Look for ways to automate tasks. Identify ways to improve performance. Find methods to enhance operations.
  • Recommend and implement system upgrades. Make improvements to the architecture. Develop strategies for automation. These changes should improve reliability and scalability.
  • Work across hardware, software, and network technologies in distributed computing and broadcast environments.
  • Work with the broadcast engineering, operations, and technology teams. The goal is to address operational and business needs. We will create technical solutions that can grow and adapt.
  • Ensure automation solutions adhere to corporate security, compliance, privacy, and governance policies.
  • Provide technical direction for the project at every stage. This includes designing the architecture, implementing it, and supporting operations.
  • Mentor team members on automation best practices, scripting methodologies, and observability tools.
  • Maintain documentation and procedures for automation workflows. Keep knowledge repositories for monitoring architectures. Manage system integrations.
  • Develop processes and tools that improve incident response, troubleshooting efficiency, and operational workflows.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and automation practices, recommending new tools and techniques where appropriate.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • A bachelor's degree is required in one of the following areas: Broadcast Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Media Technology, or Digital Media Engineering.
  • Equivalent experience of 5 to 7 or more years in broadcast engineering, NOC operations, or automation development, or applicable certifications, may be accepted in place of a degree.
  • Applicable certifications include: 1. Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications like CBNE, CBTE, or CBRE. 2. Skyline Communications DataMiner certifications such as DMA or DMS training tracks. 3. Cisco certifications such as CCNA or CCNP. 4. Cloud certifications from Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google, or Oracle.
  • Experience with Skyline DataMiner or comparable broadcast monitoring platforms.
  • Experience integrating systems using REST APIs, SNMP, webhooks, or other telemetry protocols.
  • You should have experience in developing automation scripts. You also need to have experience with monitoring tools. Additionally, experience with operational dashboards is required.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or PowerShell.
  • Knowledge with architectures driven by system events, observability, and alerting systems.
  • Experience working with containerized services, including Docker and Kubernetes, and modern automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of modern broadcast workflows, including playout automation, video encoding and transcoding, IP video transport (SMPTE 2110, NDI, and SRT), and satellite or fiber distribution.

Overview:

 

As a member of the Paramount+ Content Systems Product team, you will help shape the automation strategy for our tools and systems. These are the systems that power our global streaming experiences. What an exciting place to be! Your mission is to learn the manual, hands-on challenges of our partner teams. Then you build the right solutions to solve the right problems at the right time.

 

You will play a key role in keeping Paramount+ running efficiently. We are growing to millions of new subscribers around the world!   • Stakeholder Alignment: Bring partners in product, tech, and operations together on delivery scope. Then get set for exciting global launches!

job.description:

Overview:

 

Paramount+ streams some of the biggest live sports and events in the world, and our Live Services Product (LSP) oversees the backend platform that makes it possible. LSP provides operators with one experience through our Live Events CMS. The live services automations team supports this. They create specialized services to manage provider integrations. They also oversee orchestration, automation, and distribution. Each of these services is separate.

 

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to expand the Live Services Automation area within LSP. This includes systems that automatically process incoming live signal inputs. You will set up and manage channel infrastructure. You will also make sure that each live show element is checked and ready before it goes on air. Finally, you will consistently distribute live content to our target destinations for the Paramount+ experience.

 

This is a deeply technical, backend-first role. The Live Events CMS owns the operator-facing surface, and you own the domain logic underneath it that extends its functionality through automation with 1st party/3rd part integrations. You'll partner closely with the CMS product owner to make sure the workflows you build surface cleanly through the CMS, and you'll report to the Live Services lead on platform strategy and vision.

 

Experience with live streaming, broadcast, or real-time systems is strongly preferred. We want someone who understands the ecosystem and its challenges. They should know what works and what might fail during a live event. This knowledge will help them build systems that work well and can recover automatically. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

Own Backend Platform Strategy

 

  • Shape and ship the roadmap for the Live Services Platform. Focus on automation, workflows, and links between systems.

  • Build services that scale with every live event. Cover the full path from scheduling to playback and monitoring.

 

Drive Automation & Orchestration

 

  • Design automation that removes manual steps from live event setup.

  • Build "self-healing" workflows that boost reliability and cut extra   work.

 

Lead Integrations Across Systems

 

  • Own the links between Summit and other systems. This covers scheduling, channels, listings, signal acquisition, and monitoring.

  • Keep data flowing smoothly across internal platforms and third-party services.

 

Translate Operations into Systems

 

  • Partner with Live Operations and Engineering. Turn real-time needs into backend  solutions that scale.

  • Spot bottlenecks and design systems that run better at scale.

 

Define Technical Solutions

 

  • Write clear product docs with senior engineering and product leads. This covers API contracts, workflows, sequence diagrams, and system designs.

  • Give engineering teams clear direction on architecture, dependencies, and      integration patterns.

 

Agile Product Ownership

 

  • Act as Product Owner for a devoted engineering team.

  • Manage the backlog, set priorities, and ship deeply technical platform features.

 

Cross-Functional Management

 

  • Align stakeholders across product, engineering, and operations on backend      platform strategy and delivery.

  • Support big live event launches with systems that never miss a beat!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 2-4 years in Technical Product Management or a closely related engineering role, with hands-on depth in backend systems, APIs, and/or platform products.

  • A track record of shipping automation, orchestration, or distributed integrations.

  • You should have a solid knowledge of event-driven architecture. You should also know about workflow orchestration and contracts between services.

  • Comfort living in APIs, system links, and data flows; UI experience is not needed.

  • Well-developed technical writing: API specs, sequence diagrams, system workflows.

  • Experience owning a backlog and leading technical delivery on an Agile team.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Live streaming, live sports, or broadcast operations experience — you understand the stakes of a live event and how automation reduces them.

  • Experience integrating third-party data providers (stats, scheduling, listings, or similar feeds) into a platform via versioned contracts.

  • Knowledge of reliability patterns: retries, reconciliation and observability at scale.

Overview: 

Vice President, Office of the CFO, Analytics and Special Projects is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role within the Paramount Finance organization, serving as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the CFO. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution, ensuring the CFO’s organization runs with discipline, clarity, and focus and also leading high-priority finance special projects.   The successful candidate will combine strong financial acumen with exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills, equally comfortable leading a complex analytical workstream as running a leadership town hall. This person will act as a proxy and trusted extension of the CFO across the finance leadership team and key cross-functional partners, while also protecting the CFO’s time and ensuring the right priorities get the right attention.   This is designed to serve as a launch pad into a senior finance leadership role within the organization. The Vice President will gain direct exposure to enterprise-level strategy, financial operations, and executive decision-making, while building the relationships and credibility needed to step into a broader finance leadership position at the conclusion of the program.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic Leadership & Special Projects
  • Lead and manage high-priority finance special projects on behalf of the CFO, including strategic initiatives, cross-functional analyses, and transformation efforts.
  • Serve as a thought partner to the CFO on key business decisions, synthesizing complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Drive follow-through on strategic priorities across the finance leadership team, ensuring alignment and accountability against commitments.
  • Prepare board and executive-level briefing materials, presentations, and talking points for the CFO.
  • Support earnings, investor day, and board-related content development in partnership with Investor Relations and Corporate Finance.
Priority & Time Management
  • Serve as a gatekeeper and air-traffic controller for the CFO’s time, triaging incoming requests and ensuring the CFO’s bandwidth is focused on the highest-value priorities.
  • Exercise independent judgment on what does and does not require the CFO’s direct attention, resolving issues on his behalf where appropriate.
  • Anticipate needs and potential issues before they escalate, proactively coordinating with stakeholders to keep initiatives on track.
Organizational Leadership & Communications
  • Plan and execute finance organization town halls, all-hands meetings, and leadership offsites, including content development and logistics.
  • Own the CFO’s staff meeting cadence, setting agendas, leading follow-ups, and tracking action items to closure.
  • Serve as a central point of contact between the CFO’s office and the broader finance leadership team, as well as cross-functional partners.
  • Shape internal communications strategy for the finance organization, ensuring consistent and clear messaging.
  • Represent and speak on behalf of the CFO in select internal forums where his direct presence is not required.
Operating Rhythm & Team Effectiveness
  • Partner with the CFO’s direct reports to coordinate priorities, surface issues early, and remove roadblocks.
  • Manage the CFO’s key operating mechanisms (staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles) and maintain a scorecard of strategic priorities.
  • Partner with the CFO and Human Resources on finance organization design, headcount planning, and leadership succession considerations.
  • Work closely with Human Resources to help build and maintain a healthy team culture within the finance leadership organization.
  • Coordinate the finance organization’s initial response to urgent or sensitive issues (e.g., control matters, audit findings) in partnership with the relevant functional leaders.
  • Build relationships with Chiefs of Staff across the C-suite to keep the CFO’s agenda aligned with company-wide priorities.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10 -15 years of experience in finance, strategy, investment banking, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Strong foundation in financial analysis, corporate finance, or FP&A experience with financial planning processes preferred.
  • Prior chief of staff, strategy, or similar experience supporting a senior executive strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting board or investor-facing materials is a plus.
  • Strong technical fluency, including hands-on proficiency in SQL and familiarity with AI/automation tools and their application to finance workflows.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • High emotional intelligence and discretion; ability to build trust and exercise sound judgment across all levels of the organization.
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and representing the CFO’s perspective in his absence.

CBS Stations is looking for a dynamic and collaborative VP of Digital, Streaming and Social to steer multiplatform strategy for 15 owned and operated stations across the U.S. S/he will oversee the digital, streaming and social teams, working in close coordination with Stations leadership to find and engage new audiences while delivering on key editorial priorities for each station.

 

Your day-to-day:

  • Oversee digital, social and streaming teams in each market, providing regular guidance and best practices for each platform
  • Set and execute on a digital vision for each platform, both current and emerging
  • Collaborate with general managers and news directors in each market to activate digital teams on key priorities, both in the day-to-day and around tentpole events
  • Work with stations teams on-the-ground to develop digital-first content for distribution on social, streaming and YouTube
  • Coach reporters on digital and social best practices 
  • Regularly communicate digital numbers, takeaways, wins and missed opportunities
  • Work with leadership to implement technology that improves digital team workflows

 

You are:

  • A seasoned digital media professional with demonstrated experience growing digital audiences, preferably in local news
  • Comfortable managing teams and fellow people managers who work in different locations
  • An exceptionally collaborative person who thrives in a matrixed environment
  • A transparent and clear communicator
  • Strategic but tactical – you’re not just setting strategy, but pinch-hitting as needed to deliver in the day-to-day


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. Overview:

Owns compensation strategy and execution for the company's AI/ML, product, and technology organizations — the highest-stakes, most competitive talent pools in the business. Partners with engineering and product leadership, recruiting, and Total Rewards leadership to design pay structures that win and retain talent in an AI labor market where comp packages move fast and get very large, very publicly.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Compensation strategy for tech/AI orgs: Design base, bonus, and equity structures for ML research, applied AI, and core engineering/product roles, including specialized retention and sign-on packages for high-demand AI talent
  • Market intelligence: Track fast-moving AI comp benchmarks (base salary inflation, mega equity grants, competitor offer data) and translate that into internal guidance before the market moves again
  • Leveling & career frameworks: Refine and maintain job architecture and leveling guides for technical ladders (IC and management tracks) that hold up as roles evolve quickly
  • Executive & critical-talent comp: Structure offers and retention packages for senior technical leaders and other business-critical hires, including complex negotiations
  • Equity strategy: Partner with Legal/Finance on equity plan design, refresh grant strategy, and dilution management specific to tech talent pools
  • Cross-functional partnership: Act as the trusted comp advisor to engineering/product VPs and recruiting leaders — fast turnaround on offer construction, counter-offer strategy, and internal equity checks
  • Program governance: Ensure pay equity, compliance, and consistency across the technical org as it scales, while staying flexible enough to move at hiring speed

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in compensation, with meaningful time designing comp for AI/ML or high-growth technical orgs at a large or high-growth tech company
  • Direct experience with the current AI talent market — comfort with unconventional, large, or fast-negotiated packages
  • Strong quantitative/analytical background; fluent in comp modeling, market data tools (Radford, Aon, etc.), and equity mechanics

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Track record advising senior technical and product leaders directly, not just running programs from a distance

This role leads Paramount Consumer Products' relationship with Amazon and the club channel. Amazon is North Americas most significant e-commerce and marketplace partner. The Vice President will create and implement a detailed strategy for the Paramount Products & Experiences business. This involves working with Amazon's Vendor Central, Seller Central, and the third-party marketplace ecosystem. As a key pillar in the overall market strategy, this role is integral to the success of the larger organization. Therefore, there is a premium on strategic thinking, direct and indirect team guidance, collaboration, and use of data to drive business growth with this key retail partner.

 

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Customer strategy & business planning - lead the team and play an active role in creating the strategic framework for the multi-year and annual business plans for Amazon.
  • Leverage and help improve the Joint Business Planning process to improve customer relationships, and to achieve/exceed revenue goals.
  • Outline strategies and actions to grow revenue by supporting licensees in developing meaningful presence and experiences for Paramount's brands on Amazon, working across the buying, marketing, and retail media functions to maximize revenue opportunities.
  • Data curiosity - hands on and data driven approach to account team guidance, with curiosity serving as the central tenet.
  • Track performance to understand drivers and detractors, using this information to inform guidance, guide the team's direction and drive solid retailer dialogues.
  • Lead the account's digital shelf strategy. This involves managing detail page content, optimizing search and discovery, creating A+ content, and ensuring catalog health. You will collaborate with licensees and internal content teams to improve conversion and increase search visibility.
  • Promotional & retail media investment - this role manages funding for promotional and retail media. You will work with Amazon to find the best ways to use these funds. This includes Amazon Advertising, Amazon DSP, and other retail media placements. The focus will be on increasing sales and improving the return on ad spend.
  • Relationship management and elevation - develop and maintain close collaboration with the buying, planning, and marketing teams.
  • Specifically, the strategic partnership with senior management within Amazon is a key responsibility.
  • Licensee relationships - collaborate with the sales teams of major licensees to ensure a fully integrated collaboration with Amazon.
  • Team guidance - positively contribute to team dynamics within the different Senior Team guidance forums, area of responsibility, Retail organization in totality as well as cross functionally.
  • Lead your team and inspire them. Help your direct reports grow through long-term coaching. Contribute to the organization by collaborating with other teams. This includes teams focused on categories, marketing, and product development.
  • P&L responsibility - establishing and managing budgets and forecasts for Amazon, maintaining annual and quarterly revenue and expense detail.
  • Work within a matrixed team representing Amazon on cross-functional senior teams.
     

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in retail development or key accounts including working with Amazon or a similar large e-commerce retailer. Ideally, you will have experience in the entertainment or licensing area.
  • Significant knowledge of the unique environment of warehouse clubs.
  • Bachelors degree; MBA preferred.
  • Extensive experience with Amazon's platforms such as Vendor Central and Seller Central.
  • Knowledge of retail media offerings and omni-channel partners.
  • Experienced people leader with a successful track record of working with executive team guidance, both external and internal.
  • Deep knowledge and proven success in creating and executing multi-million dollar integrated retail plans that include a broad range of vehicles including merchandising, POS materials, PR, promotions and events.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
     

Additional Qualifications

  • World class interpersonal skills including meeting facilitation/presentation, and solid verbal and writing skills.
  • Important strengths needed to succeed on a sales team: participation in guidance forums, negotiation skills, strategic thinking, analytical skills, decision-making, communication skills, teamwork and integrity.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, fulfillment models, including FBA and digital merchandising.
  • Willingness to push boundaries, experiment, learn fast and execute.
  • Experience working in a global matrixed environment preferred, with solid cross-functional team guidance.
  • Solid planning, organizational and execution skills.

Overview: 

CBS News Streaming is seeking a New York-based WGA Line Producer to join our 24/7 news coverage team. This role is ideal for a collaborative, editorially driven producer who thrives in a fast-paced, live news environment. The successful candidate will have exemplary news judgment, well-developed organizational skills, and a passion for visual storytelling. They will play a key role in producing live coverage, making sound editorial decisions under deadline, and partnering with teams across the newsroom to deliver accurate, compelling content. This role is represented by the WGA East.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Work closely with the executive producer & supervising producer in a fast-paced, demanding environment, handling breaking news and news-of-day demands for a 24-hour digital news channel
  • Line produce editorial news content, shape show flow and stack elements in the rundown
  • Work from the control room to guide shows in and out of breaks and to navigate both live and recorded content, including helping to determine when it will run in future hours
  • Partner with assignment desk and booking team to request correspondents and live interview guests
  • Order informative graphics and utilize compelling video to create engaging news programs
  • Distribute assignments and direct a team of writers, associate producers and digital associates to build original content as well as edit and repurpose content from broadcast and other content partners
  • Write teases, headlines, opening package and readers for live programming, including story slugs and lower-third banners
  • Generate story ideas for future coverage
  • Assign and record swap content for automated software wheel
  • Monitor and take newsworthy live events to air in the control room
  • Communicate with anchors, correspondents and control room team ahead of and during live shows, exhibiting a calm and professional demeanor in high pressure situations
  • Serve as a mentor to junior writers
  • Coordinate with sales department to implement accurate ad loads in rundowns
  • May also perform the responsibilities of content producers, producers, and associates producers and digital associates, as needed

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience producing and writing copy for a national broadcast, cable or streaming network, or equivalent local TV news experience in a major market Command of AP style and broadcast writing with impeccable grammar and spelling
  • Ability to multi-task and handle multiple assignments for regular programming as well as rolling breaking news coverage
  • Superior news judgment & critical thinking skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in journalism or related field
  • Fluency using ENPS is a must
  • Deep knowledge of news standards, rights and clearances and fact-checking practices
  • Must pass comprehensive CBS News Digital writing test
  • Must be available to work all shifts — early morning, dayside, nights, weekends and holidays — sometimes on short notice or as coverage, scheduling and news events warrant, as this is a 24-hour news organization
  • This position is based in New York and requires working in-person at the CBS Broadcast Center
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Well-developed communication skills and ability to train and advise associate producers, production assistants and junior staff in writing and editing broadcast copy
  • Deep knowledge of editorial production, including control room experience, with well-developed writing and copy-editing skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to work in dynamic environment, deal with intense deadlines and continually react to breaking news with factual programming and creative storytelling
  • Broad knowledge of top stories driving the news cycle, including political news, and a knack for identifying lesser-known angles that resonate with audiences

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

CBS News is looking for a full-time personal finance writer for our "MoneyWatch: Managing Your Money" vertical, an affiliate content section dedicated to sharing informative commerce stories about high-interest financial topics - from mortgage interest rates to life insurance policies to tax tips, gold investing, student loans and more. The goal of this project is to drive revenue via clicks and conversions through this content. The ideal candidate has a personal finance writing background and can write quickly and accurately without sacrificing accuracy or CBS News standards. They should also have an understanding of sponsored content, affiliate links and experience optimizing content for search. This is a remote-eligible position.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Pitch and write in-depth explainers, reviews and "best-of" listicles as well as quick-turnaround daily personal finance stories based on the news cycle and seasonality
  • Use data to inform MoneyWatch vertical priorities and adjust content decisions
  • Optimize headlines and copy for SEO
  • Update and maintain a library of existing articles
  • Assist the senior editor and managing editor with content planning and calendar management
  • Participate in broader strategic discussions with partners
  • CPE certification is a plus but not required
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of writing experience, preferably in business, personal finance or affiliate marketing (lead generation)
  • Ability to write clean, clear and accurate content on deadline, without sacrificing CBS News standards
  • Ability to interpret data and metrics to inform story ideation and performance
  • Experienced with affiliate marketing and knowledge of the space
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Business mindset, comfortable using content to generate revenue
  • Strong understanding of sponsored content and affiliate links
  • Experience optimizing content for search

Victoria, BC Area

From prospecting to closing and account management, you’ll lead the full sales cycle and play a critical role in our continued success. Candidates should be based within the Victoria, BC region.

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients through regular communication and strategic consultation
