Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager join our growing team!

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has been ranked the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. ROOM42 is 21GRAMS’ in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — the team that turns briefs, Figma files, and napkin sketches into working, beautiful, compliant digital deliverables for the top pharma and biotech companies in the world.

We are looking for an AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) to run technical delivery across the full ROOM42 output spectrum — marketing websites, microsites, emails (including Veeva rep-triggered and approved email), banners, IVAs, conference kiosks and interactive experiences — built with in-house developers and specialist vendor partners. This is the person who owns whether the right work gets to the right build team, whether the estimate is real, whether it ships to spec and on time, and who is increasingly using AI to make all of that faster and more consistent. The project manager and account teams own the client relationship and the date. The TDM owns whether that date is achievable and gets the work built — qualifying intake, routing to the right build team, running the review-and-QA lifecycle, holding vendors to standard, and applying AI where it creates genuine delivery leverage, not novelty.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Intake & Technical Qualification

  • Triage incoming requests from Workfront and Jira; assign deliverable type, complexity tier, and dependency flags (Veeva, MLR, client restrictions) within a defined SLA.
  • Return incomplete requests rather than absorbing them — no handoff to build without specs, assets, link matrix, CTAs/UTMs, and a real level-of-effort estimate.
  • Own or validate the estimate before any build commitment, using ROOM42’s estimation tooling and rate card. 

Build Team Routing & Vendor Management

  • Decide in-house vs. vendor partner per project against MSA offshore rules, client restrictions, Veeva dependency, and capacity — and escalate routing decisions that carry cost or transition implications.
  • Run day-to-day vendor delivery: standing syncs, staging-date accountability, cap-burn visibility against SOW, and knowledge-transfer documentation during vendor transitions.
  • Escalate quality issues to the vendor lead and commercial issues to the Digital & Technology leadership.

Technical Delivery Lifecycle

  • Own delivery from kickoff through post-launch: dev kickoff, staging links, review-round sequencing (R1/R2/R3), MLR/PRC submission readiness, QA gate, and go-live.
  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across a concurrent portfolio; proactively flag risks to Producers and Delivery leadership before they surface in status calls.
  • Drive milestone gates with QA — confirm that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready, not optimistically ready.
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping timelines, licensing, PDUFA-anchored dates) and surface conflicts before they collide.

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate the delivery workflow — status synthesis, ticket hygiene, QA support, specification drafting, and documentation — not as novelties but as real accelerators.
  • Partner on ROOM42’s AI-augmented QA and design-to-code workflows (visual regression, accessibility scanning, Figma-to-code handoff) so quality is structural and repeatable across deliverable types.
  • Help define and document AI-assisted delivery playbooks per deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner, and evaluate emerging tooling for genuine leverage.
  • Apply judgment to AI output — know where AI-assisted work needs human review before it reaches a client, and keep quality from degrading as volume scales.

Quality, Standards & Portfolio Hygiene

  • Define ‘done’ for each deliverable type with the technical lead and QA — not just ‘it works,’ but performant, accessible, cross-browser validated, MLR-clean, and visually faithful to approved design.
  • Own quality accountability for your portfolio: if something ships broken or fails an MLR technical review, own the root cause and the remediation.
  • Enforce Jira/Workfront field discipline and status accuracy so the portfolio is legible to leadership and reporting is reliable.
  • Lead post-launch reviews on major engagements; translate defect patterns into upstream process improvements.

Partnership & Communication

  • Serve as the technical delivery counterpart to Producers, account teams, UX/UI, developers, and QA — translating between them without jargon.
  • Partner with Producers on SOW scoping: turn creative and functional requirements into accurate hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout plans.
  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical delivery credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, and demo walkthroughs.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Hands-on AI implementation experience in a real delivery context — you have built or stood up AI-assisted workflows that shipped, not just experimented with tools. This means applying AI to concrete delivery problems (specification drafting, estimation, ticket and status synthesis, QA support, documentation, triage classification, deployment), measuring whether it actually saved time, and exercising judgment over the output before it reaches a client.
  • Daily, practical fluency with AI build and delivery tooling — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Figma-to-code integrations, AI-assisted QA — and the discernment to tell genuine leverage from hype and to catch where AI output degrades quality at scale.
  • 5+ years of digital project or technical delivery management in an agency or production environment, running concurrent digital builds from intake through launch.
  • Hands-on experience delivering across web (WordPress and/or Drupal), email, and banners; exposure to IVAs, Veeva, or interactive experiences a strong plus.
  • Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-delivery experience — familiarity with MLR/PRC review cycles, compliance gates, and fixed regulatory launch dates.
  • Vendor and cross-functional coordination: routing work, holding external partners to standard, and managing offshore/nearshore delivery.
  • Fluency in delivery tooling: Jira, Workfront or comparable, and a working understanding of QA, staging/UAT/production flow, and design-to-code handoff.
  • Enough technical literacy to hold a credible build conversation with developers and vendors, scope realistically, and know when to pull in the technical lead — without needing to write production code.

Nice to have

  • Experience defining and documenting AI-augmented delivery playbooks so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner across a team or vendor pod.
  • Hands-on work with agentic tooling — MCP servers, AI browser agents, or generative UI frameworks — and a point of view on where each creates real delivery leverage.
  • Built AI-assisted QA automation in production: visual regression, accessibility scanning, or AI-generated test coverage.
  • Veeva certification (approved email and/or IVA).
  • Experience standing up delivery processes, studios, or standards from the ground up.

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Technology Lead to join our growing team!   

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has done a lot in its first 5+ years. Known for our creativity, we've just been ranked as the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. It takes a team to do ambitious things, and our ambition is to help people connect with healthcare – by making advertising less of an interruption and more worth people’s time because it gets them. As an agency with the full capabilities of Real Chemistry at our fingertips, we’ve got endless potential.   

At ROOM42 — 21GRAMS' in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — we are seeking an AI-Forward Technical Lead who is simultaneously a craftsperson, a creative partner, and an accelerator. This person moves fluidly between writing production-quality code, protecting design intent through every build decision, and orchestrating AI tooling to compress the distance from concept to shipped experience. Whether the starting point is a client brief, a Figma file, or a napkin sketch, this Technical Lead is the person who figures out the fastest, most technically sound path to a working, beautiful, compliant deliverable — and builds it. 

This role spans the full ROOM42 output spectrum: marketing websites, microsites, conference kiosks and panel experiences, interactive apps, and data-driven digital tools for healthcare and pharma clients. The ideal candidate has mastered the traditional web development lifecycle and is actively transforming it — using AI at every meaningful stage. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you’ll do:  

Build and Architect 

  • Own end-to-end technical execution for ROOM42 deliverables — websites, microsites, interactive apps, conference kiosk and panel experiences, and real-world evidence platforms 

  • Write and review production-quality code across the full stack; maintain a target of 50% direct hands-on contribution alongside leadership responsibilities 

  • Architect solutions that balance speed-to-market with long-term maintainability, security, and accessibility compliance 

  • Lead technical solutioning on new engagements — translating UX wireframes and creative briefs into clearly scoped, achievable builds 

DevOps and Delivery Infrastructure: 

  • Own Git workflows, branching strategy, and code review standards across all active ROOM42 builds 

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for ROOM42's primary hosting environments (WP Engine, Pantheon, Acquia, Netlify/Vercel for JAMstack); make deployments repeatable and low-risk 

  • Manage staging, UAT, and production environment configurations; provision and document access for all ROOM42 developers 

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across the DevOps lifecycle — from scaffolding new projects to post-deploy validation 

 

AI-Augmented Design-to-Code Pipeline: 

  • Operate Figma MCP server integration to accelerate design handoff — extracting tokens, components, and layout specs directly into code-ready outputs; eliminating manual interpretation cycles 

  • Leverage AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor AI) as daily build accelerators — not novelties — across front-end, back-end, and configuration work 

  • Define and document ROOM42's AI-augmented build workflows for each deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner 

  • Stay ahead of emerging agentic tooling (MCP servers, AI browser agents, generative UI frameworks) and evaluate when adoption creates genuine delivery leverage 

 

QA and Test Automation: 

  • Implement AI-assisted QA automation across ROOM42 project types — visual regression testing, accessibility scanning, cross-browser checks, and functional testing pipelines 

  • Establish a QA automation baseline for repeatable deliverable types (CMS sites, kiosk apps, email builds) so that human QA effort concentrates on edge cases and client-specific requirements 

  • Triage technical defects surfaced by QA — classify root cause, assign or resolve remediation, verify fix integrity before re-advancing to UAT  

Standards, Mentorship, and Team Health: 

  • Define and maintain ROOM42's technical standards across deliverable types — coding conventions, repo structure, accessibility requirements, security baselines, deployment protocols 

  •  Conduct code reviews for all ROOM42 developers before deliverables advance to QA; enforce standards consistently and use reviews as teaching moments 

  • Partner with RC's VP of Technology on standards alignment, tooling strategy, and team architecture as the practice scales 

  • Lead technical onboarding for new ROOM42 hires — tool access, standards orientation, and first-week productivity within two weeks of start date 

  • Serve as primary technical escalation point when blockers threaten delivery; resolve environment, integration, and access issues within 24 hours of identification 

 

Technical Delivery: 

  • Partner with Producers and TDMs on SOW scoping — translate creative and functional requirements into accurate technical estimates for hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout 

  • Own the technical delivery lifecycle for key ROOM42 engagement from kickoff through post-launch, work with technical delivery managers to ensure timeline integrity, milestone readiness, and handoff completeness 

  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across all active projects; proactively flag risks to Delivery Managers before they surface in status calls 

  • Drive milestone gates: work closely with QA lead to ensure that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready — not optimistically ready 

  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping APIs, licensing constraints) and surface conflicts before they collide 

  • Own technical documentation throughout each engagement: architecture decisions, environment setup, API integration specs, deployment runbooks — so no knowledge lives only in one person's head 

  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, demo walkthroughs — presenting clearly and without jargon 

 

Quality Outcomes: 

  • Define 'done' for every deliverable type — not just 'it works' but that it is performant, accessible, secure, cross-browser validated, and visually faithful to approved design 

  • Own quality accountability end-to-end: if something ships broken, looks wrong, or fails an MLR technical review, this role is accountable for the root cause and the remediation 

  • Work with QA lead to establish and maintain a ROOM42 quality checklist for each deliverable type — covering functional, visual, performance, accessibility, and security checks — so quality is structural, not ad hoc 

  • Review developer output not only for code correctness but for UX implementation fidelity: does the built experience actually look and behave like the approved design? 

  • Lead post-launch quality reviews on major engagements; document defect patterns and translate them into upstream process improvements 

  • Champion performance as a quality dimension: page load, animation smoothness, kiosk responsiveness, and interactive load times are quality metrics, not afterthoughts 

  • Maintain zero tolerance for preventable defects reaching client UAT — own the internal quality bar so clients aren't the ones finding the obvious problems 

 

Design Eye, UX/UI Partnership, and Creative Collaboration: 

  • Speak UX fluently — understand information architecture, user flows, interaction patterns, and content hierarchy well enough to actively contribute to UX decisions, not just receive them 

  • Evaluate wireframes and prototypes through both a user experience lens and a technical feasibility lens simultaneously: identify where a flow creates friction before it's built, and where a design pattern creates technical debt before it ships 

  • Read a Figma file not just for spec values but for design intent — understand what the designer was solving for and protect that intent through every build decision, especially when specs have gaps or edge cases aren't covered 

  • Catch UX implementation drift before QA does: spot when a multi-step interaction is off-sequence, a loading state is missing, an error condition is unhandled, or a mobile breakpoint breaks the intended user journey 

  • Catch visual implementation drift with the same discipline: notice when padding is off, a typeface is rendering incorrectly, a hover state feels wrong, or a component is pixel-perfect in isolation but contextually broken in the live layout 

  • Participating actively in UX and design reviews as a technical partner — able to say 'that interaction pattern will feel laggy on kiosk hardware' or 'here's how we can get the same UX outcome with a lighter implementation' or 'this flow needs an empty state that the design doesn't account for' 

  • Understand foundational UX/UI principles — user task flow design, progressive disclosure, feedback and affordance, responsive and adaptive layout, motion and timing — well enough to make confident decisions when the design file doesn't cover every scenario 

  • Bridge the gap between design and engineering vocabulary; translate UX intent and creative direction into precise technical implementation notes that developers can execute without ambiguity or interpretation risk 

  • Push back constructively when a UX or design spec is technically infeasible at the required timeline or budget — and always bring an alternative that preserves the experience intent, not just a 'no' 

  • Appreciate that in healthcare and pharma, the human story being told is someone's life — and that the quality of the experience we build, how it feels to use, how clearly it communicates, how gracefully it handles errors, is not separate from the mission 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.  

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.  

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

 

What you should have:   

  • 7+ years of hands-on development experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead, staff engineer, or architect role 

  • Demonstrable full-stack proficiency — not a generalist who dabbles; someone who can build, review, and unblock at every layer 

  • A genuine design eye with UX/UI depth: able to evaluate user flows and interaction patterns for experience quality, read a Figma file for intent, catch UX and visual implementation drift, and make confident decisions at the design-code boundary without designer supervision 

  • Technical delivery experience: has owned milestone tracking, risk communication, and deployment readiness across concurrent projects — not just individual coding output 

  • Demonstrated accountability for quality outcomes: has owned defect triage, post-launch quality reviews, and upstream process improvements when things go wrong 

  • Active, daily practitioner of AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code) — able to define team-wide workflows around them 

  • Hands-on experience with Figma MCP server or comparable design-to-code AI tooling; familiar with design token standards and component handoff patterns 

  • QA automation experience: visual regression, accessibility automation, or AI-assisted test generation in a production environment

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)

  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes

  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work

  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client

  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions

  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members

  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting

  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

The Account Manager (AM) is the bridge between the clients and their project needs. The AM is in a position of leadership within the organization and must successfully partner with the Project Management Team to oversee large project teams and manage multiple projects within an account. This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will work eastern business hours.

job.title: AI Business Partner
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

AI Business Partner - Activation

Role Overview

The AI Business Partner translates business priorities into practical AI solutions that improve how work gets done. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, domain expertise, and applied AI, this role identifies high-value opportunities, builds working prototypes and pilots, and partners cross-functionally to scale successful solutions.

This Partner will be aligned to Activation, a portfolio that spans media, social, content, creator/influencer/Starpower, and omnichannel. The work will vary across these areas and will be conducted in partnership with the designated business and discipline leads. Discipline leaders own business strategy, workflow priorities, functional requirements, stakeholder alignment and adoption within their respective capabilities. The Activation AI Business Partner brings applied AI and technical expertise to assess feasibility, prototype solutions, support operationalization and scale validated capabilities across Activation. The right person is comfortable moving between distinct disciplines with different maturity levels, tooling and ways of working, and can sequence where to focus first.

This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly from ambiguity to action — working with stakeholders to define problems, rapidly testing ideas using modern generative AI tools, and helping the organization adopt AI in ways that are useful, responsible, and aligned with business needs.

What you'll do:

AI Opportunity Identification & Prioritization

  • Partner with business and discipline leaders to identify high-value opportunities to apply generative AI across workflows, deliverables, and business processes.
  • Translate business priorities, functional requirements and user needs defined with discipline leaders into clearly scoped AI use cases, pilots, and solution concepts.
  • Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, adoption potential, scalability and risk.
  • Partner with discipline leaders  to prioritize opportunities within individual capabilities and help sequence initiatives  across the broader Activation portfolio.
  • Maintain visibility across the Activation AI opportunity pipeline to identify shared needs, reusable components, dependencies and opportunities for cross-discipline scale

 

Prototyping & Solution Development

  • Build and iterate on working prototypes, pilots, and lightweight AI-enabled tools in response to business priorities and functional requirements established with business and discipline leads using modern development environments, LLM APIs, agentic workflows, and related technologies.
  • Design prompts, workflows, and tool interactions that guide AI behavior toward accurate, useful, and contextually relevant outcomes.
  • Test solutions quickly with representative users and discipline subject matter experts, incorporate user feedback, and refine prototypes based on real-world usage and evolving requirements.
  • Move ideas from concept to demonstrable value, balancing speed, practicality, technical feasibility, quality and responsible AI requirements.
  • Provide technical consultation during discovery to help discipline leaders distinguish between workflow, process, data, platform and AI-related needs

 

Cross-Functional Delivery & Scaling

  • Own the technical progression of validated concepts from discovery through prototype, pilot, handoff and scaling, in partnership with the appropriate teams (i.e., platform, data, security, governance teams, etc.)
  • Partner closely with AI technical teams, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transition validated prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions where appropriate.
  • Define technical requirements, solution dependencies, integration considerations and implementation paths in partnership with technical specialists.
  • Identify when an opportunity should be addressed through an existing enterprise capability, workflow redesign, vendor solution, configurable agent, lightweight prototype, or production-grade build.
  • Work with business and discipline leads to align on priorities, solution design, success metrics, rollout approach and post-launch ownership.

 

Adoption, Enablement & Change Management

  • Partner with discipline leaders to support successful adoption of AI solutions through solution-specific guidance, training, onboarding materials, and usage playbooks.
  • Communicate AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations in clear, accessible language for non-technical audiences.
  • Equip discipline leaders and subject matter experts with reusable materials they can adapt for role-specific training, change management, and workflow adoption.
  • Capture adoption feedback, usage barriers, and technical issues and translate them into product or solution improvements.
  • Help build AI fluency across the organization by enabling teams to use tools responsibly and effectively in their day-to-day work.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and practical innovation.

 

Governance, Quality & Responsible AI

  • Help ensure AI solutions are designed and applied in ways that are responsible, compliant, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare communications environment.
  • Incorporate considerations related to privacy, safety, quality, transparency, and human oversight into solution design and rollout.
  • Partner with relevant stakeholders to align AI use with organizational standards, governance expectations, and evolving best practices.
  • Promote thoughtful experimentation while maintaining appropriate safeguards and quality controls.

 

Domain Expertise Application

  • Apply working knowledge strong understanding of healthcare communications, including advertising, activation, communications, and medical domains, to shape relevant and impactful AI solutions.
  • Apply working knowledge of and demonstrate fluency in paid media, social, and influencer marketing — including the platforms, buying and measurement mechanics, and campaign workflows that drive day-to-day execution.
  • Partner with designated discipline leaders and subject matter experts for deep functional expertise, strategic judgement, workflow validation and quality assessment.
  • Understand how agency Activation teams operate, including campaign cycles, reporting cadences, client and platform dependencies, and where handoffs create friction.
  • Ensure solutions reflect real-world workflows, stakeholder needs, and the nuances of regulated client environments.
  • Translate domain knowledge into practical requirements that improve usability, relevance, and business fit.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience in AI innovation, product, or a related area.
  • Demonstrated experience in media, social, influencer, or adtech — agency-side, platform-side, or in an ad tech product/analytics role. This background is a priority for this position; the technical dynamics of media are difficult to learn quickly on the job.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing, and iterating on generative AI workflows, prototypes, copilots, agents, or similar solutions.
  • Proficiency with LLM APIs, prompting strategies, AI-assisted development environments, and modern tools used to prototype AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical, testable AI use cases and solution concepts.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and execution skills in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to evaluate solutions through the lens of usefulness, risk, quality, and business impact.

 

Skills and Competencies

  • Paid Media; Social Media; Influencer Marketing; Campaign Operations; Media Measurement & Analytics
  • Agentic Workflows; AI - Artificial Intelligence; Large Language Models (LLMs); Machine Learning
  • Coding; Programming Languages; Software Engineering
  • Product Demonstration; Technical Troubleshooting
  • Implementation Management; Solution Delivery; Solution Design
  • Client Relationship Management; Problem Analysis; Workflow Analysis

 

This position is crucial in driving the execution of AI strategies at Real Chemistry, ensuring that AI initiatives are not only innovative but also practical, effective, and aligned with real-world needs. The chosen candidate will play a pivotal role in enhancing the organization's capabilities and fostering a culture of AI-driven innovation and continuous improvement.

job.title: Art Director
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is a global health innovation company with offices across Europe and the US. We believe that the way to real, transformative change is through the uncommon combination of disciplines, technologies, and our greatest asset – our people. We are currently looking to add to our alchemic mix of more than 1,800 talented professionals. This is a great opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing global company committed to making the world a healthier place for all. 

The Art Director is not a rookie designer, nor worse yet a poser, but a bonified agency tested AD. Our ideal candidate is the first person to offer up ideas and sketches, as well as the last to lay hands upon the finished art before it goes to review. They thrive in a world filled with self-expression and live to “tweak” a not-so-subtle PMS color, or “kern” a headline a writer just plunked down. Their experience in design creation is vast and they fully embrace what it means to be “the visual expert.” Knowing all the while what clients expect from their AD and delivering nothing short of visual genius across all marketing channels.   

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or Lambertville—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do: 

  • Maintain a partnership approach with peers from all departments (e.g., Account Services, Brand Planning, Creative, Medical Strategy, etc.) on all our client’s business   

  • Participate in new business/client activities and pitches as requested   

  • Set and maintain high visual brand standards commensurate with Creative BU expectations   

  • Interact well with project teams to understand business objectives and audience demographics   

  • Basic understanding of wireframing, site mapping, UX design   

  • Any other duties as reasonably assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations require  

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

What you should have: 

  • Proven ability to think and design beyond campaign to help develop and drive creative solutions (multiple platforms) for client brands   

  • 5+ years' experience as an Art Director at an advertising or digital agency. Experience in Pharma or Health and Wellness marketing a plus   

  • Must present a portfolio of 10 pieces of your work that demonstrates both your conceptual and execution-based capabilities across all digital and print platforms   

  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Advertising, Interactive or another Design-related program   

  • Visual Creativity, always curious, always ahead of the design trends, consistently utilizing new creative techniques from creative brief through deliverable   

  • Demonstrates a deep understanding in building design layout, visual hierarchy, typography, storyboarding and management of photographers, illustrators, directors   

  • Embraces all forms of design across multiple marketing channels and platforms (Digital & Traditional)   

  • Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (including XD, Premier), Microsoft Office   

  • Experience in Sketch, AXURE is a plus   

 

Pay Range: $80,000 - $90,000

Real Chemistry Media is a healthcare-focused media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization dedicated to helping life sciences brands create more meaningful customer relationships. Through integrated media, omnichannel strategy, CRM, analytics, and engagement solutions, we help clients design and activate connected experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

The Associate Director, Client Experience (Media) leads integrated media and omnichannel planning across complex pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. This role is responsible for translating business objectives, customer insights, and audience needs into strategic media programs that engage healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers while driving measurable business performance.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What You'll Do

  • Lead integrated planning across paid, earned, owned, and omnichannel engagement initiatives.
  • Develop strategic HCP and DTC media recommendations informed by audience insights, market conditions, and business objectives.
  • Oversee media investment strategies, channel mix recommendations, measurement frameworks, and optimization plans.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor for clients navigating evolving healthcare engagement challenges.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Strategy, CRM, Analytics, Creative, and Activation teams.
  • Guide campaign performance discussions and identify opportunities for innovation and growth.
  • Manage and develop planning talent while maintaining excellence across all client deliverables.

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If

  • You are a strategic thinker who enjoys turning complex business challenges into integrated media and customer engagement solutions.
  • You understand how media, omnichannel engagement, CRM, analytics, content, and customer experience work together to influence behavior.
  • You can comfortably advise pharmaceutical and life sciences clients on media investment decisions, audience strategy, and performance optimization.
  • You enjoy building strong client partnerships and are viewed as a trusted problem solver rather than simply a service provider.
  • You bring a point of view to discussions, supported by data, research, experience, and industry trends.
  • You are comfortable leading teams while also remaining actively involved in strategic thinking and client problem solving.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the quality standard across a broader portfolio of work.
  • You are motivated by helping healthcare brands create more meaningful, measurable customer experiences.

What You Should Have

  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare media experience.
  • Deep expertise across integrated media planning and omnichannel customer engagement.
  • Experience developing HCP and DTC media strategies for complex brands or therapeutic areas.
  • Strong client leadership, presentation, and storytelling abilities.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple client relationships and teams.

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. The Omnichannel Strategy team sits at the center of this ecosystem, partnering closely with Media, Analytics, CRM, Engagement, Creative, Technology, and Client Services teams to design customer-centric experiences that align business objectives, audience needs, and channel activation. Our strategists help clients move beyond channel planning to deliver coordinated engagement across the full customer journey. 

The Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead the development of omnichannel engagement strategies for assigned brands, products, and business challenges, grounded in a strong understanding of media strategy and how paid media connects across the broader customer experience. This role translates audience insights, customer needs, media behaviors, market dynamics, and business objectives into actionable journey architectures, media and channel strategies, and engagement plans that drive measurable outcomes.   As a strategic leader, you will guide audience segmentation, customer journey development, media and channel planning, engagement strategy, and orchestration design while serving as a trusted strategic partner to clients and internal teams. You will collaborate across Media, Analytics, CRM, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services to create integrated experiences that connect customer needs with business goals.

What you’ll do 

  • Architect omnichannel engagement strategies with media strategy at the core, connecting paid media with owned, earned, CRM, field, and digital channels.
  • Lead audience segmentation, persona development and customer prioritization across healthcare professional, patient, caregiver and other relevant audiences. 
  • Design end-to-end customer journeys that identify audience needs, barriers, behaviors, triggers and engagement opportunities. 
  • Develop media and channel orchestration frameworks that define the role of paid media and connect it effectively across owned, earned, field, CRM, and digital touchpoints.
  • Lead client and internal workshops focused on audience strategy, journey design and engagement planning. 
  • Define measurement frameworks, testing plans and strategic requirements for CRM, analytics and engagement platforms. 
  • Translate client needs, market research, media and campaign performance, and audience insights into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams.
  • Oversee supporting strategists, delegate work and review deliverables for strategic quality and consistency. 
  • Contribute to scoping conversations and manage multiple client workstreams to established timelines and utilization expectations. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have

job.description:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team. This is role for someone who is ready to help manage high-quality social programs, develop smart content and keep complex work moving across healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our team brings together healthcare knowledge, creative thinking, content development, paid media awareness and strong execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours. 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Help lead social media programs across organic, paid, influencer and integrated workstreams, translating strategy into clear, compliant and platform-native execution. 
  • Develop and manage social content plans, editorial calendars, campaign assets, post copy, creative briefs and supporting materials in partnership with strategy, creative, paid media and account teams. 
  • Bring an integrated social and digital lens to the work, connecting day-to-day social execution to broader communications goals and client priorities.  
  • Support and, at times, lead recurring client and internal meetings, helping turn discussion, feedback and decisions into clear next steps, timelines and deliverables. 
  • Coordinate across internal teams, vendors and client stakeholders to keep social content, approvals, publishing and reporting workstreams organized and on track. 
  • Communicate recommendations, project updates and social insights in a clear, thoughtful way for clients and cross-functional partners. 
  • Use AI-enabled tools, Canva, social listening platforms and analytics dashboards to support research, brainstorms, content development, reporting and presentations. 
  • Bring a curious, responsible approach to emerging tools and social trends, while keeping healthcare accuracy, client privacy, compliance and brand standards at the center. 
  • Help guide team members by providing direction, feedback and support on content, timelines, reporting and client-ready deliverables. 
  • Contribute to social and cultural POVs, trend notes and thought starters that bring timely, relevant thinking to clients, industry and our RC teams. 
  • Support business growth through research, proposal inputs, client development materials and strong day-to-day relationship management. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What you should have:  

  • 5–8 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency or client-service experience, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience coordinating social content development, review processes, calendars, campaign materials and client-ready deliverables. 
  • Experience guiding or mentoring team members 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on social work with project coordination, client communication, team support and new business or organic growth needs. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 
  • Strong social media judgment, including the ability to develop content plans, post copy, briefs, recommendations and executional materials that align to strategy. 
  • Understanding of major social platforms, audience behavior, platform-native content best practices and the role of social within broader healthcare communications. 
  • Ability to contribute to channel recommendations, paid social approaches, influencer considerations, content calendars and social media reports that tell a clear story. 
  • Comfort with social publishing, listening, analytics, paid social and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong writing, organization and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape clear copy and serve as a dependable social media partner to clients and internal colleagues. 

 

Pay Range: $90,000 - $115,000

Real Chemistry is seeking a Director, Client Media Solutions to join our growing team!

The Director, Client Media Solutions is a strategic leader responsible for developing audience-first media strategies across a portfolio of healthcare clients. This individual partners closely with internal teams and client stakeholders to deliver integrated planning, investment recommendations, and measurement approaches that support business objectives and drive performance.

The Director plays a key role in translating audience insights, market dynamics, and performance data into actionable media plans. They collaborate across Client Experience, Activation, Analytics, Creative, and Strategy teams to ensure alignment and consistency in planning. This role also contributes to strengthening planning processes, supporting team development, and advancing media capabilities across the organization.

This is a hybrid role based in any of our U.S. offices, including New York, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or Lambertville, or working remotely within the U.S., depending on team and business needs.

Media Strategy & Planning

  • Lead the development of media strategies and integrated plans across assigned healthcare clients, ensuring alignment to business goals and audience needs
  • Support annual planning, campaign launches, investment allocation, and channel strategy development
  • Translate audience insights, competitive landscape, and performance data into clear planning recommendations
  • Execute audience-first omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, and consumer audiences
  • Identify and recommend emerging media opportunities and innovations that enhance campaign effectiveness

Client Management

  • Serve as a day-to-day strategic partner to client stakeholders, supporting ongoing planning and optimization conversations
  • Present media plans, performance updates, and recommendations with clarity and confidence
  • Build strong client relationships through reliable delivery, proactive communication, and problem solving

Planning & Measurement

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Director, Real World Data to join our growing team!

At Real Chemistry we’re powering cross-functional teams with real-world data and advanced analytics to drive results for cross-functional teams throughout the lifecycle. Anchored by a rich longitudinal patient database, combined with market leading ML capabilities, Real Chemistry is laser focused on the transformation of data into actionable insights and commercialization strategies.

The Director has a multi-faceted role, with a primary responsibility for exceptional client delivery and strong client relationships. The Director also plays an active role in the sales process, communicating the value of Real Chemistry and uniquely identifying solutions to clients’ business problems. Therefore, this role will straddle both sales and delivery, and provide a critical linkage between the two functions. Given the wide range of the Director's responsibilities, a seasoned understanding of the evolving pharmaceutical market (precision medicine, omnichannel data analytics, patient level data integration, etc.), strong client-facing communication skills/language, and experience working with or at agencies are critical to success.

Travel within the region is estimated at 20%.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

 

What you’ll do:

Delivery

The Director will lead multiple, parallel consulting engagements leveraging health claims data to address client needs. The role will encompass both external, client-facing and internal project leadership responsibilities. The delivery role will involve solutioning for internal Real Chemistry teams as well as external clients, and the clear and detailed translation of sold engagements to the operations team for analysis, while simultaneously managing ongoing project delivery. The Director maintains proactive and consistent communication across client and delivery teams. Responsibilities to include:

  • Understand the agency environment to design and develop strategies, methodologies, and solutions to support advertising, communications, medical, media, and commercially-focused clients.
  • Facilitate and manage all project communication needs, including client-facing communications and internal communications
  • Act as single point of contact with the following parties: Managing Principal, Client, Sales Lead, and Operations team (ongoing and consistent communication with all parties critical for delivery success)
  • Create and maintain delivery timelines in conjunction with client and internal teams
  • Maintain appropriate scope for ongoing client engagements and follow-ups, while managing a portfolio of client engagements
  • Conduct thorough quality control (QC) measures and pressure-test analysis outputs based on desk research and experiential logic
  • Derive insights and create PowerPoint stories from secondary claims data that address client needs/questions, with comfort delivering presentations to internal teams or brand/analytics teams within external organizations

Business Development

The Director also proactively identifies and qualifies leads, supporting teams across the agency to develop, assess, and solution for multiple qualified opportunities at any given time. The Director understands unique client business problems and translates solutions into sales support materials and development of sales-related presentations. Responsibilities include:

  • Cultivate relationships with existing clients and contacts within the biopharma industry, generate interest for Real Chemistry analytics offerings, and translate to sales opportunities
  • Identify client opportunities proactively, and work with Managing Principal and sales team to qualify and pursue sales leads
  • Support the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in developing sales materials for identified opportunities
  • Design and develop strategies and methodologies to deliver against client needs, and translate into compelling sales and pitch materials
  • Understand the dynamic competitive landscape and successfully position Real Chemistry in competitive selling situations
  • Assist the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in managing client relationships
  • Assist the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in identifying upselling opportunities

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

job.title: Director, Social Media
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team and lead smart, platform-native social work that drives meaningful impact for healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our Social Media team blends deep healthcare expertise with sharp strategy, standout content, paid media fluency and data-driven execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. As Director, you’ll be a day-to-day lead across multiple books of business, helping teams move from big ideas to smart execution while coaching people, guiding clients and raising the quality of the work. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours. 

What You’ll Do: 

Social Leadership, Strategy & Business Impact 

  • Lead integrated social media programs across organic, paid and influencer workstreams, translating strategy into smart, compliant, platform-native execution. 
  • Lead complex client engagements with confidence, helping teams deliver strategic, high-quality work that drives measurable impact. 
  • Bring clarity and momentum to client programs by pairing strong creative instincts, sharp copy and smart storytelling with organized, insight-led execution. 

Client Partnership, Meetings & Storytelling 

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day client lead, running recurring, ad-hoc and planning meetings with confidence, clarity and a little spark. 
  • Connect the dots across social, paid, influencer and performance data, turning analytics into clear insights, recommendations and senior-level narratives. 
  • Stay one step ahead of client needs, bringing thoughtful solutions, clear next steps and a steady hand to help programs run smoothly from planning through execution. 

AI, Innovation & Smarter Social Operations 

  • Champion responsible AI adoption across social workflows, using tools like Microsoft Copilot, Canva, social listening platforms and analytics dashboards to improve research, ideation, content development, reporting and presentations. 
  • Help teams use AI with good judgment, keeping healthcare accuracy, client privacy, compliance and brand standards at the center. 

Business Growth & New Opportunities 

  • Partner with colleagues to identify opportunities to expand, refine or elevate social media programming across existing accounts. 
  • Contribute to growth opportunities by shaping smart social POVs, strategic recommendations and pitch-ready thinking. 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You if: 

Mindset, Ownership & Leadership Style 

  • You’re a confident, curious social leader who loves the pace of platform change but keeps the work grounded, strategic and reputable. 
  • You can zoom out to spot patterns, connect insights to business opportunities and zoom in to make the strategy, copy, storytelling and details sharper. 
  • You enjoy coaching people, building trust with clients and living our values: Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I.” 

What Experience & Skills You Should have: 

Experience, Leadership & Healthcare Context 

  • 7–10 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, assignments and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience leading teams, managing performance and supporting the development of direct or indirect reports. 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on client work with team leadership, internal initiatives and business development support. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 

Social, Paid, Influencer, Analytics & Tools 

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behavior and content best practices across organic, paid and influencer-led programs. 
  • Experience building strategic plans, channel recommendations, paid social approaches and insight-led performance narratives for senior stakeholders. 
  • Fluency with social buying, publishing, listening, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong communication, organization and judgment, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape strong copy, delegate effectively and keep work moving. 

Pay Range: $105,000 - $155,000

job.title: Director, Technical Products and Operations
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products.  These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time

  • Bridge strategy, creative, analytics, and activation — ensuring alignment from campaign planning through measurement and optimization.
