Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is the media engine of Real Chemistry, bringing together deep healthcare expertise, audience intelligence, data, technology, and creativity to build more connected and impactful experiences. We partner with healthcare and pharmaceutical brands to develop integrated media and omnichannel strategies designed around how people actually engage, make decisions, and take action.

The Group Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead and evolve omnichannel strategy across multiple clients, brands, therapeutic areas, and engagement programs. This role is responsible for driving integrated, measurable customer experiences that advance client business objectives while helping shape and grow Real Chemistry Media's omnichannel strategy capabilities.

As a senior strategic leader, you will bring a strong understanding of media strategy, audience planning, and the role paid media plays within the broader customer experience, combining that expertise with customer engagement strategy, behavioral science, data, analytics, and technology to create omnichannel solutions that influence behaviors and improve outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, a leader within the strategy discipline, and a key partner to Media, Analytics, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services teams.

What You'll Do

  • Lead omnichannel strategy development and delivery across multiple clients, brands, therapeutic areas, and engagement programs, ensuring consistent strategic excellence and measurable business impact.
  • Develop integrated media, audience, journey, engagement, and channel strategies that align with client objectives and drive behavior change across the customer experience.
  • Define the strategic role of paid media within the broader omnichannel ecosystem, connecting paid channels with CRM, owned, earned, field, content, and digital experiences.
  • Establish and evolve best practices for audience architecture, customer journey design, media and channel planning, orchestration, workshop facilitation, governance, and optimization.
  • Guide complex engagement ecosystems involving multiple customer types, media channels, markets, products, and business units.
  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, providing executive-level counsel on media and omnichannel strategy, customer experience, activation, measurement, and growth.
  • Own strategic delivery, client retention, and growth across a portfolio of accounts, including some of the agency's largest and most complex engagements.
  • Partner with Media, Analytics, Engagement Strategy, Creative, and Client Services teams to deliver integrated solutions grounded in data, audience insights, media performance, and business objectives.
  • Lead client workshops, strategic planning sessions, and executive presentations that influence decision-making and drive alignment.
  • Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage media, technology, AI, analytics, and customer insights to improve client outcomes and strengthen agency capabilities.
  • Lead, develop, and coach strategists across the organization, supporting performance management, talent development, and succession planning.
  • Contribute directly to discipline growth through client expansion, business development, thought leadership, and the development of new strategic offerings and capabilities.
  • Maintain a strong billable contribution while supporting overall team utilization, revenue growth, and the continued evolution of Real Chemistry Media's omnichannel strategy practice.

This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If

  • You are a strategic thinker who enjoys solving complex client and business challenges through audience insights, data, media, and collaboration.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and energized by evolving client needs and business priorities.
  • You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable leading through ambiguity.
  • You thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy balancing strategic leadership with execution.
  • You are passionate about mentoring others and building high-performing teams.
  • You are motivated by driving measurable client impact and advancing the future of healthcare engagement.

What You Should Have

  • 12+ years of experience in media strategy and/or omnichannel strategy with significant media responsibility, within healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences.
  • Strong knowledge of paid media strategy and the role channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, and other digital media play within an integrated healthcare customer experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing omnichannel strategies across multiple accounts, brands, therapeutic categories, customer types, channels, and markets.
  • Deep expertise in audience architecture, customer journey design, media and channel strategy, orchestration planning, behavioral science, measurement, and data-driven optimization.
  • Experience connecting paid media with CRM, field engagement, owned and earned channels, content, and digital experiences to create cohesive HCP and/or patient journeys.
  • Ability to interpret media performance, audience data, research, and customer insights and translate them into strategic recommendations for clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to lead large, complex client engagements independently, advise executive stakeholders, and translate business objectives and insights into scalable strategic solutions.
  • Experience establishing consistent methodologies, governance models, operating frameworks, and strategic standards across teams and accounts.
  • Track record of driving client retention, organic growth, and new business while balancing billability, team utilization, and commercial objectives.
  • Experience leading multiple strategy teams and managing three to eight direct or indirect reports, including performance management, coaching, career development, succession planning, recruiting, and overall work quality.

 

Pay Range: $175,000-$200,000

TITLE: IT Service Desk Analyst

Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact! We are currently seeking a Service Desk Analyst based between our New Jersey office and New York office, who has an enthusiasm to learn and embrace a career in Information Technology for a global company.  

The role will be working closely with the IT Team and Team Lead for your given region and follow directions from our IT leadership team globally. 

 

ROLE-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

  • This role will be on site between our New Jersey and New York Offices.
  • Experience working on-site within an IT Team ranging from Junior staff to Senior and working with all levels of staff and leadership.
  • On-site IT/Desk Side Support
  • Expected to help globally with all IT support when able to, including remote support.
  • Able to work well under pressure and deal with all angles of support at all levels, for example, walk ups, service desk, chat, and phone, including meeting rooms setups for internal and client meetings along with town halls and company events.

 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain ticketing and inventory systems that support end users. 
  • Help, guide and train our staff and end user base.
  • Support and enforce security, policies, and procedures. 
  • Support and follow our IT Asset Management processes and procedures. 
  • Onboarding and offboarding end users along with onboarding training as required. 
  • Maintain knowledge of current technology, equipment, services, and standards for IT.  
  • Respond to telephone calls, emails, support tickets, or in-person requests for technical support. 
  • Help with technical support to the Real Chemistry end users, including all levels within reasonable working times and days based on the needs of the worldwide offices. 
  • Remote and onsite support for technologies and computer systems. 
  • Based in a company office to interact with upper-level management on an in-person as well as be present to answer all IT department requests from IT staff/Direction of IT leadership. 
  • Ability to set up and support conference rooms using apps and technology such as Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Logitech Meet Up, etc. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3-5 years’ experience in a Service Desk role. 
  • Completed an IT practitioners’ course/certifications or equivalent / proven track record and experience. 
  • Comfortable with AI technology such as Microsoft Co-Pilot / Co-Work.
  • 1st and 2nd line support for the business. 
  • Good technical knowledge that accompanies excellent customer service. 
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Able to work well under pressure and deal with all angles of support at all levels (Examples: walk-ups, service desk, chat, and phone). 
  • Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Has a wide range of experience and applies to sound judgement to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.  
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent issues. 
  • Manage, maintain, and add to our evolving KB’s/Solutions 
  • Demonstrated aptitude for learning new technologies. 
  • Team Player and able to work on your own initiative. 
  • Experience in the following technologies/products: 
    • Apple MAC OSX for all versions. 
    • Windows 11 operating systems. 
    • iOS-based devices. 
    • Android based devices. 
    • Microsoft Azure / Intune. 
    • Microsoft Office 365 technologies. 
    • Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive. 
    • Conference rooms are set up using Microsoft Teams, and other technologies. 
    • Experience working on a global service desk. 
    • Prioritization of work. 
    • IT Asset Management Systems. 
    • Experience deploying and supporting iOS devices and Android devices. 
    • Experience supporting and using helpdesk/service desk systems such as Freshservice, Service Now. 

Advantageous: 

  • CompTIA A+, N+, S+ 
  • Microsoft MD100, 101, 102

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Search to join our growing Biddable Media team! 

A Manager, Paid Search is responsible for the end-to-end execution, performance, and day-to-day management of paid search campaigns across assigned accounts. This individual translates client objectives into tactical campaign strategies, owns campaign optimization and budget management, identifies opportunities for account growth, and communicates performance insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. The Manager also coordinates day-to-day projects and begins developing leadership skills by delegating work, overseeing campaign execution, and mentoring junior team members. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own the day-to-day execution and performance of paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and supporting search technologies, from planning and setup through launch, optimization, and reporting. 
  • Develop tactical paid search strategies aligned with client objectives, audience strategies, KPIs, and broader integrated media plans. Contribute to campaign forecasts, planning inputs, and supporting data analysis. 
  • Oversee flawless campaign launches, including campaign setup, trafficking, quality assurance, tracking, tagging, and delivery requirements. 
  • Own campaign pacing, budget management, and ongoing optimization, monitoring real-time performance and making data-driven adjustments to meet client KPIs and improve account performance. 
  • Track campaign spend, maintain accurate budget forecasts, and actualize budgets monthly while proactively identifying and communicating pacing or delivery risks. 
  • Troubleshoot platform, tracking, attribution, trafficking, and reporting issues using strong platform expertise and analytical problem-solving skills. 
  • Translate campaign data into clear performance narratives, actionable insights, and optimization recommendations that connect results to client objectives. 
  • Proactively identify and recommend account evolutions, testing opportunities, and platform innovations that improve campaign effectiveness and support account growth. 
  • Communicate account status, campaign performance, and recommendations directly to clients and vendors; participate actively in client meetings and lead day-to-day discussions with support from senior leadership as appropriate. 
  • Develop paid search strategies, performance recommendations, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate day-to-day account projects and collaborate with Integrated Media, Analytics, Strategy, Ad Operations, Creative, and Client Experience teams to deliver campaign objectives and manage cross-functional dependencies. 
  • Delegate and oversee campaign responsibilities assigned to Associates and Senior Associates, breaking down projects into manageable tasks and ensuring deliverables are accurate and timely. 
  • Mentor and train junior team members on platform execution, campaign processes, and best practices while continuing to develop people leadership capabilities. 
  • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, training materials, automation initiatives, and emerging platform capabilities that strengthen team efficiency and performance. 

This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If  

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What You Should Have  

  • 3+ years of professional experience managing digital media campaigns, with significant hands-on experience in paid search. 
  • Strong expertise in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and paid search campaign management. 
  • Experience managing campaigns end to end, including planning, setup, launch, optimization, reporting, and performance analysis. 
  • Strong understanding of bidding strategies, keyword management, audience targeting, attribution, conversion optimization, and campaign measurement. 
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor campaign performance, manage budgets and pacing, and optimize toward established KPIs. 
  • Experience developing forecasts, tracking spend, and maintaining accurate monthly budget actualization. 
  • Ability to troubleshoot platform, tracking, tagging, attribution, and reporting issues. 
  • Experience translating campaign data into meaningful insights, performance narratives, and optimization recommendations. 
  • Strong client communication, presentation, analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Demonstrated project-management, organizational, and prioritization capabilities, including coordinating deliverables across multiple accounts and teams. 
  • Experience delegating tasks, overseeing campaign workstreams, or mentoring and training junior team members. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant reporting and analytics platforms. 
  • Experience with bid management, analytics, and attribution tools is preferred. 
  • Pharmaceutical and healthcare marketing experience is preferred but not required. 

 

Pay Range: $60,000-$80,000

Job Summary: 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team! 

The Manager, Paid Social is responsible for social campaign paid planning, strategy, execution, implementation, and delivery to meet client objectives. 

You’ll be the day-to-day partner to strategy & account teams and will leverage your knowledge of paid social media to support strategy development and delivery. You will activate omni-channel, digital first marketing and advertising campaigns for our clients, leveraging your capabilities in managing paid social media, dynamic ad creative, personalization, and integrated digital media programs. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you’ll do: 

  • Collaborate with internal team and client peers to support strategic solutions that respond to business and communications challenges with healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers 
  • Act as day-to-day paid social media lead across several healthcare accounts, but part of an integrated team; responsible for the execution of social media campaign planning, setup, creation, QA, optimization, performance, and management  
  • Cultivate and maintain in-depth knowledge and understanding of social media platforms and trends to guide account teams and help Real Chemistry continue to be a leader in the space 
  • Create and help present thoughtful, clear, concise decks that translate business objectives and strategies into tangible media plans that achieve business goals 
  • Provide counsel and guidance internally and with client on guiding creative and placement optimizations as well as best practices for incorporating paid social into an overall social strategy 
  • Provide strong input on KPIs for program success and performance data, partnering with analytics teams on building measurement approaches that deliver on KPI’s and goals 
  • Support financial processes; monitor budgets in ad platforms, maintain flowcharts, review and approve campaigns in MediaOcean/Prisma 
  • Provide proactive recommendations on research findings, campaign results, industry trends and innovation, competitive pressures to keep clients informed and manage programs upon best practices of paid social media 
  • Ability to understand key metrics and utilize data and analytics to inform trading strategies and campaign management approach 
  • Build close partnerships with media partners and understand the ecosystem from demand, supply, verification, measurement etc. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

 

What you should have: 

  • 1-3 years of experience managing paid social media and being a hands-on trader, managing a client’s performance marketing/advertising-driven activities across multiple social platforms 
  • Preference for experience in pharma/healthcare industry, but not required - must have strong knowledge of the platforms and data used to support and measure the overall performance of the campaign 
  • Proficiency with social media buying platforms: Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Reddit Ads, X Ads etc. - Meta Blueprint, X Ads Academy/Twitter Flight School and Google Certifications a plus  
  • Display an in-depth understanding of the functionality, strategies behind social media driven campaigns and best practices of all major social platforms 
  • Exceptional project management skills: demonstrated ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines, prioritize and manage detailed budgets 
  • Ability to work well under pressure and to build relationships with internal teams 
  • Work related diversity, equity and inclusion involvement a plus

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Social Media join our growing team!   

This is a hybrid role, based in New York City, Lambertville, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.  

What you’ll do:  

  • Master all things social media: X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Snapchat, YouTube, Pinterest, TikTok you name it. You will have in-depth knowledge of today’s top social platforms.  
  • Develop Organic and Paid Strategies: Counsel clients on best practices incorporating paid social into an overall social strategy. Display knowledge of the functionality, strategies behind social media driven campaigns and best practices of all major social platforms including Facebook/Instagram, X, LinkedIn, etc.   
  • Sharpen your creative skills: You will write compelling, engaging and fresh social media content as well as support templatized graphics creation in Canva and/or work with creative teams, including designers and copy writers, to develop outstanding content for our clients, customized for social platforms and ad units.  
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Act as day-to-day social media lead across multiple healthcare accounts, but part of an integrated team of account, paid social, earned, influencer, analytics and digital media colleagues. Advise the execution of social media tactics including content development and distribution, paid promotions and results reporting.  
  • Thrive in a face-paced, ever evolving environment: Organization is critical for success in this role, whiling maintaining strong organization and tracking of client communications to ensure all deadlines are met. Act as source of truth and knowledge holder when it comes to timelines and processes. Ability to manage multiple competing deadlines, while understanding how to prioritize is key.   
  • Appreciate a world culture that requires constant learning and innovation: Cultivate and maintain in-depth knowledge and understanding of social media trends and platforms to guide account teams and help Real Chemistry continue to be a leader in the space.    

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.  
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  
  • You are a highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

What you should have:   

  • 2-4 years of experience in social media, in biotech or pharmaceutical   
  • College degree (BA or equivalent)   
  • Shown proficiency in social media, both personally and professionally   
  • Understanding of how paid promotion works on the main social media platforms: Facebook/Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok. Experience with social media ad technologies is a plus   
  • Experience working with influencers to create social content  is a plus  
  • Experience in social channel engagement and community management monitoring  
  • Highly organized, mindful of deadlines with the ability to multi-task and work under limited supervision   
  • Experience collaborating effectively internally and externally as part of an integrated team   
  • Outstanding written and oral communications and presentations skills   
  • Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint   
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role preferred   
  • Understanding of the FDA regulations guiding social media efforts for biotech and pharma clients   

Pay Range: $60,000-$75,000

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

No-one’s favourite brand is the one that helps them live longer; we believe it should be. Over the last 5+ years, 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, has been on a mission, bringing a more soulful, meaningful and fundamentally more human approach to healthcare brands. And it’s been successful. But we need to do more. As part of that, we’re looking for a Medical Copywriter with solid experience and a passion for great work to join our growing London team, helping lead client strategy engagements and oversee project and drive new business opportunities.

 

Our mission is about creating the most effective work for clients through the power of creativity, and that starts with listening and thinking. By knowing the audience better than they know themselves, and applying that insight to the client’s business opportunity, we can build brands and create campaigns that are more powerful than any sneaker brand. And for that, we need you in our pursuit of:

  • Using science and creativity to help HCPs improve the lives of patients

  • Putting ourselves in our clients’ shoes

  • Being open to challenges and trying new things

  • Achieving excellence, and persevering…even when it’s tough and we are afraid

  • Doing our personal best – together as a team and as individuals – always!

 

 

What you’ll do:

  • Write clear and concise commercially minded documents, adapting style for different audiences such as healthcare professionals and patients, while adhering to the ABPI code of conduct and quality control processes.

  • Collaborate closely with the strategy, creative and account teams

  • Utilize a variety of credible resources to understand the science and strategy behind assigned projects, ensuring awareness of brand objectives and competitive landscapes.

  • Contribute to proposal development, pitch activities, and brainstorming sessions, while communicating therapy area knowledge effectively.

  • Manage and take ownership of projects, ensuring timelines and deadlines are met, and proactively addressing potential barriers to project completion with solutions.

  • Engage confidently with clients, responding promptly to requests and participating in the briefing process to ensure a clear understanding of project requirements.

  • Participate in the review process, executing editorial deliverables while adhering to project schedules, budgets, and briefs.

  • Immerse in the advertising, medical communications and pharma industry, staying informed about innovations, trends, and developments to integrate into project work creatively.

  • Contribute to maintaining high standards of practice and industry guidelines, ensuring consistent communication and status updates with the account team.

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​You have a passion for science and creativity

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree (minimum Masters, advanced degree preferred [eg, MD, PhD, PharmD] in a science subject required

  • Experience in medical writing, ideally in an agency setting

  • Possesses a solid scientific background and able to learn new therapeutic areas quickly and demonstrate this knowledge

  • Possesses a good understanding and appreciation of the clinical trials process (phases, data representation, drug approval process and key statistical variables)

  • Enthusiasm for learning and a keen eye for detail

  • Demonstrates a clear, concise and accurate writing style, and:

  • Understands the typical language which should and should not be used (comparisons, unverified claims etc.)

  • Understand the processes involved in new business and terminology

  • Demonstrate strong organisational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation

  • Have confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) - particularly PowerPoint

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

 

Medical Writer

Please note, this is not an entry-level position and requires previous experience.

Role Purpose

Our MWs play a fundamental role in our business by contributing to day-to-day project delivery within an account to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for a proactive communicator with a passion for science, a keen interest in AI, and a keen eye for detail who is looking to develop their medical writing career further.  

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Has a good understanding of assigned therapeutic areas
    • Effectively analyses and interprets scientific data to work on a wide range of assigned projects
  • Strategic knowledge:
    • Understands the medical affairs and commercial spaces within which clients work
    • Reviews literature and competitive information to continually expand understanding of brand/marketplace and emerging competitors and shares findings and implications with teams
    • Participates in meetings and strategic discussions with clients, authors, and advisors
  • AI
    • Confidently and efficiently uses AI tools to support assigned tasks, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in their work
    • Seeks out new opportunities to apply AI tools in to improve personal workflow and task management
  • Project ownership:
    • Takes some responsibility for day-to-day delivery of scientific content under supervision of MW2 or SMW and higher
    • Ensures communication objectives are met on assigned projects
  • Editorial:
    • Adapts writing style to suit different audiences (e.g. primary and secondary care physicians, nurses or patients)
    • Structure and writes more commercially focused or complicated materials such as story flows/strategic frameworks, competitor intelligence, advisory board reports, etc. with clear supervision from SMW or higher
  • Quality control:
    • Ensures all work is referenced appropriately and is provided with a full reference pack
    • Ensures all work is tagged appropriately on VVPM
    • Is fully adherent to and shows a good working knowledge the ABPI code of conduct
    • Demonstrates knowledge of good practice/industry guidelines and ensures project work is compliant with these with supervision from senior team
  • On site: May go on-site across a variety of events and interacting with clients and faculty to develop and finalise content
  • Client liaison: Has begun to have client contact for content development on straight-forward projects and escalates queries in more challenging scenarios
  • Project management
    • Adheres to project schedules and briefs
    • Understands key dates in project timelines and keeps the account team apprised of status on projects by providing timely and accurate communication
    • Proactively clarifies how a project status is tracking versus the number of hours available
    • Participates in the tracking of project deliverables, identifying impact of out-of-scope changes
    • Adheres to project budgets, or proactively provides appropriate reasons not to
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on writing and company processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and have a keen eye for detail
  • You should bring previous experience as a (junior) medical writer at an agency or within a pharmaceutical organisation

Procurement, Growth & Strategic Relationships Lead

Real Chemistry is seeking a Procurement, Growth & Strategic Relationships Lead

to join our team.

This is a U.S. hybrid role, based in or near one of our U.S. hubs including Boston - Massachusetts; Carmel - Indiana; Chicago - Illinois; Lambertville - New Jersey; 

This role is ideal for a relationship-driven leader who knows how to navigate client procurement and strategic sourcing environments to unlock and expand long-term partnerships. Reporting to the Head of Business Strategy and Growth, you will serve as a trusted bridge between Real Chemistry and our clients’ procurement and strategic sourcing teams — opening doors, building credibility, deepening engagement, and creating the opportunity for growth.

What You’ll Do

 

  • Build and own trusted relationships with new and select existing client procurement and strategic sourcing stakeholders, serving as a credible, consistent point of contact who understands their goals and drives solution identification and growth opportunities.
  • Proactively generate and qualify new leads within client procurement and strategic sourcing organizations, building and advancing a robust pipeline of introductory and expansion opportunities across capabilities and markets.
  • Plan, organize, and lead client procurement capability meetings, developing and delivering curated, client-relevant content for introductory, capability, and relationship conversations that showcase Real Chemistry’s full range of services and solutions.
  • Serve as a consistent door opener for Real Chemistry, proactively introducing capability and account leads to new stakeholders, business units, and decision-makers within client procurement organizations to create fresh entry points for growth.
  • Partner closely with existing client leads to develop a deep understanding of each client’s business, priorities, and procurement dynamics — translating those insights into strategies that expand and strengthen our engagements.
  • Support evolution of Real Chemistry’s overall framework for engaging client procurement teams, creating a repeatable model that supports growth across our extended portfolio.
  • Keep senior stakeholders informed on relationship status, growth opportunities, and any risks to existing engagements.
  • Drive post-engagement debriefs to capture learnings and continuously strengthen how we build and grow client relationships.

 

This Role Is a Good Fit If You

 

  • Lead with relationships — you build trust quickly, invest in long-term partnerships, and know that the best commercial outcomes follow genuine connection
  • Are energized by growth — you see every client interaction as an opportunity to expand what’s possible and are motivated by opening new doors
  • Are a natural connector who can move fluidly between client-facing conversations and internal collaboration across teams and disciplines
  • Are a strategic thinker who can also execute with precision — especially in situations without an existing playbook
  • Are comfortable leading through influence rather than authority in a highly matrixed organization
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven agency environment and adapt quickly as priorities shift
  • Are driven, resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity as the business evolves
  • Value continuous improvement and are always looking for ways to make relationships and processes stronger

 

What You Should Have

 

  • 12+ years of experience in client relationship management, account leadership, strategic sourcing, or procurement — with at least 5 years in a senior leadership position; candidates from account or client services backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply if they bring deep, demonstrated experience engaging client procurement and strategic sourcing organizations
  • A proven track record of generating new business leads and building and growing strategic client relationships, including meaningful experience navigating and influencing client procurement, strategic sourcing, or finance stakeholders — with demonstrated success opening doors to new stakeholders and leading capability meetings that convert into new engagements
  • Deep healthcare industry experience across pharmaceutical, biotech, life sciences companies, or agency partners
  • Understanding of the procurement landscape, including market trends, client ESG priorities, and regulatory requirements across the healthcare ecosystem — including global experience
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust at all levels of a client organization and articulate the Real Chemistry value proposition compellingly
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple relationships and priorities simultaneously
  • Highly motivated self-starter who can create structure and momentum where none exists

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media’s product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product’s future.

We are hiring a Product Manager to lead the definition of that product. Reporting to the VP, Product, you will work closely with engineering, design, data science, and customers to turn open-ended problems into shipped software. You will own what gets built and define the shape of the product as it evolves. The team is small and we’re building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Own product areas on the roadmap end to end, from problem definition through launch and iteration.

  • Work closely with designers and engineers, holding a high bar for quality and helping the team meet it.

  • Collaborate across teams to prioritize the backlog against customer impact, technical reality, and business commitments.

  • Partner with data engineering and data science on the models and recommendation features built on top of them.

  • Use product analytics, usage data, competitive analysis, and qualitative user feedback to figure out what’s working and what to build next.

  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to inform the platform vision and product development process as the team scales.

  • Define product milestones and collaborate with project management to keep engineering, design, and client teams on track to deliver on time.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What You Should Have:

  • 4+ years in product management or similar roles shipping B2B or enterprise software.

  • Experience working closely with engineering, design, and data teams to lead workflow and data-heavy products.

  • Fluency with APIs, data models, and AI/LLM feature development.

  • Skill at writing clear specs and breaking large problems into shippable iterations.

  • Expertise and enthusiasm about building considered enterprise software, and solid footing in the competitive landscape.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and seeking early feedback from users to inform improvements.

  • Ability to communicate and drive buy-in with technical and non-technical audiences and collaborators.

  • Experience in Agile product development environments.

  • Bonus points for martech, adtech, orchestration tooling, or healthcare experience.

 

Pay Range: $100,000-$125,000

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Manager to join our growing Medical Affairs team!   

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering assigned medical affairs projects from initiation through final closeout, including planning, coordination, budget management, routing, approvals, and launch of project deliverables. Projects may include slide decks, print projects, congress materials, advisory board materials, scientific communications, and smaller digital initiatives. This role serves as a main point of contact across internal and external teams, partnering closely with Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, User Experience, Technology, and Quality Assurance partners to keep work on time, on budget, and aligned to client expectations.

Whether it’s bringing in the right resources at the right time, aligning priorities with the account team, or identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions early, no two days are the same.  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago or Indianapolis—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily work Eastern business hours.

What you’ll do:  

  • Clearly communicate expectations to internal teams and vendors to support the efficient flow of work throughout the agency. 
  • Partner with key agency teams to ensure projects stay on track and agreed-upon milestones are met, including Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, Strategic Planning, Information UX, Technology, and Programming teams. 
  • Plan, schedule, and monitor work to meet timeline, budget, and quality goals in accordance with relevant guidelines. 
  • Collaborate with finance and accounting teams on revenue recognition/invoicing processes 
  • Participate in client and stakeholder meetings as needed, with a clear understanding of project status and timelines to respond to relevant questions and provide project updates when appropriate.
  • Perform risk planning and mitigation to minimize project risk. 
  • Help create service or departmental standard operating procedures 
  • Route deliverables to appropriate core team members for review and signoff via the electronic project routing system.  
  • Ensure signoff prior to key milestones, including core team review, medical/scientific review, client review, vendor handoff, and final release. 
  • Develop detailed work plans, schedules, and status reports to keep internal teams, clients, and external partners aligned throughout the project life cycle. 
  • Serve as a day-to-day project lead, helping define scope and objectives while motivating cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. 
  • Coordinate project deliverables from concept through delivery, ensuring the appropriate internal departments, reviews, approvals, and handoffs are engaged at each stage. 
  • Support adherence to agency process and manage the quality assurance phase for all projects.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are a highly organized self-starter who can work independently and manage tight deadlines. 

What you should have:   

  • 3+ years of Project/Program Management or relevant experience. 
  • 2+ years of experience in budget management. 
  • Working familiarity with industry-specific processes, including medical, legal, regulatory, and client review. 
  • Background working on teams focused on medical affairs, scientific communications, medical education, or related non-promotional healthcare communications projects. 
  • Demonstrated track record of leading small- to medium-scale projects from conception through completion. 
  • Experience working cross-functionally with medical/scientific, editorial, account, creative, and project management partners to deliver high-quality products and services. 
  • Proficient in creating timelines and tracking progress against schedules.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As a Senior Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium to large projects. As a client account lead or captain (depending on the size of the account), you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead and/or sponsor.

 

You should have a clear understanding of the programme as a whole (not just the projects you are working on) across your accounts, increasing your involvement in the strategic planning and financial management of your accounts and focusing on developing your leadership style to actively manage up and down, based on project needs.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client (leading updates on more complex projects); anticipate client needs; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Confidently formulate objectives and strategies for new client work with support from your account lead, ensuring that programme strategy is pulled through

  • Lead large projects with less support from your account lead, being accountable for the whole project from start to finish

  • Provide counsel to the client throughout the project with confidence to challenge the client when required; manage challenging conversations with the client, as required

  • Provide support to your account lead in addressing programme and team challenges

  • Formulate solutions to client challenges such as last-minute requests

  • Have a clear understanding of the programme as a whole (not just the projects you are working on), including the client objectives, strategy and environment so that you are able to confidently lead internal meetings and client calls

  • Ensure momentum is maintained across the programme and contact with client continues whenever the account lead is absent

 

Business development

  • Identify areas for organic growth within existing accounts (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics) and confidently sell new ideas in to clients, with support from your account lead

  • Play a management role in the new business process (assisting in the production of credentials and pitch presentations, coordinating and managing team members and external suppliers), having a significant share of voice/visibility with the internal cross-functional team

 

Team management

  • Begin to develop your leadership style, instilling professional values and good working habits in your teams

  • Look for opportunities to inspire, motivate, and empower your team on a daily basis, leading by example and setting the standard for junior accounts team members

  • Provide coaching and mentoring to junior team members and manage their performance

  • Support interviewing for new AAs – SAAs

  • Line manage at least one accounts team member AAs – SAAs, providing day-to-day support and longer-term career development guidance

 

Financial management

  • Develop more complicated budgets for integrated client programmes and track resource use against available budget throughout the month

  • Coach others to develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting back on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Support your account lead with the financial management of your accounts, proactively getting involved in invoicing, forecasting and resourcing and attend month-end finance meetings

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across the majority of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Keep abreast of award-winning work and insights from other industries, sharing as appropriate

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Excellent business communication skills, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • Excellent business communication skills

  • Informal/formal presentation and writing skills; including presenting to clients

  • Skilled in data communication

  • Experience with Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, and Excel).

  • Edit junior staff writing and presentation material

  • Must have Medical Education experience; integrated experience preferred.

  • Skilled in data communication and able to develop final documents and presentations

  • Able to develop solutions to client needs and problems, with a strong work ethic and a track record of high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Manager join our growing Medical Affairs team!   

The Senior Account Manager for the Scientific and Medical Affairs team is the client’s key day-to-day contact, managing relationships and helping to set their expectations of the agency. You make sure that your colleagues know what is going on and are delivering effectively. You are thinking about future opportunities as well as today’s work.   

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:  

  • Day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans  
  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work, delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  
  • You are a highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

What you should have:   

  • A minimum of 4-5+ years of prior experience in healthcare agency client services roles with medical affairs, publications, and/or medical information experience required 
  • Highly organized with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail  
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration  
  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation

job.title: Senior AI Transformation Analyst
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is seeking an  AI Transformation Senior Analyst to help reimagine how our business runs. You will join our transformation team, working alongside ambitious, supportive, and hard-working colleagues who always seek to do things better, faster, and smarter.

As an AI Transformation Senior Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in mapping how work gets done today and designing how it should get done in an AI-enabled future. Starting with our General & Administrative (G&A) functions, including finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, and internal communications, you will document current-state processes and operating models, design future-state alternatives, and help bring them to life across several AI transformation initiatives. You will also build the business case for each opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on the value they deliver. You will look holistically across people, processes, systems, and vendors to determine what should be automated or redesigned and which solution best fits each need, from a reusable AI skill to an end-to-end Copilot Cowork workflow or a coordinated team of AI agents. This position reports to the Vice President, Strategy and Revenue Analytics.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Map current-state processes: Lead process discovery with G&A stakeholders across finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, internal communications, and more to document how work gets done today, including handoffs, systems, data flows, vendors, pain points, and the time and cost behind each step.
  • Design future-state operating models: Translate current-state findings into practical future-state designs that rethink roles, responsibilities, governance, and ways of working, rather than simply digitizing today's processes.
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities: Assess where AI and automation can eliminate, streamline, or augment manual work, build business cases that size the impact, and shape a prioritized transformation roadmap.
  • Match the right solution to the problem: Determine the right fit for each need, whether a reusable AI skill, a Copilot Cowork workflow, a coordinated swarm of AI agents, an enhancement to an existing system, or a process change with no new technology at all, and partner with technical teams to pilot and scale solutions.
  • Get more from current automations: Inventory and assess the automations and tools already in place, identify gaps and redundancies, and recommend how to extract more value from existing investments.
  • Rethink sourcing and vendors: Analyze what we outsource versus perform in-house, assess vendor fit and cost, and determine where AI enablement means outsourced work should instead be automated or brought in-house.
  • Drive change and adoption: Partner with function leaders to plan and execute transitions, including change management, training, communications, and success measures that make new ways of working stick.
  • Advise leadership: Develop clear, executive-ready materials, including process maps, operating model blueprints, business cases, and roadmaps, and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if you:

  • Think like a consultant and act like an owner, bringing structured problem solving and a bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges.
  • Are energized by rethinking traditional processes for the age of AI, and stay curious about emerging tools, agents, and automation approaches.
  • See the whole picture across people, processes, systems, vendors, and data, and understand how a change in one area ripples through the others.
  • Are highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, adept at managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment while delivering results under tight deadlines.
  • Build trust quickly with stakeholders at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership, and can guide teams confidently through change.

What you should have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in strategy, transformation, or digital consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Deloitte Digital, or similar firms, large or boutique), or in a corporate strategy, transformation, or M&A integration role.
  • Hands-on experience with transformation work, such as digital transformation, M&A integration, acquisitions, or divestitures, including process mapping, integration or separation planning, Day 1 readiness, or operating model design.
  • Demonstrated experience mapping current- and future-state processes and designing target operating models, ideally across G&A or back-office functions.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI assistants, AI agents, workflow automation platforms such as Power Automate or Workato, or RPA) and the ability to translate business needs into practical automation use cases.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and analysis tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings simply and confidently to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • PR, communications, advertising, healthcare, or agency experience a plus.

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

job.description:

Role Overview

Real Chemistry is looking for an experienced Senior Analyst (Omnichannel Analytics) to help us build and scale our business intelligence practice for our media and omnichannel clients through advanced analytics, insights, and attribution modeling. We are looking for someone with hands-on-keyboard experience crafting analyses that answer clients’ key business questions about media performance. Reporting to the Director, Beyond Insights, this position will be client facing, with the opportunity to speak to ongoing deliverables and work with cross-functional media, strategy, and technology teams. You will get to use a new set of data partners to seamlessly integrate media and channel data flowing from partners into Tableau dashboards and ultimately client-facing performance reports. 

Location: This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN. 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Build, manage, and deliver time-based performance reporting for media and omnichannel campaigns (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting) 
  • Integrate media, channel, and partner data sources into Tableau dashboards and client-facing performance reports 
  • Conduct data exploration, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and mining across structured media and marketing data sources 
  • Develop quantitative analyses, predictive models, and attribution approaches that explain how media programs are performing and where to optimize 
  • Craft analyses and insights that answer clients’ key business questions, and present findings directly to client and internal stakeholders 
  • Partner with media, strategy, data engineering, and marketing technology teams on measurement methodology and campaign execution 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence/advanced analytics/data analytics working closely with data 
  • Pharmaceutical media and marketing experience, with hands-on exposure to HCP and/or consumer omnichannel campaigns 
  • Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis, including the development of algorithms leveraging SQL, R or Python 
  • Experience working with relational databases and with Snowflake or Databricks 
  • Experience with visualization tools/packages such as Tableau or PowerBI, and with creating dashboards 
  • Experience with reporting in media tools like Google Campaign Manager, Doubleclick Campaign Manager and Adobe Experience Manager 
  • Experience building reports in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations to senior clients externally or to senior internal stakeholders 
  • Formal training/education in quantitative/data analysis, and an understanding of causal inference 
  • Understanding of visual information design principles 
  • Knowledge of agile principles/project management and experience with agile tools and methodologies 

The Ideal Candidate 

  • Creative. You are energized by turning messy, multi-source media data into clear answers to real business questions. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers 
  • Customer first. You enjoy client-facing work and can explain your analysis and its implications to a non-technical audience 
  • A collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional teams and are comfortable working across Media, Analytics, Strategy, and Technology partners 
  • A culture carrier. You embody Real Chemistry’s values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I.”

Job Summary: 

The Senior Art Director is a senior-level creative contributor within the agency who may interface directly with Real Chemistry clients as well as all areas of the organization. Primary responsibilities include guiding the ideation and creative development for projects, business development, and some corporate marketing as needed. In addition to possessing an excellent knowledge of effective graphic and/or presentation design techniques (via both the Adobe Creative Suite and Microsoft Office, especially Word and PowerPoint), a successful Senior Art Director should possess a thorough understanding of the principles of successfully integrating copy with art and layouts. This position also requires strong creative problem-solving skills and the ability to translate strategic ideas into polished deliverables and then present them to key stakeholders.  

This is a hybrid role, based in New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will work eastern business hours.

 What you'll do:

Otherwise known as the “essential functions”, these are the parts of the job that a crucial to successful performance. 

  • Provide quality assurance for all related design deliverables 
  • Manage/lead/direct promotional art projects  
  • Assess client needs, propose, and develop innovative multimedia solutions 
  • Understand and develop new technology to maintain agency competitiveness 
  • Possess advanced experience with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop 
  • Provide a work breakdown structure (WBS) and budget for complex deliverables 
  • Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing 
  • Potential to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments

 This position is a perfect fit for you if:

What you should have:

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

starpower, part of Real Chemistry, is a leading entertainment, talent, influencer, and cultural marketing agency that helps brands build authentic connections with audiences through the power of culture. For more than two decades, we've partnered with brands to develop impactful programs spanning celebrity partnerships, influencer marketing, talent procurement, experiential activations, content, sponsorships, and strategic consulting. Widely recognized as the bridge between Hollywood and healthcare, starpower brings unmatched expertise in connecting healthcare, wellness, consumer, and lifestyle brands with the talent, creators, and cultural moments that matter most.

 

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Entertainment & Sport will develop, negotiate, and execute strategic partnerships for specific healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts. Working closely with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams, this role will connect brands with entertainment and sport properties, teams, leagues, and talent. The position requires deep industry relationships, strong commercial judgment, and agency-or buyer-side experience building brand partnerships from strategy through activation.

Title: Senior Director, Entertainment & Sports

 

Responsibilities

 

Client Partnership Strategy

  • Develop entertainment and sports partnership strategies for healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts, in collaboration with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities with properties, teams, leagues, talent, rights holders, and other industry partners based on each client’s objectives.
  • Translate client objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into differentiated partnership platforms and activation ideas.

 

Deal Development, Negotiation & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end partnership process, including opportunity sourcing, valuation, proposal development, rights packaging, negotiation, contracting support, and activation planning.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations that balance brand impact, audience relevance, budget, risk, and measurable value.
  • Partner with legal, finance, creative, strategy, experiential, influencer, social, and media teams to deliver programs on time and within scope.
  • Oversee partnership activation and optimization, ensuring contractual rights are fully leveraged and programs meet brand and compliance requirements.

 

Client Leadership & Industry Relationships

  • Serve as a senior advisor on assigned client accounts, partnering with Real Chemistry leadership to guide partnership choices and present recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and agency partners.
  • Use market intelligence and relationships to create access, uncover opportunities, and strengthen negotiating positions for clients.

 

Business Development & Team Contribution

  • Support new business pitches, proposals, and organic growth opportunities by contributing partnership expertise, recommendations, and industry insights.
  • Partner with Real Chemistry leadership to strengthen entertainment and sports resources, partner networks, evaluation tools, case studies, and best practices.
  • Represent Real Chemistry at relevant industry events and stay current on emerging properties, talent, platforms, audience behaviors, and partnership models.
  • Share expertise with team members and foster collaborative, rigorous, and commercially minded ways of working.

 

Qualifications and Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in entertainment and sports partnerships, sponsorships, brand marketing, or a related field.
  • Significant agency- or buyer-side experience developing, negotiating, and executing partnerships for brands.
  • Deep, active relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and relevant intermediaries.
  • Demonstrated expertise in rights valuation, deal structure, negotiation, contracting processes, activation planning, and partnership measurement.
  • Experience in healthcare, health and wellness, or another highly regulated category is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer audiences, culture, media, experiential marketing, social platforms, and talent-led programs.
  • Excellent client leadership, communication, presentation, and financial skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex partnerships and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, detail-oriented, and energized by building new capabilities and offerings.

 

Pay Range: $135,000 - $180,000

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

The Role

The Senior Director, Strategy will focus primarily on:

  • Supporting and leading enterprise new business opportunities
  • Contributing to organic growth initiatives within existing accounts
  • Building strategic pitch decks and narrative frameworks
  • Supporting and leading workshop development and facilitation

This role is highly collaborative and execution-focused. You will help architect the story, build the deck, and ensure the strategic narrative is clear, differentiated, and persuasive.

 

What You’ll Do

Enterprise New Business

  • Partner with senior strategy leads to shape pitch strategy and positioning
  • Build structured, insight-driven pitch decks that tell a clear and compelling story
  • Synthesize clinical, market, competitive, and audience insights into sharp strategic frameworks
  • Ensure alignment between strategy, creative, medical, engagement, and data teams

Organic Growth Support

  • Shape the development of strategic narratives for expansion opportunities
  • Build materials that introduce fresh thinking and elevate client conversations
  • Support and/or lead workshop preparation, materials development, and facilitation

Strategic Storytelling

  • Translate complex scientific and commercial information into clear business implications
  • Establish logical flow and narrative cohesion across presentations
  • Elevate the quality, clarity, and confidence of pitch, RFI, and new business materials

What Makes You a Strong Fit

    pharmaceutical marketing
  • Experience supporting new business or pitch environments
  • Breadth across multiple therapeutic categories
  • Strong strategic writing and storytelling skills
  • Exceptional PowerPoint and deck-building capability
  • Ability to structure ambiguous information into clear narratives

You are:

  • Structured, curious, decisive
  • Comfortable with ambiguity
  • Confident but coachable
  • Detail-oriented and quality-driven
  • Energized by high-stakes moments
  • Motivated by building something new
