job.title: Senior Manager, Evidence & Insights (RWE & HEOR)
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for an Senior Manager join our growing Evidence & Insights team! 

The Senior Manager, Evidence & Insights provides strategic and scientific support across real-world evidence (RWE), health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and evidence generation. This role co-leads client engagements end-to-end, helping to shape evidence strategies, oversee analytics and deliverables, and advise biopharma and related stakeholders. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do: 

  • Co-lead and support RWE and HEOR strategy across client programs, including evidence planning, study design, and interpretation of findings to inform value, access, and payer and health system decision-making. 
  • Design and support evidence generation plans (e.g., RWE studies, retrospective database studies, economic models) aligned to product lifecycle needs and client requirements. 
  • Develop and oversee the process for systematic literature reviews (SLRs), including the development of study protocols, execution of study searches, delegation of screening, and oversight of data extraction and reporting (leveraging the Nested Knowledge platform where possible).
  • Translate complex real-world datasets and outcomes evidence into clear, defensible insights and recommendations for clients (clinical, economic, and utilization outcomes). 
  • Serve as a client co-lead alongside Director and VP: build trusted relationships, guide strategic direction, and ensure work products meet scientific rigor, timelines, and client expectations. 
  • Directly manage staff planning, internal and external project timelines, internal and external communications, and budgets to ensure projects are adequately staffed, managed, and executed.
  • Stay current on evolving evidence standards and trends impacting access decisions, including: 
    • HTA requirements and value frameworks 
    • Payer evidence expectations and comparative effectiveness 
    • RWE guidance and regulatory considerations 
    • Measurement/reporting of quality, performance, and outcomes 
  • Co-lead scoping and resourcing for engagements: define scope of work, timelines, budgets, and staffing plans; proactively manage risks and changes. 
  • Partner cross-functionally to connect evidence strategy to broader client objectives and account growth. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have: 

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience in HEOR, RWE, SLR, epidemiology, outcomes research, market access strategy, or closely related fields (consulting and/or biopharma experience preferred). 
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in health economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, or related discipline. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in HEOR/RWE study design and execution and ability to translate evidence into access-relevant strategy. 
  • Strong project/program leadership experience, including managing teams on complex, multi-workstream engagements and ensuring scientific and editorial quality. 
  • Excellent writing, editing, and executive communication skills; ability to craft clear narratives from technical analyses. 
  • Strong analytical fluency and comfort engaging with complex datasets and statistical outputs (hands-on analytics not required but highly valued). 
  • Client-service orientation, sound judgment, high attention to detail, and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook). 

 Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

Job Summary:  

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Manager, Integrated Intelligence join our growing team!   

Real Chemistry Analytics enables smarter decision-making through the power of data, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and actionable insights. Our teams help clients understand audience behavior, measure performance, uncover growth opportunities, and optimize business outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. By combining healthcare expertise with data science, measurement, and strategic consulting, we help clients transform complex information into meaningful actions that drive impact for brands, healthcare professionals, and patients.  

In this role, you will help turn data from a range of sources into meaningful insights and clear, strategic narratives from both quantitative and qualitative data. You will work in partnership with senior leads and cross-functional teams to deliver standard and custom analyses across integrated communications and business questions.  

Curiosity and a willingness to think outside the box are a must, as we are often tasked with answering age-old communications and marketing questions in a new way. 

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.  

Who you are:   

  • You have a passion for telling stories fueled by data and insights   
  • You’re innovative and want to bring value and new ideas to everything you do   
  • You have a moderate understanding of (or willingness to learn) the healthcare/pharmaceutical space   
  • You thrive in an environment that requires constant learning and adaptation   
  • You are reliable, organized, and conscientious  
  • You work well independently, but also enjoy collaborative work assignments   
  • You get the importance of staying on top of the details and believe in exceeding expectations   

What you’ll do:  

  • Manage and support day-to-day analytics and intelligence workstreams across client accounts, remaining actively involved in the research, data analysis, and development of deliverables. 
  • Assist in the development of integrated analyses that connect multiple data sources and translate findings into clear insights, implications, strategic recommendations, and cohesive narratives. 
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis across social, digital, search, media, audience, competitive, and customer data to uncover meaningful trends and opportunities. 
  • Build and refine keyword-based queries, Boolean searches, data pulls, and analytical frameworks, while guiding junior team members in their development and application. 
  • Aggregate, clean, organize, interpret, and quality-check data, particularly for complex, ambiguous, or high-priority assignments. 
  • Help synthesize research into clear strategic narratives that guide client communications and engagement strategies. 
  • Manage and contribute directly to recurring and ad hoc reporting, as well as audience, influencer, competitive, landscape, and measurement assessments. 
  • Contribute to KPI frameworks, success metrics, benchmarks, and measurement plans. 
  • Partner with account, strategy, activation, data visualization, and data science teams to deliver integrated solutions, and present findings and recommendations to internal and external audiences. 
  • Aid in the management of project timelines, deliverable expectations, and day-to-day coordination while reviewing work, coaching junior team members, and stepping into the details when needed. 
  • Contribute to methodology development, process improvements, proprietary tools, new-business efforts, and capability-building initiatives across the Integrated Intelligence team. 

What you’ll bring:   

  • 4+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: marketing analytics, communications analytics, social listening, digital analytics, audience research, strategic planning, search analytics, primary or syndicated research, or healthcare/pharmaceutical marketing. Agency experience strongly preferred, given the specific client mix for this role. 
  • Deep understanding and experience with social media listening, including comfort working with data across social platforms and familiarity with platforms such as Brandwatch, Quid, Meltwater or Muck Rack.  
  • Familiarity with cross-channel measurement reporting and analytics, including KPI tracking, performance benchmarks, audience engagement, digital behavior, and communications outcomes. 
  • Project management experience, including handling timelines and expectations for multiple deliverables. 
  • Experience developing reporting deliverables, landscape analyses, performance readouts, or insight-driven presentations.  
  • Experience with multi-modal research approaches, using novel data sets and triangulating across methodologies to deliver impact. 
  • A passion for telling stories motivated by data and insights, bringing creativity to analytics, and merging art and science, qual and quant.  
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot.  

 

Pay Range: $85,000 - $105,000

This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Confidently steps into new therapeutic areas
    • Starting to lead discussions with clients and external experts on therapy area, drivers which influence treatment decision-making and patient pathways
  • Strategic knowledge: Helps to lead meetings and strategic discussions with clients
  • AI
    • Proactively utilizes a broad range of AI solutions to streamline complex projects, with support from others
    • Evaluates and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of projects, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with team members to optimize project delivery
    • Provides guidance and training to team members on best practice
  • Project ownership:
    • Leads content delivery for complex projects with supervision from senior team, delegating to AMW/MWs as needed and where appropriate to ensure timely execution to a high standard
    • Skilled in achieving communications objectives by employing a broad range of channels and formats
  • Project development:
    • Interrogates briefs from clients/internal teams and proactively flags any queries or potential issues
    • Applies critical thinking skills towards a project brief to achieve deliverables in a timely and efficient manner
    • Provides a proactive, solution-focused approach towards resolving queries, and addressing feedback
    • Initiates discussions with Account Teams regarding potential barriers to successful project completion that may arise
  • Editorial:
    • Develops compelling narratives from complex information
    • Structures and writes novel projects that may not have been executed previously
  • Quality control:
    • Takes responsibility for overall quality of deliverables with supervision from senior team
    • Reviews JMWs’ work for adherence to brief, client objectives and quality of writing, providing constructive feedback
  • On site: Leads elements of the on-site programme across a variety of events with support from others
  • Client liaison: Leads scientific discussion with clients and external experts as appropriate to capture briefs, resolve queries, and progress scientific content development in timely and efficient manner
  • Growth and new business
    • Supports development of scientific content for new therapeutic areas for new business
    • Proactively identifies new business opportunities with new and existing clients
  • Project management: Provides timely and accurate communication to accounts team on writer hours, and project progress
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on account-specific therapy area knowledge and processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • You should bring previous experience of medical writing at an MW level or above

  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and capable of nurturing relationships. Previous experience mentoring MWs and interacting regularly with clients is essential

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Position Summary:

The Senior Medical Writer serves as an integral part of the Real Chemistry Medical Communications division in developing scientific content in support of a variety of omnichannel medical communication tactics, as assigned to particular therapeutic areas and client brands. The Senior Medical Writer must have the ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific data and translate these into compelling and relevant clinical communications and commercial/medical messages. The Senior Medical Writer collaborates closely with the Medical Director and cross-functional teammates in the development and execution of scientific strategies and tactics. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you'll do:

  • Develop core deliverables (eg, PowerPoint slides, manuscripts, video scripts, executive summaries) and ancillary materials (eg, participant handouts, moderator guides) for medical communication projects, including promotional/medical presentations, advisory board meetings, product theaters as well as various educational videos and digital solutions
  • Perform and analyze literature searches and scientific research regarding clinical data and key scientific information for content development projects to meet client needs for relevant, up-to-date, evidenced-based, and accurate medical communication content
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director, in partnership with Creative and Client Services, on medical storytelling, drawing upon client insights, landscape intelligence, and relevant evidence-based medical literature to provide informed and relevant strategic recommendations
  • Partner with Presentation and Graphic Designers on various illustrations, animations, and creative applications of medical and scientific information
  • As assigned, develop relationships and collaborate closely with clients and key opinion leaders to develop scientific content and execute medical communication strategy to communicate complex scientific information to medical professionals 
  • Conduct quality checks on all content-related materials, including annotated deliverables, to ensure scientific integrity and accuracy, and support Veeva submissions of all medical communication deliverables for client medical/legal/regulatory reviews by highlighting all relevant references and creating detailed reference notes
  • Support project management within the cross-functional team by effectively communicating and aligning with Account and Project Managers, and actively participating in all internal and client meetings
  • Train and mentor more junior medical writers under the guidance of the Medical Director
  • Maintain full compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements as well as all applicable US laws and regulations
  • Perform any other duties as reasonably assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations warrant 

Working Conditions:

  • Work Schedule/Hours: This position requires occasional nonstandard work hours in accordance with project needs, deadlines, deliverables, and urgent client requests    
  • Business Travel: This position requires moderate overnight/weekend travel (up to 20%) based upon client geography
  • This position has no direct reports and does not perform supervisory tasks 

What you should have: 

  • Advanced degree (eg, MD, PhD, PharmD, MPH, MS) in a healthcare-related field required 
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in medical education, scientific research, or clinical practice/insights preferred, or 2-3 years of experience in medical education in a pharmaceutical company or medical communications agency required, with experience in promotional/medical communication to healthcare professionals preferred
  • Experience with medical, legal, and regulatory reviews preferred
  • Expert verbal and written communication skills in the field of medical science 
  • Intermediate ability to analyze the scientific relevance, validity, and credibility of the published medical literature
  • Intermediate level of conceptual and functional understanding of modern digital marketing practices and the applications of artificial intelligence technology 

Core Competencies:

Whether acting in a promotional or nonpromotional nature, we serve as envoys for our clients’ messages, a resource for their customers, and stewards of the money they invest with us. As such, Real Chemistry holds employees to a high standard when it comes to communication, culture, and collaboration, specifically: 

  • Model corporate values—Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability With an “I”—in interactions with colleagues, clients, vendors, and HCPs as well as exercise impeccable professionalism and sound judgement when representing the agency
  • Demonstrate strong work efficiency by managing time, meeting deadlines, and achieving billability expectations
  • Display excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as a high level of emotional intelligence, as demonstrated by advanced verbal, writing, and presentation skills as well as a strong ability to influence and impact others through meaningful and persuasive delivery
  • Exhibit advanced teaming and collaboration skills, including proactively communicating changes, completing tasks as assigned and on agreed timeline, adapting to changes provided by the team, and seeking opportunities to help other teammates
  • Apply the knowledge and skills necessary to deliver high-quality work, as exhibited by strong accuracy, problem solving, quality management, and client-centric behaviors 

Pay Range: $90,000-100,000

The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our growing Promotional Medical Education team!   

The Senior Project Manager leads the planning, coordination, and delivery of complex client campaigns across one or more accounts. This role keeps teams aligned, manages scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and client approvals, and partners closely with Account, Finance, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will work Eastern standard business hours.

  • Own day-to-day project management for assigned campaigns from initiation through closeout, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget 
  • Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, status reports, and resource plans across multiple complex deliverables and teams 
  • Partner with Account, Finance, internal teams, subcontractors, and client stakeholders to keep work moving and ensure clear communication at every stage 
  • Monitor budgets weekly, support revenue recognition and invoicing activities, and flag financial risks or scope changes early 
  • Lead project meetings, manage client review and approval processes, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards and relevant guidelines 
  • Identify, escalate, and help resolve risks, timeline conflicts, resource constraints, and project issues 
  • Support business development efforts by contributing project management guidance, budgets, timelines, and implementation planning as needed 
  • Participate in project audits and help reinforce consistent project management processes and best practices 
  • Coach, mentor, and train project management team members and contribute to onboarding or discipline-specific training 
  • Share best practices through the Project Management Community of Practice and contribute to process improvements or standard operating procedures
  • Participate in hiring activities for the project management discipline, such as panel interviews or job shadows 
  • Develop and empower people, manage change, build relationships and influence others, build and lead effective teams, and achieve results

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines 

What you should have:   

  • 4+ years of project management experience in an agency setting
  • 3+ years of experience in budget development/management 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related business experience 
  • Experience leading multiple cross-functional project teams and deliverable types, as well as successful management of campaign budgets 
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills and familiarity with structured project management methodology; PMP certification preferred 
  • Strong communication, organization, leadership, problem-solving, and client-readiness skills 
  • Prior experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical industry or agency preferred
  • Experience in Workfront is highly preferred

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Senior Strategist 

21GRAMS | Strategy | London 

Job Summary 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Strategist to join the growing 21GRAMS Strategy team in London. This is an opportunity to support high-profile global accounts within one of healthcare advertising’s most creative agencies, working alongside award-winning creative, strategy and client teams. 

You will combine strong research and analytical foundations with creative strategic thinking. You will explore markets, audiences and competitors, turn insights into clear strategic recommendations, and help shape work that resonates with clients and their audiences. The role will mainly support senior strategists while offering strong scope to learn, collaborate internationally and progress as the team continues to grow. 

What you’ll do 

  • Conduct primary and desk research to build a clear understanding of markets, sectors, audiences and behaviours. 
  • Develop consumer and stakeholder insights that help shape creative and brand strategy. 
  • Carry out category and competitor analysis, identifying the most relevant opportunities and challenges. 
  • Support senior strategy colleagues across global account work, strategic projects and client deliverables. 
  • Contribute to creative briefs, strategic narratives and presentations, making complex findings clear and engaging. 
  • Work closely with Creative, Client Services, Medical Education and wider cross-functional teams. 
  • Support new business pitches through research, insight development and strategic thinking. 
  • Present thinking confidently to internal teams and, as experience grows, to clients. 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are curious, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in understanding people and what drives them. 
  • You are a clear and engaging communicator who enjoys presenting ideas and contributing to discussion. 
  • You bring positive energy, ambition and a desire to develop within strategy. 
  • You can balance detailed research with the ability to step back, identify the key insight and tell a compelling story. 
  • You are collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across different disciplines and with colleagues in other markets. 
  • You are adaptable, organised and able to deliver high-quality work against deadlines. 
  • Our Company values - Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” - really speak to you. 

What you should have 

  • Approximately 3-5 years of strategy, planning, research or insight experience within an agency environment. 
  • Experience in healthcare advertising is welcome, but candidates from traditional consumer or AOR advertising agencies who are interested in moving into healthcare will also be considered. 
  • A strong foundation in market research, desk research, audience insight and competitor or category analysis. 
  • Experience working across more than one client, category, sector or therapy area. 
  • An understanding of how agency teams operate, including fast-paced delivery and changing priorities. 
  • Experience supporting new business pitches is useful but not essential. 
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to distil information into clear, persuasive recommendations.

job.title: Social Content Creator
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

The Role:  

We're looking for a senior social-first content creator who lives and breathes digital culture and knows exactly what stops the scroll. You'll create platform-native content that connects brand goals with real-world healthcare impact, blending creativity, strategy, and what audiences are actually engaging with right now. You will sit and be embedded on the social media team. 

This is your chance to make health feel less clinical and more human, using your design chops, storytelling instincts, and cultural fluency to create scroll-worthy work that performs. Think: TikTok edits that explain the science and get shared. Instagram carousels that inform without boring. And LinkedIn posts that even non-HCPs want to save.  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Develop platform-native content concepts and creative approaches tailored to how audiences consume content across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and emerging social platforms
  • Turn complex (sometimes science-y) info into clean, creative stories that hit for both consumers and professionals  
  • Serve as a social-first creative expert, advising internal teams on content formats, creator trends, editing styles, platform best practices, and evolving audience behaviors
  • Collaborate with social strategy to develop concepts and formats that break through  
  • Identify emerging trends, content formats, and cultural moments to inform timely, relevant social content
  • Contribute to new business and pitch work with agile social-by-design creative that shows what we’re capable ofour social-first approach to content

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What you should have:  

  • 4-5 years of content creation experience (agency, freelance, in-house doesn’t matter as long as you’ve got the receipts)  
  • Experience creating social content using Adobe Creative Suite, and related creative tools, including Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or After Effects, with the ability to select the right tool for the right creative challenge
  • Experience creating short-form video, social graphics, carousels, motion assets, and creator-style content
  • Partner with social strategy to concept, and independently create, edit, and deliver social content from idea through final asset while balancing multiple brands
  • Able to translate complex topics into content that informs and engages 
  • Organized, fast-moving, and unfazed by multiple workstreams or deadlines 
  • Passionate about creativity with purpose and how digital content can actually drive better health outcomes  

Pay Range: $85,000 - $110,000

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to run delivery across the platform. Reporting to the VP, Product, you will be the person who knows where every workstream stands and what needs to happen for the team to be unblocked. This role covers software delivery for a product team, including sprints, releases, and dependencies across teams. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Run the delivery plan for the platform, including coordinating milestones and the dependencies between teams.

  • Own Agile ceremonies and keep sprints, backlogs, and release schedules up to date and easy to access.

  • Coordinate delivery across internal teams and external partners, keeping commitments and handoffs clear on both sides.

  • Track blockers and scope changes early and drive decisions with the right people in the room.

  • Manage release coordination across environments and teams.

  • Give leadership and stakeholders a clear, current picture of status and timelines.

  • Build the delivery process as the team scales, knowing when to adjust so it can be followed by all.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What You Should Have:

  • 4+ years managing software delivery for product or engineering teams, in B2B or enterprise software.

  • Experience coordinating one program across multiple external vendors or partners and several internal teams.

  • Strong Agile fluency, including running ceremonies, managing backlogs, and adapting the process to the team rather than the reverse.

  • Enough technical depth to follow conversations about APIs, data pipelines, environments, and releases, and to ask the question that surfaces a risk.

  • Skill at turning an ambiguous set of workstreams into a plan people can act on.

  • Experience managing dependencies and timelines across teams you do not manage.

  • Fluency with delivery and tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, GitHub, or Linear, including keeping them accurate as a source of truth.

  • Ability to communicate status and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Bonus points for martech, adtech, orchestration tooling, or healthcare experience.

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$100,000

job.title: Artist Agreements & Clearances Manager
job.description:
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

The Artist Agreements & Clearances Manager is a cross-company role responsible for securing and managing artist agreements, releases, and content clearances in support of production and distribution across the Recording Academy and its affiliates. In this position, you will be a key liaison between internal stakeholders, artists, managers, labels, publishers, and legal teams, supporting events, series, exhibits, GRAMMY Studios programming, and expanding organizational objectives. You are a detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for music and the music industry. You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships, can balance creative needs with legal and company requirements, and are calm under pressure. You have a collaborative spirit and service mentality.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

Artist Releases & Agreements

  • Draft, negotiate, execute, and manage artist agreements and releases across all Recording Academy and affiliate productions, ensuring timely execution for live and pre-recorded content.
  • Maintain organized records of all agreements, including rights granted, restrictions, and obligations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure content usage plans and artist negotiations are accurately reflected in contractual terms.

 

Sync and Misc. Clearances

  • Secure synchronization rights and related clearances for music and content use across all Recording Academy and affiliate platforms.
  • Coordinate with record labels, publishers, PROs, and other rights holders to obtain necessary licenses.
  • Track and manage rights by territory, media, term, and usage to ensure compliance.
  • Oversee the license lifecycle, including payments, amendments, extensions, expirations, and archiving
  • Troubleshoot and resolve clearance issues under tight production timelines.
  • Support additional clearance needs, including artwork, likeness, podcast, and other media usage.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with internal stakeholders early in the process to assess and address clearance, release, and agreement needs.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for all artist-related contractual and clearance matters.
  • Clearly communicate requirements, risks, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders.

 

Process & Systems Management

  • Refine workflows for outreach, negotiations, contract execution, and rights tracking.
  • Maintain and improve systems for documenting, tracking, and reporting rights and permissions.
  • Keep standardized clearance process resources current and accessible.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and mitigate risk.

 

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure content is cleared prior to distribution across all platforms.
  • Flag risks and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Stay current on music rights, licensing practices, and industry standards.

 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • 5+ years’ experience in music business affairs, content clearance, and music publishing.
  • Paralegal experience and/or the ability to draft and review content licensing agreements and negotiate terms with knowledge of how smaller negotiations affect big-picture relationships.
  • Established relationships with record labels, music publishers, and artist management.
  • Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and comprehensive follow-through.
  • Flexibility to succeed in a fast-paced production environment with tight deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects proactively and independently while providing cross-company support.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting salary for this position is $64,400 to $70,800 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity. 

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Preventative Health & Wellness
job.description:
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR 

The Assistant Manager will play an integral role in supporting and executing MusiCares’ Preventive Health & Wellness program delivery. Guided by the Managing Director, you will support the growth and sustainability of comprehensive preventive care services addressing the needs of music pros across physical health, mental health and financial health. You will also be responsible for operational, client-focused and administrative team support.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Support the Managing Director to refine and expand MusiCares’ comprehensive suite of preventive care services based on data-driven needs.

  • Provide key support to ensure high-quality operations including provider engagement, efficient and timely connection with clients and fiscally responsible clinic management.
  • Coordinate ongoing communications between providers and the Preventive Health & Wellness team.
  • Monitor registrations, participation and provider feedback to support continuous improvement.
  • Leverage knowledge of the intersection of physical, financial and mental health to inform the development of a preventive care package that is adaptable based on the unique needs of the music industry.
  • Collaborate with the Networked Care team to ensure providers offer relevant and topical services based on Wellness in Music data and clinic/program feedback.

 

Develop and maintain systems for effective and sustainable referral pathways.

  • Support the Managing Director with development of pre-qualified systems and ongoing evaluations of the client engagement process.
  • Cross-collaborate across Health & Human Service teams, supporting development of referral pathways that improve client access to customized care services. Collaborate with care teams to ensure effectiveness of internal referrals in addition to cross-departmental work with Marketing and Development teams.
  • Serve as a liaison with Recording Academy staff and across affiliates to help promote services and devise protocol to educate broader industry partners about comprehensive preventive care packages.
  • Evaluate efficacy and ROI of services.
  • Create systems to track client feedback that aligns with organizational procedures and data collection methods.

 

Support program effectiveness through data and reporting and contribute to overall Health & Human Services team collaboration.

  • Support compiling, reviewing and reporting of team/program data for the Board of Directors, grant writing, and internal and external partners.
  • Develop strong knowledge of MusiCares’ data that drives programs and services.
  • Assist with staffing and event coordination for on/off site events, including travel as needed.
  • Participate in team meetings and professional development opportunities.

 

Operational support, including administrative coordination to manage team workflows.

  • Work across the Preventive Health & Wellness team through established processes.
  • Strengthen program operations through effective coordination with providers.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance program/team efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Contribute to implementation of organizational strategic vision and plan.

 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of administrative experience, ideally with a non-profit organization with a similar programmatic focus.
  • A passion for MusiCares’ mission and an interest to professionally grow in this area.
  • Commitment to confidentiality and issues of privacy with the ability to maintain both.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite, Mailchimp, Eventbrite, Airtable, and/or comparable creative suite software.
  • Knowledge of database products and how to optimize data for reports and departmental analytics.
  • Strong communication skills and high emotional intelligence with the ability to interact with a variety of different constituents with a strong client service approach.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative and entrepreneurial business environment.
  • Ability to maintain composure during high-stress, complex situations, particularly when assisting with client care.
  • Ability to adapt well to change while remaining flexible and open minded.

The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.

INTERNSHIP DETAILS  

  

SPRING INTERNSHIP  

APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR STUDENTS: 11/20/2026  

SPRING INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DATES: 1/11/2027 – 4/16/2027   

*The New York Chapter Intern position pays county/state minimum wage rates, based on work location.  

  

  

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR  

  

The Recording Academy New York Chapter is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team.  

 

Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others.  

 

Our paid Internship Program offers a unique opportunity for full-time college students (juniors or seniors) to gain on-site training in office administration, events management and artist relations, in exchange for college credit. Candidates should be energetic, hard-working and have aspirations of a career in the music industry.  

  

  

WHAT YOU'LL DO  

  

  • Internship duration is for a semester (12 weeks or equivalent).  
  • Hours are part-time (20-24 hours a week).  
  • Intern will work with the chapter office on local events during regular business hours as well as some evenings and weekends.  
  • Internship will provide in-depth exposure to professional recording industry techniques and practices.  
  • Projects may include assistance with event management, educational programs, newsletters, membership recruitment, database management, demographics analysis, and administrative office support.  

 

  

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE   

  

  • Currently enrolled in a college/university. One year of course work towards degree in related field is preferred.  
  • Letter from school stating that intern will receive college credit for the Recording Academy internship.  
  • Display an interest in music and commitment to a career in the recording industry.  
  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills.  
  • Exhibit proficient computer skills.  
  • Be a junior, senior or graduate student.  

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES:    

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.    

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time. The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.    

  

  

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES  

  

RECORDING ACADEMY  

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.  

  

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY  

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.  

  

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION  

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.  

  

MUSICARES  

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.  

  

GRAMMY MUSEUM  

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include GRAMMY in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.  

  

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY  

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. job.title: Staff Attorney
job.description:
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The Staff Attorney will support the Chief Legal Officer, Associate General Counsel, Senior Managing Director of Legal Affairs, and overall Legal Affairs team with the Academy’s day-to-day transactional needs. Utilizing your excellent judgment, team collaboration skills, and commitment to the highest level of honesty, fidelity and integrity, you will provide legal advice to the Academy and its affiliates on a range of contracts.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts covering a range of Academy and affiliate activities, including vendor and services agreements, programming, events, licensing, technology and new initiatives under development.
  • Advise business teams on contract interpretation and obligations, explaining legal issues to non-lawyers in a digestible manner.
  • Issue spot and quickly assess when to escalate matters to more senior members of the Legal Affairs department.
  • Work with the team to streamline contract processes from commencement to conclusion, including maintaining contract playbooks and using technology to standardize processes.
  • Maintain organized records of executed contracts and related documents.
  • Collaborate intra- and inter-departmentally to maintain appropriate contract templates for business team use.
  • Assist with implementing and updating Academy and affiliate policies and procedures to ensure compliance and efficient administration of resources.
  • Stay informed about legal developments relevant to the Academy’s and its affiliates’ business operations.

 

 SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 
  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • License to practice law (or ability to become licensed) in state of residence.
  • 2-3 years’ experience practicing transactional law at an established law firm and/or in-house in a corporate legal or business affairs department.  
  • Experience advising on music and entertainment business matters strongly preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including an established track record of superior legal draftsmanship and negotiation, and the demonstrated ability to conclude matters efficiently and beneficially for the client. 
  • Must be a forward-thinking individual with sound, practical, and business-minded judgment including the ability to “think outside of the box,” come up with intelligent solutions to problems, master new technologies utilized to streamline contract systems, and assess and explain the business and legal impact of alternative options.
  • Ability to work well both independently and as part of a greater team, moving projects forward diligently and proactively.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

job.title: Media Sales Strategist
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Media Sales Strategist 

  

***Please note that this role will be based in Alberta*** 

  

Who we're looking for:  

  

We are seeking a dynamic Media Sales Strategist to join our team. This role is pivotal in driving revenue across multiple platforms, including Radio, Television, Digital, Out-of-Home (OOH), and Sports. The Media Sales Strategist will enhance operational efficiency and streamline sales tasks, allowing Account Managers to focus on building strong business relationships and improving solution selling skills.

 

The ideal candidate will possess a solid background in multimedia sales, exceptional project management skills, strong technical proficiency and a collaborative approach to working with both internal and external stakeholders, along with a keen understanding of the evolving media landscape. 

  

What you'll do:  

  

Transactional Task Management 

  • Exceed annual revenue targets by efficiently managing transactions and ensuring operational accuracy.
  • Assist Account Managers in developing strategy and crafting multi-media proposals and presentations that align with client KPIs.
  • Utilize AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to enhance efficiency and share insights with the team. 

  

Campaign Support 

  • Assist with operational details for campaign development and execution, ensuring seamless communication with internal teams and clients as needed.  
  • Collaborate with departments such as Credit, Creative, AdOps, Branded Content & Integrations, Go-to-Market Team, and Insights.  
  • Working knowledge of the RSM order management systems (S4M, DOMO and Hivestack) and monitor campaigns for optimal performance. 
  • Collaborate closely with sales teams to ensure all campaign deliverables are aligned and completed according to their business requirements 

  

Data Hygiene Maintenance 

  • Oversee the post-sale client journey for digital, OOH and post-campaign for TV and Radio campaigns, with creation of multiplatform wrap reports. 

  

Enable Consultative Selling 

  • Assist Account Managers by managing proposals, developing media strategy, and managing campaign deliverables, allowing them to focus on strategic sales priorities.
  • Foster a solution-focused team culture that promotes continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Assist with customer service support in the absence of Account Managers. 

  

What you'll bring:  

  • Proven success in a consultative sales or agency role, acting as a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Solid understanding of various media channels, including radio, linear TV, digital display, Video/Connected TV, OOH
  • Proficiency in using data and analytics to inform strategy and measure success.
  • Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to develop effective media strategies across various platforms and adapt quickly to changing market conditions.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with various programs and systems relevant to media sales.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Active listening and problem-solving capabilities.
  • A collaborative mindset with a focus on positive engagement and empathy.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
  • A strategic thinker with a vision for shared goals.
  • Creative problem-solver, open to diverse ideas.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing business conditions.
  • Strong time management skills to effectively track and prioritize responsibilities.
  • Passionate about media and its evolving landscape. 

 

What's in it for you? 

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including:

  • Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.
  • Discounts: Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
  • Paid time off for volunteering.
  • Company matching contributions to charities you support.

Growth & Development Opportunities:

  • Self-driven career development programs.
  • Rogers First: priority in applying to internal roles of interest.

Wellness Programs:

  • Employee & family assistance program.
  • Virtual Healthcare.
  • Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT). 
  • Low or no-cost fitness membership.

Our commitment to the environment and diversity:

  • Work for an organization committed to environmental protection.
  • Strong commitment to diversity and inclusion with employee resource groups supporting equity-deserving groups including groups representing People of Colour, 2SLGBTQIA+, Indigenous Peoples, Persons with Disabilities and Women. We all bring something different, and we know what makes us different makes us great.

 

To protect our people, brand and assets, a pre-employment background check will be conducted. As part of our selection process, all candidates must clear a criminal background check. Additionally, a credit check and drivers abstract may be required depending on the role.

 

Schedule: Full time
Shift: Day
Length of Contract: Not Applicable (Regular Position)
Work Location: 535 7th Avenue Sout West (811), Calgary, AB
Travel Requirements: None
Background Check(s) Required: Canadian Criminal Record Check 
Posting Category/Function: Sales & Account Support
Requisition ID: 340039

 

To support career growth, collaboration, and high-performing teams, all Corporate Employees are expected to work onsite. We believe that in-person connection strengthens our culture and drives industry-leading performance.

 

At Rogers, we believe the key to a strong business, is a diverse workforce where equity and inclusion are core to making everyone feel like they belong. We do this by embracing our diversity, celebrating our different perspectives, and working towards creating environments that empower our people to bring their whre that they have what they need to be at their best. job.title: Part-Time Producer - CityNews Vancouver
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Part-Time Producer - CityNews Vancouver 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

We’re looking for a Part-Time News Producer to shape and strengthen the CityNews brand. Our producers are called upon to oversee the creation of ground-breaking original and breaking news content on our streaming channels, our daily news programs, and our digital platforms. Various producing responsibilities will form a regular part of the work, including lining-up newscasts, vetting news content and coordinating event coverage, and overseeing our 24/7 livestream channel. The position will require evening and weekend shifts.

 

What you'll do: 

  • Line up news shows and take them to air.
  • Collaborate with supervising producers for show needs/requirements.
  • Complete, vet all production elements needed for air (fonts, graphics, outcues etc.).
  • Find, chase, research news content for multiple markets.
  • Write content and vet stories.
  • Assign news stories when needed.
  • Locate visuals/materials needed to tell story.
  • Support and communicate with field teams (VJs, ENG).
  • Contribute to /help generate story ideas and pitches.
     

What you bring:

  • An insatiable curiosity. We want producers who are always asking why and pushing our stories into territories that our competition is not exploring, while also offering context that our audience is seeking
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, as required
  • Patience and a willingness to explore new ways of producing news

TSC, the retail arm of Rogers, is one of Canada's top 10 eCommerce retailers, with a loyal customer base that shops with us across multiple channels. Our assortment covers fashion, jewellery, beauty, home and electronics, so every day brings new data and new questions to answer.

Reporting to the Director of Planning, Digital Product & Analytics, you'll be at the centre of how we make decisions as our eCommerce & Digital Analytics analyst.   • Come up with original story ideas and produce original stories that you will shoot and edit.
  • Deliver stories which will stand out from the competition, emphasizing creativity over traditional methods.
  • Report for our 24/7 CityNews Alberta livestream. These are sometimes live, sometimes on tape and often include a talkback with our anchor.
  • Provide original and enterprise content for our new prime time news specials.
     

What you will bring:

 

  • A passion for storytelling - you know what makes a great story and know how to tell it.
  • Ability to find original stories about people and issues which reflect Edmonton’s exciting and diverse communities.
  • Experience in shooting and editing.
  • A self-starter with a can-do, solution-oriented attitude
  • An understanding of multi-platform coverage, not confined by a ‘typical’ television reporter package.
  • A conversational live-reporting style
  • News moves fast! You must be able to multi-task and deliver for multiple daily deadlines
  • Because news never stops - you are prepared to work evenings and weekends.
  • Valid driver’s licence and clean driving record.
     

Here’s what you can expect in return:

 

  • A manager who deeply cares about your development and long-term career at Rogers
  • A team that trusts and wants to win together
  • Smart and accomplished colleagues who are focused on both the “what” and the “how”
  • All the hardware (iPhone/Laptop) and software you need to succeed.

​

To protect our people, brand and assets, a pre-employment background check will be conducted. As part of our selection process, all candidates must clear a criminal background check. Additionally, a credit check and drivers abstract may be required depending on the role.

 

 

Work Location: 5915 Gateway Boulevard (218), Edmonton, AB
Travel Requirements: Up to 10%
Background Check(s) Required: Credit Check and Driver's Abstract 
Posting Category/Function: Broadcasting & Editorial
Requisition ID: 344610

 

To support career growth, collaboration, and high-performing teams, all Corporate Employees are expected to work onsite. We believe that in-person connection strengthens our culture and drives industry-leading performance.

 

At Rogers, we believe the key to a strong business, is a diverse workforce where equity and inclusion are core to making everyone feel like they belong.
