job.title: Local Sales Manager, WCPO
job.description:
Are you a proven sales leader who knows how to inspire a team, build winning strategies, and drive real results? WCPO is looking for a Local Sales Manager who thrives at the intersection of media, marketing, and leadership. In this role, you'll guide a talented team of Account Executives to help local businesses grow by connecting them with customers through a powerful suite of multi-platform advertising solutions — from broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display, and email targeting. If you're energized by coaching people, developing creative sales strategies, and making a measurable impact in your market, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Cincinnati is a city that punches well above its weight — a vibrant, welcoming river city with a rich history, world-class culture, and a food scene that has earned national recognition. The Cincinnati Art Museum, the Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, and the American Sign Museum are just a few of the cultural gems that make the city a destination in its own right. The revitalized Over-the-Rhine neighborhood, with its stunning 19th-century architecture, craft breweries, and acclaimed restaurants, has become one of the most celebrated urban districts in the Midwest.


Sports are a serious way of life here. Cincinnatians are passionate about the Bengals, the Reds, and FC Cincinnati — and attending a game at Paycor Stadium or Great American Ball Park along the Ohio River is an experience unlike any other. Beyond the stadiums, the region offers beautiful parks, miles of trails along the Little Miami Scenic Trail, and easy access to the rolling hills of both Ohio and Northern Kentucky, making it a great place for hikers, cyclists, and outdoor enthusiasts.


Cincinnati is also an incredibly affordable place to live, with a strong job market, diverse and distinct neighborhoods — from Hyde Park and Oakley to Covington just across the river in Kentucky — and a genuine sense of community. Whether you're raising a family, building a career, or simply looking for a city with authentic character and momentum, Cincinnati delivers on all fronts.

job.title: Meteorologist, KGTV
job.description:
KGTV, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in San Diego, CA, is looking for a skilled and passionate Meteorologist to analyze meteorological data gathered by satellites and radar to prepare reports and forecasts for the public. You'll be the trusted voice that helps San Diegans — from the coastline to the inland valleys — plan their days, stay safe during severe weather, and feel connected to their community. Whether you're delivering a daily weathercast or breaking into programming with an urgent update, your work will have a real and lasting impact across TV, radio, and digital platforms.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely traffic reports across broadcast and digital platforms, including updates on incidents, road closures, and conditions impacting local commuters.
  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.
  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.
  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.
  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit, and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred
  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy, including weather and newsroom computer systems
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Knowledge of editing systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

San Diego is one of the most enviable places to live in the country, and for good reason. With its year-round Mediterranean climate, stunning Pacific beaches, and iconic landmarks like Balboa Park, the world-famous San Diego Zoo, and the historic Gaslamp Quarter, the city offers a lifestyle that's hard to match. Whether you're catching waves at La Jolla Shores, hiking the bluffs at Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve, or exploring the vibrant food scene in North Park and Barrio Logan, there's always something new to discover.


San Diego is also a proud sports city, home to the MLB's San Diego Padres at Petco Park and the newest addition to the local sports landscape, San Diego FC of MLS. The craft beer scene is legendary — with pioneering breweries like Stone Brewing and Ballast Point putting the city on the national map. The city's close proximity to the Pacific coast, mountains, desert, and the international border with Tijuana, Mexico, makes it one of the most geographically diverse metros in the nation.


Beyond the beaches and burritos, San Diego boasts a thriving tech and biotech industry, world-class universities, and a strong military community that gives the city a deeply patriotic and community-minded spirit. It's a place where big-city energy meets laid-back coastal living — and once you're here, it's easy to see why so many people never want to leave.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV
job.description:
At Scripps-owned KTNV, you’ll tell the stories that help Las Vegas viewers understand what’s happening in their community and why it matters. As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll take stories from idea to air, researching, writing, shooting and editing compelling content for television and digital platforms.


You’ll be out in the community, talking with the people at the center of the story and bringing clarity and context to fast-moving news. From breaking news and live reports to memorable enterprise stories, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase strong journalism, visual storytelling and your own creative voice. If you’re a self-starter who thrives on deadlines and wants to make an impact through local journalism, this is an opportunity to do meaningful work in one of the country’s most dynamic news markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop compelling story ideas by evaluating assignments, news leads and tips.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation and research.
  • Write accurate, engaging stories that meet broadcast and AP style standards.
  • Shoot high-quality video and still photography that strengthens your storytelling.
  • Edit video and produce content for television, digital and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver taped interviews, narration and live reports from the scene of breaking and developing news.
  • Collaborate with photographers on assigned stories to create cohesive, visually strong coverage.
  • Partner with producers to help prepare newscasts and meet daily editorial needs.
  • Work with digital team members to develop multimedia stories and extend coverage across platforms.
  • Respond quickly and effectively as stories evolve in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits are required. Driving is an essential part of this role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills with a focus on accuracy, clarity and engaging storytelling.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and experience capturing video in the field.
  • Videography and nonlinear editing experience preferred, including Final Cut Pro or similar editing systems.
  • Computer literacy, including familiarity with newsroom computer systems.
  • Confidence posting and adapting content for websites and multimedia platforms.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with photographers, producers and digital teams.
  • Self-motivation, sound news judgment and the ability to perform in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Flexibility to move between reporting, shooting, editing and live storytelling as the news demands.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll be part of a collaborative newsroom focused on serving the Las Vegas community with relevant, compelling journalism. Our team brings different backgrounds, perspectives, interests and storytelling strengths to the newsroom, all with a shared goal: connecting audiences with the stories that affect their lives. You’ll work alongside journalists who value teamwork, curiosity, creativity and the energy that comes with chasing a great local story.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas gives journalists a remarkable range of stories to tell and experiences to enjoy outside the newsroom. Beyond the world-famous Strip, the Las Vegas Valley offers distinctive neighborhoods, a vibrant food and entertainment scene and a community with plenty of personality.


When you're off the clock, Southern Nevada's landscape offers a dramatic change of pace, with desert scenery and abundant opportunities to get outdoors. Whether you're drawn to live entertainment and restaurants or prefer exploring the desert and surrounding natural areas, Las Vegas offers plenty to discover.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS News 5, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.


Cleveland is a resilient and passionate city with a rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and a strong sense of pride. From the shores of Lake Erie and the vibrant downtown district to world-class healthcare, arts, sports, and cultural institutions, Northeast Ohio offers endless opportunities to tell meaningful stories that impact viewers' lives. WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.
  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.
  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.
  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling
  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities
  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems
  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills
  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, blending Midwest charm with big-city energy. Situated on the shores of Lake Erie, Cleveland offers stunning waterfront views, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. The city is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra, Cleveland Museum of Art, and championship sports teams including the Guardians, Browns, and Cavaliers. Food lovers will appreciate the city's diverse culinary landscape, from historic West Side Market to innovative farm-to-table restaurants and craft breweries.


Cleveland's affordable cost of living, strong sense of community, and access to outdoor recreation—including Metro Parks, lakefront trails, and nearby Cuyahoga Valley National Park—make it an ideal place to build both your career and your life. With a revitalized downtown, diverse neighborhoods like Tremont, Ohio City, and Little Italy, and a growing tech and healthcare sector, Cleveland offers the perfect balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corp Transactions (Remote)
job.description:
The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corporate Transactions to provide legal counsel on matters related to the distribution of the Company’s local stations, networks, and programming across multiple platforms, including over-the-air, MVPD, streaming, and digital.


This role will structure, negotiate, and draft a variety of commercial agreements; prepare regulatory filings; and oversee compliance with FCC regulations in partnership with internal teams. The Senior Counsel will also support the Company’s mergers and acquisitions activity and advise business leaders on regulatory and transactional matters, with a focus on operational effectiveness, risk management, and alignment across the enterprise.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Advise on regulatory and contractual rights, obligations, most-favored-nation provisions, and transactional standards related to retransmission consent, network, and program distribution.
  • Draft offers and contracts based on approved deal terms; coordinate with Distribution in negotiations.
  • Review and negotiate inbound contract requests from outside parties, including retransmission consent, network distribution, non-disclosure, master services, and related agreements.
  • Create new contract forms as needed to accommodate evolving business models.
  • Evaluate standard terms and template agreements to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
  • Coordinate with business units to manage deal flow and contract execution.
  • Manage outside counsel when appropriate and oversee contract management system.
  • Monitor FCC regulatory requirements and compliance obligations relevant to the Company’s operations.
  • Draft and coordinate FCC compliance materials in collaboration with internal teams.
  • Work closely with the VP of Government Affairs on compliance-related matters, with advocacy retained by that office.
  • Assist, as needed, with preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual FCC filings and reports.
  • Maintain accurate compliance records and ensure timely submission of required reports to federal agencies.
  • Provide guidance to internal stakeholders to uphold compliance standards across business units.
  • Support Company M&A activity, i.e., securing regulatory approvals.
  • Prepare required regulatory filings and notices including but not limited to FCC license transfer applications (incl. waiver requests).
  • Coordinate with Company’s corporate development and M&A counsel on strategy regarding regulatory approval.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in good standing with at least one state bar: OH, NY, NJ, or GA preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience at a law firm, as a house counsel in technology, regulatory, or intellectual property law, and/or in a business role focusing on program licensing and distribution

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Strong contract drafting skills with experience in licensing, production, and local media distribution
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations applicable to broadcast and digital platforms
  • Accuracy and disciplined approach to compliance and risk management
  • Skilled in counseling creative and business partners, balancing legal and business considerations
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Word, Excel, and related tools
  • Demonstrated experience in federal regulatory compliance requirements, including FCC rules and reporting processes
  • Demonstrated experience in retransmission consent, corporate governance processes, and related compliance requirements

job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connection - KTVQ
job.description:
Are you a connector, a listener, and a community champion? KTVQ is looking for a passionate and strategic community engagement leader to serve as the station's primary bridge to the people and organizations that define our market. In this role, you'll build trusted relationships across civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government sectors — translating community insight into action that strengthens our journalism, deepens audience trust, and creates lasting local impact. If you thrive at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and service, this is your opportunity to shape how KTVQ shows up for the community it serves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related field

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, hunters, fishing enthusiasts, beekeepers, travelers, boaters, community leaders, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Billings, MT, where outdoor enthusiasts enjoy the big small-town charm and quick access to national parks. Skiing is right outside your door, as well as an expansive 47 miles of walking and biking trails that surround the largest city in Montana. There is no better place to hit the trails than in Montana's Trailhead. Billings offers hundreds of acres of city parks. Ride or walk along the legendary Yellowstone River, take in the forever views from Swords Park, or head west to a wilder landscape near Zimmerman Trail. The Magic City lives up to its name with culture and arts, including plentiful shopping, a theater, restaurants, and famous local brew pubs. The vibrant economy fosters an entrepreneurial spirit and a medical hub that boasts a regional health care center and is home to two universities. Positioned as a gateway to Yellowstone National Park and Wyoming, excursions including the beautiful Big Horn Mountains and more, without the big city hassles, are abundant. It is no wonder Billings has been voted #24 of the Top 100 Best Places to Live in America, but don't worry, it is the humble, independent, and caring people who truly make Billings the Magic City to live, work, and play.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/4/2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Boise is one of the West's most exciting and livable cities, a place where big-city energy meets the ease of an outdoor lifestyle. Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains along the Boise River, the city offers a stunning natural backdrop and near-endless recreation — from world-class skiing and snowboarding at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown, to hiking and mountain biking the Ridge to Rivers trail system, to floating the Boise River Greenbelt in summer. Sun Valley, one of America's premier ski destinations, is just a couple of hours away.


Downtown Boise is a thriving cultural hub packed with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, live music venues, and a vibrant arts scene anchored by the Treefort Music Festival and the Boise Contemporary Theater. The city is home to Boise State University and its iconic blue turf, giving it a youthful, collegiate energy alongside a rapidly growing tech sector that's earned it recognition as one of the top emerging markets in the nation. The Saturday farmers market, the Historic Egyptian Theatre, and the Basque Block — one of the most concentrated Basque communities outside of Spain — all add to Boise's rich, one-of-a-kind character.


Best of all, Boise consistently ranks among the most affordable major metros in the West, offering a high quality of life without the cost or congestion of larger coastal cities. With short commutes, friendly neighborhoods, and 206 days of sunshine a year, Boise is the kind of place where you'll quickly wonder why you didn't move here sooner.

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, musicians, community leaders, swimmers, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Missoula, MT where the Clark-Fork River really does run through this vibrant city. Set at the convergence of five mountain ranges, earning Missoula the name of the "hub of five valleys". Missoula is surrounded by 60,000 acres of wilderness and is an outdoor paradise, with national forests, ski areas, incredible hikes, and bicycling, raging rivers with excellent blue-ribbon trout fishing. Missoula has repeatedly earned its ranking as a top 100 Best Places to live and was recently recognized as one of the healthiest places in the US with the highest life expectancy compared to any other city in Montana. If you seek a life that isn't consumed by your work or your commute, where living is about community, exploring the same trails as Lewis and Clark, as well as new adventures, and a place where "fur babies" are considered part of the Missoulian community than this is the place for you! After Billings, Missoula is the second-largest city and metropolitan area in Montana and is home to the University of Montana, a public research university. Where else can you walk outside and jump on a mountain trailhead or drive two to three hours and arrive at the gates of both Glacier and Yellowstone National Park? The economy is growing, culture and arts are thriving, calling filmmakers such as Paramount's Yellowstone to call on Missoula for some of the most beautiful scenic movie and TV show backgrounds. Truly the last best place!​

job.title: Sr Reporter, KMVT
job.description:
At KMVT, local journalism is about more than covering the news. It’s about building lasting relationships with the people and communities that make southern Idaho home. As a Senior Reporter, you’ll bring experience, curiosity, and strong journalistic judgment to investigative, long-form, breaking, and multi-platform reporting that matters to local audiences.


You’ll develop trusted sources, dig deeper into the stories shaping the region, and create meaningful journalism with accuracy, fairness, and authenticity at its core. This is an opportunity to become deeply connected to the community and make a lasting impact at a station where local relationships matter. For an experienced journalist looking for a place to put down roots, Twin Falls offers an appealing combination of community connection, an affordable lifestyle, and access to Idaho’s remarkable outdoors.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a strong network of sources throughout southern Idaho and build authentic relationships with community members and local experts.
  • Investigate public records, cultivate personal sources, and conduct in-depth research to uncover and tell meaningful stories.
  • Lead coverage of significant breaking news and pursue investigative and long-form reporting that provides context and value to local audiences.
  • Create compelling multi-platform journalism using video, photography, graphics, digital storytelling, and other visual elements.
  • Report live from the field and operate cameras with still photography and video capabilities.
  • Connect audiences with a diversity of perspectives and stories that strengthen community belonging.
  • Collaborate with newsroom colleagues on editorial and content planning, workflows, best practices, and multimedia coverage that meets strategic goals and deadlines.
  • Maintain the highest standards of accuracy, objectivity, fairness, ethics, and sensitivity to community expectations.
  • Engage with the community beyond daily assignments by participating in local events and staying closely connected to the issues important to the region.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle periodically to cover assignments throughout the market.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience is preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of news reporting experience, including in-depth or long-form reporting, is required; experience with community, digital, and solutions-based journalism is preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Deep expertise in investigative and long-form reporting and a strong command of journalistic standards.
  • A talent for memorable storytelling and a distinct, engaging on-air presence.
  • A consumer-focused approach and commitment to understanding what matters most to local audiences.
  • Strong multimedia skills spanning reporting, writing, web publishing, still photography, online video, infographics, databases, and social media.
  • Knowledge of reporting fundamentals, including privacy, ethics, access, open meetings, public records, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • Exceptional accuracy, fairness, editing, writing, and working knowledge of Associated Press style.
  • Ability to use digital, video, mapping, social networking, and other technology to strengthen reporting across platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook, along with web publishing tools.
  • Adaptability, emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to produce strong journalism in a deadline-driven newsroom.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KMVT, you’ll join a newsroom that values curiosity, collaboration, and a genuine connection to the people it serves. Our team brings different experiences, interests, and perspectives to the work, but shares a commitment to journalism that helps southern Idaho audiences better understand their communities. We believe the strongest local reporting starts with listening, showing up, earning trust, and investing in the relationships that turn a station into a true community partner.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Twin Falls gives you the opportunity to build a life and a career in southern Idaho, with a strong sense of community and an affordable lifestyle that can make it easier to put down roots for the long term. It’s a place where a local journalist can truly get to know the people, organizations, and issues they cover, building the sources and relationships that lead to more meaningful reporting.

Outside the newsroom, southern Idaho’s landscape provides an unforgettable backdrop for life in the region. Whether you’re drawn to outdoor recreation, scenic surroundings, or simply the opportunity to become part of a close-knit community, Twin Falls offers a setting where you can invest in your career, your community, and the place you call home.

job.title: Sr. Analyst, Local Digital Inventory
job.description:
Are you a data-savvy media professional who loves turning inventory insights into real revenue impact? Scripps is looking for a Sr. Analyst, Local Digital Inventory to manage and optimize digital video and connected TV inventory across our local station streaming and website properties. In this role, you'll lead inventory forecasting, allocation, availability analysis, sponsorship planning, and performance reporting — all in direct support of our revenue goals and advertiser commitments. Working hand in hand with Sales, Ad Operations, Finance, Product, and technology teams, you'll drive sell-through and yield improvements while protecting both campaign delivery and the viewer experience. If you're energized by solving complex inventory challenges in a fast-moving, collaborative environment, this is the opportunity for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Create and maintain calendar templates to track sold sponsorships and HPTOs.
  • Analyze avails and sponsorships that maximize inventory to reach budgetary goals.
  • Manage software integration to and from WideOrbit traffic and Order Management System.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with sponsorships not running on pages correctly.
  • Create and generate potential revenue loss/gain reports.
  • Create and maintain format template groups.
  • Create and maintain avails tracking docs for all local media stations.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales Operations teams to support shared inventory and revenue objectives.
  • Develop and maintain forecasts for digital video and CTV supply by market, platform, device, content type, audience, daypart, and sales channel.
  • Monitor sell-through, fill rate, CPM, revenue, and delivery trends; recommend pricing floors, packaging, prioritization, and channel mix adjustments that improve monetization.
  • Identify under delivery, overbooking, pacing, frequency, and supply-quality risks early; coordinate corrective action with Sales and Ad Operations.
  • Produce recurring inventory, capacity, and revenue reports with clear recommendations for sales leadership and operational partners.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Applied knowledge of broadcast logs, digital media inventory, sales operations, and inventory management processes
  • Strong analytical and forecasting skills, with the ability to interpret inventory, revenue, and delivery data and identify risks and opportunities
  • Working knowledge of digital advertising, connected TV, programmatic delivery, and relevant traffic, order management, and ad-serving platforms
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and large data sets
  • Sound business judgment, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, work independently, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced environment

job.title: Sr. Mgr., Community Connections, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a dynamic Senior Manager, Community Connections to serve as the station's primary bridge to the communities we serve. In this pivotal role, you'll build the trusted relationships that keep WEWS at the heart of Northeast Ohio — turning community intelligence into real journalistic impact, forging meaningful partnerships, and ensuring our station remains an essential, credible voice in the lives of Clevelanders. From leading newsroom community engagement priorities to coordinating forums, town halls, and public-service initiatives, you'll champion connection at every level and make sure every audience member feels heard and valued.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/04 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city that surprises and rewards — a place where world-class culture, deep sports pride, and genuine community spirit come together on the shores of Lake Erie. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and Museum calls Cleveland home, as does Playhouse Square, the largest performing arts center in the United States outside of New York City. The Cleveland Museum of Art is internationally renowned and offers free general admission, while the Great Lakes Science Center and Cuyahoga Valley National Park — just a short drive south — give residents endless ways to explore, learn, and unwind.


Cleveland's neighborhoods are as vibrant and diverse as the people who live in them. Ohio City's West Side Market is a beloved institution brimming with local vendors, craft food, and community energy, while Tremont, Little Italy, and the Detroit-Shoreway corridor each bring their own distinct character, dining scenes, and arts communities. The city's food culture has blossomed into a genuine destination, with nationally recognized chefs and a range of restaurant experiences to suit every taste.


Sports are a way of life here — home of the Cleveland Guardians, Cleveland Browns, and Cleveland Cavaliers, the city rallies passionately around its teams season after season. With a cost of living that remains affordable relative to other major metros, a growing job market, and a downtown that continues to reinvent itself, Cleveland offers both roots and opportunity for those ready to be part of something meaningful.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic community connector to serve as the station's primary bridge between our newsroom and the people we serve. In this role, you will cultivate trusted partnerships across Buffalo's civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government landscape — turning community intelligence into meaningful journalism, impactful events, and lasting audience relationships. If you believe local news is most powerful when it is deeply rooted in the community it covers, this is your opportunity to make that vision real every single day.

Buffalo, New York is a city on the rise — a proud, resilient community with deep roots, genuine warmth, and an exciting future. Sitting at the eastern edge of Lake Erie and just across the border from Canada, Buffalo offers an enviable quality of life at a fraction of the cost of larger metros. The revitalized waterfront along Canalside draws visitors and residents alike year-round, with concerts, ice skating, kayaking, and festivals that celebrate everything Buffalo has to offer. The city's rich architectural heritage — including Frank Lloyd Wright landmarks and the stunning Guaranty Building — gives it a character unlike anywhere else in America.


Buffalo is a food lover's city with a distinct identity. From the birthplace of the Buffalo wing at the Anchor Bar to world-class chef-driven restaurants in Elmwood Village and Larkinville, the dining scene punches well above its weight. The arts community is equally vibrant, anchored by Albright-Knox Northland (now Buffalo AKG Art Museum), Shea's Performing Arts Center, and a thriving live music scene. Sports are a way of life here — Bills fans are legendary for their passion, and the Sabres bring NHL excitement to KeyBank Center each season.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find no shortage of adventure. Niagara Falls is just 20 minutes away, offering one of the world's most iconic natural wonders right in your backyard. The region's state parks, ski areas in the nearby hills, and easy access to the Finger Lakes wine country make Buffalo an ideal home base for those who love to explore. With a strong sense of community, affordable neighborhoods, and a city that genuinely welcomes newcomers, Buffalo is a wonderful place to plant roots and make a real difference.

job.title: Web Content Producer, Sales
job.description:
Are you a detail-driven digital producer who loves bringing campaigns to life online? Scripps is looking for a talented web professional to create, launch, maintain, and optimize contest and sponsorship experiences across our local television station websites. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of revenue, creativity, and technology — translating sold sponsorship elements into polished digital executions that make advertisers look great and audiences come back for more. From building contest landing pages and managing entry forms to ensuring every disclosure and eligibility rule is exactly right, your work will directly support local station revenue and strengthen the digital presence of Scripps markets across the country. If you thrive in a deadline-driven environment, love getting the details right, and enjoy collaborating across teams, this is your opportunity to make a real impact at one of America's leading broadcasting companies.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Create and update contest landing pages, sponsorship hubs, contest pages, entry forms, rules pages, confirmation messaging, and related content in our enterprise content management system (CMS).
  • Coordinate intake, requirements, asset collection, production, approvals, scheduling, launch, updates, expiration, archiving, and post-campaign review, as well as expertise on legal guidelines regarding contests.
  • Translate sold sponsorship elements into digital executions that accurately reflect client commitments, brand standards, campaign dates, markets, and deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary web-production contact for station sales, marketing, creative, digital, legal, and operations teams across multiple markets.
  • Perform prelaunch and ongoing quality assurance for links, forms, images, copy, disclosures, dates, mobile display, accessibility, tagging, and overall user experience.
  • Ensure official rules, eligibility language, privacy disclosures, sponsor identification, and contest content are posted as approved; escalate legal or policy questions when required.
  • Maintain reusable CMS components, page templates, documentation, naming conventions, and organized digital assets to improve speed and consistency.
  • Manage multiple simultaneous campaigns with firm launch dates, communicate status and risks, and resolve blockers before they affect station or advertiser commitments.
  • Use available analytics and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve traffic, engagement, conversion, and campaign execution.
  • Diagnose publishing, rendering, form, tracking, or content issues and coordinate with technical teams or vendors when resolution requires additional support.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Knowledge of content management systems, web publishing practices, process improvement, and documentation standards
  • Ability to create and maintain responsive digital experiences using established tools and standards
  • Strong project coordination, organizational, and prioritization skills in a deadline-driven environment
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to perform quality assurance, identify risks, and escalate issues appropriately
  • Clear communication, sound judgment, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Knowledge of digital advertising, analytics, accessibility, privacy, and regulatory requirements, with a focus on advertiser and campaign needs
  • Knowledge of digital media, publishing, contests, and sponsorship campaigns
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for troubleshooting and developer collaboration
  • Familiarity with digital campaign platforms, tools, and integrations
  • Ability to apply enterprise standards while adapting work to local-market needs

job.title: Asia Editor
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

Semafor is expanding across Asia to help decision-makers in the region and around the world make sense of the region’s rapidly shifting dynamics in trade, technology, finance, geopolitics and global power, in the primary theater where the new global economy is being built. 

We want to connect the dots across this complex landscape, delivering rigorous, independent business journalism to the world’s most discerning readers and are looking for a talented journalist with deep knowledge of China and the Asia-Pacific region to help lead an expansion effort across digital platforms and live journalism. 

A seasoned leader with a track record of managing teams, the successful candidate will bring a deep understanding of the economic and financial forces transforming Asia — with a focus on how China is reshaping the region and the world. 

We’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial attitude, a deep sense of their audience, sure feet and a clear voice to produce useful, revelatory, and fair coverage in an enormous and complex part of the world. This person will be charged with chronicling the forces shaping Asia including trade, technology, capital flows, energy, CEOs, power, politics, and policy.

The successful candidate will be well-sourced and eager to get scoops and deliver big interviews, while bringing a sophisticated perspective in delivering thought-provoking and insightful stories. Reporting to the Global Managing Editor, the Asia Editor will be charged with building out our Asia-based reporting team and products, targeting sophisticated, engaged, and globally aware readers who live in — or have deep interest and connections to — the region.

The ideal candidate will be based in Singapore, but Semafor is open to applicants in other parts of the region. 

Your responsibilities

  • Work with Semafor’s leaders to shape our Asia vision and product.
  • Help recruit for and build Semafor’s Asia-based reporting team.
  • Lead the development of Semafor’s Asia briefings and products that best cater to our readers, viewers, and listeners.
  • Anchor Semafor’s coverage across Asia — across all platforms and live journalism.
  • Write must-read stories about the region, with a focus on business, economics, technology, and energy for a sophisticated audience who live in, or have interest and connections to Asia.
  • Participate in event moderation, as well as media appearances on TV, radio, and podcasts.
  • Collaborate closely with other parts of Semafor’s global newsroom and audience teams.

 

What makes you qualified

  • 10+ years of journalism experience, including relevant experience covering Asia
  • A track record of newsroom leadership.
  • Experience and interest in global financial and business journalism.
  • A strategic, sophisticated approach to identifying themes and focuses of coverage across sectors and borders.
  • Bring speedy insight to big news stories, and flair and personality to writing.
  • A passion for world events and issues and a broad interest in a wide range of subjects.
  • Broad media consumption habits across conventional and unconventional sources.
  • Eagerness to be part of a dynamic work environment demanding initiative, flexibility, and a willingness to jump in wherever needed to help the team succeed.
  • Experience working with diverse teams with teammates from many different backgrounds.
  • Diligence and reliability to work without hands-on supervision.
  • The ability to think constantly about story distribution and audiences, across many forms of media and platforms.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Audience Booker - Private Roundtables (Contract)
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Semafor is seeking an experienced Contract Audience Booker to lead audience curation, recruitment, and booking for a portfolio of invitation-only executive roundtables.

This role requires a combination of editorial judgment, audience development expertise, and strong operational discipline. The successful candidate will be responsible for assembling high-quality, relevant groups of senior executives aligned with each roundtable's editorial theme and the objectives of its underwriting partner.

The role requires independent ownership of the booking process, close cross-functional coordination, and the ability to deliver a carefully curated audience against defined participation targets.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy & Curation

  • Develop targeted invitation lists for private executive roundtables based on editorial themes, audience briefs, and partner objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize relevant senior executives, decision-makers, and industry leaders.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to ensure the proposed audience meets both editorial standards and partner expectations.
  • Maintain a balanced, high-quality audience mix that supports meaningful discussion and engagement.

Audience Recruitment & Booking

  • Own the invitation and booking process from initial outreach through confirmed attendance.
  • Draft and execute personalized invitations and follow-up communications.
  • Track outreach, responses, confirmed attendees, and declines, maintaining accurate booking records.
  • Proactively manage the recruitment pipeline to meet audience targets and address gaps in representation.
  • Manage substitutions, cancellations, and last-minute changes.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a key audience contact for internal editorial, events, and partner management teams.
  • Work closely with Partner Management Leads to understand partner priorities, provide booking updates, and manage expectations.
  • Maintain clear, timely communication on booking progress, audience composition, and potential challenges.
  • Ensure all stakeholders have accurate and up-to-date information ahead of each event.

Event Readiness & On-Site Handoff

  • Prepare and finalize attendee lists, briefing documents, and relevant participant information.
  • Coordinate with event operations teams on check-in, seating, and attendee management requirements.
  • Ensure a clear and accurate handoff to on-site teams, including last-minute updates and special considerations.
  • Support final attendance reconciliation and post-event reporting.

What makes you qualified

  • Demonstrated experience in senior-level audience recruitment, executive event booking, or high-touch invitation-only events.
  • Strong research skills and sound judgment in identifying relevant executives and organizations.
  • Excellent written communication and professional outreach skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple booking pipelines and deadlines.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working across editorial, commercial, and events teams.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain tight operational processes.
  • Comfort engaging with senior executives and their offices.

Additional Job Details

This position is ideally based out of either our New York, NY or Washington, DC or Fully Remote.


Salary Range: $1,700 per week flat project rate.

job.title: Audience Development - Events (Contract)
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role 

Semafor is seeking an experienced Contract Audience Developer to support audience development and event execution for Semafor World Economy, our flagship global convening in Washington, D.C.

This role will take end-to-end responsibility for audience development across assigned events and programming, from initial audience strategy and list building through invitations, registration, attendee communications, and on-site readiness.

The successful candidate will combine strong audience judgment with hands-on operational capabilities, ensuring that each event attracts the right mix of attendees, meets its participation targets, and delivers a seamless attendee experience.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy & Curation

  • Develop and execute audience acquisition plans for assigned Semafor World Economy events.
  • Build and curate targeted invitation lists using Semafor's internal databases and other relevant sources.
  • Translate event briefs into clear audience criteria, including seniority, industry, organizational relevance, and desired audience composition.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to align audience recruitment with editorial priorities, event objectives, and partner commitments where applicable.

Audience Acquisition & Communications

  • Draft compelling invitation copy, registration messaging, reminders, and other attendee communications.
  • Coordinate with the design team on the development and deployment of event invitations and associated creative assets.
  • Manage invitation distribution, personalized outreach, follow-ups, and attendee communications.
  • Track audience acquisition performance and proactively adjust outreach strategies to meet targets.

Event Website & Registration Management

  • Manage event website content, registration pages, and RSVP workflows for assigned events.
  • Ensure all event information, registration details, speaker content, and attendee-facing materials are accurate and current.
  • Maintain accurate registration data and manage attendee status changes, cancellations, and waitlists.
  • Coordinate with relevant teams to troubleshoot registration issues and ensure a seamless attendee experience.

Capacity & Audience Management

  • Own RSVP tracking and audience reporting for assigned events.
  • Manage registration pipelines against venue capacity, attendance projections, and audience composition targets.
  • Monitor not only the volume of registrations but also the quality and relevance of confirmed attendees against the event brief.
  • Identify audience gaps and proactively recruit additional participants to maintain the desired balance.
  • Manage oversubscription, waitlists, and last-minute attendance changes.

Cross-Functional Event Delivery

  • Work closely with Editorial, Events, Design, Partnerships, and Audience Development teams throughout the event lifecycle.
  • Maintain clear internal reporting on audience recruitment, registration progress, and operational readiness.
  • Prepare final attendee lists, event briefings, and handoff materials for on-site teams.
  • Support event execution, attendee management, and post-event reporting as required.

Ideal Experience & Skills

  • Strong experience in audience development, event marketing, or attendee acquisition for high-profile business events.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage event audience development from initial planning through execution.
  • Excellent judgment in curating senior executive and business audiences.
  • Strong copywriting skills, with experience developing professional event invitations and communications.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, event registration platforms, spreadsheets, and website content management tools.
  • Ability to manage registration pipelines, capacity targets, and multiple simultaneous deadlines.
  • Highly organized, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working across editorial, commercial, marketing, and event operations teams.

Additional Job Details

This position is ideally based out of either our New York, NY or Washington, D.C. offices, but we are open to remote candidates outside either region.

Compensation; Flat weekly rate of $1,800.

job.title: Digital & Social Platform Editor
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

Semafor is seeking a Digital & Social Platform Editor to help amplify our journalism across platforms and formats.

This is not a  traditional “social posting” role. We’re looking for someone who understands how modern media travels — across video, live events, podcasts, breaking news, YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X, and emerging platforms. The right candidate understands that packaging and distribution is editorial — and an important part of propelling our journalism forward.

This role sits at the center of newsroom, audience, video, audio, and events. You’ll help shape the strategy for how Semafor’s journalism is framed, edited, clipped, promoted, and distributed in real time . 

You should have strong editorial instincts, comfort with video and light editing workflows, sharp news and platform judgment, and a deep understanding of how to create platform-native content that drives reach without compromising editorial quality. Interest in business, politics, media, technology, and global affairs is important.

Responsibilities

Packaging & Distribution of Our Best Journalism

  • Work with newsroom leaders to identify the strongest moments, angles, and formats for distribution across scoops, breaking news, enterprise reporting, interviews, video, podcasts, and live journalism
  • Develop deep relationships with distribution platforms, with a special focus on LinkedIn, YouTube and X 
  • Package and distribute Semafor journalism across social and digital platforms in formats optimized for each audience and channel
  • Write platform-native copy, headlines, captions, hooks, and framing that increase engagement and discoverability
  • Publish and optimize content across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms

Video & Live Content

  • Support rapid-turnaround distribution from Semafor events, including clipping live mainstage conversations in real time, or editorial video
  • Knowledge of analytics, audience development, and platform performance trends
  • Interest in business, politics, media, technology, and global affairs
  • Work closely with video and audio producers to extend the reach and lifecycle of original content
  • Execute social video editing, formatting, subtitling, and platform optimization
  • Ability to clip, package, and publish short-form video from interviews, podcasts, newsroom shoots, and live events

Events & Promotion

  • Support promotional campaigns for Semafor events, franchises, and editorial launches
  • Coordinate social coverage plans and live posting during major convenings and newsroom moments
  • Help extend the reach of Semafor’s live journalism before, during, and after events
  • Develop and implement promotion plans for shows and big events across all platforms

Audience & Editorial Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the newsroom and audience teams to identify distribution opportunities and audience growth strategies
  • Apply editorial judgment to determine what content should travel, where it should live, and how it should be framed
  • Monitor performance trends, audience behavior, and platform shifts to inform publishing strategy
  • Maintain Semafor’s editorial standards, voice, and accuracy across all distributed content

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in social media, audience development, digital publishing, or platform distribution
  • Strong editorial instincts and understanding of news judgment
  • Experience publishing across major social and video platforms, with a particular focus on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Reddit
  • Understanding of platform-native storytelling and audience behavior
  • Ability to work quickly and calmly in a fast-paced newsroom and live event environment
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Experience covering or supporting live events
  • Familiarity with Premiere, CapCut, Descript, or similar editing tools
  • Experience working with a wide array of journalists, newsroom teams

Compensation: The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000 annually based on individual candidate experience and skills.

job.title: Director, Partnership Management
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team at a rapidly growing media and publishing company. In this role, you will lead and contribute to the cross-functional execution of key accounts and integrated client-facing projects across their entire lifecycle (transitioning from sale to post-sale delivery), ensuring they align with clients’ objectives and Semafor’s commitment to delivering value across its editorial platforms and properties. Acting as the primary liaison between internal teams and external partners, you will be responsible for becoming both the client and Semafor expert – shepherding collaborative processes, crafting key strategic deliverables, ensuring Semafor’s execution meets the promised scope, keeping timelines on course, and attaining industry-beating standards to maintain the highest level of client satisfaction.

Your Responsibilities

Client Relationship Strategy & Management

  • Operate and serve as a trusted advisor to clients and partners (often at the most senior, C-Suite levels), ensuring their priorities are at the forefront of project management.
  • Manage integrated client programs from start to finish, serving as the primary contact between all parties to ensure deliverables and components are on track and within scope.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for post-sale execution for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and timely responses.

Client Transition Management

  • Serve as the bridge between marketing, sales, revenue operations, events, and other Semafor teams during client onboarding and across the length of the client partnership.
  • Master client objectives, strategies, and partnership components in the final pre-sale phase to ensure all deliverables, timelines, and expectations are fully understood and documented.
  • Lead internal kickoff meetings with relevant stakeholders to align on the scope of work, deliverables, client nuances, and success metrics.
  • Host client onboarding and kickoff sessions, providing a smooth handoff from the sales team while building trust and confidence with the client.

Partnership Management and Ongoing Strategy 

  • Oversee the ongoing execution of integrated client programs with extreme ownership ensuring seamless delivery and a premium ‘white glove’ experience for clients. Programs will include:
    • Live Events (i.e.,multi-day summits, forums, custom events, etc.) working in partnership with the Head of Semafor Events
    • Digital Advertising (i.e., newsletters, web, and social sponsorships, etc.) working in partnership with the Revenue Operations team
    • Custom Content (i.e., branded articles, ad units, audio segments, videos, etc.) working in partnership with the Senior Creative Director
    • Extensions into proprietary research, strategic services, innovation measurement strategies, and new product incubation
  • Collaborate with internal teams (creative, sales, editorial, event production, marketing, product, audience, etc.) to ensure successful execution of integrated campaigns and events.
  • Lead recurring status meetings preparing proactive agendas, leading calls, capturing notes and takeaways and following up with a detailed summary and capture of action items. 
  • Develop detailed project plans and timelines, tracking progress and addressing any roadblocks proactively.
  • Promote a free flow of information among partners and team members, ensuring transparency and alignment.
  • Track and communicate project status, risks, and emergent issues with clarity, fostering shared understanding of goals and success criteria across all stakeholders.
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including updated project plans, file management, and presentations.

Problem-Solving

  • Proactively and elegantly address and resolve any client concerns or challenges to ensure high levels of satisfaction.
  • Work cross-functionally to troubleshoot issues and optimize campaign and event performance.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships, upsell additional services, and drive client retention in close collaboration with sales.
  • Prepare and present campaign and event performance insights, orchestrate, prepare, and deliver post-campaign reports, and provide recommendations for future initiatives.
  • Deeply understand and leverage client performance data to make compelling sales arguments and narratives.
  • Ensure delivery against partnership goals and objectives including realization of contracted revenue and attainment of targeted profit margins.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Finance to align regular reporting against partnership P&L's aligned to over partner KPIs.

Industry Expertise

  • Stay up to date with digital publishing trends, advertising best practices, and event management innovations.
  • Provide insights and thought leadership to clients, positioning Semafor as a strategic partner.
  • Assist in building out new systems and practices to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency.

What makes you qualified

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, client services, or a related field within media, marketing, or editorial environments.
  • Experience working with global clients across the US, Gulf, and beyond, and a deep understanding and appreciation for cultural, business, and geopolitical dynamics. A bonus for experience with clients focused on B2B and B2G strategies. 
  • Proven ability to manage complex, integrated projects involving multiple stakeholders and deliverables.
  • Experience managing both large and small format events, digital advertising campaigns, podcasts, and marketing services.
  • Expertise in project management tools and methodologies, with a strong focus on operational efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of and respect for media, journalism, and the importance of editorial independence.
  • Ability to thrive in an ultra fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and a talent in managing competing priorities.
  • Sophisticated communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with proven experience working directly with clients at a very senior, C-Suite level.
  • Exceptional program management skills (driving program execution across multiple complex projects, timelines and clients), balanced with a savvy ability to engage and satisfy stakeholders.
  • Compelling collaboration skills and partnership mind-set, able to quickly build relationships, earn trust, and operate effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign data and provide actionable insights.
  • Advanced leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coach others through complex solutioning to deliver results.
  • Familiarity with digital advertising platforms (e.g., programmatic tools, Google Ads) and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics), as well as project management software like Asana.
  • Experience with Boostr or similar CRM and campaign management tools.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY or Washington, DC at Semafor Headquarters.

Candidates must be willing to work flexible hours and travel domestically and internationally on an as-needed basis.

Comprehensive employee benefits: unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, flexible spending, health savings accounts, life insurance, 401(k), pre-Tax commuter benefits. 

Salary Range: $150,000 - $170,000/year Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc.
