As the Editorial Event Producer, you will work closely with Semafor’s Executive Editor and live journalism team to help produce our flagship global economic event. You will engage prospective guests, develop thoughtful programming recommendations, and manage multiple executive relationships with exceptional communication. The role requires the ability to speak fluently across industries and global economic issues, understand what makes an executive or policymaker compelling on stage, and connect their expertise to the broader editorial agenda.

You will take ownership of guest outreach and booking timelines, working proactively to move conversations forward and navigate complex organizations to reach the right people. You should be a resourceful, self-starting researcher who knows how to find information when it is not readily available, quickly get up to speed on unfamiliar companies, industries, and leaders. Throughout, you will bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, creativity, and an entrepreneurial mindset to building a newsworthy, high-caliber program featuring some of the most influential leaders in business, government, technology, and finance.

Your Responsibilities 

  • Own outreach and booking for a portfolio of senior executives, government leaders and other high-profile prospective guests for Semafor’s flagship economic event.
  • Identify contacts and pursue outreach with persistence, creativity, and sound judgment across executive offices, communications teams, and other channels.
  • Own outreach pipelines, leading follow-ups and updates as needed to secure commitments..  
  • Serve as a compelling ambassador for Semafor, speaking fluently about the event’s editorial mission, audience, and value proposition and persuasively articulate why an executive should participate.
  • Leverage the strongest verbal communication skills when communicating with executive teams and exhibit professionalism, warmth, responsiveness and attention to detail throughout the booking process.

  • Develop a strong understanding of each individual executive, their company, industry, and areas of expertise, articulating how each will contribute meaningfully to the broader program.
  • Apply strong editorial and strategic judgment to assess the relevance and significance of prospective guests and make thoughtful programming recommendations.

What makes you qualified

  • A Bachelor's degree is required.
  • 7+ years in broadcast journalism, executive communications, event content or programming development, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex editorial programs across dozens of speakers and sessions.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and proven ability to engage confidently with senior-level executives.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication, including the ability to craft compelling invitations and executive briefs.
  • Strongest organizational and time-management skills, adept at juggling multiple relationship streams.
  • Knowledgeable about major business and economic trends, along with skills to translate them into mainstage moments and other convenings for executives, with assistance from the editorial team. 
  • An entrepreneurial drive grounded in an eagerness to learn and grow alongside the company as it continues to scale and evolve. 
  • Passion for the media industry and great journalism.

job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Executive Business Partner & Office Manager to join our New York City office. This role is pivotal in providing key administrative and executive support to the Chief Commercial Officer and other members of the Sales team, while ensuring the smooth operation of the office. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional organizational skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. This position is full-time and based out of Semafor’s New York office with the option to work remotely on Fridays. 

Your Responsibilities 

Executive Business Partner

  • Manage and maintain executives' schedules, appointments, travel arrangements, and expenses
  • Arrange and coordinate meetings
  • Prepare and distribute correspondence, memos, letters, and forms
  • Assist in the preparation of research, reports, presentations, and data analysis
  • Handle confidential information with discretion
  • Monitor and respond to incoming communications (including emails and phone calls) as needed
  • Coordinate and manage projects and follow-up actions on behalf of executives to ensure timelines are met
  • Act as the point of contact between executives and internal/external clients
  • Maintain electronic and hard copy filing systems
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and other documents as needed
  • Serve as a liaison between the CCO and other departments within the organization on behalf of CCO
  • Build and lead the daily operations for the CCO, such as meeting preparation, planning, and research 
  • Build and run cadence for executive leadership meetings, revenue team meetings, and leadership offsites, including structuring and helping to deliver company-wide communication at direction of CCO
  • Project Manage cross-functional strategic initiatives, facilitate special projects, and ensure action items are executed on behalf of the CCO
  • Operate at a tactical, strategic, and operational level, handling the oversight of projects that do not neatly fit within the organizational chart or that fall between departments or leadership areas of responsibility
  • Acts as an extension of the CCO and information funnel, filter, and facilitator with internal and external stakeholders
  • Assess all inquiries directed to the CCO, determine priority and the proper course of action

Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is hiring an exceptional Lead Editor for its signature briefing, Flagship. Aimed at the core Semafor audience — senior executives, decision makers, and policymakers — Flagship distills the biggest, most important, and interesting news from across the world into tight, analytically rich, and deeply contextualized updates for sophisticated, time-poor readers. Its core strength is that it is complex, comprehensive, and completable.

The successful candidate will help run this product and infuse the Flagship sensibility across the Semafor newsroom, its products, site, and app. They will both write and edit with fluidity and should be armed in particular with strong associative intelligence — able to tie together complex ideas and seemingly disparate developments — alongside a deep understanding of the factors driving global geoeconomics, particularly when it comes to developments in technology, business, economics, finance, and trade. The Lead Editor will be skilled at making connections, implicit and explicit, across themes, geographies, and industries, while also bringing delight to readers’ daily lives. They will handle the news with sobriety and historical nuance.

The successful candidate will report to the Global Managing Editor, as part of a team of contributors worldwide, helping drive both daily editions of Flagship. They will be based in London.

Your responsibilities

  • Work with Semafor journalists to shape Flagship’s tone and coverage, and write most of it on a daily basis in the UK morning.
  • Support the production of the edition that publishes in the US evening with insights and ideas.
  • Collaborate across the Semafor newsroom, working with all our teams and verticals, contributing broadly to coverage beyond Flagship — in particular by writing, editing, or assigning stories.
  • Help lead the conception and execution of a Semafor app.
  • Write smart, sophisticated, analytically hefty updates for an elite audience.
  • Participate in event moderation, as well as media appearances on TV, radio, and podcasts.

What makes you qualified

  • 5 to 10 years of journalism experience, with a track record of major writing roles or leadership of high-level newsletters or briefings.
  • Experience and interest in global financial and business journalism.
  • A strategic, sophisticated approach to identifying themes and focuses of coverage across sectors and borders.
  • Bring speedy insight to big news stories, and flair and personality to writing.
  • A passion for world events and issues and a broad interest in a wide range of subjects.
  • Broad media consumption habits across conventional and unconventional sources.
  • Eagerness to be part of a dynamic work environment demanding initiative, flexibility, and a willingness to jump in wherever needed to help the team succeed.
  • Experience working with diverse teams with teammates from many different backgrounds.
  • Diligence and reliability to work without hands-on supervision.
  • The ability to think constantly about story distribution and audiences, across many forms of media and platforms.

job.description:

About the role

AI, politics, private credit, supply shocks, and other global forces are upending the world of business and finance, reordering how money moves around the globe.

We're looking for an unbeatable reporter to break big stories on the bleeding edge of Wall Street and across global markets— private investing, hedge funds, banking, prediction markets, and private equity.

This is a big-game-hunting role where you won’t be asked to match stories readily available on the internet. Instead, you'll follow your sources to memorable scoops and places where other reporters aren't going. In addition to breaking news, you'll write reported columns and views that actually say something — smart, original takes that help our readers understand what's really happening and why it matters. You'll take swings at stories that need more time, conduct high-profile interviews with some of the most powerful people in global business and finance, and bring your unique voice to Semafor's briefings, live journalism, and shows, as well as on TV, podcasts, and other media appearances.

Responsibilities

  • Help lead the expansion of Semafor business from a twice-weekly business and finance briefing to a daily must-read 
  • Break significant, agenda-setting stories on the business and finance beat — private credit, hedge funds, private equity, banking, and the political and geopolitical forces reshaping the world of business and capital markets
  • Write reported columns and analytical pieces with real point of view for a sophisticated audience of executives, investors, and decision-makers
  • Work closely with Semafor colleagues across the global newsroom 
  • Develop and maintain deep, senior-level sources across Wall Street, financial institutions, and the regulatory and political ecosystem around capital markets
  • Appear on TV, podcasts, and Semafor's marquee live journalism, where you'll host on-the-record interviews with the most senior business and finance leaders

Who you are

  • A proven, scoop-hungry reporter with at least 5 years of experience and a demonstrated track record of sourcing up on Wall Street, inside boardrooms, and private Signal chats— and a clear sense of where the next beat of a big story is heading
  • Someone who has developed a voice and smart takes on the biggest news in finance, and who can move fluidly between breaking a story and writing something authoritative and compelling about what it means
  • A comprehensive reader of the competitive landscape, always aware of what's been done and what hasn't
  • A self-starter with experience in fast-moving, ambitious newsroom environments and the willingness to jump in wherever the team needs you
  • A contagious passion for news in all its forms

Compensation

The base salary for this position ranges from $140,000 to $200,000. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented accounting professional with a solid foundation in month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations, who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment. This role will work closely with the Controller to strengthen processes, internal controls, and documentation, and will partner with FP&A on cost analysis and reporting. Prior experience in the media industry is a plus. This position offers meaningful growth potential as the accounting & finance team continues to scale.

What You’ll Do:

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end close process, ensuring all close deliverables are completed accurately and on a timely basis.
  • Prepare and post journal entries in accordance with GAAP, ensuring transactions are properly recorded and supported.
  • Prepare and analyze monthly account reconciliations for assigned balance sheet and income statement accounts, researching and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across entities, ensuring balances tie out and are properly eliminated in consolidation 
  • Review the general ledger for accurate coding across all financial dimensions (department, project, entity, etc.), proactively identifying and correcting miscoded transactions.

  • Support the Controller with audits, special projects, and ad hoc analyses as needed.

  • Comfortable wearing many hats and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment.

What You Offer

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field from an accredited university or college; CPA or CPA candidate a plus.
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and general ledger accounting principles.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills with a strong emphasis on Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling).
  • Experience with a general ledger/ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks) required; Bill.com or similar AP platform experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with proven organizational and time management skills and a strong sense of ownership and accuracy.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance role, with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines.
  • Experience in the media, publishing, or entertainment industry is a plus.

job.title: Spend Management Lead (Accounts Payable & T&E)
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is seeking an Accounts Payable and T&E Manager to own end-to-end accounts payable operations and travel and expense management for the Finance team. The ideal candidate is an experienced accounts payable and expense professional who can manage the full payables lifecycle from vendor onboarding through payment application, serve as an administrator of our expense platform, and play a customer service role in supporting our employees with their travel. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently and as part of a team, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast paced, high energy environment, and the desire to be on the ground floor of a rapidly growing startup.

This position is full-time and based out of Semafor’s New York office with the option to work remotely on Fridays.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end accounts payable process, from vendor onboarding through payment processing and payment application, ensuring proper account and dimension coding for accurate financial reporting.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all vendor interactions, resolving vendor inquiries and issues, and partnering with management to ensure timely, accurate vendor payments.
  • Manage annual 1099 filings and other required tax documentation, ensuring accurate vendor tax records (e.g., W-9s) and timely IRS reporting
  • Ensure compliance with global tax/regulatory requirements (including VAT as applicable)
  • Manage our virtual card platform, including card issuance, controls, and reconciliation.  
  • Oversee end-to-end T&E processing, exception handling, and reimbursements in accordance with company policy.
  • Serve as a super user of the expense platform, providing training and proactive troubleshooting support to employees.
  • Assist employees with travel arrangements and regularly audit and report on T&E trends, recommending process improvements.
  • Maintain organized, up-to-date files for vendor agreements and SOWs for contractors, ensuring documentation is complete and easily accessible for reference and audit purposes
  • Monitor our vendor spend and assist management with identifying cost savings, contract renewals and duplication
  • Assist with month-end close, including account reconciliations, AP and T&E accruals
  • Provide assistance with ad hoc projects and other initiatives aimed at improving the financial performance of the business.

Where This Role Can Grow

  • Champion the launch of our new expense platform, Emburse Enterprise, shaping how Semafor manages travel and expenses for years to come.
  • Own the build-out of a new virtual card platform from the ground up, designing the controls and processes that will scale with the company.
  • Help optimize our global payments processes as Semafor's footprint continues to expand into new markets.
  • Grow into a trusted resource on travel, guiding the team through complex arrangements and uncovering meaningful savings along the way.

What You Offer

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field from an accredited university or college.
  • 4+ years of experience in accounts payable and travel & expense management.
  • Knowledge of basic accounting principles and an eagerness to learn
  • Experience implementing a new expense platform is a plus.
  • Experience managing a virtual card platform.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office Skills with a strong emphasis on Excel.
  • Bill.com or other payment platform experience is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail, proven organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and works well in a team environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Compensation: 

The base salary for this position at the time of posting will range from $105,000. - $115,000.per year.  Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, location, experience, level of responsibility and qualifications.

Additional Details;

This role is on site in our New York City Headquarters from Monday - Thursday and work from home on Fridays.

job.title: Technology Reporter — Business of Tech, AI & Power
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the role

We're looking for a proven, scoop-hungry Tech Reporter to cover the business of tech with a relentless focus on AI, and the forces — money, power, and politics — that are reshaping the industry and the world it's remaking.

Your focus will be on big-game hunting — getting the scoops and stories that will set Semafor apart. You'll be tracking what the largest companies in history are building, how they’re making money, and how the people who run them are accumulating capital and political influence. You’ll uncover how AI is restructuring industries and reordering markets, and how governments in Washington, Brussels, and Beijing are rushing to catch up. In addition to writing agenda-setting stories for Semafor's tech and business coverage, you’ll contribute to our newsletters, shows, live journalism, and cross-platform collaborations across the newsroom.

The ideal candidate has cultivated sources at the executive level inside the major AI labs, in venture capital and private equity, on Capitol Hill, and inside the White House and federal agencies — and knows how to work all of them to land stories no one else has.

Responsibilities

  • Produce a regular cadence of scoops and definitive analytical pieces 
  • Build and maintain high-level sources across the AI labs, major tech companies, venture and growth capital, and the political ecosystem around tech policy
  • Write agenda-setting stories that situate individual company or policy decisions in the larger context of capital accumulation, geopolitical competition, and technological transformation
  • Collaborate with Semafor journalists across business, finance, politics, and international coverage to produce breakout cross-beat stories
  • Contribute to Semafor's live journalism, including news-breaking, on-record panels with senior business and political figures

Who you are

  • five or more years of relevant experience in tech or business journalism, with a demonstrated track record of sourcing deeply inside companies and venture capital
  • Proven ability to blend insider knowledge with authoritative "what-it-means" analysis for a sophisticated audience of executives, investors, and policymakers
  • A reporter who has already developed a voice and sharp takes on the biggest stories in tech
  • Someone who thinks beyond the story of the day — spotting the bigger themes, the quiet power shifts, the deals and decisions that only make sense months later
  • Self-starter with experience in fast-moving, ambitious newsroom environments and the willingness to jump in wherever the team needs you
  • A contagious passion for news in all its forms, and a genuine obsession with where technology and power intersect

Compensation

The base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $175,000. Individual compensation varies based on experience, qualifications, and scope of responsibility. Semafor offers comprehensive benefits including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and pre-tax commuter benefits.

job.title: Senior Marketing Specialist- MSD (New York or Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC Music Group’s Music Services division is looking for a Senior Marketing Specialist to join our team in either New York City or Nashville. This role serves as the VP of Marketing's right hand, executing projects, leading efforts to get campaigns live in our platforms, and analyzing AI tools to process improve and create faster, more efficient workflows. It also supports the MSD operations team on tracking, reporting, and process work.

The ideal candidate is a tech-savvy self-starter who writes well, catches what others miss, and doesn't wait to be told the next step. Deep marketing strategy experience isn't required; understanding why the work matters is. The successful candidate will be a hands-on practitioner who keeps marketing and operations work moving. While the majority of this role’s time will focus on marketing duties, this role also supports the Operations team with project tracking and reporting.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Independently manage multiple marketing and operations workstreams at once: tracking timelines, owners, and dependencies in Asana, Monday, Jira, or similar.
  • Drive projects through to completion by project managing all aspects of campaigns and ensuring the VP of Marketing keeps ahead of deadlines.
  • Partner with the division’s businesses, outside agencies, and other internal teams to ensure launches and deliverables stay on schedule.
  • Build, review, and launch email campaigns, social posts, and web updates in HubSpot, Mailchimp, and social platforms.
  • Analyze campaign dashboards and recommend next actions based on what the data shows.
  • Manage campaign calendars, asset libraries, and CRM hygiene in partnership with the Marketing team.
  • Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows for the team to streamline repetitive tasks.
  • Draft and edit copy for emails, social, presentations, and internal communications for accuracy, tone, and brand voice.
  • Ensure consistency in alignment, spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy against brand standards for all deliverables.
  • Produce and update design assets using tools such as Canva, Figma, or Adobe Express.
  • Support the MSD operations team with project tracking, reporting, and preparing presentation materials, all with an eye towards process improvements.
  • Take on ad hoc cross-functional projects as priorities shift or special projects as assigned.

What Makes You Qualified:

  • 3+ years in marketing, project management, operations, or a related role.
  • Proven ability to independently manage several workstreams at once while maintaining strong attention to detail, using project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Jira.
  • Comfortable learning new platforms quickly.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Mailchimp, or social media management tools.
  • Comfortable using emerging technologies and AI tools daily to research, draft, summarize, and automate routine work.
  • Working knowledge of marketing fundamentals. 
  • Experience managing email, social, campaigns, and analytics.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience analyzing dashboards and reporting tools to drive business decisions and revenue growth.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a strong editorial judgment to spot copy that is generic, off-tone, or inaccurate.
  • A self-starter who finds answers independently, anticipates next steps, and flags problems early.
  • A sharp eye for visual detail and brand consistency.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, operations, and internal partners.
  • Excellent organization and project management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What Would Be Music to Our Ears:

  • Experience in music publishing, rights administration, or the broader music industry (strong plus).
  • Hands-on experience with design tools such as Canva, Figma, or the Adobe suite.
  • Experience building automations or integrations (e.g., Zapier, HubSpot workflows, AI agents).
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.


This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our New York City or Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Digital Remedy is a Performance Marketing Partner for brands & agencies, headquartered in New York City, that specializes in helping marketers deliver better outcomes and higher ROI on their media investments.

Digital Remedy offers access, measurement, and optimization across all major media channels with a speciality in Performance CTV. Our proprietary platform has been recognized by the Drum and Digiday for product excellence and was recently named Digiday’s Best New Streaming Advertising Platform. We have seen exponential growth and adoption across Tier 1 brands and agencies, including several Fortune 500 companies and Big 6 agency holding companies. We’ve spent over 20 years investing in performance solutions and we are well positioned to continue offering our clients a way to anchor their campaigns in real world business outcomes.

We are looking for a top Account Executive to join our fast growing sales team. As an Account Executive you will play a critical role with our energetic and talented sales & customer team. The Account Executive will lead all stages of the life cycle of a customer in order to secure, retain, and grow digital ad revenue with our customers and partners. The ideal candidate must be able to develop and execute a focused solution based strategy in order to maximize our value back to the customer.

We are looking for a person with a passion for digital media, a desire to be at the leading edge of technological change in the digital media industry and the ability to learn and contribute quickly.

  • Show consistency in exceeding sales targets and key performance indicators. 
  • Manage client relationships inclusive of strategy recommendation and up-selling.

 

Our Ideal Candidate

  • Proven track record of success in exceeding sales targets and key performance indicators. Knowledge of all facets of digital media, OTT/CTV industry landscape a plus.

Tennis Channel is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Coordinator, Channel Operations to support the 24/7/365 operational execution and day-of-air integrity of our expanding portfolio of FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) channels, including Tennis Channel 2 and PickleballTV.

Reporting directly to the Manager, FAST Channel Operations, this role serves as an essential operational point of contact responsible for daily playlist preparation, live tournament tracking, metadata accuracy, advertising cue-point verification, and transmission quality control. Because professional tennis operates across global time zones, this position requires full flexibility to work non-traditional hours—including dedicated overnights, early mornings, weekends, and holidays aligned with international tournament coverage.

The ideal candidate thrives in a high-tempo live sports broadcast environment, possesses sharp technical and editorial problem-solving skills, and demonstrates meticulous attention to detail under tight live-to-air deadlines.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

 

  • Hours & Shift Structure: 24/7/365 operations coverage. This is a full-time position working dedicated overnight and early-morning shifts, including weekends and holidays, aligned with live tournament windows across worldwide time zones (ATP/WTA global tours, Grand Slams, PPA pickleball).

  •  

In this role you will...

Execute Channel Scheduling & Playout

  • Under the direction of the Manager, build, review, maintain, and release accurate daily and multi-day channel playlists utilizing cloud-based playout systems (e.g., Amagi) and traffic schedules.

  • Coordinate playlist timing and media elements for live matches, studio wrap shows, encore telecasts, original programming, and promotional priority blocks.

  • Monitor live-event tournament dynamics—including weather interruptions, match overruns, court assignments, and join-in-progress (JIP) scenarios—and make real-time playlist and log adjustments to maintain schedule integrity.

  • Execute day-of-air programming adjustments and hot-swaps in response to breaking live tournament coverage across domestic and international time zones.

  •  

Monitor Channels & Maintain Quality Control

  • Perform active eyes-on-glass monitoring across linear FAST feeds and OTT distribution platforms (e.g., Samsung TV Plus, Roku Channel, Amazon Prime Video, Pluto TV) to ensure uninterrupted playback, audio/video synchronization, pristine picture quality, and compliant closed captioning.

  • Inspect, verify, and quality-check SCTE-35 advertising markers, program segment breaks, and commercial cue points to support monetization accuracy and viewer retention.

  • Conduct pre-air QC on playlists, media files, secondary graphics events, and promotional assets prior to scheduled transmission.

  •  

Manage Asset Ingest, Metadata & Partner Coordination

  • Track the intake, processing, segmentation, and technical validation of file-based video assets, confirming media readiness ahead of transmission deadlines.

  • Enter and audit rich program metadata, including titles, synopses, episode numbers, ratings, territorial restrictions, and Electronic Program Guide (EPG) schedules across distribution endpoints.

  • Act as the operational floor contact during live match windows, proactively logging incidents, triaging playout anomalies, and escalating technical issues to Broadcast Operations, Engineering, Playout Vendors, and Platform Support.

  • Adhere to contractual rights windows, territorial blackout rules, and network Standards & Practices guidelines.

  • Handle Operational Administration & Provide Shift Coverage

  • Maintain accurate operational shift logs, discrepancy reports, incident tickets, and daily run sheets.

  • Deliver structured, comprehensive handoffs between operational shifts to ensure continuity across tournament coverage cycles.

  • Follow and uphold standard operating procedures (SOPs) for live event execution, emergency filler routing, and ad-break contingencies.

  •  

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 2 years of operational experience in FAST, live streaming, broadcast playout, master control, traffic, or digital media operations.

  •  

  • Shift Availability: Ability to work dedicated overnight and early-morning shifts, weekends, and holidays in a 24/7/365 live sports environment, matching the global tennis calendar.

  •  

  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience working with cloud-based playout automation platforms (e.g., Amagi CLOUDPORT or similar), broadcast CMS, or traffic scheduling systems.

  •  

  • Live Operations Aptitude: Demonstrated experience handling live sports or breaking events, with the ability to calculate runtimes, adjust join-in-progress segments, and navigate delay scenarios under tight deadlines.

  •  

  • Digital Video & Metadata: Familiarity with broadcast video file specifications, closed captioning formats (608/708, WebVTT), SCTE-35 cue markers, EPG delivery, and content segmentation.

  •  

  • Communication & Composure: Strong verbal and written communication skills; proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical, editorial, and commercial teams while maintaining composure during high-pressure live broadcast situations.

  •  

  • Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) and broadcast collaboration tools.

  •  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior direct operational experience with Amagi cloud playout and scheduling workflows.

  • Prior experience supporting 24/7 live-sports FAST channels or AVOD services across major CTV aggregators.

  • Familiarity with major distribution delivery endpoints (Roku, Samsung TV Plus, Amazon Prime Video, Fubo, Apple, etc.).

  • Working knowledge of professional tennis (ATP/WTA tours, tournament structures, time-zone shifts) and pickleball (PPA).

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. About Tennis Channel

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.

 

o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 

o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will produce daily newscasts and oversee the production of newscasts and special programming. You will work closely with producers and reporters on daily selection and coverage.   • A strong commitment to journalistic standards and ethics
  • Extraordinary people skills with an emphasis on coaching and motivating
  • Strong understanding of how to drive digital traffic

job.title: Human Resources Manager
job.description:
Sinclair is looking for an experienced Human Resources Manager to join KABB and WOAI-TV in providing front-line, on-site, day-to-day HR support. The HR Manager will also support our station in Corpus Christi, TX.

The HR Manager provides on-site, practical, day-to-day guidance across each of the functional areas of human resources including recruiting, onboarding and offboarding, benefits, leaves of absence, employee relations, training, and performance management. The successful candidate brings three to five years of human resources experience in a fast-paced environment, along with sound judgment, clear communication, reliable follow-through, and strong attention to detail.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with HR colleagues and station leaders to provide responsive, practical support to employees and managers across multiple stations, while building an understanding of each station’s people, operations, and culture.

  • Help ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations, including FMLA, FLSA, workers’ compensation, ADA, and EEO requirements; interpret and apply company policies consistently and help managers understand their responsibilities.

  • Support employee relations matters, including being responsive to complaints and investigations in coordination with the Regional HR Manager.

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding actions, including preparing materials, presenting information, and collecting required documentation.

  • Support recruiting by posting openings, preparing offer letters, coordinating pre-employment requirements, maintaining accurate tracking records, communicating promptly with candidates, and helping ensure compliant hiring practices.

  • Support benefits administration by maintaining working knowledge of company plans, assisting with Open Enrollment communications and employee education, and participating in audits as needed.

  • Support performance management and review cycles, including compliance tracking, follow-up, and audits.

  • Administer leaves of absence in accordance with company policy, benefit plan requirements, and applicable federal, state and local laws.

  • Respond to unemployment, worker’s compensation claims and employment verification requests.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential electronic HR and personnel records, and handle sensitive employee information with discretion.

  • Help plan and coordinate employee training, morale events, and team activities, manage assigned HR projects and perform other related duties as needed.

  • This is an onsite position supporting our stations in San Antonio, Corpus Christi, with the potential to expand to additional Sinclair stations.

  • Some travel to assigned locations required.

     

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources or a related field.
  • Three to five years of human resources experience.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees and managers at all levels.
  • A positive, service-oriented approach and dependable follow-through on assigned work.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and sensitive situations, including when under pressure and/or tight deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and close attention to detail.
  • Oracle HRIS experience is a plus.

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
Live Desk Anchor — Good Morning Alabama

 

WBMA/WJSU/WCFT is looking for a dynamic, full-time Live Desk Anchor to join Good Morning Alabama. This role is central to our morning coverage: You’ll lead live desk reporting during breaking news, deliver live traffic updates from the studio and help viewers understand what’s happening as news develops.

 

The Live Desk Anchor also fills in for our primary anchors as needed, appears regularly in our midday newscast and leads an on-air franchise that runs every other week. We’re looking for an outstanding journalist, a confident communicator and a collaborative team leader who brings strong news judgment, a competitive passion to win and an openness to innovation. A strong social media presence and a commitment to engaging with the audience are important parts of the job.

 

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills
  • A smooth, engaging on-air delivery
  • Sharp breaking-news judgment and the ability to work calmly under pressure
  • Strong writing and ad-libbing skills
  • The ability to explain traffic conditions and breaking news clearly and quickly
  • Strong communication skills and an active interest in audience engagement
  • The ability to develop and deliver a consistent, compelling news franchise

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • At least three years of on-air experience
  • Live commercial television experience
  • Strong live reporting skills, especially during breaking news
  • Exceptional written communication skills and a conversational writing style
  • Strong editorial judgment and a proven ethical foundation
  • Flexibility to fill in for primary anchors and contribute to morning and midday newscasts

 

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel.

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: News Anchor (Part-Time)
job.description:
WSYX/ABC 6 is seeking a curious, confident, and engaging part-time host for After the Headlines, a new weekday 7:30 p.m. program built to take viewers deeper into the stories they’ve just seen in our regular newscasts.

This is a conversation-driven show, not a traditional newscast. The host will guide discussions with reporters, newsmakers, and community voices, helping audiences understand what’s behind the headlines, why it matters and what questions remain. The right candidate is an excellent journalist and communicator who can bring energy, authenticity, and thoughtful curiosity to every conversation.

What You’ll Do

  • Host After the Headlines and lead clear, engaging conversations about the day’s important local stories.
  • Work with producers, reporters, and editors to identify stories that benefit from added context, explanation, or accountability.
  • Prepare thoughtful questions, research topics, and help shape discussions that are informative, fair, and compelling.
  • Collaborate with reporters and other Sinclair journalists, drawing on their expertise and firsthand reporting to deepen the conversation.
  • Conduct interviews with newsmakers, experts, and community members in studio, remotely and in the field as needed.
  • Contribute to the show’s development across broadcast, streaming, social and digital platforms.
  • Maintain strong editorial judgment, accuracy, and ethical standards.
  • Participate in promotional and community activities as assigned.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong journalist with excellent writing, interviewing, and communication skills.
  • A natural conversational presence who can make complex topics understandable and keep discussions moving.
  • Sound news judgment, curiosity, and the ability to ask direct, thoughtful follow-up questions.
  • Confidence working live and adapting when conversations or breaking news take an unexpected turn.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work closely with producers, reporters and colleagues across platforms.
  • Experience in television news, reporting, anchoring, hosting, interviewing or a related field is preferred.
  • A degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, is preferred.

 

This is a part-time position. Schedule and hours will be discussed with candidates.

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

job.title: Regional Sales Assistant
job.description:
KECI has an exciting opportunity for a Regional National Sales Assistant. If you would like to work in the exciting business of television sales, this could be the job for you!

Responsibilities include:

  • Primary function is data entry of national sales orders from national advertisers
  • Daily entry of National Sales orders into the traffic system with accuracy and complying to order contract, inventory, and scheduling constraints.
  • Daily maintenance and research on national sales orders to troubleshoot and resolve order-related issues and discrepancies
  • Regular communication and collaboration with both internal and external contacts to ensure campaign success.
  • Develop a strong understanding and adherence to the National sales process and nuances, systems, and SOPs
  • Consistent independent prioritizing and organizing of workload with a sense of urgency and balance.
  • Completion of assigned tasks within the given deadline.
  • Regular generation, manipulation, and maintenance of reports both from internal systems and Excel spreadsheets.
  • Daily use of Windows PC including Office programs such as Outlook, Teams, Excel, and Word.
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Skills and Qualifications:

  • At least 1-2 years’ experience of administrative support preferred
  • A high level of organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and multi-task
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple tasks under a deadline
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Consistently comply with organizational directives and national standard operating procedures.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for effective interaction with internal and external team members
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
  • Broadcast Sales, media buying, or agency experience is a plus
  • Maintain a positive demeanor and customer service focus

job.title: Sales and Marketing Assistant
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our media sales efforts by supporting our sales operations. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Build Relationships: Connect with internal and external clients, understanding their needs to provide support. 

 

o Innovate and Inspire: We value creativity at all levels of our organization and encourage you to think outside the box to find new ways to support our business and elevate our brand.

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams to ensure a top-notch customer experience. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

 

o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned administrative or business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  

 

o Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  

 

o A Passion for Helping Others: You are committed to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.   

 The base hourly compensation range for this role is $20.00 to $21.31. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Sales Marketing Coordinator supports Sinclair’s National Sports Ad Sales team throughout the sales and sponsorship process. The role helps develop client concepts and integrated marketing solutions, then works with teams across Creative Services, Ad Operations, Social, Content and Production to bring those ideas to life.

The coordinator contributes to innovative, revenue-generating partnerships for new and existing sponsors. This position reports to the Senior Director of Sales Marketing and follows a hybrid schedule based in Sinclair’s New York office.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented candidate with an interest in sports media. Familiarity with media sales, RFP responses and campaign management is a plus.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner with the Sales Marketing team to develop integrated solutions across linear, digital and social platforms.
  • Work with internal teams to develop client and agency pitches, using PowerPoint and Excel and supporting the media buying and RFP process.
  • Coordinate with On-Air Graphics, Social, Content and Production teams to execute branded content, in-show integrations and sponsorship enhancements.
  • Brainstorm with internal partners to create custom, multi-channel sponsorship ideas for brands.
  • Support campaign strategy and performance projections in collaboration with Sales.
  • Develop presentations and one-sheets for programming, events and tournaments with Research, Production, Marketing and other teams.
  • Track marketplace trends and share relevant insights in brainstorms and weekly Sales meetings.

 

Desired Characteristics:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects efficiently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across departments.
  • Skilled at creating presentations, especially in Microsoft PowerPoint.
  • Able to work with urgency and prioritize competing projects.
  • Proactive, self-sufficient and resourceful.
  • Creative thinker who can develop fresh, effective solutions.
  • Interested in sports, content creation and pop culture, especially the NFL, NBA, soccer, tennis and college sports

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 1–2 years of experience in media sales, advertising, marketing or a related field.
  • Understanding of branded content, digital media and online video, including basic digital media metrics such as CPM, CPV, impressions and KPIs.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office. Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator, is a plus but not required.
  • General knowledge of sports.

 

The base hourly compensation range for this role is $25.50 to $30.00 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

The base salary range for this position is $44,000 - $55,000 annually. This role is also eligible for uncapped commission under the applicable sales compensation plan. Commissions are earned on eligible sales closed by the employee, subject to the terms and conditions of the plan. Actual commission earnings may vary based on individual performance, sales results, and achievement of applicable sales goals. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Senior Product Support Specialist
job.description:
Sinclair Digital is hiring a Senior Product Support Specialist! Join Sinclair Digital, the innovation engine behind the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country. We’re at the forefront of transforming how local news and television are produced, distributed, and consumed across multiple platforms. This position is based in Seattle, WA.

Our Product Support Specialists play a crucial role in providing technical support for our Content Management System and our News station’s websites and mobile apps.  They are responsible for conducting administrative-level tasks such as creating new users, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, providing guidance to users, escalating issues to our software development team, and working closely with our software engineers to ensure that requests are prioritized and handled properly.  

As a Senior Product Support Specialist, you are expected to be expert-level at the position, lead complex troubleshooting efforts, and provide mentorship to the other team members. You will also be responsible for maintaining our knowledge base and ensuring that it is up-to-date and accurate.  You will identify opportunities for continuous learning for the team and help coordinate those activities.  You will serve as a point of escalation when additional expertise is required, or when a customer requires additional TLC.     

 Responsibilities:  

  • Technical Expertise:  
    • Provide advanced technical support to internal users of our CMS software application via phone, email and ticketing system.  
    • Lead troubleshooting efforts for user-reported issues, diagnose root causes, and identify comprehensive solutions.  
    • Research and resolve technical problems using internal knowledge bases and collaborating with developers.  
  • Mentorship and Leadership:  
    • Mentor and guide junior support team members, fostering their professional development.  
    • Conduct training sessions and share best practices with the support team.  
    • Audit support tickets for issues and address them as needed.  
  • Documentation and Knowledge Management:
    • Document solutions and frequently asked questions (FAQs) to build a robust internal knowledge base.  
    • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our systems through ongoing training and keeping abreast of new features and updates.  
  • User Assistance:  
    • Provide clear and concise instructions to users with varying levels of technical expertise.   
    • Meet or exceed the Service Level Agreements for time to respond and time to resolve.   
  • Manage Escalated Issues:  
    • Escalate issues that require software development level support.  Generate tickets with thorough detail on what is required, the priority of the issue, and include thorough steps for issue recreation.   
    • Attend daily standup meetings with Engineering and provide feedback on new items to triage.   
    • Test and validate bug fixes.   
  • On-Call Duties:  
    • Take on-call shifts from 5:00 PM to 5:00 AM on a rotational basis.  
    • Support the front-line Product Support Specialist on-call with issues that require senior-level expertise. 

 

Qualifications:  

  • At least 5 years of progressive experience in a technical support role with software-related products. 2 or more of those years as a Tier 2/3, Senior, or Lead-level support.  
  • Strong understanding of web technologies and content management systems.  
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.   
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.  
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and support tools.   
  • Understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle.  

 

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Experience supporting software used in the media or news industry.  
  • Experience with video technologies.  
  • Knowledge of web development languages such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript. 
  • Understanding of database management systems.  
  • Experience with tools including Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Analytics.   
  • Product Management experience.  
  • Management experience.  
  • Software testing experience. 

 

Attributes:  

  • Positive Attitude 
    • Patient and empathetic  
    • Enthusiastic and helpful 
    • Team player  
  • Good Communicator 
    • Active listener  
    • Professional demeanor  
  • Problem-Solving Skills 
    • Analytical and methodical 
    • Resourceful 
    • Detail-oriented 
    • Commitment to continuous learning 
  • Adaptable 
  • Good time management skills  
  • Strong work ethic 
  • Natural leader who inspires and motivates others  

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $32.69 to $40.86. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

 Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

 Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

About the Team

The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk.

job.title: Software Development Engineer – Backend / Platform
job.description:
Tennis Channel is building a modern, scalable backend platform to power the next generation of our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) experience across mobile, TV, and hybrid applications. As an SDE – Backend / Platform, you'll help build the core services behind live streaming, content management, personalization, analytics, and operational tooling that support millions of users across devices.

In this role, you'll design, develop, and operate backend systems using modern cloud technologies, distributed systems, microservices, and large-scale data platforms. You'll work closely with mobile, product, data, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable, high-performing services that power the Tennis Channel ecosystem.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced environment where your work directly shapes the product experience. We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building scalable, maintainable software and have experience with backend platforms, cloud infrastructure, data systems, or media and streaming technologies. Experience in OTT, broadcasting, or entertainment is a plus.

In this role you will…

  • Design and implement backend services (microservices, REST / GraphQL APIs, event-driven systems) to power core features: content ingestion, metadata, user profiles, personalization, video metadata, recommendations, etc.
  • Build scalable, highly available systems that handle high throughput and low latency requirements (e.g. for live events, real-time analytics).
  • Work with media / video teams to integrate backend systems for streaming, transcoding, content delivery (CDN), metadata synchronization, DRM, ad insertion.
  • Define data models, database schemas, and caching strategies to support queries at scale.
  • Instrument services with monitoring, metrics, tracing, alerting, and health checks; own reliability and observability for your services.
  • Collaborate with mobile / front-end / hybrid app engineers to define API contracts, error modes, versioning, and graceful degradation.
  • Participate in system design, architectural decisions, and trade-off discussions.
  • Improve developer productivity via tooling, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, build pipelines, and shared libraries.
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive improvements in performance, resilience, security, and cost optimization.
  • Stay current with state-of-the-art backend technologies, cloud architectures, distributed systems, database systems, caching, streaming, and big data pipelines.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional backend / full-stack engineering experience (not internships).
  • Strong experience in one or more backend languages (e.g. Java, Kotlin, Go, Scala, Python, Node.js).
  • Solid understanding of building HTTP / gRPC / WebSocket APIs, API versioning, error handling, and pagination.
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL) and/or NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis) along with schema design, indexing, queries, and query optimization.
  • Familiarity with caching layers (Redis, Memcached), message queues / streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Kinesis), and event-driven systems.
  • Experience with metrics, logging, tracing (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
  • Familiar with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (unit, integration, contract tests), deployment strategies, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).
  • Strong debugging, profiling, and performance optimization skills.
  • Excellent collaboration skills — you’ll be working across domains (mobile, video, data) in a small, cross-functional team

 

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Tennis Channel

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

About Sinclair

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest.
