job.title: Station Manager
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Station Manager to lead this market.  This is a frontline leadership role - not a desk job - and the top priority is revenue growth with a clear digital revenue strategy and an operational partnership with the General Manager. You will co-author the station operating plan, own digital growth, and translate strategy into measurable sales and operational execution with focus on overall revenue growth.

Primary Goals 

  • Co-create and execute the station Operating Plan with the GM — lead forecasting, P&L management, budget accountability, and tactical execution to hit quarterly/annual targets.
  • Own the station’s digital revenue strategy — grow streaming/OTT, programmatic, social, display, mobile, email, and lead-gen income; build integrated digital products for local advertisers.
  • Turn strategy into results — design go-to-market plans for linear + digital-first programs, measure performance, and iterate quickly to scale what works.

 

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop and scale digital product offerings (OTT/CTV, programmatic, social, email, local search, lead-gen) and integrate them with traditional TV packages.
  • Partner daily with the GM to set the Operating Plan: budgets, revenue targets, staffing plans, promotions calendar (gantt chart), and contingency plans for breaking events.
  • Lead sales strategy and execution — train and coach the sales team to sell integrated, data-driven campaigns and demonstrate value with metrics.
  • Own sales forecasting, pipeline health, and KPI reporting; use analytics to drive pricing. 
  • Drive new business development with aggressive, targeted outreach and modern prospecting techniques (CRM, lead gen software, AI tools).
  • Manage employee relations and station relations in absence of the GM — ensure on-air/digital continuity and execution during breaking news or weather events.
  • Hire, mentor, and hold staff accountable; foster a collaborative culture that balances creativity with performance.
  • Build and maintain strong local client relationships; identify and convert non-traditional revenue opportunities (events, sponsorships, branded content).
  • Ensure cross-department alignment (news, promotions, engineering, finance).

 

Success Metrics / KPIs (what you’ll be measured on)

  • Digital revenue growth (OTT/CTV, programmatic, social, email, digital sponsorships) — quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year.
  • Integrated campaign penetration — percent of total revenue from campaigns that include digital + linear components.
  • Operating Plan performance — revenue vs. budget, margin, and forecast accuracy.
  • Sales team performance — budget attainment, pipeline conversion rate, average deal size.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in senior management at a TV station or media company with a hands-on background in TV advertising sales and operations.
  • Proven track record growing digital revenue — direct experience with OTT/CTV, programmatic, social, email, and digital sponsorship products.
  • Strong capability in data, analytics, and attribution — able to translate metrics into pricing, packages, and sales programs.
  • Experience co-creating operating plans / P&L management with station leadership; strong budgeting and forecasting skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership: hiring, coaching, motivating, and holding sales and operations teams accountable.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills; highly focused on new business development using modern prospecting tools (CRM, AI).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills; comfortable presenting results and strategy to senior leadership.
  • Technical & tools: Excel, PowerPoint, CRM systems, programmatic/SSP/DSP familiarity preferred; OSI or similar traffic/billing experience a plus.

 

Preferred

  • Experience building pricing, packaging for new linear + digital products, and working with third-party vendors.
  • Demonstrated use of AI or automation in sales operations.
  • Background in community engagement that drives audience growth and advertiser affinity.

 

Why Sinclair

  • Leadership role with measurable strategic impact across two markets.
  • Opportunity to define and scale a modern, digital-first revenue engine while preserving linear strengths.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and the ability to rapidly move ideas to market.

job.title: NOC Analyst
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connected Vehicle Services) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Connected Vehicle (SiriusXM CV) is a leading provider of connected services to vehicle manufacturers, delivering one of the most broadly adopted connected vehicle platforms in North America for the last 25 years. Named the 2020 Company of the Year in the Telematics Industry by Frost & Sullivan, we provide safety, security and convenience services to millions of vehicle owners across major automotive brands. Our teams are continuously working to develop leading-edge technology that can not only add convenience to the daily lives of so many drivers across the country but our advancements in safety and security could also help save their lives.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst will be responsible for monitoring large computer networks and servers farms for problems from a central location. They analyze problems, perform troubleshooting and incident response on the systems, communicate with Operations teams and track problems through to resolution. The NOC engineer will lead the effort for notifications (e-mail, text, and phone), cross functional team triage sessions, status to Senior Leadership teams and communications to internal/external stakeholders during production incidents. Responsible for 24x7 monitoring of systems performance and communicates any problems to team and management.  Recommends and performs operational enhancements, including but not limited to: process improvement, documentation updates, monitoring enhancements and communications to leadership on production incidents. 

What you’ll do:

  • Assist with maintaining NOC operational, escalation, and notification documentation.
  • Owns efforts for incident notifications, gathering internal participants for triage sessions and communications via notifications to all internal and external stakeholders
  • Documents steps taken during the Incident to resolve the issue and communicates them to the incident team
  • Coordinates with the IT Support Center any necessary problem escalation and makes sure operations staff and management are informed of any major errors.
  • Timely and accurately create and update Incident Tickets using ticketing system.
  • Ensures all work is done completely and correctly, including all logs and preventative maintenance.
  • Monitors overall system, server and application performance. Notes and records anomalies, and recommends enhancement to improve performance.
  • Identify any trending in current monitoring system and recommend changes or improvements.
  • Recommends changes and enhancements that improve efficiency of operation.
  • Thoroughly communicates shift review to oncoming shift.
  • Maintains all logs, records, and reports relative to shift operations.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance activities.
  • Perform Network password reset requests.

What you’ll need:

  • Associate’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical school education.  Equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 0-2 years related experience in a computer/network operations environment. Adapts well to rapidly changing environment. 
  • Possesses excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask, displays attention to detail, organizational and time management skills. 
  • Works independently as a member of a team and leads by example. 
  • Works closely with IT personnel regarding operations issues.
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts (12 hours per shift) is required.   May require weekend/over-night shifts
  • Additional shift coverages may be asked to cover TSOC activities.
  • Proficient in the following areas (Windows, Linux)
  • Experience in a Network Operations Center environment is required.
  • Experience with updating and tracking technical issues in a ticketing system is required.
  • Basic systems and/or network engineering knowledge is required.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

job.title: Principal Engineer, Data Operations
job.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America. As the combined advertising revenue organization of Sirius XM Holdings Inc., SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBCUniversal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As the Principal Engineer, Data Operations, you will serve as a principal technical authority for enterprise Data Operations, defining scalable architecture, standards, and governance practices that enable trusted, performant, and accessible data products across SiriusXM Media. You will shape the technical strategy for Snowflake-based data models, semantic layers, KPI frameworks, and DataOps practices that support business, product, publisher, and advertiser use cases. Your work will directly influence how the organization measures success, scales data quality, and makes data-driven decisions without direct people-management responsibility.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the principal technical owner for Data Operations architecture, standards, and best practices across enterprise data platforms.

  • Set the technical direction for data operations capabilities that support reliable, scalable, secure, and efficient data movement and processing across the organization.

  • Define and evolve scalable Snowflake, dbt, semantic layer, and KPI architecture patterns that enable trusted, governed, and performant data assets.

  • Lead critical design decisions for large-scale data models, metric standardization, semantic architecture, and data quality frameworks that support business and product outcomes.

  • Partner with data engineering, product, analytics, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions and architecture recommendations.

  • Drive technical alignment with the product roadmap and vision by ensuring KPI metrics, data models, and semantic definitions are well-defined, actionable, and reusable.

  • Establish and advance technical standards for dbt, testing frameworks, CI/CD, Git workflows, orchestration, documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Resolve complex DataOps and data architecture issues across large-scale ecosystems, including streaming, podcasting, satellite, publisher, and advertiser use cases.

  • Review and guide the development of data pipeline requirements, process models, architectural recommendations, and reusable implementation patterns.

  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to analysts, engineers, and cross-functional partners without direct performance-management responsibility.

  • Create formal networks with key technical and business decision makers to influence enterprise data strategy, platform evolution, and long-term DataOps capabilities.

  • Manage and analyze large-scale data volumes (1+ PB) across complex ecosystems that power streaming, podcasting, satellite, publisher, and advertiser use cases.

  • Define and champion engineering standards, design principles, governance practices, and reusable patterns for data operations.

  • Guide and mentor engineers and technical leaders across a wide range of audiences, raising technical judgment and operational excellence throughout the organization.

  • Represent the organization’s data operations capabilities with senior stakeholders and, when appropriate, external technical communities.

What You’ll Need:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 6 years’ experience; or equivalent experience.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.

  • Principal-level experience in data operations, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems architecture, or enterprise data platform strategy.

  • Expert command of the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Git, orchestration tools, data modeling and metric governance, CI/CD practices, testing frameworks, and semantic layer platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy, architecture standards, and scalable implementation patterns across complex enterprise data ecosystems.

  • Deep expertise in dimensional modeling, metric standardization, semantic architecture design, governed KPI frameworks, and data quality practices.

  • Demonstrated success resolving critical technical issues and shaping broad architectural or design decisions.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional analytics, product, engineering, and business stakeholders through technical strategy, architecture recommendations, and data-driven decision making.

  • Experience mentoring senior analysts, engineers, or technical partners and raising technical quality across teams without direct people-management accountability.

  • Track record of anticipating business or technology challenges and introducing meaningful process, product, service, or platform improvements.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide and mentor engineers and technical leaders without relying on direct people-management authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a passion for making data accessible, actionable, and trusted at enterprise scale.

  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $ 180,800 to $ 210,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. AdsWizz is the underlying monetization solution for well-known music platforms, podcasts, and broadcasting groups worldwide, giving advertisers of all sizes unprecedented access to premium and niche audio content. Through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats, AdsWizz efficiently connects buyers and sellers for digital audio and podcast advertising. AdsWizz is a global company with a presence in over 40 countries and a Technology Development Hub in Bucharest, Romania.

How you’ll make an impact:
As a Senior Staff Data Engineer, you will join a highly performing team of engineers who build, own, and maintain backend services, data products and reporting applications. You will design, collaborate, and execute building the AdsWizz data products and reporting systems at scale while automating and providing insights into the data onboarding with the SXM Media and AdsWizz services.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and build high-performance, reliable, and scalable reporting APIs and data pipelines.

  • Lead high-level architecture discussions and planning sessions work with ad measurement, revenue and addressability data.

  • Work with various teams of engineers building software in a collaborative development process.

  • Collaborate with the Product team to clarify the scope of the projects by giving thoughtful feedback which challenges and clarifies requirements intent.

  • Execute tasks with utmost clarity and precision, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and providing clear direction to drive projects forward effectively.

  • Collaborate with the Global Operations and Cloud Infrastructure teams to ensure flawless production deployments and support the Incident Management team.

  • Responsible for mentoring and guiding junior engineers.

What you’ll need:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience in Python or Java programming language (preferably JDK17 or higher).

  • 7+ years designing, building, and managing data pipelines using Spark, BigQuery, AWS EMR, and GCP Cloud Analytics.

  • 7+ years of experience crafting REST API based-microservices and scalable products, utilizing diverse cloud platforms (ideally AWS).

  • Cloud data warehouse & analytics platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery).

  • Observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack.

  • Data pipeline expectations framework experience (like Monte Carlo data, Great Expectations, Soda).

  • Working with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Messaging platforms and stream data processing (like Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub).

  • Collaboration tools like Miro (or Lucidchart), Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong understanding of engineering software processes, lifecycle methodology, configuration management, release management, and system verification and testing.

  • Ability to work independently and oversee entire projects or significant parts, focusing on research and completing the tasks on time.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and a dedication to continuous improvement.

  • Nice to have expertise in Caching implementations (like Redis, Memcached, etc.).

· Proactively anticipate the needs of the A&R staff by foreseeing problems and preventing them by taking action and making recommendations related to schedules, communications, travel, and systems.

Who you are:

job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The manager will own the planning and execution of paid digital ad campaigns in collaboration with the project manager and artist teams, with a concentration on D2C growth and efficiency.   • Content Ideation. Help brainstorm content ideas for bespoke advertising objectives, incorporating real-time trends into creative campaigns.

  • Billing reconciliation. Coordinate billing reconciliation and invoice fulfillment for digital advertising partners.

job.title: Manager, Corporate Development, Asia
job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. We have nurtured some of music's most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

 

What you will do:

job.title: Performance Marketing Manager
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment är ett av världens ledande musikbolag med drygt 5 000 medarbetare globalt. På Sony Music Sverige arbetar ca 80 medarbetare med att dagligen skapa, utveckla, marknadsföra och distribuera våra artisters musik ur vårt breda urval av svensk och internationell repertoar. Vår vision är att vara Sveriges bästa musikbolag och arbetsplats inom branschen, kända för vår innovation, kreativitet och framgång, präglat av mångfald och passion för musik.

Sammanfattning av rollen
Brinner du för performance marketing och mäter du framgång i konverteringar snarare än räckvidd? Sony Music Sweden söker en datadriven, handlingskraftig och analytisk Performance Marketing Manager med gedigen erfarenhet av avancerad, konverteringsdriven digital annonsering. Du planerar, sätter självständigt upp och optimerar ett stort antal kampanjer – med ett tydligt mål; att driva konvertering och skapa långsiktiga resultat.

Du blir en del av vår Commercial-avdelning, där vi inte bara driver kampanjer för våra artister, utan framför allt marknadsför våra spellistor och artisternas största hits genom tiderna, både i Sverige och internationellt. Vi arbetar i grunden som en e-handlare: våra kampanjer optimeras mot konvertering och faktiska resultat snarare än traditionella räckviddsmål. Hos oss får du arbeta operativt med avancerade, datadrivna kampanjer och våra egenutvecklade marknadsföringsverktyg.

Rollen är baserad i Stockholm.

Vad kommer du att göra?
Som Performance Marketing Manager kommer du bland annat att:

  • Självständigt planera, sätta upp och optimera ett stort antal parallella kampanjer (ca 10–30 per vecka), med ansvar för budget, leverans och resultat.
  • Driva konverteringsfokuserade kampanjer för spellistor, artister, katalog och e-handel – från målgrupp och budskap till konvertering.
  • Granska och analysera kampanjdata över flera plattformar och löpande optimera mot konvertering, CPA och ROAS.
  • Säkerställa korrekt tracking och mätning – pixlar, Conversions API, UTM-struktur och förstapartsdata – i nära samarbete med våra analytiker och utvecklare.
  • Arbeta systematiskt med A/B-testning och konverteringsoptimering av annonser, målgrupper och landningssidor.
  • Bidra med ett varumärkesbyggande perspektiv och förståelse för vad som gör våra spellistor attraktiva och relevanta, med målet att skapa långsiktigt engagemang hos lyssnarna.
  • Samarbeta med teamet för att utveckla nya idéer, arbetssätt och lösningar som förbättrar våra resultat.

Vem är du?

  • Du har gedigen erfarenhet av performance marketing med fokus på konverteringsdriven annonsering, avancerad tracking och komplexa kampanjupplägg, gärna inom e-handel eller liknande digitala verksamheter.
  • Mycket goda praktiska kunskaper i Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads och TikTok Ads Manager. Du är van att självständigt sätta upp, hantera och optimera kampanjer.
  • Goda kunskaper om tracking och mätning, exempelvis spårningspixlar, Conversions API/server-side tracking, attribution och förstapartsdata.
  • Erfarenhet av konverteringsoptimering (CRO) och systematisk A/B-testning.
  • Förståelse för SEO, sökbeteenden och hur digital annonsering kan bidra till organisk tillväxt.
  • Förmåga att analysera och visualisera data samt presentera insikter som leder till konkreta förbättringar.
  • God förmåga att skriva engagerande och säljande texter för digitala kampanjer på svenska och/eller engelska.
  • Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att driva försäljning i en webbshop samt grundläggande kunskaper i Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects).

Personliga egenskaper

  • Du är kommersiellt driven och motiveras av mätbara resultat.
  • Du är analytisk, nyfiken och tycker om att testa, utvärdera och optimera för att ständigt förbättra resultaten.
  • Du är kreativ och har känsla för målgrupper, budskap och vad som skapar engagemang.
  • Du är strukturerad, organiserad och trivs med att hantera många parallella kampanjer.
  • Du är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att arbeta operativt och hands-on.
  • Du är kommunikativ, prestigelös och samarbetar gärna med andra.
  • Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya förutsättningar.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Som en del av Sony Music får du chans att vidga dina vyer och naturligt växa in i ett globalt nätverk.
  • Möjligheten att arbeta med avancerade, datadrivna kampanjupplägg i en miljö där vi ständigt utvecklar nya verktyg och arbetssätt.
  • Här får din kreativitet flöda fritt; vi uppmuntrar nya idéer som kan revolutionera hur vi skapar banbrytande kampanjer.
  • Ett team och en arbetsmiljö som genomsyras av kreativitet, engagemang och internationellt samarbete.
  • En konkurrenskraftig lön med förmåner och möjligheter till professionell utveckling.

Ansökan
Är detta rollen för dig? Skicka in din ansökan senast den 13 november 2026. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Som en aktiv del i ett samhälle med kulturell och social mångfald är Sony Musics ambition att präglas av inkludering och bred representation, samt vara en arbetsplats med lika möjligheter för alla. Sony Music anställer, bibehåller, befordrar och i övrigt behandlar alla medarbetare och kandidater efter erfarenhet, kvalifikationer och kompetens, oavsett kön, religion, ursprung, ålder, sexuell läggning, könsidentitet eller funktionsvariationer.

As Retail Production Coordinator you will provide administrative and operational support to Ceremony of Roses’ Retail Production team. You’ll collaborate with internal teams, manufacturers, and retailers to keep the production process running seamlessly and take part in delivering new releases to retailers.

Success in this role means being highly organized, a great communicator, and proactive in keeping Retail Production operations running smoothly. Your contributions will fuel the growth of Ceremony of Roses’ Retail business and help deliver exciting products to fans around the globe.

What you'll do:

job.title: Solutions Manager - The Orchard
job.description:
The Orchard have an exciting opening for a Solutions Manager to join us in the Johannesburg offices.

The Solutions Manager is responsible for the end-to-end operational onboarding of clients , content management, and synthesizing all back-office inquiries to resolve administrative and operational issues efficiently and accurately. 

You will serve as the primary client-facing representative for backend teams - including Legal, Finance, and Operations - this role ensures seamless account setups, catalog ingestions, and digital rights workflows.

You will work closely with the Relationship Management team and Operational Support. As Solutions Manager you will navigate complex technical platforms to advocate for client needs, maintain catalog integrity, and manage the full client lifecycle through offboarding.

The Orchard team meet in the office Monday- Thursday.  Most teams usually work remotely on Fridays.

What you'll do:

Client Onboarding & Lifecycle Management

  • Oversee end-to-end onboarding for new artists and labels, managing the path from contract signature and account setup to payment readiness, catalog ingestion, and distribution delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with the Relationship Team and Contract Admin during contract cutovers to guarantee smooth operational transitions.
  • Manage the complete client offboarding process when agreements expire or conclude, ensuring clean catalog handovers and system updates.

Administrative & Back-Office Representation

  • Act as the primary, client-facing liaison for internal back-office teams (Legal, Finance, Operations), addressing client inquiries, gathering feedback, and advocating for client needs.
  • Proactively lead client outreach regarding annual tax drills, royalty statement issues, and administrative legal/finance matters.
  • Resolve financial and account readiness questions, including payment release criteria and royalty statement clarifications.

Release Operations & Content Management

  • Advise clients on product logistics and oversee complex digital release setups tailored to specific label and campaign requirements.
  • Open, own, and resolve Concierge support threads in close coordination with Operations and Relationship Support teams.
  • Review, approve, and manage Tier 1 releases and resolve Content Review escalations across the assigned team roster.
  • Partner with Operations to execute content deletions, takedowns, price tier changes, territory/DSP availability updates, and overall digital catalog maintenance.
  • Manage video delivery workflows, including video release approvals, updates, copyright claims, and channel partnerships.

Technical Expertise & Compliance

  • Complete and maintain required platform certifications (YouTube, Label Management, Metadata tests) and demonstrate expert navigation of internal systems and DSP tools (Zendesk, Spotify Catalog Manager, Apple Music / iTunes Connect).
  • Work directly with the Claims team to engage clients on flagged content issues and resolve rights disputes.

Who you are:

  • Strong understanding of digital music distribution and the end-to-end release lifecycle, from contract onboarding and catalogue ingestion through delivery, maintenance and offboarding.

job.title: Specialist, Audience Development & Media Buying – Columbia
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

This role is fundamental to the core of the Audience Development and Media Buying team within the Digital Marketing department of Columbia Records. The specialist will help ideate and execute campaigns to build fan communities, focusing on first-party data capture and subsequent usage of that data in marketing. They will also be responsible for the planning and execution of paid digital ad campaigns for upcoming releases across the roster, under the supervision of the department head. Creativity, attention to detail, and data acumen are essential to this role. The ideal candidate will have a passion for music, fan culture, and analytics with a pro-active, problem-solving work ethic.

What you'll do:

  • Fan-Building Data Initiatives. Ideate and integrate fan data initiatives into digital marketing plans with an eye towards long-term fan journeys.

  • Paid Digital Advertising. Support the paid digital media strategy, including planning, execution, and reporting, for your designated roster of Columbia frontline artists.

  • Content Ideation. Help brainstorm content ideas for bespoke advertising objectives, incorporating real-time trends into creative campaigns.

  • Reporting and Storytelling. Synthesize campaign insights for senior management and artist teams; derive narrative from numbers; own reporting templates and innovate tracking documentation

  • Resource building. Learn existing tools to streamline digital media processes and explore new platforms to further innovate workflow.

  • Billing reconciliation. Coordinate billing reconciliation and invoice fulfillment for digital advertising partners.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • At least one year of relevant Paid Media experience preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with paid media platforms (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager)
  • Proficient in Excel; extremely detail-oriented and organized.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Creative and collaborative mindset.
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Adaptive to change and able to prioritize deadlines.
  • Social media & internet culture obsessed.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: VP, Nordics and Baltics - The Orchard
job.description:
The Orchard is seeking a dynamic, entrepreneurial leader to manage and execute its growth strategy, team building and client relationship initiatives in the Nordics & Baltics. Driving efficient communication and best practices, setting and attaining measurable goals, developing and upskilling staff, and articulating, operationalising and evolving the company’s value proposition are critical to the candidate’s success.  The candidate must have relationships across the industry at all levels and the ability to elevate the company’s revenue and profile within the current client and retail base.

The VP is the primary conduit for new revenue and value proposition opportunities. The successful candidate must be able to drive the business at a fast pace in an ever-changing environment.  While not required, experience in the independent sector is preferred.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution company operating in over 50 markets worldwide – distributing and marketing music from independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world. At The Orchard, our focus is to provide a comfortable, social and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

What you’ll do:

  • Act as the primary conduit for identifying and securing new business opportunities within the Nordics and Baltics, ensuring a constant pipeline of high-value independent label and artist signings.
  • Drive revenue growth by articulating and operationalising the company’s value proposition to the local market.
  • Manage relationships with distributed music clients across a variety of genres, including high-touch frontline and high-volume catalogue labels.
  • Oversee regional offices, ensuring local compliance and operational efficiency is met while supporting the local leadership team.
  • Lead and develop the local regional team, providing mentorship to local leadership.
  • Maintain high-level relationships with major retail and industry partners across the territory, elevating the company's profile at events and conferences.
  • Collaborate with the MD, UK & Europe, and other global stakeholders to align Nordic strategy with the broader company-wide strategy
  • Drive product adoption of The Orchard’s tools and services across the client base.
  • Act as local industry representative, attending events and conferences as required. 

Who you are:

  • Previous experience in a senior management/business leadership role, leading high performing teams, preferably in the independent music sector.
  • Strong experience and understanding of the local music industry and digital landscape.
  • Experience within a label or distribution company managing catalogues, frontline releases and relationships. Independent sector experience preferred.
  • Excellent knowledge of the digital space, including music retail, analytics and social media, with an ability to adapt to a constantly changing landscape.
  • Highly advanced organisational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritise to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to speak effectively across all levels of business, both internally and externally.
  • Passionate about Independent music, with a willingness to attend industry events and shows.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as required and able to travel internationally.
  • Fluent in English

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Director - Internal Communications
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   THIS IS A CONTRACT (12 MONTH) WITH THE POTENTIAL TO CONVERT TO A PERMANENT FULL-TIME POSITION, IN OUR NEW YORK CITY OFFICE.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to lead the strategy and execution of our global internal communications program. Based in New York, this role will partner with senior leadership and teams across the company to strengthen how SoundCloud informs, engages, and connects our global workforce.

A key priority for this role will be leading the successful migration and launch of SoundCloud’s next-generation intranet. You will serve as the communications and program lead for a large, cross-functional team spanning People & Culture, IT and Cybersecurity, Brand, Communications, Finance and SoundCloud’s Webflow owners. You will establish the project’s governance and roadmap, align stakeholders, oversee content strategy and migration, and drive employee adoption of the new platform.

This role is crucial to fostering a strong culture of collaboration, inclusion, and connectivity by ensuring employees have timely access to clear, useful, and engaging information.

If you are a strategic leader, skilled storyteller, and experienced change communicator who is passionate about creating a best-in-class employee experience, and you know how to bring complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and oversee a comprehensive internal communications strategy serving employees across SoundCloud’s global offices, including New York, Los Angeles, Berlin and London, setting the strategic direction in close partnership with the executive team
  • Lead SoundCloud’s intranet migration from planning through launch and adoption, including platform governance, stakeholder alignment, information architecture, content strategy, content auditing and migration, testing, training and ongoing optimization
  • Serve as the central program lead for a cross-functional intranet working group spanning People & Culture, IT, Brand, Finance and more, establishing clear roles, milestones, decision-making processes and accountability
  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to ensure the new intranet meets employee needs while aligning with SoundCloud’s brand, security, privacy, accessibility and operational requirements
  • Partner with Chief of Staff to produce agenda, content, and coordination of speakers for internal events, including monthly company-wide All Hands 
  • Counsel executives and senior leaders on communications that provide employees with clarity, context, and connection to SoundCloud’s business priorities
  • Identify and manage opportunities to elevate SoundCloud and its executives through relevant industry awards and recognition programs, including developing and submitting compelling nominations
  • Oversee SoundCloud’s internal editorial calendar, delivering timely communications related to company strategy, People initiatives, organizational change and workplace culture
  • Align internal messaging, employee experience and employer branding with SoundCloud’s mission, core behaviors and product positioning
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to develop employer-branding strategies that position SoundCloud as a best-in-class employer and help attract a diverse pool of candidates on Linkedin, Glassdoor and beyond.
  • Manage and continually improve SoundCloud’s internal communications channels, including the intranet and employee newsletters, using engagement data and employee feedback to assess effectiveness
  • Partner with People and Workplace teams to develop communications strategies that increase engagement and enhance the employee experience
  • Collaborate with the DEI team and Diversity Resource Groups to promote initiatives and programming through messaging that fosters understanding, inclusion, and engagement across the organization
  • Monitor trends and emerging practices in internal communications, employee engagement, and workplace technology, providing guidance and new ideas to internal stakeholders

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of internal communications experience within a global company or agency environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading a large-scale intranet implementation, migration or digital workplace transformation involving multiple business and technical functions
  • Strong program and project-management skills, including experience establishing governance, coordinating complex workstreams, managing competing priorities and holding stakeholders accountable to deadlines
  • Experience leading change-management and employee-adoption programs for new platforms, systems or ways of working
  • Ability to translate business, technical, security and employee-experience requirements into a clear strategy and executable plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across cultures, functions and levels of seniority
  • Experience developing and executing internal communications strategies within a global organization
  • Confidence working with and providing counsel, guidance and constructive feedback to senior executives
  • Exceptional design and branding acumen, with experience developing presentations, videos and creative collateral
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, adapt quickly and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to build alignment, navigate differing stakeholder perspectives and move complex cross-functional initiatives forward
  • Experience using data, analytics, and employee feedback to assess communications effectiveness and improve engagement

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $175,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. job.description:

You will work within a high-performing, multi-disciplinary squad across our frontend (React, iOS, and Android) and backend (GraphQL, TypeScript) services, focused on strategic Artist Success products including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and artist-facing growth and insights experiences. This is an IC-heavy role for a technical expert who wants to drive architecture and execution while maintaining a hands-on presence in the code.

The ideal candidate has a track record of building and evolving complex, high-quality products across frontend, API, backend, and data systems. You are a generalist who can navigate user-facing application logic, service architecture, data-intensive systems, or infrastructure bottlenecks with equal ease.

Read about engineering at SoundCloud

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other partners to shape the technical direction and roadmap across Artist Success products, including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and related artist-facing experiences. You'll help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions and build scalable, secure systems that support large datasets and high-performance user experiences
  • Act as a senior technical contributor for a small, expert squad. You will contribute through architectural clarity, rigorous peer reviews, and a focus on maintaining high execution momentum
  • Work as a peer to product managers and designers to define requirements across Artist Success. You'll turn vague business "wants" into concrete technical "hows," ensuring the team builds the right things in the most efficient way
  • Ensure high technical standards across frontend and backend disciplines. While the team is highly capable, you are responsible for contributing to the overall technical health, consistency, and long-term sustainability of the codebase
  • Own the infrastructure and health of your domain. You'll manage deployment patterns, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and ensure we adhere to modern security standards
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier while keeping the needs, judgment, and experience of the people using and building our products at the center of the work

  • Strong proficiency in GraphQL and TypeScript for building reliable APIs and services, with familiarity in Golang or Scala, and a strong understanding of storage, querying, and data-intensive systems such as BigQuery and SQL
  • Strong capability in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and container orchestration
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data

job.description:
About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

 

Title: Account Manager
Department: Customer Services
Job Location: Washington, DC (Hybrid: In office on Tuesdays & Wednesdays)
Reports To: Manager, Account Management 
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Non-exempt 

Position Summary:
The Account Manager, as part of the Account Management team within the Customer Services Department, is responsible for the routine processing of incoming registrations, supplemental documents, and Letters of Direction (LOD) submissions, as well as recurring administrative tasks assigned to the team. This role involves creating new accounts, maintaining and updating existing accounts, and processing LODs by establishing associations between artist and LOD recipient payee accounts, including the allocation of royalty items at the specified percentages and effective dates. The Account Manager also processes Default Allocation applications and conducts outreach as needed via phone and email to artists and LOD recipient clients. In all aspects of the role, the Account Manager is expected to provide excellent customer service and to perform duties efficiently and accurately to ensure timely service and maximized pay-through rates for clients.

Essential Functions:
• Evaluate and process new registrations by creating new accounts
• Evaluate and process new LOD submissions by creating or modifying existing accounts, applying associations between artist and LOD recipient payees, and associating royalty items at the proper percentage(s) and effective date(s);
• Evaluate and process Default Allocation applications;
• Conduct outreach regarding document completion, LOD clarification, and Default Allocation application to clients (as needed);
• Update existing accounts by processing supplemental documents/tasks
• Provide excellent customer service via email and phone
• Meet production and quality standards
• Conduct document completion or clarification outreach to clients
• Assist with Support team calls and/or inquiry overflow (as needed);
• Work on special projects (as needed)

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook)
• Salesforce and/or database experience is a plus
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Proven capacity to work independently, think critically, multi-task, and report progress under tight deadlines
• LOD familiarity is a plus
• Customer Service experience and/or knowledge of music genres is a plus

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:
• Post-secondary education or certification is a plus

ADA Specifications:
• This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position all of the time
• The person in this position may need to move about the corporate office less than half the time
• This position operates office equipment that requires the constant use of hands/fingers/wrists (ex: typing) all of the time
• This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:
• This position has less than 25% travel requirements

 

PAY RANGE: $26.44/hr - $30.28/hr

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

SoundExchange is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.  If you need an accommodation, please email jobs@soundexchange.com.

job.title: Part-Time Receptionist
job.description:
Position Summary

The Receptionist receives incoming calls, determines the nature of each call, and directs callers to the appropriate person or department. This position serves as the first point of contact for visitors, clients, and callers, providing professional and courteous customer service while supporting general administrative operations.

In addition, this role may provide administrative support to other departments, including Sales and Promotions, as needed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Meet and greet customers, visitors, and clients in a professional manner.
  • Operate a multi-line switchboard telephone system.
  • Communicate with callers in a professional, friendly, and efficient manner while minimizing hold times.
  • Take detailed messages, including caller name, company name (if applicable), time of call, and message details.
  • Provide basic information and assistance to callers with general inquiries.
  • Assist with filing, scanning, copying, and other administrative duties as needed.
  • Prepare sales and service gas tickets for the Accounting Department.
  • Serve as backup support to the Sales Department Cashier.
  • Assist the General Manager with clerical and administrative duties as needed.
  • Provide administrative support to additional departments, including Sales and Promotions, as needed.
  • Attend meetings and training sessions as scheduled.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.
  • Maintain a friendly, professional, courteous, and efficient demeanor with all customers, vendors, and employees.

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None.

Minimum Requirements
  • Minimum of 2 years of recent administrative support or receptionist experience.
  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to operate a multi-line telephone system.
  • Ability to read, comprehend, and follow instructions and information.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with the public and within a team environment.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.

In addition to meeting the qualifications listed above, candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of the position successfully.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
Physical Requirements

This position primarily involves sedentary work, including extended periods of sitting, with occasional walking or standing. The role may require light lifting and routine office movement as needed.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Spanish Broadcasting System is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
About SBS:

As a pioneer in Spanish-language media, SBS has always been at the forefront of the evolution of Hispanic entertainment in the U.S. In this era of technological advancements and media convergence, SBS is poised to capitalize on its vast array of proprietary content across multiple platforms. Our unwavering commitment is to create exceptional, high-quality branded entertainment that resonates deeply with the Hispanic consumer. Our impressive growth on the web with LaMusica.com and the promising reception of our latest venture, the podcast initiative, are testament to SBS' long-term strategy. By seamlessly delivering content through diverse channels, we not only maximize revenue but also extend the reach of our beloved brands. SBS remains steadfast in our leadership position in today's dynamic and ever-expanding U.S. Hispanic market, and we are determined to continue pushing boundaries and shaping the future of Hispanic media.

Position Summary

The Senior Accountant is responsible for analyzing multiple complex financial reports in preparation to present the company’s financial statements.  The Senior Accountant regulates and authenticates financial transactions and maintains a ledger to ensure effectiveness and accuracy of all accounting tasks.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Overall accounting and variance analysis.
  • Perform various functions directly related to the accounting month-end close process, which include but are not limited to preparing journal entries and supporting schedules, reconciling bank and ledger accounts, and reviewing detailed transactions for accuracy and validity of accounting treatment.
  • Analyze and prepare entries related to payrolls, benefits, commissions, barter, invoices, contracts, and various vendor payments for posting to the general ledger.
  • Analyze actual results against budgets and forecasts.
  • Prepare ad-hoc or other financial reports, as necessary.
  • Maintain US GAAP accounting and ensure compliance with all relevant accounting literature.
  • Maintain SOX compliance and update related process flows.
  • Review and analysis of financial statements and key metrics for assigned areas.
  • Prepare general ledger entries and balance sheet reconciliation in compliance with policies and procedures.
  • Identify and implement process improvements as continuous improvement.
  • Liaise with external auditors and provide documentation as necessary.
  • Help design and implement internal controls over accounting processes.
  • Update and maintain schedules to reflect activities and balances at period end, involving generating relevant system reports or obtaining data from third-party sources (such as sub-ledger reports, GL details, amortization schedules, payroll reports, account statements, contracts, and invoices).
  • Ensure accuracy by reconciling figures with source documents and validate the completeness and accuracy of acquired data.
  • Conduct calculations for items like accrued commissions and bad debt reverses.
  • Conduct reconciliation for SL to GL and books to bank where applicable.
  • Gather documentation and conduct research to explain and support changes in activities compared to prior periods.
  • Investigate aged balance to propose appropriate resolutions for reconciling items or accrual components.
  • Execute necessary adjustments via Journal Entries to ensure accurate representation of financial data.
  • Verify and ensure all required adjustments impacting account balances were made for each market in consolidated schedules.
  • Reconcile consolidated schedules with the consolidated general ledger to ensure alignment.
  • Analyze balance sheet accounts to appropriately classify balances between Short Term and Long Term, distinguishing between receivables or payables with terms exceeding one year as Long Term.
  • Additional accounts reconciliation and analysis as needed.

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed duties.  Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • May lead projects.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • 4 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong technical accounting and financial analytical skills.
  • Detail-oriented and organized. Superior analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to meet a constant stream of deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively with different levels of employees.
  • Familiarity with accounting software and programs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Why work for SBS?

 

Spanish Broadcasting Systems (SBS) offers a unique and exciting opportunity to be part of the leading Hispanic-focused media company in the industry. By joining our team, you will become an integral part of shaping and influencing the landscape of Spanish-language broadcasting. We take pride in our rich heritage and commitment to serving the vibrant Hispanic community with compelling content and innovative programming. At SBS, you will be surrounded by a diverse and talented group of professionals who share a passion for media, creativity, and cultural connectivity. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies, you will have the tools to bring your ideas to life and create impactful experiences for our audience. Additionally, SBS provides ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, with ongoing learning and development programs designed to enhance your skills and advance your career. If you are seeking a dynamic and rewarding career in the world of Spanish-language broadcasting, SBS is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the lives of millions of people every day.

job.title: Data Engineer II (Remote US)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE:  

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.

HOW WE WORK:  

At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that’s thrown at us.

Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You’ll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers.

When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?

JOB TITLE: Data Engineer II 
LOCATION: REMOTE- US


THE ROLE: 

We're looking for a Data Engineer II to join Splice's Data Engineering team and help scale the platform that powers creator payouts, revenue reporting, and product analytics across Splice's product lines.

Data Engineering builds and maintains the reliable foundation that makes trusted data possible, enabling teams across Splice to work from a governed, consistent source of truth. We are accountable for the warehouse and pipeline foundation; ingestion, transformations, and the standards and quality guardrails that keep data consistent, timely, and usable. This is a mid-level, high-ownership role: engineers here carry features from technical design through delivery, monitoring, and documentation, and participate in our on-call rotation.

The work requires hands-on data engineering experience. Our stack; BigQuery, SQLMesh, Python, Dagster- is distinct from Splice's web engineering stack, and effective contribution requires domain expertise in data pipeline systems, not general software engineering background.

TEAM INFORMATION: 

You'll be joining Splice's Data Engineering team, a small, embedded platform team responsible for the pipelines, transformations, and warehouse infrastructure the rest of the company depends on. Our systems support finance-critical processes (contributor payouts, GAAP revenue reporting), product analytics, and data reliability for customer-facing features like recommendations. We operate with a shared on-call rotation and a strong bias toward observable, well-documented, durable systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

Pipeline Development & Transformation

  • Build and maintain data models in SQLMesh, including incremental strategies, testing, and documentation
  • Continuously improve and evolve our orchestration and transformation infrastructure as the platform scales
  • Modernize legacy pipeline jobs in Python and SQLMesh, reducing technical debt over time

Reliability & Observability

  • Participate in on-call rotation; triage and resolve incidents including ETL failures, data unavailability, and core metric breakage
  • Build introspectable software: define alert thresholds, emit metrics and logs, produce dashboards, and establish closed-loop escalation paths
  • Improve observability across the platform so failures are caught early and resolved quickly

Finance & Revenue Pipelines

  • Extend and maintain pipelines powering creator payouts and GAAP-compliant revenue reporting across Splice's product lines
  • Build pipeline support for new revenue streams as Splice launches them

Platform Quality & Optimization

  • Improve query performance and reduce compute costs in BigQuery
  • Contribute to ingestion platform work and product analytics infrastructure
  • Uphold our definition of done: validation complete, documentation updated, monitoring in place before closing a ticket

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience in a production environment
  • Proficiency in SQL — window functions, CTEs, query optimization, execution plan analysis
  • Proficiency in Python for pipeline logic, data transformation, and testing (maintainable code, not just scripts)
  • Experience with a modern transformation framework — SQLMesh, dbt, or equivalent — including incremental models, testing, and documentation
  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use BigQuery); understands partitioning, clustering, and cost management
  • Experience with at least one workflow orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to build observable, reliable data systems — alerting, dashboards, and data quality checks
  • Comfortable owning small-to-medium features from technical design through delivery with limited guidance

SPLICE BENEFITS: 

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive pay with annual reviews and equity opportunities.
  • Time Off: Unlimited PTO to recharge and thrive.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with immediate vesting and company match.
  • Parental Support: 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for non-birthing parents, and 18-20 weeks for birthing parents.
  • Flexible Work Options: Work remotely or connect at our office hubs and creative spaces worldwide.
  • Professional Growth: Annual learning budget, leadership programs, and team ambassador opportunities.
  • Community & Connection: Inclusive events, team meet-ups, and vibrant Employee Resource Groups.

The national pay range for this role is $94,952 - $118,690. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.

SENIOR BRAND MARKETING MANAGER, SOCIAL & COMMUNITY

LOCATION: Remote (US) — Los Angeles preferred, but not required

THE ROLE

Splice is looking for a full-time Senior Social & Community Manager to own the voice of Splice across our organic social portfolio and our Discord community. This is one of the most visible roles on the team and is central to the strategic direction of Splice: what you publish, how you show up, and what you learn from our audience shapes how the business thinks about creators. You’ll plan and publish content, run programming that brings producers together, engage directly with them in the comments, DMs, and Discord, and use performance data to sharpen what we make next. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the culture of music production. You make music yourself, you know what resonates with creators, and you can turn that instinct into content and community moments that earn attention. You’ll work closely with our brand, community, and product teams to translate what’s happening at Splice into things our community actually wants to see and take part in. As our portfolio grows, so does the role, with the opportunity to take on social and community channels for additional Splice brands.

WHO WE ARE

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. WHAT YOU'LL DO

Social

  • Own the organic social strategy and publishing calendar across all Splice channels, from ideation through scheduling, posting, and platform-native optimization, and decide where we show up as platforms and audience behavior change
  • Create and edit content yourself, from concept to final cut, with a fast turnaround and a strong point of view on what will land
  • Show up in the comments, DMs, and replies as the voice of Splice, engaging producers directly, surfacing their work, and building real relationships in the process
  • Spot and act on cultural moments, trends, and sounds in real time, including reactive posting outside of the calendar
  • Partner with brand, product, and community teams to turn launches, artist packs, and platform news into content that feels native to each channel rather than an announcement
  • Source and amplify community and creator-generated content, coordinating directly with producers and artists

Community

  • Manage and grow the Splice Discord server, keeping conversation active and welcoming day to day
  • Plan and run recurring community programming, including beat battles, community challenges, and remix competitions, from concept and rules through promotion, judging, and recognition of winners
  • Start and sustain regular conversations that give producers a reason to come back, share their work, and give each other feedback
  • Work with moderators and internal teams to keep the community healthy, and bring what you hear in Discord back to the wider business

Data and reporting

  • Track performance across social and community channels and translate the numbers into clear recommendations: what to double down on, what to stop, and what to test next
  • Use data to make decisions on content, programming, and channel investment, and report on channel health, community growth, and engagement to the business on a regular cadence
  • Develop workflows to move faster and produce more, across ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, and analysis

Growth

  • As the Splice portfolio grows, take on strategy and management of social and community channels for additional brands, with the scope of the role growing alongside the portfolio

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years managing social channels for a brand, artist, label, or creator-facing company, with examples of work you can point to
  • Experience owning a multi-channel organic social presence, not a single platform
  • Experience speaking directly to a creator audience, ideally in music, but adjacent creative categories will be considered
  • You make music with a DAW. You understand production workflows from the inside and can talk to producers as a peer
  • A proven track record of building and engaging a community, not just growing follower counts, including hands-on experience running a Discord server or a comparable community space
  • Experience planning and running community programming such as contests, challenges, or competitions
  • Native fluency across the major social platforms, including the formats, editing conventions, and publishing tools for short-form video, long-form video, and text-based channels
  • Strong comfort with social and community analytics, and the ability to turn data into decisions and clear reporting for a business audience
  • Hands-on experience and a genuine appetite for new tools as they emerge
  • Strong writing and a natural instinct for tone. You can be funny, direct, and human without sounding like a brand account

NICE TO HAVES

  • Based in Los Angeles, with the ability to attend shoots, sessions, and creator meet-ups in person
  • Experience with Blender or other 3D rendering/animation tools, and the ability to create original content with them
  • Comfortable being on camera and featured in Splice content
  • Existing relationships in the producer, artist, or label community
  • Motion design, photography, or audio editing chops

job.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
job.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.
