You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

job.title: Artist & Label Partnerships Manager - GSA (15-month fixed-term)
job.description:
We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors.

As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization.

In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. 

We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. 

This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

job.title: Data Scientist - Business Analytics
job.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features that span both product and business teams. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

job.title: Director of Sales - Emerging & Scaled (New Business)
job.description:
Spotify's Emerging & Scaled (E&S) business is growing rapidly across the US and Canada, and we're investing in accelerating first-time advertiser growth. As part of our mission to help brands connect with fans through audio and video, we're expanding our New Business organization.
We're looking for an experienced Director of Sales to lead our New Business acquisition strategy across North America. In this role, you'll lead and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team, driving the full sales cycle from prospecting through closing. Reporting to E&S leadership, you'll shape scalable acquisition strategies, strengthen pipeline generation, and create a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching and measurable performance goals. You'll play a key role in unlocking new advertiser categories and driving sustainable net-new revenue growth.

job.title: Growth Lead - Japan
job.description:
Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets.
Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
job.description:
At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.

Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

job.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer.

As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

job.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
job.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.

You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

job.title: Sales Manager, Enterprise — Spotify Technology
job.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As Sales Manager for our Enterprise team, you will lead the Account Executives who drive new business for Spotify Technology. Reporting to the Director of Sales, you'll set the strategy for how we win with organizations of 1,000+ employees, where buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and fewer, larger deals can take many months to close.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you'll shape our enterprise sales approach while staying close to the deals, coaching your team through complex opportunities and helping them close. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to develop sellers, run a disciplined sales process, and engage confidently with senior engineering leaders will be key to your success.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

job.title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays.

You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

job.title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
job.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

job.title: Controller
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world’s most ambitious clients.

 

We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a work force with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.

 

Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

Overview

SSC Agency Controller

 

The Agency Controller is responsible for overseeing all accounting, compliance, and internal control activities for their agency within the SSC organization. This role partners closely with agency leadership, other Shared Services teams, Internal Audit, and Corporate Accounting to ensure accurate accounting, efficient month-end close processes, balance sheet integrity, and compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

 

The Controller serves as a key business partner to agency management while driving standardization, automation, and 

continuous process improvement across accounting operations.

 

Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Close•    Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities for assigned agency.•    Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation.•    Ensure adherence to close deadlines and service level commitments.•    Maintain ownership of balance sheet reconciliations and account certification processes.•    Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and company accounting policies.•    Coordinate support for external and internal audit requests.•    Serve as the primary accounting partner for agency leadership.•    Lead, coach, and develop accounting staff and senior accountants.•    Establish performance expectations and accountability measures.•    Drive standardization of accounting processes across agencies.•    Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.•    Partner with Shared Services and systems teams on process transformation projects.

Qualifications

Required•    Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, other related field•    Certified Public Accountant License•    8+ years of progressive accounting experience.•    3+ years of leadership or people management experience.•    Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting.•    Experience managing month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.•    Advanced Excel skills.•    Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

 

Preferred•    Public accounting background.•    Advertising agency, marketing services, media, or professional services industry experience.•    Experience with ERP systems, reporting tools, and financial automation technologies.•    Experience in a Shared Services or global accounting environment.

Compensation

Compensation Expectations are 160-180K

job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
About Us

UNICEPTA, as a part of The Marketing Cloud here at Stagwell, is a leading provider of media intelligence, communication insights, and reputation management solutions for many of the world's most recognized brands. For decades, organizations have relied on UNICEPTA to transform complex media and business information into actionable intelligence that drives strategic decision-making.

 

As we continue to expand our presence across North America, we are investing in experienced sales professionals who can help accelerate growth, build meaningful enterprise relationships, and position UNICEPTA as a strategic partner to Fortune 1000 organizations.

 

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition and revenue growth across the U.S. market. This is a true hunter role designed for a high-performing enterprise seller who thrives on developing pipeline, navigating complex buying environments, and winning strategic enterprise business.

 

Responsibilities

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities through strategic outbound and account-based selling efforts.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities within Fortune 1000 organizations.
  • Generate and close net-new logo business across communications intelligence, media intelligence, social listening, reputation management, and consumer insights functions.
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle from initial outreach through contract execution.
  • Develop relationships with senior-level stakeholders across Communications, Public Relations, Corporate Affairs, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Brand Strategy, and Executive Leadership teams.
  • Lead consultative sales conversations that align UNICEPTA's solutions with customer business objectives and strategic priorities.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive sponsors, procurement, legal, and cross-functional decision-makers.
  • Create and execute territory plans focused on high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Collaborate with solutions, strategy, product, and delivery teams to develop winning proposals and business cases.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage additional Stagwell capabilities when they can enhance customer outcomes.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed individual pipeline, activity, and revenue targets.

 

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of exceeding quota and closing complex enterprise opportunities within large organizations.
  • Experience selling to Fortune 1000 companies or similarly sophisticated enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated success generating net-new business through outbound prospecting, executive engagement, and account-based sales strategies.
  • Strong understanding of the media intelligence, social listening, reputation intelligence, consumer insights, PR technology, or communications technology landscape.
  • Experience selling to stakeholders within Communications, Public Relations, Corporate Affairs, Marketing Intelligence, Consumer Insights, Brand Strategy, or related business functions.
  • Track record of managing six- and seven-figure opportunities involving multiple stakeholders and lengthy consultative buying cycles.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication skills, and ability to build credibility with senior business leaders.
  • Highly entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently while influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong business acumen and disciplined sales process management.
  • Existing relationships within enterprise communications, insights, marketing, or corporate affairs organizations are a plus.

 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in New York City for this role is $115,000 - $135,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This role includes commission-based incentive compensation.

 

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Global Investment Director
job.description:
Overview

Stagwell Media Platform (SMP) is seeking an ambitious, commercially astute, and entrepreneurial Global Investment Director to build and lead a next-generation global investment function. This is a unique opportunity to create a critical capability from the ground up, shaping the tools, processes, governance, and ways of working that support global investment, pricing, productivity, and trading initiatives across multiple markets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading complex multi-market new business pricing exercises, driving productivity programs for existing clients, and developing scalable investment frameworks that enable better commercial outcomes across the organisation. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on delivery and requires someone equally comfortable building sophisticated pricing models, designing global processes, influencing senior stakeholders, and supporting commercial negotiations with media partners.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of creating and launching new products, capabilities or processes, alongside a passion for innovation, automation, and AI-enabled transformation of media investment practices.

Responsibilities

Global New Business Pricing & Commercial Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end development of multi-market pricing submissions for global and regional pitches.
  • Partner with agency, client, and market leadership teams to develop competitive, commercially sound investment strategies.
  • Build and maintain global pricing methodologies, templates, benchmarks, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and accuracy across all pricing exercises.
  • Develop market-by-market investment assumptions and challenge local pricing submissions where required.
  • Present pricing strategies and recommendations to senior agency leadership, clients, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Act as the central investment lead for strategic new business opportunities.

Productivity & Existing Client Investment Management

  • Design and implement global productivity methodologies and reporting frameworks.
  • Lead annual productivity planning exercises and commercial improvement programs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve buying efficiency, operational effectiveness, and commercial outcomes across client portfolios.
  • Develop processes, tools, and governance to support ongoing investment performance measurement.
  • Partner with regional and local investment teams to implement productivity initiatives and best practices.
  • Translate complex data into actionable commercial recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Function Creation & Transformation

  • Build the SMP Global Investment function from its current foundation.
  • Develop the operating model, governance structure, service offerings, and engagement processes.
  • Create scalable global tools, templates, frameworks, and knowledge repositories.
  • Establish investment excellence standards and best practices across markets.
  • Drive adoption and change management across regional and local teams.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and simplification of investment workflows.

AI, Innovation & Process Modernisation

  • Champion the adoption of AI and advanced technologies within investment and trading processes.
  • Develop innovative approaches to pricing, forecasting, benchmarking, and productivity analysis.
  • Identify and implement tools that improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.
  • Lead modernization initiatives that reduce manual effort and create scalable solutions.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation across the investment function.

Trading & Strategic Partnership Support

  • Support the SMP Trading & Partnerships team across strategic commercial initiatives.
  • Contribute to media partner negotiations through commercial analysis, benchmark validation, and deal evaluation.
  • Assist in the development of trading programs, partnership frameworks, and investment opportunities.
  • Support strategic partner engagement and identify opportunities to create additional value for clients and agencies.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maximize the commercial impact of SMP partnerships.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships across agency leadership, investment teams, client teams, procurement functions, and media partners.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across global, regional, and local markets.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on investment strategy, pricing, productivity, and commercial performance.
  • Communicate complex investment concepts clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
  • Build trusted relationships with key external stakeholders, including industry trade bodies, pitch consultants, auditors, and intermediary partners, enhancing SMP's credibility, market reputation, and influence across commercial, investment, and governance initiatives.

Compensation

job.title: Sr Analyst, Maconomy
job.description:
Overview

The Senior Analyst, Financial Systems (Maconomy) serves as a hands-on functional expert for Deltek Maconomy, supporting the administration, configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Stagwell's global ERP platform.

 

This role partners closely with Finance, Shared Services, Business Applications, and agency stakeholders to support day-to-day operations, troubleshoot complex issues, implement system enhancements, and ensure the integrity of financial data across the global organization.

The ideal candidate has deep hands-on experience with Deltek Maconomy and a strong understanding of project-based financial operations, including project accounting, billing, accounts receivable, general ledger, revenue recognition, intercompany accounting, and multi-entity environments.

Success in this role will be measured by system reliability, issue resolution, process improvements, data quality, and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Maconomy Administration & Support

  • Serve as a functional subject matter expert for Deltek Maconomy.
  • Configure and maintain Maconomy modules in accordance with business requirements.
  • Support day-to-day system administration and production support.
  • Troubleshoot complex system issues and perform root cause analysis.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend enhancements to improve efficiency.
  • Assist with configuration changes while maintaining global standards.

Financial & Operational System Support

  • Support Maconomy modules including:
  • General Ledger
  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Project Accounting
  • Revenue Recognition
  • Billing
  • Intercompany
  • Fixed Assets
  • Investigate and resolve financial transaction and posting issues.
  • Support project and job setup, billing configuration, and revenue recognition processes.
  • Assist with reconciliation of financial data across integrated systems.
  • Maintain master data integrity, including chart of accounts, entities, customers, vendors, and projects.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes through automation and system enhancements.
  • Recommend configuration improvements that reduce manual effort and improve user experience.
  • Support implementation of new functionality and process standardization initiatives.
  • Assist with automation, integrations, APIs, and ETL-based solutions.
  • Participate in initiatives to improve month-end close efficiency and financial accuracy.

Governance & Controls

  • Support SOX-compliant system controls and financial governance.
  • Ensure configuration changes follow established change management processes.
  • Assist with user access reviews, audit requests, and documentation.
  • Support data integrity and system auditability.
  • Help identify and resolve control gaps and process risks.

System Enhancements, Testing & Integrations

  • Participate in Maconomy upgrades, releases, and new entity deployments.
  • Develop and execute unit, system integration, and user acceptance testing.
  • Support integrations between Maconomy and enterprise applications including:
  • Mediaocean
  • OneStream
  • Banking platforms
  • Payroll systems
  • Reporting and analytics platforms
  • Validate data accuracy before and after production deployments.

User Support & Documentation

  • Provide Level 2/Level 3 support for global business users.
  • Develop functional documentation, process maps, and user guides.
  • Train end users on Maconomy functionality and new enhancements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and recommend solutions.

Compensation

280000 PLN

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Stephens Media Group is a privately-owned company that helps to generate revenue for local businesses. We do this by communicating the right message, to the right audiences, so businesses can start seeing new customers right away.

We are looking for a skilled Account Executive to find business opportunities and manage customer relationships. You’ll be directly responsible for the preservation and expansion of our customer base. The ideal candidate will have a passion for sales and experience in media and digital advertising with exceptional customer service. The right candidate is a reliable professional able to achieve a balance between customer orientation and a results-driven approach. The goal is to find opportunities and turn them into long-term profitable relationships based on trust and mutual satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Create detailed business strategies to facilitate the attainment of goals and quotas
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from finding a client to securing a deal
  • Unearth new sales opportunities through networking & prospecting in order to develop into long term partnerships
  • Present products & capabilities to prospective clients
  • Recommend and process digital advertising campaigns
  • Provide professional post-sales support to enhance customer devotion
  • Remain in frequent contact with clients in order to uncover their additional needs
  • Respond to complaints and resolve issues aiming toward customer contentment and the preservation of the company’s reputation
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data

Requirements

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive, or in other sales/customer service role
  • 2+ years in media &/or digital advertising sales is preferred, but not required
  • Knowledge of market research, sales and negotiating principles
  • Outstanding knowledge of MS Office; knowledge of CRM software is a plus
  • Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships
  • Organizational and time-management skills
  • A business acumen
  • Enthusiastic and passionate

Education

  • High school diploma
  • BS or BA in business administration, sales or marketing, preferred but not required

Here are the 7 must-have qualities we look for in every Account Executive:

  1. Extremely competitive
  2. Deep need to get others to see things from his/her perspective
  3. A tenacity to open up new opportunities daily
  4. High self-esteem that doesn’t take rejection personally
  5. A willingness to use the telephone to set up face-to-face meetings
  6. The desire to creatively communicate (we’ll teach you how!)
  7. Cares as much about team success as individual success

Send materials to Laurie Hammermeister

job.title: Stingray Jobs
job.description:
Department Marketing Location Montreal

At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a growing company, a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment? 

Our marketing department is currently looking for a temporary contract Customer Experience Specialist. This person assists customers to resolve product or service issues by clarifying the customer’s report, identifying the cause of the problem, selecting and explaining the best solution to solve the problem, following up to ensure prompt resolution. Collects information reported by customers to prepare reports for analysis. As the front-line human interface for Stingray’s services, this person is responsible for representing the brand and ensuring an optimal experience for the customer.

 

Your day-to-day

  • Ensure that all customers who interact with Stingray have the best experience possible
  • Provide product and service information to customers via email
  • Decipher issues reported by customers to select and reply with the most appropriate response to quickly resolve the issue;
  • Identify and reproduce issues to be escalated to Technical, Content or Delivery Teams;
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and during the holidays;

Your qualifications

  • Degree or diploma from an accredited college or university (in progress or completed);
  • Minimum 3 years experience in a similar position
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, English and French;
  • Empathetic and sympathetic to customer needs, as well as decisive and driven to help
  • Ability to work independently as well as a member of a team
  • Exceptional diplomatic capabilities, strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong multi-tasking skills
  • Solid knowledge of PCs, Macs, Internet connections, web browsers, mobile devices, smart TVs, with particular emphasis and interest in music, audio, and video;
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office Outlook, Excel, Word,
  • Strong analytical and deductive skills to quickly isolate and determine specific product issues.
  • Ability to address serious situations, while still expressing a sense of fun that is inherent in the products;
  • Ability to manage stress and maintain a positive attitude during peak business periods.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and during the holidays;

Nice-to-haves

  • Spanish, Dutch, or German, is an asset.
  • Experience with Zendesk.

Life at Stingray

  • A cool office in Montreal & a hybrid work policy 
  • Stingray café with breakfasts and snacks offered every day 
  • Free fitness classes offered weekly  
  • Access to private nutrition & wellness advising 
  • Free language classes

Stingray is a leading global music, media and technology company, and Canada’s premier radio broadcaster.  At Stingray, creativity, collaboration and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA.

We are currently looking for a Media Sales Strategist to join our New Glasgow team and cover the Northeastern area of the province! This position reports to the General Sales Manager/General Manager for Nova Scotia.

Stingray offers one of the most robust multimedia platforms for businesses to market and sell their products and services, locally, nationally or globally. Our ideal candidate has a strong multimedia marketing and sales background, and has demonstrated the ability to manage and grow an active client list, while understanding the importance of a team mentality with a desire to be part of the fabric of the community.

Located in Northern Nova Scotia, New Glasgow serves as the commercial center for the region of Pictou County with a population of 43,000 – a picturesque area alongside the Atlantic Ocean less than two hours from Halifax.

Your day-to-day

  • Be the local sales leader of the two Stingray Radio stations in Pictou County – 94.1 The Breeze and Q97.9.  You will have the opportunity to harness the power of these popular stations while also representing all Stingray Radio Stations from Vancouver to St. John’s, unlocking vast sales potential across a nationwide network.

Your qualifications

  • You have 2+ years of in-person, consultative sales or account management experience (experience in multi-media advertising or digital media is a plus).
  • Ability to self-manage, proven high-achieving performer in all facets of life with a track record of consistently achieving and exceeding sales targets.

Stingray Group Inc. is a leading music, media, and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. As a premium provider of curated direct-to-consumer and B2B services, we reach 400 million subscribers in 156 countries.

Stingray Advertising connects brands to passionate audiences across an expansive, multi-platform music ecosystem. Wherever consumers are watching, listening, or scrolling, Stingray is there.

Anchored by North America’s largest retail audio advertising network—reaching 800+ million monthly shoppers across 25,000+ top retail locations—we offer a seamless, full-funnel media suite across four core touchpoints:

  • In-Store Audio: Point-of-sale reach in major retail hubs like Walgreens and Albertsons.
  • In-Car Audio: Uninterrupted connection with commuters on the move.
  • In-Stream Audio: Digital audio streaming across premium music experiences.
  • In-Screen Audio (FAST/CTV): High-impact connected TV and video environments.

From home to the car to the aisle, we empower brands to connect with active audiences at every step of their journey.

We are seeking an experienced Pharmaceutical Category Sales Specialist to lead and scale our RX and OTC pharmaceutical advertising business across the US.

In this role, you will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) and category leader. Rather than managing an isolated territory silo, your primary mission is to matrix-support and enable our existing US sales team to unlock and accelerate pharmaceutical revenue within their established account bases. You will bring deep industry knowledge, regulatory expertise, and strategic insight to help our sales force articulate the power of Stingray’s entire multi-platform network—from point-of-care digital streaming and CTV video to point-of-sale in-store retail audio.

Your day-to-day

  • Enable & Scale Revenue: Partner directly with the US sales force to co-sell, strategize, and close pharmaceutical and RX business across all seller territories.
  • Category Leadership & SME: Act as the internal authority on the pharmaceutical media ecosystem, educating sales teams and clients on how multi-platform media (streaming audio, CTV, in-car, and in-store audio) drives consumer action.
  • Client & Agency Strategy: Build and maintain senior-level relationships with pharma-focused media agencies, healthcare holding companies, and direct brand marketers.
  • Market Ambassador: Represent Stingray at key industry events, conferences, and within the pharma advertising community to elevate brand presence and stay ahead of evolving market trends.
  • Insight-Driven Solutions: Utilize data, measurement tools, and audience research to craft high-impact proposals across video, streaming, and retail platforms, navigating regulatory/legal nuances unique to pharma.
  • Retail & Ecosystem Alignment: Work closely with commercial and agency partners to optimize brand integration across all physical and digital touchpoints.

Your qualifications

  • 8+ years of media sales experience, with a heavy focus on the pharmaceutical and healthcare categories (RX/OTC).
  • Deep Category Expertise: Expert-level understanding of pharma media buying, FDA/legal compliance guidelines, and health marketing nuances.
  • Multi-Platform & Retail Media Knowledge: Prior experience selling digital audio, CTV/video, or retail media/in-store solutions is highly preferred.
  • Proven Track Record: History of meeting or exceeding revenue goals and navigating complex sales cycles.
  • Agency Relationships: Established senior-level network across major US healthcare media agencies and brand marketers.
  • Strong Presenter & Educator: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate multi-platform media opportunities into compelling sales narratives.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Natural team player who excels in a matrixed environment, supporting colleagues to close deals together.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree, post-graduate certification, or equivalent experience in Media, Advertising, or Business.

What's in it for you?

  • High-Impact Influence: Play a key strategic role shaping a high-growth vertical for a leading multi-platform media network.
  • Collaborative Culture: Drive revenue through a support-and-enablement model where team success is celebrated.
  • Full-Funnel Inventory: Leverage cutting-edge programmatic capabilities across high-traffic digital, video, streaming, and retail media environments.
  • Competitive Package: Executive-level package with strong base salary, revenue-incentivized bonus potential, and comprehensive benefits.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Policy
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Suno exists to unlock the joy of making music. Millions of people use Suno to turn ideas into songs, and our platform generates music at a scale no moderation playbook was written for. We believe AI amplifies and empowers the people who make music, and keeping that ecosystem safe, fair, and trusted is core to the product, not a cost center bolted onto it. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/4IWNXlPv9MXDsCQe The role You will lead Trust & Safety Policy at Suno. Directly building and shaping our policies, you will also partner with PM, Eng, and Legal to understand the impact policies have on detection and remediation of violative content, fraud, bots, and identity issues, while also navigating music rights and our regulatory obligations. Generation volume grows faster than any human review model can, so we focus on policies that enable our enforcement systems to scale with the platform, hold it to a high degree of accuracy, and understand what decisions cost. You will report to the Head of Trust & Safety and partner regularly with Comms, Product, Engineering, ML, and Legal.

What you'll do

Own the Trust & Safety policy portfolio end to end: content and behavior policies, enforcement standards, and the policy roadmap as generation volume and product surface area grow. Write policy that machines can enforce: translate principles into decision criteria, model thresholds and reviewer guidance that produce consistent outcomes at millions of generations per day. Own policy for the hard genAI music problems: artist voice impersonation, rights-adjacent abuse, synthetic content disclosure and prompt-level misuse, in partnership with Legal. Turn regulatory obligations (DSA, OSA and emerging AI-content regimes) into enforceable internal policy and audit-ready documentation, in partnership with Legal. Run the policy development lifecycle: risk assessment, stakeholder review, launch guidance, enforcement calibration and post-launch measurement of policy effectiveness. Set the escalation and edge-case framework: who decides what, on what timeline, with what precedent, so novel cases become policy instead of one-off judgment calls. Publish externally when it counts: community guidelines, transparency reporting inputs, and policy explanations creators can actually understand. Partner with Product and Engineering early so policy shapes features before launch rather than cleaning up after them. What you'll bring 7+ years in trust & safety, platform policy, or integrity work, including 3+ years owning a policy domain at a UGC or generative AI platform. A portfolio of policies you wrote that shipped and held up: you can walk through the risk assessment, the enforcement design, and what you changed after launch data came in. Demonstrated

experience

making policy machine-enforceable: decision trees, model threshold input, labeling taxonomies or reviewer guidance that produced measurable consistency gains. Fluency in the regulatory landscape shaping platform policy (DSA, OSA and emerging AI-content regimes) and a record of converting obligations into operational requirements rather than memos. Working knowledge of music rights, IP or media licensing sufficient to write credible policy alongside Legal without needing them to hold the pen. Evidence of moving Product, Engineering and Legal to adopt policy positions they did not start with. Writing that operators, executives and regulators can each use: precise enough to enforce, clear enough to defend publicly. Nice to have Music, media, or IP-adjacent platform

About the Role

As our Sr. Staff Threat Intelligence Engineer, you’ll lead Suno’s work to understand and counter the adversaries targeting our platform, our users, and our business across security, trust & safety, and fraud. You’ll identify who is targeting Suno and how they operate, and turn that understanding into defenses across the company. Your analysis will shape how our security, T&S, and fraud teams prioritize risk and invest in protections. Your technical depth will make sure those recommendations hold up in our systems. This is a high-leverage role that will define how Suno anticipates and responds to emerging threats as the platform grows

What You'll Do

Investigate the threat actors and campaigns targeting Suno, from account takeovers and payment fraud to coordinated platform abuse, and connect activity across all three areas. Analyze large-scale event and account data with Python and SQL to find patterns, link related activity, and size emerging threats. Translate adversary tactics into concrete countermeasures, recommending detection, product, and architecture changes that engineering teams can build. Brief security, T&S, and fraud leaders with intelligence ranging from quick situational updates to deeper strategic assessments. Raise the bar for the team by setting standards for collection, analysis, and tradecraft as the threat intelligence function grows. Protect the community creating on Suno, so making music stays safe, fun, and open to everyone

with generative AI misuse, such as account farming, API or reseller abuse, or automated content abuse. Background at a consumer platform or a company built on user-generated content.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel
  • Strong, accurate data entry skills and the ability to keep up in a high-volume environment
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and procedures
  • Experience with Oracle NetSuite preferred

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You do well in a fast-paced, deadline-driven setting.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven technology or digital media sales Account Executive to join our team. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through the sale of digital and television media solutions, including streaming and broadcast television, digital advertising, and content partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in digital sales, business development with a deep understanding of media and marketing trends, and the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. This role requires a strategic approach to identifying opportunities, pitching solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive sales by identifying and securing new business opportunities across multiple digital channels, including streaming, online video and display, and content marketing solutions.
  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture long-term relationships with clients, ensuring their marketing needs are met and identifying areas for upselling and cross-selling additional services.
  • Consultative Selling: Provide consultative solutions to clients by understanding their business goals, analyzing market trends, and recommending tailored marketing strategies that drive results.
  • Market Research & Lead Generation: Research industry trends and competitor offerings to develop a robust pipeline of prospective clients and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Proposal Development & Pitching: Craft compelling sales presentations and proposals that showcase the value of our media offerings, using data and insights to communicate potential ROI.
  • Campaign Management & Optimization: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution, monitoring performance, and optimizing for maximum effectiveness and client satisfaction.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Regularly review and report on sales targets, campaign performance, and key metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management, and product teams to align on campaign strategies, creative assets, and ad placements that meet clients’ needs.
  • Performance Management: Strategically use CRM and prospecting tools to manage and achieve quotas as it pertains to activity metrics and revenue goals.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media sales, advertising, or a related industry
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and industry trends, including programmatic, streaming media, display, video, social, and content marketing
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interpret data and analytics to provide actionable insights
  • Self-motivated, with a passion for sales and digital media
  • Proficient in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with ad management tools a plus

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in working with business owners and/or agency clients
  • Knowledge of streaming and digital media
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, DSPs, and SSPs.

Why Join Us? We offer a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions make an immediate impact. Join a forward-thinking team and drive the future of media sales with access to cutting-edge tools and resources.

Salary: Competitive base + commission

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KUSA KTVD-TV Denver, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Denver, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Denver's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed

job.description:

The Account Manager supports Account Executives’ sales efforts by taking ownership of fulfillment in such a way that the AE can play their role of being client-facing, creating opportunities and closing revenue. The Account Manager manages the day-to-day responsibilities of accounts to ensure proper implementation of their solutions. The Account Manager influences and drives sales by providing superior customer service and support across Broadcast Television and Digital, aiming at retaining clients and growing business. This  job reports to Sales Manager. 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to assigned Account Executives on post-sale activity including campaign implementation, maintenance, and review.
  • Daily interaction with existing advertising agencies and direct clients; this responsibility includes maintenance of client schedules on television and digital in addition to implementation of special projects and promotions.
  • Works in tandem with Account Executives, Marketing Director, Research Director, and Creative Services to support client needs.
  • Attend sales meetings and sales trainings to gain sales, product and process information and keep abreast of company products and services to articulate to client, when appropriate.
  • Partner with designated Account Executives in identifying new/incremental revenue based on campaign results.
  • Assist designated Account Executives with maintenance of contracts, generating avails, traffic, make-goods, collection and overall customer service.
  • Regular tracking of clients’ audience delivery using ratings, impressions, clients KPIs, and campaign fulfillment.
  • Coordinate with team to set up new customer accounts, contracts, order entry and revisions.

 

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of account management in a professional, fast-paced media sales environment.
  • Track record of successfully retaining and growing clients.

  • Prior experience using CRM systems and MS Office suite.
  • Able to make decisions and solve problems independently to support customer needs.

TEGNA, one of the most geographically diverse broadcasters in the U.S., is seeking an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Shared Services team. This position will be part of the TEGNA corporate team with company-wide responsibility but will be physically located at our NBC Affiliate in Indianapolis, WTHR. The Accounts Receivable Specialist will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the accounts receivable sub-ledger for assigned stations/accounts. Additionally, in collaboration with collector and stations sales, the Specialist will resolve credit balances – refund, application, or transfer. Overall, this position is responsible for a “clean” aging providing collectors accurate balances when making their collection calls.


Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:


•    Identify balances needing adjustment and prepares online adjustment requests for routing
•    Work with station personnel to move adjustment requests through the process per policy
•    Reconcile customer receivable accounts and timely applies prepayments to invoices
•    Research and reconcile account balances and account activity per station/customer request
•    Provide account statements upon request
•    Conduct research for short pay discrepancies and resolve to proper next actions
•    Build and maintain positive relationships with station personnel and collectors
•    Provide a high standard of customer service to both internal and external customers


Requirements:

•    High School Diploma or GED
•    2 years of active experience with accounts receivable balances using an aged balance report as the primary source tool in a high-volume entry environment with responsibility for hundreds of accounts and collaborating with remote personnel
•    Knowledge of the accounting journal entry resulting from actions taken to resolve balances
•    Understanding of cash application and AR procedures and is a “numbers” person
•    Ability to quickly learn and achieve proficiency in new software applications as needed
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills including superior customer service skills
•    Professionalism and strong work ethic
•    Strong time-management and organizational skills


Preferred Qualifications:


•    Two or four-year degree
•    4 or more years of experience
•    Intermediate Excel skills – comfort exporting to Excel and manipulating results
•    Broadcast Industry experience
•    Wide Orbit Software experience

WBIR, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Knoxville, Tennessee, is looking for a dynamic Administrative Assistant to join our team. This position will provide high-level administrative and project management support to the President and General Manager and station leadership team members in supporting our employees. This role is essential in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, coordinating key projects, and managing communication flow between departments in a fast-paced media environment. The position requires a high level of discretion and strict confidentiality of company proprietary information.
Responsibilities:
• Provide administrative support for various departments including News, Sales and Technology with the utmost confidentiality.
• Develop and Lead Employee Care Initiatives: •Help onboard new employees, preparing I-9 documents and photo ID badges.
 •Plan and coordinate meetings/events and parties, including ordering meals and catering.
• Maintain messaging in station video boards to enhance staff communication
•Writes and publishes monthly station newsletter highlighting department updates, birthdays, anniversaries and upcoming events
• Collaborates with News Director, Director of Sales and Head of Technology on executing internal/external plans.
• Assist in the organization of tracking station projects including strategic planning, town halls, and other staff events through proficiency in office technologies (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) required.
• Oversee aspects of general office support including copying, faxing, mailing, and filing.
• Order and manage office supplies, badges, business cards as needed.
• Works cooperatively with vendors and suppliers.
• Make travel arrangements for employees such as booking flights, cars, and hotel.
• Help leadership team prepare reports and presentations.
• Other duties and responsibilities as needed.

• 3-5 years’ experience providing administrative support to a medium-sized organization. College degree preferred.
• Knowledge of the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the technical aptitude to learn new systems. • Must be collaborative communicator with excellent written and verbal skills.
• Self-starter who can think critically, make sound decisions, and follow through on projects/tasks with little or no supervision.
• Ability to understand and anticipate the needs of different departments and support each effectively.
• Strong attention to detail and organization with the ability to track multiple projects and deadlines.

job.title: Broadcast Inventory Specialist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Position:        Inventory Specialist
Department:    TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO)
Location:    Any TEGNA market 

Description:
We are hiring! The TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) team is looking for a talented and motivated person to join our team.
A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.  

Specific job requirements include:
•    Using WideOrbit Traffic software, manage commercial inventory by accurately preempting or placing spots on the broadcast log
•    Meet daily log finalization deadlines and clear oversold inventory 13 weeks out
•    Understand and follow spot placement guidelines to ensure client specifications are met
•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry
•    Various other duties as assigned


If this sounds like a great fit, we are looking for applicants with the following skills and experience:
•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)
•    Broadcasting, cable or radio traffic or sales support experience (preferred)
•    WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (preferred)
•    Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word and Excel (required)
•    Attention to detail and strong organizational skills (required)
•    Desire to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (required)
•    If you have relevant work experience, we are willing to train the right candidate
•    Work from home flexibility, must be in a TEGNA market  

 

 

The application deadline for this position is Nov 25, 2026

Pay Range $19.23—$21.63 USDPay Range$19.23—$21.63 USD

The Digital Sales Strategist will assist and strategize with key members of the sales staff including Account Executives, Account Managers, and sales leaders, to build digital solutions by leveraging ad-serving interfaces and other operational platforms. The Digital Sales Strategist’s primary responsibility is campaign success through pre-sales order entry, management, and optimization of Digital Media campaigns to ensure launch and successful delivery.

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

  • Consistently prospect for new revenue opportunities using client and category insights. 
  • Upsell current clients by engaging them in the full product line of KPNX-TV Phoenix offerings. 
  • Create custom solutions-driven campaigns that meet client needs across multiple media platforms including broadcast, digital, and Streaming (OTT). 
  • Seek opportunities to expand relationships with key clients by taking an active role in understanding their business needs and competitive landscape. 
  • Establish strong relationships with internal team members by providing the Account Management team with clear and concise direction for the successful execution of campaigns. 
  • Partner with your Account Manager to provide exceptional customer service and contract fulfillment.
  • Strategically utilize Matrix and station CRM to manage day-to-day activity, pipeline, and forecasts.
  • Positively and professionally represent the media group to the community at events and surrounding businesses.

Requirements: 

  • 1-3 years of digital marketing sales support, inside or outside sales experience.
  • Expert knowledge of all facets of digital sales and marketing with good grasp of OTT and targeted display.
  • Adept at creating new revenue opportunities from synergies between interactive sales and other mediums.
  • Google AdWords and Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) certifications highly desirable.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office programs and knowledge of Salesforce or other CRM software.
  • Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and ability to multi-task.
  • Demonstrate effective problem solving and decision-making skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office products.
  • Self-motivation and a strong work ethic are essential attributes.

• Establish and maintain a superior customer service relationship with the sites.
• Review various monthly reports and analysis for internal and external management and audit groups.
• Utilize good judgment in maintaining essential job functions through planning, analysis and follow up.
• Take initiative on tasks that will result in operational efficiencies.
• Perform other duties as required, including special projects and potentially complete more complex Journal Entries or Balance Sheet Reconciliations.

• Bachelor's degree is preferred in accounting or business-related concentration with 1-5 years of related experience.
• Good problem solving, organizational and time management skills. Analytical and detailed oriented.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with emphasis on superior customer service.
• Good knowledge of US GAAP and Sarbanes Oxley requirements.
• Strong systems orientation, with proficiency in Microsoft Office.

10 Tampa Bay News is looking for an Investigative Producer to dig deep, hold the powerful accountable, and deliver impactful stories for viewers across all our platforms: broadcast, CTV streaming, and digital.

Responsibilities:

job.title: Lifestyle Host/Reporter
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the NBC TEGNA-owned affiliate in St. Louis, Missouri is looking for a dynamic, creative and engaging Lifestyle Host & Multimedia Journalist to join Show Me St. Louis, our locally produced lifestyle and entertainment program. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms.
St. Louis is filled with incredible people, neighborhoods, restaurants, businesses, nonprofits, attractions and experiences, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to tell their stories.


The ideal candidate is an engaging on-air personality and strong storyteller who is equally comfortable hosting in the studio, reporting in the field and working behind the camera. This person should know how to take an idea from concept to air, whether that means interviewing a guest live, shooting and editing a feature story, creating an engaging live shot or working with a local business or community partner to develop compelling content. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:
•    Host Show Me St. Louis and deliver on-air content in an engaging, conversational and accurate manner.
•    Shoot, write, edit and report compelling lifestyle and community stories.
•    Conduct engaging interviews both in studio and in the field.
•    Develop original content showcasing the people, places, businesses, food, entertainment, nonprofits and experiences that make the St. Louis region unique.
•    Pitch fresh, creative and timely story ideas and help shape future Show Me St. Louis programming.
•    Generate fun, creative and content-driven live shots and field segments.
•    Work professionally and collaboratively with advertising clients and community partners to turn their ideas into compelling television.
•    Create content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
•    Maintain an active and professional social media presence while finding new ways to engage with viewers.
•    Use photography and editing tools to create polished, visually engaging stories.
•    Contribute to sponsored content, station initiatives, special programming and community events.
•    Collaborate with producers, photographers, sales teams and other departments to execute content across platforms.
•    Manage multiple stories and projects while consistently meeting deadlines.

Requirements:
•    2–4 years of experience in broadcast journalism, multimedia journalism, lifestyle television, hosting or a related field preferred.
•    Strong on-camera presence with an authentic, approachable personality.
•    Strong interviewing, writing and storytelling skills.
•    Experience shooting and editing video.
•    Ability to independently take a story from idea to finished product.
•    Comfortable working with advertising clients, local businesses, nonprofits and community organizations.
•    Creative thinker who understands how to make lifestyle content informative, entertaining and visually compelling.
•    Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to perform under tight deadlines.
•    Experience in creating content for social and digital platforms.
•    Experience with ENPS and EDIUS is preferred.
•    Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.

Who We're Looking For
We want someone who is curious about St. Louis and genuinely excited to explore it. Someone who can walk into a restaurant kitchen, community event, local business or live studio interview and immediately make people feel comfortable.
This person should bring personality and creativity to the show while also having the journalistic and production skills to find a story, shoot it, write it, edit it and tell it well.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to help viewers discover something new about St. Louis every day.

  • Use social media to determine content of newscasts and highlight big social stories.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.
  • Develop story ideas, write, shoot and edit news stories for on-air broadcasting.

  • Interview news subjects and research for facts and credibility.

  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.
  • Maintain and develop sources who will help bring our reporting to the next level.
  • Shoot, write, produce and edit on air and online content within deadlines.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.
  • Use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.

  • Must be organized with the ability to work under constant deadlines.

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WMAZ-TV Macon, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Macon is seeking an innovative Producer to shape our daily newscasts. At WMAZ-TV Macon, we build creative shows that engage, educate and inform our audiences. We prioritize original storytelling and investigative journalism as key components of our newscasts to set our product apart in the Macon market. 

At TEGNA, we are committed to our core values: We Win, We Work Smarter, We Demand the Truth, and We Do the Right Thing. These values guide how we create content and serve our communities.

We value a collaborative, motivated journalist who works well within a team to bring the truth to our growing audiences across platforms, starting with our streaming and broadcast services. We want your authentic personality to drive your storytelling and writing in an exciting and captivating manner to hold the audience.

You’ll also have access to modern tools and workflows as TEGNA continues to drive innovation.

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Use your natural curiosity to pitch compelling stories.
  • Show off your creativity and storytelling skills.
  • Craft stories of all lengths on all platforms for specific audiences.
  • Meet daily deadlines.
  • Combine live pictures, graphics, compelling video and emotional sound to create an engaging experience for our audience.
  • Booth continuous coverage on our live streams for breaking news and community events.
  • Consistently try new things after thoughtful discussion with supervisors.
  • Allow the impactful and emotional conversations the community needs to drive the content in your rundown.
  • Use data analytics to help shape the content of your show.
  • Challenge traditional ways of doing things.
  • Ensure all communities and viewpoints have a voice and presence in your show.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in journalism, communications or related field or equivalent years of experience.
  • 0-1 years of news content experience.
  • Top-notch communication skills are an absolute must.
  • Solid journalistic judgement and a news philosophy that emphasizes accurate, fair and unique local content, along with community engagement. 
  • Understanding of the tenets of professional journalism.
  • Skills in producing engaging, content-driven newscasts and digital content.
  • Strong social media skills, including an active news hound presence on your preferred social platforms. 
  • Organizational skills and the ability to work under time pressure deadlines.
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events. 
  • ENPS and Edius system experience preferred.
