job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. TEGNA is looking for a Project Manager, Sponsorships to own the operational backbone of our network-wide sponsorship business. You’ll work with B2B Integrated Marketing leadership, sales leadership, and Commercial Production Managers (CPMs) across our stations and markets to build sponsorship sales materials, coordinate fulfillment on larger sponsorships, and keep the process organized, current, and continuously improving. 

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll be the connection point between sales, creative, production, and station teams, making sure the right packages are in market, the right people have the right information, and every commitment is delivered.

Responsibilities:

  • Sponsorship Packages & Sales Materials
  • Partner with marketing and sales leadership to build and refine sponsorship packages, including names, tiers, and deliverables
  • Station & CPM Coordination
  • Serve as the coordination point between stations and CPMs on cross-market and multi-deliverable sponsorships
  • Define and organize scope, timelines, and deliverable requirements, and communicate them clearly to the relevant CPMs and station teams
  • Track and route the deliverables needed to fulfill larger sponsorship commitments, and flag risks or gaps early
  • Execute on sponsorship elements as needed
  • Process & Governance
  • Maintain a clear view of which sponsorship packages are active versus retired, and flag any materials or proposals that reference a retired package
  • Support sponsorship reviews by capturing notes and action items, and archive completed packages in Box
  • Coordinate with tech operations and design on process improvements
  • Keep process documentation current, track trends across sponsorships, and recommend improvements to streamline the workflow
  • Manage multiple sponsorships simultaneously across different stages, from package build through fulfillment

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in project management, broadcast or media operations, sales support, or marketing operations
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across sales, creative, and production teams
  • Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to produce polished, sales-ready materials
  • Experience with project management tools such as Monday.com (or similar), document management platforms such as Box, and production tools like Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple sponsorships at once
  • Comfort working independently in a remote/hybrid environment
  • Preferred
  • Experience in local broadcast, television, or digital media
  • Familiarity with sponsorship sales, packaging, or fulfillment workflows
  • Experience working with distributed teams across multiple markets

What Success Looks Like

  • Sales teams always have current, accurate, easy-to-find sponsorship materials
  • No retired packages appearing in active proposals
  • Larger sponsorships delivered on time, with stations and CPMs clear on scope and responsibilities #LI-MS1

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. Help us build the future of statewide local news in Arizona.
TEGNA is creating a statewide news operation by bringing together teams in Phoenix and Tucson to build a stronger content organization serving viewers across Arizona. We are looking for MMJ Reporters based in Tucson to be part of a dedicated Southern Arizona news team serving our Tucson stations while also contributing to statewide coverage across our Phoenix and Tucson broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. This reporter will cover breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues and the people shaping Tucson and Southern Arizona. They will be deeply connected to the Tucson community while working as part of one collaborative Arizona newsroom serving audiences across both markets. This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The MMJ Reporter will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Report, shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Own and develop original story ideas rooted in Tucson and Southern Arizona that are relevant locally and statewide
•    Build deep relationships and trusted sources throughout Southern Arizona
•    Deliver clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Serve as a regular live presence across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.
•    Uphold our newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, urgency and compelling storytelling.

Requirements:
•    2 years of reporting experience preferred.
•    Proven ability to shoot, write, edit and produce strong broadcast and digital stories independently.
•    Demonstrated ability to deliver polished, engaging live reports daily, including during breaking news.
•    Strong news judgment, writing ability, ethical decision-making and attention to accuracy.
•    A track record of generating original story ideas and building trusted sources in a community.
•    Comfort working independently in the field while collaborating closely with a larger newsroom.
•    Ability to work quickly, calmly and accurately under deadline pressure.
•    Experience using social media and digital platforms for newsgathering and audience engagement

The Sports Partnership Account Executive is responsible for achieving or exceeding sports revenue goals by partnering with a team of Account Executives to develop and close new and existing advertiser opportunities across 9NEWS and TEGNA’s multiplatform sports portfolio. 

You’ll join Account Executives on sales calls, build strategic sports marketing solutions, and help advertisers connect with passionate fans through premier sports properties including the Denver Broncos, Denver Nuggets, Colorado Avalanche, Colorado Rockies, NBC Sports Properties, Premion OTT Sports programming, and other sports properties connected with 9NEWS. 

Success in this role comes from strong sales collaboration, creative sports strategy, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn linear TV, content sponsorships, digital, streaming, and OTT opportunities, including PREMION, into compelling advertising solutions that drive revenue growth and measurable client outcomes.

  • Join Account Executives on client sales calls as the sports subject matter expert, helping uncover needs, shape opportunities, and advance business.

  • Create custom campaigns and sponsorship concepts that meet client needs across broadcast, digital, streaming, OTT, and content sponsorships. 
  • Upsell current clients across the full 9NEWS sports and media product line. 
  • Collaborate with sales leadership, marketing, research, production, digital, and operations teams to build integrated campaigns.

  • Manage CRM activity, pipeline, forecasts, and sports revenue updates. 
  • Represent 9NEWS at client events, networking opportunities, and sports-related hospitality as needed.

  • Strong understanding of sports marketing, fan engagement, sponsorship packaging, and advertiser strategy.

Reports to the Director of Sales at 9NEWS and works closely with Sales Management, Account Executive Team, clients, agencies, internal marketing and production teams, and external sports partners. 

Competitive compensation includes base salary plus an incentive plan tied to sports revenue growth, sales collaboration, and overall performance. On-target compensation range of $150,000-$200,000 based on experience, qualifications, and market considerations.

job.description:

WTSP the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Tampa Bay is transforming the way we gather and present news, and we’re looking for a Story Desk Editor to embrace our transition to the newsroom of the future. 

This hybrid role combines the skills of an assignment editor and a digital content producer to serve as the hub of the newsroom. The Story Desk Editor drives daily editorial execution, curates and produces impactful stories, and ensures our content connects authentically with audiences across streaming, digital, social and broadcast platforms.

Role Summary

As a Story Desk Editor, you will be part of the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing and curating stories across platforms.

You will lead coverage during breaking news, shape daily story planning, and curate content across platforms. This position requires decisive editorial judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines. You will collaborate with MSJs, producers and photojournalists to deliver accurate, relevant and engaging stories that serve the community.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and communicate newsroom coverage during breaking news, ensuring accuracy, urgency and balance
• Identify and plan stories that matter most to the community, using editorial judgment and social listening
• Create and edit engaging content for digital platforms: website, mobile app and streaming,
• Guide newsroom logistics and provide editorial support for MSJs, producers, and photojournalists
• Edit reporter content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations
• Enhance storytelling with creative elements (graphics, video, audience-submitted content, etc.)
• Use available metrics to inform coverage and improve audience reach
• Support newsroom operations and coverage planning as needed
• Uphold TEGNA’s journalistic standards and values across all platforms

Requirements:

What You’ll Bring

• 1–3 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production, or related role
• Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure
• Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce accurate and compelling content quickly
• Experience with newsroom systems, CMS tools
• Organizational skills to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment
• A collaborative, solutions-focused mindset that thrives in a team environment
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or equivalent experience


Why TEGNA

TEGNA is reimagining local journalism for the newsroom of the future. With 64 stations across 51 markets, we deliver trusted, fact-based news that informs, engages, and empowers communities. Our values Demand the Truth, Work Smarter, Debate Fearlessly, Listen Carefully, and Zero-Base Every Process guide everything we do.

you.

9NEWS produces accurate, relevant news content across platforms, empowering people to make informed decisions for themselves and their families. 9NEWS is a brave space for journalists to pursue their purpose, uncover and tell the truth, elevate Colorado's diverse voices, combat disinformation, and create understanding, accountability, enlightenment, and empathy.   9NEWS is owned by TEGNA.
Our Core Values
Do the Right Thing
We Win
We Demand the Truth
We Work Smarter
Compensation

• Excellent writing, reporting, and storytelling skills across multiple platforms.
• A collaborative spirit and the ability to elevate teammates and newsroom culture.
• Curiosity, creativity, and a desire to continually innovate.
• A deep understanding of journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and accountability.
Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field preferred.
• Five to seven plus years of experience in professional television news, including significant anchoring experience.
• Proven success in a competitive news environment.
• Demonstrated ability to connect with audiences across broadcast, digital, streaming, and social platforms.

job.title: Account Specialist
job.description:
ABOUT YOU:


In this role, you will serve as the strategic liaison between Marketing, Programming, Production, Creative, PR, Research, Media and other cross-functional teams to drive the successful execution of integrated marketing initiatives. You will manage projects and campaigns through a 360° multiplatform approach, translating business priorities, content strategies, and audience insights into coordinated promotional plans that support business objectives across linear, digital, social, streaming, and emerging platforms.


The Multiplatform Account Specialist is responsible for ensuring alignment among stakeholders, overseeing campaign workflows, facilitating communication across teams, and delivering projects on time and according to strategic priorities.


YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)


  • Lead the end-to-end management of multiplatform marketing projects and campaigns, ensuring alignment with business objectives and audience engagement goals.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing, Programming, Production, Creative, PR, Research, Media, and other stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and execution.
  • Translate business priorities, content strategies, and project requirements into integrated communication and promotional plans across linear, digital, social, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Coordinate campaign development, timelines, deliverables, approvals, and asset distribution to ensure timely and accurate execution.
  • Develop strategic briefs and provide actionable insights that guide creative development, messaging, and promotional strategies.
  • Maintain a comprehensive view of project status, proactively managing priorities, identifying risks, and resolving issues throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Ensure creative teams and partners have the information, materials, and direction needed to produce effective marketing assets.
  • Leverage audience, content, market, and competitive insights to inform campaign recommendations and identify opportunities to maximize reach and performance.
  • Support the integration of marketing, communications, and public relations efforts to strengthen content visibility and audience engagement.
  • Monitor campaign performance, compile results, and facilitate post-campaign analyses to identify learnings, best practices, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Prepare and communicate project updates, campaign status reports, strategic recommendations, and key insights to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization, influencing and driving alignment among cross-functional teams without direct authority.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)


  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Public Relations, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, advertising, account management, promotions, media, content, entertainment, or related industries.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

job.title: Assignment Desk Editor
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented and driven Assignment Desk Editor based in Miami to join its news team. The ideal candidate will bring strong editorial judgment, production experience, and a passion for breaking news. This role is responsible for coordinating story development, securing high-profile guests, booking interviews, field producing, and ensuring coverage is compelling and relevant across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. The successful candidate will manage story assignments, coordinate logistics, support field crews, and follow up on daily newsroom workflows across multiple news programs and platforms. This individual must be a strategic and creative thinker, a self-starter, and a collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.


YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Constantly monitor and respond to breaking news and developing stories across multiple platforms.
  • Monitor news wires, social media, scanners, broadcasts, and online sources to quickly identify breaking news opportunities.
  • Generate, research, verify, plan, and develop story ideas for newscasts, digital platforms, and special coverage.
  • Coordinate daily story production with reporters, photographers, and multimedia journalists by gathering visual elements, securing video feeds, and arranging interviews relevant to assignments.
  • Secure high-profile guests, newsmakers, public figures, and subject matter experts.
  • Coordinate and manage live remotes, video feeds, live shots, and interview logistics under tight deadlines.
  • Coordinate field crews throughout the news gathering and production process, including scheduling interviews and providing accurate logistical information.
  • Continuously update stories with the latest developments and information.
  • Maintain the iNews system updated with crew locations, assignments, and timelines.
  • Monitor law enforcement, fire communications, scanners, wires, and beat checks for breaking news and spot coverage opportunities.
  • Assist writers, producers, editors, and digital teams with information gathering and story updates.
  • Arrange, download, and supervise incoming video feeds.
  • Participate in editorial meetings and communicate daily coverage plans and developments.
  • Assist with news production and special projects as assigned.
  • Field produce and travel as needed for major news coverage and special assignments.
  • Stay informed on national and international current events, legal developments, and culturally relevant topics.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing breaking news situations and adapting quickly to changes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines independently.
  • Be available to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during breaking news and continuous coverage situations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • BS/BA or MA in Communications, Journalism, New Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Minimum of 2 years of newsroom experience required.
  • At least 1 year of experience as a Producer and/or Assignment Editor preferred.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of current affairs.
  • Highly motivated, creative, assertive, detail-oriented, and organized.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience managing multiple social media platforms.
  • Basic video editing knowledge.
  • Ability to monitor and record multiple video feeds simultaneously.
  • Experience working with non-linear editing and archive systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, iNews, Avid, live feed systems, and social media platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of city agencies, public safety operations, and key newsmakers preferred.
  • Must be willing to work onsite in Miami, FL.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, reach, and sit for up to 8 hours.
  • Employment and education verification required.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work full-time in the United States.

 

OUR BENEFITS:

job.title: Manager, Ad Sales Strategy & Analytics
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching audiences across streaming, digital, social, audio, live events, sports, and linear television. Powered by the scale of ViX, premium content, first-party audience capabilities, and deep cultural connection with Hispanic consumers, we help brands drive measurable business outcomes across every stage of the consumer journey.


The Manager, Ad Sales Strategy & Analytics plays a key role in driving advertising revenue growth through revenue forecasting, sales performance analytics, competitive intelligence, and strategic decision-making.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Sales Planning & Analytics, this role owns the weekly advertising revenue forecast and develops bottoms-up revenue projections while partnering closely with Ad Sales and Finance leadership. The Manager will evaluate pipeline and bookings performance, identify revenue risks and opportunities, and translate complex business data into actionable recommendations for Sales and executive leadership.


The role partners across Ad Sales, Finance, Research, Business Development, and Sales Operations.


YOUR DAY TO DAY: Revenue Strategy & Forecasting

•       Own the weekly advertising revenue forecast and develop bottoms-up projections by account, category, platform, and other relevant dimensions.

•       Analyze revenue pacing, bookings, forecast accuracy, and performance against budget, plan, and prior year.

•       Identify and quantify revenue risks and opportunities and provide recommendations to Sales and Finance leadership.

•       Partner with Ad Sales and Finance on forecasting, annual planning, budgeting, target setting, and long-range revenue planning.

•       Develop scenarios and sensitivity analyses to assess changes in sales performance and marketplace conditions.


Sales Performance & Pipeline Analytics

• Leverage Salesforce to analyze pipeline health, bookings, opportunity stages, expected revenue, aging, win rates, conversion, and pipeline coverage.

• Monitor sales performance against revenue targets and quotas and identify opportunities to improve pipeline generation, conversion, and sales productivity.

• Develop dashboards, scorecards, and performance reporting for Sales leadership.

• Evaluate account, seller, category, and platform performance to identify revenue opportunities and risks.

Sales Compensation & Incentive Analytics

• Support sales compensation and incentive planning through quota, attainment, performance, and revenue analysis.

• Develop and validate analytics supporting bonus and incentive calculations.

• Evaluate the relationship between sales performance, compensation plans, and revenue outcomes.


Market & Competitive Intelligence

• Analyze market share, advertiser spending, category trends, competitive activity, and marketplace dynamics.

• Leverage syndicated research and competitive intelligence platforms including Nielsen, MediaRadar, Vivvix, and similar sources.

• Identify whitespace, share-of-wallet, and growth opportunities across advertisers, categories, and platforms.

• Translate market intelligence into actionable revenue and sales recommendations.


Cross-Platform Revenue & Monetization

• Analyze advertising performance across linear television, streaming, digital, social, audio, sports, live events, and emerging platforms.

• Evaluate ViX, digital, and social revenue opportunities and audience/content monetization.

• Partner with Sales, Research, Product, and Business Development on new advertising products, packages, and cross-platform monetization opportunities.

• Assess the financial and revenue implications of new products and monetization strategies.


Executive & Strategic Decision Support

• Develop executive presentations, dashboards, and strategic narratives covering revenue performance, forecasts, pipeline, financial results, market trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Present analyses and recommendations to the CFO, President of Ad Sales, senior Sales leadership, and broader Sales organization.

• Lead ad hoc analyses and strategic projects addressing key business priorities.

• Serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales and Finance leadership.


Reporting, Analytics & Team Leadership

• Build and automate recurring reporting, dashboards, and forecasting processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

• Partner with Sales Operations, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to improve data quality and reporting processes.

• Manage and mentor a junior analyst, providing prioritization, coaching, quality control, and professional development.



YOU HAVE Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• 2+ years in analytics, sales strategy, finance, revenue management, business intelligence, media, advertising, or a related field.

• Experience with revenue forecasting, sales performance analytics, financial analysis, or strategic planning.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations and executive-level insights.

• Experience managing multiple priorities and independently owning projects.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in media, advertising, television, streaming, or digital advertising.

• Experience with Salesforce and sales pipeline analytics.

• Experience with Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar BI platforms.

• Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python.

• Experience with Nielsen, MediaRadar, or similar syndicated research platforms

• Familiarity with AI-powered tools for data analysis, reporting, and process improvement.

• Experience with sales compensation, quota, bonus, or incentive analytics.

• Experience developing revenue forecasting models and measuring forecast accuracy.

• Experience partnering with Finance and Sales leadership on budgeting, forecasting, or financial performance.

• Prior people management or mentorship experience.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

• Must be willing to work 3 days in office in New York.

• Employment and education will be verified

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.


SALARY RANGE Base Salary – $100,000- $115,000 + Benefits

job.title: Multimedia Journalist & Producer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

Univision Texas Central is looking for a motivated, competitive, and news-hungry Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) and Producer who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative newsroom and is passionate about delivering impactful journalism to our Hispanic communities.

This hybrid role combines strong newscast production skills with the initiative, creativity, independence, and on-air reporting capabilities of a multimedia journalist. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable producing compelling newscasts, developing original stories, and independently reporting from the field. As editorial needs evolve, this individual will also be expected to serve as an on-camera journalist, delivering live and pre-recorded reports, covering breaking news, and developing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This role requires someone who can confidently transition between producing behind the scenes and reporting in front of the camera.

We are building a newsroom culture rooted in ownership, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, and a relentless commitment to journalism. We value individuals who take initiative, communicate openly, embrace feedback, support their teammates, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.

 

We believe great journalism is a shared responsibility. Every producer plays an active role in identifying stories, developing sources, verifying information, advancing coverage, and responding to breaking news. We are looking for someone who doesn’t simply wait for assignments but actively seeks opportunities to inform our audience and strengthen our coverage.

Success in this role requires more than technical ability. It requires a team-first mentality, strong editorial instincts, adaptability, and a genuine desire to contribute to a newsroom where everyone is invested in the collective success of our journalism.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Produce compelling, accurate, and visually engaging newscasts and/or news content for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Identify, pitch, research, and develop original, impactful stories that matter to Hispanic audiences in San Antonio, Austin, and surrounding communities.
  • Demonstrate the versatility, confidence, and editorial readiness to transition between newscast production, assignment desk responsibilities, and independent field reporting based on daily newsroom priorities and operational needs.
  • Actively contribute to the daily assignment process by monitoring developing news, identifying coverage opportunities, gathering and verifying information, following up on leads, and helping advance stories throughout the day.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment when evaluating story relevance, urgency, impact, and potential for audience engagement.
  • Independently report from the field as assigned, serving as a Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) responsible for researching, conducting interviews, gathering video and sound, writing scripts, editing packages, and producing complete news stories.
  • Deliver live and pre-recorded on-camera reports for newscasts and digital platforms, including breaking news coverage, developing stories, and independently researched enterprise reporting. Be prepared to work in the field without an assigned photographer or additional reporting support when necessary.
  • Build and organize rundowns, write compelling scripts, develop effective story treatments, and execute creative showcasing elements that strengthen the newscast.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with community members, public officials, organizations, and other sources to generate original reporting and follow-up opportunities.
  • Monitor news wires, scanners, social media, competing outlets, and other reliable sources to identify breaking news and developing stories.
  • Coordinate closely with assignment editors, reporters, photographers, anchors, producers, and digital teams to ensure effective news gathering, timely communication, and efficient execution.
  • Take initiative during breaking news and severe weather coverage, adapting quickly to changing circumstances and supporting newsroom needs in both the field and the control room.
  • Identify opportunities to advance stories beyond the initial report by pursuing additional interviews, new angles, accountability questions, and meaningful follow-ups.
  • Produce platform-appropriate digital content, including short-form videos, social media updates, and other multimedia storytelling elements.
  • Maintain clear and timely communication across shifts, ensuring important editorial developments, pending follow-ups, and coverage needs are properly shared with the next team.
  • Contribute actively to editorial meetings by bringing fresh story ideas, informed perspectives, and solutions that strengthen coverage.
  • Take responsibility for assigned work from beginning to end, maintaining accuracy, meeting deadlines, communicating challenges, and following through on commitments.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and ownership by supporting other newsroom functions when editorial priorities or breaking news demand it.
  • Uphold high standards of accuracy, fairness, ethical journalism, and editorial integrity across all platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

 

 

YOU HAVE:

  • Strong news judgment and a demonstrated passion for local journalism and community-focused storytelling.
  • Experience in television news production, multimedia journalism, reporting, or a related newsroom environment.
  • Strong writing, research, interviewing, and fact-checking skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research, shoot, write, edit, and deliver complete multimedia news stories for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills, including the ability to confidently deliver live reports, pre-recorded standups, and breaking news updates.
  • Ability and willingness to work independently in the field, including covering breaking news, developing original stories, and reporting without an assigned photographer or additional reporting support.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple responsibilities and meet tight deadlines.
  • A proactive, competitive mindset and the initiative to identify, develop, and pursue stories without waiting for direction.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams and newsroom functions.
  • A team-first mentality, openness to feedback, adaptability, and a demonstrated commitment to accountability and collective success.
  • Proficiency in Spanish, including strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to communicate and research effectively in English.
  • A commitment to factual accuracy, fairness, balanced reporting, ethical journalism, and editorial integrity.
  • Flexibility and willingness to transition between newscast production, assignment desk responsibilities, and independent field reporting based on editorial priorities and newsroom needs.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, overnights, weekends, and holidays.
  • undefined DESIRED SKILL & EXPERIENCE:Experience producing local television newscasts and reporting independently as an MMJ.Proficiency with newsroom production systems, including iNews or comparable platforms.Experience operating professional video cameras, field audio equipment, mobile reporting tools, and nonlinear editing software.Strong understanding of live news production, rundown management, and control room coordination.Experience with digital-first storytelling, social media publishing, and streaming news content.Familiarity with Central Texas communities and issues affecting Hispanic and Spanish-speaking audiences.Demonstrated ability to develop exclusive stories, cultivate sources, and generate enterprise reporting.Experience covering breaking news, severe weather, elections, and other major local events.A degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:Ability to perform newsroom and field-reporting responsibilities, including operating and transporting news-gathering equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.Ability to work in various indoor and outdoor environments as required by assignments.Ability to work schedules that may include evenings, weekends, or holidays based on newsroom needs.Ability to travel locally for field reporting and other newsroom assignments as necessary.undefinedOUR BENEFITS:TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.Apply on-line at TelevisaUnivision’s career page:https://corporate.televisaunivision.com/careers/

job.title: Principal Data Engineer
job.description:
SOBRE EL PUESTO Y EL EQUIPO

En TelevisaUnivision, somos la empresa líder mundial de medios de comunicación en español,

llegando a millones de consumidores a través de plataformas digitales, streaming, redes

sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos expandiendo

nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, estamos realizando importantes inversiones en

tecnología, datos e innovación para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a nuestros suscriptores e

impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio a largo plazo.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de

datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de

reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en

decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto,

Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision.

El Principal Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave como líder técnico en el diseño,

desarrollo e implementación de nuestra plataforma de datos. Será fundamental para definir la

arquitectura y la dirección técnica de la plataforma a varios años, participará directamente en la

resolución de los desafíos más complejos relacionados con el procesamiento de datos en

tiempo real y por lotes (batch), y brindará mentoría a ingenieros de niveles junior e intermedio

para elevar los estándares de ingeniería de todo el equipo.

El candidato ideal combina una sólida experiencia práctica en sistemas de datos distribuidos y

procesamiento de datos en streaming con el criterio necesario para tomar decisiones

arquitectónicas de largo plazo, la capacidad de influir y alinear equipos sin autoridad jerárquica

directa y un compromiso genuino con el desarrollo profesional de otros ingenieros.


SOBRE TI

Eres un líder técnico con experiencia práctica que diseña plataformas completas, no solo

pipelines de datos. Te sientes igualmente cómodo desarrollando código para entornos de

producción, defendiendo decisiones arquitectónicas durante revisiones de diseño, colaborando

con ingenieros junior para resolver problemas complejos y explicando las ventajas y desventajas

de distintas soluciones a líderes ejecutivos.

Cuentas con:

• Conocimiento experto de los servicios de datos de Google Cloud Platform (GCP),

especialmente BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer y Cloud

Storage.

• Amplia experiencia en el diseño de arquitecturas en tiempo real y orientadas a eventos,

incluyendo semánticas de procesamiento exactamente una vez (exactly-once), manejo

de datos que llegan con retraso y evolución de esquemas.

• Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL, así como de frameworks de transformación de

datos como dbt.

• Experiencia comprobada definiendo la dirección técnica de plataformas utilizadas por

múltiples equipos y liderando su implementación a lo largo de varios trimestres.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones

escalables y eficientes.

• Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera

efectiva.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con

equipos técnicos y no técnicos.

• Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de

conocimientos.

• Interés genuino en desarrollar ingenieros junior y fomentar una cultura de ingeniería

sólida.


RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA

Arquitectura de la plataforma de datos, desarrollo y estrategia técnica

• Desarrollar implementaciones de referencia, frameworks y bibliotecas reutilizables que

puedan ser adoptadas por otros ingenieros, incluyendo plantillas de ingesta de datos,

patrones de dbt y Airflow, y módulos de IaC en Pulumi.

• Liderar el diseño de pipelines de datos en tiempo real utilizando Pub/Sub y Dataflow,

incluyendo esquemas de eventos, registros y evolución de esquemas, procesamiento

exactly-once, gestión de marcas de tiempo (watermarking) y manejo de datos que llegan

con retraso.

• Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las

pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción.

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el

ecosistema.

Colaboración multifuncional

• Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de

Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones

técnicas.

• Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo

de la plataforma.

• Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de

procesos y eficiencia operativa.

Rendimiento y optimización

• Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el

rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas

y almacenamiento en BigQuery.

• Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la

plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes.

• Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e

integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

• Liderar la respuesta ante incidentes graves relacionados con los datos, realizar análisis

posteriores a incidentes sin atribución de culpas (blameless postmortems) e impulsar

soluciones estructurales para prevenir su recurrencia.

Liderazgo y contribución al equipo

• Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica,

revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos.

• Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de

ingeniería.

• Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de

Datos de alto desempeño.

• Evaluar e impulsar la adopción de tecnologías emergentes, incluyendo flujos de trabajo

de ingeniería asistidos por inteligencia artificial y herramientas de datos basadas en

modelos de lenguaje de gran tamaño (LLM), manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y

seguridad.


REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA

Experiencia y habilidades requeridas

• Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de

Información o un campo técnico relacionado, o experiencia equivalente.

• Más de 12 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de

Big Data.

• Al menos 2 años de experiencia en un rol de liderazgo técnico (Tech Lead), definiendo la

dirección técnica de múltiples equipos.

• Experiencia demostrable brindando mentoría y desarrollando ingenieros de niveles

junior e intermedio.

• Trayectoria comprobada en el diseño y operación de plataformas de datos en tiempo

real y de gran volumen en entornos de producción, por ejemplo, plataformas que

procesan miles de millones de eventos al día.

• Experiencia de nivel experto con GCP: BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam),

Cloud Composer (Airflow) y Cloud Storage. También se considerará experiencia con AWS.

• Dominio experto de Python y SQL, así como experiencia con dbt en entornos de

producción.

• Conocimiento profundo de conceptos de procesamiento de datos en streaming,

incluyendo tiempo del evento frente al tiempo de procesamiento, ventanas de

procesamiento (windowing), marcas de tiempo (watermarks), entrega exactly-once y

mecanismos de control de presión (backpressure); experiencia con Kafka, Flink o Spark.

• Conocimiento experto en modelado de datos para analítica, incluyendo modelado

dimensional, modelado de eventos y formatos de tablas lakehouse como Apache

Iceberg.

• Amplia experiencia con Infraestructura como Código (Pulumi o Terraform), CI/CD y

pruebas automatizadas para pipelines de datos.

• Experiencia demostrable gestionando la confiabilidad de los datos, incluyendo objetivos

de nivel de servicio (SLO), observabilidad de datos, gestión de incidentes y análisis

posteriores a incidentes.

• Experiencia comprobada en la reducción de costos de plataformas de datos en la nube a

gran escala.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita, verbal y de presentación, incluyendo la

elaboración de documentos de diseño y la comunicación con audiencias técnicas y

ejecutivas.

Requisitos deseables

• Experiencia en empresas de suscripción, plataformas de video en streaming (OTT),

medios de comunicación u organizaciones deportivas, incluyendo datos de calidad de

reproducción, interacción de usuarios y publicidad en plataformas con anuncios (AVOD).

• Experiencia dando soporte a cargas de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de Datos,

incluyendo pipelines de características (feature pipelines), características en tiempo real

y datos para sistemas de recomendación y personalización.

• Experiencia con contratos de datos (data contracts), registros de esquemas (schema

registries) y herramientas de catalogación o trazabilidad de datos (data lineage).


REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México.

• Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Principal Data Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

At TelevisaUnivision, we are the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of consumers across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear television, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing heavily in technology, data, and innovation to deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and drive long-term business growth.

 

The Data Engineering team designs, builds, and operates the high-volume, high-velocity data pipelines that power ViX, including playback and engagement events, subscription data, advertising data, and the analytics data warehouse that turns them into business decisions. The team works closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics teams across TelevisaUnivision.

The Principal Data Engineer will play a key role as a technical leader in the design, development, and deployment of our data platform. You will be critical in setting the architecture and multi-year technical direction for our data platform, stay hands-on with the hardest real-time and batch data problems, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers to raise the engineering bar across the team.

The ideal candidate pairs deep hands-on expertise in streaming and distributed data systems with the judgment to make long-lived platform decisions, the influence to align teams without direct authority, and a genuine commitment to growing other engineers.

About You

You are a hands-on technical leader who designs platforms, not just pipelines. You are equally comfortable writing production code, defending an architecture in a design review, pairing with a junior engineer on a tricky problem, and explaining trade-offs to executives.

You bring:

  • Expert-level knowledge of Google Cloud Platform data services, especially BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer, and Cloud Storage
  • Deep experience designing real-time and event-driven architectures with exactly-once semantics, late-arriving data, and schema evolution
  • Mastery of Python and SQL, and data transformation frameworks such as dbt
  • A track record of setting technical direction for a platform used by many teams, and seeing it through multi-quarter delivery

·       Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform

·       Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable and efficient solutions

·       Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

·       Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across technical and non-technical teams

·       A continuous improvement mindset and passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing

  • A passion for mentoring junior engineers and building a strong engineering culture

Your Day-to-Day (Responsibilities)

Data Platform Architecture, Development & Technical Strategy

·       Build reference implementations, frameworks, and reusable libraries that other engineers adopt, covering ingestion templates, dbt and Airflow patterns, and IaC modules in Pulumi

  • Lead the design of real-time pipelines on Pub/Sub and Dataflow, including event schemas, schema registry and evolution, exactly-once processing, watermarking, and late-data handling

·       Own assigned pipelines end to end, from design and development through testing, deployment, and production support

·       Ensure data quality, integrity, security, and availability across the data ecosystem

Cross-Functional Collaboration

·       Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

·       Contribute to data architecture discussions and long-term platform strategy

·       Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies

Performance & Optimization

·       Optimize data storage, processing, and orchestration for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, including BigQuery query and storage costs

·       Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data pipeline and platform issues, and contribute to incident reviews

·       Implement best practices for data governance, observability, testing, and CI/CD

  • Lead incident response for severe data incidents, run blameless postmortems, and drive systemic fixes

Leadership & Team Contribution

·       Mentor and support junior data engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

·       Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering best practices

·       Participate in technical interviews and help grow a high-performing data engineering team

  • Evaluate and drive adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-assisted engineering workflows and LLM-enabled data tooling, while maintaining strong quality and security standards

You Have (Qualifications & Experience)

Required Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments
  • 2+ years in a Tech-lead role setting technical direction across teams
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing junior and mid-level engineers
  • Proven track record designing and running real-time data platforms in production at high volume, for example billions of events per day
  • Expert-level experience with GCP: BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer (Airflow), and Cloud Storage; AWS experience will also be considered
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, and production experience with dbt
  • Deep knowledge of stream processing concepts: event time vs. processing time, windowing, watermarks, exactly-once delivery, and backpressure; Kafka, Flink, or Spark
  • Expert understanding of data modeling for analytics, including dimensional modeling, event modeling, and lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform), CI/CD, and automated testing for data pipelines
  • Demonstrated ownership of data reliability: SLOs, data observability, incident management, and postmortems
  • Demonstrated success reducing cloud data platform cost at scale
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including design documents and communication with technical and executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription, streaming video (OTT), media, or sports organizations, including playback quality, engagement, and ad-supported (AVOD) data
  • Experience supporting ML and data science workloads: feature pipelines, real-time features, recommendation and personalization data
  • Experience with data contracts, schema registries, and data catalog or lineage tools

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States
  • Employment/education will be verified

·       Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

 

Our Benefits

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO, tuition reimbursement, wellness and employee support programs, 401(k), and life and other insurance plans.

This is in addition to a comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage options.

job.title: Sales Strategy & Excellence Lead
job.description:
SALES STRATEGY & EXCELLENCE LEAD

Ubicación: Santa Fe, presencial  


Acerca de TelevisaUnivision

TelevisaUnivision es la compañía líder de medios y contenido en español a nivel global, con un ecosistema que integra televisión, streaming, contenido digital y soluciones publicitarias. A través de sus plataformas y capacidades de innovación, conecta a las marcas con audiencias relevantes y ofrece soluciones comerciales orientadas a generar impacto y resultados de negocio.


Sobre el puesto

El Sales Strategy & Excellence Lead será responsable de diseñar y optimizar la estrategia comercial y los procesos operativos del equipo de Ad Sales Streaming & D2C, impulsando la eficiencia de la operación, la productividad comercial y el crecimiento de los ingresos publicitarios.

Esta posición conectará la estrategia de ventas con las áreas de Producto, Finanzas, Legal, Crédito, Facturación y Ad Operations para facilitar la implementación y monetización de nuevos productos y formatos publicitarios. Asimismo, transformará información de mercado, datos de audiencia y resultados de campañas en propuestas de valor y narrativas comerciales que respondan a las necesidades de marcas y agencias, fortalezcan la venta consultiva y aceleren el desarrollo de nuevos negocios.


Sobre ti

Buscamos a una persona con visión estratégica y sólida orientación a resultados, capaz de combinar análisis comercial, excelencia operativa y conocimiento del ecosistema de publicidad digital y streaming. Deberá contar con experiencia en la optimización de procesos comerciales, análisis de indicadores, gestión de proyectos transversales y desarrollo de propuestas de valor para clientes estratégicos.

Será fundamental su capacidad para traducir información compleja en recomendaciones accionables, influir en equipos multidisciplinarios y facilitar la adopción de nuevas soluciones comerciales, manteniendo el enfoque en la generación de ingresos, la experiencia del anunciante y la eficiencia del negocio.


Requisitos:

  • Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Ingeniería, Economía o carreras afines.
  • Inglés avanzado.
  • Entre 7 y 10 años de experiencia en estrategia comercial, Sales Operations, Sales Planning o Sales Enablement, preferentemente en medios digitales, AdTech, streaming (OTT/CTV) o empresas de tecnología.
  • Experiencia desarrollando estrategias comerciales, presentaciones ejecutivas, pitches consultivos y propuestas de valor para clientes estratégicos.
  • Dominio de indicadores comerciales, análisis de pipeline, forecasting y elaboración de tableros de control.
  • Experiencia en administración y optimización de CRM, preferentemente Salesforce.
  • Conocimiento de modelos de monetización publicitaria digital, compra programática y estrategias basadas en datos de primera mano (1P).
  • Experiencia coordinando procesos comerciales y administrativos con áreas de Finanzas, Legal, Crédito, Cobranza y Facturación.
  • Habilidad para liderar proyectos transversales, negociar con distintas áreas y resolver problemas de manera estructurada.

Será un plus:

  • Experiencia en empresas globales de tecnología, redes sociales o plataformas de streaming.
  • Conocimiento de Connected TV (CTV), AdTech, live streaming, commerce media y formatos publicitarios interactivos.
  • Experiencia en metodologías de medición publicitaria, atribución, Brand Lift Studies, Marketing Mix Modeling y análisis de ROI.

Tu día a día

  • Diseñar e implementar estrategias y procesos comerciales que impulsen la productividad del equipo de Ad Sales y el crecimiento de los ingresos publicitarios.
  • Coordinar con Producto, Innovación, Finanzas, Legal, Crédito, Facturación y Ad Operations la habilitación integral de nuevos productos y formatos publicitarios, desde su implementación operativa hasta su monetización.
  • Desarrollar narrativas comerciales y propuestas consultivas basadas en datos de mercado, audiencias y objetivos de negocio, atendiendo las necesidades específicas de marcas y agencias.
  • Establecer y dar seguimiento a los procesos de forecasting semanal, mensual y trimestral, identificando riesgos, oportunidades y desviaciones en las proyecciones comerciales.
  • Crear y actualizar presentaciones comerciales, casos de éxito, materiales de venta y playbooks que fortalezcan la efectividad de la fuerza comercial.
  • Diseñar y monitorear tableros de indicadores clave, incluyendo conversión de oportunidades, ticket promedio, velocidad del pipeline, retención de anunciantes y productividad comercial.
  • Administrar y optimizar las herramientas de CRM, definiendo lineamientos de uso, calidad de datos, automatización y seguimiento de oportunidades comerciales.
  • Impulsar la capacitación continua del equipo de ventas en tendencias de publicidad digital, streaming, AdTech, compra programática, uso de datos y venta consultiva.
  • Acompañar al equipo comercial en presentaciones, negociaciones y oportunidades estratégicas con anunciantes y agencias clave, desarrollando soluciones alineadas con sus objetivos de negocio.
  • Colaborar con los equipos comerciales y de medición para interpretar resultados de campañas, demostrar el retorno de inversión publicitaria e identificar oportunidades de renovación y crecimiento de cuentas.

Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision promovemos un entorno de trabajo colaborativo e inclusivo, con oportunidades para desarrollar tu talento, participar en proyectos de innovación y contribuir al crecimiento de nuestro ecosistema de medios y entretenimiento.

Los beneficios específicos se comunicarán conforme a las condiciones aplicables a la posición.


Inclusión

En TelevisaUnivision estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y la construcción de un entorno inclusivo en el que las personas puedan desarrollar su talento y contribuir con sus perspectivas, experiencias y habilidades. Todas las candidaturas serán consideradas conforme a los requisitos del puesto, sin distinción por características personales protegidas por la legislación aplicable.

 

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
SOBRE EL PUESTO Y EL EQUIPO

En TelevisaUnivision, somos la empresa líder mundial de medios de comunicación en español,

llegando a millones de consumidores a través de plataformas digitales, streaming, redes

sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos expandiendo

nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, estamos realizando importantes inversiones en

tecnología, datos e innovación para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a nuestros suscriptores e

impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio a largo plazo.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de

datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de

reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en

decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto,

Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision.

El Senior Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave en el diseño, desarrollo e implementación

de nuestra plataforma de datos para streaming. Será responsable de gestionar integralmente

pipelines de datos en producción, desde la ingesta en tiempo real hasta la transformación de

datos estructurados y preparados para su análisis. Asimismo, colaborará con los equipos de

Ciencia de Datos, Analítica y Producto para comprender sus necesidades de información y llevar

las iniciativas hasta su implementación.

El candidato ideal combina sólidos conocimientos técnicos con una mentalidad colaborativa,

pasión por resolver desafíos complejos relacionados con los datos y compromiso con la entrega

de soluciones de alta calidad a gran escala.


SOBRE TI

Eres un profesional de Ingeniería de Datos que se desenvuelve con éxito en entornos dinámicos

y colaborativos, y disfruta transformando datos complejos en información de valor para el

negocio.

Cuentas con:

• Amplia experiencia en plataformas modernas de datos en la nube, especialmente

Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud

Composer.

• Dominio avanzado de Python, SQL y frameworks de transformación de datos como dbt.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos a gran escala, tanto por lotes

(batch) como en tiempo real (streaming).

• Experiencia trabajando con sistemas distribuidos a gran escala y tecnologías de Big Data,

incluyendo Spark y Hadoop.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones

escalables y eficientes.

• Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera

efectiva.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con

equipos técnicos y no técnicos.

• Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de

conocimientos.


RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA

Desarrollo de la plataforma de datos

• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos por lotes (batch) escalables,

confiables y eficientes utilizando Airflow (Cloud Composer), Python, SQL y dbt.

• Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de ingesta de datos en tiempo real que permitan

transferir datos de eventos desde Pub/Sub hacia Cloud Storage y BigQuery mediante

Dataflow.

• Desarrollar y optimizar modelos dimensionales de datos y flujos de trabajo dentro del

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse) para respaldar iniciativas de reportes,

analítica, Machine Learning y Producto.

• Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las

pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción.

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el

ecosistema.

Colaboración multifuncional

• Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de

Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones

técnicas.

• Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo

de la plataforma.

• Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de

procesos y eficiencia operativa.

Rendimiento y optimización

• Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el

rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas

y almacenamiento en BigQuery.

• Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la

plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes.

• Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e

integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

Liderazgo y contribución al equipo

• Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica,

revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos.

• Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de

ingeniería.

• Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de

Datos de alto desempeño.


REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA

Experiencia y habilidades requeridas

• Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de

Información o un campo técnico relacionado.

• Más de 7 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de

Big Data.

• Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo y gestión integral de pipelines de datos de nivel

productivo, desde su diseño hasta su operación.

• Amplia experiencia con Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Cloud

Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud Composer. También se considerará experiencia con

AWS.

• Experiencia con herramientas de orquestación de flujos de trabajo y transformación de

datos, como Airflow y dbt.

• Experiencia en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos en tiempo real o casi en tiempo real.

• Sólido conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de almacenamiento de datos (data

warehousing), incluyendo modelado relacional y dimensional.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Sólido conocimiento de frameworks de procesamiento distribuido de datos, incluyendo

Spark.

• Fuertes habilidades analíticas, de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas.

Requisitos deseables

• Experiencia brindando soporte a flujos de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de

Datos.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de observabilidad de datos, frameworks de calidad de

datos y prácticas de integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

• Experiencia trabajando en organizaciones de suscripción, medios de comunicación,

plataformas de streaming o productos digitales.


REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México.

• Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

At TelevisaUnivision, we are the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of consumers across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear television, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing heavily in technology, data, and innovation to deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and drive long-term business growth.

 

The Data Engineering team designs, builds, and operates the high-volume, high-velocity data pipelines that power ViX, including playback and engagement events, subscription data, advertising data, and the analytics data warehouse that turns them into business decisions. The team works closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics teams across TelevisaUnivision.

 

The Senior Data Engineer will play a key role in the design, development, and deployment of our streaming data platform. You will own production data pipelines end to end, from real-time ingestion through modeled, analytics-ready data, and partner with data science, analytics, and product teams to understand their data needs and drive initiatives to completion.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset, a passion for solving complex data challenges, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions at scale.


ABOUT YOU:

You are a data engineering professional who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and enjoys transforming complex data into actionable business value.

 

You bring:

·       Deep expertise in modern cloud-based data platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer

·       Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and data transformation frameworks such as dbt

·       Hands-on experience building both batch and real-time (streaming) data pipelines at scale

·       Experience working with large-scale distributed systems and big data technologies, including Spark and Hadoop

·       Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform

·       Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable and efficient solutions

·       Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

·       Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across technical and non-technical teams

·       A continuous improvement mindset and passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing

 

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (Responsibilities)

Data Platform Development

·       Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient batch data pipelines using Airflow (Cloud Composer), Python, SQL, and dbt

·       Build and maintain real-time ingestion pipelines that land event data from Pub/Sub into Cloud Storage and BigQuery using Dataflow

·       Build and optimize dimensional data models and workflows in the analytics data warehouse to support reporting, analytics, machine learning, and product initiatives

·       Own assigned pipelines end to end, from design and development through testing, deployment, and production support

·       Ensure data quality, integrity, security, and availability across the data ecosystem


Cross-Functional Collaboration

·       Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

·       Contribute to data architecture discussions and long-term platform strategy

·       Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies


Performance & Optimization

·       Optimize data storage, processing, and orchestration for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, including BigQuery query and storage costs

·       Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data pipeline and platform issues, and contribute to incident reviews

·       Implement best practices for data governance, observability, testing, and CI/CD


Leadership & Team Contribution

·       Mentor and support junior data engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

·       Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering best practices

·       Participate in technical interviews and help grow a high-performing data engineering team

 

YOU HAVE: (Qualifications, Experience)

Required Experience & Skills

·       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field

·       7+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments

·       Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL

·       Hands-on experience building and owning production-grade, end-to-end data pipelines

·       Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer; AWS experience will also be considered

·       Experience with workflow orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow and dbt

·       Experience building real-time or near-real-time data pipelines

·       Strong understanding of data warehousing best practices, including relational and dimensional modeling

·       Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Pulumi or Terraform

·       Solid understanding of distributed data processing frameworks, including Spark

·       Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities

Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience supporting machine learning and data science workflows

·       Familiarity with data observability, data quality frameworks, and CI/CD practices

·       Experience working within subscription-based, media, streaming, or digital product organizations

 

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States
  • Employment/education will be verified

·       Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

 

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO, tuition reimbursement, wellness and employee support programs, 401(k), and life and other insurance plans.

This is in addition to a comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage options.


TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Senior Video Streaming Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. We continue to expand our global footprint through our flagship streaming platform, ViX.

The Engineering team is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the infrastructure that powers high-quality video streaming experiences for millions of users worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of site reliability engineering, DevOps, and media workflows, with a strong focus on video delivery systems and streaming technologies.

You will play a critical role in architecting and evolving our media infrastructure, leveraging both open-source and proprietary technologies to support live and on-demand streaming at scale.

 

ABOUT YOU:

You bring deep expertise in building and scaling media and streaming infrastructure. You are passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and have a strong understanding of video streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and modern DevOps practices.

You thrive in highly technical environments, enjoy working across teams, and are motivated to build resilient, high-performance systems that deliver seamless playback experiences to global audiences.


YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

·       Design, architect, and implement scalable streaming infrastructure using both open-source and proprietary technologies

·       Build and optimize systems including:

o   Video transcoding pipelines

o   Just-in-time (JIT) packaging

o   Rights and entitlements management systems

o   CDN caching strategies for VOD and live streaming delivery

o   Server-side ad insertion (SSAI)

o   Service mesh architectures (Envoy)

·       Develop and manage cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code across platforms such as GCP and AWS

·       Build, operate, and scale containerized media workflows on Kubernetes

·       Leverage serverless technologies including edge compute, Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions

·       Define and implement high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery strategies aligned with SLAs

·       Manage automation and orchestration platforms supporting production services

 

YOU HAVE: (Qualifications, Experience)

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript or Rust
  • Advanced expertise designing, deploying, and operating systems on Kubernetes
  • Experience implementing Envoy within complex microservices architectures
  • Proficiency in CDN configuration and optimization, including VCL scripting (e.g., Fastly)
  • Deep knowledge of streaming protocols and formats, including:
    • HLS, DASH, CMAF
    • Low-latency streaming (LL-HLS, LL-DASH)
  • Experience with ad stitching and dynamic ad insertion, including integrations with Google Ad Manager (GAM)
  • Hands-on experience implementing and managing DRM systems, including:
    • SPEKE v1/v2
    • FairPlay, Widevine, PlayReady
