job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Application Delivery
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The Developer Platforms mission at The New York Times builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and paved paths that help product teams ship high‑quality experiences quickly and safely. Our Application Delivery team owns the shared software delivery platform (CI/CD, artifact management) and deployment workflows used by hundreds of engineers across News, Cooking, Games and Audio to ship software.

As the Times leans into AI‑assisted and agentic development, Application Delivery is where those changes become real. You will set the technical direction for how AI‑generated and agent‑driven change flows safely, observably, and at scale through CI/CD.

You'll help teams reduce release risk with modern deployment patterns, and turn effective delivery practices into reusable pipelines and templates that scale across the organization, much like our GenAI platform roles turn internal practices into reusable tools and agents. When you improve this platform, you change how The New York Times ships software.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the DevEx Application Delivery team. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical direction of software delivery as a shared product: shape paved paths in our shared platform that improve code health, release quality, and delivery speed for product teams.

  • Set the technical direction for agent‑ready delivery: design the policy, guardrails, and paved paths that turn AI‑generated and agent‑driven changes (migrations, test generation, pipeline maintenance) into safe, observable releases at scale by partnering with our Developer AI team.

  • Collaborate with Product, engineering leaders, and internal users to shape the roadmap for the delivery platform and bring measurable impact on quality and speed.

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and observable software delivery systems and workflows that improve reliability, and overall software quality and velocity.

  • Champion engineering excellence in delivery by setting best practices for testing, deployment strategies, progressive delivery, and observability that are easy to adopt through the platform.

  • Mentor engineers across the mission, contribute to hiring, and help foster an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture centered on shared platforms and high‑quality software delivery.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our mission and values and a commitment to our purpose to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience building the technical strategy and driving software delivery (Github Actions, Argo CD or equivalent CI/CD systems) or similar platform work with broad organizational impact beyond operations.

  • Experience building and scaling a platform as a product for internal engineers with multi-tenancy serving many teams through self‑service paved paths, with attention to adoption, backward compatibility, and isolation/guardrails between tenants

  • Demonstrated proficiency in building and maintaining production services in one or more general‑purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or Java), including code review and debugging complex issues.

  • 5+ years of experience with containers, Kubernetes, package management tools(Helm or equivalent), IAC tools(Terraform or equivalent), Gitops‑based deployment workflows and cloud services such as AWS, GCP.

The Publishing group at The New York Times builds and maintains the content management system powering all Times platforms. We empower engineering teams to evolve digital experiences while providing creators with interconnected tools to uphold our journalistic mission.

The Content Data Products team governs the centralized, compliance-cleared platform for all Times content data. Partnering closely with the New AI Products and Platforms (NAPP) team—whose Discovery Engine (search, knowledge graph, and AI) relies on our infrastructure—we ensure our rich archive is ingested, structured, attributed, and indexed across all brands (News, Cooking, Wirecutter, The Athletic, Games) and multimedia formats (articles, video, interactives).

We are looking for a Technical Product Manager II to lead our content data warehouse roadmap and its feeding pipelines. Reporting to the Senior TPM for NAPP, you will partner with engineering to bring product strategy across editorial, AI, and partner requirements.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

Responsibilities:

  • Roadmap Execution: Lead the strategy and delivery for the content data warehouse and ingestion pipelines for new content types and metadata enrichment.

  • Data Modeling & Indexing: Define specifications for modeling, ingesting, and indexing new content formats (e.g., video, interactives, acquired brand content) for search, retrieval, and AI use cases.

  • Catalog Optimization: Partner with operations, legal, and teams to audit archival structures, address metadata gaps, and improve catalog completeness.

  • Collaboration: Gather requirements, establish data contracts, prioritize features, and communicate roadmap progress and risks across engineering, design, editorial, and leadership.

  • Product Delivery: Guide the end-to-end product development lifecycle from concept to launch with high quality.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical product management with a focus on content data and platform infrastructure.

  • 3+ years of experience launching complex software products in close partnership with engineering teams.

  • Demonstrated experience with unstructured or multimedia data ingestion pipelines and downstream integrations (e.g., search indexes, analytics, ML/AI systems).

  • Experience navigating ambiguous spaces, conduct research, define technical requirements, and experience communicating complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, Journalism, or equivalent experience.

  • Familiarity with search/retrieval systems and how structured metadata powers search engines and AI capabilities.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational database architecture, and schema auditing.

The Data Platform mission is to help us use data to answer important questions, power user experiences, and inform strategic decisions.

The New York Times is looking for a Technical Product Manager II to shape product direction for Data Platform's Compute and Storage team. The team builds shared compute engines, lakehouse storage, and connective infrastructure so engineers can publish and own data products without managing the underlying platform.

You will partner with engineering, machine learning, analytics, and others across the company to deliver reliable, scalable, easy-to-use capabilities. You will make data infrastructure more accessible and efficient through reusable products for diverse workloads.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters in Times Square, with an expectation of working onsite 3+ days per week. You will report to the Technical Product Director of Data Platforms.

job.title: Vice President, Government Affairs
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is seeking an experienced leader to direct its government relations and public policy strategy. This role serves as the primary lead for policy and legislative matters, heading engagement with U.S. policymakers and regulators, as well as state and international officials as needed, on issues affecting the company. In this position, you will drive the design and execution of the public policy agenda, managing external resources to protect and advance the company’s interests. The position reports to the Chief Legal Officer and the Chief Communications and Brand Officer.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters or Washington, D.C. office, with some travel required. You can typically expect to come into the office three days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Shape and oversee the company’s government affairs and public policy strategy in coordination with leadership, legal, communications, and commercial teams to support long-term priorities.
  • Represent the company on U.S. legislative, regulatory, and other policy matters and champion issues facing a global news organization.
  • Track and analyze relevant legislative, policy, and regulatory developments, providing timely briefings and recommendations to leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Formulate clear policy positions and propose, draft, and advocate for legislation, regulatory guidance, and policy frameworks.
  • Build and maintain relationships with lawmakers, congressional staff, federal, state, local, and international officials, interest groups, and other key contacts. 
  • Manage and direct the activities of external lobbying firms and public affairs consultants to maximize performance and accountability and achieve agreed-upon objectives. 
  • Lead the company's participation in industry coalitions, trade associations, and external groups, including providing support to senior executives representing the company on those bodies, while driving coalition-building and stakeholder engagement to champion key issues.
  • Partner with internal legal, communications, and commercial teams, securing alignment between policy responses and legal positions, communications strategies and commercial efforts; lead timely cross-functional responses to specific matters where necessary.
  • Advise on international policy strategies to navigate evolving regulatory environments in non-U.S. markets.
  • Oversee compliance with local, state, federal, and international lobbying disclosure rules, registrations, and reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrate support for and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of experience in government relations or legislative advocacy.
  • Experience working with federal and state legislative and regulatory processes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Communications, Economics, or a related field.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to concisely summarize complex issues and policies to create effective advocacy points and strategies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of policy issues relevant to a global news organization, including press freedom, intellectual property, data privacy laws, and market competition.
  • Experience selecting and managing external lobbying firms, public affairs consultants, and outside counsel.
  • A network of relationships with lawmakers, legislative staff, interest groups, and industry peers.

As part of the Commercial Business and Legal Affairs team and reporting to the SVP, Associate General Counsel & Strategic Partnerships, the Vice President, Head of Privacy (Privacy, Cyber Security, Consumer Compliance) is responsible for all legal aspects of data privacy, information security, and consumer marketing and subscriptions-related compliance across the company and for managing the Company's privacy compliance function. You will work closely with senior executives and operational leads as well as the working team, including the areas of marketing operations, subscription growth, product, engineering, technology, data governance, information security, commercial contracts, and marketing and advertising technology. In this position, you will manage a team. 

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Advise all internal clients on the risks and operational controls related to the development, collection, use, transfer, and governance of personal data of consumers, employees, and other stakeholders. This will include privacy, online safety, and cybersecurity (from both U.S. and international perspectives). 

  • Advise key business stakeholders on the company’s data governance, cybersecurity, marketing and subscriptions compliance efforts in a manner consistent with the Company’s goals and culture.

  • Drive measurable improvements in privacy program maturity, incident readiness, vendor governance, compliant product launches, and privacy risk reduction. Manage privacy program resourcing, vendor support, and outside counsel engagement for privacy matters, as applicable.

  • Draft and/or update privacy program-related policies and standards, public-facing and internal; as well as terms of use, terms of sale, and other consumer-facing acceptable use and moderation policies.

  • Supervise and oversee the preparation and updating of Data Protection Impact Assessments and other risk assessment and audit activities as needed. Conduct comprehensive business risk assessments; develop/implement risk mitigation and corrective action plans where needed.

  • Advise on privacy regulatory and contractual compliance in marketing, ad sales, direct and programmatic advertising, identity resolution, data clean rooms, and third-party data and ad tech integrations to help ensure compliance with privacy and consumer protection laws and industry standards.

  • Review, draft and negotiate data protection agreements and security exhibits and work closely with the appropriate teams to advise on third party risk reviews. 

  • Advise on all relevant consumer protection, subscriptions and marketing laws, regulations and best practices.

  • Provide product counseling to include privacy, cybersecurity and consumer compliance legal advice as well as other areas of related legal need – in connection with product and platform developments and releases. 

  • Regularly track and counsel clients on legal US and international developments in areas of data privacy, cybersecurity and consumer marketing and subscription compliance.

  • Serve as legal lead for all security incident response, working closely with the company’s Chief Information Security Officer and other key stakeholders; draft and update information security policies and procedures.

  • Provide advice and guidance to data science and analytics teams on privacy-compliant deployment of machine learning models and personalization.

  • Oversee and develop company-wide training strategy and execution for areas of coverage.

  • Serve as point of contact for data protection authorities, regulatory inquiries, and industry groups.

  • Excellent judgment and professional integrity.

  • Handle high-volume workload efficiently.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor is required and must be a member of the New York Bar.

  • 15+ years of experience in US and international data privacy and protection; negotiating data privacy-related agreements, building, implementing, and maintaining a global privacy program; supporting cybersecurity. 

  • 5+ years of experience managing people with proven experience effectively managing cross-functional relationships and competing priorities.

  • 5+ years of previous in-house experience.

  • Experience advising on online safety laws such as age-appropriate design codes and app store age signals laws, and sensitive data privacy regulations such as laws governing health data in ad tech and biometric privacy.

  • Experience advising or managing legal professionals who advise on a wide variety of consumer-related issues both domestic and international, including payflow, subscription offerings, marketing, auto-renewal and click-to-cancel laws, anti-spam, Telephone Consumer Protection Act, unfair and deceptive practice laws, customer care complaints and escalations, and payment card rules.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in-house experience at a tech platform, media company, and/or subscription-first company.

job.title: Video Journalist, International
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. The New York Times International desk is looking for a Video Journalist to produce and edit stories with multimedia correspondents. You will join a team tasked with creating new approaches to our international reporting in video, working with a growing group of foreign correspondents who work in video as well as text.

The goal is to help our audience understand the world through powerful video stories, reaching our core audience as well as new viewers who increasingly consume journalism in video. We will experiment with a mix of direct, immersive vertical video forms that can bring our audience with us on the ground.

You will join a multi-disciplinary team of video journalists that will shape this work. This role is based in our New York office, working remotely with correspondents in the field to produce, edit and publish stories. You should have a refined understanding of video production and storytelling, including video editing, shooting and writing for narration, with a clear sense for how to creatively use graphics and animation to illustrate complex ideas. 

Your news judgement about what makes a good story in video will be crucial, as will creative ideas for how to reenvision the basic elements of foreign correspondence, across news, features and analysis. You must be an effective collaborator and a strong communicator who can work closely with regional editors and video colleagues to shape our approach to this coverage.

This position is based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. 

Responsibilities:

  • Write, produce, edit and publish videos with hybrid correspondents, in close partnership with regional editors.
  • Devise new approaches to digital video storytelling both on and off platform.
  • Work with correspondents to create a playbook for how to cover a region or beat in video.
  • Collaborate closely with International editors, correspondents and video colleagues.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • The role reports to the Senior Producer, International in New York.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of video storytelling, video editing and production experience at a news organization.
  • A strong portfolio, preferably of inventive short-form video.
  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.
  • Broad knowledge of current events and news.
  • Deep curiosity about video habits and users and platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in the trenches of production, including editing, shooting and field production.
  • The ability to edit quickly and accurately with Adobe Premiere. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience covering international news. 
  • Foreign language fluency.
  • Strong experience with archival research, including sourcing and clearing user-generated video content.
  • Fluency with animation and motion graphics as an integral part of your script writing process.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage field crews and hire and manage freelancers when necessary.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and adapt to change within an unpredictable news and production environment.
  • A record of working with teams of journalists in difficult field assignments.
  • High creative standards and a drive to push work to its best possible form.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

job.title: Video Journalist, Reporter Video
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is an industry leader in visual journalism with reporting that includes extraordinary news coverage, investigations, and culture and lifestyle reporting. The Reporter Video team identifies compelling stories and brings the depth and breadth of our news report onto our site and other platforms through video that features the expertise of our world-class journalists.

This is a role for someone who wants to produce, edit and publish short-form vertical videos daily and is versatile enough to work on news, features, enterprise and investigative projects with colleagues across the newsroom. You have expertise in video storytelling, including video editing and writing creatively to visuals, as well as a sharp sense of the digital landscape. 

Your portfolio and work samples should reveal a strong grasp of modern mobile video storytelling, and it should show that you’re a quick learner with creative ideas and the ability to work on small or large teams. You are solid technically, ideas-oriented and have solid news judgment. Cinematography skills are an added asset. We’re looking for someone who excels on deadlines and has experience juggling multiple projects at any given time. 

This is an in-office position based in London and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Write, produce, edit and publish short-form vertical videos every day.
  • Help to identify breaking news and enterprise across our news report and create video that features the expertise of our journalists, whether working with reporters on camera or using voiceover or visual storytelling techniques including graphics and animation.
  • Write visually rich scripts with an emphasis on visual takeaways.
  • Experiment with various forms of short-form vertical video storytelling. 
  • Collaborate with visual editors to generate video formats that bring our best journalism to new audiences.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to a Senior Producer for Reporter Video in London.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Proven experience with video storytelling, video editing and production experience at a news organization.
  • Excellent news judgment and proven ability to work with colleagues and reporters to synthesize newsgathering and/or investigations into a tight, informative and engaging video.
  • Experience producing shoots and interviewing experts on camera.
  • Experience creating original videos that intelligently incorporate audio, video, still images and text.
  • Strong video editing skills with Adobe Premiere.
  • Facility in using photo, video, audio, graphics and animation in storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Thorough knowledge of global current events particularly in Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
  • Able to meet deadlines and adapt to change within an unpredictable news and production environment
  • Design and animation skills including experience with design and animation software (Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects).
  • Experience working collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Available to work a flexible schedule.

In your cover letter, include links to three videos from your work that best reflect the kind of reporter video work you could see The New York Times making. For each video, briefly describe your role in producing it, what you think worked particularly well, and what you would improve or approach differently. 

Applications without links to video portfolios/work samples will not be considered.

Job Requirements The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. The Growth Marketing team is tasked with driving new subscriber acquisition & driving Disney Streaming’s profitability business objectives for ESPN DTC and The Disney Bundle. The team is responsible for the planning, execution, and optimization of user acquisition and performance marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate has a passion for the digital media landscape and understands the intricacies and unique attributes of every step in the marketing funnel. The successful candidate will bring a highly analytical, creative, and flexible growth mindset to the role, which will be critical to deliver breakthrough thinking for this channel. We are seeking a collaborative and results-driven Specialist, Programmatic Media (ESPN) to support paid acquisition and performance marketing initiatives for ESPN's Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business, including ESPN DTC, bundle, and sport-specific add-on offerings. Reporting to the Manager, Paid Media (ESPN), this role will help execute Programmatic media strategies that drive subscriber growth across ESPN's streaming products while ensuring campaigns are delivered efficiently and effectively. The Specialist will support day-to-day campaign planning, activation, optimization, and performance analysis of Programmatic media, partnering closely with cross-functional teams including Brand Marketing, Awareness Marketing, Creative, and external media partners. This role will support campaign execution around key live sports moments, identify optimization opportunities, and share performance insights with the team to support acquisition efficiency and business outcomes. What Sets This Role Apart Opportunity to shape the growth strategy for one of the world’s most iconic sports brands. Contribute to subscriber growth for ESPN’s streaming products. Gain exposure to a unique blend of performance marketing, innovation, and live sports activation.

Responsibilities

and Duties of the Role: Support team in executing, and optimizing both programmatic and digital media growth strategies to drive ESPN DTC subscriber acquisition, conversion & efficiency Contribute to media strategy and help manage a portfolio within existing programmatic and digital channels (i.e. display, native, video, audio, etc.) Execute campaign and optimization strategies for programmatic and/or digital media campaigns around live sports to meet or exceed strict direct response goals Monitor campaign performance and pacing, identify opportunities for budget optimization, and share findings with the team to support a positive return on marketing spend Research, evaluate, and test new programmatic and/or digital media opportunities that will move the business forward from a direct response perspective Support day-to-day relationships with DSPs, publishers with Auction capabilities, SSPs, and data partners Support the development and testing of new audience segments, including retargeting, lookalikes, custom audiences, etc., ensuring documented results Collaborate cross-channel, with larger marketing teams, to align on performance trends to ensure holistic team success Coordinate with agency counterparts on day-to-day tasks, helping ensure work is distributed appropriately to meet team deadlines Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic working environment, supporting live sports & key tentpole events with a proven large-scale media property Minimum

experience

job.title: Account Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Account Specialist with a strong SaaS background who can independently manage a large customer portfolio, drive retention strategies, and identify growth opportunities. This role is best suited for candidates with experience handling high-volume customer portfolios and a proven track record in renewals, retention, and upsell motions within a B2B SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing customer renewals and identifying upsell opportunities within an assigned territory and customer portfolio.
  • Engaging customers through the most effective virtual sales channels.
  • Understanding customer needs and positioning appropriate solutions to drive retention and growth.
  • Supporting the development and execution of territory growth strategies.
  • Leveraging product knowledge to identify opportunities and collaborating with Sales Specialists when deeper expertise is required.
  • Managing customer relationships throughout the renewal lifecycle and mitigating churn risks.
  • Using Salesforce and data-driven insights to progress opportunities and achieve revenue targets.
  • Nurturing existing customer relationships and driving expansion opportunities across non-named accounts.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to deliver customer value and commercial outcomes.

Required Qualifications

You are an ideal fit for the Account Specialist role if your experience includes:

  • 3-5 years of experience managing SaaS customer accounts, renewals, retention, and upsell motions within a subscription-based business model.
  • Experience managing a high-volume portfolio of customer accounts and consistently achieving renewal and revenue targets.
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, contract renewals, churn mitigation, and account growth strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage customer relationships across multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce to manage opportunities and customer portfolios.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Spanish.
  • Customer-centric approach with a focus on retention, adoption, and value realization.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage a large book of business in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills with a track record of driving renewals and identifying growth opportunities.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks and opportunities across a customer portfolio.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing portfolios of 300+ customer accounts.
  • Experience handling renewal and retention motions within B2B SaaS organizations.
  • Experience managing $2M+ ARR portfolios or similarly sized books of business.
  • Experience within Legal Technology, Risk, Compliance, Financial Technology, Information Services, or other B2B SaaS industries.
  • Consistent track record of exceeding renewal, retention, and upsell targets.
  • Experience working with executive stakeholders and complex customer environments.

      ​Compensation: Base salary and a variable compensation that is directly related to your success.

        To apply, please upload your updated resume in English.

        Location: CDMX

        #LI-JA1

         

         


        What’s in it For You?

        • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
        • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
        • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
        • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
        • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
        • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
        • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

         

         

        About Us

        Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

        We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

        As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

        We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

        Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

        More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

job.title: Accounting Technical Specialist with Portuguese
job.description:
Job Description

This opening is within the Content team, developing and maintaining global financial statement templates on our ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting software, which currently supports compliance in over 40 countries. You will work primarily with the UK and Polish teams, and with the wider global Product and Content teams, with a focus on Portuguese-language financial statements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the development of reporting templates used by clients to create their financial statements in Portuguese
  • Assist in maintaining existing reporting templates so they comply with accounting regulations in different countries
  • Push templates to the web version and identify any issues that will affect clients
  • Conduct testing to verify content accuracy and software functionality, including testing of reporting templates and systems testing of the platform to ensure quality standards, development protocols, and requirements are met; document findings and help drive fixes
  • Assist in the preparation of release documentation including release notes, client and internal communications
  • Support internal stakeholders and Customer Support with research of client enquiries; gather feedback from the Support and Professional Services teams

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or other numerical qualifications (or equivalent overseas qualification)
  • Fluent Portuguese and English
  • Good technical skills
  • Strong attention to detail; knowledge of financial reporting
  • Clear written and verbal communication; receptive to feedback
  • Works well in teams, shares information, and follows through on commitments, including independently and within a team spread across the world

Preferred Qualifications

  • Introductory familiarity with tax and accounting research tools and AI-driven platforms; eager to learn new tools
  • Basic experience with tax and accounting compliance software (e.g., ONESOURCE or similar local tools) a plus
  • Foundational knowledge of data formats/structures (e.g., CSV, XML, SQL, XBRL, JSON) is helpful
  • Knowledge of any other language would be a plus



#LI-AB3

 

 


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

job.title: Analyst - Global Trade Content
job.description:
Job Description:

The Analyst – Global Trade Content is responsible for the accurate compilation, maintenance, validation, and quality assurance of global trade regulatory content. This role supports regulatory research, tariff content management, data analysis, standardization, product support, and documentation activities to ensure trade content is accurate, timely, and compliant with internal standards. The analyst is also expected to actively utilize AI and digital tools to improve productivity, accuracy, consistency, and content quality while adhering to company governance and data privacy requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conducts comprehensive research and analysis to interpret and update global trade regulations from official government sources.
  • Monitors official sources for assigned tariffs and promptly delivers accurate updates into internal systems.
  • Converts regulatory updates into standardized or system-compatible formats for loading.
  • Analyzes customer or internal inquiries related to assigned tariffs and provides well-researched, accurate responses in a timely manner.
  • Identifies reliable contacts and official data sources for assigned countries and establishes effective working relationships.
  • Documents processes, procedures, and work instructions according to established guidelines and templates.
  • Identifies and reports bugs in standard files and systems and assists in testing new features and improvements through the ADO process.
  • Supports project management tasks including data collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Uses AI and digital tools daily to support research, comparison, validation, formatting, content updates, and efficiency improvements.
  • HS nomenclature, classification rules, explanatory notes.
  • Tariff schedules and regulatory interpretation related to HS.
  • HS related data validation includes HS codes, Description, UOM charges, controls, regulations, additional codes, etc.
  • Data Extraction, Validation and analysis of the HS tariffs content data.
  • Shift Timings: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (IST).
  • Work from office for 2-3 days in a week (Mandatory)

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Trade, Business, Economics, Information Science, or a related field.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledge of Harmonized System (HS) and Customs regulations.
  • Knowledge in import and export operations.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Ability to independently gather, analyze, and interpret trade data.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel.
  • AI-enabled productivity and research tools.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a professional or academic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with data extraction, transformation, validation, and content management processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and regulatory content.
  • Strong documentation and process improvement skills.

job.title: Associate Lead Software Engineer
job.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer I, you will lead the development of complex software systems, focusing on delivering high-quality solutions while leveraging your experience to enhance functionality. This role requires experience with distributed systems design, data modeling, database optimization and the ability to evaluate AI tools for specific use cases. You'll manage technical debt effectively while designing scalable microservices.

  • We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of complex, large-scale solutions using .NET, Azure, React JS and Microservices architecture. You will own end-to-end delivery for key products or programs, driving technical strategy, architecture, and execution.

  • In this role, you will solve ambiguous, high-impact problems, define design approaches, and ensure high-quality delivery aligned with business goals. You will lead multiple cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and establish best practices in coding, design patterns, and system design. Additionally, you will drive innovation by leveraging emerging technologies, including AI/ML and Generative AI, while ensuring scalability, security, and operational excellence.

    Backend - C# (C Sharp), DotNet (.Net), Backend MicroServices, Azure or Amazon Services (Service Bus, KeyVault) , Kubernetes, Docker

    Front End - JavaScript, Angular or React JS, HTML, SCSS

job.title: Associate Lead Software Engineer -C#, .net, Angular
job.description:
Associate Lead Software Engineer (.NET, Angular, Oracle, PostgreSQL) – ONESOURCE Tax Provision

Thomson Reuters is seeking an experienced Associate Lead Software Engineer with expertise in .NET, Angular, Oracle, and PostgreSQL to join our dynamic team developing the next generation of the ONESOURCE Tax Provision application suite. Our engineering team is composed of professionals from diverse backgrounds, all driven by a commitment to building exceptional software that delivers measurable value and enhances customer satisfaction.

As an Associate Lead Software Engineer, you will be responsible for contributing to the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable and robust solutions leveraging the Microsoft .NET framework, Angular for front-end development, and Oracle and PostgreSQL for data management. Your passion for engineering excellence, focus on delivering high-quality software, and dedication to continuous improvement will be key to our success. You will embrace an AI-First, agentic approach throughout the software development lifecycle, demonstrating adaptability and strong problem-solving skills in an ever-evolving environment.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to define project objectives, specify development activities, and ensure the timely delivery of key milestones. Your excellent communication skills will enable you to effectively articulate the strategic value of engineering solutions and align technical initiatives with business objectives.

About ONESOURCE Tax Provision

ONESOURCE Tax Provision is a comprehensive software suite designed to automate and streamline the corporate income tax provision process. The platform simplifies complex tax compliance by ensuring adherence to evolving regulations, optimizing workflows, and reducing the risks and costs associated with financial reporting. Seamlessly integrating with existing ERP systems, ONESOURCE automates tax calculations, journal entries, and data management, while providing real-time visibility into the tax provision process. By leveraging current regulatory content and advanced analytics, ONESOURCE empowers organizations to enhance operational efficiency, mitigate compliance risks, and accelerate financial close in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.


About the Role

As an Associate Lead Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in the development and enhancement of our ONESOURCE Tax Provision application suite. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and developing high-quality software applications in collaboration with a geographically distributed team, following industry best practices.
  • Applying expert knowledge of software development methodologies to architect and build complex, scalable SaaS solutions.
  • Driving key technical decisions related to platform architecture, coding standards, and implementation strategies.
  • Contributing throughout the Agile development lifecycle, including design, programming, testing, documentation, quality assurance, and deployment.
  • Leading code reviews to uphold coding standards and provide constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Mentoring and guiding junior team members, fostering adherence to best practices and supporting their professional growth.
  • Accurately estimating development efforts and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements and participate in application design.
  • Providing technical leadership and guidance to management, helping to define and shape the technical roadmap for new product development.
  • Dedicating time to innovation, exploring new technologies, tools, or projects that align with your areas of interest and expertise.

About You

You are an Associate Lead Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience across multiple programming languages and technologies, demonstrating the ability to quickly adapt and master new tools and frameworks. You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, bringing strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality, scalable software solutions. Your qualifications include:

Technical Expertise

  • Extensive experience in software development, with proficiency in .NET development (C#, VB.NET).
  • Expertise in responsive front-end and single-page application development using Angular.
  • Strong knowledge of REST API design and development, including experience with documentation tools such as Swagger and Postman.
  • Hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
  • Familiarity with DataDog for observability, application performance monitoring (APM), and real user monitoring (RUM).
  • Proven experience in cloud-native development using AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with agentic AI-First development tools and processes, leveraging AI to enhance workflows and operations.
  • Solid understanding of application security, encompassing both web services and web application security.
  • Lead-level expertise in design patterns and N-Tier architecture for scalable enterprise applications.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with a track record of resolving complex technical issues.

Preferred Skills

  • Comprehensive knowledge of object-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, and core computer science principles.
  • Proven ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • Experience translating business requirements into analytics solutions and data visualizations.
  • Advocacy for code quality, maintainability, and scalability, ensuring long-term success of software solutions.
  • A drive for innovation and a commitment to continuous improvement in development processes.
  • Energetic self-starter who thrives in collaborative team environments and communicates daily progress and blockers effectively.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to make sound decisions and resolve conflicts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to articulate technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • A Customer First mindset, focusing on delivering Outcomes over Output that drive business value.

job.title: Associate Picture Editor, Global Pictures Desk (fixed-term)
job.description:
Job Description

Reuters is looking for an enthusiastic journalist with advanced English and a sharp eye for detail who can effortlessly sift through the thousands of photos our photographers shoot every day. 

 

You will join our global team editing the news pictures service, which is mainly based at our centre in Gdańsk, Poland. In your role you will contribute to the daily picture file. 

 

Our Global Pictures Desk team ensures the quality, accuracy and speed of delivery of news pictures to our clients worldwide. We have a dynamic newsroom including video, text, and graphics journalists which collaborate to produce a compelling professional news product unavailable anywhere else. And we are the first to know the news. 

 

This is a hybrid, fixed-term role based in Gdańsk, Poland. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Gather images sent in from editors and photographers from around the globe. 
  • Research and edit photos and photo captions, writing captions in English quickly and accurately so photos can be delivered to our global clients. 
  • Maintain close operational links between pictures, text, video and online operations to guarantee integrated news coverage and production. 
  • Live edit many major news, sport and entertainment events. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Fluent English 
  • Professional experience and general interest in photography and journalism in a junior position. 
  • A love for both news and news photography and a strong, up-to-date knowledge of current affairs. 
  • Competent working knowledge of Apple computers and Adobe Photoshop. 
  • Sound news and pictures judgment and an ability to spot a breaking story. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills while working under time pressure. 
  • Willingness to work as part of a global 24/7 rotating shift system, including weekends and public holidays, with occasional night shifts. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Any additional language would be an asset.

#LI-KA1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.

job.title: Content Author
job.description:
Content Author


Job Description

The Content Author is an entry point into the content team's career path, combining hands-on content authorship with full ownership of the content production process. This role analyzes source material from multiple resources and writes, edits, and updates clear, accurate, customer-facing content, while also performing the technical production tasks — coding, copyreading, merging, rendering, loading, and validating — needed to move that content through the team's systems and into publication. The Content Author works under the guidance of more senior team members while building independent proficiency in the team's content, processes, and systems, with the goal of taking on progressively broader responsibility over time. Specific product knowledge is not required at entry; the role is designed around generalizable content and systems skills that apply across the team's product portfolio.


Key Responsibilities 

  • Read source material from multiple places and write, edit, and update content so it's clear and correct, with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Handle the full content production process in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): coding, copyreading, editing, merging, DITA formatting, and checking content. 
  • Turn confusing, incomplete, or mixed-up source material into clear, well-organized content for customers. 
  • Take ownership of your own content's accuracy and completeness; work independently on familiar tasks and ask for help on harder ones. 
  • Spot routine content problems, fix what you can, and know when to ask for help on anything unclear. 
  • Meet deadlines by managing your own workload and working well with teammates. 
  • Help test and review content to make sure it works and reads well across different formats. 
  • Suggest small process improvements when you spot them. 
  • Leverage strong product knowledge to enhance our workflow and content, for strategic products. 
  • Learn the team's content, systems, and tools, and pick up general product knowledge over time. 

Required Qualifications

  • Process-oriented: comfortable following and improving structured, multi-step content workflows. 
  • Attention to detail: consistently accurate, complete, and quality-checked work. 
  • Strong writing skills: clear, well-organized, professional writing across content types. 
  • Strong sense of voice: able to write and edit in a consistent, appropriate tone and style. 
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity: works effectively from incomplete, conflicting, or multi-source information and knows when to escalate. 
  • General product knowledge: comfortable learning new product context quickly; deep expertise in any single product is not required at entry. 
  • Works successfully in a team environment and understands team member roles. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to AI-assisted content tools or workflows. 
  • Familiarity with knowledge maps or other structured-content models. 
  • Basic content or data analytics skills. 
  • Experience with DITA or other structured-authoring frameworks. 
  • Experience working in a component content management system (CCMS). 
  • Broader content creation experience (e.g., digital, consumer-facing, or SEO-oriented content). 
  • Strong product knowledge in a strategic product area.

Job Description

Are you passionate about the chance to bring your extensive technical experience to manage development team through complex, full life cycle implementation in a world class company? The Corporate and Commercial Engineering Organization within Thomson Reuters is looking to add a strong CPQ Lead Solution Engineer to a well-established global engineering team. This position requires someone who is a passionate about technology, a strong team player, and is comfortable working with a variety of people and technology stacks. This is a chance to get in and make an impact transforming the way our customers interact with us as we shape the next generation of an enterprise-wide experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the Engineering strategy, planning, design, and implementation of Conga configure, price and quote (CPQ), Conga Turbo Price, Conga Digital Commerce, and PROS Pricing solutions.  
  • Provide technical leadership by establishing best practices, enforcing quality standards, conducting code reviews, and mentoring team members to drive high performance.
  • Lead technical research, prototyping, and solution evaluation to recommend optimal tools and architectures, while staying current with updates in Salesforce and Conga.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, technical leads, architects, and third parties to deliver solutions.

job.title: Director, Medium Law Firms GTM Strategy & Operations
job.description:
Job Description


The Director of GTM Strategy & Operations, MidLaw, will be responsible for driving the go-to-market (GTM) strategy and operations for the Mid Law customer segment. This role will involve developing and executing scalable initiatives that drive overall productivity and growth of the business.  It involves overseeing channel planning and strategy, partnerships & alliances, sales technology utilization, enablement, professional development, and ensure alignment with our overall business objectives.


Key Responsibilities


  • Mid-Law Customer Success & Gen AI: Lead initiatives to enhance customer success and leverage generative AI technologies
  • Partnership & Alliances: Build and maintain strategic partnerships and alliances
  • Customer Lifecycle Mapping: Map out customer lifecycles to identify key touchpoints and opportunities for engagement
  • Channel Planning & GTM Strategy: Develop and execute channel planning and GTM strategies to drive business growth
  • Channel Enablement + Professional Development: Ensure that all channels are equipped with the necessary tools and resources to succeed
  • Key Initiative Management & Impact Measurement: Oversee key initiatives and measure their impact on business objectives
  • GTM Systems, Technology, Operational Efficiency: Optimize GTM systems, technology, and operational efficiency
  • Competitive Analysis: Conduct competitive analysis to identify market trends and opportunities
  • Market & Customer Research/Insights: Lead market and customer research initiatives, including the State of Small Law Survey and thought leadership efforts

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s - or minimum of 8 years of professional experience required
  • 3+ years in a role requiring an analytical skillset and experience deriving insights from data
  • 2+ years of direct or indirect leadership experience
  • Experience presenting to executive audiences
  • Experience working in a cross-functional team with the ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders at an appropriate level (incl. senior-level relationships) 

Preferred Qualifications


  • Adept in working with large and complex data sets and combining data from disparate sources

job.title: Front-End Lead Software Engineer, Reuters
job.description:
Job Description

Lead the front-end engineering direction for Reuters’ content platform as we modernize and scale the products that reach billions of people every day. You will set architectural direction, unblock the team on complex problems, and drive a shift-left quality culture in partnership with Quality Engineering. This is a senior technical leadership role with real influence over how one of the world’s most trusted news organizations builds for its professional audience.


Reuters employs over 2,700 journalists across nearly 200 locations and delivers real-time text, images, and video in more than 20 languages. You will work within the front-end engineering team on Reuters.com and its mobile apps, bridging technical and business requirements across product, design, and engineering, and representing front-end engineering to cross-functional stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own architectural decisions for the front-end platform, balancing user experience, performance, and complexity, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Lead solution design reviews for new and existing features, and drive engineering standards and best practices across the team.
  • Mentor senior and junior engineers, and unblock the team on complex technical problems across the front-end codebase.
  • Partner with Quality Engineering to embed automated testing earlier in the development lifecycle, making testability a first-class consideration in design and code review.
  • Build automated quality gates into the CI/CD pipeline so regressions are caught before they reach production.
  • Root-cause and resolve production issues affecting the front-end platform, and participate in a DevOps on-call rotation.
  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted development tools for code generation, code review, and test generation to improve team velocity and code quality.

Required Qualifications

Education and experience

  • 10+ years building highly scalable, customer-facing front-end applications, including experience leading engineering teams

Technical skills

  • TypeScript and modern JavaScript — Advanced
  • React — Expert
  • HTML5/CSS3 — Expert
  • RESTful APIs — Advanced
  • AWS — Intermediate to Advanced
  • Git version control and CI/CD pipelines
  • Docker containerization
  • Automated testing frameworks: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright
  • Performance optimization and security best practices

Core competencies

  • Technical leadership and mentorship: guiding senior and junior engineers and setting standards the team adopts
  • Quality ownership: championing shift-left testing and automated quality gates alongside Quality Engineering
  • Stakeholder communication: presenting technical solutions and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Independent judgment under ambiguity: making sound architectural decisions with incomplete information
  • Production problem-solving: root-causing issues quickly and reducing technical debt over time

Preferred Qualifications

Additional experience and technical skills

  • Next.js or other SSR/SSG frameworks
  • GraphQL
  • Microfrontends architecture
  • Familiarity with the team’s broader stack: AngularJS and Tailwind (front end); Java with Spring Boot and TypeScript with AWS Lambda (back end); MongoDB and Amazon Aurora (data); AWS, including AWS Elemental Services (cloud)
  • Experience with video technologies

job.title: Jovem Aprendiz
job.description:
Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Aprendiz em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!
 
A Thomson Reuters combina a inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões confiantes e administrar melhor seus negócios.
Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.
 

Job Description

Estamos em busca de um(a) Aprendiz para atuar na área de Suporte, integrando nosso time de atendimento voltado às áreas fiscal, contábil e de folha de pagamento. Nesta posição, você terá a oportunidade de desenvolver conhecimentos profissionais, apoiar clientes e usuários por meio de atendimento telefônico e adquirir experiência em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Prestar suporte aos clientes e usuários por meio de atendimento telefônico.
  • Auxiliar no esclarecimento de dúvidas relacionadas aos processos fiscal, contábil e de folha de pagamento.
  • Registrar e acompanhar solicitações de suporte conforme os procedimentos da área.
  • Colaborar com a equipe para garantir a qualidade e eficiência no atendimento.
  • Apoiar atividades administrativas relacionadas à área de suporte.

Required Qualifications

  • Ensino médio completo ou cursando.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido, das 09h30 às 15h30 (1 dia por semana em curso teórico, 1 dia por semana em home office, 3 dias por semana presenciais).

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint).
  • Conhecimentos básicos de informática.

#LI-GG1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

Além disso, oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiências e para aquelas com crenças religiosas sinceras, conforme a legislação vigente. Você pode encontrar mais informações sobre como solicitar uma adaptação aqui.

Descubra como se proteger de anúncios de emprego fraudulentos aqui. Para obter mais informações sobre a Thomson Reuters, visite nosso site em thomsonreuters.com

job.title: Key Account Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Are you an experienced Enterprise sales professional looking to grow your career with a leading technology company? Join Thomson Reuters as a Key Account Manager and help drive growth by building strategic relationships and connecting customers with solutions that address complex Tax and Global Trade challenges.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing Enterprise accounts, building a strong sales pipeline, identifying new business opportunities, and managing complex sales cycles with senior decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute territory plans to generate a strong pipeline across Enterprise accounts and drive large, complex deals.
  • Proactively prospect and identify new business opportunities while building strong relationships with senior decision-makers, including C-level executives and leaders across Tax, Finance, Supply Chain, and Technology.
  • Lead consultative customer conversations to identify Tax, compliance, and Global Trade opportunities and connect customer needs with Thomson Reuters solutions.
  • Educate customers on topics such as tax reform, regulatory compliance, and tax-related risks, helping them understand relevant business impacts and opportunities.
  • Manage complex sales cycles involving Solutions teams, partners, global stakeholders, and international contracts.
  • Maintain strong CRM discipline, accurate forecasting, effective pipeline governance, and high-quality opportunity management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and share market and customer insights to continuously strengthen the commercial strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Solid experience in consultative B2B Enterprise sales, preferably within software, ERP, technology solutions, or complex services.
  • Experience with solutions, processes, or customer environments related to Tax, Tax Compliance, Global Trade Management (GTM), special tax regimes, or trade operations.
  • Strong resilience, discipline, and energy, with the ability to perform effectively in a highly proactive sales and prospecting environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, autonomy, executive presence, and excellent communication skills.
  • Experience selling complex technology or SaaS solutions to large Enterprise customers.
  • Experience engaging with C-level executives and senior stakeholders across Tax, Finance, Supply Chain, or Technology functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Thomson Reuters Solutions or related solutions

#LI-TG1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
