job.title: Lead AI Forward Engineer
job.description:
The Lead AI Forward Engineer designs and guides the delivery of AI-powered solutions that reduce operational toil and accelerate technology teams across the CIO organization. This role operates as a forward-deployed solution architect and engineer, partnering closely with teams to identify opportunities, design end-to-end architectures, and drive implementations to production.
 

You will own solution design from concept through deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and extensible. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, define repeatable patterns, and help build new capabilities through hands-on implementation, mentorship, and shared standards.

About the role:

Solution Architecture and Delivery

  • Identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI automation and intelligent agents across CIO technology teams.
  • Design end-to-end AI solutions, including workflows, integration patterns, data flows, and operational considerations.
  • Guide implementation from prototype to production, ensuring solutions meet reliability, security, and compliance expectations.
  • Define reusable architectural patterns and reference designs to enable broader adoption across teams.
  • Build scalable pipelines to collect and analyze inference‑ and workflow‑level telemetry, integrating with TR's data backbone.
  • Develop dashboards and reports providing clear visibility into performance, reliability, safety, and cost.
  • Ensure compliance with TR's AI standards for monitoring, governance, privacy, and auditability.

AI System Design and Technology Strategy

  • Evaluate and recommend AI/ML technologies and platforms (LLM orchestration, agentic frameworks, cloud AI services) based on capability, cost, risk, and fit.
  • Design flexible architectures that can evolve with model/provider changes and emerging AI capabilities.
  • Apply sound judgment on when AI is appropriate vs. when simpler automation or traditional engineering approaches are better.
  • Establish and track SLOs/SLIs for critical AI services to meet enterprise reliability and compliance requirements.
  • Integrate AI observability tooling into CI/CD so new models, prompts, and workflows are automatically enrolled in monitoring and evaluation.
  • Develop automated guardrails and policy enforcement (e.g., limits, anomaly detection, abuse/failure pattern detection) with cloud engineering and security teams.

Cross Functional Partnership and Influence

  • Partner with engineering teams, service owners, and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical requirements and solution designs.
  • Communicate trade-offs and design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership when needed.
  • Mentor engineers and share patterns, practices, and lessons learned to raise overall AI solution design maturity.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science and AI teams to design and run evaluation frameworks for LLMs/ML models (offline/online tests, benchmarks, canaries, A/B experiments).
  • Work with Product, Data Science, AI Inference Engineering, and Enterprise AI teams to onboard new AI use cases into the observability platform from day one.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Engineers (AWS, Azure and GCP) and SREs to align AI observability with broader platform observability and capacity management.
  • Support scaling and monitoring of AI infrastructure and workloads during major releases and global events.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Strong solution design/architecture capability: end-to-end system design, integration patterns, API thinking, and operational design.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML and LLM application patterns, including:
    • LLM capabilities/limitations, prompt design, orchestration approaches, and agent workflows
    • Practical trade-offs (latency, quality, cost, safety, reliability)
    • Production AI systems and observability challenges (prompting, context windows, RAG, hallucinations, provider variability).
  • Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and ability to prototype and validate designs with hands-on technical work.
  • Cloud architecture familiarity in AWS, Azure, or GCP, including common service patterns and enterprise constraints.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, CI/CD, and cloud‑native architectures.
  • Strong communication skills: ability to document designs, influence decisions, and align diverse stakeholders.

About you:

Preferred Background

  • 10+ years of experience with progression in solution architecture, technical strategy, or senior engineering roles.
  • Experience building software prototypes and taking solutions to production in ambiguous, low-precedent environments.
  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks and patterns (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), RAG/vector search concepts, and enterprise integration considerations.
  • Experience with DevOps/Platform Engineering/SRE principles and designing for operational excellence.
  • Exposure to enterprise service management (e.g., ServiceNow/ITSM), security architecture, and compliance-oriented environments.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, architectural governance, or cross-team enablement.

#LI-SS5


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. job.title: Legal Innovation Advisor- Corporates
job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is building a new senior advisory function to serve our most strategic corporate accounts. The Legal Innovation Advisor is a client-facing role operating at the intersection of AI strategy, technology transformation, and in-house professional services. This person engages senior department leadership to help them think through how AI changes the way their legal, tax, and compliance functions operate — and works across the full client lifecycle from pre-sale through post-sale to ensure Thomson Reuters is positioned as an indispensable strategic partner.

Strong candidates may come from senior roles inside corporate legal or tax departments, law firms with substantial corporate practices, or accounting and advisory organizations. The role is not about product demos or adoption metrics — it is about executive relationships and strategic counsel at the department leadership level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior executive advisor for a portfolio of strategic corporate accounts, engaging department leadership — General Counsel, VP of Legal Operations, Chief Tax Officer, or equivalent — on AI strategy, transformation roadmap, and operating model design.
  • Build trusted, peer-level relationships with corporate leadership that give Thomson Reuters a seat at the table when strategic technology decisions are being made.
  • Partner with the Account Executive across the full sales and relationship lifecycle — from pre-sale and close through post-sale — providing the executive credibility and strategic altitude that enables the broader account team to operate more effectively.
  • Develop and deliver a clear, informed point of view on how AI is reshaping in-house legal and tax functions — specific enough for a GC staff meeting, grounded enough for a skeptical CFO.
  • Partner and maintain dotted line relationships to Product Organization to deeply understand our product roadmap, feature development and upcoming launches to best articulate back to customers.   
  • Surface executive-level insight back to TR product and business leadership on where corporate departments are investing, what is blocking AI adoption, and what senior leaders need from their technology partners.
  • Represent Thomson Reuters at senior corporate legal, legal ops, and tax industry forums, client roundtables, and executive events.

Required Qualifications

  • A background as a senior technology, legal operations, innovation, or transformation leader inside a major corporation, law firm, or professional services organization
  • 10–20 years of career experience, with meaningful time inside an organization that mirrors the clients you will serve.
  • Practical understanding of how corporate decision-making works — how to build buy-in across legal, finance, IT, and business leadership, and where technology transformation stalls.
  • A grounded point of view on how AI changes in-house legal and tax staffing, vendor strategy, compliance obligations, and service delivery — developed through direct experience.
  • Familiarity with relevant Thomson Reuters products — CoCounsel, Practical Law, Westlaw, HighQ — and how they fit into a broader enterprise technology environment.
  • Ability to operate credibly with department leadership without a commercial agenda — you will not carry a quota, but your relationships will directly influence retention and growth.
  • Executive communication skills: effective one-on-one with a skeptical General Counsel and equally effective in a governance or technology committee setting.
  • Collaborative by nature — you will work alongside CSMs, Solutions Consultants, AI Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Professional Services, each owning a distinct part of the client relationship.

job.title: Manager, Software Development Engineering- Search & IR
job.description:
Manager, Software Engineering 

Content Tools • CoCounsel Agent Context 

 

Overview of the Role 

CoCounsel Agent Context is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to lead the engineering team responsible for building, operating, and evolving Thomson Reuters’ Content Tools platform. Content Tools are the purpose-built APIs and capabilities that give AI agents precise, reliable access to TR’s most valuable legal content — including case law, statutes, regulations, citations, and Practical Law materials. These tools are mission-critical infrastructure: the bridge between TR’s authoritative content assets and the AI-powered products — such as CoCounsel Legal — that depend on them. 

 

The Manager owns the full engineering lifecycle for Content Tools: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations. Equally important, this leader will navigate a distributed development model in which tools are built and contributed by multiple teams across the organization. The Manager is responsible for establishing governance, design standards, and contribution workflows that keep the ecosystem coherent as it grows — while serving as the primary engineering accountability point for tool quality, reliability, and developer experience. 

 

This is a people and technical leadership role managing a team of 8 engineers. The successful candidate brings strong platform thinking, a collaborative leadership style, and deep credibility in building API-first systems — with the technical depth to engage in architecture, system design, and engineering reviews, and to contribute directly to delivery where appropriate. Experience in domains where information quality and retrieval precision carry high stakes is strongly preferred. 

About the Role 

In this position, you will provide: 

 

Tool Engineering & Technical Leadership 

  • Own the end-to-end engineering roadmap for Content Tools — spanning tool design and implementation, CLI and SDK exposure, CI/CD pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, and cloud operations — balancing new capability delivery with rigorous quality and reliability standards 
  • Work alongside the team on delivery by engaging deeply in architecture and system design, participating in technical reviews, and making targeted hands-on engineering contributions when they materially advance delivery or unblock the team. 
  • Drive an API-first, contract-driven approach to tool development: every tool ships with a versioned CLI contract, schema, and clear ownership metadata that makes it discoverable and usable by consuming teams without direct engineering involvement 
  • Establish and enforce the patterns, templates, and contribution standards that allow distributed teams to build and contribute tools consistently — including review workflows, quality gates, namespace governance, and guidance on when to create new tools versus extend existing ones 
  • Lead the build-out of the information retrieval (IR) evaluation framework, ensuring every tool is validated against representative datasets before release and that performance regressions are caught automatically in CI/CD 
  • Champion full-stack operational ownership: the team defines, builds, tests, deploys, and operates what it ships — including on-call rotations, SLO definitions, incident response, and health monitoring for production tool services 
  • Partner closely with TR Labs and CoCounsel Engineering teams to ensure content tools meet the interface requirements of agentic workflows — covering tool invocation patterns, result provenance, and citation handling 
  • Oversee platform infrastructure, including cloud services (AWS), observability tooling, rate limiting, caching strategies, and multi-tenant access controls that protect licensed content 

 

Distributed Development Governance 

  • Serve as the engineering accountability point for the Content Tools ecosystem as a whole — not just the tools your team builds directly, but the standards and guardrails that govern contributions from partner teams across the organization 
  • Define and maintain contribution workflows, architectural review criteria, and consistency checks that prevent capability duplication and ensure interoperability across a growing tool catalog 
  • Manage tool lifecycle policies, including deprecation, migration support, versioning strategies, and breaking-change processes — communicating proactively with consuming teams to minimize disruption 
  • Build and maintain a centralized tool registry with machine-readable descriptions, usage guidance, and performance characteristics — making the tool ecosystem discoverable and self-service for agent developers 
  • Establish shared development infrastructure — common libraries, boilerplate generators, mock services, and local development environments — that makes it easy for any team to build tools correctly 

 

Team Management 

  • Build and lead a team of 8 software engineers (including Senior and Staff levels), managing hiring, onboarding, performance, and professional development with a focus on deep technical ownership 
  • Develop engineers who combine strong software fundamentals with domain fluency in information retrieval, content APIs, and agentic system design — engineers who are proud to own their work from first commit to production dashboard 
  • Foster a culture of empowered ownership where engineers have the autonomy to define problems, the authority to make sound technical calls, and the accountability to carry work through to reliable production operations 
  • Translate complex content technology concepts for non-technical stakeholders — making the value and trade-offs of Content Tools investments legible to product managers, business leaders, and partner teams 
  • Model and reinforce AI-assisted development as a team norm: more than 50% of code written with AI assistance is the target, not a stretch goal 

 

Strategic Delivery 

  • Define and maintain engineering processes for a team that both builds shared tool infrastructure and delivers production content capabilities — ensuring rigorous testing, code review, and continuous evaluation of tool quality through offline IR grading pipelines and online signals 
  • Establish platform health and developer experience benchmarks — including tool reliability SLOs, client onboarding time-to-value, IR evaluation pass rates, and tool invocation accuracy — and use them to drive continuous improvement 
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging tool protocols (including MCP support) and retrieval patterns, with a clear-eyed view of production-readiness and operational implications 
  • Cultivate strong working relationships with Labs, Product, and CoCounsel Engineering — engaging early in agentic workflow design to ensure content tools are shaped to the access patterns agents actually need 
  • Collaborate across the organization to align the Content Tools roadmap with business priorities in CoCounsel Legal Next, Westlaw, and the broader TR product portfolio 

About You 

You’re an ideal fit if you have: 

 

Required Experience 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 
  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or engineering management role 
  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating API-first systems consumed by multiple teams, with a product mindset toward developer experience and internal customer satisfaction 
  • Proficiency in Python and strong software engineering fundamentals, API design, testing strategy (unit, integration, and IR/evaluation), and CI/CD practices 
  • Demonstrated technical depth in complex systems, including the ability to decompose designs, reason through alternatives and trade-offs, ask incisive questions, and influence sound technical decisions in partnership with Senior and Staff engineers, architects, and scientists. 
  • Experience building and governing shared platform infrastructure in a distributed development model — including contribution standards, versioning policies, and cross-team coordination 
  • Strong working knowledge of information retrieval concepts — including precision/recall trade-offs, hybrid search, citation networks, and document retrieval patterns — sufficient to make sound architectural decisions and partner effectively with scientists, together with demonstrated ability to deepen expertise rapidly in adjacent domains such as agentic systems and evaluation frameworks. 
  • Proven ability to lead teams that own their production systems end-to-end, including on-call responsibilities, SLO management, and incident response 
  • Strong leadership skills: experience in agile methodologies, excellent communication, and the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, and science teams 
  • Awareness of AI ethics, content licensing considerations, and responsible deployment of retrieval systems 

 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience building tools or APIs for agentic AI systems, including familiarity with tool protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar 
  • Background in legal technology, knowledge management, or other high-stakes information retrieval domains where provenance, accuracy, and entitlement enforcement are critical 
  • Hands-on experience with search and retrieval infrastructure (e.g., Elasticsearch, Vespa, OpenSearch) and the trade-offs between semantic and structured search 
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for retrieval systems, including dataset design, IR metrics (Precision, Recall, NDCG, etc.), and CI/CD integration of quality gates 
  • Familiarity with content access control, policy-based entitlements, and licensing enforcement in multi-tenant environments 
  • Experience operationalizing tooling for LLM-powered workflows, including prompt engineering, tool description design, and agent invocation patterns 

What Success Looks Like 

In the first 90 days: 

  • Develop a thorough understanding of the current Content Tools architecture, tool inventory, CI/CD pipelines, IR evaluation infrastructure, and the most pressing gaps in quality, reliability, and developer experience 
  • Establish strong working relationships with CoCounsel Engineering, Product, and TR Labs teams — understanding each stakeholder’s priorities and pain points firsthand 
  • Complete any open hiring on the team, making high-quality decisions that strengthen technical depth and cultural fit 
  • Identify and begin addressing the highest-leverage near-term improvements to contribution governance, delivery friction, and operational posture 

In the first year: 

  • Lead the team through a major platform milestone — a significant expansion of the tool catalog, delivery of a materially improved governance and contribution model, or an equivalent initiative — with strong technical execution and minimal disruption to consuming teams 
  • Grow the team into a high-performing engineering organization where full-stack ownership, constant shipping, and AI-assisted development are embedded habits 
  • Build a visible and trusted presence with the TR Labs team — participating actively in agentic workflow design discussions and establishing a reliable integration pathway from tool build to agent use 
  • Establish Content Tools as a trusted, well-documented, and measurably reliable internal platform — with partner teams able to build, contribute, and iterate on tools without requiring direct involvement from the Content Tools Engineering team 
  • Become a recognized technical and organizational leader within CoCounsel Agent Context — providing strategic input on tool ecosystem direction, influencing cross-team engineering standards, and developing the next generation of Senior and Staff engineers on the team

job.title: Marketing Analyst
job.description:
Marketing Analyst

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Marketing Analyst em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

A Thomson Reuters combina inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões com confiança e administrar melhor seus negócios.

Nós ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham. Nossa equipe reúne informação, inovação e insights para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, apoiando nossos clientes na tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Sobre a vaga / About The Role

Nesta oportunidade, como Marketing Analyst, você irá:

  • Gerenciar e executar estratégias de CRM com foco em relacionamento, engajamento e conversão de clientes e prospects.
  • Desenvolver jornadas de comunicação automatizadas para diferentes estágios do funil de marketing e vendas.
  • Criar, segmentar e administrar bases de leads, garantindo qualidade dos dados e eficiência das campanhas.
  • Planejar e executar campanhas de nutrição por canais como e-mail marketing, WhatsApp e outras plataformas digitais.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para aumentar a adoção de novos produtos, promover oportunidades de cross-sell e upsell e fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes.
  • Criar e acompanhar landing pages voltadas para conversão, trabalhando em parceria com equipes de conteúdo e design.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho das campanhas, identificando oportunidades de otimização e melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Marketing, Vendas e Produto para maximizar a geração de oportunidades de negócio.
  • Garantir a correta utilização das ferramentas de automação de marketing e CRM, mantendo a eficiência dos processos e fluxos de comunicação.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações com insights e recomendações baseadas em dados.

Sobre você / About You

Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as seguintes qualificações e experiências:

  • Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Publicidade, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em CRM, automação de marketing e gestão de bases de dados.
  • Vivência na criação e execução de campanhas de relacionamento e nutrição de leads.
  • Experiência com segmentação de público, construção de jornadas de comunicação e estratégias de conversão.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de automação de marketing, CRM e ferramentas de análise de resultados.
  • Experiência com campanhas de e-mail marketing e canais digitais de relacionamento, incluindo WhatsApp.
  • Diferencial: Vivência com estratégias de retenção, cross-sell e upsell.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, RD Station ou similares.

#LI-KN1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

Além disso, oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiências e para aquelas com crenças religiosas sinceras, conforme a legislação vigente. Você pode encontrar mais informações sobre como solicitar uma adaptação aqui.

job.title: Multimedia News Producer
job.description:
Job Description  

Are you passionate about breaking news and excited by the opportunity to reach millions of readers around the world in real time?  

The Digital Production Desk at Reuters in Bangalore is looking for a Multimedia News Producer to help curate, package and deliver the most important news to Reuters.com and media clients. Working at the heart of Reuters' global news operation, you will play a key role in bringing together text, video, photos and graphics to create compelling digital experiences for audiences worldwide.  

In this opportunity as a Multimedia News Producer , you will be part of the India digital desk in Bangalore, editing, localizing and publishing stories with relevant multimedia assets for Reuters.com and for media clients subscribing to our ready-to-publish products through Reuters Ready.  

Reuters is transforming how news is produced through AI-enabled workflows that help journalists discover, curate, package and deliver news more efficiently. Successful candidates will be expected to embrace AI-powered tools, contribute to newsroom innovation, and help shape the future of trusted journalism while maintaining Reuters' highest editorial standards.  

This is a 24/7 operation involving shift work and regular weekend coverage.   


Key Responsibilities  

As a Multimedia News Producer, you will:  

  • Act as a human-in-the-loop editor for AI-assisted production workflows, evaluating and refining AI-generated story packages, headlines, metadata and multimedia recommendations while ensuring compliance with Reuters editorial standards, ethics and governance requirements.  


  • Monitor Reuters text, photo and video services to identify misses, if any, and promote the most important and engaging stories for digital audiences.  


  • Collaborate with editors across Asia, Europe and the Americas to curate and design the Reuters homepage and other key landing pages.  


  • Proofread and quality-check social media posts, mobile alerts, Google panels, corrections and other digital publishing outputs.  


  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, speed and editorial judgment while operating in a fast-paced, real-time news environment.  


  • Contribute feedback on AI-enabled tools and workflows to support continuous improvement and innovation.   


Required Qualifications  

You're a fit for the role of Multimedia News Producer if your background includes:  

  • Degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, or a related field from a reputed university or institute.  


  • At least 3-4 years of experience in a news agency, newspaper, digital publisher or television newsroom.  


  • Strong news judgment and the ability to prioritize competing stories quickly and accurately.  


  • Excellent writing and editing skills.  


  • Knowledge of politics, business, economics, policy, markets, technology, sports, entertainment and global affairs.  


  • Experience working with multimedia content, including photos, video and digital storytelling formats.  


  • Experience working with digital publishing platforms, newsroom tools or content management systems.  


  • Demonstrated interest in AI-enabled newsroom workflows and a willingness to adopt emerging editorial technologies.  


  • Curiosity about how AI can improve newsroom efficiency and audience experiences, coupled with a commitment to continuous learning and experimentation.   


Preferred Qualifications  

  • Strong team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills.  


  • Ability to work quickly and accurately under deadline pressure.  


  • Comfortable working in an AI-augmented newsroom and leveraging approved AI tools to support editorial workflows.  


  • Understanding of the opportunities and risks of AI in journalism, including the importance of human oversight, source verification, accuracy and ethical use.  


  • Good understanding of digital publishing technologies, audience engagement and multimedia storytelling.  


  • Analyzing audience needs and deliver content that is relevant, engaging and valuable to Reuters' global digital audiences.  


#LI-BD1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

About Reuters

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.

 

 

About Thomson Reuters

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

job.title: Operations Analyst
job.description:
Job Description:


Reuters is looking for bright, detail-orientated people to join its team of operations analysts in Bangalore. You will be part of a global operations team that forms the backbone of Reuters news management. The global team provides critical support to ensure our news operations run smoothly; our stories are resourced appropriately; we have the right staff in the right places at the right time; and that our staff are safe throughout the world.  

As an operations analyst, you will provide critical support for a variety of functions including:

  • Freelancer and vendor management
  • Payment follow-ups
  • Procurement
  • Customer queries
  • News research
  • News planning assistance 

This is a great opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a new team that has made a real impact in freeing up resources across our news operation. You’ll need to be comfortable using spreadsheets and working diplomatically via email and phone to resolve problems and ensure our processes are running efficiently. An interest in news and an understanding of journalism is highly desirable as there will be opportunities to assist with updating news planning calendars, answering customer queries and helping journalists with database searches. You must be willing to work evening and overnight shifts.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist General Managers on freelancer contracts, vendor account setup and payments. Ensure timely follow through on unresolved issues
  • Track staff issues, including managing up-to-date headcount tracker and assisting on issues related to our contractor population.
  • Manage purchase orders using internal procurement tool, Ariba
  • Answer queries from Refinitiv customers about news stories
  • Update news planning calendars as required
  • Assist with news database searches 

 

Required Qualifications:

  • Max 1-2 years of experience into Business Operations, Operations role in a global environment
  • Good Command over Excel, Power BI knowledge is an added advantage
  • Ensure all reports are accurate, current and easily accessible when needed
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Willingness to work in rotational shifts, 24/5 operations (Mandate)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to use database search tools

job.title: Pentest Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description :

Thomson Reuters is seeking a Pentest Coordinator to support and coordinate penetration testing initiatives across the organization. This role combines project management, stakeholder coordination, and cybersecurity knowledge to ensure successful delivery of penetration testing activities. The successful candidate will manage multiple workstreams, collaborate with internal teams and external vendors, and drive process improvements through automation and AI-enabled solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and manage penetration testing projects from initiation through completion.
  • Define, track, and manage project timelines to ensure successful and timely delivery.
  • Communicate project schedules, milestones, risks, and progress updates to stakeholders.                                                    
  • Facilitate tracking of remediation activities for vulnerabilities discovered during penetration testing
  • Ensure required inputs and dependencies for penetration testing activities are provided on time.
  • Create and maintain project plans, status reports, meeting notes, risk logs, and project documentation.
  • Monitor project scope, budget, timelines, and resource utilization.
  • Facilitate meetings with internal stakeholders and external security vendors.
  • Gather and analyze business and technical requirements for security assessments.
  • Drive collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, and cross-functional teams.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and implement automation and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Support a remote-first, outcome-focused working environment across global time zones.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Total experience 4+ years 
  • 2+ years of experience in technical roles such as Penetration Testing, Application Security, Information Security, or Cybersecurity.
  • Experience coordinating projects, workstreams, or security initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and multitasking abilities.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and global teams.
  • Passion for automation, process optimization, and AI-driven innovation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in project management within cybersecurity or application security environments.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and Power Automate
  • Basic knowledge of Snowflake and Power BI.
  • Experience coordinating penetration testing engagements with third-party vendors.
  • Proven experience supporting distributed and remote teams.

job.title: Polling Correspondent
job.description:
Job Description:

Reuters is seeking a Polling Correspondent to join its global polling team, which produces market-leading forecasts and exclusive stories on economic and financial-market developments across 50 key economies. This is an exciting early-career opportunity for a journalist to turn insights from economists, analysts, polling data and fast-moving events into accurate, timely reporting used by market participants, LSEG clients and policymakers around the world.

Reporting to Hari Kishan, Editor In Charge, you will collaborate with colleagues across Reuters' globally distributed polling team. You will contribute to regular and ad hoc polls covering central-bank decisions, macroeconomic indicators, inflation, growth, unemployment, foreign exchange, bond yields and equity markets, while helping deliver high-quality journalism that informs a global audience.

Relocation support is available, but the role doesn’t require travel.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the planning, execution, and analysis of regular and ad hoc Reuters polls on macroeconomic trends, financial markets and central-bank policy, helping ensure timely and reliable results.

  • Monitor economic data releases, market-moving events, and central-bank decisions to identify timely polling opportunities and develop strong story angles.

  • Analyze poll findings alongside relevant economic and market developments to produce accurate, concise and insightful stories for Reuters' global audience.

  • Build and maintain professional relationships with economists, analysts and other relevant sources to strengthen Reuters' polling panels and reporting expertise.

  • Contribute ideas for survey questions, data-driven analysis and enterprise stories that maximize the value and impact of Reuters' exclusive poll results.

  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across locations and time zones to meet deadlines, support global coverage and maintain high editorial standards.

  • Use approved AI and digital tools to improve reporting workflows, data analysis, polling processes and storytelling while adhering to Reuters standards for accuracy and impartiality.

  • Editorial Judgment and Accuracy: Applies sound news judgment and handles economic, market and polling information with care, precision and impartiality.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in economics, journalism, or a related field, with one to two years of experience as a journalist, reporter or correspondent.

  • Strong writing, reporting and news judgment, with a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness and impartiality.

  • Interest in, or basic knowledge of, economics, financial markets and central-bank policy.

  • Microsoft Excel - Intermediate proficiency, including the ability to organize, analyze and interpret data using spreadsheets.

  • Comfort working with data and translating polling results, economic indicators and market developments into clear journalistic insights.

  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence engaging with economists, analysts and other professional sources.

  • Ability to manage competing deadlines, work effectively in a collaborative global environment and work the assigned rotational shift schedule.

  • Editorial Judgment and Accuracy: Applies sound news judgment and handles economic, market and polling information with care, precision and impartiality.

  • Analytical Thinking: Interprets data, poll results and market developments to identify meaningful trends and reporting opportunities.

  • Clear Communication: Produces concise, accessible stories and communicates professionally with sources and colleagues.

  • Collaboration and Global Mindset: Works effectively with colleagues across geographies, cultures and time zones.

  • Adaptability and Deadline Discipline: Responds effectively to breaking developments, changing priorities, rotational shifts and evolving newsroom tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience reporting on macroeconomics, financial markets and/or central-bank policy.

  • Prior experience conducting, supporting or analyzing polls, surveys or other structured data-collection projects

  • Python — Basic proficiency, particularly for data analysis, data cleaning or reporting-related workflows.

  • Familiarity with using AI-enabled tools responsibly to support research, data analysis, reporting or storytelling.

job.title: Product Manager, Compliance Products Government
job.description:
Product Manager, Compliance Products


Job Description:

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap for the trust, security, and compliance capabilities of our agentic AI platform. This is a high-visibility role for someone who has shipped SaaS products inside regulated environments and understands how compliance requirements — for example FedRAMP, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDRP and other privacy frameworks — translate into concrete product requirements, engineering work, and customer trust.


You must have real, hands-on experience delivering product features and roadmaps that satisfy compliance and audit requirements as a normal part of your development lifecycle. You'll work closely with engineering, security, legal, and customer-facing teams in a modern agile/CI-CD environment, translating regulatory and enterprise-customer requirements into a roadmap that keeps us shippable, auditable, and fast.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap for compliance-relevant capabilities of the platform, including identity, access control, audit logging, data residency, and secure deployment models.
  • Translate regulatory and framework requirements (FedRAMP, GDPR, IRAP, SOC 2, HIPAA, and others) into clear, actionable product and engineering requirements.
  • Partner with security and engineering teams to ensure compliance and security requirements are built into the development pipeline.
  • Work with security and infrastructure teams on requirements tied to FIPS 140-3 validated cryptography, TIC (Trusted Internet Connections) requirements, NIST 800-53 and other federal/government security mandates.
  • Support audit readiness requirements working with legal, security, and compliance teams to ensure the product can produce the evidence and controls auditors require.
  • Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that hold up under both engineering scrutiny and audit scrutiny.  Define success metrics for compliance-related features and report progress to leadership and ensure QA plans meet the needs of the regulations.
  • Prioritize a roadmap that balances enterprise/regulatory requirements against broader platform velocity and customer needs. Track evolving regulatory and industry requirements and proactively brings changes into the roadmap.
  • Partner with sales, customer success, and solutions engineering to support enterprise and government customer needs. 

Required Qualifications:

  • Product management experience in a SaaS environment, with a track record of owning and shipping product roadmaps.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, agentic systems, or platforms with autonomous decision-making components and the trust, safety, and governance requirements.
  • Experience developing products that need to comply with regulatory or industry frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC, and HIPAA. Deep expertise in any single framework is not required — what matters is experience embedding compliance requirements into product development as a routine deliverable.
  • Experience working in agile development environments with modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience partnering with security, legal, and compliance teams, and comfort operating in environments with formal audit cycles.
  • Strong technical fluency — able to have credible, detailed conversations with engineers about architecture, security controls, and infrastructure trade-offs.
  • Exceptional written communication skills; comfortable writing PRDs, and executive summaries alike.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align engineering, legal, security, sales, and executive stakeholders around a shared roadmap.
  • Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, in a fast-moving, progressive company culture.

Preferred Qualifications:

Prior experience supporting a FedRAMP ATO (Authority to Operate) process or similar government authorization process.

Experience with other compliance standards such as SOC, HIPAA, and data residency/sovereignty requirements in international markets.


#LI-DS4

job.title: Senior Manager, Change Management
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager, Change Management is responsible for leading change strategy and execution for large-scale strategic initiatives across Marketing & Communications, a 700+ person organization. This role designs and executes change strategies that drive adoption, readiness, and sustained behavior change across people, process, and technology transformations.

The Senior Manager partners closely with MarComm leaders, program teams, and functional and business stakeholders to assess change impacts, build stakeholder alignment, manage resistance, and enable successful delivery of initiatives. Success in this role depends on influencing without direct authority across a large, matrixed organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the change strategy and roadmap — develop and execute change approaches, translating business needs into clear change objectives, plans and measurable outcomes. 
  • Drive impact and readiness assessment — translate future-state process and technology designs into people/process/behavior impacts, run structured impact and readiness assessments by stakeholder group, and maintain an impact heat map across the 700+ person org. 
  • Own sponsorship and stakeholder alignment — build and run sponsor engagement plans, coach MCLT and senior leaders on visible sponsorship, act as trusted advisor on complex change, and align initiative leads on impacts and priorities across teams. 
  • Direct enablement and training strategy — deliver role-based training and job aids with enablement and training partners, keeping messaging consistent without overloading the business. 
  • Define and track change effectiveness — set adoption/usage/value-realization metrics and reporting routines that give leaders visibility into what's working and where to intervene. 
  • Embed change into PMO governance — make change risk and readiness a standing input to program reviews, with one methodology applied consistently across initiatives. 
  • Build reusable change infrastructure — playbooks, tools, and templates that drive consistency and efficiency across the org. 

Required Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years in change management or organizational effectiveness, ideally in marketing, communications, or creative operations
  • Proven track record owning change independently (not as part of a larger change team) at comparable scale
  • Executive-level stakeholder management; influence without authority across a large, distributed team

  • Prosci/CCMP certification preferred; strong process mapping and business-analysis skills

job.title: Senior Marketing Strategist
job.description:
Senior Marketing Strategist

Você busca impulsionar sua carreira em Marketing Estratégico em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

A Thomson Reuters combina inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam profissionais a tomar decisões com segurança e administrar melhor seus negócios. Nossa equipe conecta informação, inovação e insights para resolver desafios complexos nos mercados Jurídico, Tributário, Contábil e de Comércio Exterior, apoiando clientes em momentos críticos de tomada de decisão.

Sobre a Posição / About the Role

Nesta oportunidade, como Senior Marketing Strategist, você será responsável por desenvolver e executar estratégias de marketing que impulsionem o crescimento do negócio, fortaleçam a marca e gerem demanda qualificada para as nossas soluções. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Desenvolver estratégias de marketing alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio e às prioridades da organização.
  • Liderar iniciativas de geração de demanda, posicionamento de marca e crescimento de mercado.
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar campanhas multicanais com foco em aquisição, engajamento e retenção de clientes.
  • Analisar tendências de mercado, comportamento do consumidor e movimentações da concorrência para identificar oportunidades estratégicas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de Vendas, Produto, Customer Success e Comunicação para garantir alinhamento e maximizar resultados.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, ROI de campanhas e métricas de funil, propondo ações de otimização contínua.
  • Desenvolver planos de go-to-market para novos produtos, soluções e iniciativas estratégicas.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders internos e externos, influenciando decisões baseadas em dados e insights de mercado.
  • Promover os valores e comportamentos da Thomson Reuters no dia a dia.

Sobre Você / About You

Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as seguintes habilidades e experiências:

  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

job.title: Senior Polling Analyst
job.description:
Job Description:

Reuters is seeking a Senior Polling Analyst to help lead its global economic and financial-markets polling operation. This role turns complex survey data, market expectations and macroeconomic developments into timely, authoritative insights that inform Reuters journalism and support LSEG financial data clients, market participants and policymakers.

Working as part of Reuters' global polling team, you will lead and improve polls across approximately 50 key economies, covering central-bank policy, interest rates, inflation, growth, labour markets, currencies, bond yields and equities. You will collaborate with polling correspondents, editors and analysts across regions and time zones, while helping maintain the accuracy, independence and methodological rigour that underpin Reuters polls.

 

Relocation Support / Travel: Relocation support may be available in accordance with company policy. No travel is required for the role, but it involves working rotational shifts or hours aligned with global market and news cycles.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end Reuters polls covering macroeconomic indicators, central-bank policy and financial markets, from planning survey schedules and questions through data collection, validation, analysis and publication.
  • Analyse large current and historical datasets to identify shifts in economist and market expectations, forecast trends, outliers, consensus changes and longer-term developments across major economies.
  • Deliver clear, timely and actionable findings for Reuters news stories, market alerts, graphics and broader economic and financial-market coverage.
  • Use spreadsheets, Python and AI-enabled analytical workflows to improve data processing, automation, quality assurance, survey analysis and presentation of poll results.
  • Monitor market-moving developments—including economic releases, central-bank decisions and geopolitical or financial events—to identify timely polling opportunities and support editorial priorities.
  • Strengthen poll methodology and data quality by refining survey design, contributor management, validation processes and data-management practices, while upholding Reuters standards for accuracy, impartiality, sourcing and ethics.
  • Build and maintain relationships with economists, strategists and analysts, helping to broaden and diversify Reuters' poll contributor panels; provide quality control, project leadership and informal mentoring to junior colleagues where appropriate.

 

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in economics, finance, statistics, data science, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • At least two years of relevant experience in polling, financial journalism, economic research, market analysis, data analysis or a related field, ideally involving macroeconomic or financial-market data.
  • Strong working knowledge of macroeconomics, financial markets and central-bank policy, including interest rates, inflation, growth, labour-market indicators, currencies, bond markets and equities.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse complex and large datasets, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate findings into accurate, relevant and concise insights.
  • Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet-based analysis and structured-data management.
  • Working proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language for data analysis, automation and data-quality checks, including the ability to understand, adapt and use existing code.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work effectively across international teams and time zones, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced news and markets environment.

 

Core Competencies

  • Analytical judgement: Interprets complex economic, market and polling data accurately; distinguishes meaningful changes from noise or anomalies.
  • Accuracy and methodological rigour: Applies careful validation, strong attention to detail and sound judgement to protect data quality and editorial integrity.
  • Clear communication: Explains technical findings in concise, accessible language for journalists, financial professionals and other audiences.
  • Collaboration: Builds productive relationships with contributors, correspondents, editors and colleagues across functions, regions and time zones.
  • Ownership and adaptability: Takes initiative, manages multiple deadlines and responds effectively to fast-moving market and news developments.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience conducting, designing or managing surveys, polls or consensus forecasts involving economists, strategists, analysts or other expert contributors.
  • Experience in financial journalism, a newsroom, an economic-research institution, a central bank, a financial-services firm or a market-data provider.
  • Experience using Python data-analysis libraries and workflows for automation, data validation and visualization.
  • Familiarity with Reuters Editorial Handbook principles, or demonstrated commitment to impartiality, transparency, ethical data practices and editorial independence.



#LI-BD1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

About Reuters

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.

 

 

About Thomson Reuters

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
Summary:

We are seeking a strategic and technical Senior Product Manager to drive product market fit for CoCounsel, Tax, Audit & Accounting across corporate customers of all sizes, from global, large enterprises to mid-market and smaller corporate teams. The Senior Product Manager will be instrumental in identifying our biggest market opportunities across our Corporate customer base and shaping how a diverse range of corporate in-house teams leverage CoCounsel's platform to transform their tax, accounting, and financial reporting operations.

About the Role

  • Corporate Segment Focus: Define and execute the product strategy for CoCounsel Tax, Audit & Accounting across the corporate customer segment. Develop a nuanced understanding of where our biggest market opportunities exist and prioritize accordingly, ensuring deep product-market fit for the diverse range of in-house tax, accounting, and financial teams we serve. Own the vision for how CoCounsel should look and feel for corporate customers, mapping out how the experience must differ from today's accounting firm-centric model to meet the unique needs, workflows, and personas of in-house teams.

  • Customer & Market Research: Engage directly with customers and partners to identify unmet needs, validate hypotheses, and continuously refine roadmap priorities. Conduct deep dives into usage data and behavior patterns to surface insights that inform strategy and translate complex in-house tax, accounting, and financial reporting workflows into clear, actionable product requirements.

  • Enterprise Enablement: Oversee development of capabilities suited to large, complex organizations, including workflow integrations, security and compliance standards, and scalable deployment models appropriate for global enterprise environments. Create a corporate templates library and revamp onboarding for corporate users.

  • MCP/API & Platform Strategy: Champion our corporate AI strategy, anchored in an MCP/API integration model. Develop a strong point of view on how CoCounsel's agentic capabilities connect across the broader corporate product portfolio to serve the distinct needs of corporate personas.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and subject matter experts to design, develop, and launch innovative AI-driven features. Serve as a key liaison for product marketing, sales, and sales operations, ensuring go-to-market strategies are grounded in deep product knowledge, field feedback informs roadmap decisions, and segment teams have clear positioning and the tools they need to succeed.

About You

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of delivering enterprise SaaS or legal/tax technology products.

  • Deep understanding of in-house corporate tax, accounting, and financial reporting workflows and the operational needs of in-house corporate teams, including familiarity with the broader corporate tax product portfolio and landscape.

  • Strong grasp of AI-driven product development, including agentic platforms, and the practical application of MCP/API integration strategies to serve complex enterprise personas. Familiarity with AI coding a plus

  • Proven ability to manage and influence diverse stakeholders and keep cross-functional efforts aligned toward shared outcomes.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing settings, including product demos and discovery conversations with corporate clients.

  • Experience partnering across engineering, data science, and subject matter expert teams to ship sophisticated, technically complex products.

  • Strong ability to distill complex concepts for both technical teams and senior business stakeholders, and to influence without direct authority.

  • Experience navigating security, compliance, and integration requirements for global corporations.

  • Comfortable operating in a resource-constrained environment and moving fast; familiarity with AI-assisted development tools is a plus.

#LI-SS

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $137,900 USD - $256,100 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $119,700 USD - $222,300 USD. job.title: Senior Software Engineer AI
job.description:
Job Description

AI/ML Lead Engineer (Python) - Thomson Reuters

About Thomson Reuters

Thomson Reuters delivers technology and product engineering capabilities for its Tax, Accounting, and Practice business. We support the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of products serving tax, accounting, audit, and practice management professionals, enabling scalable technology solutions across the Thomson Reuters portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical execution of AI initiatives, including architecture design, roadmap alignment, and delivery oversight.

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML solutions leveraging modern AI technologies, MLOps, and LLMOps best practices.

  • Optimize AI model performance through advanced techniques, including domain adaptation of third-party models and algorithms.

  • Build and enhance AI-powered applications, including AI agents and intelligent automation solutions.

  • Design and implement monitoring frameworks to track application performance, user behavior, and product insights.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

  • Stay current with emerging AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI technologies and drive adoption of relevant innovations.

  • Act as a technical thought leader by contributing to architecture discussions, sharing AI expertise, and influencing engineering direction.

  • Support continuous improvement of development, deployment, and operational processes for AI systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python development.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning and AI solution development.

  • Strong experience in Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, FastAPI, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow/PyTorch, with hands-on expertise in developing AI/ML solutions across Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)/Document Analysis systems.Experience building AI Agents and AI-powered applications.

  • Knowledge of MLOps tools, frameworks, and deployment workflows.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to or hands-on experience with .NET and C# technologies.

  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.

  • Familiarity with LLMOps practices and AI model lifecycle management.
