job.title: Senior Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a pivotal role in delivering Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE—our industry-leading corporate tax and e-invoicing platform—to multinational clients across Greater China. You will serve as the primary technical and functional consultant, bridging the gap between customer business requirements and technical solution delivery. Combining deep Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) integration experience with tax and e-invoicing domain expertise, you will lead end-to-end implementations, partner with distributed delivery teams, and help top-tier organizations modernize and automate their tax compliance processes.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Senior Solution Architect, you will:

  • Drive Client Workshops & Requirements Gathering: Lead business and functional requirements workshops with customer tax, finance, and IT stakeholders to understand their current processes and business objectives.
  • Lead Solution Architecture & Gap Analysis: Perform detailed gap analyses between customer processes and ONESOURCE capabilities, designing target operating models and end-to-end integration architectures.
  • Author Technical & Functional Specifications: Develop clear, comprehensive documentation covering integration architecture, data flows, ERP connectivity, and configuration parameters.
  • Configure & Integrate Systems: Configure ONESOURCE applications and partner with technical consultants to ensure seamless integration with customer ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) and local Chinese tax solutions.
  • Manage Testing & Quality Assurance: Design and execute comprehensive test strategies, test cases, and validation scripts to ensure robust data flow and accurate tax determination.
  • Deliver Go-Live & Post-Implementation Support: Provide expert troubleshooting, cutover support, and advisory during go-live phases to ensure smooth transitions and high customer satisfaction.
  • Enable Users & Share Best Practices: Develop and deliver end-user training, empowering customer teams to maximize the value of their software investment.
  • Collaborate Across Global Teams: Partner seamlessly with remote delivery teams, product management, and professional services leadership to resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Support Pre-Sales & Practice Growth: Provide domain expertise for pre-sales engagements, client onboarding, and develop reusable delivery assets to enhance team scalability.

Required Qualifications

You are an ideal fit for the Senior Solution Architect role if your experience includes:

  • 10+ years of enterprise software implementation and consulting experience focused on tax automation, compliance, or finance systems for multinational clients.
  • Proven track record leading end-to-end ERP implementations, with a solid functional understanding of SAP or Oracle finance and accounting workflows.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Chinese enterprise tax and e-invoicing platforms (such as Golden Tax System, SAP, Oracle, Baiwang Cloud, Aisino, Yonyou, or Kingdee).
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex data flow and integration issues.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and consulting skills, with fluency in English and Chinese to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% for on-site customer engagements, with flexibility for business cutover requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical development experience in SAP (ABAP), Oracle tools, Java, or .NET environments.
  • Professional accounting or taxation credentials (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CA) or relevant enterprise software certifications.
  • Experience delivering projects within a hybrid model, balancing on-site customer engagement with remote/offshore technical delivery teams.

job.title: Senior Solutions Manager, Legal AI FDE
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Manager, Legal AI FDE to lead product strategy and execution for customer-facing Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements in CoCounsel Legal. In this role, you will own the product direction and execution of complex Legal FDE engagements, working directly with law firm customers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, commercial segments, and core product teams.You will turn high-value legal workflow problems into well-defined solutions and scalable product capabilities. This role focuses on end-to-end AI product lifecycle management across multiple customer deployments and requires a keen interest in the legal industry and how legal teams operate in practice. You will combine customer discovery, disciplined delivery, and strategic product judgment to ensure bespoke solutions create immediate customer value while generating reusable insights and capabilities for the broader product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Engagement and Use-Case Discovery: Partner directly with law firms, corporate legal departments, legal operations teams, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risk considerations, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous needs into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

  • Product Leadership Across FDE Engagements: Lead product execution across multiple legal FDE engagements. Establish priorities, structure discovery, guide delivery decisions, and maintain alignment among customers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and core product teams.

  • Backlog and Execution Management: Own and maintain engagement backlogs with strong hygiene, prioritization, and transparency. Ensure work is scoped, sequenced, and tracked across discovery, build, validation, launch, and handoff.

  • End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership: Manage product work from intake through development, deployment, adoption, release readiness, and transition to core product teams or ongoing customer ownership. Ensure decisions, context, and learnings are documented and reusable.

  • Productization of Bespoke Legal Solutions: Identify recurring legal workflows, integration patterns, and solution components that can become repeatable capabilities. Recommend when work should remain customer-specific and when it should be generalized for broader market value.

  • Legal AI Quality and Trust: Partner with engineering, subject-matter experts, and product teams to define validation criteria appropriate for legal workflows, including accuracy, transparency, traceability, security, and responsible AI considerations.

  • Strategic Influence: Synthesize customer needs and deployment insights into recommendations for product roadmaps, reusable service offerings, enablement, and investment priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS, AI-enabled products, workflow platforms, integrations, or implementation-heavy environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer-facing product work across multiple stakeholders and parallel initiatives.

  • Proven ability to convert ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategy, requirements, prioritization, and execution plans.

  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineering teams and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of legal teams, legal operations, law firm workflows, or adjacent professional-service environments.

  • Familiarity with legal use cases such as legal research, drafting, review, knowledge management, litigation, transactional, compliance, or legal operations.

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, agentic workflows, APIs, enterprise integrations, or document-intensive workflows.

  • Proven track record of transitioning bespoke customer solutions into reusable product capabilities or scalable delivery patterns.

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer, Reuters
job.description:
Job Description

Own the web delivery layer that keeps Reuters’ content platform available, fast, and easy to configure for customers around the world. You will provision and maintain origin and CDN infrastructure, define the reliability targets that protect the platform, and automate the manual work that slows launches and incident response. This is a hands-on role at the center of how one of the world’s most trusted news organizations reaches billions of people every day.


Reuters employs over 2,700 journalists across nearly 200 locations and delivers real-time text, images, and video in more than 20 languages. You will report into the Software Engineering organization and work with internal engineering teams and external clients to coordinate launches, upgrades, and delivery timelines. Participation in a global, multi-timezone on-call rotation is part of the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own origin and CDN provisioning for Reuters’ content platform, including site and domain hostnames, SSL enforcement, redirects, static and root files, and authentication headers, from initial setup through ongoing maintenance.
  • Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for the platform’s delivery layer, and lead or contribute to blameless postmortems that drive follow-up actions to closure.
  • Maintain infrastructure as code so provisioning and configuration stay repeatable, auditable, and ahead of traffic growth through capacity planning.
  • Diagnose and resolve delivery issues affecting site availability and performance, using logs, metrics, and alerts as part of a global on-call rotation.
  • Automate manual, repetitive delivery tasks and adopt AI-assisted tooling for log and alert triage, anomaly detection, and runbook generation to speed up diagnosis and reduce toil.
  • Manage launch tickets and execute site upgrades, coordinating timelines with internal engineering teams and external clients.
  • Build tooling that reduces time-to-launch and configuration errors across the content platform.

Required Qualifications

Education and experience

  • 7+ years configuring highly scalable, customer-facing applications

Technical skills

  • HTTP, caching, and CDNs for large-scale public sites
  • Analyzing application and cloud performance using logs, metrics, and alerts
  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • At least one server-side language: Python or Node.js
  • Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or CloudFormation

Core competencies

  • Systems ownership: taking full responsibility for the reliability and performance of the systems you run
  • Automation mindset: identifying repetitive work and building durable solutions to eliminate it
  • Incident response: diagnosing production problems calmly and driving root-cause analysis to closure
  • Cross-functional communication: conveying status and risk clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Problem-solving at scale: approaching delivery challenges for large, globally distributed audiences

Preferred Qualifications

Additional experience and technical skills

  • Building and deploying web applications in the cloud, with AWS preferred
  • Familiarity with Akamai or comparable CDN providers
  • Experience in DevOps teams owning the full lifecycle of their services
  • Comfort working across a global, multi-timezone team

Additional qualities that help candidates stand out

  • A demonstrated interest in driving automation, including exposure to AI-assisted operational tooling

job.title: Sr Manager Marketing Strategy
job.description:
Sr Manager Marketing Strategy

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Sr Manager Marketing Strategy em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

A Thomson Reuters combina inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões com confiança e administrar melhor seus negócios.

Nós ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham. Nossa equipe reúne informação, inovação e insights para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, apoiando nossos clientes na tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Sobre a vaga / About The Role

Nesta oportunidade, como Sr Manager Marketing Strategy, você irá:

  • Liderar a estratégia de marketing para o segmento de Pequenas e Médias Empresas (PME), alinhando iniciativas aos objetivos de crescimento e geração de receita da companhia.
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de geração de demanda com foco em aquisição de clientes, crescimento de pipeline e aumento de conversão.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas multicanais, incluindo mídia paga, marketing digital, redes sociais, conteúdo, eventos e programas de engajamento.
  • Atuar em parceria com os times de Vendas, Revenue Operations e Produto para impulsionar resultados em MQL, SQL, Pipeline e Closed Won Pipeline (CWP).
  • Planejar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de performance, identificando oportunidades de otimização e crescimento.
  • Liderar a construção de jornadas de aquisição e nutrição de leads, garantindo uma experiência consistente e eficiente ao longo do funil.
  • Gerenciar orçamento de marketing, priorizando investimentos com foco em ROI e impacto no negócio.
  • Apoiar o posicionamento da marca junto ao mercado PME, fortalecendo a percepção de valor das soluções da Thomson Reuters.
  • Liderar e desenvolver profissionais da equipe, promovendo uma cultura orientada por resultados, inovação e colaboração.
  • Apresentar análises, resultados e recomendações estratégicas para lideranças locais e globais.

Sobre você / About You

Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as seguintes qualificações e experiências:

  • Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Publicidade, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).
  • Sólida experiência em marketing B2B ou B2B2C, com forte atuação em geração de demanda e crescimento de receita.
  • Experiência em marketing digital, incluindo mídia paga, performance marketing, automação, redes sociais e marketing de conteúdo.
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS, tecnologia, fintechs ou negócios voltados para o segmento PME.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de automação de marketing, CRM e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Diferencial: Experiência em estratégias de Product Marketing e Go-to-Market para soluções SaaS.

#LI-KN1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. job.title: Staff Software Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

Are you a hands-on engineer who wants to build AI agents that do real work? Not demos, but agents that provision infrastructure, investigate incidents, answer the questions engineers would otherwise file a ticket for, and take action safely on production systems?

Our technology organization runs the cloud, compute, and network platforms that thousands of engineers across Thomson Reuters build on, spanning AWS, Azure, and our own data centers. We are rethinking how that platform is built and operated, with AI agents and automation taking on work that used to require tickets, runbooks, and manual toil. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead that work.

We are a software engineering team within Thomson Reuters’ technology organization. We design and build AI agents, agent tooling, and infrastructure automation that change how technology teams across the company work. We also own and evolve internal platform and developer tools used by engineers across the company.

We place a high degree of trust in our engineers and expect them to deliver. We move quickly, ship to production, and learn from what our users actually do. In return, you will have interesting problems, the resources to solve them, and real room to shape how a large enterprise adopts AI.


Key Responsibilities


  • We build for production, so a prototype is a starting point, not a deliverable. We eliminate toil by design, asking whether software, automation, or an agent should handle repetitive work. We use AI in our own development workflow and apply engineering judgment to everything it produces. We reuse before we build, and we value aptitude and judgment over experience with any specific toolset.
  • Design and build AI agents that reason over context, call tools, and take action on real systems, from single-purpose assistants to multi-step workflows with human approval where it matters.
  • Build the APIs, MCP servers, and integrations that give agents safe, well-scoped access to cloud providers, source control, service management, observability, and internal platforms.
  • Build infrastructure-as-code, pipelines, and self-service capabilities that let engineers get what they need without waiting on a person.
  • Own production-grade concerns for agents, including evaluation and regression testing, observability, cost and latency management, guardrails, least-privilege access, defenses against prompt injection, and auditability.
  • Lead technically by owning the design of major systems, writing clear design documents, leading design and code reviews, establishing reusable patterns and standards, and mentoring engineers across the team.
  • Apply judgment about when AI fits, recognizing when a deterministic script, a better API, or a process change is the right answer and making that case clearly.
  • Partner with platform, cloud, security, and SRE teams, and with the stakeholders whose work is being automated, to turn ambiguous problems into well-defined solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and operating production systems.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Python is the primary language and experience with it is a plus, but strong engineers from Go, TypeScript, C#, Java, or similar backgrounds who are ready to work in Python are welcome.
  • Hands-on experience building applications or agents on large language models, including tool and function calling, context management, retrieval (RAG), and structured outputs, with a practical understanding of failure modes such as hallucination, non-determinism, and prompt injection.
  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure and with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
  • Experience with modern delivery practices, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines), automated testing, and containers.
  • A secure-by-design mindset, especially when giving software the ability to act on production systems.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a strong design document and explain complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading through influence, and raising the quality of a team’s work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks and SDKs such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Understanding of what these frameworks abstract is valued more than experience with any one of them.
  • Experience designing evaluation suites for LLM systems, or with LLM observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, LangSmith).
  • Experience with Kubernetes, serverless architectures, or event-driven systems.
  • Background in platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps, including on-call and incident response.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (DNS, firewalls, cloud networking) or IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience working in large, regulated, or compliance-conscious enterprise environments.

#LI-VGA1


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer I (Open)
job.description:
Job Description


Staff Software Engineer — Content Tools

Content Tools • CoCounsel Agent Context


Overview of the Role

The CoCounsel Agent Context team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for Content Tools — the purpose-built APIs that give AI agents precise, governed access to Thomson Reuters’ proprietary legal content across various international jurisdictions. Content Tools are the bridge between TR’s authoritative content and the AI products, such as CoCounsel Legal, that depend on them, and they carry high stakes — every result an agent returns must be accurate and grounded in TR’s authoritative content. This Staff Engineer defines how those tools are designed, evaluated, and operated, and sets the patterns that every engineer — on this team and on contributing partner teams — builds against.


This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of API design, information retrieval, and agentic systems. Staff Engineers here define what to build and why, not just how: they solve ambiguous problems that span multiple teams and systems, and their work is felt well beyond their own code. The team’s operating principles are non-negotiable. You own your work end-to-end, from the first commit to the production dashboard. You ship to production constantly, and you treat delivery friction as an engineering problem to solve, not a fact of life. You use AI-assisted development as a primary tool, with the majority of code written with AI assistance. And you practice verified spec-driven development: acceptance criteria and an evaluation suite define a tool’s behavior before the implementation exists and gate every change in CI. Because AI writes most of the code, what you truly own is the spec and the eval that verifies it — the eval is the spec, and you are accountable for the outcome, not the lines. The successful candidate brings platform thinking, deep API and evaluation instincts, enterprise-grade security awareness, and a product-minded approach to developer experience — treating each tool’s contract as a product in its own right.


Key Responsibilities

In this position, you will focus on:


Content Tool Architecture & API Ownership

  • Set the technical direction for the Content Tools catalog: define the design patterns, schema templates, and contribution standards every tool is built against, and the guidance on when to create a new tool versus extend an existing one — resolving problems of broad scope with little precedent to guide solutions
  • Drive an API-first, contract-driven approach: every tool ships with a versioned contract, schema, and ownership metadata that makes it discoverable and self-service for consuming teams and agent developers, who should never need to ask you how to use your tool
  • Architect the retrieval and search layer behind the catalog — relevance and ranking quality on the team’s Vespa based search platform, and the trade-offs between structured and semantic retrieval — partnering with TR Labs on the underlying search algorithms
  • Define the agent invocation model for the catalog: clean tool boundaries exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol), result payloads designed for token economy, and latency budgets that hold across multi-hop retrieval chains, giving agent orchestrators predictable, well-documented interfaces to TR and third-party content
  • Build and own the shared development and testing infrastructure — common libraries, scaffolding generators, mock services, and local environments, built on the team’s Python, FastAPI, and Claude Agent SDK stack — that makes it easy for any team member to build a Content Tool correctly the first time

Verified Spec-Driven Development & Evaluation

  • Own verified spec-driven development as a team-wide standard: define how acceptance criteria and evaluation datasets are written before implementation to specify a tool’s behavior, IR metrics (precision, recall, NDCG), and CI gates that verify every change and set the bar every engineer’s eval suite follows
  • Treat evaluation as foundational infrastructure the team is still maturing: assess current coverage across tool families, close the highest-risk gaps first, and prevent teams from redundantly reinventing evaluation capability
  • Define how offline grading pipelines and online signals combine into a continuous, trustworthy quality picture for every tool in production

Reliability & Operations

  • Take full operational responsibility for what you and your area own — you built it, you own it, you run it: own the on-call model and SLO targets for your services, and build the automation that reduces operational toil for the whole team
  • Lead incident response for high-severity issues, write thorough post-mortems, and drive systematic fixes that prevent recurrence
  • Build the observability that makes reliability visible — including trace-level instrumentation for agentic retrieval paths, where standard request/response logging cannot explain a non-deterministic failure
  • Own performance and cost strategy for the tool layer: capacity planning, caching, and rate limiting that keep the platform reliable and economical as tenants, content volumes, and query traffic grow, with fast, safe delivery treated as a first-class engineering goal rather than a trade-off against reliability

Technical Leadership & Governance

  • Function as the technical authority other engineers and partner teams turn to for Content Tools API, evaluation, and architecture decisions; author cross-team Architecture Decision Records for cross-cutting choices and contribute to the code- and design-review policy the team follows
  • Multiply the team: develop Senior engineers through architecture guidance, design pairing, and constructive review, with measurable growth in the people you mentor — your impact is the patterns you set and the engineers you grow
  • Build durable relationships with the teams that depend on you — CoCounsel Engineering, TR Labs, and product owners — , feeding structured requirements back into the roadmap, and reducing time-to-value for new adopters
  • Establish team-wide AI-assisted development patterns and model them visibly; capture decisions in writing where the team can find them, so work is legible to async readers
  • Make the hard calls: say no to unnecessary complexity, advise senior leadership on complex , and champion ethical AI and responsible, secure deployment across the team’s work

You’re an ideal fit if you have:


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression to staff-level or equivalent technical leadership — including ownership of a functional area and leadership of significant cross-team initiatives
  • Mastery of Python and strong fundamentals across API design, testing strategy (unit, integration, load and evaluation), system design, and security architecture
  • Track record of designing and operating API-first systems consumed by multiple teams, with a product mindset toward developer experience — including versioning, backward compatibility, and clear contracts
  • Working fluency with information-retrieval concepts (precision/recall trade-offs, hybrid search, ranking, citation networks) sufficient to make sound architectural decisions and partner credibly with research scientists
  • Demonstrated experience designing or owning evaluation frameworks for retrieval or LLM systems: dataset design, IR metrics, CI-gated eval suites, and tracing and observability for non-deterministic workflows
  • Proven reliability ownership at the system level: designing on-call models, setting SLOs, leading incident response, and a clear philosophy that shipping frequently and operating reliably are complementary, not in tension
  • Demonstrated security and access-control practice:
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tools; you write the majority of your code with AI assistance, produce higher-quality work because of it, and establish the patterns that help the team do the same
  • Strong communication: you explain complex retrieval and architecture concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and build alignment across engineering, product, and science

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building tools or APIs for agentic AI systems, including tool protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar
  • Background in legal technology, knowledge management, or other high-stakes information domains where source attribution, accuracy, and entitlement enforcement are critical
  • Hands-on experience operating search and retrieval engines (OpenSearch, Vespa, Elasticsearch) — cluster sizing, index lifecycle, and the trade-offs between semantic and structured search
  • Experience operationalizing tooling for LLM-powered workflows: tool-description design, prompt engineering, and agent invocation patterns
  • Experience establishing contribution governance for a platform built on by multiple teams — review workflows, registry/namespace management, and deprecation and migration policies
  • Familiarity with content licensing and policy-based entitlements in multi-tenant environments
  • Working understanding of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and API gateways (such as Apigee) — enough to operate, secure, and reason about the services you own

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days:

  • Develop a comprehensive mental model of the Content Tools architecture — tool inventory, CI/CD pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, and the legacy dependencies and migration paths in flight — and identify the top architectural risks and debt items across the team’s systems by shipping multiple tools
  • Establish working relationships with CoCounsel Engineering, Product, and TR Labs, understanding each stakeholder’s priorities and integration pain points firsthand
  • Establish your AI-assisted development workflow and model it visibly for the team; take on-call ownership for your functional area
  • Ship at least one high-impact improvement that demonstrates judgement and taste, not just velocity, and assess eval coverage across tool families to pinpoint the most urgent gaps

In the first year:

  • Drive the architecture for a major Content Tools initiative — a significant catalog expansion, the evaluation framework, or a comparable platform milestone — from design through production, establishing the patterns and templates other engineers build against
  • Establish Content Tools as a well-documented, measurably reliable internal platform: verified spec-driven development as the default, SLO coverage across core services, automated eval gates in CI, on-call runbooks, and a track record of fast, high-quality incident resolution
  • Multiply the team: at least two Senior engineers have grown measurably through your architecture guidance, design pairing, and mentorship
  • Be recognized across the organization as the Content Tools architecture authority — shaping team standards, influencing cross-team architecture, and advising leadership on complex

job.description:
Support Operations Analyst


Job Description

Thomson Reuters is seeking a Support Operations Analyst to join the Customer Service & Support Operations team in Manila, Philippines (PHL-Taguig). This individual contributor role (TR5 level) reports to the Senior Manager, Support Operations. You will be the delivery and sustainment layer for the OE Support Operations portfolio. You will handle ad hoc reporting and analysis, manage projects that automate processes and reports, and keep the Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate estate accurate and available. Leaders and over 800 contact center agents rely on this estate every day across the Tax, Legal, and Corporate product groups. Working with the Power Platform Solutions Developers who build these solutions, you will own the project management that helps them land, from requirements through adoption, and you will remain accountable for their accuracy once they are live.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver accurate, timely ad hoc reporting and analysis for Operations, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, and CS&S leadership, including requests that arrive outside the planned roadmap.
  • Own project management for process and report automation initiatives, covering requirements, stakeholder alignment, user testing, launch, adoption, and on-track delivery.
  • Sustain the accuracy, availability, and governance of the Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate estate so that reported data stays trusted.
  • Build and maintain a single, defensible source of truth across CS&S data sources, including Salesforce, Genesys, LiveHelp, Aspect, and Snowflake.
  • Produce contact driver, handle time, quality, customer experience, and workforce analytics, and turn them into written recommendations that state the insight, the implication, and the recommended action.
  • Monitor dataset refreshes and flow failures, resolve escalations the same day where operations require it, and act as secondary owner for automation and reporting assets built by the Power Platform Solutions Developers.
  • Apply Generative AI and automation tools to speed up documentation, analysis, and reporting, and validate AI-assisted output against operational reality before it is used.

Required Qualifications

  • Four or more years of experience in business analysis, operational reporting, or workforce management analytics within a contact center or shared services environment.
  • Hands-on Power BI development experience, including data modeling, DAX, semantic models, and report publication.
  • Working knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse, sufficient to maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance existing solutions.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query.
  • Familiarity with contact center and WFM platforms such as Genesys, Aspect/Alvaria, and Salesforce, and with their underlying reporting data.
  • Project management discipline, including requirements definition, stakeholder management, user testing, and structured status reporting.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to brief leaders clearly, lead with the bottom line, and raise risks early.
  • Comfort working across competing priorities, where planned project work and unplanned operational requests run at the same time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SQL and Snowflake experience.
  • Exposure to process improvement methodology such as DMAIC or Lean Six Sigma.
  • Demonstrated use of Generative AI tools in a real operational or analytical workflow.
  • Experience building or maintaining Copilot Studio agents or AI-assisted process documentation.

job.description:
Job Description:

The Talent Acquisition Coordinator (TAC) is responsible for driving efficient and consistent recruiting

operations that support the successful hiring of top talent. By partnering with recruiters, hiring managers,

and candidates, this role ensures a positive candidate experience, seamless interview coordination, and

effective execution of pre-employment processes. The TAC contributes to operational excellence through

strong attention to detail, process adherence, and exceptional stakeholder support

Job Type: Contractor – 1-year contract – under 3rd party employer (Vendor - Ascent)

 

Key Responsibilities:

Interview Scheduling & Coordination

• Manage end-to-end interview scheduling across multiple regions and time zones

• Coordinate complex interview panels, including executive-level interviews

• Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to confirm interview structure, timelines, and logistics

• Monitor scheduling SLAs and proactively resolve conflicts, reschedules, and no-shows

 

Candidate Experience

• Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process

• Communicate interview details, expectations, and logistics in a clear and timely manner

• Ensure a positive, professional, and high-touch candidate experience

• Manage interview reminders and day-of coordination support

 

Recruiting Operations Support

• Maintain accurate candidate data and statuses within Workday (or ATS)

• Support recruiters with requisition activity, interview tracking, and process updates

• Ensure timely documentation and dispositioning of candidates

• Track and follow up on interview feedback and next steps

 

Pre-Employment & Offer Support

• Coordinate pre-employment activities such as background checks and documentation

• Partner with recruiters and HR teams to support offer processes

• Monitor completion of pre-hire requirements and escalate issues when needed

 

Process Excellence & Collaboration

• Act as a key partner to recruiters and hiring managers to ensure efficient process flow

• Identify opportunities to improve scheduling, coordination, and candidate experience

• Adhere to defined SOPs, SLAs, and compliance requirements

• Support global operations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

 

Required Qualifications:

 

• 1–2 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or HR Operations

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize high-volume work

• Experience coordinating meetings, schedules, or logistics across multiple stakeholders

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• High attention to detail and accuracy

 

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience supporting recruiting or HR processes in a corporate environment

• Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (e.g., Workday) and scheduling tools (e.g., Rooster)

• Experience working in a global or matrixed organization

• Ability to manage stakeholders across time zones

Key Competencies

• Customer service mindset (candidate-first approach)

Strong coordination and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities

• Collaboration and stakeholder management

• Process discipline and continuous improvement mindset

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive 

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential! 

 

If you’re ready to embark upon an exciting career that affords you the opportunity to form meaningful client relationships, develop creative advertising campaigns using our best-in-class multimedia solutions, all while having your finger on the pulse of Southwest Montana…then we want to hear from you!  

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Identify, pursue, and schedule meetings with local business owners and decision makers to discuss and uncover their marketing needs and challenges 
  • Use our proprietary data, analytics, and multimedia marketing solutions to build, present, and sell customized advertising plans to potential clients  
  • Build, maintain and develop close working relationships with your clients to identify and upsell new advertising solutions 
  • Use your influence and relationship-building skills to provide ongoing customer service, research, and market analysis 
  • You will be responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to local and regional businesses in the Bozeman area and beyond 
  • You will work with and sell integrated advertising solutions including broadcast radio, LIVE event sponsorships and digital including website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social, Streaming TV and much more 

 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1+ year of sales or marketing experience (preferred) 
  • Strong marketing and advertising acumen 
  • Effective verbal and written communications are essential 
  • Experience selling or a working knowledge of digital advertising solutions preferred 
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales 
  • A passion towards customer focused solution sales 
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required) 
  • BA/BS degree (preferred) 

 

What’s In It for You? 

  • Competitive compensation package with UNCAPPED earning potential  
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days) 
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community 
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
  • Company-provided laptop 
  • Casual, high-energy, supportive, and collaborative work environment 
  • 4-week long sales training program  
  • Unlimited growth opportunities!  

 

Why Townsquare Media Group? 

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps along with a network of national music/content brands.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.

job.title: Digital Sales Manager
job.description:
Digital Sales Manager

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Why Townsquare Media Group & Townsquare Ignite:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets, including trusted Tuscaloosa Stations..

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

Founded in 2010, Townsquare Ignite is the fastest-growing revenue and profit driver of Townsquare Media, offering a powerful suite of digital solutions that includes owned and operated digital properties, a proprietary programmatic advertising platform, and an in-house demand and data management platform powered by first-party data. Our all-in-one 360° advertising technology and DSP-agnostic trade desk provide access to all major ad exchanges and more than 250 billion impressions per day. Campaigns run across desktop, mobile, apps, connected TV, search, and social—supported by advanced targeting, white-glove service, and a full-service in-house creative team—giving sellers the tools, scale, and support to win and grow digital business.

 

The Digital Sales Manager Opportunity:

Do you love helping businesses grow through modern, results-driven marketing? Are you a sales leader who thrives in digital and knows how to elevate teams through strategy, coaching, and execution? This is a rare opportunity to lead a local market as a Digital Sales Manager, owning digital revenue growth while also leading and supporting broadcast sales performance.

 

At Townsquare, we are redefining local media by combining the power of trusted radio brands with industry-leading digital marketing solutions. We’re looking for a hands-on leader with deep digital sales expertise to accelerate growth across Townsquare Ignite and Amped (digital on our owned and operated properties), while maintaining strong broadcast fundamentals.

 

The Digital Sales Manager serves as the senior revenue leader for the market, responsible for driving total market performance with a digital-first mindset. This role blends digital strategy, team leadership, and client-facing sales execution. You will act as the market’s digital authority—guiding sellers, partnering with clients, and leading complex, integrated deals—while also overseeing broadcast sales activity.

 

Responsibilities:

Digital & Revenue Leadership

  • Own and drive digital revenue growth for the market, with a strong emphasis on Townsquare Ignite and Amped solutions
  • Develop and execute a digital-forward sales strategy that aligns broadcast and digital into integrated, results-based programs
  • Set, track, and hold the team accountable to digital and total revenue goals, pipeline activity, and KPIs
  • Lead by example in selling complex digital and integrated campaigns, assisting Account Executives with high-impact opportunities
  • Drive new business development while expanding and retaining key accounts

Digital Strategy & Expertise

  • Serve as the digital subject matter expert for the market
  • Lead adoption and mastery of full-funnel digital solutions including Programmatic, Search, Social, Video, OTT/CTV, and Owned & Operated digital
  • Analyze campaign performance and reporting to guide optimization, renewals, and incremental revenue growth
  • Translate performance data into clear, compelling insights for clients and sellers

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, retain, and develop top-performing sales talent
  • Coach and train new and existing Account Executives on consultative selling, digital strategy, and solution-based presentations
  • Maintain a strong in-field presence, participating in client and prospect meetings alongside sellers
  • Set and enforce daily, weekly, and monthly activity, pipeline, and performance standards

Market & Community Leadership

  • Represent Townsquare as a trusted marketing partner to key clients, agencies, and community stakeholders
  • Monitor competitive activity and evolving market trends to identify growth opportunities
  • Act as a key member of the local leadership team

 

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of sales management experience in digital and/or broadcast media
  • Extensive experience selling digital marketing solutions including Programmatic, Search, Social, Video, and OTT/CTV
  • Proven track record of driving digital revenue growth and exceeding sales targets
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel digital marketing strategies and performance metrics
  • Experience setting, tracking, and enforcing sales KPIs and revenue goals
  • Demonstrated success in consultative selling and complex deal execution
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and proposal development skills
  • Radio or broadcast experience is a plus, but not required
  • Website and owned-and-operated digital sales experience a plus
  • Valid Driver’s License and insurance

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive base plus performance-based bonus 
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Company discounts, pet insurance, and volunteer time off
  • Strong career growth opportunities within Townsquare Media

job.title: Director of Digital & Radio Content - Fort Collins
job.description:
Director of Digital & Radio Content – Fort Collins

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Where Creative Leadership Meets Local Impact:

Are you a strategic, people-first content leader with a passion for building winning brands and developing top-tier talent? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Director of Digital & Radio Content to lead our MARKET market—overseeing strong local brands and driving audience growth across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.

This is a full-time, in-office leadership role working closely and collaboratively with a talented local team. You’ll set the vision for local content, coach and develop market-leading talent, and play a hands-on role in creating compelling, clickable, and shareable content that resonates with the local community—while partnering closely with sales and leadership to drive revenue and impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital & Radio Content for Fort Collins, you’ll provide leadership, strategy, and creative direction for our local brands—ensuring excellence across on-air, online, and on-site experiences. This role blends high-level strategy with hands-on leadership and content creation. You will:

  • Establish and execute a clear, competitive vision for local content while maintaining ownership of the overall sound, content strategy, and brand execution across all stations to drive audience growth, market leadership, and business results.

  • Host a live, engaging on-air show on a regular, ongoing basis, preparing daily content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Create and publish a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Create and oversee compelling local content and digital storytelling across websites, mobile platforms, and social channels
  • Design and execute programming clocks, music strategy, and tactical plans to grow time spent listening, audience occasions, and digital reach
  • Oversee sound design, station imaging, and audio architecture—keeping content fresh, creative, and impactful
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Demonstrated success as a content leader with strong people management skills
  • 3+ years of management experience
  • Strategic mindset with a strong understanding of industry trends and audience behavior
  • On-air programming experience with deep knowledge of content creation and curation
  • Strong writing, communication, and storytelling skills across platforms
  • Familiarity with a wide range of digital assets, tools, and publishing workflows
  • Proven ability to lead in competitive markets and drive measurable results
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect content strategy to revenue outcomes
  • Sound judgment, creativity, and a strong desire to win

job.title: Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5
job.description:
Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5

* This is a full-time, in-office position in Trenton that involves working closely and collaboratively with our New Jersey content teams. * 

 

Lead the Next Evolution of Digital News & Audience Growth

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

This is a digital-first, hands-on content leadership role at the intersection of journalism, content, audience, and growth. You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital News & Audience, you’ll help shape our digital content strategy while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution. You’ll serve as both a leader and a hands-on editor, helping shape the digital voice of our local brands. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading digital news and content strategy for New Jersey 101.5, helping identify, develop, and execute compelling original and breaking-news coverage across platforms
  • Creating, editing, publishing, and packaging content across websites, apps, social media, video, newsletters, and other digital channels
  • Partnering with journalists, on-air personalities, producers, and creators to turn strong ideas and existing content into platform-specific digital experiences
  • Elevating our social and video storytelling, including platform-native hooks, headlines, captions, thumbnails, pacing, formats, and creative approaches for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms
  • Coaching and collaborating with content teams on digital storytelling, SEO, audience development, social strategy, and evolving best practices
  • Using audience and content analytics to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, and make data-informed editorial decisions
  • Expanding content distribution through SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and other audience-growth channels
  • Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives
  • Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities
  • Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment
  • A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience
  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news
  • Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video
  • Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others
  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development
  • Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows
  • Curiosity about emerging platforms, creator trends, changing audience behaviors, and new technologies
  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where creativity and growth are encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

job.title: Market President
job.description:
Market President – Cedar Rapids/ Waterloo

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *


Lead the Market. Shape the Future.

Are you a proven sales leader with a passion for developing high-performing teams, driving revenue growth, and making a lasting impact in your community?

Townsquare Media Group is looking for a dynamic Market President to lead our Cedar Rapids/ Waterloo operation. This is more than a sales management role—it's an opportunity to serve as the local leader of one of the most recognized media organizations in the country.

You'll be responsible for growing revenue across our portfolio of broadcast, digital, live event, and marketing solutions while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and performance. If you thrive on leading from the front, developing talent, and delivering results, we'd love to talk with you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Cedar Rapids/ Waterloo stations.   

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Market President, you'll be responsible for the overall success of the market, leading revenue growth, developing top talent, and representing Townsquare Media throughout the community. You'll serve as the senior leader for the market, partnering with sales, content, and operational teams to drive performance across all areas of the business.

Lead Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic vision that drives sustainable revenue and profit growth across broadcast, digital, live events, and marketing solutions
  • Lead market-wide sales initiatives focused on new business development, key account growth, and client retention
  • Partner with sales leaders and Account Executives to secure high-value business opportunities and deliver integrated marketing solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, agencies, and business leaders throughout the community
  • Analyze market performance and implement strategies that maximize revenue, profitability, and market share

Lead & Develop the Team

  • Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales leaders and Account Executives
  • Establish a culture of accountability, performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Coach leaders and sellers to achieve and exceed individual, team, and market goals
  • Partner with content and programming leaders to ensure brand excellence and audience growth across all platforms
  • Lead regular business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and performance discussions

Build the Market & Community Presence

  • Serve as the face of Townsquare Media within the local business community
  • Represent the company at community events, industry organizations, and key client meetings
  • Build partnerships that strengthen Townsquare's visibility, reputation, and influence within the market
  • Foster a culture that supports both business success and community engagement

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Oversee market budgeting, forecasting, and overall financial performance
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations and all federal, state, and local requirements
  • Monitor market performance metrics and implement action plans to improve results
  • Align market resources, talent, and business strategies to achieve long-term growth objectives

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of sales leadership experience in media, advertising, marketing, or a related industry
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue goals and delivering profitable growth
  • Experience leading teams in both traditional and digital advertising environments
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing solutions, including programmatic, social, search, and website strategies
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, coaching, and retaining high-performing talent
  • Ability to create strategic plans and translate vision into measurable results
  • Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, budgeting, and revenue management
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Community-minded leadership style with a passion for local business growth
  • A hands-on, lead-from-the-front mentality—this is not a sit-behind-the-desk leadership role

 

What’s In It for You?

We know exceptional leaders create exceptional results. Here's what you can expect:

  • Competitive base salary with Bonus Plan
  • 3 weeks PTO
  • 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal/floating holidays)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Ongoing leadership development and professional growth opportunities
  • The opportunity to lead a market, build a team, and make a meaningful impact in your community

job.title: Multi-Media Account Executive
job.description:
Multi-Media Account Executive

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including our trusted Sierra Vista stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a key member of our local sales team, you’ll take full ownership of building and managing a book of business. You’ll focus on bringing in new clients while maintaining long-term relationships with existing accounts. This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships
  • Cross-sell and upsell to expand your clients’ reach and ROI
  • Partner with internal teams and collaborate on campaign execution and strategy
  • Work directly with your Market Leadership to meet and exceed individual and team goals

This is a consultative sales position where success is defined by your ability to build trust, deliver results, and help local businesses thrive.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales goal
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and securing new business
  • Strong work ethic, drive, and competitiveness
  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • Real opportunities for career growth in a fast-moving multi-media organization

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:
