job.title: Part-Time Producer, Create or Destroy
job.description:
Part-Time Producer, Create or Destroy

Vox Media and The Wisdomous Company are seeking a highly organized, editorially sharp, and business-fluent Producer for Create or Destroy: Reimagining Marketing, a weekly video podcast hosted by Seth Matlins.

The show is built on the premise that marketing is not a siloed department within an organization, but an enterprise-wide mindset and core growth engine. Because every company decision—from product design, supply chain, and HR to capital allocation, data architecture, and board composition—ultimately touches the customer, every decision either creates value or threatens to destroy it. Each week, the show features unvarnished, actionable, and irreverent conversations with influential thinkers and leaders across the business and cultural landscape.

This role is central to the weekly video and audio production pipeline, managing the tactical execution, editorial rigor, and quality control needed to take episodes from initial research through recording, post-production, and multi-platform publication. The ideal candidate pairs foundational technical chops in video podcast production with a solid grasp of modern marketing, business strategy, and brand dynamics.

This is a temporary, part-time position for a 6-month assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Editorial Research & Briefing: Conduct thorough research on featured enterprise leaders, market developments, and corporate case studies. When needed, prepare detailed host prep packets, narrative outlines, and interview questions centered on how internal and external forces shape value creation and destruction.
  • Production Lead on Create or Destroy: Direct weekly in-studio and remote recording sessions, manage technical setups (audio/video capture, lighting, framing), liaise closely with host Seth Matlins, and guide guest talent through seamless tapings.
  • VIP & C-Suite Logistics: Own the end-to-end production calendar, coordinating prep calls and recording logistics with high-profile guests, executive assistants, and corporate communications teams.
  • Post-Production & Assembly: Execute the foundational assembly edit (rough cuts, paper edits, and stringouts); craft compelling, high-converting episode titles and SEO-informed descriptions tailored to business decision-makers.
  • Ad Integration & Monetization: Coordinate with ad operations and sales teams to facilitate the timely recording, placement, and delivery of sponsored segments and host-read endorsements.
  • Quality Control & Distribution: Perform rigorous quality control checks on master audio and multi-camera video exports; manage publishing workflows across YouTube, Megaphone, and supporting feeds.
  • Audience Growth & Social Clipping: Identify high-impact, provocative soundbites from each episode; oversee the cutting, captioning, and quality control of short-form video clips optimized for B2B engagement across LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in video podcast production, digital video journalism, or multimedia content creation, preferably within a fast-paced media network or business publication.
  • Demonstrated business & marketing literacy: A working understanding of corporate strategy, brand marketing, consumer behavior, and executive decision-making, along with genuine curiosity about how companies drive sustainable growth.
  • Hands-on production proficiency: Practical experience with video and audio editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Audition, or Descript) and remote recording tools (e.g., Riverside.fm).
  • Multi-platform packaging expertise: A strong grasp of YouTube audience retention mechanics, packaging (titles and thumbnails), and how to optimize professional video content for platforms like LinkedIn.
  • Executive-level communication: Comfort directly producing, briefing, and interacting with high-profile guests such as CEOs, CMOs, founders, and cultural leaders.
  • Meticulous project management: Proven ability to manage multi-track deliverables, asset files, and tight weekly turnaround deadlines without sacrificing editorial polish.

job.title: Photography Director, The Cut
job.description:
PHOTOGRAPHY DIRECTOR, THE CUT 

WHO WE ARE

New York Magazine and The Cut are part of Vox Media, the leading modern media company. We guide our audience from discovery to obsession. We inspire essential conversations about what’s now, what’s next, and what’s possible.

As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Cut is looking for a Photo Director to set and lead our visual strategy across digital, social, video, and print. The ideal candidate will have at least ten years of experience in visual production and a deep understanding of photography, art direction, and visual storytelling, along with an enviable book of contacts across agencies, photographers, and creatives. This role requires strong editorial judgment, exceptional leadership skills, and the ability to manage many projects and deadlines at once in a fast-paced environment. You will report to Lindsay Peoples, Editor-in-Chief of The Cut and work closely with her to uphold and advance the visual identity of The Cut, while partnering with editorial teams to turn ideas into compelling visual narratives. You will also lead and mentor the photo team, guiding them to deliver strong results while nurturing their craft and creative sensibilities.

We're looking for someone who obsessively follows culture (from politics to fashion to celebrity) and knows what makes a Cut story. You should have impeccable visual taste, big ideas on how to expand the visual language of The Cut, and a passion for storytelling.

WHO YOU ARE

Responsibilities & Qualifications

  • Set the visual strategy for The Cut across print, digital, social, and video
  • Provide clear visual direction, constructive feedback, and support to the photo team
  • Spearhead all aspects of photo shoot production, from commissioning teams and liaising with vendors to ensuring each shoot is successful and on budget
  • Track and maintain the overall photo budget, setting and assigning individual project budgets to team members and communicating clearly with editorial leadership and finance partners on all active projects
  • Manage workflow, including assigning work, overseeing workloads, and maintaining visual quality
  • Manage photo research, image selection, credits, and CMS upload and publication
  • Conduct deep visual research and curate lists of photographers accompanied by visual boards
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with the editors across The Cut to understand their visual needs and orchestrate projects accordingly
  • Regularly pitch ideas for new photographers, essays, and photo-driven stories
  • Develop and maintain relationships with photo agencies, independent photographers, stylists, and studios
  • Ensure contracts, photo fees, and usage rights are in place for all images, whether produced or researched, and that all photography meets ethical standards and adheres to copyright law
  • Collaborate with sales, partnerships, editorial, web, social, and video teams to ensure the highest level of visual execution across all platforms
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in visual production, photo editing, or a related field
  • Strong people manager with a track record of inspiring and developing talent
  • Excellent editorial judgment, with demonstrated experience managing teams to develop visual stories across platforms and a detailed understanding of each platform's requirements
  • Proficiency in photo editing software such as Adobe Creative Suite and Photoshop
  • Ability to travel on occasion for assignments and shoots
  • Enjoy a collaborative and fast-paced work environment

job.title: Senior Product Designer
job.description:
Senior Product Designer 

 

About the Role

This role is on the New York Magazine dedicated Product team, which is responsible for the customer touchpoints that pertain to all its digital products. This role will also partner directly with Consumer Revenue, Editorial and other teams when required.

 

The Product team analyzes and creates the platforms that connect New York Magazine’s content with our audiences. We’re adept, curious problem-solvers who transform creative ideas into successful products. Great design and user experience are essential to our ability to connect with our readers, and the Product Design team plays an important role in what we create, ensuring that our products are engaging, useful, and beautiful.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate digital experiences & interfaces for consumer revenue & subscription, and adjacent products.
  • Design and execute projects across the entire product lifecycle, from concepts to multi-platform product launches.
  • Present solutions to stakeholders, frame design decisions, articulate tradeoffs, and advocate for the reader and subscriber, while concurrently driving core business objectives.
  • Solve complex design problems, while synthesizing multiple inputs along the way. 
  • Evaluate, iterate & optimize existing product performance.
  • Contribute to and maintain scalable pattern libraries & design systems that uphold a family of brand identities across platforms and touchpoints.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with engineering, product, and data, as well as consumer revenue and editorial stakeholders on product strategy and execution.
  • Participate in design rituals, give and receive constructive feedback, and help elevate the broader design team's culture and process.
  • You will report to the VP of Product Design, NYmag.com.

Basic Qualifications:

  • A design degree: Product Design, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
  • 5+ years professional experience with a portfolio showcasing end-to-end responsive web and app experiences.
  • 5+ years creating complex typography systems, visual hierarchies, and scalable design systems.
  • 3+ years of experience designing for digital media, editorial, subscription, or commerce platforms.
  • Success translating multiple brand identities across several digital platforms and touchpoints.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, and enthusiasm for design iteration.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, New York Magazine
job.description:
Staff Software Engineer, New York Magazine

Vox Media Group LLC

Vox Media Group LLC is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the technology behind New York Magazine’s journalism and consumer subscriptions business. Your primary focus will be the websites, publishing platform, and subscription experiences supporting New York, The Cut, Vulture, Intelligencer, The Strategist, Grub Street, and Curbed. You’ll also contribute to the NYMag mobile apps for iOS and Android.

As a hands-on technical engineering leader, you’ll help editors publish compelling stories, readers discover journalism they value, and subscribers get the most from their relationship with our brands. Your work will span editorial experiences and the subscriber journey, from registration and purchase through onboarding, account management, and ongoing engagement.

You’ll partner with product, design, editorial, and consumer revenue teams to guide technical decisions and deliver improvements across web and mobile. You’ll also help advance our responsible use of AI and agentic workflows to increase delivery speed, expand engineering capacity, and improve efficiency.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead complex engineering initiatives. Translate product and business needs into technical plans, align collaborators around architectural decisions, and guide projects from discovery through delivery and operation.
  • Build and improve consumer subscription experiences. Develop subscription offers, checkout flows, promotions, gifting, onboarding, and account management features that support acquisition, conversion, and retention.
  • Strengthen subscriber identity and access. Improve the integrations connecting authentication, payments, subscription status, and content entitlements so readers can reliably access what they’ve purchased across web and mobile.
  • Support experimentation and growth. Partner with consumer revenue, product, and analytics teams to improve paywalls, registration experiences, and subscription journeys through reliable experiments and measurable results.
  • Evolve our publishing platform. Build reusable components, editorial tools, and reader experiences that support the distinct needs of our brands and make publishing easier.
  • Contribute to the NYMag mobile app. Partner with mobile engineers on reading experiences, content discovery, and subscriber features. Design APIs and content models that support consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Guide incremental modernization. Identify architectural risks and technical debt, improve developer workflows, and balance near-term delivery with the long-term maintainability of an established platform.
  • Improve quality and reliability. Investigate production issues, strengthen automated testing and observability, and address performance, accessibility, and security across publishing and subscription workflows.
  • Champion responsible AI use. Develop and refine AI-assisted and agentic workflows for implementation, testing, debugging, review, and documentation. Protect sensitive information, validate generated changes, and maintain accountability for the resulting software.
  • Help the team succeed. Mentor engineers, lead constructive code and design reviews, document important decisions, and establish shared practices that improve the team’s effectiveness.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Deep JavaScript expertise and substantial experience building and operating production web applications and Node.js services.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives across systems or teams, with impact beyond their individual contributions.
  • Strong frontend fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser behavior, and application performance, alongside experience with frameworks such as Vue or React.
  • Experience designing APIs, data models, and integrations, including reliable handling of authentication, authorization, and transactional workflows.
  • Sound judgment when evolving mature codebases, including knowing when to extend existing patterns and when to introduce new approaches.
  • Strong debugging and testing skills, with experience diagnosing problems across application, service, and data boundaries.
  • The ability to connect engineering decisions to reader experience and business outcomes, including subscription conversion, engagement, and retention.
  • Experience using AI development tools responsibly, including providing useful context, evaluating generated output, and recognizing when human review and decision-making are essential.
  • Clear communication, collaborative technical leadership, and the ability to contribute to a TypeScript and React Native codebase.

Additional experience that would be valuable includes:

  • Consumer subscriptions, digital media, ecommerce, or other businesses built around recurring customer relationships.
  • Paywalls, payment platforms, subscription billing integrations, identity systems, or entitlement management.
  • Experimentation platforms, conversion analytics, and customer lifecycle experiences.
  • React Native, Expo, or shipping applications for iOS and Android.
  • Content management systems, editorial workflows, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
  • Building reusable AI workflows, agent tooling, or automation that improves engineering productivity.

Our web platform uses Node.js, Express, Clay CMS, Vue, and Handlebars. Our mobile app uses TypeScript, React Native, and Expo. You’ll work across these technologies and the services connecting content, customer accounts, and subscriptions.

We value curiosity, trust, respect, and clear communication. We’re looking for someone who enjoys sharing knowledge, learning from colleagues, and helping the whole team succeed. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every technology listed.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

job.title: Director/Senior Director, Deal Structuring & Valuation
job.description:
At Warner Chappell Music (WCM) - the global music publishing arm of Warner Music Group (WMG) - we shape the culture of songwriting and champion songs that resonate for generations by creating transformational opportunities for songwriters everywhere. Our people and culture are at the epicenter of our company, and we are looking for team members who share our service-oriented mindset and have a passion for looking after our songwriters.

A little bit about our team:

The deals office drives the evaluation and structure of all recorded music and music publishing deals to enable long-term growth. We partner with closely with global business leaders to assess opportunities that balance creativity with commercial value strengthening our market position and shareholder value

Your role:

The Director, Deal Structuring & Valuation will play a critical leadership role within the Deals Office, leading all aspects of the financial assessment, complex modeling, and strategic structuring of significant deals across recorded music and music publishing. This role demands deep industry knowledge, advanced analytical capabilities, and the ability to proactively identify deal structures that maximize shareholder returns while aligning with business strategy and artist-first values.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the development and refinement of sophisticated financial models and valuation analyses for high-stakes deals (e.g., partnerships, artist/publishing catalog acquisitions, and frontline deals).

  • Drive the strategic structuring of deal economics and terms, collaborating closely with senior business, legal, and creative collaborators to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and growth plans.

  • Proactively identify and assess diverse deal structures to optimize financial returns and lead risk effectively.

  • Develop and implement global frameworks and best practices for deal valuation methodologies, financial forecasting, and scenario planning.

  • Manage adherence to deal budgets, forecast expenditures, and ensure adherence to cash targets and corporate return thresholds.

  • Prepare and present compelling financial analyses and deal recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Mentor and guide junior analysts/managers on financial modeling techniques, valuation best practices, and industry-specific deal nuances.

  • Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and evolving monetization models to inform innovative deal structures and pricing strategies.

About you:

  • 7-10+ years of progressive experience in finance, corporate development, investment banking, or a similar deal-focused role, with significant experience in the music, entertainment, or media sectors.

  • Extensive expertise in advanced financial modeling, valuation techniques (DCF, precedent transactions, comparable company analysis), and deal structuring.

  • Proven track record of successfully leading financial analysis for complex commercial agreements.

  • Deep understanding of music rights, revenue streams, and the unique economic drivers of the music industry.

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Superior communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate at all levels.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

  • MBA, CFA, or equivalent experience strongly preferred

About Us:

Before the fans and fame, the soundtracks and syncs, there is the song. And before the song comes the songwriter - the heart of an art form that defines generations, and the soul of our business. Songwriters are our inspiration; we are their partners, collaborators, and crusaders. Songwriters shape culture; and here at Warner Chappell Music we help hone their craft, build their careers, and protect their legacies. We value curiosity, collaboration, and commitment – which helps set us apart and helps us in our commitment and global service to our songwriters. We are Warner Chappell Music - where songwriters are heard.

As part of the larger Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

job.description:

Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

The Corporate Finance Department at Warner Music Group is responsible for overseeing all of the financial operations of the Company in partnership with the finance groups at the labels and individual companies within Warner Music Group. The department provides financial reporting, accounting, planning, budgeting, and financial compliance for the Company. The department is filled with fun, outgoing and overall successful individuals who work hard all while enjoying the perks of working in the Music Industry.


Your role:

Warner Music Group is excited to offer this opportunity in the Corporate Finance Department. This position is responsible for analyzing certain income statement accounts and other key reporting metrics for budget, actuals and forecast submissions on a consolidated basis for Warner Music Group. This position reports to the VP of Financial Reporting. 


Here you’ll get to:

  • Prepare financial statement analytics and reviews for non-operating income statement activity (i.e. “below-the-line” accounts) for budget, actuals and forecasts
  • Coordinate with segments and affiliates on the accurate recording and submission of below-the-line activity for all required income statement submissions including depreciation, amortization, interest expense, interest income, equity income, noncontrolling interest, foreign exchange gains and losses, and other non-operating activity.
  • Prepare of debt covenant calculations, including a trailing twelve months adjusted EBITDA calculation, for budget, forecasts, and quarterly and annual report periods
  • Prepare CFO Analytics Package which is used by the Company’s Global CFO to assist in their preparation of the quarterly earnings process
  • Assist in preparation of management reporting deliverables for key metrics and below-the-line analysis
  • Collaborate with external reporting and technical accounting to ensure below-the-line activity is properly reported in accordance with US GAAP and disclosed in the WMG quarterly and annual financial statements (e.g. Form 10-K, Form 10-Q)
  • Assist with the preparation review of certain monthly recurring journal entries in our consolidation system (HFM)
  • Oversee the Sr. Financial Analyst – Consolidations and Financial Reporting who is responsible for performing the monthly intercompany reconciliation, monitoring the status of the monthly close, and preparing various financial reporting deliverables.
  • Liaise directly with Financial Planning and Analysis to prepare quarterly income statement analysis, management discussion and analysis, and other ad-hoc reporting and analysis in connection with our quarterly earnings process.
  • Collaborate with External Reporting and Investor Relations to assist in the development in the quarterly and annual press releases earning scripts documents, and other financial communications.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience in accounting
  • Big Four public accounting or large multinational experience preferred
  • CPA or CPA candidate a plus
  • Intermediate level knowledge of GAAP/SEC accounting and reporting
  • Proficient with MS office (Excel, PowerPoint and Word)
  • Knowledge of SAP, S/4HANA, Hyperion Financial Management is a plus



We’d love it if you also had:

  • Strong work-ethic and a self-starter with effective organizational skills with attention to detail who proactively seeks out new solutions
  • Demonstrate problem solving, decision making, and continuous process improvement skills
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize projects. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Demonstrates partnering, influencing, and communication skills up and down the organizational structure to convey key elements in a concise and positive manner
  • Ability to communicate clearly and identify issues, without being prompted to do so
  • Ability to work proactively, independently, and as a strategic partner in a team environment
  • Ability to find and implement efficiencies within tasks successfully
  • Demonstrates critical thinking and dedication to deepening understanding of work being done
  • Passion for music and desire to build a career in Finance


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. Job Title: Manager, Marketing (Revolution)


A little bit about our team:

Revolution is Warner Records’ distribution and artist development business, helping emerging artists grow their audiences and build lasting careers. We work across genres, combining a nimble and personal approach to artist development with the expertise and resources of Warner Records. Our team partners closely with artists and managers, bringing together marketing, viral, creative, and distribution support to help each project move forward.


Your role:

In this role, you’ll own campaigns for an assigned roster, leading new releases and sustaining momentum across the catalog. As the main day-to-day contact for artists and managers, you will translate their goals into clear plans and coordinate with internal and external partners to deliver on them.  Additionally, you’ll manage timelines, budgets, and communication while bringing fresh ideas and solving problems as they arise.  This exciting new role will have the opportunity to help shape a growing business and make a direct impact on the artists we support!


Here you’ll get to:

  • Own marketing strategy and campaign management for an assigned roster, from release planning through ongoing catalog development
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for artists and managers, building trust, managing expectations, and providing clear, timely updates
  • Partner with the viral team to develop campaign briefs, align on priorities, and coordinate execution, keeping artist feedback and campaign goals connected
  • Lead campaign meetings and maintain project plans across internal teams and external partners, assigning responsibilities, tracking deadlines, and following through on commitments
  • Manage release calendars and coordinate artwork, content, approvals, and distribution deadlines to ensure releases are delivered accurately and on time
  • Bring fresh, practical marketing ideas tailored to each artist’s identity, genre, and audience, adapting quickly when new opportunities emerge
  • Develop and manage campaign budgets, select and coordinate vendors, track spending, and recommend investment priorities in collaboration with leadership and Finance
  • Review streaming, social, and campaign performance to refine strategy, identify catalog opportunities, and turn results into clear next steps
  • Resolve day-to-day issues independently, anticipate delays, and keep leadership informed of key developments and decisions that need input

About you:

  • You have 2–4 years of relevant experience in marketing, campaign or project management, artist services, or a related field
  • You have strong organizational skills and a track record of managing multiple projects at once, with close attention to detail and consistent follow-through
  • You have excellent communication and relationship skills, with the ability to earn artists’ trust, lead productive conversations, and manage expectations
  • You are passionate about music across genres and understand how different artists, audiences, and fan communities call for different approaches
  • You have a strong understanding of TikTok, viral marketing, and how audiences discover and engage with music online
  • You enjoy developing original, resourceful ideas and turning them into practical plans with the teams responsible for execution
  • You enjoy taking ownership in a fast-paced environment, balancing changing priorities and solving problems with sound judgment
  • You have confidence working with campaign budgets and performance data to inform decisions

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience working with independent or emerging artists at a label, distributor, or management company
  • Experience coordinating campaigns with viral marketing teams, creative agencies, or external marketing partners
  • Familiarity with music analytics tools, release workflows, and project management platforms

Job Title: Sr. Manager, Digital Accounts, Order to Cash


A little bit about our team: 

Warner Music’s Nashville Shared Services Center (SSC)  is the home to the financial and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our US, Canadian, and Latin American Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The Nashville Center embodies the innovative and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in nurturing entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities.


Your role: 

If you are an amazing Order-To-Cash (OTC) leader who wants to deliver technical and process oriented solutions within our regional center, then keep reading!


Here you’ll get to: 

  • Lead the Digital and Royalty Stream AR team and ensure operational tasks are being completed as required.
  • Candidate will own and be responsible for invoices, collections, cash application, Revenue Assurance and risk assessments.
  • Candidate will also play an active role in cash forecasting, bad debt management, and will liaise with various stakeholders within and outside the organization.
  • Facilitate setup and tracking of new accounts and maintain relationships with DSPs and licensing and sync partners for the Recorded Music and Publishing segments.
  • Manage DSP portal access and statement tracking, including shared credentials and follow-up on missing statements.
  • Provide input and analysis relating to risk of Digital Accounts as needed and overall management of the Risk Review schedule and timeline for the Digital portfolio.
  • Serve as primary contact for SSC Accounting, Legal, Finance, and Business Teams.
  • Review contracts for terms, advances, payments, reporting, and pricing for use in various tracking and reconciliation projects.
  • Manage and track Invoice Advance/Guarantees, Formatting, and Prep Fees to ensure timely payment.
  • Implement, translate and review contractual language for royalty related revenue stream customers and other partners.
  • Accurately record and report all digital revenues by media type and ensure that all cash is properly applied and required triggers for revenue recognition are met.
  • Lead and develop both internal and offshore resources including day-to-day management of the offshore Digital team (SLAs, coverage, SOPs, knoweldge transfer and escalation).
  • Assist in preparing Cash Forecasts for significant revenue streams associated with our industry in partnership with FP&A
  • Prepare accruals for outstanding unprocessed or revised sales reporting files.
  • Work with customers to resolve account discrepancies and collect any additional monies.
  • Own unapplied cash and on-account or advance balances. Reconcile lump-sum collective receipts to invoices and clear residuals per contract terms.
  • Partner with Sales and Business Development on payment plans and customer escalations, with decisions documented.
  • Ensure proper tracking of income for cash projection and application references.
  • Oversee daily cash reporting, and other follow-up processes as needed.
  • Define and monitor aging, unapplied cash, billing accuracy, on-time invoicing and collection effectiveness.
  • Develop efficient, innovative ways to streamline and improve processes around use and storage of data reported, i.e. Current List, Digital Income and other excel spreadsheets currently in use.
  • Concentrate on cleanup activities while maintaining an eye on process improvement possibilities. 
  • Leading account review, cash forecast and bad debt meetings with Corporate Controllership and Finance Shared Service Leadership.
  • Facilitate monthly royalty payments for promotional funds, rights holders, and other internal payees as needed.
  • Support revenue recognition function where applicable.
  • Partner with RTR on AR and cash reconciliations and SOX evidence for Digital.
  • Own and review SOX controls established and operating over the Digital portfolio
  • Maintain SOPs, backups and cross-training for Digital close and SOX tasks.

About you: 

  • 10 years of progressive experience in Finance Operations, shared services, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, and related OTC processes or revenue accounting.
  • Minimum of five years leading large teams including outsourced support resources
  • Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA and Vistex (or a similar royalty and billing platform)
  • Expert process knowledge of the sub-towers: Customer Master Data, Credit Management, Billing, Collections, Dispute Management, and Cash Application.
  • Bachelor’s degree required (Finance preferred)
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, data governance, and SOX compliance.
  • Well versed in data analytics with proficiency with BI software, Excel, or other tools to construct data matching models.

We’d love it if you also had: 

  • Deep understanding of ASC 606 (US GAAP) and/or IFRS 15(Revenue from contracts with Customers.)   
  • Detailed understanding of Music Industry revenue streams
  • MBA in Finance
  • Working knowledge of Music Industry meta data on products, tracks, and other artist related works.

job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team

Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is one of the most influential newsrooms in the world, and our subscriber base is growing to match. This role sits at the center of that growth responsible for how enterprise clients and professional product subscribers experience The Post after they sign up. WP Intelligence is our professional intelligence product line, delivering curated reporting, data, and analysis for decision-makers across industries. As the Engagement Marketing Lead for Enterprise and WP Intelligence, you will own the subscriber journey from activation through renewal designing omnichannel programs that help organizations and professionals get lasting value from their subscriptions.

Reporting to the Director of Engagement and Retention, you will partner closely with Enterprise Sales and Account Management, WP Intelligence Editorial, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and Brand Marketing to build and execute strategies that drive measurable engagement and long-term retention.

Why This Role Matters

  • You support The Post’s mission to deliver world-class journalism while expanding reach and influence

  • You drive data-informed marketing strategies that improve activation, usage, and long-term retention

  • You thrive in collaborative environments that value initiative, clarity, and continuous improvement

  • You enjoy leading fast-paced, cross-platform programs that enhance subscriber experience and fuel business growth

How You'll Support the Mission

Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and execute full-funnel lifecycle programs that increase usage and deepen engagement across app, site, newsletters, and subscription benefits for enterprise and professional product subscribers.

  • Build subscriber journeys spanning lead progression, account activation, onboarding, education, loyalty, and renewal maintaining playbooks that support scalable, repeatable execution.

  • Design approaches that serve multiple audiences within a single account, including corporate and higher education end users, students, and key decision-makers.

  • Identify and promote product features, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that drive long-term value and contract renewal.

  • Partner with Brand, Product, Engineering, and Editorial to align lifecycle initiatives with broader business goals and the group customer experience.

Performance and Experimentation

  • Monitor engagement trends, feature adoption, and lifecycle performance using dashboards and core KPIs.

  • Translate subscriber behavior into insights that guide strategy and experimentation.

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests to refine segmentation, messaging, channel sequencing, and timing.

  • Identify friction points in the subscriber experience and collaborate cross-functionally to improve activation, engagement, and renewal rates.

  • Partner with Analytics and Data Engineering to refine audience definitions, data inputs, and targeting models.

Execution and Operations

  • Design and manage integrated engagement campaigns across email, onsite surfaces, in-app messages, and push notifications.

  • Develop clear creative and technical briefs that guide asset production; lead QA and auditing to uphold accuracy across all touchpoints.

  • Document processes and improve operational workflows to support scalable delivery.

  • Use subscriber signals and feedback gathered in partnership with Enterprise Sales, Account Management, and Support — to inform proactive engagement strategies and feature improvements.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in digital, growth, EdTech, or subscription marketing with deep expertise in customer engagement, activation, or habit formation across diverse audiences.

  • Experience working with B2B customers and partnering with internal Sales teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Marketing Technology platforms like Iterable, and familiarity with customer data systems and e-commerce platforms.

job.title: Congressional Reporter (5-month contract)
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a sourced, creative and high-energy reporter to cover the U.S. Senate on a temporary basis.


This is a full-time, approximately five-month assignment filling in for a member of our Congress team who will be on parental leave. The temporary contract position is expected to begin Nov. 30.


We are looking for an aggressive and versatile journalist who can hit the ground running on one of Washington’s most competitive beats. The successful candidate will know how to cultivate sources, break news, explain complex policy fights and demystify the sometimes arcane workings of the Senate — from reconciliation and the filibuster to holds, confirmations and floor procedure — for a broad audience.


The ideal candidate has a proven ability to deliver agenda-setting reporting and a clear sense of how to tell stories about Congress that resonate well beyond Washington. This reporter will illuminate the personalities, power struggles and policy battles shaping the Senate, bringing authority and insight to consequential developments while finding opportunities for enterprise and accountability reporting. We are looking for someone who can deploy seriousness, wit and narrative flair as the story demands.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You

  • You are driven to break news and compete aggressively on one of Washington’s most consequential beats.
  • You thrive on cultivating sources and uncovering what is happening behind the scenes.
  • You enjoy making complicated legislative and procedural fights clear and compelling for a general audience.
  • You are fascinated by the personalities, alliances and power dynamics that shape the Senate.
  • You are collaborative and eager to contribute immediately to a high-performing team.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Work collaboratively with The Post’s Congress team to make what happens in the Senate — and how it affects people across the country and around the world — interesting and accessible to a broad audience.
  • Break news on senators, Senate leadership, key committees and the political and policy dynamics driving the chamber.
  • Quickly develop and maintain sources among senators, aides, committee staff, administration officials, activists, lobbyists and others seeking to influence the Senate.
  • Cover major policy and procedural fights, including legislation, nominations and confirmations, explaining both the political stakes and real-world consequences.
  • Track the relationship between the Senate and other centers of political power, including the House, White House and federal judiciary.
  • Identify opportunities for enterprise and accountability reporting, including potential conflicts of interest, misconduct and abuses of power.
  • Produce fast, authoritative journalism as news develops while pursuing original reporting that distinguishes The Post’s coverage.
  • Adhere to the highest ethical standards, ensuring fairness, rigor and meaningful opportunities for subjects of our reporting to respond.
  • Think creatively about the best formats for our journalism, collaborating with data reporters, graphics journalists, photographers, designers and video journalists to maximize impact.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • At least five years of experience covering Congress, another legislature or a similarly competitive political or government beat, with a track record of breaking impactful stories.
  • Experience covering the Senate is strongly preferred.
  • Existing Senate sourcing and familiarity with Senate rules, institutions and procedure that would enable you to contribute quickly are significant advantages.
  • Demonstrated ability to report and write breaking news with speed, clarity and precision.
  • Strong source-building skills and an instinct for original and consequential reporting.
  • An ability to explain complicated policy and procedural matters without resorting to insider language.
  • Excellent news judgment and the ability to balance the demands of daily coverage with enterprise and accountability reporting.
  • An eagerness to collaborate with colleagues across a competitive, fast-moving newsroom.
  • A commitment to accuracy, fairness and the highest standards of journalism.

Interested candidates should upload a cover letter, résumé and three examples of their work (as PDFs) to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Nov. 1 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Deputy Congress Editor Sean Collins, Congress Editor John Wagner, Deputy Politics & Government Editor Jen Liberto and Politics & Government Editor Nick Baumann.


This is a full-time contract position expected to begin Nov. 30 and last approximately five months while a member of the Congress team is on leave. It pays between $8,000 - $10,000 per month, depending on experience level and qualifications.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Financial Controller plays a critical leadership role in ensuring the integrity, transparency, and long-term sustainability of The Washington Post’s financial operations as a privately held media organization. Reporting to the Acting CFO, this role provides enterprise-wide stewardship of global accounting, financial reporting, governance, and systems evolution—supporting informed decision-making and responsible growth. 


This role is designed for a strategic financial leader who can lead meaningful transformation while maintaining rigorous accounting discipline. In the near term, the Financial Controller will assess current-state accounting operations, systems, and team capabilities and lead a deliberate redesign of the controllership function. This includes rethinking how accounting work is structured, enabled by technology, and experienced by the team. Over time, the scope of this role will expand, further strengthening enterprise-wide financial stewardship. 


As a highly visible leader, the Financial Controller balances hands-on execution with enterprise leadership—providing trusted stewardship in a complex, evolving environment while shaping the future of how accounting operates at The Washington Post. 


What Motivates You 

  • Leading financial stewardship in a privately held media organization where integrity, discretion, and long-term thinking are essential 
  • Challenging legacy processes and assumptions to reimagine how accounting work can be performed and delivered 
  • Driving transformation that goes beyond incremental improvement to reshape operating models, team culture, and ways of working 
  • Serving as both a strategic leader and a hands-on expert when the work or moment requires it 
  • Building strong, capable teams through active coaching, clear expectations, and a commitment to continuous development 

 

How You’ll Support the Mission 

 

Strategic Accounting & Financial Leadership 

  • Provide enterprise leadership for global accounting operations, including general ledger, close, consolidation, and statutory reporting. 
  • Establish and advance a long-term vision for the controllership function aligned with organizational strategy and the needs of a privately held media company. 
  • Assess, redesign, and modernize accounting processes, operating models, and organizational structure to support scale, resilience, and effectiveness. 
  • Operate as a “player-coach,” moving seamlessly between strategic leadership and hands-on accounting work as needed during periods of transformation, team development, and systems change. 

Financial Reporting, Controls & Governance 

  • Maintain final accountability for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all internal and external financial reporting. 
  • Own the worldwide consolidation and end-to-end accounting close process. 
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce global accounting policies and standards to ensure consistency and compliance, including revenue recognition. 
  • Design, implement, and maintain a strong internal control environment appropriate to a privately held enterprise. 
  • Oversee financial reporting controls and internal audit activities. 
  • Prepare and present financial reports, analyses, and insights to senior leadership. 

ERP, Systems & Technology Transformation 

  • Lead the evaluation, selection, and migration of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including assessment of tradeoffs, risks, and long-term implications. 
  • Own the future-state accounting systems architecture and ensure alignment with business strategy, scalability needs, and data integrity standards. 
  • Provide hands-on leadership during system migrations, recognizing and mitigating change and execution risk. 
  • Drive optimization of existing and new systems to improve automation, accuracy, and transparency across accounting operations. 

Audit, Risk & Stakeholder Partnership 

  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors, including coordination of pension and 401(k)-related audits. 
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality, timely, and informative financial reporting. 
  • Collaborate with FP&A to ensure reporting supports internal decision-making and provides meaningful operational insights. 
  • Assume leadership of enterprise Risk functions as the role evolves, strengthening governance and risk awareness across the organization. 

People Leadership & Culture Building 

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing global accounting organization, recognizing that the current team is capable and still developing. 
  • Actively coach and mentor leaders and individual contributors, setting a high bar for performance, accountability, and growth. 
  • Establish a strong team culture and identity grounded in excellence, trust, inclusion, and continuous improvement. 
  • Create clarity around roles, expectations, and development pathways to support both near-term transformation and long-term capability building. 

Skills and Experience You Bring 

  • Deep technical accounting expertise with the ability to apply standards in complex, real-world business environments 
  • Demonstrated experience leading ERP evaluation, selection, and migration initiatives, including ownership of future-state system design 
  • Proven ability to lead and sustain transformation, including rethinking operating models and ways of working 
  • Comfort operating as both a strategic leader and hands-on practitioner during periods of change 
  • Strong judgment, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information 
  • Ability to translate accounting and financial concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders 
  • Experience operating effectively in highly visible leadership roles with critical deadlines and competing priorities 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance 
  • CPA designation 
  • 5+ years of experience leading teams to include people managers 
  • 10+ years progressive experience in accounting or financial management, including senior-level leadership responsibility at Big 4 or similar organization with revenue and systems complexities 
  • Experience leading ERP system evaluations and migrations 
  • Experience with global accounting operations, financial reporting, and audit coordination 
  • Experience in media, advertising, or directly related industries. 
  • Experience with automation or leading automation strategy and implementation 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Public accounting experience 
  • Experience in a privately held, multi-entity, or complex organizational environment 
  • Prior responsibility for or partnership with risk management, internal audit, or governance functions 
  • Experience leading accounting or finance transformations during periods of organizational or systems change

  • Anticipating risks, removing blockers, and keeping complex programs and activations on track.
  • Working collaboratively across creative, editorial, technical, event, and operational teams.
  • Continuously improving processes and identifying scalable solutions that support efficiency, consistency, and business growth.
  • Using data, automation, and AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to improve workflows and execution while maintaining strong human judgment and oversight.

How You'll Support the Mission


Program & Production Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of custom advertising programs, branded content campaigns, and event activations across digital, experiential, live, and virtual platforms.
  • Independently manage programs from kickoff and planning through production, launch, live execution, optimization, and post-campaign wrap-up.
  • Translate sold programs into clear execution plans that align stakeholders, resources, timelines, deliverables, event logistics, and client expectations.
  • Evaluate operational feasibility, resourcing needs, and executional tradeoffs and recommend solutions that balance quality, scalability, and business priorities.

Event & Sponsorship Execution

  • Serve as the primary production point of contact for event and program sponsors, guiding them through onboarding, asset collection, approvals, fulfillment, and execution.
  • Manage sponsor deliverables and branded integrations, including logos, speaking briefs, digital assets, event signage, marketing materials, and on-site or virtual activations.
  • Partner with Events, Editorial, Marketing, Creative, Production, venues, and external vendors to deliver engaging live and virtual experiences.
  • Manage event-related timelines, logistics, dependencies, and sponsor requirements to ensure activations are delivered on time and according to specifications.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a central point of coordination across Creative, Events, Editorial, Design, Development, Video, Audio, Ad Operations, Product, Marketing, and external partners.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project timelines, workflows, status reporting, and delivery documentation across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and executional gaps and implement mitigation plans to keep programs on track.
  • Navigate competing priorities, evolving stakeholder needs, and shifting timelines while maintaining delivery quality and accountability.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase operational efficiency, scalability, consistency, and program quality.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead day-to-day client and sponsor communication related to production timelines, deliverables, approvals, requirements, and execution strategy in partnership with Sales and Account Management.
  • Independently facilitate meetings and discussions with clients, agencies, sponsors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage feedback and approval processes to maintain alignment between client expectations and execution realities.
  • Serve as a trusted operational partner by communicating updates, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly and proactively.

Custom Product, Performance & Optimization

  • Collaborate with Ad Operations and Product teams to implement custom advertising solutions and event programs across platforms, ensuring custom elements are built, tested, quality-checked, and launched according to specifications.
  • Support social media, content distribution, promotional, and audience-engagement strategies in partnership with internal teams.
  • Partner with Account Management and Performance teams to monitor campaign delivery, attendee engagement, sponsorship effectiveness, and other relevant performance indicators.
  • Contribute production insights, custom metrics, event engagement data, and sponsor recap materials to post-campaign analysis and recommend opportunities to improve future execution and client outcomes.

Automation & Efficiency

  • Use AI-enabled and automation tools where appropriate to improve project tracking, scheduling, status reporting, meeting documentation, production coordination, quality assurance, and launch validation.
  • Explore opportunities to use emerging tools for audience insights, sponsorship reporting, risk identification, event planning, and activation support while maintaining strong human oversight, strategic judgment, and relationship management.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, production, account management, client services, or campaign execution within advertising, media, events, branded content, or related environments.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex, high-visibility, multi-stakeholder programs from initiation through delivery.
  • Experience executing custom, branded, or native advertising campaigns, including live or virtual event activations and sponsor fulfillment.
  • Strong understanding of digital media, content production, experiential logistics, advertising workflows, and integrated campaign execution.
  • Demonstrated experience managing sponsor or client relationships and leading communications with clients, agencies, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, project planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to proactively identify risks and drive solutions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative, editorial, technical, event production, and operational teams.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, navigate ambiguity, and drive execution with minimal oversight.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and project management platforms such as Asana, Jira, Prisma, or MediaOcean.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, workflow automation, collaboration, analytics, or reporting tools preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field preferred.

job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.

Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post’s Finance Department is seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to join our Financial Accounting and Reporting team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the integrity of financial data that enables our leaders to make informed, strategic decisions. You will thrive here if you are adaptable to evolving business priorities, curious about the bigger picture, and eager to apply your accounting expertise to enhance processes and deliver high-quality results.
 

What Motivates You

  • You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality financial information that supports strategic decision-making.

  • You have a keen eye for detail and maintain efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

  • You adapt quickly to shifting priorities and balance speed with precision in your daily work.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join the Subscriptions team at The Washington Post. This role spans the full application stack with a strong emphasis on the cloud infrastructure, delivery systems, and operational practices that keep our subscription products reliable and scalable. As a senior engineer, you will take ownership of complex technical work, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve how the team builds, deploys, and operates software.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AWS, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and production operations, along with strong application development experience in Java - our primary backend language - and Node.js, and familiarity with React. We value autonomy, initiative, strong communication, and meaningful day-to-day use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including continually finding new ways to apply AI to development, automation, operations, and team effectiveness.


What Motivates You

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for both the software you build and the systems that run it.
  • Passionate about reliable, scalable systems and making software delivery faster, safer, and more repeatable.
  • Proactive and comfortable driving complex work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Comfortable moving across application code, AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, developer tooling, and production operations.
  • Actively uses AI in day-to-day engineering and continually looks for ways to expand its impact on development, automation, operations, and productivity.
  • Enjoys collaborating across teams, mentoring others, and communicating technical decisions clearly upward and sideways.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate applications and services supporting our subscription products.
  • Own technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation through deployment, observability, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Design and maintain scalable, reliable AWS infrastructure using services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Build and evolve Infrastructure as Code, with experience using AWS CDK strongly valued.
  • Design, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and developer workflows.
  • Configure, operate, troubleshoot, and improve self-hosted engineering platforms such as Jenkins, Airflow, and similar systems.
  • Develop backend services and APIs primarily using Java, with Node.js used across supporting services, automation, and tooling.
  • Contribute to frontend applications built with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript when needed.
  • Build automation that reduces operational overhead and improves the reliability and repeatability of development and production processes.
  • Establish strong observability and diagnose complex issues spanning applications, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and third-party integrations.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, taking ownership of incident diagnosis, mitigation, communication, and systemic follow-up.
  • Identify technical debt, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement and proactively drive solutions.
  • Communicate technical decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to engineering peers, leadership, product partners, and adjacent teams.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical standards, architecture discussions, documentation, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI extensively throughout the engineering lifecycle and identify opportunities to apply it to development, infrastructure, troubleshooting, automation, incident investigation, and operational workflows.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience, including designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.
  • 4+ years of experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code in production environments.
  • 3+ years of backend development experience with Java, including building and operating production services and APIs. Java is the team’s primary backend language.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Node.js, including services, automation, developer tooling, or infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience administering and operating self-hosted engineering platforms such as Jenkins, Airflow, or similar technologies in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, IAM, security, scalability, reliability, and operational best practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with containerized workloads and services such as Docker and ECS.
  • Strong production operations and observability experience, including logs, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting across applications and infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting business-critical systems through an on-call rotation, incident response, and post-incident remediation.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to contribute to application code when needed.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently identify, scope, and drive complex technical work with limited oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively upward and across organizational boundaries.
  • Significant hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools in day-to-day work. Candidates should be able to discuss concrete examples of applying AI to infrastructure, automation, software development, troubleshooting, incident investigation, documentation, or other engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on AWS, DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure experience, including ownership of highly available, scalable production environments.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and operating CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code across multiple applications or teams.
  • 5+ years of backend development experience with Java and 3+ years with Node.js.
  • 2+ years of experience with React or a comparable modern frontend framework, with the ability to contribute to and support modern JavaScript/TypeScript applications when needed.
  • Deep experience with AWS CDK and building reusable infrastructure patterns, constructs, and deployment tooling.
  • Significant production experience administering and evolving Jenkins, Airflow, or comparable self-hosted engineering platforms.
  • Deep experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Experience building reusable infrastructure, deployment patterns, automation, and developer tooling used across engineering teams.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as DataDog and AWS-native monitoring services.
  • Experience improving developer experience and engineering productivity through platform engineering, automation, and self-service tooling.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing infrastructure, reliability, and operational practices across team boundaries.
  • Advanced use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including experience helping other engineers expand their effective use of AI across infrastructure, operations, automation, troubleshooting, and software development.
