Why we're hiring:

The Enterprise Security Architect at WPP will be a pivotal role, responsible for defining and evolving the security architecture within WPP. This role ensures that WPP's technology landscape is designed with security, resilience, and compliance as fundamental pillars. The architect will bridge the gap between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technical implementation, specifically focusing on embedding security best practices.

Operating heavily in the Cyber Risk and Compliance function, the role will have a strong Security Operations architecture focus and will be key to ensuring the Security Operations function is successful and effective.  

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the security foundation of one of the world's leading creative transformation companies. You will work on cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with diverse global teams, and directly contribute to protecting WPP's intellectual property, client data, and brand reputation in an evolving digital landscape.

 

What you'll be doing:

Security Architecture Strategy: Develop, maintain, and communicate the domain-specific security architecture vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with WPP's overall enterprise security strategy and business goals.

Secure Design & Development: Provide expert architectural guidance and oversight for key projects and initiatives within the domain, advocating for secure design principles, patterns, and practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

 Compliance & Governance: Ensure that architectural designs and implementations adhere to relevant regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001) and internal security policies. Participate in security audits and assessments, translating findings into actionable architectural improvements.

 Threat & Risk Management: Conduct architectural risk assessments and threat modelling within the domain, identifying potential vulnerabilities and recommending appropriate mitigating controls. Integrate risk management practices into architectural decision-making.

 Cybersecurity Integration: Embed advanced cybersecurity concepts, technologies, and best practices (e.g., identity and access management, data protection, network security, incident response capabilities) into the domain's architecture.

Standards & Patterns: Define and promote security architecture standards, guidelines, and reusable patterns for the domain to foster consistency, efficiency, and robustness across solutions. Create associated designs and artefacts as the requirement arises. 

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with other Enterprise Architects, Security Operations, CISO office, Development Teams, Product Owners, and Legal/Compliance to translate security requirements into technical solutions and gain consensus on solutions and architectural direction.

Technology Evaluation: Research, evaluate, and recommend new security technologies and architectural approaches that can enhance the security posture and efficiency of the domain.

Documentation & Communication: Create clear, concise, and comprehensive security architecture documentation, including diagrams, principles, and decision records. Effectively communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Security Solution Architecture: When required, form, lead and contribute to successful deliver of specific security solutions and workstreams.

 

What you'll need:

  • Bachelors\master’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or CCSP are highly desirable.
  • Architectural Expertise: Proven experience (2+ years) as an Enterprise Architect, Domain Architect, or Security Architect in a large, complex enterprise environment, preferably within the advertising, media, or professional services industry.
  • Security Frameworks: Deep understanding and practical experience with security architecture frameworks (e.g., NIST, SABSA, TOGAF-ADM with security overlays) and industry best practices.
  • Cybersecurity Knowledge: Strong understanding of contemporary cybersecurity threats, attack vectors, and defence mechanisms. Experience with various security domains including application security, infrastructure security, data security, cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), and identity management.
  • Compliance Acumen: Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and other relevant industry compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • Risk Management: Demonstrated ability to perform security risk analysis, articulate risks to stakeholders, and propose effective architectural mitigations.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to decompose complex security challenges into manageable architectural solutions.
  • Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence technical teams and senior leadership on security architectural direction.
  • Technical Acumen: Hands-on experience with security tools and technologies is a plus, enabling informed architectural decisions.

 As Data Operations Lead, you will establish and head our new Data Integration & Operations team in Chennai. This is a build-and-run role: you'll define how the team operates while leading day-to-day delivery of operational excellence across global data products. 

 You will be the custodian of production—owning the operational layer including CI/CD automation, deployment pipelines, monitoring, data quality enforcement, incident management, and support. This role requires deep technical knowledge of Databricks and modern data platforms, alongside the ability to lead, mentor, and scale a growing team.

 

What you'll be doing:

Technical Ownership & Execution 

  • Lead the team responsible for data integration, orchestration, and platform operations across Azure and GCP environments 
  • Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Databricks Asset Bundles for data workflows 
  • Design platform-wide monitoring, logging, and alerting covering pipeline execution, data quality, SLA compliance, and cost 
  • Manage production deployments and own centralized job orchestration via Databricks Jobs/Workflows (scheduling, dependencies, retries, notifications) 
  • Implement comprehensive data quality testing and validation using dbt's testing framework and custom checks 

Operational Standardization 

  • Create and roll out standard operating procedures, runbooks, onboarding guides, and automation patterns 
  • Establish reusable deployment frameworks and project templates for consistent implementation across markets 
  • Build and maintain the Central Data Solution Repository with reusable assets (dlthub pipelines, dbt models, tests, macros) 
  • Define repeatable deployment patterns ensuring standards and best practices are followed globally 

Platform Support & Governance 

  • Set up and manage SLAs, incident workflows, and escalation models 
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational risks in cloud-based data platforms 
  • Partner with DevOps to leverage Databricks Unity Catalog for governance, access control, and lineage 
  • Enforce data quality standards and governance policies embedded within pipeline code 

Team Leadership 

  • Lead and mentor the Data Integration & Operations team in Chennai 
  • Shape the team's operating model, priorities, and capabilities 
  • Act as subject matter expert and escalation point for technical operations 
  • Facilitate regular retrospectives to drive continuous improvement and optimize processes 
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams globally 

What you'll need:

Experience 

  • 7+ years in data operations, platform engineering, or data engineering with hands-on production experience 
  • 3+ years in technical leadership or team lead capacity, with proven ability to build and scale teams 
  • Demonstrated experience establishing DataOps practices and operational frameworks from the ground up 

Technical Expertise 

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks platform, specifically: 
  • Databricks SQL Warehouses, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows 
  • Databricks Asset Bundles for Infrastructure as Code 
  • Delta Lake performance optimization 
  • Strong proficiency with dbt (Core): project structure, macros, tests, documentation, CI/CD integration, production troubleshooting 
  • Expert-level cloud platform knowledge (Azure and/or GCP): 
  • Object storage (ADLS/GCS), secret management (Key Vault/Secret Manager) 
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) 
  • CI/CD mastery with GitHub Actions: workflow design, secrets management, automated testing and deployment 
  • Proficient in Python for automation and scripting (experience with dlthub is a major plus) 
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation, quality testing, and troubleshooting 

 

Operational & Leadership Skills 

  • Proven ability to design operational frameworks: monitoring, alerting, incident management, SLA tracking 
  • Experience managing production data platforms with high uptime requirements 
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to articulate technical concepts to diverse audiences 
  • Strong documentation skills and commitment to knowledge sharing 

  • Preferred Skills 

    • Experience working in multi-cloud environments (Azure + GCP) 
    • Familiarity with Power BI or similar BI platforms 
    • Understanding of FinOps practices for cloud cost optimization

Who Should Apply 

 This role is ideal for candidates with: 

  • Real, hands-on project experience building and running production data platforms at scale 
  • Proven leadership in establishing DataOps practices and growing high-performing teams 
  • Deep technical expertise in the Databricks ecosystem and modern data stack 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset—comfortable with ambiguity and building systems from the ground up 

 This role is not a fit if your experience is primarily theoretical, course-based, or lacks production-grade exposure to the core technologies outlined above.

job.title: Data Steward - People Platforms
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

Operational reporting and team support

  • Provide first-line support for master data issues raised by downstream consumers and business users.
  • Contribute to operational reporting on stewardship volumes, exception trends, match rates, and resolution times.

Support data migration and reconciliation activities during source system onboarding and platform changes.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in a data stewardship, data administration, or master data management role.
  • Practical understanding of MDM concepts including golden records, matching, survivorship, and entity resolution.
  • Familiarity with enterprise master data management and data governance solutions (e.g. Informatica MDM, Informatica Data Governance) or equivalent platforms is desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data investigation, validation, and reporting.
  • Understanding of data governance principles including data classification, ownership, and stewardship workflows.
  • Willingness to work with AI and machine learning tools as part of day-to-day stewardship operations, including reviewing AI-suggested matches, classifications, and enrichments.
  • Experience working with ERP or HCM data (Workday, SAP, Dynamics, or similar) is an advantage.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies methodically.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent stewardship tasks and priorities.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to document and explain findings clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data problems.
  • Enthusiasm for developing expertise in master data management, data governance, and AI-assisted data operations.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

Job Description – Delivery Manager  

Location: Gurugram, India 
Experience: 12–16 years, with 5+ years in delivery management 
Function: Technology Delivery 

Role Overview 

We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager with strong expertise in Agile delivery and exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled ways of working. 

The role involves leading multiple Agile teams, driving predictable delivery, managing cross-functional dependencies, and improving delivery efficiency through effective processes and AI-enabled tools. 

The ideal candidate will have strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead end-to-end delivery across multiple Agile teams and initiatives. 
  • Drive Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. 
  • Ensure clear sprint goals, prioritized backlogs, and predictable execution. 
  • Monitor delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, sprint predictability, and cycle time. 
  • Manage dependencies, risks, impediments, and stakeholder escalations. 
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, QA, and global stakeholders to align priorities and delivery commitments. 
  • Establish effective delivery governance, reporting, and communication cadences. 
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI tools for improved planning, documentation, reporting, testing, and productivity. 
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, quality, and team effectiveness. 
  • Manage resource planning, capacity, and allocation across teams. 

Required Skills & Experience 

  • 12–16 years of experience in technology delivery or program management. 
  • 5+ years of experience managing Agile delivery across multiple teams. 
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, Agile principles, and scaled Agile practices. 
  • Experience managing cross-functional technology teams in a global delivery environment. 
  • Practical exposure to AI/GenAI tools and their application in delivery workflows. 
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, engineering practices, and release management. 
  • Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Agile metrics, and delivery reporting. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent certifications. 
  • Experience in Agile transformation or delivery excellence initiatives. 
  • Exposure to AI-assisted engineering, workflow automation, or productivity improvement initiatives. 

Success Measures 

  • Improved delivery predictability and team throughput. 
  • Effective management of dependencies and delivery risks. 
  • Improved stakeholder satisfaction and delivery transparency. 
  • Measurable productivity improvements through AI and automation. 
  • Improved quality and overall team effectiveness. 

Ideal Candidate 

A delivery-focused leader who combines strong Agile expertise with practical AI awareness. The candidate should be capable of leading multiple teams, driving accountability, managing complex dependencies, and delivering measurable improvements in productivity and execution. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.title: Director of Product, Creative Capability
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-powered marketing platform, helping teams move from insight and ideation through to the development and delivery of effective creative work at scale.

We are building the trusted environment where the best of AI and human craft meet, so that when a creative chooses to work in Open, it is because Open genuinely makes the work better, not just faster. Done well, this means creative teams across WPP trust Open enough to bring their best thinking to it first, every time, rather than working around it.

We are looking for a seasoned marketing and advertising creative technologist with a passion for building industry-leading products to join as a Director of Product for Creative and help lead the creative capability in WPP Open. This is a hands-on, practitioner-led product role for someone who has spent real time inside agency creative and production teams, using AI tools day-to-day to develop visual concepts, generate assets, produce video and iterate creative routes, not just experimenting with them in isolation.

Sitting at the intersection of code, AI and craft, you will work directly alongside creative directors, strategists and producers to prototype and stress-test ideas quickly, determining which combination of AI models, tools and human skill is needed to bring a concept to life at the speed and quality the work demands. You will be the hands-on translator who bridges the gap between what a creative idea needs and what WPP Open can build, benchmarking industry practice, evaluating new tools, and turning validated ways of working into repeatable product capability that the wider creative community can rely on.

A major part of this role is earning the trust of creative practitioners by proving, in their hands and on real briefs, that WPP Open can help them push ideas further rather than simply produce them faster.

What you'll be doing:

This role sits within Experience Development, the team shaping how WPP Open turns ideas, workflows and AI capability into usable product experiences. You will work closely with Creative, Product, Technology, Product Design, Research and client-facing teams. You will:

  • Lead and grow the creative technology capability within WPP Open, setting the standard for how AI tools and workflows are applied across the creative process, from first idea to finished concept.
  • Act as the hands-on translator between creative ambition and technical execution, taking a brief or idea and working out which mix of AI models, tools and human craft is needed to deliver it at speed.
  • Shape product priorities by prototyping and iterating concepts directly alongside creative directors, strategists and producers, stress-testing ideas before they move into production.
  • Own a defined product area within the creative capability, translating practitioner needs, client opportunities and platform strategy into a clear set of priorities and outcomes.
  • Define clear product requirements in partnership with design, research, engineering and delivery teams, making sure validated ideas can move from discovery into build without losing the creative intent.
  • Use practitioner feedback, client signals, usage data and market insight to make prioritisation decisions, balancing creative value, feasibility, adoption and commercial impact.
  • Benchmark and evaluate the fast-moving landscape of AI creative and video models, as well as native AI creative platforms, to identify what's working, what's missing, and where WPP Open should build, partner or buy.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to turn validated creative workflows into scalable, reusable capability within WPP Open, including nodes, pipelines and templates.
  • Mentor and set craft standards for a growing community of creative technologists across WPP's agencies, sharing best practice on prompt design, model selection and creative-AI workflow.
  • Own the feasibility and quality bar for AI-generated creative work, validating that outputs are genuinely usable in real marketing campaigns, not just impressive in a demo.
  • Represent the voice of the creative practitioner in product discovery, roadmap planning and stakeholder alignment, ensuring new capabilities reflect how ideation and concept development actually happen.
  • Build and maintain a library of proven creative AI techniques, prompts and workflows that can be taught and reused across teams.
  • Support pitches, client demos and showcases by rapidly producing high-craft, AI-assisted creative work that demonstrates what's possible in OPEN.
  • Define clear success measures for new creative capabilities, including adoption by practitioners, quality of outputs, reusability across teams and value demonstrated in client-facing work.

What you'll need:

  • Extensive hands-on experience in an advertising, marketing or production environment, using AI creative and video tools to produce real campaign assets, not just personal experimentation.
  • A strong craft background in creative development, with a clear understanding of how ideas move from concept through to something that can be judged, shared and produced.
  • Proven experience prototyping quickly, ideally within agency creative or production teams, turning a brief or idea into a working proof of concept under time pressure.
  • Deep, current knowledge of the AI creative tools landscape, and genuine comfort experimenting with new models, tools and workflows as they emerge.
  • Working technical fluency, such as familiarity with APIs, no-code or low-code workflow tools, or light scripting, to prototype and integrate AI tools into production pipelines.
  • Experience leading, mentoring or setting standards for a team or community of creative practitioners.

job.description:

Who we are:

We create data products and technology that make advertising work better for people.

WPP Open is WPP’s intelligent marketing operating system, fuelling growth for the world’s most admired brands. Purpose-built for an era that demands a modern approach to data management, usage, and brand growth, we deliver modular products and interconnected capabilities across the marketing lifecycle.

Operating globally across WPP, we empower marketers and agencies to drive sustainable, data-enabled growth through connected technology and intelligent automation.

Who we are looking for:

As Director of Product Management – Media & Creative Activation & Optimization, you will lead a core capability area within Unified Activation in WPP Open, focused on executing and optimizing media and creative performance at scale.

This is a genuine product-building role. You will take activation and optimization problems from concept and rapid prototype through production, go-to-market, adoption, and measurable operational impact. You will have significant autonomy to shape product vision, roadmap, and priorities, working at pace to turn complex activation challenges into scalable, automated products.

This is a senior IC product leadership role. You own a capability area end-to-end — setting direction, managing the roadmap, and driving delivery across multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement.

You own campaign optimization across media and creative — from structured optimization (budget, bidding, targeting, DCO, in-flight creative performance across walled gardens and open platforms) to unstructured, agent-driven troubleshooting and optimization workflows. You also own the cross-product governance layer that keeps activation consistent from intake through live execution.

Unified Activation connects creative production, pre-launch quality assurance, campaign setup and activation, and cross-platform monitoring and optimization into one workspace from creative handoff to live campaign execution, with full governance and traceability across platforms.

Unified Activation Capabilities

This capability area spans the full path from creative handoff to live, optimized delivery covering creative readiness, campaign activation, campaign optimization for media and creative, and the governance that keeps work consistent across platforms.

Creative management. Creative briefs, schedules, and variants become activation-ready requirements. Assets are organized with quality metadata and status visibility. AI-assisted checks catch format, duration, safe-zone, and related issues before launch, while performance insights and quality signals inform creative decisions. The outcome is faster, more reliable creative handoff.

Campaign activation. Media plans become structured, launch-ready campaigns targeting, budgets, bidding, and naming rules included. Approved creative reaches buying environments with automated tagging, mapping, and pre-launch integrity checks. The outcome is scalable, faster activation with fewer broken paths.

Campaign optimization. Spanning media and creative. Algorithmic optimization uses ML models to optimize budgets, bids, and targeting parameters for cross-platform uplift while campaigns are live. Monitoring covers portfolio-level campaign health, delivery pacing, and KPI performance across platforms. Agentic optimization handles unstructured troubleshooting and optimization turning delivery signals into recommendations and governed actions when problems are open-ended rather than rule-bound. Dynamic Creative Optimization sits within this same area, measuring and improving how creative performs once live across walled gardens, buying platforms, ad servers, and other activation environments.

Cross-module governance. Shared taxonomies, advertiser and platform best-practice guardrails across intake, activation, and in-flight execution. Governed connectivity into major ad platforms using so access stays persistent, auditable, and free of direct token exposure.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and execution roadmap for Optimization & Governance within the Unified Activation platform in WPP Open.
  • Own campaign optimization across media and creative algorithmic ML optimization of budgets, bids, and targeting; portfolio-level monitoring of campaign health, delivery, and KPI performance; and agentic optimization for unstructured troubleshooting and open-ended performance improvement.
  • Own Dynamic Creative Optimization measuring, governing, and improving creative performance while campaigns are live across walled gardens, buying platforms, ad servers, and other activation environments.
  • Own governance for the capability area taxonomies, advertiser compliance rules, and best-practice guardrails across creative and media activation workflows, including in-flight execution.
  • Define and deliver agentic activation and optimization workflows that automate creative distribution, dynamic taxonomy generation & platform guardrails.
  • Partner with Product Ownership, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, resilient integrations across major media buying platforms, ad servers, and WPP Open services.
  • Translate complex business problems from WPP agencies and global brand clients into concrete product requirements, functional specifications, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Own direction and priorities across multidisciplinary delivery teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement.
  • Manage dependency and cross-functional alignment across WPP Open platform teams, ensuring cohesive delivery across governance, integration services, and shared data layers.
  • Partner with Support and Enablement teams to ensure capabilities are successfully launched, adopted, and embedded into agency workflows.
  • Establish clear success metrics, tracking product adoption, workflow time savings, error reduction, zero tracker leakage outcomes, and client performance / KPI-driven uplift across global markets.

What you'll need:

Essential

  • Deep expertise in at least one activation domain such as campaign activation, creative management, trafficking, optimization, or governance with the ability and appetite to broaden across the wider suite.
  • Evidence of building and operationalizing automation or product capabilities that solve real workflow or activation problems.
  • Evidence of taking solutions beyond concept or requirements into practical use, including driving adoption or measurable workflow improvement.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic and AI-assisted tools to prototype product concepts, explore technical systems, accelerate documentation, and communicate ideas.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Ownership, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Enablement through influence rather than formal reporting lines.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex agency and client problems into clear product priorities.
  • Sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with engineering, architecture, and data teams and make informed product decisions.

Preferred

  • Formal product-management experience at Senior Product Manager or Director level.
  • Experience owning or delivering enterprise SaaS, AdTech, or MarTech products.
  • Experience managing or leading delivery across Engineering and Data Science teams.
  • Broader activation knowledge across creative, media, trafficking, governance, and campaign optimization including in-flight structured optimization, agentic troubleshooting, and dynamic / creative optimization workflows.
  • Experience with major advertising and activation platforms such as Google Ads, DV360, CM360, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, and relevant third-party activation technology (e.g. Grasp, Smartly, Concord, SKAI).
  • Experience developing ML/AI-driven optimization products, automated decision systems, or agentic workflows.
  • Technical experience with API-led integrations, relational data models, and SQL.
  • Experience working within agile product-delivery environments and frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, or Shape Up.
  • Day-to-day fluency with modern AI-assisted product workflows (e.g. rapid prototyping, codebase exploration, automated documentation).

Success Attributes

  • Strategic thinker: Capable of decomposing complex, fragmented media operations into unified, automated software products.
  • Builder mindset: Comfortable moving quickly from problem definition to prototype, production and adoption rather than stopping at strategy or requirements.
  • High autonomy: Able to establish direction, make informed product decisions and run with an area of ownership without requiring close management.
  • High ownership: Demonstrates resilience and operational discipline in managing cross-functional initiatives under shifting technical landscapes.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Enablement Lead, EMEA accelerates adoption of WPP Enterprise Technology products in market for WPP Media. The role translates global product strategy into regional rollout plans, orchestrates stakeholder readiness, and measures value realization (adoption %, time-to-value, enablement NPS), ensuring that enterprise platforms deliver outcomes for agencies and markets in the region

What you'll be doing:

Strategy & Demand

  • Shape and qualify market demand; align initiatives with domain roadmaps and architecture.
  • Translate global product strategies into regional execution plans and benefit hypotheses.
  • Feed demand into governance forums (e.g., PRB/TSB) with clear business cases and readiness criteria.

Rollout & Governance

  • Design localized rollout plans with dependencies, risks, controls and cutover steps.
  • Run governance cadences (weekly status, risk/issue logs, QBRs) and maintain Wrike dashboards.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, info-security and change standards.

Stakeholders & Communications

  • Act as the primary interface between product teams and markets; orchestrate two-way feedback.
  • Prepare townhall decks, leadership briefings and market comms; support hiring/enablement needs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to remove blockers and drive decisions.

Measurement & Improvement

  • Define and track KPIs for adoption and time-to-value; publish enablement scorecards.
  • Run launch retrospectives; update playbooks and prerequisites based on insights.
  • Contribute to portfolio-level reporting on value, efficiency and cost avoidance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Platform adoption (e.g., OMS/Choreograph modules) vs baseline: +20–30% YoY
  • Time-to-launch for prioritized products: ≤ agreed SLA from gate to go-live
  • Enablement satisfaction/NPS from stakeholders: ≥ 60
  • Readiness index (prerequisites met pre-launch): ≥ 90%

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience in enterprise technology enablement, program management, or regional rollout leadership within matrixed organisations
  • Proven stakeholder engagement at senior levels; ability to influence without authority.
  • Experience leading multi-market product rollouts with clear governance and benefit tracking.
  • Data-driven approach to enablement design and measurement (dashboards, adoption analytics).
  • Fluent English (written & verbal).

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications: Prosci/ADKAR, PMP/Prince2, Agile (Scrum/SAFe).
  • Experience with media/advertising operations.
  • Exposure to regional compliance topics (privacy, labour, finance controls).

Tools & Platforms

Required: Wrike (or equivalent PM tool), one HRIS (e.g., Workday), one ERP (e.g., D365).Preferred: Choreograph/OMS, Chase Media, Adaptive, Power Platform.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

job.title: End User Device Administrator
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

The End User Device Administrator is responsible for the end to end administration, lifecycle management, financial governance and support of corporate end user devices across the EMEA Tech Ops organisation. This role ensures devices are procured, secured, tracked, configured, supported, and retired in line with enterprise policies, compliance requirements, and operational standards.
The administrator works closely with Finance, Security, Procurement, Telco partners (e.g., Vodafone), and local IT teams to maintain an efficient, secure, and consistent mobile experience for employees across the region.

This role is fully on-site for 5 days a week.

What you'll be doing:

•    Process and validate mobile device requests in line with corporate policies and eligibility criteria.
•    Coordinate device ordering, shipping, and activation with Telco partners and suppliers.
•    Ensure new devices are registered in Apple Business Manager or Android Zero Touch before deployment.
•    Support SIM provisioning, number assignment and phone line activation.
•    Manage mobile contracts, upgrades, replacements, and deactivations.
•    Liaise with carriers (e.g. Vodafone) for escalations, billing queries and network issues.
•    Identify, respond and challenge high/exceptional usage as appropriate
•    Work with partners and local Tech Ops colleagues to maintain an accurate inventory of mobile devices, ownership, and lifecycle status using asset management systems.
•    Track lost, stolen, or non compliant devices, ensuring appropriate actions (lock, wipe, retire) wherever possible.
•    Ensure compliance with security, BYOD, data privacy, and corporate usage policies.
•    Produce regular reporting on device usage, compliance, lifecycle, and cost centres.
•    Facilitate support for mobile related issues (enrolment failures, app issues, policy blocks, connectivity), supporting local Tech Ops teams to resolve issues or secure support from other partners & colleagues.
•    Escalate to vendors, internal engineering, or security teams where required.
•    Responsible for regional mobile spend reporting, preparing management reporting updates, and working with Tech Ops management teams to drive efficiencies in spend across the region.
•    Support the development and refinement of mobile device policies, standards, and guidelines.
•    Contribute to harmonising regional/global mobile processes, consolidating multiple tenants, policies, or tools.
•    Identify opportunities to improve provisioning workflows, automation, and user experience.
•    Understand and support the enrolment of corporate apps into WPP’s Mobile Applications Management (MAM) platforms
•    Support initiatives to deliver Mobile Device Management (MDM) across the organisation

 

What you'll need

•    Experience in management and administration of enterprise IT hardware estates, preferably mobiles
•    Understanding of iOS and Android device configuration, security, and lifecycle management.
•    Experience administering mobile lines/SIMs with telco providers.
•    Strong troubleshooting skills and user focused support experience.
•    Ability to manage asset inventories and maintain accurate documentation.
•    Experience in financial analysis and collating management information reporting
•    Knowledge of MAM policies, conditional access, and enterprise mobile security frameworks.
•    Experience in large, multitenant or multi OpCo environments.
•    Understanding of corporate procurement and vendor management.
•    Detail oriented with excellent organisational skills.
•    Strong skills across core M365 product suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and Service-Now
•    Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
•    Proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset.
•    Able to work with international teams across time zones.
•    Comfortable balancing security, usability, and operational efficiency.

  • Experience developing with Python and/or Node.js.

  • Experience with Git-based development practices and workflows.
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and YAML

job.title: Enterprise Architect – Modern Workplace
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

About WPP ET    WPP Enterprise Technology provides Technology services for WPP, the world’s largest communications services group. As a creative transformation company, WPP is helping its clients transform the future through extraordinary work. WPP ET is an integral part of that journey, and we are proud to provide technology for some of the world’s most creative brands.

Own the end-to-end target architecture for the entire Modern Workplace estate, spanning all four towers — Identity, Client Devices, Productivity Tools and Office Technology. This role provides the strategic, cross-tower technical coherence that cannot be outsourced: it sets the standards, patterns and guardrails that Kyndryl and the tower teams design, build and operate within, and ensures the workplace is secure, integrated, modern and future-ready as one connected employee experience.

 

What you'll be doing:

•    Define and own the target-state architecture for the whole Modern Workplace estate across Identity, Client Devices, Productivity Tools and Office Technology.
•    Set cross-tower architecture principles, standards, reference patterns and technology roadmaps.
•    Act as the design authority for all major and cross-tower workplace change.
•    Architect the integration across towers — identity-led security, devices, collaboration and meeting-room/voice services — into one coherent, seamless employee experience.
•    Embed security-by-design, zero-trust, resilience, accessibility, data protection and total cost of ownership across every domain.
•    Assure that Kyndryl-delivered designs and changes align to WPP architecture and standards across all four towers.
•    Own the workplace technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and horizon-scanning for emerging capability, including AI in the workplace.
•    Advise the Modern Workplace Director and all tower heads, aligning the architecture to WPP business and agency priorities.
•    Set the architecture, patterns and guardrails that Kyndryl implements and operates within.
•    Assure that partner-delivered designs and changes meet WPP security, resilience and standards.
•    Act as design authority and approval gate for partner architecture decisions.

 

What you'll need:

•    Enterprise architecture spanning the full digital-workplace estate — identity, device/endpoint, collaboration & productivity, and office/meeting-room & voice technologies.
•    Proven cross-domain architecture leadership across an end-to-end workplace estate at global scale.
•    Architecture frameworks and modelling (e.g. TOGAF) applied pragmatically.
•    Security-by-design, zero-trust and data-protection architecture for the workplace.
•    Integration and platform architecture across cloud (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace), endpoint and identity ecosystems.
•    Strong communication and influence with engineering, vendor and executive audiences.
•    Recognised architecture experience in the relevant domain at enterprise scale.
•    Relevant architecture or platform certifications (e.g. TOGAF or vendor architect tracks).
•    Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.•    Sets the target architecture, standards and design patterns for the domain.
•    Designs for security, scale, resilience and total cost of ownership.
•    Influences engineering and vendor teams without direct authority.
•    Balances strategic ambition with pragmatic, deliverable decisions.
•    Stays current with platform direction and emerging capability.

We are looking for a highly technical IT manager to oversee End User Services (EUS) and drive strategic technology operations across the India market. This role ensures optimal service delivery, enhances IT frameworks, and manages a diverse technology landscape, integrating user endpoint infrastructure, security, and compliance requirements. The successful candidate will lead IT transformation initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technology services with business objectives while maintaining robust system integrity and security posture.

What you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Line Management of Engineer Resources

  • Directly manage EUS Leads and Engineers, facilitate resource planning and workload distribution, ensuring optimal efficiency across projects and operational demands.
  • Set clear goals, expectations, and KPIs to measure individual and team performance across technical operations.
  • Lead mentoring and skills development initiatives, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Champion process standardization, implementing ITIL and service management best practices for consistent execution.

Ticket Queue Management & SLA Compliance

  • Oversee ticket queue management, ensuring incidents and requests are categorized, prioritized, and assigned efficiently.
  • Monitor SLA compliance, tracking ticket resolution times and ensuring adherence to service performance metrics.
  • Ensure documentation of all incidents and service requests, creating detailed root cause analyses for major recurring issues.
  • Lead stakeholder communication on SLA performance, ensuring transparency in service quality and incident handling expectations.

Performance Optimization

  • Utilize ITIL methodologies to improve service delivery, reduce incidents, and enhance end-user experience.
  • Implement continuous improvement initiatives, analyzing ticket backlog data to enhance service response times and reduce bottlenecks.
  • Identify opportunities to implement AI-driven support solutions, including chatbots, predictive analytics, and self-service portals to streamline IT assistance.

Infrastructure & End-User Services Management

  • Manage, implement, and optimize end-user service solutions to enhance support function in the XXX market
  • Oversee device management, endpoint security, and identity access controls, ensuring compliance with global standards.
  • Manage deployment, configuration, and lifecycle support for core user environments, including endpoint devices, collaboration platforms, business systems and remote access solutions.

Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Develop and refine country IT infrastructure roadmaps, ensuring alignment with business needs and scalability considerations.
  • Lead technology standardization efforts for network architecture, Active Directory, endpoint security, and service automation platforms.
  • Collaborate with global technology teams to integrate IT frameworks, including enterprise mobility, security policies, and system automation.
  • Drive continuous improvements in system architecture, ensuring optimized performance of IT assets across on-premises and cloud-based environments.

Security, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Implement cybersecurity best practices in coordination with the Cyber, Risk & Compliance (CRC) team.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance across identity & access management (IAM), endpoint encryption, and data protection strategies.
  • Lead incident response protocols, overseeing vulnerability management, SIEM monitoring, and remediation efforts.

Vendor & Cost Optimization

  • Manage enterprise agreements with our technology partners, vendors and providers, ensuring cost-effective procurement of any licensing and services.
  • Optimize IT budgets, identifying opportunities for cost reduction in service contracts and hardware lifecycle management.
  • Evaluate emerging technology solutions that align with business expansion and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

Project Management & IT Transformation

  • Lead market deployment of global IT initiatives, including Network, Infrastructure, Modern Workplace, and Security transformations.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams on technology rollouts, overseeing user migration strategies, cloud adoption plans, and infrastructure upgrades.

Qualifications & Technical Expertise

  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Experience with endpoint management platforms, including MDM solutions like Jamf and Intune.

Our mission is to redefine the agency-client partnership, fostering a culture of deep collaboration, agility, and measurable impact.

WPP Open X is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and exceptionally skilled Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to our senior executives. This pivotal role requires an individual who thrives in a fast-paced, demanding environment, adept at managing diverse administrative tasks both independently and collaboratively.  This office-based position will be primarily based at WPP's Sea Containers House in London, with an expected presence of at least 3 – 4 days per week.

You will be essential in ensuring the smooth operation of executive functions, demonstrating flexibility, composure, and a proactive approach even under pressure.   • Proactively manage complex executive calendars, strategically optimizing time and anticipating demands.

  • Organise and compile comprehensive briefing materials for a range of engagements, including internal meetings, client presentations, external conferences, and speaking engagements, ensuring executives are thoroughly prepared.
  • Assist in the seamless coordination and execution of key events such as industry gatherings, internal team meetings, offsite sessions, private dinners, and corporate hospitality events, from planning to post-event follow-up.

  • Proven Executive Assistant Experience: Demonstrable track record in a similar high-level support role, ideally within a dynamic creative or agency environment, adept at managing complex executive needs.
  • Advanced Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strategic Organization & Prioritization: Exceptional ability to manage complex calendars, master multitasking, and strategically prioritise demanding workloads with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Impactful Communication: Confident, articulate, and professional communicator, adept at engaging and influencing personnel at all levels, including senior leadership, clients, and global partners.

Finance Director

Reporting to: Norway and Sweden Market Leader & EMEA CFO

Location: Sweden

 

Who we are:
Burson is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

Burson is part of WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), the creative transformation company. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the role

Burson is seeking a commercially focused Finance Director, to lead finance across our Swedish market, with oversight of Norway. This is a senior market finance leadership role, partnering closely with local and regional leadership to drive financial performance, strengthen operational discipline and support sustainable growth across the two markets.

The role will be responsible for financial planning, reporting, forecasting, controls, compliance and commercial finance support across a business of approximately $10m revenue. It requires someone who can operate strategically, but who is also comfortable being close to the detail in a smaller market environment.

We are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on and commercially astute finance leader who can provide clear insight, challenge and counsel to leadership teams, while ensuring strong governance, accurate reporting and effective financial management.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead finance across Sweden and Norway, ensuring strong financial management, governance and commercial discipline across both markets.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to both market leadership, providing clear insight, challenge and counsel to support business performance and decision-making.
  • Own the budgeting, forecasting and planning processes, ensuring alignment with local market priorities, regional expectations and group reporting requirements.
  • Provide accurate, timely and meaningful financial reporting, including revenue, profitability, margin, cost management, cash flow and working capital performance.
  • Translate financial data into clear commercial insight, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that help leaders make informed decisions.
  • Partner with client and business leads on pricing, profitability, resourcing and commercial decision-making to support sustainable growth.
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes, working closely with local, regional, shared service and group finance teams.
  • Ensure the integrity of financial records, reporting and controls, maintaining compliance with Burson/WPP policies and relevant Swedish and Norwegian requirements.
  • Lead on audit, tax, statutory reporting and external advisor relationships, ensuring deadlines are met and risks are managed effectively.
  • Drive improvements in finance processes, systems and ways of working, creating greater consistency, efficiency and accountability across the markets.
  • Support strong operational discipline around revenue recognition, billing, collections, approvals and project financial management.
  • Lead, support and develop the local finance function, building strong relationships across a matrixed, international environment.

Experience You’ll Bring:

  • Significant experience in senior finance, financial control, Financial Planning & Analysis or commercial finance roles, ideally within a professional services, communications, consulting, agency or matrixed international environment.
  • Strong understanding of financial management within a smaller or mid-sized market, with the ability to balance strategic input with hands-on delivery.
  • Proven experience partnering with senior leaders to improve financial performance, commercial discipline and operational decision-making.
  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, reporting, variance analysis and performance management experience.
  • Good understanding of accounting, controls, audit, tax and compliance requirements across Sweden; exposure to Norway or wider Nordic markets would be advantageous.
  • Experience working with regional or group finance teams, ideally in an international network or multinational organisation.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and turn it into clear, actionable insight.
  • High level of integrity, sound judgement and confidence in providing constructive challenge.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain finance matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.
  • Fluent English is essential; Swedish language skills are highly desirable. Norwegian language skills or experience working with Norway would be an advantage.

job.description:

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Forward Deployed Engineer (Applied Research)

About WPP:

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, connecting marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in one place. It is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of AI at scale—delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at greater scale and lower cost. Our proprietary, opt-in media solutions give clients access to unique advantages and cutting-edge capabilities through a single point of access to addressable media, combining premium inventory with universal customer signals. They enable cross-channel storytelling, cross-platform AI optimisation and robust measurement of business impact to maximise campaign effectiveness.

About the team:


Strategic Initiatives & Applied Research works at the intersection of emerging technology, client
demand and WPP’s product strategy. We build production-lite solutions to test strategically
important opportunities, prove their technical and commercial value, and turn successful work
into reusable capabilities for Product and Engineering.


Our first major programme is agentic media buying, but our remit is broader: applied AI,
agent-to-agent workflows, new platform connections and other emerging opportunities to help
shape the future of WPP’s products. We want generalists who are happy to move onto the next
frontier problem once this one is proven.


The role


Forward Deployed Engineers are hands-on product engineers who work close to clients,
publishers and the market. You will combine technical depth with commercial understanding and
consultancy-style problem solving: helping to define a problem, building the solution, testing it in
a real setting and translating what works into reusable technical capability.
This is neither isolated prototyping nor slide-led consulting. You will be accountable from
discovery through implementation, field validation and handover.


What you'll do


- Build and ship working systems fast - agentic workflows, data pipelines, interfaces and
integrations. All centered on answering a commercial question, not a technical one.
- Work directly with external partners, clients, internal operational and commercial teams
to translate ambiguous problems into deliverable technical outcomes.


- Build at production-lite quality: moving quickly while incorporating observability,
validation, sensible testing and graceful failure rather than creating either disposable
prototypes or prematurely over-engineered systems.


- Build the business case alongside the build: what it's worth, who pays for it, what it costs
to scale.


What you’ll bring


- experience in software engineering, data science or a related field, with a track record of
getting things into real use.

- Strong Python and hands-on cloud experience


- Demonstrable experience building agentic/LLM systems - tool and structured calling
orchestration, evaluation, and a realistic view of what breaks when you try to get
production value out of them.


- Consultancy-style experience gained through consulting, professional services, solutions
engineering, forward deployment or an internal business-transformation function.


- Strong product and commercial judgement, with the ability to communicate technical
choices and business implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


- Comfort operating in ambiguity, learning unfamiliar domains quickly and balancing speed
with operational credibility.


- Willingness to travel internationally several times a year and develop a strong working
knowledge of media and advertising technology.


Nice to have


- Exposure to ad tech or media: ad servers, SSPs/DSPs, programmatic, or order
management systems


- Front-end or dashboarding skills for building demonstrable interfaces

As WPP becomes a more connected and integrated enterprise, you will help create a stronger sense of belonging to WPP, while recognising the distinctive brands and cultures that make up our organisation.

With significant internal and external visibility, you will shape how WPP is positioned as an employer in the AI era. You will help us attract the skills and capabilities that will define our future, from AI, analytics and commerce to influencer talent, while strengthening the experience that engages and retains our world-class creative and strategic talent.

What you'll be doing:

Shape and activate our global Employee Value Proposition

You’ll lead the development and activation of WPP’s global Employee Value Proposition (EVP) and help shape an employee experience that reflects who we are today and where we’re going as part of Elevate28. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on how we attract, engage and retain talent as WPP continues to evolve.

  • Partner with Marketing & Communications to understand what matters most to our people and the talent we want to attract, using these insights to shape a compelling and authentic global EVP.
  • Define and bring our EVP to life across purpose, growth, AI capability, creative scale, inclusion, belonging, reward and recognition.

About Data & Technology Solutions 

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data and technology organisation. We build the platforms, products, and engineering capabilities that power marketing transformation at scale. 

WPP Open is our AI-powered platform for marketing. It connects people, data, tools, and AI into a single ecosystem, enabling teams to deliver better outcomes faster, more efficiently, and at global scale. 

Our teams of engineers, product leaders, and operators work across multiple domains to build systems that power planning, execution, and delivery for some of the world’s largest brands. 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

We are looking for a senior product-minded engineering leader to drive delivery and execution for our commerce product area and to lead the application of AI into our SDLC. 

 

You will be core part of our product development process and help to inform roadmap and will lead your team in translating product priorities into reliable, high‑quality engineering outcomes. Additionally, you will lead the application and adaptation of AI-driven development practices, ensuring systems operate effectively in real‑world, production environments. This role requires strong systems thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex integrations in a rapidly developing environment. 

 

Work in this area spans both core commerce marketing systems and the data flows and pipelines required to interact with these systems, requiring a blend of data-aware system design, application engineering, and integration engineering. 

 

You are: 

  • A product-focused engineering leader with strong technical credibility and demonstrated ability in influencing and driving the roadmap.  
  • Comfortable operating in integration-heavy, business-critical systems 
  • Significant experience in programme design and systems architecture. 
  • Demonstrated portfolio incorporating AI driven development into the end-to-end SDLC.  
  • Data & metrics-driven, able to manage complexity across multiple teams, platforms and external partners. 
  • Focused on outcomes tied to business performance. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

Engineering Leadership & Team Development 

  • Lead engineering delivery across teams building commerce marketing capabilities. 
  • Establish and develop team mentorship paths aiming to incorporate agents into day-to-day work. 
  • Accountable for the career growth and development of senior engineers and their teams across craft, delivery and business outcomes. 

Stakeholder Alignment & XFN Collaboration 

  • Act as the primary engineering partner to Product, Design, Commercial, and Delivery stakeholders. 
  • Translate business requirements into actionable engineering outcomes and technical product direction. 
  • Drive alignment with engineering leads and XFNs from partner teams to deliver integrated roadmaps. 

End-to-End Accountability 

  • Take ownership across the full software development lifecycle — from discovery through to release and post-production maintenance. 
  • Ensure systems are reliable, performant, and capable of operating under real-world conditions. 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED 

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience 
  • Proven experience delivering complex, operational systems at scale 
  • Strong experience with APIs, distributed systems, and integrations 
  • Experience working with systems that integrate with external platforms or partner ecosystems 
  • Strong understanding of system performance, latency, and production reliability 
  • Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled product features into production, including integrating LLMs and generative AI services 
  • Strong experience with modern cloud data warehouse and lakehouse platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift) 
  • Solid understanding of data modelling, ELT/ETL pipelines, and orchestration tooling (e.g. dbt, Airflow), including data quality, lineage, and governance 
  • Deep experience architecting and operating systems on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) 
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, containers and Kubernetes, serverless, and event-driven design 
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD, observability, cloud security and IAM, and cloud cost optimisation (FinOps) 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead delivery in multi-team, dependency-heavy environments 
  • Strong stakeholder management across Product, Delivery, and Engineering 

 

If you are ready to lead engineering delivery at scale, working across complex systems and driving real business outcomes, we encourage you to apply.

The Head of Executive Compensation leads the design, governance and oversight of executive remuneration across WPP. Reporting to the Global Reward Director, the role is a trusted adviser to the CPO, ExCo and RemCo, translating business strategy into executive reward arrangements that support long-term value creation, pay for performance and the attraction and retention of senior talent. The role ensures WPP’s approach remains competitive, responsible and aligned with global regulatory, investor and shareholder expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and philosophy: Define and evolve WPP’s executive reward philosophy, governance framework and incentive architecture, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, culture, performance and external market practice.
  • Executive reward design: Lead the design and review of short-term and longterm incentives, benefits, retention and termination arrangements, balancing competitiveness, affordability, risk and shareholder expectations.
  • Appointments and transitions: Structure competitive and compliant reward packages for ExCo and other senior leadership appointments, promotions, international moves and exits.
  • RemCo governance: Lead the annual RemCo calendar and prepare high-quality papers, financial modelling, recommendations and decision materials for the Committee, CPO and senior stakeholders.
  • Disclosure and compliance: Oversee executive remuneration disclosures and monitor regulatory, listing, tax, governance and investor requirements across relevant jurisdictions.
  • Risk and controls: Maintain robust governance and controls, including incentive plan rules, discretion, malus and clawback provisions, ensuring decisions are documented and consistently applied.
  • Insight and analytics: Lead executive benchmarking, pay-for-performance assessment, scenario modelling and analysis of market, investor and proxyadviser trends to inform recommendations.
  • Stakeholder leadership: Partner across People, Finance, Legal, Tax, Company Secretariat, Reward and external advisers and providers to ensure joined-up advice and effective delivery and administration.

Critical Knowledge & Experience

  • Significant executive compensation experience gained in a complex global organisation and/or leading reward consultancy.
  • Proven experience advising RemCo, Boards, CPOs and senior executives, with the judgement and credibility to navigate sensitive and high-impact decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare clear, high-quality committee papers, recommendations and executive remuneration disclosures.
  • Deep technical expertise in short-term incentives and long-term incentives, performance equity, deferred reward, executive benefits, share plans and associated governance and disclosure requirements.
  • Strong understanding of public-company remuneration practice, institutional investor and proxy-adviser expectations, and relevant regulatory and listing requirements.
  • Experience managing cross-border executive reward matters, including relevant tax, mobility, legal and regulatory considerations.
  • Advanced analytical and financial modelling capability, with the ability to translate complex data into clear options and recommendations.

Key Competencies

  • Executive reward expertise – applies strong grounding in executive pay design, incentive mechanics, governance and market practice to develop practical, defensible solutions.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen – connects reward decisions to business priorities, performance and long-term value creation.
  • Executive influence and communication – communicates complex and sensitive matters clearly and builds confidence with senior stakeholders.
  • Governance, discretion and judgement – applies sound judgement, integrity and appropriate challenge in a highly confidential environment.
  • Analytical rigour – uses financial modelling, market evidence and scenario analysis to develop robust recommendations.
  • Collaborative leadership – works effectively across a global matrix, aligning multiple functions, advisers and delivery teams.

job.title: Head of Marketing Performance (SVP)
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
