THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and transformative SVP, Product to lead the critical capability area of Marketing Performance within the WPP Open platform. This is a truly unique opportunity to define the future of how WPP measures and attributes marketing effectiveness across our vast and diverse agency and client ecosystem. 

Leveraging WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform, you will lead the development of best-in-class solutions that turn live signals into predictive intelligence, empower our agencies and clients to drive superior outcomes, and solidify WPP Open's competitive edge. Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum. 

This role demands a leader who can not only set a compelling product vision, but also inspire and lead a multi-disciplinary team, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. You will directly contribute to achieving key WPP Open priorities, including driving profitability, maximizing strategic advantage, and delivering an integrated, intelligent experience for our users and clients. 

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation.  Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

  • Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 
  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery. 
  • Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption. 
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations. 
  • Cultivate and manage high-impact relationships with key internal and external partners, driving collaborative initiatives and maximizing mutual value. 

Product Development & Execution:

  • Oversee the entire product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and post-launch iteration, emphasizing agile and iterative development. 
  • Prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic impact, client value, technical feasibility, and business objectives, with a relentless focus on driving meaningful adoption and impact. 
  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable products and features that meet defined requirements, performance standards, and the architectural principles of WPP Open. 
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback. 

 Domain Expertise & Innovation:

  • Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM, including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation). 
  • Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain. 
  • Proven track record of successfully bringing complex, data-driven, and AI-enabled products from concept to market, driving significant competitive advantage and exponential growth. 
  • Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization. 
  • Strong understanding and application of modern agile product development methodologies. 
  • Experience managing significant operating and capital expenditure budgets and defining commercial models for product portfolios. 
  • Proven experience in managing global product rollouts and supporting a large, diverse client base (e.g., 1000+ clients across multiple markets). 

 

Domain Expertise: 

  • Advanced, hands-on knowledge of how marketing activity across Paid, Earned, Shared, Owned media channels is measured, coupled with a proven ability to translate this expertise into a compelling product vision and strategic roadmap. 
  • Deep expertise in advanced measurement techniques including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) (including various methodologies like Bayesian), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and marketing experimentation. 
  • Strong understanding of marketing data sources, data ingestion, transformation, and reporting challenges. 
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data. 

 

Leadership & Communication: 

  • Exceptional leadership, team-building, and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing diverse talent. 
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences (technical, business, executive, client) and build compelling presentations. 
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities, capable of building strong relationships and collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Proven ability to navigate and excel within a fast-paced, multi-market, matrixed global organization. 

 

Strategic & Analytical Thinking: 

  • Exceptional strategic thinking and complex problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify ptimal courses of action and articulate a clear, long-term vision. 
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with the ability to make informed decisions based on market insights, user data, and business objectives. 
  • A proactive, independent, and adaptable leader with a strong sense of ownership, thriving within demanding, fast-paced environments.

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

job.title: Head of Programme, EPM
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is embarking on a major transformation to replace its legacy BFC platform and modernise enterprise performance management across the group. The programme will deliver a scalable, integrated capability for financial consolidation, planning, forecasting and management reporting. This change is critical to:

  • Replace ageing and increasingly constrained consolidation technology
  • Standardise and simplify group finance processes, data and controls
  • Improve the speed, quality and transparency of close, planning, forecasting and reporting
  • Create a scalable EPM foundation that supports future business and regulatory needs

A dedicated Head of Programme is needed to lead this complex, business-critical transformation across Finance and Enterprise Technology, align senior stakeholders, manage implementation partners and ensure the new EPM capability is delivered safely and adopted globally.

The Head of Programme is accountable for the overall success of the EPM Transformation Programme, replacing WPP’s legacy BFC platform and delivering a modern enterprise performance management capability for group consolidation, planning, forecasting and management reporting. The role provides leadership, governance and direction across finance, technology, data, process and change workstreams, ensuring the programme delivers controlled transition, measurable business outcomes and sustainable adoption. Key responsibilities include:

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and maintain the EPM programme vision, target outcomes and integrated roadmap, aligned to Finance and Enterprise Technology strategy.
  • Governance & Assurance: Establish robust governance, design authority, delivery controls and assurance across business, data, technology and implementation partners.
  • Benefits Realisation: Deliver measurable improvements in close, consolidation, planning, forecasting, reporting, controls and user productivity.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong relationships with Finance, Enterprise Technology, markets, agencies, sponsors and delivery partners to secure decisions and resolve issues.
  • Resource & Financial Management: Oversee the programme budget, resources, commercial commitments and system integrator performance to optimise cost, quality and value.
  • Change & Adoption: Ensure finance process readiness, data migration, training, deployment and adoption across a complex global organisation.

What you'll be doing:

  • Define and maintain the vision, outcomes and integrated roadmap for the EPM Transformation Programme
  • Build strong relationships with senior Finance, Enterprise Technology, market and agency leaders to drive alignment, decisions and ownership
  • Lead the replacement of BFC and implementation of the selected EPM platform across consolidation, planning, forecasting and reporting
  • Ensure business, process, data, technology and change deliverables are high quality, clearly scoped and linked to quantifiable benefits
  • Be accountable for programme mobilisation, planning, orchestration, delivery and transition into service
  • Own the integrated programme plan, budget, resources, governance, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, communications and change approach
  • Coordinate dependencies with Finance transformation, ERP, data, integration, security, controls and other enterprise programmes
  • Establish clear visibility across workstreams, markets, agencies and partners to resolve cross-functional delivery challenges
  • Develop and maintain programme risk and assurance plans, including migration, cutover, financial control and business continuity risks
  • Work closely with the PMO to provide accurate, decision-focused reporting and maintain delivery controls
  • Run stage gates, design decisions and readiness reviews across the programme lifecycle
  • Act as the principal liaison between sponsors, Finance leadership, governance forums, delivery teams and implementation partners
  • Maintain the business case, benefits profile and investment position, ensuring decisions remain value-led
  • Oversee process design, solution delivery, data migration, integration, testing, cutover, training and adoption
  • Manage the EPM software vendor, system integrator and other third parties against contractual commitments, outcomes and performance measures
  • Lead and develop programme and project management staff, setting clear expectations and providing coaching and feedback
  • Ensure all workstreams use Strategy and Transformation delivery standards and tools, including the Transformation Delivery Framework and Wrike
  • Identify and champion improvements that strengthen programme performance and delivery maturity
  • Share lessons learned and reusable practices across the programme and project management community

What you'll need:

 Experience & Background

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale finance or EPM transformation programmes in a global, multi-entity organisation.
  • Proven track record implementing enterprise platforms for financial consolidation, planning, forecasting and management reporting.
  • Strong understanding of group finance processes, close and consolidation, financial controls, data migration and business change.
  • Demonstrated experience managing EPM vendors, system integrators and third-party delivery partners through selection, design, implementation and deployment.

Leadership & Strategic Capability

  • Ability to define and articulate a clear programme vision, roadmap, and benefits case.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, including C‑suite, functional heads, and agency/market leaders.
  • Experience leading matrixed teams and managing cross‑functional delivery across geographies.
  • Demonstrated ability to set the right delivery culture, behaviours, and expectations.

Governance, Control & Delivery Excellence

  • Deep understanding of programme governance, including stage gates, reporting, RAID management, and financial controls.
  • Ability to establish and maintain robust delivery frameworks, quality standards, and assurance.
  • Skilled in risk management, including identifying systemic risks, interdependency conflicts, and developing mitigation plans.

Why we're hiring:

The Head of Security Incident Management is responsible for leading and maturing WPP's global Security Incident Management capability, providing strategic, operational, and technical leadership across the entire incident response lifecycle.

Reporting directly to the Director of Operational Security, this role owns the Security Incident Management function, including Security Incident Management Leads, Senior Security Incident Responders, and Security Incident Responders. The position ensures that security incidents are managed consistently, effectively, and in accordance with WPP policies, regulatory obligations, and operational standards.

The role evolves and scales incident response capabilities in alignment with WPP's Autonomic Security Operations (ASO) strategy and automation-first operating model. This includes oversight of people, process, technology, governance, service performance, and continuous improvement.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the end-to-end Security Incident Management capability across WPP.

  • Act as the senior escalation authority for Sev1 and Sev2 security incidents.
  • Ensure appropriate incident governance, communication, decision-making, and stakeholder engagement throughout the incident lifecycle.
  • Provide executive-level updates during significant cyber security incidents and crisis situations.
  • Define and own the Security Incident Management strategy, roadmap, and maturity objectives.

  • Lead strategic coordination during major cyber incidents, ransomware events, breaches, regulatory incidents, and business-critical security events.
  • Coordinate Operational Security, Legal, Privacy, Enterprise Technology, Communications, Executive Leadership, and external partners.
  • Oversee engagement with forensic providers, law enforcement, cyber insurance providers, and specialist third parties where required.
  • Ensure effective recovery, lessons learned, and organisational improvement following major incidents.
  • Own Security Incident Management policies, standards, procedures, playbooks, and operating documentation.
  • Ensure incident response activities are auditable, measurable, and aligned to governance requirements.
  • Chair incident review and service improvement forums.
  • Oversee Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Post Incident Review (PIR) programmes, ensuring actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.
  • Support internal audit, client assurance, certification requirements, and regulatory reviews.
  • Define and own Security Incident Management KPIs, KRIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.
  • Provide regular reporting to Operational Security Leadership, Cyber Leadership, and executive stakeholders.
  • Drive continual service improvement through data-led decision-making.
  • Maintain visibility of incident trends, response effectiveness, control gaps, and organisational risk exposure.
  • Ensure lessons learned are converted into measurable improvements across detection, response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and automation.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and career development for personnel within the Security Incident Management function.
  • Build and maintain a high-performing investigation and response culture.
  • Establish competency frameworks, training plans, certification pathways, succession planning, and effective resource coverage.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary cyber security teams in large, global organisations.
  • Deep technical understanding of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud security, identity security, email security, and digital forensics.

job.title: IAM Engineer - SSO
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Senior Identity and Access security Engineer is responsible for governing who, and what, can access DTS systems, data, APIs, tools, workflows and AI-enabled capabilities.

This is a hands-on governance and control role, reporting into the SVP Security and Compliance. The role ensures that access across DTS is appropriate, auditable, reviewed, least-privileged and aligned with security, privacy, compliance and client commitments.

The scope covers traditional human access, external users, privileged access, service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, dataset access, and the emerging governance of AI agents and agentic workflows.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Security, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal/DPO, TechOps, Enterprise Technology and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure DTS has a clear and controlled model for access across platforms such as WPP Open, Choreograph, InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve and related DTS capabilities.

 

What you'll be doing:

1. Identity and access governance framework

Define and maintain the access governance framework for DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining access governance standards, processes and control expectations.
  • Establishing how access should be requested, approved, provisioned, reviewed, revoked and evidenced.
  • Ensuring access governance covers internal users, external users, clients, partners, vendors, service accounts, machine identities and AI agents.
  • Aligning identity and access governance with DTS architecture, security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.
  • Ensuring access governance is practical for product and engineering teams to implement.

 

2. Access reviews and recertification

Own the process for regular access reviews and recertification across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining the scope, frequency and evidence requirements for access reviews.
  • Coordinating access reviews for critical DTS systems, production environments, privileged roles, sensitive datasets, client-facing platforms and administrative tools.
  • Ensuring access review outcomes are tracked, remediated and evidenced.
  • Identifying stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Escalating overdue, high-risk or unresolved access issues through the appropriate governance channels.

 

3. Privileged access governance

Ensure privileged access across DTS is properly controlled, justified and auditable.

This includes:

  • Reviewing access to production systems, cloud environments, security tools, databases, CI/CD tooling, administrative consoles and sensitive platforms.
  • Supporting least-privilege, just-in-time and time-bound access models where appropriate.
  • Working with Cloud and Platform Security and Infrastructure to improve privileged access controls.
  • Ensuring privileged access risks are visible in the DTS risk register where required.

 

4. External user, client and partner access governance

Govern access for external users, clients, agencies, partners and vendors.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for external user onboarding, approval, permissions, expiry and offboarding.
  • Ensuring external access has a clear business owner and justification.
  • Supporting access governance across client workspaces, agency environments, partner integrations and shared collaboration areas.
  • Working with Product and Engineering to ensure tenant, workspace and client-level isolation is appropriately governed.
  • Tracking risks related to stale accounts, vendor access, partner permissions and external user overprivilege.

 

5. Service account, machine identity and API access governance

Govern non-human access across DTS systems and platforms.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for service accounts, machine identities, automation users, API keys, tokens, secrets and integration credentials.
  • Ensuring non-human access has clear ownership, purpose, scope, rotation, expiry and auditability.
  • Working with Product, Engineering, Cloud Security and Infrastructure to reduce unmanaged credential risk.
  • Ensuring service accounts and machine identities are included in access reviews.
  • Supporting stronger governance of API access, token issuance, credential lifecycle and integration permissions.

 

6. AI and agentic access governance

Define and oversee the governance model for AI agents and agentic workflows across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining how AI agents are identified, permissioned, monitored, reviewed and revoked.
  • Ensuring agents have clear ownership, scoped permissions and auditable actions.
  • Defining which agent actions require human approval or additional control.
  • Governing agent access to APIs, tools, datasets, workflows, client environments and production capabilities.
  • Ensuring agents act within delegated authority and cannot exceed the permissions of the user, system or business process they represent.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and Security to ensure agentic workflows are designed with clear action boundaries.
  • Working with the Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead to test whether agent permissions and action boundaries can be bypassed.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering to ensure AI access models support permitted use, minimisation and data protection requirements.

7. Data access governance

Govern access to sensitive, client, partner and WPP-owned data across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for dataset access approval, review, revocation and evidence.
  • Supporting data classification from an access-control and security-governance perspective.
  • Ensuring access to sensitive data is role-based, purpose-based, least-privileged and auditable.
  • Supporting controls for cross-client, cross-market, cross-agency and partner data access.
  • Ensuring data access governance supports InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open and other DTS data collaboration use cases.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering on data minimisation, permitted use, retention and privacy-by-design requirements.
  • Ensuring data access risks are surfaced through the DTS risk process.

 

8. Governance of access to tools, workflows and actions

Ensure access governance extends beyond systems and datasets into tools, workflows and actions.

This includes:

  • Defining governance for access to operational tools, workflow automation, orchestration systems, AI tools and administrative actions.
  • Ensuring high-risk actions are subject to appropriate approval, logging and monitoring.
  • Supporting segregation of duties across sensitive workflows.
  • Ensuring automated workflows and agents have clearly scoped authority.
  • Working with Security Operations to ensure high-risk access and actions are visible in monitoring and detection processes.

 

9. Auditability, evidence and reporting

Maintain clear evidence of access governance and support audit and assurance requirements.

This includes:

  • Producing access governance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, client assurance, internal audit and risk reviews.
  • Working with the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure access controls, reviews, exceptions and remediation actions are documented.
  • Reporting on access review completion, high-risk access, overdue actions and access control gaps.
  • Supporting client and audit questions related to identity, access, privileged roles, service accounts, AI agents and data access.
  • Ensuring access governance is repeatable, measurable and auditable.

 

Who you'll be working with:

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer will be accountable for:

  • DTS identity and access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews and recertification.
  • Privileged access governance.
  • External user, client, partner and vendor access governance.
  • Service account, machine identity, API key and token governance.
  • AI agent identity, permission and action governance.
  • Dataset and sensitive data access governance.
  • Governance of access to tools, workflows and high-risk actions.
  • Access governance evidence for audit, compliance and client assurance.
  • Escalation of material access risks into the DTS risk process.

 

What you'll need:

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience in identity governance, access management, IAM, security governance, GRC, data access control or platform security.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, access reviews, privileged access and segregation of duties.
  • Experience governing access across SaaS platforms, cloud environments, APIs, data platforms or enterprise technology estates.
  • Knowledge of identity platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID or similar.
  • Understanding of service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, secrets and non-human access governance.
  • Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, delegated authority and tool-access governance would be highly valuable.
  • Understanding of data classification, dataset access governance, privacy-by-design and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture, product, engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy and compliance teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to coordinate reviews, evidence, remediation and reporting.
  • Ability to translate complex access issues into clear risks, controls and practical actions.

 

Leadership expectations

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer is expected to:

  • Be structured, disciplined and pragmatic.
  • Bring clarity to complex access and permission models.
  • Challenge excessive, unclear or poorly governed access.
  • Work constructively with product and engineering teams to design workable controls.
  • Avoid creating unnecessary bureaucracy while ensuring access is properly governed.
  • Treat human, machine and agent access as part of the same control landscape.
  • Escalate material access risks clearly and early.
  • Support DTS in building a secure, auditable and scalable access governance model.

 

Success measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

  • DTS having clear identity, access and data access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews completed on schedule with evidence.
  • Reduction in stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Stronger governance of privileged access and production access.
  • Clear ownership and review of service accounts, machine identities, API keys and tokens.
  • Defined governance for AI agent identities, permissions and actions.
  • Improved auditability of access to data, APIs, tools, workflows and production systems.
  • Better alignment between identity, security, privacy, architecture, product and engineering teams.
  • Material access risks being visible through the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.
  • Increased confidence that DTS can answer: who or what has access to what, why, and when was it last reviewed?

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing; it connects marketing professionals, data, tools, and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest, and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI delivering better informed creative ideas faster, at scale, and at lower cost.

We're endlessly curious, and our team of thinkers, builders, creators, and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

Role Purpose

As Incident Manager for the WPP Open Platform, you will own the end to end incident management lifecycle from detection through resolution to post incident review   ensuring platform stability, SLA compliance, and transparent communication across all stakeholders.

This is not a traditional incident management role. You will be expected to design, build, and continuously improve automated incident management workflows that connect our toolchain   Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp   into a seamless, intelligent, and low friction incident response system.

You will serve as the central coordination point for all P1 and P2 incidents, driving rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and proactive prevention. You will work closely with L1/L2 Support Engineers, the Team Lead, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure WPP Open delivers a reliable, world class experience to our global agency users.

Incident Ownership & Response

  • Own the full incident lifecycle for all P1 and P2 incidents: detection, triage, escalation, coordination, resolution, and closure
  • Serve as the primary war room coordinator during major incidents, driving cross functional teams toward rapid resolution
  • Ensure timely and accurate stakeholder communication at every stage of an incident
  • Maintain a clear audit trail of all actions, decisions, and communications throughout each incident
  • Enforce and continuously improve escalation matrices, response time targets, and SLA commitments
  • Perform post incident reviews and drive root cause analysis (RCA) with actionable preventive measures
  • Track and report on incident metrics, SLA performance, MTTR, MTTD, and repeat incident trends

Incident Automation & Toolchain Integration

  • Design and implement automated incident workflows across the full toolchain: Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp
  • Build and maintain ChatOps workflows in Slack and Teams   automating incident channel creation, responder assignment, status updates, and escalation triggers
  • Automate Statuspage updates based on monitoring alerts and incident severity thresholds, ensuring real time public facing status communication with zero manual delay
  • Configure Jira automation rules for incident ticket creation, priority routing, SLA timers, escalation triggers, and post incident task generation
  • Automate customer facing communication through Intercom and Zendesk   including incident acknowledgement messages, progress updates, and resolution notifications
  • Build WhatsApp and Teams notification workflows for executive and stakeholder briefings during critical incidents
  • Maintain and improve Confluence automation for RCA templates, incident documentation, and runbook generation triggered by incident closure
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting tools (Datadog, Statuspage, PagerDuty) with the communication stack to ensure zero gap detection to notification flows
  • Continuously evaluate and improve automation coverage   reducing manual steps, improving response speed, and ensuring consistency across all incident communication channels

Process & Knowledge Management

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce incident management playbooks, runbooks, and escalation procedures
  • Build and maintain a centralized incident knowledge base in Confluence   ensuring learnings from every major incident are captured and actioned
  • Define and own the post incident review process   including templates, timelines, and accountability tracking for preventive actions
  • Identify recurring incident patterns and work proactively with engineering teams to eliminate root causes
  • Drive continuous improvement of incident detection, response, and communication processes

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

  • Own all incident communications   internal (engineering, product, leadership) and external (agency users via Intercom/Zendesk/Statuspage)
  • Produce regular incident reports, trend analyses, and SLA performance summaries for leadership and stakeholders
  • Present post incident reviews and improvement plans to the Support Manager and Platform leadership
  • Maintain stakeholder notification lists and communication templates across all channels

Collaboration

  • Work closely with L1/L2 Support Engineers and the Team Lead to ensure smooth ticket triage, escalation, and handover during incidents
  • Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to improve platform observability, alerting quality, and deployment safety
  • Collaborate with Product teams to communicate platform stability status and incident impact on feature delivery

Skill Requirements

Essential Skills

Incident Management:

  • Minimum 3+ years of hands on incident management experience in an enterprise SaaS or digital platform environment
  • Proven experience owning P1/P2 incident response end to end   coordination, communication, escalation, and resolution
  • Deep understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management frameworks
  • Demonstrated experience in writing and maintaining incident runbooks, playbooks, and post incident reviews
  • Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent incidents calmly and effectively under pressure

Automation & Toolchain:

  • Jira / Jira Service Management: Advanced experience   automation rules, workflow configuration, SLA management, dashboard creation
  • Confluence: Automation templates, structured documentation, RCA frameworks, space management
  • Statuspage: Configuring and automating incident pages, component management, subscriber notifications, API driven updates
  • Slack: Building incident workflows, channel automation, bot integration, ChatOps implementation
  • Microsoft Teams: Automated notifications, incident bridge coordination, webhook integrations
  • Intercom: Automated customer messaging, incident broadcast campaigns, user segmentation for notifications
  • Zendesk: Ticket automation, trigger configuration, macro management, SLA rules
  • WhatsApp Business API or equivalent: Automated stakeholder notification workflows (desirable)
  • Experience integrating monitoring tools (Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar) with communication platforms via webhooks, APIs, or native integrations

Communication & Soft Skills:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication   ability to deliver clear, concise updates to both technical and non technical audiences simultaneously
  • Proven ability to remain composed and authoritative under pressure during major incidents
  • Strong stakeholder management skills   comfortable presenting to senior leadership during and after incidents
  • Ability to write structured, jargon free incident communications for agency/end users

 

Desirable Skills

  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification
  • Familiarity with Datadog or similar APM tools for monitoring to incident integration
  • Knowledge of SLO/SLI/Error Budget frameworks
  • Experience building incident management programs from scratch in a fast scaling platform environment

Behaviours

job.title: Lead Developer
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

WPP ET is undergoing a significant transformation to modernise ways of working and adopt cloud-based, micro-service architectures, automation, and digitised user experiences. Within this transition, the Lead Developer plays a strategic engineering role in the Chase Media Central programme, ensuring the platform’s custom extensions, integrations, data flows, and application components are built to enterprise standards and remain stable as the programme scales across regions. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you provide architectural direction for integration patterns, lead development work, guide developers through complex technical problems, and define coding standards and engineering best practices. You act as the technical authority for integrations and platform components, ensuring that all custom code interacting with Business Central, local applications, and market-specific systems is reliable, scalable, and maintainable. You work closely with Product, QA, Implementation, Data, BI, and market teams to ensure code, interfaces, and workflows align with business requirements while maintaining high engineering quality. You will also contribute to requirement refinement, solution design, technical documentation, code reviews, and production troubleshooting. Success in this role is defined by strong engineering output, predictable delivery, high-quality integrations and application components, well-supported developers, and trust from product and market stakeholders.

What you'll be doing:

Technical Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Provide technical direction for development activities across integrations, application components, and platform workflows.
  • Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategies, documentation expectations, and review practices.
  • Lead code reviews and ensure consistent engineering quality across all developers.
  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear, implementable designs and patterns.

 Application & Integration Development

  • Design and develop high-quality solutions across C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Azure services, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Build and maintain integration components between Media Central (Business Central) and local or global media/finance systems.
  • Prepare detailed technical design documentation and contribute to the refinement of user stories and backlog items.
  • Participate in testing activities (unit, regression, functional), supporting QA teams through defect clarification and validation.

Platform Reliability & Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring clear communication and structured root-cause analysis.
  • Support business-critical applications and ensure continuity through robust troubleshooting and fix delivery.
  • Create and maintain support guides, release notes, and knowledge-sharing artefacts to ensure operational readiness.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with BI, QA, Data, Implementation, and Product teams to ensure that technical solutions align with business needs and programme objectives.
  • Collaborate with vendor teams to clarify requirements, validate behaviours, and maintain alignment with global delivery timelines. Continuous Improvement & Technical Enablement
  • Champion development best practices, modern engineering techniques, automation opportunities, and process enhancements.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to developers and junior engineers to build capability and improve code quality.
  • Drive reusability, standardisation, and performance improvements across integration and application components.                          

What you'll need:

Essential Technical Skills

  • 5–7 years of application development experience with deep expertise in Microsoft technologies (C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Azure). 
  • Strong understanding of integration practices (e.g., REST patterns, scheduled data sync, data transformation logic).
  • Solid grounding in development methodologies (Agile, Waterfall), CI/CD, version control, and modern DevOps-aligned workflows. 
  • Ability to design and review technical architecture components, data flows, interface contracts, and solution documentation.
  • Experience preparing and validating technical specifications, user stories, test cases, and design artefacts.  

 Professional & Leadership Skills

  • Ability to lead and support developers in complex problem-solving and architectural decisions.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to break down technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple regions.

  • Monitoring performance of tools and tracking any issues and escalation in proactive manner, driving escalations as needed

Working closely with the Infosum's junior management accountant, you will collaborate on Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and SAP BFC reporting processes while also contributing to initiatives that drive greater efficiency, improve controls, and enhance ways of working across both the finance function and the wider business.   Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective relationships across multiple teams and levels of seniority. You will partner closely with colleagues across Finance and the business, helping to ensure the delivery of high-quality financial information and supporting key strategic objectives.   This role sits within the Infosum Finance Team, reporting directly to the SVP Finance of Infosum in the short term and longer term to the Financial Controller. It offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative global organisation.   InfoSum is WPP’s privacy-first data collaboration technology, trusted by global businesses to unlock the full potential of their first-party data without risk. Its patented, cross-cloud, decentralized collaboration technology leverages advanced Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) to radically transform how companies generate audience intelligence and drive better customer experiences. 

What you'll be doing:

Month-End, Year-End & Variance Analysis

  • Take ownership of the preparation of monthly Management Accounts, ensuring all balances are accurately reconciled to the Trial Balance.
  • Prepare and post journals, including accruals and salary postings, in line with IFRS accounting standards.
  • Lead monthly variance analysis against budget and forecast, providing clear insights and exception reporting to support decision-making.
  • Investigate and resolve post month-end queries in a timely manner.
  • Ensure all supporting schedules reconcile to the Profit & Loss statement and Balance Sheet.
  • Own the month-end reporting pack, ensuring compliance with Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR).
  • Support SOX, interim and year-end audits by providing relevant documentation, analysis and responses to auditor requests.
  • Prepare direct and indirect tax filings as required for the UK legal entity and support preparation with external advisers for non UK legal entities.

Group & WPP Reporting

  • Prepare management and external reporting submissions, including supporting schedules within BFC.
  • Partner with the EMEA finance team to resolve reporting queries and ensure the accuracy of submissions.
  • Produce and submit monthly financial commentaries to EMEA stakeholders.
  • Prepare and submit quarterly and year-end reporting packs in line with Group reporting requirements.

Continuous Improvement & Business Support

  • Ensure ongoing compliance with company policies, financial controls and SOX requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls and drive efficiencies across the finance function.
  • Act as a key contact for the Junior Management Accountant in the team, managing ad hoc queries and ensuring effective collaboration.
  • Support a range of finance and business improvement initiatives, including project work and other ad hoc activities as directed by the Financial Controller and SVP Finance for Infosum.

This role offers broad exposure across financial reporting, controls, audit and business partnering, providing an excellent opportunity to develop within a fast-paced, global organisation.

Essential

  • CIMA, ACA or ACCA qualified.
  • Strong Excel skills, with the ability to analyse, manipulate and present financial data effectively.
  • Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Able to quickly adapt to changing priorities, manage competing demands and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and reconciliation skills.

Location: London 

Shape the future of AI, data and marketing technology at WPP 

 

WPP is redefining how marketing, creativity, media, data and AI come together at global scale. 

As a Product Marketing Manager within WPP Data & Technology Solutions (DTS), you'll help shape the positioning, go-to-market strategy and adoption of some of WPP's most strategic technology investments, including WPP Open, our AI-powered marketing operating system, alongside Open Intelligence and other emerging capabilities. 

 

Working at the intersection of product, commercial strategy, technology and client transformation, you'll play a critical role in helping some of the world's largest brands unlock greater value from AI, data and marketing technology. These roles will work across four verticals of Creative/Production, Media, Data/Identity, and Partnerships. 

 

This is a unique opportunity to join the Product Marketing organisation at a pivotal moment in WPP's transformation, helping define how next-generation AI and data products are understood, adopted and brought to market across one of the world's largest marketing and communications companies.

  • Act as the bridge between Product, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams. 
  • Develop positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategies for products, features and capabilities. 
  • Translate complex technical concepts into compelling, commercially relevant narratives. 
  • Create sales enablement materials, customer-facing collateral, presentations and thought leadership content. 
  • Partner closely with product leaders and subject matter experts to build expertise in the products, capabilities and markets you support. 
  • Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and strengthen WPP's market position. 
  • Support client pitches, internal enablement and strategic growth initiatives. 
  • Drive cross-functional projects and bring structure to fast-moving, evolving priorities. 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Marketing and Client teams to ensure successful product adoption and market engagement.

  • Experience in Product Marketing within adtech, martech, SaaS, data, AI or product-led technology businesses. 
  • Understanding of how technology products are positioned, communicated and successfully brought to market. 
  • Experience creating positioning, messaging, sales enablement and customer-facing content. 
  • Ability to work effectively with technical, commercial and marketing stakeholders. 
  • Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes where they don't yet exist. 
  • A self-starter with ownership, accountability and curiosity. 
  • Interest in emerging technologies and the evolving role of AI in marketing and business transformation. 

 

This is not a traditional Product Marketing role 😊 

You'll be joining a global Product Marketing team responsible for bringing WPP's most strategic technology, data and AI capabilities to market. 

You'll work alongside leaders across Open, Open Intelligence and others while partnering with teams developing products and capabilities used throughout WPP and by some of the world's leading brands.

Knowledge Systems Manager

We're looking for a technically capable Knowledge Systems Manager to build, administer and evolve our knowledge management ecosystem on Zendesk. This is a hands-on role: you'll build tools and apps directly on the platform, work alongside engineers on integrations and UX, and take ownership of authentication and API-level troubleshooting, while also maintaining the knowledge base and the documentation that keeps it useful. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering and Support to make self-service, search and AI-assisted knowledge experiences genuinely work.

Key Responsibilities

Zendesk Platform Development

  • Design, build and maintain custom applications on Zendesk App Builder (e.g. dashboards, content management tooling, publishing workflows).
  • Own configuration of Zendesk Guide: themes, article templates, content presentation and publishing workflows.
  • Work directly with developers/engineers on Zendesk UX and UI translating requirements into technical specs and reviewing implementation.
  • Support and extend AI and automation features within Zendesk.

APIs, Authentication & Integrations

  • Build and maintain integrations between Zendesk and other enterprise systems (e.g. Zendesk API with Microsoft Teams, for querying the knowledge base directly from Teams).
  • Work confidently with APIs: authentication, requests, troubleshooting failures end-to-end.
  • Understand and troubleshoot OAuth, SSO and SAML authentication patterns, including recurring cross-brand/cross-tenant auth issues.
  • Partner with platform administrators and developers on new integrations and system enhancements.

Knowledge Base Management & Content

  • Maintain the day-to-day health of the knowledge base, applying the information architecture, taxonomy and content standards set by the Knowledge Director.
  • Create and maintain user-facing documentation for product features, workflows and releases.
  • Support knowledge strategy and self-service initiatives set by the Knowledge Systems Director; surface opportunities and risks from day-to-day platform work.

AI-Powered Knowledge Management

  • Use AI tools to accelerate content creation, maintenance and knowledge discovery, within the agent/pipeline architecture set by the wider team.
  • Optimise knowledge content for AI retrieval and generative AI / agent experiences.

Analytics & Insights

  • Analyse knowledge base usage, search behaviour and content performance to find gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Produce regular reporting to feed into the wider knowledge strategy and roadmap.

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk Guide/App Builder or a comparable platform, including custom app development and day-to-day configuration.
  • Working knowledge of APIs and authentication concepts (OAuth, SSO, SAML) with the ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently.
  • Experience delivering integrations between a knowledge/support platform and other enterprise systems.
  • Experience creating technical documentation and user-facing guidance.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineers on technical requirements, UX/UI, and implementation.
  • Experience using AI tools for content or workflow purposes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills.
  • Ability to analyse data and turn it into concrete improvement recommendations.

Technical Skills

  • Zendesk Administration & App Builder
  • API integration & troubleshooting
  • OAuth / SSO / SAML
  • HTML, CSS, JSON (low-code development)
  • Taxonomy & metadata management
  • Workflow automation
  • AI prompt engineering
  • Analytics & reporting

Desirable

  • Experience with generative AI implementations and RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) concepts.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting AI-powered customer support solutions.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • Shipped at least one new Zendesk App Builder tool or integration that measurably improves a workflow (e.g. content ops, publishing, cross-system querying).
  • Reduced reliance on engineering support for common Zendesk configuration, integration and auth issues.
  • Improved knowledge base search success and content discoverability.
  • Established measurable knowledge governance processes, with content quality and freshness improved across the KB.
  • Delivered actionable insights through knowledge analytics and reporting.
  • Supported AI initiatives that make effective use of organisational knowledge.

BURSON BUCHANAN

MANAGING DIRECTOR

JOB PURPOSE

As a Managing Director at Burson Buchanan, you will be a principal growth engine, client counsellor, and key leader within our premier strategic advisory boutique. Burson Buchanan delivers high-level advisory and communications support to clients on major capital markets events, ongoing financial communications, high-profile litigation and government investigations, crises and other reputation-defining events. Backed by Burson’s global network and market-leading data, analytics and AI tools, Burson Buchanan is defining strategic communications advisory for the intelligence era.

As a business generator, you will leverage your deep network of relationships within the advisory community—including leading investment banks, law firms and other advisory firms—and in the executive ranks and boardrooms of leading companies to help originate new business leads and opportunities. As a strategic senior counsellor, you will oversee accounts and lead teams in responding to the market-shaping events faced by Burson Buchanan clients, ensuring we consistently deliver excellent client work while driving sustainable account growth and long-term client retention.

As a member of the Burson Buchanan Senior Leadership Team (SLT), you will help shape the strategic direction of the firm. Leading by example, you will set the tone for a team culture that is built on high performance, teamwork, and open and respectful feedback to continue to elevate the value we bring to clients.

CLIENT & STRATEGIC ADVISORY

  • Advise and lead: serve as a trusted, high-level strategic advisor at the C-suite and Board level, delivering peer-to-peer counsel on complex capital markets activity (e.g., M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism situations) as well as high-stakes reputational issues (e.g., crisis/issues management and litigation).
  • Innovate: Position Burson Buchanan as the UK’s premier strategic comms advisory by seamlessly blending deep capital markets acumen with Burson’s state-of-the-art AI technology suite. Leverage Burson’s global network to support clients across multi-jurisdictional financial and corporate communications challenges.
  • Market leader: Maintain a comprehensive, forward-looking understanding of global capital markets, macroeconomic drivers, regulatory shifts, and competitive dynamics to add transformative value to client mandates.
  • Client service leader: Lead complex client accounts and major transaction mandates, ensuring flawless execution, game-changing strategic positioning, and the highest standards of quality control across all deliverables.
  • Lead by example: Operate with a true “player-coach” mindset—demonstrating the agility to transition seamlessly from board-level counsel to rolling up your sleeves on core deliverables, taking proactive ownership to solve both client and firm-wide challenges.

 

COMMERCIAL & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

  • Origination & growth: act as a primary business generator for Burson Buchanan. Proactively identify, target, and convert high-value new business opportunities that advance the firm’s commercial priorities.
  • Network & brand ambassador: serve as a prominent external ambassador for Burson Buchanan through market commentary, event participation, and senior industry networking to enhance agency profile and lead pipeline.
  • Cross-agency opportunities: proactively identify cross-selling opportunities across the broader Burson and WPP networks, bringing multi-disciplinary capability to capital markets clients.

LEADERSHIP, PEOPLE & CULTURE

  • Senior Leadership Team: serve as an active member of the SLT, contributing directly to agency-wide strategy, operational excellence, talent strategy, and long-term positioning.
  • High-performance culture: model leadership behaviours, setting a benchmark for ambition, strategic depth, and commercial urgency across a high-functioning team of advisors—while helping to build a culture that fosters connection and respect.
  • Talent development & mentorship: line manage, mentor, and inspire talent, fostering career growth and retention within the financial comms practice.
  • AI & innovation leadership: lead by example in the adoption of innovative solutions for our clients, including AI-driven communications tools, ensuring team adherence to WPP tools, ethical frameworks, and best practices.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

As a Managing Director at Burson Buchanan, you will be a principal growth engine, client counsellor, and key leader within our premier strategic advisory boutique. Burson Buchanan delivers high-level advisory and communications support to clients on major capital markets events, ongoing financial communications, high-profile litigation and government investigations, crises and other reputation-defining events. Backed by Burson’s global network and market-leading data, analytics and AI tools, Burson Buchanan is defining strategic communications advisory for the intelligence era.

As a key leader in our Litigation and Special Situations work, you will be responsible for building, launching, and scaling Burson Buchanan’s new Litigation Communications practice across the UK and Europe, as well as supporting the firm’s efforts to counsel clients on high-stakes capital markets events, crises and other market-shaping issues.

You will establish Burson Buchanan as the premier strategic advisory boutique for contentious matters in Europe. While this represents an exciting new capability for Burson Buchanan in the UK and Europe, you will build upon and draw strength from the deep crisis, regulatory, and corporate affairs expertise in Burson Buchanan in the U.S. and embedded across the wider Burson and WPP global networks.

As a business generator, you will leverage your deep network of relationships at leading law firms and in the executive ranks (especially at the General Counsel level) and boardrooms of leading companies to help originate new business leads and opportunities. As a strategic senior counsellor, you will oversee accounts and lead teams in responding to the market-shaping events faced by Burson Buchanan clients, ensuring we consistently deliver excellent client work and results.

As a member of the Burson Buchanan Senior Leadership Team (SLT), you will help shape the strategic direction of the firm. Leading by example, you will set the tone for a team culture that is built on high performance, teamwork, and open and respectful feedback to continue to elevate the value we bring to clients.

PRACTICE LEADERSHIP & STRATEGIC ADVISORY

  • Shape the market offering: define and execute the go-to-market strategy to launch and scale Burson Buchanan’s Litigation Communications capability across the UK and Europe, building on the established work and expertise within Burson Buchanan in the U.S. and in lockstep with Burson’s broader litigation and crisis capabilities.
  • Advise and lead: serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite, Boards, General Counsels, and outside legal counsel on high-stakes and high-profile litigation and government investigations, including:
    • Securities & Financial Litigation
    • Antitrust & Competition Matters
    • Government & Regulatory Investigations
    • White Collar Crime & Whistleblower Cases
    • IP, Patent & Trade Secrets
    • Class-Action, Collective Litigation & MDL
    • Employee & Labour Disputes
  • Client service leader: lead complex litigation, government investigations, and crisis and issues mandates, ensuring flawless execution, game-changing strategic positioning, and the highest standards of quality control across all deliverables.
  • Innovate: champion bold, innovative, and data-informed comms strategies, leveraging our global network to support clients across complex legal and corporate communications challenges.
  • Lead by example: operate with a true “player-coach” mindset—demonstrating the agility to transition seamlessly from board-level counsel to rolling up your sleeves on core deliverables, taking proactive ownership to solve both client and firm-wide challenges.

COMMERCIAL & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

  • Origination & growth: act as a principal revenue driver, cultivating a deep referral network of law firm partners, litigators, litigation funders, and General Counsels across key UK and European legal hubs (London, Frankfurt, Paris, Brussels, Dublin).
  • Pitch & proposal leadership: lead client pitches, RFPs, and crisis response mobilisations with speed, authority, and commercial rigor.
  • Cross-selling: identify opportunities to cross-sell litigation comms to Burson Buchanan’s existing corporate/financial retainer clients, while introducing Burson’s wider corporate, PA, and IR services to newly acquired legal dispute clients.
  • Network & brand ambassador: serve as a prominent external ambassador for Burson Buchanan through market commentary, event participation, and senior industry networking to enhance agency profile and lead pipeline.

PEOPLE, BRAND & LEADERSHIP

  • Senior Leadership Team: serve as an active member of the SLT, contributing directly to agency-wide strategy, operational excellence, talent strategy, and long-term positioning.
  • Team building & talent acquisition: recruit, build, and mentor a specialist litigation communications team as the practice scales, instilling a high-performance, fast-paced boutique mindset.
  • High-performance culture: model leadership behaviours, setting a benchmark for ambition, strategic depth, and commercial urgency across a high-functioning team of advisors—while helping to build a culture that fosters connection and respect.
  • AI & innovation leadership: lead by example in adopting innovative solutions for our clients, including AI-driven communications tools, and ensure team adherence to WPP tools, ethical frameworks, and best practices.
  • Cross-agency collaboration: work closely with the UK Senior Leadership Team and European regional leadership to leverage existing crisis skillsets and integrate litigation comms into wider group offerings.

Thought leadership & market profile: establish Burson Buchanan as the definitive voice on litigation communications in Europe through published thought leadership, media commentary, legal industry event sponsorships, and panel participation.

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Finance Director

Reporting to: Norway and Sweden Market Leader & EMEA CFO

Location: Norway

 

Who we are:
Burson is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

Burson is part of WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), the creative transformation company. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the role

Burson is seeking a commercially focused Finance Director, to lead finance across our Swedish market, with oversight of Norway. This is a senior market finance leadership role, partnering closely with local and regional leadership to drive financial performance, strengthen operational discipline and support sustainable growth across the two markets.

The role will be responsible for financial planning, reporting, forecasting, controls, compliance and commercial finance support across a business of approximately $10m revenue. It requires someone who can operate strategically, but who is also comfortable being close to the detail in a smaller market environment.

We are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on and commercially astute finance leader who can provide clear insight, challenge and counsel to leadership teams, while ensuring strong governance, accurate reporting and effective financial management.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead finance across Sweden and Norway, ensuring strong financial management, governance and commercial discipline across both markets.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to both market leadership, providing clear insight, challenge and counsel to support business performance and decision-making.
  • Own the budgeting, forecasting and planning processes, ensuring alignment with local market priorities, regional expectations and group reporting requirements.
  • Provide accurate, timely and meaningful financial reporting, including revenue, profitability, margin, cost management, cash flow and working capital performance.
  • Translate financial data into clear commercial insight, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that help leaders make informed decisions.
  • Partner with client and business leads on pricing, profitability, resourcing and commercial decision-making to support sustainable growth.
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes, working closely with local, regional, shared service and group finance teams.
  • Ensure the integrity of financial records, reporting and controls, maintaining compliance with Burson/WPP policies and relevant Swedish and Norwegian requirements.
  • Lead on audit, tax, statutory reporting and external advisor relationships, ensuring deadlines are met and risks are managed effectively.
  • Drive improvements in finance processes, systems and ways of working, creating greater consistency, efficiency and accountability across the markets.
  • Support strong operational discipline around revenue recognition, billing, collections, approvals and project financial management.
  • Lead, support and develop the local finance function, building strong relationships across a matrixed, international environment.

Experience You’ll Bring:

  • Significant experience in senior finance, financial control, Financial Planning & Analysis or commercial finance roles, ideally within a professional services, communications, consulting, agency or matrixed international environment.
  • Strong understanding of financial management within a smaller or mid-sized market, with the ability to balance strategic input with hands-on delivery.
  • Proven experience partnering with senior leaders to improve financial performance, commercial discipline and operational decision-making.
  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, reporting, variance analysis and performance management experience.
  • Good understanding of accounting, controls, audit, tax and compliance requirements across Sweden; exposure to Norway or wider Nordic markets would be advantageous.
  • Experience working with regional or group finance teams, ideally in an international network or multinational organisation.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and turn it into clear, actionable insight.
  • High level of integrity, sound judgement and confidence in providing constructive challenge.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain finance matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.
  • Fluent English is essential; Swedish language skills are highly desirable. Norwegian language skills or experience working with Norway would be an advantage.

job.title: Penetration Tester
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
