  • Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)
  • Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance
  • Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]
  • Position Type: Full-Time

 

Role Overview

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Engineer is responsible for embedding security directly into the design, development, testing, and operation of DTS products and platforms.

This is a hands-on security engineering role. The role requires someone who can work directly with product and engineering teams, review designs, assess APIs, run threat models, test systems, coordinate penetration testing, identify vulnerabilities, and help teams remediate issues.

The role ensures DTS products, APIs, data collaboration capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and client-facing services are designed, built, and tested securely. It also owns the practical offensive security and adversarial assurance activity needed to test DTS products from an attacker’s perspective.

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security Operations, Privacy, Cloud and Platform Security, and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure security issues are identified early, fixed effectively, and tracked through governance where required.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-on Product and Application Security

Provide hands-on security support across DTS products and engineering teams. This includes:

  • Reviewing product designs, technical designs, APIs, services, and integrations.
  • Identifying security weaknesses in applications, workflows, and data flows.
  • Advising engineering teams on secure implementation.
  • Supporting secure design decisions during product discovery and delivery.
  • Helping teams resolve security issues pragmatically without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

2. Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Embed security into the software development lifecycle across DTS. This includes:

  • Defining and applying secure engineering standards.
  • Supporting secure coding practices.
  • Reviewing CI/CD security controls.
  • Supporting SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and container scanning.
  • Helping teams triage, prioritise, and remediate security findings.
  • Working with engineering teams to make security checks practical and repeatable.

3. Threat Modelling and Security Design Reviews

Run threat modelling and security design reviews for new and changed capabilities. This includes:

  • Facilitating threat modelling sessions with engineering and product teams.
  • Reviewing authentication and authorization designs.
  • Assessing API exposure, data flows, trust boundaries, and abuse cases.
  • Identifying risks around tenant isolation, privilege escalation, data leakage, and misuse.
  • Documenting key findings, recommendations, and residual risks.

4. Offensive Security and Adversarial Testing

Carry out and coordinate offensive security testing across DTS products and platforms. This includes:

  • Performing hands-on security testing of products, APIs, and workflows.
  • Coordinating external penetration tests.
  • Supporting red team and purple team exercises where required.
  • Testing abuse cases and attacker paths.
  • Testing access control, authentication, authorization, and data leakage risks.
  • Validating remediation of security findings.
  • Feeding material risks into the ISMS and Risk Officer for tracking.

5. API, Integration and Data Product Security

Provide security assurance for APIs, integrations, and data products. This includes:

  • Reviewing externally exposed APIs and partner integrations.
  • Assessing rate limiting, authorization, tenant isolation, logging, abuse prevention, and data leakage controls.
  • Supporting secure integration between InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open, and third-party platforms.
  • Reviewing data product workflows for misuse, excessive access, or unintended exposure.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering on privacy-sensitive APIs, algorithms, and outputs.

6. AI and Agentic Security Testing

Provide hands-on security review and adversarial testing for AI-enabled and agentic capabilities. This includes:

  • Testing prompt injection, tool misuse, data leakage, and excessive agency.
  • Reviewing how agents access APIs, data, tools, and workflows.
  • Testing whether agent permissions can be bypassed or escalated.
  • Assessing action boundaries and human approval points.
  • Working with Identity, AI, and Data Access Governance to validate agent access models.
  • Documenting AI and agentic security risks and remediation actions.

7. Vulnerability Triage and Remediation Support

Help teams understand, prioritise, and fix security vulnerabilities. This includes:

  • Reviewing vulnerability findings from scans, penetration tests, code reviews, cloud tools, and external reports.
  • Prioritising findings based on exploitability, exposure, data sensitivity, and business impact.
  • Working directly with engineers to define remediation options.
  • Validating that fixes are effective.
  • Supporting exception and risk acceptance decisions where remediation is delayed.
  • Ensuring significant issues are visible through the DTS risk process.

8. Engineering Enablement and Security Coaching

Act as a practical security partner to engineering teams. This includes:

  • Providing secure implementation guidance.
  • Creating lightweight security patterns and examples.
  • Coaching engineers on common application, API, and AI security risks.
  • Helping teams understand the “why” behind security requirements.
  • Supporting a culture where security is part of product quality, not a separate approval gate.

Key Accountabilities

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead will be accountable for:

  • Hands-on application and product security support across DTS.
  • Secure SDLC guidance and practical adoption.
  • Threat modelling and security design reviews.
  • API, integration, and data product security reviews.
  • Offensive security and adversarial testing activity.
  • AI and agentic security testing.
  • Vulnerability triage, remediation guidance, and fix validation.
  • Coordination with ISMS/Risk to ensure material risks and exceptions are tracked.
  • Helping engineering teams build secure systems without unnecessary delivery drag.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have:

  • Strong hands-on experience in application security, product security, offensive security, security engineering, or penetration testing.
  • Good understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, SaaS platforms, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
  • Experience with threat modelling and secure design reviews.
  • Practical knowledge of common application and API security risks, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, injection, data leakage, privilege escalation, and supply chain risk.
  • Experience using security testing tools and techniques across web applications, APIs, cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management workflows.
  • Experience working directly with engineers to remediate findings.
  • Understanding of AI and agentic security risks would be highly valuable.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with engineering, product, architecture, security, and leadership stakeholders.
  • A pragmatic, delivery-aware approach to security.

Leadership Expectations

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Engineer is expected to:

  • Be hands-on and technically credible with engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted security partner, not just a reviewer or approver.
  • Challenge insecure designs constructively.
  • Help teams find practical ways to reduce risk.
  • Prioritise issues based on real-world exploitability and business impact.
  • Work across multiple DTS product areas without becoming a delivery bottleneck.
  • Escalate material risks clearly through the appropriate governance routes.
  • Promote secure engineering habits through practical guidance and example.

Success Measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

  • Security being embedded earlier in product and engineering delivery.
  • Reduction in high-risk application, API, and product vulnerabilities.
  • Regular threat modelling and security reviews for critical DTS capabilities.
  • Effective offensive and adversarial testing of products, APIs, and workflows.
  • Faster remediation of penetration test and security testing findings.
  • Improved security assurance for AI and agentic workflows.
  • Engineering teams receiving practical, actionable security guidance.
  • Material security risks being surfaced and tracked through the DTS risk process.
  • Security being viewed by engineering teams as an enabler of trusted delivery rather than a blocker.

Platform Engineer

Level: Mid-Level Engineer, Technology Solutions
Location: Copenhagen
Reporting to: Lead Engineer

About Open Intelligence

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational platform infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the heart of a vast network and is deeply integrated with the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry.

Operating at this scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle more than 60,000 requests per second. With operations across the US and UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure supports globally distributed services across our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a skilled Platform Engineer to design, build, evolve, and optimize our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes. You will work closely with software engineers, QA, IT, and product teams to streamline development workflows, improve system reliability, and ensure our infrastructure is secure and scalable.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys building reliable platform solutions and is keen to use modern development and testing technologies. You will partner with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure our platform meets evolving business needs.

What You Will Do

  • Design scalable, cloud-native systems on platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform to support high-throughput applications and services.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using HashiCorp Terraform.
  • Build secure, multi-account and cross-cloud environments.
  • Optimize cost efficiency for high-scale workloads and low-latency microservices.
  • Improve visibility into performance and cost metrics across environments and workloads.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters for containerized applications and microservices.
  • Implement blue/green and canary deployment strategies.
  • Build robust automation using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Argo Workflows.
  • Automate testing, security scans, and compliance checks.
  • Support colleagues in making architectural choices about cloud services.
  • Promote a small, coherent, and flexible configuration surface to reduce deployment time and improve release confidence.
  • Champion DRY and DevOps principles through code reviews, documentation, and shared tooling.

What You Will Need

  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in enterprise-scale environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Proven expertise in Infrastructure as Code using HashiCorp tools or equivalent.
  • Deep experience containerizing and orchestrating applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar, with an automation-first mindset.
  • Golang knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience implementing observability and monitoring solutions such as Datadog, Prometheus, or the Elastic Stack.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VPCs, load balancing, DNS, IAM, and security groups.
  • Experience supporting large-scale technology platforms, ideally in AdTech or marketing technology.
  • Knowledge of security principles, best practices, and compliance standards such as GDPR.
  • Experience supporting multi-region, globally distributed systems.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner across engineering and product teams.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset focused on reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

job.description:

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

WHO WE ARE

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. Your strong understanding of data and SQL will be key to communicating effectively with engineering and data science teams and making informed product decisions.

You are:

  • Data-curious, with a proven ability to analyze information and derive actionable insights.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of breaking down complex problems and defining clear product needs.
  • An excellent communicator, able to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive learner, eager to deepen your understanding of AdTech, product management, and data-driven methodologies.
  • Collaborative, thriving in a cross-functional team environment and contributing to a shared vision.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support Product Development & Lifecycle Management
  • Assist in defining, documenting, and prioritizing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria based on user needs, business goals, and data analysis.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Data Scientists, and UX Designers to ensure a shared understanding of product features and their underlying data implications.
  • Help manage and refine product backlogs, participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews), and support release cycles.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities and stay informed about industry trends in data and AI for marketing.

 

Leverage Data for Product Insights and Validation

  • Utilize SQL and other data analysis tools to query datasets, analyze product performance, identify trends, and generate insights that inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to understand data availability, schemas, quality, and potential for new product features or enhancements.
  • Define and track key product performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, helping to evaluate the success of new features post-launch.
  • Help ensure data quality and integrity within product features, flagging discrepancies or potential issues.

 

Facilitate Stakeholder Communication & Feedback

  • Communicate product updates, release notes, and progress to various internal stakeholders, effectively highlighting the data-driven rationale behind product decisions.
  • Gather feedback from users, internal teams (e.g., commercial, operations), and clients to continuously iterate and improve our products.
  • Support in preparing presentations and documentation to articulate product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

 

Continuous Learning & Contribution

  • Actively seek to deepen your understanding of AdTech data, our internal platforms (including WPP Open), and user behaviors through self-study and mentorship.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management processes and tools within the team.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 0-2 years of experience in a product, business analyst, data analyst, or similar role with exposure to software development.
  • Proficiency in SQL is essential, with the ability to write complex queries to extract, analyze, and manipulate data from various sources.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehousing concepts.
  • English fluency C2
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to define and document clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable product insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and vice-versa.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

 

If you are ready to be at the forefront of the AdTech industry, shaping its future, and driving success for both our clients, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

job.title: Programme Lead (Value & Delivery) - Enterprise AI
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is accelerating the adoption of AI across the enterprise, investing in a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to transform how work gets done across our global business.

Within Enterprise Technology, we're enabling this transformation by building the platforms, capabilities and operating models that will power the next generation of work. From Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation to emerging AI technologies and agentic workflows, we're embedding AI into the fabric of how WPP operates globally.

We're looking for a Programme Lead (Value & Delivery) to help ensure those investments translate into measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the heart of WPP's Enterprise AI programme, owning the critical link between delivery and impact. While delivery teams focus on building AI solutions, you'll focus on proving and maximising their value, ensuring solutions become embedded into the way people work and that benefits are measured, evidenced and sustained over time.

You'll work with senior business stakeholders and functional leaders to shape investment decisions, drive adoption at scale and ensure WPP realises the full value of its AI ambitions.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own value realisation for WPP's Enterprise AI portfolio, ensuring investments deliver measurable business outcomes and demonstrable return on investment.
  • Develop and maintain business cases, benefits frameworks, adoption metrics and executive reporting for senior Technology and Transformation stakeholders.
  • Take accountability for the successful adoption and long-term sustainability of AI solutions after go-live.
  • Lead the transition of the Enterprise AI opportunity pipeline into permanent in-house ownership, qualifying and prioritising demand before it enters delivery.
  • Own the enterprise-wide adoption and measurement framework, establishing baselines, KPIs, benchmarks and reporting standards across multiple business environments.
  • Lead the WPP Frontier Lab, evaluating emerging AI products and translating market developments into practical business recommendations.
  • Manage the AI Hub demand funnel and agent registry, ensuring opportunities are prioritised effectively and existing capabilities are leveraged before new solutions are created.
  • Define and implement the operating model for Enterprise AI, helping establish what business-as-usual looks like as AI scales across WPP.
  • Represent AI adoption, value realisation and programme outcomes at steering committees, programme boards and senior leadership forums.
  • Lead and develop a small specialist team focused on value tracking, adoption measurement and operational excellence.
  • Partner closely with delivery, governance and business stakeholders to ensure a consistent, evidence-led approach to Enterprise AI.

What we are looking for:

  • Significant experience leading enterprise transformation, value realisation, programme delivery or business change initiatives within large global organisations.
  • A proven track record of owning business cases, benefits frameworks and post-implementation value measurement.
  • Experience transitioning programmes from outsourced or partner-led delivery into sustainable in-house ownership.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to build, challenge and defend investment cases.
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders across functions such as Finance, Shared Services, Tax or Transformation.
  • The ability to influence at senior levels while remaining equally effective with operational teams.
  • Excellent analytical capability and the confidence to challenge assumptions, methodologies and reported outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready materials and recommendations.
  • Experience leading distributed teams and operating across complex stakeholder environments.

job.description:

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Role Purpose:

WPP is undergoing an exciting global transformation, and we are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Automation Quality Analyst specialising in Playwright to join our quality assurance team. As an Automation QA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by designing and maintaining automated test coverage, executing test plans, identifying defects, and collaborating with development teams to resolve issues. You will help sustain the reliability of our platform under a trunk-based, continuously delivered way of working. Your work will help us deliver exceptional user experiences and maintain high standards of product excellence. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Automation Quality Analyst, you will:

  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable test cases and automation coverage.
  • Develop, document and execute detailed test plans and test cases.
  • Design and automate end-to-end tests using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Implement and maintain test automation frameworks.
  • Execute automated and manual test cases, and perform both formal and exploratory testing.
  • Conduct regression testing to verify that resolved issues do not affect existing functionality.
  • Identify, document and track defects using bug tracking tools, providing clear and concise descriptions of issues.
  • Review test cases and automated tests written by other QA engineers.
  • Embed automated tests within the CI/CD pipeline, keeping merge-gate and nightly regression suites reliable.
  • Investigate and address test flakiness to maintain confidence in automated results.
  • Participate in design and requirement reviews, providing input on testability and quality risks.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues.
  • Work with the DevOps and SRE teams to ensure test environments and test data are stable and available.
  • Lead testing activities during sprint and release cycles.
  • Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical teams, and report test results to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and methodologies.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends and best practice in software testing and test automation.

Skill Requirements:

We understand that candidates may not have every single skill listed below. We encourage you to apply if you possess a strong foundation in automation QA and a willingness to learn and grow.

  • 3–5 years' proven experience as a QA engineer or in a similar role, including hands-on test automation.
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, tools and processes, and of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience testing complex web applications.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining test automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tooling, such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
  • Knowledge and experience of API testing (Postman or any other similar tool).
  • Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g. Jira, TestRail).
  • Ability to lead testing activities during sprint and release.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, detail-oriented with a keen eye for identifying issues and inconsistencies.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field is preferred.

Desirable experience

  • Experience working in a trunk-based development and continuous delivery environment.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing tooling.
  • Familiarity with basic SQL queries for database validation.
  • Exposure to performance testing concepts.
  • Experience stabilising large end-to-end regression suites and reducing automation debt.

Detection Engineering is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-fidelity detection logic across enterprise security platforms. This role focuses on proactive threat detection, automation-first practices, and continuous improvement of detection coverage and accuracy, supporting the WPP SOC transformation into an Autonomic Security Operations model.

What you'll be doing:

  • Develop, test, and maintain detection rules and logic across SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Conduct RCA on missed detections, delayed responses, and high-severity incidents.
  •  Identify technical and process-level causes of detection failures or inefficiencies.

  • Continuous Security Improvement (CSI)
  • Maintain a CSI backlog (detection gaps, telemetry blind spots, false positives to reduce).
  •  Analyze detection performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Align detection priorities with business risk and the SOC transformation roadmap.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Hunting teams to operationalize detection improvements.
  •  Work with Threat Intelligence teams to integrate emerging TTPs into detection logic.
  • Contribute to purple team exercises by validating detection logic against simulated attack paths.

Strategic Alignment to GCAT SOC10x

  • 10X People: Continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • 10X Process: Embed agile workflows and automation-first principles.
  • 10X Technology: Leverage AI/ML for detection tuning and anomaly detectio.
  • 10X Visibility: Ensure comprehensive telemetry ingestion and observability.
  • 10X Speed: Reduce detection-to-response cycle through orchestration and automation.

What you'll need:

Technical Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud security platforms.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell).
  • Familiarity with detection-as-code principles and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat-informed defense.

Collaboration & Communication

  •  Ability to work closely with SOC analysts, threat hunters, and engineers.
  • Skilled in documenting detection logic and RCA outcomes.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • GIAC GCTI, GCFA, or equivalent advanced security certifications.

job.title: Senior Analytics Manager
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The WPP DTS Business Intelligence team is looking for an exceptional Senior Analytics Manager to lead two of the four working pillars within our 14-person (and growing) global BI function: Product & Engineering Intelligence and Sentiment & Value Intelligence.

In this role, you will be the vital bridge connecting day-to-day tactical analytics with the broader WPP DTS Business Intelligence vision. You will partner directly with product leadership, engineering, UI/UX research, client, and market enablement teams to establish trusted telemetry, evaluate feature adoption, and measure the business value of our digital products.

You will have line management responsibility for 2 analysts (split across the UK and US), serving as a dedicated mentor and technical guide to help them deliver their best work and grow their careers. Working closely with the VP of Business Intelligence, you will establish unified tracking standards, integrate qualitative sentiment with behavioural data, and ensure our reporting delivers the critical ‘so what’ that inspires executive action.

This role is flexible hybrid.

What you'll be doing:

  • Connect Tactical Delivery with Strategic Vision: Bridge day-to-day analytics execution with the overarching BI roadmap, ensuring that project-level deliverables advance wider organisational priorities.
  • Project & Operational Leadership: Lead and manage multiple projects across the team, ensuring delivery remains on track with our roadmap, challenges are resolved or escalated efficiently, tasks are delegated effectively, and high standards of data quality and output integrity are maintained.
  • Lead Product & Engineering Intelligence: Partner with product leadership, engineers, designers, and enablement teams to establish and maintain unified tracking and measurement standards, oversee the build of intuitive self-serve adoption dashboards, and deliver strategic deep dives that steer product roadmaps—adapting measurement and intelligence to the changing product landscape as required.
  • Drive Sentiment & Value Intelligence: Partner with our colleagues in the Research team to make sense of product user sentiment and feedback. Synthesise behavioural product analytics with qualitative survey feedback into a cohesive narrative quantifying productivity, operational impact, and client outcomes.
  • Team Mentorship & People Leadership: Line-manage, mentor, and coach 2 direct reports (UK and US), actively reviewing work, unblocking technical challenges, providing hands-on guidance, and fostering an environment of continuous learning and high analytical rigour.
  • Champion Data Quality & Reconcile Complex Datasets: Take accountability for reporting accuracy and data integrity. Confidently reconcile messy, disparate, or fragmented data sources into structured, trustworthy reporting assets.
  • Insight-Led Storytelling & Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a key business advisor across all levels of the organisation—engaging technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. Translate complex data into clear, compelling, and actionable stories that focus relentlessly on business impact rather than just numbers.
  • Foundational Governance & Enablement: Collaborate with the wider BI team on our shared data infrastructure layer (BigQuery, Databricks) to uphold event taxonomy standards, KPI definitions, and governed data management.

What will you bring:

  • Analytics Experience: Significant hands-on experience in business intelligence, product analytics, data analytics, or equivalent roles, with a proven track record of moving beyond pure data ‘reporting’ to deliver actionable "so what" insights that influence decisions. Experience with Google Analytics or equivalent analytics packages would be particularly helpful.
  • People Leadership & Mentoring: Demonstrated experience managing, coaching, or mentoring analysts; genuine enthusiasm for developing junior-to-mid-level talent and guiding them through analytical and technical roadblocks.
  • Navigating Messy & Fragmented Data: Proven ability to connect, clean, and reconcile diverse, non-standard datasets (e.g. behavioural event tracking, operational databases, survey data, enablement metrics) with meticulous attention to detail and data quality.
  • Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and collaborating effectively with peers regardless of their level of data literacy.
  • Product Analytics Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of digital product delivery, measurement approaches, metric definitions, user journey mapping, and feature adoption metrics.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in SQL and modern BI/visualisation platforms (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Looker). Hands-on familiarity with data manipulation and modern cloud data environments (e.g. BigQuery).
  • Mixed-Methods Exposure: Experience leading, working with, or integrating qualitative user feedback/Voice of the Customer (VoC) research alongside quantitative behavioural datasets is a strong plus.

What you'll need:

  • Analytical Thinking: Able to simplify complex problems, break projects into component parts, and evaluate them systematically to identify causal relationships and construct effective frameworks for problem solving.
  • Communication: Able to convey messages clearly and persuasively, adapting your style, tools, and techniques to suit different technical and non-technical audiences and the nature of the information.
  • Planning and Organising: Able to think ahead to establish effective courses of action for yourself and others, prioritising and managing activities against deadlines, staffing, and resource requirements.
  • Resilience: Able to maintain personal effectiveness and composure under pressure or setbacks, bringing sustained motivation, energy, and commitment to your work in challenging situations.
  • Data Literacy: Able to navigate large, multi-source datasets, separate signal from noise, and articulate clear pathways from raw data to useful, actionable analysis.
  • Data Analysis & Storytelling: Able to synthesise complex datasets into clear, impactful data narratives that convey actionable insights to decision-makers and drive business outcomes.
  • Self-Sufficiency: Able to independently problem-solve, prioritise your workload, and investigate complex data without requiring close supervision.
  • Growth Mindset: Able to continually develop your capabilities, viewing challenges as learning opportunities and demonstrating hard work and persistence to overcome skill gaps.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

job.title: Senior AQA Engineer
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role Purpose:

WPP is undergoing an exciting global transformation, and we are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Automation Quality Analyst, specialising in Playwright, to join our Central QA team. In this senior role you will lead the automation of our regression and end-to-end test suites, set the standard for test quality across the team, and act as a go-to technical reference for other QA engineers.You will be instrumental in sustaining the reliability of our platform under a trunk-based, continuously delivered way of working, where quality has to be built in early rather than inspected at the end. Beyond strong automation fundamentals, we are looking for someone attuned to modern, AI-assisted ways of working — using AI tooling to accelerate test design, authoring and analysis without compromising rigour. This is a senior position with a clear path towards a QA Lead role for the right person. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Senior Automation Quality Analyst, you will:

Automation and test engineering

  • Lead the design, build and maintenance of automated end-to-end and regression suites using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable test cases and automation coverage.
  • Perform formal and exploratory testing; execute and review both automated and manual test cases.
  • Identify, document and track defects, providing clear and concise descriptions that allow developers to reproduce and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Conduct regression testing to verify that resolved issues do not affect existing functionality.

Continuous delivery and the merge gate

  • Embed testing into the CI/CD pipeline, keeping the merge gate reliable and the nightly regression green.
  • Use AI tooling to accelerate test authoring, data creation and defect analysis, applying sound judgement to validate AI-assisted output.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues, and with SRE and DevOps to keep test environments and test data stable.
  • Lead testing activities during sprints and releases.
  • Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, and report test results.
  • Define and apply the criteria for what belongs in the merge gate versus the nightly suite, keeping gate suites within an agreed time budget so they give fast, trustworthy feedback.
  • Own test stability — triage flaky tests, apply the quarantine policy, and drive fixes so confidence in automated results is maintained.
  • Design test coverage appropriate to each environment as code progresses from integration through to pre-production and performance environments.
  • Provide test evidence to support release readiness and the Go/No-Go decision.

Standards, mentoring and hand-over

  • Set and uphold automation standards; review other engineers' test cases and automated tests and mentor QA engineers on good practice.
  • Stabilise test suites and hand them over to POD teams, supporting developers in maintaining them once ownership transfers.
  • Work across multiple POD teams and codebases, adapting to differing priorities while keeping a consistent quality bar.
  • Participate in design and requirement reviews, providing input on testability and quality risks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and methodologies, and keep current with industry trends and best practice.

Collaboration and communication

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate test authoring, data creation and defect analysis, applying sound judgement to validate AI-assisted output.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues, and with SRE and DevOps to keep test environments and test data stable.
  • Lead testing activities during sprints and releases.
  • Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, and report test results.
  • Support investigation of production incidents where test coverage or quality is a contributing factor.

Skill Requirements:

We understand that candidates may not have every skill listed below. We encourage you to apply if you have a strong automation foundation and the drive to lead and grow.

  • 6–8 years' proven experience as an automation QA or test engineer, with a track record of owning automation on complex web applications.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise in Playwright with TypeScript — designing and maintaining automation frameworks from the ground up.
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, tools and processes, of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and of trunk-based and continuous delivery workflows.
  • Proficiency with GitHub and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions and/or GitLab CI) to run tests as part of the pipeline.
  • Experience with API testing (Postman or similar).
  • Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g. Jira, TestRail).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing — practical use of AI tooling to improve the speed and quality of QA work.
  • Proven ability to lead testing activities during sprint and release, and to mentor other QA engineers.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for identifying issues and inconsistencies.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities across teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field is preferred.

Desirable experience

  • Experience stabilizing large end-to-end regression suites and driving down automation debt.
  • Exposure to performance testing concepts and reliability engineering practices.
  • Familiarity with basic SQL queries for database validation.
  • Exposure to working with Python.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

job.title: Senior Credit & Collections Analyst
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are hiring a Senior Collections Analyst to support and strengthen our Accounts Receivable and Collections operations across the Group. This role is critical to ensure accurate and timely collection of customer payments, full compliance with internal controls, and effective collaboration with internal departments and Group entities. As a senior profile, this person will also play a key role in driving process improvements and efficiencies within the Collections team.

 

What you'll be doing:

As a Senior Collections Analyst, you will be responsible for end-to-end management of the collections process, including:

  • Managing customer collections through regular email and phone follow-up to ensure timely payment.
  • Overseeing and controlling the daily posting of customer payments in the Group's ERP systems.
  • Performing cash reconciliations and matching payments against outstanding invoices.
  • Contributing to the resolution of discrepancies and disputes with customers, in close collaboration with the Group's legal entities and internal departments.
  • Preparing financial reports related to the Accounts Receivable area, including Ageing Reports, and ad hoc analysis.
  • Delivering month-end closing reports and ensuring all required documentation and reporting is completed in accordance with SOX compliance requirements and deadlines.
  • Actively participating in the Group's treasury forecasting by providing accurate and timely collections data.
  • Maintaining regular and structured communication with key stakeholders across the Group's entities, delivering high-quality and synthesized information on the Collections area.
  • Coordinating with the different legal entities of the Group to maximize customer collections through joint actions and strategies.
  • Supporting internal and external audits related to the Accounts Receivable area, ensuring all required documentation and evidence is accurate and readily available.
  • Developing and maintaining procedures and SOPs for the Collections area, ensuring processes are documented, up to date, and aligned with the Group's standards.
  • Identifying and proposing improvements to the manager and the organization to drive efficiencies within the Collections area and the broader Accounts Receivable team.

 

Who you'll be working with:

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Shared Services, Billing, and Commercial teams across the Group, as well as with external clients. This role requires daily interaction with both local and international stakeholders to ensure efficient and accurate collections processes.

We’re growing the data engineering capability behind ad-tech solutions that process large-scale, real-time audience data. In this role, you’ll take deep technical ownership of the data model that supports targeting and measurement decisions for advertisers at scale.

You’ll help evolve a complex, interconnected data platform while working with modern distributed processing technologies and a highly collaborative engineering team.

Who you’ll be working with

You’ll work closely with data engineers and colleagues across Quality Assurance, Analytics and connector teams. We value teamwork over ego, collaboration over competition, open and honest communication, strong opinions held with curiosity, and continuous improvement through kaizen.

  • Scala-based backend services

  • Work across a broad modelling surface, including audience types, behavioural signals, relational structures, embeddings and anomaly detection.
  • Develop and maintain Spark-based data jobs in an environment using Scala, GCP, Parquet and BigQuery, with a clear understanding of end-to-end data flow.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance, Analytics and connector teams to ensure data correctness, integrity and reliable downstream use.
  • Write production-ready code that is readable, testable, performant and resilient to edge cases and failures.
  • Contribute to team practices, continuous improvement and constructive peer feedback while taking ownership of data quality and engineering standards.

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, with a strong record of delivering complex, multi-layer data pipelines.
  • Experience with Scala or a similar strongly typed or advanced functional programming language; you’re comfortable reasoning about complex type systems and willing to develop further in Scala.
  • Experience with Apache Spark and large-scale distributed data processing.
  • 3+ years of experience with GCP and big-data stores such as BigQuery.
  • The ability to build a clear mental model of a large, interconnected data domain and reason about how changes in one area affect others.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data models and technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network—deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry.

Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale—ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

Why We’re Hiring

We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Management – ID Activation to lead the strategy and development of identity-driven audience activation capabilities across the advertising ecosystem.

You will own the end-to-end product vision for audience onboarding, identity resolution, data syndication, and partner activation workflows. Your work will help make audience delivery more scalable, interoperable, privacy-conscious, and measurable across major media platforms.

This is an opportunity to shape products at the intersection of AdTech, identity, data, and media while leading a team and influencing partners across WPP.

What You’ll Be Doing

Define Product Strategy and Roadmaps

  • Set the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for ID Activation capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand activation through new identity providers, destinations, channels, and strategic integrations.
  • Build business cases and prioritize investments based on customer demand, revenue potential, technical feasibility, and strategic value.
  • Translate market, partner, and client needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.

Own the Audience Activation Lifecycle

  • Own the full activation lifecycle, from audience ingestion and onboarding through identity resolution, enrichment, qualification, governance, packaging, syndication, delivery, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish scalable operating frameworks that support consistent audience activation across products and partners.
  • Improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency across activation workflows.

Enable Multi-Channel Activation

  • Develop solutions that support activation across programmatic, social, connected TV, and emerging media channels.
  • Define product requirements for multiple identifier types, including email-based identifiers, mobile advertising IDs, RampID, UID2, hashed personally identifiable information, and platform-specific identifiers.
  • Partner with technical teams to support scalable, API-driven activation across cloud-based data platforms.

Lead Partner Integrations and Ecosystem Management

  • Lead product management for integrations with media platforms, identity providers, DSPs, SSPs, data exchanges, and clean-room partners.
  • Define integration requirements and frameworks for platforms such as Google Customer Match, Meta Custom Audiences, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Magnite, Experian, and other strategic partners.
  • Manage partner roadmaps and relationships to maintain interoperability, service quality, and competitive differentiation.
  • Work with Engineering to design and maintain scalable APIs and data-exchange mechanisms.

Shape Identity and Data Strategy

  • Develop strategies that improve addressability while supporting responsible, privacy-conscious data use.
  • Evaluate emerging identity frameworks, identity graphs, graph providers, and privacy-enhancing technologies.
  • Define requirements for deterministic and probabilistic identity-resolution workflows.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Security teams to support compliance with applicable privacy regulations and internal standards.

Drive Measurement and Execution

  • Define success measures for activation products, such as adoption, time to activate, match quality, delivery reliability, partner performance, and client impact.
  • Establish product-management and execution processes that support predictable delivery of roadmap commitments.
  • Use performance insights, operational feedback, and customer needs to continuously improve the product experience.

Lead and Develop Teams

  • Lead and develop a team of product managers responsible for identity and audience activation capabilities.
  • Serve as a primary liaison across Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Commercial, Privacy, Legal, and Security teams.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert and advocate for identity and audience activation across the organization.

Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leaders, Data Operations, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Commercial teams, Privacy, Legal, and Security. You will also collaborate with external identity providers, media platforms, DSPs, SSPs, data exchanges, clean-room partners, agencies, advertisers, publishers, and other technology partners.

What You’ll Need

  • Significant product-management experience in AdTech, martech, identity, data platforms, audience activation, or a related field; typically 8+ years or equivalent depth of experience.
  • Experience leading product managers and complex cross-functional initiatives; typically 3+ years in a people-leadership or product-leadership capacity.
  • Strong understanding of DSPs, SSPs, clean rooms, identity ecosystems, audience activation workflows, customer-match frameworks, and programmatic advertising infrastructure.
  • Experience managing external technology partnerships and complex third-party integrations.
  • Technical fluency in APIs, data-exchange platforms, identity-resolution systems, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance long-term strategy with hands-on execution, operational delivery, and prioritization.
  • Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create alignment across technical and commercial teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with identity providers or frameworks such as LiveRamp, TransUnion, Experian, Neustar, RampID, or UID2.
  • Familiarity with data clean-room environments such as InfoSum, Snowflake, Habu, or similar platforms.
  • Experience building audience activation products for large advertisers, agencies, publishers, or media platforms.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

Location Requirement

This is a hybrid role based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Candidates must currently reside in Denmark or be willing to relocate independently, as relocation support is not provided for this position.

 

About Open Intelligence 

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Open Intelligence is a highly strategic initiative at the intersection of data science, advertising technology, and audience insights. Our team is building the data and ML systems that power the next generation of marketing and media intelligence, deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our system continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. 

Based in our Copenhagen office, you will join a broader Open Intelligence team of roughly 50 people, including 14+ data scientists and a strong group of engineers working across data and ML production systems. 

 

Who We Are Looking For 

We are looking for a Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer with a strong background in infrastructure, platform engineering, data systems, or large-scale software engineering. 

You do not need to come from a pure ML infrastructure background to succeed in this role. What matters most is that you have strong engineering fundamentals and experience building robust, scalable, production-grade systems. You may have built cloud platforms, backend services, distributed data pipelines, or internal developer tooling, and you are excited to apply that experience to systems that support modern AI and ML workloads. 

You are comfortable working close to both engineers and data scientists, translating experimental or research-oriented work into reliable, maintainable production components. You care about system design, operational excellence, automation, observability, and maintainability. You value clean interfaces, strong testing practices, and infrastructure that can scale with growing demands. 

Beyond your technical skills, you are a strong communicator who can collaborate across disciplines, explain trade-offs clearly, and contribute to a high-trust, high-output team environment.

 

Why we're hiring:

We are hiring because we need experienced engineers who can help us design for scale, improve platform reliability, reduce operational friction, and build the foundations that allow advanced AI work to deliver real-world impact. To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. 

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, production-grade infrastructure that supports data and ML workloads in the cloud, primarily on GCP. 
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists and engineering peers to translate research prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. 
  • Design and implement data and ML platforms with strong reliability, scalability, observability, and operational maturity. 
  • Identify and address technical debt, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies across infrastructure and platform components. 
  • Contribute to engineering best practices across CI/CD, version control, testing, automation, and repo maintenance. 
  • Participate in knowledge sharing, technical discussions, and continuous improvement across the team. 

 

What You Will Need 

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, or large-scale software engineering. 
  • Strong practical experience with Python and SQL. 
  • Experience designing and operating systems in cloud environments such as GCP, AWS, or Azure. 
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar ML platforms. 
  • Experience with CI/CD, version control, API design, and testing best practices. 
  • Experience with building or supporting large-scale data or ML platforms, cloud platforms or other scalable production systems. 
  • A strong interest in building reliable, automated, and well-engineered platforms that support advanced AI and data workloads. 
  • A collaborative mindset and a willingness to work across disciplines in a fast-moving engineering environment.

 

Nice to Have 

  • Familiarity with data processing and orchestration tools such as Spark, Flink, Airflow. 
  • Experience with infrastructure and deployment tooling such as Docker, ideally Kubernetes.

job.title: Senior Product Director, Agent Experience
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realise the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

 

Why we are hiring:
We seek an experienced product leader to own how agents get built, published, discovered and trusted across WPP Open.

This role brings together two capabilities, Agent Builder, the environment in which anyone at WPP creates an agent — its instructions, model, tools, data and permissions — and the Agent Catalog & Hub, where those agents are published, found, governed and put to work. The ideal candidate will have built or scaled a creation platform together with the marketplace or catalog that distributes what it produces, and will understand that a builder without curation produces sprawl, while a catalog without a builder has nothing to curate.

WPP Open serves high numbers of users across our agencies, and the agent estate is already large. At our scale the challenges are not the building experience alone and you will treat governance as a product essential.  

This role will own the shift from an agent catalog to a skills marketplace. This requires a product leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who can keep an established platform healthy while moving it somewhere new.

 

What You Will Do:

Within this IC role, reporting into the Senior Director Product Enablement WPP Open – you will:

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Agent Builder and the Agent Catalog & Hub as a single connected product area, ensuring alignment with the broader Open strategy and business objectives.
  • Partner with Product Leadership to shape a product roadmap, emphasising value realisation through lean and iterative methodologies.
  • Define the creation experience: how a non-technical user assembles a capable agent, and how a more technical user goes further.
  • Own discovery, trust and reuse in the Catalog & Hub — search, taxonomy, metadata, ownership, versioning, ratings and lifecycle — so that the right agent is found rather than rebuilt.
  • Build governance into the product. Classification, review, approval, publication controls and audit should be native capabilities of building and publishing, delivered as an active member of the Agent Governance team.
  • Define and deliver the evolution from agent catalog to skills marketplace.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Design and UX to deliver a connected build, publish and adopt journey. You will set clear objectives with teams and ensure alignment of plans and workstreams to achieve them.
  • Balance commitments and governance features against new capabilities.
  • Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.
  • Use data to drive product strategies and plans — catalog health, duplication, adoption, abandonment and build patterns — gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from stakeholders to enhance product adoption and usage continually.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients. Keep stakeholders up to date with strategic direction and the product roadmap and communicate new product releases to ensure successful advocacy and adoption.

 

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles, including time owning a platform product at enterprise scale.
  • Proven track record delivering enterprise SaaS platform products.
  • Experience working with platforms such as Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow AI Agent Studio and an understanding of how these are adopted, extended and governed inside large enterprises.
  • Understanding of modern agent architectures: LLMs, RAG patterns, tool and function calling, MCP or equivalent tool connectivity, prompt design and evaluation.
  • Demonstrated experience with discovery and distribution at scale — search, taxonomy and metadata design, curation, ratings and reviews, versioning, deprecation and lifecycle management.
  • Experience treating governance, compliance or quality as product capabilities.
  • Proficiency in leading and implementing agile development frameworks for delivering technical products, coupled with experience collaborating with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering products that integrate with third-party enterprise systems. Understanding of APIs, system integrations and data interoperability.
  • Experience leading, coaching or mentoring Product Managers and Product Owners, and elevating processes, tools and ways of working across a team.

job.title: Senior Product Director, Agentification, Skills and Data
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realise the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster and at scale.

 

Why We Are Hiring:

We are seeking a technically minded product leader to define what WPP's agents are actually able to do. This is a new role, created to own the layer beneath the interface: the core set of skills and tools that agents call, the guardrails that keep them safe to use, the data and context they reason over, and the agentification of WPP's own applications so that they can be operated by an agent and not only by a person.

The ideal candidate will have taken an established product and made it agent-native — exposing its capabilities as tools, skills and data an agent can call, defining the contracts, permissions and behaviour around them, and proving the result is reliable to put in front of enterprise customers. Skills, tools and agentification are not new in the industry, and we are looking for someone who has already done this work somewhere it mattered.

This is a more technical product role in the Agentic Experience pillar and sits at the intersection of product and AI. You may come from product management, engineering or data science. What matters is that you can hold a clear point of view on where a capability belongs — in the model, in a tool, in the data, or in the interface — and defend it with evidence.

It is also a visionary / forward-looking role in the pillar. A good deal of what you will own does not exist yet, and part of the job is deciding what should. This requires a product leader who is comfortable with ambiguity but still ships, and who can bring a large organisation along with them.

 

What You Will Do:

Within this IC role, reporting into the Senior Director Product Enablement WPP Open – you will:

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for skills, tools and agentification across WPP Open, ensuring alignment with the broader Open strategy and business objectives.
  • Define the core set of skills that WPP's agents are built from — what exists as a first-party skill, what is left to users to compose, and what should not be a skill at all.
  • Own the tool layer: how WPP and third-party capabilities are exposed to agents through well-defined interfaces, contracts, permissions and connectivity standards such as MCP.
  • Lead the agentification of WPP applications, working with the teams that own them to make their capabilities callable, observable and safe to operate agentically.
  • Define the guardrails (what an agent may do, on whose authority, with what data), working with Agent Governance so they are built into the product.
  • Own the evaluation and quality approach for skills and for chained agent output: how capability is tested before release and monitored after it.
  • Define the data and context strategy that agents reason over, spanning retrieval, grounding, memory, context management and the interfaces to WPP's data and knowledge assets.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, UX and Data to deliver a coherent skills layer. Set clear objectives with teams and ensure alignment of plans and workstreams to achieve them.
  • Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.
  • Use data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from stakeholders and systems to enhance product adoption and usage continually.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients, and make an unfamiliar technical area legible to senior stakeholders so that new capabilities are understood and adopted, and their benefits championed.

 

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, engineering leadership or applied data science, with significant time spent on AI or platform products.
  • Proven track record of taking an established SaaS or enterprise product and making it agent-native.
  • Deep and current knowledge of agent architectures: LLMs, tool, skill and function calling, RAG and retrieval design, context & memory management, multi-agent orchestration, and connectivity standards such as MCP.
  • Direct experience with working with agent and tooling ecosystems such as MCP/A2A servers and clients, LangChain or LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or comparable skill and tool frameworks.
  • Experience defining guardrails, permissions and safety controls for autonomous or semi-autonomous systems and making them part of the product.
  • Experience with evaluation of non-deterministic systems: test sets, scoring rubrics, regression testing, human review and production monitoring.
  • Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow orchestration and data interoperability, with the ability to hold a credible technical conversation with senior engineers.
  • Experience with data and knowledge platforms — retrieval, embeddings, semantic search, taxonomy and grounding against enterprise content.

 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
