About WPP Open Intelligence

The Activation team is the engineering arm of WPP Open Intelligence. We build the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that support WPP’s activation capabilities.

Approximately one-third of global media spend flows through WPP, and our platform is deeply integrated with major supply-side partners across the AdTech industry. At our current scale, our edge services handle more than 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process approximately 10,000 requests per second.

With operations across the US and UK and planned expansion across EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure operates at significant global scale. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, highly reliable systems.

Why We’re Hiring

We are expanding our engineering team to support the next stage of growth and a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These products are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while protecting user privacy.

Our infrastructure is expanding globally, and we are deepening integrations with leading supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are looking for engineers who can help us design for the next order of magnitude while keeping our systems resilient, performant, observable, and compliant.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own reliable backend services and API integrations in production. You will help drive solutions from design through delivery, raising the quality of both the systems we build and the way we operate them.

You will work across partner API clients, internal APIs, workflow steps, orchestration components, and the interfaces between Open Intelligence and activation systems. We value strong software engineering fundamentals—including clean design, testable code, and sound operational practices—over allegiance to any particular framework.

  • Design, develop, and review backend services and API integrations to a high engineering standard.
  • Own and evolve orchestration and gateway components, including workflow steps, partner API clients, internal service APIs, and activation interfaces.
  • Partner with Product, lead engineers, and teams across audience, data, and performance to turn requirements into durable production services.
  • Build robust integrations with authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, versioning, clear error handling, and operational runbooks.
  • Establish and maintain production standards for CI/CD, unit and integration testing, API contract testing, observability, auditability, and safe releases.
  • Maintain an end-to-end view of the activation flows you support, identifying dependencies, incidents, and technical debt and proposing sequenced improvements.
  • Contribute hands-on to critical foundations such as gateways, tool registries, workflow runtimes, and guardrails hooks; mentor colleagues through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing.

Who You’ll Work With

You will collaborate closely with Product, lead engineers, and sibling teams across audience, data, and performance. You will contribute to an engineering-led environment where teams communicate trade-offs clearly, share ownership of end-to-end flows, and work together to improve reliability over time.

What You’ll Need

  • Substantial software engineering experience - 5+ years or equivalent depth of production ownership—in backend, platform, or API-focused roles.
  • A track record of delivering and operating backend services, integrations, or platforms in production at meaningful scale.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language, such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin; Python is preferred.
  • Experience designing and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems, such as asynchronous jobs, queues, durable state, or orchestration.
  • Experience owning third-party and internal integrations, including authentication, error handling, versioning, monitoring, and partner-driven change.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, and testing practices including unit, integration, and boundary or contract testing where APIs are involved.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and production observability through metrics, logs, or tracing.

Reliability and Collaboration

  • You communicate technical trade-offs clearly with engineers, Product, and partner teams.
  • You surface blockers early and present practical options.
  • You take ownership of incidents, postmortems, technical debt, and systemic improvements—not only feature delivery.
  • You are comfortable mentoring engineers through reviews, design feedback, and clear ownership boundaries.

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering orchestration, workflow, or agentic systems, including tool registries, policy or guardrail mechanisms, or human-in-the-loop flows.
  • Familiarity with AdTech or MarTech concepts such as SSPs, DSPs, deals, audiences, or campaign activation.
  • Full-stack exposure through internal user interfaces or operational tools backed by the APIs you build.
  • Experience working in a monorepo or large shared codebase with many integration surfaces.
  • Awareness of data privacy and the safe handling of sensitive data in distributed systems, including audit trails or decision logs.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design for a multi-person initiative without formal people management.
  • Interest in using AI coding assistants and prompt engineering responsibly to improve productivity without compromising quality.

job.description:

Role Purpose:

WPP is undergoing an exciting global transformation, and we're looking for a passionate and driven Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our dynamic and innovative team This leadership opportunity is a great fit for someone who blends hands-on coding expertise with a strategic understanding of modern application architecture, cloud-native technologies, and agile team collaboration within the media and marketing landscape. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and maintain safe deployment patterns (blue-green, canary, progressive delivery) using ArgoCD for GitOps sync and Kargo for environment promotion across dev, staging and production.
  • Instrument logs, metrics, traces and alerts to improve signal and reduce noise; define SLIs and SLOs with service owners and drive alerting from them.
  • Tune and troubleshoot GKE workloads: autoscaling (HPA/VPA, cluster autoscaler), node pool strategy, network policies, resource requests/limits and workload isolation.
  • Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules for core infrastructure (VPCs, GKE, CloudSQL, Pub/Sub, IAM, secrets, Cloudflare), with consistent naming, tagging and policy enforcement across environments and cloud providers.
  • Lead or support incident response, diagnose production issues from telemetry, run blameless postmortems and drive long-term fixes to completion.
  • Detect and eliminate configuration drift; standardize secrets handling, short-lived credentials and environment parity.
  • Automate operational toil with Python and shell scripting and harden CI/CD pipelines with clear rollout-readiness standards.

Skill Requirements:

We understand that candidates may not have every single skill listed below. We encourage you to apply if you possess a strong foundation in product ownership and a willingness to learn and grow. 

  • Have 4–6+ years of experience in backend or infra-focused engineering roles (e.g., SRE, platform, DevOps, or fullstack), with at least 2 years owning production systems at scale.
  • Can confidently write or review production-grade code and infra-as-code (Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, etc.).
  • Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, ideally GKE, including autoscaling, ingress/gateway strategies and network policies.
  • Solid GCP fundamentals (IAM, VPC design, Workload Identity, Secret Manager, CloudSQL performance characteristics) and working experience with at least one major cloud (AWS or Azure or GCP).
  • Think in systems: you understand cascading failure, timeout boundaries, dependency health, and blast radius.
  • Regularly contribute to incident mitigation or long-term fixes (not just closing alerts).
  • Can influence through well-written PRs, documentation, and thoughtful design reviews.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare or a comparable edge/CDN/WAF platform.

Nice to have: 

  • Experience with Kargo or similar progressive promotion tooling (Argo Rollouts, Flagger).Experience developing or integrating Kubernetes operators.
  • Familiarity with service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and structured alerting.
  • Building or integrating Kubernetes operators and CRDs.

Tools & Expectations:

  • Datadog - Monitor infrastructure health, capture service-level metrics, reduce alert fatigue through high signal thresholds.
  • PagerDuty - Own incident management pipeline. Route alerts by severity and align with business SLAs.
  • GKE / Kubernetes - Improve cluster stability and workload isolation. Define auto-scaling configurations and tune for efficiency.
  • ArgoCD -  Keep releases consistent across clusters, monitor sync health, and define safe promotion gates between environments.
  • Helm / GitOps - Validate release consistency across clusters. Monitor sync status and rollout safety.
  • Terraform Cloud - Support DR planning and detect infrastructure changes through state comparisons.
  • CloudSQL - Diagnose DB and networking issues. Monitor latency, enforce access patterns, and validate WAF usage.
  • Cloudflare -  Manage DNS, WAF, rate limiting and caching; diagnose edge latency and validate security rules.
  • Secret Management - Audit access to secrets, apply short-lived credentials, and define alerts for abnormal usage.
  • Python / Bash  -  Automate toil, build internal tooling, and script diagnostics.

job.title: Senior Technology Risk Analyst
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

Senior Technology Risk Analyst
  • Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)
  • Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance
  • Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]
  • Position Type: Full-Time

Role Purpose

The Senior Technology Risk Analyst is responsible for managing and continuously improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across Data & Technology Solutions. You will ensure that security policies, controls, risks, exceptions, and governance processes are properly maintained, evidenced, reviewed, and acted upon.

Reporting to the SVP Security and Compliance, you will provide the operational backbone for security governance across DTS. This is a hands-on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) role. You will collaborate across security, product, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, legal, risk, compliance, and delivery teams to transform security governance into a dynamic, working management system rather than a static documentation exercise.

Key Responsibilities

1. ISMS Ownership & Operation

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the DTS ISMS.
  • Maintain the ISMS framework, documentation, control library, policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Ensure the ISMS accurately reflects how DTS operates across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and engineering.
  • Support alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and wider WPP security requirements.
  • Ensure ISMS artefacts are version-controlled, approved, reviewed, and communicated appropriately.
  • Maintain clear evidence of security governance activity, control operation, risk treatment, and management reviews.

2. Policy Management & Control Governance

  • Own the lifecycle of DTS security and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.
  • Coordinate policy reviews with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.
  • Ensure policies are practical, clear, enforceable, and aligned with DTS's operating reality.
  • Track policy exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, and review dates.
  • Ensure policy changes are communicated and seamlessly embedded into operational processes.

3. Risk Review Board Operation

  • Establish and continuously run the DTS Risk Review Board.
  • Define the Board’s cadence, agenda, inputs, outputs, attendees, and escalation routes.
  • Prepare comprehensive risk packs, dashboards, decision logs, and action trackers.
  • Ensure risks are presented clearly, consistently, and with appropriate supporting evidence.
  • Track decisions, owners, due dates, mitigations, exceptions, and residual risks.
  • Escalate risks exceeding agreed thresholds to the SVP Security and Compliance, DTS leadership, the CISO office, or other appropriate forums.

4. Risk Register Management

  • Own and maintain the central DTS security and compliance risk register.
  • Capture, assess, categorise, and maintain security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience, third-party, and technology risks.
  • Ensure all risks have clear descriptions, owners, likelihood/impact ratings, inherent risk scores, mitigations, residual risk scores, treatment plans, and target dates.
  • Partner with risk owners to ensure mitigations are realistic, funded, and actively progressed.
  • Track overdue risk actions and escalate insufficient progress.
  • Produce regular risk reporting for DTS leadership and wider WPP governance forums.

5. Control Assurance & Evidence Management

  • Support ongoing assurance activity by ensuring controls are consistently evidenced, tested, and reviewed.
  • Maintain control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, client assurance, internal audits, and other compliance needs.
  • Coordinate evidence collection from Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, HR, Legal, and Enterprise Technology.
  • Identify gaps between documented controls and actual operating practices, tracking remediation plans.

6. Compliance Support & Audit Readiness

  • Support DTS compliance obligations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR-related controls, and client-specific requirements).
  • Help prepare for internal/external audits, client reviews, security questionnaires, and due diligence exercises.
  • Maintain an organized, always-ready evidence library and audit trail.
  • Support management reviews required by ISO 27001 and other governance frameworks.

7. Exception, Waiver & Remediation Tracking

  • Manage the formal process for security exceptions, policy waivers, risk acceptances, and remediation plans.
  • Ensure exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time-bound, and assigned to accountable owners.
  • Track compensating controls, monitor residual risk, and manage the renewal/escalation of expired exceptions.

8. Third-Party & Supplier Risk Support

  • Help assess security and compliance risks associated with vendors, partners, tools, platforms, and managed services.
  • Maintain supplier risk records and coordinate with Procurement, Legal, CISO, Enterprise Technology, and Product teams.
  • Ensure third-party risk is appropriately integrated into the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.

9. Security Governance Reporting

  • Produce clear, reliable, and actionable governance dashboards and reports for the SVP Security and Compliance and DTS leadership.
  • Translate complex governance and technical data into clear business language, highlighting trends, overdue actions, and material risks.

10. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture

  • Foster a collaborative and practical security governance culture across DTS.
  • Coach risk owners on how to describe, assess, treat, and monitor risks.
  • Ensure risk processes support business delivery rather than becoming bureaucratic overhead.

Key Accountabilities

The ISMS and Risk Officer will be directly accountable for:

  • Effective operation, accuracy, and maintenance of the DTS Senior Technology Risk Analyst.
  • Continuous, disciplined operation of the DTS Risk Review Board.
  • Up-to-date, approved, and realistic security policies, standards, and control documentation.
  • Structured tracking of risks, exceptions, waivers, and remediation plans.
  • Audit-ready evidence management and reliable governance reporting to leadership.

Skills & Experience

Required:

  • Proven experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or ISMS operation.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and practical ISMS management.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, cloud security, SaaS platforms, and enterprise security controls.
  • Experience maintaining risk registers, policy frameworks, control libraries, and audit evidence repositories.
  • Experience running or supporting risk committees, governance forums, or control review boards.
  • Excellent technical writing skills (policies, standards, risk statements, and governance reports).
  • Ability to collaborate with technical teams and translate technical issues into business risk/compliance language.
  • Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a constructive yet persistent approach to driving action.

Preferred:

  • Experience operating within a complex, matrixed, enterprise environment is highly valued.

Leadership Expectations

  • Disciplined & Reliable: Bring structure, order, and high standards of documentation to risk and compliance processes.
  • Pragmatic & Delivery-Aware: Build trust with technical teams by making governance useful, proportionate, and aligned with delivery.
  • Proactive: Follow through persistently on actions, dates, and evidence, and escalate bottlenecks clearly.
  • Collaborative: Support the SVP Security and Compliance in building a mature, transparent, and well-governed security function.

Success Measures

  • A current, well-maintained DTS ISMS with zero "reactive" compliance rushes.
  • Security policies and standards reviewed, updated, and communicated on schedule.
  • The Risk Review Board operating systematically with clear actions and high leadership engagement.
  • DTS risk register actively used by leadership to drive risk-based decisions.
  • Audit and certification evidence organized so there are "fewer surprises" during external audits and client reviews.
  • Security governance fully embedded as a natural part of daily DTS operations.

job.description:

Why we're hiring:

WPP is undertaking a major transformation of its enterprise Service Management capability, replacing its existing ServiceNow platform with a modern, AI-enabled service management platform that will establish a simpler, more standardised, and scalable global operating model. The current environment has evolved over many years and now requires a structured re-platforming programme to remove legacy complexity, reduce fragmentation, improve governance, and align more closely with industry best practice. 

This role will own the platform that underpins service management across Technology Operations and the wider Enterprise Technology team along with Finance, HR, and other corporate functions, making it a strategically important platform. Working with senior stakeholders and strategic implementation partners, you will define and deliver the future service management capability, ensuring the platform, operating model, governance, and service management processes support a modern, scalable, AI-enabled enterprise. 

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in Enterprise Service Management and ITIL, with the judgement to apply industry best practice pragmatically rather than dogmatically. You will understand how to leverage the best elements of ITIL and modern service management frameworks to design efficient, automated, and user-centric services that improve employee experience, simplify operations, and provide a scalable foundation for WPP’s future. 

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the end-to-end transformation of WPP’s Service Management Platform across strategy, design, delivery, migration, rollout and adoption. 
  • Define and execute a comprehensive transformation plan aligned to WPP’s Technology Operations strategy, including a clean rebuild approach that prioritises standard platform capabilities and reduces customisation. 
  • Remove legacy complexity, duplication, fragmented processes and technical debt while establishing a single, coherent global operating model for service management. 
  • Design and deliver an AI-enabled service model incorporating virtual agents, conversational interfaces, automation-first workflows, self-service, intelligent routing and future agentic automation capabilities. 
  • Define and implement a new governance model, including global standards, controls, design principles, ownership structures, decision forums and design authority mechanisms. 
  • Lead delivery in partnership with Kyndryl as the operational delivery partner and the Service Management Platform vendor as the platform expertise and best-practice partner. 
  • Coordinate internal Enterprise Technology teams, delivery partners, platform specialists and senior stakeholders, creating clear accountability across all workstreams and delivery teams. 
  • Oversee redesign, rebuild, migration, testing, rollout, transition and adoption, managing risks, dependencies, issues and decisions through strong programme governance. 
  • Engage senior stakeholders across Enterprise Technology and the wider Group, providing clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and areas requiring executive steer. 
  • Ensure the transformation delivers measurable improvements in service quality, operational efficiency, user experience, scalability, governance and operational resilience.

Essential 

  • Significant experience leading large-scale technology transformation programmes in complex, global organisations. 
  • Strong understanding of enterprise service management, IT service management, service desk operations, and global support models. 
  • Proven experience delivering platform transformation, rebuild, migration, or major operating model change. 
  • Demonstrable ability to simplify complex legacy environments and move towards standardised, best-practice platform capabilities. 
  • Experience defining and implementing governance models, design principles, global standards, and operating controls. 
  • Strong delivery leadership, with the ability to manage complex plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and stakeholders. 
  • Experience working with strategic partners, managed service providers, platform vendors, and internal technology teams. 
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence at CIO, executive, and cross-functional leadership level. 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex transformation activity clearly and concisely.
  • Strong commercial and operational judgement, with the ability to balance speed, standardisation, risk, cost, and business impact. 
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams and delivery activity across multiple regions. 

Desirable

  • Familiarity with ITIL, service management process design, service governance, and operational performance frameworks. 
  • Experience working in a creative, media, technology, or professional services organisation.

WPP ET is undergoing a significant transformation to modernise ways of working, shift to cloud-based and micro-service architectures, increase automation, and digitise colleague and client experiences. While integrations form a central part of the scope, the role remains broad: you contribute to platform enhancements, application workflows, user-facing features, debugging, release readiness, and cross-team engineering practices. transformation steps used by downstream teams (Reporting, BI, Data Migration).

About Open Intelligence

The Activation team within Open Intelligence builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that support WPP’s global media ecosystem.

Our edge services currently handle more than 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process approximately 10,000 requests per second. We operate across the US and UK and are expanding into EMEA and APAC.

We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable and highly reliable systems for privacy-conscious data products and activation services.

Why We’re Hiring

Open Intelligence is expanding its privacy-preserving data products and global infrastructure. As we extend our operations across EMEA and APAC and deepen integrations with major supply-side partners, we need engineers who can help us scale resilient, performant and compliant activation systems.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the next phase of our growth by building services and integrations that remain reliable as our global footprint and product capabilities expand.

What You’ll Do

  • Discuss, design and implement technical solutions for backend services and API integrations, while reviewing code in line with team standards.
  • Build and maintain orchestration and gateway components, including workflow steps, partner API clients, internal APIs and services that connect activation systems.
  • Collaborate with Product, Lead Engineers and sibling teams across audience, data and performance to deliver reliable production services.
  • Strengthen third-party and internal integrations through authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting and clear error handling.
  • Write and maintain unit, integration and contract tests, contributing to CI/CD practices and safe releases.
  • Improve observability and auditability through structured logging, metrics, tracing and traceable actions aligned with campaign and orchestration requirements.
  • Take part in operational ownership by investigating incidents, fixing bugs, updating runbooks, addressing technical debt and sharing knowledge with the team.

You’ll join an engineering-led team working closely with Product, Lead Engineers and colleagues across audience, data and performance. You’ll receive guidance from experienced engineers while taking ownership of the services and integrations you help build and maintain.

  • +3y Professional experience in software engineering, typically around three or more years in backend, platform or API-focused roles—or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience building and operating backend services and APIs in production, including REST/HTTP services or webhooks.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Go, Java or Kotlin. Python is preferred.
  • Experience integrating external or internal APIs, including authentication, pagination, request and response handling, error models and operational debugging.
  • Experience with Git, unit and integration testing, contract testing or equivalent quality practices, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with a cloud platform such as GCP, AWS or Azure, plus containerized deployment. Exposure to Docker or Kubernetes is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous or event-driven systems such as queues, background jobs or workflow steps, together with an interest in infrastructure as code and production observability.

  • Workflow or orchestration systems, including state machines, durable jobs or schedulers.

job.title: SVP, Head of Marketing Performance
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and transformative SVP, Product to lead the critical capability area of Marketing Performance within the WPP Open platform. This is a truly unique opportunity to define the future of how WPP measures and attributes marketing effectiveness across our vast and diverse agency and client ecosystem. 

Leveraging WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform, you will lead the development of best-in-class solutions that turn live signals into predictive intelligence, empower our agencies and clients to drive superior outcomes, and solidify WPP Open's competitive edge. Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum. 

This role demands a leader who can not only set a compelling product vision, but also inspire and lead a multi-disciplinary team, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. You will directly contribute to achieving key WPP Open priorities, including driving profitability, maximizing strategic advantage, and delivering an integrated, intelligent experience for our users and clients. 

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation.  Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

  • Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 
  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery. 
  • Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption. 
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations. 
  • Cultivate and manage high-impact relationships with key internal and external partners, driving collaborative initiatives and maximizing mutual value. 

Product Development & Execution:

  • Oversee the entire product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and post-launch iteration, emphasizing agile and iterative development. 
  • Prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic impact, client value, technical feasibility, and business objectives, with a relentless focus on driving meaningful adoption and impact. 
  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable products and features that meet defined requirements, performance standards, and the architectural principles of WPP Open. 
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback. 

 Domain Expertise & Innovation:

  • Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM, including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation). 
  • Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain. 
  • Proven track record of successfully bringing complex, data-driven, and AI-enabled products from concept to market, driving significant competitive advantage and exponential growth. 
  • Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization. 
  • Strong understanding and application of modern agile product development methodologies. 
  • Experience managing significant operating and capital expenditure budgets and defining commercial models for product portfolios. 
  • Proven experience in managing global product rollouts and supporting a large, diverse client base (e.g., 1000+ clients across multiple markets). 

 

Domain Expertise: 

  • Advanced, hands-on knowledge of how marketing activity across Paid, Earned, Shared, Owned media channels is measured, coupled with a proven ability to translate this expertise into a compelling product vision and strategic roadmap. 
  • Deep expertise in advanced measurement techniques including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) (including various methodologies like Bayesian), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and marketing experimentation. 
  • Strong understanding of marketing data sources, data ingestion, transformation, and reporting challenges. 
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data. 

 

Leadership & Communication: 

  • Exceptional leadership, team-building, and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing diverse talent. 
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences (technical, business, executive, client) and build compelling presentations. 
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities, capable of building strong relationships and collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Proven ability to navigate and excel within a fast-paced, multi-market, matrixed global organization. 

 

Strategic & Analytical Thinking: 

  • Exceptional strategic thinking and complex problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify ptimal courses of action and articulate a clear, long-term vision. 
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with the ability to make informed decisions based on market insights, user data, and business objectives. 
  • A proactive, independent, and adaptable leader with a strong sense of ownership, thriving within demanding, fast-paced environments.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a Technical Security Governance Lead – Exposure Management to help build, mature, and govern a modern exposure management capability across our global environment.

This role focuses on understanding how attackers see us—across external, internal, and AI-enabled environments—and ensuring the organization continuously validates, prioritizes, and reduces real-world attack opportunities.

This is a highly strategic, lead-level role for someone who understands modern attack paths and wants to shape how security is measured and improved. You will move beyond theoretical risk into practical attacker realism—governing the adversarial testing programs, attack surface visibility, exploitability validation, and attack path analysis that keep WPP secure.

What you'll be doing:

Technical Security & Exposure Governance

  • Define and shape the governance framework, guardrails, and minimum standards for continuous exposure management across WPP.
  • Drive continuous improvement in attack surface visibility, control effectiveness, and risk-driven exposure governance.
  • Establish escalation thresholds for validated exploitable paths and constructively challenge delayed remediations.

Adversarial Assurance Governance

  • Oversee and govern continuous adversarial testing and offensive validation programs across infrastructure, applications, APIs, cloud, and identity.
  • Partner with and govern specialist external providers to validate real-world exploitability and attack paths.
  • Help internal teams understand where technical weaknesses translate into realistic attack opportunities.

AI Adversarial Testing Governance

  • Shape and govern the adversarial testing approaches for AI and agentic systems, a rapidly growing and critical domain for WPP.
  • Support and oversee testing for modern AI risks, including prompt injection resilience, tool misuse, data leakage scenarios, and agent permission boundaries.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to mature security controls and drive safer AI adoption.

Attack Surface & Path Analysis

    • Maintain strategic visibility of WPP’s external-facing assets, governing unknown asset discovery, internet exposure drift, and shadow IT.
    • Map and analyze complex attack paths across identity boundaries, privilege escalation routes, lateral movement pathways, and cloud trust relationships.
    • Identify and escalate systemic exposure patterns to prevent recurring vulnerabilities.

What you'll need:

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in offensive security, exposure management, red teaming, or attack surface management.
  • Strong technical understanding of attacker tradecraft, adversarial testing methodologies, and modern attack techniques (e.g., EASM, BAS, Attack Path Analysis).
  • Proven experience analyzing attack paths within cloud- and identity-based environments.
  • Interest or experience in AI security and emerging AI attack models.
  • Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Industry certifications such as OSCP, CREST, or CISSP are highly regarded.

Personal Attributes:

  • Strategic & Impact-Focused: Ability to align technical security exposure with broader business risks and goals.
  • Collaborative Leader: Strong relationship-building skills to work effectively with diverse, global teams and influence remediation without direct authority.
  • Proactive & Accountable: A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, comfortable navigating a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

job.title: Treasury Manager
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Treasury Manager will lead treasury operations across the US and Canada within a complex, fast-paced FTSE-listed organisation, partnering closely with the Group Treasury team in London. This is a high-impact role responsible for ensuring effective cash management, liquidity optimisation and treasury governance across the region, while supporting strategic business objectives.

Key responsibilities include cash flow forecasting, working capital management, FX risk oversight, surplus cash investment, bank relationship management and ensuring strong treasury controls. The role also plays a critical part in driving cash visibility, forecasting accuracy and operational efficiency across the business.

In addition to leading two direct reports, the Treasury Manager will provide functional oversight and influence across Shared Service Centre teams, working closely with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and wider finance stakeholders to improve treasury outcomes. Success in this role will require strong technical treasury expertise, sound commercial judgement, excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to deliver results through both direct leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead treasury operations across the US and Canada, overseeing cash management, liquidity, funding, cash flow forecasting, working capital and treasury governance.
  • Own regional cash flow forecasting, partnering with Shared Services and Finance leaders to improve accuracy, visibility and accountability.
  • Drive working capital performance, using treasury insights to support cash conversion, reduce funding requirements and enhance reporting.
  • Manage regional FX exposure, identifying risks, supporting hedging activities and ensuring compliance with Group Treasury policy.
  • Optimise surplus cash through appropriate investment and deposit strategies, balancing liquidity, risk and return objectives.
  • Partner with Shared Services teams to strengthen forecasting processes, cash visibility and treasury controls across AP, AR and payment activities.
  • Lead regional banking relationships, including account structures, cash pooling, bank rationalisation, mandates and KYC requirements.
  • Ensure robust treasury controls, governance and compliance, with a focus on fraud prevention, operational resilience and audit readiness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve balance sheet efficiency through cash repatriation, reduced idle cash and enhanced liquidity management.
  • Provide leadership, coaching and development for treasury team members, fostering a high-performing and collaborative team culture.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to simplify treasury operations, improve reporting and increase visibility of cash and financial risk.

Key Success Measures

  • Cash flow forecast accuracy and timeliness.
  • Improved working capital and cash conversion performance.
  • Reduced idle cash and increased cash pooling participation.
  • Effective management of FX exposures and policy compliance.
  • Optimised yield on surplus cash within approved risk parameters.
  • Banking efficiency, account rationalisation and control effectiveness.
  • High-quality service delivery, reporting accuracy and issue resolution across Shared Services.

What you'll need:

We're looking for a commercially minded treasury professional with the experience and confidence to operate in a complex, international business environment.

  • Significant treasury experience within a large, multinational corporate environment, ideally a Fortune 500, FTSE-listed or equivalent public company.
  • Strong expertise in cash management, liquidity structures, cash pooling, forecasting, intercompany funding and surplus cash management.
  • Experience working with or overseeing Shared Service Centre activities, including AP, AR, payments, collections and working capital processes.
  • Solid understanding of FX risk management, hedging principles, exposure analysis and treasury policy compliance.
  • A commercial mindset, with the ability to translate treasury activity into tangible business outcomes and performance improvements.
  • Proven leadership experience, with the ability to coach, develop and manage high-performing teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with senior finance leaders, shared services teams, banks and corporate functions.
  • Strong analytical and systems capability, including treasury management systems, ERP platforms, banking platforms and advanced Excel skills.
  • A high level of control awareness, attention to detail and sound judgement in managing financial and operational risk.
  • A professional treasury or accounting qualification (ACT, CTP or equivalent) is preferred.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

必要なスキル・経験
  • 総合広告代理店での3年以上の実務経験（うちアカウントマネジメントまたはプロジェクトマネジメント経験2年以上必須）
  • マス広告、デジタル、イベントなど、複数のチャネルを統合したキャンペーンのプロジェクトマネジメント経験

  • 優れたコミュニケーション能力、交渉力、調整力
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力（歓迎）

 

求める人物像
  • 高い当事者意識を持ち、細部にまでこだわり、プロジェクトを成功に導く遂行力がある方
  • 複雑な課題を整理し、解決策を立案・実行できる論理的思考力を持つ方
  • 社内外の多様なチームメンバーと円滑なリレーションシップを築き、協調して業務を推進できる方
  • 変化の速い環境に柔軟に対応し、常に改善点を見つけて実行に移せる方
  • チームを成功に導くことに情熱を持てる方

 

主な職務
  • プロジェクトマネジメントと制作進行管理:Integration Leadと連携し、担当チャーターのプロジェクト計画（スコープ、スケジュール、予算、体制）を策定し、実行する。プロジェクトの遅延や問題の発生を未然に防ぎ、必要に応じてエスカレーションを行う。
  • ステークホルダーとの連携:社内外の関係者との会議体を設計・運営し、円滑なコミュニケーションと迅速な意思決定を促進する。
  • レポーティング:プロジェクトの状況を定期的にレポーティングし、関係者へのタイムリーな情報共有を徹底する。

 

 

Job Overview

As a member of the Studio X Integration team, you will support the Integration Lead and be responsible for managing projects to ensure the smooth delivery of integrated marketing solutions. In response to client challenges, you will collaborate with a team composed of multiple WPP agencies and external partners, acting as a central hub for progress management, issue resolution, and communication throughout the entire process from strategy to execution and delivery. As a member of VML & Ogilvy Japan, part of the WPP network, you will lead a high-performing team comprised of specialists from across WPP Japan, playing a crucial role in driving the success of Coca-Cola's marketing strategies in the Japanese market.

Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a full-service advertising agency, including at least 2 years in account management or project management.
  • Proven project management experience on integrated campaigns spanning multiple channels such as mass advertising, digital, and events.
  • Experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Deep knowledge and practical experience in scope definition, schedule management, budget management, and risk management.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
  • Business level English proficiency (preferred).
Who you are
  • You have a strong sense of ownership, pay close attention to detail, and possess the drive to lead projects to successful completion.
  • You have strong logical thinking skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and devise and implement effective solutions.
  • You are a natural collaborator who can build and maintain smooth relationships with diverse internal and external team members.
  • You are adaptable, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and proactively seek out and implement improvements.

Key Accountabilities

  • Stakeholder Collaboration:Design and manage meetings with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth communication and prompt decision-making.
  • Reporting:Regularly report on project status to ensure timely and thorough information sharing among all relevant parties.

VML & Ogilvy Japan GK was established in April 2019 as a partnership between Geometry Global and The Ogilvy Group to enhance our offering to brands in Japan in support of their business ambitions and marketing objectives. We believe in the power of creativity to drive meaningful change that delivers positive business outcomes. Now more than ever the ability for an agency to flex and adapt to clients changing needs is vital in the application of communications, brand experience, commerce and technology. Our blend of global and local expertise and marketing capability is designed to meet the challenges of today while setting our clients up for success from tomorrow and beyond. VML & Ogilvy Japan GK is a WPP company (NASDAQ: WWPGY).

VML & Ogilvy Japan GK embraces and celebrates diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. job.description:

JOB OVERVIEW: 

Business Director (BD) is a leader amongst many stakeholders, including clients, internal account, creative, cross domains. S/he is a key driver of business stability as well as growth. 

BD is wholly responsible for an assigned portfolio of clients, new business and staff. Within this portfolio, BD has full P&L and revenue delivery responsibilities. Beyond financial accountability, BD is responsible for the quality of agency output, both strategically and creatively.  

BD works closely with senior management on the overall strategic direction of the agency and day-to-day agency management. S/he is involved in new business development, talent development and staff coaching. S/he forms strong working relationships with the senior people of VOJ. 

BD has a strong understanding of brand management, strategic planning, customer engagement, and customer management, and develops new business as well as grows existing business. 

 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Client Management 

  • With the Client Group (CG) leader, responsible for total revenues and direct contributions to the accounts in your group 
  • Work with relevant parties to deliver financial targets and control costs 
  • With the CG leader to develop the yearly business plan and monthly dialogue reports for all key accounts 
  • Independently and in partnership with the appropriate internal partners, develop, refine and implement a business development strategy 
  • Manage and ensure quality of client services 
  • Manage key client briefs, projects and requests, including the refinement of the above 
  • The typical day-to-day management of clients and their requests including presentations, documentation, client activity administration, etc. 
  • Present and pitch our services to potential clients in a competitive context 
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities 
  • Identify and deliver new business activities that augment and/or expand VOJ services 
  • Maintain regular dialog with CG’s senior leadership to maintain the strategic relationship 
  • Understand CG’s business model and business challenges on a regular basis 
  • Manage CG’s expectations especially during planning stages, in order to ensure they are aligned with VOJ’s deliverables and quality 

Strategy 

  • Provide account planning and strategic support to key clients, demonstrating sound strategic planning capabilities, including brand planning, digital engagement planning, and communication planning 
  • Advise clients in the development of successful customer management strategies 
  • General business planning and marketing strategy advice 
  • Understand industry/market trends and the success factors critical to the organization’s long-term sustainability and competitiveness 
  • Understand the offering of VOJ’s 6 Capabilities 
  • Develop a strategic plan based on a vision and mission and translate the strategy into a business plan and tactics  
  • Modify business plans based on changing business conditions 

Creative Leadership 

  • Passionate about good ideas, nurture the ideas of others  
  • Demonstrate enthusiasm for the creative industry in general and bring curiosity and creativity to daily work 
  • Inspire team members and help generate “Big Ideas” with legs, ideas that are effective and sell for the brand 
  • Understand the importance and integrity of the creative product 
  • Earn the trust and respect of creative colleagues 
  • Give good direction and feedback; contribute ideas; push for better work 
  • Challenge clients to accept our best ideas and then sell them well 
  • Help build a place where creativity thrives, and big ideas are expected 

Leadership & People Management 

  • Establish himself/herself as a role model 
  • Have a vision and get excited about the future and all it may bring; see possibilities rather than impossibilities 
  • Able to share his/her vision and excitement for change with others 
  • Identify good talents, inspire people to want to work for/follow him/her 
  • Have an inspiring and approachable style of leadership, strive to make things better 
  • Respect and believe in others, strive to bring out their inner greatness, ensure the development and appropriate training of team members, and build an efficient team with high morale 
  • Make and take responsibility for, and demonstrate commitment to appropriate decisions in a timely manner, esp. when significant information is incomplete and/or ambiguous 
  • Have a broad perspective and be open to varied options 
  • Abide by the WPP Code of Business Conduct 

 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • A minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in communications or a related field, with a strong preference for experience within the advertising or marketing industry.  
  • Demonstrated experience in leading, mentoring, and managing high-performing teams.  
  • Proven track record of leadership excellence and success in building and retaining talent.  
  • Exceptional verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently engage and influence high-level executives internally and externally.  
  • Highly goal-oriented, organized, and dedicated approach to all aspects of work.  
  • Strong understanding of P&L management, financial acumen, and revenue generation strategies.  
  • In-depth knowledge of brand management, strategic planning, customer engagement, and customer management principles.  
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, Digital, Public Relations, or a closely related field are plus.

コカ・コーラ社を担当するチームにおいて、日々のクライアント対応を担う重要な役割です。社内外のクリエイティブ、戦略、メディア、ソーシャル、デジタル、ショッパーなどの専門チームと密に連携しながら、TVCM、イベント、デジタル、ソーシャル、店頭など多様なタッチポイントを統合したマーケティングキャンペーンの企画・開発・制作をリードしていただきます。世界広告最大手のWPPグループに属するVML & Ogilvy Japanの一員として、クライアントの信頼されるパートナーとなり、ビジネスの成功に貢献することが期待されます。

  • 戦略的リーダーシップ
    • ストラテジストと連携し、洞察に満ちたブランド戦略やコミュニケーション戦略の立案を推進する。

job.title: VML & Ogilvy | Senior Social Strategist (WPP Content Studio), Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

The Role 

You are a hands-on strategist who can turn a brand problem into social work people would choose to spend time with. You find the audience behavior that matters, give social a clear job and build a plan the team can make. 

You own strategy workstreams across client brands, from always-on content to campaigns and creator work. You work with the Social Strategy Lead and with creative, account, media, production and analytics teams. You lead client conversations on your assignments and help junior strategists improve through direct feedback. 

You know the platforms from the inside, but you can also zoom out to the brand idea and the wider customer journey. You understand how organic content and paid social move people from discovery to action, and can explain why a plan should perform. 

What You Will Lead 

Social Strategy and Planning 

  • Turn business and brand briefs into audience insight, a clear social role and useful creative briefs.
  • Build always-on and campaign plans with distinct jobs for channels such as Instagram (Meta), TikTok, X, LINE and YouTube, where relevant.
  • Give organic, paid, owned and earned work distinct roles across the funnel, with creators and communities where they serve the idea.
  • Stay involved from strategy through content planning and production so the idea survives execution.

Performance, Data, and AI 

  • Use social listening, platform data and client research to find opportunities and test assumptions.
  • Lead paid social planning for your assignments: objectives, audiences, placements, budget split, creative variants and test design.
  • Work with media and analytics teams to read performance, improve creative and targeting, and make clear recommendations on spend.
  • Set KPIs for each stage of the funnel, with a baseline and a learning goal. Know when reach, engagement, traffic, conversion or cost per result matters.
  • Build agentic workflows with AI and WPP.open that turn client briefs, audience signals and performance data into strategic choices, then carry those choices into creative briefs, channel plans, content guidance and next tests, with human review.

Content and Channels 

  • Partner with creatives to shape platform-native ideas, hooks and formats that work in feeds and paid placements.
  • Write channel guidance and examples that make the strategy useful to creators and production teams.
  • Apply a current understanding of Japanese audience behavior and platform conventions.
  • Define the role of creators and influencers in the plan and how their contribution will be judged.

Client Leadership and Teamwork 

  • Lead the strategy and paid social planning workstream for assigned projects, present your thinking and handle client feedback clearly.
  • Work with account, creative, media, creator and analytics partners to make one coherent plan.
  • Mentor junior strategists through briefs, reviews and specific feedback on their work.
  • Keep decisions, deadlines and handovers clear when several projects are moving at once.

What You Bring 

Experience 

  • Strong social strategy experience across brands, with independent ownership of campaigns or always-on programs.
  • Work that shows the path from insight and brief to live content and what it achieved.
  • Experience leading paid social and performance marketing plans, with a working knowledge of how campaigns are set up, bought, optimized and measured across the funnel.
  • Working knowledge of major social platforms in Japan, organic social and creator partnerships.
  • Ability to connect brand strategy and the wider customer journey to the work social can do best.
  • Confidence presenting recommendations to clients and working across disciplines.

Craft 

  • Sharp at finding the useful insight, writing a single-minded brief and making a clear deck.
  • Able to guide content ideas without flattening what makes them native to a platform.
  • Comfortable with listening, analytics and paid platform results, and able to turn a report into the next action.
  • An instinct for building useful agentic workflows, with the judgment to check and improve their output.

Mindset 

  • Close to social culture without chasing every trend.
  • Collaborative, practical and open to challenge.
  • Calm under pressure and comfortable moving between strategy and detail.
  • Generous with junior teammates and accountable for your own work.

Language Requirements 

Able to work effectively with Japanese and English-speaking teams and clients.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

The Role

You will be a key social and influencer strategist.

A strategist who lives inside platforms, reads culture in real time, and translates signals into ideas that move both the brand and the business.

You will shape social and influencer strategies for always-on programs and integrated campaigns across Instagram, X, TikTok, LINE, YouTube and emerging platforms. You will connect organic, paid, owned and earned media into one cohesive ecosystem while ensuring strategies remain insight-led, platform-native and aligned with broader business and marketing objectives.

You will work closely with clients, creative, production, media, analytics and external partners to translate strategy into execution, ensuring every piece of work delivers measurable business impact.

You will use social tools, AI, and data to build smarter workflows, stronger insights and faster delivery.

This role suits someone who is strategic, hands-on, commercially minded and passionate about helping brands grow through social and influencer marketing. You will be expected to take ownership of strategic workstreams and lead projects from strategy through execution, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across the business. Someone who thrives in ambiguity, simplifies complexity and consistently raises the quality of work around them.

You work well with people, and you work well on your own.

You think. You do. You deliver.

Key Responsibilities

Social Strategy

  • Lead the development of integrated social and influencer strategies for always-on programs and campaigns aligned with business and brand objectives.
  • Contribute to quarterly and annual strategic planning in partnership with clients and internal teams.
  • Define the role of each social platform across Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube and emerging channels.
  • Connect organic, paid, owned and earned media into one cohesive strategy.
  • Translate business challenges, consumer insights and cultural trends into clear strategic direction and actionable creative briefs.
  • Ensure strategic consistency across platforms while enabling culturally relevant and platform-native executions.
  • Use AI and social intelligence tools to sharpen insights, uncover opportunities and accelerate delivery.

Influencer Strategy & Partnerships

  • Develop influencer activation strategies that align with the overall social strategy.
  • Define creator roles, content territories, platform mix and activation approaches for each campaign.
  • Develop creator selection criteria balancing audience relevance, credibility, reach and engagement.
  • Partner closely with influencer agencies, creator platforms and external partners to ensure strategic alignment and execution quality.
  • Develop influencer briefing principles, content guardrails and approval workflows that protect brand quality and consistency.
  • Identify opportunities for social-first innovation, emerging creators, new platforms and strategic partnerships.
  • Evaluate influencer performance and provide recommendations to strengthen future creator programs.

Performance, Data & Optimization

  • Build KPI frameworks for both organic and paid activity.
  • Develop measurement plans and learning agendas for campaigns.
  • Track performance through weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reporting.
  • Partner with analytics teams to interpret brand and campaign performance.
  • Present actionable insights, performance reviews and optimization recommendations to clients.
  • Use social listening, trend analysis, AI and audience data to guide content and strategic decisions.
  • Turn insights into practical recommendations that improve future performance.

Creative & Production Collaboration

  • Translate approved strategies into clear, inspiring creative briefs.
  • Partner with creative teams to shape platform-native ideas and content systems.
  • Guide storytelling, content formats, creator partnerships and channel recommendations.
  • Brief copywriters, designers, creators and production teams to ensure alignment with the strategic intent.
  • Provide strategic guidance throughout content production and campaign development to maintain alignment with business objectives and platform best practices.
  • Review creative output and ensure deliverables meet both strategic and creative expectations before client presentation.

Client & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted social and influencer strategy partner for clients throughout the lifecycle of a project.
  • Lead strategic discussions within projects and confidently present recommendations, insights and future opportunities to clients.
  • Share platform updates, cultural trends, thought leadership and best practices with clients and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively across account, creative, media, production, analytics and research teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Support regional and global initiatives by adapting global strategies into locally relevant execution.
  • Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders to ensure smooth collaboration across markets.
  • Take ownership of the strategic workstream from briefing through optimization while ensuring alignment across all project stakeholders.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 8–10+ years of experience in social strategy, influencer strategy or integrated digital marketing.
  • Proven experience developing and delivering social and influencer strategies for major brands.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube and emerging platforms.
  • Experience working across organic, paid, owned and earned media.
  • Experience collaborating with creative, production, media and analytics teams throughout campaign development.
  • Experience working with regional or global stakeholders is highly desirable.
  • Strong client presentation, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.

Craft

  • Fluent in consumer insight, social strategy and content planning.
  • Strong understanding of influencer ecosystems and creator marketing.
  • Able to build strategic frameworks that connect business objectives to creative execution.
  • Skilled in social listening, trend analysis and performance measurement.
  • Strong at translating data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Comfortable using AI tools, prompt engineering, and automation to improve efficiency and quality.

Mindset

  • Curious, commercially minded and solutions-oriented.
  • Thinks strategically while remaining highly hands-on.
  • Comfortable switching between long-term planning and day-to-day execution.
  • Confident working across cross-functional teams and leading projects in fast-paced environments.
  • Collaborative, proactive and accountable.
  • Passionate about growing clients' businesses and strengthening the Content Studio's strategic capability.

 

Language Requirements

  • Professional proficiency in both Japanese and English.
