job.title: VML & Ogilvy | Social Strategy Lead, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Purpose:

The Social Strategy Lead plays a senior leadership role across social strategy and intelligence within WPP Content Studio Japan.

This person helps shape how social is understood, planned, measured, and evolved across Content Studio clients, including BAT, Nestle, and future WPP Japan clients.

This is not an executional planner role, but a leadership role for someone who can set direction, read culture, interpret platform signals, guide strategy teams, and help clients understand what brands should do on social and why.

The role sits at the intersection of social strategy, culture, data, platform behavior, creator ecosystems, AI-enabled workflows, and measurable business impact.

The Social Strategy Lead works closely with the Content Studio Lead, who owns business and account leadership. Together, they ensure the studio delivers work that is strategically sharp, creatively strong, operationally realistic, and commercially valuable.

What Success Looks Like

  • WPP Content Studio Japan has a clear, credible, and differentiated social POV.
  • Every client has a clear social strategy across always-on, campaign, creator, paid, organic, owned, and earned.
  • Social listening and performance data turn into real creative and business decisions.
  • Teams stop reacting to trends blindly and start using signals intelligently.
  • Clients see WPP Content Studio as a senior social strategy partner, not just a content delivery team.
  • AI and WPP.open become practical tools inside strategy, insight, ideation, reporting, and learning loops.
  • Social work becomes more platform-native, culturally relevant, measurable, and easier to scale.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Social Strategy Leadership
  • Lead social strategy initiatives across key WPP Content Studio Japan clients.
  • Set clear platform roles across Meta, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, emerging channels, and client-specific ecosystems.
  • Connect organic, paid, owned, earned, creator, and community activity into one clear strategic system.
  • Translate business goals into social priorities, content principles, channel roles, and measurement frameworks.
  • Ensure always-on and campaign work ladder up to a clear brand and business objective.
  • Act as the senior social strategy POV across key client conversations and internal decision-making.
  1. Social Intelligence, Culture, and Listening
  • Lead the studio’s social intelligence and listening capability.
  • Turn social signals into actionable insight, not trend noise.
  • Oversee how teams read audience behavior, platform shifts, category conversations, creator movements, and cultural tensions.
  • Build repeatable intelligence outputs for clients and internal teams.
  • Use social data to identify opportunity spaces, risk areas, content territories, creator angles, and community behaviors.
  • Ensure Japan-first cultural nuance is embedded into social strategy, especially for regulated or sensitive categories.
  1. Platform and Content Direction
  • Guide teams on what works natively across different platforms and why.
  • Define format strategy by platform, audience, behavior, and objective.
  • Shape recommendations around hooks, storytelling, creator formats, community mechanics, captions, social commerce, search behavior, and shareability.
  • Partner with creative teams to push ideas beyond generic calendars and campaign cut-downs.
  • Ensure content is designed for the feed, the algorithm, the audience, and the brand.
  1. Creator and Community Strategy
  • Define the strategic role of creators across client work.
  • Guide creator archetypes, casting logic, briefing angles, collaboration models, and success metrics.
  • Partner with casting, PR, media, and account teams to ensure creator work is more than talent selection.
  • Build community-aware thinking into social plans, including conversation drivers, UGC mechanics, participation loops, and earned potential.
  • Help clients understand when to use creators, when not to, and how to measure value beyond reach.
  1. Measurement, Reporting, and PDCA
  • Define KPI frameworks across organic, paid, creator, campaign, and always-on content.
  • Ensure reporting answers what worked, what failed, why, and what to do next.
  • Partner with analytics and media teams to connect performance data with creative decisions.
  • Establish learning loops that improve briefs, formats, creative rules, posting rhythm, and content investment.
  • Push the studio away from passive reporting and toward active optimization.
  1. AI and WPP.open Enablement
  • Use AI and WPP.open to improve strategy quality, speed, and scale.
  • Help design AI-enabled workflows for insight mining, persona development, content territory building, platform adaptation, reporting, and post-campaign learning.
  • Partner with the Chief Content Architect to codify useful agentic workflows.
  • Set clear human review points so AI supports judgment but does not replace it.
  • Help strategy teams build better prompts, better frameworks, and better decision systems.
  1. Client and Stakeholder Leadership
  • Join senior client conversations as the social strategy lead.
  • Present social POVs clearly and confidently to clients, regional teams, and internal leadership.
  • Help clients navigate platform changes without hype or panic.
  • Translate complex social behavior into simple business-facing recommendations.
  • Support new business and organic growth by showing how WPP Content Studio can lead modern social thinking.
  1. Team Leadership and Standards
  • The Social Strategy Lead works closely with strategy and planning talent across WPP Content Studio Japan to elevate strategic quality and collaboration.
  • This includes close collaboration with social strategists, content planners, social analysts, and related strategic roles across client teams.
  • The role is responsible for setting the standard of strategic thinking across the studio, ensuring that every planner and strategist works from a shared understanding of social behavior, platform roles, audience insight, creator ecosystems, and performance learning.
  • The Social Strategy Lead is accountable for developing the strategy team’s capability, reviewing strategic outputs, mentoring talent, and ensuring planners and strategists are proactive, culturally sharp, data-aware, and able to guide both clients and creative teams with confidence.
  • Create clear ways of working between strategy, creative, media, analytics, account, and production teams.
  • Build a culture of curiosity, speed, accountability, and practical excellence.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a community manager.
  • Not a content calendar operator.
  • Not just a trend hunter.
  • Not a reporting-only role.
  • Not responsible for running the business alone.
  • Not the person who fixes every executional issue.

This person sets the social direction and ensures the studio acts intelligently.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +5 tears of strong senior experience in social, digital or content strategy, or platform-led brand strategy.
  • Proven ability to lead strategy across multiple brands or business units.
  • Deep understanding of Japan social behavior and major platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, creator ecosystems, paid/organic dynamics, and emerging formats.
  • Hands-on experience with social listening, performance reporting, audience insight, and cultural analysis.
  • Ability to connect data, culture, platform behavior, brand goals, and creative ideas.
  • Confident client-facing presence with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or mentoring strategy, planning, intelligence, or content teams.
  • Comfortable using AI tools, prompt systems, WPP.open, and automation to strengthen strategy work.
  • Strong deck, storytelling, presentation, and simplification skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Clear, calm, and decisive.
  • Culturally curious and platform-native.
  • Strategic but practical.
  • Strong enough to challenge weak thinking.
  • Collaborative without being passive.
  • Comfortable leading through influence.
  • Able to simplify complexity for clients and teams.
  • Obsessed with making the work sharper, not just faster.

Language Skills

  • Japanese: Business fluent or native-level preferred.
  • English: Business fluent.
  • Must be comfortable presenting and writing across both Japanese and English working environments.

We’re looking for a VP, Development, Prototyping & Innovation to lead the technical capability that turns ideas, research and emerging technologies into validated prototypes, reusable technical assets and scalable solutions across Open Intelligence Solutions (OIS).

This is a newly defined leadership role sitting at the intersection of R&D, product, engineering and emerging technology. You’ll help determine which ideas are worth pursuing, prove their technical and commercial viability, and establish the engineering foundations needed to take successful concepts towards production.

You’ll be the bridge between research and delivery — ensuring that innovation moves quickly without compromising on technical quality, security, governance, architecture or scalability.

A significant part of the role will involve emerging AI technologies, including AI applications, agentic systems, AI orchestration and MCP tooling, alongside cloud-native development, MLOps and platform integration.

What you’ll do

Lead development, prototyping and innovation

  • Own the development and prototyping capability for Open Intelligence Solutions.
  • Turn strategic concepts, client opportunities, research outputs and emerging technologies into demonstrable prototypes and reusable technical assets.

  • Establish frameworks for prioritising, building and evaluating experiments, proofs of concept and technical spikes.
  • Create clear governance around the transition from prototype → pilot → production.
  • Ensure prototypes demonstrate genuine business value before being positioned as scalable solutions.

Shape engineering standards and architecture

  • Define engineering standards, reference architectures, code governance and reusable development patterns across OIS.
  • Raise standards around quality, maintainability, security and consistency across prototypes and technical accelerators.
  • Lead the architecture of solutions integrating with WPP Open, data platforms, APIs and enterprise technology environments.

Drive AI and technical innovation

  • Provide technical leadership for AI application development and agentic systems.
  • Establish practical implementation patterns for AI orchestration frameworks and MCP tooling.
  • Help teams experiment rapidly with AI-enabled capabilities while maintaining appropriate standards around architecture, security, data governance and operational readiness.
  • Develop reusable approaches to MLOps, deployment automation and cloud-native development.

Build and lead technical capability

About the role

We’re looking for a VP, Statistical Measurement to lead statistical methodology, measurement standards and quantitative quality across our Open Intelligence Solutions (OIS) portfolio.

This is a senior leadership role within Strategic Data Science, focused on ensuring that the analytical work we produce is rigorous, credible and commercially meaningful.

You’ll be the organisation’s authority on statistical methodology and numerical quality, helping teams turn complex data into robust evidence that clients and senior stakeholders can trust. You’ll shape the evolution of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution, incrementality, causal inference and experimental design, while establishing consistent standards for validation, statistical quality assurance and communicating uncertainty.

You’ll also play an important role in preparing the organisation for an increasingly AI-assisted analytical environment, ensuring that both people and AI-enabled workflows apply statistical methods responsibly and communicate findings accurately.

What you’ll do

Own statistical methodology and measurement standards

  • Own statistical methodology and measurement standards across the OIS portfolio.
  • Ensure analytical approaches are technically rigorous, fit for purpose and consistently applied.
  • Establish standards for statistical hygiene, validation, uncertainty and quantitative quality assurance.
  • Ensure analytical claims are supported by robust experimental, causal and econometric evidence.
  • Act as the organisation’s authority on numerical quality, measurement credibility and analytical validity.
  • Challenge weak assumptions, over-claims and methodological risks before outputs reach senior stakeholders or clients.

Shape the future of measurement

  • Lead the evolution of MMM and econometric measurement capabilities, ensuring approaches are robust, interpretable and aligned to commercial decision-making.
  • Develop frameworks and practical guidance for attribution, causal inference, experimental design and incrementality.
  • Create validation frameworks and QA mechanisms that increase confidence in measurement outputs.
  • Establish best practices around model diagnostics, sensitivity testing and evidence thresholds.
  • Partner directly with clients and senior stakeholders to ensure measurement outputs are credible, understandable and commercially actionable.

Build statistical capability across the organisation

  • Develop tools, frameworks and approaches that improve statistical storytelling, insight communication and data visualisation.
  • Lead and develop Senior Measurement Scientists and Statistical Specialists across areas including econometrics, MMM, experimental design, incrementality, attribution, causal inference, statistical QA and validation.
  • Build statistical education and capability programmes that raise the standard of analytical thinking across the organisation.
  • Help develop responsible AI-assisted analytical workflows, ensuring statistical methods are applied appropriately and outputs are communicated clearly.
  • Work closely with OIS R&D, Product, Enterprise Technology, Data Platform, DTS Product & Engineering, WPP Open, domain leads and applied AI teams.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for an experienced statistical or measurement leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and the ability to influence at senior level.

You’ll bring:

  • Significant experience leading statistical, measurement, econometric or data-science capabilities.
  • Deep expertise in areas such as MMM, econometrics, attribution, causal inference, incrementality and experimental design.
  • A strong understanding of statistical methodology, model validation and quantitative quality assurance.
  • Experience establishing measurement standards, frameworks or best practices across complex organisations.
  • The ability to assess analytical approaches critically and identify methodological risks, weak assumptions and unsupported conclusions.
  • Experience translating sophisticated statistical concepts into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience, with the ability to build trust in complex measurement outputs.
  • Experience leading and developing senior statistical, measurement or data-science specialists.
  • An interest in the application of AI to analytical workflows, with a clear understanding of the importance of statistical rigour and responsible use.
  • Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to tell a compelling story from complex statistical evidence.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role Title: VP/ SVP - Client Partner
Team: Marketing & Business Development
Location: Tokyo, Japan

About WPP Media

WPP Media, part of WPP, is a leading media agency driven by performance, data, analytics, and creative technology. We excel in multichannel audience planning and strategic media expertise. Our clients include Google, Dell, Uber, Airbnb, Mazda and Hitachi. Our mission: to make advertising more valuable.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced, strategic, and operationally excellent Client Partner to lead our relationship with Google in Japan, a top-tier client across WPP Media. WPP Media manages the digital mandate for Google in Japan.

This role sits at the intersection of senior client partnership, planning craft, execution excellence, and operational leadership. You will lead a cross-functional team and be accountable for flawless delivery, clear governance, strong strategic POVs, and executive-level influence—ensuring Google and MFG stakeholders have full visibility, confidence, and industry-leading work.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Strategic Advisor (Senior Stakeholders)

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior Google stakeholders (CMMs / PA Leads and their -1s), providing insights and recommendations that directly map to Google’s business priorities.
  • Translate business goals and market realities into media priorities, opportunities, and clear actions.
  • Challenge the status quo constructively: improve briefs, strategy, plans, and operations with better, actionable alternatives.

Strategic Planning & Industry-Leading Thinking

  • Lead strategic planning across initiatives, ensuring every campaign solves a defined business problem and is designed with measurable outcomes.
  • Deliver “outside-in” POVs: bring best practices, competitive intelligence, and emerging platform/consumer trends into actionable recommendations and next steps.
  • Drive test-and-learn frameworks and ensure learnings are documented and scaled.
  • Incorporate AI and automation to elevate output quality, speed, and decision-making where appropriate.

Operational Excellence: “Run the House Like a Machine”

  • Own day-to-day operational leadership with a no-surprises standard: smooth operations, disciplined execution, and proactive issue management.
  • Establish and maintain governance mechanisms (e.g., operating cadence, RACI, QA gates, escalation paths, decision logs) to ensure clarity and accountability.
  • Maintain full visibility across all initiatives (what’s working, what’s at risk, what’s next), surfacing risks early with mitigation options and decision asks.
  • Prioritize and triage workload to ensure focus on the highest-impact work and avoid wasted effort, rework, and last-minute fire drills.

Execution Quality & QA (Zero Dropped Balls)

  • Ensure flawless execution through rigorous QA processes, clear ownership, and adherence to Google’s quality standards.
  • Drive continuous process improvement without being asked—simplify complexity, increase consistency, and improve speed and precision.

Financial, Scope, and Resource Management

  • Manage client budgets effectively while ensuring profitability, ROI, and strong stewardship.
  • Lead quarterly resourcing discussions with MFG Regional, feeding into fee/FTE allocations and ensuring the right talent is deployed to the right priorities.
  • Own scope control and change management: align deliverables to priorities, secure decisions early, and reduce rework through strong briefing and QA.

Connector Across Google, MFG, and WPP

  • Navigate seamlessly across Google local, regional, and global stakeholders, and across the wider WPP network.
  • Bring the best of regional/global practices into Japan at consistent quality; export Japan successes as repeatable playbooks where applicable.
  • Activate the full WPP ecosystem (not just media) when needed to solve broader business challenges (e.g., data/measurement, creative technology, commerce, analytics).

Executive Influence & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive readouts with clear narratives: performance, implications, trade-offs, decisions required, and next steps.

job.title: WPP Media | Head of Influencer Solutions
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Overview

WPP Media Japan is revolutionizing the advertising industry through the power of data and artificial intelligence. At WPP Media, our vision for the Influencer Solutions team (GOAT) is to become the leading data-driven influencer consultancy.

Purpose of Role

The Head of Influencer Solutions is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic direction, commercial success, and operational excellence of the agency's influencer marketing practice in Japan. This role combines strategic thought leadership with senior client stewardship, leading a multi-disciplinary team across account management, strategy, and campaign delivery to drive significant growth and establish the agency as the leading influencer solutions partner in the market. The Head of Influencer Solutions is accountable for financial ownership, team development, and defining the future of influencer marketing for our clients and the agency.

Key Responsibilities

The below are the key responsibilities for this role:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Define and execute the long-term strategic vision for the influencer solutions practice in Japan, setting clear objectives for growth, innovation, and market positioning.
  • Lead all strategic thinking for the agency's top-tier influencer clients and most critical new business pitches, acting as the senior strategic voice and trusted advisor.
  • Translate complex client business problems into clear, powerful strategic platforms that solve real business challenges through influencer marketing.
  • Champion innovative approaches to influencer marketing, pushing the agency and its clients beyond conventional thinking to leverage emerging platforms, creator trends, and cultural movements.
  • Act as a thought leader both internally and externally, representing the agency at industry events, contributing to market discourse, and elevating the agency's reputation.

Client Leadership & Growth

  • Act as the senior strategic lead and trusted advisor across a portfolio of the agency's most important influencer marketing clients.
  • Build and nurture strong, influential relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers, positioning yourself as an indispensable strategic partner.
  • Lead long-term strategic account planning, including annual planning sessions and quarterly business reviews, ensuring the agency's services are deeply aligned with clients' core business objectives.
  • Work closely with other WPP agencies on strategic planning and allocation across accounts, driving integrated solutions and maximizing value across the WPP network.
  • Lead all major commercial negotiations, including contract renewals, new service proposals, and multi-year partnership agreements.

Commercial Ownership & P&L Management

  • Take full ownership of the P&L for the influencer solutions practice, including revenue targets, forecasting, profitability, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and execute ambitious growth strategies to drive significant year-on-year revenue growth across existing clients and new business.
  • Identify and convert opportunities for deep strategic partnerships, multi-service integration, and expansion into new verticals and client categories.
  • Oversee pricing strategies, margin management, and commercial negotiations to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.
  • Lead new business development efforts, directing the team in winning major pitches and expanding the agency's client portfolio.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary team across account management, strategy, and campaign delivery functions, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, innovation, and collaboration.
  • Set clear performance expectations and manage the career development and growth of all team members, ensuring high levels of motivation, retention, and effectiveness.
  • Build and scale the team in line with business growth, recruiting top talent and ensuring the right capabilities are in place to meet client and market demands.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex client challenges, commercial issues, and executional risks, providing expert guidance and decisive leadership.
  • Create a high-performance culture that attracts and retains the best talent in the influencer marketing industry.

Operational Excellence & Innovation

  • Oversee the end-to-end quality of all deliverables across the influencer solutions practice, from strategic planning to campaign execution and reporting.
  • Define and implement best practices, processes, and workflows that drive efficiency, quality, and profitability across all client work.
  • Drive innovation in methodologies, tools, and technologies, ensuring the agency remains at the forefront of the evolving influencer marketing landscape.
  • Ensure the team consistently delivers insightful, data-driven results that demonstrate clear ROI and business impact for clients.
  • Stay at the forefront of platform changes, cultural trends, regulatory developments, and market dynamics in Japan and globally.

Cross-Functional & Network Collaboration

  • Partner with senior leadership across all agency functions and WPP network agencies to ensure seamless integration and delivery of best-in-class solutions.
  • Represent the influencer solutions practice at the highest level in key client meetings, new business pitches, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key platform partners (Meta, Google, TikTok, LINE, etc.), talent agencies, and industry bodies in Japan.
  • Collaborate with regional and global influencer leads across the WPP network to share best practices and drive innovation.

Performance Requirements

  • Achieving and exceeding annual revenue growth and profitability targets for the influencer solutions practice.
  • Maintaining high client satisfaction, retention, and expansion across the portfolio of key accounts.
  • Successful leadership, development, and retention of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team.
  • A high win-rate on new business pitches and demonstrable growth in the agency's market share.
  • Consistent delivery of high-quality, innovative, and effective strategic work that drives measurable business results for clients.
  • Strong reputation and visibility as a thought leader in the Japanese influencer marketing industry.

Skills and Competencies

  • Proven, extensive experience in a senior leadership role within influencer marketing, social media, or digital marketing, ideally within an agency environment in Japan or APAC.
  • A strong track record of building, leading, and scaling successful teams across multiple functions (account management, strategy, campaign delivery).
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and commercial acumen, with demonstrated success in driving significant revenue growth and managing P&L.
  • Outstanding leadership and mentoring capabilities, with the ability to inspire and develop diverse teams.
  • Deep expertise in influencer marketing across all major platforms, with a strong understanding of the Japanese social media landscape, creator economy, and cultural nuances.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain trusted C-suite level relationships with major clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Expert-level communication and presentation skills in both Japanese and English, with the ability to command a room and articulate complex strategies with clarity.
  • Strong collaborative skills and experience working across matrix organizations and agency networks (WPP experience highly valued).
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and growth.


About WPP Media:

At WPP Media, we are Open, Optimistic, and Extraordinary. 

  • Open. We cultivate trust by taking ownership and accountability, and we empathetically and intelligently balance people and client experience in everything we do. 
  • Optimistic. We mobilize the enterprise, driving our vision forward, and we champion growth and career development so we can all thrive. 
  • Extraordinary. We harness our shared capabilities to inspire transformational creativity, and lead collectively to deliver a seamless client and colleague experience.

WPP Media is WPP’s media investment group and the world’s leading media investment company with a mission to shape the next era of media where advertising works better for people. The company is responsible for more than $60 billion in annual media investment, as measured by the independent research bureau COMvergence. Through its global agencies Mindshare, Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom, and mSix&Partners, and cross-channel performance (MMD), data (Choreograph) and investment solutions, WPP Media leverages a unique combination of global scale, expertise, and innovation to generate sustained value for clients wherever they do business.

The Media Planning Director (PA Lead) leads a team, pod, or market and is responsible for the planning, execution, and optimization of a portfolio of media campaigns. This role ensures budgets are deployed effectively against campaign objectives, leveraging the full range of available inventory through tactical planning and ongoing, cross-channel optimization.

The Director has end-to-end ownership of the tactical media plan and its execution, translating the brand’s overall media strategy into action while adapting to evolving market conditions and opportunities. As the senior lead, the Director sets the standard for account management by maintaining a clear focus on client objectives and best practices.

  • Oversee all deliverables produced by the pod or market, either directly or through delegation, ensuring work meets briefs, quality standards, and client expectations prior to delivery
  • Take direct responsibility for the performance of assigned media budgets, ensuring investments deliver against intended brand and direct response outcomes

  • Drive continuous improvement of processes and workflows to increase efficiency, elevate work quality, and improve both client and team satisfaction
  • Develop strategic relationships with key agency partners and act as a senior point of escalation for complex or sensitive issues

  • Line-manage and coach media planning team members, providing clear direction, timely and actionable feedback, and support for career growth and development

 

A bit about yourself:

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience, with 5–7 years in digital media or advertising
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across all platforms, with the ability to engage clients and internal stakeholders effectively
  • Deep knowledge of digital marketing and media, with hands-on experience planning, executing, and optimizing brand and direct response campaigns
  • Ability to forecast campaign outcomes, manage media spend, and evaluate performance against objectives
  • Experience using media research and measurement tools such as Comscore, GWI, TGI, and YouGov
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with strong attention to detail, QA rigor, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines
  • Proven problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and develop practical, data-informed solutions
  • Strong client relationship management skills and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment
  • Demonstrated leadership capability, with the ability to motivate, guide, and support team members in a positive and constructive manner
  • Strong business acumen, quantitative reasoning, and strategic thinking skills
  • Native-level Japanese (ideally with media/advertising terminology) and business-level English proficiency - TOEIC 800 or above

job.title: WPP Production | AI Production Solutions Architect, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

About the Role

WPP Production is looking for a hands-on Production Solutions Architect to transform how content is produced for clients in Japan.

Rather than simply delivering 100 content assets, this role designs and implements the workflow through which those 100 assets - and the next 1,000 - can be produced efficiently, consistently and responsibly.

You will work with clients to understand their production challenges, design AI-enabled workflows, configure agents and automation tools, run pilots and help transition successful solutions into live production.

You will primarily use WPP Open, Open Production and other approved WPP capabilities, supplemented by approved third-party tools where appropriate.

This is an autonomous individual-contributor role embedded in Japan and working closely with Global Solutions Design, APAC Expansion Studios, the Agentic Centre of Excellence and WPP Open.

Key Responsibilities

Client Discovery and Solution Design

  • Lead client workshops to understand business objectives, content requirements and current production processes.
  • Map existing workflows and identify opportunities for AI, automation and process improvement.
  • Translate client challenges into practical use cases, solution designs, business cases and implementation roadmaps.
  • Design workflows connecting people, platforms, AI agents and automation tools.
  • Define agent responsibilities, inputs, outputs, hand-offs, human review points and quality controls.
  • Support client pitches, proposals, scopes of work and commercial estimates.

Agent and Workflow Implementation

  • Configure approved AI agents and production workflows within WPP Open and other approved environments.
  • Develop prompts, system instructions, knowledge sources, structured inputs and output formats.
  • Build and test rapid prototypes using natural-language, no-code and low-code tools.
  • Evaluate outputs for quality, accuracy, brand compliance and production usability.
  • Configure existing global solutions for Japanese client requirements before proposing new development.
  • Define requirements and collaborate with the Agentic CoE, Creative Technologists or AI Engineers when more complex development is required.

Pilot Delivery and Operationalization

  • Plan and deliver client pilots and proofs of concept.
  • Define test cases, success criteria and expected operational benefits.
  • Measure improvements in production time, cost, throughput and quality.
  • Turn successful pilots into repeatable production workflows.
  • Create operating manuals, playbooks, role definitions and quality-control processes.
  • Train client and internal teams to operate the implemented solution.

Global Collaboration and Governance

  • Act as the Japan-market extension of WPP Production's global solutions and AI capabilities.
  • Use existing global agents, workflows and playbooks wherever possible to avoid duplication.
  • Follow global intake and governance processes for new agents, automation solutions and third-party tools.
  • Share successful Japan solutions and learning with regional and global teams.
  • Partner with WPP Open on platform requirements and WPP Enterprise Solutions on complex MarTech integrations.
Experience and Skills
  • Five or more years of relevant experience in content production, creative technology, MarTech, workflow automation, solutions consulting or a related field.
  • Practical experience using generative AI, automation, no-code or low-code tools.
  • Ability to configure prompts, AI agents and multi-step workflows.
  • Good understanding of content-production processes across digital, social, video, adaptation, localization or scaled content.
  • Experience gathering client requirements and turning them into practical solutions.
  • Ability to build and test prototypes, not only provide strategic recommendations.
  • Strong client communication, workshop facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Commercial awareness and the ability to contribute to proposals, estimates and business cases.
  • Ability to work independently and move projects forward with limited supervision.
  • Professional fluency in Japanese and English.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with regional and global teams.

Experience with WPP Open, Adobe GenStudio, Firefly, Workfront, AEM, DAM platforms or similar technologies would be an advantage.

Measures of Success
  • Client-funded revenue and billable utilization.
  • Solutions progressing from discovery to pilot and live operation.
  • Adoption of WPP Open and approved production workflows.
  • Measurable improvements in production speed, cost, quality and scalability.
  • Reuse of global solutions and contribution of Japan learning back to the global network.
  • Client satisfaction and compliance with WPP governance requirements.
The Person We Are Looking For

You are comfortable leading a client discussion, translating the challenge into a production workflow, configuring the relevant agents and tools, and testing the solution with real users.

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you are technically curious, commercially minded and motivated to build. You know when to configure a solution yourself and when to involve specialist engineering or global teams.

Most importantly, you are interested in delivering a repeatable way to produce content - not simply delivering the next asset.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

主な役割

プリントプロジェクトマネージャーは、弊社が担当する大手FMCG(日用消費財)クライアントのプロモーション・キャンペーンの企画や制作(主に店頭MD)に関するプロデュースやプロジェクトマネジメントをメイン業務とします。制作にあたっては正確で迅速そして高品質な作業が求められますが、タイトなスケジュールの中で要求される様々なプレッシャーに負けない精神力も同時に求められます。

 

責任範囲

  1. クライアントからのブリーフを正確に理解し、社内外のステークホルダーとともに制作物を企画・提案・進行する
  2. クライアントとの関係構築や円滑なコミュニケーション、チームでのリーダーシップ 
  3. 担当制作チームへのディレクションなど含め全体プロデュース 
  4. プロジェクトの予算・スケジュール管理

 

求められる能力と経験

  1. 広告代理店、広告制作会社で営業・プロジェクトマネジャーとして制作進行管理の経験5年以上
  2. 制作企画、印刷、撮影、カラーレタッチの制作に関する十分な知識
  3. 優れたチームプレーヤーであり、プレッシャーのもとで正確に作業でき、トレーニングを通したスキルアップにも積極的であること
  4. グラフィック制作とチェックプロセスへの順守と改善提案ができること
  5. 創造的で柔軟性があり、業務への情熱と前向きな姿勢を持ち続けられること
  6. タイトな納期に対応できる作業スピードを持ち、要求の厳しいクリエイティブおよびプロダクション環境で働く能力があること
  7. 優れたコミュニケーション能力と対人スキル
  8. 日本語のネイティブスピーカーであること

歓迎される能力と経験

  1. Adobe InDesign、Illustrator、Photoshopなどデザインソフトの実務経験
  2. 英語力 (基本的な会話やドキュメンテーションの解読力)

WPP Productionについて

私たちWPP Productionは、WPPグループ内のあらゆるコンテンツプロデューサー、スタジオ、そして制作（クラフト）の専門家を結集し、ひとつの繋がった組織として統合されたグローバル・プロダクション・カンパニーです。

世界最高峰の人間によるクラフトマンシップ（熟練した制作技術）と次世代テクノロジーを融合させ、大規模なマルチチャネル・コンテンツシステムを企画・デザインし、世界へと届けています。

国境のないボーダレスなコラボレーションを前提に構築され、深い制作技術の専門性に裏打ちされた私たちは、常時稼働（Always-on）かつAI主導で動く現代のマーケティング世界のために設計された「プロダクション・エンジン（制作の中核）」です。　なお、WPP ProductionはWPPグループの一員です。

job.title: WPP Production | Transcreation Account Manager, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

The Role:

The Transcreation Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for project managing localisation work for the clients Marketing Communications (Marcom) team. The TAM works closely with the clients Marcom Project Manager and a network of creative talents from various markets. This person needs to engage with other cross-functional teams of producers and project managers to ensure work is delivered on time, on quality and within budget. Constant need to communicate and negotiate priorities and deadlines with internal and external teams to ensure expectations are well managed is required. Primary tasks include organising and coordinating schedules, distributing workload, tracking progress of projects and allocated budget.

 

You will be responsible for project managing localization projects (incl. Transcreation of headlines) ensuring good communication with all stakeholders.

 

You will focus on building strong relationship with the Client Talent Network and briefing new projects accurately. Strong organization and time management skills when managing Clients, with focus on quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Validator Network Management

  • Ensure a thorough understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements, SOW and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
  • Manage a network of creative people and ensure they are motivated to perform
  • Coordinate weekly status meetings/monthly review sessions
  • Organize teamwork, create a balanced work schedule and ensure work is of high standards and delivered on time
  • Flag any potential team issues to the line manager and be actively involved in finding a solution
  • Review talent performance and drive constant performance improvement by working closely with talent manager and providing regular feedback on all talent
  • Highlight and resolve quality control issues with the network

 

Project & Account Management

  • Coordinate and ensure all parties follow the agreed workflows and manage them through the process
  • Work alongside and support client’s Traffic Manager when briefing and tracking projects through to completion
  • Ensure that there is clear division and allocation of workload among team members
  • Ensure that trackers are updated at all times
  • Monitor timelines and manage client expectations
  • Monitor budget utilization and flag potential issues
  • Monitor internal workflows and identify areas for improvement
  • Advise line manager on resource gaps and flag potential issues
  • Plan resources for large overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
  • Work closely with talent manager in delivering recruitment briefs on time
  • Ensure account delivers consistently against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
  • Identify bottle necks/pain points for the validation network, suggest resolution and advise
  • Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
  • Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters
  • Lead overseas projects for up to 3 weeks (2 – 3 times per year)

 

Finance Management

  • Quarterly planning
  • Regular budget spend reports – monitor and analyse progression of spends
  • Flag important budget fluctuations, peaks to the Client and line manager and track spend progress
  • Monthly financial reconciliation
  • Ensure full compliance with all financial procedures and policies

 

Client Management

  • Co-ordinate between all relevant parties: Hogarth team, Client traffic and cross-functional teams and Validation network
  • Set and manage client expectations for deliverables and timeframes
  • Understand and work under the confidentiality policy
  • Build strong, trusting relationships with all key client stakeholders

 

Requirements:

  • A minimum of 4 years Project Management/Traffic background in an ad agency or in-house creative department
  • Experience managing multi-market projects
  • Experience working on global brands, ideally across all media, including print, interactive and film
  • Demonstrable experience managing total creative workflow, i.e, internal briefing, briefing to vendors/studios, managing key milestones/deadlines, presentations/internal approvals, executions, delivery
  • Proven project management skills
  • Self-driven, organized and have an eye for detail
  • Proficient with technology and tools
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in high-pressure situations and tight time frames
  • A hands-on, can do approach to solving problems
  • Fluent written and spoken English and Japanese
  • Must be able to travel as required, sometimes several weeks at a time

ポジション概要

**Transcreation Account Manager（TAM）**は、クライアントのマーケティングコミュニケーション（Marcom）チームにおける、ローカライゼーション案件のプロジェクトマネジメントを担当するポジションです。

クライアント側のMarcom Project Managerや、各市場のクリエイティブ人材ネットワークと密接に連携しながらプロジェクトを進行します。また、プロデューサーやプロジェクトマネージャーなどの部門横断チームとも協働し、納期・品質・予算を管理しながら、プロジェクトを円滑に進行することが求められます。

社内外の関係者と継続的にコミュニケーションを取り、優先順位や納期を調整・交渉しながら、関係者の期待値を適切にマネジメントすることも重要な役割です。

主な業務には、スケジュールの策定・調整、業務の割り振り、プロジェクトの進捗管理、予算管理などが含まれます。

また、ヘッドラインのトランスクリエーションを含むローカライゼーションプロジェクト全体を管理し、すべてのステークホルダーとの円滑なコミュニケーションを図ります。

Client Talent Networkとの良好な関係構築や、新規プロジェクトにおける正確なブリーフィングも担当します。品質を重視しながら複数の案件やクライアントを管理するため、高い組織力とタイムマネジメント能力が求められます。

主な業務内容

Validator Network Management

バリデーターネットワークの管理

  • 担当アカウントにおける契約上の義務、商務条件、SOW（業務範囲記述書）、SLA（サービスレベル合意書）を十分に理解し、必要に応じてチーム全体にも共有・浸透させる
  • クリエイティブ人材のネットワークを管理し、パフォーマンスを発揮できる環境を整える
  • 週次のステータスミーティングおよび月次レビューを調整・運営する
  • チームの業務を整理し、適切なワークロードを設定するとともに、高い品質を維持しながら期限内に業務が完了するよう管理する
  • チーム内で発生する可能性のある問題を上長に共有し、解決策の検討・実行に積極的に関与する
  • Talent Managerと密接に連携し、各メンバーへの定期的なフィードバックを通じて継続的なパフォーマンス向上を支援する
  • ネットワーク内で発生する品質管理上の課題を特定し、解決する

Project & Account Management

プロジェクト・アカウント管理

  • 関係者間の調整を行い、合意されたワークフローに沿ってプロジェクトが進行するよう管理する
  • クライアント側のTraffic Managerと連携し、プロジェクトのブリーフィングから進捗管理、完了までをサポートする
  • チームメンバー間の役割・業務分担を明確にする
  • 各種プロジェクトトラッカーを常に最新の状態に保つ
  • スケジュールを管理し、クライアントの期待値を適切にコントロールする
  • 予算の使用状況をモニタリングし、問題が発生する可能性がある場合は早期に共有する
  • 社内ワークフローを確認し、改善できる領域を特定する
  • リソース不足や潜在的な問題について上長に報告・提案する
  • 大規模な海外プロジェクトのリソース計画を行い、新たな採用が必要となる場合はTalent Managerおよび上長へ共有する
  • Talent Managerと連携し、必要な採用要件・ブリーフを適切なタイミングで提供する
  • SLAやKPIを含む、契約上求められるサービス水準を継続的に達成できるよう管理する
  • Validation Networkにおけるボトルネックや課題を特定し、改善策を提案する
  • チームメンバーがプロセスやワークフローを適切に遵守できるよう、必要なトレーニングを特定する
  • 新入社員のオンボーディングについて計画・準備・実施する
  • 年2～3回程度、最長3週間の海外プロジェクトをリードする

Finance Management

予算・財務管理

  • 四半期ごとの計画策定
  • 定期的な予算使用状況レポートの作成、および支出状況のモニタリング・分析
  • 大きな予算変動や支出の増加が発生した場合、クライアントおよび上長へ共有し、その後の支出状況を管理する
  • 月次の財務照合作業
  • すべての財務関連プロセスおよびポリシーを遵守する

Client Management

クライアントマネジメント

  • Hogarthチーム、クライアント側Trafficチーム、部門横断チーム、Validation Networkなど、すべての関係者間の調整を行う
  • 成果物および納期についてクライアントの期待値を設定・管理する
  • 機密保持に関するポリシーを理解し、それに沿って業務を遂行する
  • クライアント側の主要なステークホルダーと、強固で信頼性の高い関係を構築する

応募要件

  • 広告代理店または事業会社のインハウスクリエイティブ部門における、4年以上のプロジェクトマネジメントまたはトラフィックマネジメント経験
  • 複数の国・市場にまたがるプロジェクトを管理した経験
  • グローバルブランドに携わった経験。印刷物、デジタル／インタラクティブ、映像など、複数のメディアに関する経験があれば尚可
  • クリエイティブ制作の一連のワークフローを管理した実務経験
    （社内ブリーフィング、ベンダー／スタジオへのブリーフィング、マイルストーン・納期管理、プレゼンテーション、社内承認、制作・実行、納品など）
  • 優れたプロジェクトマネジメント能力
  • 自発的に行動でき、高い組織力と細部への注意力を持っている方
  • テクノロジーや各種ツールの活用に抵抗がない方
  • プレッシャーの高い状況や短い納期の中でも、周囲と協力しながら効果的に業務を進められる方
  • 課題に対して自ら手を動かし、前向きに解決に取り組める方
  • 英語および日本語で、ビジネス上必要な読み書き・会話が流暢にできること
  • 必要に応じて出張が可能であること。場合によっては数週間の出張となることがあります

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

Purpose of the role 

The Senior Analyst, Purchase to Pay (PTP), is part of a team responsible for performing day to day tasks within the Purchase to Pay (PTP) function covering Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense and Payment, as well as Month End Closing process and some other specific accounting activities related to the stream. The Senior Analyst will be required to handle activities for any of the subfunctions within the PTP function as assigned by the PTP manager.

Key responsibilities include accurate and timely recording and payment of vendor invoices, statutory payments, employees claim and intercompany transactions in accordance to the defined SLAs/KPIs while adhering to Company policies and procedures as well as relevant legal and statutory requirements.

The Senior Analyst will work with management to drive the implementation of global process initiatives to streamline and/or automate the PTP process which includes system enhancement and process improvement. 

What you'll be doing:

Job Description 

Accounts Payable (AP) & Invoice Processing:

Receive and scan vendor invoice/vendor billing files and supporting documents  Check all invoices for proper documentation, attach the invoice to the AP System and submit for payment accordingly. Ensure invoices are processed in line with WPP Policies, SOX requirements, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). Process invoices, credit memos and debit memos in a timely and accurate manner according to SLA / KPI set by management and agreed with WPP Operating Companies (OpCo) Ensures that all invoices assigned are properly accounted for at the end of each business day. Respond to vendor inquiries. Follow up with vendor and respective OpCo to resolve all discrepancies in a timely manner Verifies vendor accounts by reconciling monthly statements and related transactions. Perform reconciliations of vendor statements, research and address discrepancies as appropriate. Review reconciliation and supporting documentation for purchases made by Company Settled Credit Card and revert to OpCo on queries Properly book and upload all intercompany transactions Work with PTP Leaders on Account Analysis to clear Aged AP and Net Debit Balance (NDB)

Payments Processing:

Generate proposed payment selection file or be the reviewer of proposed payment selection file in accordance with agreed timetable.  Submit the payment selection file to the OpCo in line with the agreed timetable or be generater of payment confirmation file in accordance with agreed timetable, base on proposed payment selection approved. Review, request amendments where applicable, and submit to approvers to authorise payment aligned to the agreed timetablet or be the reviewer the amendments and regenerate payment confirmation. Transact payment to bank in accordance with the country/OpCo banking functionality Responsible for the following tasks related to payments: Act as main contact with bank regarding payments queries. Process Time and Expense (T&E) related payment. Process and post cheque and wire remittance deposits to the appropriate bank account and invoices, ensuring reconciliation of the batch. Ensures payment is made to vendors in accordance to Company Policy and SOX Guidelines Work with Master Data Team to set up new vendors in the system or updating existing vendor details. Ensure correct e-mail contact details of payment beneficiary are recorded in master data Generate remittance advice Work with Record to Report (RTR) on all payment transactions on bank reconciliations, resolve reconciling items and escalate to the OpCo any unreconciled/aged items for resolution/confirmation of treatment

Travel and Expense (T&E) Processing:

Perform review checks of claim submitted: valid receipts, valid tax, valid approval in line with the OpCo policy (where there is no systemic workflow) and that the claim information matches the supporting receipts Where required, amend the tax codes in accordance with the local tax legislation based on approval from Manager Process claim for payment or reject the claim (providing reasons for rejection) Submit payment file aligned to the timetable agreed with the OpCo

Other Responsibilities:

Generate aging reports, identify critical issues and drive resolution independently Accountable and responsible for the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of scope assigned in accordance to the SLAs/KPIs defined with management and agreed with OpCo Handle high complexity issues with minimal guidance from Team Lead / Manager. Perform account reconciliations and journal entries at month end close. Issue reports on a monthly basis and assist Manager to drive achievement of KPI and SOX requirements on periodic report and review. Drive month end close activities and help Manager to coach junior team members. Process back up reports for data storage/archiving. Proactively identify, propose and implement continuous improvement opportunities in existing processes within the team.  Lead Continuous Projects, workshops and trainings for the PTP team and across the SSC as PTP subject matter expert Comply to internal and external regulations and procedures, that should be in line with the company policies, standard operating procedures, and/or Target Operating Model (TOM) Guide new and existing team members through proper knowledge transfer; sharing of resource, knowledge and experience and best practice thereby ensuring quality is maintained through any staff transition.

 

What you'll need:

Qualifications

Degree in Finance & Accounting or related field with relevant mix of qualification and experience 3-5 years of relevant experience in shared service environment. Basic knowledge of fundamental accounting concepts, practices, and procedures Having shared service centre experience is preferred Knowledge of SOX Compliance norms relating to the process Experience in using ERP system is an added advantage

Skills and Competencies

Able to speak, read and write in Thai Language Fluent written and spoken English Strong interpersonal skills Teamwork - Able to communicate and work within a team environment Proactive – Time management and Organization skills Project Management and Analytical skills Attention to Details - Ability to maintain high level of accuracy in preparing and entering information to the AP System and Banking Portals Time management and Organization skills  Ability to handle high volume task and able to adapt complex work environment Able to communicate and work within a team environment Excel skills mandatory Familiar with Office 365 Willing to travel overseas if required

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

Senior Analyst will be responsible for period end close activities, ensures accuracy and timeliness in processing all general ledger entries, fixed assets transaction, bank transactions, financial and management reporting, accounts reconciliation, statutory audit and tax computation while adhering to WPP group policies and company procedures. He/She is responsible to regularly track and resolve outstanding issues and escalate to relevant parties as necessary.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness in processing general ledger entries, fixed assets transaction, banking transaction, financial and management reporting, accounts reconciliation, statutory audit and tax computation (both direct and 
indirect) in accordance WPP policies and procedures, local accounting standard and requirements and SLAs.

• Regularly track and resolve outstanding issues being identified and escalate to relevant parties as necessary.
• Liaise with internal/external stakeholders as and when necessary
• Ensure service level agreements (SLA) and monthly performance and productivity KPIs are met
• Ensure the ownership for all applicable internal controls related to RTR processes. 
• Proactively identify, propose and implement continuous process improvement opportunities in existing processes within the team
• Participate in continuous process improvement projects and plans
• Involvement in ad hoc activities or project. 
• Perform review work on analyst
• Perform knowledge transfer with new joiner
• Works independently within guidelines and policies, and receives minimal guidance.
• Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience and provides functional guidance.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE :

• Bachelor Degree in Accounting or related field, and/or professional accounting qualification (ACCA/CPA/MIA etc.)
• Able to speak, read and write in Thai Language

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Risk Sales is a dynamic, global organization focused on helping businesses make smarter decisions through trusted news, data, insights, and information solutions. Our teams partner with organizations across industries to understand their unique challenges and connect them with the Dow Jones products and services that drive growth, manage risk, and support informed decision-making.

 

About the Role

Our Risk Sales team is seeking an Account Manager to work customers and prospects across our Risk and Compliance, Factiva, and Newswires solution lines.


You Will:

  • ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT: Provide a high level of account management service, by building excellent customer relationships, understanding our customers' businesses, and resolving issues in a timely manner; understand competitor solutions the customer is using and the customer's current and developing needs  
  • NEW BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY: Generate new streams of revenue through sales of products and services which address prospects business needs 
  • CUSTOMER GROWTH:  Identify opportunities for increasing revenue within the account territory via up-selling and cross-selling
  • CUSTOMER SATISFACTION: Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through regular communication with all customers, and build solid working relationships with each customer 
  • SUCCESSFUL RENEWALS:  Develop and execute on plans to manage strategic account renewals,
  • ROLLOUT AND ADOPTION:  Ensure appropriate levels of customer training and awareness are provided by closely partnering with the Customer Engagement team 
  • PRODUCT & MARKET KNOWLEDGE:  Clearly express the value proposition and benefits of the Dow Jones products and solutions to specific sectors and markets, and use this knowledge to help increase the value and adoption of our solutions by our customers
  • FORECASTING:  Manage Sales Forecast and Pipeline to ensure clear reporting of forthcoming renewals, additional sales opportunities, plus the associated revenue and timescales 

You Have:

  • 4+ years sales experience and a proven track record of success in selling solutions to corporate or financial customers
  • The ability to work well in cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams, as well as being highly self motivated and able work independently when required
  • Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) to ensure the Dow Jones value position is clearly articulated to our prospects and customers
  • Strong results orientation, with the commitment and drive to achieve new business goals in a complex business environment
  • Strong level of business acumen and awareness to help build credibility with the customer, spot potential opportunities within a peer group or industry sector, and express the benefits of Dow Jones in an appropriate business context
  • Strong time management skills, with an ability to manage tasks in a fast paced environment, and track progress against appropriate activity goals 
  • Experience working with, or within, Risk & Compliance functions would be an advantage
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

Our Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Retirement Plans
  • Comprehensive Insurance Plans
  • Lifestyle Programs & Wellness Resources
  • Education Benefits
  • Family Care Benefits & Caregiving Support
  • Commuter Transit PrograM
  • Subscription Discounts
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Financial Health Programs
  • Cybersecurity Protection

job.title: AI Process Engineer - SOX Audit & Compliance
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.



About the Role:

As AI Process Engineer - SOX Audit & Compliance, you will help modernize how IT Compliance operates. You will own end-to-end execution across the IT SOX program and adjacent certifications (ISO, PCI, SOC 2), while helping build the next generation of compliance operating practices, moving from manual, email-based evidence collection toward AI-assisted workflows, automated controls testing, and consolidated cross-certification evidence. You will operate with high autonomy across a global, cross-functional program, running the day-to-day of one or more compliance workstreams while contributing directly to controls automation, evidence-request modernization, and the consolidation of certification cycles. You will report to the Director, IT SOX Compliance.



You Will:

  • Support execution across compliance workstreams, assisting with policy rollouts, training programs, and audit/certification cycles across IT SOX, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and SOC 2
  • Track compliance timelines and operational tasks, helping manage deadlines, evidence-request workflows, and status reporting to keep global audits on schedule
  • Coordinate with internal and external partners—including Legal, Risk, Finance, operational technology teams, internal/external auditors, and offshore testing partners—to facilitate evidence collection
  • Identify straightforward compliance issues, surfacing findings with context to leadership and assisting in tracking remediation efforts 
  • Promote compliance awareness across Technology squads, helping translate framework requirements into routine tasks that engineers and operators can execute
  • Support controls automation initiatives, working with leadership to identify repetitive testing workflows that can be modernized through automated and AI-assisted tools



You Have:

  • 2 to 4 years’ experience in IT compliance, audit, controls testing, or a related discipline within technology or enterprise environments
  • Foundational knowledge and practical experience supporting an audit cycle end-to-end under IT SOX, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or SOC 2 frameworks
  • Proven cross-functional coordination, comfortable partnering with Legal, Risk, Finance, Internal Audit, external auditors, and offshore testing teams simultaneously
  • Able to translate compliance framework language into operator-friendly tasks, and technical findings into executive-ready summaries
  • Ability to take a high-level objective and return a structured plan and shipped outcomes without extensive oversight
  • Hands-on comfort with automation, analytics, and modern productivity tools
  • Working understanding of how AI, automation, and intelligent workflows can reduce manual effort in compliance operations
  • Bias toward simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement
  • An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field of study -OR- equivalent experience
  • Audit/compliance certifications (CISA, CRISC, CISSP, ISO Lead Auditor) welcomed, but not required

job.title: Associate Analyst MENA
job.description:
Job Description:

About the Role:

An intelligence analyst working on Dragonfly's MENA desk. This is a full-time, permanent position, based in Dubai. The analyst is contracted to work 40 hours a week, though additional work may be occasionally required depending on specific projects or international travel. The analyst will report to the MENA desk lead. The MENA is responsible for Dragonfly's coverage which provides anticipatory security and strategic intelligence for global businesses and international organisations. As with all our roles our hybrid working policy applies. 


 

You Will:

  • Your primary responsibility as MENA Analyst is to conduct desk-based open source research, production of political, security and geopolitical risk assessments, human source cultivation and development in the relevant markets.
  • You will prepare and deliver reports, presentations and briefings providing briefings to clients and other audiences.
  • You will provide responsive customer service and develop positive working relationships with clients and prospects as well as advocate for the Dragonfly brand
  • You will develop and maintain our resources, including human intelligence sources, subcontractors, data feeds and open source networks. 
  • You may also have responsibility for mentoring and/or managing other analysts or researchers. 

You Have:

  • 3-5 years of experience in working in security analysis, political risk research or crisis risk management 
  • Sound analytical knowledge about political and security developments in the MENA region
  • Experience in providing responsive customer service and maintaining positive working relationships with clients and prospects
  • You are honest and curious, able to make analytical judgements based on evidence and reason, without concerns about being proven wrong

job.title: Associate Director - Consulting (Dow Jones Energy)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Associate Director - Consulting in Dow Jones Energy’s global bespoke consulting practice, you will develop, quote, lead and conduct bespoke research consulting projects covering multiple business lines including energy, feedstocks, olefins, plastics, aromatics, inorganics, syngas, and other materials. This is an opportunity for a highly experienced consulting professional who possesses in-depth knowledge of the chemical, petrochemical, refining and energy industries across various regions. You will have ownership of project execution, client relationships, and mentorship of the consulting team. You will report to the Executive Director - Consulting. 



You Will:
  • Own projects executed from Houston and ensure their timely delivery
  • Actively manage the consultancy project team, including team members assigned to projects from other regions, and ensure smooth execution of projects
  • Utilize internal and external subject matter experts for in-depth analysis
  • Support consulting directors and senior management in project implementation
  • Manage, guide and mentor the analysts and consulting team through successful completion of project tasks
  • Interface with clients and present study findings
  • Participate in business development activities and assist in proposal writing for the consulting business
  • Participate in resource planning, performance appraisal and recruiting processes
  • Contribute to team discussions on various consulting projects as a knowledgeable stakeholder

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

job.title: B2B Sales Director, Reputation Intelligence
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Opportunity 

Help communications and corporate affairs leaders understand emerging reputation risks—and build the customer base for a new Dow Jones intelligence platform.

 

Dow Jones Reputation Radar combines Storyful’s social and narrative intelligence with Factiva’s licensed news content. It helps organizations understand which narratives are gaining traction, who is influencing them and where reputational pressure may build next, so leaders can make better-informed decisions.

 

As we prepare for general availability, we are seeking an experienced enterprise seller to generate new business and help establish a focused, repeatable sales approach. You will combine the opportunity to build an emerging business with the credibility, customer relationships and market reach of Dow Jones.

 

About the Role

Working in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week, you'll be a senior, quota-carrying sales person with direct responsibility for creating pipeline, developing opportunities and winning enterprise customers.

 

Your initial focus will be communications and corporate affairs teams in financial services, with the potential to expand into other priority sectors as we establish successful use cases.

 

You will own opportunities from prospecting and discovery through demonstration, negotiation and close. Success requires understanding how customers make decisions, identifying a meaningful business need and building a compelling case for investment—including where Reputation Radar complements an existing set of tools.

 

You will work with Dow Jones account teams and colleagues across Product, Marketing and Intelligence. Your customer conversations will also help refine our targeting, messaging, sales materials and product priorities.

 

This role suits someone who enjoys personally winning business and using what they learn to improve how a new product is brought to market.

 

You Will

  • Create and convert new-business pipeline. Personally prospect into priority accounts, develop qualified opportunities and deliver against an agreed revenue target.
  • Build focused account plans. Select and prioritize accounts using customer needs, business triggers, revenue potential and likelihood to convert. Establish clear actions and next steps.
  • Lead consultative discovery. Understand how customers identify reputation risks, brief leadership and make decisions, and where their current approach falls short.
  • Build a credible value case. Connect Reputation Radar’s capabilities to the customer’s priorities and demonstrate why the investment matters.
  • Navigate enterprise buying groups. Build relationships with senior Communications, Corporate Affairs and related stakeholders, while engaging users, budget holders, Procurement and other decision makers.
  • Own the full sales cycle. Coordinate demonstrations and specialist input, develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms and progress opportunities through contracting and close.
  • Work with the wider Dow Jones sales organization. Partner with account teams to identify relevant opportunities within existing customer relationships and help them recognize where Reputation Radar can add value.
  • Turn Marketing activity into commercial action. Collaborate on targeted campaigns, events and content, and take ownership of account follow-up and conversion.
  • Bring customer insight back into the business. Share patterns in buyer needs, objections, competitive alternatives and purchasing decisions to strengthen positioning, sales enablement and product development.
  • Maintain commercial discipline. Keep accurate Salesforce records, qualify opportunities consistently and provide reliable forecasts.
  • Represent Dow Jones and Storyful in customer meetings, industry events and executive discussions.

 

You Have

  • 12+ years of professional sales experience
  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding enterprise B2B sales targets, including personally creating and closing new business
  • Experience selling information services, data, intelligence, strategic advisory or enterprise SaaS solutions
  • Experience engaging senior Communications, Corporate Affairs, Marketing, Public Affairs, Risk or executive stakeholders, or a clear ability to translate relevant adjacent experience to these buyers
  • The ability to sell through discovery, business value and customer outcomes, supported by clear examples of navigating complex buying decisions
  • A structured approach to account selection, prospecting, qualification and pipeline development
  • Strong listening, presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and adapt your approach to different stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating with account managers, marketing teams and product or subject-matter specialists while retaining ownership of sales progress
  • The judgment and initiative to operate effectively as a product and its commercial approach evolve
  • Willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office at least 3 days a week

 

Particularly Useful

  • Knowledge of the communications, reputation, public affairs, media intelligence or risk intelligence ecosystem
  • Success introducing a new product, entering a new market or building demand where a buying category is still developing
  • Experience selling to financial services organizations
  • Existing relationships with senior communications and corporate affairs leaders
  • Experience working across multinational enterprise accounts

 

About Storyful

Storyful is a social and narrative intelligence company within Dow Jones. Combining proprietary technology with expert analysis and verification, Storyful helps organizations understand how information and narratives spread, influence stakeholders and shape reputation.

 

Dow Jones Reputation Radar brings together Storyful and Factiva capabilities to support communications and corporate affairs leaders with timely, decision-ready reputation intelligence.
