job.title: Vice President - Head of Consulting (Dow Jones Energy)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Vice President - Head of Consulting, you will lead Dow Jones Energy’s bespoke solutions business across both public and private sector markets — owning its strategy, proposition, commercial performance, and external profile. In this role, you will combine commercial leadership with operational rigor and a strong external presence, scaling a professional services practice that translates the analytical depth of Dow Jones Energy data and insights into high-impact engagements for corporate, government, and multilateral clients. You will report to the Senior Vice President - Head of Research, Consulting & Community.



You Will:
  • Design and execute the growth strategy for the Energy Consulting business, setting clear commercial, brand, and delivery targets
  • Ensure the consulting team meets or exceeds business development and growth targets
  • Drive the evolution and scaling of the consulting practice — its operating model, talent and delivery capabilities
  • Own the business with a relentless focus on customer value, output quality, business margin, expert utilization, and delivery efficiency across every engagement
  • Design, champion, and continuously evolve the Energy Consulting value proposition, articulating differentiated offerings that capitalize on Dow Jones Energy’s expertise across energy, chemicals and resources, as well as the broader Dow Jones capability suite
  • Serve as a senior external face of the business — representing Dow Jones Energy on stage, on air, and in print to shape how clients and the broader market understand global energy and chemical market dynamics
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Research and Community leadership within Dow Jones Energy to translate our analytical depth into commercially successful consulting engagements
  • Support business development and consulting operations with travel to all regions up to 40% of time 



You Have:
  • 20+ years’ experience in the energy, chemical, or commodity consulting space
  • A track record of leading an advisory business of $20M+ in revenue with full P&L accountability and proven topline and margin growth
  • Experience presenting at industry conferences on panels and to groups of c-suite decision makers

job.title: VP, Creative
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Brand and Experiences group plays an integral role in positioning the company for advancement and growth. We are responsible for the outward expression and inward embodiment of our Brand.  We develop the core capabilities, tools, and assets required to extend the Brand and empower GTM functions across the business by activating the Brand through campaigns, events, sponsorships, and tradeshows.  We do this by partnering with other areas of marketing, product, and sales groups to create high-impact opportunities to grow subscribers, sponsors, and accelerate the growth agenda.


The organization consists of a number of key, senior-level COE roles in areas such as Brand and Experiential Marketing, as well as senior capability leads. Together, this team will collaborate to build a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand to create awareness and drive preference.

About the Role:

Dow Jones is hiring a VP, Creative to join our Brand leadership team in New York City. This role will be the Global Head of Creative, and act as a guardian of brand and advertising across all Dow Jones and WSJ brands. Reporting to the Head of Brand and Experiences, you will lead our in-house creative team, consisting of design, copywriting, video and developing talent. In this role, you will also collaborate with our lead creative agency on specific campaigns helping to ensure brand consistency. 


You Will:

  • Accelerate the team’s path to creating ideas, platforms, and concepts that meet our biggest Brand objectives.
  • Evolve the creative function, centering our work internally and externally, on media-agnostic ideas, capable of being activated across a wide array of paid, owned, and earned media channels.
  • Build, lead, and review work of the creative team in the production of all creative assets including advertising, video, print, performance media, and sales collateral
  • Serve as a leader for Creative talent within Marketing and across the Dow Jones community, serving as an inspiration and problem solver for others.
  • Build and manage a talented multi-disciplinary team composed of all functions (visual design, copy, video), enabling every aspect of creative development and delivery in-house.
  • Strengthen the Corporate AI agenda, by developing capabilities and tools leveraging AI to multiply the scale and impact of the Creative team

You Have:

  • Industry Expertise
  • Client-side or Senior Agency leadership experience
  • Fluency in award-winning brand creativity 
  • Experience and success in managing premium, large scale, complex brands is required
  • Financial services, Retail, or Journalism category experience preferred but not required
  • Combination of B2B and B2C expertise preferred but not required

Functional Expertise:

  • 15+ years in marketing, strategy, or planning roles
  • Experience working in marketing strategy, branding, and research and insights
  • Knowledge of brand purpose and aligning values and purpose with commercial objectives
  • Experience working with matrixed global brands and multi-division organizations with separate target audiences for each business unit
  • Experience marketing and messaging to multiple target groups including B2B and B2C
  • Understanding of subscription marketing and how to operate within a matrixed marketing organization
  • Customer-centric mentality and understanding of user experience

Personal Disposition:

  • Persuasive storyteller and original thinker
  • Highly adaptable and fluid, able to quickly learn about new businesses and customer segments
  • Executive presence to inspire confidence with internal and external constituents
  • Entrepreneurial and an inventive problem solver
  • Ability to balance creative and conceptual thinking
  • Ability to distill essential insights from research and create clear, actionable briefs
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale productions, complex projects, and large teams with a broad range of skills, experiences, and tools
  • Proactive, team player with strong interpersonal skills and positive energy
  • Entrepreneurial and an inventive problem solver; curious and passionate about all areas of marketing, media, content, and design
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a dynamic fast-paced environment that requires exceptional attention to detail
  • Have a propensity towards making things, vs. managing others, able to get projects and initiatives past the finish line with a high degree of quality.

job.title: VP, Video Sales & Strategy
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Media Sales connects leading brands with influential audiences through our trusted portfolio, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch and Investor’s Business Daily. Our teams across Sales, Marketing, Creative and Client Success work together to deliver innovative advertising solutions and exceptional client experiences across digital, print, video, audio, events and custom content

 

About the Role

Dow Jones is seeking a commercially minded VP, Video Sales & Strategy to drive the growth and commercialization of its digital video advertising business. This role combines strategic thinking with commercial execution to refine go-to-market strategy, develop key relationships, and expand revenue opportunities.

 

The VP will directly report to an SVP of Advertising Sales in the Chief Revenue Officer’s organization and will work closely with the new video team under the Chief Growth Officer.

 

This is a senior role for a leader who understands both how digital video inventory is bought and sold across today’s increasingly complex media ecosystem. The ideal candidate brings deep experience working with advertisers, media agencies, publishers and platforms and understands how video investment decisions are made across premium publishers, streaming environments, social platforms, programmatic channels and other digital distribution platforms.


This individual should have deep knowledge of FAST, AVOD/SVOD, YouTube, as well as Advanced Television buying/planning/selling, and Programmatic Buying and Selling (DSP, SSP).

 

As Dow Jones plans significant investment into serialized shows, the VP will play a central role in shaping and executing the commercial strategy for Dow Jones’s existing and future digital video inventory, including how inventory is positioned, packaged, priced and brought to market. This person will work closely with sales leadership, product, programming, audience, advertising operations and finance teams to maximize the value of Dow Jones video inventory and create compelling, scalable solutions for advertisers and agencies.

 

A primary focus of the role will be leveraging strong relationships with the digital and video buying centers within major holding companies: diversifying revenue pipeline and integrating Dow Jones video solutions within proprietary buying models, technologies, and upfront/scatter ecosystems. Additionally, the VP will work alongside existing sales teams and client-direct relationships bringing deep video expertise to help grow existing relationships with video-specific revenue pipeline. 


You Will:

Video Sales Strategy & Commercial Development

  • Develop and execute the commercial and go-to-market strategy for digital video advertising.
  • Define positioning, packaging, and pricing strategy for video inventory to maximize value across platforms.
  • Identify growth opportunities across direct, agency, programmatic, and new demand channels.
  • Partner with internal teams (product, programming, operations, finance) to create and commercialize scalable video solutions leveraging Dow Jones brands.
  • Monitor marketplace dynamics, competitive offerings and advertiser demand to inform video sales strategy and commercial positioning.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing video revenue and develop new sources of Demand.
  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on the evolving digital video marketplace and the changing ways video is bought and sold.

Agency & Marketplace Development

  • Leverage existing and build relationships with key stakeholders within the digital and video buying centers at major media agencies and agency holding companies. 
  • Lead strategic conversations and business development efforts with senior agency and client stakeholders.
  • Represent the brand at industry events including Newfronts, Upfronts, Possible, Cannes.
  • Work directly with agency leaders and buyers to understand evolving marketplace needs and translate those insights into commercial opportunities.
  • Leverage and develop relationships across the broader digital video ecosystem, including advertisers, agencies, platforms and other key industry stakeholders. 

 

Sales Leadership & Team Development

  • Help build and lead a focused video sales capability targeting agency and client video buying centers.
  • Manage and develop a dedicated team as the organization and business opportunity evolve.
  • Coach sellers on navigating complex agency organizations and developing relationships with relevant planning, investment and buying stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the broader Dow Jones sales organization to align coverage and maximize opportunities.

 

You Have:

  • 15+ years of experience in digital media, advertising sales, video advertising, or agency investment.
  • Significant experience buying, selling and/or commercializing digital video advertising inventory.
  • Strong understanding of how digital video is bought, sold, packaged, priced and measured across multiple platforms and distribution environments.
  • Experience working with premium publishers, digital video platforms, streaming businesses, media agencies or other major participants in the video advertising ecosystem.
  • Deep relationships with senior stakeholders at major media agencies and agency holding companies.
  • Strong experience leading and developing sales teams.
  • Excellent client relationship, negotiation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

  • Work with production team on original narrative content, from conceptualization to final delivery

  • Work with graphics, audio and post-production departments to help bring productions to life.
  • Other duties as required

 

 

Qualifications:

 

  • WWE product knowledge preferred but not mandatory
  • At least four years of production experience
  • Ability to tell long ad short stories through editing. Experience using Avid, Adobe After Effects, and PhotoShop a plus
  • Ability to perform assigned content requests in a fast paced, deadline heavy environment
  • Experience with camera operation a plus
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Capable of working both independently and as a member of a team
  • Some travel required for field shoots
  • Ability to conceptualize ideas in a creative, non-traditional way
  • Capable of handling various responsibilities and multiple projects simultaneously

job.title: Logistics Clerk
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This is 3-Month Assignment onsite in Stamford, CT WWE Headquarters.


The primary role of a Logistics (Mailroom) Clerk is to process and distribute incoming mail to employees in our corporate setting. They sort mail and log incoming mail as required. Mailroom clerks deliver messages and packages from one department or individual to another within an office, maintain shipping and mailing supplies, such as envelopes, tape, and stamps, and keep an inventory of these supplies. In addition, the mailroom clerk will handle all outgoing packages; they package items, ensure proper labeling, and arrange pickup from the post office, UPS, FedEx, or other carriers.

 

Mailroom Clerk Duties and Responsibilities

Mailroom clerk must perform various tasks to fulfill all the demands of this occupation:

 

Sort and Distribute Mail

One responsibility of a mailroom clerk is to sort incoming and interoffice mail and distribute to employees and departments. Mailroom clerk could use any of the following: computer or automated system to sort mail and track its delivery.

 

Manage Inventory of Shipping Supplies

Mailroom clerk is responsible for maintaining an adequate supply of shipping materials, such as boxes, tape, and labels. Manage the inventory of these items and re-order materials as needed to keep the required number of supplies on hand.

 

Handle Outgoing Packages

Mailroom clerk is not only responsible for incoming mail but outgoing packages as well. They pick up outgoing mail from departments and prepare packages for shipment. Mailroom clerks typically choose the best methods for shipment, box, and label packages, and plan with carriers for pick up times to meet shipping deadline needs.

 

Mailroom Clerk Skills

It is important for the mailroom clerk to demonstrate strong communication, organizational, and customer service skills to succeed in this profession. Mailroom clerks should be detail-oriented multitaskers who are able to stand and carry packages for long periods of time. Time management skills and the ability to work independently are essential for this position. In addition, the ability to prioritize when it comes to the delivery and shipping of parcels is critical for those in this role. Besides these skills, it is important for the mailroom clerk to possess the following abilities:

  • Sort mail by department and individual employees
  • Distribute incoming and interoffice mail in a timely manner
  • Prepare outgoing shipments
  • Arrange package pickups with appropriate carriers
  • Manage inventory of shipping and mail supplies
  • Lift 50lbs – 75lbs “Team Lift” packages
  • Potential full-time employee requires a valid driver’s license
  • Be proficient in with SSO Applications as well as Microsoft Word, Outlook, Slack, and Excel to create necessary documents and communicate with employees.
  • Knowledge of Shipping Software and procedures with some familiarity of international shipping.
  • Operate and check basic office equipment – from copiers to fax machines, mailroom clerks often employ the use of various office machines to complete necessary tasks
  • Operation of electric pallet jacks

job.description: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO - Zimmer Communications Jobs Jobs | Login Location: Columbia, MO, USA Pay Rate: Pay Type: Employment Type: Part Time Email Me This Job Part - Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle - Wake Up Missouri 93.9 The Eagle is looking for a dynamic Co-Host to join our top-rated morning News/Talk show, Wake Up Missouri . This is an opportunity to co-host a fast-paced, three-hour morning show heard across Missouri. ARE YOU THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR? Do you have an opinion about almost anything at the drop of a hat? Do you love sharing observations about your life, your experiences and the events everyone is talking about? Are you a storyteller who can turn an everyday experience into entertaining radio? When breaking news happens, we change direction and go with it. You need to be prepared, curious, conversational and nimble enough to contribute wherever the show goes. Our target audience is clearly defined, and the show is built to give its personalities the opportunity to connect with listeners and succeed. WHAT YOU'LL GET You'll join a terrific on-air team in a supportive, creative environment. You'll also receive top-notch coaching and ongoing feedback designed to help you develop your personality, sharpen your skills and win in this role.
